Rilipi cu muihnak nih a khuh i ti cungah cun Pathian ṭhawnnak cu aa chawk."},"3":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih, “Ceunak um seh,” tiah a ti i ceunak cu a hung um.","ref":"2Kor 4.6"},"4":{"text":"Ceunak cu a zoh i aa lawm. Cun ceunak le muihnak cu a ṭhen hna i"},"5":{"text":"ceunak cu “Chun” tiah min a sak i muihnak cu “Zan” tiah a ti. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um — cucu ni khatnak ni cu a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Ti le ti a ṭhentu hna ding caah aa kuaimi van pakhat in um seh law, ti cu hmun hnih ah um hna seh,” tiah a ti i cu tining cun a hung si.","ref":"2Pet 3.5"},"7":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih cun van kuai cu a ser i a tang i a ummi ti le a cung i a ummi ti cu a ṭhen hna;"},"8":{"text":"van kuai cu a min ah “Van” a sak. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni hnihnak ni cu a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Van tang i a ummi ti cu hmun khat ah i pum hna seh law vawlei kha hung lang seh,” tiah nawl a pek i cu bang cun a hung si."},"10":{"text":"Vawlei cu a min ah “Vawlei” a sak i a pumhtermi ti cu “Rili” tiah a ti. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Vawlei cungah hin thingram a phunphun kho hna seh, a tlaimi kung hna le rawl a phunphun thei a phunphun a vuimi rawlkung hna,” tiah a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah cun vawlei cungah cun thingram a phunphun an kho, rawl a vuimi rawlkung hna le thei a tlaimi thingkung hna an si. Pathian nih a tuahmi cu a zoh i a lung a si."},"13":{"text":"Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni thumnak ni cu a si."},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Chun le zan a ṭhentu ding le ni le kum le caan kha zeitik in dah an i thawk cio ti hngalhtertu dingah van ah khin ceunak um hna seh;"},"15":{"text":"cun cu ceunak hna nih cun vawlei hi ceuh hna seh,” tiah a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih cun ceunak ngan pipi pahnih hi a ser hna, ni hi chun uktu dingah a ser i thlapa hi zan uktu dingah a ser; arfi zong khi a ser hna;"},"17":{"text":"ceunak hna cu van ah khin vawlei a run ceuhtu dingah a chiah hna,"},"18":{"text":"chun le zan a uktu hna ding le ceunak le muihnak a ṭhentu hna dingah a chiah hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"19":{"text":"Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni linak ni kha a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun aa thawh i, “Ti nih hin thilnung phun tampi a hrin hna lai i va hi thli lakah hin an zuang lai,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si.”"},"21":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih cun rili chung i a ummi sahrang ṭihnung pipi le ti lak i a tlongmi thilnung a phunphun le va a phunphun kha a ser hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"22":{"text":"Cun thluachuah a pek hna i, “Ti chung i a ummi thilnung hi karh u law rili hi khat u, va hi tampi in karh u,” tiah a ti hna."},"23":{"text":"Zanlei cu a dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni nganak ni a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Vawlei nih hin inn zuat saṭil a phunphun le ramlak saram a phunphun, a hme he a ngan he, hring hna seh,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun inn zuat saṭil a phunphun le ramlak saram a phunphun a hme he a ngan he a ser hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"26":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Atu cu minung kan ser cang hna lai; kanmah mui an keng lai i kanmah he kan i lo lai. Nga si hna seh, va si hna seh, inn zuat saṭil si hna seh, ramlak i a ummi saram a hme he a ngan he si hna seh, an uk dih hna lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Kor 11.7"},"27":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih minung cu amah mui lo in a ser, minung cu Pathian mui in a ser hna. Mipa le minu kha a ser hna.","ref":"Mat 19.4; Mar 10.6"},"28":{"text":"Thluachuahnak a pek hna i, “Tefa tampi in ngei u law nan tefa cu vawlei cung khuazakip ah khat hna seh, cun annih nih vawlei cu uk hna seh. Nannih cu nga cung le va cung le ramlak saram a hme he a ngan he an dihlak cung i nawlngeihnak kan pek hna,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 5.1-2"},"29":{"text":"Nan ei awk caah thlai phun kip le thei phun kip kan pek hna;"},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ramsa vialte hna le va vialte hna le vawlei ah a lawn in a lawnmi vialte nunnak thaw a ngeimi vialte hna caah ram hring le thlaihnah borbor ka pek hna,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"31":{"text":"Pathian nih a sermi thil vialte cu a zoh i a lung a si ngaingai. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni ruknak ni cu a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun vawlei le van le vawlei le vancung i a ummi thil vialte cu ser an si."},"2":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah Pathian nih a tuahmi thil vialte cu a lim hna i cu ni ah cun rian ṭuan loin a um.","ref":"Exo 20.11"},"3":{"text":"Ni sarih ni cu thluachuah a pek i a dang tein a chiah, zeicahtiah cu ni cu a thil ser a lim i rianṭuan loin a um ni kha a si."},"4":{"text":"Vawlei le van i a ummi thil vialte ser an sining cu cuticun a si. Bawipa Pathian nih vawlei le van i a ummi thil vialte hna cu a ser hna tikah,"},"5":{"text":"vawlei cungah hin ramkung zeihmanh a um lo i thlaici zeihmanh a kho lo, zeicahtiah vawlei cungah khan ruah a surter rih lo i vawlei cung i rian a ṭuantu ahohmanh an um rih lo."},"6":{"text":"Asinain ti cu vawlei chungin a put i vawlei kha a hnawnter."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih vawlei khan tlak tlawmpal a lak i mipa ah a ser; nunnak petu thaw kha a hnar chungah a chuahhnawh i mipa cu a hung nung.","ref":"1Kor 15.45"},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih nichuahlei ah Eden dum pakhat a ser i cuka ah cun a sermi mipa kha a chiah.","title":"Eden Dum"},"9":{"text":"Vawlei chung cun aa dawhmi thingkung le rawl ca i a ṭhami kung a phunphun kha a khohter hna, dum laifang ah cun nunnak thingkung, chia le ṭha hngalh khawhnak thingkung zong a khohter.","ref":"Biat 2.7; 22.2,14"},"10":{"text":"Eden cun tiva pakhat a luang i cu tiva nih cun dum cu ti a toih. Cu tiva cu tiva pali ah aa ṭhen."},"11":{"text":"Pakhatnak cu a min ah Pishon a si; cu tiva cu Havilah ram a velchum i a luangmi kha a si."},"12":{"text":"Cuka ah cun sui thiang ngaingai phun kha an hmuh i a man a sungmi thingthling le oniks lungvar sen zong an hmuh hna."},"13":{"text":"Tiva pahnihnak a min cu Gihon a si; cu tiva cu Kush ram velchum i a luangmi kha a si."},"14":{"text":"Tiva pathumnak cu Tigris a si, cu tiva cu Assiria ram nichuahlei i a luangmi kha a si. Tiva palinak cu Zufrates tiva kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih mipa cu a lak i Eden dum chungah cun dum cu a thlawh awk le ven awkah a chiah."},"16":{"text":"Mipa cu a thawh i, “Dum chung i a ummi thingkung vialte hi an thei na ei dih ko hna lai,"},"17":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a ṭha le a ṭhalo hngalhnak pe khotu thingkung a tlai hi cu na ei lai lo. Cu thingthei cu na ei hrimhrim lai lo. Na ei ahcun, na ei ni hrimhrim ah na thi lai,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih cun, “Mipa amah lawng i a um hi a ṭha lo, hawile bawmtu ka serpiak lai,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah vawlei khan saram an dihlak le va an dihlak kha a ser hna i mipa sinah cun an min rak sak awkah a ratpi hna. Mipa nih min a rak sakmi hna kha an min ah a cang lan."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun mipa nih cun inn zuat saṭil vialte le va vialte le ramlak saram vialte cu min a sak hna, asinain amah caah cun hawile bawmtu an um lo."},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih mipa cu thu hluahmah in a hngilhter i aa hngilh karah cun a hnakruh pakhat kha a zuh i cu a zuhnak cu titsa in a phih."},"22":{"text":"Mipa hnakruh a zuhmi cun minu pakhat a ser i a sinah cun a ratpi."},"23":{"text":"Cun mipa nih cun aa thawh i, “Atu hi pei keimah phun taktak a simi cu a si hi; Ka ruh i lakmi ruh, ka sa in lakmi sa. A min ah “Nu” si seh, zeicahtiah amah cu mipa chungin lakmi a si,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah cun pei pa nih a nu le a pa a kaltak hna i a nupi he an i fonh i pum khat i an can hi a si cu.","ref":"Mat 19.5; Mar 10.7-8; 1Kor 6.16; Efe 5.31"},"25":{"text":"Mipa le a nupi cu an pahnih in hnipuan an ngei lo, sihmanhsehlaw an ning a zak lo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian nih a sermi saram hna lakah rul hi a zer bik. Rul nih cun minu kha a thawh i, “Dum chung i a ummi thingthei hi a zeihmanh nan ei lai lo tiah Pathian nih an ti taktak hna maw?” tiah a hal.","title":"Sualnak Kong (Rom 5.12-21)","ref":"Biat 12.9; 20.2"},"2":{"text":"Nu nih cun, “Dum laifang i a ummi thingthei khi dah ti lo cu,"},"3":{"text":"dum chung i a ummi thingthei vialte hi azeipaoh kan ei khawh ko hna,” tiah a leh. “Pathian nih khi thing khi cu a tlai nan ei lai lo, a tongh zong nan tawng lai lo, nan tongh ahcun nan thi lai, a kan ti,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Rul nih cun, “Cucu ahmaan lo; nan thi lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Pathian nih cu bantukin a ti cu, kha thingthei nan ei ahcun nan ei cangka in amah bantukin hngalhnak nan ngei ve lai i a ṭha le a ṭhalo kha nan hngal ve lai ti a hngalh caah a si,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Nu nih cun thingkung cu mithlang ngai a si le a thei cu mitthi ngai a si kha a hmuh tikah a fimmi si cu zeitluk in dah a nuamh hnga ti kha a ruat. Cucaah a thei cu a lawh i a ei. Cun a va zong kha tlawmpal a pek ve i a ei ve."},"7":{"text":"An ei dih cangka in hngalhnak kha an vun hmu i taklawng an si kha an i hngal; cucaah theipi hnah kha an i ṭhit i an i hruk."},"8":{"text":"Cu ni zanlei sang ah cun Bawipa Pathian cu dum chung i aa chawh kha an theih i thing lakah khan an i thup."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa Pathian nih cun mipa cu a vun auh i, “Khuazei ah dah na um?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Mipa nih cun, “Dum chung i naa chawh thawng kha ka theih i taklawng ka si caah ka thin a phang, kaa thup,” tiah a leh."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih cun, “Aho nih dah taklawng na si cu an chimh?” tiah a hal. “Ei hlah tiah kan timi thei kha na ei dahra?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Mipa nih cun, “Na ka serpiakmi nu nih khan thei cu ei awkah a ka pek i ka ei,” tiah a leh."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian nih minu cu a thawh i, “Zeicahdah hihi na tuah?” tiah a hal. Minu nih cun, “Rul nih a ka hlen i a ka eiter,” tiah a leh.","ref":"2Kor 11.3; 1Tim 2.14"},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih rul cu a thawh i, “Hi ruangah hin nangmah cu dantat na si; hi chiatsernak hi nangmah lawng nih na in lai. Atu thawk hin na paw in na lawn cang lai i na eimi rawl cu leidip a si lai.","title":"Pathian Nih Dan A Tat Hna"},"15":{"text":"Nangmah le nu cu nan i hua lai, a tefa le na tefa cu ral an si lai. Mi nih na lu kha rial an in zuam lai i nang nih an kedil kha cuk naa zuam ve lai,” a ti.","ref":"Biat 12.17"},"16":{"text":"Cun minu cu a thawh i, “Fa na pawinak i harnak na inmi kha ka karhter lai, fa na hrinnak i fahnak na inmi kha ka karhter lai; asinain na va cu na duh ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai i amah cu na cung bawi a si lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Adam cu a thawh i, “Na nupi bia na ngaih i ei hlah kan timi thei kha na ei caah vawlei hi nangmah ruangah chiatserh a si lai. Na ei khim rawl hmuhnak dingah na nun chung fak piin rian na ṭuan a hau lai."},"18":{"text":"Hlingbur le belh kha an kho tung lai i ramlak thingram kha na ei a hau lai.","ref":"Heb 6.8"},"19":{"text":"Rawl na hmuh khawhnak dingah, vawlei i na kir ṭhan hlan tiang, thlan hripi puak in na cawl a hau lai; Nangmah cu, cu vawlei cun sermi na si. Leidip na si i leidip ah na kir ṭhan lai,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Mipa nih a nupi cu a min ah Evi a sak, zeicahtiah amah cu minung vialte nu a si."},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih Adam le a nupi cu saphaw hnipuan a serpiak hna i a aihter hna."},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa Pathian nih khan aa thawh i, “Atu cu mipa hi a ṭha le a ṭhalo a hngalh ve cang caah kanmah bantuk a si cang. Cucaah cun nunnak thingkung hi a banh sual lai i a thei hi a ei lai i zungzal in a nung sual ko lai,” a ti.","title":"Adam le Evi A Dawi Hna","ref":"Biat 22.14"},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa Pathian nih khan Eden dum chung cun a ṭhawl i amah a sernak vawlei kha thlawh awkah a kalter."},"24":{"text":"Pathian nih mipa cu a chuah i Eden dum nichuahlei kamah khan cherubim vancungmi hna le zei ti lei paoh i aa mer khomi mei vainam kha a chiah hna. Annih nih cun nunnak thingkung kha ahohmanh nih naih kho hna hlah seh tiah an cawngh."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Adam nih a nupi Evi cu a hngalh i fa a pawi. Fapa pakhat a hrin i, “ Bawipa bawmhnak thawngin fapa pakhat ka hmuh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a min ah Kain a sak.","title":"Kain le Abel"},"2":{"text":"Cun hnu deuh ah a nau Abel zong kha a hun hrin. Abel cu tuukhal a si i Kain cu lothlo a si."},"3":{"text":"Kain nih cun a lochung chuak cu Bawipa sinah laksawng ah a rak put hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Abel zong nih khan a saṭil nih an hrin hmasa bikmi hna kha a rak put ve hna i a thah hna i an sa a ṭhatnak bik kha Bawipa sinah cun laksawng ah a pek ve hna. Bawipa cu Abel le a laksawng cungah khan a lung a si,","ref":"Heb 11.4"},"5":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Kain le a laksawng cungah khan cun a lung a si lo. Kain cu a thin a hung i a hmai a chia."},"6":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa nih Kain cu a thawh i, “Zeicahdah na thin a hun i na hmai a chiat?"},"7":{"text":"Ṭhatnak kha rak tuah law cu na merh ko hnga; sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak kha na rak tuah caah sualnak nih cun nangmah tei awkah sahrang bantukin an bawh ko. Nangmah kha uk an duh, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih na tei awk a si,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Kain nih a nau Abel kha a thawh i, “I chawk tuah u sih,” a ti. Lo an va phak tikah khan Kain nih a nau cu a thah.","ref":"Mat 23.35; Luk 11.51; 1John 3.12"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa nih Kain cu, “Na nau Abel tah, khuazei ah dah a um?” tiah a hal. Kain nih cun, “Ka hngal lo. Ka nau cawngtu maw ka si awk a si?” tiah a leh."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih cun, “Zeicahdah hi thil ṭhalo hi na tuah? Ngai hmanh! Nangmah nih na chuahmi na nau thisen nih khan vawlei in a ka auh lengmang ko.","ref":"Heb 12.24"},"11":{"text":"Nangmah cu chiatserh na si cang i hi hmun hin ṭhawl na si lai. Hi hmun vawlei hi na nau thisen na chuahmi dolh awkah a kaa a rak angmi kha a si."},"12":{"text":"Lo na thlawh tikah vawlei nih rawl zeihmanh an chuahpiak lai lo; vawlei cungah inn ngei loin a vak lengmangmi na si lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Kain nih khan Bawipa cu: “Hi dantatnak hi ka caah a fak tuk."},"14":{"text":"Hi ram le nangmah hmaika in na ka ṭhawl i kei cu mivakvai ka si cang lai i a ka hmumi paoh nih an ka thah lai,” tiah a leh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Kain cu, “Cuticun a si lai lo, nangmah an thatmi paoh cu a let sarih in teirul cham a si lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Bawipa nih Kain cungah cun, a hmumi paoh nih that hna hlah seh tiah hmelchunhnak pakhat a chiah."},"16":{"text":"Kain nih cun Bawipa cu a kaltak i Eden nichuahlei i a ummi ram “Vahvaihnak ram” timi ah cun a va um."},"17":{"text":"Kain nih a nupi cu a hngalh i fa a pawi i fapa pakhat a hrin i a min ah Enok a sak. Cun Kain nih cun khua pakhat a ser i cu khua cu a min ah a fapa min chuankhan in Enok a sak.","title":"Kain Tefa"},"18":{"text":"Enok nih fapa pakhat a ngeih i a min cu Irad a si; Irad cu Mehujael pa a si, Mehujael cu Methusael pa a si i Methusael cu Lamek pa a si."},"19":{"text":"Lamek cu nupi pahnih a ngei, pakhat cu Adah a si i a dang pakhat cu Zillah a si."},"20":{"text":"Adah nih cun Jabal a hrin i Jabal cu, caw a khal i thlam chung i khua a sami pawl, a hringsortu hna a si."},"21":{"text":"Jabal nau cu a min ah Jubal a si, amah cu tingtang le thonglawi tum a thiammi hna a hringsortu hna a si."},"22":{"text":"Cun Zillah nih Tubal-Kain a hrin i amah cu thir le dar hreihriam vialte a sertu hna a hringsortu a si. Tubal-Kain far cu Naamah a si."},"23":{"text":"Lamek nih khan a nupile cu a thawh hna i, “Ka nupi Adah le Zillah, ka bia ngai tuah u. Mipa pakhat cu, amah nih a ka tuk caah ka thah, Tlangval pakhat cu, amah nih a ka hliam caah ka thah."},"24":{"text":"Kain a tutu paoh cu a let sarih in phuhlam an si ahcun, Keimah a ka tutu chinchin cu let sawm sarih let sarih in phuhlam an si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Mat 18.22"},"25":{"text":"Cun Adam nih khan a nupi cu a hngalh ṭhan i fapa a hrin. A nupi nih cun, “Kain nih a thahmi Abel airawltu ah khan Pathian nih fapa pakhat a ka pek,” a ti i a min ah Seth a sak.","title":"Seth Tefa Hna"},"26":{"text":"Seth nih cun fapa pakhat a ngeih i a min ah Enosh a sak. Cu caan cun mi nih Bawipa kha a min in biak hram an thawk."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hihi Adam tefa hna min cazin cu a si. (Pathian nih minung a rak ser hna ah khan amah he i lo in a rak ser.","title":"Adam Tefa Hna (1Cha 1.1-4)","ref":"Gen 1.27-28"},"2":{"text":"Nu le pa in a ser hna i thluachuahnak a pek hna i “Minung phun” tiah min a sak hna).","ref":"Mat 19.4; Mar 10.6"},"3":{"text":"Adam cu kum za le sawm thum a si tikah amah bantuk a simi fapa pakhat a ngei i a min ah Seth a sak."},"4":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Adam cu kum za riat a nung rih. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"5":{"text":"kum za kua le sawm thum a si ah a thi."},"6":{"text":"Seth cu kum za le kum nga a si ah fapa pakhat Enosh a ngei i"},"7":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za riat le kum sarih a nung. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"8":{"text":"kum za kua le hleihnih a si ah a thi."},"9":{"text":"Enosh cu kum sawm kua a si ah fapa pakhat Kenan a ngei i"},"10":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za riat le kum hleinga a nung. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"11":{"text":"kum za kua le kum nga a si ah a thi."},"12":{"text":"Kenan cu kum sawm sarih a si ah fapa pakhat Mahalalel a ngei i"},"13":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za riat le sawm li a nung. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"14":{"text":"kum za kua le kum hra a si ah a thi."},"15":{"text":"Mahalalel cu kum sawm ruk le kum nga a si ah fapa pakhat Jared a ngei i"},"16":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za riat le sawm thum a nung. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"17":{"text":"kum za riat sawm kua le panga a si ah a thi."},"18":{"text":"Jared cu kum za sawm ruk le kum hnih a si ah fapa pakhat Enok a ngei i"},"19":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za riat a nung. Fa dang kha a ngeih hna i"},"20":{"text":"kum za kua sawm ruk le pahnih a si ah a thi."},"21":{"text":"Enok cu kum sawm ruk le kum nga a si ah fapa pakhat Methuselah a ngei."},"22":{"text":"Cu hnuah Enok cu Pathian he i kom in kum za thum a nung i fa dang kha a hrin hna;"},"23":{"text":"kum za thum sawm ruk le kum nga tiang a nung."},"24":{"text":"Enok cu a nun chung dihlak Pathian he tlongleng ṭi in a nung i Pathian nih a lak caah a um ti lo.","ref":"Heb 11.5; Jud 14"},"25":{"text":"Methuselah cu kum za sawm riat kum sarih a si ah fapa pakhat Lamek a ngei i"},"26":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za sarih kum sawm riat le kum hnih a nung. Fa dang kha a hrin hna i"},"27":{"text":"kum za kua le kum sawm ruk le kum kua a si ah a thi."},"28":{"text":"Lamek cu kum za sawm riat le pahnih a si ah fapa pakhat a ngei i"},"29":{"text":"“ Bawipa nih chiat a serhmi vawlei i rian har kan ṭuannak hin, hi pa nih dinhnak a kan pek lai,” tiin, a min ah Noah a sak."},"30":{"text":"Cu hnuah Lamek cu kum za nga sawm kua le kum nga a nung. Fa dang a ngeih hna i"},"31":{"text":"kum za sarih sawm sarih le kum sarih a si ah a thi."},"32":{"text":"Noah cu kum za nga a si hnuah fapa pathum Shem, Ham le Jafeth kha a ngeih hna."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu tikah cun vawlei cung khuazakip ah minung tampi an um cang i fanu kha an hrin hna.","title":"Minung Ṭhat Lonak","ref":"Job 1.6; 2.1"},"2":{"text":"Cu fanu hna an i dawh cu pathian fapa hna nih khan an hmuh hna i cucaah an duhmi kha an i thim hna i an ṭhit hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih aa thawh i, “Minung hi zungzal in nun cu ka sianh hna lai lo, zeicahtiah titsa an si. Atu thawk in kum za le kum kul nak tam an nung ti lai lo,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cu caan le cu hnu zongah cun, vawlei cungah hin Nefilim mingan pipi kha an rak um i annih cu minung fanu hna le pathian fapa hna tefa kha an si. Annih cu hlanliomi mi ralṭha le mi minthang kha an si.","ref":"Nam 13.33"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih minung cu khuazakip ah an ṭhat lo tuk hringhran le an lungchung cu ruahnak ṭhalo lawnglawng a khah kha a hmuh tikah,","ref":"Mat 24.37; Luk 17.26; 1Pet 3.20"},"6":{"text":"minung a rak ser hna i vawlei cung i a rak umter hna kha a ngaih a chia. Aa ngaichih i,"},"7":{"text":"“Ka sermi minung vialte hna hi vawleicung in ka hloh dih hna lai. Saram vialte le va vialte he ka hloh dih hna lai, ka rak ser hna hi kaa ngaichih,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Asinain Noah nih cun Bawipa kha a lung a ton."},"9":{"text":"Noah tefa hna cu hihi an si: fapa pathum a ngeih hna, Shem, Ham le Jafeth an si. Noah cu miṭha a si i amah lawnglawng kha cu caan ah cun Pathian lung a tongmi a si; Pathian he i hawikomh in a nungmi a si.","ref":"2Pet 2.5","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw midang vialte cu Pathian mithmuh ah miṭhalo an si dih i an ṭhat lonak cu khuazakip ah a karh."},"12":{"text":"Pathian nih vawlei cu a zoh tikah a ṭha hrimhrim lo ti kha a hmuh, zeicahtiah minung kha an dihlak in sual in an nung."},"13":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Noah cu a thawh i, “Minung hi an dihlak in hrawh awkah ka ruah cang. An dihlak in ka hrawh hna lai, zeicahtiah vawlei hi sualnak an tuahmi in a khat.","title":"Noah Nih Lawng A Ser"},"14":{"text":"Cucaah cun lawng pakhat in i ser, thing ṭha kha hmang hna law a chungah a khaan ser hna, cun lawng cu a chunglei he a lenglei he kahtazasi thuh dih."},"15":{"text":"A tung pe za li le sawm nga, a vang pe sawm sarih le pe nga, a san pe sawm li le pe nga in na sak lai."},"16":{"text":"Lawng cu a cungkhuh na ser lai i a cungkhuh le a vampang karah lehhmah hleiriat na awnter lai. Dot thum in na sak lai i a kam ah innka na ser lai."},"17":{"text":"A nungmi thil vialte hrawhnak ding caah vawlei cungah buanchukcho ka tlunter lai. Vawlei cung i a ummi thil vialte an thi dih lai,"},"18":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw nangmah he cun biakamnak tu ka ser lai. Lawng chungah cun na nupi le na fapa hna le an nupile hna kha na luhpi hna lai i"},"19":{"text":"saram chungin a nu le a pa cio nung tein chiah dingah na luhpi ve hna lai."},"20":{"text":"Nung tein chiah dingah va phun dihlak chungin pahnih cio, saram phun chungin, a hme he a ngan he, pahnih cio, lawng chungah cun luhpi an si lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun nanmah ca le anmah caah rawl phun zakip na lak hna lai i na khon hna lai,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Noah nih khan, Pathian nih a fialmi vialte cu a tuah dih.","ref":"Heb 11.7"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Noah cu a thawh i, “Na innchung khar dihlak he lawng chungah cun lut tuah; nangmah lawnglawng hi atu mi hna lakah hin ka lung a ka tongmi na si.","title":"Buanchukcho"},"2":{"text":"Saram thiang pawl kha cu tuah sarih cio in i luhpi hna (saram thiang timi cu ei khawhmi pawl tinak a si), asinain a thianglo pawl kha cu a nu pakhat le a pa pakhat lawngin i luhpi hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun va zong kha tuah sarih cio in i luhpi hna. Cu ti na tuah cu saram hna le va hna kha, vawlei cungah hin an ci lo hlah seh tinak caah a si lai."},"4":{"text":"Ni sarih chungah vawlei cungah hin ruah ni sawm li le zan sawm li ka surter lai i ka sermi thil nung vialte cu hrawh an si dih lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Noah nih cun Bawipa nih a chimhmi vialte kha a tuah dih hna."},"6":{"text":"Vawlei cung i buanchukcho a tlun ah cun Noah cu kum za ruk a si."},"7":{"text":"Amah le a nupi, a fapale hna le an nupile hna cu buanchukcho in luat awkah lawng chungah cun an lut.","ref":"Mat 24.38-39; Luk 17.27"},"8":{"text":"Cun Pathian nawl pek bangin, saram thiang pawl khan phun khat ah a nu le a pa cio, a thianglo pawl khan phun khat ah a nu le a pa cio ve, va hna chung khan phun khat ah a nu le a pa cio le saram hna pawl chung khan phun khat ah a nu le a pa cio ṭhiamṭhiam Noah sinah cun lawng chungah khan an lut.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Ni sarih hnuah vawlei cungah buanchukcho cu a tlung."},"11":{"text":"Noah kum za ruk a si kum, thla hnihnak thla a ni hleisarih ni ah, vawlei tang i a ummi rilipi a hna vialte kha an i hung i van i awng vialte zong khi an i hung ve i ti cu vawlei cungah an tla,"},"12":{"text":"vawlei cungah ruah cu ni sawm li le zan sawm li a sur."},"13":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun Noah le a nupi, a fapa pathum hna, Shem, Ham le Jafeth le an nupile kha, lawng chungah cun an lut."},"14":{"text":"An sinah cun ramlak saram a phunphun le inn zuat saṭil a phunphun le saram a phunphun le va a phunphun zong kha an lut ve."},"15":{"text":"Thilnung phun kip kha a nu le a pa cio Noah sinah cun,"},"16":{"text":"Pathian nawlpek ning khan, lawng chungah cun an lut. Cun Bawipa nih Noah hnu cun innka cu a khar."},"17":{"text":"Buanchukcho cu ni sawm li chung a um i ti cu a thuh caah lawng cu a cawi khawh.","ref":"2Pet 3.6"},"18":{"text":"Ti cu a thuk deuh lengmang i lawng cu ti cungah cun a vuan."},"19":{"text":"Ti cu a thuk chin lengmang i tlang sang bikbik kha a khuh dih hna i"},"20":{"text":"tlang par a zik cungah khan pe kul le pe nga a kai,"},"21":{"text":"vawlei cung i a ummi thilnung vialte cu an thi dih — va vialte, saṭil vialte, saram hna phun vialte, mi vialte, an thi dih."},"22":{"text":"Vawlei cung i a ummi thilnung vialte an thi dih."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih vawlei cung i a ummi thilnung vialte cu a thah dih hna, cu hna lakah cun minung zong an i tel, saṭil zong an i tel, saram hna phun zong an i tel, va zong an i tel. Hrawh lomi cu Noah le a sin i lawng chung i a ummi lawnglawng kha an si."},"24":{"text":"Vawlei cungah ti cu ni za le ni sawm nga chung a thuk chin lengmang ko."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian nih Noah le a sin i lawng chungah a ummi saram vialte le saṭil vialte kha a philh hna lo, cucaah vawlei cungah thli a hranter i ti cu ṭum hram aa thawk.","title":"Buanchukcho Donghnak"},"2":{"text":"Vawlei tang rilipi an hna hna le van i a ummi awng hna cu a phih hna. Van in a rung surmi ruah cu a tlaih hna i"},"3":{"text":"ti cu a ṭum chin lengmang. Ni za le ni sawm nga chung ti cu a ṭum i"},"4":{"text":"thla sarihnak thla a ni hleisarih ni ah Ararat ram tlang pakhat ah lawng cu aa din."},"5":{"text":"Ti cu a ṭum chin lengmang i thla hranak thla a ni khat ni ah tlang par kha an lang."},"6":{"text":"Ni sawm li hnuah Noah nih thlalangawng kha a hun i"},"7":{"text":"langak pakhat a thlah. (Vawlei cungin ti cu a kao hlantiang a kenkip ah a zuang lengmang)."},"8":{"text":"Cun Noah nih cun ti cu a zor cang maw zor cang lo ti hngalhnak dingah ṭhuro pakhat a thlah,"},"9":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ti nih khan vawlei kha a rak khuh dih rih caah futnak hmun a hmu lo. Cucaah Noah nih khan a kut in a hei banh i lawng chungah cun a luh ṭhan."},"10":{"text":"Ni sarih a ngan hnuah lawng chung cun ṭhuro cu a thlah ṭhan."},"11":{"text":"A sinah zanlei ah khan a ra kir i a hmur in oliv hnah tharte hi a hun i put. Cucaah Noah nih ti cu a ṭum cang ti kha a hngalh."},"12":{"text":"Cun Noah nih cun a dang ni sarih a ngan ṭhan i ṭhuro kha a thlah ṭhan; tutan cu a ra kir ti lo."},"13":{"text":"Noah kum za ruk le kum khat a si kum, thla khatnak thla a ni khatnak ni ah, ti cu vawlei cungin a kao dih. Lawng cungkhuh kha a hun i khua a hei zoh tikah, vawlei cu a ro cang ti kha a hmuh."},"14":{"text":"Thla hnihnak thla, cu thla ni kul le ni sarih ni ah vawlei cu a dihlak in a ro."},"15":{"text":"Pathian nih Noah cu a thawh i,"},"16":{"text":"“Na nupi le na fapa hna le an nupile hna he, lawng chung hin chuak cang u."},"17":{"text":"Cun saram vialte zong kha chuah hna — va si hna seh, saṭil si hna seh, saram hna phun si hna seh, chuah dih hna law vawlei cungah hin fa hring ṭhan hna seh law karh ṭhan hna seh,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah Noah cu a nupi le a fapa hna le an nupile hna he khan lawng chung cun an chuak."},"19":{"text":"Ramlak saram vialte, inn zuat saṭil vialte, va vialte, saram hna phun vialte kha, anmah le an phun ning cio in a bubu in lawng chung cun an chuak."},"20":{"text":"Noah nih Bawipa caah biakṭheng pakhat a ser; saram thiang pawl le va chung khan phun khat ah pakhat cio a lak hna i khangh thawinak caah biakṭheng cungah cun a khangh hna.","title":"Noah Nih Raithawinak A Tuah"},"21":{"text":"Bawipa nih cu rim thaw cu a theih tikah, “Minung tuahmi ruangah vawlei cu zeitikhmanh ah chiat ka serh ṭhan ti lai lo; minung cu a no lio tein a ruahnak cu a ṭhalo ti kha ka hngalh. Atu i ka tuah bantuk hin zeitikhmanh ah thilnung vialte kha ka hrawk ṭhan ti hna lai lo."},"22":{"text":"Vawlei a um chung paohpaoh cu Tuh caan a um lai i ṭuan caan zong a um ko lai. Khuasik caan a um lai i khualum caan a um lai, ṭhal caan a um lai i fur caan a um lai, chun a um lai i zan a um lai. Hi hna hi zeitikhmanh ah an dong lai lo,” a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian nih Noah le a fapa hna cu thluachuah a pek hna i, “Fa tampi in ngei hna u law nan fale cu vawlei cung khuazakip ah khat hna seh.","title":"Pathian le Noah Biakamnak","ref":"Gen 1.28"},"2":{"text":"Vawlei cung saram vialte, va hna le saram hna phun hna le nga hna zong nih an in ṭih hna lai. Annih cu an dihlak in nanmah kut tangah chiah an si."},"3":{"text":"Saram vialte le thlaihring vialte cu nan ei khawh hna lai; an dihlak in rawl caah kan pek hna;"},"4":{"text":"asinain sa kha a chung i thi a um lioah cun nan ei lai lo, zeicahtiah nunnak cu thi cu a si.","ref":"Lev 7.26-27; 17.10-14; Lev 19.26; Deu 12.16,23; 15.23"},"5":{"text":"Pakhatkhat nih an in thah hna ahcun, thihnak in dan ka tat hna lai. Nanmah an thattu hna saram cu ka thah hna lai i ahohmanh a minung hawi a thatmi cu dan ka tat hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Minung cu Pathian mui keng in sermi a si caah, minung a thatmi cu, a minung hawi nih an thah ve lai.","ref":"Gen 1.26; Exo 20.13"},"7":{"text":"Nannih cu fa tampi ngei u law nan tefa hna kha vawlei cung khuazakip ah khat dih hna seh,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 1.28"},"8":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Noah le a fapale cu a thawh hna i,"},"9":{"text":"“Nanmah le nan hnu i a um lai ding nan tefa hna sinah, atu ah biakamnak ka tuah,"},"10":{"text":"cun nan sin i a ummi thilnung vialte — va si hna seh, saṭil si hna seh, saram si hna seh — lawng chungin a chuakmi paohpaoh sinah khan ka tuah."},"11":{"text":"Ka biakamnak cu hihi a si: Thilnung vialte kha buanchukcho in hrawh an si ti lai lo. Zeitikhmanh ah buanchukcho nih vawlei hi a hrawk ti lai lo, tiah bia kaa kam,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Nanmah le saram vialte hna sin i ka sermi ka biakamnak zungzal in a hmunmi hmelchunhnak caah,"},"13":{"text":"ka chuncha cu minmei chungah khin ka chiah. Vawlei he biakamnak ka sermi hmelchunhnak a si lai."},"14":{"text":"Minmei cu vawlei cung i ka zaamter i minmei chung i chuncha a langh fate,"},"15":{"text":"buanchukcho nih thilnung vialte kha a hrawk ṭhan ti hna lai lo ti in nanmah le saram vialte hna sin i biakamnak ka tuahmi kha ka hngalh ṭhan lai."},"16":{"text":"Chuncha cu minmei chung i a hung langh tikah ka hmuh lai i nanmah le vawlei cung thilnung vialte sin i zungzal hmunmi biakamnak ka sermi kha ka hngalh ṭhan lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Pathian nih Noah cu a thawh i, “Hi hmelchunhnak hi vawleicung thilnung vialte hna sin i biakamnak ka tuahmi hmelchunhnak a si,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Lawng chungin a chuakmi Noah fapa hna cu Shem, Ham le Jafeth an si (Ham cu Kanaan pa a si).","title":"Noah Zu A Ri"},"19":{"text":"Hi Noah fapa pathum hi vawlei cung mi vialte a hringsortu hna an si."},"20":{"text":"Noah cu lothlo a si i amah cu mitsur dum a ser hmasa biktu a si."},"21":{"text":"Mitsur zu cu a din i a ri, a thilpuan vialte kha aa phoih dih i a thlam chungah taklawng in a it."},"22":{"text":"Kanaan pa Ham nih khan a pa taklawng in a rilh ko cu a hmuh tikah a unau pahnih kha a va chimh hna."},"23":{"text":"Cu tikah Shem le Jafeth nih cun puan pakhat kha an i lak i an kenglei ah an chiah i an liang le an liang in an i zawn. Cun hnulei chit in thlam chungah cun an va lut i an pa cu an va khuh; an pa taklawng in a um cu an hmuh nakhnga lo khattelei kha an zoh peng."},"24":{"text":"Noah cu a zuritnak khan a hung fim i a fapa a hniang bik nih a cung i a tuahmi kha a hngalh tikah,"},"25":{"text":"aa thawh i, “Kanaan cungah chiat tlung ko seh; a unau hna sal a si lai,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Shem Pathian Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u. Kanaan cu Shem sal a si lai."},"27":{"text":"Pathian nih Jafeth cu karhter seh law A tefa hna cu Shem tefa hna he um ṭi hna seh. Kanaan cu Jafeth sal a si lai,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Buanchukcho hnuah Noah cu kum za thum le sawm nga a nung i"},"29":{"text":"kum za kua le sawm nga a si ah a thi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Noah fapa Shem, Ham le Jafeth i an tefa hna cu hihi an si, buanchukcho hnu i an hrinmi an si:","title":"Noah Fapa Hna Tefa Hna (1Cha 1.5-23)"},"2":{"text":"Jafeth fapa hna cu Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal Meshek le Tiras an si."},"3":{"text":"Gomer fapa hna cu Ashkenaz, Rifath le Togarmah an si."},"4":{"text":"Javan fapa hna cu Elishah, Tarshish, Kit mi le Rodan mi an si."},"5":{"text":"Annih hi rili kam le tikulh i khua a sami hna hringsortu an si. Hi hna hi Jafeth tefa cu an si; an phun cio in an ram cio ah khan khua an sa i anmah le an holh cio kha an hmang."},"6":{"text":"Ham fapale cu Kush, Izipt, Put le Kanaan an si."},"7":{"text":"Kush fapa cu Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah le Sabteka an si. Raamah fapa cu Sheba le Dedan an si."},"8":{"text":"Kush nih cun fapa pakhat a ngeih i a min ah Nimrod a si; amah cu vawlei cung uktu a liannganmi hna lakah a hmasa bik a si."},"9":{"text":"Amah cu vawlei cungah sakap bik zong a si i cucaah mi nih phungthluk bia ah, “Nimrod bantuk sa kah thiam,” ti a si tawn."},"10":{"text":"Pennak a uk hmasa bikmi hna cu Babel, Erek le Akkad an si i an dihlak in Shinar ram chung ummi an si."},"11":{"text":"Cu ram cun Assiria ram ah a kal i Nineveh khua le Rehoboth-Ir khua le Kalah khua le"},"12":{"text":"Resen khua kha a tlak hna, Resen cu Nineveh le Kalah khuapi karlak i a ummi a si."},"13":{"text":"Izipt cu Lud le Anam le Lehab le Naftuh le"},"14":{"text":"Pathrus le Kasluh le Kaftor mi hna pa kha a si i cu hna chung cun Filistin mi kha an chuak."},"15":{"text":"Kanaan cu Sidon (a fapa upa bik) le Heth le"},"16":{"text":"Jebus mi hna le Amor mi hna le Girgash mi hna le"},"17":{"text":"Hiv mi hna le Arki mi hna le Sinmi hna le"},"18":{"text":"Arvad mi hna le Zemari mi hna le Hamath mi hna pa kha a si. Hi hnuah hin, Kanaan miphun chung i phun dangdang hna kha an i ṭhek i"},"19":{"text":"Kanaan ram ramri cu Sidon in Gerar leiah Gaza tiang a phan, Cun Sodom le Gomorrah le Admah le Zeboiim leiah Lasha tiang a phan fawn."},"20":{"text":"Hi hna hi Ham tefa cu an si, an phun cio in an ram cio ah khan khua an sa i anmahle an holh cio kha an hmang."},"21":{"text":"Jafeth u Shem zong nih khan fa a hrin hna, amah cu Eber tefa a hringsortu hna kha a si."},"22":{"text":"Shem fapale cu Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud le Aram an si."},"23":{"text":"Aram fapa hna cu Uz, Hul, Gether le Mash an si."},"24":{"text":"Arpakshad cu Shelah pa a si i Shelah cu Eber pa a si."},"25":{"text":"Eber nih fapa pahnih a ngeih hna i pakhat cu a min ah Peleg a si, cun a nau cu a min ah Joktan a si; Peleg an saknak a sullam cu amah chan ah khan vawlei mi kha an i ṭhen dih caah a si."},"26":{"text":"Joktan cu Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"27":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,"},"28":{"text":"Obal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"29":{"text":"Afir, Havilah le Jobab pa a si. Hi hna hi an dihlak in Joktan fa an si."},"30":{"text":"An umnak ram cu Mesha in Sefar leiah, nichuahlei tlang pipi hna tiang kha a si."},"31":{"text":"Hi hna hi Shem tefa cu an si, an phun cio in an ram cio ah khan khua an sa i anmahle an holh cio kha an hmang."},"32":{"text":"Hi hna hi Noah tefa hna nih an hrinmi hna miphun cu an si, anmahle an i hrinsor ning cio le an phun kalning cio in. Vawlei cung miphun vialte hna hi buanchukcho hnuah Noah fapa hna nih an hrinsormi hna an si."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hlanah cun vawleicung mi vialte hna nih hin holh phun khat lawng an rak ngei i bia an rak hmanmi cu an i khat dih.","title":"Babel Innsang"},"2":{"text":"Nichuahlei i an hei i thawn tikah Shinar ram ah khan nelrawn pakhat an va phan i cuka ah cun umhmun an khuar."},"3":{"text":"Cun pakhat le pakhat cu, “Ra u! Tlakrawh ser u si law mei in raw hna u sih,” an i ti. Cuticun inn saknak ah tlakrawh cu an hman hna i a senghnak ah bitumen an hman hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun annih nih an i thawh i, “Atu cu khuapi pakhat kan ser lai i a chungah innsang pakhat, a par van tawng in kan sak lai. Kan thang kan i chuah lai i vawlei cungah hin kan i ṭhek lai lo,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun hi mi hna nih khuapi an sermi le innsang an sakmi zoh awkah khan Bawipa cu a rung ṭum i"},"6":{"text":"“Atu cu hi mi vialte hna hi miphun phun khat an si, holh pakhat lawng an hmang i atu i an tuahmi hi hmailei ah an tuah laimi thil a hramthawknak lawng a si. A rauh hlanah an duhmi thil paoh kha an tuah khawh ko lai."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah cun pakhat le pakhat an holh an i hngalh khawh nakhnga lo, vung kal u si law an holh kha vung danter dih hna u sih,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa nih vawlei cung khuazakip ah a ṭhek dih hna i khuapi ser cu an ngol."},"9":{"text":"Cu khuapi cu a min ah Babel an ti, zeicahtiah cuka ah cun Bawipa nih mi vialte kha an holh a danter hna i cuka cun vawlei cung khuazakip ah khan a ṭhek hna."},"10":{"text":"Hihi Shem tefa cu an si. Buanchukcho hnu kum hnih ah Shem cu kum za khat a tling i fapa pakhat a hrin i a min ah Arpakshad a si.","title":"Shem Tefa Hna (1Cha 1.24-27)"},"11":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun kum za nga a nung i fa dang zong kha a ngeih hna."},"12":{"text":"Arpakshad cu kum sawm thum le kum nga a si ah fapa pakhat Shelah a ngei;"},"13":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za li le kum thum a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"14":{"text":"Shelah cu kum sawm thum a si ah fapa pakhat Eber a ngei;"},"15":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za li le kum thum a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"16":{"text":"Eber cu kum sawm thum le kum li a si ah fapa pakhat Peleg a ngei;"},"17":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za li sawm thum a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"18":{"text":"Peleg cu kum sawm thum a si ah fapa pakhat Reu a ngei;"},"19":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za hnih le kum kua a nung i fa dang a ngeih hna."},"20":{"text":"Reu nih kum sawm thum le kum hnih a si ah fapa pakhat Serug a ngei;"},"21":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za hnih le kum sarih a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"22":{"text":"Serug nih kum sawm thum a si ah fapa pakhat Nahor a ngei;"},"23":{"text":"cu hnuah cun kum za hnih a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"24":{"text":"Nahor nih kum kul le kum kua a si ah fapa pakhat Terah a ngei;"},"25":{"text":"cu hnuah kum za khat le kum hleikua a nung i fa dang zong a ngeih hna."},"26":{"text":"Terah nih kum sawm sarih a si tikah Abram le Nahor le Haran kha a hrin hna."},"27":{"text":"Terah tefa cu hi hna hi an si: Terah cu Abram le Nahor le Haran pa a si. Haran cu Lot pa a si i"},"28":{"text":"Haran cu amah a chuahkehnak Khaldi ram Ur khua ah khan a pa a nun lioah a thi."},"29":{"text":"Abram nih cun Sarai a ṭhit i Nahor nih Haran fanu Milkah kha a ṭhit, Haran cu Iskah pa kha a si."},"30":{"text":"Sarai cu a cing i fa a ngei kho lo."},"31":{"text":"Terah nih a fapa Abram le a tu Lot, Haran fapa kha le, Abram nupi Sarai kha, Kanaan ram lei i kal awkah Khaldi ram Ur khua khan a thawhpi hna. Sihmanhsehlaw Haran khua tiang an kal i cuka ah cun umhmun an khuar."},"32":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Terah cu a thi i a thih ah cun kum za hnih le kum nga a si."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Abram cu a thawh i, “Na ram le na rualchan le na pa inn kha chuahtak hna law kan hmuhsak laimi ram ah kal tuah.","title":"Pathian Nih Abram A Auh (Lam 7.2-5)","ref":"Lam 7.2-3; Heb 11.8"},"2":{"text":"Tefa tampi kan pek lai i miphun nganpi ah an cang lai. Nangmah cu thluachuah kan pek lai i na min kan thanter lai, cucaah na min cu thluachuah peknak ah an hman lai."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah thluachuah an petu kha thluachuah ka pek ve hna lai i chiat an serhtu kha chiat ka serh ve hna lai. Vawlei cung miphun vialte nih hin, Nangmah thluachuah kan pek bantuk hin thluachuah kan pe ve, tiah an ka hal lai,” a ti.","ref":"Gal 3.8"},"4":{"text":"Abram cu kum sawm sarih le kum nga a si tikah, Bawipa nih a chimh bantuk khan, Haran khua cun aa thawh; Lot kha a sinah a kal ve."},"5":{"text":"Abram cu a nupi Sarai le a nau fapa Lot le Haran khua an um hnu i an ngeihmi an chawva vialte le an sal vialte hna he khan Kanaan ram lei kal ah cun aa thawh. Kanaan ram an phak tikah"},"6":{"text":"Abram cu ram chungah cun aa chawk i Shekhem khua an hmunthiang, Moreh thing zarh an timi kha a va phan. (Cu lioah cun Kanaan mi kha cu ram chungah cun an um ko rih)."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu Abram sinah khan a lang i, “Hi ram hi na tefa ka pek hna laimi ram cu a si,” a ti. Cuka ah cun amah sin i a rung langmi Bawipa caah khan Abram nih biakṭheng pakhat a ser.","ref":"Lam 7.5; Gal 3.16"},"8":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun thlanglei ah khan a vun i thawn chin i Bethel khua nichuahlei i a ummi tlang ram ah khan umhmun a khuar, cuka cu Bethel le Ai karlak ah khan a si, Bethel kha nitlaklei ah a um i Ai kha nichuahlei ah a um. Cuka ah cun biakṭheng zong kha a ser i Bawipa kha a biak."},"9":{"text":"Cun thlanglei ah khan riahhmun pakhat hnu pakhat in a vung i thawn chin lengmang i Negeb ram tiang a phan."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cuka ram ah cun rawl a um lo i mangṭam cu a fah ngaingai caah Abram cu Izipt ram i caan tlawmpal vung um ta awkah khan thlanglei kha a panh chin lengmang.","title":"Abram Izipt Ah A Zaam"},"11":{"text":"Izipt ram chung a luh laite ah khan a nupi Sarai cu a thawh i, “Nang cu mi dawh na si."},"12":{"text":"Izipt mi nih an in hmuh tikah, Abram nupi a si, an ti lai i nangmah duh ah keimah kha an ka thah lai."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah a far ka si, tiah na ti hna lai i nangmah thawngin an ka nunh lai i ka caah harnak zeihmanh a um lai lo,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 20.2; 26.7"},"14":{"text":"Izipt ram an vung luh tikah khan a nupi mi dawh a si cu Izipt mi nih khan an rak hmuh."},"15":{"text":"An bawi pawl nih khan, aa dawh hringhran cu an hmuh i Faro kha an chimh i siangpahrang inn ah khan an kalpi."},"16":{"text":"Amah ruangah cun Faro nih cun Abram cu ṭha tein a zohkhenh i tuu run le meheh run le caw le laa le sal le kalauk kha a pek."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abram nupi Sarai kha a inn ah cun a kalpi ruangah cun Bawipa nih Faro le a inn chung i a ummi vialte hna cu zawtnak a fakmi in dan a tat hna."},"18":{"text":"Cu tikah Faro nih Abram cu mi kha a auhter hna i, “Zeicahdah hi bantukin ka cungah rian na ṭuan? Zeicahdah ka nupi a si tiah na ka chimh lo?"},"19":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka far a si na ti i na ka ṭhitter? Na nupi hi i lak law kal u,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Faro nih a mi kha nawl a pek hna i Abram cu a nupi le a ngeihmi vialte he khan ram chung cun an dawi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abram cu Izipt ram khan a chuak i chaklei ah Negeb ram leiah khan a hung kal, a sinah cun a nupi le a ngeihmi vialte le Lot zong kha an kal ve.","title":"Abram le Lot An I Ṭhen"},"2":{"text":"Abram cu mi rum ngaingai a si, tuu tampi a ngei, meheh tampi a ngei, caw tampi a ngei i sui le ngun zong tampi a ngei."},"3":{"text":"Cun riahhmun pakhat hnu pakhat in Negeb ram in Bethel khua leiah khan aa thawn, hmasa i Bethel khua le Ai khua karlak i a rak riahnak hmun kha a hei fuh."},"4":{"text":"Biakṭheng a rak sernak hmun ah khan a hung kal ṭhan i cuka ah cun Bawipa kha a biak."},"5":{"text":"Abram he a kal ṭimi Lot zong nih khan tuu le meheh le caw le a sin i a um vemi minung kha a ngeih ve hna."},"6":{"text":"An pahnih in hmunkhat i um awkah saṭil tlonnak ram nih a zaat hna lo, saṭil tam tuk an ngei veve."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah Abram saṭil cawng hna le Lot saṭil cawng hna kha an i si lengmang. (Cu lioah cun Kanaan mi hna le Periz mi hna kha cu ram chungah cun an um ko rih)."},"8":{"text":"Cun Abram nih Lot cu a thawh i, “Kannih cu rualchan kan si, na mi hna le ka mi hna hi an i sik lengmang awk a si lo."},"9":{"text":"I ṭhen u sih. Ram hi na duhnak kaa zawn i thim law ka kaltak ko. Nang kehlei i na kal ahcun kei orhlei ah ka kal lai, orhlei i na kal ah cun kehlei ah ka kal lai,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Lot cu khua a cuan i Jordan tiva nelrawnpi kha Zoar khua tiangin ti tampi a um i Bawipa dum bantuk le Izipt ram bantuk a si kha a hmuh. (Cucu Bawipa nih Sodom le Gomorrah khua a hrawh hna hlan kha a si.)","ref":"Gen 2.10"},"11":{"text":"Lot nih cun Jordan nelrawn cu a ningpi in aa thim i nichuahlei ah khan a kal. Abram le Lot an i ṭhenning cu, cuticun a si."},"12":{"text":"Abram cu Kanaan ram chungah khan khua a sa i Lot cu nelrawn i a ummi khualipi hna lakah khan a um i Sodom khua pawngah khan riahhmun a ser."},"13":{"text":"Sodom khuami cu miṭhalo, Bawipa cung i ṭhat lonak a tuahmi misual an si."},"14":{"text":"Lot aa ṭhial hnuah Bawipa nih Abram cu a thawh i, “Na umnak hmun khan, nichuah nitlak chaklei thlanglei vialte cuan tuah hna;","title":"Abram Cu Hebron Ah Aa Ṭhial"},"15":{"text":"na hmuhmi ram vialte kha nangmah le na tefa cu kan pek hna lai i a zungzal in nan ta a si lai.","ref":"Lam 7.5"},"16":{"text":"Tefa tampi kan pek lai i an tam tuk ah ahohmanh nih an rel kho hna lai lo, leidip cu ahohmanh nih an rel khawh hna lo bantuk khi an si lai."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah i tim law ram hi a pumpi in ṭol tuah, zeicahtiah a dihlak in nangmah cu kan pek lai,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah Abram nih a riahhmun cu a ṭhial i Hebron khua i Mamre thingzarh an umnak ah khan a va um, cuka ah cun Bawipa caah biakṭheng pakhat a va ser."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Shinar ram siangpahrang Amrafel, Ellasar siangpahrang Ariok, Elam siangpahrang Khedorlaomer le Goiim siangpahrang Tidal nih","title":"Abram Nih Lot A Chanh"},"2":{"text":"siangpahrang a dang panga kha an doh hna, cu hna cu: Sodom siangpahrang Bera, Gomorrah siangpahrang Birsha, Admah siangpahrang Shinab, Zeboiim siangpahrang Shemeber le Bela siangpahrang an si (Bela cu Zoar a si)."},"3":{"text":"Hi siangpahrang panga hi hmunkhat ah an ṭangṭi i Siddim nelrawn ah khan an ralkap cu an pumh hna; Siddim nelrawn cu atu i Rili Thi timi khi a si."},"4":{"text":"Khedorlaomer kut tangah khan kum hleihnih an rak um i a kum hleithumnak ah amah kha an doh."},"5":{"text":"A kum hleili kum ah Khedorlaomer le amah he a ṭangṭimi hna kha an ralkap he an ra ciammam i Refaim mi kha Ashteroth Karnaim ah, Zuzim mi kha Ham ah, Emim mi kha Kiriathaim nelrawn ah,"},"6":{"text":"Hormi kha Seir tlang ah an tei hna i thetse rawn kam i a ummi Elparan khua tiang an dawi hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun an hun i mer i Kadesh ah khan an hung kir i Amelek mi hna ram vialte le Hazazontamar i a ummi Amor mi kha an tei hna (Kadesh cu Biaceihnak Cerhti ti zongah ti a si)."},"8":{"text":"Cun Sodom siangpahrang, Gomorrah siangpahrang Admah siangpahrang, Zeboiim siangpahrang le Bela siangpahrang nih (Bela cu Zoar a si),"},"9":{"text":"Elam siangpahrang Khedorlaomer le Goiim siangpahrang Tidal le Shinar siangpahrang Amrafel le Ellasar siangpahrang Ariok doh awkah Siddim nelrawn ah an ralkapbu cu a hunpi hna, khatlei ah panga le khatlei ah pali an si."},"10":{"text":"Siddim nelrawn cu bitumen an cawhnak khor in a khat i cucaah Sodom siangpahrang le Gomorrah siangpahrang kha raltuknak hmun cun zam an i timh tikah cu khor chungah cun an tla. A dang cu tlang ah khan an zam."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang pali hna nih cun Sodom le Gomorrah i a ummi thil vialte kha, rawl vialte he an i lak i an kal."},"12":{"text":"Lot zong cu Sodom i a um caah a ngeihmi thil vialte he an kalpi ve."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a luat sualmi pakhat nih Hebru mi Abram cu cu kong cu a chimh. Abram cu Mamre thingzarh pawng i khua a sami a si, Mamre cu Eshkol le Aner hna u kha a si i hi hna hi Abram he ṭangṭi an si."},"14":{"text":"Abram nih a rualchan an tlaih ti kha a theih tikah a riahhmun i a ummi a minung hna lak i zumhawktlak a timi minung za thum le hlei riat kha a kawh hna i siangpahrang hna cu Dan khua tiang an dawi hna."},"15":{"text":"A mi cu bu hnih ah a ṭhen hna i zan ah an tuk hna i an tei hna. Damaskas khua chaklei i a ummi Hobah tiang an dawi hna i"},"16":{"text":"an thilri vialte kha an chuh ṭhan dih hna. A rualchan Lot le a chawva vialte zong kha a kirpi ṭhan hna, nu hna le mi dang zong an i tel."},"17":{"text":"Abram cu Khedorlaomer le amah sinah a ṭangmi siangpahrang hna a va tei hnanak in a ra kir tikah, Sodom siangpahrang nih khan Shaveh nelrawn an timi in a rak don, (Shaveh nelrawn cu siangpahrang Nelrawn ti zongah ti a si).","title":"Melkhizedek Nih Abram Thluachuah A Pek (Heb 7.1-2)"},"18":{"text":"Cun Salem Siangpahrang Melkhizedek, Cung Nung Bik Pathian tlangbawi zong a simi nih khan Abram cu changreu le mitsur zu a rak phorh i","ref":"Heb 7.1-10"},"19":{"text":"thluachuah a pek i: “Van le vawlei a sertu Cung Nung Bik Pathian nih Abram cu thluachuah in pe seh."},"20":{"text":"Na ral an teitertu Cung Nung Bik Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh,” a ti. Cun Abram nih hranchaw a lakmi vialte cheuhra cheukhat a pek."},"21":{"text":"Cun Sodom siangpahrang nih Abram cu a thawh i, “Ka minung hna dah ti lo cu, na lakmi thil paohpaoh kha an dihlak in nangmah nih i chiah ko hna,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abram nih cun a leh i, “Van le vawlei a sertu Cung Nung Bik Pathian hmaiah chiatser tein bia kaa kam i,"},"23":{"text":"na thil a simi paohpaoh, la fang pakhat le phanah hri tiangin zeihmanh kaa lak lai lo, ka ti. Cucaah cun nang zong nih zeitikhmanh ah, “Abram cu keimah nih pei ka rumter ko cu,” na ti kho ve lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Zeihmanh keimah caah kaa lak lai lo. Ka mi hna nih an hman cangmi thil hna le ka sin ṭang hna nih an hmuhtin awk a si vemi thil lawnglawng kha ka cohlan hna lai; Aner, Eshkol le Mamre nih khan an covo cu an i lak ve lai,” a ti."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Abram nih langhnak a hmuh i Bawipa bia kha a theih. Bawipa nih cun a thawh i, “Abram, na thinphang hlah. Keimah cu phaw bantukin an hupphengtu ka si. Na laksawng cu a nganpi a si lai,” a ti.","title":"Pathian le Abram Biakamnak"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abram nih cun a thawh ve i, “Maw Bawipa Pathian, kei cu fa ka ngei lo; cucaah zeitindah laksawng cu na ka pek khawh lai? Ka ro a ka cotu ding cu Damaskas khuami Eliezer hi pei a si ko hi."},"3":{"text":"Fa zeihmanh na ka pe lo i cucaah cun ka sal hna lak i pakhatkhat nih ka ro an ka co cu a hau ko lai,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, “Hi sal hi na rocotu cu a si lai lo, na rocotu cu nangmah na fapa hrimhrim a si lai,” tiin a chimh cu a theih ṭhan."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun lengah a chuahpi i, “Van khi zoh law na rel khawh ahcun arfi khi rel tuah hna. Na tefa cu khi arfi zat khi an si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Rom 4.18; Heb 11.12"},"6":{"text":"Abram nih Bawipa cu a zumh i cu a zumhnak cu Bawipa nih a dinnak ah a cohlanpiak.","ref":"Rom 4.3; Gal 3.6; Jei 2.23"},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Abram cu a thawh i, “Hi ram hi nangmah pek awkah Khaldi ram Ur khua in chuah an fialtu cu Bawipa hi ka si,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abram nih cun, “Maw Bawipa Pathian, cucu ka ta a si lai ti cu zeitindah ka hngalh khawh lai?” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih cun, “Cawla kum thum a timi pakhat, meheh kum thum a timi pakhat, tuukawng kum thum a simi pakhat, cun ṭhuro pakhat le laileng pakhat kha rak ka pe hna,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Hi saram vialte hi Abram nih Pathian sinah khan a rak put hna. A cheu hna i a cheumi hna cu hmaitonh cio ah tlang hnih in a chiah hna; va kha cu a can hna lo."},"11":{"text":"Langta nih an run zuanhnawh hna i a ṭhawl hna."},"12":{"text":"Ni a tlak cuahmah tikah khan Abram cu aa hngilh i a cungah ṭihnak nganpi a tlung.","ref":"Job 4.13,14"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a thawh i, “Na tefa hna cu ram dang ah khual an si lai, cuka ah cun sal ah an cang lai i kum za li chung hremnak an ing lai.","ref":"Exo 1.1-14; Lam 7.6"},"14":{"text":"Asinain cu bantukin a hremtu hna miphun kha keimah nih dan ka tat hna lai i cu ram in an chuah tikah chawva tampi he an chuak lai.","ref":"Exo 12.40-41; Lam 7.7"},"15":{"text":"Nang tu cu chan tling in na nung lai i dai tein na thi lai; khup kha hmuah in na nun hnuah an in vui lai."},"16":{"text":"Na tefa hna cu chan li hnuah an ra kir ṭhan lai, zeicahtiah Amor mi hna cu dantat awk tlak hrimhrim in an sual tik lawngah ka ṭhawl hna lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun ni a tlak i khua a muih tikah a khumi mei um pakhat le a alhmi mei tom pakhat kha an hung chuak i sa a chiahmi hna karlak ah khan an kal."},"18":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun Bawipa nih Abram cu bia a kam i, “Hi ram hi a dihlak in na tefa kha ka pek hna lai tiah bia kaa kam, Izipt ram ri i a ummi tiva in tiva ngan Zufrates tiang a si lai;","ref":"Lam 7.5"},"19":{"text":"Ken mi hna ram le Keniz mi hna ram le Kadmon mi hna ram le"},"20":{"text":"Hit mi hna ram le Periz mi hna ram le Refaim mi hna ram le"},"21":{"text":"Amor mi hna ram le Kanaan mi hna ram le Girgash mi hna ram le Jebus mi hna ram zong hi an i tel chih dih lai,” a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abram cu a nupi Sarai nih fa zeihmanh a hrinpiak lo. Sarai nih cun Izipt mi salnu pakhat a ngei i a min ah Hagar a si.","title":"Hagar le Ishmael"},"2":{"text":"Sarai nih cun Abram cu a thawh, i, “Zohhmanh, kei cu Bawipa nih fa ngeih a ka sianh lo. Cucaah cun zeicahdah ka salnu hi na ihpi ko lo? Fa a hei ka hrinpiak ko hnga dah kaw,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cuticun Sarai nih Izipt mi a salnu Hagar cu Abram kha nupi caah a pek. (Cu thil cu bantukin a hung um cu Abram kha Kanaan ram chung i kum hra a um hnuah a si)."},"4":{"text":"Abram nih Hagar cu a ihpi i fa a pawi. Hagar nih cun fa ka pawi ti kha a hun i hngalh tikah porhlawt in aa la i Sarai kha zeihmanh ah a rel lo."},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah Sarai nih Abram cu a thawh i, “Hagar nih zeihmanh i a ka rel lo hi nangmah palh a si. Keimah hrimhrim nih ka sal cu kan pek i fa ka pawi ti aa hngalh cangka keimah kha a ka serhsat. Cucaah kannih pahnih lakah hin ahodah a ding ti kha Bawipa nih kan ceih seh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Abram nih a leh i, “A ṭha ko, amah cu na sal a si i na kut tangah pei a um ko cu; na duhning paoh in a cungah tuah ko,” a ti. Cucaah Sarai nih cun a vun hrem ve i Hagar cu a tli."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi nih Hagar cu Shur lei kalnak lam i a ummi cerhti, thetse rawn cerhti ah khan a ton i,"},"8":{"text":"“Sarai salnu Hagar, khuazei in dah na rat i khuazei ah dah na kal lai?” a ti. Hagar nih cun, “Sarai sinin ka zaam,” tiah a leh."},"9":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih cun, “Sarai sinah cun va kir ṭhan law a kut tangah ṭha tein va um,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih cun, “Tefa tam tuk hringhran kan pek lai i a rel in rel cawk an si lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Fapa pakhat na ngei lai i a min ah Ishmael na sak lai, Zeicahtiah Bawipa nih na harnak kha an theihpiak."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na fapa cu ramlak laa bantuk a si lai, a mi kip kha a doh hna lai i mi kip nih khan an doh ve lai. A rualchan hna umnak in lamhlapi ah khua a sa lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Hagar nih cun amah le amah kha, “A ka hmutu cu ka hmuh taktak ko maw?” tiah aa hal i cucaah Bawipa cu, “Nang cu mi a hmutu Pathian na si,” ti min in a auh."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah cun pei Kadesh le Bered karlak i a ummi tikhor cu, “Beer-la-hai-roi” tiah mi nih an ti cu, (Beer-la-hai-roi a sullam cu, “A ka hmutu Pathian nung tikhor,” ti a si)."},"15":{"text":"Hagar nih cun Abram cu fapa a hrinpiak i a min ah Ishmael a sak.","ref":"Gal 4.22"},"16":{"text":"Abram cu kum sawm riat le kum ruk a si."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abram cu kum sawm kua le kum kua a si tikah Bawipa cu a sinah a lang i, “Kei cu Lianngan Bik Pathian ka si. Na nun chung vialte ka nawl ka ngai law soi awk zeihmanh um loin um.","title":"Cuarpartan, Biakamnak Hmelchunhnak (Exo 12.43—13.2)"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah sinah biakamnak ka ser lai i tefa tampi kan pek lai,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Abram cu a khuk aa bil i a bawh lioah Pathian nih cun,"},"4":{"text":"“Hi biakamnak hi kan pek: nangmah cu miphun tampi a hringsortu hna na si lai."},"5":{"text":"Na min kha Abram si ti loin Abraham a si cang lai. Zeicahtiah miphun tampi hringsortu ah kan ser cang.","ref":"Rom 4.17"},"6":{"text":"Tefa tampi kan pek lai i a cheu cu siangpahrang an si lai. Na tefa cu an tam tuk hringhran lai caah miphun phun ah an i chuah lai."},"7":{"text":"“Ka biakamnak cu, zungzal hmunmi biakamnak caah, nangmah le a ra lai ding chan i na tefa hna sinah, ka fehter lai. Nangmah na Pathian le na tefa hna an Pathian ka si lai.","ref":"Luk 1.55"},"8":{"text":"Hi ram, atu i khual na sinak ram hi, nangmah le na tefa hna cu kan pek hna lai. Kanaan ram hi a ning piin nan ta a si zungzal lai i keimah hi an Pathian ka si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Lam 7.5"},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih Abraham cu a thawh i, “Nangmah zong nih keimah he kan biakamnak hi na zulh hrimhrim ve lai, nangmah le hmailei chan i a um laimi na tefa hna nih nan zulh hrimhrim ve lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun nangmah le na tefa hna nih tuah awkah kan hna a tla nan ti awk cu hihi a si: nanmah lak i pa paohpaoh cu nan cuarpar nan i tan dih lai.","ref":"Lam 7.8; Rom 4.11"},"11":{"text":"Atu ri hin cun fapa nan ngeihmi paohpaoh cu ni riat a si ah an cuarpar nan tan hrimhrim hna lai, nan inn chung i a chuakmi nan sal hna zong, cun ramdangmi sin i nan cawkmi sal hna zong an i tel chih dih lai. Hi nih hin nanmah le keimah karlakah biakamnak a um kha a langhter lai.","merge":"12"},"13":{"text":"Pakhat hmanh hrelh loin nan cuarpar cu tan nan si lai i cu nih cun nanmah sin i biakamnak ka sermi hi zungzal hmunmi biakamnak a si kha nan cungah hmelchunhnak in a langhter lai."},"14":{"text":"Cuarpar aa tan lomi pa cu a miphun chungin hlonh a si lai, zeicahtiah keimah he biakamnak cu a zul lo,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Abraham cu, “Na nupi cu Sarai tiah na ko ti lai lo, a min cu Sarah a si cang."},"16":{"text":"Amah cu thluachuahnak ka pek lai i fapa pakhat an hrinpiak lai. Amah cu thluachuah ka pek lai i miphun hna nu a si lai; a tefa hna lakah cun siangpahrang zong an um lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Abraham cu a khuk aa bil i asinain, “Mipa nih kum za khat a si ah fa a ngei kho ngai hnga maw? Sarah nih hin kum sawm kua ah fa cu a ngei ngai hnga maw?” ti a ruah ah a nih a chuak."},"18":{"text":"Pathian cu a thawh i, “Ishmael cu ka huhphenhpiak law nungdam tein ka zohkhenhpiak ko tiah kan nawl,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih, “Na palh; na nupi Sarah nih fapa an hrinpiak lai i a min ah Isak na sak lai. Amah le a tefa hna sinah khan ka biakamnak cu ka fehter lai. Cu ka biakamnak cu zungzal hmunmi biakamnak a si."},"20":{"text":"Ishmael huhphenh awk kha na ka hal, cucaah hitihin ka tuah lai: Ishmael cu thluachuahnak ka pek lai i fa tampi le tefa tampi ka pek lai. Amah cu bawi bawi hleihnih pa a si lai i a tefa cu miphun nganpi ah ka ser hna lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun ka biakamnak cu, Sarah nih kumvoi atu tik i an hrinpiak laimi na fapa Isak sinah ka fehter lai,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Pathian le Abraham cu an i chawnh dih in Pathian nih cun Abraham cu a kaltak."},"23":{"text":"Cu ni ṭhiamṭhiam ah cun Abraham nih a fapa Ishmael le a salpa vialte kha, Pathian nih a chimh bangin, an cuarpar a tan hna; a inn i a chuakmi si hna seh, a cawk in a cawkmi si hna seh, a inn i a ummi pa paohpaoh cu an cuarpar a tan hna."},"24":{"text":"Abraham cu cuarpartan a si ah kum sawm kua le kum kua a si i"},"25":{"text":"a fapa Ishmael cu kum hleithum a si."},"26":{"text":"An pahnih cun ni khat te ah,"},"27":{"text":"an sal vialte hna he cun an cuarpar cu tan an si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu Abraham sinah Mamre i thingzarh hna lakah khan a lang. Chun ni lin lai i Abraham cu a thlam innka i a ṭhut lioah khan,","title":"Isak Chuahnak Biakamnak (Heb 13.2)"},"2":{"text":"khua a hei zoh i mipa pathum an dir ko kha a hmuh hna. A hmuh hna le cangka a va tli i a va don hna. A khuk aa bil i,","ref":"Heb 13.2"},"3":{"text":"“Bawipa, Ka inn ah tang ta loin kei santlailo pa hi, ka lanhtak sawh hlah."},"4":{"text":"Ti in cahpiak hna ning law nan ke i ṭawl u law thing toiah hin i din ta u."},"5":{"text":"Rawl tlawmpal tein in serpiak hna ning law ei ta u law cun nan bat a dam in nan lan te lai. Ka inn nan ra phan cang ṭung i rawl ei ta lo cu ka sia a herh,” a ti. Annih nih, “A ṭha ko, na chim bantuk cun tuah ko,” tiah an leh."},"6":{"text":"Abraham cu khulrang in thlam chungah khan a vung lut i Sarah cu a thawh i, “Khulrang in changvut na ngeihmi lak i a ṭha bik kha pawng sawm thum in i lak law nawng law changreu ah ser tuah,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun cawrun leiah khan a va tli i a thau milmialmi cawfa pakhat kha a va tlaih i a salpa pakhat kha a pek i zokzok in a rak can i chumh awkah a rak timh."},"8":{"text":"Cawhnuk thawhpat le cawhnuk hring le sa kha a hunh hna i an ei lioah cun thingkung tangin a dirhnawh hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Na nupi Sarah tah khuazei ah dah a si?” an ti. “Thlam chungah khin a um ko,” tiah a leh hna."},"10":{"text":"A lengtu hna pakhat nih cun aa thawh i, “Na nupi Sarah nih kumvoi atu tikah hin fapa a hrin lai i cu tikah cun ka ra ṭhan te lai,” a ti. Sarah nih cun a hnulei innka khan a ngaih ko hna.","ref":"Rom 9.9"},"11":{"text":"Abraham le Sarah cu an tar ngaingai cang i Sarah cu nuphung hmanh a hngal ti lo."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Sarah cu a ni i, “Atu cu fa ngei dingah ka tar tuk cang, cu lunglawmhnak cu ka hmu ngai hnga maw? Cu pinah ka va zong a tar fawn,” a ti.","ref":"1Pet 3.6"},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Abraham cu a thawh i, “Zeicahdah Sarah nih a nih i, ‘Hi tluk i ka tar hnuah hin fa cu ka ngei kho ngai hnga maw?’ a ti?"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa caah hin zei thil paoh hi a har tukmi a um maw? A caan a tlin tikah kumvoi atu tikah hin na sinah ka ra ṭhan lai i Sarah nih fapa a hrin lai,” a ti.","ref":"Luk 1.37"},"15":{"text":"Sarah cu a thin a phang i, ka ni lo, tiah aa pheh. Anih nih, “Na ni ko, na ni hrimhrim ko,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Mi cu an i thawh i Sodom khua a langhnak hmun ah khan an kal i Abraham zong cu anmah thlahpah ah an sinah a kal ve.","title":"Abraham Nih Sodom Khua Caah Thla A Cam"},"17":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih amah le amah cu aa thawh i, “Ka thil tuah laimi hi Abraham cu chim loin ka um kho lo."},"18":{"text":"A tefa hna cu a ngan i a ṭhawngmi miphun ah an cang lai i vawlei cung miphun vialte hna nih hin Abraham thluachuahnak ka pekmi bantuk kha kan pe ve tiah an ka hal lai."},"19":{"text":"A hmaanmi le a dingmi thil tuah hi ka nawlbia zulh a si ti kha a fale le a hnu i a ra laimi a tefa hna kha a cawnpiaknak hna hnga, amah cu ka thim cang. Cun bia kaa kammi vialte kha ka tuahpiak lai,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih cun, “Sodom le Gomorrah khua hi an thang a chia ngaingai ko i an sualnak cu a ngan ngaingai ko."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah kan theihmi thawng hi a hmaan maw hmaanlo ti hngalh awkah ka vung kal hrimhrim lai. A si taktak le si taktak lo kha ka vung hliah lai,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun mi kha an i thawh i Sodom leiah cun an kal, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa cu Abraham sinah khan a taang."},"23":{"text":"Abraham nih Bawipa cu a hei naih i, “A sual lomi cu a sualmi hna sinah na thah chih taktak ko hna lai maw?"},"24":{"text":"Khuapi chungah khan a sual lomi sawm nga um hna seh law na hrawh ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai maw? Sawm nga khamh awkah khan an khua cu na zuah hnga lo maw?"},"25":{"text":"A sual lomi cu a sualmi hna sinah khan na that bal hna lai lo. Cucu a si kho lo. Nangmah nih cucu na tuah bal ding a si lo. Cu ti a si ahcun, a sual lomi cu a sualmi bantukin pei dantat an si ve kun hnga cu. Cucu a si kho lo. Vawlei cung dihlak bia a ceihtu Dingthlu Lairel nih cun ding tein pei a ceih lai cu,” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a leh i, “Sodom khua chung i a sual lomi minung sawm nga ka hmuh hna ahcun, cu sawm nga ruangah cun khua cu a ningpi in ka zuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Abraham nih khan a hun i thawh ṭhan i, “Kei cu leidip le vutcam si ko hmanh ning law, Bawipa, nangmah cu ngamh ngaiin kan chawnh hi ka ngaithiam ko."},"28":{"text":"Sawm nga si loin sawm li le panga um hna seh law tah zeitindah a si hnga? Panga in an tlawm ruangah cun khua cu na hrawh dih ko hnga maw?” a ti. Bawipa nih cun, “A sual lomi sawm li le panga ka hmuh hna ahcun khua cu ka hrawk lai lo,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Abraham nih cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Sawm li lawng um hna seh law tah?” a ti. Anih nih, “Sawm li an um ahcun ka hrawk lai lo,” a ti ve."},"30":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Bawipa, ka cungah na thin hung sawh hlah. Ka chim rih ko lai. Sawm thum lawng um hna seh law tah?” a ti. Anih nih, “Sawm thum ka hmuh hna ahcun ka hrawk hna lai lo,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Abraham nih cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “ Bawipa, na sinah ngamh ngaiin bia ka chim lengmang hi ka ngaithiam ko. Kul lawng um hna seh law tah?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Kul ka hmuh hna ahcun ka hrawk lai lo,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih cun, “Bawipa, na thinhung hlah, voi khat in ka chim ko rih lai. Pahra lawng um hna seh law tah?” a ti. Cun anih nih, “Pahra an um ahcun ka hrawk lai lo,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Abraham he bia an i ruah dih cun, Bawipa cu a kal i Abraham zong cu inn ah a ṭin."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zanlei sang ah vancungmi pahnih kha Sodom khua chung i an va luh tikah, Lot cu mi an i ton tawnnak hauka hramah khan a rak ṭhu. A hmuh hna cangka a tho zau i annih kha a rak don hna. An hmaiah cun a kun i,","title":"Sodom Khuami An Sualning"},"2":{"text":"“Ka bawipale hna, nan salpa inn ah ra lut tuah u law ka tlung tuah u. Nan ke kha i ṭawl u law tuzan cu riak u. Thaizing ah nan tho lai i nan kal duhnak ah cun nan kal chin te lai,” a ti hna. Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih, “A si lo, khualai ah hin kan riak ko lai,” tiah an leh."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a nawl lengmang hna i a donghnak ah a inn ah cun an kal. Lot nih cun changreu kha a ser i rawl thaw ngai a serpiak hna i annih nih an ei."},"4":{"text":"Khual cu an ih hlanah, Sodom khuami pa nih khan inn cu an rak kulh. Khuachung mipa vialte cu a no he a tar he an tling dih."},"5":{"text":"Lot cu an vun auh i, “Na inn i a riakmi pahnih hna kha khuazei ah dah an si? Hun chuahter hna law kan rak ihpi hna lai,” an ti.","ref":"Biac 19.22-24"},"6":{"text":"Lot cu lengah a va chuak i innka cu a khar."},"7":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka duate le, zei kan ti hnga, hi bantuk ṭhat lonak cu tuah sawh hlah u!"},"8":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, pa a hngal rih lomi fanu ngaknu pahnih ka ngei hna. Annih tu hi rak chuahpi hna ning law nan duh paoh in nan rak tuah hna lai. Sihmanhsehlaw hi khual hi cu zeitin hmanh in ti hna hlah u, ka inn chung i a ummi ka khual an si i ka huhphenh hna hrimhrim awk a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih an thawh i, “Kan kian, a nang ramdangmi hi i thlak hlah, nangmah nih hin maw cutin tuah u khatin tuah u na hei kan ti. Kan kian, cu lo ahcun anmah nak fak in kan in tongh sual lai,” an ti. Lot cu an en i innka kha baoh awkah an hei fuh."},"10":{"text":"Asinain, inn chunglei i a ummi mi pahnih nih khan Lot cu inn chungah khan an hun hnuh i innka cu an khar."},"11":{"text":"Cun lenglei i a ummi vialte kha an mit an cawtter hna i cucaah innka kha an hmu kho lo.","ref":"2Sia 6.18"},"12":{"text":"Mi pahnih nih khan Lot cu an thawh i, “Hika ah hin midang na ngei ti hna maw? Na fapa hna le na fanu hna le khua chung i na mi a simi hna paohpaoh kha i chuahpi hna law hika hmun hin chuak u,","title":"Lot Cu Sodom In A Zaam"},"13":{"text":"zeicahtiah hi hmun hi kan hrawh cang lai. Hi mi hna an thangchiatnak hi Bawipa nih a theih cang i Sodom khua hi hrawh awkah a kan thlah cang,” an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Lot cu a va chuak i a fanule a ṭhitu hna ding pawl kha, “Khulrang in hika hmun hi chuahtak u, hi hmun hi Bawipa nih a hrawh lai,” a ti hna. Sihmanhsehlaw aa capo tiah an ruah."},"15":{"text":"Khua a hung dei tikah vancungmi nih khan Lot cu an hnawh i, “I hnawh tuah! Na nupi le na fanu pahnih kha i lak hna law chuak u. Cu ti nan chuah ahcun khua a rawh tikah nan thi lai lo,” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Asinain Lot cu aa nuainai i sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih khan a cungah zaangfahnak kha a ngeih caah, mi nih khan amah cu le a nupi le a fanu pahnih hna cu an kut in an hnuh hna i khua lengah an chuahpi hna i cuka ah cun an kaltak hna.","ref":"2Pet 2.7"},"17":{"text":"Cun khua chungin an chuahpi dih hna hnuah khan vancungmi pakhat nih cun aa thawh i, “Nan nun nakhnga tli u! Hnulei zoh hlah u, nelrawn chungah dircon hlah u. Tlang ah tli u law nan thi lai lo,” a ti hna."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Lot nih a leh i, “ Bawipa, cucu a si kho lo."},"19":{"text":"Zohhmanh, ka cungah zaangfahnak nganpi na tuah cang i ka nunnak na ka khamh hi na ka zaangfah ruangah cun a si ko. Tlang cu an hla tuk i ka phak hlanah rawhnak nih khan a ka cil lai i ka thi lai."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah cun khi khua hmete khi na hmu maw? A nai i ka phak khawh lai. Cucaah khika ah khin ka kalter, hmun hmete men a si ko kha na hmuh ko i khika ah ka nunnak kha a him ko lai,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Anih nih aa thawh i, “Cucu ka hna a tla; khi khua cu ka hrawk lai lo."},"22":{"text":"I hnawh! A tlik in tli! Khika na phak hlanah cun zeihmanh ka tuah kho lo,” a ti. Lot nih khan cu khua cu khua hmete a ti caah a min ah Zoar sak a si."},"23":{"text":"Ni a chuah ah khin Lot cu Zoar a phan ve;","title":"Sodom le Gomorrah Rawhnak"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih Sodom le Gomorrah cungah cun kat mei kha a surter i","ref":"Mat 10.15; 11.23-24; Luk 10.12; 17.29; 2Pet 2.6; Jud 7"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun cu khua pahnih hna le cu nelrawn a dihlak le khuapi chung i a ummi vialte hna le ram chung i a khomi thil vialte hna cu a hrawh dih hna."},"26":{"text":"Lot nupi cu hnulei aa mer i cite tung ah a cang.","ref":"Luk 17.32"},"27":{"text":"A thaizing zingkate ah Abraham cu Bawipa hmai i a dirnak hmun ah khan khulrang in a va kal."},"28":{"text":"Sodom le Gomorrah le nelrawn cu a vun cuanh hna i, somei nganpi chung i meikhu a chuah hluahmah bantuk khin, vawlei cun meikhu cu a tho."},"29":{"text":"Asinain Pathian nih nelrawn chung ummi khua kha a hrawh hna tikah Abraham kha a philh lo i Lot kha himnak hmun ah a zamter."},"30":{"text":"Lot cu Zoar i um kha a ngamh lo caah a fanu pahnih hna he khan tlang ah an i thawn i cuka ah cun lungkua chungah an um.","title":"Moab Mi Hna le Ammon Mi Hna An Chuahkehnak"},"31":{"text":"A fanu upa deuh nih khan ngakchia deuh cu a thawh i, “Kan pa hi a tar cang i a ningcang in fa kan ngeih khawhnak dingah vawlei cungah hin ahohmanh vat awk pa an um ti lo."},"32":{"text":"Cucaah cun, ra law, zu kan ritter lai i kan ihpi lai i amah thawng cun fa kan ngei lai,” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun zu cu an dinh i a fanu upa deuh nih khan a ihpi, sihmanhsehlaw a rit tuk caah cucu a hngal lo."},"34":{"text":"A thaizing ah upa u nih khan ngakchia u cu a thawh i, “Zahan ah khan kan pa cu ka ihpi cang; tu zan ah hin ritter rih u sih law ka tuah bantuk khan nang nih va tuah ve. Cun kan pahnih in kan pa thawngin tefa kan ngei veve lai,” a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cucaah cu zan ah cun zu cu an ritter ṭhan i a ngakchia deuh nih khan a ihpi ve. Cu zan zong cu a rit tuk caah cucu a hngal lo."},"36":{"text":"Cuticun Lot fanu pahnih hna cu an pa thawngin fa an pawi."},"37":{"text":"A upa deuh nih khan fapa a hrin in a min ah Moab a sak. Amah cu atu Moab mi a hringsortu hna hi a si."},"38":{"text":"A ngakchia deuh zong nih khan fapa a hrin ve i a min ah Ben-ammi a sak. Amah cu atu Ammon mi a hringsortu hna hi a si."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham cu Mamre khan Negeb ram leiah aa thawn i Kadesh le Shur karlak ah khan a um. Gerar i a um lioah khan","title":"Abraham le Abimelek Kong","ref":"Heb 11.9,13; Lam 7.16"},"2":{"text":"a nupi Sarah cu ka far a si tiah a ti. Cucaah Gerar siangpahrang Abimelek nih khan a sinah Sarah cu ratpi u, tiah a ti hna."},"3":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun a mang ah Pathian cu a sinah a lang i, “Sarah hi va ngeimi a si caah nan thi lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abimelek nih khan a naih hmanh a naih lo i cucaah, “Bawipa, a sual lomi cu na ka thah ko lai maw?"},"5":{"text":"Abraham nih pei aa thawh i, ‘Ka far a si,’ a ti cu, cu hleiah, amah hrim zong nih pei, ‘Ka ṭa a si,’ a ti cu. Mah hihi lung thiang tein ka tuah i zeihmanh ka palhnak a um lo,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Pathian nih cun a mang ah khan a vun leh i, “A si, lung thiang tein na tuah ti kha ka hngalh; cucaah cun pei ka cungah na sual sual lai tiah a tongh hmanh kan tonghter lo cu."},"7":{"text":"Asinain atu cu minu kha a va sinah kirter ṭhan. A va cu profet a si i thla an campiak lai i na thi lai lo. Sihmanhsehlaw na kirter ṭhan lo ahcun, nangmah le na innchungkhar kha nan thi dih lai, tiah ralrinnak kan pek,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing zingkate ah Abimelek nih a sinum vialte kha a kawh hna i hi thil vialte kha a chimh hna i an thin a phang ngaingai."},"9":{"text":"Cun Abimelek nih Abraham kha a auh i, “Kan cung i na tuahmi hi zeidah a si? Zei palhnak dah na cungah ka tuah i hi ṭhat lonak nganpi hi kan cungah tlunter na zalh? Ka cung i na tuahmi hi ahohmanh nih a tuah awk a si hrimhrim lo."},"10":{"text":"Zeicahdah mah hihi na tuah?” tiah a hal."},"11":{"text":"Abraham nih cun a leh ve i, “Hika ah hin Pathian a ṭihmi pakhat hmanh an um lai lo i ka nupi duh ah hin keimah tu kha an ka thah lai tiah ka rak ruah caah a si."},"12":{"text":"Amah cu ka far cu a si taktak, ka pa fanu cu a si nain ka nu fanu cu a si lo, cucaah ka ṭhit."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih ka pa inn in ram dang i a ka kalter tikah, amah cu ka thawh i, ‘Ka cung i zumhawktlak tein na tuah dingmi rian pakhat na ngei, cucu khuazeika kan kalnak hmanh ah, ka ṭa a si, na ka ti lai,’ ka ti,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Abimelek nih khan Abraham cu Sarah kha a pek ṭhan i tuu le sal zong kha a pek chih hna."},"15":{"text":"Abraham cu a thawh i, “Ka ram chung khuazeika hmanh ah hin na duhnak paoh ah na um kho,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Sarah kha a thawh i, “Na ṭa cu ngun tangka phar thong khat ka pek lai i cucu na sin i a ummi vialte hna sinah, na thiang ti langhternak caah a si lai; sualnak zeihmanh na tuah lo kha an dihlak in an hngalh lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Abraham nupi Sarah cung i a tlungmi thil ruangah khan Bawipa nih Abimelek inn chung i a ummi nu vialte kha fa ngei kho loin a tuah dih hna. Cucaah Abraham nih Abimelek kha thla a campiak i Pathian nih a damter. A nupi le a salnu hna zong kha a damter hna i fa an ngei kho ṭhan.","merge":"18"}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih bia aa kam bang khan Sarah cu a bawmh i","title":"Isak Chuahnak (Heb 11.11)"},"2":{"text":"fa a pawi i Abraham kha a tar hnuah fapa a hrinpiak. An fapa cu Pathian nih a chimmi caan te ah khan a chuak.","ref":"Heb 11.11"},"3":{"text":"Abraham nih a min ah Isak a sak."},"4":{"text":"Isak cu ni riat a si tikah, Pathian nih a fial bang khan Abraham nih cun a cuarpar a tan.","ref":"Gen 17.12; Lam 7.8"},"5":{"text":"Isak a chuah ah Abraham cu kum za khat a si."},"6":{"text":"Sarah nih cun aa thawh i, “Pathian nih lawmhnak le nihnak a ka pek. Cu kong a theimi paoh nih an ka nihpi lai,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Ahohmanh nih Abraham cu, Sarah nih fano a cawm te hna lai, tiah an rak chim kho lai lo. Asinain a tar lei sang ah fapa pakhat ka hrinpiak ko,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Ngakchia cu a ṭhang i a hnuk thlah ni ah Abraham nih puai nganpi a serpiak."},"9":{"text":"Ni khat cu Izipt minu Hagar nih Abraham a hrinpiakmi fapa Ishmael kha Sarah fapa Isak he cun lente an i celh.","title":"Hagar le Ishmael A Ṭhawl Hna"},"10":{"text":"Cucu Sarah nih a hmuh i, “Hi salnu le a fapa hi ṭhawl hna. Ka fapa Isak nih a co awk hnga a simi na chawva vialte hi, hi salnu fapa nih hin a tinco ve awk a si hrimhrim lo,” a ti.","ref":"Gal 4.29-30"},"11":{"text":"Hi nih hin Abraham cu a lungre a theihter ngaingai, zeicahtiah Ishmael zong cu a fapa a si ve."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih Abraham cu a thawh i, “Ngakchiapa le na sal Hagar kongah lungrethei in um hlah. Sarah nih an chimhmi paoh cu tuah ko, zeicahtiah tefa kan kamhmi cu Isak chung hin an chuak lai.","ref":"Rom 9.7; Heb 11.18"},"13":{"text":"Na salnu fapa zong kha tefa tampi ka pek ve lai i miphun pakhat an tling ve lai, amah zong cu na fapa pei a si cu,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"A thaizing cu zingka tein Abraham nih Hagar cu rawl tlawmpal le saphaw tithawl ti a khat tein a ummi kha a pek i nau kha a puakter i a kalter hna. Hagar cu Beer-sheba ramlak ah khan a vai lengmang."},"15":{"text":"Ti cu a dih tikah ngakchia cu burbuk pakhat toiah a chiahtak i"},"16":{"text":"lam hla nawn, thal kah phak hrawng khin a hngah. “Ngakchia a thih cu ka hmu ngam lo,” a ti i cuka i a ṭhut lioah cun fak piin a ṭap."},"17":{"text":"Pathian nih ngakchiapa a ṭah cu a run theih i vancung in Pathian vancungmi nih khan Hagar cu a run chawnh i, “Hagar, zeicahdah na lungre a theih? Na thinphang hlah. Pathian nih ngakchiapa a ṭah kha a theih cang."},"18":{"text":"Tho law va kal law va cawi law va pom. A tefa cu miphun nganpi ah ka ser hna lai,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Hagar cu a mit kha khua a hun hmuhter i tikhor pakhat a hmuh. A va kal i ti thawl khan ti cu a va than i ngakchiapa kha a dinh."},"20":{"text":"Ngakchiapa cu Pathian nih a umpi i a ṭhang i Paran ramlak ah khan khua a sa; amah cu sakah thiam ngaimi a hung si."},"21":{"text":"A nu nih Izipt ram in nupi a ṭhitpiak."},"22":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun Abimelek cu a ralbawi ngan bik Fikol he khan Abraham sinah cun an va kal i, “Na tuahmi thil kip ah Pathian nih an umpi.","title":"Abraham le Abimelek Biakamnak","ref":"Gen 26.26"},"23":{"text":"Cucaah cun keimah siseh ka fale si hna seh ka tefa si hna seh, na kan hlen nakhnga lo Pathian hmaiah hin bia i kam. Kei cu na cungah zumhawktlak in ka um, cu bantuk cun nang zong ka cung le na umnak ram cungah hin zumhawktlak na si nakhnga bia i kam,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih, “Kaa kam,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Abraham nih Abimelek cu Abimelek sinum pawl nih an chuhmi tikhor kong kha a chimh."},"26":{"text":"Abimelek nih cun, “Cucu ka hngal lo. Na rak ka chim lo i atu hi ka theih hmasa bik a si,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih Abimelek cu tuu le caw tlawmpal a pek i an pahnih in biakamnak an ser."},"28":{"text":"Abraham nih tuufa pasarih kha a tuurun chungin a dang tein a chiah hna i"},"29":{"text":"cucu Abimelek nih, “Zeicahdah kha ti khan na tuah?” tiah a hal."},"30":{"text":"Abraham nih cun, “Hi tuufa pasarih hi na ka cohlan hrimhrim hna lai. Zeicahtiah cu ti na ka cohlannak nih cun, hi tikhor a cotu hi keimah ka si kha a langhter lai,” tiah a leh."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah cuka hmun cu a min ah Beer-sheba ti a si, zeicahtiah an pahnih in biakamnak an tuahnak cu cuka ah cun a si."},"32":{"text":"Beer-sheba ah biakamnak kha an tuah dih cun, Abimelek le a ralbawi ngan bik Fikol cu Filistin mi hna ram ah khan an kir ṭhan."},"33":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih Beer-sheba ah cun thingkung pakhat a phun i Bawipa, Zungzal Hmunmi Pathian kha a biak."},"34":{"text":"Filistin mi hna ram ah cun Abraham cu saupi a um."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun Pathian nih Abraham kha a hneksak i, “Abraham,” tiah a ti i Abraham nih, “ Bawipa, na chimmi bia ka ngai ko,” tiah a leh.","title":"Isak Thawinak","ref":"Heb 11.17-19"},"2":{"text":"Pathian nih cun a thawh i, “Na fapa, fapa pakhat lawngte na ngeihmi Isak na dawtmi kha i lak law Moriah ram ah va kal. Cuka ah cun kan hmuhsak laimi tlang cungah khangh thawinak ah na khangh lai,” a ti.","ref":"2Cha 3.1"},"3":{"text":"A thaizing cu zingka tein Abraham nih a laa kha a dan a danh i Isak le a sinum pahnih hna he tiah an kal. Thawinak ding caah cun thing tlawmpal a hlam i Bawipa nih a chimhmi hmun leiah khan kal aa thawh."},"4":{"text":"A ni thum ni ah Abraham nih cun cu hmun cu lamhlatpi khin a hei hmuh."},"5":{"text":"Cun a sinum pawl cu a thawh hna i, “Nannih cu hika ah hin rak um u. Khika ah khin Pathian va biak awkah ngakchiapa le keimah hi kan va kal lai i kan va biak dih in nan sinah kan ra kir ṭhan lai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih khanghthawinak ca ding thing cu Isak kha a phorhter i amah nih mei le nam kha a put hna. Cuticun hmunkhat ah an pahnih cun an kal."},"7":{"text":"Isak nih khan a pa cu, “Ka pa,” tiah a ti i a pa nih cun, “Hawi, ka fapa,” tiah a leh.
