Isak nih cun, “Mei le thing cu an um, sihmanhsehlaw khanghthawinak ca ding tuufa tah khuazei ah dah a si kun?” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Abraham nih cun, “Pathian nih a khan te ko lai, ka fapa,” tiah a leh i cuticun an pahnih cun hmunkhat ah an kal lengmang."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa nih a chimhmi hmun kha an phak tikah, Abraham nih biakṭheng pakhat a ser i a cungah thing kha a chiah. A fapa cu a ṭem i biakṭheng cung thing cungah cun a chiah.","ref":"Jei 2.21"},"10":{"text":"Cun ka thah lai tiah nam a vun i lak ah khin"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi nih vancung in a run auh i, “Abraham, Abraham!” tiah a ti. Abraham nih, “Asi, hika ah ka um ko,” tiah a leh."},"12":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun, “Ngakchiapa kha fahnak zeihmanh pe hlah, a cungah zeihmanh zong tuah fawn hlah. Fapa pakhat lawngte na ngeihmi hmanh pek sian loin na ka um lo caah Pathian nawl ngaih cu na duh ngaingai ti kha ka hngalh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Abraham cu khua a hei hoi i tuukawng pakhat burbuk lak i a ki in a rak taan ko kha a hmuh. A hei fuh i a va lak i a fapa can ah khanghthawinak ah cun a thawi."},"14":{"text":"Abraham nih cu hmun cu, “ Bawipa nih a khaan ko,” tiah min a sak i atu chan tiang zongin mi nih, “ Bawipa tlang cungah cun Bawipa nih a khaan ko,” an ti tawn."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi nih Abraham cu vancung in a voi hnihnak a run kawh ṭhan i,"},"16":{"text":"“Keimah nih keimah min hrimhrim in biakamnak ka ser lai — hihi Bawipa chimmi bia a si — fapa pakhat lawngte na ngeihmi kha pek sian loin na ka um lo caah thluachuah tam piin kan pek lai.","ref":"Heb 6.13-14"},"17":{"text":"Van i arfi zat le rili kam i thetse zat khin tefa kan pek lai. Na tefa nih cun an ral kha an tei hna lai.","ref":"Heb 11.12"},"18":{"text":"Cun vawlei cung miphun vialte nih, na tefa thluachuah ka pek hna bantuk hin thluachuah kan pe ve, tiah an ka nawl lai — hi vialte cu nangmah nih ka nawl na ngaih caah a si,” a ti.","ref":"Lam 3.25"},"19":{"text":"Cun Abraham cu a sinum hna sinah khan a kir i Beer-sheba ah khan hmun khat ah an tlung ṭi i cuka ah cun khua a sa."},"20":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun Abraham nih a nau Nahor nih khan Milkah he fa an hrin hna ti kha a theih:"},"21":{"text":"Uz cu fapa upa bik a si, a nau ah Buz a si, cun Aram pa Kemuel a si,"},"22":{"text":"cun Khesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaf le Bethuel an si."},"23":{"text":"(Bethuel cu Rebekah pa kha a si). Milkah nih Abraham nau Nahor kha hi fapa pariat hi a hrinpiak hna."},"24":{"text":"Nahor nupi a pahnihnak Reumah nih, Tebah, Gaham, Tahash le Maakah a hrin hna."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sarah cu kum za kum kul le kum sarih a nung i","title":"Sarah A Thi I Abraham Nih Thlan A Cawk"},"2":{"text":"Kanaan ram chung Kiriath-arba khua ah a thi (Kiriath-arba cu Hebron ti zongah ti a si). Abraham nih khan a ruak tuamhlawmnak ding cu a tuah i a ṭah."},"3":{"text":"Cun a thimi a nupi cu a kaltak i Hit mi hna sinah khan a va kal i,"},"4":{"text":"“Kei cu hika ah hin ramdangmi le a lang i a ra um tami ka si. Cucaah nan vawlei tlawmpal cu kan i vuinak ding caah ka zuarh u law ka duh, ka nupi cu cuka ah cun ka vui khawh nakhnga,” a ti.","ref":"Heb 11.9,13; Lam 7.16"},"5":{"text":"Annih nih an leh i, “Bawipa, kan bia kan ngai."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan lakah a ṭhawngmi bawi pakhat na si; kan ngeihmi thlan lak i a ṭha bik ah na mithi cu vui ko. Ahohmanh nih an ngeihmi thlan cu sianh loin an in um lai lo i na mithi vui cu an in dawn lai lo,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cu tikah Abraham cu a dir i an hmaiah a kun i,"},"8":{"text":"“Hika ah hin ka nupi cu vui seh ti nan ka duh a si ahcun, Hit mi Efron, Zohar fapa kha ka nawlpiak u law"},"9":{"text":"amah ta a simi Makpelah lungkua kha ka zuarh seh. Cu lungkua cu a lo kam i a ummi a si. Nan hmaika hrimhrim ah hin a man tling tein a ka zuarh nakhnga ka nawlpiak u law kei nih vuinak hmun kaa ngeih ve lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Efron zong cu Hit mi hna sinah pumhnak hmun khua hauka ah khan a ṭhu ko i cuka i a ummi vialte theih ah cun,"},"11":{"text":"“Bawipa, cuticun a si lai lo, lo le a chung i a ummi lungkua cu an dihlak in nangmah kan pek lai. Ka mi hna an hmaika hrimhrim ah hin nangmah cu kan pek lai i na nupi cu na vui lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abraham cu mi zapi hmaiah cun a kun i"},"13":{"text":"mi vialte nih thei kho hna seh tiin Efron cu a thawh i, “Na duh ning cun si sawh seh; cucaah cun ka bia hi ngai tuah: lo cu a ningpi in kan cawk lai. Cun a man kan pekmi cu ka cohlang law ka nupi cu cuka ah cun ka vui lai,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Efron nih cun a hun leh ve i,"},"15":{"text":"“Bawipa, nang le kei kar ah cu ram ngun tangka phar za li man thamtham cu zeidah a va si. Na nupi cu cu lo chungah cun va vui ko,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Abraham cu a hna a tla ve i Hit mi hna theih hngan i Efron nih cu zat in si seh a timi zat khan Abraham nih cun a thlai — chawdawr pawl nih an thlai ningin ngun tangka phar za li a si."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun Mamre nichuahlei i a ummi Makpelah lo Efron ta a rak simi kha, Abraham thil ah a cang; a lo he a chung i a ummi lungkua he, thingkung vialte he, Abraham ta ah an cang dih."},"18":{"text":"Pumhnak i aa telmi Hit mi vialte nih khan cu lo cu Abraham ta a si cang ti kha an hngalhpi."},"19":{"text":"Cun Abraham nih khan a nupi cu hi lungkua, Kanaan ram chung i a ummi lungkua ah cun a vui."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun Hit mi hna ta a rak simi lo le a chung lungkua kha vuinak hmun caah Abraham ta ah an cang."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham cu a tar ngaingai cang i a thil tuahmi kip ah khan Bawipa nih thluachuahnak a pek.","title":"Isak Nupi Halnak le Ṭhitnak"},"2":{"text":"A sal upa bik, a ngeihmi thil vialte a zohkhenhtu kha a thawh i, “Ka phei tangah na kut chia law bia i kam."},"3":{"text":"Van le vawlei uktu Pathian Bawipa min in chiatser in, ka sinah bia i kam ti kan duh. Cu bia kamter kan duhmi cu hihi a si: atu i ka umnak Kanaan ram mi hi ka fapa Isak nupi caah na ṭhi hrimhrim hna lai lo."},"4":{"text":"Ka chuahkehnak ram ah khan na va kal lai i ka rualchan hna chung khan ka fapa Isak caah cun nupi na va ṭhit lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"A salpa nih cun a thawh i, “Hika ram lei rat awkah ngaknu nih cun an inn cu kaltak duh hlah seh law tah zeitindah ka tuah hnga? Na fapa cu maw na chuahkehnak ram ah cun ka kirter ṭhan hnga?” tiah a hal."},"6":{"text":"Abraham nih cun, “Ka fapa cu cuka ah cun na kirter hrimhrim hnga lo."},"7":{"text":"Vancung Pathian Bawipa nih, ka pa inn le ka sahlawh le ka rualchan vialte hna sinin a ka chuahpi i, hi ram hi na tefa ka pek hna lai, tiah chiatser tein bia a ka kam. A vancungmi kha na hmaiah a thlah lai i cuka ah cun ka fapa caah nupi ding na va hmuh ko lai."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nu nih khan an zulh duh lo ahcun, ka sin i bia naa kammi na luat lai. A zei si hmanh ah, ka fapa cu a kir bel cu ram ah cun na kirpi bal hnga lo,” tiah a leh."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah a salpa nih cun a bawipa Abraham phei tangah cun a kut kha a chiah i a fialmi kha tuah dingin bia aa kam."},"10":{"text":"A salpa nih cun a bawipa kalauk chungin pahra kha a lak hna i laksawng man sungsung kha aa phorh hna i Mesopotamia ram Nahor khua i kal awkah cun aa thawh."},"11":{"text":"A va phak tikah, khua pawng i a ummi tikhor pawngah khan a kalauk cu a bawhter hna. Cu caan cu zanlei sang, nu nih ti than awk i an rat caan khi a si."},"12":{"text":"Cun thla a cam i, “ Bawipa, ka bawipa Abraham i a Pathian, nihin ah hin hlawhtlinnak ka pe law ka bawipa sin i bia na kammi kha hmunhter ko."},"13":{"text":"Atu ah hin khua chung ngaknu nih ti an rung thannak ding tikhor ah hin ka um i hi tikah"},"14":{"text":"ngaknu kha ka thawh i, ‘Zaangfahnak in na ti-um kha vun ṭhum law ti din awk ka pe tuah,’ ka ti i, ‘Ding hen, na kalauk hna zong kha ti ka pek hna lai,’ a timi cu, na sal Isak ca i na thimmi si seh. Cu bantuk thil a si ahcun, ka bawipa sin i na biakamnak kha a hmun tiah ka hngalh lai,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"A thlacam a dih hlanah khin Rebekah kha a ti-um cu a liang ah a run i khinh i a ra. Rebekah cu Bethuel fanu kha a si, Bethuel cu Milkah fapa kha a si i Milkah cu Abraham nau Nahor nupi kha a si."},"16":{"text":"Rebekah cu ngaknu a si i aa dawh ngaingai. Tikhor ah cun a vung kal i a um khat cun ti cu a vung than i a hung chuak ṭhan."},"17":{"text":"Abraham salpa nih khan a hei tlikhnawh i, “Zaangfahnak tein na um chung ti kha din awkah ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Rebekah nih cun, “Ding hen, bawipa,” a ti i a ti-um cu a liang cung cun a vun ṭhumh i a tlaih bu khan a dinter."},"19":{"text":"A din dih in Rebekah nih khan, “Na kalauk hna ca zongah hin ka vung than lai i cim tein ding hna seh,” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Saṭil ti dinnak kuang ah khan a ti cu a bungh i tikhor chungah cun a vung tli ṭhan i a kalauk kha an tihal a riamh cikcek hlantiang ti cu a thanpiak hna."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa nih ka khualtlawnnak ah hin hlawhtlinnak a ka pe maw pe lo tiin mipa nih khan Rebekah cu dai tein a zoh ko."},"22":{"text":"Kalauk kha ti a dinh dih hna hnuah Abraham salpa nih khan a man a fak ngaimi sui hnartonh pakhat kha aa chuah i a hnar ah cun a tonh, cun sui kuthrolh ngan pipi pahnih zong aa chuah i a kut ah khan a hrolh hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun ngaknu cu a thawh i, “Ahodah na pa a si, ka chim tuah. Na pa inn ah cun keimah le ka mi hna caah riahnak hmun a um hnga maw?” tiah a hal."},"24":{"text":"Ngaknu nih cun, “Nahor le Milkah fapa Bethuel fanu ka si,” tiah a leh."},"25":{"text":"“Kan inn ah cun ramro le saṭil rawl zong tampi a um i nanmah riahnak ca hmun zong a um ko,” a ti fawn."},"26":{"text":"Cun Abraham salpa nih cun a khuk aa bil i Bawipa kha a biak."},"27":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Ka bawipa Abraham i a Pathian, ka bawipa sin i a biakam let lo tein a ummi cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Bawipa nih ka bawipa i a unau inn ah ding tein a ka hruai ko,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Ngaknu cu a nu inn ah khan a va tli i cu kong cu a dihlak in a chimh dih."},"29":{"text":"Rebekah ṭa Laban kha, mipa umnak tikhor lei i va kal awkah cun lengah khan a tli."},"30":{"text":"A hnartonh le a far kut i a kuthrolh kha a hmuh hna i a far nih mipa nih a ka chimh a timi a chimmi zong kha a theih tikah Abraham salpa, a kalauk hna pawng i a dirnak tikhor ah khan a va kal."},"31":{"text":"Amah cu, “ Bawipa, ra lut tuah. Nangmah cu Bawipa nih thluachuah an pekmipa na si. Zeicahdah lengah cun na um ko. Kan inn chungah nangmah caah hmun pakhat kan sersiampiak cang i na kalauk hna ca zongah hmun a um ko,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cucaah mipa cu inn chungah khan a lut i Laban nih khan kalauk cu an thil a ṭhumh hna i ramro le rawl kha a pek hna. Cun Abraham salpa le a mi hna ke ṭawlnak caah ti a rak put."},"33":{"text":"Rawl kha an hun hunh hna, sihmanhsehlaw mipa nih khan aa thawh i, “Ka rathnawh chanmi thil ka chim hlanah cun ka ei lai lo,” a ti. Laban nih, “Chim ko,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Abraham salpa nih cun aa thawh i, “Kei cu Abraham sal ka si."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa nih ka bawipa cu thluachuahnak tampi a pek i mi lianngan pakhat ah a ser. Tuurun le mehehrun le caw le sui le ngun le salnu le salpa le kalauk le laa kha a pek hna."},"36":{"text":"Cun ka bawipa nupi Sarah nih khan ka bawipa cu a tar toiah fapa pakhat a hrinpiak i ka bawipa nih a fapa cu a ngeihmi thil vialte kha a pek dih."},"37":{"text":"A nawlbia kha ngaih awkah chiatserh tein bia a ka kamter i cu biakam ah cun hitihin a ti: ‘Ka umnak Kanaan ram ngaknu hna chungin ka fapa caah nupi na hal hrimhrim lai lo."},"38":{"text":"Ka pa miphun, ka sahlawh ka rualchan hna sinah na kal lo i cu hna sinin ka fapa caah nupi na ṭhit lo a si ahcun, na cungah chiatnak tlung seh,’ a ka ti."},"39":{"text":"Cun ka bawipa cu ka thawh i, ‘Nu nih cun a ka zulh duh lo ah tah, zeitindah a si hnga, ka ti."},"40":{"text":"A ka leh i, ‘Amah nawl ka ngaih zungzalmi Bawipa nih a vancungmi kha na sinah a kalter lai i na hlawh a tling ko lai. Ka mi hna sinin, ka pa chungkhar hna sinin ka fapa cu nupi na va hmuhpiak ko lai."},"41":{"text":"Hihi na tuah ahcun, chiat kan sertermi hin na luat lai, cun ka rualchan hna sinah na va kal i an in pek duh lo ahcun, chiat kan sertermi khan na luat ṭhiamṭhiam lai,’ a ka ti."},"42":{"text":"“Cun nihin i tikhor ka ra phak ah khan thla ka cam i, Bawipa, ka bawipa Abraham i Pathian, ka khualtlawnnak ah hin nangmah nih thluachuahnak ka pe ko."},"43":{"text":"Atu hi tikhor ah hin ka um. Ngaknu pakhatkhat tithan i an rat tikah ka rak thawh lai i, ‘Na ti-um chung khan din awk ti ka pe tuah,’ tiah ka rak ti lai i"},"44":{"text":"cu i anih nih, ‘Ding hen, cun na kalauk hna zong kha ti ka dinh hna lai,’ a ti ahcun, cu ngaknu cu Bawipa nih ka bawipa fapa nupi ca i a thimmi si seh, ka ti."},"45":{"text":"Ka lung chungin thla ka cammi a dih hlanah cun, Rebekah kha a ti-um a liang ah run i khinh in a ra i tithan ah cun tikhor chungah khan a vung ṭum. Amah cu ka rak chawnh i, ‘Zaangfahnak in ti din awk ka pe tuah,’ ka ti."},"46":{"text":"Khulrang in a ti-um cu a liang cung khan a ṭhumh i, ‘Ding hen, na kalauk hna zong kha ka dinh hna lai,’ a ti. Cuticun ka din i ka kalauk hna zong cu ti cu a dinh hna."},"47":{"text":"Ngaknu cu ka thawh i, ‘Ahodah na pa a si?’ ka ti. A ka leh i, ‘Nahor le Milkah fapa Bethuel i fanu ka si,’ a ti. Cun a hnar ah khan hnartonh ka tonh i a kut ah khan kuthruk kha ka hruk hna."},"48":{"text":"Ka khuk kaa bil i Bawipa kha ka biak, cun lam ṭha tein a ka hruaitu Pathian, ka bawipa Abraham i a Bawipa kha ka thangṭhat. Amah nih cun ka bawipa i a unau inn ah hin a ka hruai i a fanu kha ka Bawipa fapa caah cun ka hmuh cang."},"49":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka bawipa cungah hin a phung ning bantukin rian cu kan ṭuan lai nan ti ahcun ka chim u; cun kan ṭuan hnga lo nan ti ahcun ka chim fawn ko u, cuticun lung i thleh awk kaa hngal lai,” a ti."},"50":{"text":"Laban le Bethuel nih cun, “Hi thil hi Bawipa sinin a rami a si caah kannih nih biakhiahnak hi kan tuah awk a si hnga lo."},"51":{"text":"Hika ah pei Rebekah cu a um ve ko hi; i lak law i kalpi ko. Bawipa hrimhrim nih a chim bang cun, na bawipa fapa nupi cu va si ko seh,” tiin an leh."},"52":{"text":"An bia cu Abraham salpa nih khan a theih tikah vawlei lei hoih in a kun i Bawipa kha a biak."},"53":{"text":"Cun sui hlawn le ngun hlawn le hnipuan kha a chuah hna i Rebekah kha a pek hna. A ṭa le a nu zong kha a man a fakmi laksawng a pek hna."},"54":{"text":"Cun Abraham salpa le a mi hna nih cun rawl cu an ei i an din i cu zan cu cuka ah cun an riak. A thaizing an thawh tikah salpa nih khan, “Ka bawipa sinah ka tlunter cang u,” a ti."},"55":{"text":"Asinain a nu le a ṭa nih khan, “Ngaknu cu kan sinah zarh khat maw ni hra in dik um rih ko seh. Cun a kal te lai,” an ti."},"56":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih a thawh hna i, “Ka camter hlah u. Bawipa nih ka khualtlawnnak ah hin ka hlawh a tlinter cang; cucaah cun ka bawipa sinah ka kirter ko u,” a ti."},"57":{"text":"Annih nih, “Ngaknu kha au u si law zeitindah a ti ve hnga, hal hmasa hnik tuah u sih,” an ti."},"58":{"text":"Cucaah Rebekah cu an auh i, “Hi pa sin kal cu na duh maw?” tiah an hal. Anih nih, “Ka duh ko, ka kal lai,” tiah a leh hna."},"59":{"text":"Cucaah an far Rebekah kha amah a cawngtu nu he Abraham salpa le a mi hna sinah cun an kalter."},"60":{"text":"Cun Rebekah cu thluachuah an pek i, “Kan farnu, nang cu mi thong tampi nu ah va cang law, Na tefa hna nih khan an ral hna khuapi kha tei hna seh,” an ti."},"61":{"text":"Cun Rebekah le a sinum ngaknu pawl cu kalauk an i cit hna i mipa sinah cun an kal; Abraham salpa nih khan Rebekah cu aa lak i an kal."},"62":{"text":"Isak cu Beer-lahai-roi ah khan a rak i thawn i Negeb rawn ah khan a um."},"63":{"text":"Ni khat cu zanlei sang ah khin tuan nawn ah ram lakah khan a vaa chawk i kalauk an rat kha a hmuh."},"64":{"text":"Cun Rebekah nih Isak kha a hei hmuh. A kalauk cung khan a ṭum i,"},"65":{"text":"Abraham salpa kha, “Khika hmun i mipa, kanmah lei i a rami khi ahodah a si?” tiah a hal. “Ka bawipa a si,” tiah a leh. Cucaah a hmaikhuhnak puan kha aa lak i a hmai cu aa khuh."},"66":{"text":"Salpa nih khan a tuahmi vialte cu Isak kha a chimh dih."},"67":{"text":"Cun Isak nih cun Rebekah cu a thlam ah aa luhpi i a nupi ah a cang. Isak nih cun Rebekah cu a dawt ngaingai i cucaah a nu thih hnuah Rebekah nih khan Isak cu a hna a ngamter ṭhan."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Abraham nih midang pakhat a ṭhit ṭhan i a min ah Keturah a si.","title":"Abraham Tefa Dang (1Cha 1.32-33)"},"2":{"text":"Keturah nih cun Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak le Shuah a hrinpiak."},"3":{"text":"Jokshan cu Sheba le Dedan pa a si, cun Dedan fapa hna cu Asshurim, Letushim, le Leummim an si."},"4":{"text":"Midian fapa hna cu Efah, Efer, Hanok, Abida le Eldaah an si. Hi hna hi an dihlak in Keturah tefa an si."},"5":{"text":"Abraham nih a ngeihmi thil vialte cu Isak kha a pek ta dih."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thih hlanah a nupi dang hna fapa hna zong kha laksawng a pek hna i nichuahlei ah a kalter hna; a fapa Isak sinin aa hlatmi ram Nichuahlei ram ah a kalter hna."},"7":{"text":"Abraham cu kum za sawm sarih le kum nga a nung.","title":"Abraham Thihnak le Vuinak"},"8":{"text":"Chan tling cikcek in a nun hnuah a thi i a phunhawi hna sinah khan pumh a si ve."},"9":{"text":"A fapa Isak le Ishmael nih khan Makpelah lungkua ah khan an vui, cu lungkua cu Mamre nichuahlei i a ummi lo, Hit mi Zohar fapa Efron ta a simi i a ummi kha a si."},"10":{"text":"Cu lo cu Abraham nih khan Hit mi hna sin cun a cawk i Abraham le a nupi Sarah cu an pahnih tein cuka ah cun vui an si.","ref":"Gen 23.3-16"},"11":{"text":"Abraham thih hnuah a fapa Isak cu Pathian nih thluachuah a pek. Isak cu Beer-lahai-roi ah khan khua a sa."},"12":{"text":"Hi hna hi Ishmael tefa kha an si, Ishmael cu Sarah salnu Izipt mi Hagar nih Abraham a hrinpiakmi fapa kha a si."},"13":{"text":"Ishmael fapa hna an min cu, an chuah ningin, aa chang lengmang in hi ning hin a si: Ishmael fapa upa bik cu Nebaioth a si, cun Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,"},"14":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa,"},"15":{"text":"Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Nafish, le Kedemah an si."},"16":{"text":"Hi hi Ishmael fapa hna cu an min cio le an khua cio le an umnak hmun cio he tiah an si — phuntungtu hleihnih le an phun cio an si."},"17":{"text":"(Ishmael cu a thih i a miphun hna sin i fonh a si ah khan kum za sawm thum le kum sarih a si.)"},"18":{"text":"Ishmael tefa cu Havilah le Shur karlak ram ah khan an um, cu ram cu Izipt ram in nichuahlei, Assiria lei lam ah khan a si. An rualchan hna he a dang in an um."},"19":{"text":"Abraham fapa Isak tefa cu hihi an si: Isak pa cu Abraham a si.","title":"Esau le Jakob Hrinnak (Rom 9.10-12)"},"20":{"text":"Isak cu Rebekah a ṭhit ah kum sawm li a si, Rebekah cu Mesopotamia ram i a ummi Aramean miphun Bethuel fanu a si i a ṭa cu Aramean miphun Laban kha a si."},"21":{"text":"Isak nupi cu fa a ngeih lo caah Isak nih cun Bawipa sinah thla a campiak. A thlacamnak cu Bawipa nih a leh i Rebekah cu fa a pawi."},"22":{"text":"A chung i a ummi faphir pa veve a simi cu pakhat le pakhat an i nam len tikah cun aa thawh i, “Hi bantukin a si ding a si ahcun, zeicahdah ka thih ko lo?” a ti. Cun Bawipa sinah a sullam hal awkah a kal i,"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a rak thawh i, “Na chungah hin miphun pahnih an um. Aa ralmi miphun phun hnih na hrin hna lai, pakhat cu a ṭhawng deuh lai i a upa deuh nih a ngakchia deuh kha a rianh lai,” a ti.","ref":"Rom 9.12"},"24":{"text":"A nithla a tlin tikah fa cu a hrin hna i faphir an si."},"25":{"text":"A chuak hmasamipa cu a sen i a cuar cu a hmulmi puan bantuk a si, cucaah a min ah Esau an sak."},"26":{"text":"Cun a nau kha a hung chuah tikah a u kedil kha fek tein aa tlaih, cucaah a min ah Jakob an sak. An chuah ah Isak cu kum sawm ruk a si."},"27":{"text":"Ngakchia cu an pahnih in an hung ṭhang, Esau cu sakah thiammi a si, ramvaih a duh ngaimi a si, sihmanhsehlaw Jakob cu midai, miholhlo, inn lawng i a ummi a si.","title":"Esau Nih Upa Sinak A Zuar"},"28":{"text":"Isak nih Esau cu a dawt deuh, zeicahtiah a sa kahmi sa kha a ei lengmang, sihmanhsehlaw Rebekah nih Jakob kha a dawt deuh ve."},"29":{"text":"Ni khat cu Jakob kha pehang a rak chuang i cu lioah cun Esau kha ram vaihnak in a ra tlung."},"30":{"text":"A rawl cu a ṭam i Jakob cu, “Ka rawl a ṭam tuk, kha thil sen kha ka khat in ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti. (Cu ruangah cun Esau cu Edom ti i min sak a sinak cu a si.)"},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jakob nih aa thawh i, “Fater na sinak kha na ka pek ahcun kan pek lai,” a ti."},"32":{"text":"Esau nih cun, “A ṭha ko, ka thih cang leh lai hi ta! Cu fater sinak ko cu a!” a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih cun, “Na fater sinak cu kan pek hrimhrim lai tiah bia i kam hmasa,” a ti. Esau nih cun biakamnak cu a ser i a fater sinak cu Jakob sinah cun a zuar.","ref":"Heb 12.16"},"34":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih changreu le pehang a pek i a ei a din hnuah a tho i a kal. Fater a sinak kha Esau nih cun zei ah a rel lo."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mangṭam a dang a tlung ṭhan, Abraham chan i hlan deuh i a tlungmi hleiah khan. Cucaah cun Isak cu Filistin mi Siangpahrang Abihmalek sin Gerar khua ah a va kal.","title":"Gerar le Beersheba Ah Isak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu Isak sinah khan a lang i, “Izipt ram ah cun vung kal hlah, um kan tinak ram tu ah um ko."},"3":{"text":"Hika ah hin tlawmpal in um ko law na sinah ka um lai i thluachuah kan pek lai i hi ram vialte hi nangmah le na tefa kha kan pek hna lai. Na pa Abraham sin i ka sermi biakamnak kha ka let lai lo.","ref":"Gen 22.16-18"},"4":{"text":"Van i arfi zat khin tefa kan pek lai i hi ram vialte hi annih cu ka pek hna lai. Na tefa thluachuah ka pek hna bantuk hin thluachuah kan pe ve tiah vawlei cung miphun vialte nih an ka hal lai."},"5":{"text":"Abraham nih khan ka nawl a ngaih i ka nawlbia vialte kha a zulh hna caah nangmah cu thluachuahnak kan pek lai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Isak cu Gerar ah khan a um."},"7":{"text":"Cuka mi hna nih a nupi kong kha an hal tikah, ka nupi a si, a ti ngam lo caah, ka far a si, a ti. Rebekah cu aa dawh ngaingai i cucaah amah an duh ruangah keimah kha cuka mi hna nih cun an ka thah lai, tiah a thin a phan caah cuticun a ti.","ref":"Gen 12.13; 20.2"},"8":{"text":"Cuka i Isak cu sau nawn a um hnuah khin, Filistin mi Siangpahrang Abimelek nih cun a thlalangawng in khua a hei cuan i Isak nih Rebekah a pom kha a hmuh."},"9":{"text":"Abimelek nih Isak cu ra seh tiah mi a hei thlah i, “Zohhmanh, na nupi a si hrimhrim lai. Zeicahdah ka far a si na ti kun?” a ti. Cun Isak nih cun, “Ka nupi a si ka ti ahcun an ka thah lai ti ka phan caah a si,” ti in a leh."},"10":{"text":"Abimelek nih cun, “Kan cung i na tuahmi hi zeidah a si ruat hmanh. Ka mi pakhatkhat nih na nupi cu an ihpi sual ko hnga i kan cung i sualnak a tluntertu cu nangmah na si hnga,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Abimelek nih khan mi cu an dihlak in nawl a pek hna i, “Hi mipa siseh, a nupi siseh, an cungah ṭhat lonak a tuah mi cu thah nan si lai,” a ti hna."},"12":{"text":"Cu ram ah cun Isak nih thlaici a tuh i cu kum ah cun a tuhmi thlaici a let za khat in a zun; cucu Bawipa nih thluachuah a pek caah a si."},"13":{"text":"A ṭhangcho chin lengmang i mirum ngaingai ah a cang."},"14":{"text":"Tuurun tampi le cawrun tampi le sal tampi a ngeih hna caah Filistin mi nih khan an nahchuah."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah cun a pa Abraham a nun lio i Abraham salle nih an cawhmi tikhor vialte kha an chilh dih hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun Abimelek nih Isak cu a thawh i, “Kan kaltak cang. Kanmah nakin na ṭhawng tuk cang,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Isak cu a kal i Gerar nelrawn ah khan khua a sa."},"18":{"text":"A pa Abraham a nun lio i Abraham salle pawl nih an rak cawhmi tikhor, Filistin mi nih an chilh dihmi kha a cawh ṭhan hna. Isak nih cun a pa nih min a rak bunhmi ṭhiamṭhiam kha a bunh hna."},"19":{"text":"Nelrawn chungah cun Isak salle nih cun tikhor pakhat an cawh i cerh pakhat an hmuh."},"20":{"text":"Gerar khua saṭil khal hna le Isak saṭil khal hna cu an i si i bu khat nih, “Hi ti hi kanmah ta a si,” an ti, a dang bu khat ve nih, “Kanmah ta a si,” an ti ve. Cucaah cu tikhor cu a min ah Isak nih Esek a sak; amah he an i sik ruangah cun."},"21":{"text":"Isak salle pawl nih cun tikhor a dang pakhat an cawh ṭhan i cu kongah cun siknak a um ṭhiamṭhiam, cucaah a min ah, Sitnah a sak."},"22":{"text":"Cuka hmun cun aa ṭhial i tikhor a dang pakhat a cawh ṭhan. Cu kong ah cun siknak a um lo, cucaah a min ah Rehoboth a sak. Aa thawh i, “Atu cu hi ram chungah hin Bawipa nih luatnak a kan pek cang i hika hmun ah hin kan ṭhangcho cang lai,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Mah ka hmun cu Isak nih a chuahtak i Beersheba ah a kal."},"24":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun Bawipa kha a sinah a lang i, “Kei cu na pa Abraham Pathian kha ka si. Na thinphang hlah, keimah nih kan umpi ko. Ka sal Abraham ruangah thluachuahnak kan pek lai i tefa tampi kan pek lai,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Isak nih biakṭheng pakhat a ser i Bawipa cu a biak. Cun cuka ah cun a thlam kha a bunh i a salle nih khan tikhor pakhat an cawh."},"26":{"text":"Abimelek cu a fimchimtu Ahuzzath le a ralbawi Fikol he tiah Isak ton awkah Gerar khua in an ra.","title":"Isak le Abimelek Biakamnak","ref":"Gen 21.22"},"27":{"text":"Isak nih cun a rak thawh i, “Hlan vial ah na ka rem lo i na ram in na ka dawi, zeicahdah atu ah keimah ton awkah na rat?” a rak ti."},"28":{"text":"Annih nih cun, “Atu cu Pathian nih an umpi kha kan hngalh i nangmah le kanmah karlak ah biakamnak a fekmi a um awk a herh tiah kan ruah."},"29":{"text":"Na cungah harnak zeihmanh kan tuah lo bantukin nang zong nih kan cungah na tuah nakhnga lo bia i kam ti kan in duh. Na cungah zaangfahnak kan rak ngei i dai tein kan in kalter. Atu cu Bawipa nih thluachuah an pek cang,” an ti."},"30":{"text":"Isak nih puai a tuahpiak hna i an ei i an ding."},"31":{"text":"A thaizing cu zingka tein an tho i chiatser in biakamnak cu an tuah veve. Isak nih, dam tein va kal cang u, a ti hna i a sinin dai tein an i ṭhen."},"32":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun Isak cu a salle nih tikhor an cawhmi kong cu an ra chimh. “Ti kan hmuh cang,” tiah an ti i"},"33":{"text":"cucaah cu tikhor cu a min ah Shibah a sak. Cucaah cun pei cu khua cu Beer-sheba tiah ti a si rih cu."},"34":{"text":"Esau cu Hit mi Beeri fanu Judith a ṭhit ah kum sawm li a si. Cun Hit mi Elon fanu Basemath zong kha a ṭhit fawn."},"35":{"text":"Isak le Rebekah cu an lung an lawmh loter ngaite hna."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isak cu a tar cang i a mit khua a hmu ti lo. A fapa upa deuh Esau kha a auh i, “Ka fapa,” tiah a ti i, Esau nih, “Hawi,” a ti.","title":"Jakob Nih Thluachuah A Co"},"2":{"text":"Isak nih cun a thawh i, “Ka tar i ka thi chom cang lai."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah cun na hriam, na li le na thal kha i lak hna law ram va vai law sa va ka kahpiak."},"4":{"text":"Cun ka duh tawnmi rawl kha thaw tein ka chuanpiak law ra ka pe. Ka ei lai i ka thih hlanah ka thluachuahnak hmanung bik cu kan pek lai,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Isak nih a fapa Esau bia a ruah cu Rebekah nih khan a rak ngaih hna. Esau cu a pa ram vaihpiak awk i a kal tikah,"},"6":{"text":"Rebekah nih khan Jakob cu a thawh i, “Tu naite ah khan na pa nih Esau cu,"},"7":{"text":"‘Sa ka kahpiak law rawl ka chuanpiak. Ka ei lai i ka thih hlanah Bawipa hmaiah ka thluachuahnak cu kan pek lai,’ a ti kha ka theih."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka fapa, ka bia ngai law kan chimhning paoh in tuah."},"9":{"text":"Mehehrun lakah khan va kal law meheh no a thaumi pahnih in va ka lakpiak, cun ka chuan hna lai i na pa nih a duhmi rawl ah khan ka ser hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Na pa cu na hei chanh lai i a ei lai i a thih hlanah a thluachuahnak kha an pek lai,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jakob nih cun a nu cu, “Esau cu mi hmulruh a si i kei cu mi cuarnal ka si kha na hngalh."},"12":{"text":"Ka pa nih ka tawng sual seh law ka hlen kha a hngalh lai; cucaah cun thluachuahnak cu chim loin chiatsernak tu ka cungah kaa tlunter sual hnga maw,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"A nu nih cun, “Ka fapa na cung i chiatsernak naa tlunter sual a si le cu chiatsernak cu keimah cung tu ah tlung ko seh. Ka chim bantuk hin va tuah ko, va kal law meheh cu va ka lakpiak ko hna,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah cun a va kal i a sinah cun a ratpi hna i a pa nih a duhmi rawl ah khan a chuan hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun Rebekah nih Esau thil ṭha bikbik, an inn chung i a chiahmi kha, a lak hna i Jakob kha a aihter hna."},"16":{"text":"Meheh phaw cu Jakob kut le a hmul a um lonak a hngawng ah khan a benh hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun thaw ngaingai in a chuanmi rawl le changreu a sermi cu a pek."},"18":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a pa sinah cun a vung kal i, “Ka pa,” tiah a vun ti i a pa nih, “Hawi,” tiah a rak leh. “Ka fapa pahnih lak i aho deuh kha dah na si?” tiah a ti i"},"19":{"text":"Jakob nih cun, “Na fapa upa deuh Esau kha ka si. Na ka chimhmi kha ka tuah cang. Tho law ka rak in putmi sa hi ei law thluachuahnak cu ka pe tuah,” tiah a leh."},"20":{"text":"Isak nih cun, “Zeitindah cu tluk khulrang in na hmuh khawh, ka fapa?” tiah a ti i Jakob nih, “ Bawipa na Pathian nih a ka bawmh caah a si,” tiah a leh."},"21":{"text":"Isak nih Jakob cu, “Rak ka naih deuh law kan tawng tuah lai. Ka fapa Esau na si taktak maw si taktak lo?” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jakob nih khan a pa cu a hei naih i a pa nih cun a rak tongh i, “Na aw cu Jakob aw a si ṭung, na ban cu Esau ban a si ṭung,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jakob cu a ban kha Esau ban bantukin a hmul caah a hngal kho lo. A thluachuahnak kha pek a vun i thawk cang nain"},"24":{"text":"aa thawh ṭhan i, “Ka fapa Esau na si taktak maw?” a ti ṭhan. “Ka si ko,” tiah a leh."},"25":{"text":"Isak nih cun, “Na sa cu rak ka pe. Ka ei lai i ka thluachuahnak cu kan pek lai,” a ti. Jakob nih cun a hei pek i din awkah mitsur zu zong a pek chih."},"26":{"text":"Cun a pa nih cun a thawh i, “Rak ka naih deuh law ka hnam tuah ka fapa,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Hnamh awkah a hei fuh i Isak nih khan a puan kha a rak hnimh i a thluachuahnak cu a pek: “Ka fapa rim hi Bawipa nih thluachuah a pekmi lo rim bantuk a si.","ref":"Heb 11.20"},"28":{"text":"Pathian nih van dap kha in pe seh law na lo kha ṭhatser hna seh. Rawl tampi le mitsur zu tam piin in pe seh."},"29":{"text":"Miphun tampi cu na sal si hna seh law na hmaiah kun hna seh. Na rualchan hna cungah nang cu bawi si law Na nu tefa hna cu na hmaiah kun hna seh Chiat an serhmi cu chiatserh si ve hna seh, thluachuah an pemi cu thluachuah si ve hna seh,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 12.3"},"30":{"text":"Isak nih a thluachuahnak a pek cu a lim i Jakob cu a kal kate ah khin, a u Esau kha a ram vaihnak cun a rung tlung."},"31":{"text":"Amah zong nih cun rawl cu thaw ngaiin a chuan i a pa cu a hei put. A pa cu, “Ka pa, tho law na fapa nih ka rak in putmi sa cu ei law na thluachuahnak cu ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Isak nih cun, “Ahodah na si?” tiah a ti. “Na fapa upa deuh Esau ka si,” tiah a leh."},"33":{"text":"Isak cu a therh in a therh i, “Ahodah sa aa thah i a rak ka pemi kha a si kun? Na rat hlan deuhte ah khan pei ka rak ei cu. Amah cu ka thluachuah donghnak kha ka pek cang i cucaah amah ta a si zungzal ko lai,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cucu Esau nih a theih tikah fakpi le lunghno ngaiin a ṭap i, “Kei zong na thluachuahnak cu ka pe ve ko,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Isak nih cun, “Na nau kha a ra i a ra ka hlen a si ko. Amah nih cun na thluachuahnak cu aa lak ko cang,” tiah a leh."},"36":{"text":"Esau nih cun, “Atu hi a voi hnihnak a ka hlen a si. A min Jakob a si hi a rak si awk hrim pei a si hi. Fater ka sinak kha aa lak i atu cu ka thluachuahnak zong kha aa lak fawn. Thluachuahnak cu pakhat tal na ka nganh ti lo maw?” a ti.","ref":"Gen 25.29-34"},"37":{"text":"Isak nih cun Esau cu a leh i, “Amah cu nangmah bawi ah ka ser cang i a rualchan vialte cu a sal ah ka ser cang hna. Rawl le mitsur zu kha ka pek cang. Na ca i ka tuah khawh ding zeidah a tang ti i, ka fapa?” a ti."},"38":{"text":"Esau nih a pa cu ngol duh loin a nawl chih lengmang i, “Ka pa, thluachuahnak cu pakhat lawng maw na ngeih ko? Kei zong ka pe ve ko,” a ti i fak piin a ṭap.","ref":"Heb 12.17"},"39":{"text":"Cun Isak nih cun a thawh i, “Vawlei rumnak na caah a um ti lo, Van dap na lo caah a um ti lo.","ref":"Heb 11.20"},"40":{"text":"Na vainam in na nung lai i na nau sinum na si lai. Asinain na doh ve tikah Na hngawng i a hngawngkual cu na khiah lai,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 36.8; 2Sia 8.20"},"41":{"text":"A pa nih Jakob kha thluachuahnak a pek caah cun Esau nih Jakob cu a huat i a lungchung in, “Ka pa cu va thi deng cang kaw, a zun ngaih kan lim cun Jakob cu ka thah lai,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Rebekah nih khan Esau nih aa tinhmi cu a theih i cucaah Jakob kha a auh i, “Ngai hmanh, na u Esau nih phuhlam an timh i thah an timh."},"43":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka fapa, kan chimhning in tuah. I tim law ka ṭa Laban sinah Haran khua ah va zam."},"44":{"text":"Amah sinah cun na u a thin a dam i"},"45":{"text":"a cung i na tuahmi a philh hlantiang va um. Cun mi ka hun thlah hna lai i na ra kir ṭhan te lai. Zeicahdah ka fapa nan pahnih tein ni khat ah nan ka thihtak hnga?” a ti."},"46":{"text":"Rebekah nih Isak cu a thawh i, “Esau nih a ṭhit mi hna ramdangmi a nupile nih hin an ka nor tuk hringhran. Jakob zong nih Hit mi hi a ṭhit ve sual ahcun, ka caah thih hmanh a ṭha deuh,” a ti.","title":"Isak Nih Jakob Cu Laban Sinah A Kalter"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Isak nih Jakob cu a kawh i thluachuah a pek hnuah, “Kanaan mi nu hi cu ṭhi hna hlah."},"2":{"text":"I tim law Mesopotamia ram i a ummi na nu pa Bethuel inn ah va kal. Cuka nu pakhatkhat cu vaa ṭhit hna, na pu Laban fanu pakhatkhat kha vaa ṭhit hna."},"3":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Pathian nih na nupi ṭhitnak ah cun thluachuah in pe seh law fa tam piin in pe seh law miphun tampi hna pa ah in ser seh."},"4":{"text":"Abraham thluachuah a pek bantuk khan nangmah le na tefa hna cu thluachuah in pe hna seh law, atu i na umnak ram, Pathian nih Abraham a pekmi ram hi nangmah ta si seh,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 17.4-8"},"5":{"text":"Isak nih Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram i a ummi Aramean mi Bethuel fapa Laban sinah khan a thlah. Laban cu Jakob le Esau nu Rebekah ṭa kha a si."},"6":{"text":"Esau nih Jakob kha Isak nih thluachuahnak a pek i nupi vaa ṭhit awkah Mesopotamia ram ah a kalter ti kha a theih. Cun thluachuah a pek ah khan, Kanaan mi nu na ṭhi lai lo tiah nawl a pek ti zong kha a theih fawn.","title":"Esau Nih Nupi Dang A Ṭhit"},"7":{"text":"Jakob nih a nu le a pa kha an nawl a ngaih hna i Mesopotamia ram ah a kal cang ti kha a hngalh."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Esau nih, ka pa Isak nih Kanaan mi nu kha a duh hna lo ti kha a hngalh."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah cun Abraham fapa Ishmael sinah khan a va kal i nu dang pakhat a va ṭhit, a min cu Mahalath a si, amah cu Ishmael fanu kha a si i Nebaioth far a si."},"10":{"text":"Jakob cu Beer-sheba khan aa thawh i Haran khua leiah cun a kal.","title":"Bethel Khua I Jakob Mang"},"11":{"text":"Hmun pakhat khi a va phan i ni a tlak caah cuka ah cun a riak. A it i chantling ah lung aa tlinh."},"12":{"text":"Mang a manh i a mang ah cun hlei pakhat a hmuh i cu hlei cu vawlei in van tiang a phan i cu hlei ah cun Pathian vancungmi kha an kai i an ṭum lengmang.","ref":"Jhn 1.51"},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih cun, “Keimah hi Bawipa, Abraham le Isak Pathian kha ka si. Na ihnak ram hi nangmah le na tefa kha kan pek hna lai.","ref":"Gen 13.14-15"},"14":{"text":"Na tefa cu an tam tuk ah vawlei cung leidip zat an si lai. An ram cu nichuahlei he nitlaklei he chaklei he thlanglei he a kau chin lengmang lai i vawlei cung miphun vialte nih na tefa hna thluachuah ka pek hna bantuk hin kan pe ve tiah an ka hal lai.","ref":"Gen 12.3; 22.18"},"15":{"text":"Khuazeika na kalnak hmanh ah kan umpi zungzal lai i kan huhphenh zungzal lai, cucu philh hlah, cun hi ram ah hin kan kirpi ṭhan lai. Kan chimhmi vialte ka tuah dih hlanah cun nangmah cu kan kaltak lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Jakob cu a hun i hlau i, “ Bawipa cu hika hmun ah hin a um taktak, a hngalh bel ka rak hngal lo i a si,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"A thin a phang i, “Hika hmun hi hmun ṭihnung ngai pei a rak si hi! Pathian inn le vancung kutka pei a rak si hi,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Jakob cu zingka tein a tho i aa tlinhmi lung cu philh lonak lung ah a bunh i Pathian sin i pekchanhnak caah chiti a toih."},"19":{"text":"Cu hmun cu a min ah Bethel a sak. (Cu hlanah cun cu khua cu a min ah Luz rak ti a si)."},"20":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih Bawipa Pathian sinah cun chiatser in biakamnak a tuah i, “Atu ka khualtlawnnak ah hin na ka umpi i na ka huhphenh i rawl le hnipuan na ka pek i"},"21":{"text":"ka pa inn ah him tein ka kir ṭhan ahcun nangmah cu ka Pathian na si lai."},"22":{"text":"Philh lonak lung ah ka phunmi lung hi na inn a si lai i na ka pekmi thil vialte cheu hra ah cheu khat kan pek lai,” a ti."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob cu a kal lengmang i nichuahlei mi hna ram cu a phan.","title":"Jakob Cu Laban Inn A Phan"},"2":{"text":"Lo ah khin tikhor pakhat a hei hmuh i a pawngah cun tuu run thum nih an bawhhnawh ko. Tuurun cu cu tikhor ti cu an dinh tawn hna i cu tikhor cu a chin ah lung nganpi a si."},"3":{"text":"Tuurun vialte kha an pumh dih hna tikah tuukhal pawl nih khan a chin lung cu an thawn tawn i ti cu an dinh tawn hna. Cun lung cu a umnak ah khan an chiah ṭhan tawn."},"4":{"text":"Jakob nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka duale, khuazei mi dah nan si?” a ti hna. Annih nih, “Haran khuami kan si,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun, “Nahor fapa Laban kha nan hngalhmi a si maw?” a ti hna i annih nih, “Asi, kan hngalhmi a si,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"“A dam tah a dam maw?” tiah a hal hna i, “A dam ko. Zohhmanh, a fanu Rachel kha a tuurun he an ra khih,” tiah an leh."},"7":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih cun, “Atu cu ni a sangpi rih i saṭil run khumh a cut rih lo caah, zeicahdah ti nan dinh hna lo i nan thlah rih hna lo?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Annih nih, “Tuurun vialte kha kan pumh dih hlan hna le lung chin kha kan i bawmh lulhmalh i kan thawn hlanah cun, cucu kan tuah kho lo; cu hnu lawngah cun kan tuurun cu ti kan dinh khawh hna lai,” an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cu bantukin Jakob nih bia a ruah lio lengmang hna ah cun Rachel kha a pa tuurun he khan a ra phan ve. Rachel cu a pa tuurun a zohkhenhtu kha a si."},"10":{"text":"Jakob nih a nu ṭa Laban tuurun he Rachel cu a hmuh tikah tikhor ah khan a va kal i lung kha a thawn i tuu kha ti a dinh hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun Rachel kha a hnamh i a ṭap."},"12":{"text":"Rachel cu a thawh i, “Kei cu na pa far Rebekah fapa ka si,” tiah a ti. Cu kong cu a pa va chimh awkah Rachel cu a tlik in a tli i"},"13":{"text":"a pa nih a far fapa Jakob kong cu a theih tikah amah ton awkah cun a ra le ve. A kuh i a hnamh i a inn ah khan a luhpi. Cun Jakob nih Laban cu thil umtuning vialte kha a chimh."},"14":{"text":"Laban nih cun a thawh i, “Asi, nangmah cu ka thi le ka sa taktak na si,” tiah a ti. Cuka ah cun Jakob cu thla khat pumte a um."},"15":{"text":"Laban nih Jakob cu, “Ka rualchan na si ai pat tiin alak in ka rian ṭuan cu a ṭha hnga lo. Zeizat dah kan pek hnga?” a ti.","title":"Jakob Nih Laban Fanu A Ṭhit"},"16":{"text":"Laban nih cun fanu pahnih a ngeih hna i a upa deuh cu a min ah Leah a si i a ngakchia deuh cu Rachel a si."},"17":{"text":"Leah cu aa dawh tuk lo, Rachel tu cu a tungtai a ṭha i aa dawh ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Jakob nih cun Rachel cu a duh i, “Kum sarih in kan rianh lai i na fanu a ngakchia deuh Rachel hi na ka pek lai,” a ti"},"19":{"text":"Laban nih cun, “Midang peknak cun nangmah pek cu ka duh deuh. Cucaah cun ka sinah cun um,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Rachel conak dingah cun Jakob nih khan kum sarih cu rian kha a ṭuan i asinain a dawt caah khan cu kum sarih cu ni tlawmte bantuk men ah khin a rel ko."},"21":{"text":"Jakob nih cun Laban cu, “Ka caan a tling cang, na fanu cu ka pe cang kun law ṭhi cang ning,” a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah Laban nih nupi ṭhitnak puai a tuah i cuka mi vialte cu a sawm hna."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu zan ah cun Rachel kha si loin Leah tu kha Jakob sinah cun a hei kalpi i Jakob nih a rak ihpi."},"24":{"text":"(Laban nih cun a salnu Zilpah kha a fanu Leah cu a kalh)."},"25":{"text":"A thaizing ah cun Jakob nih Leah a si kha a hngalh. Laban cu a thawh i, “Zeicahdah hi bantukin ka cungah na tuah? Rachel pek dingin pei na rian cu ka ṭuan cu, zeicahdah na ka hlen kun?” a ti."},"26":{"text":"Laban nih cun, “Hika ah hin cun u le hlanah naule nih va ngeih phung a si lo."},"27":{"text":"Nan i ṭhitnak puai zarh khat chung hi tlinter ko law cucu a dih in kum sarih na ka rianh rih dingah cun Rachel cu kan pek lai,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Jakob cu a hna a tla i ṭhitumnak zarh cu a dih tikah, Laban nih a fanu Rachel cu nupi ah a pek."},"29":{"text":"(Laban nih a salnu Bilhah kha a fanu Rachel cu a kalh)."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah Jakob nih khan Rachel zong cu a ihpi i Leah nakkhan a dawt deuh. Laban cu a dang kum sarih a rianh ṭhan."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa nih Leah cu dawt lo deuh a si kha a hmuh tikah anih tu kha fa ngeih khawhnak a pek i Rachel kha cu fa ngei loin a um ko.","title":"Jakob Hrinmi Fale Hna"},"32":{"text":"Leah cu fa a pawi i fapa a hrin. Aa thawh i, “ Bawipa nih ka harnak kha a ka hmuhpiak cang, atu cu ka va nih a ka dawt cang lai,” a ti; cucaah a min ah Reuben a sak."},"33":{"text":"Fa a pawi ṭhan i a dang fapa a hrin ṭhan. “Kei cu dawt lomi ka si kha Bawipa nih a theih caah hi fapa hi a ka pek ṭhan,” a ti i cucaah a min ah Simeon a sak."},"34":{"text":"Fa a pawi ṭhan i fapa a hrin ṭhan. “Atu cu fapa pathum ka hrinpiak cang caah ka va hi ka sinah fek deuh in aa ṭem cang lai,” a ti i cucaah a min cu Levi a sak."},"35":{"text":"Fa a pawi ṭhan i fapa a hrin ṭhan. “Atu cu Pathian ka thangṭhat lai,” a ti i cucaah a min cu Judah a sak. Cun fapa a ngei ti lo."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rachel nih Jakob fa a hrinpiak khawh lo kha a hmuh tikah a u kha a nahchuah i Jakob cu a thawh i, “Fa ka pe, cu ti a si lo ahcun ka thi lai,” a ti."},"2":{"text":"Jakob cu Rachel cungah khan a thin a hung i, “Pathian ai cu ka rawlh kho lo. Fa ngei loin an umtertu cu Pathian pei a si cu,” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Rachel nih cun, “Ka salnu Bilhah hi ihpi kun, amah tal nih fa ka hrinpiak seh. Cuticun amah thawngin nu ka cang kho ve lai,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun a salnu cu a va kha a pek i a va nih cun a ihpi."},"5":{"text":"Bilhah cu fa a pawi i Jakob cu fapa a hrinpiak."},"6":{"text":"Rachel nih khan, “Pathian nih keimah ṭanh in bia a ka ceihpiak cang. Ka thlacamnak kha a theih i fapa a ka pek,” a ti i cucaah a min cu Dan a sak."},"7":{"text":"Rachel salnu Bilhah cu fa a pawi ṭhan i Jakob cu a dang fapa a hrinpiak ṭhan."},"8":{"text":"Rachel nih cun, “Ka u he kan i cuh i keimah nih ka tei,” a ti i cucaah a min cu, Naftali a sak."},"9":{"text":"Leah nih fa ka ngei kho ti lo ti kha a hngalh tikah a salnu Zilpah kha Jakob cu nupi ah a pek."},"10":{"text":"Cun Zilpah nih cun Jakob cu fapa a hrinpiak."},"11":{"text":"Leah nih cun, “Ka van a ṭha ko,” a ti i cucaah a min cu Gad a sak."},"12":{"text":"Leah salnu Zilpah nih cun Jakob cu fapa a hrinpiak ṭhan i"},"13":{"text":"Leah nih cun, “Ka vaa lawm hringhran dah! Atu cu nu nih, Lunglawm minu an ka ti lai,” a ti i cucaah a min cu Asher a sak."},"14":{"text":"Changvut ṭuan caan ah khin Reuben cu lo ah a va kal i mandarek kha a va hmuh hna i a nu sinah a rak put hna. Rachel nih khan Leah cu, “Na fapa nih a rak phorhmi mandarek kha tlawmpal in ka pe ve,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Leah nih cun, “Ka va na ka chuh hi naa za rih lo maw? Ka fapa mandarek zong lak rih na zalh hi?” a ti. Rachel nih cun, “Na fapa mandarek kha na ka pek ahcun Jakob he tu zan ah na it kho lai,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Lo in zanlei ah Jakob cu a hung tlun tikah Leah nih cun a va don i, “Tu zan cu ka sinah na ih a hau, ka fapa mandarek in kan cawk cang,” a ti. Cucaah cu zan cu a ihpi."},"17":{"text":"Pathian nih Leah thlacamnak kha a leh i fa a pawi i Jakob cu fapa panganak a hrinpiak."},"18":{"text":"Leah nih cun, “Ka salnu kha ka va ka pek caah Pathian nih laksawng a ka pek,” a ti i cucaah a min ah cun Issakhar a sak."},"19":{"text":"Leah cu fa a pawi ṭhan i Jakob cu fapa paruknak a hrinpiak."},"20":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Pathian nih laksawng ṭha ngaingai a ka pek. Atu cu fapa paruk ka hrinpiak cang caah ka vaa nih a ka khinhhramh cang lai,” a ti i cucaah a min ah cun Zebulun a sak."},"21":{"text":"Cun fanu a run hrin i a min ah Dinah a sak."},"22":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Rachel kha a vun philh ve lo i a thlacamnak kha a leh i fa ngeih khawhnak a pek."},"23":{"text":"Fa a pawi i fapa a hrin. Aa thawh i, “Fa ngeih lo ningzahnak kha Pathian nih a ka lakpiak cang."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih fa dang zong ka pe ko rih seh,” a ti i a min ah Josef a sak."},"25":{"text":"Josef chuah hnu khan Jakob nih Laban cu a thawh i, “Atu cu inn ah ka tlunter cang.","title":"Jakob le Laban An I Hlennak"},"26":{"text":"Kan rianh man i na ka pekmi ka nupi hna le ka fale hna hi ka pe hna law kal cang ning. Ṭha tein na rian kan ṭuanpiak cu nangmah nih na hngalh,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Laban nih Jakob cu a thawh i, “Biachimnak nawl ka pe ve tuah: litin in ka hngalhmi cu, Bawipa nih thluachuah a ka pek hi nangmah thawngin a si."},"28":{"text":"Na ṭuan man chim law kan pek lai,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jakob nih cun, “Zeitindah na rian ka ṭuan le keimah nih ka zohkhenh hna thawngin zeitluk in dah na saṭil an karh cu na hngalh."},"30":{"text":"Ka rat hlanah cun na saṭil cu tlawmte lawng an rak si, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu tampi ah an i chuah cang; keimah thawngin Bawipa nih thluachuah cu an pek ko. Atu cu keimah ca kaa ṭuan caan a si ve cang,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Laban nih cun, “Zeidah kan pek lai?” tiah a ti ṭhan i Jakob nih cun, “Ka duhmi cu ṭuan man kha a si lo. Ka chimmi hi na tuah ding ahcun na saṭil kha kan zohpiak rih ko lai."},"32":{"text":"Nihin ah na saṭil run chungah khan ka vaa chawk dih lai i tuufa a nak paohpaoh le meheh fa a ṭial paohpaoh le a ṭial a deh in aa dehmi paohpaoh kha a dang ah ka va chiah dih hna lai i cucu ka ṭuan man cu an si lai."},"33":{"text":"Hihi a zafangmi thil a si tiah ka ruah. Hmailei ah ka din le din lo cu fawi tein na hmuh khawh ko lai. Ka ṭuan man kha na rak zoh hna tikah, ka meheh hna lakah a ṭial lomi le a ṭialning a deh in aa dehmi a si lomi le tuufa a nak lomi na hmuh hna ahcun, cucu a fir in firmi an si ti kha na hngalh lai,” a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun Laban nih khan, “A ṭha na chimning cun kan tuah lai,” tiah a leh."},"35":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu ni ah cun Laban nih khan, mehehtum a ṭialmi vialte le a deh in aa dehmi vialte, mehehpi a ṭialmi vialte le a deh in aa dehmi vialte, an pum cungah rannak a ngeimi vialte kha a dang in a chiah dih hna i tuu a nakmi zong kha a dang in a chiah dih hna i a fapale kha a khalhter hna."},"36":{"text":"Cun cu run cu Jakob umnak in a hlat khawh chung ni thum lamkal ah a va chiah hna i a tangmi cu Jakob nih a khalh hna."},"37":{"text":"Jakob nih cun aa thawh ve i poplar thing le almond thing le fahia thing a hringmi nge kha aa lak hna i an hawng a hlih hna i cucaah cun a rang in an ṭial."},"38":{"text":"Hi thing nge hna hi saṭil tidinnak kuang hmaiah khan a chiah hna. Cuka i a chiah hna cu saṭil cu tidin awk i an rat ah khan an i kaih tawn caah a si."},"39":{"text":"Saṭil nih thing nge chiahmi hna hmai i an i kaih caah cun a phei in a ṭialmi le ṭial dip in a ṭialmi le ṭial hrawl in a ṭialmi kha an hrin hna."},"40":{"text":"Jakob nih tuu kha a dang tein a chiah hna i Laban saṭil run chung i a ṭialmi le a nakmi hna sinah khan a tlonter hna. Cuticun Jakob nih cun amah saṭil run cu aa ser ve i Laban saṭil run he khan a fonh hna lo."},"41":{"text":"Saṭil lak i a ṭhawngṭhawng pawl kha an phol tikah tidinnak kuang ah khan an hmaiah cun fung kha a chiah hna i cuticun fung ṭial lakah khan a kaihter hna."},"42":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a derthawm pawl an phol ah cun an hmaiah fung kha a chia hna lo. Cucaah a derthawm pawl cu Laban ta an si i a ṭhawng pawl cu Jakob ta an si."},"43":{"text":"Khulrang in a rum ko. Saṭil run tampi le sal le kalauk le laa kha a ngeih hna."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Laban fapa hna nih, “Kan pa ngeihmi vialte Jakob nih aa lak dih cang. A chawva vialte cu kan pa ta in aa lakmi an si,” tiah an ti thawng kha a theih.","title":"Laban Sinin Jakob A Zaam"},"2":{"text":"Cun Laban zong nih hmasa i a rak umtuning bantuk khan um ti loin a umtuning cu aa dang cang ti zong kha a hmuh."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih khan, “Na pupa hna le na rualchan hna ram ah khan kir cang. Na sinah ka um lai,” a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Jakob nih Rachel le Leah cu bia a hei cah hna i a saṭil run an tlonnak pil ah khan ka tong hna seh a ti."},"5":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nan pa umtuning hi hmasa i ka cung i a umtuning bantuk kha a si ti lo; sihmanhsehlaw ka pa Pathian nih cun a ka umpi ko."},"6":{"text":"Ka thazang a dih-umnak in nan pa ca i rian ka ṭuan cu nan pahnih in nan hngalh."},"7":{"text":"Asinain a ka hlen i ka hmuh awk hnga kha voi hra a ka hlen. Sihmanhsehlaw ka cung i ṭhat lonak tuah cu Pathian nih a onh lo."},"8":{"text":"Laban nih, ‘Meheh lak i a ṭial paoh na rianṭuan man ah si hna seh,’ a ti ah, saṭil run vialte nih a ṭial lawng tein fa an hrin. ‘Ṭial hrawl in a ṭialmi meheh cu na rianṭuan man ah si hna seh,’ a ti ah saṭil run vialte nih ṭial hrawl lawng tein fa an hrin."},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih saṭil run tampi kha nan pa sinin a lak hna i keimah a ka pek."},"10":{"text":"“Saṭil phol caan ah mang ka manh i ka mang ah cun a kaihtu hna meheh tum kha ṭial hrawl in a ṭialmi le, ṭial dip in a ṭialmi le a deh in aa dehmi an si kha ka hmuh."},"11":{"text":"Cu ka mang ah cun vancungmi nih a ka thawh i, ‘Jakob,’ a ka ti i, kei nih, ‘Hawi,’ ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun, ‘Zohhmanh, a kaihtu hna mehehtum vialte khi a ṭial le ṭial hrawl in a ṭialmi le a deh in aa dehmi an si khih. Hi bantukin thil ka siternak cu Laban nih na cung i a tuahmi vialte kha ka hmuh caah a si."},"13":{"text":"Kei cu Bethel khua i na sin i a langmi Pathian kha ka si, Bethel khua cu rolung pakhat chiti na toih i keimah sinah biakamnak na sernak khua kha a si. Cucaah atu cu i tim law na chuahkehnak ram i kal awkah hi ram hin chuak tuah’ a ka ti,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Gen 28.18-22"},"14":{"text":"Rachel le Leah nih cun, “Kan pa sinin kan co hnga dingmi thil zeihmanh a um ti lo."},"15":{"text":"Kannih cu ramdang mi in pei a kan zoh ko cu. A kan zuar i kan man a hmuhmi vialte cu a hman dih."},"16":{"text":"Pathian nih kan pa sinin a lakmi chawva vialte cu kanmah le kan fale ta a si ko cang. Pathian nih an fialning paoh in tuah ko,” tiah an leh."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Kanaan ram i a ummi a pa sin kir awkah khan Jakob cu aa tim. A fale hna le a nupi hna kha kalauk cungah a chuan hna i Mesopotamia ram i a ngeihmi chawva vialte he a saṭil run vialte cu a hmaiah a kalter chung hna.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Laban cu a tuu hmul meh ah khan a kal i a um lo karah a pa ta a simi an chungkhar pathian hna kha Rachel nih a rak fir hna."},"20":{"text":"Jakob nih Aramean mi Laban cu a hlen i a kal lai kha a chim lo."},"21":{"text":"A ngeihmi thil vialte kha aa lak i a zaam. A chuak i Zufrates tiva kha a tan i Gilead Tlanglei kha a fuh."},"22":{"text":"Ni thum hnuah Jakob a zaam ti kha Laban cu an chimh.","title":"Laban Nih Jakob A Dawi"},"23":{"text":"A mi kha aa kalpi hna i Jakob cu an dawi, ni sarih hnuah Gilead Tlang ah a phanh."},"24":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun Aramean mi Laban sinah khan Pathian cu mang in a ra i, “Jakob sinah hronak bia na chim nakhnga lo i ralring,” a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jakob cu tlang ah khan a rak riak i Laban nih cun a hun phanh. Laban zong cu Gilead Tlang ah cun a riak ve."},"26":{"text":"Laban nih Jakob cu a thawh i, “Zeicahdah na ka hlen i ka fanule cu ral tlaihmi bangin naa kalpi hna?"},"27":{"text":"Zeicahdah na ka hlen i keimah chimh lo tein na kal? Rak ka chim law cu lunglawmhnak le hla le tingtang le thonglawi he ka rak in thlah hnga lo maw."},"28":{"text":"Ka tu tete hna le ka fanule hmanh, dam tein vaa kal cang kun u tiin a hnamh hmanh na ka hnamhter hna lo. Hi na tuahmi ah hin na va hrut hringhran dah!"},"29":{"text":"Na cungah hin harnak ka duh ahcun ka tlunter khawh ko. Asinain zahan ah na pa Pathian nih, ‘Jakob sinah hronak bia na chim nakhnga lo i ralring,’ tiah a ka ti."},"30":{"text":"Inn tlun naa ngaih tuk cang caah na kal ti cu ka hngalh, asinain zeicahdah ka pathian kha naa fir hna?” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Jakob nih cun, “Ka thin a phannak cu na fanu hna kha hramhram in na ka chuh sual hna lai ti ka ruah caah a si."},"32":{"text":"Cun hika i a ummi aho sin hmanh ah na pathian cu na hmuh hna ahcun, cu pa cu thah a si lai. Kan mi hna hmuh hngan te ah hin, na ta a simi paoh cu kawl law i lak hna,” tiah a leh. Rachel nih a fir hna kha Jakob nih a hngal lo."},"33":{"text":"Laban cu Jakob thlam chungah khan a lut i a kawl; cun Leah thlam chungah khan a lut, cun an salnu pahnih hna thlam chungah khan a lut, sihmanhsehlaw a pathian cu a hmu hna lo. Cun Rachel thlam chungah khan a lut."},"34":{"text":"Rachel nih khan an innchungkhar pathian kha rak la hna kaw cucaah cun kalauk kengdan chungah a chiah hna i an cungin a ṭhut danh hna. Laban nih cun thlam cu a kawl dih sihmanhsehlaw a hmu hna lo."},"35":{"text":"Rachel nih a pa cu a thawh i, “Bawipa, na hmai i ka dir khawh lo caah hin ka cungah na thin hung hlah, nuphung ka hngalh lio a si caah a si,” a ti. Laban nih cun a kawl len hna nain a innchungkhar pathian tete cu a hmu kho hna lo."},"36":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu a thin a pok cang i Laban cu, “Zei sualnak ko dah ka tuah i zei phung ko dah ka buar i hiti i na ka kawl le na ka suat?"},"37":{"text":"Ka ngeihmi thil vialte cu na thlok dih cikcek hna, na innchungkhar thil a simi zeital na hmu hna maw? Na mi hna le ka mi hna hmaiah hin chia law, ahodah a ding, ahodah a ding lo, kan ceih hna seh."},"38":{"text":"Na sinah kum kul ka um i na tuu nih si hna seh na meheh nih si hna seh fa an hrulh bal lo, na tuurun chungin na tuukawng zong ka ei bal hna lo."},"39":{"text":"Sa nih tuu pakhat khat a seh tikah, keimah palh ruangah a si lo, tiin a ruak cu na hmuh awkah na sinah ka ratpi bal lo, keimah nih ka liam ko. Chun i firmi siseh zan i firmi siseh na liam hna lai na ka ti."},"40":{"text":"Chun ah nilin voi tampi ka in i zan ah khuasik voi tampi ka in. Kaa hngilh khawh lo caan voi tampi a um."},"41":{"text":"Cuticun na sin i kum kul ka um chung kha a si zungzal ko. Na fanu pahnih hna caah kum hleili kan rianh i na saṭil run hna caah kum ruk kan rianh. Cu na hmanh cun ka hmuh hnga ding ka ṭuan man kha voi hra te na ka thlen."},"42":{"text":"Ka pa Pathian Abraham Pathian, Isak nih a biakmi Pathian nih khan rak ka umpi hlah seh law kut ro in na ka kalter ko hnga. Asinain Pathian nih cun harnak ka inmi le ka rianṭuanmi kha a hmuh i zahan ah bia a kan ceih cang,” a ti."},"43":{"text":"Laban nih Jakob cu a leh ve i, “Ka fanu hna hi keimah ta an si, ngakchia hna hi keimah ta an si, saṭil run hna hi keimah ta an si. Na hmuhmi vialte hi keimah ta an si dih. Asinain atu cu ka fanu hna le an fale hna caah zeidah ka tuah khawhmi a um?","title":"Jakob le Laban Biakamnak"},"44":{"text":"Biakamnak tu ser u si law cu bia kan i kammi kan lung a kan pem tawntu ah lungpumh pakhat ser u sih,” a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih philh lonak lung pakhat a bunh i"},"46":{"text":"a mi kha lung va khawm u a ti hna i an va khawmh i a hram ah cun an pumh hna. Cun lungpumh hramah cun rawl an ei."},"47":{"text":"Laban nih khan cu lungpumh cu Jegar-sahadutha tiah min a sak i Jakob nih cun Galeed tiah min a sak."},"48":{"text":"Laban nih cun, “Hi lungpumh hi nangmah ca le keimah caah hngalh ṭhantertu si seh,” a ti. Cu ruangah cun cu hmun Galeed an tinak cu a si."},"49":{"text":"Cun Laban ṭhiamṭhiam nih cun, “A dangdang i kan um tikah Pathian nih kan zohkhenh ciocio seh,” a ti fawn. Cucaah cu hmun cu Mizpah tiah ti a si."},"50":{"text":"Laban nih cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Ka fanule hi ṭhaṭhilo in na tuah hna ah siseh, nu dang na ṭhit hna ah siseh, keimah nih cun ka hngal lai lo nain Pathian nih a run kan zoh ko kha philh hlah,” a ti."},"51":{"text":"Cun Laban nih Jakob cu, “Hi hna hi kan karlak i ka pumhmi hna lung cu an si i hihi philh lonak lung cu a si."},"52":{"text":"Hi lungpumh le hi philh lonak lung hi hngalhter ṭhantu an si. Nangmah doh awkah hi lungpumh hi ka lonh lai lo i nang zong nih keimah doh awkah hi lungpumh le hi philh lonak lungphun hi na lonh ve lai lo."},"53":{"text":"Abraham Pathian le Nahor Pathian cu kan karlak biaceihtu si seh,” a ti. Cun Jakob nih khan a pa Isak nih a biakmi Pathian min in biakamnak a tuah."},"54":{"text":"Sa pakhat a thah i tlang cungah cun raithawinak ah a pek i a mi hna kha rawl ei awkah cun a sawm hna. An ei dih hnuah cu zan cu tlang ah cun an riak"},"55":{"text":"A thaizing cu zingka tein Laban nih khan a tu tete hna le a fanu hna cu dam tein vaa kal cang u tiin a hnamh hna i aa thawh i inn leiah a kir."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob cu a kal lengmang i Pathian vancungmi nih khan an ton.","title":"Jakob Nih Esau Ton Aa Tim"},"2":{"text":"A hmuh hna tikah, “Hi hi pei Pathian ralkapbu a si hi,” a ti i cucaah cuka hmun cu a min ah Mahanaim a sak."},"3":{"text":"Jakob nih a u Esau sinah khan, Seir peng Edom ram ah cun lamkaltu a hei thlah hna."},"4":{"text":"Hi bantukin nan va chim lai, tiah a cawnpiak hna: “Kei Jakob na salpa hi Laban sinah ka va um i cu can cu kir lo in khua ka va sa ti kha ka bawipa Esau cu chimh kan duh."},"5":{"text":"Caw le laa le tuu le meheh le sal kha ka ngei ve hna i na zaangfahnak hmuh awkah atu hi bawipa, na sinah mi ka rak thlah hna,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Lamkaltu kha Jakob sin i an ra kir tikah, “Na u Esau sinah cun kan va kal i asinain nangmah ton awkah khan a rak i thawh cang. Mi za li aa ratpi hna,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Jakob cu a thin a phang ngaingai i a awlok a chong. A sin i a ummi minung hna le a tuu hna le a meheh hna le a caw hna le a kalauk hna kha bu hnih ah a ṭhen hna."},"8":{"text":"Esau nih a bu hmasa u hi kan tu ai kun, a hmanung u hi cu a luat kho lai,” tiah a ruah."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jakob nih khan thla a cam i, “Ka pu Abraham Pathian le ka pa Isak Pathian, ka thlacamnak hi ka theihpiak tuah. Bawipa, nangmah nih na ka thawh i, ‘Na ram le na rualchan hna sinah kir law na caah thil cu tluang tein ka umter ko hna lai; na ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Na sal ka cung i na zaangfahnak le zumhawktlak na sinak na langhtermi hi a hmu dingah aa tlakmi ka si lo. Jordan tiva kha ka ṭhiangṭhunh he lawng ka rak tan, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu hi bu bu hnih hna he hin ka ra kir."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka u Esau kut chung hin ka khamh ko tiah kan nawl. Kanmah doh awk le hrawh awkah, hi nu le ngakchia hna tiang hin hrawh awkah a ra rua tiah ka ruah i ka thin a phang ko."},"12":{"text":"‘Na caah thil cu tluang tein ka umter ko hna lai i tefa kan pek lai i an tam tuk ah a rel in rel cawk an si lai lo, rili kam thetse zat khi an si lai,’ tiin bia na ka kammi kha philh sawh hlah,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 22.17"},"13":{"text":"Cuka i zan khat a riah hnuah a ngeihmi chungin hi thil hna hi a u Esau laksawng ding caah a thim hna:"},"14":{"text":"Mehehpi za hnih le mehehtum pa kul, tuupi za hnih le tuutum pa kul,"},"15":{"text":"hnuk sur liomi kalauk sawm thum, an fale he, cawpi sawm li, cawtum pahra, laapi pakul le laa tum pahra."},"16":{"text":"Run khat kha a sal pakhat cio a zohter hna i annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka hmaiah rak kal chung u law run khat le run khat kha aa hlat nawn in zulhter hna u,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sal hmasa bik kha a thawh i, “Ka u Esau nih an ton i, ‘Khuazei ah dah na bawipa cu a si? Khuazei ah dah nan kal lai? Naa ṭhit mi na saṭil hi aho ta dah an si?” tiah an hal tikah,"},"18":{"text":"‘Na sal Jakob ta an si. Ka bawipa Esau nangmah caah laksawng ah an kuat. Amah Jakob cu kan hnute ah hin a ra lio ve,’ na ti lai,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Pahnihnak pa le pathumnak pa le saṭil a ṭhitu vialte kha aa khat cio ah a chimh hna i, “Esau cu nan ton tikah hitihin nan ti lai:"},"20":{"text":"‘Asi, na sal Jakob cu kan hnute ah hin a ra lio ve ko,’ nan ti lai,” a ti hna. Jakob nih cun, “Ka hmai i ka rak kalter chungmi laksawng nih hin a thin a damter lai i keimah i ka ton tikah cun a ngaihthiam zong maw a ka ngaihthiam khawh,” tiah a ruah."},"21":{"text":"Laksawng cu an rak kalpi chung i anih cu cuka an riahnak hmun ah cun cu zan cu a rung riak."},"22":{"text":"Cun zan ah cun Jakob cu a tho i a nupi pahnih hna le a salnu pahnih hna le a fa hleikhat hna kha aa kalpi hna i Jabbok Tiva kha tan tawnnak hmun in a tan.","title":"Peniel Ah Jakob le Vancungmi An I Pai"},"23":{"text":"Khattelei ral i a chuahter dih hna hnuah a ngeihmi thil vialte zong kha va ral ah cun a kalter hna."},"24":{"text":"Amah lawng hnuah a tang. Cun mipa pakhat nih khuadei tiang a hung paih.","ref":"Hos 12.3-4"},"25":{"text":"Mipa nih cun ka tei kho ti lo ti kha a hmuh tikah Jakob cu a khel ah a thongh i an i paih lioah cun Jakob cu a khelruh a pelh."},"26":{"text":"Mipa nih cun, “Ka thlah, khua a dei deng cang,” a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Jakob nih cun, “Thluachuahnak na ka pek lo ahcun kan thlah bal lai lo,” tiah a leh."},"27":{"text":"Mipa nih cun, “Na min ahodah a si?” tiah a hal i, “Jakob,” tiah a leh."},"28":{"text":"Mipa nih cun, “Na min cu Jakob a si ti lai lo. Pathian zong na paih, minung zong na paih hna i na tei hna; cucaah na min cu Israel a si cang lai,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 35.10"},"29":{"text":"Jakob nih, “Na min ka chim,” tiah a ti i asinain anih nih, “Zeicahdah ka min cu na ka hal?” a ti. Cun Jakob cu thluachuah a pek.","ref":"Biac 13.17-18"},"30":{"text":"Jakob nih, “Pathian kha hmaitonh in ka hmu nain ka nung rih,” a ti i cucaah cuka hmun cu a min ah Peniel a sak."},"31":{"text":"‘Jakob nih Peniel in a chuah ah ni zong a chuak ve, a khel ruangah cun a bei."},"32":{"text":"Cu ruangah cun pei atu chan tiangin Israel tefa hna nih hin khelbo cung i a ummi tit an ei lonak hi a si cu; Jakob a thonghnak kha cu tit hlum ah cun a rak si."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob nih Esau minung za li he an rat kha a hmuh i cucaah ngakchia kha Leah, Rachel le salnu pahnih kha a phawt hna.","title":"Jakob le Esau An I Tong"},"2":{"text":"Annih le an fale kha hmaisuang ah a chiah hna, cun Leah le a fale nih khan an hun chan hna i Rachel le Josef cu hnu bik ah a chiah hna."},"3":{"text":"Jakob cu an hmaiah khan a kal i a u a phak hlanah voi sarih vawlei ah a kun."},"4":{"text":"Esau tu nih cun a hun zuanhnawh i a kuh i a pom i a hnamh. An pahnih in an ṭap."},"5":{"text":"Esau cu a hnuhmai a hun i mer i nu le ngakchia kha a hmuh hna tikah, “Hi na sin i a ummi hna hi mi zei dah an si?” tiah a hal. Jakob nih, “Bawipa, hi hna hi Pathian nih a ka zaangfahmi ka fale an si,” tiah a leh."},"6":{"text":"Cun salnu kha an fale he an ra i an kun;"},"7":{"text":"cun Leah le a fale kha an si; cun a hmanung bik ah Josef le Rachel kha an si i an ra kun ve."},"8":{"text":"Cun Esau nih, “Bu dang ka tonmi hna kha tah? Zei sullam dah khakha a si?” a ti. Jakob nih, “Na ka zaangfah khawh nakhnga ca i ka rak thlahmi an si, bawipa,” tiah a leh."},"9":{"text":"Esau nih cun, “A zaa in ka ngei ko, ka nau; na ta cu nangmah caah i chiah ko,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Jakob nih, “Cuticun si hin hlah seh. Na ka zaangfah a si ahcun kan pekmi laksawng cu ka cohlanpiak ko. Hi tlukin ka cung i na ṭhat caah na hmai hmuh hi ka caah Pathian hmai hmuh tluk a si."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah caah ka rak phorhmi ka laksawng cu ka cohlanpiak ko hna; Pathian nih a ka zaangfah i ka herhmi vialte kha a ka pek ko,” a ti. Aa lak hlan lo a nawl lengmang."},"12":{"text":"Esau nih cun, “I tim u si law kal u sih. Kei nan hmaiah ka kal lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Jakob nih cun, “Bawipa, ngakchia cu thazang an ngeih lo le kan tuu le kan caw kha an fale hna he ka ruah hna awk a herh kha na hngalh. Fak tuk in kan kalpi hna ahcun, ni khat hmanh a si ah, a run ningin an thi ko lai."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka bawipa, rak kan kaltak ko. Hnu in duhsah in ka run in zulh lai. Seir i kan in phak hlantiang kan kal khawh chungin ngakchia le caw hna he ti cun kan ra ve ko lai,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Esau nih, “Ka mi hi tlawmpal in kan chiahtak kun lai,” a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Jakob nih, “Cucu na ka zaangfah caah a si taktak ko, bawipa, asinain a herhnak a um lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Esau cu, cu ni ah cun Seir leiah cun a kir ṭhan."},"17":{"text":"Jakob tu cu Sukkoth leiah khan a kal i cuka ah cun amah ca i inn le caw ca i dornak thlam kha a sak hna. Cu ruangah cuka hmun cu a min ah Sukkoth ti a si."},"18":{"text":"Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram khan a ra kir i Kanaan ram chung khua Shekhem kha him tein a phan. Khua hmailei i a ummi lo ah khan riah hmun cu a khuar."},"19":{"text":"Cu lo cu Shekhem pa Hamor tefa hna sin khan ngun tangka za khat in a cawk.","ref":"Jos 24.32; Jhn 4.5"},"20":{"text":"Cuka ah cun biakṭheng pakhat a ser i a min ah El, Elohe-Israel, a sak."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jakob le Leah nih an hrinmi an fanu Dinah kha cu rammi nu cu a leng hna.","title":"Dinah An Tlaihhrem"},"2":{"text":"Cuka ram bawi Shekhem, Hiv mi Hamor fapa nih khan a hmuh tikah a tlaih i a ihpi i a min a chiatter."},"3":{"text":"A lungthin cu Jakob fanu Dinah cung lawngah cun a um i ngaknu cu a dawt i bia thlumthlum in a chawnh."},"4":{"text":"Cun a pa cu, “Ngaknu cu ka ṭhitpiak,” tiah a nawl."},"5":{"text":"Jakob nih a fanu a min a chiatter kha a theih, asinain, a fapale kha ramlak ah caw an khal i an um lo caah an ra kir hlan cu zeihmanh tuah loin a um."},"6":{"text":"Shekhem pa Hamor cu Jakob he bia vaa ruah awkah khan a va kal i"},"7":{"text":"cu lio te ah cun Jakob fapale zong cu ramlak khan an ra tlung. Shekhem nih cu bantuk thil ṭhalo a tuah i Jakob fanu a sualnak thawngin Israel mi a serhsat hna kha an theih tikah a lau in an lau i an thin a khenh ngaingai hna."},"8":{"text":"Hamor nih khan a thawh i, “Ka fapa Shekhem nih na fanu cu a duh, cucaah cun a nupi ah kan pe ko."},"9":{"text":"Ṭhitumnak in hmunkhat i a ṭangṭimi ah i cang u si law kannih nih na fanu kha kan ṭhit hna lai i nannih nih kan fanu kha nan ṭhit ve hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun kan sinah kan ram chungah hin khua nan sa ve lai i nan duhnak hmun paoh ah nan um lai, nan duhduh in chaw nan let lai i nan ngeihmi thil kha nan ta a si lai,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Shekhem nih cun Dinah pa le a ṭale cu a thawh hna i, “Hi te hi cu ka zaangfah ko u law nan duhmi paoh kha kan pek ko hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Zei laksawng dah nan duh, man zong nan duh zat in hau ko u; amah kha nan ka ṭhitter paoh ahcun nan ka halmi paoh cu kan pek ko hna lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Jakob fapa pawl nih cun, Shekhem nih an farnu Dinah kha a thang a chiat caah bia an leh hna tikah Shekhem le a pa cu an hlen hna."},"14":{"text":"An thawh hna i, “Kan farnu cu cuarpar tan lomi pa cu kan vatter kho lo; kan vatter a si ahcun kan caah thangchiatnak a si hnga."},"15":{"text":"Kan hna a tlak khawh nakhnga dingah thil pakhat lawnglawng a um i cucu pa vialte nan cuarpar nan i tan lawngah a si hnga."},"16":{"text":"Cu tikah cun kan fanu cu nan kan ṭhit hna hnga i kannih zong nih nan fanu cu kan in ṭhit ve hna hnga. Nan sinah khua kan sa hnga i miphun phun khat ah kan cang hnga."},"17":{"text":"Asinain kan chimmi cu nan duh lo i cuarpar nan i tan lo ahcun, kan farnu cu kan i lak lai i kan kal ko lai,” an ti."},"18":{"text":"An chimmi cu Hamor le a fapa Shekhem nih cun a ṭha ko tiah an ruah i"},"19":{"text":"Jakob fanu cu a duh ngaingai caah an chimmi cu khulrang in a tuah. A innchungkhar lakah amah cu biapi bik a simi a si."},"20":{"text":"Khua hauka pumhnak hmun ah khan Hamor le a fapa Shekhem cu an va kal i an khuami cu,"},"21":{"text":"“Hi hna hi kan cungah miṭha an si; kan ram chungah hin umter ve hna u si law an duhduh in khualtlawng ko hna seh. Kan ram nih hin a tlum khawh ve ko hna lai. An fanule kha ṭhi hna u sih, annih zong nih kan fanule kha ṭhi ve hna seh."},"22":{"text":"Asinain hi mi hna kannih he miphun phun khat an si khawh nakding cu anmah bantukin kan cuarpar kan i tan ve lawngah a si."},"23":{"text":"An saṭil le an chawva le an caw hna cu kan ta an si lai. Cucaah kan lakah um ve ko hna seh ti cu kan hna tla cio ko u sih,” an ti hna."},"24":{"text":"Hamor le Shekhem nih an chimmi cu khuami vialte kha an hna a tla i pa vialte kha an cuarpar an i tan dih."},"25":{"text":"Cu hnu ni thum, an zual ling te ah khin, Jakob fapa pahnih Simeon le Levi, Dinah ṭale nih khan, an nam an i lak riangmang i a thli tein khua chungah cun an lut i pa vialte kha an thah dih hna."},"26":{"text":"Hamor le a fapa Shekhem kha an thah hna i Shekhem inn khan Dinah cu an lak i an kal."},"27":{"text":"An farnu a thang an chiat caah cun Jakob fapa a dang nih khan a ngan a fakmi cu an tuk hna i khua chung i thil sunglawi deuh paohpaoh kha an lak dih."},"28":{"text":"Khua chung i a ummi thil he ramlak i a ummi thil he an lak dih hna — an saṭil run le laa le thil kip kha an lak hna."},"29":{"text":"An chawva vialte kha an lak, nu le ngakchia pawl vialte kha an tlaih hna i inn chung i a ummi thil vialte kha an i kalpi dih."},"30":{"text":"Jakob nih Simeon le Levi cu, “Harnak chungah nan ka paih ai; atu cu hi ramchung mi vialte Kanaan mi hna le Periz mi hna nih an ka huat cang. Kei cu mi tampi a ngeimi ka si lo, cucaah cun hi hna vialte hi an i fonh dih i an ka tuk ahcun, keimah he ka innchungkhar dihlak he an kan hloh ko lai,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih, “Kan farnu kha hlawhhlang bantukin tuah cu kan ing kho lo cu ta,” tiah an leh."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian nih Jakob cu a thawh i, “I tim law Bethel ah kal law cuka ah cun va um. Cun na u Esau sinin na zam lio i na sin i a langmi Pathian caah khan cuka ah cun biakṭheng pakhat in va ser,” a ti.","title":"Jakob Thluachuah A Pek","ref":"Gen 28.11-17"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah Jakob nih cun a innchungkhar le a sin i a ummi kha an dihlak in, “Nan i chiahmi ramdang pathian kha hlonh dih hna u; i thianh u law thil thiang i hruk u."},"3":{"text":"Hika hmun hi kan chuahtak lai i Bethel ah kan kal lai, cuka ah cun harnak ka in caan le khuazeika ka kalnak hmanh i a ka umpitu Pathian caah khan biakṭheng pakhat ka ser lai,” a ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah an i chiahmi ramdang pathian vialte le an i tonhmi hnatonh vialte kha Jakob cu an pek i Shekhem pawng i a ummi kuhthing toiah khan a thuh hna."},"5":{"text":"Jakob le a fapa hna cu kal awk i an i thawh tikah khan, an pawngkam khuami hna cungah cun ṭihnak nganpi a tlung i cucaah an dawi ngam hna lo."},"6":{"text":"Jakob cu a mi vialte hna he Kanaan ram khua Luz cu an phan (Luz cu Bethel a si)."},"7":{"text":"Cuka ah cun biakṭheng pakhat a ser i cuka hmun cu a min ah Bethel a sak; zeicahtiah a u sinin a zam lioah khan khaka hmun ah khan a sinah Pathian a lang."},"8":{"text":"Rebekah umtu Deborah kha a thi i Bethel khua thlang i kuhthing tangah cun an vui. Cucaah “Ṭahnak kuhthing” tiah min an sak."},"9":{"text":"Jakob cu Mesopotamia ram in a hung kir ṭhan tikah khan Pathian cu a sinah a lang ṭhan i thluachuah a pek."},"10":{"text":"Pathian nih cun a thawh i, “Na min cu Jakob a si, sihmanhsehlaw atu ri hin cun na min cu Israel a si cang lai,” a ti. Cucaah Israel ti a si.","ref":"Gen 32.28"},"11":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih amah cu, “Keimah cu Lianngan Bik Pathian ka si. Fa tam piin ngei hna. Tefa tampi na ngei lai i a cheu cu siangpahrang an si lai. Na tefa cu an tam tuk lai caah miphun tampi ah an cang lai.","ref":"Gen 17.4-8"},"12":{"text":"Abraham le Isak ka pekmi hna ram kha nangmah kan pek lai i cu ram cu na hnu i a ummi na tefa hna zong cu ka pek hna lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih an i chawnhnak hmun ah khan Jakob cu a kaltak i vancung ah a kir ṭhan."},"14":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Jakob nih rolung pakhat a bunh i a cungah cun din awk thawinak a toih i chiti zong a toih.","ref":"Gen 28.18-19"},"15":{"text":"Cuka hmun cu a min ah Bethel a sak."},"16":{"text":"Bethel khua cun an i thawh i Efrath khua in hla nawn an si rih lioah khin, Rachel cu a nau ngan a fak i a zualhma ngaingai.","title":"Rachel A Thi"},"17":{"text":"Cu ti i a ngan a fah lioah cun, nau hlawmtu nu nih khan, “Na thinphang hlah, fapa na ngei ṭhan,” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun a thaw hmanung bik sinah cun, a cahpah khin, “Ben-oni run ti u,” a ti, asinain a pa nih cun, Benjamin tiah a min cu a sak."},"19":{"text":"Rachel cu a thi i Efrath lei kalnak lam ah khan an vui. Efrath cu Bethlehem ti a si cang."},"20":{"text":"Jakob nih a thlan ah cun philh lonak lung pakhat a phun i cu “Rachel Lungphun” cu atu tiang hin cuka ah cun a um."},"21":{"text":"Israel cu a va lan i Eder innsang ralchan ah khan a riahnak hmun cu a ser."},"22":{"text":"Israel kha cu ram i a um lioah cun Reuben nih khan a pa nupi pakhat Bilhah cu a ihpi. Cu kong cu Israel nih khan a theih i a thin a hung ngaingai. Jakob fapa cu hleihnih an si:","title":"Jakob Fapa Hna (1Cha 2.1-2)","ref":"Gen 49.4"},"23":{"text":"Leah fa ah Reuben, Jakob fapa upa bik, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Isakhar le Zebulun an si."},"24":{"text":"Rachel fa ah Josef le Benjamin an si."},"25":{"text":"Rachel salnu Bilhah fa ah, Dan le Naftali an si."},"26":{"text":"Leah salnu Zilpah fa ah, Gad le Asher an si. Hi hna hi Jakob nih Mesopotamia ram ah a hrinmi an si."},"27":{"text":"Jakob cu a pa Isak sin kha a phan, Isak cu Mamre ah khan a rak um i Mamre cu Abraham le Isak an rak umnak khua a si, (Mamre cu Kiriath-arba ti zongah ti a si, Hebron ti zongah ti a si).","title":"Isak Thihnak","ref":"Gen 13.18"},"28":{"text":"Isak cu a thih ah kum za le sawm riat a si,"},"29":{"text":"Tar tlung nung in a mi hna cu thihnak ah khan a fonh hna i a fapa Esau le Jakob nih khan an vui."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Esau tefa cu hi hna hi an si, (Esau cu Edom ti zongah ti a si).","title":"Esau Tefa Hna (1Cha 1.34-37)"},"2":{"text":"Esau nih Kanaan minu kha a ṭhit hna, cu hna cu Hit mi Elon fanu Adah, Hiv mi Zibeon fapa Anah i fanu Oholibamah,","ref":"Gen 26.34"},"3":{"text":"le Ishmael fanu Basemath an si; Basemath cu Nebaioth far a si.","ref":"Gen 28.9"},"4":{"text":"Adah nih Esau cu Elifaz a hrinpiak, Basemath nih Reuel a hrinpiak;"},"5":{"text":"cun Oholibamah nih Jeush, Jalam le Korah a hrin hna. Hi hna hi Esau nih Kanaan ram chungah a hrinmi an si."},"6":{"text":"Cun Esau nih a nupi hna le a fapa hna le a fanu hna le a innchung i a ummi vialte hna le, a caw vialte hna le Kanaan ram chung i a ngeihmi thilri vialte hna he khan aa pong i a nau Jakob sinin ram hlapi ah a kal."},"7":{"text":"Zeicahdah a kal ti ahcun Jakob he an umnak ram nih khan a cawm kho ti hna lo; saṭil tam tuk an ngei i hmunkhat ah an um kho ti lo."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Esau (Edom) cu Seir tlangram ah khan a va um."},"9":{"text":"Hi hna hi Seir tlangram i a ummi Edom mi hna an pa Esau i a tefa cu an si."},"10":{"text":"Esau fapa hna min cu hihi an si: Elifaz, amah cu Esau nupi Adah fapa a si, Reuel, amah cu Esau nupi Basemath fapa a si."},"11":{"text":"Elifaz fapa hna cu: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam le Kenaz an si."},"12":{"text":"Timna cu Esau fapa Elifaz nupi hna lak i pakhat a si i amah nih cun Amalek a hrin. Hi hna hi Esau nupi Adah fapa cu an si."},"13":{"text":"Reuel fapa hna cu: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah le Mizzah an si. Hi hna hi Esau nupi Basemath fapa cu an si."},"14":{"text":"Esau nupi Oholibamah fapa hna cu Jeush, Jalam le Korah an si. Oholibamah cu Zibeon fapa Anah i a fanu a si."},"15":{"text":"Hi hna hi Esau tefa lakah phuntungtu pawl cu an si. Esau fapa upa bik Elifaz fapa hna lak i bawi cu Teman, Omar, Zefo, Kenaz,"},"16":{"text":"Korah, Gatam le Amalek an si. Hi hna hi Edom ram chung i a ummi Elifaz tefa hna lak i phuntungtu cu an si. Annih cu Adah fapa kha an si."},"17":{"text":"Esau fapa Reuel fapa cu hi hna hi an si. Annih lak i phuntungtu cu: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah le Mizzah an si. Hi hna hi Edom ram chung i a ummi Reuel tefa hna lak i phuntungtu cu an si. Annih cu Esau nupi Basemath fapa kha an si."},"18":{"text":"Esau nupi Oholibamah fapa cu hi hna hi an si: an phuntungtu cu Jeush, Jalam le Korah an si. Esau nupi Oholibamah, Anah fanu, nih a hrinmi phuntungtu cu hi hna hi an si."},"19":{"text":"Esau (Edom) tefa cu hi hi an si i an phuntungtu hna zong cu hi hna hi an si."},"20":{"text":"Hor miphun Seir fapa cu hi hi an si, annih cu cuka rammi cu an si: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,","title":"Seir Tefa Hna (1Cha 1.38-42)"},"21":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer le Dishan. Hi hna hi Hor miphun an phuntungtu, Edom ram i a ummi Seir fapa cu an si."},"22":{"text":"Lotan fapa cu Hori le Heman an si; Timna cu Lotan far a si."},"23":{"text":"Shobal fapa cu Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shefo, le Onam an si."},"24":{"text":"Zibeon fapa cu Aiah le Anah an si. (Anah hi a pa Zibeon laa ramlak i a khalh lio hna ah, ti lum cerh a hmutu kha a si)."},"25":{"text":"Anah fale cu, Dishon le Anah fanu Oholibamah kha an si."},"26":{"text":"Dishon fapa cu Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, le Kheran an si."},"27":{"text":"Ezer fapa cu Bilhan, Zaavan le Akan an si."},"28":{"text":"Dishan fapa cu Uz le Aran an si."},"29":{"text":"Hor miphun phuntungtu hna cu Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah"},"30":{"text":"Dishon, Ezer le Dishan an si. Hormi phuntungtu cu an phun ning cio in Seir ram ah hi hna hi an si."},"31":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang ahohmanh nih Edom ram cu an uk hlanah, cu ram a rak uktu siangpahrang cu hi hna hi an si.","title":"Edom Siangpahrang Hna (1Cha 1.43-54)"},"32":{"text":"Beor fapa Bela nih Edom ram cu a rak uk, a khua cu a min ah Dinhabah a si."},"33":{"text":"Bela a thih tikah Bozrah khuami Zerah fapa Jobab nih khan a hun chaan."},"34":{"text":"Jobab a thih tikah Teman mi hna ram i a ummi Husham nih a hun chaan."},"35":{"text":"Husham a thih tikah, Moab ram chung i Midian a rak teitu Bedad fapa Hadad nih khan a hun chaan. A khua min cu Avith a si."},"36":{"text":"Hadad a thih tikah Masrekah khuami Samlah nih khan a hun chaan."},"37":{"text":"Samlah a thih tikah, Zufrates tiva kam i a ummi khua Rehoboth khuami Shaul nih khan a hun chaan."},"38":{"text":"Shaul a thih tikah, Baal-hanan, Akhor fapa nih khan a hun chaan."},"39":{"text":"Akhor fapa Baal-hanan a thih tikah Hadad nih a chaan. A khua min cu Pau a si i a nupi cu Mehetabel a si. Mehetabel cu Matred fanu a si i Matred cu Mezahab fanu a si."},"40":{"text":"Esau tefa hna lak i phuntungtu cu hi hna hi an si, an phun ning cio le an umnak hmun ning cio in ṭial an si: Timna, Albah, Jetheth,"},"41":{"text":"Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,"},"42":{"text":"Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,"},"43":{"text":"Magdiel le Iram. Hi hna hi Edom phuntungtu hna cu an si, anmah ram a simi i an umnak hmun ning cio in ṭial an si (Edom mi hna pa cu Esau a si)."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asinain Jakob cu a pa rak umnak Kanaan ram chungah khan a um ko."},"2":{"text":"Jakob tefa hna tuanbia cu hihi a si. Kum hleisarih a simi tlangval Josef cu a unau pawl, a pa nupi Bilhah le Zilpah fapa hna he khan tuu le meheh an cawng tawn i a unau pawl nih thil ṭhalo an tuahmi kha a pa cu a chimh tawn.","title":"Josef le A Unau Hna Kong"},"3":{"text":"Josef cu a tar hnu i a hrinmi a fa a si caah Israel nih khan a fale dang nakin a dawt khun i angki leng a saumi ban fual kha a serpiak."},"4":{"text":"An pa nih annih nakin Josef a dawt deuh kha a unau hna nih cun an hmuh tikah an huat ngaingai i a chawnh hmanh ṭhiṭha in an chawn duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Voi khat cu Josef nih cun mang a manh i a mang cu a unau pawl kha a chimh hna. Cucaah cun an huat chinchin."},"6":{"text":"A thawh hna i, “Ka mang hi ngai hmanh u."},"7":{"text":"Lo pakhat ah hin kan dihlak in kan um i faphal kan tom len ko. Cu lioah cun ka faphal cu a tho i ding tein a dir. Cun nannih nan faphal hna nih khan an kulh i a hmaiah an kun,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"A unau pawl nih cun, “Kan cungah siangpahrang ka si lai tiin dahra naa ruah? Nangmah nih cun maw na kan uk ko hnga?” an ti i a mang kong a chimhmi hna ruangah cun an huat chinchin."},"9":{"text":"Cun Josef nih cun mang dang pakhat a manh ṭhan i, “Mang dang pakhat ka manh ṭhan i cu ka mang ah cun nika le thlapa le arfi hleikhat nih ka hmaiah an kun,” tiah a unau pawl cu a chimh hna."},"10":{"text":"A mang cu a pa le a unau pawl kha a chimh hna i a pa nih cun a sik i, “Zei bantuk mang dah na manh?
