fapa Uri fapa Bezalel kha a thim cang.","title":"Pathian Umnak Thlam Sertu (Exo 31.1-11)"},"31":{"text":"Amah cu Bawipa nih Pathian Thlarau in a khahter caah thil dawh a phunphun ser khawhnak thiamnak le thil ti khawhnak le hngalhnak kha a ngei i"},"32":{"text":"dawh tein pungsan suai khawhnak le sui le ngun le dar in dawh tein ṭamh thiamnak le"},"33":{"text":"ṭamhnak lungvar at thiamnak le thing dawh tein suai thiamnak le thil dawh a phunphun ser thiamnak kha a ngei."},"34":{"text":"Bezalel le Dan phun chungmi Ahisamak fapa Oholiab cu Bawipa nih an thiamnak kha midang cawnpiak thiamnak a pek hna."},"35":{"text":"Lung ṭialtu hna le pungsan suai thiammi hna le tuuhmul a dum, a sendung, a sen le khumla hmang ṭhia tah a thiammi hna le puantah thiammi hna zungthiamnak kha, thil a phunphun an tuah khawh nakhnga a pek hna. Thil a phunphun kha an tuah khawh i pungsan suai thiam ngaingaimi an si."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Bazalel le Oholiab le Bawipa nih thiamnak le hngalhnak a pekmi zungthiammi vialte hna, biakinn saknak caah a herhmi thil paohpaoh tuah a thiammi hna nih khan, zeizong vialte cu Bawipa nih a chimning tein an ser awk a si lai,” a ti hna."},"2":{"text":"Moses nih Bezalel le Oholiab le Bawipa nih thiamnak a pekmi zungthiam pawl vialte, rianṭuan awk caah timhcia in a ummi vialte hna kha a auh hna i rian cu thawk cang u tiah a ti hna.","title":"Laksawng Tampi An Rak Put"},"3":{"text":"Israel mi nih biakinn saknak caah an thawhmi thawhlawm vialte cu Moses nih khan a pek hna. Israel mi nih khan an thawhlawm cu zingfate in Moses sinah khan an rak put lengmang."},"4":{"text":"Biakinn a satu zungthiam pawl nih khan an rian cio cu an kaltak zau i Moses sinah cun an ra i"},"5":{"text":"“ Bawipa nih a kan fialmi rianṭuannak caah mi zapi nih an rak putmi cu a za leng a si cang,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah riahhmun chungah cun Moses nih bia a thanh i, “Biakinn saknak ca thawhlawm kholhmi ah ahohmanh nih, nu nan si ah pa nan si ah, rak tho ti hlah u,” a ti. Cuticun mi nih khan thil rak put cu an ngol."},"7":{"text":"An rak put cia kha rian a dihlak limnak ding caah a za leng a si cang."},"8":{"text":"Rian a ṭuanmi hna lak i zungthiam bikbik pawl nih khan Pathian umnak thlam cu an ser. Puan zun hra in cu biakinn cu an ser i cu puan cu khumlahrual hmangṭhia le tuuhmul dum, sendung le a sen in tahmi an si i an cungah cherubim kha dawh tein an suai hna.","title":"Pathian Umnak Thlam Sernak (Exo 26.1-37)"},"9":{"text":"Puan cu an i ngaw dih i a sau pe sawm li le pe hnih, a kauh pe ruk cio an si."},"10":{"text":"Puan zun nga cu hmunkhat ah an ṭhit hna i a dang zun nga zong cu hmunkhat ah an ṭhit ve hna."},"11":{"text":"An bu a lenglei bik i a ummi puan tlang ah khan puan dum in hnam an sih hna."},"12":{"text":"Bu khatnak puan hmasa bik ah khan hnam sawm nga an sih hna i bu hnihnak puan a hmanung bik ah khan, bu khatnak he i rup dingin hnam sawm nga ṭhiamṭhiam an sih fawn hna."},"13":{"text":"Sui sio sawm nga an ser hna i cu sui sio cun an bu hnih cun hmunkhat ah an peh hna. Cuticun Pathian umnak thlam cu inn pakhat ah a cang."},"14":{"text":"Cun meheh hmul in puan zun hleikhat an ser hna i cucu Pathian umnak thlam cung i a ummi thlam kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Zun khat cu pe sawm li le pe nga cio an sau i pe ruk cio an kau, an dihlak in an i ngaw cio."},"16":{"text":"Zun nga kha bu khat ah an ṭhit hna i a dang zun ruk kha bu khat ve ah an ṭhit hna."},"17":{"text":"Bu khatnak puan hmanung bik ah khan a hnam sawm nga an sih hna i a dang bu zongah khan cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun sawm nga an sih ve hna."},"18":{"text":"Cu bu hnih pehnak ah cun dar sio sawm nga an ser hna i cuticun thlam khat ah a cang."},"19":{"text":"Thlam khuhnak cu tuukawng phaw si sen in buhmi in an ser i cu khuhnak a khuh chintu cu saphaw ṭha ngaiin an ser."},"20":{"text":"Pathian umnak thlam caah cun anri thing in vampang an ser hna."},"21":{"text":"Vampang cu pe hleinga sau le lehhmah kul le pasarih kau cio an si i"},"22":{"text":"pakhat le pakhat pehnak dingah aa rupmi a fong pahnih cio an ngeihter hna."},"23":{"text":"Thlanglei kam caah vampang kul an ser hna i"},"24":{"text":"an kedanh caah ngun in sermi kedanh sawm li an ser hna, tlap khat nih danh hnih cio an co i a fong an ngeihmi cio ah khan an danh hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun thlam chaklei kam caah khan tlap kul an ser hna,"},"26":{"text":"tlap khat caah danh hnih lengmang in ngun kedanh sawm li an ser hna."},"27":{"text":"Thlam hnulei, nitlaklei caah khan tlap ruk an ser hna,"},"28":{"text":"cun thlam hnulei a kil veve caah khan tlap hnih an ser hna."},"29":{"text":"Hi a kil tlap hna hi a hram in an i peh i a par tiang an i tlai, a kual hmasa bik tiang khan an i tlai. A kil vampang pahnih hna cu, cuticun ser an si."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah vampang pariat le ngun kedanh hleiruk, tlap khat caah pahnih lengmang an si."},"31":{"text":"Cun anri thing in thingthluan an ser hna, khattelei kap vampang caah thluan nga,"},"32":{"text":"khattelei kam vampang caah thluan nga, nitlaklei kam, a hnulei vampang caah thluan nga an ser hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun a laifang thingthluan cu khattelei deng in khattelei deng tiang vampang laifang in an khan."},"34":{"text":"Vampang cu sui an hut hna i thingthluan hrolhnak dingah khan sui kual an thlaih hna, sui kual zong cu sui in an hut ve hna."},"35":{"text":"Puanzar cu tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a senmi le khumla hrual hmangṭhia in an ser hna i a cungah cherubim hmanthlak kha dawh tein an suai hna."},"36":{"text":"Puanzar dohnak caah cun anri tung pali an ser hna i sui in an hut hna i sui sio an thlaih hna. Tung an dirnak caah cun ngun kedanh pali an ser hna."},"37":{"text":"Thlam chung luhnak innka caah tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a sen le khumla hrual hmangṭhia in puanzar an ser i dawh tein an ṭamh."},"38":{"text":"Tung panga an ser hna i sio an thlaih cio hna, an lu lei kha le an fung kha sui an hut hna. Tung caah cun dar kedanh panga an ser hna."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bezalel nih khan biakamnak kuang cu anri thing in a ser; a tung dong hnih le a cheu, a vang dong khat le a cheu a si i a san dong khat le a cheu a si.","title":"Biakamnak Kuang Sernak (Exo 25.10-22)"},"2":{"text":"Sui thiang in a chung he a leng he a hut i a velchum in sui in a tlang a kawm."},"3":{"text":"Cun a putnak ding caah sui kual pali a ser hna i a ke pali ah khan a thlaih hna, kam khat ah kual hnih lengmang a thlaih hna."},"4":{"text":"Anri thing in lang a ser hna i sui in a hut hna."},"5":{"text":"Kuang kap i a ummi kual ah khan a hrolh hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun a chin sui thiang in a ser, lehhmah sawm li le panga a sau i lehhmah kul le pasarih a kau."},"7":{"text":"A chin a donghnak veve caah cun denmi sui in cherubim pahnih a ser hna,"},"8":{"text":"kam khat ah pakhat veve in a chiah hna. A chin he cun i pehtlai dih in a ser hna."},"9":{"text":"Cherubim vancungmi nih cun an thla kha an cunglei ah an zam i cuticun a chin kha an huh; pakhat le pakhat hmaitonh in an um i kuang chin kha an zoh veve."},"10":{"text":"Cabuai cu anri thing in a ser, pe thum a sau, pe khat le a cheu a kau i pe hnih le lehmah pathum a sang.","title":"Cabuai Sernak (Exo 25.23-30)"},"11":{"text":"Sui thiang in a tuam i a velchum in sui taisawm a somh."},"12":{"text":"A tlang kha lehhmah pali kau in a ser i a tlang ah cun sui taisawm a somh."},"13":{"text":"A zawnhnak dingah sui kual pali a ser hna i a kil pali, a ke umnak ah khan a thlaih hna."},"14":{"text":"A zawnhnak lang hrolhnak kual cu a tlang pawngah khan a chiah hna."},"15":{"text":"A lang cu anri thing in a ser hna i sui a hut hna."},"16":{"text":"Cabuai ca kheng cu sui thiang in a ser hna: din awk thawinak ca hmanmi kheng hna le hrai hna le awi-um hna le khengkuar hna cu sui in a ser hna."},"17":{"text":"Meiinn tung cu sui thiang in a ser. A hram le a tung cu denmi sui in a ser hna; cun a thuamhnak pangpar a kuhkulul tete hna le a par a sarhmi hna cu a tung he cun i pehtlai dih in a ser hna.","title":"Meiinn Tung Sernak (Exo 25.31-40)"},"18":{"text":"Kam khat in nge pathum veve an tho i an dihlak ah paruk an si."},"19":{"text":"Cu nge paruk hna nih cun ṭamhnak pangpar pathum cio an ngei i cu pangpar hna cu almon par bantukin sermi an si, a kuhkulul tete le a par a sarhmi an ngei cio."},"20":{"text":"Meiinn tung nih cun ṭamhnak pangpar pali a ngei i cu pangpar hna cu almon par bantukin sermi an si i a kuhkulul tete le a par a samhmi an ngei cio."},"21":{"text":"A nge tuah thum hna tang cio ah khan a kuhkulul pakhat cio an um."},"22":{"text":"A kuhkulul hna le a nge hna cu meiinn tung he khan an i peh dih; denmi sui in sa khat ah ser an si dih ko."},"23":{"text":"Cun meiinn tung caah cun meiinn pasarih a ser hna; cun a cengceh le a vutcam ruhnak cu sui thiang in a ser hna."},"24":{"text":"Meiinn tung le a thilri vialte sernak ah sui thiang pawng za khat a hman."},"25":{"text":"Zihmui khanghnak biakṭheng kha anri thing in a ser. Tungvangpalh a si i pe khat le a cheu a sau i pe khat le a cheu a kau, cun pe thum a sang. A ki cu a pum he cun an i peh dih.","title":"Zihmui Khanghnak Biakṭheng (Exo 30.1-5)"},"26":{"text":"A cung, a kap kap li le a ki cu sui in a hut hna i a velchum in sui taisawm a somh."},"27":{"text":"A zawnhnak dingah sui kual pahnih a ser hna i a kap veve ah a tlang tangah khan a putnak ding lang hrolhnak dingah khan a thlaih hna."},"28":{"text":"A lang cu anri thing in a ser hna i sui a hut hna."},"29":{"text":"Thuhnak chiti thiang le zihmui thiang rim thawmi cu zihmui sertu nih a sermi bantukin a ser hna.","title":"Thuhnak Chiti le Zihmui (Exo 30.22-38)"}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khanghthawinak ca biakṭheng cu anri thing in a ser. Tungvangpalh a si, pe sarih le a cheu a sau i pe sarih le a cheu a kau, cun pe li le a cheu a sang.","title":"Biakṭheng (Exo 27.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"A kil pali ah khan ki pali a bunh hna i cu ki pali hna cu a pum he khan an i peh dih. A dihlak in dar in a tuam."},"3":{"text":"Biakṭheng ca thilri, um, cawhlek, khengkuar, sio le mei zawhnak pakan kha a ser hna. A thilri vialte cu an dihlak in dar in a ser hna."},"4":{"text":"Biakṭheng caah cun fingrilh pakhat a ser i cu fingrilh cu dar fingrilh a si. Cu fingrilh cu a tlang tangah khan a chiah i biakṭheng canceo cu a hun phak."},"5":{"text":"Cun a zawnhnak kual pali a ser hna i dar fingrilh kil pali ah cun lang hrolhnak ding caah khan a thlaih hna."},"6":{"text":"Lang cu anri thing in a ser hna i dar in a tuam hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun biakṭheng kap i aa thlaihmi kual ah khan a hrolh hna. Biakṭheng cu thing phel in a ser i a chung cu a kua."},"8":{"text":"Kut ṭawlnak dar kheng le a hunnak dar tawdanh cu nu pawl bihnak thlalang in a ser hna, cu nu pawl cu pumhnak thlam luhnak i rian a ṭuanmi kha an si.","title":"Kut Ṭawlnak Kheng (Exo 30.18)"},"9":{"text":"Tual kha a ser. Thlanglei kam ca puanzar cu khumlahrual hmangṭhia in tahmi a si i pe za le sawm nga a sau.","title":"Puan Biakinn Tual (Exo 27.9-19)"},"10":{"text":"Tung pakul hna le an dirnak kedanh pakul hna cu dar in sermi an si. Cu tung sio hna zong cu dar in sermi an si; cun cu tung nih cun ngun fung an ngei cio."},"11":{"text":"Chaklei kamah puanzar cu pe za le sawm nga a sau i tung pakul nih an doh, cu tung pakul hna cu dar kedanh pakul chungah khan an dir i sio an ngei cio i ngun fung zong an ngei cio."},"12":{"text":"Nitlaklei kamah puanzar cu pe sawm sarih le pe nga a sau i tung pahra nih an doh, cu tung pahra hna cu dar kedanh pahra chungah khan an dir i sio an ngei cio i ngun fung zong an ngei cio."},"13":{"text":"A nichuahlei kam cu pe sawm sarih le pe nga a kau."},"14":{"text":"A chung i vung luhnak khattelei kamah khan puanzar an um i pe kul le pe hnih le a cheu an kau i tung pathum kedanh chung i a dirmi nih khan an doh hna."},"15":{"text":"Khattelei kap zongah cun cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun a um; cucaah tual i vung luhnak kutka ah khan a kap hnih in puanzar pe kul le pe hnih le a cheu a kau i kedanh pathum chungah a dirmi tung pathum nih an dohmi kha an um veve."},"16":{"text":"Tual velchum i an hmanmi puanzar cu khumla hrual hmang ṭhia in tahmi an si."},"17":{"text":"Tung kedanh cu dar in an ser hna i tung ca i sio hna le an fung hna le an par khuhnak cu ngun in sermi an si. Tual kulhnak tung vialte cu ngun fung in peh dih an si."},"18":{"text":"Tual luhnak kutka ca puanzar cu dawh tein ṭamhmi a si i tuuhmul a dum, a sendung le a sen le khumlahrual hmang ṭhia in tahmi an si. Pe sawm thum a sau i pe sarih le a cheu a sang i tual kulhnak puanzar bantuk kha a si."},"19":{"text":"Dar kedanh pali chungah a dirmi tung pali nih an doh hna. An sio le an par tuamnak le an fung cu ngun in sermi an si."},"20":{"text":"Pathian umnak thlam le a velchum i a ummi a tual khenhnak fung cu dar in sermi an si."},"21":{"text":"Biakamnak lungtlap an chiahnak Pathian umnak thlam chung hmanmi thilri cu hihi a si: Cu thilri hna cu Moses nih a fial hna ningin tuahmi an si i tlangbawi Aaron fapa Ithamar kuttang i a ṭuanmi Levi mi hna nih an sermi an si.","title":"Biakinn Ca Hmanmi Thilri"},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses a fialmi vialte kha Judah phun chungmi Hur fapa Uri fapa Bezalel nih khan a tuah dih hna."},"23":{"text":"Amah a bawmtu Dan phun chung mi Ahisamak fapa Oholiab kha lung ṭial thiam, pungsan suai thiam le tuuhmul a dum, sendung, a sen le khumla hmangṭhia tah thiam a si."},"24":{"text":"Biakinn chung hmanmi sui cu a dihlak in pawng thong hnih za le sawm kua panga a si. Bawipa sinah pekchanhmi biakinn cuaithlainak in thlaimi an si."},"25":{"text":"An milu relning in thawhmi ngun cu pawng thong sarih, za nga sawm nga a si, cu zong cu biakinn cuaithlainak in thlaimi ṭhiamṭhiam an si.","ref":"Exo 30.11-16"},"26":{"text":"Milu relnak ah relmi nih an thawh awk hnga a simi ning cio ah an thawhmi cu hi zat hi a si i biakinn cuaithlainak in thlaimi an si. Milu relnak ah cun, pa kum kul ri in a cunglei cu thong za ruk le thong thum, za nga le sawm nga an si.","ref":"Mat 17.24"},"27":{"text":"Ngun chungin pawng thong sarih le za nga cu biakinn tungdanh le puanzar kedanh hna sernak ah khan hman an si: kedanh za khat an si i kedanh pakhat ah pawng sawm sarih panga cio a si."},"28":{"text":"A taang rihmi ngun pawng sawm nga cu tung, sio hna le an par khuhnak hna le an fung hna kha sernak ah khan Bezalel nih a hman."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa sin pekmi dar cu pawng sing thum le pahra a phan."},"30":{"text":"Cu dar cun pumhnak thlam luhnak innka tungdanh hna le dar biakṭheng le a dar fingrilh le biakṭheng ca thilri vialte le"},"31":{"text":"a velchum i a ummi tual kulhnak tungdanh hna le tual luhnak kutka tung danh hna le Pathian umnak thlam le a velchum tual ca fungkhenh vialte kha a ser hna."}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuuhmul a dum, a sendung le a senmi khan tlangbawi nih biakinn chung rian ṭuannak ca i a hman ding puan kha an ser hna. Bawipa nih Moses a chimhning khan Aaron ca puan thiang cu an ser hna.","title":"Tlangbawi Ca Thuam (Exo 28.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Angki thiang cu sui le tuuhmul a dum, a sendung le a sen a simi le khumla hrual hmang ṭhia khan a ser."},"3":{"text":"Sui tlap kha pan tein an den i an riam hnuah tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a senmi le khumla hrual hmang ṭhia in tahmi puan ah khan an tah chih hna i thawi in dawh tein an ṭamh."},"4":{"text":"Angki cu hnam a kap veve ah an sih i liang ah bah khawh a si."},"5":{"text":"Dawh tein tahmi taisawm cu angki he cun peh chih a si i cu taisawm cu angki ser bantuk khan ser a si ve, Bawipa nih Moses a fial bantuk te khan ser a si ve, Bawipa nih Moses a fial bantuk khan sui le tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a senmi le khumlahrual hmang ṭhia khan ser a si."},"6":{"text":"Karnelian lungvar kha an remh hna i sui tlangkawm chungah khan an benh hna, min khenhnak bantukin an ṭial hna i an cungah cun Israel fapa hna an min kha an ṭial."},"7":{"text":"Tlangbawi angki liang bahnak hnam ah cun an benh hna. Cu lungvar cu Israel fapa hna caah khan lung pemtertu lungvar an si i Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantukte khan tuah a si."},"8":{"text":"Ṭangbenh cu, angki bantuk khan, dawh tein a ser. Sui le tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a senmi le khumla hrual hmang ṭhia in an ser."},"9":{"text":"Tungvangpalh bil khawh dingin an ser; bil tikah a tung lehhmah pakua a si i a vang lehhmah pakua a si."},"10":{"text":"A cungah khan lungvar tlar li in an benh hna: a tlar hmasa bik ah cun rubi le topaz le karnet an si;"},"11":{"text":"a tlar hnihnak ah cun emeral, safaiar le daimon an si;"},"12":{"text":"a tlar thumnak ah jasin le agate le amethist an si,"},"13":{"text":"a tlar linak ah beril le oniks le jasper an si. Sui tlangkawm chungah ṭhutter an si."},"14":{"text":"Lungvar cu hleihnih an si i an cungah Israel fapa hna min kha an i ṭial. Min khenhnak bantukin ser an si. Israel phun hleihnih hna chung min pakhat cio kha an cungah cun aa ṭial cio."},"15":{"text":"Hri bantukin hrualmi sui thiang in sermi cikcin kha ṭangbenh caah cun an ser."},"16":{"text":"Sui tlangkawm pahnih le sui kual pahnih kha an ser hna i cu sui kual pahnih hna cu ṭangbenh a cunglei tlang kil pahnih ah khan an thlaih hna."},"17":{"text":"Sui hri pahnih cu sui kual ah khan an ṭem hna i"},"18":{"text":"sui hri khattelei an donghnak cu sui tlangkawm ah khan an hren veve hna i cuticun tlangbawi angki liang bahnak hnam pahnih hna hmailei ah khan an ṭem chih hna."},"19":{"text":"Sui kual pahnih an ser hna i ṭangbenh a tanglei tlang ki, angki a hun changtu a chunglei kamah khan an thlaih hna."},"20":{"text":"Sui kual pahnih an ser ṭhan i angki liang bahnak hnam pahnih hna an hmailei tanglei ah khan an thlaih hna; cucu a tlang pawngte ah khan a si i angki ca taisawm ṭha tein tahmi cungte ah khan a si."},"21":{"text":"Ṭangbenh sui kual cu angki sui kual ah khan la dum in an ṭem chih hna i cuticun ṭangbenh cu taisawm cungah khan a um i a poih lo; cu ti an tuahmi cu Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantuk te khan a si."},"22":{"text":"Angki a khuhtu puan cu tuuhmul a dummi lawnglawng in an tahmi a si."},"23":{"text":"Puan laifang i a ummi awng cu saphaw angki chung i a ummi awng bantuk kha a si. A awng cu tlek zau hlah seh tiah a tlang an kawm."},"24":{"text":"Puan a tanglei tlang ah cun tuuhmul a dum le sendung le a sen le khumla hrual hmangṭhia in taleti kha an ser hna."},"25":{"text":"Sui thiang khi-ing kha an ser hna i puan a tanglei tlang a velchum ah cun taleti le taleti karlak ah khan an chiah diahmah hna."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses a fial bantuk te khan, tlangbawi rian caah hmanmi puan cu a tanglei tlang duahmah ah khan khi-ing tete le taleti kha an thlaih diahmah hna."},"27":{"text":"Aaron le a fapa hna caah khan angki cu khumla hmangṭhia in an ser hna,"},"28":{"text":"lupawng cu khumla hmangṭhia in, lukhuh cu khumla hmangṭhia in, tawhrolh tawi cu khumla hrual hmangṭhia in,"},"29":{"text":"taisawm cu khumla hrual hmangṭhia le tuuhmul a dum, sendung le a senmi in an ser hna i dawh tein an ṭamh hna; Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantuk te khan an ser hna."},"30":{"text":"Cun Pathian sin pekmi ti hngalhnak hmelchunhnak cu sui thiang in an ser i min khenhnak cung ṭial bang khin “ Bawipa sin pekmi,” tiah an ṭial."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantuk te khan hri dum in lupawng par ah khan an ṭem chih."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun pumhnak thlam rian vialte cu lim an si. Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantukte khan Israel mi nih cun an tuah.","title":"Rian An Lim (Exo 35.10-19)"},"33":{"text":"Cun Moses sinah khan Pathian umnak puan biakinn, a cungkhuh thlam, a thilri vialte, a sio, a vampang, a thingthluan, a tung, an kedanh,"},"34":{"text":"tuukawng phaw si sen in buhmi in sermi a khuh, saphaw ṭha phun in sermi a khuh, phentu puanzar,"},"35":{"text":"biakamnak hngalhter ṭhantu lungtlap chiahnak kuang, a zawnhnak lang le a chin,"},"36":{"text":"cabuai le a thuamthil vialte, Pathian hmai hunmi changreu,"},"37":{"text":"sui thiang in sermi meiinn tung, a meiinn hna, a tlar in chiahmi meiinn hna, an thilthuam vialte, meiinn ca chiti,"},"38":{"text":"sui biakṭheng, thuhnak chiti, rimhmui zihmui, thlam luhnak kutka ca puanzar,"},"39":{"text":"dar biakṭheng le a dar fingrilh, a tung le a thilthuam vialte, kut ṭawlnak hmaihum le a hunnak,"},"40":{"text":"tual ca puanzar, tung, an kedanh, tual luhnak kutka ca puanzar, a hri le a thlam khenhnak fung, Pathian umnak thlam pumhnak thlam chung i rian ṭuannak ca i a herhmi thil vialte,"},"41":{"text":"biakinn chung tlangbawi rian ṭuannak ca thuam thiang, Aaron le a fapa hna nih tlangbawi rian an ṭuan caan i an i hruk awk thuam thiang, hi vialte hi an si."},"42":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantuk te khan Israel mi nih cun rian vialte kha an tuah dih."},"43":{"text":"An tuahmi vialte kha Moses nih ṭha tein a zoh i Bawipa nih a chimhning tein an tuah ti kha a hmuh. Cucaah Moses nih thluachuah a pek hna."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a thawh i,","title":"Puan Biakinn Cu Pathian Sinah An Pek"},"2":{"text":"“Thla khatnak thla ni khatnak ni ah Pathian umnak thlam pumhnak thlam cu na dirter lai."},"3":{"text":"Biakamnak hngalhter ṭhantu lungtlap hna umnak kuang kha a chungah na chiah lai i puanzar na khuh lai."},"4":{"text":"Cabuai kha a chungah na chiah lai i a cungah a thilri vialte kha na chiah hna lai. Meiinn tung zong kha na luhpi lai i a cungah a meiinn kha na chiah hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Zihmui khanghnak sui biakṭheng kha, biakamnak lungtlap hna umnak kuang hmaiah khan na chiah lai i pumhnak thlam luhnak innka ah khan puanzar kha na zar lai."},"6":{"text":"Pumhnak thlam hmaiah khan khangh thawinak biakṭheng kha na chiah lai."},"7":{"text":"Kut ṭawlnak hmaihum kha pumhnak thlam le biakṭheng karlak ah khan na chiah lai i a chungah ti na chiah lai."},"8":{"text":"A kulhtu tual kulhnak puanzar kha na zar hna lai i tual luhnak kutka puanzar kha na zar hna lai."},"9":{"text":"“Cun thuhnak chiti kha naa lak lai i Pathian umnak thlam le a chung i a ummi thil vialte kha na thuh hna lai. Cu thlam cu le a thilri vialte kha Pathian sinah na pek hna lai i cuticun thil zarh ah a cang lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun khanghthawinak biakṭheng le a thilri vialte kha chiti na thuh hna lai. Cuticun Pathian sinah na chanh hna lai i a zarh ngaingaimi thil ah an cang lai."},"11":{"text":"Kut ṭawlnak hmaihum le a danh zong kha chiti na thuh hna lai i Pathian sinah na pek hna lai."},"12":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa hna kha pumhnak thlam innka ah na ratpi hna lai i ti in na kholhter hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Aaron kha puan thiang cu na aihter lai i chiti na thuh lai i cuticun na thianter lai i ka tlangbawi rian kha a ṭuan lai."},"14":{"text":"A pawngah khan a fapale kha na ratpi hna lai i angki kha na aih hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun an pa chiti na thuh bantuk khan chiti na thuh ve hna lai i ka tlangbawi rian kha an ṭuan lai. Chiti na thuhmi hna nih khan dong loin tlangbawi a siter hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nih a fial bantuk tein zeizong vialte kha Moses nih a tuah dih."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Izipt ram in an chuah hnu a kum hnihnak, thla khatnak thla ni khatnak ni ah khan Pathian umnak thlam cu an dirter."},"18":{"text":"Moses nih khan a dirter. A danh vialte kha a chiah hna, a vampang kha a dirter hna, a thingthluan kha a hrolh hna, a tung kha a dirter hna."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih a fial bantuk te khan Pathian umnak thlam chungah cun thlam kha a samh i thlam cu a khuh kha a khuh."},"20":{"text":"Cun biakamnak lungtlap kha a lak hna i kuang chungah khan a chiah hna. Kuang i thlaihmi sui kual ah khan lang kha a hrolh hna i a chin kha a chinh."},"21":{"text":"Cun kuang cu Pathian umnak thlam chungah khan a chiah i a phentu puanzar kha a zar hna. Cuticun Bawipa nih a chimh bantuk te khan biakamnak lungtlap umnak kuang kha him tein a umter."},"22":{"text":"Cun cabuai kha pumhnak thlam chungah khan a chiah, cucu Pathian umnak thlam chaklei kamah khan a si i puanzar lengah khan a si i"},"23":{"text":"a cungah khan Pathian hmai hunmi changreu kha a hun hna, cucu Bawipa nih a chimhningte khan a si."},"24":{"text":"Meiinn tung kha pumhnak thlam chungah cun cabuai he hmaitonh in a chiah, cucu thlam thlanglei kamah khan a si."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa hmaiah meiinn tung cungah cun meiinn kha a chiah hna i cucu Bawipa nih a chimhning te khan a si."},"26":{"text":"Sui biakṭheng kha pumhnak thlam chungah khan, puanzar he hmaitonh in a chiah."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa nih a fial bantuk khan a cungah khan a rim a thawmi zihmui kha a khangh."},"28":{"text":"Thlam luhnak innka puanzar kha a zar hna."},"29":{"text":"Pumhnak thlam innka ah khan khangh thawinak biakṭheng kha a chiah. Bawipa nih a chimh bantukin cu cungah cun khangh thawinak kha a thawi i ei awk thawinak kha a khangh hna."},"30":{"text":"Thlam le biakṭheng karah cun kut ṭawlnak hmaihum kha a hun i kut ṭawlnak dingah ti kha a chungah cun a chiah."},"31":{"text":"Moses le Aaron le Aaron fapa hna nih khan an kut le an ke kha an i ṭawl."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bantuk te khan pumhnak thlam i an luh le biakṭheng lei i an kal ah, an i ṭawl lengmang."},"33":{"text":"Thlam le biakṭheng kulhtu tual kulhnak puanzar kha a zar hna. Cuticun Moses nih rian vialte kha a lim."},"34":{"text":"Pumhnak thlam cu minmei nih a huh i Bawipa sunparnak kha a chung cu a khat.","title":"Pumhnak Thlam Cung Minmei (Nam 9.15-23)","ref":"1Sia 8.10-11; Isa 6.4; Eze 43.4-5; Biat 15.8"},"35":{"text":"Pumhnak thlam cungah cun minmei kha a um i Bawipa sunparnak cu a chung kha a khah caah Moses cu a lut kho lo."},"36":{"text":"Israel mi kha riahhmun pakhat in riahhmun pakhat ah an i ṭhial tikah Pathian umnak thlam cung i minmei kha aa ṭhial lawnglawng ah an i ṭhial tawn."},"37":{"text":"Minmei kha aa ṭhial lo ahcun annih zong riahhmun dang ah khan an i ṭhial ve lo, minmei aa ṭhial ni tiang kha an ngan tawn."},"38":{"text":"Pathian an sin i a um hmelchunhnak minmei cu, chun ah Pathian umnak thlam cungah khan a um i zan ah minmei chungah khan mei alh a um; cucu Israel mi nih riahhmun pakhat in pakhat ah an i thawn lengmang ah khan an hmuh zungzal."}}}}},"3":{"info":{"name":"Levitikas","shortname":"Lev","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a kawh i tonnak thlam chungin a chawnh i hi bangin a ti:","title":"Khangh Thawinak Kong"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah cun chim law, annih sinah: Nannih lakah ahohmanh nih Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak nan tuah tikah saṭil pekchanhnak cu cawrun chungin siseh, tuurun chungin siseh, nan rak put lai, ti hna."},"3":{"text":"“A pekchanhnak cu cawrun chungin khangh thawinak a si ahcun, a tum do a tlami kha pek a si lai; Bawipa hmaiah amah cu cohlan a si nakhnga tonnak thlam innka ah cun a pek lai;"},"4":{"text":"amah nih khangh thawinak sa a lu cungah cun a kut a chiah lai i amah caah remnak tuahnak caah cohlanpiak a si lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa hmaiah cawtum kha a thah lai i Aaron fapa hna, tlangbawi hna nih khan, sa thi cu an pek lai i, tonnak thlam innka i a ummi biakṭheng kha a velchum in an theh lai."},"6":{"text":"Cun khangh thawinak sa cu a phaw a hawh lai i a can cikcek lai;"},"7":{"text":"cun tlangbawi Aaron fapa hna nih cun biakṭheng cungah cun mei an kau lai i a ningcang tein mei cungah cun thing an chiah lai;"},"8":{"text":"cun Aaron fapa hna tlangbawi hna nih cun biakṭheng cung mei cung thing cungah cun sazam hna cu, a lu le a thau cu a ningcang tein an chiah hna lai;"},"9":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a chungril hna le a ke hna cu ti in an ṭawl hna lai. Cun tlangbawi nih a dihlak in khangh thawinak caah biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai; mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"10":{"text":"“Khangh thawinak ca i a pekchanhmi cu tuurun chungin siseh, meheh run chungin siseh a si ahcun, a tum dotla a si lai;"},"11":{"text":"cun Bawipa hmaiah a ummi biakṭheng chaklei kamah a thah lai i Aaron fapa hna tlangbawi hna nih khan a thi cu biakṭheng kha a velchum in an theh lai."},"12":{"text":"Cun a can cikcek lai, a lu he a thau he, cun tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cung mei cung thing cungah cun a ningcang tein a chiah hna lai;"},"13":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a chungril le a ke hna cu ti in a ṭawl hna lai. Cun tlangbawi nih a dihlak te cun a pek lai i biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai; khangh thawinak, mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"14":{"text":"“ Bawipa sin i a pekchanhmi cu vate khangh thawinak a si ahcun, a pekchanhmi ṭhuro si hna seh laileng no si hna seh a rak put hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih biakṭheng ah a rak put lai i a lu cu cat lak in a merh lai i biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai; cun a thi cu biakṭheng sirah cun a thlor lai;"},"16":{"text":"cun a cok cu a hmul he a lak lai i biakṭheng pawng i nichuahlei kam vutcam chiahnak hmun ah cun a hlonh lai;"},"17":{"text":"a thlaki a thlongh hna lai, sihmanhsehlaw a pum cu a cheu lai lo. Cun tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cungah cun, mei cung thing cungah cun a khangh lai; mah cucu khangh thawinak, mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw cu a si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih changvut thawinak kha Bawipa sin i thawinak ah a rak put tikah, a pekchanhmi cu changvut dipmite a si lai; chiti a toih lai i frankinsen a toih lai i","title":"Changvut Thawinak Kong"},"2":{"text":"Aaron fapa hna tlangbawi hna sinah khan a rak put lai. Cun cu chung cun changvut dipmi le chiti cu a frankinsen vialte he pei khat in a lak lai; cun tlangbawi nih cun mah hi cu hngalh camcinnak caah biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai; mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun changvut thawinak chungin a taangmi cu Aaron le a fapa hna caah a si lai; mah hi cu mei in thawinak Bawipa sin pekmi hna lakah a thiang bik a si ve."},"4":{"text":"“Changreu rawhnak um chung i rawhmi changvut thawinak cu na pekchanh tikah, thilnu telh lo changvut dip chiti he cawhmi changreu a si lai, asiloah, thilnu telh lo changreu pan chiti thuhmi a si lai."},"5":{"text":"Na pekchanhmi cu u-kang chungah reumi changvut thawinak a si ahcun, thilnu telh lomi changvut dip chiti he cawhmi a si lai;"},"6":{"text":"na hmal cikcek lai i chiti na toih lai; mah cucu changvut thawinak a si."},"7":{"text":"Cun na pekchanhmi cu um in chuanmi changvut thawinak a si ahcun changvut dip le chiti in na ser lai."},"8":{"text":"Hi thil in sermi changvut thawinak cu Bawipa sinah na rak put lai; tlangbawi sinah na chanh tikah biakṭheng ah a kalpi lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih changvut thawinak chung cun hngalh camcinnak kha a lak lai i biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai; mah cucu mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun changvut thawinak chungin a tangmi cu Aaron le a fapa hna caah a si lai; mah hi cu mei in thawinak Bawipa sin pekmi hna lakah a thiang bik a si ve."},"11":{"text":"“ Bawipa sinah nan rak putmi changvut thawinak paohpaoh cu thilnu telh in sermi a si lai lo; zeitintiah thilnu siseh khuaihliti siseh Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak caah nan khang lai lo."},"12":{"text":"Theitlai hmasa bik thawinak caah cun Bawipa sinah nan rak put ko hna lai, sihmanhsehlaw rimthaw caah cun biakṭheng cungah nan khang hna lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Nan changvut thawinak vialte cu cite nan phulh hna lai; nan Pathian he biakamnak cite cu nan changvut thawinak vialte chungin nan bauter lai lo; nan pekmi vialte sinah cite nan pek chih lai."},"14":{"text":"“ Bawipa sinah theitlai hmasa bik hna changvut thawinak nan pek ahcun, nan theitlai hmasa bik hna changvut thawinak caah cun a voi tharmi chungin lakmi, mei in reu i rialmi fang nan pek lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun chiti nan toih lai i frankinsen nan toih ve lai; mah cucu changvut thawinak pakhat a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih hngalh camcinnak caah cun rialmi fang le chiti cawhmi a cheu cu, frankinsen a dihlak he, a khangh lai; mah cucu Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak a si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat nih a pekchanhmi cu daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak a si ahcun, cawrun chungin saṭil pakhatkhat, a pa siseh a nu siseh, a pekchanh ahcun, Bawipa hmaiah dotla a pek awk a si lai.","title":"Daihnak Thawinak Kong"},"2":{"text":"Cun a pekchanhmi lu cungah a kut a chuan lai i tonnak thlam innka ah a thah lai i Aaron fapa hna, tlangbawi hna nih khan, a thi cun biakṭheng kha a velchum in an theh lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak chungin, Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak caah, a chungril khuhtu thau le, a kiar vialte le,"},"4":{"text":"a kal pahnih le an cung i a tai zawn ah a ummi thau le, kal hna he a lak chihmi a thin tuamtu cu a pek hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa hna nih biakṭheng cungah mei cung i thing cung i khangh thawinak sa cungah cun an khangh lai; mei in thawinak, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si."},"6":{"text":"“A pekchanhmi cu, Bawipa sin i daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak caah, tuurun chungin saṭil pakhat a pa siseh a nu siseh a si ahcun, dotla a si lai."},"7":{"text":"A pekchanhmi cu tuufa a si ahcun Bawipa hmaiah a pek lai."},"8":{"text":"A laksawng lu cungah cun a kut a chuan lai i tonnak thlam hmaiah a thah lai; cun Aaron fapa hna nih a thi cu biakṭheng a velchum ah khan an theh lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak chung cun, Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak caah, a thau kha le, a thaumi a mei cu a thluan in, a kengruh tiangin a hun khoihmi le, a chungril a khuhtu thau le a kiar vialte le,"},"10":{"text":"a kal pahnih a tai zawn i a ummi thau he, cun a thin tuamtu a kal hna he a lak chihmi cu a pek lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cungah cun Bawipa sinah mei in pekmi rawl ah a khangh lai."},"12":{"text":"“A pekchanhmi cu meheh a si ahcun, Bawipa hmaiah a pek lai."},"13":{"text":"A lu cungah a kut a chuan lai i tonnak thlam hmaiah a thah lai; cun Aaron fapa hna nih a thi cu biakṭheng a velchum ah khan an theh lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun mah chung cun, Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak caah amah laksawng ah, a chungril a khuhtu thau le, a kiar vialte le"},"15":{"text":"a kal pahnih a tai zawn i a ummi thau he, cun a thin tuamtu a kal hna he a lak chihmi cu a thawi lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cungah rimthaw ca i mei in thawimi rawl ah a khangh hna lai. Thau vialte cu Bawipa ta a si."},"17":{"text":"Thau siseh thi siseh nan ei lai lo, mah hihi nan chan chung vialte, nan umnak hmun kip ah, zungzal nawlbia a si lai.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu, “Israel mi kha chim hna law,","title":"Sual Thawinak Kong"},"2":{"text":"timh ciammam si loin sualnak a tuah i Bawipa nawlbia a buarmi hna cu a tanglei nawlbia hi an zulh a hau lai, va ti hna."},"3":{"text":"Sualnak a tuahmi cu Tlangbawi Ngan a si i mizapi cungah mawhnak a tlunter a si ahcun, cawtum no dotla pakhat Bawipa sinah a sualnak hna caah cun a thawi lai."},"4":{"text":"Cawtum cu tonnak thlam innka ah Bawipa hmaiah cun a rak put lai i cawtum lu cungah cun a kut a chuan lai i Bawipa hmaiah cun cawtum cu a thah lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun chiti thuhmi tlangbawi nih cawtum thi tlawmpal cu a lak lai i tonnak thlam ah a rak put lai;"},"6":{"text":"thi chungah cun tlangbawi nih a kutdong a hnim lai i hmunthiang puanzar hmai Bawipa hmaika ah cun thi cu tlawmpal in voi sarih a theh lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih tonnak thlam chung a ummi rimthaw zihmui biakṭheng ki hna ah cun, Bawipa hmaika ah, thi cu tlawmpal a thuh lai. Cun cawtum thi a taang mi cu tonnak thlam innka ah a ummi khangh thawinak biakṭheng hram ah cun a thlet lai."},"8":{"text":"Cun sual thawinak cawtum thau vialte cu a chuah dih lai, a chungril tuamtu thau siseh, a kiar siseh,"},"9":{"text":"a kal pahnih a tai zawn ah a ummi le an thau si hna seh, a thin tuamtu siseh, a lak hna lai i"},"10":{"text":"daihnak thawinak ca i pekchanhmi cawtum a thau a tuah bantuk khan, khangh thawinak biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cawtum phaw le a sa vialte cu, a lu he, a ke hna he, a chungril hna he, a ek he,"},"12":{"text":"cawtum cu a pumpi in riahbuk lengah hmun thiang pakhat vutcam thletnak hmun ah cun, a kalpi lai i thing cungah a khangh lai; vutcam thletnak hmun ah cun khangh a si lai."},"13":{"text":"“Israel mi bu nih an bupi in hngalh loin sualnak an tuah i cu thil cu zapi hmuh lomi thil a si i Bawipa nih tuah lo awk tiin nawl a pekmi pakhatkhat cu an tuah i an mawh ahcun,"},"14":{"text":"annih nih an tuahmi sualnak cu a langh tikah, an zapi in sual thawinak caah cawtum no pakhat an thawi lai i tonnak thlam hmaiah an rak put lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun an bu chung upa hna nih cawtum lu ah cun Bawipa hmaika ah an kut an chuan lai i cawtum cu Bawipa hmaika ah an thah lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun chiti thuhmi tlangbawi nih cawtum thi cu tlawmpal in tonnak ah a rak put lai i"},"17":{"text":"tlangbawi nih cun sathi chungah cun a kutdong a hnim lai i Bawipa hmaiah puanzar hmaiah cun voi sarih a theh lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun sathi cu tlawmpal in tonnak thlam chungah a ummi biakṭheng ki ah cun a thuh lai, Bawipa hmaika ah cun; cu sathi a taangmi cu tonnak thlam innka ah a ummi khangh thawinak biakṭheng hram ah cun a thlet lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun a thau vialte cu a lak dih lai i biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai."},"20":{"text":"Cu bantukin cawtum cu a tuah lai; sual thawinak cawtum a tuah bantuk khan, mah hi zong cu a tuah ve lai; cun tlangbawi nih cun annih caah remnak a ser lai i annih cu ngaihthiam an si lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun cawtum cu riahbuk lengah a kalpi lai i a hmasa cawtum a khangh bantuk khan a khangh ve lai; mah hihi mi zapi ca i sual thawinak a si."},"22":{"text":"“Uktu pakhatkhat nih sualnak a tuah tikah, Bawipa a Pathian nih tuah lo awk i nawl a pekmi thil pakhatkhat kha hngalh loin a tuah i a mawh tikah,"},"23":{"text":"cu sualnak a tuahmi cu a hngalh ahcun, aa thawinak caah meheh pakhat, a pa dotla, a rak put lai."},"24":{"text":"Amah nih meheh lu cungah cun a kut a chuan lai i Bawipa hmai i khangh thawinak an thahnak hmun ah khan a thah lai; mah hihi sual thawinak a si."},"25":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih sual thawinak thisen cu tlawmpal in a kutdong in a tawh lai i khangh thawinak biakṭheng ki ah cun a thuh hna lai i a tangmi a thi cu khangh thawinak biakṭheng hram ah cun a thlet lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun a thau vialte cu biakṭheng ah a khangh hna lai, daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak sathau bantuk khan; cu bantuk cun tlangbawi nih a sualnak caah cun remnak a tuahpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"27":{"text":"“Zaran chungin pakhatkhat nih Bawipa nih tuah lo awk i nawl pekmi thil pakhatkhat tuah in, hngalh lo i sualnak a tuah i a mawh a si ahcun,","ref":"Nam 15.27-28"},"28":{"text":"sualnak a tuahmi kha a hngalh tikah aa thawinak caah meheh pakhat, a nu dotla, a tuahmi a sualnak caah cun a rak put lai."},"29":{"text":"Cun sual thawinak lu cungah cun a kut a chuan lai i sual thawinak cu khangh thawinak hmun ah khan a thah lai."},"30":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih a thi cu tlawmpal in a kutdong in a lak lai i khangh thawinak biakṭheng ki ah khan a thuh hna lai i a taangmi a thi cu biakṭheng hram ah cun a thlet lai."},"31":{"text":"Cun a thau vialte cu daihnak thawinak chungin a thau lak a si bang khan a lak dih lai i tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cungah Bawipa ca i rimthaw ah a khangh lai; cun tlangbawi nih a caah remnak a tuahpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"32":{"text":"“Sual thawinak ca i a pekchanhmi ah tuufa a rak put ahcun, a nu dotla a rak put lai i"},"33":{"text":"sual thawinak lu cungah cun a kut a chuan lai i sual thawinak caah khangh thawinak an thahnak hmun ah khan a thah lai."},"34":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih sual thawinak sathi cu tlawmpal in a kutdong in a lak lai i khangh thawinak biakṭheng ki ah cun a thuh hna lai i a tangmi a thi cu biakṭheng hram ah a thlet lai."},"35":{"text":"Cun a thau vialte cu daihnak thawinak ca i pekchanhmi tuufa chungin a thau lak a si bantuk khan a lak lai i, tlangbawi nih biakṭheng cungah, Bawipa sinah mei in pekchanhmi hna cungah khan, a khangh lai. Cun tlangbawi nih sualnak a tuahmi caah khan remnak a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai.”"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih thil a hmuhmi ah siseh, a hngalhmi ah siseh, hngaltu a si i zapi hmaiah chiatsertertu aw a theih zongah a chim duh lo ahcun, a sual a ṭhat lonak kha amah nih a in lai."},"2":{"text":"Cun, ahohmanh nih a thiang lomi thil, a thiang lomi saram ruak siseh, a thiang lomi saṭil ruak siseh, a thiang lomi a lawnmi ruak siseh a tongh i amah nih a hngalh lo i aa buar ahcun, amah nih a hun hngalh cangka in a mawh lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun ahohmanh nih minung thian lonak, zei bantuk thian lonak phun hmanh in thianglo si ai kun, cun amah nih a hngalh lo i a buar ahcun, amah nih a hun hngalh tikah a mawh lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun ahohmanh nih ṭhat lonak tuah awk siseh, ṭhatnak tuah awk siseh, i ruat cungcang loin a hmur in zei bantuk chiatsernak hmanh si ai kun, a ser i amah nih a hngalh lo ahcun, a hun hngalh tikah hi chiatsernak pakhatkhat cungah a mawh lai."},"5":{"text":"Hi thil pakhatkhat cungah a mawh ahcun, sualnak a tuahmi kha a phuan lai i"},"6":{"text":"sualnak a tuahmi caah khan Bawipa sinah sual thawinak a rak put lai, tuurun chungin a nu, tuufa siseh meheh siseh, sual thawinak caah a si lai; cun tlangbawi nih a sualnak caah remnak a serpiak lai."},"7":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw tuufa kha a ngeih nih a tlinh lo ahcun, sualnak a tuahmi caah khan sual thawinak caah ṭhuro pahnih siseh, laileng no pahnih siseh, Bawipa sinah a rak put lai, pakhat cu sual thawinak caah a si lai i pakhat cu khangh thawinak caah a si lai."},"8":{"text":"Tlangbawi sinah a rak put hna lai i tlangbawi nih cun sual thawinak ding ca cu a thawi hmasa lai; a hngawng cu a merh lai, sihmanhsehlaw a lu cu a chat lai lo i"},"9":{"text":"sual thawinak thisen cu tlawmpal in biakṭheng sirah a theh lai i thisen a taangmi cu biakṭheng hram ah a zor lai; mah cucu sual thawinak a si."},"10":{"text":"Cun, pahnihnak cu a phunglam ning in khangh thawinak caah a thawi lai i sualnak a tuahmi caah khan tlangbawi nih remnak a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"11":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw ṭhuro pahnih siseh, laileng no pahnih siseh, a ngeih nih a tlinh lo ahcun, sualnak a tuahmi thawinak caah khan, sual thawinak caah changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu khat a rak put lai; chiti a toih lai lo, frankinsen zong a toih lai lo, zeitintiah mah hi cu sual thawinak a si."},"12":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi sinah a rak put lai i tlangbawi nih pei khat in a lak lai i biakṭheng cungah Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak cungah cun hngalh camcinnak ah a khangh lai; mah cucu sual thawinak a si."},"13":{"text":"Cu bantukin tlangbawi nih a caah, hi thil pakhatkhat hna cung i sualnak a tuahmi caah cun remnak a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai. Cun a taangmi cu changvut thawinak i bantuk khan tlangbawi caah a si lai.”"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses kha hi bangin a chimh,","title":"Phungbuar Thawinak Kong"},"15":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih phung a buar i Bawipa thil a thiangmi pakhatkhat cungah hngalh loin a sual ahcun, Bawipa sin i phungbuar thawinak caah tuurun chungin tuukawng pakhat dotla a rak put lai; hmunthiang i shekel ning khan ngun shekel zeizat man a si kha na tuak lai; mah cucu phungbuar thawinak a si."},"16":{"text":"A thiangmi thil cung i a palhsualnak caah cun rulhnak a tuah lai i a cheu nga cheu khat a chap lai i tlangbawi kha a pek lai; cun tlangbawi nih phungbuar thawinak tuukawng khan remnak a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"17":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih Bawipa nih tuah lo awk i nawl a pekmi tuahnak in a sual ahcun, a hngalh lo hmanh ah, a mawh ko, a ṭhat lonak cu amah nih a in lai."},"18":{"text":"Tuurun chungin tlangbawi sinah tuukawng pakhat dotla, nangmah nih phungbuar thawinak caah a man a za na timi a rak put lai i tlangbawi nih remnak, hngalh loin a tuahmi a palhnak caah khan, a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"19":{"text":"Mah cucu phungbuar thawinak a si; Bawipa hmaiah a mawh ko.”"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hitin a ti,","ref":"Nam 5.5-8"},"2":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih, a innpa kha chawva kennak kong ah siseh ṭilva zohkhenhnak kong ah siseh a hlen i, ramhnak in siseh, a innpa kha hremnak in siseh,"},"3":{"text":"thiltlau kha a hmuh i cu kong ah lihchimnak le ding loin chiatsernak in siseh, Bawipa cungah a sual i phung a buar ahcun mah hi thil vialte minung nih an tuah tawnmi hna chungah hin"},"4":{"text":"pakhatkhat ah a sual i a mawh tikah, a firmi siseh, hramhram in a lakmi siseh, amah an kentermi siseh, thiltlau a hmuhmi siseh,"},"5":{"text":"ding loin chiat a serhnawhmi zei thil paoh siseh a rulh lai; tling tein a rulh lai i a cheu nga cheu khat a chap lai i a phungbuar thawinak ni ah a ngeitu sinah khan a pek ṭhan lai."},"6":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi sinah Bawipa sin i a pekchanhmi phungbuar thawinak cu a rak put lai, tuurun chungin tuukawng pakhat dotla, nangmah nih phungbuar thawinak caah a man a za na timi a si lai;"},"7":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih cun Bawipa hmaiah remnak a serpiak lai i, a mawhnak thil a tuahmi paohpaoh kong ah ngaihthiam a si lai.”"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hi bangin a ti,","title":"Thawinak Hna Phungbia"},"9":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa hna cu hi bangin nawl pe hna: Mah hihi khangh thawinak phunglam a si. Khangh thawinak cu biakṭheng cung tappi ah cun zan khuadei zinglei tiang chiah a si lai i biakṭheng mei cu a alh camcin lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih a puan hmangṭhia cu aa hruk lai i a pum cungah a puan hmangṭhia tawhrolh cu aa hrolh lai i, biakṭheng cung i mei nih a kangh dihmi khangh thawinak vutcam cu a lak lai i biakṭheng kamah a chiah hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun a puan kha aa phoih hna lai i puan dang aa aih lai i vutcam cu riahbuk leng hmunthiang ah a kalpi lai."},"12":{"text":"Biakṭheng cung i mei cu alhter camcin a si lai, a mih awk a si lai lo; zing fate in tlangbawi nih a cungah thing a tih lai i a cungah khangh thawinak cu a ningcang tein a chiah lai i, a cungah daihnak thawinak hna thau cu a khangh lai."},"13":{"text":"Biakṭheng cungah cun mei alhter a si thluangthluan lai; a mih awk a si lai lo."},"14":{"text":"“Cun mah hihi changvut thawinak phunglam a si. Aaron fapa hna nih Bawipa hmaika ah biakṭheng hmaiah an pekchanh lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun pakhat nih changvut thawinak changvut dip cu pei khat in a lak lai, changvut thawinak cung i a ummi chiti le frankinsen vialte he, cun mah hihi hngalh camcinnak caah Bawipa ca i rimthaw ah biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun a tangmi cu Aaron le a fapa hna nih an ei lai; hmunthiang ah thilnu telh loin an ei lai; tonnak thlam tual chungah an ei lai."},"17":{"text":"Thilnu he reu a si lai lo. Mei in keimah sin i thawinak hna chungin anmah vo ah ka pek cang hna; a thiang bikmi thil a si ve, sual thawinak le phungbuar thawinak bantuk khan."},"18":{"text":"Aaron tefale hna chungin pa paohpaoh nih an ei lai; Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak hna chungin nan tefa chan tiangin zungzal nan vo a si lai; cu thil a tawngmi hna paoh cu thleidan an si lai.”"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hi bangin a ti,"},"20":{"text":"“Mah hihi chiti thuh a si ni ah Aaron le a fapa hna nih Bawipa sinah an pekchanh awk thawinak a si lai. Pekchanh tawnmi changvut thawinak ah changvut dip ephah pakhat cheu hra cheu khat, a cheu cu zinglei ah, a cheu zanlei ah."},"21":{"text":"Chiti he ukang cungah ser a si lai; ṭhate i cawh in na rak put lai, changvut thawinak bantukin reu cia in a dar tete in na rak put lai i, Bawipa ca i rimthaw ah na pekchanh lai."},"22":{"text":"Aaron fapa hna lak in amah a chaangtu ding i chiti thuhmi tlangbawi nih zungzal nawlbia bangin Bawipa sinah a pekchanh lai; a dihlak in khangh a si lai."},"23":{"text":"Tlangbawi changvut thawinak kip cu a dihlak in khangh a si lai; ei a si lai lo.”"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hi bangin a ti,"},"25":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa hna sinah hi bangin chim tuah, Mah hihi sual thawinak phunglam a si. Khangh thawinak thahnak hmun ah khan sual thawinak cu Bawipa hmaiah thah a si lai; mah cucu a thiang bik a si ve."},"26":{"text":"Sualnak caah a pechantu tlangbawi nih cun a ei lai; hmun thiang pakhat ah ei a si lai, tonnak thlam tual chungah cun."},"27":{"text":"A sa a tawngtu paoh cu thleidan a si lai; cun a thi kha puan cungah a tlak ahcun, a tlakmi puan cu hmun thiang pakhat ah na suk lai."},"28":{"text":"Cun sa chuannak tlak-um cu khuai a si lai; sihmanhsehlaw marlei in chuan a si ahcun mah cucu ṭawl in ti in tlengh a si lai."},"29":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna lak i pa paoh nih cun an ei lai; mah hihi a thiang bik a si ve."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hmunthiang chungah remnak tuahnak ca i tonnak thlam chungah rak putmi thi an laknak sual thawinak cu, ei a si lai lo; mei in khangh a si lai."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Mah hihi phungbuar thawinak phungbia a si. A thiang bik a si ve."},"2":{"text":"Khangh thawinak an thahnak hmun ah khan phungbuar thawinak cu an thah lai i a thisen cu biakṭheng a velchum ah khan an theh lai."},"3":{"text":"A thau cu a dihlak in pekchanh a si lai, a thaumi a mei, a chungril, a khuhtu thau,"},"4":{"text":"a kal pahnih a tai zawn ah a ummi thau he, cun a kal he a lak chihmi a thin tuamtu"},"5":{"text":"mah hna hi tlangbawi nih Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak ah biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna lai; cucu phungbuar thawinak a si."},"6":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna lak i pa paoh nih cun mah cucu an ei lai; hmun thiang pakhat ah ei a si lai; mah cucu a thiang bik a si ve."},"7":{"text":"Phungbuar thawinak cu sual thawinak bantuk a si, an pahnih caah phunglam pakhat a si; sa cu remnak a sertu tlangbawi ta a si lai."},"8":{"text":"Cun mi zei khangh thawinak hmanh a thawipiaktu tlangbawi nih cun, an pekchanhmi khangh thawinak phaw cu a co lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun changvut thawinak kip cu, reunak um chung i reumi siseh, um chung i reumi siseh, ukang chung i reumi siseh, a pechantu tlangbawi ta a si lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun changvut thawinak kip cu, chiti he cawh in siseh a ro in siseh, Aaron fapa vialte hna nih aa tluk cio in an co lai."},"11":{"text":"“Cun mah hihi mi nih Bawipa sinah an pek awk daihnak thawinak pekchanhnak phunglam cu a si."},"12":{"text":"Lawmhnak ca i pek a si ahcun, lawmh thawinak he cun thilnu telh lo changreu chiti he cawhmi, thilnu telh lo chang per tete chiti thuhmi le, chiti he ṭha tein cawhmi changvut dip cu a pekchanh chih lai."},"13":{"text":"Lawmhnak ca i daihnak thawinak a pekchanhmi ah cun, thilnu telhmi changreu zong a rak put chih lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun mah cu chung cun thawinak kip chungin changreu pakhat a thawi lai, Bawipa sin i thawinak caah; mah cucu daihnak thawinak hna thisen a thehtu tlangbawi ta kha a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun lawmhnak ca i daihnak thawinak pekchanhmi sa cu thawinak a tuah ni ah cun ei a si lai; a thaizing tiangin zeihmanh a taanter lai lo."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a pekchanhmi thawinak cu biakam thawinak siseh, mah lungtho tein thawinak siseh a si ahcun, thawinak a tuah ni ah ei a si lai i a tangmi cu a thaizing zongah ei a si lai,"},"17":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a kiptuh tiang thawinak sa a tangmi cu mei in khangh a si lai."},"18":{"text":"A daihnak thawinak pekchanhmi sa cu a ni thumnak ni i ei a si ahcun, a pechantu cu cohlan a si lai lo, a pechantu zong cu pekchanh ah relpiak a si lai lo; thil fihnung a si lai i a eitu nih a ṭhat lonak cu a in lai."},"19":{"text":"“A thiang lomi thil zeihmanh a tawngtu sa cu ei a si lai lo; mei in khangh a si lai. Sa cu a thiangmi vialte hna nih an ei lai,"},"20":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thian lonak a cung i a um lioah Bawipa daihnak thawinak pekchanhmi sa a eimi cu, cu mi cu a miphun sinin hlawt a si lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun ahohmanh nih thil thianglo, minung thian lonak siseh, saram thianglo siseh, a thiang lomi thil fihnung zeipaoh siseh, a tawngh i Bawipa daihnak thawinak pekchanhmi sa a ei ahcun cu mi cu a miphun sinin hlawt a si lai.”"},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah,"},"23":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah va chim tuah, cawtum siseh, tuu siseh, meheh siseh, a thau nan ei lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Amah tein a thimi saram siseh, sa nih a sehmi siseh, a thau nan ei hrimhrim lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw zeidang caah cun nan hman khawh lai."},"25":{"text":"Zeitintiah Bawipa sinah mei in pekmi thawinak sa a thau a eimi kip cu a miphun sinin hlawt a si lai."},"26":{"text":"Cu hlei ah zei thi paoh, va thi siseh, saram thi siseh, khuazei nan umnak hmanh ah nan ei lai lo.","ref":"Gen 9.4; Lev 17.10-14; 19.26; Deu 12.16,23; 15.23"},"27":{"text":"Thi zei hmanh a eimi cu a miphun sinin hlawt a si lai,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hitin a ti,"},"29":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah hi bangin va chim tuah, Bawipa sinah a pekchanhmi daihnak thawinak a pekchanhmi nih Bawipa sinah a rak put lai; a daihnak thawinak hna a pekchanhmi chung cun Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak ding hna cu"},"30":{"text":"amah kut hrimhrim in a rak put lai; Bawipa hmaiah a ii cu hninh thawinak caah a hninh khawh nakhnga, a thau cu a ii he a rak put lai."},"31":{"text":"Tlangbawi nih a thau cu biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai, sihmanhsehlaw a ii cu Aaron le a fapa hna caah a si lai."},"32":{"text":"Cun na daihnak thawinak hna pekchanhmi chungin thawinak caah a orhlei phei cu tlangbawi cu na pek lai;"},"33":{"text":"Aaron fapa hna lakah daihnak thawinak hna thi le thau a thawitu nih a orhlei phei cu a co lai."},"34":{"text":"Zeitintiah Israel mi hna nih an pekchanhmi daihnak thawinak chungin tlangbawi Aaron le a fapa hna cu hninhmi ii le thawimi phei cu ka pek cang hna; mah cucu Israel mi sinin a zungzal in an hmuh awk a si."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak hna chungin Aaron le a fapa hna nih an covo cu a si; mah cucu Bawipa tlangbawi rianṭuan awk ca i pek an si ni ah an sinah thianter a si;"},"36":{"text":"chiti thuh an si ni ah Israel mi nih mah hihi an pek hna awk cu Bawipa nawlpekmi a si; an tefa chin tiangin a zungzal in an hmuh awk cu a si.”"},"37":{"text":"Mah hihi khangh thawinak, changvut thawinak, sual thawinak, phungbuar thawinak, thianternak le daihnak thawinak hna phunglam cu a si."},"38":{"text":"Israel mi kha Bawipa sinah nan thawinak kha rak pu tuah hna u tiah Sinai ramlak i nawl a pek hna ni i Bawipa nih Moses kha Sinai Tlang i nawl a pekmi cu a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah,","title":"Aaron le A Fapa Hna Thianternak (Exo 29.1-37)"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron cu a fapa hna he kalpi hna law, puan hna le thuhnak chiti le thilnu telh lo changreu bawm khat le sual thawinak cawtum le tuukawng pahnih hna kha kalpi ve hna;"},"3":{"text":"cun tonnak thlam innka ah mi zapi cu pum hna,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin a tuah i mi zapi cu tonnak thlam innka ah cun an i pum."},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses nih mi zapi sinah cun, “Mah hihi tuah awk tiah Bawipa nawl pekmi cu a si,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron le a fapa hna cu a ratpi hna i ti in a kholh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun angki leng cu a hruk i, taisawm a sawmh i, tlangbawi angki fual a hruk i, tlangbawi angki a aih i, dawh tein tahmi tlangbawi angki hri in a sawmh, mah hri cun a ṭem chih."},"8":{"text":"Cun ṭangbenh kha a cungah a benh i ṭangbenh chungah cun Urim le Thummim kha a chiah hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun lupawng a ponh i a lupawng cungah, hmailei ah, sui kheng, a thiangmi bawi luchin cu, a benh; Moses nih Bawipa nih nawl a pek bang khan a tuah."},"10":{"text":"Cun Moses nih thuhnak chiti kha a lak i puan biakinn le a chungah a ummi thil vialte kha a thuh hna i a thianter hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun chiti cu tlawmpal in biakṭheng ah cun voi sarih a theh i, biakṭheng le a umkheng vialte le a hmaihum le a hunnak cu thianter awk caah a thuh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun thuhnak chiti cu tlawmpal in Aaron lu ah a toih i a thuh i a thianter."},"13":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron fapa hna cu a ratpi hna i angki leng a hruk hna i taisawm a sawmh hna i lupawng a ponh hna, Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan."},"14":{"text":"Cun sual thawinak cawtum cu a rak put i Aaron le a fapa hna nih sual thawinak cawtum lu cungah cun an kut an chuan."},"15":{"text":"Moses nih a thah i a thi cu a lak i biakṭheng ki hna ah cun a velchum in a kutdong in a thuh, cun biakṭheng ca i remnak ser awkah biakṭheng cu a thianter i a hramah thi cu a thlet i a thianter."},"16":{"text":"Cun a chungril a tuamtu thau vialte le a thin tuamtu le a kal pahnih cu an thau he a lak hna i Moses nih biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cawtum cu a phaw le a sa le a ek he riahbuk lengah mei in a khangh, Bawipa nih Moses kha nawl a pek bang khan."},"18":{"text":"Cun khangh thawinak tuukawng kha a hun pek; Aaron le a fapa hna nih tuukawng lu cungah cun an kut an chuan."},"19":{"text":"Cun Moses nih a thah i a thi cu biakṭheng velchum ah a theh."},"20":{"text":"Cun tuukawng cu a can i Moses nih a lu le a sa le a thau cu a khangh hna."},"21":{"text":"Cun a chungril le a ke hna cu ti in a ṭawl hna i Moses nih tuukawng cu a pum in biakṭheng cungah khangh thawinak caah, rimthaw Bawipa sin i mei in thawinak caah, a khangh, Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan."},"22":{"text":"Cun a dang tuukawng pakhat, thleidannak tuukawng cu, a pek; cun Aaron le a fapa hna nih tuukawng lu cungah an kut an chuan."},"23":{"text":"Cun Moses nih a thah i a thi cu tlawmpal in a lak i Aaron orhlei hnakhaw parte le a orhlei siapi le a orhlei kepi ah a thuh hna;"},"24":{"text":"cun Aaron fapa hna cu an ratpi hna i Moses nih thi cu tlawmpal in an orhlei hnakhaw par tete le an orhlei siapi le an orhlei kepi ah a thuh hna; cun Moses nih thi cu biakṭheng velchum ah a thlet."},"25":{"text":"Cun a thau le a thaumi a mei le a chungril tuamtu thau vialte le a thin tuamtu le a thau he a kal pahnih le a orhlei phei cu a lak hna;"},"26":{"text":"cun thilnu telh lo changreu bawm Bawipa hmai i a ummi chung khan thilnu telh lo changreu pakhat le chiti he cawhmi changreu hlum khat le changreu pante dar khat kha a lak hna i sathau cungah le orhlei phei cungah khan a chiah hna;"},"27":{"text":"cun mah thil vialte hi Aaron le a fapa hna kut chungah a chiah hna i Bawipa hmaiah hninh thawinak caah a hninh hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun Moses nih an kut chungin a lak hna i khangh thawinak he biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna, thleidannak thawinak, rimthaw Bawipa ca i mei in thawinak caah a khangh hna."},"29":{"text":"Cun Moses nih a ii cu a lak i Bawipa hmai i hninh thawinak caah a hninh; Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bangin, mah cucu thleidannak tuukawng chungin Moses vo cu a si."},"30":{"text":"Cun Moses nih thuhnak chiti tlawmpal le biakṭheng cung i a ummi thi tlawmpal cu a lak i Aaron le a puan hna cu a theh hna i, a fapa hna le a fapa hna puan hna zong cu a theh hna; cu bangin Aaron le a puan hna le a fapa hna le a fapa hna puan hna cu a thianh ṭi hna."},"31":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron le a fapa hna cu, “Tonnak thlam innka ah sa kha chuang u law, cuka ah sa le thleidannak thawinak bawm chung i a ummi changreu cu ei u, ‘Aaron le a fapa hna nih an ei lai,’ tiah nawl ka pek bang khan, a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cun sa le changreu a tangmi cu mei in nan khangh lai."},"33":{"text":"Cun tonnak thlam innka in ni sarih chung nan chuak lai lo, nanmah thleidannak ni hna a tlin hlantiang, zeitintiah nanmah thleidannak caah ni sarih a herh lai."},"34":{"text":"Nihin i tuahmi bang hin, nannih ca i remnak ser awkah Bawipa nih nawl a kan pek cang."},"35":{"text":"Tonnak thlam innka ah, chunzan in ni sarih chung, Bawipa nih an fialmi hna tuah awkah, nan thih sual nakhnga lo nan um lai; zeitintiah cu bang cun nawl pek ka si,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses in nawl a pekmi tuah awk thil vialte cu Aaron le a fapa hna nih an tuah."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni riat ni ah Moses nih Aaron le a fapa hna le Israel upa hna kha a auh hna i","title":"Aaron Nih Raithawinak A Pekchanh"},"2":{"text":"Aaron sinah, “Cawtum no pakhat in sual thawinak caah, cun khangh thawinak caah tuukawng pakhat, dotla veve, la hna law, Bawipa hmaiah thawi hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna sinah, ‘Sual thawinak caah meheh tum pakhat le, khangh thawinak caah cawfa pakhat le tuufa pakhat, kum khat veve a si i dotla veve a simi le,"},"4":{"text":"daihnak thawinak hna caah cawtum pakhat le tuukawng pakhat la hna law, Bawipa hmaiah thawi hna, cun chiti he cawhmi changvut thawinak zong; zeitintiah nihin ah Bawipa cu nannih sinah a lang lai,’ tiah ti hna,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses nih nawl a pekmi cu tonnak thlam hmaiah an hun hruai hna i aa pummi nih an dihlak in an hun naih i Bawipa hmaiah an dir."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses nih, “Mah hihi Bawipa nih tuah awkah nawl an pekmi hna cu a si; cun Bawipa sunparnak cu nannih sinah a lang lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron sinah, “Biakṭheng cu hei naih law, na sual thawinak le na khangh thawinak cu thawi hna, cun nangmah le mi hna caah remnak ser tuah; cun mi hna thawinak cu rak pu law, an caah remnak ser tuah, Bawipa nawl peknak bang khan,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Heb 7.27"},"8":{"text":"Cu caah Aaron nih biakṭheng cu a hei naih i sual thawinak cawfa kha a thah, mah cucu amah caah a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa hna nih a thi kha a sinah an rak put i thi chungah cun a kutdong a hnim i biakṭheng ki ah cun a neh i thi cu biakṭheng hram ah cun a thlet;"},"10":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw sual thawinak sa i a thau le a kal hna le a thin tuamtu hna cu Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan, biakṭheng cungah a khangh."},"11":{"text":"A sa le a phaw cu mei in riahhmun lengah a khangh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun, khangh thawinak cu a thah i Aaron fapa hna nih a thi cu an pek i biakṭheng cu a velchum in a theh."},"13":{"text":"Cun khangh thawinak sa cu a zamzam in a lu he an hun pek i biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun a chungril le a ke kha a ṭawl hna i khangh thawinak he biakṭheng cungah a khangh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun mizapi thawinak cu a pek; sual thawinak meheh, mizapi ca i a simi cu, a lak i a thah i sualnak caah a thawi, sual thawinak hmasa bik bang khan a tuah."},"16":{"text":"Cun khangh thawinak kha a pek i a phunglam ning in a thawi."},"17":{"text":"Cun changvut thawinak kha a pek; pei khat in a lak i zinglei khangh thawinak hleiah biakṭheng cungah a khangh."},"18":{"text":"Cawtum le tuukawng zong kha a thah hna, mah cucu mi zapi ca i daihnak thawinak an si. Aaron fapa hna nih a thi cu an pek i biakṭheng cu a velchum in a theh.","ref":"Lev 3.1-11"},"19":{"text":"Cun cawtum thau le tuutum thau le, a thaumi mei le, chungril tuamtu le, kal hna le, thin tuamtu cu an pek i"},"20":{"text":"an thau cu an ii cungah an chiah hna i an thau cu biakṭheng cungah a khangh,"},"21":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an ii le a orhlei phei cu Bawipa hmai i hninh thawinak caah Aaron nih a hninh hna, Moses nawlpek bangin."},"22":{"text":"Cun Aaron nih mi zapi leiah cun a kut a hler hna i thluachuah a pek hna. Cun sual thawinak le khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak hna a thawi dih in a rung ṭum.","ref":"Nam 6.22-26"},"23":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron cu tonnak thlam chungah an lut i an hung chuah tikah mi zapi kha thluachuahnak an pek hna i, Bawipa sunparnak cu mi vialte sinah cun a lang."},"24":{"text":"Cun Bawipa hmaika in mei a hung chuak i biakṭheng cung i khangh thawinak le thau cu a kangh hna; cun mi vialte nih khan an hmuh tikah an au i an bawk."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa Nadab le Abihu nih an meilaknak kheng cu an i lak veve i a chungah mei an chiah i a cungah zihmui an phulh i Bawipa hmaiah a thiang lomi mei cu an thawi, nawl a pek lomi hna kha an tuah.","title":"Nadab le Abihu Sualnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa hmaika in mei a hung chuak i a kangh hna i Bawipa hmaika ah cun an thi."},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah Moses nih Aaron sinah, “Mah hihi Bawipa nih a chimmi cu a si, ‘Ka pawng i a ummi hna lakah thianghlim in kaa langhter lai i mi vialte hmaiah thangṭhat ka si lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti. Cun Aaron cu dai tein a um ko."},"4":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron pa unau Uzziel fapa Mishael le Elzafan cu a kawh hna i, “Hmaiah hung chuak u, hmunthiang hmai in nan unau hna cu riahhmun lengah chuahpi hna u,” tiah a ti hna."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah an ra chuak i Moses nih a chim bang khan riahhmun lengah an angkileng in an hnuh hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron le a fapa hna Eleazar le Ithamar sinah, “Nan sam i thlah hlah u, nan puan kha thlek hna hlah u, nan thih sual i mibu dihlak cungah thinhunnak a rat sual nakhnga lo; sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih a kanghtermi mei kanghnak cu nan unau, Israel chungkhar dihlak nih khan, ṭah hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Cun tonnak thlam innka khan, nan thih sual nakhnga lo, chuak hlah u; zeitintiah Bawipa thuhnak chiti cu nan cungah a um,” tiah a ti. Cun Moses bia bangin an tuah."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Aaron cu a chawnh i,"},"9":{"text":"“Nangmah nih siseh, na fapale hna nih siseh, tonnak thlam chungah nan luh tikah mitsur hang siseh zu siseh nan ding lai lo, nan thih sual nakhnga lo; mah cucu a zungzal in nan tefa hna chan tiangin nawlbia a si lai."},"10":{"text":"Nannih nih a thianghlim le zaran tawnghmi, cun a thianglo le a thiang kha nan thleidan lai i"},"11":{"text":"Israel mi hna kha Moses in Bawipa nih a chimmi nawlbia vialte kha nan cawnpiak hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Moses nih, Aaron le a tangmi a fapa hna Eleazar le Ithamar sinah, “ Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak hna chungin a tangmi changvut thawinak kha la u law, biakṭheng pawngah thilnu telh loin ei u, zeitintiah mah cucu a thiang bik a si.","ref":"Lev 6.14-18"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa sinah mei in pekmi thawinak hna chungin nangmah le na fapa hna vo a simi kha, nawlpek nan si bangin hmunthiang ah nan ei lai."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hninhmi ii le thawimi phei cu, nangmah le na fapa hna le na fanu hna le tiah, a thiangmi hmun paoh ah nan ei lai. Zeicaahtiah Israel mi hna pekchanhmi daihnak thawinak chungin, mah hna cu nangmah le na fapa hna vo ah pek nan si.","ref":"Lev 7.30-34"},"15":{"text":"Thawimi phei le hninhmi ii cu Bawipa hmai i hninh thawinak ca i hninh awkah, mei in thawinak hna thau he nan rak put lai, mah cucu nangmah le na fapa hna caah, Bawipa nawl peknak bangin, zungzal in nan vo a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Moses nih sual thawinak meheh kong kha fel tein a hlat i zohhmanh, an rak khangh diam cang ai! Cun Aaron fapa a taangmi hna Eleazar le Ithamar cungah a thin a hung i,"},"17":{"text":"“Zeicahdah sual thawinak cu hmunthiang chungah nan ei lo? A thiang bik thil mi zapi ṭhat lonak phortu ding i Bawipa hmai i remnak serpiaknak ca i mah cucu nannih kha pekmi a si ṭung!","ref":"Lev 6.24-26"},"18":{"text":"Zohhmanh, a thi cu hmunthiang a chunglei ah nan luhpi lo. Nannih nih nawl kan pek hna bang khan hmunthiang chungah nan rak ei hrimhrim awk a si,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Aaron nih Moses sinah, “Zohhmanh, nihin ah Bawipa hmai i an sual thawinak le an khangh thawinak kha an thawi cang, sihmanhsehlaw mah hi bantuk thil hna nih hin an ka tlak kun! Nihin ah sual thawinak kha rak ei ning law, Bawipa mithmuh ah cohlan awk tlak a rak si hlei hnga maw?” a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Moses nih mah cucu a theih tikah a lung a tling ko."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron sinah,","title":"A Thiang le A Thianglo Saram (Deu 14.3-21)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah va chim tuah u, vawlei cung i a ummi saram vialte lakah mah hna hi a nungmi thil nan ei awk cu an si lai."},"3":{"text":"Saram lakah a tin a ṭe i aa ṭhen i rawlret a khaimi cu nan ei lai."},"4":{"text":"Asinain rawlret khaimi lakah siseh, tin ṭemi lakah siseh, mah hna hi cu nan ei lai lo: kalauk, rawlret cu a khai nain a tin a ṭet lo caah nannih caah a thianglo a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun vawrvok, rawlret a khai nain a tin a ṭet lo caah nannih caah a thianglo a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun saveh, rawlret a khai nain a tin a ṭet lo caah a thianglo a si."},"7":{"text":"Cun vok, a tin a ṭe i aa ṭhen ko nain rawlret a khai lo caah, nan caah a thianglo a si."},"8":{"text":"An sa nan ei lai lo i an ruak nan tawng lai lo; nan caah a thianglo an si."},"9":{"text":"“Ti chung i a ummi thil vialte lakah mah hna hi nan ei lai. Rili chungah siseh, tiva chungah siseh, ti chung i a ummi, ṭeh le phokphawher a ngeimi thil paohpaoh cu nan ei hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw rili chungah siseh, tiva chungah siseh, a ummi, ṭeh le phokphawher a ngei lomi, ti chungah a lawn in a lawnmi thil le ti chung i a nungmi thil hna cu, nannih caah fihnung an si."},"11":{"text":"Nannih caah fihnung an si zungzal lai; an sa nan ei lai lo i an ruak cu fihnung ah nan rel hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Ti chungah a ummi thil zeipaoh ṭeh le phokphawher a ngei lomi cu nan caah fihnung a si."},"13":{"text":"“Cun, va hna lakah mah hna hi fihnung ah nan rel awk an si lai, nan ei hna lai lo, fihnung an si: muvanlai, tettet, mu-ar-cawi,"},"14":{"text":"kaite, muchia phun kip,"},"15":{"text":"langak phun kip,"},"16":{"text":"ostrik, thlanghnap, rili-va mupi phun kip,"},"17":{"text":"chimbu, tingala, tivapual,"},"18":{"text":"ti-ar, pelikan, langta,"},"19":{"text":"tivakok, ram varang phun kip, chuangtuar, le palak."},"20":{"text":"“Buṭit-khaubawk thla a ngei i ke pali in a kalmi vialte cu nan caah fihnung an si."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thla ngeimi buṭit-khaubawk ke pali in a kalmi lakah a keṭeng cung i vawlei i pernak ca i ke a ngeimi cu nan ei lai."},"22":{"text":"Cu hna chungah cun, khauzik phun kip, khuangbai phun kip, buṭit phun kip, le khaubawk phun kip cu nan ei khawh hna lai."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thla ngeimi buṭit-khaubawk ke pali a ngeimi vialte cu nannih caah fihnung an si."},"24":{"text":"“Cun mah thil hna thawng hin thianglo nan cang lai; an ruak a tawngtu paoh cu zanlei tiang an thur lai i"},"25":{"text":"an ruak in zeipaoh a latu nih a thilpuan a suk lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai."},"26":{"text":"A tin a ṭe nain a tin aa ṭhen lomi saram siseh, rawlret a khai lomi saram siseh, nannih caah a thianglo a si; a tawngmi hna paoh cu thianglo an si lai."},"27":{"text":"Ke pali in a kalmi saram hna lakah a kebor in a kalmi vialte cu nannih caah thianglo an si; an ruak a tawngtu paoh cu zanlei tiang thianglo an si lai i"},"28":{"text":"an ruak a phortu nih a thilpuan kha a suk lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai; annih cu nan caah thianglo an si."},"29":{"text":"“Cun vawlei ah a lawn in a lawnmi hna lakah mah hna hi nan ca i thianglo an si: zuhri, zu, kinglang ngan phun kip,"},"30":{"text":"ṭekral, tang, kinglang, thetse rawn kinglang le conghrang."},"31":{"text":"A lawnmi thil vialte lakah mah hna hi nan ca i thianglo an si; mah hna hi an thih tikah a tawngtu hna paoh cu zanlei tiang thianglo an si lai."},"32":{"text":"Cun, an thih tikah an tlakhnawhmi thilri paoh cu a thur lai, thing thilri siseh, puan siseh, saphaw siseh, sawngkhoi siseh, hman awk thil a simi paohpaoh; ti chungah ciah a si hrimhrim lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai; cu tikah a thiang lai."},"33":{"text":"Cun annih lak i pakhatkhat cu tlak um a simi paohpaoh cungah a tlak ahcun, a chung i a ummi vialte cu thianglo an si lai i nan khuai lai."},"34":{"text":"Cu um chung i ei awk a ummi zei rawl paoh, ti nih a ciahmi paoh cu, thianglo a si lai; cun cu bantuk um paohpaoh chung i din awk thil vialte cu thianglo an si lai."},"35":{"text":"Cun zei thil paoh an ruak pelpawi a zeipaoh nih a tlakmi hna cu thianglo an si lai; changreu rawhnak a si zongah, meiphu a si zongah, khuai cikcek a si lai; thianglo an si i nan caah thianglo an si lai."},"36":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cerhti siseh tikuang a chung i ti a ummi cu siseh a thiang lai, asinain zeipaoh an ruak a tawngtu paoh cu thianglo an si lai."},"37":{"text":"Cun an ruak zei zawn paoh nih cin awk a simi thlaici zei paoh a nenh ahcun, a thiang ko;"},"38":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thlaici cu ti in ciah a si i an ruak zei zawn paoh nih a nenh ahcun, nan caah thianglo a si."},"39":{"text":"“Cun nan eimi saram zeipaoh a thih ahcun, a ruak a tawngtu paoh cu zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai,"},"40":{"text":"cun a ruak a eimi paoh cu a thilpuan a suk hna lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai; a ruak a putu paoh zong nih a thilpuan a suk hna lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai."},"41":{"text":"“Vawlei ah a vah in a vak lulhmalhmi thil paoh cu fihnung a si; ei awk a si lai lo."},"42":{"text":"A paw in a lawnmi zeipaoh siseh, ke pali in a kalmi zeipaoh siseh, ke tampi a ngeimi zeipaoh siseh, vawlei ah a vah in a vakmi thil vialte cu nan ei hna lai lo; zeitintiah fihnung an si."},"43":{"text":"A vah in a vakmi thil zeihmanh khan nannih nih fih nan i nunter lai lo; cun cu hna cun a thur zong nan i thurter lai lo, thianglo nan si sual hnga."},"44":{"text":"Zeitintiah keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si; cu caah i thianter u law, thianghlim u, keimah ka thian caah. Vawlei ah a vah in a vakmi thil zeihmanh in i thurter hlah u.","ref":"Lev 19.2; 1Pet 1.16"},"45":{"text":"Zeitintiah keimah cu nan Pathian si awkah, Izipt ram in an chuahpitu hna Bawipa ka si; cucaah nannih cu nan thian awk a si, keimah ka thian caah,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Mah hihi saram le va le ti chung i a cawlcangmi thilnung kip le vawlei i a vakmi thil kip kong i phunglam a si;"},"47":{"text":"a thiang le thianglo le a nungmi thil ei awk a si hngami le a nungmi thil ei awk lo a si hngami hna thleidannak caah a si."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah hitin a ti,","title":"Fahrin Hnuah Nu Thianternak"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi kha chim hna: Nu nih fa a pawi i fapa a hrin ahcun, ni sarih thianglo a si lai; nuphung a hngalh caan bantuk khan thianglo a si lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun a ni riat ni ah a cuarpar tan a si lai.","ref":"Gen 17.12; Luk 2.21"},"4":{"text":"Cun thisen ruangah cun i thianh lengmang in ni sawm thum le ni thum a um rih awk a si lai; aa thianhnak ni a tlin hlan lo cu thil thiang zeihmanh a tawng lai lo, hmunthiang chung zongah a lut lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw fanu a hrin ahcun, zarh hnih thianglo a si lai, nuphung a hngalh caan bantuk khan; cun thisen ruangah cun i thianh lengmang in ni sawm ruk le ni ruk a um rih awk a si lai."},"6":{"text":"“Cun aa thianhnak ni kha a tlin tikah, fapa caah siseh, fanu caah siseh, tlangbawi sinah, tonnak thlam innka ah khangh thawinak caah tuufa kum khat a timi a rak put lai i sual thawinak caah laileng no pakhat maw ṭhuro pakhat dik a rak put lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun amah nih Bawipa hmaiah a thawi lai i remnak a serpiak lai; cun a thi chuahnak cun amah cu a thiang lai. Mah hihi fapa a hringmi caah siseh, fanu a hringmi caah siseh, phunglam a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun tuufa kha a ngeih khawh lo ahcun, ṭhuro pahnih maw, laileng no pahnih dik a lak hna lai, pakhat cu khangh thawinak caah a si lai i a dang cu sual thawinak caah a si lai; cun tlangbawi nih remnak a serpiak lai i amah cu a thiang lai.”","ref":"Luk 2.24"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron sinah hitin a ti,","title":"Thinghmui Zawtnak Kongah Phunglam"},"2":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat cu a pum cuar cungah phinnak siseh, pharnak siseh, bonak siseh pakhatkhat a ngeih i cucu a pum cuar cung i thinghmui zawtnak ah a can tikah, cu tikah cun tlangbawi Aaron sinah siseh, tlangbawi a simi a fapa pakhatkhat sinah siseh, ratpi a si lai i"},"3":{"text":"tlangbawi nih cun a pum cuar cung i zawtnak a umnak zawn cu a zoh lai; zawtnak a umnak zawn hmul cu a ran i a zawtnak cu a pum cuar nakin a thuk deuh a lawh ahcun, cucu thinghmui zawtnak a si; tlangbawi nih a zoh dih tikah amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a pum cuar i a bomi cu a ran i cuar nakin a thuk deuh a lawh lo i a hmul kha a ran lo ahcun, tlangbawi nih zawtnak a ngeimi cu ni sarih chung a hren lai i"},"5":{"text":"ni sarihnak ni ah cun a zoh lai, cun amah hmuhnak ah zawtnak cu amah ning a si i a cuar ah zawtnak cu a karh lo ahcun, tlangbawi nih a dang ni sarih a hren rih lai;"},"6":{"text":"tlangbawi nih cun ni sarihnak ni ah a zoh ṭhan lai i zawtnak a umnak zawn cu a dulh i zawtnak cu cuar ah khan a karh lo ahcun, tlangbawi nih cun amah cu a thiang tiah a thanh lai; mah cucu a phar sawhsawhmi a si; a thilpuan a suk hna lai i a thiang ko lai."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah thiannak ca i tlangbawi sin i aa hmuh hnuah khan a pharmi cu a cuar ah a karh ahcun, tlangbawi hmaiah khan a chuak ṭhan lai;"},"8":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i a cuar ah a pharnak kha a karh ahcun tlangbawi nih cun amah cu a thianglo tiah a thanh lai; mah cucu thinghmui zawtnak a si."},"9":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat cu thinghmui zawtnak nih a tlaih tikah tlangbawi sinah chuahpi awk a si lai;"},"10":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i a cuar ah a rangmi hmul a chuahtertu a rangmi phinnak a um i a phinnak ah cun a sa hring a langh ahcun,"},"11":{"text":"cucu a pum cuar chung i thinghmui hma hlun a si, tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; a hreng lai lo, zeitintiah amah cu thianglo a si ko."},"12":{"text":"Cun thinghmui zawtnak cu cuar ah a chuah i, tlangbawi nih a hmuh khawh tiangah a zawmipa a cuar cu a lu in a ke tiang thinghmui zawtnak nih cun chuak lakin a khuh ahcun,"},"13":{"text":"tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i thinghmui zawtnak nih khan a pum dihlak kha a chuah cang ahcun, cu pa cu cu zawtnak in a thiang tiah a thanh lai; a rang ah a cang dih cang i amah cu a thiang."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a cungah sa hring a langh ahcun amah cu thianglo a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Tlangbawi nih sa hring cu a zoh lai i amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; sa hring cu thianglo a si, zeicahtiah thinghmui zawtnak a si."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a sa hring cu aa thlen ṭhan i a rang ah aa can ṭhan ahcun tlangbawi sinah a ra lai i"},"17":{"text":"tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i a zawtnak cu a rang ah aa thlen ahcun, tlangbawi nih a zawmi cu a thiang tiah a thanh lai; amah cu a thiang cang."},"18":{"text":"Cun pakhatkhat cuar i khuaihli a um i a dam tikah,"},"19":{"text":"cu khuaihli umnak i a rangmi phinnak siseh, a sen nawn a rang nawn in a bomi siseh a chuah ahcun, tlangbawi sinah hmuhsak awk a si lai;"},"20":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i cuar nakin thuk deuh a lawh i a hmul kha a ran ahcun, tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; mah cucu thinghmui zawtnak a si, hma chungin a hung langmi a si."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi nih a zoh i a cung i a ummi hmul kha a ran lo i, cuar nakin a thuh deuh lo i sihmanhsehlaw a dulh ahcun, tlangbawi nih ni sarih a hren lai;"},"22":{"text":"cun cuar ah a karh ahcun tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; a cuar cu zawtnak a ing."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a bomi cu kaa khat lawngah a um i a karh lo ahcun, khuaihli hma hmape a si; tlangbawi nih a thiang tiah a thanh lai."},"24":{"text":"“Asiloah, mipa pakhat cu a cuar a kangh i a kanghnak tit hring cu a bo i sen nawn rang nawn in a um, asiloah a ran tikah,"},"25":{"text":"tlangbawi nih a zoh lai i a bonak ka i hmul cu a ran i cuar nak thuk deuh in a langh ahcun, cucu thinghmui zawtnak a si; mei hma in a hung chuakmi a si tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; thinghmui zawtnak a si."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi nih a zoh i a bonak ka i a hmul kha a ran lo i cuar nakin a thuk deuh lo i a dulh ahcun, tlangbawi nih amah cu ni sarih a hren lai i"},"27":{"text":"ni sarihnak ni ah a zoh lai; cuar ah a karh ahcun tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; cucu thinghmui zawtnak a si."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a bo cu kaa khat lawngah a um ko i cuar ah a karh lo i a dulh ahcun, mah cucu mei hma in a hung phingmi a si; tlangbawi nih amah cu a thiang ko tiah a thanh lai; zeicahtiah mah cucu mei hma hmape a si ko."},"29":{"text":"“Pa nih siseh, nu nih siseh, an lu ah maw an khahmul ah maw zawtnak an ngeih tikah,"},"30":{"text":"tlangbawi nih zawtnak cu a zoh lai i cuar nakin thuk deuh in a langh i cuka hmul cu a en i a pan ahcun, tlangbawi nih amah cu thianglo a si tiah a thanh lai; mah cucu thakpherh, lu maw khahmul thinghmui zawtnak a si."},"31":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih a thakmi zawtnak cu a zoh i cuar nak i thuk deuh in a langh lo i a chungah hmul nak a um lo ahcun, tlangbawi nih cun thakpherh zawtnak a ngeimi cu ni sarih a hren lai;"},"32":{"text":"ni sarih ni ah tlangbawi nih cu zawtnak cu a zoh lai i thakpherh cu a karh lo i a chungah hmul eng a um lo i thakpherh cu cuar nakin thuk deuh in a langh lo ahcun,"},"33":{"text":"a hmul cu amah nih aa meh lai;
