tlangbawi nih a tuakning in, cu bang cun a si lai."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlanh a duh ahcun a man tuakmi cungah cheu nga cheu khat a chap lai."},"14":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat nih a inn cu Bawipa ca i thian awkah a pekchanh ahcun, tlangbawi nih a ṭha ah maw a chia ah dik a tuak lai; tlangbawi nih a tuakning in, cu bang cun a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun a pechantu nih a inn cu tlanh a duh ahcun, a man tuakmi cungah tangka in cheu nga cheu khat a chonh lai i amah ta a si lai."},"16":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat nih roconak in amah ta a simi ram a cheubang cu Bawipa sinah a pekchanh ahcun, a man na tuakning cu a chung i thlaici tuhmi zat ning in a si lai; barli homer pakhat tuhnak cu ngun shekel sawm nga ah tuak a si lai."},"17":{"text":"Jubili kum in a pekchanhnak cu a si ahcun, nangmah nih a man na tuakning bantuk cun a hmun lai;"},"18":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a lo cu jubili hnuah pekchanh a si ahcun, tangka in a man cu, jubili kum ṭhan hlantiang a tangmi kum zat ning in tlangbawi nih a tuak lai i nangmah nih a man na tuakmi chungin ṭhumhnak a um te lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun a pechantu nih a lo cu tlanh a duh ahcun, a man tuakmi cheu nga cheu khat cu tangka in a man ah cun a chonh lai i amah ta in a hmun lai."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw lo cu tlanh a duh lo ah siseh, lo cu midang sin i a zuar cang ah siseh, tlanh a si ti lai lo;"},"21":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw mah lo cu jubili i luatter a si tikah Bawipa caah a thiangmi ah, ulh-amh awk i sermi lo bantuk ah a cang lai; tlangbawi ta ah a si lai."},"22":{"text":"Roconak in a comi si loin a cawk in a cawkmi lo kha Bawipa sinah a pekchanh ahcun,"},"23":{"text":"tlangbawi nih a man cu jubili kum tiangah zeizat dah a si ti kha a tuak lai i a tuakmi zat ning cun cu pa nih cun Bawipa ca i a thiangmi thil ah, cu ni ah cun a pek lai."},"24":{"text":"Jubili kum ah cun a cawknak pa, roconak in a rak cotupa sinah khan, lo cu a kir ṭhan lai."},"25":{"text":"Man tuaknak paohpaoh cu biaknak inn shekel ning in a si lai: shekel pakhat ah gerah pakul a si lai."},"26":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw later fa paohpaoh cu, Bawipa ta an si caah, ahohmanh nih an pekchanh awk a si lo; cawtum siseh, tuu siseh, Bawipa ta a si."},"27":{"text":"Cun a thiang lomi saram a si ahcun, nangmah nih a man na tuak ning in a cawk ṭhan lai i cheu nga cheu khat a chap lai; a tlanh lo ahcun a man tuakning ah zuar a si lai."},"28":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw ulh-amhmi thil, Bawipa sinah mi pakhatkhat nih a pekchanhmi paohpaoh cu, a ngeihmi chungin zeihmanh siseh, minung a si ah, saram a si ah, ro i a comi a lo a si ah, zuarh awk zong a si lai lo i tlanh awk zong a si lai lo; ulh-amhmi thil paohpaoh cu Bawipa caah a thiang bik a si.","ref":"Nam 18.14"},"29":{"text":"Ulh amhmi minung cu ahohmanh a si ah, mi sinin hrawh cikcek hngami paohpaoh cu tlanh a si lai lo; thah a si ko lai."},"30":{"text":"“Ram chung thil, cheu hra cheu khat vialte cu, ram chung i thlakmi thlaici a si ah, thingkung hna theitlai a si ah, Bawipa ta a si; Bawipa ca i a thiangmi a si.","ref":"Nam 18.21; Deu 14.22-29"},"31":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih a cheu hra cheu khat azeihmanh kha tlanh a duh ahcun cheu nga cheu khat a bet lai."},"32":{"text":"Cun tuurun chungin siseh, cawrun chungin siseh, cheu hra cheu khat paohpaoh cu, saṭil khaltu ṭhiangṭhunh toi i a lanmi saṭil a pahranak paohpaoh cu, Bawipa ca i a thiangmi an si lai."},"33":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih a ṭhat a chiat kha a dothlat lai lo; a thlen zong a thleng lai lo; a thlen a si ahcun a thlennak le a thlenmi kha an pahnih in a thiangmi ah an cang lai; tlanh khawh a si lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Mah hihi Sinai Tlang ah Bawipa nih Israel mi hna caah Moses a pekmi nawlbia cu an si."}}}}},"4":{"info":{"name":"Nambar","shortname":"Num","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu Sinai ramlak ah, tonnak thlam chungah cun, Izipt ram in an chuah hnu kum hnihnak kum thla hnihnak thla ni khatnak ni ah cun, a chawnh i hitin a ti:","title":"Sinai Ah Israel Mi An Rel Hna","ref":"Nam 26.1-51"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mibu vialte hna cu an milu rel tuah hna, a chungchung in, a phunphun in, an min zat ningin, pa paohpaoh, pakhat hnu pakhat;"},"3":{"text":"kum kul ri in a cunglei, Israel mi chung i phawnam tlai kho vialte, a phu a phu in Aaron le nangmah nih nan rel hna lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun nan sinah phun khat chungin mi pakhat cio an um lai i cu hna cu an chung lak i a lu cio an si lai."},"5":{"text":"Mah hna hi nanmah an umpitu hna ding an min cu a si. Reuben phun chungin, Shedeur fapa Elizur;"},"6":{"text":"Simeon phun chungin, Zurishaddai fapa Shelumiel;"},"7":{"text":"Judah phun chungin Amminadab fapa Nahshon;"},"8":{"text":"Issakhar phun chungin, Zuar fapa Nethanel;"},"9":{"text":"Zebulun phun chungin, Helon fapa Eliab;"},"10":{"text":"Josef fapa hna chungin, Efraim chungin Ammihud fapa Elishama, cun Manasseh chungin Pedahzur fapa Gamaliel;"},"11":{"text":"Benjamin phun chungin Gideoni fapa Abidan;"},"12":{"text":"Dan phun chungin, Ammishaddai fapa Ahiezer:"},"13":{"text":"Asher phun chungin Okhran fapa Pagiel;"},"14":{"text":"Gad phun chungin, Deuel fapa Eliasaf;"},"15":{"text":"Naftali phun chungin Enan fapa Ahira.”"},"16":{"text":"Mah hna hi mibu chungin thimmi, an thawhkehnak phun hruaitu hna. Israel mi chung i miphun hna an lu cu an si."},"17":{"text":"Moses le Aaron nih minthlak a simi hna hi an lak hna i"},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu nawl a pek bangin, thla hnihnak thla ni khatnak ni ah cun, a chungchung in, a phunphun in, kum kul ri in a cunglei an min zat ningin, pakhat hnu pakhat in, min aa thlami hna cu, Israel mibu cu a ning piin an pumh hna."},"19":{"text":"Cu bangin Sinai ramlak ah a rel hna."},"20":{"text":"Israel fapa upa bik Reuben mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, pakhat hnu pakhat in, kum kul ri in a cunglei pa paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"21":{"text":"Reuben phun mi cu sang li le thong ruk le za nga an si."},"22":{"text":"Simeon mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, min thlakmi hna cu, an min zat ningin, pakhat hnu pakhat in, kum kul ri in a cunglei pa paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"23":{"text":"Simeon phun mi cu sang nga thong kua le za thum an si."},"24":{"text":"Gad mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"25":{"text":"Gad phun mi cu sang li, thong nga, za ruk le sawm nga an si."},"26":{"text":"Judah mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"27":{"text":"Judah phun mi cu sang sarih, thong li le za ruk an si."},"28":{"text":"Issakhar mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"29":{"text":"Issakhar phun mi cu sang nga, thong li le za li an si."},"30":{"text":"Zebulun mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ning in, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"31":{"text":"Zebulun phun mi cu sang nga, thong sarih le za li an si."},"32":{"text":"Josef mi hna chungin Efraim mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"33":{"text":"Efraim phun mi cu sang li le za nga an si."},"34":{"text":"Manasseh mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"35":{"text":"Manasseh phun mi cu sang thum, thong hnih le za hnih an si."},"36":{"text":"Benjamin mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"37":{"text":"Benjamin phun mi cu sang thum, thong nga le za li an si."},"38":{"text":"Dan mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ning in, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"39":{"text":"Dan phun mi cu sang ruk, thong hnih le za sarih an si."},"40":{"text":"Asher mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"41":{"text":"Asher phun mi cu sang li, thong khat le za nga an si."},"42":{"text":"Naftali mi hna cu, an tefa hna, an chungchung in, an phunphun in, an min zat ningin, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte:"},"43":{"text":"Naftali phun mi cu sang nga, thong thum le za li an si."},"44":{"text":"Mah hna hi relmi cu an si, Moses le Aaron nih Israel mi hruitu hleihnih, anmah le an phun cio airawl hna he i bawmh in an relmi hna cu."},"45":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi cu an ning piin, an phunphun in, kum kul ri in a cunglei paohpaoh, phawnam tlai kho vialte: —"},"46":{"text":"an ning piin sing ruk, thong thum, za nga le sawm nga an si."},"47":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Levi mi hna cu an chuahkehnak phun in annih sinah relchih an si lo.","title":"Levi Mi Rian Peknak"},"48":{"text":"Zeicahtiah, Bawipa nih Moses sinah,"},"49":{"text":"“Levi phun lawnglawng hi na rel hna lai lo i annih cu Israel mi hna lakah min relnak na tuah hna lai lo;"},"50":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Levi mi cu hngalhternak puan biakinn le a thilthuam vialte le a chung i a ummi thil vialte zohkhenhtu ah na chiah hna lai; annih nih puan biakinn le a thilthuam vialte an put awk le an zohkhenh awk a si lai i puan biakinn velchum ah cun riah hmun an khuar lai."},"51":{"text":"Puan biakinn cu kalpi awk a si tikah Levi mi nih an ṭheh lai i puan biakinn cu bunh awk a si tikah Levi mi nih an bunh lai; midang ahohmanh nih a ra naih ahcun, amah cu thah a si lai."},"52":{"text":"Israel mi hna nih an thlam cu an bu ning cio ah an bunh hna lai, mi kip nih mah le bu cio ah, cun mah le hmelchunhnak cio ah;"},"53":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Levi mi hna cu hngalhternak puan biakinn velchum ah riahhmun an khuar lai, Israel mi an bu cungah thinhunnak a um nakhnga lo; cun Levi mi nih hngalhternak puan biakinn cu an zohkhenh lai,” a ti."},"54":{"text":"Cu bangin Israel mi nih an tuah; Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi dihlak bang khan an tuah."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu a chawnh hna i hi bangin a ti.","title":"Phun Cio Riahhmun le Lu Hna"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna cu anmah le an alan pawng cio ah, an pupa hmelchunhnak i tar in an um awk a si lai; tonnak thlam cu a zeilei kap paoh in hoih cio ah riahhmun cu an khuar lai."},"3":{"text":"Nichuahlei, ni a hung chuahnak lei kam i a um hngami hna cu Judah riahhmun alan a si lai, an bubu in, Judah mi a hruitu hna cu Amminadab fapa Nahshon a si,"},"4":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang sarih, thong li, za ruk a si."},"5":{"text":"Amah chang ah riahhmun a khuar hnga ding cu Issakhar phun an si lai, Issakhar mi a hruitu hna cu Zuar fapa Nethanel a si,"},"6":{"text":"amah bu cu an rel ning ah sang nga, thong li, le za li a si."},"7":{"text":"Cu hnuah Zebulun phun an si lai, Zebulun mi a hruitu hna cu Helon fapa Eliab a si,"},"8":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang nga, thong sarih le za li a si."},"9":{"text":"Judah riahhmun cu a ning piin, an bubu in, sing khat, sang riat, thong ruk le za li a si. Kal tikah anmah hi a pok hmasa bik an si lai."},"10":{"text":"“Thlanglei kam i a um hnga ding cu Reuben riahhmun alan a si lai, an bubu in, Reuben mi a hruitu hna cu Shedeur fapa Elizur a si,"},"11":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang li, thong ruk le za nga a si."},"12":{"text":"Cun amah a hun chang ah riahhmun a khuar hnga ding cu Simeon phun an si lai, Simeon mi a hruitu hna cu Zurishaddai fapa Shelumiel a si,"},"13":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang nga, thong kua le za thum a si."},"14":{"text":"Cu hnuah Gad phun a si lai, Gad mi a hruitu hna cu Reuel fapa Eliasaf a si;"},"15":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang li, thong nga, za ruk le sawm nga a si."},"16":{"text":"Reuben riahhmun cu a ning piin, an bubu in, sing khat, sang nga, thong khat, za li le sawm nga a si. Anmah hi a pokmi a pahnihnak an si lai."},"17":{"text":"“Cun tonnak thlam cu a pok lai, riahhmun hna laifang i Levi mi hna riahhmun he cun; riahhmun an khuar ning te khan an pok lai, anmah le an umnak ning ciote khan, alan pakhat hnu pakhat in."},"18":{"text":"“Nitlaklei kam i a um hnga ding cu Efraim riahhmun alan a si lai, an bubu in, Efraim mi a hruitu hna cu Ammihud fapa Elishama a si,"},"19":{"text":"amah bu cu an rel ning ah sang li le za nga a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun amah chang ah cun Manasseh phun an si lai, Manasseh mi a hruitu hna cu Pedahzur fapa Gamaliel a si,"},"21":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang thum, thong hnih le za hnih a si."},"22":{"text":"Cun Benjamin phun an si lai, Benjamin mi a hruitu hna cu Gideoni fapa Abidan a si,"},"23":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang thum, thong nga le za li a si."},"24":{"text":"Efraim riah hmun cu a ning piin, an bubu in, sing khat, thong riat le za khat a si. Anmah hi kal tikah a pokmi a pathumnak an si lai."},"25":{"text":"“Chaklei kamah Dan riahhmun alan, an bubu in, a si lai, Dan mi a hruitu hna cu Ammishaddai fapa Ahiezer a si,"},"26":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang ruk, thong hnih le za sarih a si."},"27":{"text":"Cun amah chang ah riahhmun a khuar hnga ding cu Asher phun an si lai, Asher mi a hruitu hna cu Okhran fapa Pagiel a si,"},"28":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang li, thong khat le za nga a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Naftali phun an si lai, Naftali mi a hruitu hna cu Enan fapa Ahira a si,"},"30":{"text":"amah bu cu an relning ah sang nga, thong thum le za li a si."},"31":{"text":"Dan riahhmun cu a ning piin sing khat, sang nga, thong sarih le za ruk a si. Anmah hi a pokmi a hmanung bik an si lai; alan pakhat hnu pakhat in.”"},"32":{"text":"Mah hihi Israel mi hna cu an phun cio ah rel tikah an si; riahhmun hna ah a ummi vialte an bu cio ah relmi cu sing ruk le thong thum, za nga le sawm nga an si."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bangin Levi mi hna cu Israel mi lakah rel an si lo."},"34":{"text":"Cu bangin Israel mi nih an tuah. Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi vialte bantukin, cu bangin an bu cio ah riahhmun an khuar, cun cu bangin an pok, anmah le an chungkhar cio ah, anmah le an phun ning cio ah."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Sinai Tlang ah Moses kha a chawnh tikah, mah hna hi Aaron le Moses tefa cu an si.","title":"Levi Mi Zeizat An Si le An Rian"},"2":{"text":"Mah hna hi Aaron fapa hna min cu an si: a upa bik ah Nadab, cun Abihu le Eleazar, cun Ithamar;","ref":"Nam 26.60"},"3":{"text":"mah hihi Aaron fapa hna min cu an si, chiti thuhmi tlangbawi, tlangbawi rian ṭuan awkah a thleidanmi hna cu."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nadab le Abihu cu, Sinai ram lakah Bawipa hmaiah a thiang lomi mei an pekchanh tikah khan an thi, fa an ngei lo. Cu caah Eleazar le Ithamar nih an pa Aaron a nun lio khan tlangbawi rian cu an ṭuan.","ref":"Lev 10.1-2; Nam 26.61"},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"6":{"text":"“Levi phun cu nai ah ratpi hna law, tlangbawi Aaron hmaiah chia hna, amah cu bultawl hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Puan biaknak inn ah rian an ṭuanpah in amah ca le aa pummi dihlak caah tonnak thlam hmaiah rian an ṭuan lai;"},"8":{"text":"tonnak thlam thil thuam vialte cu an zohkhenh lai i puan biakinn ah rian an ṭuanpah in Israel mi caah rian an ṭuan lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna cu Aaron le a fapa hna kha na pek hna lai; annih cu Israel mi chung in amah sinah an ning piin pekmi an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun Aaron le a fapa hna cu rian na pek hna lai i an tlangbawi rian cu an ṭuan lai; sihmanhsehlaw midang ahohmanh nih a ra naih ahcun, amah cu thah a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"12":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, Levi mi hna cu Israel mi hna lak in Israel mi hna lak i fater, nu paw chungchuak hmasa bik hna, can-ai ah ka lak cang hna. Levi mi cu keimah ta an si lai,"},"13":{"text":"zeitintiah fater vialte cu keimah ta an si; Izipt ram chung i fater vialte ka thah hna ni ah khan Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte cu, minung siseh, saram siseh, keimah ca hrimhrim ah ka thianter hna; annih cu keimah ta an si lai: keimah cu Bawipa ka si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 13.2"},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu Sinai ramlak ah a chawnh i,","title":"Levi Mi Milu Relnak"},"15":{"text":"“Levi fapa cu rel tuah hna, an phun ningin le an chung ningin; pa paohpaoh, thla khat ri in a cunglei na rel hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Moses nih, Bawipa bia bangin, nawl pek a si bangin, a rel hna."},"17":{"text":"Mah hihi Levi fapa hna cu an min in an si: Gershon le Kohath le Merari."},"18":{"text":"Cun mah hihi Gershon fapa hna cu an chung cio ningin an si: Libni le Shimei."},"19":{"text":"Cun Kohath fapa hna cu an chung ning cio ah: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel."},"20":{"text":"Cun Merari fapa hna cu an chung cio ningin: Mahli le Mushi. Mah hna hi Levi chungkhar hna cu an si, an phun ning cio ah."},"21":{"text":"Gershon cu Libni chung le Shimei chung thlatu a si; mah hna hi Gershon chung hna cu an si."},"22":{"text":"Thla khat ri in a cunglei pa vialte relmi hna cu thong sarih le za nga an si."},"23":{"text":"Gershon chung hna cu puan biakinn hnu lei, nitlaklei ah khan riahhmun khuar awk an si lai;"},"24":{"text":"Gershon mi hna phun an lu ah cun Lael fapa Eliasaf a si."},"25":{"text":"Cun Gershon fapa hna nih tonnak thlam chungah an zohkhenh awk hnga cu puan biakinn cu a si lai, a thlam he, a khuhnak he, tonnak thlam innka zar,"},"26":{"text":"tual kulhnak puanzar, tual innkazar puan biakinn le biakṭheng velchum i a ummi cu le a hri hna; hi hna he aa tlaimi rian vialte."},"27":{"text":"Kohath cu Amram chung le Izhar chung le Hebron chung le Uzziel chung thlatu a si; mah hna hi Kohath chung hna cu an si."},"28":{"text":"Thla khat ri in a cunglei pa vialte relmi hna, hmunthiang a zohkhenhtu ding hna cu, thong riat le za ruk an si."},"29":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna cu an chungchung in puan biakinn thlanglei kamah riahhmun an khuar awk a si lai,"},"30":{"text":"Kohath mi hna a chungchung in a ummi an phun lu cu Uzziel fapa Elizafan a si."},"31":{"text":"Cun annih nih an zohkhenh awk hnga cu kuang le cabuai le meiinn tung le biakṭheng hna le, tlangbawi nih an hmanmi hmunthiang umkheng hna cu le puanzar an si lai; mah hna he aa tlaimi rian vialte."},"32":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Aaron fapa Eleazar cu Levi mi hna a hruitu hna lak i upa bik a si lai i, hmunthiang zohkhenh awk an rian a simi hna a hruitu a si lai."},"33":{"text":"Merari cu Mahli chung le Mushi chung thlatu a si: mah hna hi Merari chung cu an si."},"34":{"text":"Thla khat ri in a cunglei pa vialte relmi hna cu thong ruk le za hnih an si."},"35":{"text":"Merari chung hna an phun lu cu Abihail fapa Zuriel a si; annih cu puan biakinn a chaklei kamah riahhmun khuar awk an si."},"36":{"text":"Merari fapa hna zohkhenh awk caah ruahmi cu puan biaknak inn a tungtlang hna le, a fung hna le, a tung hna le, a hram hna le hman awk a thilri vialte an si lai; mah hna he aa tlaimi rian vialte."},"37":{"text":"Tual velchum i tung hna zong, an hram le an khenhteo le an hri hna he tiah."},"38":{"text":"Cun puan biakinn hmailei nichuahlei, nichuak hoih tonnak thlam hmailei i riahhmun a khuar hnga ding cu Moses le Aaron le a fapa hna an si lai, Israel mi hna ca i tuah awk a simi paoh, hmunthiang chung i phunglam hna cu anmah rian a si lai; midang ahohmanh a ra naihmi paoh cu thah a si lai."},"39":{"text":"Bawipa nih nawl a pek hna bangin Moses le Aaron nih, a chungchung in, thla khat ri in a cunglei pa paohpaoh an relmi, Levi mi vialte hna cu sang hnih le thong hnih an si."},"40":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i, “Israel mi hna an fater pa, thla khat ri in a cunglei vialte cu rel hna, zeizat an si cu an min in na lak lai.","title":"Fater Tlanhnak Kong"},"41":{"text":"Cun Levi mi cu keimah caah na lak hna lai — keimah cu Bawipa ka si — Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte hna can ah na lak hna lai, cun, Levi mi saṭil hna cu Israel mi hna saṭil hna lak i later fa can ah na lak hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cu caah Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin Moses nih Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte cu a rel dih hna."},"43":{"text":"Fater pa vialte, an min zat ningin, thla khat in a cunglei relmi hna cu sang hnih thong hnih, za hnih le sawm sarih pathum an si."},"44":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"45":{"text":"“Levi mi hna cu Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte can ah la hna law, Levi mi saṭil hna cu an saṭil can ah la hna; cun Levi mi cu keimah ta an si lai: keimah cu Bawipa ka si."},"46":{"text":"Cun Levi mi pa hna nakin, Israel mi hna fater an tam deuhnak za hnih le sawm sarih le pathum hna tlanhnak caah khan,"},"47":{"text":"pakhat ah shekel panga lengmang na lak lai; hmunthiang shekel ning i rel in, shekel pakhat i gerah pakul a simi kha, na lak hna lai;"},"48":{"text":"cun a hlei a simi hna tlanhnak tangka cu Aaron le a fapa hna cu na pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cucaah Levi mi nih an tlanhmi hna cung i a hlei a simi hna tlanhnak tangka cu Moses nih a lak;"},"50":{"text":"Israel mi hna fater hna sin cun, hmunthiang shekel ning i rel in shekel thong khat, za thum le sawm ruk panga a lak;"},"51":{"text":"cun Moses nih tlanhnak tangka cu, Bawipa bia bangin, Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin, Aaron le a fapa hna kha a pek hna."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu a chawnh hna i hi bangin a ti,","title":"Levi Mi Ṭuan Awk Rian"},"2":{"text":"“Levi fapa hna lak i Kohath fapa hna kha rel tuah hna u, an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio ah,"},"3":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, rian ah a lut khomi vialte, tonnak thlam chung i rianṭuan awkah rel hna u."},"4":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna i tonnak thlam chung i an rian cu, a thiang bik thil hna cu an si lai."},"5":{"text":"Riahhmun cu pawh aa timh tikah, Aaron le a fapa hna nih an lut lai i phenhnak puanzar kha an ṭhumh lai i biahngalhternak kuang kha mah cu cun an tuam lai;"},"6":{"text":"cun a cungah meheh phaw in sermi zualnak in an zual lai, cun cu cungah cun a dihlak in a dummi puan an khuh lai i a laang cu an hrolh hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun umcamcin changreu cabuai cungah cun a dummi puan an phah lai i a cungah pakan hna le rimhmui khanghnak kheng tete le kanto hna le thlet thawinak ca i awi-um hna cu an chiah hna lai; umcamcin changreu zong cu a cungah cun a um ve lai;"},"8":{"text":"cun an cungah puan sen an khuh hna lai i mah cucu meheh phaw in sermi zualnak in an zual hna lai i a laang cu an hrolh hna lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun puan dum an lak lai i ceunak ca meiinn tung cu a meiinn hna le a hmihnak hna le a pakan hna le chiti an peknak um vialte he tiah an khuh lai:"},"10":{"text":"cun a thilthuam vialte he meheh phaw in sermi zualnak chungah cun an sanh lai i putnak laang cungah cun an chuan lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun sui biakṭheng cungah khan puan dum an khuh lai i meheh phaw in sermi zualnak in an zual lai i a laang kha an hrolh hna lai;"},"12":{"text":"cun rianṭuannak umkheng vialte, hmunthiang chung i hmanmi kha an lak hna lai i puan dum chungah an chiah hna lai i meheh phaw in sermi zualnak in an zual hna lai i putnak laang cungah an chuan hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Cun biakṭheng vutcam kha an luah lai i a cungah puan senduk an khuh lai;"},"14":{"text":"cun a cungah biakṭheng thilthuam vialte mah ka rianṭuannak i hmanmi, meilaknak kheng hna le thir zum hna le cawhlek hna le khengkuar hna le, biakṭheng thilthuam vialte hna cu an chiah lai; cun a cungah meheh phaw in sermi khuhnak an phah lai i a laang cu an hrolh hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun Aaron le a fapa hna nih hmunthiang le hmunthiang thilthuam vialte cu an khuh dih tikah, riahhmun cun aa thawh lioah, cu hnuah Kohath fapa hna cu mah hna hi zawnh awkah an ra lai, sihmanhsehlaw thil thiang kha an tawng hrimhrim hna lai lo, an thi sual hnga. Mah hna hi tonnak thlam thilri Kohath fapa hna nih an i zawnh awk hnga cu an si."},"16":{"text":"“Cun tlangbawi Aaron fapa Eleazar cu van awk ca i chiti, rimthawmi zihmui, hun camcinmi changvut thawinak le thuhnak chiti cu a zohkhenhtu a si lai, puan biakinn a dihlak in le a chung i a ummi thil vialte le, hmunthiang le a thilthuam vialte zohkhenh zong a si lai.”"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu a chawnh hna i,"},"18":{"text":"“Kohath chung hna phun cu Levi mi hna chungin lohter hna hlah u;"},"19":{"text":"thil thiang bik pawng an rat tikah an nun i an thih nakhnga lo, annih cu hitihin nan va ti hna lai: Aaron le a fapa hna kha an lut lai i an rian cio le an phorh ding thil cio kha an thiah hna lai,"},"20":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a thiangmi thil hna zoh awkah, caan tawite ca hmanh a si ah, annih an lut lai lo, an thi sual lai,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"22":{"text":"“Gershon fapa hna zong kha rel tuah hna, an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio ah;"},"23":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, na rel hna lai, rianṭuannak ah a lut khomi vialte, tonnak thlam chung i rian ṭuan awkah."},"24":{"text":"Mah hihi Gershon chung hna an rian cu a si lai, rianṭuannak le thil phorhnak ah:"},"25":{"text":"puan biakinn puanzar le tonnak thlam a khuh he, cun a cung i a ummi tuu phaw in sermi khuhnak, cun tonnak thlam innka zar,"},"26":{"text":"tual kulhnak puanzar, cun puan biakinn le biakṭheng velchum i a ummi tual kutka luhnak puanzar, cun an hri le an rianṭuannak ca i thilthuam vialte; cun cu hna he aa pehtlai in a herhmi vialte cu an tuah lai."},"27":{"text":"Gershon fapa hna an rian vialte cu Aaron le a fapa hna nawl in a si lai, an phorh awk hnga vialte ah siseh, an tuah awk hnga vialte ah siseh; cun an phorh awk hnga vialte cu anmah rian ah na hluai lai."},"28":{"text":"Mah hihi Gershon mi hna an fapale hna i an chung cio in, tonnak thlam chungah an rian cu a si, cun an rian cu tlangbawi Aaron fapa Ithamar nih a zoh lai."},"29":{"text":"Merari fapa hna tu cu an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio in na rel hna lai;"},"30":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, na rel hna lai, rianṭuannak chungah a lut khomi paoh tonnak thlam rianṭuan awkah cun, na rel hna lai."},"31":{"text":"Mah hihi phorh awkah annih thiahmi cu a si, tonnak thlam chung i an rianṭuannak a ning khan ah: puan biakinn a tungtlang hna, a fung hna le, a tung hna le a hram hna he tiah,"},"32":{"text":"cun tual velchum i a ummi tung hna, an hram hna he an khenhteo hna he an hri hna he, an thilthuam vialte le an thilri vialte he tiah; cun annih kha phorh awk fialmi thil hna cu an min in na thiah hna lai."},"33":{"text":"Tlangbawi Aaron fapa Ithamar kut tangah Merari fapa hna chunglei i an rian, tonnak thlam chung i an rianṭuanmi cu a dihlak in, mah hihi a si,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron le mibu a hruaitu hna nih cun Kohath fapale hna cu an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio ah an rel hna,"},"35":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, tonnak thlam chung i rianṭuan awkah, rianṭuannak chung i a lut khomi paohpaoh;"},"36":{"text":"cun a chungchung in an relmi hna cu thong hnih, za sarih le sawm nga an si."},"37":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses in nawl a pekmi bangin Moses le Aaron nih an relmi hna, tonnak thlam chung i rian a ṭuanmi vialte, Kohath mi hna chungle hna cu mah zat hi an si."},"38":{"text":"Gershon fapa hna, an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio ah,"},"39":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, tonnak thlam chung rianṭuan awk ca i rianṭuannak i a lut khomi paohpaoh,"},"40":{"text":"an chung cio le an phun ning cio in rel ah thong hnih, za ruk le sawm thum an si."},"41":{"text":"Bawipa nawl peknak bangin Moses le Aaron nih an relmi hna, tonnak thlam chung i rian a ṭuanmi vialte, Gershon fapa hna i chungle hna cu mah zat hi an si."},"42":{"text":"Merari i fapa hna chungle hna cu an chung ning cio le an phun ning cio in,"},"43":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, tonnak thlam chung i rianṭuan awk ca i rianṭuannak i a lut khomi paohpaoh,"},"44":{"text":"a chungchung in rel ah thong thum le za hnih an si."},"45":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses in nawl pekmi bangin Moses le Aaron nih an relmi hna Merari fapa hna chungle cu mah zat hi an si."},"46":{"text":"Levi mi hna chung i relmi vialte, Moses le Aaron le Israel mi hna hruaitu hna nih an relmi, an chung cio ningin le an phun cio ningin,"},"47":{"text":"kum sawm thum ri in kum sawm nga tiang, tonnak thlam chung i ṭuan awk rian le phorh awk rian ṭuan awk ca i a lut khomi,"},"48":{"text":"annih lak i relmi hna cu thong riat le za nga le sawm riat an si."},"49":{"text":"Moses in pekmi Bawipa nawlbia bangin thiah an si, anmah le an rian cio ah khan, rian ṭuan siseh, thil phorh siseh; cu bangin annih cu a rel hna, Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan, a rel hna."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Riahhmun In A Thiang Lomi Chuahnak"},"2":{"text":"“Riahhmun lengah thinghmui zawtnak a ngei paoh le, thil chuak a ngei paoh le miruak he i tawnghnak in a thiang lomi vialte cu an chuah hna nakhnga nawl pe hna;"},"3":{"text":"pa siseh nu siseh na chuah hna lai, riahhmun lengah na chuah hna lai, zeitintiah a laifang i ka umnak an riahhmun cu an thurhhnawmh nakhnga lo,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cu bangin Israel mi nih an tuah i riahhmun lengah an chuah hna; Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bangin, cu bangin Israel mi nih an tuah."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Rulhnak Phung","ref":"Lev 6.1-7"},"6":{"text":"“Israel mi cu va chim hna, Pa nih siseh nu nih siseh a minung hawi cungah ṭhat lonak a tuah i cu a tuahmi thawngin Bawipa he bia i kamnak kha a rawk i a tuahtu nih cun a sualnak kha a hngalh tikah,"},"7":{"text":"sualnak a tuahmi cu a phuan lai i a sualnak caah cun tling tein rulhnak a tuah lai; cheu nga cheu khat a chap lai i a cung i sualnak a tuahnak mi kha a pek lai."},"8":{"text":"Asinain, sualnak tuahmi ca rulhnak cohlangtu ah mipa nih khan rualchan a ngeih lo ahcun, sualnak tuahmi ca rulhnak kha Bawipa sinah tlangbawi caah a kal lai, remnak tuukawng, amah ca i remnak sernak hleiah khan."},"9":{"text":"Cun pekchanhmi thil vialte, Israel mi hna thil thiang vialte, tlangbawi sin i an rak putmi hna cu, amah ta an si lai;"},"10":{"text":"mi kip i an thil thiang hna cu amah ta an si lai; mi zeihmanh nih tlangbawi an pekmi thil cu a zeihmanh amah ta a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Lunghrinhnak Kong I Phung"},"12":{"text":"“Israel mi cu va chim hna, Mipa pakhatkhat cu a nupi nih hei pialtak seh law, a cungah zumhawktlak loin thil tuah seh law,"},"13":{"text":"mipa pakhatkhat nih pum duhnak in ihpi seh law, a va nih hngal ṭung hlah seh law, amah cu aa thurhhnawmh cang nain puang ṭung loin a um lioah khan, tlaih a si lo caah amah cungah tehte um ṭung hna hlah seh law;"},"14":{"text":"cun a va cungah lunghrinnak lungthin a tlun i aa thurhhnawmh cangmi a nupi kha a lunghrinh ahcun, asiloah lunghrinnak lungthin cu a cungah a tlung i a nupi cu aa thurhhnawmh lo nain a lunghrinh ahcun,"},"15":{"text":"khi tikah mipa nih a nupi cu tlangbawi sinah a ratpi lai i amah kongah a herhmi pekchanhnak kha a rak put lai, cucu barli dip ephah cheu hra cheu khat a si lai; chiti a toih lai lo, frankinsen zong a toih lai lo, zeicahtiah lunghrinh changvut thawinak, hngalh ṭhannak changvut thawinak a si; ṭhat lonak hngalh ṭhanternak caah a si."},"16":{"text":"“Cun tlangbawi nih nu cu hmaiah a ratpi lai i Bawipa hmaiah khan a dirter lai;"},"17":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih tlak um in ti thiang kha a lak lai i puan biakinn ṭuang i leidip kha tlawmpal in a lak lai i ti chungah cun a paih lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih minu kha Bawipa hmaiah a dirter lai, a sam kha a phoih lai i a kut chungah hngalh ṭhannak changvut thawinak kha a chiah lai, mah cucu lunghrinnak changvut thawinak kha a si. Cun a kut in tlangbawi nih cun khaatnak ti, chiatnak a tluntertu cu, aa put lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih minu cu chiat hi bangin a serter lai i, ‘Nangmah nih na va nawlngeihnak toiah na um lioah ahohmanh nih an in ihpi lo i thurhhnawmhnak leiah naa mer lo ahcun, hi khaatnak ti, chiatnak a tluntertu hin luat ko."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na va nawlngeihnak toiah na um nain, na rak pial i na rak i thurhhnawmh i na va hleiah mipa pakhatkhat nih an ihpi ahcun,"},"21":{"text":"cu ti a si ahcun, (tlangbawi nih minu cu chiat cu serter seh law, minu sinah chim seh) ‘Na mi hna lakah Bawipa nih nangmah cu chiathrutnak in inter seh, Bawipa nih na phei kha a tlonghter i na pum kha a phinter tikah;"},"22":{"text":"hi chiathrutnak a tlunhtu ti hi na paw chungah lut seh law, na pum cu phinter seh law, na phei cu tlonghter seh,’ tiah a ti lai. Cun minu nih cun, ‘Amen, Amen,’ a ti lai."},"23":{"text":"“Cun tlangbawi nih hi chiatsernak bia hna cu cauk chungah a ṭial lai i khaatnak ti chungah khan a tlengh hna lai;"},"24":{"text":"cun minu kha chiatnak a tlunhtu khaatnak ti kha a dinter lai i chiatnak a tluntertu ti kha a chungah a lut lai i nganfahnak a pek lai."},"25":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih minu kut chung khan lunghrinh changvut thawinak kha a lak lai i changvut thawinak cu Bawipa hmaiah a hninh lai i biakṭheng ah a rak put lai;"},"26":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih, cu changvut thawinak hngalh camcinnak caah cun, changvut thawinak cu pei khat in a lak lai i biakṭheng cungah a khangh lai i a hnuah nu cu ti kha a dinter lai."},"27":{"text":"Cun minu kha ti cu a dinter tikah, amah kha a rak i thurhhnawmh i a va toiah zumh awk tlak loin a rak um ahcun, chiatnak a tlunhtu ti cu a chungah a lut lai i a ngan a fahter lai i a pum cu a phing lai i a phei cu a tlong lai i, cu nu cu a mi hna lakah chiathrutnak a ingmi ah a cang lai."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw minu cu a rak i thurhhnawmh lo i a thian ko ahcun, cu ti a si ahcun amah cu a luat lai i fa a hrin hna lai."},"29":{"text":"“Mah hihi lunghrinhnak kong i phungbia cu a si, nu nih a va nawl ngeihnak toiah a um nain a pial i aa thurhhnawmh tikah siseh,"},"30":{"text":"asiloah, pa cungah lunghrinnak thinlung a tlun i a nupi kha a lunghrinh tikah siseh; khi tikah minu cu Bawipa hmaiah a dirter lai i tlangbawi nih mah phungbia vialte hi minu cungah cun a tuah lai."},"31":{"text":"Pa cu ṭhat lonak in a luat lai, sihmanhsehlaw nu nih cun a ṭhat lonak cu a in lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i hi bangin a ti,","title":"Nazir Mi Ca Phung"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi cu va chim tuah hna, pa nih siseh, nu nih siseh a si khunmi biakamnak, Nazir biakamnak, Bawipa sin i i thleidan awkah a tuah tikah,"},"3":{"text":"zu le zureu din awk kha a hrial lai; zu in siseh, zureu in siseh, sermi a thormi zong kha a ding lai lo, cun mitsur hang zong a ding lai lo, mitsur thei zong a ei lai lo, a hring in siseh, a car in siseh.","ref":"Luk 1.15"},"4":{"text":"Aa thleidan chung vialte cu mitsur ruang in a chuakmi thil zeihmanh a ei lai lo, a ci le a hawng hmanh a ei hna lai lo."},"5":{"text":"“I thleidan awk i bia aa kam chung vialte cu a lu cu namte zeihmanh nih a tawng lai lo; Bawipa ca i aa thleidannak a caan a tlin hlantiang cu a thiang lai; a sam kha aa zuah lai."},"6":{"text":"“ Bawipa sinah aa thleidan chung vialte cu miruak pawngah a kal lai lo."},"7":{"text":"A pa siseh a nu siseh, a unau siseh a far siseh, cu hna an thih hmanh ahcun, aa thurter lai lo; zeicahtiah Pathian sin i aa thleidannak cu a lu cungah a um."},"8":{"text":"Aa thleidan chung vialte Bawipa caah a thiang."},"9":{"text":"“Cun mi pakhatkhat cu a pawngah duak tiah a thih sual i a thiantermi a lu kha a buar ahcun, aa thianh ni ah a lu kha aa meh lai; ni sarihnak ni ah aa meh lai."},"10":{"text":"Ni riat ni ah ṭhuro pahnih maw, laileng no pahnih dik, tonnak thlam innka ah, tlangbawi sinah a rak put lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih pakhat cu sual thawinak caah a thawi lai i pakhat cu khangh thawinak caah a thawi lai, cun remnak a serpiak lai, zeitintiah miruak thawngin a sual cang. Cun cu ni theng ah cun a lu kha a thianter lai i"},"12":{"text":"aa thleidan caan kha Bawipa sinah aa thleidang ṭhan lai; cun tuufa a pa pakhat, kum khat a timi phungbuar thawinak caah a rak put lai; sihmanhsehlaw a caan hmasa deuh kha cu pakpalawng a si lai, zeicahtiah aa thleidannak kha a buar."},"13":{"text":"“Cun mah hihi Nazir caah phungbia a si, aa thleidannak caan kha a dih tikah: amah cu tonnak thlam innka ah khan ratpi a si lai i","ref":"Lam 21.23-24"},"14":{"text":"a laksawng cu Bawipa sinah a pekchanh lai, khangh thawinak caah tuufa pakhat a pa kum khat a ti i do a tlami, cun sual thawinak caah tuufa pakhat a nu kum khat a ti i do a tlami, cun daihnak thawinak caah do a tlami tuutum pakhat,"},"15":{"text":"cun thilnu telh lo changreu bawm khat, chiti he cawhmi changvut dip in sermi changreu hlum hna le changreu a per tete chiti thuhmi le an changvut thawinak hna le an thlet thawinak hna an si lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih Bawipa hmaiah a chuahpi hna lai i a sual thawinak le a khangh thawinak cu a thawi hna lai,"},"17":{"text":"tuukawng cu Bawipa sin i daihnak pekchanh thawinak caah a thawi lai, thilnu telh lo changreu bawm khat he khan; tlangbawi nih a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak zong kha a thawi hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun Nazir mi nih a thiantermi a lu cu tonnak thlam innka ah aa meh lai i thiantermi a lu cun sam cu a lak lai i daihnak pekchanh thawinak tang i a ummi mei ah khan a paih lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih chumh hnuah tuukawng a liang cu le bawm chungin thilnu telh lo changreu pakhat le changreu pante thilnu telh lomi pakhat cu a lak hna lai i Nazir mi kut chungah khan a chiah hna lai, aa thianhnak a sam aa meh dih hnuah khan,"},"20":{"text":"cun tlangbawi nih Bawipa hmai i hninh thawinak ah a hninh hna lai; annih cu tlangbawi ca i a thiangmi covo an si, a ii hninhmi le a phei thawimi he khan; cu hnuah cun Nazir mi nih cun mitsur hang a din khawh lai."},"21":{"text":"“Mah hihi biakamnak a tuahmi Nazir caah phungbia a si. Nazir a si ca i biakamnak a tuahning khan Bawipa sin i a pekchanhnak cu a si lai, zei dang a ti khawhmi hleiah; biakamnak a tuahmi ning khan, cu bantukin Nazir mi a si ca i aa thleidannak phungbia ning khan a tuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Tlangbawi Thluachuah Peknak"},"23":{"text":"“Aaron le a fapa hna cu, ‘Hi bangin Israel mi cu thluachuah nan pek hna lai, nannih nih annih sinah,"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih thluachuahnak in pe hna in, in zohkhenh ko hna seh;"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa nih nan cungah a hmai tlanter seh law, vel in ngeih ko hna seh;"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa nih mithmai ṭha in pe hna seh law, daihnak in pe ko hna seh, tiah nan chim lai,’ tiah chim hna."},"27":{"text":"“Cu bangin ka min cu Israel mi hna cungah an chiah lai i thluachuahnak ka pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses nih puan biakinn cu a dirter dih i a thilri vialte he chiti a thuh i a thianter hna i biakṭheng le a umkheng vialte zong chiti a thuh i a thianter dih hna ni ah,","title":"Biakṭheng Pekchanhnak"},"2":{"text":"relmi chung i a ummi Israel hruaitu hna, phun khat chung i lu a si ciomi hna, hrin khat chung i hruaitu a si ciomi hna nih cun pekchanhnak an tuah i"},"3":{"text":"an pekchanhnak cu Bawipa hmaiah an ratpi, khuh ngeimi leng paruk le cawtum hlei hnih, hruaitu pahnih caah leng khat lengmang, cun pakhat caah cawtum pakhat lengmang; mah hna cu puan biakinn hmaiah an pekchanh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu,"},"5":{"text":"“Annih sinin mah hna hi cohlang hna, tonnak thlam rianṭuannak caah khan hman an si nakhnga, cun Levi mi kha pe hna, anmah le an rianṭuanning cio khan,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cu caah Moses nih leng le cawtum cu a lak hna i Levi mi kha a pek hna."},"7":{"text":"Gershon fapa hna kha leng pahnih le cawtum pali a pek hna, an rianṭuanning bantukin;"},"8":{"text":"cun leng pali le cawtum pariat cu Merari fapa kha a pek hna, tlangbawi Aaron fapa Ithamar zohkhenhnak tang i an rianṭuanning in."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Kohath fapa cu zeihmanh a pe hna lo, zeicahtiah annih cu thil thiang, liang i put awk a simi hna zohkhenh kha thiah an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun hruaitu hna nih cun biakṭheng thianternak ca i pekchanhnak cu an pek, chiti thuh a si ni ah cun; cun hruaitu hna nih cun an pekchanhnak cu biakṭheng hmaiah an pek."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses sinah, “Annih nih an pekchanhnak cu an pek awk an si, ni khat ah hruaitu pakhat lengmang nih, biakṭheng pekchanhnak caah,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"A ni hmasa bik ah a pekchanhmi thil a pemi cu Amminadab fapa Nahshon, Judah hrin, kha a si;"},"13":{"text":"a pekchanhmi thil cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin; an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"14":{"text":"cun sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khatte in,"},"15":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"16":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"17":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Amminadab fapa Nahshon i a pekchanhmi cu a si."},"18":{"text":"Ni hnihnak ni ah Issakhar a hruaitu hna Zuar fapa Nethanel nih pekchanhnak a tuah;"},"19":{"text":"a pekchanhnak ca i a pekmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"20":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khatte in;"},"21":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"22":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"23":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga, le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Zuar fapa Nethanel pekchanhmi cu a si."},"24":{"text":"Ni thumnak ni ah Zebulun mi hna hruaitu Helon fapa Eliab cu a si:"},"25":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"26":{"text":"sui pakan shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khatte in;"},"27":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"28":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"29":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Helon fapa Eliab pekchanhmi cu a si."},"30":{"text":"Ni linak ni ah cun Reuben mi hruaitu Shedeur fapa Elizur kha a si:"},"31":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in,"},"32":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat, shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khatte in;"},"33":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat,"},"34":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"35":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Shedeur fapa Elizur i a pekchanhmi cu a si."},"36":{"text":"Ni nganak ni ah cun Simeon mi hna a hruaitu Zurishaddai fapa Shelumiel a si:"},"37":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"38":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"39":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"40":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"41":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Zurishaddai fapa Shelumiel pekchanhmi cu a si."},"42":{"text":"Ni ruknak ni ah Gad mi a hruaitu hna Deuel fapa Eliasaf a si:"},"43":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat, shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"44":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"45":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"46":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"47":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga, le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Deuel fapa Eliasaf pekchanhmi cu a si."},"48":{"text":"Ni sarihnak ni ah Efraim mi a hruaitu hna Ammihud fapa Elishama a si:"},"49":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi, changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"50":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat, shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"51":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"52":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"53":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Ammihud fapa Elishama pekchanhmi cu a si."},"54":{"text":"Ni riatnak ni ah Manasseh mi a hruaitu hna Pedahzur fapa Gamaliel a si:"},"55":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"56":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"57":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"58":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"59":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Pedahzur fapa Gamaliel pekchanhmi cu a si."},"60":{"text":"Ni kuanak ni ah Benjamin mi a hruaitu hna Gideoni fapa Abidan a si:"},"61":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"62":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"63":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"64":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"65":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Gideoni fapa Abidan i a pekchanhmi cu a si."},"66":{"text":"Ni hranak ni ah Dan mi a hruaitu hna Ammishaddai fapa Ahiezer a si:"},"67":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"68":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"69":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"70":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"71":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Ammishaddai fapa Ahiezer pekchanhmi cu a si."},"72":{"text":"Ni hlei khatnak ni ah Asher mi a hruaitu hna Okhran fapa Pagiel a si:"},"73":{"text":"a pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"74":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khat tein;"},"75":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"76":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"77":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Okhran fapa Pagiel pekchanhmi cu a si."},"78":{"text":"Ni hlei hnihnak ni ah, Naftali mi a hruaitu hna Enan fapa Ahira a si:"},"79":{"text":"amah pekchanhmi cu mah hi an si, ngun kheng pakhat shekel za khat le sawm thum a ritmi, ngun pakan kuar pakhat shekel sawm sarih a ritmi, hmunthiang shekel ningin, an pahnih in changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a khat veve in;"},"80":{"text":"sui pakan pakhat shekel pahra a ritmi, zihmui a khatte in;"},"81":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi pakhat;"},"82":{"text":"sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat;"},"83":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i cawtum pahnih, tuukawng panga, meheh a pa panga le tuufa a pa kum khat a timi panga. Mah hihi Enan fapa Ahira pekchanhmi cu a si."},"84":{"text":"Biakṭheng cu chiti thuh a si ni ah, Israel mi hruaitu hna sinin biakṭheng ca i pekchanhmi thil cu mah hihi a si: ngun kheng hleihnih, ngun pakan kuar hleihnih, sui pakan hleihnih,"},"85":{"text":"ngun kheng cu shekel za khat le sawm thum cio an rit, pakan kuar cu shekel sawm sarih cio, umkheng chung ngun vialte cu shekel thong hnih le za li, hmunthiang shekel ningin, a si,"},"86":{"text":"sui pakan hleihnih hna kha, zihmui a khat cio ah, pakhat ah shekel pahra cio, hmunthiang shekel ningin, pakan chung i sui vialte cu shekel za khat le kul a si;"},"87":{"text":"khangh thawinak ca i ṭilva vialte kha cawtum hleihnih, tuukawng hleihnih, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi hleihnih, an changvut thawinak cio he; cun meheh a pa hleihnih, sual thawinak caah;"},"88":{"text":"cun daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak ca i ṭilva vialte cawtum kul le pali, tuukawng sawm ruk, meheh a pa sawm ruk, tuufa a pa kum khat a timi sawm ruk. Mah hihi biakṭheng ca i pekchanhmi thil cu a si, chiti thuh a si hnuah khan."},"89":{"text":"Cun Moses nih tonnak thlam chungah Bawipa he i chawnh awk i a luh tikah khan biahngalhternak kuang cung i a ummi velngeihnak ṭhutdan cung khan, cherubim pahnih hna karlak khan amah a run chawntu aw cu a theih i cuticun amah cu a run chawnh."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Aaron Nih Meiinn A Van Hna","ref":"Exo 25.31-40; 37.17-24"},"2":{"text":"“Aaron sinah, ‘Meiinn na van hna tikah, meiinn pasarih hna nih khan meiinn tung hmailei kha an ceuh awk a si lai,’ tiah va chim,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Aaron nih cu bangin a tuah; cu ka meiinn hna cu meiinn tung hmailei kha ceuh dingin a van hna, Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan."},"4":{"text":"Cun mah hihi meiinn tung an serning kha a si, denmi sui i sermi cu; a hram in a pangpar tiang a den in denmi a si; Bawipa nih Moses a hmuhsakmi sawisam ning khan, cu bang cun meiinn tung cu a ser."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Levi Mi Thianhnak"},"6":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sin khan Levi mi kha la hna law, thianh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun annih cu thianh awkah hi bangin na tuah hna lai: tlenghnak ti kha na theh hna lai i namte in an pum a dihlak in i met hna seh, cun an thilpuan su hna seh law, i tleng hna seh."},"8":{"text":"Cun cawtum no pakhat le chiti he cawhmi changvut dip a changvut thawinak kha la hna seh, cun cawtum no a dang pakhat sual thawinak caah na lak lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun Levi mi cu tonnak thlam hmaiah khan na chuahpi hna lai i Israel mibu an ningpi in na pumh hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Levi mi cu Bawipa hmaika ah na chuahpi hna tikah, Israel mi nih Levi mi hna cungah an kut an chuan lai,"},"11":{"text":"cun Israel mi hna hninh thawinak caah Aaron nih Levi mi hna cu Bawipa sinah a pekchanh hna lai. Bawipa rianṭuan cu annih ta a si naklai."},"12":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna nih cun cawtum hna lu cungah cun an kut an chuan lai; Levi mi hna ca i remnak sernak ah, pakhat cu sual thawinak caah, pakhat cu khangh thawinak caah, Bawipa sinah na pekchanh lai."},"13":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna cu Aaron le a fapa hna hmaiah na umter hna lai i, Bawipa sin i hninh thawinak caah na pekchanh hna lai."},"14":{"text":"“Cu bangin Levi mi cu Israel mi hna lakin na thleidan hna lai i Levi mi cu keimah ta an si lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun cu hnuah cun tonnak thlam i rianṭuan awkah, Levi mi hna cu na tlengh hna i hninh thawinak ca i na pekchanh hna hnuah an lut lai."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah annih cu an ningte in Israel mi hna lakin keimah sin i pekmi an si; paw chungin a chuakmi vialte, Israel mi vialte hna fater hna can ah keimah nih kaa lak cang hna."},"17":{"text":"Zeitintiah Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte cu minung i a si ah, saram i a si ah, keimah ta an si; Izipt ram chung i fater vialte ka rak thah hna ni ah khan keimah caah annih cu ka thianter cang hna i,","ref":"Exo 13.2"},"18":{"text":"Levi mi hna cu Israel mi hna lak i fater vialte can ah khan ka lak cang hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna lakin Levi mi hna cu tonnak thlam chung i Israel mi hna ca i rian ṭuan awkah le Israel mi hna ca i remnak ser awkah Aaron le a fapa hna sinah laksawng ah ka pek cang hna, zeicahtiah Israel mi nih hmunthiang pawng i an rat sual zongah Israel mi hna lakah rai a um nakhnga lo,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cu bangin Moses le Aaron le Israel mibu nih an ningpi in, Levi mi hna cungah cun an tuah; Levi mi hna kong he aa peh in Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi vialte bangin Israel mi nih an cungah an tuah."},"21":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna nih cun sualnak in an i thianh i an hnipuan kha an suk hna; cun Aaron nih Bawipa hmaiah hninh thawinak bantuk ah a pekchanh hna i annih kha thianh awkah Aaron nih remnak a tuahpiak hna."},"22":{"text":"Cun cu hnuah cun Levi mi hna cu tonnak thlam chung i Aaron le a fapa hna hmai i an rianṭuan awkah an lut; Bawipa nih Levi mi hna kongah Moses nawl a pek bangin, cu bangin annih cungah an tuah."},"23":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses sinah,"},"24":{"text":"“Mah hihi Levi mi hna covo cu a si: kum kul le kum nga ri in a cunglei nih tonnak thlam chung i rian kha ṭuan awkah an lut lai;"},"25":{"text":"cun kum sawm nga an ti in rian an i tlaihmi kha an ngol lai i an ṭuan ti lai lo,"},"26":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw tonnak thlam chung rian, a zohkhenhnak rian ah khan, an unau hna cu ṭuan an bawmh hna lai, asinain rian tu cu an ṭuan ti lai lo. Mah bantuk hin Levi mi hna an rian thiahnak ah cun na tuah lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, Izipt ram in an chuah hnu a kum hnihnak thla khatnak thla ah khan Moses cu Sinai ramlak ah a chawnh i,","title":"Lanhtak Puai Ulhnak","ref":"Exo 12.1-13"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna nih Lanhtak Puai cu a caan khiahmi te ah khan ul hna seh."},"3":{"text":"Atu thla ni hleili ni ah, zan lei ah, a caan khiahmi te ah khan nan ulh lai; a nawlbia vialte le a phunglam vialte ning khan nan ulh lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Moses nih Israel mi hna cu lanhtak puai ul dingin a chimh hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun lanhtak puai cu thla khatnak thla, a ni hleili ni ah cun, zanlei ah Sinai ramlak ah an ulh; Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi dihlak bang khan Israel mi nih an tuah."},"6":{"text":"Cun mi zeimaw miruak a tawng i a thurmi, cucaah cu ni i lanhtak puai a ul kho lomi an um i, cu ni ah cun Moses le Aaron hmaiah an ra i,"},"7":{"text":"cu hna nih cun a sinah, “Miruak tawnghnak in kannih cu kan thur cang; zeicahdah Israel mi hna lak i a caan khiahmi Bawipa sin i pekchanhnak pek cu nan kan thlauh?” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Moses nih annih sinah, “Um rih tuah u, nannih kongah Bawipa nawl peknak zeidah a si kha thei hmasa rih tuah ning,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"10":{"text":"“Israel mi cu va chim hna, nannih lak i mi pakhatkhat maw, nan tefa hna lak i pakhatkhat cu, miruak tawnghnak in a thur ahcun khual lam hla a tlawn ah maw, Bawipa sin lanhtak puai cu a ulh ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"11":{"text":"Thla hnihnak thla ni hleili ni zanlei ah an ulh lai; thilnu cawh lo changreu le a khami an he an ei lai."},"12":{"text":"Zinglei tiang a zeihmanh an taanter lai lo, cun a ruh zong pakhat hmanh an khiak lai lo; lanhtak puai ca i nawlbia vialte ning khan an ulh lai.","ref":"Exo 12.46; Jhn 19.36"},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thiang a si i khual a tlawng lo nain lanhtak puai ulh loin a um menmi cu, cu mi cu a mi hna sinin hlonh a si lai, zeicahtiah Bawipa sin pekchanhnak cu a caan khiahmi te ah khan a pek lo caah; mah mi nih cun a sualnak cu a phorh ko lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun nan lakah khual pakhat a pem i Bawipa sin lanhtak puai cu a nawlbia le a phunglam ning in ulh a duh ve ahcun, cu bantuk cun tuah ko seh; mipem ca le mah ram mi caah nawlbia pakhat lawng nan ngeih awk a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Puan biakinn an dirter ni ah cun, minmei nih puan biakinn, bia hngalhternak thlam cu a zelh i, zanlei ah cun puan biakinn cungah cun mei alh mui bantukin zinglei tiang a um.","title":"Puan Biakinn Cung Minmei (Exo 40.34-38)"},"16":{"text":"Cuticun a um camcin ko; chun ah minmei nih, zan ah meialh mui bantuk nih a zelh."},"17":{"text":"Cun minmei cu puan biakinn cung cun cunglei i aa ṭhial chel paoh ah, Israel mi hna cu kal ah an i thawh; cun minmei a ṭumnak hmun paoh ah, cu ka ah cun Israel mi nih riahhmun an khuar tawn."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nawl pek in Israel mi hna cu an i thawh tawn i Bawipa nawl pek in riahhmun an khuar tawn; minmei cu puan biakinn cungah a cam chung paohpaoh an riahhmun ah cun an cam."},"19":{"text":"Minmei cu puan biakinn cung i a um kha ni tampi a si hmanh ah Israel mi nih Bawipa nawlbia cu an zulh ko i an i thawh lo."},"20":{"text":"Voi khatkhat cu minmei cu puan biaknak inn cungah ni tlawmte lawng a um i Bawipa nawlbia bangin riahhmun ah an cam; cun Bawipa nawlbia bangin an i thawh."},"21":{"text":"Cun voi khatkhat cu minmei cu zanlei in zinglei tiang a cam; cun minmei cu zinglei i aa ṭhial tikah annih nih an i thawh, asinain ni khat le zan khat hoi hna a cam zongah minmei cu aa ṭhial tik paoh ah annih cu an i thawh."},"22":{"text":"Ni hnih a si ah, thla khat a si ah, caan sau deuh zong a si ah, minmei cu puan biaknak inn cung i a um, cu ka i a cam chung cu, Israel mi hna cu an riahhmun ah an cam ko i an i thawh lo; sihmanhsehlaw aa ṭhial tikah annih cu an i thawh tawn."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nawlbia in riahhmun an khuar i Bawipa nawlbia in an i thawh tawn; Moses sinin Bawipa nawlbia an hmuh bangin Bawipa bia cu an zulh."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Ngun Muko"},"2":{"text":"“Ngun muko pahnih in ser tuah; a den in denmi an si lai; mi zapi kawhnak le riahhmun in thawhter hnanak caah na hman lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun an pahnih in tum an si tikah mi zapi cu an dihlak in tonnak thlam innka ah khan nangmah sinah an i pum lai."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw pakhat lawng an tum ahcun, hruaitu hna, Israel phun i an lu hna kha nangmah sinah an i pum lai."},"5":{"text":"Ralrinnak na tum tikah nichuahlei kap i a ummi riahbuk hna cu an i thawh lai."},"6":{"text":"Cun ralrinnak a voi hnihnak na tum tikah thlanglei kap ah a ummi riahbuk hna cu an i thawh lai. An i thawh lai paoh ah ralrinnak tum lengmang a si lai."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi zapi cu hmun khat i pumh awk an si tikah na tum lai, asinain ralrinnak cu na tum lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa, tlangbawi hna nih khan muko cu an tum hna lai. Muko cu nannih caah nan tefa chin tiangin zungzal nawlbia caah an si lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun nannih an hremtu hna nan ral he nan ram chung i nan i doh tikah muko cun ralrinnak nan tum lai, Bawipa nan Pathian hmaiah hngalh nan si camcin i nan ral hna sinin khamh nan si nakhnga."},"10":{"text":"Nan i lawmh ni le a caan khiahmi nan puai hna le nan thla hramthawknak hna zongah nan khangh thawinak hna le nan daihnak pekchanhnak thawinak cungah muko cu nan tum hna lai; nan Pathian hmai i nannih cu theihhngalh an sitertu hna an si lai: keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Kum hnihnak kum, thla hnihnak thla, cu thla a ni kul ni ah cun, minmei cu hngalhternak puan biakinn cung cun aa ṭhial i","title":"Sinai In Israel Mi An I Ṭhial"},"12":{"text":"Israel mi hna cu Sinai ramlak khan an i thawh i riahhmun riahhmun lengmang in an kal i, minmei cu Paran ramlak ah khan a dir."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinin nawl a pekmi hna bangin an i thawh a hmasa bik a si."},"14":{"text":"Judah mi hna riahhmun hmelchunhnak cu aa thawh hmasa bik, an bubu in; cun an bu cung i a ummi cu Amminadab fapa Nahshon kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Issakhar mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Zuar fapa Nethanel kha a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Zebulun mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Helon fapa Eliab kha a si."},"17":{"text":"Cun puan biakinn cu an ṭheh tikah, puan biakinn a putu hna Gershon fapa hna le Merari fapa hna kha an i thawh."},"18":{"text":"Cun Reuben riahhmun hmelchunhnak kha an bubu in aa thawh i an bu cung i a ummi cu Shedeur fapa Elizur kha a si."},"19":{"text":"Cun Simeon mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Zurishaddai fapa Shelumiel kha a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Gad mi hna phun an lu i a ummi cu Deuel fapa Eliasaf kha a si."},"21":{"text":"Cun Kohath mi cu an i thawh i thil thiang kha an zawnh i an phanh hlanah puan biakinn kha an rak dirter cang."},"22":{"text":"Cun Efraim mi hna riahhmun hmelchunhnak kha an bubu in aa thawh i an bu cung i a ummi cu Ammihud fapa Elishama kha a si."},"23":{"text":"Cun Manasseh mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Pedahzur fapa Gamaliel kha a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Gideoni fapa Abidan kha a si."},"25":{"text":"Cun Dan mi hna riahhmun hmelchunhnak cu an bubu in aa thawh, riahhmun vialte hnulei ralvengtu a si; an bu cung i a ummi cu Ammishaddai fapa Ahiezer kha a si."},"26":{"text":"Cun Asher mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Okhran fapa Pagiel kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Cun Naftali mi hna phun an bu cung i a ummi cu Enan fapa Ahira kha a si."},"28":{"text":"Mah hihi Israel mi hna nih an i thawh tikah an bubu cio in an kalning cu a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun Moses pu Hobab, Midian miphun Reuel i a fapa sinah khan Moses nih, “ Bawipa nih, ‘Kan pek hna lai,’ a timi hmun i kal awkah kan i thawh; kan sinah ra law, ṭhatnak kan in tuah lai; zeitintiah Bawipa nih Israel kha ṭhatnak a kamh,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah nih, “Ka kal lai lo; keimah ka ram le ka rualchan hna sinah ka kal lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Kan kaltak sawh hlah, zeicahtiah ramlak ah zeitindah riahhmun kan khuar lai kha na hngalh i kannih caah mit bantuk na si lai."},"32":{"text":"Cun kannih sin i na kal ahcun Bawipa nih kan cung i ṭhatnak a tuahmi paoh cu, mah cucu nangmah cungah kan tuah ve lai,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cu bangin Bawipa tlang in ni thum kal ah an kal i Bawipa biakamnak kuang kha annih ca i, i dinhnak hmun kawl awkah annih hmaiah ni thum lamkal a rak kal chung."},"34":{"text":"Cun Bawipa minmei cu, an riahhmun in an i thawh fate chun ah annih cungah a um."},"35":{"text":"Cun kuang cu aa thawh fate Moses nih, “Tho tuah, maw Bawipa, na ral kha i ṭhek dih hna seh law, nangmah an huatu hna cu na hmaiah zaam hna seh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 68.1"},"36":{"text":"Cun aa dinh tikah, “Ra kir tuah, maw Bawipa, Israel mi a thong a sang hna sinah hin,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun mi hna nih cun Bawipa theih ah sifah retheih an innak ruangah khan an zai; mah cucu Bawipa nih a theih tikah a thinhunnak cu a alh i Bawipa mei cu annih lakah a kang i riahhmun kikam i a ummi riahbuk a cheu khat hna cu an kang dih.","title":"Nih Manna le Nimte A Thlak Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cu tikah mi nih Moses cu an auh i, Moses nih Bawipa sinah thla a cam i mei cu a dai."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah cu ka hmun min cu, Bawipa mei cu annih lakah a kangh caah Taberah ti a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun annih lak i phun dang mi he aa cawhmehmi hna cu sa an haw ciammam i Israel mi hna zong cu an ṭap ṭhan i, “Sa ei awk hei ngei u si law mu!"},"5":{"text":"Man lo i Izipt ram i ngasa kan ei le zil le phazeti le purun le piat le vankhawng kha kan hei ngai hna dah;"},"6":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw atu cu kan thazang a car dih i hi manna hi dah ti lo cu zeihmanh zoh awk a um lo,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Manna cu koriander mu bantuk a si i a mui cu rili lungvar bantuk a si.","ref":"Exo 16.31"},"8":{"text":"Mi nih an char hna i rialnak lung in an rial hna, asiloah sum ah an phomh hna i um in an chuan hna i chang ah an ser hna; ei ah hin chiti he rawhmi chang bantuk a si."},"9":{"text":"Zan i riahhmun i dap a tlak ah hin manna cu a tla ve.","ref":"Exo 16.13-15"},"10":{"text":"Moses nih mi hna cu an innchungkhar cio i an ṭah i an pale hna an thlam innka i an ṭah kha a theih i Bawipa thinhunnak cu a alh in a alh i Moses cu a lung a lawm lo."},"11":{"text":"Moses nih Bawipa sinah, “Zeicahdah na sal hi ṭhalo in na ka tuah? Zeicahdah na mit ka tlin lo i hi mi vialte hna phorhrit hi ka cungah na ka khinh?"},"12":{"text":"Hi mi vialte hi ka rak pawi hna maw? ‘Nau cawnghramtu nih nau hnuktlai lio a cawi bangin na ṭang ah cawi hna law, an pupa hna sinah pek awkin chiat ka sermi ram ah kalpi hna,’ na ti cu keimah nih maw ka hrin hna?"},"13":{"text":"Hi mi vialte pek awkah hin khuazei in dah sa cu ka hmuh lai? Zeitintiah an ka ṭahhnawh i, ‘Kan ei awk caah sa kan pe,’ tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Hi mi hna hi keimah lawng nih ka pua kho hna lo, mah thil hi ka caah a rit tuk."},"15":{"text":"Mahtihin na ka tuah ding a si ahcun, hmakhatte ah ka that ko, na mithmai ah velngeihnak ka hmuh a si ahcun, ka retheihnak kha ka hmuhter hlah,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses sinah cun, “Israel upa hna lakin pa sawm sarih, nangmah nih mi hna cung i upa le bawi an si ti i na hngalhmi cu ka sinah ratpi tuah hna; cun tonnak thlam ah ratpi hna law, khika ah nangmah sinah dirter hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun ka rung ṭum lai i khika ah nangmah he kan i chawn lai; cun nangmah cungah a ummi thlarau cu tlawmpal in ka lak lai i an cungah ka chiah lai i nangmah lawng nih na phorh nakhnga lo, mi hna thil cu an in phorhpi lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun mi hna cu, ‘Thaizing caah i thianh u law, sa nan ei lai; zeicahtiah Bawipa theih ah nan ṭap i, “Aho nih dah ei awk sa a kan pek lai? Izipt ram vial ah khan kan va nuam ṭung,” ti i nan ti caah. Cucaah Bawipa nih sa an pek hna lai i nan ei lai."},"19":{"text":"Ni khat lawng maw, ni hnih lawng maw, ni nga lawng maw, ni hra lawng maw, ni kul lawng maw, nan ei lai lo,"},"20":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thla khat ning piin nan ei lai, nan hnarkua i a chuah i nan ca i fihnung a si tiangin, zeicahtiah nan lak i a ummi Bawipa cu nan hlawt i a hmaiah, “Zeicahhen Izipt ram khan kan rak chuah,” tiin nan ṭah caah,’ tiah ti hna,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moses nih, “Keimah zong kaa tel venak mi hna hi, ke kal lawngte hmanh sing ruk an si; cun nang nih, ‘Sa ka pek hna lai, thla khat pumte an ei lai,’ tiah na ti."},"22":{"text":"Tuu runrun le caw runrun maw an i zat awkah thahpiak an si lai? Asiloah, rili chung nga vialte maw an i zat awkah pumhpiak an si lai?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses sinah cun, “ Bawipa kut cu a tawi hlah maw? Nannih ca i ka bia bangin a tlin le tlin lo cu na hmuh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah Moses cu a chuak i Bawipa bia kha, mi cu a chimh hna; cun Israel upa hna chungin sawm sarih kha a pumh hna i thlam velchum ah khan a chiah hna."},"25":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa cu minmei khan a rung ṭum i amah cu a chawnh i amah cung i a ummi thlarau kha tlawmpal in a lak i upa sawm sarih cungah khan a chiah; cun thlarau nih annih cungah a um tikah annih nih bia an chim cukmak. Sihmanhsehlaw cu bantuk cun an tuah ṭhan ti lo."},"26":{"text":"Riahhmun ah mi pahnih an rak tang i pakhat cu a min ah Eldad a si i pakhat cu a min ah Medad a si i, annih cungah thlarau kha a um; annih cu minthlakmi lakah khan aa telmi an si ve nain thlam ah khan an kal lo i cucaah riahhmun ah khan bia an chim cuahmah ko."},"27":{"text":"Tlangval pakhat nih a va tli i Moses kha, “Eldad le Medad nih riahhmun chungah bia an chim cuahmah ko,” tiah a chimh."},"28":{"text":"Nun fapa Joshua, a tlanval lio in Moses rian a ṭuantu nih khan, “Ka bawipa Moses, thlauh hna,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moses nih anih cu, “Keimah ca lawngin dah ra na ruah hi? Bawipa mi vialte hi profet si dih in, annih cungah Bawipa nih a thlarau chia seh law ka hei tinak lakah cun!” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun Moses le Israel upa hna cu riahhmun ah an kir."},"31":{"text":"Cun Bawipa sinin thli a hrang i rili in nimte kha a ratpi hna i riahhmun pawngah cun a tlakter hna, hika leiah ni khat kal tluk, khika lei ah ni khat kal tluk, riahhmun cu a velchum in, vawlei ah dong hnih tluk chah in a tlakter hna."},"32":{"text":"Cun cu ni cu chun nitlak, zan khuadei, cun a thaizing zong, mi cu an tho i nimte cu an char hna; a tlawm bik a charmi nih homer pahra an char i anmah ca cio ah riahhmun a velchum ah cun an car hna."},"33":{"text":"Sa cu an ha karlak i a um lioah, an ei dih hlanah mi hna cungah cun Bawipa thinhunnak a alh i, Bawipa nih mi hna cu rai ṭhalo in a hrem hna."},"34":{"text":"Cucaah cu ka hmun min cu Kibroth-hattaavah, tiah ti a si; zeicahtiah khika ah khan sa a hawmi kha an vui hna."},"35":{"text":"Kibroth-hattaavah in Hazeroth ah an kal i Hazeroth ah cun an cam."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezeroth i an um lioah khan, Miriam le Aaron nih Moses cu a ṭhitmi Kush minu ruangah khan an thangchiat; zeitintiah Kush minu cu a ṭhit caah.","title":"Miriam le Aaron Nih Moses Kha An Al"},"2":{"text":"Annih nih, “Moses sin lawng in maw Bawipa nih bia a chim? Kanmah sin zongin a chim ve lo maw?” tiah an ti. Mah cucu Bawipa nih a theih."},"3":{"text":"Moses cu vawleicung mi vialte lakah lungnem bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih chikkhatte ah Moses le Aaron le Miriam sinah cun, “Ra chuak tuah u, nan pathum in, tonnak thlam ah cun,” tiah a ti. An pathum in an ra chuak."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu minmei tung in a rung ṭum i thlam innka ah cun a dir i, Aaron le Miriam kha a kawh hna i an pahnih in hmailei ah an ra."},"6":{"text":"Cun amah nih, “Ka bia ngai tuah u: Nannih lakah profet an um tikah Bawipa keimah nih langhnak in an sinah kaa hngalhter i mang in ka chawnh hna."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka sal Moses cu, cu bantuk cun a si lo; ka inn cu a dihlak in a kut chungah ka chiah;","ref":"Heb 3.2"},"8":{"text":"Amah cu hmaitonh in ka chawnh, holh thup in si loin fiang tein ka chawnh; cun amah cu Bawipa mui zong a hmumi a si. A si kun ahcun zeicahdah ka sal Moses bia al cu nan ṭih kun lo? tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Bawipa thinhunnak cu annih cungah a alh i a kal;"},"10":{"text":"cun minmei cu thlam cung cun aa ṭhial tikah, zohhmanh, Miriam cu thinghmui zawtnak ngeimi a si ko, hawhra bantukin a rang. Cun Aaron cu Miriam leiah a hei i mer i zohhmanh, mithinghmui a si ko ai."},"11":{"text":"Cun Aaron nih Moses sinah, “Maw, ka bawipa, dan kan tat sawh hlah, zeicahtiah hruh bu piin kan tuah i kan sual cang."},"12":{"text":"Amah cu a nu paw chungin a chuah tikah a titsa a cheu a dih cangmi a thimi bantuk cu, siter sawh hlah,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Bawipa cu a auh i, “Maw Pathian, amah cu damter ko, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih Moses sinah cun, “A pa nih a hmaiah a cil chak seh law, cu hmanh ah cun ni sarih chung cu ningzak in a um lai lo mei? Amah cu riahhmun lengah ni sarih chuah si seh law, cu hnuah cun luhter a si ṭhan te lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Nam 5.2-3"},"15":{"text":"Cu bangin Miriam cu riahhmun lengah ni sarih chuah a si i mi cu Miriam luh a si ṭhan hlantiang cu i thawh loin an um."},"16":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Hazeroth in an i thawh i Paran ramlak ah khan riahhmun an khuar."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah cun,","title":"Kanaan Ram Ah Ngiatu Hleihnih An Thlah Hna (Deu 1.19-33)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi ka pekmi hna Kanaan ram va ngiatthlai awkah mi thlah hna; an pa le phun, phun khat cio khan, pakhat cio na thlah hna lai, anmah lak i hruaitu cio an si lai,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Moses nih Paran ramlak khan Bawipa nawl pek bang khan a thlah hna, an dihlak in Israel mi hna an lu kha an si."},"4":{"text":"Cun mah hihi an min a si: Reuben phun in, Zakkur fapa Shammua;"},"5":{"text":"Simeon phun in Hori fapa Shafat;"},"6":{"text":"Judah phun in Jefunneh fapa Kaleb;"},"7":{"text":"Issakhar phun in Josef fapa Igal;"},"8":{"text":"Efraim phun in Nun fapa Hoshea;"},"9":{"text":"Benjamin phun in Rafu fapa Pali;"},"10":{"text":"Zebulun phun in Sodi fapa Gaddiel;"},"11":{"text":"Josef phun in (mah cucu Manasseh phun in) Susi fapa Gaddi;"},"12":{"text":"Dan phun in Gemalli fapa Ammiel;"},"13":{"text":"Asher phun in Mikhael fapa Sethur;"},"14":{"text":"Naftali phun in Vofsi fapa Nahbi;"},"15":{"text":"Gad phun in Makhi fapa Geuel."},"16":{"text":"Mah hihi Moses nih ram va ngiatthlai awk i a thlahmi hna min cu an si. Nun fapa Hoshea cu Moses nih Joshua tiah min a sak."},"17":{"text":"Moses nih Kanaan ram va ngiatthlai awkah cun a thlah hna i annih sinah, “Negeb ah khin hung kal u law, cun tlangram ah nan hung lut lai."},"18":{"text":"Ram cu zeidah a lawh kha nan hung zoh lai, a chung i a ummi hna cu an ṭhawng maw an der, an tlawm maw an tam,"},"19":{"text":"cun an umnak ram cu a ṭha maw a chia; cun an umnak khua hna cu riahbuk men maw an si kulh ngei dah an si,"},"20":{"text":"ram cu a rum maw a pam, a chungah thing an um maw um lo. Cun nan ral ṭha ko u, cuka ram theitlai cu tlawmpal in run phor u,” tiah a ti hna. Cu caan cu mitsur thei a hmin hmasa bik pawl hmin caan a si."},"21":{"text":"Cu bangin an hung kal i ram cu an hung ngiat, Zin ramlak in Hamath luhnak Rehob tiang."},"22":{"text":"Negeb ah an hung lut i Hebron kha an phan i cuka ah cun Anak tefa hna Ahiman, Sheshai le Talmai kha an rak um. (Hebron cu Izipt ram i Zoan hlan kum sarih ah rak tlakmi a si.)"},"23":{"text":"Cun Eskhol Nelrawn an phan i cuka ah cun mitsur tlai bor khat a nge in an sah i lang in pahnih nih an put; taleti le theipi zong an rak phorh."},"24":{"text":"Cuka hmun cu Eskhol Nelrawn tiah ti a si, zeitintiah cu ka ah cun Israel mi nih mitsur bor cu an sah hna."},"25":{"text":"Ni sawm li ram an va ngiatthlai hnuah cun an rung kir."},"26":{"text":"Cun Paran ramlak i Kadesh ah cun Moses le Aaron le Israel mibu vialte sinah khan an ra phan i, an sin le zapi vialte sinah bia an rak phorh i cu ram theitlai cu an hmuhsak hna."},"27":{"text":"Cun annih nih amah cu, “Na kan thlahnak ram cu kan va phan; cawhnuk le khuaihliti in a luang i mah hihi a theitlai cu an si."},"28":{"text":"Asinain cuka ram i a ummi hna cu an ṭhawng i an khua hna cu kulhmi an si i an ngan ngaingai; cun cu hleiah Anak tefa hna kha cu ka ah cun kan hmuh hna."},"29":{"text":"Negeb ram ah Amalek mi an um; tlangram ah Hit mi le Jebus mi le Amor mi an um; cun rili pawng le Jordan tiva kam thluahmah ah Kanaan mi an um,” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Kaleb nih mizapi cu Moses hmaiah a daihter hna i, “Khulrang in hung kal u sih law, hung umhnawh u sih; zeitintiah ṭha tein kan tei khawh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cu tikah a sin i a kalmi hna nih khan, “Kan do kho hna lai lo, zeitintiah kanmah nakin an ṭhawng deuh,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun an hung ngiatthlaimi ram kong cu a ṭhalo lei in Israel mi hna sinah an chim i, “Ngiatthlai awkah kan hung ṭolmi ram cu a chung i a ummi hna a eitu a si; cun cu ram chung i kan hmuhmi hna cu mi ngan pipi an si."},"33":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Nefilim mi (Nefilim in a chuakmi Anak fapa hna kha) kan hmuh hna i kanmah le kanmah cu khaubawk bantuk ceo ah khin kan i hmu i annih sin zongah cu bantuk cu kan si ko,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Gen 6.4"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun aa pummi vialte hna cu fak piin an ṭap i cu zan cu mi hna cu an ṭap dih.","title":"Israel Mi Nih An Doh"},"2":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte nih Moses le Aaron cu an zaihnawh hna; an bu ningin annih sinah, “Izipt ram ah khan rak thi u si law, a ṭha deuh hnga! Asiloah ramcar chungah hin hei thi dih ko u si law, a ṭha deuh hnga!"},"3":{"text":"Zeicahdah Bawipa nih hi ram chungah hin vainam in thih awkah a kan luhpi hnga? Kan nupile hna le kan ngakchia hna hi tlaihkhih awk men an si lai; Izipt ah kir ṭhan u si law, kan caah a ṭha deuh hnga lo maw?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun pakhat le pakhat cu, “Hruaitu pakhat i thim u si law, Izipt ah kir ṭhan u sih,” tiah an i ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron cu Israel mibu aa pummi hmaiah cun an bawk."},"6":{"text":"Cun Nun fapa Joshua le Jefunneh fapa Kaleb, ram a hung ngia thlaitu hna lak i aa tel vemi hna nih khan an puan an thleh i,"},"7":{"text":"Israel mibu ningpi sinah khan, “Ngiatthlai awkah kan hung ṭolmi ram cu ram ṭha hringhran a si ko."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan cungah aa lawmh ahcun hi ram chungah cun a kan luhpi lai i a kan pek lai, cawhnuk le khuaihliti in a luangmi ram a si ko."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu a doh bel do sawh hlah u; cun cu rammi cu ṭih hna hlah u, zeitintiah kan caah rawl pei an si ko cu; annih an himnak cu an sinin ṭhial a si cang, Bawipa cu kanmah he pei a um cu, ṭih hna hlah u,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Heb 3.16"},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an bu ning piin, lung in cheh an zalh hna. Cun Bawipa sunparnak cu tonnak thlam ah khan Israel mi vialte sinah a lang."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu, “Mah mi hna nih hin zei can dah an ka zawmhtaih lai? Cun zei can dah zum loin an ka um lai, anmah lak i hmelchunhnak mah vialte ka tuah ko ṭung?"},"12":{"text":"Rai in ka hrem hna lai i ka hlawt hna lai, nangmah chung hin annih nak i a ngan deuh le a ṭhawng deuh miphun ka ser lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moses nih Bawipa kha a chawnh i, “Cu ti a si ahcun, Izipt mi nih an theih lai i hi ram i a ummi hi an chimh hna lai,","ref":"Exo 32.11-14"},"14":{"text":"zeitintiah hi miphun hi annih lakin na chuahpimi an si. Annih nih, maw Bawipa, nang cu hi hna lakah na um kha an theih; zeitintiah maw Bawipa, nang cu hmaitonh tein an in hmuh i na minmei nih an cungah a dir i nangmah nih an hmaiah na kal, chun ah minmei tung in, cun zan ah mei alh tung in."},"15":{"text":"Cun mah mi hna hi mi pakhat men bantukin na thah hna ah cun, na minthannak a rak theimi miphun hna nih khan,"},"16":{"text":"‘ Bawipa nih hi mi hna hi chiatser tein a kamhmi hna ram ah khan a luhpi khawh hna lo caah ramcar chungah a thah hna,’ an ti lai."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa, nangmah nih, ‘ Bawipa cu a thin a fual i a fekmi dawtnak tampi a ngei, ṭhat lonak le phung buarnak cu a ngaihthiam khawh, sihmanhsehlaw a sualmi cu zei ti hmanh in a luatter men lai lo;
