an pale ṭhat lonak cu an fale cungah a tlunter lai, chan thum chan li tiangin,’ ti i bia na rak kamnak a lianhngan tluk khan na ṭhawnnak cu lianngan ko seh tiah kan nawl.","ref":"Exo 20.5-6; 34.6-7; Deu 5.9-10","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak a ngan rup le hi mi hna cu Izipt ram in atu tiang na ngaihthiam hna bangin, hi mi hna an ṭhat lonak hi ngaithiam ko hna,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, “Nangmah bia bangin ka ngaihthiam hna,","title":"Israel Mi Kha Dan A Tat Hna (Deu 1.34-40)"},"21":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw biangai tein, keimah ka nun le vawlei cung vialte Bawipa sunparnak in a khah dih lai bantukin,","ref":"Heb 3.18"},"22":{"text":"ahohmanh, Izipt ram chung le ramcar chung i ka tuahmi ka sunparnak le ka hmelchunhnak a hmu i, sihmanhsehlaw hi voi hra tiang a ka hneksak i ka aw a ngai lomi cu,"},"23":{"text":"an pupa sin i kan pek hna lai ti i chiat ka sermi ram kha an hmu lai lo, ahohmanh a ka zawmtaimi nih cun an hmu lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka sal Kaleb cu lungthin dang a ngei i tling tein a ka zulh caah, a va kalnak ram ah khan ka luhpi lai i a tefa hna nih an co lai.","ref":"Jos 14.9-12"},"25":{"text":"Kha, Amalek mi hna le Kanaan mi hna cu nelrawn chungah an um caah thaizing cu i mer u law, Rili Sen lam lei in ramcar ah kal tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron sinah hitin a chim i,"},"27":{"text":"“Zei can dah hi a ṭha lomi bu nih hin an ka zaihnawh lai? Israel mi an phunzainak, keimah cung i an phunzainak cu ka theih cang."},"28":{"text":"Annih sinah hi bangin va chim tuah, Bawipa nih, ‘Ka nun bangin, keimah theih hngan i nan chimmi cu nan cungah ka tuah lai:"},"29":{"text":"Nan ruak hna cu ramcar chungah an um lai; cun nannih lak i rel ciami vialte, kum kul ri in a cunglei keimah cungah a phunzaimi vialte kha,","ref":"Heb 3.17"},"30":{"text":"Jefunneh fapa Kaleb le Nun fapa Joshua dah ti lo cu, kan umter hna lai ti i chiat ka sermi ram ah khan pakhat hmanh nan lut lai lo."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nan ngakchia hna, annih cu tlaih khih awk men an si lai, nan timi hna kha ka luhpi hna lai i nannih nih zei i nan rel lomi ram kha an umhnawh lai."},"32":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih tu cu nan ruak cu hi ramcar ah hin an um lai."},"33":{"text":"Cun nan fale hna cu mah ramcar chungah hin kum sawm li tuukhal an si lai i nan ruak a hmanung bik cu hi ramcar chung i a ciam dih hlantiang zumhawktlak lo nan si caah khan sifah an in lai.","ref":"Lam 7.36"},"34":{"text":"Ram kha nan hung ngiatthlai ni zat khan, ni sawm li, ni khat caah kum khat, nan ṭhat lonak kha nan in lai, kum sawm li, cun ka lunglawmh lonak kha zeidah a lawh ti kha nan hngalh lai,’ a ti."},"35":{"text":"Keimah, Bawipa, nih ka chim cang; keimah doh awkah aa pummi, hi miṭhalo hna hi an dihlak cungah mah hihi ka tuah hrimhrim lai: hi ramcar chungah hin an donghnak taktak cu an phan lai i khika ah khan an thi lai,” a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun Moses nih ram kha hung ngiatthlai awkah a thlah i a hung kir ṭhan i mi zapi vialte kha ram kong thawngchia an run phorhnak thawngin a cungah a zaitermi hna,","title":"Ram Ngiatu Pahra An Thi"},"37":{"text":"ram kong thawng ṭhalo a run phormi hna cu, Bawipa hmaiah rai in an thi."},"38":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nun fapa Joshua le Jefunneh fapa Kaleb cu, ram ngiatthlai awkah a hung kalmi hna lakah khan, a nung in an tang."},"39":{"text":"Cun Moses nih mah bia hna hi Israel mi vialte kha a chimh hna i an ngaih a chia ngaingai.","title":"Hormah Ah An Sung (Deu 1.41-46)"},"40":{"text":"Cun zingka tein an tho i tlangram a sannak ah an kai i, “Zohhmanh, mahka ah hin kan um hi, Bawipa biakammi hmun ah cun kan hung kal lai; zeitintiah kan sual cang,” tiah an ti."},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moses nih, “Zeicaahdah atu ah Bawipa nawlbia kha nan buar, zeitintiah mah cucu santlai ding a si ṭung lo?"},"42":{"text":"Hung kal hlah u, nan ral nih a thah lam an in thah sual hna lai, zeitintiah Bawipa cu nan sinah a um lo."},"43":{"text":"Zeitintiah khika ah Amalek mi le Kanaan mi hna cu nan hmaiah an um i vainam in nan tlu lai. Bawipa cu nan kirtak cang caah Bawipa nih nan sinah a um lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa biakamnak kuang siseh, Moses siseh, riahhmun in an chuak lo nain, tlangram a sannak i hung kai cu an i tim ṭhiamṭhiam."},"45":{"text":"Cun cu tlangram i a ummi Amalek mi le Kanaan mi hna nih an rung ṭum i an rung tei hna i an dawi hna, Hormah tiangin."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu,","title":"Pekchanhnak Kong Phungbia"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah hi bangin va chim tuah, Nannih nih nan umhnawh laimi ram nannih kan pekmi hna nan phak tik le,"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa sinah tuurun in siseh, cawrun in siseh, mei in pekchanhnak maw, khangh pekchanhnak maw, raithawinak maw, biakamnak tlinternak maw, mah lungtho tein pekchanhnak caah maw, a caan khiahmi nan puai hna ah maw, Bawipa sinah rimthaw nan ser tikah,"},"4":{"text":"cu tikah Bawipa sinah a pekchanhnak a petu paoh nih changvut pekchanhnak i changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu khat, chiti hin cheu li cheu khat he cawhmi kha a pek lai;"},"5":{"text":"cun khangh thawinak ah siseh, raithawinak ah siseh, tuufa pakhat cio caah mitsur hang hin cheu li cheu khat na timh lai, cucu thlet thawinak caah a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun tuukawng a si ahcun, changvut thawinak caah changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu hnih, chiti hin cheu thum cheu khat he cawhmi cu na timh lai i"},"7":{"text":"thlet thawinak caah cun mitsur hang hin cheu thum cheu khat na pek lai, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"8":{"text":"Cun khangh thawinak caah siseh, biakam tlinternak ca i raithawinak caah siseh, Bawipa sin i daihnak thawinak hna caah siseh cawtum na timh tikah,"},"9":{"text":"cu tikah cu cawtum he cun changvut thawinak changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu thum, chiti hin cheu he cawhmi cu, na pekchanh lai i,"},"10":{"text":"thlet thawinak caah mitsur hang hin cheu, mei in pekchanhnak caah, na pek lai, Bawipa caah rimthaw a si lai."},"11":{"text":"“Hi bangin cawtum siseh, tuukawng siseh, tuufa a pa siseh, meheh fa siseh, pakhat cio caah tuah a si lai."},"12":{"text":"Nan timhmi hna an tam an tlawmning in, cu bantukin an tam an tlawmning in nan tuah lai."},"13":{"text":"Mei in thawinak, Bawipa sin i rimthaw cu, pekchanh tikah, mah miphun a si taktakmi vialte nih hi thil hna hi, hi bangin an tuah lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun khual pakhatkhat nih an tlawn hna ah siseh, nan tefa chin tiangin mi pakhatkhat nan sinah a um ah siseh, cu pa nih cun mei in thawinak, Bawipa sin i rimthaw cu, pekchanh a duh ahcun nanmah tuah bangin a tuah ve lai."},"15":{"text":"Hi mibu chungah, nannih caah le nannih an pemmi hna khual caah nawlbia pakhat a si lai, nan tefa chin tiangin a dong lo nawlbia a si lai. Bawipa hmaiah mipem zong cu nanmah bantuk an si ve lai."},"16":{"text":"Nanmah le nan sin i a ummi phundang mi hna caah phungbia aa khat phunglam aa khat a si lai,” tiah a chimh.","ref":"Lev 24.22"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"18":{"text":"“Israel mi sinah hitin va chim tuah, nannih kan kalpi hnanak ram chungah nan luh tikah,"},"19":{"text":"cun cu ram rawl nan ei tikah, Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak nan tuah lai."},"20":{"text":"Nan hmuh hmasa bikmi fang chungin pekchanhnak caah changreu hlum khat nan pek lai; phuhri chung i pekchanhmi bantukin nan pek lai."},"21":{"text":"Nan hmuh hmasa bikmi fang chungin nan techin fapar tiangin Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak nan tuah lai."},"22":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw nan palh i Bawipa nih Moses sinah a chimmi nawlbia vialte,"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih nawlbia an pek ni hna thawk khan nan tefa chin tiang ca in Bawipa nih Moses in nawl an pekmi vialte hna cu nan ulh lo i"},"24":{"text":"mibu nih hngalh loin tuah sual a si ahcun, a pummi vialte nih khangh thawinak, Bawipa sin i rimthaw caah cawtum no pakhat nan pek lai; a phunglam ningin a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak he, cun meheh a pa pakhat sual thawinak caah nan pek lai."},"25":{"text":"Palhnak a si ca i Bawipa sinah mei in thawinak le Bawipa hmaiah an sual thawinak, an palhnak caah an rak put cang caah, tlangbawi nih Israel mibu ningpi caah cun remnak a ser lai i ngaihthiam an si lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu an bu ningin ngaihthiam an si lai, anmah lak i a pemmi khual zong, zeicahtiah cu palhnak ah cun an zapi in an i tel dih."},"27":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat nih hngalh loin a sual sual ahcun, sual thawinak caah meheh a nu kum khat a timi a pekchanh lai.","ref":"Lev 4.27-31"},"28":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih, palhnak a tuahmi caah khan Bawipa hmaiah remnak a ser lai; cu pa nih hngalh loin a sual tikah remnak a serpiak lai i ngaihthiam a si lai."},"29":{"text":"Hngalh loin palhnak a tuahmi caah phungbia pakhat lawnglawng nan ngei lai, amah cu Israel mi taktak a si ah siseh, an lak i a pemmi khual a si ah siseh."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh nih, Israel mi taktak a si ah siseh, mipem a si ah siseh, lungpuam in sualnak a tuah ahcun, Bawipa kha a thangchiat a si, cu pa cu a mi hna lakin hlonh a si lai."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa bia kha a nautat caah le a nawlbia kha a buar caah cu pa cu hlonh hrimhrim a si lai; a ṭhat lonak cu amah cungah a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Israel mi hna cu ramlak ah an um lioah khan sabbath ni ah thing a khawmmi pakhat an hmuh.","title":"Sabbath Buarmi Thahnak"},"33":{"text":"Cun thing a khawmh lio a hmutu hna nih khan Moses le Aaron le a pummi vialte sinah khan an ratpi."},"34":{"text":"Thong ah an thlak, zeicahtiah a cungah zeidah tuah awk a si lai ti kha a fiang rih lo."},"35":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i, “Mipa cu thah a si lai; a pummi vialte nih riahhmun lengah lung in an cheh lai,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun a pummi vialte nih riahhmun lengah an chuahpi i Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bangin lung in thi lakin an cheh."},"37":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Puantlang Hmum"},"38":{"text":"“Israel mi hna sinah hi bangin va chim law, an puan ki ah a hmumbor serter hna, an tefa chin tiangin, cun a ki kip i a hmumbor cu la dum in thlaih hna seh;","ref":"Deu 22.12"},"39":{"text":"cun nannih nih hmumbor kha nan zoh lai i Bawipa nawlbia vialte kha tuah awkah nan hngalh ṭhan lai, i sum loin zulh nan duh tawnmi nanmah nan lung duhnak le mit duhnak kha nan zul ti lai lo."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah nannih nih ka nawlbia vialte cu nan hngalh camcin lai i nan tuah lai i nan Pathian sinah nan thiang lai."},"41":{"text":"Nan Pathian si awkah Izipt ram in an chuahpitu hna Bawipa nan Pathian cu ka si: keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si,” tiah a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Levi fapa Kohath i fapa Izhar i fapa Korah le, Reuben fapa Eliab i fapa hna Dathan le Abiram le, Reuben fapa Peleth i fapa On nih","title":"Korah Nih Moses A Ralchanh","ref":"Jud 11"},"2":{"text":"mi kha an pumh hna; Israel mi za hnih le sawm nga, mizapi hruaitu a simi hna, aa pummi chungin thimmi, mi minthang deuhdeuh hna he khan Moses cu an va chuahhnawh."},"3":{"text":"Moses le Aaron kha an pumhhnawh hna i annih cu, “Nan luan cang! Mi zapi cu an thiang cio ko i Bawipa cu an lakah a um ve ko. A si kun ahcun zeicahdah Bawipa mibu cungah cun nan i hlorh?” tiah an ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Moses nih a theih tikah a bawk i"},"5":{"text":"Korah le a hawile vialte cu, “Zinglei ah Bawipa nih ahodah amah ta a si i ahodah a thiang ti kha a langhter lai i a pawngah a ratter lai. Amah nih a thimmi cu amah naih ah a ratter lai."},"6":{"text":"Mah hihi tuah u, Korah le a hawile vialte hna:"},"7":{"text":"mei laknak kheng hna kha i lak u law, thaizing ah an chungah mei chia u law, an cungah Bawipa hmaiah zihmui chia u, Bawipa nih a thimmi cu a thiangmi cu a si lai. Levi fapa hna, nan luan cang!” tiah a ti hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Korah cu a chawnh i, “Levi fapa hna, ngai tuah u."},"9":{"text":"Israel Pathian nih nannih cu Israel mibu hna chungin amah sin naih i umter awk, Bawipa puan biakinn chung i rianṭuan awk le aa pummi hmai i dir i an rianṭuan awkah an thleidan hna hi nannih caah a hme tukmi thil maw a si?"},"10":{"text":"Amah naih ah nanmah le nan unau Levi fapale hna cu nanmah he an kalpi hna hi, thil tetuai maw a si? Tlangbawi rian zong nan banh rih lai maw?"},"11":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah le na hawile vialte nih nan pumhhnawhmi cu Bawipa pei a si tiah; Aaron cu mi zeidah a si, a cung i nan phunzai hi?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Eliab fapa Dathan le Abiram kha auh awkah mi a thlah hna i, annih nih, “Kan hung lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Ramcar chung i kannih kha thah awkah cawhnuk le khuaihliti in a luangmi ram in na kan chuahpi hi, thil hme tuai a si maw, kannih cung i bawi i naa ser zong hi?"},"14":{"text":"Cu hleiah cawhnuk le khuaihliti in a luangmi ram ah na kan luhpi fawn ṭung lo, mitsur dum zong ro caah na kan pe fawn lo. Mah mi hna hi an mit na khoih hna lai maw? Kan hung lai lo” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Moses cu a thin a hung ngai-ngai i Bawipa sinah, “An pekchanhnak cu hmaizah hlah. Annih sinin laa pakhat hmanh ka la lo i annih kha pakhat hmanh ka fahter hna lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Korah cu, “Thaizing ah nangmah le na hawile vialte, nangmah le annih le Aaron cu, Bawipa hmaiah hung chuak tuah u."},"17":{"text":"Nannih nih nan meilaknak cio kha nan i lak lai i an cungah zihmui nan chiah cio hna lai i Bawipa hmaiah nan meilaknak cio cu nan chuahpi lai, meilaknak za hnih le sawm nga cu; nangmah zong Aaron zong nan meilaknak veve he nan chuak lai, a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cu caah an meilaknak cio cu an i lak i an chungah mei an chiah i zihmui an phulh hna i tonnak thlam innka ah cun Moses le Aaron he tiah an dir."},"19":{"text":"Cun Korah nih mi zapi vialte cu tonnak thlam innka ah cun a pumhter hna i, Bawipa sunparnak cu mizapi vialte sinah cun a lang."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu,"},"21":{"text":"“Hi aa pummi hna sin hin i ṭhen u, chikkhatte ah ka khangh dih khawh hna nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun an bawk i, “Maw Pathian, titsa vialte i thlarau hna Pathian, mi pakhat nih a sual caah, nangmah cu mi zapi vialte cungah hin na thin a hung lai maw?” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu,"},"24":{"text":"“Mi zapi sinah, Korah le Dathan le Abiram umnak pawngkam in va ṭian u, tiah va chim hna,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Moses cu a tho i Dathan le Abiram sinah a kal i Israel mi upa hna nih khan an zulh."},"26":{"text":"Cun aa pummi hna sinah cun, “Hi miṭhalo hna thlam hna hin ṭian u, tiah kan nawl hna, cun an thil zong zeihmanh tawng hlah u, an sualnak chungah fenh chih nan si sual lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah Korah, Dathan, le Abiram hna umnak pawngkam khan an ṭian i Dathan le Abiram cu an nupile he, an fapale he, an ngakchiale he tiah, an ra chuak i an thlam innka ah cun an dir."},"28":{"text":"Cun Moses nih, “Keimah thinlung i a chuak chom in si loin, Bawipa nih pei mah rianṭuan awkah hin a ka thlah tiah ti kha mah hi hin nannih nih nan hngalh lai."},"29":{"text":"Mah hna hi mi vialte thih kel cio ah an thih le mi vialte sifah in kel cio an in ve a si ahcun, cu ti a si ahcun Bawipa nih a ka thlah lo a si lai."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, Bawipa nih thil thar zeimaw a ser i vawlei nih a kaa a an i an ngeihmi thil vialte he a dolh hna i Sheol ah a nung in an vung kal ahcun, cu tikah cun nannih nih mah hna nih hin Bawipa kha an zawmhtaih tiah nan hngalh lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Hi bia vialte a chim dih tikah, an tang vawlei cu a kak i"},"32":{"text":"vawlei nih a kaa a an i anmah le an innchungkhar hna le Korah mi vialte le an thilri vialte kha a dolh dih hna."},"33":{"text":"Cu caah annih le anmah ta a simi vialte cu Sheol ah a nung in an vung tla i vawlei nih a khuh hna i aa pummi chung cun an thi dih."},"34":{"text":"An ai thawng cun an pawngkam ah a ummi Israel mi vialte hna cu an zam i, “Vawlei nih kannih zong a kan dolh ve sual lai!” tiah an ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun Bawipa sinin mei a chuak i zihmui a pechan liomi minung za hnih le sawm nga kha a kangh dih hna."},"36":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"37":{"text":"“Tlangbawi Aaron fapa Eleazar kha, meialh chungin meilaknak kha la hna law, mei cu thai dih tuah."},"38":{"text":"Sualnak ruang i nunnak a hlomi hna meilaknak hna kha cu an thian caah, cucaah biakṭheng khuhnak ca i denmi kheng ah serter hna, zeitintiah Bawipa hmaiah an pekchanh hna; cucaah an thiang. Cu bangin Israel mi caah hmelchunhnak an si lai, tiah chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cucaah tlangbawi Eleazar nih, mei nih a kanghmi hna nih an pekchanhmi dar meilaknak hna cu a lak i biakṭheng khuhnak caah cun an den hna."},"40":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi a si lo i Aaron tefa a si lomi ahohmanh nih Bawipa hmai i zihmui khangh awkah an ra naih nakhnga lo, Israel mi hna caah mah cucu hngalhtertu a si lai, Korah le a hawile hna bang khan an si sual ve nakhnga lo — Bawipa nih Moses in Eleazar sinah a chim bangin."},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thaizing ah Israel mi nih an bu ningin Moses le Aaron cungah an zai i, “ Bawipa mi kha nan thah hna,” tiah an ti."},"42":{"text":"Cun mibu nih khan Moses le Aaron cu an pumhhnawh hna tikah, tonnak thlam lei kha an hoih i, zohhmanh, minmei nih a khuh i Bawipa sunparnak kha a lang."},"43":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron nih tonnak thlam hmailei ah khan an ra i"},"44":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"45":{"text":"“Hi mibu chung hin va chuak tuah u, chikkhatte ah ka khangh dih hna nakhnga,” tiah a ti. Cun an bawk."},"46":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron sinah, “Na meilaknak kha i lak law, biakṭheng cung mei kha a chungah chia tuah, zihmui phulh law, zokzok tein mibu sinah kalpi law, annih caah remnak serpiak hna; zeitintiah thinhunnak cu Bawipa sinin a chuak cang i rai kha a tlung cang,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Moses nih a chim bangin Aaron nih a lak i aa pummi hna chungah khan a le; cun, zohhmanh, mi hna lakah khan rai cu tlun hram a rak thawk cang; cun zihmui kha a phulh i mi kha remnak a serpiak hna."},"48":{"text":"Cun a thimi le a nungmi karlak ah a dir i rai cu a ṭian."},"49":{"text":"Cun Korah kongah a thimi hleiah, rai in a thimi cu sang khat thong li le za sarih an si."},"50":{"text":"Cun rai kha a ṭian tikah, Aaron cu Moses sinah tonnak thlam innka ah khan a kir ṭhan."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Aaron Ṭhiangṭhunh"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi cu va chim hna law, annih sinin ṭhiangṭhunh, phun khat caah pakhat in, an phun ning cio ah an hruaitu hna sin cio ah, ṭhiangṭhunh hleihnih va la hna. An min cio cu an ṭhiangṭhunh cio ah na ṭial hna lai i"},"3":{"text":"Levi ṭhiangṭhunh cungah cun Aaron min na ṭial lai. Zeitintiah, phun khat lu cio caah khan ṭhangṭhunh pakhat a si lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun, tonnak thlam chung hngalhternak hmai nangmah kan tonnak hmun ah khan na chiah hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun ka thimmipa i a ṭhiangṭhunh cu a corh lai; cu bangin Israel mi hna phunzainak, nangmah cung i an phunzainak cu, ka sinin ka daihter lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Moses nih Israel mi cu a chimh hna i an hruaitu vialte nih ṭhiangṭhunh cu an pek, hruaitu pakhat caah pakhat, an phun cio ning in, ṭhiangṭhunh hleihnih; Aaron ṭhiangṭhunh cu an ṭhiangṭhunh hna lakah a tel ve."},"7":{"text":"Cun Moses nih hngalhternak thlam chungah khan Bawipa hmaiah ṭhiangṭhunh cu a chiah hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun, a thaizing ah Moses nih hngalhternak thlam chungah a lut i zohhmanh, Levi phun ca i Aaron ṭhiangṭhunh cu a rak corh i a kuhkulul an chuak i an par i almond thei a hminmi an rak tlai.","ref":"Heb 9.4"},"9":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Bawipa hmaika cun ṭhiangṭhunh vialte cu Israel mi vialte hna sinah a rak chuahpi hna i an zoh i an ṭhiangṭhunh cio kha an i lak."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu, “Aaron ṭhiangṭhunh cu hngalhternak hmaiah khan va chia ṭhan law, ralchanh hmangmi hna caah hmelchunhnak caah chiah a si lai i keimah cungah an phunzainak cu na donghter lai, an thi sual ai hnga,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cu bangin Moses nih a tuah; Bawipa nih nawl a pek bang khan a tuah."},"12":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna nih Moses sinah, “Zohhmanh, kan lo dih ai, kan rawk dih ai, kan rawk dih cikcek ko hi ta."},"13":{"text":"A ra naihmi paoh cu, Bawipa puan biakinn a ra naihmi paoh cu, an thi lai. Kan dihlak in kan thi ko lai maw?” tiah an ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih Aaron cu a chawnh i, “Nangmah le na fapale hna le na phunhawi hna nih hmunthiang he a pehtlai in ṭhat lonak cu nan in lai; cun nangmah le na fapale hna nih tlangbawi nan sinak he aa pehtlai in ṭhat lonak cu nan in lai.","title":"Tlangbawi le Levi Mi Cawmnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun nangmah sinah na unau hna, Levi phun, na pa phun kha, ratpi hna law, nangmah kha an in fonh lai i nangmah he a ummi na fapa hna le nangmah cu hngalhternak thlam hmaiah nan um lioah an in bawmh hna lai."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah kha an in bultawl lai i thlam rian vialte zong kha an bultawl lai; sihmanhsehlaw hmunthiang umkheng si hna seh, biakṭheng siseh, an naih lai lo, anmah le nangmah zong nan thi sual hnga."},"4":{"text":"An in fonh lai i tonnak thlam cu thlam chung rian vialte ah an bultawl lai; cun a dang ahohmanh nan pawngah an ra lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Cun nannih nih hmunthiang rian le biakṭheng rian cu nan bultawl lai, Israel mi cungah thinhunnak a um ti nakhnga lo."},"6":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, nan unau Levi mi hna cu Israel mi hna chungin ka lak cang hna; annih cu tonnak thlam rianṭuan awk i Bawipa sin le nan sin i pekmi laksawng an si."},"7":{"text":"Cun nangmah le na fale hna nih biakṭheng le puanzar chung i a ummi thil he aa pehtlaimi vialte ah nan tlangbawi rian cu nan ṭuan lai; nannih nih nan bultawi lai. Nan tlangbawi rian hi laksawng ah kan pek hna; midang ahohmanh a pawngah a rami paoh cu thah a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Aaron cu, “Zoh-hmanh, keimah sin i pekchanhmi thil hna chungin khangh lomi paoh cu nangmah kan pek, Israel mi hna an thil thiang vialte cu; mah thil hna cu na vo ah nangmah kan pek i an hmuh camcin awkah na fapale kha ka pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Mei i khangh hlei thil thiang bik hna chungin mah hihi na ta an si lai: an pekchanhmi paohpaoh, an changvut thawinak paohpaoh, an sual thawinak paohpaoh le an phungbuar thawinak paohpaoh keimah an ka pekmi cu nangmah le na fapale hna caah thil thiang bik an si lai."},"10":{"text":"Hmun thiang bik ah nan ei lai; pa paohpaoh nih an ei lai; na caah thil thiang a si."},"11":{"text":"Mah zong hi na ta a si lai, an laksawng an pekchanhmi, Israel mi hna hninh thawinak vialte cu; mah hna hi nangmah le na fapa hna le na fanu hna sinah nan hmuh camcin awkah kan pek cang hna; na inn chung i a thiangmi paoh nih an ei khawh lai."},"12":{"text":"Chiti lakah a ṭha bik le mitsur hang le tirawl lakah a ṭha bik, Bawipa sinah an pekmi thei tlaiter hna cu, nangmah kan pek."},"13":{"text":"An lo chung i theitlai a hmin hmasa bik, Bawipa sin i an rak putmi hna cu, na ta an si lai; na inn chung i a thiangmi paoh nih an ei khawh lai."},"14":{"text":"Israel mi hna chungah ulh amhmi thil paohpaoh cu na ta a si lai.","ref":"Lev 27.28"},"15":{"text":"Bawipa sinah an pekchanhmi fater paohpaoh cu, minung siseh saram siseh, nangmah ta an si lai; asinain, minung fater le a thiang lomi saram fater hna cu na tlanh hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun an tlanhnak man cu (thla khat an ti tikah na tlanh hna lai) gerah pakul a simi hmunthiang shekel ningin ngun shekel panga ah na khiah lai."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw caw fater siseh, tuu fater siseh, meheh fater siseh, na tlan hna lai lo; annih cu an thiang. An thi cu biakṭheng cungah na theh lai i an thau cu mei in thawinak caah, Bawipa ca i rimthaw ah, na khangh lai;"},"18":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an sa cu nangmah ta a si lai, hninhmi ii le orhlei phei cu na ta an si bantuk khan."},"19":{"text":"Israel mi nih Bawipa sinah an pekmi a thiangmi pekchanhnak vialte cu nangmah le na fapa hna le na fanu hna he nan hmuh camcin awkah kan pek; nangmah le na tefa hna caah cite in biakamnak Bawipa hmaiah a si zungzal lai,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Aaron cu, “An ram chungah ro na ngei lai lo, annih lakah covo zong na ngei lai lo, keimah cu Israel mi hna lakah na vo le na ro ka si."},"21":{"text":"“Levi mi cu tonnak thlam chung i an rian, cu rianṭuan man ah cun Israel mi hna lak i cheu hra cheu khat cu ro caah ka pek hna.","ref":"Lev 27.30-33; Deu 14.22-29"},"22":{"text":"Cun atu thawk in Israel mi hna cu tonnak thlam pawngah an ra ti lai lo, an sualnak mawh phor in an thi sual hnga."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Levi mi nih tonnak thlam rian cu an ṭuan lai i palhnak a um ahcun anmah nih an in lai; nan tefa chin tiangin mah hihi nawlbia a si camcin lai; Israel mi hna lakah ro cu an ngei lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Zeitintiah Israel mi hna nih Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak ca i an pekmi cheu hra cheu khat cu Levi mi hna kha ro ah ka pek cang hna; cucaah Israel mi hna lakah ro an ngei lai lo, tiah ka rak ti kha,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu,"},"26":{"text":"“Cu hleiah, hi bangin Levi mi cu na chimh hna lai, ‘Israel mi hna sinin cheu hra cheu khat nan ro caah kan pekmi hna cu nan lak tikah, cu chung cun Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak nan pek lai, cheu hra cheu khat cungin cheu hra cheu khat kha."},"27":{"text":"Cun nan pekchanhnak cu phuhri i rawl le mitsur hang nennak mitsur hang bantuk ah relpiak nan si lai."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi hna sinin nan hmuhmi cheu hra cheu khat vialte chungin nanmah zong nih Bawipa sinah pekchanhnak nan tuah lai; Bawipa sin pekchanhmi cu tlangbawi Aaron kha nan pek lai."},"29":{"text":"Laksawng nan hmuhmi vialte chungin, a ṭha bik a thiang bik hna, Bawipa sinah pekchanh awk a simi hna cu, nan pek lai.’"},"30":{"text":"Cucaah annih sinah hi bangin na chim lai, ‘A ṭha bik kha nan pekchanh dih in, a tangmi cu Levi mi hna caah phuhri in a chuakmi rawl le mitsur nennak chung chuakmi mitsur hang ah rel a si lai i,"},"31":{"text":"nanmah le nan innchungkhar hna nih khuazeika hmanh ah nan ei khawh lai. Zeitintiah tonnak thlam chung i nan rianṭuan man a si."},"32":{"text":"A ṭha bikmi cu nan pekchanh tikah, sualnak mawhnak cu nan phor lai lo. Cun Israel mi hna thil thiang cu nan thurhhnawmh lai lo, nan thi sual hnga,” tiah a ti."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu a chawnh hna i,","title":"A Thiang Lomi Thianhnak"},"2":{"text":"“Mah hihi Bawipa pekmi phungbia i a nawlbia cu a si: Israel mi kha nannih sinah cawla sen, soi awk zeihmanh a ngei lo i do a tlami, hngawngkual hlinh bal lomi cu, rak pu hna seh tiah chim hna u."},"3":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Eleazar cu nan pek lai i riahhmun lengah an hruai lai i amah hmaiah an thah lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Eleazar nih a thi kha a kutdong in tlawmpal a lak lai i cu thi chung cun tlawmpal in tonnak thlam hmailei cu voi sarih a theh lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun cawla cu amah mithmuh ah an khangh lai; a phaw le a sa le a thi cu a ek he khangh a si lai i"},"6":{"text":"tlangbawi nih cun sidar thing le husop le thil sen kha a lak hna lai i cawla khanghnak mei chungah cun a paih hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih a hnipuan kha a suk hna lai, a pum cu ti in aa kholh lai i cu hnuah riahhmun chungah cun a ra lut lai. Cun tlangbawi cu zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai."},"8":{"text":"Cawla a khangmipa nih a hnipuan cu ti in a suk hna lai i a pum cu ti in aa kholh lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun a thiangmi pa nih cawla vutcam kha a ruh lai i riahhmun lengah hmun thiang pakhat ah a chiah lai; cun Israel mibu hna sual tlenghnak, i thianhnak ti caah, an chiah lai.","ref":"Heb 9.13"},"10":{"text":"Cun vutcam a ruttupa nih khan a hnipuan a suk hna lai i zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai. Mah hihi Israel mi ca le an sin i a pemmi khual caah nawlbia a si camcin lai."},"11":{"text":"“Miruak zeipaoh a tawngtu cu ni sarih chung thianglo a si lai;"},"12":{"text":"ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah i thianhnak ti khan aa thianh lai i cu bangin a thiang lai; sihmanhsehlaw ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah aa thianh lo ahcun a thiang lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih mithi aho ruak hmanh siseh, a tawngh i aa thianh lo ahcun, Bawipa puan biakinn kha a thurter; cu pa cu Israel mi sinin hlonh awk a si lai; thianhnak ti kha a cungah theh a si lo caah amah cu thianglo a si lai; a thian lonak cu a cungah a tang rih."},"14":{"text":"“Mah hihi mi pakhatkhat nih thlam chungah a thih tik i phungbia a si: thlam chungah a lutmi paoh le thlam chungah a ummi paoh cu ni sarih thianglo an si lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun aa hungmi um, a chin chinh lomi paoh cu, thianglo a si."},"16":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih lo i a um lioah nam in thahmi siseh, miruak siseh, miruh siseh, thlan siseh a tawngh ahcun ni sarih thianglo a si lai."},"17":{"text":"A thiang lomi caah cun khanghmi sual thawinak vutcam kha tlawmpal in an lak lai i ti luangmi tlawmpal he um chungah an rawn lai;"},"18":{"text":"cun a thiangmi pakhatkhat nih husop kha a lak lai i ti chungah cun a hnim lai i thlam le a thilri vialte le cuka i a ummi hna le, ruh siseh, thahmi siseh, mithi siseh, thlan siseh, a tawngmi pa cungah cun a theh lai;"},"19":{"text":"cun a thiangmi pa nih a thiang lomi cu ni thumnak ni le ni sarihnak ni ah a theh lai; cu bangin ni sarihnak ni ah khan a tlengh lai i a hnipuan a suk hna lai i ti in a kholh lai i zanlei ah a thiang lai."},"20":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw thianglo a si i aa tleng lomi cu, cu mi cu aa pummi hna lakin hlonh a si lai, Bawipa hmunthiang kha a thurhhnawmhter caah; thianhnak ti kha a cungah theh a si lo caah amah cu thianglo a si."},"21":{"text":"Cun mah hihi annih caah nawlbia a si camcin lai. Tlenghnak ti a thehtu nih khan a hnipuan a suk lai; cun tlenghnak ti a tawngmi kha zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai."},"22":{"text":"Cun a thiang lomi nih a tawnghmi thil paoh kha thianglo a si lai i, cu thil a tawngmi paoh cu zanlei tiang thianglo a si lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna cu, an bu ningin, thla khatnak thla ah Zin ramlak ah an lut i Kadesh ah an um; cu ka ah Miriam cu a thi i cu ka ah cun an vui.","title":"Lungpi Chungin Ti A Chuak (Exo 17.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Cun cu mibu caah cun ti a um lo i Moses le Aaron cu an pumhhnawh hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun mi nih Moses cu bia an chuah i, “Kan unau hna Bawipa hmai i an rak thih ah khan zeicahdik kan rak thih ve ko lo!"},"4":{"text":"Zeicaahdah Bawipa mibu cu ramlak ah hin na kan luhpi i hika ah hin kanmah he kan saṭil he kan thih ko lai?"},"5":{"text":"Cun zeicaahdah hi hmun ṭhalo i phakpi awkah Izipt ram in na kan chuahter? Mah hmun hi rawl siseh, theipi siseh, mitsur ruang siseh, taleti siseh a umnak a si lo i din awk ti zong a um fawn lo,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron cu aa pummi bu sin cun tonnak thlam innka ah an kal i an bawk. Cun Bawipa sunparnak cu an sinah a lang i,"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinah cun,"},"8":{"text":"Ṭhiangṭhunh kha i lak law, mibu kha pum tuah hna, nangmah he na u Aaron he, cun lungpi kha a ti chuahter dingin an hmaiah chim; cu bangin lungpi chungin an caah ti na chuahter lai; cu bangin mibu le an saṭil cu din awk na pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Moses nih Bawipa hmai i ṭhiangṭhunh cu nawl a pek bang khan a lak."},"10":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron nih mibu cu hmunkhat ah lungpi hmaiah cun an pumh hna i annih sinah, “Nannih ralchanh hmangmi hna, ngai tuah u; hi lungpi chung hin nan caah ti kan chuahter lai maw?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Moses nih a kut a hler i lungpi cu a ṭhiangṭhunh khan voi hnih a tuk i ti tampi a chuak i mibu le an saṭil nih an din."},"12":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu, “Nan ka zumh lo i Israel mi hna mithmuh ah nan ka thianter lo caah, cucaah nannih nih cun hi mirun hi ka pekmi hna ram chungah nan luhpi hna lai lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"13":{"text":"Mah hihi Meribah ti cu an si, Israel mi hna nih Bawipa cu bia an chuah i annih lak i a thiannak a langhternak hmun kha, a si."},"14":{"text":"Moses nih Kadesh in Edom siangpahrang sinah lamkal a hei thlah hna i, “Hi bangin nan unau Israel mi nih an ti: Kan cung i vanchiatnak a tlungmi vialte cu na hngalh ko:","title":"Edom Nih Israel Lam A Kham"},"15":{"text":"kan pupa nih Izipt ram ah an vung kal i Izipt ram ah saupi kan um i Izipt mi hna nih fak piin kanmah le kan pupa hna kha an kan hrem;"},"16":{"text":"cun kannih nih Bawipa kha kan auh tikah kan aw kha a theih i vancungmi pakhat a run thlah i Izipt ram in a kan chuahpi; atu cu hika ah hin na ramri i a ummi Kadesh khua ah kan um."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah na ram hi kan tanter ko sawh. Lo siseh mitsur dum siseh kan tanpah hna lai lo, tikhor ti zong kan ding lai lo; Siangpahrang Lampi kha kan zulh lai i orhlei ah siseh kehlei ah siseh kan i mer lai lo, na ram kan tan dih hlantiang cu,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Edom nih, “Na lan kho hnga lo, vainam he kan chuahhnawh sual hnga,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna nih amah cu, “Lampi kha kan zul ko lai i kanmah le kan saṭil nih na ti kan din ahcun a man kan in pek lai; ke in a lanh lawng kan lanhter ko, thil dang zeihmanh kan ti lai lo,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih, “Na lan kho hnga lo,” tiah a ti. Cun Edom nih mi tampi le a ṭhawngmi ralkapbu he a chuahhnawh hna."},"21":{"text":"Cu bangin Edom nih Israel cu a ram chung i lanh kha a thlauh; cu caah Israel nih amah kha a hrial."},"22":{"text":"Cun Kadesh in Israel mi hna cu an bu ning piin an chuak i Hor Tlang kha an phan.","title":"Hor Tlang Ah Aaron A Thi"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron cu, Edom ramri ah a ummi Hor Tlang ah khan a chawnh hna i,"},"24":{"text":"“Aaron cu a mi hna sinah pumh a si cang lai; Meribah ti ah khan ka nawlbia nan doh caah, Israel mi hna ka pekmi ram ah khan a lut lai lo."},"25":{"text":"Aaron le a fapa Eleazar cu la hna law, Hor Tlang ah hunpi hna law,"},"26":{"text":"Aaron cu a puan phoih hna law, a fapa Eleazar kha hruk hna; cun Aaron cu a mi hna sinah pumh a si cang lai i khika ah a thi lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin Moses nih a tuah i mibu vialte mithmuh ah Hor Tlang ah cun an hung kai."},"28":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Aaron cu a puan kha a phoih hna i a fapa Eleazar kha a hrukter hna. Khika ah tlangpar ah cun Aaron cu a thi. Cun Moses le Eleazar cu tlang cungin an rung ṭum.","ref":"Exo 29.29; Nam 33.38; Deu 10.6"},"29":{"text":"Mibu nih an dihlak in Aaron kha a thi cang ti an hngalh tikah, Israel innchungkhar vialte nih Aaron cu ni sawm thum a zuun an ngaih."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanaan miphun Arad ram siangpahrang, Negeb i a ummi nih Israel mi hna cu Atharim lam in an ra ti kha a theih tikah, Israel cu a doh i tlawmpal cu sal ah a tlaih hna.","title":"Kanaan Mi Nih Israel An Tuk","ref":"Nam 33.40"},"2":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Bawipa sinah biakamnak an ser i, “Hi mi hna cu kan kut chungah na kan pek ahcun, an khua kha kan hrawh cikcek hna lai,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Israel mi hna aw cu a ngaih i Kanaan mi hna cu an kut ah a pek hna; anmah le an khua hna cu an hrawh cikcek hna; cucaah cuka hmun cu Hormah tiah ti a si."},"4":{"text":"Hor Tlang in, Edom ram kha hrial awkah Rili Sen lam kha an tlaih i lam ah mi hna cu an ing a puang.","title":"Dar Rul","ref":"Deu 2.1"},"5":{"text":"Cun mi hna nih cun Pathian le Moses kha an zaihnawh hna i, “Zeicaahdah ramlak i thih awkah hin Izipt ram in nan kan chuahpi? Zeitintiah rawl a um lo, ti a um lo i, hi rawl ṭhalo hi cu kan fih,” tiah an ti.","ref":"1Kor 10.9"},"6":{"text":"Khi tikah Bawipa nih meirul kha mi lakah cun a thlah hna i mi kha an cuk hna caah Israel mi tampi an thi."},"7":{"text":"Cun annih nih Moses sinah an ra i, “ Bawipa le nangmah kha kan in mawhchiat hna caah kan sual cang; kannih sinin rul kha a lak hna nakhnga, Bawipa sinah thlacam tuah,” tiah an ti. Cucaah Moses nih annih caah thla a cam."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu, “Meirul pakhat in ser law, tung cungah tar tuah; rul cukmi paoh nih an zoh tikah an nung lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Moses nih dar rul pakhat a ser i tung cungah a tar; cun, rul nih pakhatkhat a cuk hna tikah, dar rul cu an zoh ahcun an nung.","ref":"2Sia 18.4; Jhn 3.14"},"10":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna cu an i thawh i Oboth ah an riak.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Moab Ram An Hel"},"11":{"text":"Cun Oboth in an i thawh i Moab ral, nichuahlei i a ummi ramlak chung i Iyeabarim ah an riak."},"12":{"text":"Cuka cun an tho ṭhan i Zered Nelrawn ah an riak."},"13":{"text":"Cuka cun an tho i Arnon tiva khattelei ral ah an riak; mah hmun cu Amor mi hna ramri in aa thawkmi ramlak chungah a si, zeitintiah Arnon tiva cu Moab ramri a si, Moab le Amor mi hna karlak ah."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa Raldohnak Cauk chungah hi bangin an ti. “Sufah i Waheb le Arnon nel hna le"},"15":{"text":"Ar khua umnak tiang a phan i Moab ramri tiang a ṭum mi Nel hna tlangpang cu,”"},"16":{"text":"Cun cuka cun Beer tiang an kal; mah cucu Bawipa nih Moses sinah, “Mi kha hmunkhat ah pum hna law, ti ka pek hna lai,” tiah a timi tikhor kha a si."},"17":{"text":"Cu tikah Israel nih mah hla hi an sa: “Maw tikhor, ti hung chuak tuah! Hla in hloi tuah u!"},"18":{"text":"Bawi nih an cawhmi tikhor, Mi hna lak i milian nih An bawifung le an ṭhiangṭhunh in An cawhmi tikhor cu.” Cun ramlak cun Mattanah tiang an kal i,"},"19":{"text":"Mattanah in Nahaliel tiang, cun Nahaliel in Bamoth tiang,"},"20":{"text":"cun Bamoth in Moab ram chung i a ummi nelrawn tiang an kal; cu nelrawn cu thetse rawn a vun zohtu Pisgah tlangpar pawngah a um."},"21":{"text":"Cun Israel nih Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon sinah lamkaltu an thlah hna i,","title":"Israel Mi Nih Sihon An Tei (Deu 2.26-37)"},"22":{"text":"“Na ram kan tanter tuah; lo ah siseh, mitsur dum ah siseh kan pial pah lai lo; tikhor ti zong kan ding lai lo; na ram chungin kan chuah hlantiang Siangpahrang Lampi kan zul ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Sihon nih Israel cu a ram tanter kha a awnh duh hna lo. A mi vialte kha a pumh hna i ramlak ah Israel doh awkah cun a kal i Jahaz a phan i Israel kha a tuk."},"24":{"text":"Cun Israel nih vainam in an sam hna i a ram kha Arnon in Jabbok tiang, Ammon mi hna ramri tiang, an lak; zeitintiah Jazer cu Ammon mi hna ramri ah a si."},"25":{"text":"Cun Israel nih mah hi khua vialte hna kha an lak i Amor mi khua vialte ah Israel cu an um, Heshbon le a khuate vialte hna ah cun an um."},"26":{"text":"Zeitintiah Heshbon cu Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon khua kha a si; Sihon nih cun Moab siangpahrang hmasa deuh kha a rak doh i Arnon tiangin a ram kha a kut chungin a rak lak."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah pupa hla a rak satu hna nih, “Heshbon ah ra tuah u, remh tuah u, Sihon khua cu fehter si seh."},"28":{"text":"Zeitintiah Heshbon in mei a chuak i Sihon khua in meizik a chuak. Moab siangpahrang Ar kha a kangh, Arnon hmunsang bawi hna zong.","ref":"Jer 48.45-46"},"29":{"text":"Maw Moab, ngaihchiat awk na va si dah! Maw Khemosh biami hna, nannih cu nan lo cang ai! A fapa hna cu ralzam ah a ser hna i, A fanu hna cu Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon sinah cun sal ah a ser hna."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah an tefa hna cu Heshbon in Dibon tiang an rawk i Medeba tiang mei a kangh hlantiang kannih nih kan ṭhio,” tiah an ti."},"31":{"text":"Cu bantukin Israel nih Amor mi hna ram ah cun an um.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Og An Tei (Deu 3.1-11)"},"32":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Jazer cu va ngiat awkah a thlah hna i a khuate kha an lak hna i khika ah a ummi Amor mi hna kha an pawnchuah hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun an i mer i Bashan lei lam kha an zulh. Bashan siangpahrang Og nih Edrei ah anmah doh awkah amah le a mi vialte he an hung chuak."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i, “Amah kha ṭih hlah, zeitintiah amah cu a mi vialte le a ram he na kut chungah kan pek cang; Heshbon ah a ummi Amor mi hna siangpahrang Sihon cungah na tuah bantuk khan, amah cungah na tuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cucaah a fapa hna le a mi vialte hna he, amah caah a taangmi pakhat hmanh um lo tiangin, amah cu an thah i a ram cu an rawlh."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu an i thawh i Jordan khattelei ral Moab ramrawn ah, Jeriko zawn ah khan, an riak.","title":"Balak Nih Balaam Bia A Cah"},"2":{"text":"Cun Zippor fapa Balak nih khan Amor mi cungah Israel nih an tuahmi vialte kha a hmuh."},"3":{"text":"Cu mi cu an tampi caah; Moab nih an ṭih ngaingai hna. Moab mi hna cu Israel mi an ṭih hnanak nih cun a tei hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Moab nih Midian upa hna sinah, “Cawtum nih lo chung ram a ṭam dih bantukin, hi bupi nih hin kan pawngkam i a ummi thil vialte a ṭam dih lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Zippor fapa Balak, cu caan lio i Moab siangpahrang a simi nih cun,"},"5":{"text":"Amaw ram i a ummi, Tiva pawng i a ummi Pethor khuami Beor fapa Balaam cu kawh awkah lamkal a hei thlah hna i, “Zohhmanh, Izipt ram in miphun pakhat an ra chuak i vawlei an khat dih i keimah zawn ah an um cang.","ref":"Nam 31.8; 2Pet 2.15-16; Jud 11"},"6":{"text":"Ra tuah law, mah mi hna hi chiat ka serhpiak hna, keimah caah an ṭhawng tuk; ka tei hna in hi ram hin ka hei dawi khawh hna hmanh hnga maw; zeitintiah thluachuah na pekmi cu thlua an chuak i, chiat na serhmi cu a chiat hna ti kha ka hngalh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah Moab upa hna le Midian upa hna cu an kut ah litin man i put in an kal i Balaam sinah an phan i Balak biacahmi cu an chimh."},"8":{"text":"Cun anih nih annih cu, “Tuzan cu hika ah hin riak u law, Bawipa nih ka sinah a chim bantuk paoh in, bia cu ka rak in phorh ṭhan hna lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Moab bawi hna cu Balaam sinah an riak."},"9":{"text":"Cun Pathian cu Balaam sinah a ra i, “Na sinah a ummi hna hi ahodah an si?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Balaam nih Pathian sinah, “Zippor fapa Balak, Moab siangpahrang nih cun, a run ka cah i,"},"11":{"text":"‘Zohhmanh, Izipt ram in miphun pakhat an chuak i vawlei kha an khat dih. Ra tuah law, annih kha chiat ka serhpiak hna; annih kha ka doh khawh hna in ka thawl khawh hna hmanh hnga maw,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Pathian nih Balaam cu, “An sinah na kal hnga lo; cu mi hna cu chiat na serh hna hnga lo, zeitintiah thluachuakmi an si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Balaam cu zinglei ah a tho i Balak bawi hna cu, “Nanmah ram ah va kir ko u, zeitintiah nanmah sin kal cu Bawipa nih a ka sianh lo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Moab bawi hna cu an tho i Balak sinah an kal i, “Balaam nih kan sin i rat cu a duh lo,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Balak nih annih nakin hmaizah awk deuh a simi bawi kha tam deuh in a thlah ṭhan hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun annih nih Balaam sinah an ra i, “Hi bangin Zippor fapa Balak nih, ‘Keimah sin rat cu zeihmanh i donhter hlah;"},"17":{"text":"zeitintiah upatnak nganpi kan pek hrimhrim lai i na ka chimhmi paoh kha ka tuah lai; ra law, mah mi hna hi chiat ka serhpiak ko hna,’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Balaam nih a leh hna i Balak sal hna sinah cun, “Balak nih a inn cu sui le ngun a khat in ka pe hmanh seh law, Bawipa ka Pathian nawlbia lengah cun zeihmanh ka tuah kho lo."},"19":{"text":"Tuzan zong hika ah hin riak tuah u, tiah kan nawl hna, Bawipa nih zeidah ka sinah a chim rih lai kha ka hngalh nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Balaam sinah zan ah a ra i, “Hi mi hna nih nangmah kawh awkah an rat ahcun, tho law, an sinah va kal ko; sihmanhsehlaw kan chimhmi lawnglawng kha na tuah lai,” tiah a sinah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah zinglei ah Balaam cu a tho i a laa cu a danh i Moab bawi hna sinah khan a kal.","title":"Balaam Laa le Vancungmi"},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kal caah Pathian thinhunnak cu a alh i Bawipa vancungmi pakhat nih amah dawntu ah lam ah a dir. Amah cu laa cungah cun aa cit i a sal pahnih cu amah sinah an um."},"23":{"text":"Cun laa nih cun Bawipa vancungmi cu lamkalai ah vainam phawi cia i put in a dir ko kha a hmuh i, laa cu lam in a pial i lo chungah a kal; cun Balaam nih laa cu lam lei i mer ṭhan awkah a tuk."},"24":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi cu mitsur dum le mitsur dum karlak i lam bi ah a dir i a kap hnih in hau a um veve."},"25":{"text":"Cun laa nih Bawipa vancungmi kha a hmuh tikah, hau cu a hei en i Balaam ke cu hau ah khan a rial chih; cucaah a tuk ṭhan."},"26":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi cu hmailei ah a kal ṭhan i orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh, i mernak a um lonak hmun, hmun ceprep pakhat ah, a dir."},"27":{"text":"Laa nih Bawipa vancungmi kha a hmuh tikah Balaam cu a bawhpi i Balaam thinhunnak cu a alh i a ṭhiangṭhunh in laa cu a tuk."},"28":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa nih laa cu a holhter i Balaam sinah cun, “Na cungah zeidah ka tuah i voi thum tiang na ka tuk?” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun Balaam nih laa cu, “Nihchuak capo ah na ka ser caah a si. Nam rak i put ning law, ka ti pei tiah, ka rak in thah ko hnga,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun laa nih Balaam cu, “Keimah cu na hmette in atu tiang i naa citmi na laa ka si lo mei? Hi bantukin na cungah ka tuah bal maw?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Na tuah bal lo,” a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa nih Balaam cu a mit a auter i, Bawipa vancungmi, vainam zuh cia a kut ah i put in, lamkalai ah a dir ko kha a hmuh, cun a lu a khun i a bawk."},"32":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi nih amah sinah cun, “Zeicaahdah hi voi thum tiang na laa kha na tuk? Zohhmanh, na tuahnak cu ka hmaiah a ṭha lomi a si caah nangmah kha donh awkah ka ra chuak."},"33":{"text":"Laa nih khan a ka hmuh i voi thum tiang hin ka hmaiah a pial. Ka hmai in rak pial hlah seh law, amah cu thah loin nangmah kha ka rak in thah cang hnga,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun Balaam nih Bawipa vancungmi sinah cun, “Ka sual cang, zeitintiah keimah donh awkah lam ah na rak dir ti kha ka hngal lo. Cucaah na mithmuh ah thil ṭhalo a si ahcun ka kir ṭhan ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi nih Balaam cu, “Mi hna sinah cun va kal ko, sihmanhsehlaw kan chimhmi bia lawnglawng na chim lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Balaam cu Balak bawi hna sinah cun a kal."},"36":{"text":"Balaam a ra cang tiah Balak nih a theih tikah, Arnon tiva nih a thlehmi an ramri, cu ramri a donghnak bik i a ummi Moab khua tiangin va don awkah a kal."},"37":{"text":"Cun Balak nih Balaam cu, “Nangmah kawh awkah mi ka rak thlah hna, a si lo mei? Zeicaahdah ka sinah na rat lo? Upatnak an pe kho lo maw ka si?” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Balaam nih Balak sinah cun, “Zohhmanh, nangmah sin ka ra phan cang! Keimah thamtham cu zeihmanh chim khawhnak nawl ka ngei i mei? Pathian nih ka ka chung i a chiahmi bia lawng pei ka chim khawh ko lai cu,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cun Balaam cu Balak sinah cun a kal i Kiriath-huzoth an phan."},"40":{"text":"Cun Balak nih cawtum hna le tuu hna in rai aa thawi i Balaam le a sinah a ummi bawi hna kha a hei hleh hna."},"41":{"text":"Cun a thaizing ah Balak nih Balaam cu Bamoth-baal ah a hun kalpi i cuka cun a naih bik i a ummi hna cu a hmuh hna."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A hramthawk ah, Pathian nih van le vawlei a ser hna tikah,","title":"Sernak Kong"},"2":{"text":"vawlei cu mui zong a ngei lo, pungsan zong a ngei lo. Rilipi cu muihnak nih a khuh i ti cungah cun Pathian ṭhawnnak cu aa chawk."},"3":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih, “Ceunak um seh,” tiah a ti i ceunak cu a hung um.","ref":"2Kor 4.6"},"4":{"text":"Ceunak cu a zoh i aa lawm. Cun ceunak le muihnak cu a ṭhen hna i"},"5":{"text":"ceunak cu “Chun” tiah min a sak i muihnak cu “Zan” tiah a ti. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um — cucu ni khatnak ni cu a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Ti le ti a ṭhentu hna ding caah aa kuaimi van pakhat in um seh law, ti cu hmun hnih ah um hna seh,” tiah a ti i cu tining cun a hung si.","ref":"2Pet 3.5"},"7":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih cun van kuai cu a ser i a tang i a ummi ti le a cung i a ummi ti cu a ṭhen hna;"},"8":{"text":"van kuai cu a min ah “Van” a sak. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni hnihnak ni cu a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Van tang i a ummi ti cu hmun khat ah i pum hna seh law vawlei kha hung lang seh,” tiah nawl a pek i cu bang cun a hung si."},"10":{"text":"Vawlei cu a min ah “Vawlei” a sak i a pumhtermi ti cu “Rili” tiah a ti. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Vawlei cungah hin thingram a phunphun kho hna seh, a tlaimi kung hna le rawl a phunphun thei a phunphun a vuimi rawlkung hna,” tiah a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah cun vawlei cungah cun thingram a phunphun an kho, rawl a vuimi rawlkung hna le thei a tlaimi thingkung hna an si. Pathian nih a tuahmi cu a zoh i a lung a si."},"13":{"text":"Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni thumnak ni cu a si."},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Chun le zan a ṭhentu ding le ni le kum le caan kha zeitik in dah an i thawk cio ti hngalhtertu dingah van ah khin ceunak um hna seh;"},"15":{"text":"cun cu ceunak hna nih cun vawlei hi ceuh hna seh,” tiah a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih cun ceunak ngan pipi pahnih hi a ser hna, ni hi chun uktu dingah a ser i thlapa hi zan uktu dingah a ser; arfi zong khi a ser hna;"},"17":{"text":"ceunak hna cu van ah khin vawlei a run ceuhtu dingah a chiah hna,"},"18":{"text":"chun le zan a uktu hna ding le ceunak le muihnak a ṭhentu hna dingah a chiah hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"19":{"text":"Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni linak ni kha a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun aa thawh i, “Ti nih hin thilnung phun tampi a hrin hna lai i va hi thli lakah hin an zuang lai,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si.”"},"21":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih cun rili chung i a ummi sahrang ṭihnung pipi le ti lak i a tlongmi thilnung a phunphun le va a phunphun kha a ser hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"22":{"text":"Cun thluachuah a pek hna i, “Ti chung i a ummi thilnung hi karh u law rili hi khat u, va hi tampi in karh u,” tiah a ti hna."},"23":{"text":"Zanlei cu a dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni nganak ni a si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Vawlei nih hin inn zuat saṭil a phunphun le ramlak saram a phunphun, a hme he a ngan he, hring hna seh,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun inn zuat saṭil a phunphun le ramlak saram a phunphun a hme he a ngan he a ser hna. A tuahmi kha a zoh i a lung a si."},"26":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih cun, “Atu cu minung kan ser cang hna lai; kanmah mui an keng lai i kanmah he kan i lo lai. Nga si hna seh, va si hna seh, inn zuat saṭil si hna seh, ramlak i a ummi saram a hme he a ngan he si hna seh, an uk dih hna lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Kor 11.7"},"27":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian nih minung cu amah mui lo in a ser, minung cu Pathian mui in a ser hna. Mipa le minu kha a ser hna.","ref":"Mat 19.4; Mar 10.6"},"28":{"text":"Thluachuahnak a pek hna i, “Tefa tampi in ngei u law nan tefa cu vawlei cung khuazakip ah khat hna seh, cun annih nih vawlei cu uk hna seh. Nannih cu nga cung le va cung le ramlak saram a hme he a ngan he an dihlak cung i nawlngeihnak kan pek hna,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 5.1-2"},"29":{"text":"Nan ei awk caah thlai phun kip le thei phun kip kan pek hna;"},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ramsa vialte hna le va vialte hna le vawlei ah a lawn in a lawnmi vialte nunnak thaw a ngeimi vialte hna caah ram hring le thlaihnah borbor ka pek hna,” a ti i cu bang cun a hung si."},"31":{"text":"Pathian nih a sermi thil vialte cu a zoh i a lung a si ngaingai. Zanlei cu a hung dih i zinglei kha a hung um, cucu ni ruknak ni cu a si."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi hna thluachuah pek cu Bawipa lawmhmi a si ti kha Balaam nih a hngalh tikah, voi dang bang khan litin ah kal ti loin ramlak lei kha a hoih peng."},"2":{"text":"Cun Balaam nih khua a hei zoh i Israel mi cu an hrin an hrinning cio in riahhmun an khuar kha a hmuh hna. Pathian thlarau nih a cungah a rung i,"},"3":{"text":"a konglam chim cu a thawk i, “Beor fapa Balaam i a bia, A mit ceuter a simipa bia,"},"4":{"text":"Pathian bia a theimi le A Lianngan Bik langhnak a hmu i a tlu nain A mit hunpiak a simipa bia cu hihi a si:"},"5":{"text":"Maw Jakob, zeitluk in dah na thlam cu an i dawh, Maw Israel, zeitluk in dah na riahhmun hna cu an i dawh!"},"6":{"text":"A kau diahduahmi nelrawn hna le tiva pawng dum hna le, Bawipa nih a phunmi hna inhliam le tipawng sidar thing bantuk an si."},"7":{"text":"A balin chungin ti a luang lai i Ti tampi chungah a ci cu a um lai, A siangpahrang cu Agag nakin a sang deuh lai i A pennak cu hlorh a si lai."},"8":{"text":"Pathian nih Izipt ram in a chuahpi; Fungtum ki bantuk a ngei, A ral miphun dang hna kha a ei dih hna lai i An ruh kha a khuai dih cikcek lai, Cun a thal in a chunh hna lai."},"9":{"text":"A kun i chiandeih bangin a bawk, Chiandeihpi a lo; aho nih dah an thawh ngam lai? Nanmah thluachuah an petu hna paoh cu thluachuakmi si ve hna seh law, Chiat an serhtu hna paoh cu chiat serh si ve hna seh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 12.3; 49.9"},"10":{"text":"Cun Balaam cungah cun Balak thinhunnak cu a alh i a kut aa tum i Balak nih cun Balaam cu, “Ka ral hna chiatserh awkah kan kawh i zohhmanh, hi voi thum tiang thluachuah na pek hna.","title":"Balaam Hmailei Kong"},"11":{"text":"Cucaah na umnak ah zam ko kun; ‘Kan hlorh hrimhrim lai,’ tiah ka rak in ti, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cu upatnak hmuh cu an sianh lo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Balaam nih Balak cu, “ ‘Balak nih a inn cu sui le ngun a khat in ka pe hmanh seh law, keimah nawl in a ha siseh a chia siseh tuahnak dingah Bawipa bia cu ka lonh kho lai lo; Bawipa nih a chimmi paoh ka chim ko lai,’ tiah ka sinah na rak thlahmi na lamkal hna kha ka rak chimh hna, a si lo mei?","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Zohhmanh, ka miphun sinah ka kal cang lai; ra ve law, mah miphun nih hin na mi hna cungah hi hnu i an tuah hnga ding cu kan hngalhter lai,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun a konglam chim cu a thawk i, “Beor fapa Balaam bia, A mit auter a simipa bia cu,"},"16":{"text":"Pathian bia a thei i Cung Nung Bik hngalhnak a hngal i, A Lianngan Bik langhnak a hmu i a tlu i, Sihmanhsehlaw a mit huh a si lomi bia cu hihi an si:"},"17":{"text":"Amah cu ka hmuh, sihmanhsehlaw atu i a si bantuk hi a si lo, Amah cu ka zoh, sihmanhsehlaw atu naite i a si bantuk hi a si lo: Jakob chungin arfi pakhat a chuak lai i Israel chungin bawifung pakhat a chuak lai; Moab cal cu a khuai lai i Sheth fapale hna cu a den dih hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Israel vial cu ral ha ngaiin an um lioah, Edom cu pawnchuah a si lai, Seir, a ral hna zong cu, pawnchuah a si ve lai."},"19":{"text":"Jakob thawngin uknak a si lai i Khua chungah a tangmi hna cu hrawh an si lai!” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Amalek lei cu a hei zoh i a konglam chim cu a thawk i, “Amalek cu miphun hna lakah pakhatnak a si, Sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak ah cun rawknak a phan lai,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Ken mi hna lei cu a hei zoh i a konglam chim cu a thawk i, “Na umnak hmun cu a fekmi a si, Na bu cu lungpi chungah a si;"},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Kain cu a iao dih lai. Zei tik tiang dah Asshur nih sal ah an kalpi lai?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun a konglam chim cu a thawk i “Aize! Pathian nih mah hi a tuah tikah ahodah a nung kho lai?"},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Kittim in sangphawlawng an ra lai i Asshur le Eber kha an hrem hna lai i Amah zong rawknak kha a phan lai,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Balaam cu a tho i a umnak hmun ah khan a kal i Balak zong a tlung ve."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel nih Shittim ah an um lioah Moab fanu hna he khan hlawh an hlang ṭi.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Peor I Baal Kha An Biak"},"2":{"text":"Mah mi hna nih hin Israel mi hna cu an pathian sin i rai an thawinak ah khan an sawm hna i an ei ve i an pathian hmaiah khan an kun."},"3":{"text":"Cu bangin Peor i Baal he cun Israel mi cu an i khitbanh i, Bawipa thinhunnak cu Israel cungah a alh;"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i, “An haotu vialte kha la hna law, Bawipa hmaiah ni tlang ah thlai hna, Bawipa thinhunnak ṭihnung a simi cu Israel sinin aa mer nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Israel mi biaceihtu hna sinah cun, “Nan mi hna lakah Peor i Baal he aa khitbanh chihmi paoh cu nan thah hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, Israel mi pakhat cu a ra i Midian minu pakhat cu a innchungkhar hna sinah aa luhpi; mah cucu Moses hmuh le Israel mibu an ningpi hmuh ah a si, tonnak thlam innka i an ṭah lioah khan."},"7":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Aaron fapa Eleazar i fapa Phinehas nih mah cucu a hmuh tikah a tho i aa pummi sin khan a chuak i a kut in fei a put i"},"8":{"text":"Israel mipa cu innchung chin dal pakhat ah khan a hei zulh i, an pahnih in a chunh hna, Israel mipa le cu minu cu, minu cu a paw ah. Cucaah Israel mi sinin rai cu kham khawh a si."},"9":{"text":"Asinain cu rai in a thimi cu sang hnih le thong li an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu,"},"11":{"text":"“Tlangbawi Aaron fapa Eleazar i fapa Phinehas nih Israel mi sinin ka thinhunnak cu a mer cang, zeitintiah annih cu keimah nih ka ṭanh hna bangin a ṭanh ve hna, cucaah ka nahchuahnak nih Israel mi cu a that dih hna lo."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah hi bangin, ‘Zohhmanh, amah cu ka daihnak biakamnak ka pek;"},"13":{"text":"mah cucu amah ca le a hnu i a tefa hna caah dong lo tlangbawi sinak biakamnak a si lai, zeicahtiah a Pathian kha a ṭanh i Israel mi caah remnak a ser,’ tiah va chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Midian nu he thahmi Israel mipa min cu Salu fapa Zimri a si; amah cu Simeon phun chung i hrin pakhat lu a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun thahmi Midian minu cu Zur fanu Kozbi a si; Zur cu Midian miphun chung i hrin pakhat lu a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu,"},"17":{"text":"“Midian mi hna cu awlokchonh hna u law, that hna u,"},"18":{"text":"zeitintiah Peor ruang i rai a tlun ni i thahmi Midian bawi fanu, an far, Kozbi kong le Peor kong i an in hlen hnanak khan annih nih awlok an in chonh hna,” tiah a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rai a tlun hnuah Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron fapa tlangbawi Eleazar cu a chawnh hna i,","title":"Moab Ah Israel Mi Kha An Rel Hna","ref":"Nam 1.1-46"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mibu cu a ningpi in rel tuah u, kum kul ri in a cunglei an phunphun in, Israel mi chungah phaw nam tlai kho vialte,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Moses le tlangbawi Eleazar nih Moab nelrawn Jordan tivakam Jeriko zawn ah khan an chimh hna i,"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan, “Kum kul ri in a cunglei paoh mi kha rel hna u,” tiah an ti hna. Izipt ram in a chuakmi Israel mi cu mah hi an si:"},"5":{"text":"Israel fater cu Reuben; Reuben fapa hna cu: Hanok, Hanok chung hna pa; Pallu, Pallu chung hna pa;"},"6":{"text":"Hezron, Hezron chung hna pa; Karmi, Karmi chung hna pa an si."},"7":{"text":"Mah hihi Reuben mi chungkhar hna cu an si i an minung cu sang li thong thum za sarih le sawm thum an si."},"8":{"text":"Pallu fapa hna cu: Eliab."},"9":{"text":"Eliab fapa hna cu: Nemuel, Dathan le Abiram an si. Mah hna hi Dathan le Abiram, mibu chungin thimmi, Korah he i komh in Moses le Aaron a dohtu kha an si. Bawipa kha an doh tikah"},"10":{"text":"vawlei nih khan a ka a an i Korah he khan hmunkhat ah a dolh hna i, mei i minung za hnih le sawm nga a kangh hna tikah khan cu bu cu a thi; annih cu ralrinnak ah an cang."},"11":{"text":"Asinain, Korah fapa hna cu an thi lo."},"12":{"text":"Simeon fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Nemuel, Nemuel chung hna pa; Jamin, Jamin chung hna pa; Jakin, Jakin chung hna pa;"},"13":{"text":"Zerah, Zerah chung hna pa; Shaul, Shaul chung hna pa an si."},"14":{"text":"Mah hna hi Simeon mi chungkhar hna cu an si, sang hnih thong hnih le za hnih."},"15":{"text":"Gad fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Zefon, Zefon chung hna pa; Haggi, Haggi chung hna pa; Shuni, Shuni chung hna pa;"},"16":{"text":"Ozni, Ozni chung hna pa; Eri, Eri chung hna pa;"},"17":{"text":"Arod, Arod chung hna pa; Areli, Areli chung hna pa."},"18":{"text":"Mah hna hi Gad fapa hna chungkhar cu an si, an minung cu sang li le za nga an si."},"19":{"text":"Judah fapa cu Er le Onan an si i Er le Onan cu Kanaan ram ah an thi."},"20":{"text":"Cun Judah fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Shelah, Shelah chung hna pa; Perez, Perez chung hna pa; Zerah, Zerah, chung hna pa an si."},"21":{"text":"Cun Perez fapa hna cu: Hezron, Hezron chung hna pa; Hamul, Hamul chung hna pa an si."},"22":{"text":"Mah hna hi Judah mi chungkhar hna cu an si, an minung cu sang sarih thong ruk le za nga an si."},"23":{"text":"Issakhar fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Tola, Tola chung hna pa; Puvah, Puvah chung hna pa;"},"24":{"text":"Jashub, Jashub chung hna pa; Shimron, Shimron chung hna pa an si."},"25":{"text":"Mah hna hi Issakhar chungkhar hna an si, an minung cu sang ruk thong li le za thum."},"26":{"text":"Zebulun fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Sered, Sered chung hna pa; Elon, Elon chung hna pa; Jahleel, Jahleel chung hna pa an si."},"27":{"text":"Mah hna hi Zebulun chungkhar hna cu an si, an minung cu sang ruk le za nga."},"28":{"text":"Josef fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Manasseh le Efraim an si."},"29":{"text":"Manasseh fapa hna cu: Makhir, Makhir chung hna pa; Makhir cu Gilead pa a si; Gilead cu, Gilead chung hna pa a si."},"30":{"text":"Mah hna hi Gilead fapa cu an si: Iezer, Iezer chung hna pa; Helek, Helek chung hna pa;"},"31":{"text":"Asriel, Asriel chung hna pa; Shekhem, Shekhem chung hna pa;"},"32":{"text":"Shemida, Shemida chung hna pa le Hefer, Hefer chung hna pa an si."},"33":{"text":"Cun Hefer fapa Zelofehad cu fapa a ngei lo, fanu lawng a ngeih hna: Zelofehad fanu hna an min cu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah le Tirzah an si."},"34":{"text":"Mah hna hi Manasseh chungkhar hna cu an si, an minung cu sang nga thong hnih le za sarih an si."},"35":{"text":"Efraim fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Shuthelah, Shuthelah chung hna pa; Bekher, Bekher chung hna pa; Tahan, Tahan chung hna pa an si."},"36":{"text":"Cun Shuthelah fapa hna cu: Eran, Eran chung hna pa an si."},"37":{"text":"Mah hna hi Efraim fapa hna chungkhar hna cu an si, a minung sang thum thong hnih le za nga an si. Mah hna hi an chung ning cio in Josef fapa hna cu an si."},"38":{"text":"Benjamin fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Bela, Bela chung hna pa; Ashbel, Ashbel chung hna pa; Ahiram, Ahiram chung hna pa;"},"39":{"text":"Shefufam, Shefufam chung hna pa; Hufam, Hufam chung hna pa an si."},"40":{"text":"Bela fapa hna cu Ard le Naaman an si: Ard cu Ard chung hna pa; Naaman cu Naaman chung hna pa."},"41":{"text":"Mah hna hi an chungkhar ning cio in Benjamin fapa hna cu an si, an minung cu sang li thong nga le za ruk an si."},"42":{"text":"Dan fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Shuham, Shuham chung hna pa cu an si. Mah hna hi an chung ning cio in Dan chungkhar hna cu an si."},"43":{"text":"Shuham chungkhar vialte hna cu an minung sang ruk thong li le za li an si."},"44":{"text":"Asher fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Imnah, Imnah chung hna pa; Ishvi, Ishvi chung hna pa; Beriah, Beriah chung hna pa an si."},"45":{"text":"Beriah fapa hna cu: Heber, Heber chung hna pa; Malkhiel, Malkhiel chung hna pa an si."},"46":{"text":"Asher fanu min cu Serah a si."},"47":{"text":"Mah hna hi Asher fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in an si, an minung cu sang nga thong thum le za li an si."},"48":{"text":"Naftali fapa hna cu an chung ning cio in: Jahzeel, Jahzeel chung hna pa; Guni, Guni chung hna pa;"},"49":{"text":"Jezer, Jezer chung hna pa; Shillem, Shillem chung hna pa an si."},"50":{"text":"Mah hna hi Naftali chungkhar hna cu an chung ning cio ah an si, an minung cu sang li thong nga le za li an si."},"51":{"text":"Mah hihi Israel mi hna an minung cu an si, sing ruk, thong khat, za sarih le sawm thum."},"52":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Ram Cu Camcawh Fung In Cheu Awk","ref":"Nam 34.13; Jos 14.1-2"},"53":{"text":"“Ram cu mah hna hi ro caah cheuh awk an si lai, an min relnak bangin."},"54":{"text":"Phun ngan deuh cu vo ngan deuh na pek lai i phun hme deuh cu vo hme deuh na pek lai; an phun dihlak in an minung rel ning cio ah an ro cu na pek hna lai."},"55":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ram cu camcawh fung khiah in phawt a si lai; an pupa hna phun min ning cio ah an co lai."},"56":{"text":"An vo cu camcawh fung khiah ningin a ngan deuh siseh a hme deuh siseh phawt an si lai."},"57":{"text":"Mah hna hi an chung ning cio ah relmi Levi mi cu an si: Gershon, Gershon chung hna pa; Kohath, Kohath chung hna pa; Merari, Merari chung hna pa.","title":"Levi Miphun Kong"},"58":{"text":"Mah hna hi Levi innchungkhar hna cu an si: Libni chung, Hebron chung, Mahli chung, Mushi chung, Korah chung, Kohath cu Amram pa a si."},"59":{"text":"Amram nupi min cu Levi fanu Jokhebed a si i Izipt ram ah Levi nih a hrinmi a si; cun Amram cu Aaron le Moses le an far Miriam a hrinpiak."},"60":{"text":"Cun Aaron nih Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar a hrin hna.","ref":"Nam 3.2"},"61":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nadab le Abihu cu Bawipa hmai i mei thianglo an pekchanh tikah khan an thi.","ref":"Lev 10.1-2; Nam 3.4"},"62":{"text":"Cun annih lak i relmi, thla khat ri in a cunglei pa hna cu, sang hnih le thong thum an si; annih cu Israel mi lakah rel an si lo, zeitintiah Israel mi lakah annih cu ro pek an si lo."},"63":{"text":"Moab nelrawn, Jordan tiva kam, Jeriko zawn ah Israel mi cu a reltu hna, Moses le tlangbawi Eleazar nih an relmi hna cu mah hna hi an si.","title":"Joshua le Kaleb An Nung"},"64":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mah hna lak ah hin Sinai ramlak i Israel mi a rak reltu hna Moses le tlangbawi Aaron nih an rak relmi hna cu pakhat hmanh an i tel lo."},"65":{"text":"Zeitintiah annih cu Bawipa nih, “Ramlak ah an thi lai,” ti ah khan a rak ti. Jefunneh fapa Kaleb le Nun fapa Joshua dah ti lo cu annih lakah pakhat hmanh an taang lo.","ref":"Nam 14.26-35"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Josef fapa Manasseh innchungkhar hna chung i Manasseh fapa Makhir i fapa Gilead i fapa Hefer i fapa Zelofehad fanu hna cu an ra, a fanu hna an min cu Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah an si.","title":"Zelofehad Fanu Hna I Nawlnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun Moses le tlangbawi Eleazar le mi bupi le an hruaitu hna hmaiah cun, tonnak thlam innka ah cun an dir i,"},"3":{"text":"“Kan pa cu ramlak ah khan a thi; amah cu Bawipa doh in aa pummi hna Korah bu chungah khan aa tel lo, sihmanhsehlaw amah sualnak ruangte ah khan a thi ko; cun fapa a ngei lo."},"4":{"text":"Zeicaahdah kan pa min cu amah hrin chungin a loh lai, fapa a ngeih lo ruangah? Kan pa unau hna lakah vo kan pe ve tuah u,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Moses nih an kong cu Bawipa hmaiah a chuahpi."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,"},"7":{"text":"“Zelofehad fanu hna cu an dik ko; an pa unau hna lakah ro na coter ve hna lai i, an pa ro cu annih kha na pek hna lai.","ref":"Nam 36.2"},"8":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna cu, ‘Mipa pakhatkhat cu a thih i fapa a ngeih lo ahcun, a ro cu a fanu kha nan pek lai."},"9":{"text":"Fanu a ngeih lo ahcun, a ro cu a unau hna kha nan pek hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Unau pa a ngeih lo ahcun, a ro cu a pa unau hna kha nan pek hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun a pa nih unau a ngeih lo ahcun, a ro cu a rualchan lakah a nai bikmi rualchan kha nan pek lai i amah nih cun a co lai. Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bangin, Israel mi hna caah nawlbia le phunglam a si lai,’ tiah na chimh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i, “Abarim tlang ah khin hung kai law, Israel mi hna ka pekmi ram cu hung cuan tuah.","title":"Moses Nih Joshua Cu Amah Chaangtu Ah A Thim (Deu 31.1-8)","ref":"Deu 3.23-27; 32.48-52"},"13":{"text":"Cun na hmuh dih in nangmah zong na mi hna sinah pumh na si ve lai, na u Aaron kha pumh a si bang khan,"},"14":{"text":"zeitintiah Zin ramlak i mibu nih an zai lioah khan, an mithmuh ah, ti ah khan, keimah thangṭhat awk i ka bia kha na doh,” tiah a ti. (Hi ti cu Zin ramlak i a ummi Kadesh khua i Meribah ti kha an si.)"},"15":{"text":"Moses nih Bawipa sinah cun,"},"16":{"text":"“ Bawipa, titsa vialte thlarau hna i Pathian nih mibu zohkhenhtu ah mipa pakhat"},"17":{"text":"an hmaiah a kal ding le an hmaiah a ra ding le, a chuahpitu hna le a luhpitu hna ah chia ko seh; Bawipa mibu cu tuukhal ngei lo tuu hna bantukin an si nakhnga lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sia 22.17; Eze 34.5; Mat 9.36; Mar 6.34"},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Moses cu, “Nun fapa Joshua, ruahnak a ngei ngaingaimi kha, la law, a cungah na kut chuang tuah;","ref":"Exo 24.13"},"19":{"text":"tlangbawi Eleazar le mibu a dihlak hmaiah khan dirter law, an mithmuh ah nawlngeihnak kha pe tuah."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah nih amah cu na nawlngeihnak tlawmpal in na thuamh lai, Israel mibu dihlak nih a bia a ngaih nakhnga."},"21":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Eleazar hmaiah khan a dir lai i amah nih Bawipa hmaiah Urim in bia a halpiak lai; amah bia in an chuak lai i amah bia in an lut lai, amah le amah sinah a ummi Israel mi an dihlak in, mibu cu a ning piin,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 28.30; 1Sam 14.41; 28.6"},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin Moses nih a tuah; Joshua cu a lak i tlangbawi Eleazar le mibupi hmaiah khan a dirter i"},"23":{"text":"a cungah a kut a chuan i Bawipa nih Moses a chimh bang khan nawlngeihnak kha a pek.","ref":"Deu 31.23"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu a chawnh i,","title":"Nifatin Pekchanhnak (Exo 29.38-46)"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi cu nawl pe hna law, hi bangin chim hna, ‘Keimah sinah pekchanhmi thil, mei in keimah sin i pekchanhnak ca i ka rawl rimthaw cu, amah caan te ah keimah sin i pekchanh awk kha nan i ralring lai.’"},"3":{"text":"Cun annih cu hi bangin na chimh hna lai, Mah hihi Bawipa sinah mei in nan pekchanhmi thawinak cu a si lai: tlaihlan thawinak caah ni khat hnu ni khat in kum khat a timi tuufa dotla a pa pahnih."},"4":{"text":"Tuufa pakhat cu zinglei ah nan thawi lai i a dang tuufa pakhat cu zanlei ah nan thawi lai;"},"5":{"text":"changvut thawinak caah ṭhuatmi chiti hin cheu li cheu khat he cawhmi changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu khat zong."},"6":{"text":"Sinai Tlang i rimthaw ca i fehtermi tlaihlan khangh thawinak, Bawipa sinah mei in pekchanhmi cu a si."},"7":{"text":"A thlet thawinak cu tuufa pahnih caah khan, hin cheu li cheu khat veve a si lai; hmunthiang ah khan Bawipa caah thlet thawinak mitsur hang cu na thlet lai."},"8":{"text":"Tuufa dang pakhat cu zanlei ah na thawi lai; zinglei i changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak bang khan, mei in thawinak Bawipa sin i rimthaw bantuk khan na thawi lai."},"9":{"text":"“Sabbath ni ah kum khat a timi tuufa dotla a pa pahnih le changvut thawinak caah chiti he cawhmi changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu hnih le a thlet thawinak:","title":"Sabbath le Thla Kip Pekchanhnak"},"10":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah mah hihi sabbath kip i khangh thawinak cu a si."},"11":{"text":"“Cun nan thla a det tik paoh ah Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak nan pekchanh lai: cawtum no pahnih, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa dotla a pa pasarih:"},"12":{"text":"cun cawtum pakhat veve caah changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip ephah cheu hra cheu thum zong; cun tuukawng pakhat caah cun changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip cheu hra cheu hnih;"},"13":{"text":"tuufa hna caah cun changvut thawinak ca i chiti he cawhmi changvut dip cheu hra cheu khat cio; mah hihi rimthaw khangh thawinak Bawipa sin i mei in pekchanhmi cu an si."},"14":{"text":"An thlet thawinak hna cu cawtum caah mitsur hang hin cheu, tuukawng caah hin cheu thum cheu khat, tuufa caah hin cheu li cheu khat an si lai; mah hihi kum chuak in thla kip i khangh thawinak cu a si."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa sin i sual thawinak ca zongah mehehtum pakhat; mah hihi tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a thlet thawinak hlei ah khan pekchanh a si lai."},"16":{"text":"Thla khatnak thla a ni hleilinak ni ah Bawipa lanhtak a si.","title":"Caan Khiah Ngeimi Puai Pekchanhnak (Lev 23.5-14)","ref":"Exo 12.1-13; Deu 16.1-2"},"17":{"text":"Cun hi thla ni hleinga ni ah hin puai a si; ni sarih chung thilnu telh lo changreu ei a si lai.","ref":"Exo 12.14-20; 23.15; 34.18; Deu 16.3-8"},"18":{"text":"A ni khatnak ni ah a thiangmi pumhnak a si lai: rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo,"},"19":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa sin i khangh thawinak mei in thawinak cu nan pekchanh lai; cawtum no pahnih, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa pasarih an si lai; dotla an si kha ṭha tein zoh hna u;"},"20":{"text":"chiti cawhmi changvut dip an changvut thawinak zong kha nan pekchanh lai; cawtum caah ephah cheu hra cheu thum, tuukawng caah cheu hra cheu hnih,"},"21":{"text":"tuufa pasarih caah cheu hra i cheu khat cio nan pekchanh lai;"},"22":{"text":"cun nannih ca i remnak ser awkah, sual thawinak caah meheh a pa pakhat zong."},"23":{"text":"Zinglei khangh thawinak, tlaihlan khangh thawinak hleiah cun, mah hihi nan thawi hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Hi bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in ni sarih chung cu nifate in mei in pekchanhmi rawl, Bawipa ca i rimthaw cu, nan pekchanh lai; tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah khan mah hihi nan pekchanh lai."},"25":{"text":"Cun ni sarihnak ni ah a thiangmi pumhnak nan ngei lai; rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo."},"26":{"text":"“Theipar hmasa bik hna ni ah, zarh hna puai ah Bawipa sin i rawl thar changvut thawinak nan pekchanh tikah, a thiangmi pumhnak nan ngei lai; rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo,","ref":"Exo 23.16; 34.22; Deu 16.9-12"},"27":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak rimthawmi cu nan pekchanh lai: cawtum no pahnih, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa pasarih;"},"28":{"text":"chiti he cawhmi changvut dip in sermi an changvut thawinak zong, cawtum hna caah ephah cheu hra cheu thum cio, tuukawng caah cheu hra cheu hnih,"},"29":{"text":"tuufa pasarih caah cheu hra cheu khat cio;"},"30":{"text":"nan ca i remnak ser awkah meheh a pa pakhat he."},"31":{"text":"Tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak hleiah khan mah hihi an thlet thawinak he nan thawi hna lai. Dotla an si kha ṭha tein zoh hna u."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Thla sarihnak thla a ni khatnak ni ah a thiangmi pumhnak nan ngei lai; rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo. Nannih caah muko tumnak ni a si lai i,"},"2":{"text":"khangh thawinak, Bawipa ca rimthaw cu, nan pekchanh lai: cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa dotla a pa pasarih;"},"3":{"text":"chiti he cawhmi changvut dip an changvut thawinak zong, cawtum caah ephah cheu hra cheu thum, tuukawng caah ephah cheu hra cheu hnih le,"},"4":{"text":"tuufa pasarih hna caah cheu hra cheu khat cio;"},"5":{"text":"cun nannih ca i remnak ser awkah sual thawinak ca i meheh a pa pakhat he;"},"6":{"text":"mah hna hi, thlapa thar i khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le tlai hlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le an thlet thawinak an phunglam ningin, rimthaw Bawipa sin i mei in pekchanhmi hleiah an si."},"7":{"text":"“Hi thla sarihnak thla a ni hra a ni ah hin a thiangmi pumhnak nan ngei lai nan i temhinter lai; rian nan ṭuan lai lo,","ref":"Lev 16.29-34"},"8":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa sinah rimthaw khangh thawinak nan pekchanh lai: cawtum no pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa pasarih; nannih caah do a tlami kha an si lai;"},"9":{"text":"cun chiti he cawhmi changvut dip an changvut thawinak, cawtum caah ephah cheu hra cheu thum, tuukawng caah cheu hra cheu hnih,"},"10":{"text":"tuufa pasarih caah cheu hra cheu khat cio:"},"11":{"text":"remnak ca i sual thawinak le tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le an thlet thawinak hna hleiah sual thawinak caah mehehtum pakhat zong."},"12":{"text":"“Thla sarihnak thla a ni hleinganak ni ah a thiangmi pumhnak nan ngei lai; rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo i ni sarih chung Bawipa caah puai nan ulh lai;"},"13":{"text":"mei in pekchanhmi khangh thawinak Bawipa ca i rimthaw cu nan pekchanh lai, cawtum no hleithum, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa hleili; dotla an si lai;"},"14":{"text":"cun chiti he cawhmi changvut dip in sermi an changvut thawinak cawtum hleithum hna caah khan ephah cheu hra cheu thum cio, tuukawng pahnih hna caah khan cheu hra cheu hnih cio,"},"15":{"text":"tuufa hleili hna caah khan cheu hra cheu khat cio;"},"16":{"text":"cun tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak caah mehehtum pakhat zong."},"17":{"text":"“Ni hnihnak ni ah cawtum no hleihnih, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"18":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ningin cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna sa i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"19":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le an thlet thawinak hna hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"20":{"text":"“Ni thumnak ni ah cawtum hleikhat, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"21":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ningin cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna ca i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"22":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"23":{"text":"“Ni linak ni ah cawtum pahra, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"24":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ningin cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna ca i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"25":{"text":"tlai hlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"26":{"text":"“Ni nganak ni ah cawtum pakua, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"27":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ning in cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna ca i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"28":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak hna le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"29":{"text":"“Ni ruknak ni ah cawtum pariat, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"30":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ningin cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna ca i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"31":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le an thlet thawinak hna hlei ah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"32":{"text":"“Ni sarihnak ni ah cawtum pasarih, tuukawng pahnih, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla hleili,"},"33":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ningin cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna ca i changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"34":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"35":{"text":"“Ni riatnak ni ah a liannganmi pumhnak nan ngei lai: rian fak nan ṭuan lai lo,"},"36":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw mei in pekchanhmi, Bawipa ca i rimthaw khangh thawinak cu nan pekchanh lai: cawtum pakhat, tuukawng pakhat, kum khat a timi tuufa a pa dotla pasarih,"},"37":{"text":"a phunglam ning le an tlawmtam ning in cawtum le tuukawng le tuufa hna caah changvut thawinak le thlet thawinak hna he khan;"},"38":{"text":"tlaihlan khangh thawinak le a changvut thawinak le a thlet thawinak hleiah sual thawinak ca i mehehtum pakhat zong."},"39":{"text":"“Nan biakam thawinak hna le nan lung tho tein thawinak hna hlei ah, mah hna hi nan khangh thawinak hna le nan changvut thawinak hna le nan thlet thawinak hna le nan daihnak thawinak hna caah a caan khiahmi puai hna ah Bawipa sinah nan pekchanh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses cu nawl a pekning te khan Moses nih Israel mi kha zeizong vialte cu a chimh hna."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Moses nih Israel mi hna i an phun hna lu hna sinah cun, “Mah hihi Bawipa nawl pekmi cu a si.","title":"Biakamnak Phung"},"2":{"text":"Mipa pakhatkhat nih Bawipa sinah biakamnak a tuah ah maw, biakamnak in amah le amah cu i ṭem awkah chiat a ser ah maw, a bia cu a hrawk lai lo; a kaa chungin a chuakmi vialte bang khan a tuah lai.","ref":"Deu 23.21-23; Mat 5.33"},"3":{"text":"Asiloah, minu pakhatkhat nih a ngaknut lio a pa inn i a um lioah biakamnak in amah le amah cu i ṭem awkah biakamnak a tuah tikah,"},"4":{"text":"a pa nih a biakamnak le a biahrennak amah le amah aa ṭemnak cu a theih i zeihmanh amah sinah a chim lo ahcun, a biakamnak vialte cu a dir lai i amah le amah aa ṭemnak biahrennak vialte zong a dir ve lai."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, a pa nih a theih ni ah a hnatlak lonak kha a langhter
