Israel mi nih nam in an thahmi hna nakin rial in a thimi cu an tam deuh."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih Amor mi hna cu Israel mi hna sinah a pek hna ni ah Joshua nih Bawipa kha a chawnh i Israel mi hna mithmuh ah, “Ni, Gibeon ah dir peng tuah, Cun Thlapa, nang, Aijalon nelrawn ah,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Miphun nih khan an ral hna cu phu an hlam hna hlantiang, Ni cu a dir peng i thlapa cu a taang. Mah hihi Jashar cauk ah aa ṭial lo mei? Ni cu van laifang ah khin a taang i ni khat pum tluk cu tlak tim loin a um.","ref":"2Sam 1.18"},"14":{"text":"Cu bantuk ni, Bawipa nih minung aw a ngaih ni bantuk kha, cu hlanah siseh cu hnuah siseh a um bal lo; zeitintiah Bawipa nih Israel cu a dohpiak."},"15":{"text":"Cun Joshua le Israel mi vialte cu an riahhmun Gilgal ah cun an kir dih ṭhan."},"16":{"text":"Hi siangpahrang panga hna cu an zaam i Makkedah i lungkua ah an i thup"},"17":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu, “Siangpahrang panga hna kha an hmuh cang hna, Makkedah i lungkua ah an i thup ko,’ tiah an chimh."},"18":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih, “Lungkua kaa ah cun lung ngan pipi hril hna u, cun a pawngah anmah cawngtu ah mi chia hna u;"},"19":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw cuka ah cun nannih cu um hlah u, nan ral kha dawi hna u, an hnu dawn pawl kha tlak phuat hna u, an khua chungah khan luhter hrimhrim hna hlah u; zeitintiah Bawipa nan Pathian nih annih cu nan kut chungah an pek cang hna,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Joshua le Israel mi hna nih an ci a mih hlantiang an thah cikcek hna tik le a tangmi tete hna cu kulhmi khua chungah an luh tikah,"},"21":{"text":"mi vialte cu him tein Joshua sinah Makkedah riahhmun ah cun an kir; Israel mi ahohmanh kha, pakhat hmanh nih bia an chim ngam lo."},"22":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih, “Lungkua kaa kha hung u law, lungkua chung khan siangpahrang panga hna kha ka sinah rak chuahpi tuah hna u,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cu bangin an tuah i lungkua chung khan siangpahrang panga hna kha a sinah an chuahpi hna, Jerusalem siangpahrang, Hebron siangpahrang, Jarmuth siangpahrang, Lakhish siangpahrang le Eglon siangpahrang hna cu."},"24":{"text":"Cun cu siangpahrang hna cu Joshua sinah an chuahpi hna tikah, Joshua nih Israel mi vialte kha a kawh hna i amah sinah a kalmi ralkap hna bawi hna sinah khan, “Rak ka naih tuah u, hi siangpahrang hna hngawng hi lam tuah hna u,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih annih sinah, “Nan thin phang hlah u, nan lung zong dong hlah u; ṭhawng u law, ralṭha ngaiin um tuah u; zeicahtiah Bawipa nih nan dohmi hna nan ral vialte cungah kha bang khan a tuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun a hnuah Joshua nih a tuk hna i a thah hna i thingkung panga cungah a thlai hna. Cun thingkung cungah cun zanlei tiang an i thlai;"},"27":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ni a tlak cuahmah tikah, Joshua nih nawl a pek hna i thingkung cung khan an ṭhumh hna i, an i thuhnak lungkua chungah khan an hlonh hna i lungkua kaa cu lung ngan pipi in an khar, nihin ni tiang hrimhrim hin a um ko."},"28":{"text":"Cun khi ni ah Joshua nih Makkedah cu a lak i cu khua le a siangpahrang cu vainam in a sam dih hna; a chung i a ummi paohpaoh cu a thah dih hna, pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo; cun Jeriko siangpahrang cungah a tuah bang khan Makkedah siangpahrang cungah cun a tuah."},"29":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu a sinah a ummi Israel mi vialte he Makkedah in Libnah ah an va lan i Libnah kha an doh;"},"30":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih cu khua cu an siangpahrang he tiah Israel mi kut chungah a pek hna; cu khua cu a chung i a ummi vialte he vainam in a sam dih hna; pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo; Jeriko siangpahrang cungah a tuah bang khan an siangpahrang cungah cun a tuah."},"31":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu a sinah a ummi Israel mi vialte hna he Libnah in Lakhish ah an va lan i an kulh i an tuk:"},"32":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih Lakhish khua cu Israel mi kut chungah a pek i a ni hnihnak ni ah a lak i cu khua cu a chung i a ummi vialte he vainam in a sam, Libnah cung i a tuah bantuk khan."},"33":{"text":"Cun Gezer siangpahrang Horam cu Lakhish bawmh awkah a hung kal i, Joshua nih amah he a mi hna he, pakhat hmanh taang lo tiangin, a thah hna."},"34":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu Israel mi vialte he Lakhish in Eglon ah an va lan; cun an kulh i an doh;"},"35":{"text":"cu ni ah cun an lak i vainam in an sam dih; cu khua chung i a ummi paoh cu khi ni ah a hrawh cikcek hna, Lakhish cung i a tuah bang khan."},"36":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu Israel mi vialte he Eglon in Hebron ah an hung kal i an hung doh;"},"37":{"text":"an lak i a siangpahrang he a khua hna he, a chung i a ummi vialte hna he, vainam in an sam dih hna; pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo, Eglon cungah a tuah bantuk khan, a chung i a ummi vialte he a hrawh dih cikcek."},"38":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu Israel mi vialte he Debir leiah aa mer i a doh,"},"39":{"text":"a siangpahrang he a khua hna he a lak dih; vainam in an sam dih hna i a chung i a ummi vialte cu an hrawh cikcek hna; pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo; Hebron cung le Libnah le a siangpahrang cung i a tuah bang khan Debir le a siangpahrang cungah a tuah."},"40":{"text":"Cu bangin Joshua nih ram cu a ning piin, tlangram siseh, Negeb siseh, rawnram siseh, tlangpangzau siseh, an siangpahrang vialte he a tei dih hna; pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo, Bawipa Israel Pathian nih nawl a pek bang khan thaw a chuah paohpaoh cu a hrawh dih cikcek hna."},"41":{"text":"Joshua nih annih cu Kadesh-barnea in Gaza tiang a tei hna. Goshen ram vialte zong Gibeon tiangin."},"42":{"text":"Bawipa Israel Pathian nih Israel mi cu a dohpi hna caah Joshua nih hi siangpahrang vialte hna le an ram cu ṭum khat ah a lak dih hna."},"43":{"text":"Cun Joshua cu amah sinah a ummi Israel mi vialte he Gilgal i an riahhmun ah cun an kir ṭhan."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun hi kong cu Hazor siangpahrang Jabin nih a theih tikah, Madon siangpahrang Jobab le Shimron siangpahrang le Akhshaf siangpahrang le","title":"Jabin Sinah Aa Ṭommi An Tei"},"2":{"text":"chaklei tlangram i a ummi siangpahrang hna le Khinneroth thlang Arabah i a ummi siangpahrang hna le rawnram i a ummi siangpahrang hna le nitlaklei Nafoth-dor i a ummi siangpahrang hna le"},"3":{"text":"nichuahlei le nitlaklei i a ummi Kanaan mi hna le, tlangram i a ummi Amor mi hna, Hit mi hna, Periz mi hna le Jebus mi hna le Hermon tang Mizpah ram i a ummi Hiv mi hna cu bia a cah hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun an ralkap vialte hna le an rang le an rangleng tampi hna he tiah an ra chuak ciammam i, bu nganpi, an tam ning cu rili kam i thetse zat hrimhrim an si."},"5":{"text":"Cun hi siangpahrang vialte hna nih cun an ralkapbu vialte cu an fonh hna i Israel mi kha doh awkah Merom ti ah cun an ra i an riak,"},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Joshua cu a chawnh i, “Annih kha ṭih hna hlah, zeicahtiah thaizing atu tikah hin an dihlak in thah cia in Israel mi sinah ka pek hna lai; an rang cu an tha nan pheh hna lai i an rangleng cu mei in nan khangh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah Joshua le a ralkap vialte hna nih cun Merom ti pawngah cun duak tiah an va pauh hna i an nam colh hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih annih cu Israel mi kut chungah a pek hna i an thah hna i, Sidon Ngan le Misrefoth-maim tiang, cun nichuahlei ah Mizpah nelrawn tiang an dawi hna; pakhat hmanh an taan ti lo tiang an thah lengmang hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih a fial bantukin Joshua nih an cungah a tuah; an rang kha an tha an pheh hna i an rangleng kha mei in a khangh hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun khi caan ah Joshua cu a let i Hazor kha a lak, an siangpahrang cu vainam in a thah; zeitintiah Hazor cu hmasa ah cun cu peng vialte hna lu cu a si."},"11":{"text":"A chungah a ummi vialte cu vainam in an thah dih hna i an hrawh cikcek hna; thaw a chuahmi pakhat hmanh an zuah lo; Hazor cu mei in a khangh."},"12":{"text":"Cun cu siangpahrang hna khua vialte le an siangpahrang hna cu Joshua nih a lak hna i vainam in a thah hna, a hrawh cikcek hna, Bawipa sal Moses nih nawl a rak pek bang khan."},"13":{"text":"Mual cung i a ummi khua hna tu cu, Joshua nih a khanghmi Hazor dah ti lo cu, Israel mi nih an khang hna lo."},"14":{"text":"Cun hi khua hranchaw vialte hna le saṭil hna cu Israel mi nih hranchaw ah an i lak dih; sihmanhsehlaw mi cu an hrawh dih hna hlantiang nam in an thah hna i thaw a chuahmi pakhat hmanh an ngan ta hna lo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nih a sal Moses kha nawl a pek bangin Moses nih Joshua kha nawl a pek chin i cu bang cun Joshua nih a tuah; Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi vialte kha pakhat hmanh a hrelhmi an um lo."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Joshua nih cu ram vialte, tlangram le Negeb vialte le Goshen ram vialte le rawnram le Arabah le Israel tlangram le a rawnram cu,","title":"Joshua Nih Ram Cu A Tei Dih"},"17":{"text":"Seir lei i a hung kaimi Halak Tlang in Hermon Tlang tang i a ummi Lebanon nelrawn i a ummi Baal-gad tiangin a lak dih hna. Cun an siangpahrang vialte kha a lak hna i a tuk hna i a thah hna."},"18":{"text":"Joshua nih cu siangpahrang hna he cun saupi an i do."},"19":{"text":"Gibeon i a ummi Hiv mi hna dah ti lo cu Israel mi hna he remnak a tuahmi khua pakhat hmanh an um lo, an dihlak in raldohnak i an lakmi an si dih."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bangin hrawh cikcek an si i zaangfahnak um loin hloh cikcek an si nakhnga, an lung ṭhawnter i Israel mi hna doh cu Bawipa tuahmi a si.","ref":"Deu 7.16"},"21":{"text":"Cun khi caan ah Joshua cu a ra i tlangram a simi Hebron, Debir, Anab le Judah tlangram vialte in le Israel tlangram vialte in Anak mi cu a hloh dih hna; Joshua nih an khua hna he a hrawh cikcek hna."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi ram chungah Anak mi cu pakhat hmanh an tang lo; Gaza le Gath le Ashdod lawngah tlawmpal an tang."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih Moses sinah a rak chim cangmi vialte bantuk khan Joshua nih ram cu a ning piin a lak i an phun ning cio i phawtning khan Joshua nih Israel mi hna sinah ro caah a pek hna. Cun ram cu ral in aa din."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mah hna hi Israel mi nih an tei i an ram an chuhmi hna, Jordan tiva ral nichuahlei ram, Arnon nelrawn in Hermon Tlang tiang, Arabah in nichuahlei paohpaoh ram siangpahrang hna cu an si;","title":"Moses Nih A Teimi Siangpahrang Hna","ref":"Nam 21.21-35; Deu 2.26—3.11"},"2":{"text":"Heshbon khua ah a ummi Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon. A uknak cu Arnon tiva nelrawn kam i a ummi Aroer khua in le cu nelrawn laifang in Ammon mi ramri Jabbok tiva tiang a si, cucu Gilead ram hnarcheu a si,"},"3":{"text":"cun Arabah zong, Khinneroth Rili tiang nichuahlei kam zuahmah in, cun Beth-jeshimoth leiah Arabah rili tiang, cucu Cite Rili a si, cun thlanglei ah Pisgah tlangpangzau hram tiangin."},"4":{"text":"Cun, Refaim mi lakin a taangmi pakhat Bashan siangpahrang Og zong. Amah cu Ashtaroth le Edrei khua ah a um."},"5":{"text":"Amah nih Hermon Tlang le Salekah le Bashan vialte, Geshur mi hna le Maakath mi hna ramri tiang, cun Gilead ram hnarcheu Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon ramri tiangin a uk."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa sal Moses le Israel mi hna nih an tei hna; Bawipa sal Moses nih cun an ram cu Reuben mi le Gad mi le Manasseh phun cheu hna sinah khan ro caah a pek hna.","ref":"Nam 32.33; Deu 3.12"},"7":{"text":"Jordan tiva nitlaklei ah, Lebanon nelrawn i a ummi Baal-gad in Seir leiah a hung kaimi Halak Tlang tiang i, Joshua le Israel mi nih an teimi, cu ram siangpahrang hna cu mah hna hi an si cun Joshua nih an ram cu Israel miphun hna sinah khan an i ṭhenhning in ro caah a pek hna, —","title":"Joshua Nih A Teimi Hna"},"8":{"text":"tlangram ah siseh, rawnram ah siseh, Arabah ah siseh, tlangpang zau ah siseh, ramlak ah siseh, Negeb ah siseh, cucu Hit mi le Amor mi le Kanaan mi le Periz mi le Hiv mi le Jebus mi hna ram an si):"},"9":{"text":"Jeriko siangpahrang, pakhat; Bethel pawngah a ummi Ai siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem siangpahrang, pakhat; Hebron siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"11":{"text":"Jarmuth siangpahrang, pakhat; Lakhish siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"12":{"text":"Eglon siangpahrang, pakhat; Gezer siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"13":{"text":"Debir siangpahrang, pakhat; Geder siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"14":{"text":"Hormah siangpahrang, pakhat; Arad siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"15":{"text":"Libnah siangpahrang, pakhat; Adullam siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"16":{"text":"Makkedah siangpahrang, pakhat; Bethel siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"17":{"text":"Tappuah siangpahrang, pakhat; Hefer siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"18":{"text":"Afek siangpahrang, pakhat; Lasharon siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"19":{"text":"Madon siangpahrang, pakhat; Hazor siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"20":{"text":"Shimron-meron siangpahrang, pakhat; Akhshaf siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"21":{"text":"Taan-akh siangpahrang, pakhat; Megiddo siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"22":{"text":"Kedesh siangpahrang, pakhat; Karmel ah a ummi Jokneam siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"23":{"text":"Nafath-dor ah a ummi Dor siangpahrang, pakhat; Galilee ah a ummi Goi-im siangpahrang, pakhat;"},"24":{"text":"Tirzah siangpahrang, pakhat; an dihlak in siangpahrang sawm thum le pakhat an si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu cu Joshua cu a upa i a tar ngaingai cang. Bawipa nih a chawnh i, “Nang cu na upa i na tar ngaingai cang, asinain co awk ram tampi a um rih.","title":"Tei Rih Lomi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Mah hihi a tang rihmi ram cu a si; Filistin mi hna ram a dihlak le Geshur mi ram a dihlak."},"3":{"text":"(Izipt nichuahlei i a ummi Shihor in chaklei ah Ekron ramri tiang, mah cucu Kanaan mi ram ah rel a si; cun Filistin bawi panga an um, Gaza i le Ashdod i le Ashkelon i le Gath i le Ekron i hna cu an si),"},"4":{"text":"cun thlanglei ah Avvim mi hna ram zong, Kanaan mi hna ram vialte le Sidon mi ta a simi Mearah, Amor mi hna ramri Afek tiang le,"},"5":{"text":"Gebal mi hna ram le nichuahlei ah Lebanon vialte, Hermon Tlang tang i a ummi Baal-gad in Hamath khua luhnak tiang,"},"6":{"text":"tlang ram i a ummi vialte Lebanon in Misrefoth-maim tiang, Sidon mi vialte hna cu. Keimah hrimhrim nih Israel mi hna hmai in ka dawi hna lai; nawl kan pek bantuk khan ram cu Israel mi hna sinah ro caah a cheuh tu cu rak cheu ko hna.","ref":"Nam 33.54"},"7":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu hi ram hi phun kua le Manasseh phun cheu hna kha ro caah cheu tuah hna,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"A dang Manasseh phun cheu hna he cun, Reuben mi le Gad mi nih Moses nih a pek hna bang khan an ro kha an co, Jordan ral nichuahlei ah khan, Bawipa sal Moses nih a pek hna bang khan:","ref":"Nam 32.33; Deu 3.12"},"9":{"text":"Arnon tiva nelrawn ri ah a ummi Aroer khua thawk in, cu nelrawn laifang ah a ummi khua le Medeba tlangrawn ram vialte Dibon tiangin;"},"10":{"text":"cun Heshbon ah a ummi Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon khua vialte, Ammon mi hna ramri tiang;"},"11":{"text":"cun Gilead ram le Geshur mi hna le Maakath mi hna ram le, Hermon tlang vialte le, Bashan dihlak Salekah tiangin;"},"12":{"text":"Ashtaroth le Edrei in a pengtu Bashan siangpahrang Og pennak vialte (Refaim mi hna lakin a taangmi hna lakah amah lawng cu a tang); mah hna hi Moses nih a tei hna i a dawi hna."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Geshur mi si hna seh, Maakath mi si hna seh, Israel mi nih an dawi hna lo; Geshur le Maakath cu nihin ni tiang hin Israel mi lakah an um ko."},"14":{"text":"Levi phun lawng kha Moses nih ro a pek lomi cu a si; Bawipa Israel Pathian sinah mei in pekchanhmi thil cu, a chimh cang bang khan annih ro cu a si.","title":"Moses Nih Vo A Pekmi Hna","ref":"Deu 18.1"},"15":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Reuben miphun cu an innchungkhar ning cio ah ro a pek hna."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah an ram cu Arnon nelrawn ri ah a ummi Aroer khua in le, nelrawn laifang ah a ummi khuapi le, Medeba hrawng tlangrawn ram vialte cu a si;"},"17":{"text":"Heshbon le tlangrawn ram chungah a ummi khua vialte he; Dibon le Bamoth-baal le Beth-baal-meon le"},"18":{"text":"Jahaz le Kedemoth le Mefaath le"},"19":{"text":"Kiriathaim le Sibmah le nelrawn tlang cungah a ummi Zereth-shahar le"},"20":{"text":"Beth-peor le Pisgah tlangpang zau le Beth-jeshimoth zong,"},"21":{"text":"cucu tlangrawn ram khua vialte le Heshbon i bawi a simi Amor siangpahrang Sihon pennak vialte cu a si. Moses nih amah cu Midian mi hruaitu hna Evi le Rekem le Zur le Hur le Reba, Sihon bawi ram chungah a ummi hna he cun a tei."},"22":{"text":"Beor fapa Balaam, camthiammi zong kha Israel mi nih an thahmi hna lakah khan vainam in an thah chih ve."},"23":{"text":"Reuben mi hna ramri cu Jordan tiva cu a si. Mah hihi Reuben mi hna nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi ram cu a si, an khuapi hna le an khuate hna he tiah."},"24":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Gad miphun zong an innchungkhar ning cio ah ro a pek hna."},"25":{"text":"An ram cu mah hna hi a si: Jazer le, Gilead ram khua vialte le, Ammon mi hna ram hnarcheu, Rabbah nichuahlei ah a ummi Aroer tiang,"},"26":{"text":"cun Heshbon in Ramath-mizpeh le Betonim tiang, cun Mahanaim in Debir ram tiang,"},"27":{"text":"cun nelrawn chungah Heshbon siangpahrang Sihon pennak a taangmi, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Sukkoth le Zafon; a ramri cu Jordan tiva Khinneroth Rili a thlanglei kam tiang a si; cu ram cu Jordan tiva ral nichuahlei ram cu a si."},"28":{"text":"Mah hihi Gad mi hna nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah, an comi ram cu a si, khuapi hna le a khuate hna he."},"29":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Manasseh phuncheu cu ro a pek; an innchungkhar ning cio in Manasseh phuncheu cu pek a si."},"30":{"text":"An ram cu Mahanaim in Bashan ram vialte a dihlak, Bashan siangpahrang Og pennak vialte cu a ning piin, Bashan chung i a ummi Jair khua vialte, khua sawm ruk hna cu,"},"31":{"text":"cun Gilead ram a cheu le Bashan ram chung i Og nih a penmi ram khuapi Ashtaroth le Edrei. Mah hna hi Manasseh fapa Makhir tefa hna cu pek an si, an innchungkhar ning cio ah Makhir mi hnarcheu cu pek an si."},"32":{"text":"Jordan tiva ral Jeriko in nichuahlei Moab nelrawn chung i Moses nih a phawtmi hna ram cu mah hna hi an si."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Levi phun cu Moses nih ro a pe hna lo; an sinah a rak chim bang khan Bawipa Israel Pathian cu an ro cu a si.","ref":"Nam 18.20; Deu 18.2"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun mah hna hi Kanaan ram chungah Israel mi nih an comi ram cu an si, tlangbawi Eleazar le Num fapa Joshua le Israel tefa hna chung i an phun cio lu hna nih an phawtmi hna cu an si.","title":"Kanaan Ram Cu Camcawhfung Zuh In An I Cheu"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan phun kua le a cheu caah cun an co ning cu camcawh fung zuh in a si,","ref":"Nam 26.52-56; 34.13"},"3":{"text":"zeitintiah Moses nih Jordan tiva ral ah phun hnih le a cheu cu ro kha a pek cang hna; sihmanhsehlaw annih lakah Levi mi hna cu ro a pe hna lo.","ref":"Nam 32.33; 34.14-15; Deu 3.12-17"},"4":{"text":"Josef tefa hna cu phun hnih an si, Manasseh le Efraim; ram chungah Levi mi hna cu vo an pe hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw umnak khua hna le cu pawngkam i caw le saṭil dang tlonnak ram lawnglawng cu pek an si."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pek bang khan Israel mi nih an tuah; ram cu an i ṭhen."},"6":{"text":"Cun Judah phunmi kha Joshua sinah Gilgal ah an ra i Keniz phun Jefunneh fapa Kaleb nih a sinah, “Nangmah le keimah kongah, Bawipa nih Pathian mi Moses sinah Kadesh-barnea ah bia a chimmi kha na hngalh.","title":"Kaleb Cu Hebron Kha An Pek","ref":"Nam 14.30"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa sal Moses nih ram cu hung ngiatthlai awkah Kadesh-barnea in a ka thlah tikah kum sawm li ka rak si; cun ka lungchung i a umning bantuk tein bia cu amah cu ka rak phorh ṭhan.","ref":"Nam 13.1-30"},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw keimah he a hung kal ṭimi ka unau hna nih khan mizapi cu an awlok an chonter hna, sihmanhsehlaw kei tu nih cun Bawipa ka Pathian kha fek tein ka zulh."},"9":{"text":"Cun Moses nih khi ni ah chiat a ser i, ‘ Bawipa ka Pathian cu fek tein na zulh caah, na ke nih a lamhmi ram cu nangmah ca le na tefa hna caah zungzal in ro an si hrimhrim lai,’ tiah a ti.","ref":"Nam 14.24"},"10":{"text":"Cun atu cu, zohhmanh, Bawipa nih a chim bang khan hi kum sawm li le kum nga chung hi Bawipa nih Moses sinah hi bia a chim ri khan a ka nunter, Israel mi nih ramlak ah an vah lioah khan; cun atu cu zohhmanh, nihin ni ah hin kum sawm riat le kum nga ka si."},"11":{"text":"Moses nih a rak ka thlah ni i ka ṭhawn tluk te khan nihin ni tiang ka ṭhawng ko rih; raldohnak caah siseh, kalnak caah siseh, ratnak caah siseh, atu i ka thazang cu kha lio i ka thazang bantuk kha a si ko."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih kha ni ah a rak chimmi tlangram cu atu ah hin ka pe tuah, zeitintiah Anak mi hna nih zeitindah khika ah kulhmi khualipi hna he an um kha, kha ni ah khan na rak theih cang. Bawipa nih a chim bang khan Bawipa nih a hei ka umpi hnga i ka hei ṭhawl khawh ko hna hnga dah kaw,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih thluachuah a pek i Hebron cu Jefunneh fapa Kaleb sinah khan ro caah a pek."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Hebron cu Keniz phun Jefunneh fapa Kaleb ro ah, Bawipa, Israel Pathian kha fek tein a rak zulh caah, nihin ni tiang hin a cang."},"15":{"text":"Hebron khua min cu a hlanah cun Kiriath-arba a rak si; hi Arba cu Anak mi hna lakah mingan bik a rak si. Cun ram cu raldohnak in aa din."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah phun caah an innchungkhar ning cio ah an vo cu thlanglei ah Edom ramri, thlanglei bik ah Zin ramlak tiang a phan.","title":"Judah Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Cun an thlanglei ramri cu Cite Rili kam, thlanglei a zohmi rili fonghlei thawk in a si."},"3":{"text":"Akrabbim i hung kainak thlanglei in a kal i Zin a hei phan, cun Kadesh-barnea thlanglei ah a hung kai, cun Hezron pawng in Addar tiang a kal, cun Karka lei ah aa mer,"},"4":{"text":"Azmon tiang a lan i Izipt Tivate ah a hung chuak; cuticun an ramri cu rili ah a dong. Mah hihi an thlanglei ramri cu a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun nichuahlei an ramri cu Cite Rili a si, Jordan tiva chuak tiang. Cun chaklei kam ramri cu Jordan tiva chuak i rili fonghlei in aa thawk;"},"6":{"text":"cun ramri cu Beth-hoglah ah a hung kai i Beth-arabah chak in a lan; cun ramri cu Reuben fapa Bohan Lung tiang a hung kai;"},"7":{"text":"cun ramri cu Akhor nelrawn in Debir tiang a hung kai; cuticun chaklei ah a kal, cun nelrawn thlanglei kamah a ummi Adummim i hung kainak ralchan i a ummi Gilgal leiah aa mer; cun ramri cu En-shemesh ti tiang a lan i En-rogel ah a dong;"},"8":{"text":"cun ramri cu Jebus mi umnak tlang thlanglei fing (cucu Jerusalem) i Hinnom fapa nelrawn leiah a hung kai; cun ramri cu, nitlaklei ah, Refaim nelrawn chaklei kamah, Hinnom horkuang ralchan i a ummi tlangpar tiang a hung kai;"},"9":{"text":"cun ramri cu tlangpar cun Neftoah Ti a putnak tiang a vung kal i cuka cun Efron Tlang khua hna tiang a lan; cun ramri cu Baalah (cucu Kiriath-jearim) leiah aa kuai i"},"10":{"text":"ramri cu Baalah nitlaklei ah Seir Tlang leiah aa let, Jearim Tlang (cucu Khesalon) chaklei fing kha a zulh i Beth-shemesh tiang a vung kal i Timnah pawng in a lan;"},"11":{"text":"ramri cu Ekron fing tiang chaklei ah a kal, cun Shikkeron leiah aa kuai i Baalah Tlang leiah a kal i Jabneel ah a chuak; cun ramri cu rili ah a dong."},"12":{"text":"Cun nitlaklei ramri cu Rili Ngan le a kam cu a si. Mah hihi Judah phun, an innchungkhar ning cio in, an velchum i an ramri cu a si."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih Joshua nawl a pekmi bangin, Jefunneh fapa Kaleb cu Judah mi hna lakah vo pakhat, Kiriath-arba cu a pek, cucu Hebron a si (Arba cu Anak pa kha a si).","title":"Kaleb Nih Hebron le Debir A Lak Hna (Biac 1.10-15)","ref":"Biac 1.20"},"14":{"text":"Cun Kaleb nih khika in Anak fapa pathum, Sheshai, Ahimah, le Talmai, Anak tefa hna cu, a dawi hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun khika in Debir khuami kha doh awkah a hung kal; hlanah cun Debir min cu Kiriath-sefer a rak si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Kaleb nih, “Kiriath-sefer atu i a latu paoh cu ka fanu Aksah kha nupi ah ka pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Kaleb nau Kenaz fapa Othniel nih a lak i, amah cu a fanu Aksah cu nupi ah a pek."},"18":{"text":"Aksah nih a sinah a rat tikah, a pa kha lo pakhat hal awkah a fial; cun a laa cungin a ṭum i Kaleb nih, “Zei dah na duh?” tiah Aksah cu a ti."},"19":{"text":"Amah nih, “Laksawng pakhat in ka pe tuah; Negeb ram chungah na ka chiah caah, tiput hna zong kha ka pek chih tuah,” a ti. Cun Kaleb nih chaklei tiput hna le thlanglei tiput hna kha a pek chih."},"20":{"text":"Judah phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi ram cu mah hi a si.","title":"Judah Ram Chung Khua Hna"},"21":{"text":"Edom ramri leiah thlanglei bik ah Judah phun i an khua hna cu mah hihi an si: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,"},"22":{"text":"Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,"},"23":{"text":"Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,"},"24":{"text":"Zif, Telem, Bealoth,"},"25":{"text":"Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (cucu Hazor),"},"26":{"text":"Amam, Shema, Moladah,"},"27":{"text":"Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,"},"28":{"text":"Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothia,"},"29":{"text":"Baalah, I-im, Ezem,"},"30":{"text":"Eltolad, Khesil, Hormah,"},"31":{"text":"Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,"},"32":{"text":"Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, le Rimmon; a zapi ah khuapi pakul le pakua an si, an khuate hna he."},"33":{"text":"Cun rawnram ah, Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,"},"34":{"text":"Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,"},"35":{"text":"Jarmuth, Adullam, Sokoh, Azekah,"},"36":{"text":"Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, Gederothaim; khuapi hleili, an khuate hna he."},"37":{"text":"Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,"},"38":{"text":"Dilean, Mizpah, Jokthe-el,"},"39":{"text":"Lakhish, Bozkath, Eglon,"},"40":{"text":"Kabbon, Lahmam, Khitlish,"},"41":{"text":"Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, le Makkedah; khuapi hleiruk, an khuate hna he."},"42":{"text":"Libnah, Ether, Ashan,"},"43":{"text":"Iftah, Ashnah, Nezib,"},"44":{"text":"Keilah, Akhzib, le Mareshah; khuapi pakua, an khuate hna he."},"45":{"text":"Ekron, a khuapi hna le a khuate hna he;"},"46":{"text":"Ekron in rili tiang, Ashdod sir i a ummi vialte, an khuate hna he."},"47":{"text":"Ashdod, a khuapi hna le a khuate hna; Gaza, a khuapi hna le a khuate hna; Izipt tiva le rili ngan le a kam tiang."},"48":{"text":"Cun tlangram ah, Shamir, Jattir, Sokoh,"},"49":{"text":"Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (cucu Debir),"},"50":{"text":"Anab, Eshtemoth, Anim,"},"51":{"text":"Goshen, Holon, le Giloh; khuapi hleikhat, an khuate hna he."},"52":{"text":"Arab, Dumah, Eshan,"},"53":{"text":"Janim, Beth-tappuah, Afekah,"},"54":{"text":"Humtah, Kiriath-arba (cucu Hebron), le Zior; khuapi pakua, an khuate hna he."},"55":{"text":"Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juttah,"},"56":{"text":"Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,"},"57":{"text":"Kain, Gibeah, le Timnah; khuapi pahra, an khuate hna he."},"58":{"text":"Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,"},"59":{"text":"Ma-arath, Beth-anoth, le Eltekon; khuapi paruk, an khuate hna he."},"60":{"text":"Kiriath-baal (cucu Kiriath-jearim), le Rabbah; khuapi pahnih, an khuate hna he."},"61":{"text":"Ramlak ah, Beth-arabah, Middin, Sekakah,"},"62":{"text":"Nibshan, Cite Khua, le En-gedi; khuapi paruk, an khuate hna he."},"63":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jerusalem khuami Jebus mi hna cu Judah mi hna nih an dawi kho hna lo; cucaah nihin ni tiangin Jebus mi hna cu Judah mi hna he Jerusalem ah an um ko.","ref":"Biac 1.21; 2Sam 5.6; 1Cha 11.4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josef tefa hna vo cu Jeriko pawng Jordan tiva Jeriko tiput hna nichuahlei kap in aa thawk i ramlak ah a lut i Jeriko in Bethel tlangram ah a hung kai;","title":"Efraim le Manasseh Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"cun Bethel in Luz ah a kal i Arki mi ram Ataroth ah a lan;"},"3":{"text":"cun nitlaklei ah Jaflet mi hna ram ah a vung kal, thlanglei Beth-horon ram tiang; cun Gezer ah a phan i rili ah a dong."},"4":{"text":"Josef mi Manasseh le Efraim nih an vo ding kha an co."},"5":{"text":"An innchungkhar ning cio ah, Efraim mi hna ram cu a tanglei bangin a si: nichuahlei kamah an vo ramri cu Ataroth-addar, chaklei Beth-horon tiang,"},"6":{"text":"cun ramri cu khika in rili ah a vung kal; chaklei ah ramri cu Mikmethath a si; cun nichuahlei ah ramri cu Taanath-shiloh lei ah aa kuai i a hei lonh i nichuahlei ah Janoah ah a kal,"},"7":{"text":"cun Janoah in Ataroth le Naarah tiang a vung kal, Jeriko kha a hei pal pah i Jordan ah a dong."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah in ramri cu nitlaklei ah a kal i Kanah tivate a phan i rili ah a dong. Cu bantukin Efraim mi hna nih an innchungkhar ning cio in an comi ram cu a si;"},"9":{"text":"Manasseh ram chung i Efraim mi hna caah an chiahmi khua hna, cu khua vialte hna le an khuate hna he cun tiah."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Gezer i a ummi Kanaan mi kha cu an dawi hna lo; cu caah nihin tiangin Kanaan mi hna cu Efraim mi hna lakah an um, sihmanhsehlaw hnekmi rian ṭuan awkah sal ah an cang cang.","ref":"Biac 1.29"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Manasseh phun kha vo pek an si, amah cu Josef fater kha a si. Manasseh fater Makhir, Gilead pa cu ralkap a si caah Gilead le Bashan kha pek a si."},"2":{"text":"Cun Manasseh phun chung i a taang rihmi hna cu an innchungkhar ning cio ah vo phawt an si, Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shekhem, Hefer le Shemida; mah hna hi Josef fapa Manasseh i a tefa hna cu pa lei in an innchungkhar ning cio ah an si."},"3":{"text":"Manasseh fapa Makhir fapa Gilead fapa Hefer i fapa Zelofehad cu fapa a ngei lo, fanu lawnglawng a ngeih hna; mah hna hi a fanule hna min cu an si: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, le Tirzah."},"4":{"text":"Tlangbawi Eleazar le Nun fapa Joshua le haotu hna sinah cun an ra i, “ Bawipa nih Moses cu, kan unau hna sinah covo kan ngeih ve nakhnga, nawl a pek,” tiah an ti. Cucaah Bawipa nawlbia bang cun an pa unau hna lakah cun covo a pek ve hna.","ref":"Nam 27.1-7"},"5":{"text":"Cuticun Manasseh nih vo hra a co, Jordan khattelei ral i a ummi Gilead le Bashan ram hleiah;"},"6":{"text":"zeicahtiah Manasseh fanu hna nih a fapa hna he vo an co ve caah a si. Gilead ram cu Manasseh mi a dang hna nih cun an co."},"7":{"text":"Manasseh ram cu Asher in Shekhem nichuahlei i a ummi Mikmethath tiang a phan; cun ramri cu thlanglei ah En-Tappuah mi umnak tiangin a vung kal."},"8":{"text":"Tappuah ram cu Manasseh ta a si, sihmanhsehlaw Manasseh ramri i a ummi Tappuah khua cu Efraim fapale hna ta a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun ramri cu Kanah tivate ah a vung kal. Hi tivate thlanglei i a ummi, Manasseh khua hna lak i a ummi khua hna hi cu Efraim ta an si. Cun Manasseh ramri cu cu tiva chaklei kam cun a kal i rili ah a dong;"},"10":{"text":"thlanglei kam cu Efraim ram a si i chaklei kam cu Manasseh ram a si, ramri ah cun rili a si; chaklei ah Asher a phan, nichuahlei ah Issakhar a phan."},"11":{"text":"Cun Issakhar le Ahser chung zongah cun Beth-shean le a khuate hna, Ibleam le a khuate hna, Dor le a khuate hna, i a ummi hna Endor le a khuate hna i a ummi hna Taanak le a khuate hna i a ummi hna, Megiddo le a khuate hna i a ummi hna cu Manasseh ta an si; a pathumnak cu Nafath a si."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Manasseh fapa hna nih cu khuami hna cu an pawnchuah kho hna lo; Kanaan mi hna cu cu ram ah cun an i benh peng ve ko.","ref":"Biac 1.27-28"},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi kha an hung ṭhawn tikah Kanaan mi hna cu hnekmi rian kha an ṭuanter hna i an dawi dih cikcek hna lo."},"14":{"text":"Cun Josef phun nih Joshua kha an chawnh i, “Kei cu atu tiangah Bawipa nih thluachuahnak a ka pek caah mi tampi ka si nain, zeicahdah covo pakhat le hmun pakhat lawnglawng na ka pek?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih annih cu, “Nannih cu mi tampi nan si ahcun, tupi ah khin hung kal u law, Periz mi le Refaim mi hna ram ah lo hung vat ngat u, Efraim tlangram cu nan caah a bit tuk ṭung cu ta,” tiah a ti hna."},"16":{"text":"Josef phun nih cun, “Tlangram cu kan caah cun aa za lo; sihmanhsehlaw rawn i a ummi Kanaan mi vialte hna cu Beth-shean le a khuate i a ummi nih si hna seh, Jezreel Nelrawn i a ummi nih si hna seh thir rangleng an ngei,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih Josef tefa Efraim le Manasseh sinah cun, “Nannih cu mi tampi nan si i nan ṭhawng ngaingai; vo pakhat lawng nan co lai lo,"},"18":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw tlangram cu nan ta a si lai, tupi a si nain nan vah lai i a deng tiangin nan co lai; Kanaan mi hna cu thir rangleng an ngei i an ṭhawng nain nan ṭhawl hna lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel mibu cu an ning piin Shiloh ah an i pum i khika ah tonnak thlam kha an bunh; an hmaiah ram cu tei in a um ko.","title":"Israel Miphun Ram An I Cheuhnak"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi hna lakah phun sarih, vo cheuh rih lomi an um."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Joshua nih Israel mi hna sinah cun, “ Bawipa, nan pupa Pathian nih an pekmi hna ram chungah hin luh i va co awkah zei can dah nan i daithlanh lai?"},"4":{"text":"Phun khat nih mi pathum cio i thawh u law, ka thlah hna lai; an i thawh lai i ram cu a dihlak in an ṭol lai i, an covo hnga ding kha ruahchih in ram kong cu an ṭial lai i keimah sinah an ra lai."},"5":{"text":"Vo pasarih ah an cheu lai, Judah pawl cu an ram chungah thlanglei ah khan an um ko lai i Josef chungle hna cu an ram chungah chaklei ah khan an um ko lai."},"6":{"text":"Hmun sarih in cheumi ram kong cu nan ṭial lai i nan ṭialmi cu hika ka sinah nan rak put lai; cun Bawipa kan Pathian hmaiah hika ah nan caah camcawh fung kan khiahpiak hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Levi mi hna cu nannih lakah vo an ngei lo, zeitintiah Bawipa tlangbawi an sinak cu an ro a si; cun Gad le Reuben le Manasseh phun cheu nih khan Bawipa sal Moses nih a pekmi hna an vo cu Jordan nichuahlei ral ah khan an co cang,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah mi hna cu an i thawh. Ram kong ṭial awkah a kalmi hna cu Joshua nih bia a beuh hna i, “Ram cu va ṭol dih u law, a kong kha va ṭial u law, ka sinah ra ṭhan u; cun nannih caah Bawipa hmaiah hika ah hin Shiloh ah camcawh fung kan khiahpiak hna lai,” tiah a ti,"},"9":{"text":"Cucaah, mi cu an kal i ram cu an ṭol dih; hmun sarih ah an cheumi ram kong cu cauk chungah a khua a khua in an ṭial; cun Joshua sinah Shiloh i an riahhmun ah khan an ra i"},"10":{"text":"Shiloh ah cun Bawipa hmaiah Joshua nih camcawh fung a khiahpiak hna. Khika ah Joshua nih Israel mi hna cu ram kha a cheuh hna, an vo cio kha, a pek hna."},"11":{"text":"Benjamin phun innchungkhar ca i camcawh fung cu a hung chuak i an comi ram cu Judah phun le Josef phun karlak ah khan a tla.","title":"Benjamin Comi Ram"},"12":{"text":"Chaklei kamah an ramri cu Jordan ah aa thawk; cun ramri cu Jeriko chak ah a ummi fing ah a hung kai, cun nitlaklei ah tlangram kha a tan i Beth-aven ramlak ah a dong."},"13":{"text":"Khika in ramri cu Luz lei ah thlanglei ah a vung kal i Luz fing (cucu Bethel) kha a phan. Cun ramri cu Thlanglei Beth-horon thlang i a ummi tlang cung i Ataroth-addar khua ah cun a vung phan."},"14":{"text":"Cun ramri cu kaa dang leiah aa mer i nitlaklei ramri ah a cang. Beth-horon thlang i a ummi mual in thlanglei ah a kal i Kiriath-baal ah a dong (cucu Kiriath-jearim a si), cu khua cu Judah phun ta a si. Mah hihi nitlaklei ramri cu a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun thlanglei kam cu Kiriath-jearim donghnak ah a thawk i ramri cu khika in Efron ah a kal, cun Neftoah Ti a putnak tiang,"},"16":{"text":"cun ramri cu Refaim nelrawn chaklei donghnak ah a ummi Hinnom fapa nelrawn ralchan i a ummi tlang hram ah a vung kal; cun Hinnom nelrawn cu a vun zul i Jebus mi fing thlang khan a lan i En-rogel a vung phan;"},"17":{"text":"cun chaklei hoih in aa kuai i En-shemesh a phan, cun khika in Adummim i hung kainak ralchan i a ummi Geliloth ah a kal; cun Reuben fapa Bohan Lung ah cun a vung kal,"},"18":{"text":"cun Beth-arabah fing kha chaklei in a hei tan i Arabah ah a vung kal;"},"19":{"text":"cun ramri cu Beth-hoglah fing chaklei ah a va lan i ramri cu Cite Rili chaklei fonghlei ah a dong, Jordan tiva thlanglei donghnak ah khan. Mah hihi thlanglei donghnak ah khan. Mah hihi thlanglei kam ramri cu a si."},"20":{"text":"Nichuahlei, kamah Jordan cu a ramri a si. Benjamin phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi ram cu, a velchum in a ramri nih a kulhning in, mah hihi a si."},"21":{"text":"An innchung khar ning cio ah Benjamin phun khua hna cu mah hihi an si: Jeriko, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,"},"22":{"text":"Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,"},"23":{"text":"Avvim, Parah, Ofrah,"},"24":{"text":"Khefar-ammoni, Ofni, Geba, — khua pa hleihnih an khuate hna he;"},"25":{"text":"cun Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,"},"26":{"text":"Mizpah, Khefirah, Mozah,"},"27":{"text":"Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,"},"28":{"text":"Zela, Haelef, Jebus (cucu Jerusalem), Gibeah, le Kiriath-jearim — khua pa hleili an khuate hna he. Mah hihi Benjamin phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi cu a si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Camcawh fung pahnihnak cu Simeon caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio ah Simeon phun caah cun; cun an vo cu Judah phun nih an comi chungah khan a si.","title":"Simeon Comi Ram"},"2":{"text":"Amah nih a comi hna cu Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,","ref":"1Cha 4.28-33"},"3":{"text":"Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,"},"4":{"text":"Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,"},"5":{"text":"Ziklag, Beth-markaboth, Hazar-susah,"},"6":{"text":"Beth-lebaoth, le Sharuhen khua pahleithum an khuate hna he;"},"7":{"text":"cu En-rimmon, Ether le Ashan khua pali an khuate hna he;"},"8":{"text":"cun hi khuapi hna velchum i a ummi khuate vialte, Ballath-beer, Negeb i Ramah tiangin. Mah hihi Simeon phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi cu a si."},"9":{"text":"Simeon phun nih an comi ram cu Judah ram chungah khan aa tel ve. Judah phun vo cu an caah a ngan tuk caah Simeon phun nih cun an comi ram chungah cun vo an co ve."},"10":{"text":"Camcawh fung pathumnak cu Zebulun phun caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio ah. An comi ram cu Sarid tiang a phan;","title":"Zebulun Comi Ram"},"11":{"text":"cun an ramri cu nitlaklei ah a hung kal i Mareal ah a lan i Dabbesheth i a ummi tivate tiang a kal;"},"12":{"text":"cun Sarid in ramri cu khattelei kamah nichuahlei ah Khisloth-tabor ramri tiang a kal;"},"13":{"text":"khika in Daberath ah a kal i Jafia a hung phan; khika in nichuahlei kam zuahmah in a kal i Gath-hefer le Eth-kazin a phan cun Rimmon ah a va kal i Neah lei ah aa kuai;"},"14":{"text":"cun chaklei ah ramri cu aa mer i Hannathon ah a kal i Iftahel nelrawn ah a dong."},"15":{"text":"Cun Kattath, Hahalal, Shimron, Idalah, le Bethlehem — khuapi hleihnih, an khuate hna he."},"16":{"text":"Mah hihi Zebulun phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio in an comi vo cu a si — hi khua hna le an khuate hna cu."},"17":{"text":"Camcawh fung palinak cu Issakhar caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio ah Issakhar phun caah cun.","title":"Issakhar Comi Ram"},"18":{"text":"Cun a ram chungah cun Jezreel, Khesulloth, Shunem,"},"19":{"text":"Hafaraim, Shion, Anaharath,"},"20":{"text":"Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,"},"21":{"text":"Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah le Beth-pazzez an um;"},"22":{"text":"ramri nih cun Tabor, Shahazumah, le Beth-shemesh zong a tongh hna i a ramri cu Jordan ah a dong — khua hleiruk, an khuate hna he."},"23":{"text":"Mah hihi Issakhar phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi vo cu a si — hi khua hna le an khuate hna he cun."},"24":{"text":"Camcawh fung panganak cu Asher phun caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio ah.","title":"Asher Comi Ram"},"25":{"text":"A ram chungah cun Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akhshaf,"},"26":{"text":"Allam-melek, Amad, le Mishal an um; nitlaklei leiah Karmel le Shihor-libnath a hei tongh i"},"27":{"text":"nichuahlei ah aa mer, Beth-dagon ah a kal i Zebulun le Iftahel nelrawn tongh in chaklei ah Beth-emek le Neiel ah a kal; cun chaklei ah a lan i Jabul,"},"28":{"text":"Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah le Sidon Ngan tiang a kal;"},"29":{"text":"cun ramri cu Ramah leiah aa mer i kulhmi khuapi Tair a phan; cun ramri cu Hosah leiah aa mer i rili ah a dong; Mahalab, Akhzib,"},"30":{"text":"Ummah, Afek, le Rehob — khua kul le khua hnih, an khuate hna he,"},"31":{"text":"Mah hihi Asher phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi ro cu a si — hi khua hna le an khuate hna he cun."},"32":{"text":"Camcawh fung paruknak cu Naftali phun caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio in, Naftali phun caah cun.","title":"Naftali Comi Ram"},"33":{"text":"A ramri cu Helef le Zaanannim ah a ummi kuhthing le Adami-nekeb le Jabneel in a thawk i Lakkum tiang a kal, cun Jordan ah a dong;"},"34":{"text":"cun ramri cu nitlaklei ah Aznoth-tabor leiah aa mer i khika in Hukkok ah a kal i thlanglei ah Zebulun le nitlaklei ah Asher le nichuahlei ah Judah kha Jordan ah a pal pah hna."},"35":{"text":"Kulhmi khua hna cu Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Khinnereth,"},"36":{"text":"Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,"},"37":{"text":"Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,"},"38":{"text":"Ziron, Migdalel, Horem, Beth-anath, le Beth-shemesh an si — khua hlei kua, an khuate hna he."},"39":{"text":"Mah hihi Naftali phun nih an innchungkhar ning cio in an comi vo cu a si — hi khua hna le an khuate hna cu."},"40":{"text":"Camcawh fung pasarihnak cu Dan phun caah a hung chuak, an innchungkhar ning cio ah.","title":"Dan Comi Ram"},"41":{"text":"Cun an comi ram chungah cun Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,"},"42":{"text":"Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,"},"43":{"text":"Elon, Timnah, Ekron,"},"44":{"text":"Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,"},"45":{"text":"Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,"},"46":{"text":"le Mejarkon le Rakkon le Joppa changtu ram cu an i tel."},"47":{"text":"Dan mi nih an ram cu an sungh tikah, Dan mi hna cu an hung kal i Leshem kha an hung doh i an tei. Vainam in an sam dih hnuah an lak i a chungah khua an sa i anmah thlatu Dan min chuankhan in Leshem cu Dan tiah an ti.","ref":"Biac 18.27-29"},"48":{"text":"Mah hihi Dan miphun nih an innchungkhar ning cio ah an comi vo cu a si — hi khua hna le an khuate hna cu."},"49":{"text":"Cun ram cu an covo cio ah an i phawt dih tikah, Israel mi hna nih cun Nun fapa Joshua kha anmah lakah vo pakhat an pek."},"50":{"text":"Bawipa nawl pek bangin a halmi hna khua, Efraim tlangram i a ummi Timnath-serah kha an pek; cu khua cu a ser ṭhan i a chungah khua a sa."},"51":{"text":"Mah hna hi tlangbawi Eleazar le Nun fapa Joshua le Israel mi phun hna i an chung cio lu hna nih Shiloh ah Bawipa hmaiah tonnak thlam innka ah camcawhfung khiah in an phawtmi covo cu an si. Cuticun ram phawt cu an lim."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Joshua cu a chawnh i,","title":"Himnak Khua Hna","ref":"Nam 35.6-32; Deu 4.41-43; 19.1-13"},"2":{"text":"“Israel mi hna cu, ‘Moses sinin nannih sinah ka chimmi himnak khua kha ser hna u,"},"3":{"text":"khika ah timh cianak um lo le hngalh loin mi a that sualmi nih a zam nakhnga; nannih caah thisen phuhlamtu sinin himnak khua an si lai."},"4":{"text":"Hi khua pakhatkhat ah hin a va zam lai i khua luhnak kutka ah cun a dir lai i khi khua upa hna sinah khan a kong cu a va chim lai; cun annih nih khua chungah cun an luhpi lai i hmun an pek lai i, anmah sinah cun a um lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun thisen phuhlamtu nih a dawi ahcun, mi thattu cu a kut chungah an rak pek awk a si lai lo, zeicahtiah a innpa a rak thah cu hngalh lo le hlanah huatnak ngei loin a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun mi zapi hmaiah biaceih awkah a dir hlan le khi caan ah tlangbawi ngan a simi a thih hlantiang cu, khi khua ah cun a um lai; khi tikah mi thattu cu a zamtakmi amah khua le amah inn ah khan a kir ṭhan lai,’ tiah chim hna,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah Naftali tlangram i Galilee ram chungah Kedesh le, Efraim tlangram ah Shekhem le, Judah tlangram ah Kiriath-arba (cucu Hebron) cu an thim hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jeriko nichuahlei Jordan tiva ral ah Reuben phun chungin tlangrawn ram ramlak i a ummi Bezer le, Gad phun chungin Gilead i a ummi Ramoth le, Manasseh phun chungin Bashan i a ummi Golan kha an thim hna."},"9":{"text":"Mah khua hna hi Israel mi vialte le an lak i khual a pemmi hna caah tinhmi an si, zeitintiah timh cianak um loin mi a thatmi paoh nih khika ah an zam i, mi zapi hmaiah a dir hlanah cun thisen phuhlamtu kut in a thih nakhnga lo, tinhmi an si."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Levi chung upa hna cu tlangbawi Eleazar le Nun fapa Joshua le Israel miphun hna i an chung cio lu hna sinah cun an ra i","title":"Levi Mi Khua Hna (1Cha 6.54-81)"},"2":{"text":"Kanaan ram chung i Shiloh khua ah cun annih sinah, “ Bawipa nih kannih cu umnak khua hna le kan saṭil ca i tlonnak ram pek dingin Moses sin in nawl a rak pek cang,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Nam 35.1-8"},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nawl peknak bangin Israel mi nih Levi mi hna cu a tanglei khua hna le saṭil tlonnak ram hna hi an vo chungin an pek hna."},"4":{"text":"Kohath mi innchungkhar hna caah cun camcawh fung cu a hung chuak. Cucaah Levi mi chungin tlangbawi Aaron tefa a simi nih khan camcawh fung khiah in Judah, Simeon, le Benjamin phun hna sinin khua hleithum an hmuh."},"5":{"text":"Cun a taang rihmi Kohath mi hna nih khan Efraim phun, Dan phun le, Manasseh phun cheu hna innchungkhar hna sin khan camcawh fung khiah in khua pahra an hmuh."},"6":{"text":"Gershon mi hna nih Issakhar phun, Asher phun, Naftali phun le Bashan i a ummi Manasseh phun cheu hna innchungkhar hna sin khan camcawh fung khiah in khua hleithum an hmuh."},"7":{"text":"Merari mi hna nih an innchungkhar ning cio in Reuben phun le Gad phun le Zebulun phun hna sinin khua hleihnih an hmuh."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses sinin nawl a pek bang khan, hi khua hna le an pawngkam i saṭil tlonnak ram hna cu Israel mi nih camcawh fung khiah in Levi mi kha an pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Judah phun le Simeon phun chungin an min in chimmi a tanglei khua hna cu an pek hna."},"10":{"text":"Levi phun i a ummi Kohath phun chungah innchungkhar pakhat, Aaron tefa hna nih cun, an co hna, zeitintiah camcawh fung cu annih cungah hmasa bik ah a tla."},"11":{"text":"Judah tlangram chung i Kiriath-arba (cucu Hebron; Arba cu Anak pa a si) le a velchum i saṭil tlonnak ram cu an pek hna."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khuapi pawng lo hna le a khuate hna cu Jefunneh fapa Kaleb kha a covo caah an pek."},"13":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Aaron tefa hna cu mi thattu ca i himnak khua Hebron le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Libnah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"14":{"text":"Jattir le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Eshtemoa le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"15":{"text":"Holon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Debir le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"16":{"text":"Ain le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Juttah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Beth-shemesh le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, — hi phun hnih hna chungin khua pakua cu pek an si;"},"17":{"text":"cun Benjamin phun chungin Gibeon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Geba le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"18":{"text":"Anathoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le Almon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pali cu pek an si."},"19":{"text":"Aaron tefa hna, tlangbawi hna cu, an khua a dihlak ah hleithum, an saṭil tlonnak ram cio he, an si."},"20":{"text":"Levi mi chung i Kohath innchungkhar hna lakah a taang rihmi Kohath mi hna cu, annih an pekmi hna khua cu Efraim phun chungin an si."},"21":{"text":"Annih cu mi thattu caah himnak khua a simi Shekhem, Efraim tlangram i a ummi le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Gezer le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"22":{"text":"Kibzaim le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Beth-horon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"23":{"text":"cun Dan phun chungin Eltekeh le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Gibbethon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"24":{"text":"Aijalon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Gath-rimmon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"25":{"text":"cun Manasseh phun cheu chungin Taanak le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le Gath-rimmon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pahnih cu pek an si."},"26":{"text":"Kohath mi lakah a taangmi innchungkhar hna i an khua kha a dihlak ah pahra an saṭil tlonnak ram cio hna he, an si."},"27":{"text":"Cun Levi mi innchungkhar hna lakah pakhat a si vemi Gershon mi hna cu Manasseh phun cheu chungin Bashan i a ummi Golan, mi thattu ca i himnak khua a simi le, Beeshterah khua le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, — khua pahnih cu pek an si;"},"28":{"text":"cun Issakhar phun chungin Kishion le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Daberath le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"29":{"text":"Jarmuth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, En-gannim le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"30":{"text":"cun Asher phun chungin Mishal le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Abdon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"31":{"text":"Helkath le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le Rehob le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"32":{"text":"cun Naftali phun chungin mi thattu caah himnak khua a simi Kedesh, Galilee ram i a ummi, le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Hammoth-dor le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le, Kartan le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pathum cu pek an si."},"33":{"text":"Gershon mi innchungkhar hna nih an co ciomi khua hma cu a dihlak ah hleithum, an saṭil tlonnak ram cio hna he, an si."},"34":{"text":"Cun Levi mi a taang rihmi Merari innchungkhar hna cu Zebulun phun chungin Jokneam le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Kartah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"35":{"text":"Dimnah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Nahalal le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"36":{"text":"cun Reuben phun chungin Bezer le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Jahaz le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"37":{"text":"Kedemoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le Mefaath le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, — khua pali cu pek an si;"},"38":{"text":"cun Gad phun chungin Gilead ah a ummi Ramoth, mi thattu caah himnak khua a simi le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Mahanaim le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"39":{"text":"Heshbon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Jazer le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna — a dihlak ah khua pali cu pek an si."},"40":{"text":"Levi phun chungin a taang rihmi Merari innchungkhar hna cu khua an pekmi hna a dihlak ah hleihnih an si."},"41":{"text":"Israel mi hna covo lakah Levi mi khua hna cu a dihlak ah sawm li le pariat, an saṭil tlonnak ram cio hna he, an si."},"42":{"text":"Hi khua hna nih hin an velchum ah saṭil tlonnak ram hna kha an ngei cio; cuticun hi khua hi a dihlak in an si."},"43":{"text":"Cu bangin Bawipa nih Israel mi cu an pupa hna sinah pek awkin chiat a sermi ram vialte kha a pek hna. An tei i khika ah um hmun an khuar.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Ram An Co Dih"},"44":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih an pupa hna sinah chiat a rak ser bantukte khan, a kenkip ah dinhnak a pek hna. An ral ahohmanh nih an celh hna lo, zeitintiah Bawipa nih an ral hna cu an kut chungah a pek hna."},"45":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel chungle hna sinah biakamnak ṭha a sermi vialte lakah khan pakhat hmanh pakpalawng ah a cangmi a um lo; an dihlak tein a tling dih."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih Reuben mi le Gad mi le Manasseh phun cheu kha a auh hna i","title":"Jordan Tivakam Biakṭheng"},"2":{"text":"annih cu, “ Bawipa sal Moses nih nawl an pekmi vialte hna kha nan tuah i nawl kan pekmi hna vialte ah ka bia kha nan ngaih;","ref":"Nam 32.20-32; Jos 1.12-15"},"3":{"text":"hi can riamruam nannih nih nan unau hna kha nihin tiang thlahthlam loin nan um i Bawipa nan Pathian nih an fialmi hna cu ṭha tein nan tuah."},"4":{"text":"Cun atu cu Bawipa nan Pathian nih nan unau hna kha bia a kam hna bangin dinhnak a pek cang hna; cucaah kir cang u law, Bawipa sal Moses nih Jordan tiva khattelei ral ah an pekmi hna nan covo a umnak ram i nan inn ah khan kal tuah u."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa sal Moses nih, Bawipa nan Pathian cu dawt awk le, a lam vialte kha zulh awk le, a nawlbia hna kha tuah awk le, amah sinah i bek awk le, amah cu nan lung dihlak le nan thlarau vialte in a rianṭuan awkah nawl an pekmi hna nawlbia le phungbia cu tuah awkah ṭha tein i ralring tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Joshua nih thluachuah a pek hna i a kalter hna; cun an inn ah an kal."},"7":{"text":"Cun, Manasseh phun i a cheu kha Moses nih Bashan ah covo a pek hna; sihmanhsehlaw a dang a cheu kha cu Joshua nih Jordan in nitlaklei ram ah an unau hna pawngah covo a pek hna. Cun Joshua nih an inn ah a thlah hna i thluachuah a pek hna tikah,"},"8":{"text":"annih sinah, “Chawva a tampi le saṭil tampi le ngun, sui, dar, le thir le thilpuan tampi he nan inn ah va kal tuah hna u; nan ral hna sinin nan lakmi hranchaw kha nan unau hna he vaa phaw u,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu cu Kanaan ram chungah a ummi Shiloh khua i Israel mi hna sin cun an ṭhen i an inn ah an kir. Bawipa nih Moses sinin nawl a peknak thawngin an comi an ram Gilead ram ah cun kal awkah an i thawh."},"10":{"text":"Kanaan ram chung Jordan tivakam hrawng ram kha an va phak tikah Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu nih khan khika ah Jordan tiva pawngah biakṭheng nganpi pakhat an ser."},"11":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna nih, “Zohhmanh, Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu nih Kanaan ram ramri ah Jordan tivakam hrawng ram chung Israel mi hna ta a simi leiphek ah, biakṭheng pakhat an ser,” tiah mi nih an chim kha an theih."},"12":{"text":"Cu kong cu Israel mi nih an theih tikah Israel mi nih an dihlak in annih kha doh hna awkah Shiloh ah an i pum."},"13":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Gilead ram i Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu sinah cun tlangbawi Eleazar fapa Phinehas kha an thlah,"},"14":{"text":"cun amah sinah bawi pahra, Israel phun hna chungin pakhat cio, Israel phun hna chung i a lu a si ciomi hna kha an i tel."},"15":{"text":"Cun Gilead ram i Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu hna sinah khan an ra i annih cu,"},"16":{"text":"“ Bawipa mibu nih an ning piin, ‘Israel Pathian cungah nan tuahmi rawinak hi zeidah a si, nihin ah Bawipa kha doh awkah Bawipa zulhnak khan nan pial i biakṭheng pakhat nan i ser hi a sullam zeidah a si?","ref":"Deu 12.13-14"},"17":{"text":"Peor i kan sualnak, cu ruang i Bawipa mibu cungah rai a tlun i a thianh hmanh kan i thianh khawh rih lomi kha, kan i za rih lo maw,","ref":"Nam 25.1-9"},"18":{"text":"cu i nannih i Bawipa sinin i i mer nan i timh? Nannih nih Bawipa cu nihin ah nan doh ahcun, Israel mibu dihlak cungah khan thaizing ah a thin a hung lai."},"19":{"text":"Atu cu, nan ram kha a thian lo a si ahcun, Bawipa puan biakinn a dirnak Bawipa ram chungah khan ra ve u law, kan lakah covo i lak ve ko ngat u; sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa tu cu doh hlah u law, Bawipa kan Pathian biakṭheng hleiah a dang biakṭheng sernak in kannih zong kha amah dotu bantuk ah rel chih kan siter ve hlah u."},"20":{"text":"Pekchanhmi thil kongah khan Zerah fapa Akhan cu zumhawktlak loin a um i Israel mibu dihlak cungah thinhunnak a tla a si lo mei? Cun a ṭhat lonak ruangah amah lawng kha a thi lo,’ an ti,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Jos 7.1-26"},"21":{"text":"Cun Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu nih Israel innchungkhar i an lu hna cu an leh hna i,"},"22":{"text":"Bawipa cu pathian hna Pathian a si, Amah nih a hngalh dih, Israel zong nih hngal seh. Bawipa kan doh ruang a si ah maw Amah cung i zumhawktlak lo kan si ruangah maw"},"23":{"text":"hi biakṭheng hi kan ser i Bawipa sinin a kan pialter a si ahcun, nihin ah hin kan zuah hrimhrim hlah u; cun a cung i khangh thawinak thawinak caah caah siseh, chang thawinak thawinak caah siseh, daihnak thawinak thawinak caah siseh, kan tuah a si ahcun Bawipa hrimhrim nih kan cungah phuhlamnak cu tuah seh."},"24":{"text":"Cu tuahnak ding caah kan tuahmi a si lo, kan tuahnak cu hmailei ah nan fale nih kan fale cu, “ Bawipa Israel Pathian he zei tlaihnak dah nan ngeih?"},"25":{"text":"Zeitintiah nannih Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna, nannih le kannih karah Bawipa nih Jordan cu ramri ah a ser ko; Bawipa chungah nannih cu covo nan ngei lo,’ an ti hna lai ti kan phan caah kan tuah cu a si. Cuticun nan fale nih kan fale cu Bawipa biak kha an ngolter sual hna hnga."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah kannih nih, ‘Khangh thawinak caah si loin le raithawinak caah si loin,"},"27":{"text":"kannih le nannih karlak ah, kan hnu i kan tefa hna karlak ah biahngaltu a si i Bawipa rian cu kannih nih amah hmaika ah kan khangh thawinak le raithawinak le daihnak thawinak in kan rak ṭuan ve tinak caah biakṭheng pakhat ser u sih; hmailei ah nan tefa hna nih kan tefa hna cu, “ Bawipa chungah covo zeihmanh nan ngei lo,” an ti sual hna nakhnga lo,’ tiah kan ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun mah hihi hmailei ah kannih sinah siseh, kan ciruang hna sinah siseh, chim a si sual ahcun, ‘ Bawipa biakṭheng a keep hi zohhmanh u, kan pupa hna nih khangh thawinak caah si loin le raithawinak caah si loin, nannih le kannih karlak i biahngaltu si dingah an rak sermi hi,’ tiah kan chim lai tiah kan ruah."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian biakṭheng a puan biakinn hmai i a dirmi hlei in, khangh thawinak le chang thawinak le raithawinak caah biakṭheng dang sernak thawng in Bawipa lam in nihin ah pial le Bawipa doh cu kan ruat naisai lo!” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Tlangbawi Phinehas le amah sinah a ummi mibu bawi hna, Israel miphun an lu cio hna nih cun, Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh mi hna nih an chimmi bia kha an theih tikah, an lung a lawm ngaingai ko."},"31":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Eleazar fapa Phinehas nih Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh mi hna cu, “ Bawipa cungah rawinak nan tuah lo caah, Bawipa cu kan lakah a um, tiah nihin ah kan hngalh; Israel mi hna cu Bawipa kut chungin nan khamh cang hna,” tiah a ti hna."},"32":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Eleazar fapa Phinehas le bawi hna cu Gilead ram i Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna sinin Kanaan ram ah Israel mi sinah an kir i bia kha an rak phorh hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun hi kong nih Israel mi kha an lung a ton hna; Israel mi nih Pathian kha an thangṭhat i, Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna an umnak ram hrawh awk i annih doh awk kha an ceih ti lo."},"34":{"text":"Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna nih cu biakṭheng cu Ed tiah min an sak; “Zeitintiah cu biakṭheng cu Bawipa cu Pathian a si tiah kan karlakah biahngaltu a si caah,” an ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Caan saupi hnuah, Bawipa nih Israel mi hna cu an velchum i an ral hna sinin dinhnak a pek hna tik le Joshua cu a upat i a tar ngaingai tikah,","title":"Joshua Rovuih Bia"},"2":{"text":"Joshua nih Israel mi vialte an upa hna le an lu hna le an biaceihtu hna le an bawi hna kha a auh hna i annih cu, “Atu cu ka upa i ka tar ngaingai cang;"},"3":{"text":"cun nannih nih Bawipa nan Pathian nih hi miphun vialte hna cungah nan caah a tuahmi kha nan hmuh cang, zeitintiah nannih an dohpiaktu hna cu Bawipa nan Pathian kha a si."},"4":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, nannih cu a tang rihmi miphun hna kha nan phun cio caah ro ah kan pek hna, ka tei ciami miphun vialte hna he, Jordan tiva thawk in nitlaklei ah Rili Ngan tiang."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian nih nan hmaiah a dawi hna lai i nan mit hmuh phak lo tiang a ṭhawl hna lai; cun Bawipa nan Pathian nih bia an kam hna bangin an ram cu nan co lai."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Moses phungbia cauk chungah aa ṭialmi vialte kha zulh awk le tuah awkah fek tein um ko u; orhlei ah siseh; kehlei ah siseh pialtak hlah u."},"7":{"text":"Nannih nih hika i nan lakah a tang rihmi miphun hna he hin i cawh lo le, an pathian hna min kha chim lo le, cu hna cun chiatser lo le, an rianṭuan lo le an hmaiah kun loin,"},"8":{"text":"nihin ni tiang nan tuah bangin Bawipa nan Pathian sinah i bek ko u."},"9":{"text":"Zeitintiah Bawipa nih nan hmai in a ngan le a ṭhawngmi miphun hna kha a dawi hna i, nannih cu nihin ni tiangah ahohmanh nih an in celh hna lo."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian nih bia an kam hna bangin amah cu an dohpiaktu hna kha a si caah, nan lak i mi pakhat nih thong khat kha a dawi hna.","ref":"Deu 3.22; 32.30"},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nan Pathian cu dawt awkah i ralring ngaingai tuah u."},"12":{"text":"Nan i mer i hika ah nannih lakah a tang rihmi miphun hna hi nan fonh hna i nan ṭhit nan lak hna i an nu hna kha nan ṭhit hna i annih nih an in ṭhit ve hna ahcun,"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian nih hi miphun hna hi nan hmai in a ṭhawl lan hna lai lo ti kha fiang tein hngal ko u; Bawipa nan Pathian nih an pekmi hna hi ram ṭha chung hin nan loh hlantiang nan caah rap le thang le, nan hnak i tuknak fung le nan mit chung i hling an si lai."},"14":{"text":"“Cun, atu cu vawleicung vialte phung bangin ka kal ve cang lai. Nannih nih nan dihlak in, Bawipa nan Pathian nih nanmah kongah biakamnak a tuahmi thilṭha vialte lakah pakhat hmanh pakpalawng a can lo kha nan lungthin le nan ruahnak in nan hngalh; nannih caah a dihlak in a tling dih, pakhat hmanh a bau lo."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nan Pathian nih nannih kongah biakamnak a tuahmi thilṭha vialte kha nan caah a tlin bantukte khan, Bawipa nan Pathian nih hi ram ṭha an pekmi hna chung hin an hrawh hna hlantiang Bawipa nih nan cungah thilṭhalo vialte kha a tlunter lai,"},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian nih nawl an pekmi hna biakamnak kha nan buar i pathian dang hna kha nan kalhnawh i an rian nan ṭuan i an hmaiah nan kun ahcun, khi tikah Bawipa thinhunnak cu nan cungah a alh lai i an pekmi hna ram ṭha hin khulrang tein nan rawk lai,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih Israel miphun vialte kha Shekhem ah a pumh hna i Israel mi upa hna le lu hna le biaceihtu hna le bawi hna kha a auh hna; cun Pathian hmaiah an hung chuak.","title":"Joshua Shekhem Ah Bia A Chimh Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih mi vialte cu, “Hi bangin Bawipa Israel Pathian nih a ti: ‘Hlan liopi ah cun nan pupa hna cu Zufrates tiva khattelei ral ah an rak um, Abraham le Nahor pa Terah cu; cun pathian dang kha an rak biak hna.","ref":"Gen 11.27"},"3":{"text":"Cun nan pa Abraham kha Tiva ral khan ka lak i Kanaan ram chung dihlak ah ka hruai i a tefa cu tampi ah ka ser hna. Isak kha ka pek i","ref":"Gen 12.1-9; 21.1-3"},"4":{"text":"Isak cu Jakob le Esau kha ka pek. Cun Esau cu Seir tlangram kha ngeih awkah ka pek, sihmanhsehlaw Jakob le a fale hna cu Izipt ah an vung kal.","ref":"Gen 25.24-26; 36.8; 46.1-7; Deu 2.5"},"5":{"text":"Cun Moses le Aaron kha ka thlah hna i Izipt cu a chung i ka tuahmi in ka hrem; cun a hnuah nannih cu kan chuahpi hna.","ref":"Exo 3.1—12.42"},"6":{"text":"Cun nan pale hna cu Izipt in ka chuahpi hna i rili kha nan phan; cun Izipt mi nih nan pale cu rangleng le rangcung ralkap in Rili Sen tiang an dawi hna.","ref":"Exo 14.1-31"},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kha an ka auh tikah, Izipt mi he nan karlak ah muihnak ka chiah i rili kha an cungah ka tlunter i ka khuhter hna; cun nannih mit nih Izipt cung i ka tuahmi kha an hmuh; cun ramlak ah caan saupi nan um."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jordan khattelei kamah a ummi Amor mi hna ram ah khan kan hruai hna; nannih kha an in doh hna i annih cu nan kut chungah kan pek hna i, an ram cu nan lak i annih cu nan hmaiah ka hrawh hna.","ref":"Nam 21.21-35"},"9":{"text":"Cun Zippor fapa Balak, Moab siangpahrang, cu a tho i nan nih kha an doh hna; cun mi a hei thlah hna i Beor fapa Balaam cu nannih kha chiat serh awkah a sawm.","ref":"Nam 22.1—24.25"},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Balaam cu ka ngai duh lo, cucaah thluachuahnak an pek hna; cuticun nannih cu a kut chungin kan chuah hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jordan tiva kha nan tan i Jeriko kha nan phan i Jeriko khuami hna le Amor mi hna, Periz mi hna, Kanaan mi hna, Hit mi hna, Girgash mi hna, Hiv mi hna le Jebus mi hna zong nih nannih kha an rak in doh hna; annih cu nan kut chungah kan pek hna.","ref":"Jos 3.14-17; 6.1-21"},"12":{"text":"Cun Amor mi siangpahrang pahnih nan hmai in a ṭhawltu hna khuaingal kha nan hmaiah ka thlah; nan vainam in siseh, nan likuk in siseh a si lo.","ref":"Exo 23.28; Deu 7.20"},"13":{"text":"Nan rak thlawh lomi ram le nan rak sak lomi khua hna kha kan pek hna i khika ah nan um; nan phun lomi mitsur ruang le oliv dum theitlai kha nan ei.’ ”","ref":"Deu 6.10-11"},"14":{"text":"“Cucaah atu cu Bawipa kha ṭih u law, amah rian kha lungtak te le zumhawktlak tein ṭuan tuah u; Tiva khattelei ral le Izipt ram ah nan pupa hna nih an biakmi pathian hna kha hlaw hna u law, Bawipa kha bia tuah u."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa biak kha nan duh lo a si ahcun nihin ni ah hin nan biak ding cu i thim u; Tiva khattelei ral ram ah nan pupa hna nih an biakmi pathian hna maw, asiloah, an ram nan umnak a simi Amor mi pathian hna dah nan i thim lai; kei le kan innchungkhar tu nih cun Bawipa kha kan biak ko lai,” tiah a ti"},"16":{"text":"Cun mizapi nih cun an leh i, “ Bawipa kha pathian dang biaktak awkah kan hlaw naisai lai lo!"},"17":{"text":"Zeitintiah Bawipa kan Pathian cu kanmah le kan pupa hna kha sal taannak inn, Izipt ram in a kan chuahpitu le kan mithmuh ah hmelchunhnak lianngan a tuahtu le kan kalnak kip le kan palmi miphun kip lakah a kan zuahtu kha a si;"},"18":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih kan hmai in mi vialte, ram chung i a ummi Amor mi hna kha, a dawi hna; cucaah kannih zong nih kan Pathian a si caah Bawipa cu kan biak lai,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Joshua nih mi zapi cu, “ Bawipa cu a rian nan ṭuan kho lai lo, zeitintiah amah cu Pathian thiang a si; nahchuak Pathian a si; nan phungbuarnak siseh, nan sualnak siseh, an ngaithiam hna lai lo."},"20":{"text":"Nannih nih Bawipa kha nan hlawt i ramdang pathian kha nan biak hna ahcun, nan cung i ṭhatnak a tuah hnuah khan, aa let lai i ṭha loin an tuah hna lai i an hrawh dih hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun mi zapi nih Joshua cu, “A si hin lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa kha kan biak ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih mizapi cu, “ Bawipa kha biak awkah nan i thim cang ti biahngaltu cu nanmah lila kha nan si,” a ti hna. Cun annih nih, “Biahngaltu cu kanmah hi kan si,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Amah nih, “Hi a si ahcun nanmah lak i a ummi ramdang pathian hna kha hlaw hna u law, nan lung in Bawipa, Israel Pathian, cu i hngatchan tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"24":{"text":"Cun mi zapi nih cun Joshua cu, “ Bawipa kan Pathian cu kan biak lai i amah aw kha kan ngaih lai,” tiah an chawnh."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah Joshua nih khi ni ah mizapi hna he cun biakamnak a tuah i annih caah Shekhem ah nawlbia le phunglam kha a serpiak hna."},"26":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih hi bia hna cu Pathian phungbia cauk chungah a ṭial hna; cun lung nganpi pakhat a lak i Bawipa hmunthiang chungah a ummi kuhthing kung tangah a bunh."},"27":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih mi vialte cu, “Zohhmanh u, mah hi lung hi kan cung i biahngaltu a si lai, zeitintiah Bawipa nih kan sinah a chimmi bia vialte kha hi lung nih hin a theih; cu caah nan cungah biahngaltu a si lai, nan Pathian cungah nan hrokhrawl sual nakhnga lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun Joshua nih mi zapi cu anmah le an comi ram cio ah a kalter hna."},"29":{"text":"Hi thil hna hnuah Nun fapa Joshua, Bawipa sal cu, a thi, kum za khat le kum hra a si.","title":"Joshua Thihnak (Biac 2.6-10)"},"30":{"text":"Cun annih nih Efraim tlangram i a ummi Gaash tlang chaklei ah a ummi amah comi Timnath-serah ah khan an vui.","ref":"Jos 19.49-50"},"31":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Joshua nunchung vialte le, Joshua hnu i a nung i Bawipa nih Israel mi caah a tuahmi rian vialte a hngaltu upa hna nunchung cu Bawipa rian kha an ṭuan."},"32":{"text":"Israel mi nih Izipt ram in an hun i kaipimi Josef ruh kha, Shekhem khua i hmun pakhat Jakob nih Shekhem pa Hamor i a fapa hna sinin tangka za khat in a cawkmi ah khan an vui; cu hmun cu Josef tefa hna rothil ah a cang.","title":"Josef Ruh Shekhem Ah An Vui","ref":"Gen 33.19; 50.24-25; Exo 13.19; Jhn 4.5; Lam 7.16"},"33":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa Eleazar zong a thi i amah fapa Phinehas nih Efraim tlangram chung i a comi Gibeah khua ah an vui.","title":"Eleazar Thihnak"}}}}},"7":{"info":{"name":"Biaceihtu","shortname":"Judg","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joshua a thih hnuah Israel mi nih Bawipa kha an hal i, “Kanaan mi hna kha doh awkah ahodah kan caah a hmasa bik ah a kal lai?” tiah an ti.","title":"Judah le Simeon Nih Adonibezek An Tlaih"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “Judah a hung kal lai; zohhmanh u, ram cu amah kut chungah ka pek cang,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Judah nih a unau Simeon sinah cun, “Kanaan mi kha kan hung doh hna nakhnga, keimah covo ram ah cun hung ka kalpi tuah; cun cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in kei zong nih na covo ram ah cun kan kalpi ve lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Simeon nih a hun kalpi."},"4":{"text":"Cun Judah cu a hung kal i Kanaan mi hna le Periz mi hna cu Bawipa nih an kut chungah a pek hna i Bezek khua ah an mi sang khat an tei hna."},"5":{"text":"Bezek khua ah cun Adoni-bezek an hmuh i an doh i Kanaan mi le Periz mi cu an tei hna."},"6":{"text":"Adonibezek cu a zam; sihmanhsehlaw an dawi i an tlaih i a siapi hna le a kepi hna kha an tan."},"7":{"text":"Cun Adonibezek nih cun, “An siapi hna le an kepi hna tan a simi siangpahrang sawm sarih nih ka cabuai toiah rawl ṭiltlawt an char tawn; ka rak tuah bangin Pathian nih a ka rulh ve cang,” tiah a ti. Jerusalem ah an ratpi i khika ah a thi."},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah mi nih Jerusalem cu an doh i an lak i vainam in an sam cikcek i khuapi cu mei in an khangh.","title":"Judah Nih Jerusalem le Hebron Khua A Lak Hna"},"9":{"text":"Cun a hnuah, tlangram le Negeb le rawnram i a ummi Kanaan mi hna kha doh awkah Judah mi hna cu an ṭum."},"10":{"text":"Cun Hebron i a ummi Kanaan mi hna cu Judah mi nih cun an fuh hna i Sheshai le Ahiman le Talmai kha an tei hna. (Hebron cu, hlanah cun a min ah Kiriath-arba a si)."},"11":{"text":"Khika in Debir i a ummi kha an hei fuh hna. Debir cu, hlanah cun a min ah Kiriath-sefer a si.","title":"Othniel Nih Debir Khua Kha A Tei i Aksah Kha A Co (Jos 15.15-19)"},"12":{"text":"Cun Kaleb nih, “Kiriath-sefer kha a chim i a la khomi cu ka fanu Aksah kha nupi ah ka pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Kaleb nau Kenaz i fapa Othniel nih a lak i a fanu Aksah cu nupi ah a pek."},"14":{"text":"Cun Aksah cu a sinah a rat tikah Othniel cu Aksah nih a pa kha ram hal awkah a fial; Aksah cu a laa cungin a ṭum i Kaleb nih a sinah, ‘Zeidah na duh?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Laksawng pakhat in ka pe tuah; Negeb ram chungah na ka chiah caah tiput zong ka pek chih tuah hna,” tiah a ti. Cun Kaleb nih chaklei tiput hna le thlanglei tiput hna kha a pek chih."},"16":{"text":"Cun Moses pu, Ken miphun a simi i a tefa hna kha ungkung khua in Negeb chung i a ummi Arad pawng i a ummi Judah ramlak ah khan Judah mi hna he an hung kal i an lakah cun an hung um.","title":"Judah le Benjamin Nih An Teimi Khua Hna"},"17":{"text":"Cun Judah cu a unau Simeon he an hung kal i Zefath i a ummi Kanaan mi hna cu an hung tei hna i an hrawh cikcek. Cucaah cu khua min cu Hormah ti a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun Judah nih Gaza le a pawngkam ram. Ashkelon le a pawngkam ram le Ekron le a pawngkam ram hna zong cu a lak hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu Judah sinah a um i tlangram i a ummi hna cu a dawi hna, sihmanhsehlaw rawn i a ummi hna cu, thir rangleng hna kha an ngeih caah an dawi kho hna lo."},"20":{"text":"Cun Moses nih a rak chim bang khan Hebron cu Kaleb an pek i Anak fapa pathum hna kha, cu ka cun a dawi hna."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Benjamin mi nih Jerusalem i a ummi Jebus mi kha an dawi hna lo; cucaah nihin tiangin Jebus mi cu Benjamin mi hna he Jerusalem ah an um.","ref":"Jos 15.63; 2Sam 5.6; 1Cha 11.4"},"22":{"text":"Josef hrin hna zong nih Bethel an hung doh i Bawipa cu an sinah a um.","title":"Josef Hrin Nih Bethel An Tei"},"23":{"text":"Cun Josef hrin hna nih cun Bethel kha ngiatthlai awkah mi an thlah hna. (Cu khua min cu, hlan ah cun Luz ti a si)."},"24":{"text":"Cun mingiathlaitu hna nih cun mipa pakhat khua chungin a chuah kha an hmuh i, “Zaangfahnak in, khua chung luhnak lam kan hmuhsak tuah, cun nangmah cu ṭha tein kan in ti ve te lai,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun khua chung luhnak lam cu a chimh hna; khua cu vainam in an sam cikcek, sihmanhsehlaw mipa le a innchungkhar vialte cu an thlah hna."},"26":{"text":"Cun cu pa cu Hit mi ram ah a kal i khua pakhat a tlak i a min ah Luz a sak; nihin ni tiang hin mah cu cu a min a si ko."},"27":{"text":"Manasseh nih Beth-shean le a khuate hna i a ummi si hna seh, Taanak le a khuate hna i a ummi si hna seh, Dor le a khuate hna i a ummi si hna seh, Ibleam le a khuate hna i a ummi si hna seh, Megiddo le a khuate i a ummi si hna seh, a dawi hna lo; sihmanhsehlaw Kanaan mi hna cu cu ram ah cun an i benh peng ko.","title":"Manasseh le Efraim Nih An Teimi Khua Hna","ref":"Jos 17.11-13"},"28":{"text":"Israel mi cu an hung ṭhawn tikah Kanaan mi hna cu hnekmi rian an ṭuanter hna, sihmanhsehlaw an dawi dih cikcek hna lo."},"29":{"text":"Efraim nih Gezer i a ummi Kanaan mi kha an dawi hna lo; sihmanhsehlaw Kanaan mi cu an lakah Gezer ah cun an um ko.","ref":"Jos 16.10"},"30":{"text":"Zebulun nih Kitron i a ummi si hna seh, Nahalal i a ummi si hna seh an dawi hna lo; sihmanhsehlaw Kanaan mi hna cu an lakah an um ko i hnekmi rian kha an ṭuan.","title":"A Taang Rihmi Phun Hna Nih An Teimi Khua Hna"},"31":{"text":"Asher nih Akko i a ummi si hna seh, Sidon i a ummi si hna seh, Ahlab i a ummi si hna seh, Akzib i a ummi si hna seh, Helbah i a ummi si hna seh, Afik i a ummi si hna seh, Rehob i a ummi si hna seh a dawi hna lo;"},"32":{"text":"an dawi hna lo caah khan Asher mi hna cu Kanaan mi hna lakah cun an um ko."},"33":{"text":"Naftali nih Beth-shemesh i a ummi si hna seh, Beth-anath i a ummi si hna seh a dawi hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw cu ka ram i a ummi Kanaan mi hna lakah cun a um; sihmanhsehlaw Beth-shemesh le Beth-anath i a ummi hna cu an caah hnekmi rian ṭuanpiaktu ah an cang."},"34":{"text":"Amor mi nih Dan mi hna cu tlangram ah an dawi ṭhan hna, rawn i rung ṭum cu an onh hna lo;"},"35":{"text":"Amor mi hna cu Har-heres, Aijalon le Shaalbim ah cun an i benh peng ko, sihmanhsehlaw Josef hrin hna kut cu an cungah a rit i hnekmi rian ṭuanpiaktu ah an cang."},"36":{"text":"Cun Amor mi hna ramri cu Akrabbim i hung kainak le Sela le a cunglei in a kal."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi cu Gilgal in Bochim ah a hung kal. Cun amah nih, “Izipt ram in kan hunpi i na pupa hna sinah pek awkin chiat ka sermi ram chungah kan luhpi. ‘Nangmah he ka biakamnak cu ka hrawk bal lai lo i","title":"Vancungmi Nih Bochim Ah A Chimh Hna"},"2":{"text":"hi ram i a ummi hna he hin biakamnak zeihmanh na tuah lai lo; an biakṭheng cu na hrawh dih hna lai,’ tiah ka ti. Sihmanhsehlaw nawl kan pekmi cu na ngai lo. Na tuahmi hi zeidah a si?","ref":"Exo 34.12-13; Deu 7.2-5"},"3":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu, na hmai in ka ṭhawl hna lai lo, ka ti; sihmanhsehlaw na caah dohtu an si lai i an pathian cu na caah rap an si lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi nih hi bia cu Israel mi vialte hna sinah a chim tikah, mi hna cu fak piin an ṭap."},"5":{"text":"Cun cuka hmun cu a min ah Bochim an sak; cuka ah Bawipa sinah rai an thawi."},"6":{"text":"Joshua nih mi kha a ṭinter hna tikah, Israel mi hna cu ram kha co awkah anmah le an covo cio ah khan an kal.","title":"Joshua Thihnak (Jos 24.29-31)"},"7":{"text":"Cun mi hna nih cun Joshua nunchung le Joshua hnuah a nungmi upa, Israel mi caah Bawipa nih rian ngan a tuahmi vialte a rak hmutu hna an nunchung ah cun Bawipa rian kha an ṭuan."},"8":{"text":"Cun Nun fapa Joshua, Bawipa sal cu, kum za le kum hra a ti ah a thi."},"9":{"text":"Efraim tlangram chung, Gaash Tlang chaklei i Timnath-heres chung i amah covo ramri chungah cun an vui.","ref":"Jos 19.49-50"},"10":{"text":"Cun cu chan mi vialte zong cu an pupa hna sinah pumh an si; cun annih hnuah Bawipa siseh, Israel ca i a tuahmi rian siseh, a hngal lomi chan thar a hung chuak."},"11":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo a simi kha an tuah i Baal kha an biak hna.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Pathian An Hlawtnak le Biaceihtu Hna"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa an pupa hna Pathian, Izipt ram in a chuahpitu hna kha an hlawt; an velchum i a ummi hna pathian hna lak hin pathian dang kha an zulh hna i an hmaiah an kun i Bawipa cu a thin an hunter."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa cu an hlawt i Baal hna le Ashtaroth kha an biak."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa thinhunnak cu Israel cungah a alh i miramhtu hna sinah khan a pek hna i an ramh hna; cun an pawngkam i a ummi an ral hna kut chungah a zuarh hna, cucaah annih nih an ral kha an celh kho ti hna lo."},"15":{"text":"Ral doh awkah an chuah fate Bawipa kut cu a chia lei in an caah a um, Bawipa nih ralrinnak a rak pek hna bang le an sinah chiat a rak ser bang khan; cucaah vansang au in an um."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah Bawipa nih biaceihtu a chuahter hna i annih cu annih a ramhtu hna kut chung khan an khamhtu hna kha an si."},"17":{"text":"Asinain annih nih an biaceihtu hna bia cu an ngai hlei lo; annih nih pathian dang sinah khan hlawh an hlang ṭhiamṭhiam ko i annih hmaiah khan an kun ṭhiamṭhiam ko; Bawipa nawlbia a rak ngaimi an pupa hna nih an rak zulhmi lam khan an pial zau i annih tuah bantuk khan an tuah lo."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih an caah biaceihtu a chuahter fate, Bawipa cu biaceihtu sinah cun a um i biaceihtu nih cun amah chan chung vialte cu an ral hna kut chungin a khamh hna; zeicahtiah annih kha a hremtu hna le vansang au in a tuahtu hna ruang i an hrum-ainak nih khan Bawipa cu an cungah vel a ngeihter."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw biaceihtu cu a thih fate, annih cu an i mer ṭhan i an pale nakkhan chia deuh in an nung, pathian dang kha an zulh hna i an biak hna i an hmaiah an kun; an tuah tawnmi le lungkhong lam an zulh tawnmi kha pakhat hmanh an hlaw hna lo."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa thinhunnak cu Israel cungah a alh i, “Hi mi hna nih hin an pupa hna sinah nawl ka pekmi ka biakamnak kha an hrawh i ka bia kha an ngaih lo caah,"},"21":{"text":"hi hnu hi cu annih hmai in, Joshua nih a thih tikah a nganhtami miphun hna kha, ka dawi ti hna lai lo,"},"22":{"text":"an pupa hna bantuk khan Bawipa lam kha an zul lai maw zul lo tiah Israel mi cu hneksaknak caah annih cu ka hman hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih hi miphun hna cu hmakhatte ah dawi loin a umtak rih hna i Joshua kut chungah khan a pe hna lo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mah miphun hna hi Bawipa nih Kanaan ram chung i raldohnak zeihmanh a hngal lomi Israel mi vialte kha, hneksaknak ding ca i a nganhtami cu an si;","title":"Israel Hneksak Awkah A Taangmi Miphun Hna"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi tefa hna nih raldohnak an hngalh nakhnga ca lawng le, cu hlan i raltuk a rak hngal bal lomi hna tei kha raldohnak a cawnpiak hna nakhnga ca lawngah a si."},"3":{"text":"Cu miphun hna cu mah hihi an si: Filistin mi hna bawi panga le Kanaan mi vialte le Sidon mi hna le Lebanon Tlang i a ummi Hiv mi hna, Baal-hermon Tlang in Hamath luhnak tiang."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih Moses in an pupa hna nawlbia a rak pekmi hna kha an ngai lai maw ngai lo ti hngalh nakding caah, cu hna cu Israel mi hneksaknak caah an si."},"5":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi hna cu Kanaan mi le Hit mi le Amor mi le Periz mi le Hiv mi le Jebus mi hna lakah cun an um i,"},"6":{"text":"an fanule cu nupi ah an ṭhit hna i an fanu hrimhrim hna cu, cu hna i an fapale sinah khan an pek hna; cun an pathian zong kha an biak hna."},"7":{"text":"“Cun Israel mi nih Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭha lo kha an tuah, Bawipa an Pathian kha an philh i Baal hna le Asherah hna rian kha an ṭuan hna.","title":"Israel Mi Kushan-rishathaim Kut Chungin A Luatter Hna"},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa thinhunnak cu Israel mi cungah a alh i Mesopotamia siangpahrang Kushan-rishathaim kut chungah khan a zuarh hna; cu caah Israel mi nih cun Kushan-rishathaim cu kum riat an rianh."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi nih cun Bawipa kha an auh tikah Israel mi caah cun Bawipa nih chuahtu pakhat a hun umter; amah nih cun a chuah hna, amah cu Kaleb nau Kenaz fapa Othniel a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa thlarau cu a cungah a tlung i Israel cu bia a ceih hna; raldoh awkah khan aa thawh i Mesopotamia siangpahrang Kushan-rishathaim kha Bawipa nih a kut chungah a pek; Kushan-rishathaim kha a tei."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah ram cu kum sawm li aa din. Cun Kenaz fapa Othniel cu a thi."},"12":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo cu an tuah ṭhan; cun Bawipa nih Moab siangpahrang Eglon cu Israel mi doh awkah a ṭhawnter, zeicahtiah Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha an tuah.","title":"Edud Nih Moab Mi Kut Chungin A Luatter Hna"},"13":{"text":"Ammon mi hna le Amalek mi hna kha a pumh hna i a kal i Israel kha a tei; cun ungkung khua kha an lak."},"14":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Moab siangpahrang Eglon cu kum hlei riat an rianh."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi nih Bawipa kha an auh tikah annih cu Bawipa nih cun chuahtu pakhat a serpiak hna, Benjamin phun Gera fapa Ehud, kehtlak kha a si. Israel mi nih amah cu Moab siangpahrang Eglon sinah ngunkhuai an phorhter."},"16":{"text":"Cun Ehud nih cun kap hnih har nam, dong khat a saumi cu aa ser i a puan tangah a orhlei phei ah aa thlaih."},"17":{"text":"Cun Moab siangpahrang Eglon cu ngunkhuai cu a pek.
