Cun Moses fapa Gershom i a fapa Jonathan le a fapa hna cu, ram kha sal i a taan ni tiang, Dan miphun caah tlangbawi an si."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah Mikah nih a sermi milem cu, Shiloh i Pathian inn ah a um chung cu, annih nih anmah caah an i chiah."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan lioah, Israel chung i siangpahrang an um lo lioah khan, Levi mi pakhat cu Efraim tlangram a ken ah a pem i Judah ram Bethlehem khua in nuchun pakhat aa lak.","title":"Levi Mipa le A Nupichun Kong"},"2":{"text":"Cun a nuchun cu a cungah a thin a hung i a sinin Judah ram Bethlehem khua i a pa inn ah khan khua a tli, khika ah thla li tluk a um."},"3":{"text":"Cun a va nih amah sinah bia nem va chim le amah kha kirpi ṭhan awkah a tho i a zulh. A sinum le laa tuah khat a kalpi hna. A nupi pa inn kha a va phan i ngaknu pa nih cun a rak hmuh tikah ton awkah lunglawmhnak in a ra."},"4":{"text":"Cun a pu, ngaknu pa nih khan, a camter i a sinah ni thum a cam; cu caah an ei an ding i khika ah an cam."},"5":{"text":"Ni linak ni ah zingka in an tho i kal awkah an i tim. Sihmanhsehlaw ngaknu pa nih cun a tupa cu, “Rawl tlawmpal in ei law, i hrim rih ngat, cu hnuah na kal te lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah mipa pahnih hna cu hmunkhat ah an ṭhu i an ei i an ding ṭi. Cun ngaknu pa nih mipa sinah cun, “Tuzan cu riak rih ko law, lunglawm tein um ko,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun mipa cu kal awkah a thawh tikah a pu nih khan a lem i khika ah a riak ṭhan."},"8":{"text":"Ni nganak ni ah kal awkah zingka tein a tho. Cun ngaknu pa nih khan, “I hrim rih tuah law, nitlak tiangin um tuah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah an pahnih in an ei ṭi."},"9":{"text":"Cun mipa le a nuchun le a sal kha kal awkah an i thawh tikah, a pu, ngaknu pa nih cun, amah cu, “Zohhmanh, atu cu ni a tla dengmang cang, zan khuadei in cam ko rih u. Zohhmanh, khua a mui cuahmah cang; hika ah hin riak law, na lung kha nuamhter ko, cun thaizing ah zing tein na tho lai i na inn ah na kal ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mipa nih zan riah cu a duh ti lo; a tho i a kal i Jebus (cucu Jerusalem) ral kha a phan. A dan danhmi laa tuah khat kha aa ngeih hna i a nuchun zong kha a sinah cun a um."},"11":{"text":"Jebus kha an hei naih tikah ni a tla dengmang cang i a salpa nih khan a bawipa cu, “Ra tuah, Jebus mi hna khua ah hin va pial u si law, khika ah va riak u sih,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun a bawipa nih amah cu, “Israel mi chungah aa tel lomi miphun dang hna khua chung luh awkah kan pial lai lo; sihmanhsehlaw Gibeah ah kan lan ko lai,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun a salpa sinah cun, “Ra tuah, hi hmun hna lakah pakhatkhat hi va fuh hna u si, Gibeah ah maw Ramah ah dik kan riah hnga,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah an lan i an kal ko; cun Benjamin ta a simi Gibeah pawng an phak tikah ni nih a tlak phuat hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun Gibeah i luh awk le riah awkah khika in an pial. Cun a lut i khua lai ah a ṭhu, zeitintiah zan riah awkah ahohmanh nih an inn chungah an tlunter hna lo."},"16":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, zanlei sang ah tarpa pakhat cu lo i a rian ṭuannak in a ra tlung; cu pa cu Efraim tlangram mi a si i Gibeah ah a pem; cu ka hmunmi hna cu Benjamin mi an si."},"17":{"text":"Cun khua a hei zoh i khualai ah cun khualpa kha a hei hmuh. Cun tarpa nih cun, “Khuazei ah dah na kal lai? Khuazei in dah na rat?” a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Judah ram Bethlehem khua in ka ratnak Efraim tlangram i hmun ken ah cun kan kal lai. Judah ram Bethlehem khua ah cun ka kal i atu cu ka inn ah ka kir lio; ahohmanh nih an ka tlunter lo."},"19":{"text":"Kan laa hna caah ram le rawl kan ngei ko i, keimah le na salnu le na sal hna he a ummi tlangval caah hin rawl le mitsur hang kan ngei ko; zeihmanh kan bau lo,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun tarpa nih cun, “Nan cungah daihnak si ko seh; nan herhmi vialte cu keimah nih kan ruahpiak hna lai; khua lai bel ah cun riak hrimhrim hlah u,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah a inn chungah a luhpi i laa cu rawl a pek hna. Cun an ke kha an i ṭawl i an ei i an ding."},"22":{"text":"Cun annih nih thanuam in an um lioah khan, zohhmanh, cu khua chung i zei ruaram lomi hna nih cun inn kha an kulh i innka kha an cumh len. Cu inn ngeitu tarpa kha, “Na inn ah a lutmipa kha kan theihhngalh nakhnga hun chuahpi tuah,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Gen 19.5-8"},"23":{"text":"Cun mipa inn ngeitupa kha, an sinah a va chuak i annih cu, “Asilo, ka nau le hna, ṭhalo tuk hringhran in um hlah u; hi mipa nih ka inn chungah a luh cang caah hi thil ṭhalo cu tuah hlah u."},"24":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, hika ah ka fanu ngaknu le a nuchun an um; ka hun chuahpi hna lai. Sual hna u law, nanmah nih a ṭha nan timi kha an cungah va tuah ko u, sihmanhsehlaw hi mipa cungah cun hi tlukin a ṭha lomi thil cu tuah hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi hna nih cun amah cu an ngai duh lo. Cucaah mipa nih a nuchun kha a tlaih i an sinah a hei chuah; cun annih nih amah kha an theihhngalh i zan khuadei in zinglei tiang an hrem. Cun khua fing a hung cah tikah an kalter."},"26":{"text":"Cun khua a dei tikah minu cu a ra i a bawipa a tlunnak inn, mipa inn ah khan, innka ah a tlu i khua a ceu hlantiang a ril ko."},"27":{"text":"Cun a bawipa cu zinglei ah a tho i innka kha a hun hna i kal awkah a chuah tikah, zohhmanh, a nuchun cu innka ah khan innkaba i tlaih in a ril ko."},"28":{"text":"Anih nih, “Tho law, kal u sih,” tiah amah cu a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh a let lo. Cun a laa cungah a chuan i mipa cu a tho i a inn leiah a kal."},"29":{"text":"Cun a inn a phanh tikah nam aa lak i a nuchun cu a can, a kut a ke in, hmun hleihnih ah a ṭhen i Israel ram vialte ah a kuat dih.","ref":"1Sam 11.7"},"30":{"text":"Cun a hmumi vialte nih, “Mah bantuk thil hi dah ngai Israel mi nih Izipt ram in an chuah ni in nihin tiangah a um bal lo, a hmuh zong kan hmu bal lo; ruat u law, i ceih ṭi u law, chim tuah u,” an ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte cu Dan in Beersheba tiang, Gilead zong tel chih in an chuak i, mibu cu Bawipa sinah Mizpah ah minung pakhat bantukin an i pum.","title":"Benjamin Mi Kha Israel Mi Nih An Tuk Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun mi vialte haotu, Israel phun vialte haotu hna cu, Pathian mi aa pummi hna chungah cun an hung chuak i vainam putmi ralkap sing li an si."},"3":{"text":"(Benjamin mi nih Israel mi hna cu Mizpah ah an hung kal ti kha an theih.) Cun Israel mi nih, “Zeitindah hi ṭhat lonak hi a chuah ning a si, kan chim tuah,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun an nawn minu va Levi mi nih khan a leh hna i, “Benjamin ta a simi Gibeah cu, cuka i riah awkah ka nuchun le keimah cu kan phan."},"5":{"text":"Cun Gibeah mi hna nih cun an ka chuahhnawh i zan ah ka riahnak inn cu an kulh. Keimah kha thah an ka timh i ka nuchun kha an sual i a thi."},"6":{"text":"Cun ka nuchun cu ka lak i ka can i Israel comi ram chung dihlak ah khan ka kuat; zeitintiah Israel chungah fihnung le hawrnak kha an tuah."},"7":{"text":"Nannih Israel mi vialte hna nih, ngaihmanh u, nan ruahnak le a ṭha nan tining kha chuah cio tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun mi vialte cu minung pakhat bantukin an tho i, “Ahohmanh kan thlam ah kan kal lai lo i ahohmanh kan inn ah kan tlung lai lo."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Gibeah cungah kan tuah laimi cu mah hihi a si: camcawhfung khiah in kan i thim lai i kan hung doh lai i,"},"10":{"text":"Israel miphun vialte chungin minung za khat ah pahra, thong khat ah za khat, sang khat ah thong khat in kan lak hna lai i mi ca i rawl pechantu an si lai, zeitintiah an rat tikah Benjamin ta a simi Gibeah cu Israel chung i hawrnak sualnak a tuahmi vialte caah khan teirul an cham lai,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi vialte cu lungthin khat tein cu khua doh awkah an i pum."},"12":{"text":"Cun Israel miphun hna nih Benjamin phun chung dihlak ah khan mi an thlah hna i, “Nan lak i a chuakmi hi zei ṭhat lonak dah a si?"},"13":{"text":"Cucaah atu ah kha mi hna, Gibeah i a ummi mi zei ruaram lo hna kha, kan thah hna i ṭhat lonak cu Israel chungin kan thianh naklai, kan pe hna u,” an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Benjamin mi hna nih cun an unau Israel mi hna bia kha an ngai duh lo."},"14":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi hna cu Israel mi he i tuknak hmun i kal awkah Gibeah i khua hna cun an chuak."},"15":{"text":"Cun khi ni ah Benjamin mi hna nih an khua hna chungin vainam pumi an pumhmi hna cu sang hnih le thong ruk an si, Gibeah i a ummi hna nih an thim cikcekmi za sarih hna hleiah khan."},"16":{"text":"Mah hi hna vialte lakah hin thim cikcekmi za sarih kehtlak an um; an dihlak in sam zai hmanh a ngan lomi lungherh cheh thiam an si."},"17":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih, Benjamin chim loin, vainam pumi sing li an pumh hna; hi mi vialte cu raltuk thiammi an si dih."},"18":{"text":"Israel mi cu an tho i Bethel ah an hung kal i Pathian kha an hal, “Kannih lakah hin ahodah Benjamin doh awkah a kal hmasa bik lai?” an ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “Judah a hung kal hmasa bik lai,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu zingka in an tho i Gibeah kha an riahhnawh."},"20":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu Benjamin doh awkah khan an chuak i, Israel mi nih cun annih kha Gibeah i doh awkah cun ṭan hmun an i serh."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin mi hna nih Gibeah chungin an hung chuak i khi ni ah Israel mi cu sang hnih le thong hnih an hrilh hna."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi cu an i serh ṭhan i hmasa bik ni i an ṭan hmun khuarnak hmun ah khan ṭan hmun an khuar ṭhan."},"23":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih an hung kal i Bawipa hmaiah zanlei tiang an ṭap; “Kan unau Benjamin mi hna he i doh awkah kan hung kal ṭhan lai maw?” ti in Bawipa kha an hal. Cun Bawipa nih, “Hung doh ṭhan hna u,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah a ni hnihnak ni ah Israel mi nih Benjamin mi cu an fuh ṭhan hna."},"25":{"text":"A ni hnihnak ni ah cun Gibeah in Benjamin cu annih kha doh awkah a chuak i Israel mi chungin sang khat le thong riat a hrilh hna; an dihlak in vainam pumi an si."},"26":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte, ralkap bu cu an ningpi in, an hung kal i Bethel an phan i an ṭap; Bawipa hmaiah an ṭhu i khi ni cu zanlei tiang rawl an ul i Bawipa hmaiah khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak kha an pekchanh."},"27":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Bawipa kha an hal i (khi caan lioah Pathian biakamnak kuang cu khika ah a um i"},"28":{"text":"Aaron fapa Eleazar i fapa Phinehas nih khi caan lioah a hmaiah rian a ṭuan) annih nih, “Kan unau Benjamin mi hna kha doh awkah kan chuak rih lai maw, asiloah kan ngol lai dah?” tiah an ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “Hung kal u; zeitintiah thaizing ah cun annih cu nan kut chungah kan pek hna lai,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah Israel nih Gibeah velchum in lamhruang attu mi an chiah hna."},"30":{"text":"Cun ni thumnak ni ah Israel mi cu Benjamin mi kha doh awkah an hung kal i voi dang bantuk khan Gibeah pawngah cun ṭan hmun an khuar."},"31":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi hna nih mi cu an chuahhnawh hna i khua lengah an va lan; cun voi dang bantuk khan mi cu thah hram an thawk hna, lam hna le ramlak ah Israel mi sawm thum tluk an thah hna. Lam pakhat cu Bethel ah a hung kalmi a si i a dang cu Gibeah ah a kalmi a si."},"32":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi nih, “Hmasa bantukin kan hmaiah an zam dih,” an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi nih, “Zam u si law, khua chungin lam ah lem hna u sih,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte cu an umnak hmun in an chuak i Baal-tamar ah ṭan hmun an khuar; cun lamhruang attu Israel mi hna nih khan Geba nitlaklei i an umnak hmun khan an hung chuak zutmat."},"34":{"text":"Israel mi lakin thim cikcekmi sang khat hna nih khan Gibeah cu an chuahhnawh i an i doh cu a fak. Sihmanhsehlaw Benjamin mi hna nih rawknak nih a kan naih ti kha an hngal lo."},"35":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Benjamin cu Israel hmaiah a tei; Israel mi nih khi ni ah Benjamin mi cu sang hnih thong nga za khat an thah hna. Hi mi hna cu vainam tlai an si dih."},"36":{"text":"Cucaah Benjamin mi nih kan sung cang ti kha an hngalh. Israel mi hna nih Benjamin mi hna hmaiah an i zamter, zeicahtiah Gibeah kha lamhruang in a attu hna kha an i bochan hna."},"37":{"text":"Cun lamhruang attu pawl nih cun khulrang in an tho i Gibeah kha an nam; lamhruang attu hna cu an chuak i khua cu vainam in an sam dih."},"38":{"text":"Israel mi le lamhruang attu hna nih an rak thimmi hmelchunhnak cu, khuapi chung khan meikhu nganpi an chuahter tikah,"},"39":{"text":"Israel mi nih raltuknak leiah kir ṭhan awk a si lai ti a si. Benjamin nih cun Israel mi cu sawm thum tluk thah hram an thawk cang; annih nih, “Hmasa bik kan i tuknak bantuk khan, kan hmaiah an sung hrimhrim ṭhan ko,” an ti."},"40":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hmelchunhnak cu khuapi chung i meikhu in kai hram a thawk tikah Benjamin mi hna nih an hnulei kha an hei zoh i zohhmanh, khua cu a ning piin meikhu in van ah a kai."},"41":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu an i let i Benjamin mi hna cu vansang au in an um, zeitintiah rawknak nih a kan naih ti kha an hmuh."},"42":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi hna hmaiah cun ramlak leiah khan an zam; sihmanhsehlaw raltuknak nih a phanh ṭhiamṭhiam hna i khua chungin a hung chuakmi hna kha an lakah an i cawh cang i an thah hna."},"43":{"text":"Benjamin mi hna cu an sam hna i Nohah in Gibeah nichuahlei ral tiang an dawi hna i an lamh hna."},"44":{"text":"Benjamin mi cu sang khat le thong riat an thi, an dihlak in mi ralṭha an si."},"45":{"text":"Cun an i mer i ramlak lei Rimmon lungpi leiah khan an zam; lampi ah mi thong nga an thi i Gidom tiangin fak piin dawi an si i mi thong hnih an thi."},"46":{"text":"Cucaah khi ni ah Benjamin mi a thimi hna cu vainam pu, sang hnih thong nga an si, an dihlak in mi ralṭha an si."},"47":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi za ruk cu an i mer i ramlak lei Rimmon lungpi leiah khan an zam i Rimmon lungpi ah khan thla li an um."},"48":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih Benjamin mi cu an kirhnawh ṭhan hna i vainam in an sam hna. Mi siseh, saram siseh, an hmuhmi paohpaoh an sam dih hna. Cun an hmuhmi khua vialte zong mei in an duah hna."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna nih Mizpah ah khan, “Ahohmanh nih kan fanu hna cu Benjamin mi sinah ṭhit awkah kan pe hna lai lo,” tiah chiat an ser.","title":"Benjamin Mi Hna Caah Nupi Ca Khuakhannak"},"2":{"text":"Cun mi hna cu Bethel ah an ra i Pathian hmaiah zanlei tiang an ṭhu i aw thang piin, lunghno ngaiin an ṭap."},"3":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Maw Bawipa, Israel mi Pathian, zeicahdah Israel mi chungah hi thil hi a hung um i Israel mi lakin nihin ah hin phun khat cu an bau?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun a thaizing ah mi cu zingka tein an tho i khika ah biakṭheng pakhat an ser i khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak kha an pekchanh."},"5":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih, “Israel miphun vialte lakah ahodah Bawipa sin i i pumhnak ah a chuak lo?” tiah an ti. Zeitintiah annih nih Mizpah ah Bawipa sin i a ra lomi kongah khan chiatsernak nganpi pakhat an ser i, “Thah a si lai,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Israel mi nih an nau Benjamin cungah cun zaangfahnak an ngei i, “Nihin ah hin Israel mi sinin phun khat cu chok an si."},"7":{"text":"Kannih nih Bawipa min in kan fanu hna cu an nupi caah kan pe hna lai lo tiah chiat kan ser cang caah, a tang rihmi hna caah cun an nupi caah zeidah kan tuah lai?” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Israel miphun hna lakah aho set dah Bawipa sinah Mizpah ah a hung kal lomi a si?” an ti. Cun zohhmanh, Jabesh-gilead in, aa pummi bu sinah riahhmun ah ahohmanh an ra lo."},"9":{"text":"Zeitintiah mi cu an pumh hna tikah zohhmanh, Jabesh-gilead i a ummi cu khika ah pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah aa pummi nih an mi ralṭha bik sang khat le thong hnih hna cu khika ah an thlah hna i, “Va kal u law, Jabesh-gilead mi hna cu vainam in va sam hna u, nu zong, ngakchia zong."},"11":{"text":"Mah hihi nan tuah awk cu a si lai; pa vialte le pa he a it cangmi nu vialte cu nan thah cikcek hna lai,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Jabesh-gilead i a ummi hna lakah cun pa a hngal rih lomi ngaknu za li an hmuh hna; annih cu Kanaan ram chung i a ummi Shiloh i riahhmun ah khan an ratpi hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun aa pummi vialte nih cun Rimmon lungpi i a ummi Benjamin mi sinah khan bia an hei cah hna i annih kha remnak bia an thanh hna."},"14":{"text":"Khi caan ah Benjamin mi cu an ra kir i Jabesh-gilead i an zuahmi nu hna kha an pek hna; sihmanhsehlaw an i za lo."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel miphun hna chungah kuainak pakhat a ser caah, Benjamin mi hna cungah cun zaangfahnak an ngei."},"16":{"text":"Cun aa pummi hna lak i upa hna nih cun, “A tang rihmi hna cu an nupi caah zeidah kan tuah lai, Benjamin mi hna lak i nu hna cu hrawh an si cang ṭung?” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Benjamin mi hna lakin a nung rihmi hna caah hin ro a um hrimhrim awk a si lai, Israel mi chungin miphun pakhat cu a loh nakhnga lo."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kan fanu hna cu nupi caah kan pe kho hna lo,” an ti. Zeitintiah Israel mi nih chiat an ser cang i “Benjamin mi nupi a pemi cu chiat si seh,” an ti."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah annih nih, “Zohhmanh, Bethel chaklei, Bethel in Shekhem i a hung kalmi lam nichuahlei, Lebonah thlanglei ah a ummi Shiloh ah kumfatin Bawipa caah puai an tuah tawnmi a um,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi kha nawl an pek hna i, “Va kal u law, mitsur dum chungah khan va bawh hna u law, va ngia hna u."},"21":{"text":"Cun Shiloh khua ngaknu hna nih lamnak chung i i tel ve awkah an ra chuah tikah, mitsur dum chung cun ra chuak u law, Shiloh ngaknu hna cu pakhat nih pakhat cio nupi ah i tlaih hna u law, Benjamin ram ah kal tuah u."},"22":{"text":"Cun annih an pale nih maw an ṭale nih maw kan sinah zai awkah an rat tikah kannih nih annih cu, ‘Raldoh lioah khan an nupi ca ding cio kan rak lakpiak ṭung hna lo, nannih zong nih nan rak pe hna lo, rak pe hna u law, atu ah mawhchiat nan si hnga, cu caah zaangfahnak in kan pe ko hna u,’ tiah kan rak ti hna lai,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi hna nih cu bangin an tuah i, an kalpimi hna a lammi hna lakin anmah zat tein nupi an i lak hna. Cun an kal i an covo ram ah khan an kir i khua kha an ser ṭhan hna i an chungah an um."},"24":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu khi caan ah khika in anmah le an phun le an innchungkhar sin cio ah khan an kir i, khika in anmah le an covo ram cio ah khan an kal."},"25":{"text":"Khi caan lioah khan Israel mi lakah siangpahrang an um lo; ahopaoh nih anmah duhmi cio kha an tuah ko.","ref":"Biac 17.6"}}}}},"8":{"info":{"name":"Ruth","shortname":"Ruth","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biaceihtu hna nih an rak uk lioah khan ram chungah cun mangṭam a tlung i, Judah ram chung i Bethlehem khuami pakhat cu, a nupi le a fapa pahnih hna he tiah, Moab ram i pem awkah an kal.","title":"Ruth le Naomi"},"2":{"text":"Cu mipa a min cu Elimelek a si, a nupi min cu Naomi a si i a fapa pahnih hna min cu Mahlon le Khilion an si; Judah ram chung Bethlehem khua i Efrath mi an si. Moab ram ah cun an va kal i khika ah an va um."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Naomi va Elimelek cu a thi i amah le a fapa pahnih cu a roh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Moab minu kha nupi ah an ṭhit hna; pakhat cu a min ah Orpah a si i a dang pakhat cu a min ah Ruth a si. Khika ah kum hra tluk an um i,"},"5":{"text":"Mahlon le Khilion cu an pahnih in an thi i, cucaah Naomi cu a fapa pahnih hna le a va nih khan an roh ai."},"6":{"text":"Cun a fapale nupi hna he khan tiah kir ṭhan awkah Moab ram khan aa thawh, zeitintiah Bawipa nih a mi kha a len cang hna i rawl a pek hna ti kha, Moab ram chung khan a theih."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah a umnak hmun khan a fapale nupi hna he khan aa thawh i Judah ram i kir ṭhannak lam ah khan an kal."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Naomi nih a fapale nupi pahnih hna kha a thawh hna i, “Va kal cang u, nanmah le nan nu le inn cio ah khan va kir cang u. Mithi hna le keimah cungah nan tuah bantuk hin Bawipa nih nan cungah zaangfahnak tuah ve ko seh."},"9":{"text":"Cun nan pahnih in va inn tangah khuasaknak nan ton khawh nakhnga Bawipa nih zaangfahnak in pe ko hna seh!” tiah a ti. Cun a hnamh hna i nguingui thlak in an ṭap."},"10":{"text":"Cun annih nih amah cu, “Kan kir lai lo, nangmah sinah na miphun hna sinah kan kir ve ko lai,” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Naomi nih, “Ka fanule hna, kir ko u, zeicahdah keimah sinah cun nan kal lai? Nan va ding caah ka paw chungah fapa ka ngeih ti ṭung hna lo?"},"12":{"text":"Va kir ko u, ka fanule hna, va kal ko u, va ngeih awkah ka tar tuk cang. Ruahchannak ka ngei rih tiin tuzan hmanh ah hin va hei ngei in fapa hei ngei hna ning law,"},"13":{"text":"nannih nih an upat tiang nan hngah hna hnga maw? Va ngei loin maw nan um ko hnga? Si hlah e, ka fanu hna, nanmah caah hin ka ngaih a chia hringhran ko, Bawipa kut cu keimah doh ah cun pei a chuah cang fam cu,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun nguingui thlak in an ṭap ṭhan; Orpah nih cun a pi cu a hnamh, sihmanhsehlaw Ruth tu nih cun aa tlaih peng."},"15":{"text":"Cun amah nih, “Zohhmanh, na va unau nupi cu amah miphun le a pathian hna sinah a kir cang; nang zong na va unau nupi cu zul in kir ve tuah,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ruth nih, “Nangmah he i ṭhen awk le nangmah zul lo i kir ṭhan awkah ka lem len hlah; zeicahtiah na kalnak ah ka kal ve lai i na riahnak ah ka riak ve lai; na miphun cu ka miphun an si ve lai i na Pathian cu ka Pathian a si ve lai;"},"17":{"text":"na thihnak ah ka thi ve lai i khika ah cun an ka vui ve ko lai. Pathian nih cu bantukin ka cungah tuah seh law, tam deuh zongin tuah ko seh, thihnak hmanh nih nangmah sinin ka ṭhen ai kun,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Naomi nih amah sinah kal aa tim hrimhrim ti kha a hmuh tikah zeihmanh a chim ti lo."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah Bethlehem tiangin an pahnih in an kal. Cun Bethlehem an phak tikah anmah ruangah an khuapi in an i tuai ur i nu hna nih cun, “Mah hihi Naomi kha a si maw?” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun anih nih annih cu, “Naomi ka ti hlah u, Mara ka ti u, zeicahtiah Lianngan Bik nih khaa ngaingai in ka cungah a tuah cang."},"21":{"text":"Khatte in ka rak kal i Bawipa nih kutro in a ka kirpi ṭhan. Bawipa nih a ka hrem i Lianngan Bik nih ka cungah harnak a tlunter tikah hin zeicahdah Naomi nan ka ti?” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cu bantukin Naomi cu, Moab ram in a kirmi Moab minu Ruth, a fapa nupi he khan a ra kir. Cun annih cu barli ṭuan domh ah khin Bethlehem khua an phan."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Naomi nih cun a va rualchan, Elimelek chung, mirum ngai, rualchan pakhat a ngei i a min cu Boaz a si.","title":"Boaz Lo Ah Ruth Nih Famua A Sua"},"2":{"text":"Cun Moab minu Ruth nih cun Naomi cu a thawh i, “Lo ah va kal ning law a rak ka zaangfahtu paoh sinah famua ka va sua lai,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Va kal ko, ka fanu,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lev 19.9-10; Deu 24.19"},"3":{"text":"Cucaah aa thawh i a kal i rawlṭuantu hna hnuah khan famua cu a va sua; cun Elimelek chung a simi Boaz ta a simi lo ah cun a va phan sual ai."},"4":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, Boaz cu Bethlehem in a ra i rawlṭuantu hna sinah cun, “ Bawipa cu nan sinah um ko seh,” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih, “ Bawipa nih thluachuah in pe ko seh,” tiah an leh."},"5":{"text":"Cun Boaz nih rawlṭuantu a zohtu hna a sinum sinah cun, “Mah hihi mizei ngaknu dah a si?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun rawlṭuantu a zohtu hna sinum nih cun, “Moab mi ngaknu kha a si, Moab ram in Naomi he a raminu kha."},"7":{"text":"Amah nih hin, ‘Zaangfahnak tein, rawlṭuantu hna hnuah hin faphal lakah famua ka suatter law, ka pumhter ko,’ tiah a ti. Cucaah a ra i zingka tein atu tiang a ṭuan lengmang, tlawmte hmanh i din hin loin,” tiah a leh."},"8":{"text":"Cun Boaz nih Ruth sinah cun, “Ngaihmanh, ka fanu, lo dang i famua va suat awkah kal hlah; hi zong hi chuahtak hlah, sihmanhsehlaw ka ngaknu pawl sinah hin um peng ko."},"9":{"text":"Annih nih an ṭuan liomi lo kha i zoh law, annih hnu in zul hna. Tlangval hna cu nangmah kha in tonghtham lo awkah bia ka riah hna khah. Cun na ti a hal tikah ti um ah khan va kal law, tlangval nih an thanmi kha va ding ko,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun a kun i vawlei lei hoih in a lu a khun in amah cu, “Phun dang mi ka si cu na hngalh ko, asinain, keimah cu na hei ka hngalh duh nakhnga ah, zeicahdah na hmaiah mithmai ṭha cu ka hmuh e?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Boaz nih a leh i, “Na va a thih ri in na pi cung i na tuahmi vialte cu tling tein an ka chimh dih ko, na nu le na pa le na chuahnak ram na kaltak hna i a hlan i na hngalh bal lomi miphun sin i na ratnak hawi hna hi."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih na tuah ciami cu in rul seh law, Bawipa, Israel Pathian, a thla tangah i dor awk i na rak fuhmi nih cun, tampi in laksawng in pe ko seh!” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Ka bawipa, ka cungah na ṭha hringhran ko, zeitintiah ka hna na ka ngamter i, na salnu si ve hmanh hlah ning law, na salnu sinah hin bia nemnem na chim,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun rawl ei caan ah Boaz nih amah cu, “Hika hin ra law, changreu hawi hna hi ra ei ve, na changreu cheuchum cu mitsur hang chungah hnim ve,” tiah a ti. Cucaah rawl ṭuantu hna pawngah khan a ṭhu i vaireu kha Boaz nih a hei chanh i a khim tiang a ei, ei bang zong tlawmpal a ngei."},"15":{"text":"Famua suat awkah aa thawh tikah khan, Boaz nih a tlangval pawl cu, “Faphal lakah hin suatter ko u law, si hlah u."},"16":{"text":"Cun a tom chung hna zong khan zuhpiak u law, kaltak hna u law, hun i suat seh, caa hlah u,” tiin nawl a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah lo chungah cun zanlei tiang a sua; a suatmi cu a tuk i barli ephah pakhat hrawng a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun aa phorh i khua chungah a lut; a pi cu a suatmi kha a hmuhsak, cun a khim hnu i a tangmi rawl zong kha a chuah i a pek."},"19":{"text":"Cun a pi nih khan amah cu, “Khuazei ah dah nihin cu na suat? Cun khuazei ah dah na ṭuan? Nangmah a rak in hngal duhtu cu thluachuahnak hmu ko seh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a pi cu aho sin i a ṭuan kha a chimh i, “Nihin ah a sin i ka ṭuan mipa min cu Boaz a si,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Naomi nih a fapa nupi sinah cun, “A nungmi cungah siseh, a thimi cungah siseh, a zaangfahnak a ngol lomi Bawipa nih cun amah cu thluachuahnak pe ko seh!” tiah a ti. Cun Naomi nih a sinah, “Cu pa cu kan rualchan a si, kan sahlawh naih bik a si,” tiah a ti fawn.","ref":"Lev 25.25"},"21":{"text":"Cun Moab minu Ruth nih cun, “Cu hleiah, ‘Ka rawl ṭuan an dih hlantiang ka sinum hna sinah hin na um ve ko lai,’ a ka ti pei,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Naomi nih, a fapa nupi Ruth sinah cun, “Ka fanu, a sinum ngaknu hna sin i na kal cu a ṭha ko lai, lo dang ah cun an in tonghtham sual hnga,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Boaz ngaknu pawl sinah cun, barli le changvut ṭuan a dih tiang a um i famua cu a sua lengmang; cun a pi sinah cun a um."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun a pi Naomi nih cun amah cu a thawh i, “Ka fanu, nangmah ca i a ṭhat nakhnga, khuasaknak kawlpiak loin maw kan um hnga?","title":"Phuhri Ah Ruth le Boaz"},"2":{"text":"A ngaknu pawl he na va umnak Boaz kha kan rualchan a si lo maw? Zohhmanh, tuzan ah phuhri ah barli a zap lai."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah i kholh law, sathau i thuh law, na hnipuan ṭha bik i hruk hna law, phuhri ah cun vung kal tuah; sihmanhsehlaw ei le din a dih hlantiang, mipa sinah cun i hngalhter hlah."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a ih tikah a ihnak kha i ngiat; cun va kal law, a ke kha va hlim law, va it ve; cun amah nih zei tuah awk kha an chimh lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Na chimmi paoh cu ka tuah lai,” tiah a leh."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah phuhri ah cun a vung kal i a pi nih a chimh bantukte khan a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Cun Boaz cu a ei a din dih in a lung aa lawm i rawltlun hram i ih awkah a kal. Cun din tein a ra i a ke cu a hlim i a it ve."},"8":{"text":"Cun zanlai ah mipa cu a lau i a khel aa let i, zohhmanh, nu pakhat kha a kehram ah a rak it ko!"},"9":{"text":"Cun, “Ahodah na si?” tiah a ti i, “Na salnu Ruth ka si; ka rualchan naih na si caah na salnu hi na puan ka zawn tuah,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Ka fanu, Bawipa nih thluachuahnak in pe ko seh; tlangval a sifakmi siseh, a rummi siseh na zulh hna lonak ah hin, a hmasa bik i nak hmanh khan hi a hmanung bik na vel hi na dawhter deuh cang."},"11":{"text":"Cun ka fanu, ṭih hlah, ka khuapi hawi vialte nih nangmah cu mi ṭha na si kha an hngalh ko caah na ka halmi vialte cu kan tuahpiak lai."},"12":{"text":"Cun keimah cu na rualchan naih ka si taktak, asinain keimah nakin a nai deuhmi pakhat a um rih.","ref":"Rut 2.20"},"13":{"text":"Tuzan cu hika ah um ko, thaizing ah amah nih nangmah caah aa naihmi rualchan nih tuah awk kha a tuah duh ahcun, a ṭha ko; tuah ko seh. Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah caah aa naihmi rualchan nih tuah awk kha a tuah duh lo ahcun, khi tikah, keimah nih, Bawipa a nun bangin, nangmah ca i aa naihmi rualchan nih tuah awk cu ka tuah lai. Zinglei tiangin it ko,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah a kehram ah cun zinglei tiang a it, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh fiangfai in i hmuh khawh hlanah khin a tho; cun amah nih, “Phuhri ah minu a ra ti kha ahohmanh theihter lo si seh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun a thawh i, “Naa aihmi na puan kha rak pu law, rak dawn tuah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a dawnh i barli kha rel ruk a tah i a cungah a khinh; cun khua chungah a lut."},"16":{"text":"Cun a pi sin a va phak tikah, “Zeitindah na si, ka fanu?” tiah a rak ti. Cun mipa nih a ca i a tuahmi vialte kha a chimh i,"},"17":{"text":"“Hi barli rel ruk hi a ka pek i, ‘Na pi sinah kut ro in na kir hrimhrim hnga lo,’ a ka ti,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun amah nih, “Zeitindah thil cu a si ti kha na hngalh hlantiang, ka fanu, hngak ko rih, zeicahtiah nihin ah cu thil cu a lim hlantiang mipa cu a um sawhsawh lai lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Boaz cu hauka ah khan a hung kal i khika ah a ṭhu; cun zohhmanh, Boaz i a chimmi rualchan naih kha a ra. Cucaah Boaz nih, “Ka kawi, ra pial ta rih tuah; hika ah hin ṭhu tuah,” tiah a ti i a ra pial i a ṭhu.","title":"Boaz Nih Ruth A Ṭhit"},"2":{"text":"Cun khua chung upa pahra kha a lak hna i, “Hika ah hin ṭhu tuah u,” a ti hna i an ṭhu."},"3":{"text":"Cun rualchan naih sinah cun, “Moab ram in a kir ṭhanmi Naomi nih kan phunhawi Elemelek ta a simi lobung pakhat kha a zuar."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah cun, cu kong cu nangmah kha kan chimh awk le hika i a ummi hna le ka mi hna lak i upa hna hmaiah hin caw, kan ti awk a si tiah ka ruah. Na tlanh hnga a si ahcun, tlan tuah; sihmanhsehlaw na tlanh duh lo ahcun, ka hngalh nakhnga ka chim tuah, zeicahtiah nangmah hleiah a tlantu ding an um ti lo i nangmah an changtu cu keimah ka si ko,” tiah a ti. Cun, “Ka tlanh lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Boaz nih a thawh i, “Naomi kut in lo cu na cawk ni in mithipa nupi Moab minu Ruth zong kha na cawk a si; mithipa min cu a ro ah na kirter ṭhan nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun rualchan naihpa nih cun, “Keimah ro tu kha ka hrawh sual lai caah, keimah caah cun ka tlan kho lai lo. Keimah nih ka tlanh khawh lo caah nangmah tu nih tlan khotu ka sinak cu i lak ko,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun mah hihi, hlan lioah cun Israel mi lakah tlanhnak le thlennak kongah, phung a rak si; biatlaknak fehternak ah pakhat nih a kedan kha aa phoih i pakhat kha a pek, mah hihi Israel mi nih thil an rak fehterning cu a si.","ref":"Deu 25.9"},"8":{"text":"Cucaah rualchan naih nih khan Boaz cu, “Nangmah caah i cawk ko,” a ti tikah khan a kedan aa phoih."},"9":{"text":"Cun Boaz nih upa hna le mizapi hna sinah khan, “Nannih cu nihin ni ah hin Naomi kut chungin Elimelek ta a simi vialte le Khilion le Mahlon ta a simi vialte cu ka cawk cang hna, ti hngaltu nan si."},"10":{"text":"Mithipa min cu a unau hna sin le a chuahnak hmun hauka in a loh nakhnga lo, mithipa min cu a ro chung i hmunhter awkah, Mahlon nih a rohmi Moab minu Ruth zong kha ka nupi si awkah ka cawk cang; cucu nannih hi nihin ah hin a hngaltu nan si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Deu 25.5-6"},"11":{"text":"Cun hauka ah a ummi vialte le upa hna nih khan, “Hngaltu kan si. Na inn chungah a ra ding minu cu, Rachel le Leah, Israel innchungkhar a dirhtu pahnih hna bantuk ah khan Bawipa nih ser ko seh. Efrathah ah hin khua awng tong law, Bethlehem ah na min thang ko seh;","ref":"Gen 29.31"},"12":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih hi ngaknu sinin an pek laimi tefa hna thawngin, na innchungkhar cu Tamar nih Judah a hrinpiakmi Perez innchungkhar bantuk kha si ko seh,” an ti.","ref":"Gen 38.27-30"},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Boaz nih Ruth cu a lak i a nupi ah a cang; a theihhngalh i Bawipa nih fapawinak a pek i fapa a hrin."},"14":{"text":"Cun nu hna nih khan Naomi sinah cun, “Nihin ni i rualchan naih chambau loin an umtertu Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh; amah min cu Israel mi lakah thang ko seh!"},"15":{"text":"Amah cu nangmah caah nunter ṭhantu le na tar leiah an cawmtu a si lai; zeitintiah na fapa nupi, nangmah an dawtu, nangmah ca i fapa pasarih nakin a ṭha deuhmi nih cun, a hrin cang,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Naomi nih ngakchia cu a lak i a pom i a umh."},"17":{"text":"Cun innpa nu pawl nih khan min an sak i, “Naomi caah fapa a chuak,” tiah an ti. Obed tiah min an sak; amah cu David pa Jesse i a pa a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun mah hna hi Perez tefa cu an si: Perez cu Hezron pa a si,"},"19":{"text":"Hezron cu Ram pa a si, Ram cu Amminadab pa a si,"},"20":{"text":"Amminadab cu Nahshon pa a si, Nahshon cu Salmon pa a si,"},"21":{"text":"Salmon cu Boaz pa a si, Boaz cu Obed pa a si,"},"22":{"text":"Obed cu Jesse pa a si i Jesse cu David pa a si."}}}}},"9":{"info":{"name":"1Samuel","shortname":"1Sam","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Efraim tlangram Ramathaim-zofim khua ah mipa pakhat a um i a min cu Elkanah a si; amah cu Jeroham fapa a si, Jeroham cu Elihu fapa a si, Elihu cu Tohu fapa a si, Tohu cu Efraim mi Zuf fapa a si.","title":"Samuel Hrinnak Kong"},"2":{"text":"Nupi pahnih a ngei, pakhat min cu Hannah a si i a dang pakhat min cu Peninnah a si. Cun Peninnah cu fa a ngei, sihmanhsehlaw Hannah cu fa a ngei lo."},"3":{"text":"Cun hi pa cu kumfate in, Eli fapa pahnih Hofni le Phinehas, Bawipa tlangbawi an sinak Shiloh khua ah khan, ralkapbu Bawipa biak awk le raithawi awkah, amah khua in a hung kal tawn."},"4":{"text":"Elkanah nih rai a thawi ni ah khan, a nupi Peninnah le a fapa hna le a fanu hna cu an dihlak in covo kha a pek cio hna;"},"5":{"text":"cun Hannah cu a daw ko nain Hannah cu Bawipa nih a nau inn a kharpiak caah covo pakhat lawng kha a pek."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih a nau inn a khar caah khan amah a engtaitu nih khan amah cu a thin hunter awkah ṭhalo tein a ti hram tawn."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun kum khat hnu kum khat a si lengmang i, Bawipa inn i a hung kal fate amah cu a ti hram lengmang tawn. Cucaah Hannah cu a ṭap i rawl ei kha a duh lo."},"8":{"text":"Cun a va Elkanah nih khan a sinah, “Hannah, zeicahdah na ṭah? Zeicahdah rawl ei na duh lo? Zeicahdah na thinlung a fah? Nangmah caah keimah cu fapa pahra nakin ka si deuh lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Shiloh i an ei an din dih khan Hannah cu a tho. Cun tlangbawi Eli cu Bawipa biaknak inn innka tung pawng i ṭhutnak ah khan a ṭhu."},"10":{"text":"Cun Hannah cu a lungre a thei ngaingai i Bawipa sinah thla a cam i lunghno ngai tein a ṭap."},"11":{"text":"Cun biatiamnak a tuah i, “Maw ralkapbu Bawipa, na salnu intuarnak hi na ka hmuhpiak i na ka cinken i, na salnu kha na philh lo i na salnu hi fapa na ka pek ahcun, a nun chung vialte amah cu Bawipa sinah ka pek lai i, luei nam nih a lu kha a tawng lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Nam 6.5"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa hmai i thla a cam lengmang lioah cun Eli nih a kaa kha a rak i chingchiah."},"13":{"text":"Hannah nih cun a lung chungin a chim; a hmur lawng kha an caang i a aw cu theih a si lo; cucaah Eli nih zuri nu ah a rel."},"14":{"text":"Cun Eli nih amah cu a thawh i, “Zei can dah na rit lai? Na zu cu chia cang ngat,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Hannah nih a leh i, “Asilo, ka bawipa, lung rethei ngaingai in a ummi nu ka si; mitsur hang siseh, zu siseh ka ding lo, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa hmaiah ka lungthin ka bungh a si."},"16":{"text":"Na salnu hi nu ṭhalo ah ka rel hlah, zeitintiah ka lung retheihnak le ka ngaihchiatnak pei ka chim lengmangmi hi a si cu,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Eli nih a leh i, “Dai tein va kal ko, Israel mi Pathian nih amah na halmi cu in pe ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Na salnu nih na mit ah duhdawtnak hmu ko seh,” tiah a ti. Cun minu cu a kal i rawl kha a ei i ngaihchia mithmai a pu ti lo."},"19":{"text":"Zingka tein an tho i Bawipa cu an biak i Ramah khua i an inn ah khan an tlung. Cun Elkanah nih a nupi Hannah kha a hngalh i Bawipa nih amah kha a philh lo;"},"20":{"text":"cun a caan a tlin tikah Hannah cu fa a pawi i fapa a hrin i, “Amah cu Bawipa sinin ka halmi a si,” tiin a min ah Samuel a sak."},"21":{"text":"Cun Elkanah le a chungle vialte cu Bawipa sin i kum fate thawinak pekchanh awk le a biahrennak pek awkah an hung kal."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Hannah cu a hung kal lo, zeitintiah amah nih a va sinah cun, “Ngakchia hi hnuk ka thlei cangka in ka ratpi lai, Bawipa hmaiah a chuah i khika ah a um zungzal nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun a va Elkanah nih cun “A ṭha bik ti i na ruahmi paoh cu tuah ko, amah kha hnuk na thlei hlantiang rak ngang rih ko; Bawipa nih a bia bel kha fehter ko seh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah hnuk a thlei hlantiang minu cu a um i a fapa kha hnuk a dinh."},"24":{"text":"Cun hnuk a thlei dih in, kum thum a timi cawtum pakhat le changvut ephah pakhat le mitsur hang cua khat he tiah, amah sinah a hun i kalpi; Shiloh i Bawipa inn ah khan a ratpi; ngakchia cu a note ko."},"25":{"text":"Cun cawtum kha an thah i ngakchia cu Eli sinah an ratpi."},"26":{"text":"Cun amah nih, “Maw ka bawipa! Na nun bangin, ka bawipa, keimah hi hika na hmai i Bawipa sin i thla a rak cam minu kha ka si."},"27":{"text":"Hi ngakchia caah hin thla kha ka rak cam; cun Bawipa nih ka halnak kha a ka pek."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa kha amah cu ka hlanh cang; a nun chung vialte amah cu Bawipa sinah hlanh a si,” tiah a ti. Cun khika ah Bawipa kha an biak."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Hannah nih thla zong a cam i, “ Bawipa cungah ka lung aa lawm; Bawipa thawngin ka thazang cu hlorh a si. Na khamhnak ah khan kaa lawmh caah, Ka ral hna cu ka kaa nih a nihsawh hna.","title":"Hannah Hla (Luk 1.46-58)","ref":"Luk 1.46-55"},"2":{"text":"“ Bawipa bantukin a thianghlim ahohmanh an um lo Nangmah hleiah ahohmanh an um lo; Kan Pathian bantuk lungpi zong an um lo."},"3":{"text":"Ninghngal tuk in bia chim ti hlah u, Ruamkainak cu nan kaa chung in chuak hlah seh; Zeitintiah Bawipa cu fimnak Pathian a si, Amah nih tuahnak hna kha an khing a thlai tawn hna."},"4":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi an likuk cu an kiak, Sihmanhsehlaw a derthawmmi nih thazang an i hruk."},"5":{"text":"A khim tawnmi cu rawl kawl ah kuli an ṭuan, Sihmanhsehlaw a ṭam tawnmi cu an ṭam ti lo. A cingmi nih pasarih a hrin cang hna. Sihmanhsehlaw fa tampi a ngeimi kha cihai in a um."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih a thah tawn hna a nun zong a nunter tawn hna. Sheol ah a kalter tawn i a chuah zong a chuahter tawn hna."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih a pamter tawn hna i a rumter tawn hna; A ṭhumh tawn hna i a hlorh zong a hlorh tawn hna."},"8":{"text":"Bawi hna sinah ṭhutter awk le Upatnak ṭhutdan coter awk caah, Sifakmi kha leidip lak in a thawh hna i Retheimi kha vutcam pumhmi lak in a cawi hna. Zeitintiah vawlei tung hna cu Bawipa ta an si i An cungah vawlei cu a chuan."},"9":{"text":"“A mithiang hna an ke kha a ven lai; Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu khuamui lakah hrawh an si lai; Zeitintiah mi nih teinak an hmuhnak cu zaang ṭhawnnak in a si lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa a raltu cu kek cikcek in den an si lai; Annih cu van in khuarit in a rithnawh hna lai. Bawipa nih vawlei cung dihlak bia a ceih lai, Amah siangpahrang cu ṭhawnnak a pek lai, Chiti a thuhmi lianhngannak cu a hlorh lai,” tiin a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Elkanah cu Ramah khua ah inn ah a tlung. Cun ngakchiapa cu tlangbawi Eli hmaiah Bawipa rian kha a ṭuan."},"12":{"text":"Cun Eli fapa hna cu mizeiruaramlo an si; Bawipa kha an hmaizah lo.","title":"Eli Fapa Hna Sualnak"},"13":{"text":"Mi zapi hna sinah tlangbawi nih an tuah tawnmi phung cu hi bangin a si, mi pakhatkhat nih raithawinak a pekchanh tikah tlangbawi sinum kha a ra lai i sa cu a tlawh hluahmah lioah a kut i a rak i putmi keuṭe ṭe thum ngei khan"},"14":{"text":"ukang chungah khan siseh, marlei chungah khan siseh, tawngca chungah khan siseh, um chungah khan siseh, a vun chunh lai i fungṭe nih a thur khawh zat paoh kha tlangbawi nih amah caah aa lak lai. Cu bantukin Shiloh ah khan, cuka i Israel mi a rami vialte hna kha an rak tuahpiak tawn hna."},"15":{"text":"Cuhleiah, a thau kha an khangh hlanah, tlangbawi sinum kha a ra tawn i rai a thawi liomi sinah cun, “Tlangbawi ca i em awkah na sa cu ka pe; zeitintiah a hring dah ti lo cu, chuan ciami sa cu an cohlang lai lo,” tiah a ti tawn."},"16":{"text":"Cun mipa nih khan a sinah cun, “A thau kha khaang hmasa rih hna seh, cun na duh zat in naa lak lai,” a ti ahcun, anih nih, “Asilo, atu hrimhrim ah na ka pek lai, cu ti a si lo ahcun, hramhram in keimah nih ka lak lai,” a ti tawn."},"17":{"text":"Cu bangin tlangval hna sualnak cu Bawipa mit hmuh ah khan a ngan ngaingai ko, zeicahtiah annih nih Bawipa sin pekchanhnak kha zawmhtaih serhsat in an tuah."},"18":{"text":"Asinain Samuel cu ngakchia si hmanh seh law Bawipa hmaiah la hmang ṭhia tlangbawi angki i aih in rian a ṭuan."},"19":{"text":"Cun a nu nih angkifual hmete a serpiak tawn i kumfate an raithawinak pekchanh awk i a va he an hung kal tikah, kum fate in a hei phorh tawn."},"20":{"text":"Cun Eli nih Elkanah le a nupi cu thluachuah a pek hna i, “ Bawipa sin i a hlanhmi thawng hin, hi minu hin Bawipa nih fa in pe hna seh,” tiah a ti; cun annih cu an inn leiah an tlung ṭhan."},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Hannah cu a vung ven i fa a pawi i fapa pathum le fanu pahnih a hrin hna. Cun ngakchiapate Samuel cu Bawipa hmaika ah cun a ṭhang."},"22":{"text":"Eli cu a tar ngaingai cang i Israel mi vialte hna cungah a fapa hna nih an tuahmi vialte le zeitindah tonnak thlam luhnak i rian a ṭuantu nu hna an ihpi hna kha a theih."},"23":{"text":"Cun amah nih annih cu, “Zeicahdah mah bantuk thil hna cu nan tuah? Zeitintiah mi vialte sin hin nan tuahnak ṭhalo hna cu ka theih."},"24":{"text":"Asilo, ka fale hna, Bawipa mi hna nih a kenkip i an chim lulhmalhmi thawng cu thawng ṭha a si hrimhrim lo."},"25":{"text":"Mi nih mi cungah a sual ahcun Pathian nih remnak a serpiak lai, sihmanhsehlaw mi nih Pathian cungah a sual ahcun, aho nih dah a nawlpiak ti lai?” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a pa bia cu an ngai duh lo; zeitintiah annih thah awk kha Bawipa duhnak a si."},"26":{"text":"Cun ngakchiapate Samuel cu pum in siseh, Bawipa le minung duhning in siseh a ṭhang lengmang.","ref":"Luk 2.52"},"27":{"text":"Cun Eli sinah Pathian mi pakhat a ra i amah sinah cun, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih a ti, Izipt ram i Farote chung sal i an um lioah khan, na pa chungle hna sinah keimah hrimhrim kaa langhter."},"28":{"text":"Cun amah cu ka biakṭheng i hung kal awk le zihmui khangh awk le keimah hmai i tlangbawi angki i hruk awkah, Israel mi phun vialte chungin ka tlangbawi si awkah ka thim; cun na pa chungle hna sinah cun Israel mi sinin ka hmuhmi mei in khanghmi pekchanhnak vialte kha ka pek.","ref":"Exo 28.4; Lev 7.35-36"},"29":{"text":"A si kun ahcun zeicahdah ka umnak ah pekchanh awk tiin nawl ka pekmi ka raithawinak hna le pekchanhnak hna cu hakkauh mit in nan zoh i keimah nakin na fapale hna cu na upat deuh hna i ka mi Israel mi nih an pekchanhmi thil lak i a ṭha bik hna cun nan i cenh?"},"30":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa Israel Pathian nih, “Na chungle hna le na pa chungle hna cu zungzal in ka hmaiah an lut an chuak lai,” tiah ka rak ti taktak, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu Bawipa nih hitin a thanh: A si naisai ti lai lo, zeitintiah a ka upatmi cu ka upat hna lai i a ka zawmtaimi cu zei ah ka rel hna lai lo."},"31":{"text":"Zohhmanh, na ban le na pa innchungkhar ban ka tan lai ni cu a ra lio, cucaah na chungle lakah tar tlung in a nungmi an um lai lo."},"32":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cungah pek a si laimi rumnak cu lungrethei in le hngarnak mit in na zoh lai i na inn chungah zeitikhmanh ah tar tlung in a nungmi pakhat hmanh an um lai lo."},"33":{"text":"Ka biakṭheng in ka hlonh lai lo ding na mi cu na mit zettertu le na lungretheihtertu ah zuah a si lai i na inn chungah hrinmi fa vialte cu vainam in an thi lai."},"34":{"text":"Cun na fapa pahnih Hofni le Phinehas cungah a tlung lai dingmi hi nangmah caah hmelchunhnak a si lai: an pahnih tein ni khatte ah an thi lai.","ref":"1Sam 4.11"},"35":{"text":"Cun keimah hrimhrim nih zumhawktlak tlangbawi pakhat, ka lung chung le ka ruahnak chungah a ummi ningin a tuahtu ding cu ka chuahter lai; cun amah cu a fekmi innchungkhar ka sakpiak lai i ka chiti thuhmi hmaiah a zungzal in a lut a chuak lai."},"36":{"text":"Cun na inn i a tangmi paohpaoh nih ngun phar khat caah siseh, changreu tlang khat caah siseh, amah kha nawl awkah an ra lai i, ‘Changreu tlawmte tal ka ei nakhnga, tlangbawi rian zei tal ah dik ka chia ko sawh,’ tiah an ti lai, a ti,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun ngakchiapate Samuel cu Eli tangah Bawipa rian kha a ṭuan lengmang ko. Cun cu caan lioah cun Bawipa bia kha a tlawm ngaingai; langhnak kha a um set lo.","title":"Pathian Nih Samuel A Auh"},"2":{"text":"Cun khi caan lioah, a mit khua hmuh lo hram aa thawk cang caah khua a hmu kho set ti lomi Eli cu amah hmun ah khan a it;"},"3":{"text":"Pathian meiinn cu a mit rih lo i Pathian kuang a umnak Bawipa biakinn chungah khan Samuel cu a it."},"4":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, “Samuel! Samuel!” tiah a kawh i anih nih, “Hika ah hin ka um!” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Eli sinah cun a va tli i, “Hika ah hin ka um, na ka kawh caah,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih, “Kan ko lo, va it ṭhan ko,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a kal i a it."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, “Samuel!” tiah a auh ṭhan. Cun Samuel cu a tho i Eli sinah a va kal i, “Hika ah hin ka um, na ka auh caah,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih, “Kan au lo, ka fapa, va it ṭhan ko,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Samuel nih cun Bawipa kha a hngal rih lo i Bawipa bia kha a sinah phuan a si rih lo."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Samuel cu a voi thumnak a kawh ṭhan. Cun a tho i Eli sinah khan a va kal i, “Hika ah hin ka um, na ka auh caah,” a va ti. Bawipa nih ngakchiapa kha a auh tiah khi tikah Eli nih a hun hngalh."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Eli nih Samuel sinah cun, “Va kal law, va it ṭhan ko; cun an kawh ṭhan ahcun, ‘Chim tuah, Bawipa, zeitintiah na salpa nih a theih ko,’ tiah na ti lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Samuel cu a kal i a umnak ah khan a va it ṭhan."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu a ra i a rung dir i voi dang bantuk khan, “Samuel! Samuel!” tiah a auh. Cun Samuel nih, “Chim ko, zeitintiah na sal nih a theih,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Samuel sinah cun, “Zohhmanh, Israel chungah hin, a theitu paoh an hna a pahnih in a khenh lai dingmi thil pakhat ka tuah dengmang cang."},"12":{"text":"Khi ni ah a innchungkhar kong i ka chimmi vialte, a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang, Eli cungah ka tlinter lai."},"13":{"text":"A fapa hna nih Pathian an vawlhpamhnak sualnak kha a hngal ko nain a thlauh hna lo caah, a innchungkhar cu zungzal ca in dantatnak ka pek dengmang cang, tiah amah kha ka chimh."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Eli innchungkhar hna cu raithawinak in siseh, pekchanhnak in siseh, sualthianhpiak khawh, zungzal in an si lai lo, tiah Eli innchungkhar hna sinah cun chiat ka ser cang,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Samuel cu zinglei tiang a it; cun Bawipa inn i innka hna kha a hun hna. Cun Samuel nih kha langhnak kha Eli chimh cu a ṭih."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Eli nih Samuel cu a kawh i, “Samuel, ka fapa,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Hika ah hin ka um,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Eli nih, “An chimhmi cu zeidah a si? Ka sinin thup hlah. An chimhmi vialte chungah khan zeihmanh ka sinin na thuh ahcun, Pathian nih na cungah cu bangin le tam deuh in tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah Samuel nih zeizong vialte a chimh dih i a sinin zeihmanh a thup lo. Cun anih nih, “Mah cucu Bawipa a si; a ṭha tiah a timi cu tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu a ṭhang i Bawipa cu a sinah a um i a bia kha pakhat hmanh vawlei ah a lohlakter lo."},"20":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte nih, Dan in Beersheba tiang, Samuel cu Bawipa profet ah fehter a si ti kha an hngalh dih."},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu Shiloh ah a lang ṭhan, zeicahtiah Bawipa cu Samuel sinah Shiloh ah khan Bawipa bia in aa langhter."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Samuel bia cu Israel mi vialte sin a phan. Cun Israel mi hna cu Filistin mi hna kha doh awkah an chuak i Ebenezer ah an riak, Filistin mi cu Afek ah an riak.","title":"Filistin Mi Nih Pathian Kuang Kha An Lak"},"2":{"text":"Filistin mi hna cu Israel mi doh awkah cun a tlang a tlang in an rak um i an hun i doh tikah Filistin mi hna nih cun Israel mi cu an tei hna, mi thong li tluk raldohnak hmun ah cun an thah hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun ralkap pawl cu an riahhmun ah an rat tikah, Israel upa hna nih cun, “Zeicahdah Bawipa nih nihin ah hin Filistin mi hna hmaiah a kan sunghter hnga? Bawipa cu kan sinah a rat i kan ral hna ṭhawnnak chungin a kan khamh nakhnga Bawipa biakamnak kuang kha Shiloh in hika ah hin ratpi u sih,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Shiloh ah mi an hei thlah hna i cherubim karlak i a ummi ralkapbu Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu khika in an rak put; cun Eli fapa pahnih Hofni le Phinehas hna kha Pathian biakamnak kuang sinah cun an rak um.","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu riah-hmun chungah a phak tikah, Israel mi vialte cu fak piin an au i cucaah vawlei zong kha a tlerh dih."},"6":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih an aunak thawng cu an theih tikah, “Hebru mi hna riahhmun i hi ti fakpi an au hi a sullam zeidah a si?” tiah an ti. Cun annih nih Bawipa kuang kha riahhmun a phan cang ti an theih tikah,"},"7":{"text":"Filistin mi hna cu an thin a phang i, “Riahhmun chungah khuazing an phan cang,” tiah an ti. Cun annih nih, “Bialo kan si ai! Hi bantuk hi cu hlanah a um bal lo."},"8":{"text":"Belo kan si ai! Aho nih dah hi a ṭhawngmi khuazing hna ṭhawnnak chung hin a kan chuah khawh lai? Hi hna hi ramlak ah Izipt mi hna kha rai phunphun in a thattu khuazing an si."},"9":{"text":"Nan ralṭha ko uh, maw Filistin mi hna, pa bantukin um uh, cu ti a si lo ahcun, nannih tang ah sal an si bantuk hin, anmah Hebru mi tangah hin sal nan si sual lai; pa bantukin um u law, do hna u,” tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Filistin mi nih cun an tuk hna i Israel mi cu an sung, anmah le an inn cio ah khan an zam dih; i thahnak fakpi a um, Israel mi ke ralkap sang thum an thi."},"11":{"text":"Pathian biakamnak kuang kha an tlaih; Eli fapa pahnih Hofni le Phinehas zong kha an thi."},"12":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi pakhat cu raltuknak hmun khan a le i cu ni lila ah cun Shiloh a phan, a puan kha a thleh hna i a lu ah vawlei aa phulh."},"13":{"text":"A phak tikah Eli cu kutka pawng i a ṭhutdan ah khan a ṭhu i lam lei kha a rak zoh, zeitintiah Pathian kuang caah khan a lung therphang in a um. Cun mipa cu khua chungah a luh i thawngpang kha a chim tikah an khua ning piin an ṭap dih."},"14":{"text":"An aukhuan thawng kha Eli nih a theih tikah, “An au urmar len ko cu zeidah a si?” tiah a ti. Cun mipa cu khulrang in a ra i Eli cu a chimh."},"15":{"text":"Eli cu kum sawm kua le kum riat a si cang i a mit cu a caw cang, cucaah khua a hmu kho ti lo."},"16":{"text":"Cun mipa nih cun Eli cu, “Keimah hi raltuknak hmun in a rami cu ka si; raltuknak hmun in nihin ah ka ra zam,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Zeitindah a si, ka fapa?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun thawngpang a rak phortu nih cun a leh i, “Israel mi cu Filistin mi hna hmaiah an zam i mi lakah thahnak nganpi a um; na fapa pahnih Hofni le Phinehas zong kha an thi i Pathian kuang kha an tlaih,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Pathian kuang, ti a vun chim tikah khan Eli cu, kutka pawng i a ṭhutdan cung khan hnulei ah aa ngal; a hngawng a kiak i a thi, zeicahtiah amah cu a tarmi a si i a rit fawn. Israel mi cu kum sawm li bia a ceih hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun a fapa nupi, Phinehas innchung cu pumlawnglo in a um i a nithla a tling dengmang. Cun Pathian kuang kha an tlaih i a va le a va pa kha an thi ti thawng a theih tikah a kun i fa a hrin; zeicahtiah a nganfah nih a hun phak colh."},"20":{"text":"Cun a thih dengmang lioah khan amah a zohkhentu nu hna nih cun, “Ṭih hlah, zeicahtiah fapa na hrin,” an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a let hna lo i zei zongah a rel fawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Cun, “Sunparnak cu Israel mi sinin aa ṭhial cang!” tiin naute cu Ikabod tiah min a sak, zeicahtiah Pathian kuang cu tlaih a si, cun a va pa le a va zong kha an thi cang."},"22":{"text":"Cun amah nih cun, “Sunparnak cu Israel sinin aa ṭhial cang, zeitintiah Pathian kuang cu tlaih a si cang,” tiah a ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi nih Pathian kuang kha an tlaih tikah, Ebenezer in Ashdod ah an kalpi;","title":"Filistin Mi Ram Ah Kuang Kha A Tang"},"2":{"text":"cun Filistin mi nih cun Pathian kuang cu an lak i Dagon inn chungah an luhpi i Dagon pawngah cun an chiah."},"3":{"text":"Cun a thaizing ah, Ashdod khuami hna cu zingkate in an thawh tikah, zohhmanh, Dagon cu a bawktakhup in vawlei ah Pathian kuang hmaiah cun a rak tlu. Cucaah Dagon cu an lak i a umnak kel ah khan an chiah ṭhan."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thaizing zingkate i an thawh tikah khan, zohhmanh, Dagon cu a boktakhup in vawlei ah Pathian kuang hmaiah a rak tlu ko i Dagon lu bul le a kut bul hna cu innkaba ah an rak ril ko; Dagon cu a pum thlur lawng kha a taang."},"5":{"text":"Dagon tlangbawi hna le Dagon inn chungah a lutmi vialte nih nihin tiangin, Ashdod i a ummi Dagon inn innka an lamh lonak cu, mah hi caah hin a si."},"6":{"text":"Ashdod khuami hna cungah Bawipa kut cu a rit i Ashdod khuami hna le a pawngkam i a ummi hna cu an thin a phanter hna i tak bonak in a hrem hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun Ashdod khuami nih zeitin thil umtuning a si kha an hmuh tikah, annih nih, “Israel Pathian i a kuang cu kan sinah a um awk a si lai lo, zeicahtiah a kut cu kan cung le kan khuazing Dagon cungah a rit ai,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Filistin bawi vialte kha an cah an pumh hna i, “Israel Pathian i a kuang hi zeitindah kan tuah lai?” tiah an ti. Annih nih, “Israel Pathian i a kuang cu Gath hrawngah ratpi si tuah seh,” tiah an leh hna. Cucaah Israel Pathian i a kuang cu cuka ah cun an kalpi."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an ratpi hnuah, Bawipa kut nih cu khua cu a ralchanh i launak nganpi a chuahter i cu khuami hna cu a tar a no in a hrem hna i an cungah tak bonak kha a chuak."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian kuang cu Ekron ah an kuat. Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian kuang cu Ekron ah a phak tikah, Ekron khuami hna nih cun, “Kanmah le kan mi hna kha thah awkah Israel Pathian i a kuang cu kan sinah an ratpi,” tiah an au."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Filistin bawi vialte kha an cah an pumh hna i, “Israel Pathian i a kuang cu kalter ko u, kanmah le kan mi hna kha a kan thah nakhnga lo, amah umnak hmun ah kirter ṭhan ko u,” tiah an ti. Zeitintiah khua chungah khan ṭih a nung ngaingaimi launak a um dih. Pathian kut cu khika ah a rit ngaingai ko."},"12":{"text":"A thi lomi cu an bo dih i khua chung aunak thawng cu van tiang a kai."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa kuang cu Filistin mi hna ram chungah thla sarih a um.","title":"Filistin Mi Nih Kuang An Khirh"},"2":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih tlangbawi hna le litin thiam hna kha an auh hna i, “ Bawipa kuang hi zeitindah kan tuah lai? A umnak ah zei he dah kan kuat lai, ti kha kan chim tuah u,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Annih nih, “Israel Pathian i a kuang kha nan kirter a si ahcun, a lawng in kirter citcet hlah u; phungbuar thawinak he nan kirter hrimhrim lai. Cun nan dam lai i zeicahdah a kut cu nan sinin aa mer lo ti kha nan hngalh lai,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Amah kan pek hngami phungbuar thawinak cu zeidah a si lai?” an ti. Annih nih, “Filistin mi hna bawi zat in, nan bonak he aa loin sui in sermi bo panga le sui zu panga; zeitintiah nannih vialte le nan bawi hna cungah a tlungmi rai cu aa khat ko."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah nan bonak mui le nan ram a hrawktu nan zu hna mui cu nan ser lai i Israel Pathian cu sunparnak nan pek lai; nanmah le nan khuazing hna le nan ram cungin a kut cu a hei zanter hmanh maw."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahdah Izipt mi le Faro nih an lung an hahter bantukin nan hahter ve lai? A cawhdeh hna hnuah mi kha an kalter hna i an chuak, a si lo mei?"},"7":{"text":"Cucaah, cawleng thar pakhat le hnuk sur lio cawpi pahnih, leng a hnuk bal rih lomi kha la hna u law, cawpi kha leng ah banh hna u law, an fale tu kha cu inn ah hruaikanh hna u."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang kha la u law, cawleng cungah khan chia u, cun a pawngah thingkuang in, phungbuar thawinak caah amah nan kuatmi sui siasal tete kha chia hna u. Cun thlah u law kalter u."},"9":{"text":"Cun zoh tuah u, amah ram lei i a hung kalmi Beth-shemesh lei i a kalmi lam kha a hun zulh ahcun, kannih cungah hi harnak nganpi a tuahtu hi amah a si; sihmanhsehlaw cu ti a si lo ahcun, a kan tutu cu amah kut a si lo, kan cungah a tlung sual i a si ko, ti kha kan hngalh lai,” an ti."},"10":{"text":"Cu bangin an tuah; hnuk sur lio cawpi pahnih cu an lak hna i lengah khan an banh hna i an fale cu inn ah an khumh hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang le sui zu tete le an bonak mui tete an khumhnak thingkuang cu, leng cungah an chiah hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun caw hna nih cun ding teomao in Beth-shemesh lei i a kalmi lam pakhat kha paw pah lengmang in an zulh; orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh an i mer lo; Filistin bawi hna nih Beth-shemesh ramri tiang an zulh hna."},"13":{"text":"Beth-shemesh khuami hna cu nelrawn chung i an changvut an ṭuan lio a si i, annih nih khua an hei cuan i kuang kha an hmuh tikah an i lawm."},"14":{"text":"Beth-shemesh khuami Joshua lo chungah khan cawleng cu a phan i khika ah a dir. Khika ah lung nganpi pakhat a um. Cawleng thing kha an ceh i caw hna cu Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak caah an pekchanh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna nih Bawipa kuang le a pawngah a ummi thingkuang, sui milem tete an umnak kha, an lak hna i lungpi cungah cun an toh hna; Beth-shemesh khua mi hna nih cun khi ni ah Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak kha an pekchanh hna i raithawinak kha an tuah hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun Filistin bawi panga hna nih khan mah cucu an hmuh tikah, khi ni ah Ekron ah an kir."},"17":{"text":"Mah hihi an bonak he aa lo in sui in sermi, Filistin mi hna nih Bawipa sin i phungbuar thawinak caah an kuatmi cu an si: Ashdod caah pakhat, Gaza caah pakhat, Ashkelon caah pakhat, Gath caah pakhat, Ekron caah pakhat;"},"18":{"text":"Filistin mi hna khua vialte, an bawi panga hna ta a simi, kulhmi khuapi si hna seh, kulh lomi khuate si hna seh, an tam an tlawm zat ningin, sui zu tete zong kha an kuat. A pawng i Bawipa kuang an chiahnak lung nganpi cu, Beth-shemesh khuami Joshua lo ah nihin tiangin hngaltu a si."},"19":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang chung kha Beth-shemesh khuami nih an bih caah tlawmpal a thah hna; annih kha mi sawm sarih a thah hna i, Bawipa nih annih kha tampi a thah hna caah an ṭap."},"20":{"text":"Cun Beth-shemesh khuami nih, “Hi Pathian thiang, Bawipa, hmaiah hin ahodah a dir kho lai? Kannih sin hin aho sinah dah a hung kal lai?” an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah annih nih Kiriath-jearim khuami hna sinah khan lamkal an hei thlah hna i, “ Bawipa kuang kha Filistin mi nih an rak put ṭhan cang. Rung u law, nanmah leiah hun i kalpi u,” an ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Kiriath-jearim khuami cu an ra i Bawipa kuang kha an lak i, tlang cung i a ummi Abinadab inn ah khan an hun kalpi. Cun annih nih Bawipa kuang zohkhenhtu ah a fapa Eleazar kha an thianter.","ref":"2Sam 6.2-4; 1Cha 13.5-7"},"2":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim ah kuang kha a phak ni in, khika ah caan saupi, kum kul tluk a um; cun Israel innchungkhar vialte nih Bawipa kha an ngai ṭhan."},"3":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Israel chungkhar vialte hna sinah cun, “ Bawipa sinah nan lung dihlak in nan kir a si ahcun, ramdang khuazing hna le Ashtaroth hna kha nanmah chungin nan hlonh hna lai i Bawipa leiah khan nan lung nan hoihter lai i amah lawng kha nan biak lai, cun amah nih Filistin mi hna kut chungin an chuahter hna lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"Samuel Nih Israel Mi Kha Bia A Ceih Hna"},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi nih Baal hna le Ashtaroth hna kha an hlawt hna i Bawipa rian lawng kha an ṭuan."},"5":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “Israel mi vialte hna cu Mizpah ah pum hna u law, Bawipa sinah keimah nih thla kan campiak hna lai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Mizpah ah an i pum i ti an than i Bawipa hmaiah an thlet i khi ni cu rawl an ul. Khika ah annih nih, “ Bawipa cungah kan sual cang,” tiah an ti. Cun Samuel nih Israel mi cu Mizpah ah bia a ceih hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih Israel mi cu Mizpah ah an i pum ti kha an theih, Filistin bawi hna cu Israel mi hna doh awkah an hung kal. Cun Israel mi nih mah cucu an theih tikah, Filistin mi cu an ṭih hna."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi nih Samuel cu, “Filistin mi hna kut chungin a kan khamh nakhnga, kan ca i Bawipa kan Pathian sin i na aunak cu ngol hlah,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Samuel nih hnuk ding lio tuufa pakhat a lak i Bawipa sinah pum khangh thawinak caah a pekchanh; cun Samuel nih Bawipa cu Israel mi caah a kawh i Bawipa nih amah cu a leh."},"10":{"text":"Samuel nih khangh thawinak kha a pekchanh lioah Filistin mi cu Israel mi kha doh awkah lam nai ah an ra; sihmanhsehlaw khi ni ah Bawipa nih aw fak piin Filistin mi hna cu khuarit in a rithnawh hna i an i tuai dih; Israel mi hna hmai in an zam dih."},"11":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu Mizpah khua in an chuak i Filistin mi kha Beth-kar thlang tiangin an dawi hna i an thah hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih lung pakhat a lak i Mizpah le Jeshanah karlak ah a phun i, “Atu tiangin Bawipa nih a kan bawmh,” tiin a min ah Ebenezer a sak."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Filistin mi hna cu an sung i Israel mi hna ram ah khan an lut ṭhan ti lo, Samuel nun chung vialte cu Filistin mi kha Bawipa kut nih khan a ralchanh hna."},"14":{"text":"Israel mi hna sinin Filistin mi nih an rak lakmi khua hna kha, Ekron in Gath tiang, Israel sinah pek ṭhan an si i, Filistin mi hna kut chungin Israel mi nih an ram cu an chanh khawh ṭhan. Israel mi le Amor mi hna karlak zongah daihnak a um."},"15":{"text":"Samuel nih Israel mi cu a nunchung vialte bia a ceih hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun kum fate in Bethel, Gilgal le Mizpah cu a tlawn diahmah lengmang hna i, hi khua dihlak ah hin Israel mi kha bia a ceih hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun a inn umnak a si caah Ramah ah a ra kir tawn i khika zongah Israel mi kha biading in bia a ceih hna. Cun khika ah Bawipa caah biakṭheng pakhat a ser."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Samuel cu a tar tikah a fapale hna kha Israel mi cung i biaceihtu ah a ser hna.","title":"Israel Mi Nih Siangpahrang Ngeih An Duh"},"2":{"text":"A hrin hmasa bik fapa cu Joel a min a si i a pahnihnak cu a min Abijah a si. Beersheba ah biaceihtu an si."},"3":{"text":"Asinain, a fapa hna cu amah lam kha an zul lo, miaknak tu kha an merhnawh. Nawhthuh kha an lak i biading kha an merh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Israel upa vialte kha an i pum i Samuel sinah Ramah ah an ra."},"5":{"text":"Amah cu an thawh i, “Zohhmanh, na tar cang, cun na fapale nih na lam an zul fawn lo. Cucaah miphun vialte hna cio bangin, a kan uktu ah siangpahrang pakhat kan chiahpiak tuah,” an ti.","ref":"Deu 17.14"},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, “A kan uktu ah siangpahrang pakhat kan pe,” an ti tikah, cu thil nih cun Samuel kha a lawmhter lo. Cun Samuel nih Bawipa sinah thla a cam."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Samuel cu a chawnh i, “Mizapi nih na sinah an chimmi bia vialte ah an aw kha ngai tuah; zeitintiah nangmah an in hlawt a si lo, an cung i siangpahrang ka sinak hin keimah an ka hlawt a si."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram in ka chuahpi hna ni in atu tiang ka cungah an tuahmi vialte ningin, keimah kha hlawt le khuazing dang hna kha bia in, cu bangin nangmah cung zongah an tuah ve."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu an bia kha ngai ko hna; sihmanhsehlaw ṭha tein ralrinnak na pek hna lai i anmah a uktu ding siangpahrang kalning kha na hmuhsak hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Samuel nih amah sinin siangpahrang a halmi hna kha Bawipa bia vialte cu a chimh hna."},"11":{"text":"Amah nih, “Nannih an uktu hna siangpahrang kalning cu hi bangin a si lai: nan fapa kha a lak hna lai i a rangleng cittu le a rang cittu le a rangleng hmai tlitu dingah a chiah hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Cun a thong pawl haotu hna le sawm nga pawl haotu hna kha aa chiah hna lai, cun a cheu cu a leithuangtu le a rawlṭuantu le a ral hriamnam sertu le a rangleng thilri sertu ah a chiah hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Nan fanu hna cu zihmui sertu le rawlchuang le changreu rawtu ah a lak hna lai."},"14":{"text":"Nan lo le nan mitsur dum le nan oliv dum hna lakah a ṭha bikbik kha a lak hna lai i a rianṭuantu hna kha a pek hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Nan rawl le nan mitsur dum chungin cheu hra cheu khat kha a lak lai i, a bawi hna le a rianṭuantu hna kha a pek hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Nan salpa hna le nan salnu hna le nan caw le nan laa hna lakah a ṭha bikbik kha a lak hna lai i amah rianṭuantu ah a hman hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Nan tuurun hna chungin cheu hra cheu khat kha a lak hna lai i nannih cu amah sal nan si lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun khi ni ah nanmahte nih nan i thimmi nan siangpahrang ruangah nannih cu nan ai len te lai; sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih khi ni ah cun an let hna lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi hna nih cun Samuel aw ngaih cu an duh lo; annih nih, “Si hlah! Kan cungah siangpahrang kan ngei ko lai,"},"20":{"text":"kannih zong miphun vialte hna cio bantuk kan si ve lai; kan siangpahrang nih cun a kan uk lai i kan hmaiah a kal lai i kan ral hna kha a kan tukpiak lai,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mi hna an bia vialte cu a theih tikah Bawipa kha a hna chungah a va rawnh chin."},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Samuel sinah cun, “An aw kha ngai hna law, siangpahrang pakhat serpiak hna,” tiah a ti. Cun Samuel nih Israel mi hna cu, “Nan khua cio ah va tlung u,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin phun mi pakhat a min Kish a si i a rum ngaimi a um; amah cu Abiel fapa a si, Abiel cu Zeror fapa, Zeror cu Bekorath fapa, Bekorath cu Afiah fapa a si;","title":"Saul Kha Siangpahrang Ah An Thim"},"2":{"text":"cun fapa pakhat a ngei i a min cu Saul a si, tlangval chuakthiam ngai a si. Israel mi lakah amah nakin aa dawh deuhmi pakhat hmanh an um lo; ahohmanh a liang cungin a lonh dih hna."},"3":{"text":"Saul pa Kish i laa cu an tlau i Kish nih a fapa Saul cu, “Sinum pakhat khan i kalpi law, tho law, laa kawl awkah cun va kal tuah,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun annih nih Efraim tlangram kha an ṭol, cun Shalisha ram kha an ṭol, sihmanhsehlaw an hmu hna lo. Cun Shaalim ram kha an ṭol, sihmanhsehlaw khika zongah an um lo. Cun Benjamin peng kha an ṭol, sihmanhsehlaw khika zongah an hmu hna lo."},"5":{"text":"Zuf peng kha an phak tikah, Saul nih a sinum cu, “Ra, kir cang u sih, ka pa nih khan laa kong kha ruat ti loin, kanmah kong tu ah lungrethei in a um sual lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih amah cu, “Zohhmanh, hi khua chungah hin Pathian mi pakhat a um i amah cu an hmaizah ngaimi a si; a chimmi vialte kha a tling dih ko. Khika ah va kal u sih; kan pawhhnawhmi kan khual tlawnnak kong hi a hei kan chimh khawh ko hnga dah kaw,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sinum sinah cun, “Sihmanhsehlaw, kan kal ahcun mipa cu zeidah kan put khawh lai? Kan zal chung i changreu a dih cang caah Pathian mi cu laksawng zeihmanh put awk a um ṭung lo. Zeidah kan ngeih?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sinum nih khan Saul cu a leh ṭhan i, “Zohhmanh, ngun shekel phar cheu li cheu khat ka ngei, kan lam a kan chimhnak dingah mah hihi Pathian mi cu ka pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"(Hlan lioah cun Israel mi hna lak i pakhatkhat nih Pathian kha hal an duh ahcun, “Ra tuah, hmutu sinah kal u sih,” tiah an rak ti tawn, zeicah tiah atu i profet timi hi hlanah cun hmutu ti a rak si.)"},"10":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sinum sinah cun, “Na bia a ṭha, ra, kal u sih,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Pathian mi a umnak khua ah khan an va kal."},"11":{"text":"Khua chung hung kal awk i fing an hun zawh lioah khin ti than awkah a rami ngaknu an ton hna i annih cu, “Hika ah hmutu kha a um maw?” tiah an hal hna."},"12":{"text":"Annih nih, “A um ko; zohhmanh u, nan hmaite ah khan a kal. I khulranh u; nihin ah hi khuami nih khuahrum bo ah khan raithawinak an ngeih caah khua chungah atu naite ah khan a ra."},"13":{"text":"Nannih nih khua chungah nan va luh ka tein, khuahrum bo i rawl ei awk i a kal hlanah khan, nan va hmuh ko lai; amah nih raithawinak cu thluachuahnak a pek awk a si caah amah a rat hlanah cun mi nih khan an rak ei lai lo; cu hnuah cun sawmmi hna nih khan an ei lai. Cucaah cun hung kal u law, nan hung ton colh ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah khua ah khan an hung kal. Khua chung i an va luh lioah khan, Samuel cu khuahrum bo lei i a kalpah ah annih lei i a rat kha an hmuh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Saul a rat hlan ni khat ah khan Bawipa nih Samuel sinah khan a rak phuan i,"},"16":{"text":"“Thaizing atu tik hrawngah hin, na sinah Benjamin peng i mipa pakhat ka rak thlah lai i amah cu ka mi Israel mi hna cung i bawi si awkah chiti na rak thuh lai. Amah nih ka mi hna cu Filistin mi kut chungin a khamh hna lai; zeitintiah an aunak kha ka sinah a phak cang caah ka mi hna nih hremnak an inmi cu ka hmuh cang,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Samuel nih Saul kha a hmuh tikah, Bawipa nih amah cu, “A kong kan chimh mipa kha mah pa hi a si! Amah hi ka mi hna uktu ding cu a si,” tiah a chimh."},"18":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Samuel kha hauka ah cun a hei fuh i, “Hmutu inn cu khuazei ah dah a si, ka chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Samuel nih Saul cu a leh i, “Hmutu cu keimah hi ka si; ka hmaiah hin khuahrum bo leiah khan kal ko, zeitintiah nihin cu keimah sinah rawl na ei lai i thaizing ah kan kalter te lai i na ruah lengmangmi cu kan chimh dih lai."},"20":{"text":"Na laa, ni thum a tlau cangmi hna cu ruat len ti hna hlah, zeicahtiah an hmuh cang hna. Cun Israel mi hna lak i duh awk thil vialte cu aho caah dah an si? Nangmah le na pa chungkhar vialte hna caah an si lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a leh i, “Keimah cu Israel phun hna lakah a hme bik Benjamin phun mi ka si lo maw? Cun ka chungle hna cu Benjamin phun chung i a ummi chungkhar vialte hna lakah a nauta bik an si lo maw? A si kun ahcun, zeicahdah mah bantuk hin ka sinah bia na chim?” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Saul le a sinum kha a kalpi hna i innchung khaan ah a luhpi hna i an sawmmi mi sawm thum tluk hna lakah khan, upatnak hmun ah khan a ṭhutter hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih rawl chuangtu sinah khan, “ ‘A dang tein rak chia,’ ti i ka rak in pekmi covo kha rak pu tuah,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah rawl chuangtu nih cun a ke le a thaumi a mei kha a hun put hna i Saul hmaika ah cun a chiah hna; cun Samuel nih, “Zohhmanh, ka rak kenretmi cu hunh na si hih. Ei tuah; zeicahtiah sawmmi hna he nan ei ṭi nakhnga, caan tinhmi a tlin hlantiang, nangmah caah chiah a si,” tiah a ti. Cucaah cu ni ah cun Saul cu Samuel sinah rawl a ei."},"25":{"text":"Cun khuahrum bo in khua chungah an run tikah inncung ah Saul cu ihnak a phahpiak i a it."},"26":{"text":"Cun ceu vukvak ah inncung i a ummi Saul cu Samuel nih a auh i, “Tho tuah, ka hei in thlah tuah lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Saul cu a tho i Samuel he cun an pahnih in khuachung lam ah khan an va chuak."},"27":{"text":"Cun khua pawngri lei i an vung kal lioah khan Samuel nih Saul sinah cun, “Na sinum kha kan lonh seh, hei chim tuah; cun a kan lonh tikah nang cu hika ah hin tlawm tein um ta rih tuah, Pathian bia cu nangmah kha kan hngalhter lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih chiti thawl kha aa chuah i a lu ah khan a toih i a hnamh i, “ Bawipa nih a mi Israel mi hna cung i bawi si awkah chiti an thuh a si lo mei? Cun Bawipa mi cu na uk hna lai i an pawngkam i a ummi an ral hna kut chung khan na khamh hna lai. Cun Bawipa nih amah ro cung i bawi si awkah chiti an thuh cang, ti hmelchunhnak cu mah hihi a si lai."},"2":{"text":"Nihin keimah sinin naa ṭhen tikah hin, Benjamin peng chung Zelzah i Rachel thlan ah khan mipa pahnih na ton hna lai i annih nih nangmah cu, ‘Kawl awkah na kalhnawhmi laa kha an hmuh cang hna, atu cu na pa nih laa kong kha lungrethei in ruat ti loin, nangmah tu kha an ruat cang i, “Ka fapa kongah hin zeidah ka tuah lai?” a ti lengmang ko,’ tiah an in chimh lai."},"3":{"text":"Cun cuka cun na va kal deuh lai i Tabor kuhthing kha na hei phan lai; cuka ah cun Bethel i Pathian sinah a hung kalmi mi pathum nih an in ton lai, pakhat nih meheh fa pathum aa cawi hna lai, cun pakhat nih changreu tlang thum aa put lai i pakhat nih mitsur hang cua khat aa phorh lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun annih nih salaam an in pek lai i changreu tlang hnih an in pek lai, cucu an kut khan na cohlan hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Filistin ralveng ralkapbu umnak Gibeath-elohim cu na va phan lai; cun cuka ah cun, khua chung i na va luh lioah khin tingtang le khuangte le thonglawi le ruakhuang he khuahrum bo in a rung ṭummi profet bu khat, a holh cukmak len komi, na ton hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa thlarau cu na cungah ṭhawng ngaiin a tlung lai i nang zong an lakah na holh cukmak ve lai i midang ah naa cang lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun hi hmelchunhnak hi na ton hna tikah, thil umtuning nih a serning paoh in va tuah ko, zeitintiah Pathian cu na sinah a um."},"8":{"text":"Cun keimah hlanah Gilgal ah na rak kal lai i, zohhmanh, nangmah sinah khangh thawinak pekchanh awk le daihnak pekchanhnak thawi awkah ka ra lai. Nangmah sinah ka rat i nangmah nih zeidah na tuah awk a si kha kan hmuhsak hlantiang, ni sarih na rak ka hngah lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu kaltak awk i aa mer tikah, Pathian nih amah kha lung dang a pek; cun hi hmelchunhnak vialte cu khi ni ah a tling dih."},"10":{"text":"Gibeah kha an phak tikah, zohhmanh, profet bu khat nih an rak ton; cu Pathian thlarau cu ṭhawng ngaiin a cungah a tlung i an lakah a holh cukmak len ve ko."},"11":{"text":"Cun hlan i amah a rak hngalmi vialte nih khan, profet hna he an holh cukmak kha an hmuh tikah, cu mi hna nih cun pakhat le pakhat cu, “Kish fapa cungah hin zeidah a tlung hnga? Saul zong profet hna lakah aa tel ve cang dahra?” tiah an i ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun cuka mi pakhat nih, “Cun ahodah an pa cu a si?” tiah a leh hna. Cucaah, “Saul zong profet hna lakah aa tel ve cang dahra?” ti cu capo siamsaknak bia ah a cang.","ref":"1Sam 19.23-24"},"13":{"text":"Cun a holh cukmak cu a dih tikah khuahrum bo ah khan a hung kal."},"14":{"text":"Saul pa unau nih khan amah le a sinum kha a thawh hna i, “Khuazei ah dah nan kal?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Laa kha kan kawl hna, cun hmuh khawh an si lo ti kha kan hngalh tikah, Samuel sinah kan kal,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Saul pa unau nih cun, “Zaangfahnak tein, Samuel nih zeidah an chimh, ka chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a pa unau sinah cun, “Laa cu an hmuh cang hna, tiah fiang tein a kan chimh,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw pennak kong Samuel nih a chimmi kha cu zeihmanh amah cu a chim lo."},"17":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mi kha Bawipa sinah, Mizpah ah hmun khat ah a auh hna i,"},"18":{"text":"Israel mi hna sinah cun, “Hi bangin Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, ‘Israel cu Izipt ram in ka hun chuahpi i Izipt mi hna kut le nannih an hremtu hna ram vialte kut chungin kan luatter hna,’ a ti."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nihin ni ah hin nannih nih, vanchiat nan tonmi vialte le nan harnak vialte chungin an khamhtu hna nan Pathian cu nan hlawt i, ‘Sihlah! kan cungah siangpahrang pakhat kan chiahpiak ko,’ nan ti. Cucaah atu cu Bawipa hmaiah, nan phun cio ning le nan chung cio ningin, chuak tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Israel phun vialte cu a hun chuahpi hna i Benjamin phun cu camcawhfung khiah in thim a si."},"21":{"text":"Benjamin phun cu a chung a chung in a hun chuahpi hna i camcawhfung khiah in Matri chung cu thim a si; a hmanung bik ah Matri chung cu a mi a mi in a chuahpi hna i Kish fapa Saul cu camcawhfung khiah in thim a si. Sihmanhsehlaw an kawl tikah an hmu kho lo."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa kha an hal ṭhan i, “Mipa kha hika ah a ra maw?” an ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “Zohhmanh, thilri lakah aa thup ko,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Khi tikah an va tli i khika khan an va lak; cun mizapi lak i a hung dir tikah mizapi lak i ahohmanh kha a liang cungin a lonh dih hna."},"24":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mizapi sinah cun, “ Bawipa nih a thimmi hi nan hmu maw? Mi vialte lakah amah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo,” tiah a ti. Cun mi vialte nih khan, “Siangpahrang cu saupi nung ko seh,” tiin an au."},"25":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mizapi cu siangpahrang umtuning ding le a rian ding cu a chimh hna i cauk chungah a ṭial hna i Bawipa hmaiah khan a chiah hna. Cun Samuel nih mi vialte cu anmah le an inn cio ah khan a tlunter hna."},"26":{"text":"Saul zong cu Gibeah khua i a inn ah a tlung ve i amah sinah cun Pathian nih an lung a canghtermi, mi ralṭha hna kha an kal ve."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, mizeiruaramlo a cheu khat nih cun, “Mah pa nih hin zeitindah a kan khamh khawh lai?” tiah an ti. An nihsawh i laksawng zeihmanh an put lo. Sihmanhsehlaw dai tein a um ko."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan ah Ammon mi Nahash cu a hung kal i Jabesh-gilead kha a dum; cun Jabesh-gilead khuami vialte nih cun, “Kanmah he biahrennak ser law, na rian kan ṭuan lai,” tiah an ti.","title":"Saul Nih Ammon Mi Kha A Tei Hna"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ammon mi Nahash nih cun annih cu, “Nan orhlei mit kan khoih dih hna i cuticun Israel mi vialte cungah ningzah hmaichiatnak ka tlunter bel ah, nannih sinah hnatlaknak cu ka tuah hnga,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Jabesh upa hna nih cun a sinah, “Kannih nih Israel ram chung vialte ah lamkaltu kan thlah hna nakhnga, ni sarih in kan ngang rih tuah. Khi tik i ahohmanh a kan khamhtu an um lo ahcun nangmah sinah kanmah tein kan i pe ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna cu Saul khua Gibeah i an rat tikah mi hna theih ah cu kong cu an chim i mi vialte cu thang piin an ṭap dih."},"5":{"text":"Saul cu cawtum kha a hun zul hna i loin a hung tlung; cun Saul nih, “Mi hna hi an zeidah a ti i an ṭah?” tiah a ti. Cucaah Jabesh khuami hna thawngpang kha an chimh."},"6":{"text":"Cun hi bia kha Saul nih a theih tikah Pathian thlarau cu Saul cungah hmual fak piin a tlung i fak piin a thin a hung."},"7":{"text":"Cawtum khuah khat kha aa lak hna i a can cikcek hna i lamkaltu hna kut in Israel ram chung vialte ah a kuat dih hna i, “Saul le Samuel zulh awkah a chuak duh lo paoh cu a cawtum hna cungah hi bantukin tuah a si lai!” tiah a ti. Khi tikah Bawipa ṭihnak kha mi cungah khan a tlung i annih nih mi pakhat bantukin an chuak."},"8":{"text":"Bezek ah a pumh hna tikah, Israel mi cu sing thum an si i Judah mi cu sang thum an si."},"9":{"text":"Cun a rami lamkaltu hna sinah cun, “Jabesh-gilead mi sinah cun hi bangin nan va chim lai: ‘Thaizing ni a hung linh vuaimai tikah khin, luatnak nan hmu lai,’ tiin,” tiah a ti. Lamkaltu hna kha an rat i Jabesh mi hna kha an chimh tik hna ah, an lung aa lawm."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Jabesh mi hna nih cun, “Thaizing ah nan sinah kanmah tein kan hun i pe lai, nannih nih a ṭha nan tining paoh in kan cungah nan tuah ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun a thaizing ah Saul nih mi kha phu thum ah a ṭhen hna i zinglei ven caan ah khin riahhmun chungah khan an lut i chun ni linh tiang Ammon mi kha an sam hna, cun a nung rihmi cu an i ṭhek dih i cucaah pahnih in a um ṭimi an um lo."},"12":{"text":"Khi tikah mi nih Samuel sinah khan, “Ahodah, ‘Saul nih cun maw a kan uk hnga?’ a titu kha an si.
