Kan thah hna nakhnga, rak chuah tuah hna,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul nih, “Nihin ah cun ahohmanh thah a si lai lo, zeicahtiah nihin ah hin Bawipa nih Israel mi lakah luatnak a ser,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mizapi hna cu, “Ra u, Gilgal ah kal u si law, pennak kha tharchuah u sih,” tiah a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah mi vialte cu Gilgal ah an kal i khika ah, Gilgal khua ah cun, Saul cu Bawipa hmaiah siangpahrang ah an ser. Khika ah Bawipa hmaiah daihnak thawinak kha an thawi i khika ah Israel mi vialte le Saul cu a tampi an i lawm."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Israel mi vialte hna sinah cun, “Zohhmanh u, nan ka chimhmi vialte ah nan aw kan ngaih hna i siangpahrang kan serpiak cang hna.","title":"Samuel Nih Mizapi Kha Bia A Chimh Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun atu cu, zohhmanh u, siangpahrang nih an hruai cang hna lai; kei cu ka tar cang i ka ṭuak zong a par cang, cun zohhmanh u, ka fapa hna cu nan sinah an um; cun kei cu ka seino lio in nihin ni tiang nan hmaiah kaa chawk lengmang."},"3":{"text":"Hika ah hin ka um hih; Bawipa le a chiti thuhmi hmaiah hin ka soi tuah u. Aho cawtum ka la bal maw? Aho laa ka la bal maw? Aho tal ka hleng bal hna maw? Aho tal ka hrem bal maw? Ka mit phenhtertu ah aho sinin nawhthuh ka la bal maw? Ka chim u law, kan rulh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Annih nih, “Na kan hleng lo, na kan hrem fawn lo, aho sin hmanh in zeihmanh na la lo,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Ka kut chungah zeihmanh nan hmuh lonak kong ah hin Bawipa cu nan cungah biahngaltu a si i nihin ah hin a chiti thuhmi cu biahngaltu a si,” tiah a ti hna. Cun annih nih, “Amah cu biahngaltu a si,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mizapi sinah cun, “Moses le Aaron kha rian a pe i nan pupa hna Izipt ram in a hun chuahpitu Bawipa kha biahngaltu cu a si.","ref":"Exo 6.26"},"7":{"text":"Cucaah dir ṭhep u law, Bawipa hmaiah Bawipa nih nanmah ca le nan pupa hna ca i khamhnak rian a ṭuanmi kha kan ruah tuah hna lai."},"8":{"text":"Jakob nih Izipt ram chungah a vung kal i Izipt mi hna nih an hrem tikah, khi tikah nan pupa hna nih Bawipa kha an auh i Bawipa nih Moses le Aaron kha a thlah hna, annih nih nan pupa hna kha Izipt ram chungin an chuahpi hna i hi hmun ah hin an umter hna.","ref":"Exo 2.23"},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa an Pathian kha an philh i Hazor siangpahrang Jabin i a ralkapbu haotu Sisera kut chungah khan le Filistin mi hna kut chungah le Moab siangpahrang kut chungah khan a zuarh hna; cun annih nih an tuk an doh hna.","ref":"Biac 3.12; 4.2; 13.1"},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kha an auh i, ‘ Bawipa kha kan hlawt i Baal le Ashtaroth kha an rian kan ṭuan hna caah kan sual cang; sihmanhsehlaw atu cu kan ral hna kut chungin kan chuahter law, nangmah na rian kan ṭuan lai,’ an ti.","ref":"Biac 10.10-15"},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Jerubbaal le Barak le Jepthah le Samuel kha a run thlah hna i nan pawngkam i a ummi nan ral hna kut chungin an chuah hna i him tein khua nan sa.","ref":"1Sam 3.20; Biac 4.6; 7.1; 11.29"},"12":{"text":"Cun nannih nih Ammon mi siangpahrang Nahash kha nanmah doh awkah a ra ti nan hmuh tikah, Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan siangpahrang a si ko lioah, keimah sinah, ‘Sihlah, siangpahrang nih kan uk ko seh,’ nan ti.","ref":"1Sam 8.19"},"13":{"text":"Cun atu cu nanmah nih nan thimmi le nanmah nih nan halmi siangpahrang cu zoh tuah u; zohhmanh u, Bawipa nih nan cungah siangpahrang pakhat a chiah cang."},"14":{"text":"Nannih nih Bawipa kha nan ṭih i a rian nan ṭuan i a aw kha nan ngaih i Bawipa nawlbia kha nan ralchanh lo le, cun nanmah le an uktu hna siangpahrang nih Bawipa nan Pathian kha nan zulh ahcun, a ṭha ko lai;"},"15":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa aw kha nan ngaih lo Bawipa nawlbia kha nan ralchanh ahcun, khi tikah Bawipa kut nih cun nanmah le nan siangpahrang kha an ralchanh hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah dir ṭhep u law, nan hmaika ah Bawipa nih a tuah laimi thil lianngan hi zoh tuah u."},"17":{"text":"Nihin hi changvut ṭuan ni a si lo mei? Khua a ritter i ruah a surter nakhnga, Bawipa kha ka auh lai i nan ca i nannih nih siangpahrang nan halnak kongah hin Bawipa hmai i nan tuahmi nan ṭhat lonak kha a ngan, ti kha nan hngalh lai i nan hmuh lai,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah Samuel nih Bawipa kha a auh i khi ni ah Bawipa nih khua a ritter i ruah a surter; cun mi vialte nih Bawipa le Samuel kha an ṭih ngaingai hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun mi vialte nih Samuel sinah cun, “ Bawipa na Pathian sinah cun, kan thih nakhnga lo, na sal hna caah hin thla kan campiak tuah; zeicahtiah kan sualnak vialte cungah hi thil ṭhalo hi kan i chap cang, kan ca i siangpahrang kan hal hi,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih mi sinah cun, “Ṭih hlah u; hi thil ṭhalo vialte hi nan tuah cang, asinain Bawipa nan zulhnak khan pial loin nan lungthin dihlak in Bawipa rian kha ṭuan tuah u;"},"21":{"text":"cun pakpalawng thil, ṭhathnem zong an ṭhathnem kho hna lo i a khamh zong an khamh kho hna lomi thil hna kha, pialhnawh hna hlah u, zeitintiah pakpalawng an si."},"22":{"text":"Nannih cu amah ca miphun i ser kha Bawipa lawmhmi a si caah, a min ngan ruang ah hin, Bawipa nih a mi cu an hlonh hna lai lo."},"23":{"text":"Cuhleiah nan ca i thlacam ka ngol thawngin Bawipa cung i sualnak ka tuah hnga cu ka duh ding naisai a si lo; lam ṭha le lam ding chung kal awk kha kan cawnpiak ko hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭih bel ṭih ko u law, nan lungthin dihlak in a rian kha zumhawktlak tein ṭuan ko u; zeitintiah nan ca i thil lianngan a tuahmi kha ruat tuah hna u."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak nan tuah ṭheo ahcun, nanmah he nan siangpahrang he nan lo dih ko lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul cu pennak hram a thawk tikah kum … a si i amah nih kum … le kum hnih Israel mi kha a uk hna.","title":"Filistin Mi He An I Do"},"2":{"text":"Saul nih Israel mi thong thum a thim hna; thong hnih cu Saul he Mikmash le Bethel tlangram ah khan an um i thong khat cu Jonathan he Benjamin phun khua Gibeah ah khan an um; cun a tangmi hna cu anmah le an thlam cio ah khan a kirter hna."},"3":{"text":"Jonathan nih Geba i a ummi Filistin ralveng ralkapbu cu a tei hna i mah cucu Filistin mi nih an theih. Cun Saul nih ram chung dihlak ah khan, “Hebru mi nih thei hna seh,” tiin muko a tum."},"4":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte nih khan, Saul nih Filistin ralveng ralkapbu kha a tei hna ti le Israel mi cu Filistin mi hna huat kan phor cang ti zong kha an theih. Cun mi hna cu Saul kha Gilgal i hei fonh awkah an auh hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi cu Israel mi kha doh awkah an i pum, rangleng sang thum, rangcung ralkap thong ruk le ke ralkap an tam ning cu rilikam thetse zat; cun an hung kai i Mikmash ah an riak, Beth-aven nichuahlei ah khan."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi nih harnak chungah kan um ti kha an hmuh tikah (zeitintiah annih cu fak piin an det hna) mi hna cu lungkua hna le khor hna le lungpi chung hna le thlan chung hna le ti inn chung hna ah an i thup,"},"7":{"text":"a cheu nih Jordan tiva kha a tannak hmun hna ah khan an tan i Gad le Gilead ram ah an zam. Saul tu cu Gilgal ah khan a um ko i mi vialte nih khan therphang lengmang in an zulh."},"8":{"text":"Samuel nih a caan a tinh tak bangin ni sarih a hngah; sihmanhsehlaw Samuel cu Gilgal ah khan a ra lo i mi nih khan amah kha an ṭiaotak lengmang cang.","ref":"1Sam 10.8"},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih, “Hika ah hin, keimah sinah, khangh thawinak kha le daihnak thawinak hna kha rak pu hna u,” tiah a ti. Cun khangh thawinak kha a pekchanh."},"10":{"text":"Khangh thawinak kha a pekchanh dih kate ah khin, zohhmanh, Samuel kha a ra; cun Saul nih khan amah ton awkah a kal i salaam a pek."},"11":{"text":"Samuel nih, “Zeidah na rak tuah?” tiah a ti. Cun Saul nih, “Mi kha ka sinin an ṭiao lengmang cang ti kha ka hmuh tik le kan ni tinhmi chungah na rat ti lo ca le Filistin mi kha Mikmash ah an i pumh luaimai caah,"},"12":{"text":"keimah nih, “ Bawipa duhdawtnak ka hal hlanah hin maw Filistin mi hna nih hin Gilgal ah hin run kan zuanhnawh hna lai,’ ka ti i cucaah khangh thawinak pekchanhnak hi ka rak i hnek ko,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Saul cu, “Na tuahmi hi hruhnak ngaingai a si; Bawipa na Pathian nih an pekmi a nawlbia cu na zul lo; zeicahtiah atu cu, Bawipa nih na pennak cu Israel mi cungah zungzal ca in a hei fehter ko hnga."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu na pennak hi aa pehtlai lai lo; zeitintiah Bawipa nih amah duhning lungthin a pumi pakhat a kawl cang; cun nangmah nih Bawipa nih an pekmi nawlbia kha na zulh hna lo caah, a mi hna cung i bawi sinak kha Bawipa nih amah cu a pek cang,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lam 13.22"},"15":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu a tho i Gilgal in Benjamin khua Gibeah ah khan a hung kal. Cun Saul nih amah sinah a ummi kha a rel hna i za ruk tluk an si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Saul le a fapa Jonathan le an sinah a ummi hna kha Benjamin khua Geba ah khan an um; sihmanhsehlaw Filistin mi cu Mikmash ah khan an riak."},"17":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna riahhmun khan raltutu phu thum in an chuak; phu khat cu Shual ram i Ofrah leiah khan an kal,"},"18":{"text":"phu khat cu Beth-horon leiah an kal, cun phu khat cu ramlak lei Zeboim nelrawn vun zohtu pawng ri leiah khan an kal."},"19":{"text":"Israel mi ram chung dihlak ah soser pakhat hmanh an rak um lo, zeitintiah Filistin mi nih, “Hebru mi nih fei le nam an i ser sual ai hnga,” tiah an ti;"},"20":{"text":"asinain Israel mi paohpaoh nih an tuhmui siseh, an hmuizum siseh, an hreitlung siseh, an fa-ah siseh, cer awkah Filistin mi hna sinah an vung kal lengmang;"},"21":{"text":"cun a man cu tuhmui ca le hmuizum caah pim khat lengmang a si i shekel cheu thum cheu khat lengmang hreitlung cernak le leng hnuk caw sawhnak fung bunh man ah a si."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah raltuk ni ah khan fei siseh, nam siseh a ngeimi, Saul le Jonathan sin i a ummi hna lakah khan an um lo; sihmanhsehlaw Saul le a fapa Jonathan kha cu an ngei."},"23":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi ralveng ralkapbu cu Mikmash i va lanhnak fiang ah khan an va kal."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat cu Saul fapa Jonathan nih khan a ralthuam a putu tlangvalpa sinah khan, “Ra law, khatte lei ral i Filistin mi ralvengtu ralkapbu sinah khin va kal tuah u sih,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a pa kha a chim lo."},"2":{"text":"Saul cu Gibeah pawngri i a ummi Migron i a ummi taleti kung toiah a um ko; amah sinah a ummi cu za ruk tluk an si,"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa tlangbawi Shiloh i a rak ummi Eli fapa Phinehas i fapa Ikabod i a unau Ahitub i fapa Ahijah zong, tlangbawi angki aa hruk i a um ve. Cun mizapi nih khan Jonathan a kal kha an hngal lo."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih Filistin mi ralvengtu ralkapbu sin i va kal aa timhnak fiang ah khan a kap hnih in lungpang an um veve, pakhat min cu Bozez a si i a dang pakhat min cu Seneh a si."},"5":{"text":"Lungpang pakhat cu chaklei ah Mikmash hmailei ah aa chong i a dang pakhat cu thlanglei ah, Geba hmailei ah aa chong."},"6":{"text":"Cun a ralthuam putu tlangval sinah cun Jonathan nih, “Hi cuarpartan lomi hna an ralvengtu ralkapbu sinah khin va kal tuah u sih; Bawipa nih kan caah rian a hei ṭuan ko hmanh hnga maw, zeitintiah khamhnak cu mi tam thawngin a si ah siseh, mi tlawm thawngin a si ah siseh, Bawipa cu zeihmanh nih a dawnh khawh ṭung lo,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun a ralthuam putu nih khan a sinah, “Na lung nih a duhning te cun tuah ko; zohhmanh, na sinah ka um, na ruahnak bantukte cu ka ruahnak a si ve,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih khan, “Zohhmanh, an sin leiah khin kan hei kal lai i kan hei i langhter lai."},"9":{"text":"Annih nih kan sinah, ‘Nan sinah kan rat hlantiang rak um rih u,’ an ti ahcun, kan umnak hmun ah khan kan dir lai i an sinah khan kan hung kal lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih, ‘Kan sinah hung tuah u,’ an ti ahcun, kan hung kal lai; zeitintiah mah hihi Bawipa nih annih cu kan kut chungah a kan pek cang ti hmelchunhnak a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah an pahnih in Filistin mi ralvengtu ralkapbu sinah cun an hei i langhter; cun Filistin mi hna nih cun, “Zohhmanh u, an i thuhnak kua chungin Hebru mi an chuak cang khi,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun ralvengtu ralkapbu hna nih cun Jonathan le a ralthuam putu cu an hei kawh hna i, “Kan sinah hung u law, thil pakhat kan in hmuhsak hna lai,” tiah an hei ti hna. Cun Jonathan nih a ralthuam putu sinah cun, “Hun ka zul tuah; zeitintiah annih cu Bawipa nih Israel mi kut chungah a pek cang hna cuh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Jonathan cu a kut le a ke i bawmh in a hung kai, a ralthuam putu nih cun a hnu in a zulh. Cun annih cu Jonathan hmaiah cun an tlu duahmah ko i a ralthuam putu zong nih a hnulei in a hun thah ve hna;"},"14":{"text":"cun cu thahnak hmasa bik Jonathan le a ralthuam putu nih an tuahmi cu, tlangrel tuhnak kauh vawlei ah khin, leileh rinkuar a cheu can tluk ah khin, mi pakul tluk an thi."},"15":{"text":"Cun riahhmun le lo lak le mi vialte lakah khan launak a um ciammam i ralvengtu ralkapbu le ral hranhtu ralkap hna hmanh cu an ther ko; cun vawlei aa hnin i launak nganpi ah a cang."},"16":{"text":"Cun Saul ralvengtu hna, Benjamin mi khua Gibeah i a ummi hna nih khan an hei zoh i, zohhmanh, mi bupi cu hilei khilei ah an i cavai len ko."},"17":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sin i a ummi hna sinah cun, “Mi i rel u law, ahodah kan sinin a kal, i zoh tuah u,” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih an i rel tikah, zohhmanh, Jonathan le a ralthuam putu kha an um lo."},"18":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Ahijah sinah cun, “Hika ah hin Pathian kuang kha rak pu tuah,” tiah a ti. Zeitintiah khi caan ah Pathian kuang cu Israel mi sinah khan a kal ve."},"19":{"text":"Cun Saul nih tlangbawi a chawnh lioah khan, Filistin mi riahhmun chung i i tuainak cu a karh chin lengmang i Saul nih tlangbawi sinah cun, “Na kut kha zuk ṭhan tuah,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Saul le a sinah a ummi vialte kha an i pum ṭhan i raldohnak chungah cun an lut; cun zohhmanh, anmah le anmah cu nam in an i tu ciammam i, i tuainak nganpi a um."},"21":{"text":"Cun cu caan hlan i Filistin mi sin i a um i an sinah an riahhmun i a hung kalmi Hebru mi hna hmanh kha, atu ah cun, Saul le Jonathan sinah a ummi Israel mi hna sin i um awkah an i mer."},"22":{"text":"Cu bantukin, Efraim tlangram i aa thupmi Israel mi vialte nih khan Filistin mi cu an zam ti an theih tikah, annih zong nih raldohnak chungah khan i tel ve in, heh tiah an dawi ve hna."},"23":{"text":"Cuticun khi ni ah Bawipa nih Israel cu a luatter; raldohnak cu Beth-aven pin tiang a phan."},"24":{"text":"Cun khi ni ah Israel mi hna cu an lungre a thei, zeicahtiah mi cungah cun chiatsernak kha Saul nih a khin i, “Ka ral hna cungah phu ka hlam i zanlei a si hlan i rawl a eimi cu chiatserh siseh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah ahohmanh nih rawl an tep lo."},"25":{"text":"Cun mi vialte cu tupi chung i an va luh tikah, zohhmanh, vawlei ah khuaihliti a rak um."},"26":{"text":"Cun mi kha tupi chung i an va luh tikah, zohhmanh, khuaihliti kha a rak tla lengmang, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh nih an kut an kaa ah an i tuh lo; zeitintiah mi nih khan chiatserhnak kha an ṭih."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jonathan nih a pa nih mi kha chiatserhnak in bia a beuh hna ti kha a thei lo; cucaah a kut in aa putmi fung par cun khuai thlar cu a sawh i a kut in aa tuh i a mit a hung fiang ṭhan."},"28":{"text":"Cun mi pakhat nih, “Na pa nih mi kha chiatserhnak in fek tein bia a beuh hna i, ‘Nihin i rawl a eimi cu chiat siseh,’ a ti,” tiah a ti. Cun mizapi cu an buhri dih."},"29":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih aa thawh i, “Ka pa nih ram hi harnak a pek ko hih. Khuaihliti tlawmpalte ka teh caah ka mit au a fian ṭhan hi zoh tuah ngat u."},"30":{"text":"Mi hna nih hin, an ral hna hranchaw an hmuhmi hi, nihin ah hin heh tiah ei ko hna seh law, zeitluk in dik a hei ṭhat deuh hnga; cucaah cun pei Filistin mi hi tampi kan thah khawh hna lo hi,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun Mikmash in Aijalon tiang Filistin mi cu an thah len hna. Cun mi cu an buhri ngaingai;"},"32":{"text":"mi hna nih cun hranchaw kha an zuanhnawh hna i tuu hna le cawtum hna le cawfa hna kha an lak hna i vawlei ah an thah hna i mi nih cun an thisen he an ei chih hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun Saul kha an chimh i, “Zohhmanh, mi nih thisen an einak thawng in Bawipa sinah an sual cang,” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “Nannih nih hlennak in nan tuah cang; hika ah hin keimah sinah lungpi pakhat in rak hril tuah u,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 9.4; Lev 7.26-27; 17.10-14; 19.26; Deu 12.16,23; 15.23"},"34":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Mizapi sinah khan vaa ṭhek u law, annih cu, ‘Mi kip nih an cawtum siseh, an tuu siseh, rak i put cio hna seh law, hika ah hin that hna seh law, ei hna seh; cun thisen ei chihnak thawngin Bawipa sinah sual hlah u,’ tiah chim hna u,” tiah a ti. Cucaah mi kip nih cu zan ah cun an cawtum cio kha an rak i put i khika ah an thah hna."},"35":{"text":"Cun Bawipa caah Saul nih biakṭheng pakhat a sak; mah cucu Bawipa ca i a sak hmasa bikmi biakṭheng a si."},"36":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Zan ah Filistin mi cu vung dawi hna u si law, zinglei khuadei tiang vung hrawk hna u sih; mi pakhat hmanh vung ngan hna hlah u sih,” a ti. Cun annih nih, “A ṭha tiah na ruahmi paoh cu tuah ko,” tiah an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi nih, “Hika ah hin Pathian naih rih tuah u sih,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Pathian cu a hal i, “Filistin mi cu ka vung dawi hna lai maw? Annih cu Israel mi hna kut chungah na pe hna lai maw?” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw khi ni ah cun amah cu a let lo."},"38":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Hika ah hin ra tuah u, mizapi a hruaitu hna nan dihlak in; cun hi sualnak hi zeitindah nihin ah a thawh ti kha hngal u law, hmu tuah u."},"39":{"text":"Zeitintiah Israel a khamhtu Bawipa nih a nun bangin, ka fapa Jonathan chungah a um a si hmanh ah, a thi hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw mi vialte lakah cun amah a hun lettu pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"40":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte sinah cun, “Nannih cu kam khat ah nan um lai i keimah le ka fapa Jonathan cu kam khat ah kan um lai,” tiah a ti. Cun mi zapi nih Saul cu, “A ṭha tiin na ruahmi cu tuah ko,” tiah an ti."},"41":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih, “Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, zeicahdah nihin cu na sal kha na ka leh lo? Hi mawhnak cu keimah chungah siseh, ka fapa Jonathan chungah siseh, a um a si ahcun, maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, Urim langhter; sihmanhsehlaw hi mawhnak cu na mi Israel mi chungah a um a si ahcun, Thummim langhter,” tiah a ti. Cun Jonathan le Saul cungah khan a tla i mizapi kha cu an luat.","ref":"Nam 27.21; 1Sam 28.6"},"42":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Keimah le ka fapa Jonathan cungah khan camcawhnak cu tuah u,” tiah a ti i Jonathan cungah khan a tla."},"43":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Jonathan cu, “Zeidah na rak tuah, ka chim tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun Jonathan nih amah cu, “Ka kut in kaa putmi ṭhiangṭhunh par in khuaihliti tlawmte ka teh; hika ah ka um ko hih, ka thi ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Pathian nih ka cungah cu bantukin le cu nak tam deuh zongin, tuah ko seh; na thi hrimhrim ko lai, Jonathan,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Khi tikah mizapi nih Saul sinah cun, “Israel chungah hi teinak nganpi a tuahtu Jonathan cu maw a thi hnga? Naisai hlah! Bawipa a nun bangin, a lu cung a samfa fa khat hmanh vawlei ah a tla lai lo; zeicahtiah nihin ah Bawipa he pei an tuah ṭi leh hi,” tiah an ti. Cuticun mizapi nih Jonathan cu an tlanh; cucaah a thi lo."},"46":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Filistin mi a dawi hna cu a kirtak i Filistin mi cu anmah umnak hmun ah khan an kal."},"47":{"text":"Saul nih Israel mi siangpahrang a can tikah a kenkip i a ummi a ral vialte, Moab mi, Ammon mi, Edom mi Zobah siangpahrang hna le Filistin mi hna kha a doh hna; a va fuhmi paoh cu a tei lengmang hna."},"48":{"text":"Cun ralṭha ngaiin a tuah i Amalek mi kha a tuk hna i Israel mi cu a roktu hna kut chung khan a luatter hna."},"49":{"text":"Cun Saul fapa hna cu Jonathan, Ishvi le Malkhishua an si; cun a fanu pahnih hna an min cu mah hihi an si: upa deuh min cu Merab, cun a ngakchia deuh min cu Mikhal;"},"50":{"text":"cun Saul nupi min cu Ahinoam a si, amah cu Ahimaaz fanu a si. Cun a ralkapbu haotu min cu Abner a si, amah cu Saul pa unau Ner i fapa a si."},"51":{"text":"Saul pa cu Kish a si, cun Abner pa Ner cu Abiel fapa a si."},"52":{"text":"Saul chan chung vialte cu Filistin mi kha fak piin an doh hna cun Saul nih pa ṭhawng siseh, pa ralṭha siseh, a hmuhmi paoh cu amah sinah a fonh chih lengmang hna."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Saul cu, “ Bawipa nih keimah cu, nangmah kha, a mi Israel mi cung i siangpahrang si awk i chiti thuh awkah, a ka thlah cang; cucaah Bawipa bia cu ngai tuah hna.","title":"Saul Nih Pathian Nawl A Al, Pathian Nih A Hlawtnak","ref":"1Sam 10.1"},"2":{"text":"Hi bangin ralkapbu Bawipa nih a ti, ‘Amalek mi nih Israel mi cungah an tuahmi, Izipt ram in an chuah i lampi i annih an rak doh hna kha, dan ka tat lai.","ref":"Exo 17.8-14; Deu 25.17-19"},"3":{"text":"Atu cu va kal law, Amalek kha va tu, an ngeihmi vialte kha va hrawk dih; zuah hna hlah, sihmanhsehlaw pa thlulo nu thlulo, ngakchia thlulo, bawhte thlulo, tuu thlulo, kalauk thlulo, laa thlulo in va that hna,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih mi kha a kawh hna i Telaim ah a rel hna, ke ralkap sing hnih le Judah mi sang khat an si."},"5":{"text":"Cun Saul cu Amalek mi hna khua cu a phan i horkuang chung cun a bawh."},"6":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Ken mi hna cu, “Kal u law, i ṭhen u, Amalek mi hna sinin vung kal u; cu ti a si lo ahcun, anmah sinah kan hrawh chih sual hna lai; zeitintiah Izipt ram in an hung chuah lioah khan nannih nih Israel mi vialte cu nan rak zaangfah hna,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Ken mi hna cu Amalek mi hna sin khan an i ṭhen."},"7":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Amalek mi cu Havilah in Izipt nichuahlei i a ummi Shur tiang a tei hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Amalek mi siangpahrang Agag kha a nung in a tlaih i mi vialte kha vainam in a sam dih hna."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul le mi hna nih khan Agag le tuu lak i a ṭha bik hna le cawtum lak i a ṭha bik hna le cenhmi saṭil thauthau hna lakin a ṭha bik hna le, tuufa hna le a ṭhami vialte kha an zuah hna i an hrawk cikcek duh hna lo; a ṭhalo le santlailo vialte lawng kha an hrawh cikcek hna."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa bia cu Samuel sinah a ra phan:"},"11":{"text":"“Saul cu siangpahrang i ka rak ser caah hin kaa ngaichih; zeicahtiah keimah zulhnak in aa mer cang i ka nawlbia kha a tuah hna lo,” tiah a ti. Cun Samuel cu a thin a hung i Bawipa kha zan khuadei in a auh."},"12":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu Saul kha zinglei i ton awkah tuan tein a tho, cun Samuel kha an chimh i, “Saul cu Karmel ah a ra, cun zohhmanh, amah caah hngalh camcinnak lung aa phun i aa mer i a lan i Gilgal ah a vang kal,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu Saul sinah a ra i Saul nih khan amah cu, Bawipa nih thluachuahnak in pe ko seh; Bawipa nawlbia cu ka tuah cang,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “A si kun ahcun, tuu awnh ka hna i a lutmi hi le cawtum pawt ka theihmi hi zeidah a si kun?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Saul nih, “Amalek mi hna sinin an ratpimi an si; zeitintiah mi nih tuu lak i a ṭha bik hna le cawtum lak i a ṭha bik hna kha Bawipa na Pathian sin i raithawi awkah an zuah hna; cun a dang vialte cu kan hrawh cikcek hna,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah Samuel nih Saul cu, “Ngol rih hmanh! Zahan ah Bawipa nih a ka chimhmi cu kan chim hmanh lai,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Chim ko,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “Nangmah naa ruahnak ah mi hmete si hmanh law, Israel miphun hna lu na si lo maw? Bawipa nih Israel mi siangpahrang ah chiti an thuh cang."},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih rian pakhat tuah awkah an thlah i, ‘Va kal law, misual mi, Amalek mi kha, va hrawk dih cikcek hna, cun an ciamh dih tiangin va do hna,’ a ti."},"19":{"text":"A si kun ahcun, zeicahdah Bawipa aw cu na zulh lo? Zeicahdah hranchaw kha na zuanhnawh i Bawipa hmai i thil ṭhalo kha na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Samuel sinah cun, “ Bawipa aw cu ka zulh ko, Bawipa nih a ka thlahnak rian ah khan ka kal ko, Amalek siangpahrang Agag kha ka ratpi i Amalek mi kha ka hrawh cikcek ko hna."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mizapi nih hranchaw le tuu hna le cawtum hna hrawh awk i ulhamhmi thil lak i a ṭha bik hna kha, Gilgal ah, Bawipa na Pathian sin i raithawi awkah an lak hna,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih a thawh i, “ Bawipa nih hin Bawipa aw zulhnak i lawmhnak ngan a ngeih tluk hin maw, Khangh thawinak le raithawinak ah hin lawmhnak a ngeih ve? Zohhmanh, nawlngaihnak hi raithawinak nakin a ṭha deuh i Amah bia ngaih hi tuukawng hna thau nakin a ṭha deuh."},"23":{"text":"Zeitintiah ralchanh hman hi litin bantukin sual a si ve i, Lungkhon hi ṭhat lo le siasal biak he an i tluk. Nangmah nih Bawipa bia na al cang caah amah zong nih nangmah cu siangpahrang sinak khan an hlawt cang,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Samuel sinah cun, “Ka sual cang; mi zapi kha ka ṭih hna i an aw ka zulh hna caah Bawipa nawlbia le nangmah bia kha ka buar cang hna."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu, ka sualnak kha ka ngaithiam law, ka sinah kir tuah, Bawipa kha ka biak nakhnga, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Saul cu, “Nangmah cu kan kirpi lai lo; zeitintiah Bawipa bia kha na al cang i, Bawipa nih Israel mi cung i siangpahrang na sinak khan an hlawt cang,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu kal awk i aa mer pah ah khin Saul nih a puan ki in a tlaih i a tlek.","ref":"1Sam 28.17; 1Sia 11.30-31"},"28":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih amah cu, “ Bawipa nih Israel pennak cu nangmah sinin nihin ah hin a thleh cang i nangmah nakin a ṭha deuhmi na innpa sinah khan a pek cang."},"29":{"text":"Cun Israel Sunparnak nih khan lih zong a chim lai lo i a ngaih zong aa ngaichih lai lo; zeitintiah i ngaihchih awkah amah cu minung a si ṭung lo,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun amah nih khan, “Ka sual ko cang; sihmanhsehlaw atu cu ka mi hna i an upa hna hmai le Israel mi hmaiah hin upatnak ka pe law ka kirpi ko. Bawipa na Pathian cu ka biak nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah Samuel nih Saul cu a kirpi i Saul nih Bawipa kha a biak."},"32":{"text":"Khi tikah Samuel nih, “Amalek mi siangpahrang Agag kha hika ah hin, ka sinah ratpi tuah u,” tiah a ti. Cun Agag cu a sinah cun thanuam ngaiin a ra. Agag nih cun, “Thihnak a khaatnak cu ka lonh cang ko hnga lo maw cu,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “Nangmah na vainam nih nu kha fa loin a tuah hna bantukin, cu bangin na nu cu nu hna lakah fa ngei lomi a si ve lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Samuel nih Agag cu Bawipa hmaiah Gilgal khua ah cun a sam cikcek."},"34":{"text":"Cun Samuel cu Ramah ah a tlung; Saul cu a inn ah Saul khua Gibeah ah khan a hung kal."},"35":{"text":"Samuel nih Saul cu a thih ni tiangin a hmu ṭhan ti lo, sihmanhsehlaw Samuel cu Saul kongah khan a ngaih a chia ko. Cun Bawipa cu, Israel mi hna siangpahrang i Saul a rak ser kha, aa ngaihchih."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Samuel sinah cun, “Israel mi hna cung i siangpahrang a sinak in ka hlawt na hmuhmi Saul kong ah hin zei can dah ngaihchia in na um lai? Na ki ah khan chiti rawn law, va kal tuah; nangmah cu Bethlehem khuami Jesse sinah kan thlah lai, zeicahtiah amah fapa hna lakah siangpahrang ca i kaa thimmi a um cang,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Cu Siangpahrang Si Awkah Chiti Thuh A Si"},"2":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “Zeitindah ka kal khawh lai? Saul nih a theih ahcun, a ka thah lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “Cawla pakhat in i lak law, ‘ Bawipa sin i raithawi awkah ka ra,’ tiah va ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Jesse kha raithawinak ah cun va sawm law, nangmah nih zeidah na tuah awk a si kha kan hmuhsak lai; cun a min kan chimhmi kha nangmah nih chiti cu na ka thuhpiak lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih nawl a pekmi cu Samuel nih a tuah i Bethlehem khua ah khan a ra. Cu khua upa hna nih amah cu ton awkah khan ther lengmang in an ra i, “Daihnak lei ca i a rami na si maw?” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Daihnak in; Bawipa sin i raithawi awkah ka ra; nanmah kha i thianh u law, raithawinak ah cun ka sinah ra ve u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun Jesse le a fapa hna kha a thianh hna i raithawinak ah khan a sawm hna."},"6":{"text":"Annih nih an rat tikah Eliab kha a zoh i, “ Bawipa chiti thuhmi cu Bawipa hmai i a ummi hi a si hrimhrim ko,” tiah a ruah."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih Samuel sinah cun, “A muisam in siseh, a pumrua in siseh, zoh hlah, zeicahtiah amah cu ka hlawt cang; zeitintiah Bawipa nih cun mi i an zohning in a zoh lo; mi nih cun lenglei langhning kha an zoh, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun lungthin kha a zoh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jesse nih Abinadab kha a auh Samuel hmaiah khan a hei kalter. Cun anih nih, “Hi zong hi Bawipa thimmi a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesse nih Shammah kha a hei kalter. Cun anih nih, “Hi zong hi Bawipa thimmi a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Jesse nih a fapa hna chung i pasarih kha Samuel hmaiah cun a kalter hna. Cun Samuel nih Jesse sinah cun, “ Bawipa nih mah hna hi cu a thim hna lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Jesse sinah cun, “Hika ah hin na fapa an dihlak in an um maw?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “A ngakchia bik a um rih, sihmanhsehlaw zohhmanh, amah cu tuu a khal,” tiah a ti. Cun Samuel nih Jesse sinah cun, “Mi hei thlah hna law, amah cu va la hna seh; zeitintiah hika a phak hlantiang kan ṭhu lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun a hei thlah hna i an run luhpi. Amah cu mi sen tertar te, mit au dawh ngai, midawh ngai a si. Cun Bawipa nih, “Tho law, amah cu thuh tuah; zeicahtiah amah hi dahkaw a si cu,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih a chiti rawnnak ki cu aa lak i amah cu a unau hna lakah cun a toih; cun Bawipa thlarau cu cu ni thawk in fak piin David cungah a tlung. Cun Samuel cu a tho i Ramah ah a kal."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa thlarau cu Saul sin khan aa ṭhial i Bawipa sinin a rami thlarau ṭhalo nih amah kha awlok a chonh.","title":"David Nih Saul Kha Tingtang A Tumpiak"},"15":{"text":"Cun Saul cu a sinum hna nih khan, “Zohhmanh, Pathian sinin a rami thlarau ṭhalo nih awlok an chonh hih."},"16":{"text":"Kan bawipa nih nangmah hmai i a ummi na sal hna hi, tingtang tum a thiammi kawl awkah nawl kan pe tuah; Pathian sinin a rami thlarau ṭhalo kha na cungah a um tikah amah nih cun a tum lai i na dam lai,” tiah an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih a sinum hna sinah cun, “Tum a thiammi ka hmuhpiak u law, ka sinah ratpi u,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Tlangval pakhat nih khan a hun leh i, “Zohhmanh, Bethlehem khuami Jesse fapa pakhat, tingtang tum a thiammi, mi ralṭha, raldoh thiammi, biachim holh rel i a fimmi, mui dawh ngai, ka hmuh; cun Bawipa cu amah sinah a um,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih Jesse sinah cun lamkal a hei thlah hna i, “Tuu sinah a ummi na fapa David kha rak ka kua tuah,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Jesse nih changreu le mitsur hang cua khat a phormi laa pakhat le meheh fa pakhat kha a lak i a fapa David sinin Saul sinah khan a kuat hna."},"21":{"text":"Cun David cu Saul sinah khan a ra i a rian ah khan a lut. Cun Saul nih khan a duh ngaingai i a hriamnam putu ah a cang."},"22":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Jesse cu bia a hei cah i, “David cu ka rian ah hin um ko seh, zeitintiah a cungah ka mit a tling,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Pathian sinin a rami thlarau ṭhalo kha Saul cungah a tlun fate, David nih khan tingtang kha aa lak i a kut in a tum tawn; cucaah Saul cu aa hrim ṭhan tawn i a dam; cun thlarau ṭhalo nih khan a chuahtak tawn."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi nih an ralkapbu hna cu raldoh awkah an pumh hna i Judah ram Sokoh khua ah; Sokoh le Azekah kar Efes-dammim ah an riak.","title":"David Nih Goliath A Thah"},"2":{"text":"Cun Saul le Israel mi cu an i pum i Elah nelrawn ah an riak i Filistin mi hna kha rak doh awkah an rak i tiang."},"3":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna cu kam khattelei tlang cungah an dir i Israel mi hna cu a dang kam khattelei tlang cungah khan an dir ve, an karlak ah horkuang pakhat a um."},"4":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna riahhmun cun an mi ṭhawng bik a min Goliath a simi, Gath khuami, a tung dong ruk le khap khat a timi cu a ra chuak."},"5":{"text":"A lu ah dar luchin aa chinh i thir ngaphaw angki aa hruk i cu angki cu a rih leiah pawng za le kul le nga a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun a ke ah ngal tuamnak dar phaw aa hruk i a liang ah dar fei aa bei."},"7":{"text":"Cun a feihlung cu thiamtlang bantuk a si i a feihmur thir cu pawng hleinga a rit; cun a phaw putu cu a hmaiah a kal."},"8":{"text":"A dir riangmang i Israel ralkap cu a hei hauh hna i, “Zeicahdah raldoh awk i i tian awkah nan hei chuah ve? Keimah cu Filistin mi ka si i nannih cu Saul sal nan si lo maw? Nanmah caah mi pakhat i thim u law, keimah sinah hin rung seh."},"9":{"text":"Keimah kha a ka doh khawh i a ka thah ahcun, kannih cu nan sal kan si lai; sihmanhsehlaw amah cu keimah nih ka tei i ka thah ahcun, nannih cu kan sal nan si lai i kan rian nan ṭuan lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Filistin mipa nih cun, “Nihin ah hin Israel ralkap cu keimah nih kan zuam hna; mi pakhat i thim u law, kan i tawng tuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Saul le Israel mi vialte nih Filistin mipa bia kha an theih tikah an lung a dong i an thin a phang ngaingai."},"12":{"text":"Cun David cu Bethlehem khua i Jesse fapa a si. Jesse cu Efrath chung a si i fapa pariat a ngei. Saul chan ah khan cu pa cu a tar cang i a kum a upa cang.","title":"Saul Riahhmun Ah David"},"13":{"text":"Jesse fapa upa bik pathum hna nih khan Saul cu raltuknak ah an zulh i raltuknak i a kalmi a fapa pathum hna min cu, a chuak hmasa bik Eliab le a hun changtu Abinadab le a pathumnak Shammah an si."},"14":{"text":"David cu a hniang bik a si; a upa bik pathum hna nih cun Saul kha an zulh,"},"15":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw David cu a pa tuu kha Bethlehem i va cawngh awkah khan Saul sin cun aa chawk aa let lengmang."},"16":{"text":"Ni sawm li chung, Filistin mipa nih cun zingfa zanfa, a chuahhnawh hna i a dirhnawh lengmang hna."},"17":{"text":"Ni khat cu Jesse nih a fapa David cu, “Na ule caah vaireu ephah pakhat le changreu tlang hra hi i lak law, na ule sinah, riahhmun ah cun, khulrang in va kal tuah;"},"18":{"text":"cun annih an thong khat haotu caah cawhnuk khal tlang hra hi i phorh fawn. Na ule kha zeitindah an um va zoh hna law, annih sinin hmelchunhnak pakhatkhat rak phor te,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Saul le a ule hna le Israel mi vialte cu Elah nelrawn chungah khan, Filistin mi hna he i do in an um, hna a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun David cu zingka tein a tho i tuu cu a cawngtu pakhat sinah a chiahtak hna i, thil kha a kalpi hna i Jesse nih a fial bantuk khan a kal; cun ralkapbu cu ral hla i sak pah in raldoh awk i i tiannak hmun i an chuah lioah khan riahhmun cu a va phan."},"21":{"text":"Cun Israel mi le Filistin mi hna cu i tuk awkah an rak i tiang, ralkapbu le ralkapbu i enhtonh in."},"22":{"text":"Cun David nih thil kha thilri zohkhenhtu sinah a chiah hna i ralkap hna sinah cun a va le i a ule cu a va biakchawnh hna."},"23":{"text":"An sin i bia a chim lioah khan, zohhmanh, an miṭhawng bik, Gath khuami Filistin mi, a min Goliath a simi kha, Filistin ralkap chung cun a hung chuak i hmasa bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam khan Israel mi cu a zuamcawh hna. Cun David nih amah bia cu a theih."},"24":{"text":"Israel mi vialte nih mipa kha an hmuh tikah an zam i an thin a phang ngaingai."},"25":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna nih cun, “Hi a hung chuak mipa hi na hmu maw? Israel zawmhtaih awk hrimhrim ah a hung chuak ko hi ta; cun hi pa a thattu hi cu siangpahrang nih laksawng tampi a pek lai i a fanu zong kha a pek lai i, a pa innchungkhar ngunkhuai a luatter lai,” tiah pakhat le pakhat an i ceih."},"26":{"text":"Cun David nih a pawng i a dirmi hna cu, “Hi Filistin mipa a that i hi thangchiatnak Israel mi sinin a ṭhialtu cu, a cungah zeitindah tuah a si hnga? Hi cuarpartan lomi Filistin mipa hi aho rialmal dah a hei si i Pathian nung ralkapbu a hei zawmhtaih hna hnga cu!” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun mizapi nih cun an leh i, “Hi pa a thattu cu kan chim bantuk khan a cungah tuah a si ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun a u upa bik Eliab nih mi hna sin i bia a chim kha a rak theih i David cungah cun a thin a hung i, “Zeidah na ra tuah?” Kha tuu, tlawmte kha ramlak ah khan aho sinah dah na kaltak hna? Na ninghngalte le raltuk zoh awkah na ra ko hih?” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Zei hen dah ka tuah i? Bia kaa khat chim thamtham cu,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun amah sin cun a dang pakhat sin leiah aa mer i cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun a chim; cun mi nih khan hmasa i an leh bantuk khan an leh ṭhan."},"31":{"text":"David nih a chimmi bia cu an theih tikah Saul kha an va chimh chin; cun amah kha a auh."},"32":{"text":"Cun David nih Saul sinah cun, “Amah ruangah hin aho hmanh an lungdong hna hlah seh; na salpa nih ka va kal lai i hi Filistin mipa hi ka va doh lai,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David cu, “Hi Filistin mipa va doh awkah hin na kal kho lai lo, zeicahtiah nang cu tlangvalte men na si i anih cu a tlanval ka in pei ralkap a si cang cu,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih Saul sinah cun, “Na salpa nih hin ka pa caah tuu ka khal tawn i chiandeih siseh, vom siseh a rat i tuufa kha tuurun chungin a seh tikah,"},"35":{"text":"ka dawi tawn i ka tuk i a ka chung khan ka chuah tawn; cun a rak ka zuanh a si ahcun a hmurhmul in ka tlaih i ka tuk i ka thah tawn."},"36":{"text":"Na salpa nih hin chiandeih si hna seh, vom si hna seh, ka thah hna; cun hi cuarpartan lomi Filistin mipa hi anmah lak i pakhat cu a si ve lai, Pathian nung ralkapbu hna a zawmhtaih hna caah hin,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Chiandeih tin chung le vom tin chungin a ka chuahtu Bawipa nih hi Filistin mipa kut chung hin a ka chuah ko lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Saul nih David cu, “Va kal law, Bawipa cu na sinah um ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David cu a ralthuam khan a thuamh; dar luchin a lu ah a chinh i thir ngaphaw angki a hruk."},"39":{"text":"Cun David nih cun ralthuam cungah cun a vainam cu aa bei, kal hnik aa zal i a kal kho lo, zeicahtiah cu bantuk cu aa hruk bal hna lo. Cu tikah David nih Saul sinah khan, “Hi hna he hin cun ka kal kho lo, zeicahtiah kaa nek hna lo,” tiah a ti. Cun David nih aa phoih hna."},"40":{"text":"Cun David nih cun a ṭhiangṭhunh kha aa lak i tiva in lung mil tete panga aa thim hna i a tuukhal zal, a saphaw zal ah khan aa sanh hna; a lungherhchehnak cu a kut in aa put i Filistin mipa kha a hei fuh."},"41":{"text":"Cun Filistin mipa kha a ra i David kha a rak naih, a phaw putu a hmai i a ummi he cun."},"42":{"text":"Cun Filistin mipa nih khan a hei zoh i David kha a hmuh tikah, zeite ah a rel lo; zeicahtiah amah cu mi sen tertarte, mi chuak thiam ngai, tlangval kate hi a si."},"43":{"text":"Cun Filistin mipa nih cun David cu, “Uico maw ka si i fung he na ka rathnawh?” tiah a ti. Cun Filistin mipa nih cun a pathian hna kha i chalh in David cu chiat a serh."},"44":{"text":"Filistin mipa nih cun David cu, “Ka sinah ra tuah, na sa kha van i a zuangmi va hna le vawlei i a ummi saram hna ka pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cu tikah David nih cun Filistin mipa cu a thawh i, “Nang nih cun vainam le fei le fei nganpi he na ka chuahhnawh; sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun ralkapbu Bawipa, Israel ralkapbu hna i an Pathian, na zawmhtaihmi min khan kan chuahhnawh."},"46":{"text":"Nihin ni ah hin Bawipa nih nangmah cu keimah kut chungah a ka pek lai i kan thah lai i na lu kan tan lai; cun Filistin ralkapbu chung i a thimi ruak hna cu nihin ah hin van i a zuangmi va hna le vawlei i a ummi sahrang hna sinah ka pek hna lai; zeitintiah vawlei cung dihlak nih Israel mi lakah Pathian a um ti kha an hngalh nakhnga le"},"47":{"text":"hi aa pummi vialte nih hin, vainam le fei in Bawipa khamhnak hi a si lo ti kha an hngalh nakhnga; zeitintiah hi raltuknak cu Bawipa ta a si i nannih cu kan kut chungah pek nan si lai,” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Filistin mipa nih khan David kha tawngh awkah a hun naih tikah, David cu ralkap an i tiannak lei ah khan, Filistin mipa he i ton awkah cun, khulrang in a va tli."},"49":{"text":"Cun David nih a zal kha a vun i purh i lung pakhat kha a vun lak i a herh i a hei chaih i Filistin mipa kha a calpadar ah a khen; lung kha a cal ah cun a pil i a bawktakhup in vawlei ah a tlu."},"50":{"text":"Cuticun David nih Filistin mipa kha, lungherhchehnak le lung pakhat in a tei i, Filistin mipa kha a khen i a thah; David nih nam aa ken lo.","ref":"2Sam 21.19"},"51":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih cun a hei tlikhnawh i Filistin mipa cungah cun a dir i a nam kha a lak i a kawng in a zuh i a thah i nam cun a lu kha a tan. Filistin mi nih an miṭhawng bik kha a thi cang tiah an hmuh tikah an zam.","ref":"1Sam 21.9"},"52":{"text":"Cun Israel mi le Judah mi hna cu an tho i an au i Filistin mi cu Gath le Ekron hauka tiang an dawi hna, cucaah hliammi Filistin mi hna cu Shaaraim in Gath le Ekron tiang lampi ah an ril liangluang ko."},"53":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna cu Filistin mi an dawi hnanak khan an ra kir i an riahhmun kha an rok."},"54":{"text":"Cun David nih Filistin mipa lu kha a lak i Jerusalem ah a ratpi; sihmanhsehlaw a ralthuam cu a thlam chungah khan a chiahtak."},"55":{"text":"Saul nih David kha Filistin mipa va doh awk i a chuah kha a hmuh tikah, a ralkapbu haotu Abner sinah khan, “Abner, hi tlangvalpate hi aho fapa dah a si?” tiah a ti. Cun Abner nih, “Na nunnak chalh in ka chim, maw siangpahrang, kan chim kho lo,” tiah a ti."},"56":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih khan, “Kha tlang valpa kha aho fapa dah a si hlat tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Cun David cu Filistin mipa a thahnak khan a hung kir ah, Abner nih cun a kalpi i a kut i Filistin mipa lu he cun Saul hmaiah a chuahpi."},"58":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sinah, “Aho fapa dah na si, tlangvalpa?” tiah a ti. Cun David nih, “Bethlehem khuami na sal Jesse fapa ka si,” tiah a leh."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul sinah bia kha a chim dih tikah, Jonathan nunnak cu David nunnak ah aa ṭhitchih i Jonathan nih amah nunnak aa dawt tluk khan a dawt.","title":"Jonathan le David Biakamnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun cu ni cun Saul nih khan a lak i a pa inn ah kirter a siang ti lo."},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah Jonathan nih David sinah khan biakamnak a ser, zeitintiah amah nunnak bantukin a dawt."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih aa aihmi puan kha aa phoih i David kha a pek, a ralthuam le a vainam le a likuk le a taisawm zong."},"5":{"text":"Cun David cu Saul nih a kuatnak paoh ah khan a hlawhtling; cucaah Saul nih ralkap hna haotu ah khan a ser. Cun mah hihi mi vialte mithmuh le Saul sinum hna mithmuh zongah khan thil ṭha a si."},"6":{"text":"Inn lei i an tlun lio, David nih Filistin mipa a thahnak in a kir tikah khan, Israel khua vialte in nu hna kha, hlasak pah le lampah in Siangpahrang Saul kha, khuang tete le lawmhnak hla le aw dawh tumnak hna he rak don awkah an chuak.","title":"Saul Nih David A Nahchuah"},"7":{"text":"Cun nu hna cu lawmhnak an tuahpah khan hla in an i chawn i, “Saul nih a thong thong in a thah hna, David nih a sang sang in,” tiah an ti.","ref":"1Sam 21.11; 29.5"},"8":{"text":"Cun Saul cu a thin a hung ngaingai i hi chimnak nih hin a lawmh loter ngaingai; aa thawh i, “David vial cu a sang sang that ah an rel i kei tu cu a thong thong that ceo ah an ka rel; pennak hi dah ti lo cu zeidah cu hleiah a ngeih ding a um ti?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun cu ni thawk in Saul nih David cu a ngiat ziar."},"10":{"text":"Cun a thaizing ah thlarau ṭhalo Pathian sinin a rami kha Saul cungah a tlung i David nih ni khat hnu ni khat a tum tawn bang khan tingtang kha a tum lioah, a inn chungah molh bia kha a chim lengmang ko. Saul nih a fei kha a kut in aa put i"},"11":{"text":"“David kha vampang ah hlinh chih ning,” tiah a ti i fei khan voi hnih a khawh. Sihmanhsehlaw David nih amah kha voi hnih a pianh manh."},"12":{"text":"Saul nih David kha a ṭih; zei-cahtiah amah sinah khan Bawipa a um, sihmanhsehlaw Saul kha cu a chuahtak cang."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih amah sin khan a ṭhial i thong khat haotu ah a ser i mi zapi hmaiah khan a chuak a lut lengmang."},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kha amah sinah a um caah David cu a thil tuahmi vialte ah a hlawhtling."},"15":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a hlawh a tling ngaingai ti kha a hmuh tikah amah kha a zeuh ngaingai."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi vialte le Judah mi vialte nih David kha an duh; zeitintiah amah cu annih hmaiah a chuak a lut lengmangmi a si."},"17":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David cu, “Hika ah hin ka fanu upa deuh Merab a um ko; nupi caah kan pek lai; keimah caah na ral bel ṭha ko law, Bawipa raldohnak cu do ko hna,” tiah a ti. Zeitintiah Saul nih, “Keimah kut cun thi hlah seh, sihmanhsehlaw Filistin mi hna kut tu in thi deuh seh,” tiah a ruah."},"18":{"text":"Cun David nih Saul sinah cun, “Keimah cu ahodah ka si i ka rualchan Israel mi lak i ka pa innchungkhar cu ahodah an si, siangpahrang tupa ka si hnga cu?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul fanu Merab cu David he ṭhitter awk caan ah khan, Meholah mi Adriel sinah nupi caah a pek."},"20":{"text":"Saul fanu Mikhal nih David kha a duh i cucu Saul kha an chimh i cu nih cun a lung a lawmhter."},"21":{"text":"Saul nih, “Amah cu a caah rap a si nakhnga le Filistin mi hna kut cu amah dotu a si nakhnga, amah cu pe ning,” tiah a ruah. Cucaah Saul nih David cu a voi hnihnak a chimh i, “Atu cu ka tupa na si lai,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sinum hna cu, “David sinah a thli tein, ‘Zohhmanh, siangpahrang nih nangmah cungah lawmhnak a ngei i a sinum vialte nih an in dawt; cucaah siangpahrang tupa cu si cang ko,’ tiah nan chim lai,” tiah nawl a pek hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun Saul sinum hna nih hi bia cu David hna theih ah an chim. Cun David nih, “Keimah bantuk misifak le aho zei rel a tong lomi caah hin, siangpahrang tupa si hi thil hmetuai ah dahra nan rel hi?” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun a sinum hna nih khan Saul cu, “David nih, cuti'n, khati'n, a ti,” tiah an chimh."},"25":{"text":"Khi tikah Saul nih, “Hi bangin David sinah cun, ‘Siangpahrang nih, siangpahrang ral hna cungah khan phu a hlam nakhnga, Filistin mi hna cuarpar za khat dah ti lo cu man zei hmanh a duh lo,’ tiah nan chim lai,” tiah a ti. Saul nih David cu Filistin mi hna kut in thihter awk kha a ruah."},"26":{"text":"Cun a sinum hna nih khan amah bia cu David kha an chimh tikah, David cu siangpahrang tupa sinak ding nih khan a lawmhter. A caan kha a luan hlanah,"},"27":{"text":"David cu a mi hna he khan an tho i an kal i Filistin mi kha za hnih an thah hna i David nih an cuarpar cu a rak phorh hna i siangpahrang tupa a si nakhnga, siangpahrang sinah cun tling tein a pek hna. Cun Saul nih a fanu Mikhal cu nupi caah a pek."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul nih Bawipa kha David sinah a um ti le Israel mi vialte nih an duh ti kha a hmuh i a hngalh tikah,"},"29":{"text":"Saul nih cun David kha a ṭih chinchin. Cucaah Saul cu David ral a si zungzal ko."},"30":{"text":"Cun Filistin bawi hna kha raltuknak ah an ra chuak tawn i an ra chuah fate David cu Saul sinum vialte hna nakkhan a hlawhtling deuh; cucaah a min cu an thangṭhat ngaingai ko."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a fapa Jonathan le a sinum vialte hna kha, David kha nan thah lai, tiah a chimh hna. Sihmanhsehlaw Saul fapa Jonathan nih David kha a tlaihchan ngaingai.","title":"Saul Nih David Kha Thah Awkah A Kawl"},"2":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu, “Ka pa Saul nih thah an timh; cucaah zinglei ah cun i ralring tuah, hmun ken fiak ah um law i thup;"},"3":{"text":"cun ka kal lai i na umnak lo lakah khan ka pa pawngah ka dir lai i nangmah kong kha ka pa cu ka ruah lai, cun zeizei ka hngalhmi a um ahcun kan chimh lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih a pa Saul sinah cun David cu a chimthiam i, “Siangpahrang nih a sal David cungah hin sualnak tuah hlah seh, zeicahtiah na cungah a sual lo i a tuahmi cu nangmah caah a ṭhami rian lengmang a si;"},"5":{"text":"thih le thih tiin Filistin mipa kha a tuk i Israel mi vialte caah Bawipa nih teinak nganpi a tuah. Na rak hmuh i na rak i lawm; cucaah cun, zeicahdah, zeiruanglo i David thahnak thawngin zeihmanh a sual lomi thisen cungah sualnak na tuah kun lai?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Jonathan aw cu a zawn i Saul nih, “ Bawipa nih a nun bangin, amah cu thah a si lai lo,” tiah chiat a ser."},"7":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu a kawh i hi thil vialte cu Jonathan nih a hmuhsak. Cun Jonathan nih David cu Saul sinah a ratpi i a hlan bantuk khan a hmaiah a um ṭhan."},"8":{"text":"Cun ral a um ṭhan hoi i Filistin mi he i doh awkah David cu a kal, tampi a thah hna, cucaah a hmai in an zaam."},"9":{"text":"Cun Saul cu a inn chung i fei i put in a ṭhut lioah khan, Bawipa sinin a rami thlarau ṭhalo cu a cungah khan a tlung; cu lioah cun David kha tingtang a tum."},"10":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David cu fei in vampang i hlinh chih ding kha a kawl; sihmanhsehlaw Saul kha a pianh manh, cucaah fei kha vampang ah aa bunh. Cun David cu a zam i a luat."},"11":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun Saul nih David inn ah khan zinglei ah a thah khawh nakhnga amah kha bawh awkah mi a thlah hna. Sihmanhsehlaw David nupi Mikhal nih, “Tuzan ah hin na nunnak naa khamh lo ahcun, thaizing ah cun thah na si lai,” tiah a chimh.","ref":"Slm 59 (A tlangpi)"},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Mikhal nih David cu thlalangawng in a vun thlak i a zam i a luat."},"13":{"text":"Mikhal nih milem pakhat kha a lak i ihkhun chungah cun a chiah i a lu ah meheh hmul chantling a tlinh i puan in a khuh."},"14":{"text":"Saul nih amah kha lak awkah mi a hei thlah hna tikah, “A zaw,” tiah a rak ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David zoh awkah cun mi a hei thlah hna i, “A ihkhun in keimah sinah hun zawn u, ka thah nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun a fialmi hna kha an rung luh tikah, zohhmanh, milem kha, a lu ah meheh hmul chantling i i tlinh in ihkhun cungah khan a rak um ko."},"17":{"text":"Saul nih Mikhal sinah cun, “Zeicahdah hi bantukin na ka hlen i ka ral kha na kalter? Cu ca i amah a rak i zuh diam cang hi,” tiah a ti. Cun Mikhal nih Saul cu a leh i, “Ka kalter tuah, zeicahdah nangmah cu kan thah lai, tiah cun pei a ka ti cu,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun David cu a zam i a luat i Ramah ah Samuel sinah a ra i Saul nih a cung i a tuahmi vialte kha a chimh dih. Cun amah le Samuel cu an kal i Naioth ah an um."},"19":{"text":"Cun Saul cu, “Zohhmanh, David cu Ramah i Naioth ah a um,” tiah an chimh."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah Saul nih David kha lak awkah mi a hei thlah hna; annih nih profet bu cu an holh cukmak len ko le Samuel kha an cungah haotu in a um kha an va hmuh tikah, Saul nih a thlahmi hna cungah khan Pathian thlarau cu a tlung i annih zong an holh cukmak ve."},"21":{"text":"Mah cucu Saul kha an chimh tikah, midang kha a thlah ṭhan hna; cun annih zong cu an holh cukmak ve. Cun Saul nih a voi thumnak ah mi a hei thlah ṭhan hna i annih zong cu an holh cukmak ve ṭhiamṭhiam."},"22":{"text":"Khi tikah amah hrimhrim Ramah ah cun a kal i Seku i a ummi tikhor nganpi kha a phan; cun, “Samuel le David kha khuazei ah dah an um?” tiah a hal hna. Cun pakhat nih, “Zohhmanh, Ramah khua chung i Naioth ah an um,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun khika in Ramah khua chung i Naioth ah cun a va kal i Pathian thlarau kha amah cungah cun a tlung ve i a kalpah cun, Ramah khua chung i Naioth a phak hlantiang a holh cukmak lengmang ko."},"24":{"text":"Cun amah zong cu a hnipuan kha aa phoih ve i Samuel hmaiah khan bia a chim cukmak ve, cun cu ni cu chun nitlak, zan khuadei, pumlawng in a it. Cucaah, “Saul zong profet hna lakah aa tel ve cang dahra?” ti a si lan.","ref":"1Sam 10.11-12"}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi tikah David cu Ramah khua chung i Naioth khan a zam i Jonathan sinah a kal i, “Zeidah ka tuah? Zeidah ka mawhnak a si? Na pa hmaiah zeidah ka sualnak a si i ka nunnak a ka kawl hi?” tiah a ti.","title":"David le Jonathan An I Hawikomhnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “A si hrimhrim lai lo! Na thi lai lo. Zohhmanh, ka pa nih hin thil ngan siseh, thil hme siseh zeihmanh keimah theihter loin a tuah lo; cun zeicahdah mah hi cu ka pa nih ka sinin a thuh lai? A thup hrimhrim lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih a leh i, “Ka cung i dawtnak na ngeih kha na pa nih fiang tein a hngalh i, ‘Jonathan nih mah hi cu thei theng duh hlah seh, a lung lam a fak ai hnga,’ tiin a ruah lai. Sihmanhsehlaw biangai tein, Bawipa a nun bantuk le nangmah nunnak a nun bantukin, keimah le thihnak karlakah hin kar khat lawnglawng a um,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah Jonathan nih David sinah cun, “Na chimmi paoh kan tuahpiak lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"David nih Jonathan cu, “Zohhmanh, thaizing cu thla thar a si i siangpahrang sin i cabuai i ṭhut kha ka tlolh awk a si lo; sihmanhsehlaw a ni thumnak zanlei tiangin lo lakah kaa thuhnak hnga ka kalter tuah.","ref":"Nam 28.11"},"6":{"text":"Cun na pa nih a ka hlam pingpang sual ahcun, nangmah nih, ‘David nih an chungkhar dihlak ca i kum fate an ngeih tawnmi raithawinak kha Bethlehem khua ah a um caah, cu amah khua Bethlehem i va kal ta duak awk kha, hramhram in a ka nawl,’ tiah na ti lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun anih nih, ‘A ṭha!’ a ti ahcun, na salpa caah hin a ṭha lai, sihmanhsehlaw a thin a hun ahcun, khi tikah, ṭhat lonak kha aa ruahchih tiah va hngal ko."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah nih na sal hi nangmah he biakamnak thiang chungah na luhpi cang caah, na sal cungah hin zaangfahnak ngei ko. Sihmanhsehlaw keimah chungah hin mawhnak a um a si ahcun, nangmah nih ka that ko; zeicahtiah, zeicahdah na pa sinah cun na ka kalpi len lai?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih, “Cucu a si naisai lai lo! Nangmah cung i ṭhat lonak tlunter awk kha ka pa nih aa ruahchih ti ka hngalh ahcun, chim loin kan um hnga maw?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun David nih Jonathan sinah cun, “Na pa nih aw hrang in in let seh law, aho nih dah a ka chimh lai?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu, “Ra, lo ah khin va kal u sih,” tiah a ti. Cucaah an pahnih in lo ah cun an va kal."},"12":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu, Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu biahngaltu si ko seh! Thaizing ah maw, a ni thumnak ni ah maw, atu caan hrawngah hin, ka pa cu ka hneksak tuah lai i, zohhmanh, David leiah ruahnak ṭha a ngeih ahcun, khi tikah nangmah sinah mi thlah lo le chimh loin kan um hnga maw?"},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka pa nih nangmah cu harnak pek an duh sual a si ahcun, him tein na kal nakhnga, cucu nangmah sinah ka phuan lo i kan kalter lo a si ahcun, Jonathan cungah Bawipa nih cu bantukin tuah seh law, cu nak tam zongin tuah ko seh. Ka pa sinah Bawipa cu a um tawn bantukin nangmah sinah um ko seh."},"14":{"text":"Ka nun rih a si ahcun, Bawipa, dawtnak zumh awk tlak kha ka cungah langhter tuah, ka thih nakhnga lo;"},"15":{"text":"cun ka innchungkhar hna sinin a zungzal in zumh awk tlak na sinak kha chat hlah. Bawipa nih David ral vialte kha vawlei cungin a hloh dih hna tikah,","ref":"2Sam 9.1"},"16":{"text":"Jonathan min cu David innchungkhar sinin chah si hlah seh. Cun Bawipa nih David ral hna cungah phu hlam ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu amah a dawtnak chalh in chiat a serter ṭhan; zeitintiah amah nunnak aa dawt bantuk te khan a dawt."},"18":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih amah sinah cun, “Thaizing hi thla thar kha a si i kan in hlam ko lai, zeicahtiah na ṭhutnak kha a lawng lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun kiptuh ah cun kan in hlam ngaingai ko lai; khi tikah, kha kong kha a hung chuah tikah, naa thuhnak ah khan na va kal lai i khi lungpumh pinah khin na um lai."},"20":{"text":"Cun hmuichon a kap bantukin kaa umter lai i a sirah cun thal pathum ka hun kah lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, tlangval kha ka hei thlah lai i, ‘Va kal law, thal kha va kawl hna,’ tiah ka ti lai. Cun tlangval sinah khan, ‘Zohhmanh, thal kha nangmah in hi lei kap ah an um, rak la hna,’ ka ti ahcun, na rat awk a si lai, zeitintiah, Bawipa a nun bangin, nangmah caah hnangam a si i ṭih awk a um lo."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangval cu, ‘Zohhmanh, na piin ah thal kha an um,’ ka ti ahcun, na kal diam awk a si lai; zeitintiah Bawipa nih an kalter diam cang."},"23":{"text":"Cun nangmah le keimah nih kan chimmi kongah cun, zohhmanh, Bawipa cu nangmah le keimah karlakah zungzal in a um ko,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah David cu lo lakah khan aa thup; thla thar kha a hung si tikah, siangpahrang cu rawl ei awkah a ṭhu."},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu voi dang tawn bantukin vampang pawng i a ṭhutdan cungah khan a ṭhu; Jonathan cu hmaitonh in a ṭhu, cun Saul sirah khan Abner a ṭhu, sihmanhsehlaw David ṭhutnak kha cu a lawng."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu ni ah cun Saul nih zeihmanh a chim lo; zeitintiah, “Zeithil nih dik a tlunh rua; amah cu a thianglo i a si ko, a thianglo i a si hrimhrim ko lai,” tiah a ruah."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a ni hnihnak ni, thla thar thaizing ah khan, David umnak cu a lawng ṭhiamṭhiam. Cun Saul nih a fapa Jonathan sinah khan, “Zeicahdah Jesse fapa hi nizan he nihin he rawl ei ah a rat lo?” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Jonathan nih Saul cu a leh i, “David nih Bethlehem khua i va kal ta duak awk kha hramhram in a ka nawl i,"},"29":{"text":"‘Ka innchung hna nih khi khua ah raithawinak an tuah i ka u nih khika i um awkah a ka hnek, cucaah ka kalter ko. Cucaah na hmaiah duhdawtnak ka hmuh a si ahcun, ka thlah law, ka ule cu va ka hmuhter tuah hna,’ tiah a ti. Hi ruangah hin siangpahrang cabuai i a rat lonak cu a si,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cu tikah Saul thinhunnak cu Jonathan cungah a alh ciammam i, “Nang, milolak le ralchanh hmangmi nu fapa, nangmah lila ningzahnak caah le na nu pum lawnnak ningzahnak caah, Jesse fapa kha naa thim cang, tiah ka hngal lo mei?"},"31":{"text":"Zeicahtiah, Jesse fapa hi, vawleicung i a nun chung paohpaoh ahcun, nangmah siseh, na pennak siseh, a hmun bal lai lo. Cucaah mi hei thlah hna law, ka sinah ratpi u, zeitintiah a thi hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"“Zeicaahdah a thih lai, zeidah a tuah i?” tiah Jonathan nih a leh."},"33":{"text":"Khi tikah Saul nih cun Jonathan cu a fei in a hei khawh i thah a zalh, cucun Jonathan nih khan a pa i David thah a timh taktak cu fiang tein a hngalh."},"34":{"text":"Cun Jonathan cu thinhung ngaiin cabuai cun a tho i thla ni hnihnak ni ah cun rawl a ei lo; zeitintiah a pa nih David kha thangchiat a phorhter caah David kha a ngaihchiatpi ngaingai."},"35":{"text":"Zinglei ah tlangval note pakhat kha aa kalpi i lo chung i David he an i tiammi hmun ah khan a va kal."},"36":{"text":"Cun a tlangvalpa sinah cun, “Va tli law, ka kahmi thal khi va char hna,” tiah a ti. Cun tlangvalpa cu a tlik lioah khin, thal dang pakhat a pinah khan a hei kah."},"37":{"text":"Cun tlangvalpa cu Jonathan nih a kahmi thal hmun a hei phak tikah khan, Jonathan nih tlangvalpa cu a hei auh i, “Thal kha na pinlei ah a si lo mei?” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih tlangvalpa cu a hei auh i, “Khulrang in i namhnawh, um hlah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Jonathan tlangvalpa nih khan thal kha a char zokzok hna i a bawipa sinah khan a ra."},"39":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangvalpa nih khan zeihmanh a hngal lo; Jonathan le David lawng nih khan thil umtuning cu an hngalh."},"40":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih a hriamnam cu tlangvalpa kha a pek hna i amah cu, “Va tlung law, khua chungah hei phor hna,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Tlangvalpa kha a kal dih cangka, lungpon sir khan David cu a hung chuak i vawlei ah a bawk i voi thum a kun; cun pakhat le pakhat an i hnam i pakhat le pakhat an i ṭah, David kha a zualhma khun."},"42":{"text":"Cun Jonathan nih David cu, “Dai tein va kal ko, zeicahtiah, ‘Keimah le nangmah karah le ka tefa hna le na tefa hna karlak ah, zungzal in, Bawipa cu um ko seh,’ tiin pei Bawipa min in kan pahnih in chiat kan ser ṭi cang kha,” tiah a ti. Cun a tho i a kal; Jonathan cu khua chungah a lut."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David cu Nob khua i tlangbawi Ahimelek sinah khan a ra; cun Ahimelek cu David ton awkah khan ther lengmang in a ra i amah sinah cun, “Zeicahdah nangmah lawng na si, ahohmanh na sinah an i tel lo?” tiah a ti.","title":"David Cu Saul Sinin A Zam","ref":"Mat 12.3-4; Mar 2.25-26; Luk 6.3"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih tlangbawi Ahimelek sinah cun, “Siangpahrang nih rian pakhat a ka fial i, ‘Kan fialmi rian le bia kan beohmi hi ahohmanh nih hngal hna hlah seh,’ tiah a ka ti. Cun cu hmun cu hmun ah kan i tong lai, tiin tlangval hna kha bia ka tiam cang hna."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah atu ah na kut ah zeidah na ngeih? Changreu hlum nga in ka pe tuah, asiloah, hika i a ummi paoh zong,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih khan David cu a leh i, “Changreu sawhsawh cu ka ngei lo, sihmanhsehlaw changreu thiang cu a um; tlangval hna cu nu sinin an i thianhhlimh paoh ahcun,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun David nih tlangbawi kha a leh i, “Rian pakhatkhat ca i ka kal tikah a si tawn bangin, biangaite chim in, nu sinin kan i thianhhlimh ko; khualtlawn sawhsawh tik hmanh ah tlangval hna umkheng hi an thiang tawn ko; nihin ah hin cun zeitluk in dah an umkheng cu a thian chinchin lai?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah tlangbawi nih khan changreu thiang kha a pek; zeitintiah khika ah khan Hunh camcinmi changreu dah ti lo cu changreu dang a um lo, cu changreu cu Bawipa hmai in ṭhial a si ni ah changreu lum in rawlh ṭhan tawnmi a si.","ref":"Lev 24.5-9"},"7":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun, khika ah khan, Saul sinum hna lak i pakhat, Bawipa hmai i taantermi a um; amah a min cu Doeg a si, Edom mi a si i Saul saṭil khaltu hna lak i upa bik a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih Ahimelek cu, “Hika ah hin fei siseh, vainam siseh, na ngei pingpang lo maw? Zeitintiah siangpahrang rian kha khulrang in tuah a herh caah ka vainam siseh, ka hriamnam siseh, kaa lak manh hna lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi nih cun, “Elah nelrawn i na thahmi, Filistin mi Goliath i a nam kha, zohhmanh, tlangbawi angki hnulei ah khin puan in aa zual i a um ko; mah khi naa lak duh ahcun i lak ko, zeicahtiah mah khi lawng khi a um,” tiah a ti. Cun David nih, “A dang khi bantuk khi a um lo, ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sam 17.51"},"10":{"text":"Cun David cu a tho i khi ni ah Saul sinin a zam i Gath siangpahrang Akhish sinah a kal."},"11":{"text":"Cun Akhish sinum hna nih cun a sinah, “Mah hihi an ram siangpahrang David kha a si lo maw? An lam pah in, “Saul nih a thongthong in a thah hna, David nih a sangsang in,” tiin pakhat le pakhat hla an i leh lo maw kha?” tiah an ti.","ref":"1Sam 18.7; 29.5"},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih hi bia cu biatak tein a ruah i Gath siangpahrang Akhish cu a ṭih ngaingai.","ref":"Slm 56 (A tlangpi)"},"13":{"text":"Cucaah an hmaiah a umtu ziaza cu a thlen i an kut chungah cun aa hruhter, kutka innkhar cung hawi hna ah khan zei zei khi dik a ṭial hna i a cil hawi hna kha a khahmul ah khan a luanter.","ref":"Slm 34 (A tlangpi)"},"14":{"text":"Cu tikah Akhish nih a sinum hna cu, “Zohhmanh u, mihrut a si ti nan hngalh ko; a si kun ahcun zeicahdah ka sinah nan ratpi?"},"15":{"text":"Mihrut ka bau hna caah maw hi pa hi ka hmai i mihrut ziaza langhter awkah nan ratpi? Hi pa hi ka inn ah a luh awk a si hnga maw?” tiah a ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David cu cuka cun a chuak i Adullam lungkua ah khan a zam; cun a unau hna le a pa innchungkhar vialte nih an theih tikah, khika ah amah sinah cun an vung kal.","ref":"Slm 57 (A tlangpi); Slm 142 (A tlangpi)"},"2":{"text":"Cun harnak a tongmi paoh le leiba a ngeimi paoh le a lung a tling lomi paoh nih khan amah cu an fuh; cun annih hna haotu ah a cang. Cun amah sinah cun mi za li tluk an um."},"3":{"text":"Cun David cu khika in Moab ram Mizpah khua ah a kal; cun Moab siangpahrang sinah cun, “Ka pa le ka nu cu, Pathian nih keimah caah zeidah a tuah lai, ti kha ka hngalh hlantiang, na sinah um hna seh, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Moab siangpahrang sinah cun a chiahtak hna i David cu ralhruang chung i a um chung vialte, a sinah cun an rak um."},"5":{"text":"Cun profet Gad nih David cu, “Ralhruang chungah um ti hlah, va kal law, Judah ram chungah va lut tuah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David cu a kal i Hereth tupi chungah khan a lut."},"6":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, David le a sin i a ummi hna kha an hmuh hna, ti kha a theih. Saul cu Gibeah ah, tlang bo pakhat ah, tamarisk thingkung toiah, a fei i put in a ṭhu i a sinum vialte hna cu a velchum in an dir.","title":"Saul Nih Nob Khua Tlangbawi A Thah Hna"},"7":{"text":"Cun a velchum i a dirmi a sinum hna sinah cun Saul nih a thawh i, “Nannih Benjamin mi hna, thei tuah u; Jesse fapa nih cun nan dihlak te hin maw lo le mitsur dum an pek cio hna lai i a thongthong haotu ah le a zaza haotu ah an ser cio hna lai,"},"8":{"text":"nannih i nan dihlak in nan ka rawiphiar len ko hi? Ka fapa nih Jesse fapa he ṭanṭinak a tuah tikah, ahohmanh nih ka sinah nan phuang lo i ka fapa nih ka sinum kha nihin ah a si bantuk hin, keimah doh awk le keimah bawh awkah a forh tikah, keimah a ka ngaihchiatpitu pakhat hmanh nan um lo i a phuan zong keimah sinah ahohmanh nih nan phuang fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cu tikah Edom mi Doeg, Saul sinum hna pawng i a dirmi nih khan a hun leh i, “Jesse fapa cu Nob ah, Ahitub fapa Ahimelek sinah a rat kha ka hmuh i,","ref":"1Sam 21.7-9; Slm 52 (A tlangpi)"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa kha a halpiak i rawl kha a pek i Filistin mi Goliath nam kha a pek,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah siangpahrang nih Ahitub fapa tlangbawi Ahimelek le a pa innchungkhar vialte, Nob ah a ummi tlangbawi hna cu auh awkah mi a thlah hna; cun an dihlak in siangpahrang sinah khan an ra."},"12":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “Ahitub fapa, thei tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Hika ah ka um, ka bawipa,” tiah a leh."},"13":{"text":"Cun Saul nih amah cu, “Zeicahdah nannih nih nan ka rawiphiar, nangmah le Jesse fapa nih hin, nangmah nih changreu le nam kha na pek i Pathian sin hawi ah na hei halpiak, cucaah cun amah nih keimah cu doh awk le bawh awkah, nihin ah a si bang hin a tho,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Ahimelek nih siangpahrang cu a leh i, “A si ah, na sinum vialte lakah, siangpahrang tupa a simi, nangmah pum rungvengtu hna haotu, na inn chungah upat a simi David tluk in, ahodah zumh awk tlak a um?"},"15":{"text":"Nihin hi maw amah caah Pathian ka chawnh hmasa bik a si? Si hlah! Siangpahrang nih na sal cungah hin siseh, ka pa innchungkhar vialte cungah hin siseh, zeihmanh khing sawh hlah seh; zeicahtiah na sal nih hin hi kong vialte hi zeihmanh ka hngal lo, a tam siseh, a tlawm siseh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih, “Na thi hrimhrim lai, Ahimelek, nangmah le na pa innchungkhar vialte,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih a pawng i a dirmi ralvengtu sinah khan, “I mer law, Bawipa tlangbawi kha that hna; annih zong David sin i an i ṭom caah a zam kha an hngal nain ka sinah an phuang lo,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang sinum hna nih khan Bawipa tlangbawi hna thah awkah khan an kut an chuah duh lo."},"18":{"text":"Cu tikah siangpahrang nih Doeg kha, “Nangmah kha i mer law, tlangbawi kha that hna,” tiah a ti. Cun Edom mi Doeg cu aa mer i tlangbawi kha a thah hna; cun khi ni ah la hmang ṭhia tlangbawi angki aa hrukmi mi sawm riat le panga a thah hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi khua Nob kha vainam in a tuk; pa he nu he ngakchia he hnuktlai lio he, cawtum he laa he tuu he, vainam in a sam hna."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ahitub fapa Ahimelek i fapa hna lakah khan pakhat, a min Abiathar a simi cu a luat i David sinah khan a zaam."},"21":{"text":"Cun David kha Abiathar nih cun, Saul nih Bawipa tlangbawi kha a thah hna, tiah a chimh."},"22":{"text":"Cun David nih Abiathar sinah cun, “Kha ni ah khan, Edom mi Doeg a um ve tikah khan, Saul a chimh ṭheo lai, tiah ka hngalh cia ko. Na pa innchungkhar chung mi vialte cu keimah nih ka thihter hna a si ko."},"23":{"text":"Ka sinah um ko, ṭih hlah; zeicahtiah ka nunnak a ka kawlmi cu nangmah nunnak an kawlmi a si ve ko; keimah sinah cun na him ko lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David cu, “Zohhmanh, Keilah kha Filistin mi nih an tuk i phuhri i rawl kha an chuh hna,” tiah an chimh.","title":"David Ramlak Ah Aa Thup"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Bawipa cu a hal i, “Hi Filistin mi hna hi ka va kal in ka va tu hna lai maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih David cu, “Va kal law, Filistin mi kha va tu hna law, Keilah kha va khamh tuah,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David cu a mi hna nih, “Zohhmanh, hika Judah ram chung hmanh ah kan ning a ṭi; Keilah khua i vung kal i Filistin ralkapbu hna vung tuk cu zeitluk in dah kan ṭih chinchin lai?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun David nih Bawipa cu a hal ṭhan. Cun Bawipa nih a leh i, “Tho law, Keilah ah cun vung kal ko; zeitintiah Filistin mi hna cu na kut chungah kan pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun David le a mi hna cu Keilah ah cun an kal i Filistin mi hna he cun an i tu, cun an saṭil hna kha an lakpiak hna i annih kha tampi an thah hna. Cuticun David nih Keilah khuami hna cu a luatter hna."},"6":{"text":"Ahimelek fapa Abiathar nih David sinah, Keilah i a zam tikah khan, tlangbawi angki pakhat he a rung."},"7":{"text":"Cun Saul kha, David cu Keilah ah a ra cang, tiah an chimh. Cun Saul nih, ‘Amah cu keimah kut chungah Pathian nih a ka pek cang; zeitintiah kutka le hrenhnak a ngeimi khua ah a luhnak thawngin, amah le amah aa hrenh khumh cang,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Saul nih mi vialte kha, Keilah i vung kal i David le a mi hna kha vung kulh awkah, raldoh awkah a auh hna."},"9":{"text":"David nih Saul nih ka cungah ṭhat lonak kha tuah awkah khua a khaan ti kha a hngalh; cun tlangbawi Abiathar sinah khan, “Hika ah hin tlangbawi angki kha rak pu tuah,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, Saul nih Keilah ah rat i khua kha keimah ruang i hrawh aa tim ti kha na sal nih ka theih hrimhrim ko."},"11":{"text":"Keilah mi nih hin keimah cu amah kut chungah an ka pe lai maw? Na sal nih ka theih bang hin Saul cu a rung hnga maw? Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, na sal hi ka chim tuah, tiah kan nawl” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “A rung lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Keilah khuami nih hin keimah le ka mi hna hi Saul kut chungah an kan pe lai maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih, “An in pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun David le a mi za ruk tluk a simi hna cu an tho i Keilah khan an chuak i an kal khawhnak paoh ah an kal. David cu Keilah khua in a chuak cang ti kha Saul cu an chimh tikah va tuk awk kha aa ṭhul."},"14":{"text":"Cun David cu ramlak i ralhruang chungah khan a um, Zif Ramlak tlangram ah khan. Cun Saul nih ni fate in a kawl, sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih amah kha a kut chungah a pe lo."},"15":{"text":"Saul nih amah kha thah awkah a kawl caah David kha a thin a phang. David cu Zif Ramlak chung Horesh ah a um."},"16":{"text":"Cun Saul fapa Jonathan kha a tho i David sinah Horesh ah khan a kal i amah kha Pathian ah a kut a fehter."},"17":{"text":"Cun amah kha, “Na thinphang hlah; zeitintiah ka pa Saul kut nih nangmah cu an hmu bal lai lo; nangmah cu Israel siangpahrang na si lai i keimah cu an changtu ka si lai; ka pa Saul zong nih mah hi a hngalh ko,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun an pahnih in Bawipa hmaiah biakamnak an ser; David cu Horesh ah khan a rung um i Jonathan cu inn ah a tlung.","ref":"1Sam 18.3"},"19":{"text":"Cun Zif mi hna cu Gibeah ah Saul sinah an va kal i, “David cu kanmah lakah, Horesh ralhau chungah, Jeshimon thlanglei i a ummi Hakhilah tlang cungah, aa thup ko lo maw?","ref":"Slm 54 (A tlangpi)"},"20":{"text":"Cucaah maw siangpahrang, run kha na lung sa duh thah a sining te khan rung tuah; cun kannih kan rak tuah ve awk cu amah kha siangpahrang kut chung i pek kha a si ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun Saul nih, “ Bawipa nih thluachuah in pe ko hna seh; zeitintiah keimah cungah zaangfahnak nan ngei."},"22":{"text":"Va kal rih u law, va fiang chin rih tuah u, a um kalnak le khika ah aho nih dah a hmuh ti kha va hngal u law va zoh u, zeitintiah amah cu a zer ngai, tiah an ka chimh."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah cun, aa thuhnak hmun vialte kha vaa chingchiah u law, ka sinah a dik hrimhrimmi theihnak he ra ṭhan u. Khi tikah nannih sinah ka kal lai i hi ram chungah a um paohpaoh ahcun, Judah mi a thongthong vialte hna lakah hin, amah cu ka kawl lai,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun an tho i Saul hmaiah, Zif ah khan an kal. David le a mi hna cu Jeshimon in thlanglei, Arabah ram chung i Maon ramlak ah khan an um."},"25":{"text":"Cun Saul le a mi hna cu amah kawl awkah khan an kal. Cun David cu an chimh; cucaah Maon ramlak i a ummi lungpi ah khan a vung kal. Cun mah cucu Saul nih a theih tikah, Maon ramlak ah cun David kha a dawi lengmang."},"26":{"text":"Saul cu tlang khattelei kam khan a kal i David le a mi hna cu tlang khattelei kam khan an kal, cun Saul le a mi hna nih khan David le a mi hna kha tlaih awkah an naih chin lengmang hna caah David cu Saul sin khan khulrang in a zam;"},"27":{"text":"khi tikah khan lamkaltu pakhat cu Saul sinah khan a ra i, “Khulrang in ra tuah, zeicahtiah ram kha Filistin mi nih an chim,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Saul nih David dawi kha a kirtak i Filistin mi kha a doh hna; cucaah cuka hmun cu Luatnak Lungpi tiah kawh a si."},"29":{"text":"Cun David cu cuka cun a hung kal i Engedi ralhruang chungah khan aa thup."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul cu Filistin mi a dawi hnanak khan a kir tikah, “Zohhmanh, David cu Engedi ramlak ah a um,” tiah an chimh.","title":"David Nih Saul Kha A Zuah"},"2":{"text":"Khi tikah Saul nih Israel mi lakin thimmi mi thong thum a lak hna i Sathar Lungpang timi hmaiah khan David le a mi hna kawl awkah cun a kal."},"3":{"text":"Cun lam pawng i tuu kiam hna cu a hei phan i cuka ah cun lungkua pakhat a rak um i Saul cu zun awkah a va lut. David le a mi hna cu lungkua a chung bik ah cun an ṭhu ko.","ref":"Slm 57 (A tlangpi); Slm 142 (A tlangpi)"},"4":{"text":"Cun David cu a mi hna nih khan, “Zohhmanh, na ral cu na kut chungah kan pek lai i nangmah nih a ṭha na tining paoh in a cungah na tuah lai, tiah Bawipa nih an timi ni kha mah hihi a si cang,” tiah an ti. Cun David cu a tho i a thlite in Saul puanki par kha a va hleh."},"5":{"text":"Cun a hnuah cun Saul puanki par a va hleh caah khan David cu lung sivang in a um."},"6":{"text":"A mi hna sinah khan, “Amah cu Bawipa chiti thuhmi kha a si caah, amah cung i ka kut samh awkin, Bawipa chiti thuhmi ka bawipa cungah hi thil ka tuahmi hi Bawipa nih ka thlauh ko seh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sam 26.11"},"7":{"text":"Cuticun hi bia hin David nih a mi hna kha a lem khawh hna i Saul tuk kha a onh hna lo. Cun Saul cu a tho i lungkua khan a chuak i a kal."},"8":{"text":"A hnuah David zong cu a tho i lungkua chung khan a chuak i Saul kha, “Siangpahrang ka bawipa!” ti in a hei auh. Cun Saul nih a hnulei kha a hei zoh tikah David nih vawlei lei hoih in a kun i upatnak kha a tuah."},"9":{"text":"Cun David nih Saul cu, “Zeicahdah, ‘Zohhmanh, David nih nangmah fahnak kha a kawl,’ tiin an timi hna bia kha na ngaih?"},"10":{"text":"Zohhmanh, zeitintiah Bawipa nih nangmah cu nihin ah, lungkua ah khan, keimah kut chung i an pek kha, nangmah mit nih nihin hrimhrim ah a hmuh cang; mi cheu nih cun nangmah thah awk kha an ka fial, sihmanhsehlaw keimah nih kan zuah. ‘Ka bawipa cu Bawipa chiti thuhmi a si caah a cungah ka kut ka samh lai lo,’ tiah ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Zohhmanh, ka pa, ka kut chung i na puanki par hi zohhmanh; na puanki par ka hlep nain nangmah kan thah lonak ah hin, ka kut chungah ṭhat lonak siseh, rawinak siseh, a um lo ti kha na hngalh lai i na hmuh ko lai. Nangmah nih ka nunnak kha lak awkah na kawl lengmang nain, na cungah ka sual lo."},"12":{"text":"Keimah le nangmah karlakah Bawipa nih bia kan ceih ko seh, Bawipa nih nangmah cungah phu ka hlampiak ko seh; sihmanhsehlaw ka kut nih cun an tu lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Hlanlio mi hna phungthluk ah, ‘Miṭhalo chungin ṭhat lonak a chuak,’ ti a si; sihmanhsehlaw ka kut nih cun an tu lai lo."},"14":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang nih hin ahodah a chuahhnawh? Ahodah na dawimi hi a si? Ui thi cia! Uihli a si ko!","ref":"1Sam 26.20"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu biaceihtu si seh law, nangmah le keimah karlak bia hi chat seh, ka zohpiak seh law ka bia hi ka chimpiak seh law, nangmah kut chung hin ka chuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Hi bia cu David nih a chim dih hna tikah Saul nih, “Mah hihi nangmah aw a si maw, ka fapa David?” tiah a ti. Cun Saul cu thangpi in a ṭap."},"17":{"text":"David sinah cun, “Nangmah cu keimah nakin na ding deuh, zeitintiah kei nih chiatnak in kan cham zongah nang nih cun ṭhatnak in na ka cham."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih keimah cu nangmah kut chung i a ka chiah tik i na ka thah lo caah hin, ka cung i zaangfahnak na tuahmi kha nihin ah hin na langhter."},"19":{"text":"Zeitintiah mipa nih a ral kha a hmuh ahcun, him tein a kalter ko hnga maw? Cucaah nihin i ka cung i na tuahmi caah hin Bawipa nih ṭhatnak in in lehrul ko seh."},"20":{"text":"Cun atu cu, zohhmanh, nangmah cu siangpahrang na si hrimhrim lai i Israel pennak cu nangmah kut ah fehter a si lai, ti kha ka hngalh."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah, keimah hnuah ka tefa hna cu na hloh hna nakhnga lo le ka min cu ka pa innchungkhar chungin na hrawh nakhnga lo, Bawipa min in ka sinah chiat ser tuah,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun David nih mah cucu Saul sinah chiat in a ser. Khi tikah Saul cu a inn ah a tlung, sihmanhsehlaw David le a mi hna cu ralhau chungah khan an hung kal."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Samuel kha a thi i Israel mi vialte nih an i pum i an ṭah i Ramah khua i a inn ah khan an vui. Khi tikah David cu a tho i Paran ramlak ah khan a vung kal.","title":"David le Abigail Kong"},"2":{"text":"Cun Maon ah khan mipa pakhat a um i a rian ṭuannak cu Karmel ah a si. Cu pa cu a rum ngaingai; tuu thong thum le meheh thong khat a ngei Amah cu Karmel ah khan a tuu hmul a met hna."},"3":{"text":"Cu pa a min cu Nabal a si i a nupi min cu Abigal a si. Minu cu a fimmi le aa dawhmi a si, sihmanhsehlaw mipa cu mikhepkha le ziaza ṭhalo a si; amah cu Kaleb mi a si."},"4":{"text":"David nih ramlak ah cun, Nabal nih a tuu hmul kha a meh hna tiah a theih."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah David nih tlangval pahra a thlah hna i David nih tlangval hna sinah cun, “Karmel ah hung kal u law, cun Nabal kha va tong u law, ka min in biakchawnhnak pe u."},"6":{"text":"Cun hi bangin amah cu, ‘Nangmah cungah daihnak um ko seh, cun na innchungkhar cungah daihnak um seh law, na ngeihmi vialte cungah daihnak um ko seh."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah nih tuu hmul mettu na ngei hna ti kha ka theih; cun na tuukhal hna cu kan sinah an um i an cungah harnak zeihmanh kan tuah lo i Karmel i an um chung vialte zeihmanh an thlau lo."},"8":{"text":"Na tlangval kha hal hna law an in chimh ko lai. Cucaah puai ni i kan rat caah hin ka tlangval hna hi na hmaiah mithmai ṭha hmuhter ko hna. Na sal hna le na fapa David hi na ngeihmi paoh rak kan pe ko sawh, a ti,’ tiah nan va ti lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"David tlangval hna cu an rat tikah hi vialte cu David min in Nabal kha an chimh; cun annih nih an ngan."},"10":{"text":"Cun Nabal nih David sinum hna cu a leh hna i, “David cu ahodah a si? Jesse fapa cu ahodah a si? Atu caan lioah hin an bawile sinin a zammi sal tampi an um."},"11":{"text":"Ka tuu hmul mettu hna caah ka thahmi sa le ka changreu le ka ti kha i lak in khuazei in an ra ti ka hngalh lomi minung kha ka pek hna lai maw?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah David tlangval hna cu an i let i an kir i hi vialte kha an chimh dih."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih a mi hna cu, “Nan vainam i thlaih dih uh,” tiah a ti hna.
