Cun an dihlak in an vainam cu an i thlaih; David zong nih a vainam cu aa thlaih ve; cun David cu za li tluk nih an hun zulh i za hnih nih an thil kha an rak hngah."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nabal sinum hna lak i pakhat nih Nabal nupi Abigail kha a va chimh i, “Zohhmanh, David nih kan bawipa kha biakchawnh awkah ramlak in mi a rak thlah hna i annih cu a rak sik hna."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi hna cu kan cungah an rak ṭha ngaingai ṭung i harnak zeihmanh kan ing lo i lo chung i kan um lio zongah zeihmanh kan thlawtthlau hna lo, anmah sin i kan kal chung paohpaoh cu;"},"16":{"text":"annih cu an sin i tuu cawng in kan um chung vialte zan ah siseh, chun ah siseh, kan caah hauhruang an si."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah mah hihi hngal law zeidah ka tuah lai ti kha i ruat tuah; zeitintiah kan bawipa le a innchungkhar vialte cung i ṭhat lonak tuah kha timh a si cang, amah hi ahohmanh nih chawnh khawh loin michiakha a si fawn ṭung,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Khi tikah Abigail cu aa namhnawh i changreu hlum za hnih le mitsur hang cua hnih le chumh awk i can ciami tuu panga le vaireu rel nga le mitsur bor za khat le theipi hlum za hnih, aa lak hna i laa cungah a chuan hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun a tlangval hna cu a thawh hna i, “Ka hmaiah rak kal u, zohhmanh u, nan hnu in kan zulh hna lai,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a va Nabal kha a chim lo."},"20":{"text":"Cun laa kha aa cit i tlang phen i a vung zuan lioah khan, zohhmanh, David le a mi hna cu amah leiah khan an rung i a ton hna."},"21":{"text":"Cun David nih khan, “Hi pa i a ngeihmi thil vialte hi pakpalawng ah dah mu ramlak ah ka hei congh tawn i a ngeihmi vialte cu pakhat hmanh tlau loin a hei um; anih nih ṭhatnak cu chiatnak in a ka rulh;"},"22":{"text":"thaizing tiang amah ta a simi a pa pakhat zong ka nganh a si ahcun, hi bantukin Pathian nih David cungah tuah seh law, hi nak tam deuh zongin tuah ko seh,” tiah a rak ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Abigail nih David kha a hmuh tikah aa hnawchan i a laa khan a ṭum i David hmaiah a kun i a lu kha a khun."},"24":{"text":"A ke hramah khan a bawk i, “Keimah cung lawnglawng ah hin, ka bawipa, mawhnak kha um ko seh; na salnu hi na hna theih ah bia chimter ko law, na salnu bia hi ka ngaihpiak ko sawh."},"25":{"text":"Ka bawipa nih hi michiakha, Nabal hi zei ah relpiak loin um ko seh, zeitintiah a min bantukte hi amah cu a si ko; Nabal a min a si bang, mihrut a si ko; sihmanhsehlaw ka bawipa nangmah na tlangval na rak thlahmi hna cu keimah na salnu nih hin ka rak hmu hna lo."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka bawipa, Bawipa a nun bantuk le na nunnak a nun bantukin, thisen chuah mawhnak le nangmah nih na kut hrimhrim in phuhlam tuahnak kha Bawipa nih tuah loin an umter caah, na ral hna le ka bawipa cungah ṭhat lonak tuah awk a kawlmi hna cu Nabal bantuk si ko hna seh."},"27":{"text":"Cun na sal nih ka bawipa sinah ka rak putmi laksawng hi ka bawipa zultu tlangval hna cu pek si hna seh."},"28":{"text":"Na salnu ka sualnak cu ka ngaithiam ko sawh; zeitintiah ka bawipa nih Bawipa raltuknak kha a tuk caah Bawipa nih ka bawipa cu a fekmi inn a serpiak ṭheo lai i na nun chung paohpaoh nangmah chungah ṭhat lonak hmuh awk a um lai lo."},"29":{"text":"Mi nih nangmah kha dawi awk le na nunnak kha kawl awkah an in thawhhnawh ahcun, ka bawipa nunnak cu Bawipa na Pathian zohkhenhnak chung i a ummi minung hna nunnak tom chungah khan tom chih a si lai; cun na ral hna nunnak tu cu lungherhchehnak ṭe karlak chung in cheh bantukin a cheh hlo hna lai."},"30":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih ka bawipa cungah nangmah kong i a chimmi ṭhatnak vialte kha a tuah dih tikah le Israel cungah bawi i an chiah tikah,"},"31":{"text":"zei ruang lo i thisen chuahnak kongah siseh, mah theng nih phu va hlamnak kongah siseh, ka bawipa nih zeihmanh na tuah lo caah, ngaihchiattertu phuhrunnak zeihmanh na ngei lai lo. Cun Bawipa nih ka bawipa hi ṭha tein an ti tikah, na salnu hi ka philh te hlah,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cun David nih Abigail cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa, Israel Pathian, nihin i keimah ton awkah nangmah an thlahtu hi thangṭhat si ko seh!"},"33":{"text":"Na fimnak hi thluachuah hmu seh law, nihin ah thisen chuah mawhnak le keimah nih keimah kut hrimhrim in phu i hlamnak tuahnak in a ka khamtu nangmah cu thluachuahnak hmu ko!"},"34":{"text":"Zeitintiah nangmah kha fahnak peknak in a ka khamtu Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih a nun hrimhrim bantukin, keimah ton awkah khan khulrang in rak ra hlah law, thaizing zingka ah cun Nabal caah hin pa pakhat hmanh an tang ti hnga lo,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun David nih amah kut khan amah ca i a rak putmi kha a cohlan i anih cu, “Na inn ah dai tein hung kal ko; zohhmanh, na aw kha kan ngaihpiak i na ka halmi kha kan pek,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun Abigail cu Nabal sin kha a phan; cun zohhmanh, a inn ah khan siangpahrang puai bantuk puai pakhat a rak tuah. Cun Nabal cu a rak i lawm cuahmah ko, zeicahtiah a ri ngaingai ko; cucaah zinglei khuaceu hlanah cun zeihmanh a chim lo."},"37":{"text":"Cun zinglei ah, Nabal cu a zu ritnak in a fim tikah khan, hi thil hna cu a nupi nih khan a chimh i a lung cu a chungah a thi i amah cu lung bantuk ah a cang."},"38":{"text":"Cun ni hra tluk hnuah Bawipa nih Nabal cu a tuk i a thi."},"39":{"text":"David nih Nabal kha a thi tiah a theih tikah, “Nabal kut ah ningzahnak ka hmuhmi phu a hlam i a sal kha ṭhat lonak tuah loin a ka khamtu Bawipa cu thangṭhat si ko seh; Bawipa nih Nabal cu ṭhat lonak a tuahmi kha amah lu cung lila ah a tlunter ṭhan,” tiah a ti. Cun David nih mi a hei thlah hna i Abigail kha a nupi caah an len."},"40":{"text":"Cun David sinum hna cu Karmel tlang ah, Abigail sinah an phak tikah annih nih amah kha, “David nih nangmah cu a nupi si awk i va lak awkah nangmah sinah a kan thlah,” tiah an chimh."},"41":{"text":"Cun a tho i vawlei lei zoh in a kun i, “Zohhmanh u, nan salnu hi ka bawipa i a sinum hna ke ṭawltu salnu a si ko,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cun Abigail cu khulrang in a tho i laa cungah aa cuan i a sinum nu panga nih khan an tuammuai. David lamkal hna kha a zulh hna i a nupi ah a cang."},"43":{"text":"David nih Jezreel khuami Ahinoam zong kha a lak i an pahnih in a nupi ah an cang."},"44":{"text":"Saul nih a fanu Mikhal, David nupi kha, Gallim khuami Laish fapa Palti kha a rak pek cang.","ref":"2Sam 3.14-16"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Zif khuami hna cu Saul sinah Gibeah ah an ra i, “Jeshimon nichuahlei ah a ummi Hakhilah tlang ah David cu aa thup ko lo maw?” tiah an chimh.","title":"David Nih Saul Kha Zif Ah A Zuah","ref":"Slm 54 (A tlangpi)"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah Saul cu a tho i Zif ramlak ah khan, Israel mi chungin thimmi thong thum he tiah, Zif ramlak i David kha kawl awkah a vung kal."},"3":{"text":"Cun Saul cu Jeshimon in nichuahlei ah a ummi lam pawng i Hakhilah tlang ah khan a riak. Sihmanhsehlaw David cu ramlak ah khan a um ko; cun Saul nih ramlak ah a ka dawi ti kha a hngalh tikah,"},"4":{"text":"David nih ngiatu a thlah hna i Saul cu a ra taktak ko, ti kha a hngalh."},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah David cu a tho i Saul riahnak hmun ah khan a ra; cun David nih Saul cu a ralkapbu haotu Abner, Ner fapa, he khan khuazei ah dah an ih ti kha a hmuh; Saul cu an riahhmun chungah cun a it i ralkapbu nih a velchum in an riahhnawh."},"6":{"text":"Cun David nih Hit mi Ahimelek le Joab unau Abishai, Zeruiah fapa, sinah khan, “Ahodah riahhmun chungah khin, Saul sinah khin, a vun ka zul lai?” tiah a ti. Cun Abishai nih, “Keimah nih kan zulh lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah David le Abishai cu ralkapbu chung cun zan ah khan an lut; cun khika ah khan Saul cu riahhmun chungah a rak it ko i a fei cu a lu hramah, vawlei ah a rak i bunh ko; cun Abner le ralkapbu hna cu a velchum in an it."},"8":{"text":"Khi tikah Abishai nih David cu, “Pathian nih nihin ah hin na ral cu na kut chungah an pek ko; cucaah fei in voi khat chunhte ah amah hi vawlei ah bunh chih ko ning, voi hnih ka chun lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih Abishai cu, “Amah kha hrawk hlah; zeitintiah ahodah Bawipa chiti thuhmi cungah a kut a samh i mawh lo in a um kho lai?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun David nih, “ Bawipa nih a nun bangin, Bawipa nih a thah te ko lai; a si lo ah a thih ni cu a phan te ko lai; a si lo ah raltuknak hmun ah a kal lai i a lo tlau te ko lai."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa chiti thuhmi cung i ka kut samh awk cu Bawipa nih ka kham ko seh; sihmanhsehlaw a lu hram i a ummi fei kha le hranthawl kha la law kal u sih,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sam 24.6"},"12":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Saul lu hram khan fei le hranthawl kha a lak hna i an kal. Ahohmanh nih cucu an hmu lo, a hngalh zong an hngal lo, ahohmanh zong an i hlau lo zeitintiah Bawipa sinin mitkuh thut kha an cungah a tlung i an i hngilh dih."},"13":{"text":"Cun David cu ralchan ah khan a va kal i lam hlatpi ah tlang cungah khan a dir i an karlak cu aa hlat ngaingai;"},"14":{"text":"cun David nih ralkapbu kha le Ner fapa Abner kha a hei auh hna i, “Abner, na ka let lai lo maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Abner nih, “Ahodah na si, siangpahrang a autu cu?” tiah a leh."},"15":{"text":"Cun David nih Abner cu, “Pa na si lo maw? Nangmah bantuk ahodah Israel mi lakah a um? A si kun ahcun zeicahdah siangpahrang na bawipa cu na kilven kun lo? Zeicahtiah mi pakhat nih siangpahrang na bawipa kha thah awkah a rak luhhnawh ṭung?"},"16":{"text":"Hi thil na tuahmi hi a ṭha lo. Bawipa a nun bangin, nang cu thih awk na tlak, zeicahtiah Bawipa chiti thuhmi, na bawipa kha na kilveng lo. Siangpahrang lu hram i fei le hranthawl a ummi kha khuazei ah dah an um cang, hun zoh tuah ngat,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Saul nih David cu a hngalh i, “Mah cucu nangmah aw a si maw, David ka fapa?” tiah a ti. Cun David nih, “Keimah aw a si, ka bawipa, maw siangpahrang,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Zeicahdah ka bawipa nih hin a salpa hi a dawi lengmang ko hnga? Zeidah ka tuahmi a um? Zei mawhnak dah ka kut chungah a um?"},"19":{"text":"Cucaah ka bawipa siangpahrang nih hin a salpa ka bia hi ka ngaihpiak tuah seh. Keimah doh awkah an forhtu hi Bawipa a si ahcun, pekchanhnak hi cohlang ko seh; sihmanhsehlaw minung an si ahcun, BAWIPA hmaiah chiat si ko hna seh, zeitintiah annih nih nihin ah hin Bawipa ro chungah covo ka ngeih nakhnga lo an ka dawi i, ‘Va kal law, pathian dang kha va bia hna,’ an ka ti."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka thisen hi Bawipa hmuhphak lonak vawlei ah luang hlah seh; zeitintiah vaking kah awkah tlang cungah ram a vaimi bantukin Israel siangpahrang nih ka nunnak kha hloh awkah a ra chuak cang,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Khi tikah Saul nih, “Ka palh cang, ra kir tuah, ka fapa David, ka nunnak cu na mit ah nihin ah hin a sun caah na cungah harnak ka tuah ti lai lo; zohhmanh, ka rak hrut hrimhrim ko i fak piin ka palh cang,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun David nih a leh i, “Maw siangpahrang, hika ah hin fei kha a um ko! Tlangval pakhat in rak thlah law ra la seh."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih mi zeipaoh kha a dinnak ca le zumhawktlak a sinak caah laksawng a pek cio hna; zeitintiah Bawipa nih nangmah cu nihin ah ka kut chungah an pek, asinain Bawipa chiti thuhmi cungah khan ka kut ka samh duh lo."},"24":{"text":"Zohhmanh, nangmah nunnak cu keimah mit ah nihin ah a sun bantukin ka nunnak cu Bawipa mit ah sung ve seh law, temhinnak vialte chungin ka chuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Saul nih David sinah khan, “Ka fapa David, nangmah cu thluachuahnak hmu ko! Thil tampi na tuah lai i cu thil hna ah cun na hlawh a tling lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David cu amah lam ah khan a kal i Saul cu amah hmun leiah khan a kir ṭhan."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David nih a lung chungin, “Ni khatkhat cu Saul kut hin ka thi te lai; Filistin mi hna ram i ka va zam nakin a ṭha deuhmi thil ka caah a um ti lo; khi tikah Saul cu Israel ram chung i keimah kawl kha a lung a dong lai i a kut chungin ka luat lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Cu Filistin Mi Sinah A Um"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah David cu a tho i amah le a sinah a ummi mi za ruk hna cu Maok fapa Akhish, Gath siangpahrang sinah khan an kal."},"3":{"text":"Cun David cu amah le a mi hna he, mi kip nih an innchungkhar cio he, cun David zong cu a nupi pahnih, Jezreel khuami Ahinoam le Karmel i a rak ummi Nabal nupi ro Abigail hna he khan, Akhish sinah, Gath ah khan an um."},"4":{"text":"Cun Saul kha, David cu Gath ah a zam cang, tiah an chimh tikah, amah cu a kawl ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih Akhish sinah khan, “Na mit ah mithmai ṭha ka hmuh a si ahcun, ram chung khuate pakhatkhat ah, khika ah ka um nakhnga, hmun pakhat ka pe tuah; zeitintiah zeicahdah na sal cu siangpahrang khua ah nangmah sinah ka um rua hnga?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah khi ni ah Akhish nih Ziklag khua kha a pek; cucaah pei nihin tiang hin Ziklag khua cu Judah siangpahrang hna ta a si cu."},"7":{"text":"Cun David nih Filistin mi hna ram chung i a um chung cu kum khat le thla li a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun David le a mi hna cu an hung kal i Geshur mi le Girzi mi le Amalek mi kha an hung chim hna; zeitintiah hi hna cu hlan liopi in hi ram chung mi, Izipt ram leiah Shur tiangin a ummi an si."},"9":{"text":"Cun David nih ram cu a tuk i pa siseh, nu siseh, a nung in a zuahmi hna an um lo, sihmanhsehlaw tuu hna le cawtum hna le laa hna le kalauk hna le puan hna kha a lak hna i Akhish sinah a ra kir ṭhan."},"10":{"text":"Akhish nih, “Nihin ah ahodah na hung hranh?” ti i a hal tikah, David nih, “Judah ram Negeb,” tiin maw, “Jerahmeel mi hna Negeb,” tiin maw, “Ken mi hna Negeb,” tiin maw, a ti tawn."},"11":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Annih nih kan kong kha an chim lai i, ‘Cuticun David nih a tuah,’ tiin an ti lai ti kha a ruah caah, Gath khua i thawngpang a hei kalpitu ding pakhat hmanh um lo dingin, pa siseh, nu siseh, pakhat hmanh a nung in a zuah hna lo. Filistin mi hna ram i a um chung vialte cu, mahticun a tuah tawn."},"12":{"text":"Cun Akhish nih David cu a zumh i, “A mi Israel mi kha aa huatter cikcek cang hna caah ka sal a si zungzal lai,” tiin a ruah."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan ah khan Filistin mi nih an ralkap kha raldoh awk caah, Israel kha doh awkah an pumh hna. Cun Akhish nih David cu a thawh i, “Nangmah le na mi hna kha keimah sinah ralkapbu chungah nan kal ve awk a si kha va hngal ko,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih, “A ṭha ko, na sal nih zeidah a tuah khawh ti kha na hngalh lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Akhish nih David cu, “A ṭha ko, nangmah cu na nun chung keimah pum rungvengtu ah kan ser lai,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Samuel kha atu cu a thi cang i Israel mi vialte nih an ṭah i amah khua Ramah ah khan an vui. Cun Saul nih thitlawnthiam le hnamngei kha ram chungin a dawi dih hna.","title":"Saul le Endor Khua Thitlawnthiamnu","ref":"Lev 20.27; Deu 18.10-11; 1Sam 25.1"},"4":{"text":"Filistin mi cu an i pum i an ra i Shunem ah riahhmun an khuar; cun Saul nih Israel mi vialte kha a pumh hna i Gilboa ah riahhmun an khuar ve."},"5":{"text":"Saul nih Filistin ralkapbu kha a hmuh tikah, a thin a phang i a ther in a ther."},"6":{"text":"Cun Saul nih Bawipa kha a hal tikah Bawipa nih mang in siseh, Urim in siseh, profet hna in siseh, a let lo.","ref":"Nam 27.21"},"7":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a sinum hna kha, “Thitlawnthiamnu pakhat in ka kawlpiak tuah u, a sinah ka va kal i amah cu ka va hal nakhnga,” tiah a ti hna. Cun a sinum hna nih cun, “Zohhmanh, Endor ah thitlawnthiam pakhat a um,” tiah an chimh."},"8":{"text":"Cun Saul cu mui dang in aa thleng i hnipuan dang aa hruk i amah sin i a um mipa pahnih he an kal; cun nu sinah cun zan ah an ra. Cun anih nih, “Thi ka tlawnpiak law, nangmah sinah a min ka chim laimi paoh hun ka chuahpiak tuah,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Nu nih khan amah sinah cun, “Saul nih thitlawnthiam le hnamngei hna cu zeitindah hi ram chungin a ṭhawl hna ti kha na hngalh hrimhrim ko ṭung. Zeicahdah ka thih nakhnga dingin ka nunnak kha rap na ka chiah?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul nih a sinah cun Bawipa min chalh in chiat a ser i, “ Bawipa a nun bangin, hi thil ruangah hin na cungah dantatnak a tlung lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun nu nih cun, “Ahodah kan chuahpiak lai?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Samuel kha hun ka chuahpiak tuah,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Nu nih Samuel kha a hmuh tikah aw fak piin a ai i nu nih cun Saul kha, “Zeicahdah na ka hlen? Nangmah hi Saul na si,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih amah cu, “Ṭih hlah; zeidah na hmuh?” tiah a ti. Cun nu nih khan Saul cu, “Vawlei chungin pathian pakhat a chuah kha ka hmuh,” tiah a chimh."},"14":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “A mui zeidah a si?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Tarpa pakhat a hung kai i a angkifual aa hruk,” tiah a ti. Cun Saul nih Samuel a si kha a hngalh i vawlei leiah a lu a khun i upatnak kha a tuah."},"15":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih Saul cu, “Zei-cahdah na hun ka chuahternak hin hna na ka hnawh?” tiah a ti. Saul nih a leh i, “Harnak nganpi chungah ka um; zeitintiah Filistin mi nih an ka tuk i Pathian nih hnulei a ka chit cang i profet hna sinin siseh, mang in siseh a ka let ti lo; cucaah nangmah cu zeidah ka tuah awk a si kha a ka chimtu dingah kan kawh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Samuel nih, “ Bawipa nih hnulei an chit cang i na ral ah a can cang caah zeicahdah keimah cu na ka hal duh ti?"},"17":{"text":"Keimah in Bawipa nih a chim bantuk khan na cungah a tuah cang; zeitintiah Bawipa nih pennak cu na kut chungin an chuh i na innpa David kha a pek cang.","ref":"1Sam 15.28"},"18":{"text":"Nangmah nih Bawipa aw kha na zul lo i Amalek cung i a thinhunnak ṭihnung kha na tlinter lo caah, kha caah khan nihin ah hin Bawipa nih na cungah mah hi a tuah.","ref":"1Sam 15.3-9"},"19":{"text":"Cu hleiah Bawipa nih Filistin mi hna kut chungah Israel mi hna zong kha nangmah he a chanh hna lai i thaizing ah nangmah le na fapa hna cu keimah sinah nan um lai; Bawipa nih Israel ralkapbu zong kha Filistin mi hna kut chungah a chanh lai,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Samuel bia thawng cun, Saul cu ṭihnak in a khat i vawlei ah chikkhatte ah a tlu thlup ko; cun chun nitlak zan khuadei zeihmanh a ei lo caah thazang zeihmanh a ngei lo."},"21":{"text":"Cun nu kha Saul sinah cun a ra i a thin a phang ngaingai ti kha a hmuh tikah amah cu, “Zohhmanh, na salnu nih na bia kha ka rak in ngaih; thih le thih tiin keimah na rak ka chimhmi kha ka rak in ngaih."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu nang zong nih na salnu hi a bia ngai ve tuah; na hmaiah changreu tlawm tein hunh ning law, na lam lei i na kal tikah thazang na ngeih nakhnga, ei tuah,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a al i, “Ka ei lai lo,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a sinum hna nih khan, minu he cun, an hnek peng i an bia kha a ngaih hna. Cucaah vawlei khan a tho i ihkhun cungah a ṭhu."},"24":{"text":"Minu nih khan a inn chungah cenhmi cawfa pakhat a ngei i khulrang in a thah, changvut kha a lak i a nawn i thilnu telh lo changreu ah a ser i,"},"25":{"text":"Saul le a sinum hna kha a hunh hna i annih nih an ei. Cun an tho i cu zan ah cun an kal diam."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Filistin mi nih an ralkap vialte cu Afek ah an pumh hna i Israel mi cu Jezreel i a ummi cerh kamah khan an riak.","title":"Filistin Mi Nih David Kha An Zum Lo"},"2":{"text":"Cun Filistin bawi hna cu a zaza le a thongthong in an lanh lengmang i David le a mi hna cu hnulei in Akhish he an lanh ve tikah,"},"3":{"text":"Filistin mi ralbawi hna nih cun an thawh i, “Hi Hebru mi hna hi hika ah hin zeidah an tuah?” tiah an ti. Cun Akhish nih Filistin mi ralbawi hna sinah cun, “Mah hihi Israel siangpahrang Saul i a sal David, keimah sin i ni hi zat le kum hi zat a um cangmi, keimah sin i a rung zam hnu i a cung i palhnak zeihmanh ka hmuh lomi kha a si lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Filistin mi ralbawi hna kha a cungah an thin a hung i Filistin mi ralbawi hna nih cun amah cu, “Mipa cu hmun na ruahpiakmi ah khan kirter ko; raltuknak hmun ah cun kan sinah kal hlah seh, raltuknak hmun ah khan kan ral ah a cang sual ai hnga. Kan mi hna cu a thah hna hnga i a thahmi hna lu cu a bawipa he i rem ṭhannak caah thilṭha bik an si ko hnga lo maw?"},"5":{"text":"Mah hi David hi an lam pah i, “Saul nih a thongthong in a thah hna, David nih a sangsang in,” tiin hla an i saktonhmi kha a si lo maw?” tiah an ti.","ref":"1Sam 18.7; 21.11"},"6":{"text":"Khi tikah Akhish nih David kha a kawh i a sinah, “ Bawipa nih a nun bangin, nangmah cu midik ngaingai na si i hi raldohnak i kan kalnak ah hin keimah sin i na luh na chuah ve hi a ding ko, tiah ka ruah; zeitintiah ka sinah na rat ni in nihin ni tiang nangmah chungah zeihmanh ṭhat lonak ka hmu lo. Sihmanhsehlaw bawi pawl nih nangmah cu an hna na tla lo."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah va kir law, Filistin bawi pawl hi lung si loin na umter hna nakhnga lo, dai tein va kal ko,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih Akhish sinah cun, “Sihmanhsehlaw zeidah ka tuah? Siangpahrang ka bawipa i a ral kha ka tuk nakhnga lo dingah hin, na rian chung i ka luh ni in atu tiangah, na sal chungah hin zeidah na hmuh?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Akhish nih David cu a leh i, “Nangmah cu keimah mit hmuh ah, Pathian vancungmi tlukin soi awk um lo na si ti kha ka hngalh ko; asinain, Filistin mi ralbawi hna nih khan, ‘Raltuknak hmun ah kan sinah kal hlah seh,’ an ti cang."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah cun nangmah sinah a rami na bawipa i a sal hna he khan zingka tein tho law, cun zing tein i thawh u law khua a dei cangka tein kal u,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah David cu a mi hna he khan zingka tein, Filistin mi hna ram i kir awkah khan an i thawh. Sihmanhsehlaw Filistin mi hna kha cu Jezreel ah an hung kal."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le a mi hna cu a ni thumnak ni ah Ziklag kha an phak tikah, Amalek mi nih Negeb le Ziklag kha an rak hranh hna. Ziklag kha an rak tei i mei in an khangh i","title":"David Nih Amalek Mi A Tei Hna"},"2":{"text":"nu hna le a chung i a ummi vialte, a hme a ngan in, an rak tlaih dih hna; pakhat hmanh an that hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw an rak kalpi diam hna i an rak kal cang."},"3":{"text":"Cun David le a mi hna cu khua kha an ra phak tikah, mei in khangh dih a rak si i an nupile le an fapale le an fanule hna cu an rak tlaih dih hna kha an hmuh."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah David le a sinah a ummi hna kha fak piin, ṭahnak thazang an ngeih ti lo tiangin an ṭap."},"5":{"text":"David nupi pahnih, Jezreel mi Ahinoam le Karmel mi Nabal nupi ro Abigail zong kha an rak tlaih hna.","ref":"1Sam 25.42-43"},"6":{"text":"Cun David cu a lungre a thei ngaingai; zeitintiah mi vialte kha an fapa hna le an fanu hna kongah khan an ngaih a chiat ngaingai caah mi nih khan amah kha lung i cheh awk an ceih lengmang. Sihmanhsehlaw David cu Bawipa a Pathian ah khan aa hriim ṭhan."},"7":{"text":"Cun David nih tlangbawi Abiathar, Ahimelek fapa sinah khan, “Tlangbawi angki kha ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Abiathar nih David sinah khan tlangbawi angki kha a rak put.","ref":"1Sam 22.20-23"},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih Bawipa kha a hal i, “Hi bu hi ka dawi hna lai maw? Ka phan hna hnga maw?” tiah a ti. A leh i, “Dawi hna, zeicahtiah na phak hrimhrim hna lai i na chanh khawh hrimhrim hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun David cu a sin i a ummi za ruk hna he khan aa thawh; Besor vate kha an va phan i cuka ah cun hnulei i an kaltakmi hna kha an rung tang."},"10":{"text":"David le a mi za li hna tu nih khan cun an dawi lengmang hna; asinain Besor vate tan awkah a ba tukmi za hnih kha cu hnuah an rung tang."},"11":{"text":"Ramlak ah khan Izipt mipa pakhat an hmuh i David sinah an ratpi; cun changreu kha an pek i a ei, din awk ti kha an pek,"},"12":{"text":"theipi car hlum khat le mitsur car bor hnih an pek. Cun a ei dih tikah a hun i hriim ṭhan; ni thum le zan thum rawl zong ei lo ti zong ding loin a rak um."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih amah cu a thawh i, “Aho mi dah na si? Khuazei in dah na rat?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Keimah cu Izipt mi tlangval ka si, Amalek mi pakhat i a sinum ka si; kan hnulei ni thum ah khan ka zawt caah ka bawipa nih hnulei ah hin a ka kaltak."},"14":{"text":"Khereth mi hna Negeb le Judah ta a simi le Kaleb i a Negeb kha kan hranh hna i Ziklag kha mei in kan khangh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun David nih amah cu, “Hi bu sinah hin na vun ka kalpi lai maw?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Kan that lai lo, cun na bawipa sinah kan pe ṭhan lai lo, tiin Pathian min in ka sinah chiat ser law, hi bu sinah hin ka vun in kalpi ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun amah nih a vun kalpi tikah khan, zohhmanh, Filistin mi ram le Judah ram in hranchaw kha tampi an lak caah a kenkip ah an rak i ṭhek dih i an rak ei, an rak ding, an rak lam len ko."},"17":{"text":"Cun David nih nitlak in a thaizing zanlei tiang a thah hna i tlangval za li kalauk aa cit i a zammi hna dah ti lo cu annih lakah a luatmi pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"18":{"text":"Amalek mi nih an lakmi vialte kha David nih a chuh ṭhan hna; David nih a nupi pahnih hna zong kha a lak ṭhan hna."},"19":{"text":"A hme siseh, a ngan siseh, fapa si hna seh, fanu si hna seh, hranchaw siseh, thil zeipaoh an rak lakmi kha siseh, zeihmanh a tlaumi a um lo; David nih a ratpi ṭhan dih hna."},"20":{"text":"David nih tuurun vialte le cawrun vialte zong kha a tlaih hna i a hmaiah mi nih an khalh hna i, “Mah hihi David hranchaw a si,” an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun David cu mi za hnih, an baat tuk ca i David a zul kho lo i Besor varek i an kaltakmi hna sin kha a ra phan; cun annih nih David le a sinah a ummi hna kha ton awkah an kal; cun David nih a hei phak deng hna tikah khan conglawmhnak a pek hna."},"22":{"text":"Khi tikah David sin i a kalmi miṭhalo hna le misual hna nih khan an thawh i, “Annih cu kan sinah an kal lo caah kan va lak ṭhanmi hranchaw hi zeihmanh kan pe hna lai lo, amah belte, an nupile le an fale cio kha i hruai hna seh law, kal ko hna seh,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih a thawh hna i, “Ka u le ka nau hna, hi bantukin Bawipa nih a kan pekmi thil kongah nan tuah hnga lo; kannih kha a kan zuah i a kan dohtu bu kha kan kut chungah a kan pek cang."},"24":{"text":"Hi kongah hin cun aho nih dah nan bia an in ngaih hna lai? Zeitintiah raltuknak hmun i a vung kalmi nih a tin a co bantuk tein thil a rak hngakmi zong nih a tin a co ve lai; aa khatrep in an i ṭhenh cio awk a si,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun cu ni thawk in nihin ni tiang Israel mi hna caah mah cucu nawlbia le phunglam ah a ser i nihin tiang a hmun."},"26":{"text":"David cu Ziklag a phanh tikah hranchaw a cheu cu Judah ram upa a hawikom hna sinah khan a kuat i, “ Bawipa ral hna sinin lakmi hranchaw chungin nanmah ca i laksawng a si,” tiah a ti;"},"27":{"text":"mah cucu, Bethel khua chung i a ummi hna le Negeb i Ramoth khua i a ummi hna le Jattir i a ummi hna le"},"28":{"text":"Aroer i a ummi hna le Sifmoth i a ummi hna le Eshtemoa i a ummi hna le"},"29":{"text":"Rakal i a ummi hna le Jerahmeel mi hna khua i a ummi hna le, Ken mi hna khua i a ummi hna le,"},"30":{"text":"Hormah i a ummi hna le Borashan i a ummi hna le Athak i a ummi hna le"},"31":{"text":"Hebron i a ummi hna, David le a mi hna an rak i chawhvaihnak hmun vialte i a ummi hna caah khan a si."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi nih Israel mi cu an tuk hna i Israel mi cu Filistin mi hna hmaiah khan an zam i Gilboa Tlang ah cun an thi liangluang ko.","title":"Saul le A Fapa Pathum An Thihnak Kong (1Cha 10.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi nih khan Saul le a fapa hna kha an phanh hna i Filistin mi nih cun Jonathan le Abinadab le Malkhishua, Saul fapa hna kha an thah hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Saul cu heh tiah an nam i thalkah thiam hna nih khan an phak ai; cun thal kah thiam hna nih khan ṭhalo tein an hliam."},"4":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a ralthuam putu sinah khan, “Na nam kha i zuh law, tleng lak in ka chun, cu lo ahcun, cuarpartan lo pawl hi an ra lai i an ka chunh ṭhiamṭhiam ṭung lai i lentecelhnak ah an ka ser sual hnga,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a ralthuam putu nih khan a tuah duh lo, zeicahtiah a thin a phang ngaingai. Cucaah Saul nih amah vainam kha aa lak i a bawhkhuh."},"5":{"text":"Cun a ralthuam putu nih khan Saul kha a thi cang tiah a hmuh tikah amah zong nih a vainam kha a bawhkhuh ve i amah sinah cun a thi."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Saul le a fapa pathum hna le a ralthuam putu le a mi vialte cu ni khat ah hmun khat ah an thi."},"7":{"text":"Cun ralchan ah a ummi Israel mi hna le Jordan tiva ral ah a ummi hna nih Israel mi kha an zam i Saul le a fapa hna kha an thi, ti an theih tikah, an khua kha an chuahtak hna i an zam; cun Filistin mi kha an ra i an khua kha an rawlh hna."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing ah Filistin mi hna nih a thimi kha an thilthuam hawh awk i an rat tikah, Saul le a fapa pathum Gilboa Tlang i an thih kha an hmuh hna."},"9":{"text":"A lu kha an cik i a ralthuam kha an hawh i thawngṭha cu an siasal hna le mi zapi hna sin i kalpi awkah Filistin mi ram dihlak ah khan thawngthanhtu an thlah hna."},"10":{"text":"A ralthuam cu Ashtaroth biakinn ah an chiah; cun a pum cu Bethshan kulhnak vampang ah an tar."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jabesh-gilead mi nih, Saul cung i Filistin mi nih an tuahmi kha an theih tikah,"},"12":{"text":"ralṭha vialte cu an tho i zan khuadei in an kal i Saul ruak le a fapa pathum hna an ruak kha Bethshan kulhnak vampang khan an va lak hna; cun Jabesh ah an ra phan i khika ah an khangh hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun an ruh cu an lak hna i Jabesh i tamarisk thingkung toiah an vui hna i ni sarih rawl an ul."}}}}},"10":{"info":{"name":"2Samuel","shortname":"2Sam","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul thih hnu i David nih Amalek mi a thah hnanak in a hung kir tikah, David cu Ziklag ah ni hnih a cam;","title":"David Nih Saul Thihnak Kong A Theih"},"2":{"text":"cun a ni thumnak ni ah Saul riahhmun in mipa pakhat, a puan tlek le a lu ah leidip i phulh in a ra. Cun David sin kha a phak tikah vawlei ah a bawk i upatnak kha a tuah."},"3":{"text":"David nih amah cu, “Khuazei in dah na rat?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Israel mi hna riahhmun in ka ra zam,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun David nih amah cu a thawh i, “Zeitindah a si? Ka chim tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih a leh i, “Mi hna nih raltuknak hmun khan an zam i mi tampi cu an tlu i an thi; cun Saul le a fapa Jonathan zong an thi,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun David nih amah a hung chimtupa tlangval sinah cun, “Zeitindah Saul le a fapa Jonathan cu an thi, tiah na hngalh?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun amah a chimtu tlangval nih khan, “Zeitimaw in Gilboa tlang ah khan ka rak um ngelcel i, khika ah khan Saul cu a fei kha i rinhchan in a rak dir i zohhmanh, rangleng le rangcung ralkap hna nih khan an naih chin cuahmah cang.","ref":"1Sam 31.1-6; 1Cha 10.1-6"},"7":{"text":"Cun a hnulei kha a hei zoh tikah a ka hmuh i a ka auh. Cun kei nih ka leh i, ‘Hika ah hin ka um,’ ka ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun anih nih keimah cu, ‘Ahodah na si?’ tiah a ka ti i, ‘Amalek mi ka si,’ tiah ka leh."},"9":{"text":"Cun anih nih keimah cu, ‘Ka pawngah dir law ka that tuah; zeitintiah vansang auhnak nih a ka tlaih cang, asinain ka nung rih ṭung,’ tiah a ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah a pawngah cun ka dir i ka thah, zeicahtiah a tluk cang hnuah khan cun a nung kho bal ti lai lo ti kha ka hngalh; cun a lu i a ummi bawi luchin le a baan i aa khihmi ban hrolh cu ka lak hna i hika ah ka bawipa sinah ka rak put hna,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih a thilpuan kha aa tlaih riangmang hna i a thleh hna i cu bantukin amah sin i a ummi vialte nih khan an tuah ve;"},"12":{"text":"Saul le a fapa Jonathan le Bawipa mi hna le Israel innchungkhar hna kha vainam in an thih caah, mithi cu an ngai, an ṭah hna i zanlei tiang rawl an ul."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih amah a chimtu tlangval sinah cun, “Khuazei in dah na rat?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih “Kei cu Amalek mi, mipem fa ka si,” tiah a leh."},"14":{"text":"David nih amah cu, “Zeitindah a si e, nangmah nih Bawipa chiti thuhmi hrawh awk i na kut zao na ṭih lo cu?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih tlangval pakhat kha a auh i, “Va kal law, va that,” tiah a ti. Cun a tuk i a thi."},"16":{"text":"Cun David nih amah cu, “Na thi cu nangmah lu cungah va um ko seh; zeitintiah nangmah kaa hrimhrim nih, ‘ Bawipa chiti thuhmi cu ka thah,’ tiin nangmah cung i biahngaltu a si,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun David nih Saul le a fapa Jonathan kha hi ṭah hla hi a lawh hna i","title":"David Nih Saul le Jonathan A Ṭah Hna"},"18":{"text":"Judah mi kha mah hihi cawnpiak awk an si lai, tiah a ti; zohhmanh, Jashar Cauk chungah aa ṭial. Amah nih a thawh i:","ref":"Jos 10.13"},"19":{"text":"Maw Israel, na sunparnak cu, na tlang cungah thah an si cang. Ralkap ṭhawng bikbik hna cu an ril cang."},"20":{"text":"Gath khua ah va thanh hlah u, Askelon khuachung lam zongah va chim hlah u, Filistin fanu hna kha an i lawm sual hnga i Cuarpartan lomi fanu hna kha an di a riam sual hnga."},"21":{"text":"Gilboa tlang hna, nan cungah ruah sur hlah seh, dap zong tla hna hlah seh lo ṭha zong um hna hlah seh; Zeicahtiah khika ah miṭhawng phaw cu thurhnawmh a si i Saul phaw cu chiti thuh ti loin a ril cang;"},"22":{"text":"Jonathan likuk cu mithahnak caah a ṭhawng, Saul vainam cu zaangfahnak a ngei lo, Miṭhawng kha an tuk hna i ral kha an thah hna."},"23":{"text":"Saul le Jonathan, duh a nung i aa dawhmi hna, nunnak ah siseh thihnak ah siseh an i ṭhen lo; muvanlai nakin an khul a rang, chiandeih nakin an ṭhawng."},"24":{"text":"Maw Israel fanu hna, Saul cu ṭah tuah u, Amah nih maimaw puan an aihter hna i lungvar le sui in an ṭamh hna."},"25":{"text":"Ralkap miṭhawng hna cu zeitindah i doh liopi ah an thih ee! Jonathan cu na tlang cungah a ril cang ai!"},"26":{"text":"Ka nau Jonathan, Nangmah cu kan ngai, Zeitluk in dah ka caah na sun Na ka dawtnak cu khuaruahhar a si, nu dawtnak kha a hluan."},"27":{"text":"Ralkap ṭhawng hna cu an tlu cang, ralhriam hna cu an rawk cang,” a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin David nih Bawipa kha a hal i, “Judah ram chung khua pakhatkhat ah ka hung kal lai maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih amah cu, “Hung kal,” tiah a ti. David nih, “Khuazei ah khin dah ka hung kal hnga?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Hebron ah,” tiah a ti.","title":"David Cu Judah Siangpahrang Ah A Cang"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah David cu khika ah khan a hung kal, a nupi pahnih Jezreel khuami Ahinoam le Karmel ram mi Nabal nupi ro Abigail zong kha an kal ve.","ref":"1Sam 25.42-43"},"3":{"text":"Cun David nih a sin i a ummi a mi vialte hna kha, an innchungkhar cio he a hun i kalpi hna i Hebron khua hna ah cun an um."},"4":{"text":"Cun Judah mi kha an ra i khika ah David cu Judah hrin siangpahrang caah chiti an thuh. David kha, “Saul a vuitu cu Jabesh-gilead mi an si,” tiah an chimh tikah,","ref":"1Sam 31.11-13"},"5":{"text":"Jabesh-gilead mi sinah cun lamkaltu a hei thlah hna i, “Nannih nih hi zumhawktlaknak kha nan bawi Saul cungah nan langhter i nan vui caah Bawipa nih thluachuahnak in pe ko hna seh!"},"6":{"text":"Atu cu Bawipa nih nan cungah a fekmi dawtnak le zumhawktlaknak kha langhter ko seh! Cun nannih nih hi thil hi nan tuah caah nan cungah ṭhatnak ka tuah lai."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah nan kut kha ṭhawng hna seh law nan ralṭha ko u; zeitintiah nan bawipa Saul cu a thi cang i Judah hrin hna nih annih cung i siangpahrang ah keimah cu chiti an ka thuh cang,” tiah a ti hna."},"8":{"text":"Ner fapa Abner, Saul ralkapbu haotu nih khan Saul fapa Ishbosheth kha a lak i Mahanaim ah a ratpi i,","title":"David le Saul Ralkap An I Tu"},"9":{"text":"Gilead le Asshur mi hna le Jezreel le Efraim le Benjamin le Israel vialte cung i siangpahrang ah a ser."},"10":{"text":"Saul fapa Ishbosheth cu Israel cung i uknak hram a thawk ah cun, kum sawm li a si i kum hnih a uk. Sihmanhsehlaw Judah hrin nih khan cun David kha an zulh."},"11":{"text":"Cun Hebron khua i Judah hrin hna cung i David siangpahrang a si chung cu kum sarih le thla ruk a si."},"12":{"text":"Ner fapa Abner le Saul fapa Ishbosheth i a sinum hna cu Mahanaim in Gibeon ah an kal."},"13":{"text":"Cun Zeruiah fapa Joab le David sinum hna cu an chuak i Gibeon tili ah khan an va ton hna; tili khatlei kamah phu khat an ṭhu i tili khattelei kamah phu dang an ṭhu."},"14":{"text":"Cun Abner nih Joab cu, “Tlangval pawl hi tho hna seh law kan hmaiah lente i celh tuah hna seh,” tiah a ti. Joab nih, “Tho hna ngat seh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun an tho i an i rel: Benjamin le Saul fapa Ishbosheth lei in hleihnih, cun David sinum hna leiah hleihnih."},"16":{"text":"Cun pakhat le pakhat, anmah le an ral cio kha, an lu in an i tlai i an hnak ah nam in an i chun i hmun khat ah an tlu hna. Cucaah cuka hmun cu Helkath-hazzurim tiah ti a si, Gibeon ah a um."},"17":{"text":"Khi ni ah an i tuk cu a fak ko; Abner le Israel mi cu David sinum hna nih khan an tei hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun khika ah Zeruiah fapa pathum, Joab, Abishai le Asahel hna kha an um ve. Asahel cu ramlak sazuk bangin a mumi a si;"},"19":{"text":"Asahel nih Abner kha orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh, pial loin a dawi."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah Abner nih a hnulei kha a hei zoh i, “Nangmah maw na si Asahel?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Ka si,” tiah a leh."},"21":{"text":"Abner nih amah cu, “Na orhlei ah maw na kehlei ah maw pial law, tlangval pakhatkhat kha tlai law, a hranchaw kha la tuah,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Asahel cu amah a dawinak khan a pial duh lo."},"22":{"text":"Cun Abner nih Asahel cu a chimh ṭhan i, “Na ka dawinak hin pial tuah; zeicahdah vawlei ah tlu lakin kan chunh lai? Na u Joab hmai zeitindah ka hmuh ngam lai?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw i mer kha a duh hlei lo; cucaah Abner nih a paw ah a fei chek in a chunh i a kenglei ah a tleng; khika ah khan a tlu i a thi colh. Cun Asahel a tluk i a thihnak hmun a phanmi paoh kha cuka ah cun an dir colh lengmang."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Joab le Abishai nih Abner kha an dawi; cun ni tla zuarzar ah khin Gibeon ramlak lei kalnak lam i a ummi Giah khua, cu khua hmai i a ummi Ammah tlang kha an phan."},"25":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi kha Abner sinah cun an i pum i bu khat ah an cang i tlangpar ah khan dirhmun an khuar."},"26":{"text":"Cun Abner nih Joab kha a hei auh i, “Zungzal in maw mah le mah hi kan i doh ko lai! A donghnak cu a fak lai tiah na hngal ko lo maw? Na mi hna cu, nan unau hna dawi hi ngol cang u, tiah zeitik ah dah na ti hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Joab nih, “Pathian a nun bangin, nangmah nih cu bantukin chim hlah law cu, ka mi hna nih hin thaizing tiangin an in dawi peng ko hna hnga,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Joab nih muko kha a tum i mi vialte nih khan Israel mi hna dawi kha an ngol i a tuk zong an i tu ti lo."},"29":{"text":"Cun Abner le a mi hna cu Arabah tan in cu zan cu zan khuadei an kal; Jordan kha an tan i chunhlan thliahmah an kal i Mahanaim kha an phan."},"30":{"text":"Joab cu Abner dawinak khan a kir; cun mi vialte kha a pumh hna tikah, David sinum hna chungin Asahel lengah hleikua an bau."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David sinum hna nih, Benjamin mi, Abner mi hna chungah khan, za thum le sawm ruk an thah hna."},"32":{"text":"Cun Asahel kha an lak i Bethlehem i a pa thlan ah khan an vui. Cun Joab le a mi hna cu zan khuadei an kal i Hebron an phak ah khua nih a dei phuat hna."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul innchungkhar le David inn-chungkhar karlakah khan i dohnak saupi a um; David cu a ṭhawng chin lengmang i sihmanhsehlaw Saul innchungkhar cu an der chin lengmang."},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih Hebron khua ah cun fapa a hrin hna: a fater cu Jezreel khuami Ahinoam fapa Amnon a si;","title":"Hebron Ah David Fapa Hna (1Cha 3.1-4)"},"3":{"text":"a pahnihnak cu Karmel ram Nabal nupi ro Abigail i fapa Khileab a si; a pathumnak cu Geshur siangpahrang Talmai i fanu Maakah i fapa Absalom a si;"},"4":{"text":"cun a palinak cu Haggith fapa Adonijah a si; a panganak Abital fapa Shefatiah a si;"},"5":{"text":"a paruknak cu David nupi Eglah fapa Ithream a si. Mah hna hi David nih Hebron ah a hrin hna."},"6":{"text":"Saul innchungkhar le David inn-chungkhar karlak i dohnak a um lioah khan Abner nih amah le amah kha Saul innchungkhar chungah khan miṭhawng ah aa ser.","title":"Abner Nih David A Doh"},"7":{"text":"Saul nih khan nuchun pakhat a rak ngei i a min cu Rizpah a si, amah cu Aiah fanu a si; cun Ishbosheth nih khan Abner cu, “Zeicahdah ka pa nuchun sinah khan na vung luh?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Khi tikah Ishbosheth bia ruangah khan Abner cu a thin a hung ngaingai i, “Judah pawl uico lu maw ka si! Nihin tiangin na pa Saul innchungkhar hna cung le a unau hna cung le a hawikom hna chungah zumhawktlak in ka um ko rih i David kut chungah nangmah cu kan chaan lo; cun maw nang nih nihin ah hin, nu he sual na hei ka puh."},"9":{"text":"Pennak cu Saul hrin chungin ṭhial i David bawi ṭhutdan cu Israel le Judah cungah Dan in Beersheba tiang fehter awkah Bawipa nih a sin i chiat a sermi kha David caah ka tlinter lo ahcun, Pathian nih cu bantukin le tam deuh zongin Abner cungah hin tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sam 15.28","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Cun Ishbosheth nih Abner cu a ṭih caah bia dang kaa khat hmanh a let kho lo."},"12":{"text":"Cun Abner nih David sinah khan Hebron ah lamkal a hei thlah hna i, “Ram hi aho ta dah a si? Keimah he biakamnak ser law, zohhmanh, Israel mi vialte cu nangmah sin i komhter awkah ka kut cu nangmah sinah a ṭang lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “A ṭha ko; nangmah he biakamnak cu ka ser lai; sihmanhsehlaw nangmah sinin thil pakhat kan hal; cu cu Saul fanu Mikhal kha ka hmai hmuh awk i na rat tikah na ratpi hmasa lo ahcun, ka hmai na ka hmu lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun David nih Saul fapa Ishbosheth sinah khan lamkal a hei thlah hna i, “Filistin mi cuarpar za khat in ka hammi ka nupi Mikhal kha ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sam 18.27"},"15":{"text":"Cun Ishbosheth nih cun mi a hei thlah hna i amah cu Laish fapa Paltiel, a va sin khan a lakter hna."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a va nih khan a zulh i Bahurim tiangin a ṭah lengmang. Cun Abner nih amah cu, “Va kal law va kir tuah,” tiah a ti i a kir."},"17":{"text":"Cun Abner nih cun Israel upa hna kha a pumhpi hna i, “Kan hnulei nawn khan David cu nan siangpahrang si awkah nan kawl lengmang cang."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu tlinter tuah u; zeitintiah Bawipa nih David cu bia a kam i, ‘Ka sal David kut in ka mi Israel mi hna cu Filistin mi kut chung le an ral vialte hna kut chungin ka chuah hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Abner nih Benjamin mi zong kha a chimh hna; cun Abner cu David kha, Israel mi le Benjamin hrin vialte nih tuah awkah a ṭha ti i an ruahmi vialte kha Hebron i va chimh awkah a kal."},"20":{"text":"Abner cu David sinah Hebron ah mi pakul he a rat tikah, David nih Abner le a sin i a ummi hna caah cun rawl danghnak a tuah."},"21":{"text":"Cun Abner nih David sinah, “Ka va kal lai i siangpahrang bawipa sinah khan, Israel mi vialte cu ka pumh hna lai. Nangmah he biakamnak an ser lai i na lung duhmi a rak si bang khan na uk hna lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David nih Abner cu a kalter i daihnak in a kal."},"22":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpalte ah cun David sinum hna cu ral an hranhnak khan Joab he an kir i hranchaw tampi an rak i phorh. Sihmanhsehlaw Abner cu David sinah Hebron ah a rak um lo, zeicahtiah a rak kalter cang i daihnak in a rak kal cang.","title":"Joab Nih Abner A Thah"},"23":{"text":"Joab le a sinah a ummi ralkapbu vialte cu an rat tikah Joab cu, “Ner fapa Abner kha siangpahrang sinah a ra i amah nih a kalter i daihnak in a kal cang,” tiah an chimh."},"24":{"text":"Khi tikah Joab cu siangpahrang sinah khan a va kal i, “Zeidah na rak tuah? Zohhmanh, Abner cu na sinah a rak ra; zeicahdah na rak kalter i cucaah a rak kal diam cang?"},"25":{"text":"Ner fapa Abner nih hin nangmah kha hlen awkah le na luh na chuah le na tuahmi vialte kha hngalh awkah a ra tiah na hngalh ko ṭung,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"David sinin Joab kha a chuah tikah, Abner kha mi a hei dawiter hna i Sirah tikhor khan an rak kirpi ṭhan; sihmanhsehlaw cu kong cu David nih a hngal lo."},"27":{"text":"Cun Abner kha Hebron i a ra kir tikah Joab nih a thli in biaruah awkah hauka chungah khan ken khat ah a kalpi i a nau Asahel thisen caah khan khika ah a paw ah a chunh i a thi."},"28":{"text":"A hnuah, mah cucu David nih a theih tikah, “Keimah le ka pennak cu Bawipa hmaika ah Ner fapa Abner thi kongah hin a zungzal in mawhchiat awk um lo kan si ko."},"29":{"text":"Dantatnak Joab lu cung le a pa innchungkhar vialte cungah tla ko seh; cun Joab chung hna lakah hin thil chuak a ngeimi siseh, thinghmui zawtnak a ngeimi siseh, lathlur a tlaimi siseh, vainam nih a thahmi siseh, rawl a pammi siseh, ṭhing bal hna hlah seh!” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun Joab le a unau Abishai nih Abner kha an thah, zeicahtiah amah nih khan Gibeon i raltuknak hmun ah khan an unau Asahel kha a rak thah."},"31":{"text":"Cun David nih Joab le a sin i a ummi vialte kha a thawh hna i, “Nan puan kha thlek hna u law, buri kha i aih u law, Abner kha ngai tuah u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun Siangpahrang David nih ruakkuang kha a zulh."},"32":{"text":"Abner cu Hebron ah an vui; cun siangpahrang nih fak piin Abner thlan ah khan a ṭap; cun mi vialte zong kha an ṭap."},"33":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Abner kha ṭah hla a lawh i, “Abner hi mihrut thih bangin maw a thih ko lai!"},"34":{"text":"Na kut kha ṭem an si lo i na ke kha hreng khenh an si lo; Miṭhalo hmai i a tlumi bantukin na tluk ko hi ta,” tiah a ti. Cun mi vialte nih an ṭah ṭhan."},"35":{"text":"Cun mi vialte nih David cu chun a si rih lioah khan rawl ei fial awkah an ra, sihmanhsehlaw David nih chiat a ser i “Ni a tlak hlan i changreu siseh, zeipaoh siseh ka teh ahcun, Pathian nih hi bangin le hi nak tam deuh zongin ka cungah tuah ko seh!” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun cucu mi vialte nih an hmuh i, siangpahrang nih a tuahmi thil zeipaoh nih an lung a ton tawn hna bang khan, an lung a ton ngaingai hna."},"37":{"text":"Cucaah mi vialte le Israel mi vialte nih, Ner fapa Abner thah kha siangpahrang duhnak cu a rak si lo ti kha khi ni ah khan an hngalh."},"38":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih a sinum hna sinah cun, “Nihin ah hin Israel mi chungah bawi le mingan pakhat a thi ti kha nan hngal lo maw?"},"39":{"text":"Siangpahrang ah chiti thuh ka si nain, nihin ah hin ka der ko; hi mi Zeruiah fapale hna hi ka caah an hak tuk. Bawipa nih ṭhat lonak a tuahtu cu a ṭhat lonak bantukin rul ko seh!” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Saul fapa Ishbosheth nih Hebron ah Abner a thi ti kha a theih tikah a lung a der i Israel mi vialte cu an hnabei a dong.","title":"Ishbosheth An Nawn"},"2":{"text":"Saul fapa nih khan ral hranh bu haotu mi pahnih a ngeih hna i pakhat min cu Baanah a si i a dang pakhat min cu Rekhab a si, annih cu Beeroth khuami Benjamin phun Rimmon fapa an si (zeitintiah Beeroth zong khan Benjamin ta ah rel chih a si;"},"3":{"text":"Beeroth mi hna cu Gittaim ah an zam i khika ah nihin tiangin mipem an si)."},"4":{"text":"Saul fapa Jonathan nih khan fapa pakhat a ngeih i amah cu a ke a bei. Saul le Jonathan kong kha Jezreel in a hung than tikah amah cu kum nga a si; cun a cawngtunu nih khan aa pom duak i a zampi; cun khulrang i a zam lioah khan a thlak sual i a ke kha a bei. Cun a min cu Mefibosheth a si.","ref":"2Sam 9.3"},"5":{"text":"Cun Beeroth khuami Rimmon fapa Rekhab le Baanah kha an i thawh i chun nilinh saling hrawng khin Ishbosheth inn ah chunlai i aa dinh lioah khin, an phan."},"6":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, innka a cawngtu cu changvut kha a thian i sihmanhsehlaw a ngu i aa hngilh ai; cucaah Rekhab le a unau Baanah cu a thli tein an lut."},"7":{"text":"Inn chung i an va luh tikah khan, a ihnak dai chung i a ihkhun cungah a ih lioah khan an tuk i an thah i a lu an tan. A lu kha an lak i Arabah lei kalnak lam khan zan khuadei an kal i"},"8":{"text":"Isbosheth lu cu David sinah Hebron ah khan an ratpi. Cun siangpahrang sinah khan, “Mah hihi na nunnak an kawltu na ral Ishbosheth, Saul fapa i a lu kha a si; nihin ah hin siangpahrang ka bawipa cu Saul le a tefa hna cungah khan Bawipa nih phu an hlampiak cang,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih Beeroth khuami Rimmon fapa hna, Rekhab le a unau Baanah cu a leh hna i, “Ral vialte chungin ka nunnak a ka tlantu Bawipa a nun bangin,"},"10":{"text":"mi pakhat nih, ‘Zohhmanh, Saul cu a thi cang,’ ti i a ka chimh i thawng ṭha ka phorh ti i a ruah tikah khan, ka tlaih i Ziklag ah ka thah, mah cucu thawngpang a rak phorhmi ca i laksawng ka rak pekmi a si.","ref":"2Sam 1.1-16"},"11":{"text":"Miding mi amah innte i a ummi, a ihkhun cung i a thattu miṭhalo hna chinchin cu, zeitluk tein dik nanmah kut ah a thisen man cu kan cawh hna lai i vawlei cungin kan hloh chinchin hna lai?” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih a tlangval kha nawl a pek hna i an thah hna i an kut le an ke kha an tan hna i Hebron khua i tidil pawngah khan an thlai hna. Sihmanhsehlaw Ishobosheth lu kha cu an lak i Hebron i Abner thlan ah khan an vui."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel phun vialte kha David sinah Hebron ah an ra i, “Zohhmanh, kannih cu na ruh le na sa kan si,","title":"David Cu Israel Mi Siangpahrang Ah An Ser (1Cha 11.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"kan hnulei caan, Saul kan siangpahrang a si lioah khan, Israel mi a chuahpitu le a luhpitu cu nangmah na si; cun Bawipa nih nangmah cu, ‘Nangmah cu ka mi Israel mi hna tuukhal na si lai i Israel mi hna bawi na si lai,’ an timi kha na si,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Israel upa vialte cu siangpahrang sinah cun Hebron ah khan an ra i Siangpahrang David nih Bawipa hmaiah Hebron ah khan anmah he biakamnak a ser i annih nih David cu Israel mi cung i siangpahrang ah chiti an thuh."},"4":{"text":"David cu pen hram a thawk tikah kum sawm thum a si i kum sawm li chung a pen.","ref":"1Sia 2.11; 1Cha 3.4; 29.27"},"5":{"text":"Hebron ah Judah mi kha kum sarih le thla ruk a pen hna; cun Jerusalem ah Israel mi vialte le Judah mi vialte kha kum sawm thum le kum thum a pen hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang le a mi hna cu Jebus mi doh awkah Jerusalem ah an kal; cu hna cu cuka ram i a ummi an si i David kha, “Hika ah hin na lut lai lo, mitcaw le kebei hmanh nih an in kham khawh lai,” tiah a rak titu kha an si. Annih nih, David cu hika ah a lut kho lai lo, tiah an ruah.","title":"David Nih Zion A Lak (1Cha 11.4-9)","ref":"Jos 15.63; Biac 1.21"},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David nih Zion ralhruang cu a lak ko ai, cucu David khua ti a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih khi ni ah khan, “Jebus mi thah a duhmi paoh cu, David lungthin nih a huatmi hna kebei le mitcaw kha hung thah hna awkah, ti kua khan hung kai hna seh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah cun, “Mitcaw le kebei hna cu inn chungah khan an lut lai lo,” tiah ti a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun David cu ralhruang chungah khan a um i cucu David khua tiah min a sak. Cun David nih khua cu, Millo in a chunglei tiang khan a velchum in a kulh."},"10":{"text":"Cun David cu Bawipa, ralkapbu Pathian kha a sinah a um caah a ngan chin lengmang."},"11":{"text":"Cun Tair siangpahrang Hiram nih David kha lamkaltu le sidar thing le zungthiammi hna le lungremhthiam hna zong kha a kuat i David kha inn pakhat an sakpiak.","title":"Hiram Nih David A Theih (1Cha 14.1-2)"},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih Bawipa nih Israel mi cungah siangpahrang ah a ka fehter cang ti le, a mi Israel mi hna ruangah a pennak kha a hlorh cang ti kha a hngalh."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih Hebron in a hun hnuah khan Jerusalem mi nupichun le nupitak tam chinchin aa chap hna i David cu fapa le fanu tam chinchin a ngei.","title":"Jerusalem Ah A Hrinmi Hna (1Cha 3.5-9 ; 14.3-7)"},"14":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem ah a hrinmi hna an min cu mah hihi an si: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"15":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"16":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada le Elifelet."},"17":{"text":"Filistin mi nih David kha Israel siangpahrang ah chiti thuh a si cang tiah an theih tikah, Filistin mi vialte nih David kha kawl awkah an hung kal; sihmanhsehlaw mah cucu David nih a theih i ralhruang ah khan a vung kal.","title":"David Nih Filistin Mi A Tei Hna (1Cha 14.8-17)"},"18":{"text":"Filistin mi cu an ra i Refaim nelrawn ah khan an i zar phut ko."},"19":{"text":"Cun David nih Bawipa kha a hal i, “Filistin mi hna doh awkah ka hung kal lai maw? Annih cu ka kut chungah na ka pe hna hnga maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih David cu, “Hung kal ko, zeitintiah Filistin mi cu na kut chungah kan pek hrimhrim hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun David cu Baal-perazim ah a ra i khika ah annih cu a tei hna i amah nih, “ Bawipa nih ka ral hna cu, tilian aa sah phut bantukin ka hmaiah a sah hna,” tiah a ti. Cucaah cu ka hmun cu a min ah Baal-perazim ti a si."},"21":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih khika ah an siasal kha an kaltak hna i David le a mi hna nih khan an lak hna."},"22":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi cu an ra ṭhan hoi i Refaim nelrawn ah khan an i zar phut ṭhan."},"23":{"text":"Cun David nih Bawipa kha a hal tikah, “Na hung kal hnga lo; an hnulei in na va hel hna lai i balsam thing zawn khan na nam hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Cun balsam thing par hna i kal thawng na theih tikah, khi tikah na cawlcang ve lai, zeitintiah khi tikah khan, Bawipa cu na hmaiah Filistin mi ralkapbu kha tuk awkah a kal cang a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih nawl a pek bangin David nih a tuah i Filistin mi hna cu Geba in Gezer tiang a thah hna."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David nih Israel mi lakin thim ciammammi sang thum kha a pumh ṭhan hna.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Pathian Kuang An Lak (1Cha 13.1-14 ; 15.25—16.6,43)"},"2":{"text":"Cun David cu a tho i a sinah a ummi vialte hna he khan, Pathian kuang, a cungah ralkapbu Bawipa min a cuang i cherubim cung i a ṭhumi kha, vung lak awkah Judah ram Baalah khua ah khan an vung kal.","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"3":{"text":"Cun Pathian kuang kha cawleng thar in an phorh i tlang cung i a ummi Abinadab inn khan an chuah pi; cun Abinadab fapa Uzzah le Ahio nih khan,","ref":"1Sam 7.1-2"},"4":{"text":"a chung i Pathian kuang a ummi cawleng thar kha an mawngh i Ahio cu kuang hmaiah khan a kal."},"5":{"text":"Cun David le Israel chungkhar vialte cu Bawipa hmaiah an thazang dihlak le hla le tingtang le thonglawi le muko le khuang le sumsel hna he tiah nuamhnak an tuah."},"6":{"text":"Cun Nakon phuhri kha an phak tikah cawtum kha an rilh caah Uzzah nih Pathian kuang kha a kut in a hei banh i a tlaih."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa thinhunnak cu Uzzah cungah a alh i a kut in kuang kha a hei banh caah Pathian nih khika ah a tuk i cuka ah Pathian kuang kiangah khan a thi."},"8":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Uzzah cungah a thinhunnak a sah caah David cu a thin a hung i cuka hmun cu a min ah Perez-uzzah tiah nihin tiangin ti a si."},"9":{"text":"Cun David cu khi ni ah Pathian kha a ṭih i, “Zeitindah Bawipa kuang cu ka sinah a rat khawh lai?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Bawipa kuang cu David khua chung i luhpi awk kha a duh lo; asinain David nih Git mi Obededom inn lei tu ah khan a kalpi."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang cu Git mi Obededom inn chungah khan thla thum a um i Bawipa nih Obededom le a innchungkhar vialte kha thluachuahnak a pek hna.","ref":"1Cha 26.4-5"},"12":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang David kha an chimh i, “ Bawipa nih Obededom innchungkhar kha Pathian kuang thawngin thluachuah a pek hna,” tiah an ti. Cucaah David cu a va kal i Obededom inn khan David khua ah lunglawmhnak in Pathian kuang kha a ratpi;"},"13":{"text":"cun Bawipa kuang a zawntu hna nih khan kar ruk an kal tikah cawtum pakhat le cenhmi saṭil pakhat kha a thawi hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun David cu Bawipa hmaiah a thazang dihlak in a lam; David cu la hmang ṭhia tlangbawi angki aa hruk."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah David le Israel innchungkhar vialte nih aupah le muko tumpah in Bawipa kuang cu an hunpi."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa kuang kha David khua chung i a luh lioah Saul fanu Mikhal nih khan thlalangawng in a hei zoh i Siangpahrang David cu Bawipa hmai i a laam le aa hlawh len ko kha a hei hmuh i a lung chungin a nihsawh."},"17":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang kha an luhpi i a umnak ding hmun caah David nih a rak bunhmi thlam chungah khan an chiah. Cun David nih khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak kha Bawipa hmaiah a pekchanh."},"18":{"text":"Cun David nih khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak kha a pekchanh dih tikah, ralkapbu Bawipa min in mizapi kha thluachuah a pek hna i"},"19":{"text":"mi vialte kha, Israel mibu cu an ning piin, nu he pa he, changreu hlum khat, sa zam khat le mitsur thei car hlum khat a phawt cio hna. Cun mi vialte cu, an inn cio ah an ṭin.","ref":"1Cha 16.43"},"20":{"text":"Cun David cu a innchungkhar kha thluachuah pek awkah a va kir. Sihmanhsehlaw Saul fanu Mikhal nih khan David cu ton awkah a ra chuak i, “Nihin cu Israel siangpahrang cu a sunglawi ko cu ta, mizeiruaramlo pakhat nih ningzah hngal loin a hnipuan aa phoih bantukin pei, a sal hna i an salnu hna hmaiah, nihin ah aa phoih ve kha!” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun David nih Mikhal cu, “Na pa le a innchungkhar vialte nakin keimah kha a ka thim i Israel mi cung i bawi a ka cantertu Bawipa hmaiah pei a si tiah — Bawipa hmaiah cun thanuamnak ka tuah ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Hi nak i nihsawh awk tlak deuh hmanh ah kaa ser ko lai i keimah mit hmanh ah zahpi awk tlak ka si ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw na chimmi sinum ngaknu pawl hna thawng khan pei upat ka si lai tiah,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Saul fanu Mikhal kha a thih ni tiangin fa a ngei lo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu amah inn ah a um i Bawipa nih a velchum i ral a ummi vialte hna lakin dinhnak a pek tikah,","title":"Pathian Nih David Sinah Biakamnak A Ser (1Cha 17.1-15)"},"2":{"text":"siangpahrang nih profet Nathan cu a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, kei cu sidar thing inn chungah ka um i sihmanhsehlaw Pathian kuang cu puan thlam chungah a um ko,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Nathan nih siangpahrang cu a thawh i, “Va kal law na lung chung i a ummi paoh cu va tuah ko, zeitintiah Bawipa cu na sinah a um,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu zan ṭhiamṭhiam ah cun Bawipa bia cu Nathan sinah a ra i,"},"5":{"text":"“Va kal law ka sal David kha, ‘ Bawipa nih hi bangin a ti: Ka umnak ding caah nangmah nih inn na ka sakpiak hnga maw?"},"6":{"text":"Israel mi kha Izipt ram in ka chuahpi hna ni thawk in nihin tiang, inn chungah ka um rih lo, sihmanhsehlaw ka umnak ca i puan thlam chungin kaa chawk lengmang ko."},"7":{"text":"Israel mi vialte he kaa chawhnak hmun dihlak ah, ka mi Israel mi hna kha zohkhenh awk i nawl ka pekmi Israel mi biaceihtu hna aho sin tal ah, “Zeicahdah sidar inn na ka sakpiak lo?” tiah bia kaa khat tal ka chim maw?’ a ti tiah va chim."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu ka sal David kha hi bangin na va chimh lai, ‘Hi bangin ralkapbu Bawipa nih a ti, nangmah cu ka mi Israel mi cungah bawi si awkah phong lak, tuu na zulhkhalh hnanak khan kan lak;"},"9":{"text":"cun khuazeika na kalnak hmanh ah nangmah sinah ka um i na hmai in na ral vialte kha ka hloh dih hna; cun vawlei cung i mi lianngan hna min bantukin min ngan kan serpiak lai."},"10":{"text":"Cun ka mi Israel mi hna caah hmun pakhat ka tuah lai i anmah hmunte ah cun an um nakhnga le hnahnawh an si ti nakhnga lo, ka phun hna lai;"},"11":{"text":"hlan lio i ka mi hna cungah biaceihtu ka rak chiah hna caan bantuk khan, zaang en hmangmi hna nih an hrem ti hna lai lo; cun nangmah cu na ral vialte hna sinin dinhnak kan pek lai. Cu hleiah Bawipa nih nangmah cu Bawipa nih inn pakhat an serpiak lai, tiin an thanh."},"12":{"text":"Cun na ni kha a tlin i na pupa hna sinah na ih tikah, nangmah pum chungin a chuak laimi na fapa cu nangmah hnuah a chan ka thawhter lai i a pennak kha ka fehter lai.","ref":"Slm 89.3-4; 132.11; Jhn 7.42; Lam 2.30"},"13":{"text":"Amah nih ka min caah inn pakhat a sak lai i a pennak bawi ṭhutdan cu zungzal in ka fehter lai."},"14":{"text":"Keimah cu a pa ka si lai i amah cu ka fapa a si lai. ṭhat lonak a tuah tikah minung fung le minung fapa hna tuknak vual in ka chimhhrin lai;","ref":"Slm 89.26-27; 1Kor 6.18; Heb 1.5"},"15":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw nangmah hmai in ka ṭhialmi Saul sinin ka lak bantuk khan a sinin a fekmi ka dawtnak cu ka la lai lo."},"16":{"text":"Cun na inn le na pennak cu ka hmaiah a zungzal fek dingin ser a si lai; na bawi ṭhutdan cu zungzal in a hmun lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 89.36-37"},"17":{"text":"Hi bia vialte ning le hi langhnak vialte ning hin, Nathan nih David kha a chimh."},"18":{"text":"Khi tikah David cu a lut i Bawipa hmaiah a ṭhu i, “Maw Bawipa Pathian, keimah cu ahodah ka si i ka innchungkhar zong hi zeidah an si, hi tiang nangmah nih na ka hruai hi?"},"19":{"text":"Asinain mah hi cu nangmah mit ah cun maw Bawipa Pathian, a hmemi thil a si ko; caan saupi lio in na sal innchungkhar kong zong hi na rak chim chung cang i hmailei ciruang ding hna zong kha na ka hmuhsak cang, maw Bawipa Pathian!"},"20":{"text":"Cun David nih na sinah zei hlei dah a chim khawh ti lai? Zeitintiah, maw Bawipa Pathian, nangmah nih na sal cu na hngalh ko!"},"21":{"text":"Nangmah na biakamnak ruangah le nangmah na lung ning tein, hi lianngannak cu na sal kha hngalhter awkah nangmah nih na tuah cang."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah cu na ngan ko, maw Bawipa Pathian; zeitintiah kannih nih kan hna in kan theihmi vialte ah nangmah bantuk an um lo i nangmah hleiah Pathian dang zeihmanh an um lo."},"23":{"text":"Pathian nih amah mi si awk ca i tlanh awkah a kalhnawh hna i amah ca i min pakhat i ser i, amah mi hna hmai in miphun pakhat le cu miphun khuazing hna kha ṭhawl in annih cu thil lianngan le ṭihnung a tuahpiakmi hna, na mi Israel mi hna bantuk hi, vawlei cungah hin zei miphun tal an um ti maw?","ref":"Deu 4.34"},"24":{"text":"Na mi Israel cu zungzal in nangmah mi si awkah nangmah nih na caah na fehter i nangmah cu maw Bawipa, an Pathian ah na cang cang."},"25":{"text":"Cun maw Bawipa Pathian, na sal le a innchungkhar kongah na rak chimmi bia kha atu cu zungzal ca in fehter ko law, na chim bang khan tuah ko;"},"26":{"text":"cun ‘Ralkapbu Bawipa cu Israel Pathian a si,’ tiin na min cu a zungzal in upat a si lai i, na sal David innchungkhar cu nangmah hmaiah fehter si ko seh."},"27":{"text":"Zeitintiah maw ralkapbu Bawipa, Israel Pathian, nangmah nih hi phuannak cu na sal sinah, ‘Nangmah cu innchungkhar pakhat kan serpiak lai,’ tiin na rak ser cang; cucaah na sal nih nangmah sinah hi thlacamnak hi a cam ngam."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah maw Bawipa Pathian, nangmah cu Pathian na si i na bia cu biatak an si i nangmah nih hi thil ṭha cu na sal kha na kamh cang;"},"29":{"text":"cucaah atu cu na salpa innchungkhar hi na hmaiah zungzal in a um nakhnga, thluachuahnak ka pekpiak ko sawh; zeitintiah maw Bawipa Pathian, nangmah nih na chim cang i na salpa innchungkhar cu nangmah thluachuahnak in thluachuah pek si zungzal ko seh,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun mah hnuah cun, David nih Filistin mi kha a tei hna i a tangchiah hna; Metheg-ammah kha Filistin mi hna kut chung khan a lak.","title":"David Nih A Ram A Kauh (1Cha 18.1-17)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Moab kha a tei i tahnak hri in a tah hna i vawlei ah a ihter hna; tlang hnih cu thah awkin a tah i tlang khat cu pum tein zuah awkin a tah. Cun Moab mi cu David sal ah an cang i David sinah khan ngunkhuai an thawh."},"3":{"text":"Cun David nih Zufrates tiva kha uk ṭhan awk i a kalpah ah Zobah siangpahrang Rehob fapa Hadadezer zong kha a tei."},"4":{"text":"Cun David nih amah sin khan rangcung ralkap thong khat le za sarih le ke ralkap sang hnih a tlaih hna i David nih leng hnuktu rang vialte kha an tha a pheh dih hna, sihmanhsehlaw rangleng za khat ca i a za ding lawnglawng kha a nganh hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun Damaskas khuami Siria mi nih khan Zobah siangpahrang Hadadezer kha bawmh awkah an rat tikah, David nih khan Siria mi cu sang hnih le thong hnih a rak thah hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun David nih Damaskas khua chung i Aram ah khan ralvengtu ralkapbu a chiah hna i Siria mi cu David sal ah an cang i ngunkhuai kha an pek. Cun Bawipa nih David cu a kalnak kip ah khan teinak a pek lengmang."},"7":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer sinum hna nih an i putmi sui phaw hna kha David nih a lak hna i Jerusalem ah a rak phorh hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer khua a simi Betah le Berothai khan Siangpahrang David nih dar tampi a lak."},"9":{"text":"Hamath siangpahrang Toi nih Hadadezer ralkapbu kha a ning piin David nih a tei dih hna ti kha a theih tikah,"},"10":{"text":"Hadadezer kha a doh i a tei caah amah cu va biakchawnh awk le va conglawmh awkah David Siangpahrang sinah khan a fapa Joram kha a hei thlah; zeitintiah Hadadezer nih khan Toi kha a rak doh lengmang tawn. Cun Joram nih ngun kheng le sui kheng le dar kheng kha a rak i phorh hna i."},"11":{"text":"Mah hna zong cu Siangpahrang David nih Bawipa sinah a teimi miphun vialte hna sinin a lakmi sui le ngun hna he khan hmunkhat ah, a pekchanh hna;"},"12":{"text":"a teimi miphun hna cu Edom, Moab, Ammon mi, Filistin mi, Amalek mi le Zobah siangpahrang Rehob fapa Hadadezer kha an si."},"13":{"text":"Cun David cu a min a thang ngaingai ko. A ra kir tikah Edom mi sang khat le thong riat cu Cite Nelrawn ah a thah hna.","ref":"Slm 60 (A tlangpi)"},"14":{"text":"Cun Edom ram chungah ralvengtu ralkapbu kha a chiah hna; Edom ram chungah a dihlak in ralvengtu ralkapbu kha a chiah hna i Edom mi vialte cu David sal ah an cang. Cun Bawipa nih David cu a kalnak kip ah teinak a pek lengmang."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Israel mi vialte cu a pen hna i David nih a mi vialte cu biading le ruannak in a uk hna.","title":"David Bawi Hna"},"16":{"text":"Cun Zeruiah fapa Joab cu ralkapbu haotu bik a si i Ahilud fapa Jehoshafat cu cazin ṭialtu a si;"},"17":{"text":"cun Ahilud fapa Zadok le Abiathar fapa Ahimelek cu tlangbawi an si i Seraiah cu caṭialtu a si;"},"18":{"text":"cun Jehoiada fapa Benaiah cu Khereth mi hna le Peleth mi hna cung i haotu a si i David fapa hna cu tlangbawi an si."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Jonathan ruangah an cung i zaangfahnak ka langhter khawh nakhnga, Saul innchungkhar lakah khan a tangmi aho tal an um maw?” tiah a ti.","title":"David Nih Mefibosheth Kha A Zaangfah","ref":"1Sam 20.15-17"},"2":{"text":"Cun Saul innchungkhar sinum pakhat a min Ziba a simi kha a um i amah cu David sinah cun an kawh; cun siangpahrang nih amah cu, “Nangmah cu Ziba na si maw?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Amah cu na salpa hi ka si,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih, “Pathian zaangfahnak cu a cungah ka langhter khawh nakhnga, Saul innchungkhar chungin a um rihmi pakhat tal an um ti hnga lo maw?” tiah a ti. Ziba nih siangpahrang sinah cun, “Jonathan fapa pakhat a um rih; amah cu a ke a bei,” tiah a ti.","ref":"2Sam 4.4"},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih cun amah cu, “Khuazei ah dah a um?” tiah a ti. Cun Ziba nih siangpahrang sinah cun, “Amah cu Lodebar ah Ammiel fapa Makhir inn ah a um ko,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun David Siangpahrang nih mi a hei thlah hna i Lodebar i Ammiel fapa Makhir inn khan an va lak."},"6":{"text":"Cun Saul fapa Jonathan i fapa Mefibosheth cu David sinah a ra i a kun i upatnak kha a pek. Cun David nih, “Mefibosheth,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Zohhmanh, na salpa hi,” tiah a leh."},"7":{"text":"Cun David nih amah cu, “Na thinphang hlah; na pa Jonathan ruangah na cungah zaangfahnak kan hmuhsak lai i na pu Saul ram vialte kha kan khirh ṭhan lai; cun ka cabuai ah rawl na ei zungzal lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun upatnak kha a tuah i, “Na salpa hi zeidah ka si i uico thi cia bantuk keimah hi na ka hramh?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Saul sinum Ziba kha a auh i, “Saul ta a simi thil vialte le a innchungkhar vialte ta a simi kha na bawipa i a fapa sinah hin ka pek cang."},"10":{"text":"Cun nangmah le na fapa hna le na sinum hna nih amah vawlei cu nan thlawhpiak lai i na bawipa fapa hi cu ka cabuai ah rawl a ei zungzal lai,” tiah a ti. Ziba cu fapa hleinga le sinum pakul a ngei."},"11":{"text":"Cun Ziba nih siangpahrang cu, “Siangpahrang ka bawipa nih a salpa a ka fial ningin, cu bantukin na salpa nih ka tuah dih lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Mefibosheth cu, siangpahrang fapa pakhat ve bantukin David cabuai ah khan rawl a ei."},"12":{"text":"Cun Mefibosheth nih fapa note pakhat a ngei i a min cu Mika a si. Cun Ziba inn chung i khua a sami vialte kha Mefibosheth sinum ah an cang dih."},"13":{"text":"Cuticun Mefibosheth cu Jerusalem ah a um; zeitintiah siangpahrang cabuai ah khan rawl a ei zungzal. Amah cu a ke a pahnih in a bei."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun mah hnuah cun Ammon mi hna siangpahrang cu a thi i a fapa Hanun nih amah hmun ah khan bawi a cang.","title":"Ammon Mi le Siria Mi Kha A Tei Hna (1Cha 19.1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih a thawh i, “Nahash fapa Hanun hi a pa nih ka cungah zumhawktlak tein a rak um bantuk khan a cungah zumhawktlak tein ka um ve lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David nih a pa kong ah khan amah cu va hnemh awkah a sinum a hei thlah hna. Cun David sinum hna cu Ammon mi hna ram chungah khan an va phan."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ammon mi an bawi hna nih khan an bawipa Hanun cu, “David nih nangmah sinah hnemtu a hun thlah hna caah hin na pa kha a upat tiin maw na ruah? David nih hin khua chung hi kawl awk le ngiatthlai awk le tei awkah a sinum hna hi a hun thlah hna, a si lo maw?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Hanun nih David sinum hna cu a lak hna i an khahmul a hnarcheu cio a meh hna i an khelbo zawn ah an puan cu a laifang in a tan hna i a kalter hna."},"5":{"text":"Mah cucu David kha an chimh tikah anmah don awkah mi a hei thlah hna; zeitintiah an ning a zak ngaingai ko. Cun siangpahrang nih cun, “Nan khahmul a corh ṭhan hlan tiang Jeriko khua ah cam ko u, cun nan ra kir ṭhan te lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Ammon mi hna nih annih cu David huat kan phor cang ti kha an theih tikah, Ammon mi hna nih cun mi an hei thlah hna i Beth-rehob i Siria mi hna le Zobah i Siria mi hna, ke ralkap sang hnih le Maakah ram siangpahrang le a mi thong khat, cun Tobram mi sang khat le thong hnih kha an i ruaih hna."},"7":{"text":"Mah cucu David nih a theih tikah Joab le a ṭhawngmi ralkapbu vialte kha a thlah hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Ammon mi hna cu an ra chuak i hauka luhnak ah khan raldoh awkah an i tiang; cun Zobah le Rehob i Siria mi hna le Tob le Maakah mi hna cu anmah tein ramlak ah cun an um ve ko."},"9":{"text":"Joab nih hmailei he hnulei he an ka tuk lai ti kha a hmuh tikah, Israel mi chungin thim khunmi a cheu kha a thim hna i Siria mi dohtu dingah khan a ningcang tein ṭan hmun a khuarter hna;"},"10":{"text":"cun a tang rihmi a mi hna cu a unau Abishai kut tangah a chiah hna i Ammon mi hna dohtu dingah khan a ningcang tein ṭan hmun a khuarter hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Siria mi hi ka caah an ṭhawn tuk ahcun na ka bawmh lai; sihmanhsehlaw Ammon mi hna kha na caah an ṭhawn tuk ahcun, ka ra lai i kan bawmh lai."},"12":{"text":"Ralṭha ngaiin um tuah, cun kan mi hna le kan Pathian khua hna caah hin pasal si u sih; cun Bawipa nih a ṭha a tining paoh in tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Joab le a sin i a ummi hna nih cun i tuk awkah Siria mi cu an hei fuh hna i an hmaiah cun an zam."},"14":{"text":"Cun Ammon mi hna nih Siria mi an zam ti an hmuh tikah annih zong, cu bantukin Abishai hmai khan an zam ve i khua chungah khan an lut. Cun Joab cu Ammon mi he i tuknak khan a kir i Jerusalem ah a tlung."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Siria mi hna nih Israel mi nih an kan tei ti kha an hmuh tikah, hmunkhat ah an i pum ṭhan."},"16":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer nih mi a hei thlah hna i Zufrates tiva ral i a ummi Siria mi hna kha an ratpi hna; Hadadezar ralkap phu ralbawi Shobak nih khan a hrui hna i Helam an ra phan."},"17":{"text":"Mah cucu David kha an chimh tikah Israel mi vialte kha hmun khat ah a pumh hna i Jordan tiva kha an tan i Helam kha an phan. Cun Siria mi nih khan David doh awkah cun a ningcang tein ṭan hmun an rak khuar i amah he cun an i tu."},"18":{"text":"Cun Siria mi cu Israel mi hna hmai in an zaam i David nih mi chungin rangleng za sarih aa citmi hna le rangcung ralkap sang li kha a thah hna i an ralkapbu ralbawi Shobak kha a hliam i cucaah cun khika ah a thi."},"19":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer sal a simi siangpahrang vialte nih khan Israel mi nih an kan tei ti kha an hmuh tikah, Israel mi he cun remnak an ser i an kut tangmi ah an cang. Cucaah Siria mi nih Ammon mi hna bawmh kha an ngamh ti lo."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ṭhal a hung chuak i siangpahrang hna nih raltuknak hmun i an kal tawn caan ah khan, David nih Joab le a sin i a ummi a sinum vialte hna le Israel mi vialte kha a thlah hna i annih nih Ammon mi kha an hrawh dih hna i Rabbah kha an dum. Sihmanhsehlaw David cu Jerusalem khua ah khan a um ko.","title":"David le Bathsheba Kong","ref":"1Cha 20.1"},"2":{"text":"Cun ni khat cu zanlei sang ah khin David cu a ihkhun in a tho i siangpahrang inncung i aa chawh tikah, inncung cun minu pakhat aa kholh lio kha a hei hmuh; cun cu nu cu aa dawh ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Cun David nih mi a hei thlah hna i minu kong kha a hlat. Cun pakhat nih, “Mah nu hi Eliam fanu Bathsheba, Hit mi Uriah nupi kha a si lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah David nih lamkal a hei thlah hna i an va lak; cun a sinah a ra i a rak ihpi. (A nuphung thian lonak in aa thianh lio kha a si). Cun a inn ah khan a kir ṭhan."},"5":{"text":"Cun minu cu fa a pawi i mi a hei thlah hna i David cu, “Fa ka pawi,” tiah a chimh."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Joab kha bia a hei cah i, “Hit mi Uriah kha rak ka kua,” tiah a ti. Cun Joab nih Uriah cu David sinah a kuat."},"7":{"text":"Uriah cu amah sinah a rat tikah David nih zeitindah Joab le mi hna kha an ningcang a si le, zeitindah raldohnak a umtu ning a si kha a hal."},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih Uriah cu, “Na inn ah vung kal law, na ke vung i ṭawl,” tiah a ti. Cun Uriah cu siangpahrang inn khan a chuak i siangpahrang laksawng nih a hei zulh colh."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Uriah cu a bawipa sinum vialte hna sinah siangpahrang inn innka ah khan a it i a inn ah a vung kal lo."},"10":{"text":"Cun David kha, “Uriah cu a inn ah a vung kal lo,” tiah an chimh tikah David nih Uriah cu a thawh i, “Khual tlawnnak in na rung tlung a si lo mei, zeicahdah na inn ah na vung kal lo?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Uriah nih David cu, “Israel le Judah le kuang cu thlam chungah an um i ka bawipa Joab le ka bawipa i a sal hna cu ramlak ah an riak ko; cu ti a si ko lioah cun maw, va ei va din awk le ka nupi he va um awkah, ka inn ah cun ka vung kal hnga? Nangmah na nun bantuk le na nunnak a nun bantukin, mah cucu ka tuah lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih Uriah cu, “Nihin zong hika ah hin cam law, thaizing ah kan kalter lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Uriah cu, cu ni le a thaizing cu Jerusalem ah a cam."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih a sawm i a hmaika ah cun a ei a ding, cucaah a ritter; cun a zanlei ah a bawipa sinum hna sin i va ih awkah a chuak, sihmanhsehlaw a inn ah a vung kal lo."},"14":{"text":"A thaizing ah David nih Joab sinah ca a kuat i Uriah cu a phorhter."},"15":{"text":"A ca chungah cun, “Uriah cu ral hratnak bik hmun hmaisuang bik ah khan na chiah lai i an tuk i a thih naklai hnulei ah nan tawntak te lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Joab nih khan khua kha a dum lioah ralṭhami an umnak hmun ti i a hngalhmi kha Uriah cu a thiah."},"17":{"text":"Cun khua chung mi cu an hung chuak i Joab he cun an i do; cun cu mi hna lakah cun David salle zong tlawmpal an thi. Hit mi Uriah zong a thi ve."},"18":{"text":"Cun Joab nih mi a hei thlah i an i tuknak kong vialte cu David kha a chimh,"},"19":{"text":"cun zualko kha bia a beuh i, “Raltuknak kong vialte kha siangpahrang sinah na chim dih tikah,"},"20":{"text":"siangpahrang cu a thin a phawh i na sinah, ‘Zeicahdah doh awk i nan kal tikah khua cu nan va naih tuk? Ralhau vampang cungin an kan kah lai tiah nan hngal lo maw?"},"21":{"text":"Aho nih dah Jerubbesheth fapa Abimelek kha a rak thah kha? Nu pakhat nih changvut rialnak lung a cunglei kha vampang in a vun thlakhnawh i Thebez ah khan a thi a si lo mei? Zeicahdah ralhau naih vampang naih tuk hringhran ah cun nan va kal?’ a ti ahcun, ‘Na salpa Uriah, Hit mi zong kha a thi ve,’ tiah na ti te lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Biac 9.53"},"22":{"text":"Cucaah zualko cu a va kal i Joab nih na va chim lai ti i a thlahhnawh chanmi vialte kha David cu a va chimh."},"23":{"text":"Zualko nih khan David cu, “Mi hna nih khan an kan tei deuh i ramlak ah khan an kan nam; sihmanhsehlaw hauka luhnak tiang kan en ṭhan hna."},"24":{"text":"Khi tikah thal kah thiam pawl nih na salle cu an kan kah i siangpahrang sal tlawmpal cu an thi; na sal Uriah, Hit mi zong kha a thi ve,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"David nih zualko sinah cun, “Hi bangin Joab sinah cun, ‘Hi thil hi na lungre i theihter hlah, zeicahtiah vainam nih cun atu ah pakhat, cun a hnuah a dang pakhat tiin pei a thah phung a si ko cu; khua na dohnak cu ṭhawnter chin law hrawk dih tuah,’ a ti tiah na va chim lai. Cun amah cu thazang na va pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Uriah nupi nih a va Uriah a thi ti kha a theih tikah a va zun cu a ngai."},"27":{"text":"Cun a ngaihnak kha a dih tikah, David nih a hei cah i a inn ah a ratter i a nupi ah a cang i fapa a hrinpiak. Sihmanhsehlaw David tuahmi thil nih cun Bawipa kha lunglawm loin a tuah."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Nathan kha David sinah a hei thlah. Amah sinah cun a ra i, “Khua pakhat ah hin mi pahnih an um i pakhat cu a rummi a si i pakhat cu sifakmi a si.","title":"Nathan Nih David Kha A Sik","ref":"Slm 51 (A tlangpi)"},"2":{"text":"Mirumpa nih cun tuurun le cawrun tam ngaingai a ngeih hna i"},"3":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw misifakpa nih cun a cawkmi tuu a nute pakhat lawng khi a ngeih. Cun amah nih cun a cawm i a fale hna he cun an ṭhang ṭi, a kheng le a hrai kha aa hrawm ve tawn i a ṭang chungah a pom tawn, amah cu a caah fanu bantuk a si ko."},"4":{"text":"Voi khat cu, mirumpa cu khualtlung pakhat a ngei i amah tuurun chungin siseh, caw run chungin siseh, sa cu thah duh riangmang loin, misifakpa tuufate tu cu a lak i a khualpa cu a thah,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun mipa cungah cun David thinhunnak cu a alh ciammam i Nathan sinah cun, “ Bawipa nih a nun bangin, mah thil a tuahtu hi thih awk a tlak;"},"6":{"text":"hi thil a tuah caah le zaangfahnak a ngeih lo caah a tuufate kha let li in a cham awk a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Nathan nih David cu a thawh i, “Mipa cu nangmah hi na si. Hi bangin Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, ‘Nangmah cu Israel mi siangpahrang ah chiti kan thuh i Saul kut chungin kan chuah;"},"8":{"text":"cun na bawipa inn cu kan pek i na bawipa nupi hna cu nangmah ṭang chungah kan pek hna, cun Israel mi chungkhar hna le Judah mi chungkhar hna cu kan pek hna; cun mah hihi a tlawm tuk ahcun, cu zat cu kan chap rih lai."},"9":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka mithmuh i ṭhat lonak tuah awkah Bawipa ka bia cu na zawmhtaih? Hit mi Uriah cu vainam in na tuk i a nupi cu nupi ah naa lak i amah cu Ammon mi hna vainam in na thah."},"10":{"text":"Cun nangmah nih na ka zawmhtaih i Hit mi Uriah nupi kha na nupi ah naa lak caah, cucaah vainam cu na inn in aa ṭhen bal lai lo,’ a ti."},"11":{"text":"Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Zohhmanh, nangmah inn chung lila in ṭhat lonak nangmah cungah ka chuahter lai i na mitka hrimhrim ah na nupile hna cu ka lak hna lai i na innpa kha ka pek hna lai i hi ni ka hmuh hngan ah hin na nupile cu a ihpi hna lai.","ref":"2Sam 16.22"},"12":{"text":"Zeitintiah nang nih cun hi thil hi a thli tein na tuah, sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun hi thil hi Israel mi vialte hna hmai le chun khua ceu ah ka tuah lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih Nathan sinah cun, “ Bawipa sinah ka sual cang,” tiah a ti. Cun Nathan nih David cu, “ Bawipa zong nih na sualnak kha an ngaihthiam cang, na thi lai lo."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mah hi thil na tuah thawngin Bawipa kha na zawmhtaih ngaingai cang caah, na hrinmi na fa cu a thi lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Nathan cu a inn ah a ṭin."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, Uriah nupi nih David a hrinpiakmi fa cu a tuk i a zaw."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Bawipa kha ngakchia caah cun a nawl; cun David cu rawl a ul i a lut i vawlei ah zan khuadei a ril ko."},"17":{"text":"Cun inn chung i upa hna nih khan amah cu vawlei khan thawhter awkah a pawngin an dirhnawh; sihmanhsehlaw a tho duh lo, anmah sinah rawl zong a ei duh lo."},"18":{"text":"A ni sarihnak ah ngakchia cu a thi.
