Cucaah Bawipa bia cu an ngaih i Bawipa bia bangin an inn cio ah an kir ṭhan."},"25":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nih Efraim tlangram ah Shekhem kha a sak i khika ah a um; cun khika in a chuak i Penuel kha a sak.","title":"Jeroboam Nih Israel Mi Sualnak Ah A Luhpi Hna"},"26":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nih a lung chungin, “Atu cu pennak hi David innchungkhar sinah a kir ṭhan ko lai,"},"27":{"text":"hi mi hna nih hin Jerusalem khua chung i Bawipa inn ah raithawinak pekchanh awkah an hung kal ahcun, khi tikah hi mi hna lung hi an bawipa, Judah siangpahrang Rehoboam sinah khan a kir lai i kei cu an ka thah lai i Judah siangpahrang Rehoboam sinah khan an kir ṭhan lai,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nih ruahnak a hal hna i sui cawfa pahnih a ser. Cun mizapi kha a thawh hna i, “Jerusalem i nan hung kal lengmang hi a za cang. Maw Israel mi hna, Izipt ram in a hun in chuahpitu hna nan pathian hi zoh tuah hna u,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 32.4"},"29":{"text":"Cun pakhat cu Bethel ah a chiah i a dang pakhat cu Dan ah a chiah."},"30":{"text":"Cun mah thil hi sualnak ah a cang, zeitintiah mi nih Bethel i a ummi sinah khan le a dang Dan i a ummi tiang khan an kalhnawh hna."},"31":{"text":"Khuahrum bo hna ah khan inn a sak hna i mi hna chung khan, Levi miphun a si lomi kha tlangbawi ah a chiah hna."},"32":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nih thla riatnak thla a ni hleinga ni ah khan, Judah ram chung i a ummi puai bantuk puai pakhat ngeih awk a si lai, a ti i biakṭheng cungah raithawinak kha a pekchanh hna; cu bangin Bethel khua ah cun a tuah, amah nih a sermi cawfa hna kha raithawinak a pekchanh hna. Cun khuahrum bo a sermi ca i tlangbawi hna cu Bethel ah a chiah hna.","ref":"Lev 23.33-34"},"33":{"text":"Bethel khua chung i a ummi, amah nih a sermi biakṭheng ah cun, amah nih amah lung chung tein a tuaktanmi thla, thla riatnak thla, a ni hleinga ni ah cun a hung kal i Israel mi caah puai pakhat kha a fehter i zihmui khangh awkah biakṭheng ah khan a hung kal."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, Judah ram chungin Pathian mi pakhat, Bawipa bia thawngin Bethel ah a ra. Jeroboam kha zihmui khangh awkah biakṭheng pawngah khan a rak dir ko.","title":"Judah Ram Profet Nih Jeroboam Cu Ralrinnak A Pek"},"2":{"text":"Cun mipa nih cun Bawipa bia in biakṭheng cu a auhnawh i, “Maw biakṭheng, biakṭheng, Bawipa nih hi bangin a ti: ‘Zohhmanh, David innchungkhar chungah fapa pakhat, a min Josiah a simi a chuak lai; cun nangmah cung i zihmui a khangmi khuahrum bo tlangbawi hna cu nangmah cungah hin rai ah a thawi hna lai i mi ruh cu nangmah cungah hin khangh a si lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"2Sia 23.15-16"},"3":{"text":"Cun cu ni ṭhiamṭhiam ah cun hmelchunhnak pakhat a pek i, “Mah hihi Bawipa nih a chimmi hmelchunhnak cu a si: ‘Zohhmanh, biakṭheng kha a cim lai i a cung i a ummi vutcam hna cu thlet an si lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Pathian mi nih Bethel biakṭheng a chimhnawhchanmi bia kha siangpahrang nih a theih tikah, Jeroboam nih cun biakṭheng cun a kut a hei samh i, “Tlai u,” tiah a ti. Cun a hei samhmi a kut cu a car i cucaah amah leiah a tum ṭhan kho ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Pathian bia in Pathian mi nih hmelchunhnak a tuahterning khan, biakṭheng zong cu a cim i biakṭheng cung i vutcam cu an hlonh hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Pathian mi cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa na Pathian cu ka nawlpiak law, thla ka campiak tuah, ka kut hi a dam ṭhan nakhnga,” tiah a ti. Cun Pathian mi nih Bawipa cu a nawl i siangpahrang cu a kut kha a dam ṭhan i hmasa i bantuk kha a si ṭhan."},"7":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Pathian mi cu a thawh i, “Ka sinah ka inn ah ra law, i hrim tuah, laksawng kan ṭhenh lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Pathian mi nih siangpahrang cu, “Na inn a cheu hmanh ka pe law nangmah sinah ka lut lai lo. Cun hi hmun ah hin changreu zong ka ei lai lo, ti zong ka ding lai lo;"},"9":{"text":"zeitintiah cuticun Bawipa bia nih nawl a ka pek i, ‘Rawl zong na ei lai lo, ti zong na ding lai lo, na ratnak lam zongin na kir ṭhan lai lo,’ a ka ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah lam dang in a kal i Bethel i a ratnak lam khan cun a kir ṭhan lo."},"11":{"text":"Bethel khua ah cun profet tar pakhat hi a um. Cun a fapa hna cu an ra i khi ni ah Pathian mi nih Bethel i a tuahmi vialte kha an chimh; siangpahrang sinah a chimmi bia zong kha an pa cu an chimh."},"12":{"text":"Cun an pa nih cun a thawh hna i, “Khuazei lei lam in dah a kal?” tiah a ti hna. Cun a fapa hna nih cun Pathian mi, Judah ram in a rami a kalnak lam kha an hmuhsak."},"13":{"text":"Cun a fapale cu a thawh hna i, “Laa kha ka danhpiak u,” tiah a ti. Cucaah laa kha an danhpiak i aa cit."},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian mi cu a hei dawi i kuhthing toi i a rak ṭhut ko kha a hmuh; cun a thawh i, “Nangmah hi Judah ram in a rami, Pathian mi cu na si maw?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “Ka si,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun anih nih amah cu, “Inn ah ka sinah ra law rawl ra ei tuah,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Na sinah kir awk ka si lo i nangmah sinah luh awk zong ka si lo; hi hmun ah hin nangmah sinah rawl zong ka ei lai lo, ti zong ka ding lai lo;"},"17":{"text":"zeitintiah Pathian bia nih hi bangin ka sinah, ‘Khika ah rawl zong na ei lai lo i ti zong na ding lai lo, na ratnak lam zongin na kir lai lo,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih amah cu a thawh i, “Keimah zong hi nangmah bantukin profet ka si ve, Bawipa bia in vancungmi pakhat nih pei ka sinah a chim i, ‘Rawl a ei i ti a din nakhnga, na inn ah hin hun kirpi ṭhan,’ a ti cu,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw amah cu lih a chimh a si."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah amah sinah a kir i a inn chungah rawl a ei i ti a din."},"20":{"text":"Cun cabuai i an ṭhut lioah khan a kirpi ṭhantu profet sinah khan Pathian bia cu a ra i,"},"21":{"text":"Judah ram in a rami Pathian mi sinah khan, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘ Bawipa bia kha na ngaih lo i Bawipa na Pathian nih nawl an pekmi nawlbia cu na zulh lo i,"},"22":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw na ra kir i, “Rawl ei hlah, ti ding hlah,” tiah a tinak hmun ah khan rawl na ei i ti na din caah, na pum cu na pupa hna thlan ah a phan lai lo,’ a ti,” tiah a au."},"23":{"text":"Cun rawl kha a ei i ti kha a din dih hnuah, a rak kirpimi profet kha laa cu a danhpiak."},"24":{"text":"Cun a kal lioah khan lam ah chiandeih nih a ton i a seh. Cun a pum cu lam ah cun a tla i laa cu a pawngah khan a dir ko; chiandeih zong cu a ruak pawngah cun a dir ve ko."},"25":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, mi an va kal i lam i a ruak a rilh ko i a ruak pawng i chiandeih a dir ko kha an hmuh. Cun an ra i profet tarpa a umnak khua ah khan mah cucu an ra chim."},"26":{"text":"Cun lam in a hun kirpi ṭhantu profet nih khan mah cucu a theih tikah, “Pathian mi, Bawipa bia zulh a duh lo mipa kha a si cu ta; cucaah Bawipa nih amah cu a chimhmi bia ningin, Bawipa nih amah cu chiandeih kha a pek i a rak thleh bauh i a rak thah,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun a fapale kha a thawh hna i, “Laa kha ka danhpiak u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun annih nih an danh."},"28":{"text":"Cun a va kal i a ruak cu lam i a rak rilh ko i laa le chiandeih kha a ruak pawng i an rak dir ko kha a hmuh. Chiandeih nih khan a ruak cu a rak ei lo, laa zong kha a thlek bauh lo."},"29":{"text":"Cun profet nih khan Pathian mi ruak cu a lak i laa cungah khan a chuan i ṭah awk le vui awkah khua ah khan a kirpi ṭhan."},"30":{"text":"Cun a ruak kha amah thlan ah khan a vui; cun amah cu an ṭah i, “Aize! ka naupa,” an ti."},"31":{"text":"Cun a vui dih hnuah a fapa hna sinah khan, “Ka thih tikah, Pathian mi ka vuinak thlan ah hin run ka vui te u, ka ruh hna cu a ruh pawngah hin run chia hna u."},"32":{"text":"Zeitintiah Pathian bia thawngin Bethel biakṭheng le Samaria ram chung khua i a ummi khuahrumbo hna inn vialte kong i a chimmi bia vialte kha a tling hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Hi thil hnu zongah hin Jeroboam cu lam ṭhalo a zulhmi khan aa mer hlei lo, sihmanhsehlaw khuahrumbo ca i tlangbawi cu mi zapi lak khan a ser hna; tlangbawi si a duhmi paoh kha khuahrumbo tlangbawi caah cun a thianter duahmah ko hna."},"34":{"text":"Cun mah hihi Jeroboam innchungkhar an ci a hmittu le vawlei cungin a hrawktu hna sualnak ah khan a cang."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan ah Jeroboam fapa Abijah kha a zaw.","title":"Ahijah Nih Jeroboam A Chimhchung"},"2":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nih a nupi kha a thawh i, “Tho law, Jeroboam nupi na si kha hngalh lo dingin i hleng law, Shiloh ah va kal tuah; zohhmanh, khika ah profet Ahijah kha a um, amah cu keimah kha, hi mi hna cungah siangpahrang na si lai, a ka titu kha a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun changreu tlang hra, changreu thlum tlawmpal le khuaihliti thawl khat in i phorh law amah sinah cun va kal tuah; amah nih ngakchia hi zeitindah a um lai kha a rak in chimh lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jeroboam nupi nih cu bang cun a tuah; a tho i Shiloh ah a kal i Ahijah inn kha a va phan. Ahijah cu khua a hmu kho ti lo, zeicahtiah a kum a upa cang i a mit khua a hmu ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Ahijah cu a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, Jeroboam nupi cu nangmah kha a fapa kong hal awkah na sinah a ra lio; zeitintiah amah cu a zaw. Amah cu hitin na rak chimh lai,” tiah a ti. A rat tikah nu dang bantuk aa siter."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw innka i a vung luh i ke thawng kha Ahijah nih a theih tikah, “Rung lut tuah, Jeroboam nupi; zeicahdah midang bantuk naa siter? Zeitintiah nangmah ca i thawng chia ngai chim awk kha fial ka si."},"7":{"text":"Va kal law Jeroboam kha, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, “Nangmah cu mi zapi hna lakin kan hlorh i ka mi Israel mi hna hruaitu ah kan ser i"},"8":{"text":"David innchungkhar sinin pennak kha ka thleh i nangmah kha kan pek; asinain, ka nawlbia kha a ul hna i a lung dihlak in a ka zul i ka mithmuh ah a dingmi lawng a tuahtu ka sal David bantuk kha nang cu na si lo,"},"9":{"text":"nang tu nih cun na hlan i a rak ummi vialte hna nakin thil ṭhalo na tuah deuh i pathian dang le thletmi milem kha na ser hna, ka thin na ka phawh i na hnulei ah na ka hlonh;"},"10":{"text":"cucaah zohhmanh, Jeroboam innchungkhar cungah ṭhat lonak ka tlunter lai i Jeroboam sin hin pa paohpaoh, Israel mi chung i miluat si hna seh, miluat lo si hna seh, ka hloh hna lai i, mi nih ek cu an khangh hirhiar bangin, Jeroboam innchungkhar cu ka khangh cikcek hna lai.","ref":"1Sia 15.29"},"11":{"text":"Jeroboam chungkhar a simi paoh khuapi chungah a thimi cu uico nih an ei lai; ramlak i a thimi cu van i a zuangmi va nih an ei lai, zeicahtiah Bawipa nih a chim cang,” a ti,” tiah va chim."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah tho law na inn ah va kal tuah. Na ke nih khua chung a lamh ah khin ngakchia cu a thi lai."},"13":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte nih an ṭah lai i an vui lai; zeitintiah Jeroboam chungkhat hna lakah amah lawnglawng hi thlan ah vui a si lai; zeicahtiah Jeroboam chungkhar chungah hin amah ah hin cun Bawipa, Israel Pathian i a ṭha a timi thil zeimaw a um."},"14":{"text":"Cuhleiah nihin ah Jeroboam innchungkhar a hloral ding Israel mi siangpahrang pakhat Bawipa nih aa serh lai. Cun hi hnuah cun,"},"15":{"text":"ti chungah phaikung aa hninh lengmang bantuk khin Bawipa nih Israel cu a tuk lai i annih nih an Asherim an i ser hnanak thawngin Bawipa kha a thin an hunter caah, an pupa hna sinah a pekmi hi ram ṭha chung hin Israel mi cu a phawi hna lai i Zufrates tiva ral ah khin a ṭhek hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu, Jeroboam amah sualnak ruang le Jeroboam nih Israel mi a sualter hnanak ruangah khan, a hlawt hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nupi cu a tho i a kal i Tirzah khua kha a phan. Cun cu inn innka hram a va phak tikah ngakchia kha a thi."},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih a sal profet Ahijah in a chimmi bia ning khan Israel mi vialte nih an vui i an ṭah."},"19":{"text":"Jeroboam tuahsernak a tang rihmi, zeitindah ral a tuk ti tehna, zeitindah a pen ti tehna cu, zohhmanh, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial."},"20":{"text":"Cun Jeroboam nih a pen chung cu kum kul le kum hnih a si; a pupa hna sinah khan a it i a fapa Nadab kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"21":{"text":"Cun Solomon fapa Rehoboam nih khan Judah ram cu a pen. Pen hram aa thawk ah khan Rehoboam cu kum sawm li le kum khat a si i, Bawipa nih Israel mi phun vialte chungin amah min chiahnak caah aa thimmi Jerusalem khua ah khan kum hleisarih a bawi. A nu min cu Naamah a si, Ammon minu a si.","title":"Rehoboam Pennak (2Cha 12.1-16)"},"22":{"text":"Cun Judah mi nih Bawipa mithmuh i a ṭha lomi thil kha an tuah i an pupa hna nih an tuahmi vialte nakin tam deuh in an tuahmi sualnak cun Bawipa cu a nahchuahnak an thawhter."},"23":{"text":"Zeitintiah annih zong nih khuahrum bo tehna, lungphun tehna, Asherim tehna kha tlang sang kip cung le thinghring tang kip ah an i ser i","ref":"2Sia 17.9-10"},"24":{"text":"cu ram chungah biaknak lei pa hlawhhlang zong an um. Israel mi hna hmai in Bawipa nih a ṭhawlmi miphun hna nih an tuahmi fihnung vialte kha an tuah ve.","ref":"Deu 23.17"},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam, siangpahrang a si a kum nganak ah Izipt siangpahrang Shishak nih Jerusalem kha a hung doh;"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa inn chung rothil le siangpahrang inn chung rothil kha a lak hna; zeizong vialte kha a lak dih hna. Solomon nih a sermi sui phaw vialte zong kha a lak hna i","ref":"1Sia 10.16-17; 2Cha 9.15-16"},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam nih anmah can ah cun dar phaw a ser hna i siangpahrang inn innka a cawngtu ralkap bawi hna kut chungah khan a chiah hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Bawipa inn chungah a luh fate, ralvengtu nih khan an i put hna i ralvengtu hna khaan ah khan an rak chiah ṭhan tawn hna."},"29":{"text":"Rehoboam tuahsernak a tang rihmi le a tuahmi vialte cu Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"30":{"text":"Cun Rehoboam le Jeroboam karlak ah khan ral a um thluangthluan."},"31":{"text":"Cun Rehoboam cu a pupa hna sinah khan a it i David khua chungah khan a pupa hna sinah cun an vui. A nu min cu Naamah a si, amah cu Ammon minu a si. Cun a fapa Abijam kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nebat fapa Jeroboam Siangpahrang, a bawi kum hleiriat kum ah khan, Abijam nih Judah ram uk hram aa thawk cu a si.","title":"Abijam Pennak (2Cha 13.1—14.1)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ah kum thum bawi a si. A nu min cu Maakah a si, Abishalom fanu a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun amah hlan i a pa nih a rak tuahmi sualnak vialte chungah khan a kal ve i a pu David lung bantuk kha si loin, a lung cu Bawipa a Pathian sinah khan a dihlak in aa biatak ngaingai lo."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David ruangah, Bawipa a Pathian nih Jerusalem khua ah meiinn pakhat a pek, amah hnuah a fapa cu a hun thawhter i Jerusalem kha a fehter;","ref":"1Sia 11.36"},"5":{"text":"zeicahtiah David nih Bawipa mithmuh i a dingmi kha a tuah i Hit mi Uriah kong ah khan dah ti lo ahcun nawl a pekmi paoh kha a nun chung vialte pakhat hmanh a pialtak hna lo.","ref":"2Sam 11.1-27"},"6":{"text":"Cun a nun chung vialte, Rehoboam le Jeroboam karlak ah khan ral a um zungzal."},"7":{"text":"Abijam tuahsernak a tang rihmi le a tuahmi vialte hna cu, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei? Cun Abijam le Jeroboam karlak ah khan ral a um."},"8":{"text":"Cun Abijam cu a pupa hna sinah a it i David khua ah khan an vui, cun a fapa Asa kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"9":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam a bawi kum kul kum ah Asa nih Judah ram pen hram aa thawk,","title":"Asa Pennak (2Cha 14.1-5 ; 15.19)"},"10":{"text":"Jerusalem ah kum sawm li le kum khat a bawi. A pi min cu Maakah, Abishalom fanu a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun a pu David nih a rak tuah bang khan, Asa nih Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi thil kha a tuah."},"12":{"text":"Biaknak lei pa hlawhhlang kha ram chungin a dawi hna i a pupa nih an sermi siasal vialte kha a ṭhial hna."},"13":{"text":"A nu Maakah zong kha, Asherah caah fihnung siasal a ser caah siangpahrang bawinu a sinak kha a ngolter; cun Asa nih a nu milem cu a hau i Kidron tivate ah khan a khangh."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khuahrum bo hna kha cu a hrawk hna lo. Asinain, Asa cu a nun chung vialte, Bawipa leiah a lung dihlak in aa biatak ko."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn chungah khan a pa biakamnak laksawng hna le amah biakamnak laksawng hna, ngun, sui le umkheng hna kha a rak put hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun Asa le Baasha, Israel siangpahrang karlak ah khan, an chan chung vialte ral a um.","title":"Asa le Benhadad An Ṭangṭi (2Cha 6.1-14)"},"17":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Baasha nih Judah ram kha a hung doh i Judah siangpahrang sinah ahohmanh chuahter lo le luhter lonak caah Ramah khua kha a ser."},"18":{"text":"Cun Asa nih Bawipa inn chung le siangpahrang inn chung i a tangmi ro ngun, le sui vialte kha a lak hna i a sal hna kut chungah khan a pek hna; cun Siangpahrang Asa nih cun Hezion fapa Tabrimmon i fapa Benhadad, Siria siangpahrang, Damaskas khua i a ummi sinah khan mi a thlah hna i,"},"19":{"text":"“Ka pa le na pa karlak i a rak um bangkhan, keimah le nangmah karlak ah ṭanṭinak um seh: zohhmanh, laksawng ah ngun le sui kan kuat; cucaah va kal law Israel siangpahrang Baasha nih hin a ka kirtak nakhnga, amah he nan ṭanṭinak kha chat tuah,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Benhadad nih Siangpahrang Asa kha a bia a ngaih i a ralkapbu haotu hna kha Israel mi khua doh awkah a thlah hna i Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maakah le Khinneroth vialte kha, Naftali ram vialte he an tei dih."},"21":{"text":"Cun mah cucu Baasha nih a theih tikah, Ramah khua ser kha a ngol i Tirzah khua ah khan khua a sa."},"22":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Asa nih Judah ram dihlak ah thawng a thanh hna, pakhat hmanh an luat lo, Ramah khua sernak ah Baasha nih a rak hmanmi lung le thing vialte kha an thiar dih i cu thingrua cun Siangpahrang Asa nih Mizpah khua le Benjamin ram i Geba khua kha a ser hna."},"23":{"text":"Asa tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a ṭhawnnak vialte, a tuahmi vialte le khua a sermi vialte hna cu, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei? Sihmanhsehlaw a tar leiah a ke ah hma a ing."},"24":{"text":"Cun Asa cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a pupa hna sinah cun a pu David khua chungah an vui i a fapa Jehoshafat kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"25":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa bawi kum hnihnak ah Jeroboam fapa Nadab nih khan Israel mi cu uk hram a thawk hna; Israel mi cu kum hnih a uk hna.","title":"Nadab Pennak"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah i a pa lam kha a zul ve i a pa nih Israel mi a sualter hnanak a sualnak kha a tuah ve."},"27":{"text":"Issakhar chungkhar mi Ahijah i fapa Baasha nih amah cu a rawi i Filistin mi ta a simi Gibbethon khua ah khan Baasha nih cun a thah; Nadab le Israel mi vialte nih Gibbethon cu an dum lio a rak si."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun Baasha nih, Judah siangpahrang Asa a bawi kum thumnak ah cun Nadab kha a thah i amah hmun ah cun amah cu a bawi."},"29":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang a can kate in Jeroboam innchungkhar vialte cu a thah dih hna; Bawipa nih a sal Ahijah Shilon mi sinah a rak chimmi bia ningte khan, a hrawh dih hlantiang, Jeroboam hrinthlak hna lakah khan thaw a chuahmi pakhat hmanh a ngan hna lo;","ref":"1Sia 14.10"},"30":{"text":"mah cucu, Jeroboam nih amah nih a sualmi sualnak hna le Israel mi a sualtermi hna sualnak ruang le Bawipa, Israel Pathian a thin a phawh caah khan a si."},"31":{"text":"Nadab tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a tuahmi vialte cu, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"32":{"text":"Cun Asa le Israel siangpahrang Baasha karlak ah khan, an chan chung vialte ral a um."},"33":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa a bawi kum thumnak ah Ahijah fapa Baasha nih Israel mi vialte cu Tirzah khua in uk hram a thawk hna i kum kul le kum li a uk hna.","title":"Baasha Pennak"},"34":{"text":"Cun Bawipa mithmuh i a ṭha lomi kha a tuah i Jeroboam lam kha a zul i Israel mi a sualtermi hna sualnak a rak tuahmi kha a tuah ve."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Baasha kong ah Hanani fapa Jehu sinah Bawipa bia a phan i,"},"2":{"text":"“Nangmah cu leidip lakin kan hlorh i ka mi Israel mi hna hruaitu ah kan ser nain, Jeroboam lam kha na zul i ka mi Israel mi kha na sualter hna i an sualnak in ka thin na ka phawh caah,"},"3":{"text":"zohhmanh, Baasha le a innchungkhar cu ka hloh cikcek hna lai i na innchungkhar hi Nebat fapa Jeroboam innchungkhar bantuk ah ka ser lai."},"4":{"text":"Baasha ta a simi paoh khua chung i a thih ahcun uico nih an ei lai; ramlak i a thih ahcun van i a zuangmi va nih an ei lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Baasha tuahsernak a taang rihmi hna le thil a tuahmi le a ṭhawnnak cu, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"6":{"text":"Cun Baasha cu a pupa hna sinah a it i Tirzah khua ah an vui; cun a fapa Elah kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"7":{"text":"Cuhleiah Baasha le a innchungkhar he ralchanh in, a kut tuahmi thil in Bawipa cu a thin a phawh i a mithmuh i ṭhat lonak a tuahmi vialte ca le Jeroboam innchungkhar bantuk a si i a hrawh zong a hrawh caah khan, Hanani fapa profet Jehu sinin Bawipa bia cu a ra."},"8":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa, siangpahrang a si kum kul le kum ruknak ah Baasha fapa Elah nih Israel mi kha Tirzah khua in uk hram a thawk hna i kum hnih a pen hna.","title":"Elah le Zimri Pennak"},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a rangleng hnarcheu haotu Zimri nih a rawi. Tirzah khua i a um lio, a innchungkhar zohkhenhtu a simi Arza inn i ri lakin zu aa din ah khan,"},"10":{"text":"Zimri cu a ra lut i a tuk i a thah, mah cucu Judah siangpahrang Asa, siangpahrang a si kum kul le kum sarihnak ah khan a si. Amah hmun ah cun Zimri cu a bawi."},"11":{"text":"Pen hram a thawk tikah khan, a bawi ṭhutdan cung i a hung ṭhut cangka cun, Baasha innchung khar vialte kha a thah dih hna; a rualchan si hna seh, a hawikom si hna seh, pa pakhat hmanh a zuah hna lo."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun Zimri nih Bawipa nih profet Jehu in Baasha kong i a chimmi bia ningin, Baasha innchungkhar vialte cu a thah dih hna;"},"13":{"text":"mah cucu Baasha sualnak vialte le a fapa Elah sualnak vialte, anmah nih an tuahmi le Israel mi an sualtermi hna le Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu an siasal in a thin an phawh ruangah a si."},"14":{"text":"Elah tuahsernak a tang rihmi le a tuahmi vialte cu Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"15":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa, siangpahrang a si kum kul le kum sarihnak ah khan Zimri cu Tirzah khua ah ni sarih bawi a cang. Cun ralkap hna nih khan Filistin mi ta a simi Gibbethon kha an riahhnawh,"},"16":{"text":"cun a riahhnawhtu ralkap nih khan, “Zimri nih a rawi i siangpahrang kha a thah,” tiah an theih; cucaah Israel mi vialte nih ralkapbu haotu Omri kha cu ni ah cun riahhmun ah cun Israel siangpahrang ah an ser."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Omri cu Israel mi vialte he Gibbethon khan an hung kal i Tirzah khua kha an dum."},"18":{"text":"Cun Zimri nih khua kha an lak cang, tiah a hmuh tikah, siangpahrang inn chung ralhruang chungah khan a lut i siangpahrang inn cu mei in aa duah chih i a thi;"},"19":{"text":"mah cucu amah nih a tuahmi sualnak le Bawipa mithmuh i ṭhat lonak a tuahmi le Jeroboam lam a zulhnak le Israel mi a sualter hna ruangah khan a si."},"20":{"text":"Zimri tuahsernak a tang rihmi le rawinak amah nih a tuahmi kha, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"21":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu cheu hnih ah an i cheu; mi hnarcheu nih Ginath fapa Tibni cu amah kha siangpahrang i ser awkah an zulh i hnarcheu nih Omri kha an zulh.","title":"Omri Pennak"},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Omri a zulmi hna nih Ginath fapa Tibni a zulmi hna kha an tei hna; cucaah Tibni cu a thi i Omri cu siangpahrang a cang."},"23":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa, siangpahrang a sinak kum sawm thum le kum khatnak ah Omri nih Israel mi cu pen hram a thawk hna i kum hleihnih a uk hna; kum ruk cu Tirzah in a uk hna."},"24":{"text":"Shemer sinin Samaria tlang cu ngun talen pahnih in a cawk; tlang ah cun ralhau a sak i a sermi khua cu tlang a rak ngeitu Shemer min chuankhan in Samaria a ti."},"25":{"text":"Omri nih Bawipa mithmuh ah thil ṭhalo a tuah i amah hlan i a rak ummi vialte hna nakkhan thil ṭhalo tam deuh a tuah."},"26":{"text":"Zeitintiah amah cu Nebat fapa Jeroboam lam kha a zul i Israel mi a sualter hnanak sualnak kha a tuah, mah cucu annih nih Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu an siasal hna in a thin an phawhnak kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Omri tuahsernak a tang rihmi le ṭhawnnak a langhtermi cu, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"28":{"text":"Cun Omri cu a pupa hna sinah a it i Samaria khua ah an vui; cun a fapa Ahab cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"29":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Asa, siangpahrang a si kum sawm thum le kum riatnak ah, Omri fapa Ahab nih Israel mi hna cu pen hram a thawk i Omri fapa Ahab nih cun Israel mi hna cu Samaria khua in kum kul le kum hnih a uk hna.","title":"Ahab Pennak"},"30":{"text":"Cun Omri fapa Ahab nih amah hlan i a ummi vialte hna nakkhan ṭhat lonak Bawipa mithmuh ah tam deuh a tuah."},"31":{"text":"Nebat fapa Jeroboam sualnak chung i kal ve kha a zaang temi thil hei si seh law cu bang, Sidon mi hna siangpahrang Ethbaal fanu Jezebel kha nupi ah aa ṭhit i a kal i Baal kha a rian a ṭuan i a biak."},"32":{"text":"Samaria khua chungah a sakmi Baal inn chungah khan Baal caah biakṭheng pakhat a ser."},"33":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih Asherah pakhat a ser. Ahab nih amah hlan i a rak ummi Israel siangpahrang vialte hna nakkhan, Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu a thin a phawh deuh."},"34":{"text":"Amah chan ah cun Bethel khuami Hiel nih Jeriko khua kha a ser; a hramlung phum ah cun fapa a hrin hmasa bik Abiram nunnak a hloh phah i a kutka ser ah cun a fapa hniang bik Segub nunnak a hloh phah, mah cucu Bawipa nih Nun fapa Joshua in a rak chimmi bia ning khan a si.","ref":"Jos 6.26"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Gilead ram chung Tishbe khua Tishbe mi Elijah nih Ahab cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa, Israel Pathian, a hmaika i ka dir tawnmi a nun bangin, dap siseh, ruah siseh, ka bia in dah ti lo ahcun, hi kum hna chungah hin a um lai lo,” tiah a ti.","title":"Elijah Nih Khuakhen A Chimchung","ref":"Jei 5.17"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa bia cu a sinah a ra i,"},"3":{"text":"“Hika hin kal law nichuahlei ah i mer tuah, cun Jordan nichuahlei i a ummi Kherith tivate ah vaa thup."},"4":{"text":"Tivate ti cu na din lai i keimah nih langak hna cu khika ah nangmah kha rawl pek awkah nawl ka pek cang hna,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah a kal i Bawipa bia ning cun a tuah; Jordan nichuahlei i a ummi Kherith tivate ah cun a va kal i a va um."},"6":{"text":"Cun langak nih zinglei ah rawl le sa, zanlei ah rawl le sa an chanh lengmang i tivate ti cu a din."},"7":{"text":"Cun tlawmpal hnuah khin, ram chungah ruah a um lo caah, tivate ti cu a reu dih."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa bia cu amah sinah a ra i,","title":"Elijah le Zarefath Nuhmeinu Kong"},"9":{"text":"“Tho law, Sidon ram khua a simi Zarefath ah va kal law, khika ah va um. Zohhmanh, khika ah khin nangmah cu cawm awkah nuhmeinu pakhat nawl ka pek cang,” a ti.","ref":"Luk 4.25-26"},"10":{"text":"Cucaah a tho i Zarefath ah cun a kal; cun khua hauka kha a phak tikah, zohhmanh, nuhmei pakhat cu thinghreu a rak khawm len ko; cun anih nih amah cu a hei auh i, “Thawl in din awk ti tlawm tein rak ka put tuah,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun a rak put hnik lioah khin a hei auh i, “Na kut in changreu tlang khat in rak ka put,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “ Bawipa, na Pathian a nun bangin, rawh ciami zeihmanh ka ngei lo, um chungah changvut pei khat lawng ka ngei i thawl chungah chiti tlawmte lawng ka ngei; cun atu hi ka tlun in mah cucu keimah le ka fapa ca i chuannak ding caah thinghreu pahnih thumte ka khawm hna; kan ei dih cun kan thi ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih amah cu a thawh i, “Ṭih hlah, va kal law na chim bang cun va tuah ko; sihmanhsehlaw a hmasa bik ah keimah cu hlum hmete in va ka serpiak law, rak ka put, cun a hnuah nangmah ca le na fapa caah cun va ser."},"14":{"text":"Zeitintiah Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, ‘ Bawipa nih ruah vawlei ah a surter hlantiang changvut um cu a lawng lai lo i chiti thawl cu a reu lai lo,’ tiin a ti,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun a kal i Elijah nih a chim bantuk khan a tuah; cun amah le Elijah le a innchungkhar nih khan ni tampi an ei."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nih Elijah in a chimmi a bia ningte khan, changvut um cu a lawng lo i chiti thawl cu a reu lo."},"17":{"text":"Cun cu hnuah cun, inn ngeitu nu fapa cu a zaw i a zawtnak cu a zual tuk caah a chungah thaw a tang ti lo."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih Elijah cu a thawh i, “Maw Pathian mipa, ka cungah lung si lonak zeidah na ngeih? Ka sualnak kha hngalhter ṭhan awk le ka fapa kha thihter awkah pei na rat ko hi!” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun amah cu a thawh i, “Na fapa cu ka pe tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun amah ṭangchung cun a lak i amah a riahnak cungdot dal chungah khan a kaipi i amah i ihkhun ah khan a ihter."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kha a auh i, “Maw Bawipa, ka Pathian, ka tlunmi nuhmeinu cung hmanh ah hin, a fapa na thahnak in, harnak na tlunter ko maw?” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun ngakchia cungah cun voi thum a bawk i Bawipa cu, “Maw Bawipa, ka Pathian, hi ngakchia nunnak hi a chungah lut ṭhan ko seh,” tiah a auh.","ref":"2Sia 4.34-35"},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Elijah aw kha a theihpiak i ngakchia cu a chungah khan a nunnak cu a lut ṭhan i a nung ṭhan."},"23":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih ngakchia cu a lak i cungdot cun inn chungah a runpi i a nu kha a pek; cun Elijah nih a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, na fapa a nung hih,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun minu nih Elijah cu a thawh i, “Atu cu nangmah cu Pathian mi na si ti kha ka hngalh i na kaa chung i a ummi Bawipa bia cu biatak a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Caan saupi hnuah, a kum thumnak ah khin Bawipa bia cu Elijah sinah a ra i, “Va kal law Ahab sinah vaa langh tuah; cun vawlei cungah ruah ka surter lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"Elijah Kha Ahab Sinah A Ra Kir"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah Ahab sin i vaa langh awkah cun Elijah cu a kal. Atu cu Samaria ram ah cun mangṭam cu a fak ko cang."},"3":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih, a innchungkhar zohkhenhtu Obadiah kha a kawh. (Obadiah nih cun Bawipa cu fak piin a upat i,"},"4":{"text":"Jezebel nih Bawipa profet hna a thah hna ah khan, Obadiah nih profet za khat a lak hna i sawm nga sawm nga in lungkua ah a thuh hna i ti le rawl in a cawm hna)."},"5":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih Obadiah cu a thawh i, “Ti chuahnak tihram vialte le hor vialte va ṭol awkah ram chungah i chawk tuah; ram hawi hna kan hei hmuh hnga i rang le laa hna hi kan hei khamh khawh sual ko hna hnga i kan saṭil hna hi sung loin kan hei um ko hnga dah kaw?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah ram cu ṭol awkah an i phaw i Ahab cu amah lawngin khattelei ah a kal, cun Obadiah cu amah lawng in khattelei ah a kal ve."},"7":{"text":"Cun Obadiah cu lam i a kal lioah khin, zohhmanh, Elijah nih a rak ton; cun Obadiah nih cun a hngalh i a bawk i, “Ka bawipa Elijah, nangmah na si maw?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun anih nih a leh i, “Keimah ka si. Va kal law na bawipa kha, ‘Zohhmanh, Elijah hika ah hin a um ko,’ tiah va chim,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Khuazei ah dah ka sual i na salpa hi rak thah awkah Ahab kut chungah na ka pek hnik?"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa, na Pathian a nun bangin, ka bawipa nih hin nangmah kawl ah mi a thlah lonak ram le miphun a um ti lo; cun annih nih, ‘Hika ah a um lo,’ tiah an rak ti tikah, cu ram cu siseh, cu miphun cu siseh, kan hmu lo tiin, chiat a serter hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun atu cu nang nih na thawh i, ‘Va kal law, “Hika ah Elijah cu a um ko,” tiah na bawipa cu va chim,’ na ka ti."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah sinin ka kal cangka, Bawipa thlarau nih ka hngalh lomi hmun ah an kalpi lai i cucaah ka rat i Ahab kha ka chimh i an hmuh khawh lo tikah, a ka thah lai, keimah na salpa nih hin ka tlanval lio in Bawipa cu ka upat ko dahkaw."},"13":{"text":"Jezebel nih Bawipa profet hna a rak thah hna ah khan, zeitindah Bawipa profet za khat hna kha sawm nga sawm nga in lungkua ah ka thuh hna i ti le rawl in ka cawm hna kha ka bawipa hi an in chim lo maw?"},"14":{"text":"Atu ah nang nih naa thawh i, ‘Va kal law, na bawipa cu, “Elijah cu hika ah a um ko,” tiah va chim, na ka ti;’ amah nih cun a ka thah ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih a thawh i, “A hmai i ka dirmi ralkapbu Bawipa nih a nun bangin, nihin ah amah sinah kaa langh hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Ahab kha va ton awkah Obadiah cu a kal i a va chimh; cun Ahab cu Elijah ton awkah khan a kal."},"17":{"text":"Ahab nih Elijah cu a hmuh tikah, “Nangmah na si maw? Israel hnahnawhnak petupa?” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih a leh i, “Keimah nih Israel mi cu harnak ka pe hna lo, nangmah le na pa hrin nih pei nan pek hna tiah, zeicahtiah nannih nih Bawipa nawlbia kha nan hlawt hna i Baal kha nan zulh hna."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah mi thlah hna law Israel mi vialte le Baal profet za li le sawm nga hna kha le Asherah profet za li Jezebel cabuai i rawl a eimi hna kha Karmel Tlang ah pum hna,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah Ahab nih Israel mi vialte cu bia a cah hna i profet hna cu hmunkhat ah Karmel Tlang ah a pumh hna.","title":"Karmel Tlang ah Elijah le Baal Profet Hna"},"21":{"text":"Cun Elijah cu mi vialte pawngah khan a ra i, “Zei can dah bei lengmang in ruahnak pahnih he nan kal lai? Bawipa cu Pathian a si ahcun, amah cu zul u; sihmanhsehlaw Baal cu Pathian a si ahcun, amah cu zul fawn ko u,” tiah a ti hna. Mi zapi nih cun bia kaa khat hmanh an let lo."},"22":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih mizapi cu a thawh hna i, “Keimah, keimah lawnglawng hi Bawipa profet a tangmi ka si; sihmanhsehlaw Baal profet cu za li le sawm nga an si."},"23":{"text":"Cawtum pahnih in kan pe u; annih nih tum khat i thim hna seh law, can cikcek hna seh law, thing cungah chia hna seh, mei bel kau loin; cun kei nih tum khat kha kaa can ve lai i thing cungah ka chiah lai, mei ka kau ve lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Cun nannih nih nan pathian min kha nan auh lai i kei nih Bawipa min kha ka auh lai; mei in a kan lettu Pathian cu, amah cu Pathian cu a si lai,” tiah a ti. Cun mi vialte nih an leh i, “Na chimmi cu a ṭha,” tiah an ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih Baal profet cu a thawh hna i, “Nannih nih cawtum pakhat kha i thim u law can hmasa u, nannih cu nan tam deuh cu ta; cun nan pathian min kha au u, sihmanhsehlaw mei bel kauhnawh hlah u,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun annih nih an pekmi hna cawtum cu an i lak i an can i Baal min cu zingka in chun tiang an auh i, “Maw Baal, kan let tuah!” tiah an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw zei aw hmanh a um lo i zeihmanh nih a let hna lo. Cun an sermi biakṭheng a velchum ah cun heh tiah an i hlok."},"27":{"text":"Cun chun ah khin Elijah nih cun a nihsawh hna i, “Fak piin au ngat u, pathian pei a si cu; khuadang a ruah lio hoi hna maw a si maw, ka khatkhat ah a kal ta rih i maw a si maw, asiloah, khual a tlawng i dik a si ko lai, aa hngilh i ṭhangh a herh zong a si ko lai dah kaw!” tiah a ti hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun annih nih fak piin an au i an phung bantukin fei le nam in anmah le anmah cu an thi pawt thluahmah in an i chun an i at."},"29":{"text":"Cun ni cu a run i mer i thlet thawinak caan tiang an au cuahmah ko, sihmanhsehlaw zei aw hmanh a um lo; zeihmanh nih a let hna lo, ahohmanh nih zei ah a rel hna lo."},"30":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih mi vialte cu a thawh hna i, “Ra ka naih tuah u,” a ti hna i mi vialte nih cun an naih. Cun anih nih an hrawh cangmi Bawipa biakṭheng kha a remh;"},"31":{"text":"Bawipa bia a sinah a phan i, “Na min cu Israel a si lai,” tiah a timi Jakob i a fapa hna an phun zat khan Elijah nih lung hlei hnih aa lak i","ref":"Gen 32.28; 35.10"},"32":{"text":"Bawipa min in biakṭheng pakhat a ser. Cun a velchum cun kahcham a cawh i a ngan lei cu thlaici rel hnih tlum hrawng a si."},"33":{"text":"Cun thing kha a ningcang tein a chiah hna i cawtum kha a can cikcek i thing cungah cun a chiah. Cun amah nih cun, “Ti ralca pali khat in chia u law, khangh thawinak le thing kha toih hna u,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Tuah ṭhan rih u,” tiah a ti i an tuah ṭhan. Cun, “A voi thumnak tuah ṭhan rih u,” a ti i a voi thumnak an tuah ṭhan."},"35":{"text":"Cun ti nih cun biakṭheng cu a kulh i kahcham zong cu ti a khat."},"36":{"text":"Cun thlet thawinak caan ah khin profet Elijah cu a pawngah a ra i, “Maw Bawipa, Abraham, Isak le Israel i Pathian, nangmah cu Israel mi chungah hin Pathian na si i keimah cu na sal ka si i hi thil vialte hi nangmah bia in ka tuah ti kha nihin ah hin langhter ko."},"37":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu Pathian na si i nangmah nih annih cu an lung na kirter ṭhan hna ti kha mi hna nih hin an hngalh nakhnga, ka let tuah, maw Bawipa, ka let tuah,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cun Bawipa mei cu a rung tla ciammam i khangh thawinak le a thing le lung le leidip kha a kangh dih hirhiar hna i kahcham chung i a ummi ti kha a liah dih."},"39":{"text":"Cun mah cucu mi vialte nih khan an hmuh tikah an bawk i, “ Bawipa hi pei Pathian cu a rak si hi, Bawipa hi pei Pathian cu a rak si hi,” tiah an ti."},"40":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih annih cu, “Baal profet kha tlai hna u, pakhat hmanh luatter hna hlah u,” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih an tlaih hna i Elijah nih Kishon tivate ah khan a vun kalpi hna i khika ah a thah hna."},"41":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih Ahab cu a thawh i, “Hung kal law hung ei law hung ding tuah, zeitintiah ruah a sur hluahmahmi thawng a um,” tiah a ti.","title":"Ruah Surnak Dingah Thla A Cam"},"42":{"text":"Cucaah ei awk le din awkah Ahab cu a hung kal. Cun Elijah cu Karmel Tlang par ah a kal i vawlei ah a kun i a hmai cu a khuk le a khuk karlak ah a chiah.","ref":"Jei 5.18"},"43":{"text":"Cun a sinum cu a thawh i, “Hung kal law rili lei kha hung cuan tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun a hung kal i a hung zoh i, “Zeihmanh a um lo,” tiah a ti. Cun, “Voi sarih in hung kal ṭhan tuah,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cun a voi sarihnak ah cun, “Zohhmanh, rili chungin mi kut tiate khi khuadawm a kai iaimai,” tiah a ti. Cun amah nih, “Hung kal law, Ahab kha, ‘Ruah nih an hren sual lai, na rangleng kha tim law vung kal cang,’ tiah hung chim,” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Cun tlawmpal ah khin van cu khuadawm le thli in a nak khuihmaih i ruah cu fak piin a sur. Cun Ahab cu a rangleng kha aa cit i Jezreel ah a kal."},"46":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kut cu Elijah cungah khan a um i a biar aa rengh i Ahab hlanah Jezreel luhnak kutka ah khan a rak tli."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab nih Jezebel cu Elijah nih a tuahmi vialte kha le zeitindah vainam in profet vialte a thah hna ti kha a chimh.","title":"Elijah Kha Horeb Ah A Zaam"},"2":{"text":"Cun Jezebel nih Elijah sinah cun lamkal pakhat a hei thlah i, “Na nunnak cu annih lak i pakhat nunnak bantuk ah khan thaizing atu tik caan i ka ser lo ahcun, cu bantukin le cu nak tam deuh zongin pathian hna nih cun ka cungah tuah ko hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah a thin a phang i a tho i a zam i Judah ta a simi Beersheba khua ah a phan, khika ah a sinum kha a chiah ta."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah tu cu ramlak ah ni khat lamkal a kal i hmunphiah thingkung tangah a ra i a ṭhu; cun a thih nakhnga a hal i, “A za cang; atu cu maw Bawipa, ka nunnak kha la ko; zeitintiah ka pupa hna nakin ka ṭha hlei ṭung lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jon 4.3"},"5":{"text":"Cun a it i hmunphiah thingkung pakhat tangah aa hngilh; cun zohhmanh, vancungmi nih a tawngh i, “Tho law ei tuah,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun khua a hun zoh i, zohhmanh, a lu leiah lung lin in rawhmi changreu hlum hlum khat le ti thawl khat a hmuh. Cun a ei a din i a it ṭhan."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi cu a voi hnihnak a ra ṭhan i a tawngh i, “Tho law ei tuah, na khual tlawnnak lam cu na celh sual lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun a tho i a ei a din i cu rawl thazang cun ni sawm li le zan sawm li, Pathian tlang Horeb leiah cun a kal."},"9":{"text":"Cun khika ah lungkua pakhat ah a phan i a riak; cun zohhmanh, Bawipa bia cu a sinah a ra i amah cu, “Elijah, hika ah hin zeidah na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Anih nih, “ Bawipa, ralkapbu Pathian cu ka ṭanh hringhran ko, zeitintiah Israel mi hna nih na biakamnak kha an hlawt i na biakṭheng kha an chimh hna i na profet hna kha vainam in an thah hna i keimah, keimah lawnglawng hi ka tang; cun keimah zong cu thah awkah an ka kawl,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Rom 11.3"},"11":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Chuak tuah, Pathian hmaiah tlang cungah va dir tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa cu a lan i a thlichia a hrang ciammam i tlang cu a cheu i Bawipa hmaiah cun lung hna cu a khuai cikcek hna, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa cu thli chungah cun a um lo; cun thli a hran dih cun li a hnin, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa cu lihnin chung zongah cun a um lo;"},"12":{"text":"lihnin a dih cun mei a hung chuak, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa cu mei chung zongah cun a um lo; cun mei a dih cun aw ṭhia aw dinte a hung chuak."},"13":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih a theih tikah a puan in a hmai kha aa huh i a va chuak i lungkua luhnak ah cun a dir. Cun zohhmanh, aw pakhat kha a sinah a ra i, “Elijah, hika ah hin zeidah na tuah?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Anih nih, “ Bawipa, ralkapbu Pathian, nangmah, nangmah lawnglawng hi kan ṭanh zungzal; Israel mi tu nih cun nangmah he an biakam kha an hrawh i na biakṭheng kha an hrawh hna i na profet kha an thah hna. Keimah lawnglawng hi ka tang i keimah zong cu thah an ka zalh lengmang,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih a thawh i, “Va kir law Damaskas ramlak leiah khan va kal tuah; cuka na phak tikah Hazael cu Siria siangpahrang si awkah chiti na thuh lai;","ref":"2Sia 8.7-13"},"16":{"text":"Cun Nimshi fapa Jehu cu Israel siangpahrang si awkah chiti na thuh lai; cun Abel-meholah khuami Shafat fapa Elisha kha nangmah changtu profet si awkah chiti na thuh lai.","ref":"2Sia 9.1-6"},"17":{"text":"Hazael vainam in a luatmi cu Jehu nih a rak thah hna lai; cun Jehu vainam in a luatmi cu Elisha nih a rak thah hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel chungah hin Baal hmai i a khuk aa bil lo i a hnamh zong a hnam lomi thong sarih kaa nganh hna lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Rom 11.4"},"19":{"text":"Cucaah khika khan a kal i Shafat fapa Elisha kha a hmai i cawtum tuah hleihnih he lei a rak thuan kha a hmuh, amah cu a tuah hleihnihnak sinah cun a rak um. Elijah cu a pawngin a lan i a puan khan a hei cheh.","title":"Elisha Auhnak"},"20":{"text":"Cun a cawtum kha a kaltak hna i Elijah cu a dawi i, “Ka nu le ka pa va hnam ta hna ning law, cun kan zulh lai,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Va kir ṭhan ko ngat, kan thlauh lo zeicahtiah na cungah zeidah ka tuah kha na hngalh,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun amah zulhnak cun a kir i cawtum tuah khat cu aa lak i a thah hna i an sa cu caw lei thuannak thing cun a chuan i mi cu a pek hna i an ei. Cun a tho i Elijah kha a zulh i amah cu a rian kha a ṭuanpiak."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang Benhadad nih a ralkap vialte kha a pumh hna; siangpahrang sawm thum le pahnih kha a sinah an ṭang, rang le rangleng hna he; cun a hung kal i Samaria kha a kulh i a doh.","title":"Ahab Nih Siria mi A Tei Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun khua chungah cun Israel siangpahrang Ahab sinah khan lamkal a vun thlah hna i, “Hi bangin Benhadad nih:"},"3":{"text":"‘Na ngun le na sui cu keimah ta an si; na nupi aa dawh bik hna le na fale hna zong keimah ta an si,’ a ti, tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih cun a leh i, “Na chim bangin, ka bawipa, maw siangpahrang, keimah le ka ngeihmi vialte cu nangmah ta kan si ko,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Lamkal hna kha an ra ṭhan i, “Hi bangin Benhadad nih: ‘Na sinah mi ka rak thlah hna i, “Na ngun le na sui cu ka pe hna, na nupi hna le na fale hna zong,” ka ti;"},"6":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thaizing atu tikah hin na sinah ka sinum ka rak thlah hna lai i na inn le na sinum hna inn hna kha an kawl hna lai i an duhmi paoh an i lak lai i an i kalpi lai,’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cu tikah, Israel siangpahrang nih ram chung upa vialte kha a auh hna i, “I chingchiah hmanh u, hi pa i harnak tuah awk a kawl ning hi; ka sinah mi a rak thlah hna i ka nupile le ka fale le ka ngun le ka sui kha a ka hal i ka rak al lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun upa vialte le mi vialte nih an thawh i, “Zei ah rak rel hlah, na hna zong rak tla hlah,” tiah an ti."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Benhadad lamkal hna cu a thawh hna i, “Ka bawipa, siangpahrang cu, ‘Na sal na ka hal hmasami vialte kha cu ka tuah lai, sihmanhsehlaw mah hi cu ka tuah kho lo,’ a ti, tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun lamkal hna cu an kal i bia cu an hei phorh."},"10":{"text":"Benhadad nih a sinah cun a hei thlah hna i, “Cu bangin pathian hna nih ka cungah tuah hna seh law tam deuh zongin tuah hna seh, Samaria khua leidip cu a ka zultu hna caah pei khat cio in a zaat ding a si ahcun,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih a leh i, “A ralthuam in aa thuammi nih aa phoihmi bantukin tluangkhawn awk a si lo,’ tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Benhadad nih hi bia cu, siangpahrang hna he thlam chung i zu an din lioah khan a theih tikah, a mi hna cu, “Nan umnak hmun tlai u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun annih nih khua cu doh awkah an umnak hmun kha an tlai cio."},"13":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh profet pakhat Israel siangpahrang Ahab pawngah cun a ra i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Hi mibu nganpi hi na hmuh cang hna a si lo mei? Zohhmanh, nihin ah annih cu nangmah kan pek lai; cun nang nih keimah cu Bawipa ka si kha na hngalh lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih, “Ahodah a hman lai?” tiah a ti. Anih nih, “ Bawipa nih hi bangin, ‘Peng cheumi uktu bawi hna i an sinum hna hi ka hman hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Ahodah i tuknak cu a thawk lai?” a ti. Cun anih nih, “Nangmah,” tiah a leh."},"15":{"text":"Cun peng cheumi uktu bawi hna sinum kha a pumh hna i annih cu za hnih sawm thum pahnih an si; cun annih hnulei ah cun Israel mi vialte cu a pumh hna i thong sarih an si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Benhadad le a bawmtu siangpahrang sawm thum le pahnih hna cu ri koin thlam chungah zu an din lio chun ah khin, annih cu an va kal."},"17":{"text":"Peng cheumi uktu bawi hna sinum hna cu an kal hmasa. Cun Benhadad nih va zoh chungtu mi kha a thlah hna i annih nih amah cu, “Samaria khua in mi an ra chuak,” tiah an chimh."},"18":{"text":"Annih nih, “Daihnak ca an ra chuah a si ahcun, a nung in tlai hna u i tuk awk i an ra chuah a si zongah, a nung in tlai hna u,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah peng cheumi uktu bawi hna ralkap hna cu, an chuak i Israel ralkap nih an zulh hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun annih nih anmah le an dohmi cio kha an thah hna; Siria mi cu an zam i Israel mi nih an dawi hna, sihmanhsehlaw Siria siangpahrang Benhadad cu rang cungin rangcung ralkap hna he an luat."},"21":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang cu a chuak i rang le rangleng hna kha a tlaih hna i Siria mi cu tampi a thah hna."},"22":{"text":"Cu tikah profet kha Israel siangpahrang pawngah khan a ra i amah sinah cun, “Ra tuah, i hrim tuah, cun na tuah hnga ding hi ṭha tein ruat tuah; zeitintiah ṭhal a hung chuah ṭhan tikah Siria siangpahrang nih doh awkah an rathnawh lai,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Siria siangpahrang cu a sinum hna nih an thawh i, “Annih an pathian cu tlang pathian an si, cucaah kannih nakin an ṭhawng deuh; sihmanhsehlaw rawn ah do hna u si law, annih nakin kan ṭhawng deuh hrimhrim lai."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah mah hi tuah tuah: siangpahrang kha anmah le an rian cio khan ṭhial hna law an hmun ah khan ralbawi chia hna;"},"25":{"text":"cun na rak sunghmi ralkapbu bantuk kha, rang can ah rang, rangleng can ah rangleng in pum ṭhan hna; cun rawn ah kan doh hna lai i annih nakin kan ṭhawng deuh hrimhrim lai,” tiah an ti. Cun an bia cu a ngaih i cu bangin a tuah."},"26":{"text":"Ṭhal ah cun Benhadad nih Siria mi cu a pumh hna i Israel mi doh awkah khan Afek ah an hung kal."},"27":{"text":"Cun Israel mi cu an pumh hna i rawl an pek hna i annih doh awkah khan an kal; Israel mi cu meheh run hmete pahnih bantukin an hmaiah khan an riak, Siria mi vial cu ram kha an khat dih."},"28":{"text":"Cun Pathian mi pakhat nih Israel siangpahrang sinah cun a ra i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Siria mi hna nih, “ Bawipa, cu tlang pathian pei a si ko cu, nelrawn pathian a si ṭung lo,” an ti caah, cucaah hi mibu nganpi hi a dihlak in na kut chungah kan pek lai i keimah cu Bawipa ka si kha na hngalh lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun annih cu ral enh veve in ni sarih chung veve an riak. Cun a ni sarihnak ni ah cun an i tawng i Israel mi nih Siria mi hna cu ni khat ah ke ralkap sing khat an thah hna."},"30":{"text":"Cun a tang rihmi hna cu Afek khua ah an zam i a tangmi hna chungah sang hnih le thong sarih cu vampang nih a nenh hna. Benhadad zong cu a zam i khua chung i inn pakhat a dal chungchin ah a lut."},"31":{"text":"Cun a sinum hna nih amah cu an thawh i, “Zohhmanh, Israel chungkhar siangpahrang hna cu zaangfah thiammi siangpahrang an si tiah kan theih; cucaah kan tai ah puanchia i venh in kan lu ah hrihrual i ngerh u si law, Israel siangpahrang sinah cun va kal hnik u sih; na nunnak a hei in zuah ko hnga dah kaw,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cucaah an tai ah puanchia an i venh i an lu ah hrihrual an i ngerh i Israel siangpahrang sinah cun an va kal i, “Na sal Benhadad nih, ‘Ka nunter ko sawh seh,’ a ti,” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “A nung rih maw? Amah cu ka unau pei a si cu,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Cun mi hna nih cun mah cucu hmelchunhnak ṭha a si tiah an ruah i amah sin cun khulrang in an i lak i, “Asi, na unau Benhadad cu,” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “Va kal u law, ratpi u,” tiah a ti. Cun Benhadad cu a sinah a ra chuak i a rangleng cung khan a ratter."},"34":{"text":"Cun Benhadad nih amah cu a thawh i, “Ka pa nih na pa sinin a lakmi khua kha kan khirh ṭhan lai; cun ka pa nih Samaria ah a rak tuah bang khan, nang zong nih Damaskas khua ah chawdawr naa ser ve lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Ahab nih a thawh i, “Hi biakamnak thawng hin kan luatter lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah amah he cun biakamnak a ser i a kalter."},"35":{"text":"Cun profet fapa hna lak i pakhat nih khan a hawipa pakhat cu, “Ka tu tuah, tiah kan nawl,” tiah Bawipa nawl peknak thawngin a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw mipa nih tuk cu a al."},"36":{"text":"Cu tikah anih nih, “ Bawipa aw kha na ngaih lo caah, zohhmanh, ka sin i na kal cangkate hin chiandeih nih an seh lai,” tiah a ti. Cun a sinin a kal cangkate cun chiandeih nih a rak ton i a seh taktak.","ref":"1Sia 13.24"},"37":{"text":"Cun midang pakhat a hmuh i, “Ka tu tuah, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti. Cun mipa nih cun a tuk i a hliam."},"38":{"text":"Cucaah profet cu a kal i lam pawngin siangpahrang cu a rak hngah, a mit cu puanchia in a rak i men i a mui a rak i hleng."},"39":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu a lanhpah ah khin siangpahrang cu a hei auh i, “Na salpa hi raltuknak hmunpi ah ka va kal i, zohhmanh, ralkap pakhat cu ka sinah a ra i mipa pakhat a rak put i, ‘Hi mipa hi zohkhenh tuah; zei maw tiin a loh sual a si ahcun, na nunnak cu a nunnak caah a si lai, asiloah, ngun talen pakhat na liam lai,’ a ti."},"40":{"text":"Cun na salpa cu khika, hika, i hnahnawk luri ngaiin ka um lioah, a rak kal diam ai,” tiah a ti. Israel siangpahrang nih cun a thawh i, “Na cung i biakhiahnak cu cu bang cun a si ko lai; nangmah nih pei naa khiah cang ko cu,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cu tikah khulrang in a mit mennak puanchia cu a phoih i Israel siangpahrang nih profet hna lak i pakhat a si kha a hngalh."},"42":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Hrawh awkah kan pekchanh ciami kha nangmah nih na kut chungin na luatter caah, cucaah a nunnak caah na nunnak a kal lai i a mi hna caah na mi an si lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang cu thinhung le hmaichia in a inn ah a kal i Samaria khua kha a phan."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jezreel mi Naboth nih Jezreel khua ah, Samaria siangpahrang Ahab inn pawngah mitsur dum pakhat a ngei.","title":"Ahab le Naboth Mitsur Dum Kong"},"2":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih Naboth cu a thawh i, “Na mitsur dum cu ka inn pawngah a um caah an hringso dum ah ka hman nakhnga, ka pe tuah; cun a can ah mitsur dum ṭha deuh kan pek lai; cucu a si lo le, nangmah nih a ṭha na ti ahcun, a man cu tangka in kan pek ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Naboth nih Ahab cu, “Ka pupa hna ro na sin i kan pek hnga cu Bawipa nih ka kham ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Naboth nih Ahab cu, “Ka pupa hna ro cu kan pe lai lo,” tiah a sin i a timi bia ruangah khan, Ahab cu thinhung le hmaichia in a inn chungah a lut. Cun a ihkhun ah a it i khattelei kha a hoi i rawl ei kha a duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a nupi Jezebel kha a sinah a ra i, “Zeicahdah cuticun na thlarau cu a thin a hun i rawl na ei duh lo?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Jezreel mi Naboth kha, ‘Na mitsur dum kha phaisa in kan cawk ko lai, cun cu ti a si lo le, na duh ahcun a ai ah mitsur dum dang kaan pek lai,’ ka ti i anih nih, ‘Ka mitsur dum cu kan pe lai lo,’ tiah a ka leh caah a si,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun a nupi Jezebel nih a thawh i, “Israel hi atu ah nangmah nih na uk maw? Tho law rawl ei law na lung kha lawmhter tuah; Jezreel mi Naboth mitsur dum cu keimah nih kan pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Ahab min in ca a ṭial i a min khenhnak in a khenh hna i cu ca cu Naboth he a khua i a um ṭimi upa hna le bawi hna sinah khan a kuat."},"9":{"text":"Cun ca chungah cun, “Rawl ulhnak thanh u law, Naboth kha mizapi lakah sang ngai ah hlorh u;"},"10":{"text":"cun mi ṭhiṭhalo pahnih in amah hmaiah cun chia hna u law, ‘Nangmah nih Pathian le siangpahrang chiat na serh hna,’ tiin bia puh hna seh. Cun chuahpi u law thi lakin lung in chep u,” tiah a ṭial."},"11":{"text":"Cun a khuami, upa hna le bawi hna a khua chung i a ummi hna nih cun, Jezebel nih bia a cah hna bang khan an tuah. Anih nih a kuatmi hna ca chungah aa ṭial bangin,"},"12":{"text":"rawl ulhnak kha an thanh i Naboth kha mizapi lakah sang ngai ah an hlorh."},"13":{"text":"Cun mi ṭhiṭhalo pahnih hna kha an ra i a hmaiah khan an ṭhu; cun mi ṭhiṭhalo hna nih khan mi zapi hmaiah cun Naboth cu bia an puh i, “Naboth nih Pathian le siangpahrang kha chiat a serh hna,” an ti. Cucaah khua lengah an chuahpi i thi lakin lung in an cheh."},"14":{"text":"Cu tikah Jezebel sinah khan mi an hei thlah i, Naboth cu lung in cheh a si cang; a thi cang,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Jezebel nih Naboth cu lung in cheh a si cang i a thi cang ti kha a theih cangka, Jezebel nih Ahab cu a thawh i, “Tho tuah, Jezreel mi Naboth nih phaisa in zuarh an sianh lomi mitsur dum kha i lak tuah; zeitintiah Naboth cu a nung ti lo, a thi cang,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Ahab nih Naboth kha a thi cang ti a theih cangka, Jezreel mi Naboth mitsur dum cu vung kal i vung i lak awkah a tho."},"17":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa bia cu Tishbemi Elijah sinah khan a ra i,"},"18":{"text":"“Tho law, Samaria khua i a ummi Ahab, Israel siangpahrang kha ton awkah vung kal tuah; zohhmanh, amah nih co awkah a kalhnawhmi Naboth mitsur dum chungah a um ko."},"19":{"text":"Cun amah cu na thawh lai i, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih, “Na thah cang i a ro zong na co cang maw?” a ti,” na ti lai. Cun nangmah nih amah cu na thawh lai i, ‘ Bawipa nih hi bangin: “Uico nih Naboth thi an liahnak hmun ah khan uico nih nangmah na thi an liah lai,” a ti,’ tiah na chimh lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sia 22.38"},"20":{"text":"Ahab nih Elijah cu, “Na ka hmuh cang mu, maw ka ralpa,” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “ Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo tuah awkah khan nangmah le nangmah cu naa zuar cang caah, kan hmuh cang."},"21":{"text":"Zohhmanh, nangmah cungah ṭhat lonak ka tlunter lai; kan hloh cikcek lai i Israel mi chungah Ahab ta a simi pa paohpaoh cu, a luatmi siseh, a luat lomi siseh, ka hrawh dih hna lai;"},"22":{"text":"cun ka thin na ka phawh ruang le Israel mi na sualter hna caah hin, na innchungkhar cu Nebat fapa Jeroboam innchungkhar bantuk le Ahijah fapa Baasha innchungkhar bantuk ah ka ser lai."},"23":{"text":"Cun Jezebel kongah hin Bawipa nih, ‘Jezreel khua kulh chungah hin Jezebel cu uico nih an ei lai,’ a ti fawn.","ref":"2Sia 9.36"},"24":{"text":"Ahab ta a simi paoh cu, khua chung i an thih a si ah, uico nih a ei hna lai; ramlak i an thih a si ah, van i a zuangmi va nih an ei hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"(Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭha lo tuah awkah aa pemi Ahab bantuk ahohmanh an um lo — cu vialte cu a nupi Jezebel nih a forh ruangah a si."},"26":{"text":"Israel mi nih ram kha an hun nam tikah an hmai in Bawipa nih ram chungin a dawimi hna Amor mi nih an biakmi siasal biaknak thil fihnung bik kha Ahab nih a tuah)."},"27":{"text":"Cun mah bia cu Ahab nih a theih tikah, a puan kha a thleh hna i a tak cungah puanchia aa hruk i rawl a ul i lungpur ngaiin aa chawk."},"28":{"text":"Cun Bawipa bia cu Tishbemi Elijah sinah khan a ra i,"},"29":{"text":"“Zeitindah Ahab nih ka hmaiah lungṭhum ngaiin a um kha na hmu ko lo maw? Ka hmaiah a lung a ṭhumh caah ṭhat lonak kha amah chan ah hin cun ka tlunter lai lo; sihmanhsehlaw a fapa chan ah a innchungkhar cungah hin ṭhat lonak kha ka tlunter lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kum thum chung cu Siria le Israel cu i do loin an um.","title":"Mikaiah Nih Ahab le Jehoshafat An Sungh Lai Kong A Chimchung (2Cha 18.1-34)"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kum thumnak ah khan, Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Israel siangpahrang sinah khan a rung."},"3":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih a sinum hna cu a thawh hna i, “Ramoth-gilead khi kanmah ta a si kannih nih dai tein kan um ko i Siria siangpahrang kut chungin kan chut lo ti kha nan hngal maw?” tiah a ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “Ramoth-gilead i vaa tuk awkah na ka kalpi hnga maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Jehoshafat nih Israel siangpahrang cu a thawh i, “Kei le nang cu mi khat kan si ko, ka mi cu na mi an si ve ko i ka rang cu na rang an si ve ko,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat nih Israel siangpahrang cu, “ Bawipa bia cu dothlat hmasa rih tuah hen,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cu tikah Israel siangpahrang nih profet kha hmunkhat ah a pumh hna, mi za li tluk an si, annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ramoth-gilead cu tuk awkah ka kal hnga maw, asiloah, kaa sum ko lai dah?” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih, “Hung kal ko, zeitintiah Bawipa nih siangpahrang kut chungah a pek lai,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jehoshafat nih, “Hika ah hin kan hal khawh ding Bawipa profet a dang pakhat tal an um ti lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu, “ Bawipa kan hal khawhnak ding mipa a dang pakhat a um rih, amah cu Imlah fapa Mikaiah a si; sihmanhsehlaw ka kong ah thil ṭha chim bal loin thil ṭhalo lawng kha a chim caah ka huat,” tiah a ti. Cun Jehoshafat nih cun, “Cuticun siangpahrang nih chim hlah seh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih bawi pakhat kha a auh i, “Imlah fapa Mikaiah kha khulrang in ratpi tuah,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Samaria hauka luhnak i phuhri ah khan, an bawi ṭhutdan cungah an ṭhu i an puan in an i thuam; cun profet vialte hna cu an hmaiah an rak chim dulmal ko."},"11":{"text":"Cun Khenaanah fapa Zedekiah nih thir ki aa ser hna i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Siria mi cu an rawk dih tiang, mah hi hin na suk hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in profet vialte nih cun an chim i, “Ramoth-gilead ah cun hung kal law, hung tei ko; Bawipa nih siangpahrang na kut chungah an pek lai,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah kawh awk i an thlahmi lamkaltu nih khan amah sinah cun, “Zohhmanh, profet hna cu lungnge tein a ṭha lei in siangpahrang sinah an bia a si; nangmah na bia zong annih lak i pakhat i a bia bantuk si ve seh law an duhning lei in chim ve ko,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Mikaiah nih, “ Bawipa a nun bangin, Bawipa nih ka sin i a chimmi cu, mah cucu ka chim ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang sinah a phak tikah, siangpahrang nih cun a rak thawh i, “Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead cu hung tuk awkah kan kal lai maw, kan i sum lai dah?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Hung kal u law hung tei hen u; Bawipa nih siangpahrang kut chungah a pek ko lai,” tiah a leh."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang nih a thawh i, “Biatak dah ti lo cu Bawipa min in ka sin i zeihmanh na chim lo awkah voi zeizat dah bia kan kamter lai?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Israel mi vialte cu khaltu a ngei lomi tuu bantukin tlang cung i an i ṭhek dih kha ka hmuh; cun Bawipa nih, ‘Hi hna hi bawi an ngei lo, anmah le an inn cio ah dai tein kir hna seh,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Nam 27.17; Mat 9.36; Mar 6.34"},"18":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu, “Keimah kongah cun ṭhatnak si loin chiatnak a chim lai, tiah kan ti ṭheo lo mei?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih cun, “Cucaah Bawipa bia cu thei tuah: Bawipa cu a bawi ṭhutdan cungah a ṭhut i vancung ralkapbu vialte a orhlei le a kehlei ah a pawng i an dir kha ka hmuh;","ref":"Isa 6.1; Job 1.6"},"20":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih a thawh i, ‘Ahab cu Ramoth-gilead ah a hung kal i khika ah a thih naklai ahodah a lem lai?’ tiah a ti. Cun pakhat nih thil pakhat a chim i a dang pakhat nih thil dang pakhat a chim ve."},"21":{"text":"Cun thlarau pakhat cu a hung chuak i Bawipa hmaiah cun a dir i, ‘Keimah nih ka lem lai,’ a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, ‘Zei in dah na lem lai?’ tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, ‘Ka va kal lai i a profet vialte hna kaa chungah nal thlarau ka va si lai,’ tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, ‘Na va lem hrimhrim lai i na lem khawh taktak lai; va kal law cu bangin va tuah,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah cun zohhmanh, Bawipa nih hi na profet vialte hna kaa chungah hin nal thlarau a chiah cang; Bawipa nih nangmah kongah ṭhat lonak a chim cang,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Khi tikah Khenaanah fapa Zedekiah kha a pawngah a ra i Mikaiah kha a biang ah a bengh i, “Zeitik ah dah Bawipa thlarau cu nangmah sin i bia chim awkah ka sinin a chuah cu a si?” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, khi ni ah, innchung chungchin dal i thuh awkah na kal tikah na hngalh te lai,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih cun, “Mikaiah kha tlai u law khua uktu Amon le siangpahrang fapa Joash sinah khan va kalpi u;"},"27":{"text":"cun siangpahrang nih hi bangin, ‘Hi pa hi thong ah rak thla u law rawl tlawmte le ti tlawmte lawng, daihnak in ka ra kir ṭhan hlantiang, rak pe u, a ti,’ tiah va chim hna u,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih a thawh i, “Daihnak in na kir ṭhan a si ahcun, Bawipa nih ka sinah bia kha a chim lo a si lai,” tiah a ti. Cun amah nih cun, “Nannih mi vialte hna, kan chimmi cu thei tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah Israel siangpahrang le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Ramoth-gilead ah khan an hung kal."},"30":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “Ka mui kaa hleng lai i raldohnak chungah ka kal ve lai, sihmanhsehlaw nang cu na bawi puan kha i aih ko” tiah a ti. Cun Israel siangpahrang cu a mui aa hleng i raldohnak chungah khan a kal."},"31":{"text":"Cun Siria siangpahrang nih cun a rangleng ralbawi sawm thum le pahnih hna cu, “Israel siangpahrang dah ti lo cu, ahohmanh a hme siseh, a ngan siseh, tu hna hlah u,” tiah nawl a pek hna."},"32":{"text":"Cun rangleng ralbawi hna nih khan Jehoshafat kha an hmuh tikah, “Amah hi Israel siangpahrang a si hrimhrim ko,” tiah an ti. Cucaah amah tuk awkah khan an i mer i Jehoshafat cu a au."},"33":{"text":"Cun rangleng bawi hna nih khan amah cu Israel siangpahrang a si lo ti an hmuh tikah, amah dawinak khan an kir ṭhan."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw pakhatpa nih tinh setsaimi ngei loin a li cu a kuaih sawhsawh i Israel siangpahrang cu a thir ngaphaw angki le a ṭangphaw karlak ah a khen; cucaah a rangleng mawngtu cu, “I mer law hi i tuknak chung hin ka chuahpi tuah, zeicahtiah an ka hliam ai,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun cu ni cu an i tuknak kha a fak ngaingai i siangpahrang cu zan lei i a thih tiang, Siria mi hna lei hoih in a rangleng chungah khan an doh chom; cun a hma thi cu rangleng tawne ah khan a luang."},"36":{"text":"Cun ni a tlak hnik lioah khin, ralkapbu chungah cun, “Nanmah le nan khua cio, nanmah le nan ram cio ah tlung dih u luao,” tiin au thawng pakhat a hung um."},"37":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang cu a thi i Samaria ah an ratpi i siangpahrang cu Samaria khua chungah an vui."},"38":{"text":"Cun rangleng kha Samaria tili pawngah an ṭawl i, Bawipa nih a chimmi bia ning khan, uico nih a thi cu an liah i hlawhhlangnu hna a chungah an i kholh."},"39":{"text":"Ahab tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le, a tuahmi thil vialte hna le, vuiho inn a sakmi le, khua a sermi vialte hna cu, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"40":{"text":"Cu bangin Ahab cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a fapa Ahaziah cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"41":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Ahab a bawi kum linak ah Asa fapa Jehoshafat nih Judah cu pen hram a thawk.","title":"Jehoshafat Pennak (2Cha 20.31—21.1)"},"42":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu pennak hram a thawk ah khan kum sawm thum le kum nga a ti i Jerusalem khua in kum kul le kum nga a uk. A nu min cu Shilhi fanu Azubah a si."},"43":{"text":"A pa Asa lam vialte kha a zulh dih; Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi tuah awkah a pialtak hin lo; asinain khuahrumbo hna kha a hrawk hna lo i mi nih khan khuahrumbo ah cun rai an thawi i zihmui an khangh ṭheo ko rih."},"44":{"text":"Jehoshafat nih Israel siangpahrang he remnak zong a tuah."},"45":{"text":"Jehoshafat tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a ṭhawnnak a langhtermi le zeitindah ral a doh ti tehna kha, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"46":{"text":"Cun a pa Asa chan lio i a rak tang rihmi hlawhhlang nu le hlawhhlang pa vialte kha a ram chungin a hloh hna."},"47":{"text":"Edom ram ah cun siangpahrang an um lo; a ai awhtu cu siangpahrang a si ko."},"48":{"text":"Jehoshafat nih Ofir i sui va phortu ah Tarshish sangphawlawng a ser hna; sihmanhsehlaw an kal lo; zeicahtiah, Eziongeber ah lawng cu an rawk dih."},"49":{"text":"Cu tikah Ahab fapa Ahaziah nih khan Jehoshafat cu, “Lawng cun kan sinum hna hi na sinum hna he kal hna seh,” tiah a ti, sihmanhsehlaw Jehoshafat nih a duh lo."},"50":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a pupa hna sinah cun a pu David khua chungah an vui; cun a fapa Jehoram cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"51":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat siangpahrang a si kum hleisarihnak ah Ahab fapa Ahaziah nih Israel cu Samaria khua in pen hram a thawk i Israel cu kum hnih a uk.","title":"Ahaziah Pennak"},"52":{"text":"Bawipa mithmuh ah thil ṭhalo kha a tuah i a pa lam le a nu lam kha a zul ve i Israel mi a sualtertu Jeroboam, Nebat fapa lam kha a zulh."},"53":{"text":"Baal kha a rian a ṭuan i a biak i a pa nih a rak tuahmi vialte kha tuah in, Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu a thin a phawh."}}}}},"12":{"info":{"name":"2Siangpahrang","shortname":"2Kgs","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahab thih hnuah Moab nih Israel kha a doh.","title":"Siangpahrang Ahaziah le Elijah"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah cu Samaria khua i a innkhaan cung nung i thing kharvar thlalangawng khan a tla i a kuah ko; cucaah lamkal kha a thlah hna i, “Va kal u law, Ekron khua pathian Baal-zebub kha, hi zawtnak hin ka dam ṭhan lai maw dam ṭhan lo, va hal tuah u,” tiah a chimh hna."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Tishbemi Elijah cu Bawipa vancungmi nih a thawh i, “Tho law, Samaria siangpahrang lamkaltu hna ton awkah hung kal tuah, annih cu, ‘Israel ram chungah Pathian a um lo caah maw nannih Ekron khua pathian Baal-zebub cu hal awkah nan kal?’ tiah hung ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih hi bangin, ‘Na hung kainak ihkhun khan na ṭum ṭhan lai lo, na thi hrimhrim lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Elijah cu a kal."},"5":{"text":"Lamkal hna cu siangpahrang sinah an kir ṭhan i anih nih annih cu, “Zeicahdah nan kir?” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun annih nih amah cu, “Kannih ton awkah khan mipa pakhat a ra i kannih cu a kan thawh i, ‘An thlahtu hna siangpahrang sinah khan va kir u law amah cu, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih a ti, Israel ram chungah Pathian a um lo caah maw Ekron khua pathian Baal-zebub kha va hal awkah mi na thlah hna? Cucaah na hung kainak ihkhun khan na ṭum ti lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw na thi hrimhrim lai,’ a ti tiah va chim u a kan ti,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nannih ton awkah a ra i hi thil an chimtu hna cu zei bantuk mi dah a si?” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Annih nih an leh i, “Sahmul puan aa aih i a tai ah saphaw taisawm aa sawmh,” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “Tishbemi Elijah kha a si cu ta,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 3.4; Mar 1.6"},"9":{"text":"Khi tikah siangpahrang nih ralkap sawm nga haotu kha a mi sawm nga he cun a thlah. Tlangpar i a ṭhu komi Elijah sinah cun a hung kal i, “Maw Pathian mi, siangpahrang nih, ‘Rung ṭum seh,’ an ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw sawm nga haotu cu Elijah nih a leh i, “Keimah cu Pathian mi ka si a si ahcun, vancung khin mei rung tla seh law nangmah le na sawm nga kha in kangh dih hna seh,” tiah a ti. Cun mei cu vancung in a rung tla i amah le a sawm nga hna cu a kangh hna.","ref":"Luk 9.54"},"11":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih ralkap sawm nga haotu a dang pakhat le a mi sawm nga kha a thlah ṭhan hna. Cun a hung kal i amah cu, “Maw Pathian mi, mah hihi siangpahrang nawlbia a si, ‘Khulrang tein rung ṭum tuah!” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Elijah nih a leh i, “Keimah cu Pathian mi ka si ahcun, vancung in mei rung tla seh law, nangmah le na sawm nga kha in kangh hna seh,” tiah a ti. Khi tikah Pathian mei kha a rung tla i amah le a sawm nga kha a kangh hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih ralkap sawm nga pawl phu thumnak a haotu le a mi sawm nga kha a thlah ṭhan hna. Cun sawm nga haotu pathumnak cu a kal i Elijah hmaiah cun a ra i a bawk i, “Maw Pathian mi, keimah ka nunnak le hi na sal mi sawm nga an nunnak hi na hmaiah a sungmi si ko seh."},"14":{"text":"Zohhmanh, vancung in mei a rung tla i ralkap sawm nga haotu pahnih hna kha an ralkap sawm nga veve he khan a rak kangh hna; sihmanhsehlaw atu cu ka nunnak cu na mithmuh ah a sungmi si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun Pathian vancungmi nih Elijah cu a thawh i, ‘Amah he cun vung kal ko; amah cu ṭih hlah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a tho i siangpahrang sinah cun amah he khan an vung kal,"},"16":{"text":"cun anih nih a thawh i, “ Bawipa nih hi bangin, ‘Nangmah nih Ekron khua pathian Baal-zebub cu va hal awkah lamkal na thlah hna caah, — mah cucu Israel ram ah hin hal awk Pathian a um lo caah maw a si? — cucaah na hung kainak ihkhun khan na ṭum ti lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw na thi hrimhrim lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cuticun Elijah nih a chimmi Pathian bia ningin amah cu a thi. Cun Ahaziah nih khan fapa a ngeih lo caah, Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat fapa Jehoram a bawi kum hnihnak ah khan, a unau Joram cu amah hmun ah khan siangpahrang a cang."},"18":{"text":"Ahaziah nih a tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna cu, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Elijah cu phuchim in van ah a cawi hnik tikah khan Elijah le Elisha cu Gilgal in an i thawh.","title":"Elisha Nih Elijah A Chaan"},"2":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih Elisha cu a thawh i, “Hika ah hin rak um tuah, tiah kan nawl; zeitintiah Bawipa nih Bethel tiang kal a ka fial,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Elisha nih, “ Bawipa a nun bangin le nangmah hrimhrim na nun bangin, kan umtak lai lo,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Bethel ah an vung kal."},"3":{"text":"Cun profet fapa hna, Bethel i a ummi kha Elisha sinah cun an ra chuak i, “ Bawipa nih nihin ah hin na bawipa cu na sinin a lak lai kha na hngal maw?” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “A si, ka hngalh; dai tein um ko u,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Elijah nih cun a thawh i, “Elisha, hika ah hin rak um tuah, tiah kan nawl; Bawipa nih Jeriko tiang kal a ka fial,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih, “ Bawipa a nun bangin le nangmah hrimhrim na nun bangin, kan umtak lai lo,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Jeriko an phan."},"5":{"text":"Cun profet fapa hna Jeriko i a ummi kha Elisha pawngah cun an ra i, “ Bawipa nih nihin ah hin na bawipa cu na sinin a lak lai kha na hngal maw?” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “A si ka hngalh; dai tein um ko u,” tiah a leh hna."},"6":{"text":"Khi tikah Elijah nih cun a thawh i, “Hika ah hin rak um tuah, tiah kan nawl; zeitintiah Bawipa nih Jordan tiang kal a ka fial,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw anih nih, “ Bawipa a nun bangin le nangmah hrimhrim na nun bangin, kan umtak lai lo,” tiah a ti. Cucaah an pahnih in an va kal."},"7":{"text":"Profet fapa hna chung khan sawm nga an kal ve i Jordan tiva pawng i an pahnih in an dir lioah khan lamhla nawn in an dir."},"8":{"text":"Cun Elijah nih a puan kha aa lak i a zual i ti kha a tuk i an pahnih in lei ro cungin an va kai hlan tiang, ti cu khattelei kam le khattelei kamah an i ṭhen."},"9":{"text":"An tan dih tikah Elijah nih Elisha cu, “Nangmah sinin lak ka si hlan ah hin zeidah kan tuahpiak lai, ka hal tuah,” tiah a ti. Cun Elisha nih, “Na thlarau hi a let hnih in ka coter tuah tiah kan nawl,” a ti.","ref":"Deu 21.17"},"10":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Thil har ngai na ka hal; asinain, nangmah sinin lak ka si lio kha na ka hmuh ahcun, mah cucu na ta a si ko lai; sihmanhsehlaw na ka hmuh lo ahcun, cu bang cun a si lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun an kal lengmang i bia an i ruah lio lengmang ah cun, zohhmanh, mei rangleng pakhat le mei rang hna nih annih pahnih cu an ṭhen hna. Cun Elijah cu phuchim in vancung ah a kai."},"12":{"text":"Cun Elisha nih khan mah cucu a hmuh i, “Ka pa, ka pa! Israel mi rangleng hna le rang cung ralkap hna khing,” tiah a au. Cun cu hnu cu amah kha a hmu ti lo. Khi tikah amah a puan kha aa tlaih hna i cheu hnih ah a cheu hna.","ref":"2Sia 13.14"},"13":{"text":"Cun Elijah sinin a rung tlami puan kha aa lak i a kir i Jordan tiva kamah khan a dir."},"14":{"text":"Cun a rung tlami Elijah puan kha aa lak i ti kha a tuk i, “ Bawipa, Elijah i Pathian cu khuazei ah dah a um?” tiah a ti. Cun ti kha a tuk tikah, ti cu a sumlei le a hnalei ah an i ṭhen i Elisha cu va ral ah a kai."},"15":{"text":"Profet fapa hna, Jeriko khua i a ummi nih khan, annih an ralchan ah amah cu an hmuh tikah, “Elijah thlarau cu Elisha cungah aa fu,” tiah an ti. Cun amah don awkah khan an ra i amah hmaiah vawlei lei hoih in an kun."},"16":{"text":"Cun annih nih amah cu, “Zohhmanh, na sal hna kan sinah hin miṭhawng pa sawm nga an um; va kal hna seh law na bawipa kha va kawl hna seh tiah kan in nawl; amah cu Pathian thlarau nih a cawi i tlang pakhatkhat cungah maw, a si lo ah, nel pakhat khat cungah dik a thlak a si ko hnga dah kaw,” tiah an ti. Cun anih nih, “Nan thlah hna hnga lo,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih amah cu a ning a zah tiang an nawl tikah, anih nih, “Thlah hna u,” a ti. Cucaah mi sawm nga an thlah hna; cun ni thum chung amah cu an kawl, sihmanhsehlaw an hmu lo."},"18":{"text":"Cun Jeriko i a cam lioah khan a sinah an ra ṭhan i annih cu, “ ‘Kal hlah u,’ tiah kan ti hna lo mei kha?” tiah a ti hna."},"19":{"text":"Cu khuami nih cun Elisha cu, “Zohhmanh, hi khua a umnak hmun hi a nuam ko, ka bawipa nih a hmuh bang hin; sihmanhsehlaw a ti a ṭha lo i a ram cu rawl a vui lo,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Anih nih, “Khengkuar a tharmi pakhat in rak ka pe u law a chungah cite rawn u,” tiah a ti. Cucaah amah sinah cun an rak put."},"21":{"text":"Cun ti chuahnak hramah khan a va kal i cite kha a va paih i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, hi ti hi ka thianter cang; hi hnuah cun thihnak siseh, naurawknak siseh, hi ti in a chuak ti lai lo, a ti,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah cu ti cu nihin tiangin, Elisha nih a chimmi bia ningin, a thiang."},"23":{"text":"Cuka cun Bethel ah a hung kal; a hung kalpah ah khin, ngakchia tlawmpal kha, cu khua chung khan an ra chuak i amah cu an nihsawh i, “Lu kolh pa, hung kal tuah! Lu kolh pa, hung kal tuah,” tiah an hauh."},"24":{"text":"Cun aa mer i a hmuh hna tikah Bawipa min in chiat a serh hna. Cun ramlak in vom a pi pahnih an ra chuak i pa ngakchia cu sawm li le pahnih an seh hna."},"25":{"text":"Khika cun Karmel Tlang ah a va kal i cuka cun Samaria ah a kir."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat a bawi kum hleiriatnak ah, Ahab fapa Joram cu Israel mi cungah Samaria khua ah siangpahrang a cang i kum hleihnih a pen hna.","title":"Israel Siangpahrang Joram Pennak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa mithmuh ah thil ṭhalo kha a tuah, sihmanhsehlaw a nu le a pa bantuk kha cu a si lo, zeicahtiah a pa nih a rak sermi Baal lungphun kha a hlonh."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nebat fapa Jeroboam nih Israel mi a sualter hnanak a sualnak kha aa tlaih i a kaltak lo."},"4":{"text":"Moab siangpahrang Mesha cu tuu zua a si i Israel siangpahrang cu kum fate in tuufa sing khat le tuukawng sing khat hmul a pek lengmang awk a si.","title":"Moab He Dohnak"},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ahab a thih tikah Moab siangpahrang nih cun Israel siangpahrang cu a doh."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah cu caan ah cun Siangpahrang Joram cu Samaria in a chuak i Israel mi vialte kha a pumh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun a kal i Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat kha bia a cah i, “Moab siangpahrang nih a ka doh; Moab doh awkah ral tuknak hmun ah na ka kalpi lai maw?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, “Kan kalpi lai; keimah le nangmah cu pum khat kan si, ka mi cu na mi an si ve ko i ka rangtum hna cu na rangtum an si ve ko,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun amah nih cun a thawh i, “Khuazeilei lam in dah kan kal lai?” tiah a ti. Joram nih, “Edom ramlak lei lam in,” tiah a leh."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Israel siangpahrang cu Judah siangpahrang le Edom siangpahrang he tiah an kal. Cun annih nih aa vel in ni sarih an kal tikah ralkap caah siseh, anmah a zultu saṭil hna caah siseh ti a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Cu tikah Israel siangpahrang nih a thawh i, “Aize! Bawipa nih kannih siangpahrang pathum hna hi Moab kut chung i pek awkah a kan kawh ko hi ta,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat nih a thawh i, “Hika ah hin Bawipa a kan halpiaktu ding Bawipa profet aho tal an um lo maw?” tiah a ti. Cu tikah Israel siangpahrang sinum pakhat nih a leh i, “Elijah kut i ti a rak toihtu Elisha, Shafat fapa kha hika ah hin a um ko,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat nih cun, “ Bawipa bia cu amah sinah cun a um,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Israel siangpahrang le Jehoshafat le Edom siangpahrang cu amah sinah cun an vung kal."},"13":{"text":"Cun Elisha nih khan Israel siangpahrang cu, “Nangmah he kan i tlaknak zeidah a um? Na pa profet hna le na nu profet hna sinah khan va kal ko,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Israel siangpahrang nih amah cu a thawh i, “Asilo; Moab kut chung i pek awkah hi siangpahrang pathum hna a autu hna hi Bawipa a si ko,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun Elisha nih cun a thawh i, “Ralkapbu Bawipa, a rian ka ṭuanmi a nun bangin, Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat kha hmaizah hlah ning law cu, a zoh zong kan zoh duh hnga lo i a hmuh zong kan hmu duh hnga lo."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tingtang tum thiammi hunpi tuah ngat u,” tiah a ti.
