Cun Jeroboam nih Israel cu Bawipa zulhnak khan a pialpi i a nganmi sualnak kha a tuahter hna."},"22":{"text":"Israel mi cu Jeroboam nih a rak tuahmi sualnak vialte kha an tuah ve i an pialtak hna lo;"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nih a sal profet vialte hna in a chim bantuk khan Israel cu a mithmuh phak lonak ah a ṭhial hlantiang, annih nih mah cucu an kaltak hna lo. Cucaah Israel mi cu anmah ram in Assiria ram ah nihin tiang sal ah an tang."},"24":{"text":"Cun Assiria siangpahrang nih Babilon, Kuth, Avva, Hamath le Sefarvaim khua in mi kha a ratpi hna i Israel mi can ah khan Samaria ram khua chungah a chiah hna; cun Samaria ram kha an co i a khua hna chungah khan an um.","title":"Samaria Chungah Mi Umter Ṭhannak"},"25":{"text":"Cun an umter ah cun Bawipa kha an ṭih lo; cucaah Bawipa nih chiandeih a thlahhnawh hna i tlawmpal an seh hna."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah Assiria siangpahrang cu an chimh i, “Nangmah nih na kalpi hna i Samaria ram khua chung i na va chiahmi miphun hna nih cu ram pathian phunglam kha an hngal lo; cucaah chiandeih a thlahhnawh hna i zohhmanh an seh len ko hna, zeicahtiah annih nih cu ram pathian phunglam kha an hngal lo,” tiah an ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Assiria siangpahrang nih khan, “Khika in nan ratpimi tlangbawi hna lakin pakhat cu khika ah khan kua ṭhan u; cun va kal seh law khika ah va um seh law cu ram pathian phunglam cu va cawnpiak hna seh,” tiah nawl a pek."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Samaria ram in an kalpimi tlangbawi hna lakin pakhat cu a ra i Bethel khua ah khan a um i zeitindah Bawipa an ṭih awk a si kha a cawnpiak hna."},"29":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miphun kip nih anmahle an pathian cio kha an i ser hna i Samaria mi nih an rak sermi khuahrum bo i hmunthiang hna ah khan an chiah hna, miphun kip nih an mahle an umnak khua cio ah khan an chiah hna."},"30":{"text":"Babilon mi nih Sukkoth-benoth an ser, Kuth mi nih Nergal an ser, Hamath mi nih Ashima an ser i"},"31":{"text":"Avva mi nih Nibhaz le Tartak an ser; cun Sefarvaim mi nih Sefarvaim pathian hna Adrammelek le Anammelek biaknak ah an fale kha mei ah an khangh hna."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa zong kha an ṭih ṭhiamṭhiam, cucaah anmah lakin khuahrum bo tlangbawi ah khan an i ser i khuahrum bo hmunthiang hna ah cun rai an thawipiak hna."},"33":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa cu an ṭih ko, sihmanhsehlaw an chuahpi hnanak miphun hna nih an tuahning khan, an pathian hna rian kha an ṭuan fawn."},"34":{"text":"Nihin ni tiang hin hlan i an rak tuahning khan an tuah ko. Annih nih Bawipa kha an bia lo i Bawipa nih Israel tiah min a sakmi Jakob i a tefa hna sinah nawl a pekmi nawlbia si hna seh, phunglam si hna seh, phungbia siseh, phung siseh, an zul lo.","ref":"Gen 32.28; 35.10"},"35":{"text":"Bawipa nih annih he biakamnak a ser i nawl a pek hna i, “Nannih nih pathian dang kha nan ṭih hna in an hmaiah nan kun in an rian nan ṭuan in raithawinak nan pechan hna lai lo;","ref":"Exo 20.5; Deu 5.9"},"36":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Izipt ram chungin a nganmi ṭhawnnak le samhmi ban he an chuahpitu hna Bawipa kha cu nan ṭih lai; amah hmaiah nan kun lai i raithawinak nan pekchanh lai.","ref":"Deu 6.13"},"37":{"text":"Cun an ṭialpiakmi hna nawlbia hna le phunglam hna le phungbia hna le phung hna cu zulh awkah nan i ralring zungzal lai. Nannih nih pathian dang cu nan ṭih hna lai lo,"},"38":{"text":"cun nanmah he ka sermi biakamnak kha nan philh lai lo. Nannih nih pathian dang kha nan ṭih hna lai lo,"},"39":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw nan Pathian cu nan ṭih lai i nan ral vialte hna kut chungin an chuahter hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih an ngai duh lo i hmasa an tuah tawn ning ṭheo khan an tuah ko."},"41":{"text":"Cuticun hi miphun hna nih hin Bawipa cu an ṭih i serchommi an siasal hna cu an biak ṭhiamṭhiam fawn hna; an fale le an fale fa hna zong nih an tuah — an pupa hna nih an tuah bantukin nihin ni tiangin an tuah ko."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Elah fapa Hoshea a bawi kum thumnak ah, Judah siangpahrang Ahaz fapa Hezekiah cu bawi hram aa thawk.","title":"Hezekiah Pennak (2Cha 29.1-2 ; 31.1)"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum kul le kum nga a si i Jerusalem khua in kum kul le kum kua a pen hna. A nu min cu Abi a si, Zekhariah fanu a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun amah nih a pu David nih a rak tuah bantuk khan Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi thil kha a tuah."},"4":{"text":"Khuahrum bo kha a hrawh hna i lungphun kha a chimh hna i Asherah kha a hau. Cun Moses nih a rak sermi dar rul kha a den cikcek, zeicaahdah tiah, Israel mi nih cu caan tiang cun zihmui kha an khanghhnawh; Nehushtan tiah an ti.","ref":"Nam 21.9"},"5":{"text":"Amah nih Bawipa, Israel Pathian aa bochan; cucaah Judah siangpahrang vialte hna lakah amah hnuah amah bantuk an um ti lo i amah hlan zongah amah bantuk an rak um lo."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah nih Bawipa kha fek tein aa tlaih i amah hnu zulhnak kha a kaltak lo i Bawipa nih Moses nawl a pekmi nawlbia kha a zulh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu amah sinah a um i a kalnak paoh ah khua awng a tong. Assiria siangpahrang kha a doh i a rian a ṭuan duh lo."},"8":{"text":"Filistin mi cu Gaza le a peng tiangin, a tuk hna i ralvennak innsang in kulhmi khua tiang, a tei hna."},"9":{"text":"Hezekiah siangpahrang a bawi kum linak, cucu Israel siangpahrang Elah fapa Hoshea a bawi kum sarihnak a si, cu kum ah cun Assiria siangpahrang Shalmaneser nih Samaria kha a hunhnawh i a kulh i","title":"Samaria Rawhnak"},"10":{"text":"kum thum a dihnak ah a lak. Hezekiah a bawi kum ruknak, cucu Israel siangpahrang Hoshea a bawi kum kuanak a si, cu kum ah cun Samaria cu a lak."},"11":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang nih Israel mi cu Assiria ram ah a kalpi hna i Halah le Gozan ram tiva Habor ah le Media mi hna khua hna ah khan a chiah hna,"},"12":{"text":"zeicahdah a si tiah annih nih Bawipa an Pathian aw kha an ngai lo i a biakamnak kha an buar, Bawipa sal Moses nih nawl a pekmi vialte hna hmanh kha an buar; a ngaih zong an ngai duh lo, a tuah zong an tuah duh lo."},"13":{"text":"Hezekiah Siangpahrang a bawi kum hleilinak ah Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib nih khan Judah ram chung i kulh mi khua vialte kha a rathnawh hna i a lak hna.","title":"Sennakherib Nih A Chim Hna (Isa 36.1-22)"},"14":{"text":"Cun Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah nih Lakhish ah Assiria siangpahrang sinah cun mi a hei thlah hna i, “Ka palh cang; ka kirtak ko; ka cung i na ka khinhmi paoh ka in lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Assiria siangpahrang nih Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah cu ngun talen za thum le sui talen sawm thum a cawh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih Bawipa inn chung i a ummi ngun vialte le siangpahrang inn rokuang chung i a ummi ngun vialte cu a pek dih."},"16":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun Hezekiah nih Bawipa biakinn innka i a ummi sui le Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah nih innka tung a hutnak hna sui cu a lak i Assiria siangpahrang kha a pek."},"17":{"text":"Cun Assiria siangpahrang nih khan ralbawi bik le tilditmi upa bik le ralbawi ngan bik kha ralkapbu nganpi he Lakhish in Jerusalem ah Hezekiah siangpahrang sinah a hei thlah hna. Annih nih an rat tikah Puansutu Lo lei i a kalmi lam pawng i a ummi, cunglei tili tidong pawngah khan an ra i an dir."},"18":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang kha an auh tikah inn zohkhenhtu Hilkiah i a fapa Eliakim le caṭialtu Shebnah le cazin tlaitu Joah, Asaf fapa kha an ra chuak."},"19":{"text":"Cun ralbawi ngan bik nih cun a thawh hna i, “Hezekiah sinah cun, ‘Hi bangin a liannganmi siangpahrang, Assiria siangpahrang nih: Zei cungah dah na lung hi a hmunh:"},"20":{"text":"Bia menmen hi raldohnak ca i fimnak le thazang an si tiah na ruah! Ahodah na vaa hngatchan i na hei ka doh?"},"21":{"text":"Zohhmanh, aa hngauhmi paoh an kut a rak chuntu hluang ṭhiangṭhunh per, Izipt naa bochan ko hih. Cu bantuk cu pei Izipt siangpahrang Faro cu amah aa bochanmi hna caah a si ko cu."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, “ Bawipa kan Pathian kan i bochan” nan ka ti ahcun, amah cu Hezekiah nih a khuahrum bo hna le a biakṭheng hna a hrawhpiak i Judah le Jerusalem cu, “Jerusalem i a ummi biakṭheng hmaiah hin nan biak lai,” a timi kha a si lo maw?"},"23":{"text":"Cucaah cun ra law Assiria siangpahrang ka bawipa he biakamnak ser tuah u: Nangmah nih aa cittu dingmi naa hmuh khawh hna ahcun, rangtum thong hnih kan pek lai."},"24":{"text":"A si kun ahcun, rangleng ca le rangcung ralkap ca i Izipt naa bochan tikah hin, zeitindah ka bawipa sal hna lak i a hme bik ralbawi pakhat hmanh hi na khirh khawh kun lai?"},"25":{"text":"Cu hleiah hi hmun hi hrawh awk i ka hunhnawh tikah hin Bawipa hnatla loin maw a si? Bawipa nih cun pei a ka thawh i, “Hi ram hi hung kalhnawh law hung hrawk,” a ka ti cu, a ti,’ tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti hna."},"26":{"text":"Cun Hilkiah fapa Eliakim le Shebnah le Joah nih ralbawi ngan bik cu, “Zaangfahnak tein na sal hna hi Aramaik holh in kan chawn tuah, zeitintiah kan hngalh ko; ralhau cungah a ummi hna theih ah Judah holh in kan chawn hlah,” tiah an ti."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ralbawi ngan bik nih cun a thawh hna i, “Hi bia hi nan bawipa le nanmah lawng sin i chim awkah maw ka bawipa nih a ka thlah? Ralhau cung i a ṭhumi hna, anmah ek lila ei awkah le anmah zun lila din awkah nannih he hrawh awkah ruah cangmi hna kha ka chim ve hna hnga lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun ralbawi ngan bik cu a dir i aw fak piin Judah holh in a au i, “A liannganmi siangpahrang, Assiria siangpahrang bia cu ngai tuah u!"},"29":{"text":"Hi bangin siangpahrang nih a ti: ‘Hezekiah cu i hlenter hlah u, zeitintiah amah nih ka kut chungin an khamh kho hna lai lo."},"30":{"text":"“ Bawipa nih a kan chuahter ṭheo lai; hi khuapi cu Assiria siangpahrang kut chungah pek a si lai lo,” ti bia in Hezekiah cu Bawipa kha i hngatchanter hlah u."},"31":{"text":"Hezekiah bia cu ngai hlah u, zeitintiah hi bangin Assiria siangpahrang nih a ti: ‘Keimah he remnak ser u law keimah sinah ra chuak tuah u; nan nun i nan thih nakhnga lo, nanmah ram bantuk a simi ram, rawl le mitsur hang a tamnak, changreu le mitsur dum a tamnak, oliv thingkung le khuaihliti a tamnak ram i kan kalpi hna hlantiang nannih nih nan dihlak in nanmahle nan mitsur ruang theitlai cio le nanmahle nan theipi kung theitlai cio kha nan ei lai i nanmahle nan tikhor cio ah ti nan din lai. Cun nannih nih Hezekiah nih, Bawipa nih a kan khamh lai, ti bia in a pingah an hruai tik hna ah a bia kha va ngai hlah u.","merge":"32"},"33":{"text":"Miphun hna pathian hna lakah aho tal nih a ram cu Assiria siangpahrang kut chungin a chanh kho bal maw?"},"34":{"text":"Hamath le Arpad pathian hna cu khuazei ah dah an um? Sefarvaim, Hena le Ivvah pathian hna cu khuazei ah dah an si? Samaria cu keimah kut chungin an chuahter kho maw?"},"35":{"text":"Jerusalem cu Bawipa nih ka kut chungin a chuahter nakhnga ding caah, hi ram vialte hna pathian hna lakah hin ka kut chungin an ram a chuahter khotu aho tal an um maw?” a ti,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi cu dai zirziar in an um i bia kaa khat hmanh an let lo, zeicahtiah siangpahrang nawl pekmi cu, “Let hlah u,” ti a si,"},"37":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang inn zohkhenhtu Eliakim, Hilkiah fapa le caṭialtu Shebnah le cazin tlaitu Joah, Asaf fapa kha an puan tlek he Hezekiah sinah cun an ra i ralbawi ngan bik bia kha an chimh."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah Siangpahrang nih a theih tikah, a puan a thleh i buri aa aih i Bawipa inn chungah a lut.","title":"Sennakherib Kut Chungin Judah A Luat (Isa 37.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Cun inn zohkhenhtu Eliakim le caṭialtu Shebnah le tlangbawi upa hna, khumpuan aa aih ciomi hna kha, profet Isaiah, Amoz fapa, sinah a thlah hna."},"3":{"text":"Annih nih amah cu, “Hi bangin Hezekiah nih, ‘Nihin cu lung retheihnak le nehsawhnak le ningzahnak ni a si. Fa cu an chuah caan a tling cang nain, hrinnak caah thazang a um lo."},"4":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang nih a nungmi Pathian zawmhtaih awkah a ralbawi ngan bik cu a rak thlah cang. Amah bia vialte cu Bawipa na Pathian nih a theih zong a theih ko cang lai i a theihmi bia cu pakpalawng ah a can zong a canter ko lai; cucaah a tang rihmi a tangmi tete hna caah hin thla cam tuah,’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Hezekiah Siangpahrang salle hna cu Isaiah sinah an rat tikah"},"6":{"text":"Isaiah nih annih cu, “Nan bawipa sinah cun, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih: Assiria siangpahrang sal hna nih an ka zawmhtaihnak bia na theihmi caah na thinphang hlah."},"7":{"text":"Zohhmanh, a chungah thlarau pakhat ka chiah lai i biathangchin a theih lai i amah ram ah a kir lai; cun amah ram chung lila ah vainam in ka thihter lai, a ti,’ tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang nih Lakhish kha a kaltak i Libnah a tuk tiah ralbawi ngan bik nih a theih tikah, cuka ah cun amah ton awkah khan a va kal."},"9":{"text":"Assiria mi hna nih, Izipt ralkapbu, Ethiopia siangpahrang Tirhakah haomi nih, kanmah doh awkah an i thawh cang, ti kha an theih i cucu siangpahrang nih a theih tikah, Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah cu ca a hei pek i,"},"10":{"text":"“Naa bochanmi pathian, ‘Ka kut chungah na tla lai lo,’ an timi cu i lun hlah."},"11":{"text":"Assiria siangpahrang nih hrawh awkah aa khinh cangmi ram hna cu zeitindah a tuah hna ti cu na hngalh ko. Ka luat hnga tiah naa ruat maw?"},"12":{"text":"Ka pupa hna nih Gozan khua, Haran khua, Rezef khua an hrawh hna le Telassar ah a ummi Beth-eden mi an thah hna i an pathian vialte hmanh nih an chanh khawh hna lo kha na theih ko."},"13":{"text":"Hamath khua, Arpad khua, Sefarvaim khua, Hena khua le Ivvah khua siangpahrang hna kha tah khuazei ah dah an um cang?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Lamkal hna kut cun Hezekiah nih ca kha a hmuh i a rel; cun Hezekiah cu Bawipa inn ah a hung kal i Bawipa hmaiah cun ca cu a samh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Bawipa hmaiah cun Hezekiah nih thla a cam i, “Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, cherubim cungah a ṭhumi, vawlei cung pennak vialte hna Pathian cu nangmah lawnglawng hi na si; nangmah nih van le vawlei kha na ser hna.","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na hna chi law thei tuah, na mit cu au law hmu tuah; cun Sennakherib nih a nungmi Pathian zawmhtaih awkah a chimmi bia hi thei tuah hna."},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, Assiria siangpahrang hna nih miphun hna le an ram cu an hrawh taktak hna i,"},"18":{"text":"an pathian hna cu mei chungah an paih taktak hna; zeitintiah annih cu pathian an si lo, mi kut serchommi men an si, thing le lung an si; cucaah cun annih cu hrawh an si."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah maw Bawipa, kan Pathian, vawlei cung pennak vialte nih, maw Bawipa, nangmah lawnglawng hi Pathian na si ti kha an hngalh naklai, amah kut chung hin kan khamh ko, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Amoz fapa Isaiah nih Hezekiah sinah bia a cah i, “Hi bangin, Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, ‘Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib kong i na thlacamnak kha ka rak theih,’ a ti."},"21":{"text":"Mah hihi amah kong ah Bawipa nih a chimmi bia cu a si: Maw Sennakherib, nangmah cu Zion fanu nih an zawmhtaih i an nihsawh, Jerusalem fanu nih na hnulei in a lu an thinhnawh."},"22":{"text":"Na nihsawh i na serhsat i Na aw na perhhnawh i ruamkai ngaiin na mit na renghhnawhmi Israel mi Thiang kha a si ko!"},"23":{"text":"Na lamkaltu hna in Bawipa na zawmhtaih i ‘Ka rangleng tampi he tlangpar ah ka kai, Lebanon tlang a kenne tiang ka phan; a sidar thing a sang bik hna le a saipres thing a ṭha bik kha ka hau hna; a ram deng bik le a chah bik a tupi chungah ka lut;"},"24":{"text":"Tikhor ka cawh hna i ramdang ti ka din hna. Cun Izipt tiva kha ka kepha in ka kaoter,’ na ti."},"25":{"text":"“Hlanpi in ka rak ruah cang, tiah na thei lo maw? Atu cu ka tlinter cang. Ralhruang in kulhmi khualipi hna cu rawkmi thilpon ah ser kan onh i,"},"26":{"text":"an chungah a ummi minung hna cu zeihmanh tuah kho loin khuaruahhar le vansang au in an um. Lo chung ramkung le inncung khomi belh bantuk, an ṭhan hlan i nichuahlei thli nih a cartermi hna bantuk an si."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na ṭhut, na luh, na chuah le ka cung i na thinhun kha ka hngalh ko."},"28":{"text":"Ka cungah na thin a hun le na ruamkainak cu ka hna chungah a ra phan cang i na hnar in ka sio in kan sio lai i na kaa chungah ka chak kan hlomh lai. Cun na ratnak lam in kan kirter ṭhan lai,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun Isaiah nih Siangpahrang Hezekiah cu, hihi nangmah caah hmelchunhnak a si lai, a ti: tukum le kumvoi cu rawl a hlih nan i rinh lai; asinain a kum thumnak ah cun rawl kha nan tuh lai, nan ṭuan lai; mitsur dum kha nan ser hna lai i an theitlai kha nan ei hna lai."},"30":{"text":"Cun Judah innchungkhar chungin a nung in a tangmi hna cu vawlei chungah thuk piin hram a thla i thei a tlaimi bantuk an si lai."},"31":{"text":"Jerusalem le Zion Tlang ah a tangmi an um lai. Ralkapbu Bawipa ṭannak nih mah hi cu a tuah lai."},"32":{"text":"“Cucaah Bawipa nih Assiria siangpahrang kong ah hi bangin a ti: Hi khua chungah a lut lai lo, hika ah thal zong a thlah lai lo, phaw he zong a rathnawh lai lo i a hram ah raldohnak chuntlung zong a serhnawh lai lo."},"33":{"text":"A ratnak lam te khan a kir ṭhan lai i hi khua chungah a lut lai lo."},"34":{"text":"Zeitintiah hi khua cu keimah ruang le ka sal David ruangah khamh awkah ka humhak lai,” tiah Bawipa nih a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun cu zan ah cun Bawipa vancungmi a kal i Assiria mi riahhmun ah cun sing khat, sang riat le thong nga a va thah hna; cun zingkate i mi nih an thawh tikah, zohhmanh, hi hna cu miruak an rak si dih ko."},"36":{"text":"Cun Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib cu a kal i inn ah a tlung i Nineveh ah a um."},"37":{"text":"Cun a pathian Nisrok biakinn chungah a biak lioah khan, a fapa Adrammelek le Sharezer nih vainam in an thah i Ararat ram ah an zam. Cun a fapa Esarhaddon cu amah hmun ah khan bawi a hung cang."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan ah Hezekiah cu a zaw i a thi dengmang. Cun Amoz fapa profet Isaiah kha a sinah a ra i, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Na innchungkhar kha a ningcang tein chia tuah; zeicahtiah na thi ko lai, na dam ṭhan lai lo,’ tiah a ti.","title":"Hezekiah Zawtnak (2Cha 32.24-26 ; Isa 38.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih vampang leiah aa mer i Bawipa sinah thla a cam i,"},"3":{"text":"‘Maw Bawipa, zeitindah nangmah hmaiah zumhawktlak le lungcheubang loin ka kal tawn i nangmah mithmuh ah a ṭhami ka tuah kha na cinken nakhnga, kan nawl,” tiah a ti. Cun Hezekiah cu a ṭap thluahmah ko."},"4":{"text":"Cun Isaiah cu a laifang tual khan a chuah hlanah khin Bawipa bia cu a sinah a ra i,"},"5":{"text":"“I let law ka mi hna bawi Hezekiah sinah cun, hi bangin Bawipa, na pu David Pathian nih, ‘Na thlacamnak kha ka theih i na mitthli kha ka hmuh; zohhmanh, kan damter lai; a ni thumnak ni ah Bawipa inn ah na hung kal lai."},"6":{"text":"Cun na nunnak ah hin kum hleinga kan chap lai. Nangmah le hi khua cu Assiria siangpahrang kut chungin kan chuah hna lai i keimah ruang le ka sal David ruangah hi khua cu ka humhak lai,’ a ti tiah va chim,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Isaiah nih, “Theipi car hlum khat in rak pu u. Cun hei kalpi hna seh law, a dam ṭhan hnga, a hma cungah khan va chia hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih Isaiah cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa nih a ka damter lai i Bawipa inn ah a ni thumnak ah ka hung kal lai, tinak caah zeidah hmelchunhnak a si lai?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Isaiah nih, “ Bawipa nih aa kam ciami cu a tuah lai i hmelchunhnak Bawipa sinin nangmah sinah a rami cu hihi a si: ni thladem hi hmailei ah maw kar hra a kal lai hnulei ah dah kar hra a kir lai?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih a leh i, “Ni thladem caah cun kar hra hei sau deuh cu a fawimi thil a si ko, asinain ni thladem cu kar hra in kir deuh ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun profet Isaiah nih Bawipa cu a auh i Ahaz ni tahnak ah a liam cangmi thladem kha kar hra a hnuh ṭhan."},"12":{"text":"Khi caan ah Babilon siangpahrang Baladan fapa Merodak-baladan nih Hezekiah cu a zaw ti kha a rak theih caah lamkaltu hna cu ca le laksawng he a hei thlah hna.","title":"Babilon Ram In Lamkaltu Hezekiah Nih A Rak Conglawmh Hna (Isa 39.1-8)"},"13":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih a rak conglawmh hna i a ro inn vialte, ngun, sui, rimthawmi, a sungmi chiti, a ral hriamnam, a thil chiahnak inn hna chung i a ummi vialte kha a hmuhsak hna; a inn chung i a ummi siseh a ram chung i a ummi siseh, Hezekiah nih a hmuhsak lomi hna a um lo."},"14":{"text":"Cun profet Isaiah cu Siangpahrang Hezekiah sinah a ra i, “Hi hna nih hin zeidah an chim? Cun khuazei in dah na sinah an rat?” tiah a ti. Cun Hezekiah nih, “Annih cu a hlatpi ram, Babilon in an ra,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Anih nih, “Na inn chungah zeidah an hmuh?” tiah a ti. Hezekiah nih, “Ka inn chung i a ummi thil vialte cu an hmuh dih ko; ka thil chiahnak inn hna chung i a ummi thil ka hmuhsak hna lomi an um lo,” tiah a leh."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah Isaiah nih Hezekiah cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa bia hi ngai tuah:"},"17":{"text":"Zohhmanh, na inn chung i a ummi thil vialte le nihin tiangin na pupa hna nih an khonmi thil hna cu Babilon i kalpi lai caan ni a ra lio; nganhtami thil zeihmanh a um lai lo, tiah Bawipa nih a ti.","ref":"2Sia 24.13-15; 2Cha 36.10; Dan 1.1-7"},"18":{"text":"Cun nangmah nih na hrinmi na fapa hna hrimhrim lakah hin a cheu cu kalpi an si lai i Babilon siangpahrang i a siangpahrang inn ah annih cu tilditmi an si lai,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Khi tikah Hezekiah nih Isaiah cu, “ Bawipa bia na chimmi cu a ṭha ko,” tiah a ti. Zeicahtiah, “Keimah chan chung i daihnak le himnak a um paoh ah zeidah?” tiah a ruah."},"20":{"text":"Hezekiah tuahsernak a tang rihmi le a ṭhawnnak vialte le zeitindah tili le tidong kha a ser i khuapi chungah ti kha a luhter ti kha, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?","title":"Hezekiah Thihnak (2Cha 32.32-33)"},"21":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a fapa Manasseh cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum hleihnih a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm nga le kum nga a bawi. A nu min cu Hefzibah a si.","title":"Manasseh Pennak (2Cha 33.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel mi hna hmai in a ṭhawlmi hna miphun hna nih an tuahmi fihnung phunglam ning khan, amah nih Bawipa mithmuh ah ṭhat lonak kha a tuah.","ref":"Jer 15.4"},"3":{"text":"Zeitintiah a pa Hezekiah nih a rak hrawhmi khuahrum bo kha a remh ṭhan hna i Israel siangpahrang Ahab nih a tuah bantuk khan Baal le Asherah caah biakṭheng a ser hna i van i a ummi thil vialte khi a biak hna i an rian a ṭuan hna."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “Jerusalem khua ah ka min cu ka chiah lai,” tiin a rak tihnawh chanmi Bawipa inn chungah biakṭheng a ser hna.","ref":"2Sam 7.13"},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inntual pahnih chungah khan van i a ummi thil vialte hna caah biakṭheng a ser hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun thawinak caah a fapa kha mei in a khangh i camh le litin kha a hman hna i thitlawn thiam le hnam kha a fuhpanh hna. Bawipa mithmuh ah ṭhat lonak tampi a tuah i a thin a hunter."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih David le a fapa Solomon sinah, “Hi inn chungah le Israel miphun vialte lakin ka thimmi Jerusalem khua chungah ka min ka chiah zungzal lai i ka mi Israel mi hna nih hin nawl ka pekmi vialte hna ning le Moses nih nawl a pekmi vialte hna ning in an tuah ahcun an pupa hna sinah ka rak pekmi ram chung hin an ke cu ka pialter lai lo,” tiah a timi inn chungah khan amah nih a serchommi Asherah siasal cu a chiah.","ref":"1Sia 9.3-5; 2Cha 7.12-18","merge":"8"},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih an ngai duh lo i Israel mi hna hmai in Bawipa nih a hrawhmi miphun hna nih an rak tuahmi nakkhan ṭhat lonak tam deuh Manasseh nih cun a tuahter hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, a sal profet hna in bia a chim i,"},"11":{"text":"“Judah siangpahrang Manasseh nih hi thil fihnung hi a tuah hna i amah hlan ah a rak ummi Amor mi nih an tuahmi vialte nakin a ṭhalo deuhmi thil a tuah hna i a siasal hna in Judah mi kha a sualter hna caah,"},"12":{"text":"cucaah Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih hi bangin a ti: ‘Zohhmanh, a ṭhat lo tuk i a theitu paoh an hna a khenh lai ding ṭhat lonak cu Jerusalem le Judah cungah ka tlunter lai."},"13":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem cungah hin Samaria tahnak hri le Ahab innchungkhar suthri thlaimi cu ka zam hna lai i mi nih kheng cu an hnawh i an hnawh dih in a khup in an chiah bang khin Jerusalem cu ka hnawh lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun a tangmi ka ro hi ka hlonh lai i an ral hna kut chungah ka chanh hna lai i an ral hna caah ral tlaihmi le hranchaw an si lai,"},"15":{"text":"zeicahtiah annih nih an pupa hna Izipt ram in an chuah ni in atu tiang ka mithmuh i ṭhat lonak kha an tuah lengmang ko;” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cu hleiah Manasseh nih Judah mi kha a sualter hna caah Bawipa mithmuh i ṭhat lonak kha an tuah i, kha a sualternak hna a sualnak hleiah khan, a sual lomi thisen tampi a chuah fawn, Jerusalem cu khattelei deng in khattelei deng tiang a khat."},"17":{"text":"Manasseh tuahsernak a tang rihmi le a tuahmi vialte le sualnak a tuahmi vialte cu, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"18":{"text":"Cun Manasseh cu a pupa hna sinah a it i amah dum chung, Uzza dum chungah an vui; cun a fapa Amon cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"19":{"text":"Amon cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum kul le kum hnih a si i Jerusalem in kum hnih a bawi. A nu min cu Meshullemeth a si, i amah cu Jotbah khuami Haruz fanu a si.","title":"Amon Pennak (2Cha 33.21-25)"},"20":{"text":"A pa Manasseh nih a rak tuah bangkhan Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah ve."},"21":{"text":"A pa nih a rak zulhmi lam kha a zulh hna i a pa nih an rian a rak ṭuanmi siasal vialte kha an rian a ṭuan hna i a biak hna;"},"22":{"text":"Bawipa, a pupa hna Pathian cu a hlawt i Bawipa lam kha a zul lo."},"23":{"text":"Cun Amon cu a sinum hna nih an rawi i siangpahrang inn chungah khan an thah."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Siangpahrang Amon a rawitu hna kha rammi nih an thah dih hna i rammi nih cun a fapa Josiah kha amah hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah an ser."},"25":{"text":"Amon tuahsernak a tang rihmi cu Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"26":{"text":"Cun amah cu Uzza dum chung i a thlan ah khan an vui i a fapa Josiah cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah cu bawi hram aa thawk tikah kum riat a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm thum le kum khat a bawi. A nu min cu Jedidah a si, amah cu Bozkath khuami Adaiah fanu a si.","title":"Josiah Pennak (2Cha 34.1-2)","ref":"Jer 3.6"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa mithmuh ah a dikmi thil kha a tuah i a pu David lam kha a zul, orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh a pial lo."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang Josiah a bawi kum hleiriatnak ah Meshullam fapa Azaliah i fapa Shafan, caṭialtu kha, Bawipa inn ah a hei thlah i,","title":"Phungbia Cauk An Hmuh (2Cha 34.8-33)"},"4":{"text":"“Tlangbawi ngan Hilkiah sinah khan hung kal law innleng cawngtu hna nih mi zapi sinin an lakmi tangka Bawipa inn chung i luhpi a simi kha zeizat dah a si tiah rak rel seh;"},"5":{"text":"cun Bawipa inn zohkhenhtu rianṭuantu hna kut chungah rak pe seh; cun annih nih Bawipa inn a remh lengmangtu,"},"6":{"text":"lehtama hna le inn satu hna le lung lei zungthiam hna kha rak pe hna seh, cun inn remhnak ca i thingah le khoihmi lung cawknak caah khan a si fawn lai."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih lihchim lo tein an ṭuan caah an kut chung i pekmi tangka kha zeitindah an hman tiah tuakpiak ṭhan an si lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi ngan Hilkiah nih caṭialtu Shafan kha, “ Bawipa inn chungah phungbia cauk kha ka hmuh,” tiah a rak chimh. Cun Hilkiah nih cauk cu Shafan kha a pek i a rel."},"9":{"text":"Cun caṭialtu Shafan cu siangpahrang sinah a ra i siangpahrang cu, “Inn chung i a ummi tangka cu na sal hna nih an bungh i Bawipa inn a zohkhenhtu rianṭuantu hna kut chungah khan an chanh cang,” tiah a chimh."},"10":{"text":"Cun caṭialtu Shafan nih cun siangpahrang cu, “Tlangbawi Hilkiah nih cauk pakhat a ka pek,” tiah a ti. Cun Shafan nih Siangpahrang hmaiah cun a rel."},"11":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih phungbia cauk chung bia cu a theih tikah a puan kha a thleh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih tlangbawi Hilkiah le Shafan fapa Ahikam le Mikaiah fapa Akbor le caṭialtu Shafan le siangpahrang sinum Asaiah kha nawl a pek hna i,"},"13":{"text":"“Va kal u law hi cauk hmuhmi chungbia kong ah hin Bawipa cu, keimah ca le mi zapi ca le Judah vialte caah, va hal tuah u; zeicahtiah, kan pupa hna nih hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi bia, kannih ca i aa ṭialmi bia vialte ning khan an rak tuah lo caah Bawipa thinhunnak kan cung i a alhmi cu a ngan ko,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah tlangbawi Hilkiah le Ahikam le Akbor le Shafan le Asaiah kha nu profet Huldah, hnipuan chiahnak zohkhenhtu Harhas fapa Tikvah i fapa Shallum nupi, sinah khan an va kal (amah cu Jerusalem khua chungah Sang Hnihnak ah khan a um); cun amah cu bia an ruah."},"15":{"text":"Cun anih nih annih cu, “ Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih hi bangin a ti, ‘Ka sinah an thlahtu hna hi,"},"16":{"text":"Hi bangin Bawipa nih a ti, zohhmanh, Judah siangpahrang nih cauk chung bia a relmi vialte kha, hi hmun cung le a chung i a ummi cungah ṭhat lonak ka tlunter lai,"},"17":{"text":"annih nih an ka hlawt i pathian dang hna sinah khan zihmui an khangh i annih nih ka thinphawhnak caah an kut in hi rian vialte kha an tuah caah hi hmun cungah hin ka thinhunnak cu a alh lai i a mit lai lo."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa hal awkah an thlahtu hna Judah siangpahrang tu cu, hi bangin nan va chimh lai. Hi bangin Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih a ti: Bia na theihmi kong ah,"},"19":{"text":"hi hmun le hika i a ummi hna cu an ṭiao lai i chiatserhnak an ing lai ti in ka chimmi bia kha na theih tikah na lung cu aa ngaihchih i Bawipa hmaiah toidor in na um ca le na hnipuan na thleh hna i ka hmai i na ṭah caah, kei zong nih na bia cu kan theihpiak ve, tiah Bawipa nih a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah zohhmanh, nang cu na pupa hna sinah kan pumh lai i dai tein thlankhor na phan lai, cun hi hmun cung i ṭhat lonak ka tlunter laimi hi na mit nih a hmu lai lo,’ a ti, tiah chim hna, a ka ti,” tiah a ti. Cun siangpahrang sinah cun bia cu an hei lanhpi."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih khan mi a thlah hna i Judah le Jerusalem upa vialte cu a sinah an i pum.","title":"Josiah Nih Siasal Biaknak A Hlonh"},"2":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu Bawipa inn ah khan a hung kal i a sinah cun Judah ram mi vialte le Jerusalem khuami vialte le tlangbawi hna le profet hna le, mi vialte, a hme siseh a ngan siseh, an kal ve; cun Bawipa inn chung i hmuhmi biakamnak cauk chung bia vialte kha an theihhngan ah a rel dih."},"3":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu tungpi hram ah khan a dir i, Bawipa kha zulh i a nawlbia hna le a hngalhternak bia hna le a phungbia hna kha a lungthin dihlak le a nunnak dihlak in zulh awk le hi cauk chungah aa ṭialmi biakamnak bia hna kha tuah awkah Bawipa hmaiah khan bia aa kam; cun mi vialte nih khan a tuahmi biakamnak cu an tuahpi ve."},"4":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih tlangbawi ngan Hilkiah le a niam deuhmi tlangbawi hna kha le innleng cawngtu hna kha Bawipa biaknak inn chungin Baal le Asherah le van i a ummi thil hna ca i sermi umkheng vialte kha chuah dih awkah a fial hna; Jerusalem khua leng Kidron lo chungah khan a khangh hna i an vutcam cu Bethel ah a kalpi hna.","title":"Josiah Nih Remnak A Tuah","ref":"2Sia 21.3; 2Cha 33.3"},"5":{"text":"Cun Judah siangpahrang hna nih Judah ram chung khua hna le Jerusalem kiangkap i a ummi khua hna khuahrum bo i zihmui khangtu ah an rak fehtermi siasal-tlangbawi kha, a phuah hna; Baal sinah siseh, ni sinah siseh, thlapa sinah siseh, arfibu sinah siseh, van i a ummi thil vialte hna sinah siseh, zihmui a khangtu tlangbawi hna zong kha a phuah hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn chung khan Asherah kha a chuah i Jerusalem khua lengah Kidron tiva ah a kalpi, Kidron tiva ah cun a khangh i dip lak in a den cikcek i a dip cu mi zapi thlan cungah a thlet."},"7":{"text":"Biaknak lei hlawhhlang an umnak inn, Bawipa inn chung i a ummi kha a hrawh hna; cuka ah cun khi nu hna nih khan Asherah caah puan an tak."},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah ram khua hna khan tlangbawi vialte kha a chuah hna i tlangbawi nih zihmui an khanghnak khuahrum bo vialte kha, Geba in Beersheba tiang a thurhnawmhter dih hna; khua uktu bawi Joshua kutka luhnak i a ummi kutka khuahrum bo khuapi kutka vung luh i cakeh lei ah a ummi hna kha a chimh dih hna."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khuahrum bo tlangbawi hna cu Jerusalem i Bawipa biakṭheng ah khan cun an hung kal lo, an unau hna sinah khan thilnu phulh lo changreu kha an ei."},"10":{"text":"Cun Hinnom fapa hna horkuang i a ummi Tofeth kha, khika ah ahohmanh nih an fapa si hna seh an fanu si hna seh, Molek sin i thawinak ah an pekchanh hna nakhnga lo, a thurhnawmhter.","ref":"Lev 18.21; Jer 7.31; 19.1-6; 32.35"},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn luhnak i a inn kulh chung i bawi inn zohtu Nathan-melek khaan pawng i Judah siangpahrang hna nih ni ca i rang an pekchanhmi hna cu a ṭhial hna i ni rangleng hna cu mei in a khangh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun Ahaz cung dot inncung i a ummi biakṭheng, Judah siangpahrang hna nih an sermi hna kha le Manasseh nih Bawipa inntual pahnih chung i biakṭheng a sermi hna kha a chimh hna i a den cikcek hna, cun a dip cu Kidron tiva ah a paih hna.","ref":"2Sia 21.5; 2Cha 33.5"},"13":{"text":"Jerusalem nichuahlei, rawhralnak tlang in thlanglei i a ummi khuahrum bo hna kha siangpahrang nih cun a thurhnawmhter hna; mah cucu Israel siangpahrang Solomon nih Sidon mi pathian fihnung Ashtoreth le Moab mi pathian fihnung Khemosh le Ammon mi pathian fihnung Milkom ca i a sermi kha an si.","ref":"1Sia 11.5,7"},"14":{"text":"Cun lungphun kha a den cikcek hna i Asherim kha a hau hna i cu hmun ah cun mi ruh khat lak in a hlonh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cu hleiah Israel a sualtertu Jeroboam, Nebat fapa nih Bethel khua ah a sermi khuahrum bo biakṭheng, kha biakṭheng kha a khuahrum bo he khan a chimh i a lung cu a den cikcek hna i dip lak in a den hna; cun Asherah zong kha a khangh.","ref":"1Sia 12.33"},"16":{"text":"Cun Josiah cu a hei i mer i tlang cungah khan thlan a hmuh hna; cun mi a thlah hna i thlan chung cun ruh kha an chuah hna i biakṭheng cungah khan an khangh i an thurhnawmhter; mah cucu Pathian mi, hi thil hna kong a rak chimchungtu nih Bawipa bia a rak thanhning te khan a si.","ref":"1Sia 13.2"},"17":{"text":"Khi tikah anih nih, “Khika i ka hmuhmi lungphun khi zeidah a si?” tiah a ti. Cun cu khuami hna nih cun, “Bethel khua biakṭheng cungah na tuahmi thil hi a rak chimchungtu Pathian mi, Judah ram in a ramipa thlan a si,” tiah an chimh.","ref":"1Sia 13.30-32"},"18":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Amah cu um ko seh; ahohmanh nih a ruh kha ṭhial hna hlah seh,” tiah a ti. Cucaah a ruh cu, Samaria in a ra mi profetpa ruh hna he khan zeihmanh an ti hna lo."},"19":{"text":"Cun Samaria ram chung khua i a ummi khuahrum bo hna i hmunthiang hna, Israel siangpahrang hna nih an ser i Bawipa a thin an phawhnak hna vialte zong kha, Josiah nih a ṭhial dih hna; Bethel ah a tuahning te khan annih cung zongah cun a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Cun khuahrum bo tlangbawi vialte khika i a ummi hna kha biakṭheng cungah a thah hna i an cungah mi ruh kha a khangh hna. Cun Jerusalem ah a kir."},"21":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih mi vialte cu, “Hi biakamnak cauk chungah aa ṭial bang hin, nannih nih Bawipa nan Pathian sinah lanhtak puai kha ul u,” tiah nawl a pek hna.","title":"Lanhtak Puai An Ulh (2Cha 35.1-19)"},"22":{"text":"Zeitintiah Israel mi bia a rak ceihtu biaceihtu hna chan ri in siseh, Israel siangpahrang hna le Judah siangpahrang chan chung vialte ah siseh, cu bantuk lanhtak puai cu ulh a um bal ti lo;"},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Josiah Siangpahrang a bawi kum hleiriatnak ah hi lanhtak puai cu Bawipa sinah Jerusalem ah an ulh."},"24":{"text":"Cu hleiah tlangbawi Hilkiah nih Bawipa inn chungah a hmuhmi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi phungbia hna kha a fehter nakhnga, Josiah nih khan litin thiam hna le hnamngei hna le milem tete hna le siasal hna le Judah ram chung le Jerusalem khua chung i fihnung a simi thil an hmuhmi vialte hna kha a hloh dih hna."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa sinah a lungthin dihlak le a nunnak dihlak le a thazang dihlak in, Moses nawlbia dihlak ningin, aa mermi siangpahrang amah hlan ah an um lo i amah hnu zongah amah bantuk a hung chuakmi an um lo."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Manasseh nih a thin phawhnak a rak tuahmi vialte ruangah khan Judah cungah Bawipa thinhunnak kha a alh ko i cu a thinhunnak ṭih a nungmi cu a ṭhum hlei lo."},"27":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih, “Israel ka ṭhial bantuk khan Judah zong hi ka mithmuh phak lonak ah ka ṭhial lai, cun ka thimmi khuapi Jerusalem hi le “Hi chungah ka min a um lai,” ti in ka rak timi inn zong hi ka hlonh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Josiah tuahsernak a taang rihmi le a tuahmi vialte cu Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?","title":"Josiah Thihnak (2Cha 35.20-27)"},"29":{"text":"Amah chan ah cun, Izipt siangpahrang Faro Neko cu Assiria siangpahrang sinah Zufrates tiva ah a hung kal. Josiah Siangpahrang cu amah ton awkah khan a kal; cun a rak hmuh tikah Faro Neko nih cun Megiddo ah a rak thah."},"30":{"text":"Cun Megiddo khan amah cu a sinum hna nih a thi cia in rangleng in Jerusalem ah an kalpi i amah thlante ah khan an vui. Cun rammi nih khan Josiah fapa Jehoahaz cu an lak i chiti an thuh i a pa hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah an ser."},"31":{"text":"Jehoahaz cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum kul le kum thum a si i Jerusalem in thla thum a bawi. A nu min cu Hamutal a si, amah cu Libnah khuami Jeremiah fanu a si.","title":"Jehoahaz Pennak le Phuahnak (2Cha 36.1-4)"},"32":{"text":"Cun a pupa hna nih an tuahning te khan Bawipa mithmuh ah ṭhat lonak a tuah."},"33":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ah cun bawi a si nakhnga lo, Faro Neko nih Hamath ram Riblah khua ah thong ah a thlak i a ram cu ngunkhuai ngun talen za khat le sui talen pakhat a cawh hna:"},"34":{"text":"Cun Faro Neko nih Josiah fapa Eliakim cu a pa Josiah hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah a canter i a min cu Jehoiakim tiah a let. Sihmanhsehlaw Jehoahaz cu a kalpi i Izipt ram a phan i khika ah a thi.","ref":"Jer 22.11-12"},"35":{"text":"Cun Jehoiakim nih Faro cu ngun le sui kha a pek, sihmanhsehlaw Faro nih nawl a pek bangkhan tangka peknak ding caah cun a mi kha ngun a khuai hna. Faro Neko pek awkah khan amah nih a tuah ningin a ram chungmi hna cu sui le ngun kha a thawhter cio hna."},"36":{"text":"Jehoiakim cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum kul le kum nga a si i Jerusalem khua in kum hleikhat a bawi. A nu min cu Zebidah a si, amah cu Rumah khuami Pedaiah fanu a si.","title":"Jehoiakim Pennak (2Cha 36.5-8)","ref":"Jer 22.18-19; 26.1-6; 35.1-19"},"37":{"text":"Cun a pupa hna nih an rak tuahning te khan Bawipa mithmuh ah thil ṭhalo kha a tuah ve."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amah chan ah cun Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar kha a hung i Jehoiakim cu kum thum chung a sal ah a cang; sihmanhsehlaw aa let i a doh.","ref":"Jer 25.1-38; Dan 1.1-2"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih a sal profet hna in a rak chimmi bia ning khan, Bawipa nih Khaldi mibu hna le Siria mibu hna le Moab mibu hna le Ammon mibu hna kha a thlahhnawh hna i Judah hrawh awkah khan a thlah hna."},"3":{"text":"Manasseh nih a tuahmi vialte ruangah le a sual lomi thisen a chuahmi ruangah, Bawipa nawl in hi thil cu Judah mi cungah, annih kha a mithmuh phak lo i ṭhial awkah, a tlung hrimhrim ko; zeitintiah Jerusalem khua kha a sual lomi thi in a khahter i Bawipa nih a ngaithiam duh lo.","merge":"4"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a tuahmi vialte cu, Judah Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Jehoiakim cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a fapa Jehoiachin kha amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"7":{"text":"Izipt siangpahrang cu a ram chungin a chuak ti lo, zeicahtiah Babilon siangpahrang nih Izipt siangpahrang ta a simi vialte Izipt tivate thawk in Zufrates tiva tiang, a lak dih."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiachin cu siangpahrang a can tikah kum hleiriat a si i Jerusalem in thla thum a bawi. A nu min cu Nehushta a si, amah cu Jerusalem khuami Elnathan fanu a si.","title":"Jehoiachin le Bawi Hna Kha Babilon Ah An Kalpi Hna (2Cha 36.9-10)"},"9":{"text":"A pa nih a rak tuahning te khan amah nih Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah ve."},"10":{"text":"Khi caan ah khan Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar sal hna cu an hung i Jerusalem khua kha an dum."},"11":{"text":"Cun a sal hna nih an kulh lioah khan, Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar cu Jerusalem khua ah khan a hung;"},"12":{"text":"cun Judah siangpahrang Jehoiachin cu, a nu he, a sinum hna he, a bawi hna he, a siangpahrang inn bawi hna he khan Babilon siangpahrang sinah cun a vaa pe. A bawi kum riatnak kum ah khan Babilon siangpahrang nih cun sal ah a tlaih i","ref":"Jer 22.24-30; 24.1-10; 29.1-2"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih a rak chimchung bang khan, Bawipa inn chung ro thil vialte le siangpahrang inn chung ro thil vialte kha a lak hna i Israel siangpahrang Solomon nih a rak sermi sui umkheng, Bawipa biakinn i a ummi vialte kha a khuai dih cikcek hna."},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem mi vialte le bawi vialte le ralṭha le miṭhawng vialte, tlaihmi thong hra, cun zungthiam le soser vialte cu a kalpi dih hna; ram chung i sifak bikmi hna dah ti lo cu ahohmanh an tang lo."},"15":{"text":"Cun Jehoiachin cu Babilon ah a kalpi; siangpahrang i a nu, siangpahrang i a nupi hna, a bawi hna le ram chung santlai bikmi hna cu Jerusalem in Babilon ah sal ah a hruai hna.","ref":"Eze 17.12"},"16":{"text":"Cun Babilon siangpahrang nih cun ralṭhami vialte, thong sarih, cun zungthiam le soser, thong khat, an dihlak in a ṭhawng i ral atu kho dingmi kha Babilon ah sal ah a kalpi hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun Babilon siangpahrang nih cun Jehoiachin i a pacheu Mattaniah kha amah hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah a chiah i a min cu Zedekiah ah a thlen.","ref":"Jer 37.1; Eze 17.13"},"18":{"text":"Zedekiah cu bawi hram aa thawk ah kum kul le kum khat a si i Jerusalem in kum hleikhat a bawi. A nu min cu Hamutal a si, amah cu Libnah khuami Jeremiah fanu a si.","title":"Zedekiah Pennak (2Cha 36.11-16 ; Jer 52.1-3)","ref":"Jer 27.1-22; 28.1-17"},"19":{"text":"Jehoiakim nih a tuah ningte khan Bawipa mithmuh i ṭhat lonak kha a tuah."},"20":{"text":"Hi thil Jerusalem le Judah i a tlun cu Bawipa a thin a hun tuk caah khan a si, a donghnak ah cun a sinin a hlonh ko hna. Cun Zedekiah nih Babilon siangpahrang a doh.","ref":"Eze 17.15"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A bawi a kum kuanak, thla hranak thla, a ni hra ni ah, Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar nih cun a ralkap vialte he Jerusalem cu a rathnawh i an dum; cun raldohnak chuntlung kha a velchum in an ser.","ref":"Jer 21.1-10; 34.1-5; Eze 24.2"},"2":{"text":"Cuticun Siangpahrang Zedekiah a bawi kum hleikhatnak tiang khua cu an kulh."},"3":{"text":"Thla linak thla a ni kua ni ah, khuapi chungah cun mangṭam cu a fak tuk cang i rammi caah rawl a um ti lo."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah khua kulhnak kha an pemh i Khaldi mi cu khua velchum ah khan an um ko nain siangpahrang le a ralkap vialte cu zan ah siangpahrang dum pawng i a ummi vampang pahnih karlak i kutka khan an zam. Cun Arabah leiah khan an kal.","ref":"Eze 33.21"},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Khaldi mi ralkap hna nih khan siangpahrang cu an dawi i Jeriko nelrawn ah khan an phak i a ralkap vialte cu a sinin an i ṭhek dih."},"6":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu an tlaih i Riblah khua ah Babilon siangpahrang sinah khan an ratpi i a cungah khan bia a rak khiah."},"7":{"text":"Zedekiah fapale cu a hmaika hrimhrim ah khan an thah hna i Zedekiah cu a mit an khoih i hreng an khenh i Babilon ah an kalpi.","ref":"Eze 12.13"},"8":{"text":"Thla nganak thla, a ni sarihnak ni ah, cucu Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar Siangpahrang a bawi kum hleikuanak a si — Babilon siangpahrang sinum, a pum ralvengtu haotu Nebuzaradan kha Jerusalem ah a ra.","title":"Judah Sal Ah A Tang (2Cha 36.17-21 ; Jer 39.8-10 ; 52.12-30)"},"9":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn le siangpahrang inn le Jerusalem khua chung inn vialte kha a khangh dih hna; inn ngan paohpaoh kha cu a khangh dih hna.","ref":"1Sia 9.8"},"10":{"text":"Cun ralveng haotu sinah a ummi Khaldi ralkap vialte nih khan Jerusalem velchum i a ummi kulhnak vampang cu an chimh."},"11":{"text":"Cun mi a tang rihmi khua chungah nganhtami hna le Babilon siangpahrang sin i a rak zammi hna kha le zapi a tang rihmi vialte hna kha ralvengtu haotu Nebuzaradan nih sal ah a hruai dih hna."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ralvengtu haotu nih khan ram chungmi lak i sifak bik hna kha mitsur ruang a run cawnghramtu le lo a run thlotu ah a nganhta hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn chungah a ummi dar tung pipi hna le Bawipa inn chungah a ummi hmaihumpi le a hunnak hna kha Khaldi mi hna nih cun an den cikcek hna i a dar cu Babilon ah an kalpi.","ref":"1Sia 7.15-26; 2Cha 3.15—4.5"},"14":{"text":"Cun um hna le cawhlek hna le mei hmihnak hna le zihmui kheng hna le, dar umkheng vialte hna, biakinn chung rianṭuannak i hmanmi vialte kha an lak hna,","ref":"1Sia 7.45; 2Cha 4.16"},"15":{"text":"meizahnak le khengkuar hna zong kha an lak hna. Ralvengtu haotu nih khan sui a simi thil paoh cu a sui kha a lak i ngun a simi thil paoh cu a ngun kha a lak."},"16":{"text":"Solomon nih Bawipa inn caah a rak sermi tungpi pahnih hna le hmaihum pakhat le a hunnak hna, hi umkheng dar hna hi cu a khing thlai cawk an si lo."},"17":{"text":"Tungpi pakhat cu a san leiah dong hleiriat a si i a cungah dar in sermi luchin pakhat a um; cu luchin a sanlei cu dong thum a si; dar in sermi taleti sur kha, cu luchin cungah cun a velchum in a um. Cun tungpi pahnihnak zong cu cu bantuk a si ve, sur zong kha a ngei ve."},"18":{"text":"Cun ralvengtu haotu nih khan tlangbawi upa bik Seraiah le a hun changtu Zefaniah le innleng cawngtu pathum hna kha a lak hna;"},"19":{"text":"cun khuapi chung khan ralkap a haotu hna bawi pakhat le khua chung i a ummi siangpahrang tlangpi bu chungmi panga le rammi a pumtu hna ralbawi i a caṭialtu le khua chung i a ummi rammi sawm ruk kha a lak hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun Nebuzaradan, ralvengtu haotu nih khan a kalpi hna i Riblah khua ah Babilon siangpahrang sinah khan a phakpi hna."},"21":{"text":"Cun Babilon siangpahrang nih khan a tuk hna i Hamath ram Riblah khua ah khan a thah hna. Cuticun Judah cu amah ram chungin saltannak chungah kalpi a si."},"22":{"text":"Judah ram chung i a tangmi hna, Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar nih a nganhtami hna cungah khan Shafan fapa Ahikam i fapa Gedaliah cu uktu ah a ser.","title":"A Tangmi Izipt Ah An Zam"},"23":{"text":"Cun ramlak i a ummi ralkapbu haotu pawl le an mi hna nih Babilon siangpahrang nih Gedaliah cu uktu ah a ser, ti an theih tikah, Mizpah ah Gedaliah sinah cun an mi hna he khan an ra, cu hna cu Nethaniah fapa Ishmael le Kareah fapa Hohanan le Netofah mi Tanhumeth fapa Seraiah le Maakah mi fapa Jaazaniah an si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Gedaliah nih annih le an mi hna sinah chiat a ser i, “Khaldi mi bawi hna ruangah hin nan thinphang hlah u; ram chungah hin um ko u law Babilon siangpahrang hi rian ko u law nan caah a ṭha ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thla sarihnak thla ah khan Elishama fapa Nethaniah i fapa Ishmael, siangpahrang chungkhar chungmi a simi kha, mi pahra he an ra i an tuk hna i Gedaliah le Mizpah ah a sin i a ummi Judah mi le Khaldi mi hna kha an thah hna."},"26":{"text":"Khi tikah mi vialte cu a hme he a ngan he, ralkapbu haotu hna he khan an tho i Khaldi mi kha an ṭih hna caah Izipt ah an kal.","ref":"Jer 43.5-7"},"27":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoiachin sal i a tan kum sawm thum le kum sarihnak, thla hleihnihnak thla a ni kul le ni sarihnak ni ah, Babilon siangpahrang Evil-merodak nih, Judah siangpahrang cu a zaangfah caah thong chungin a chuah, cu kum cu siangpahrang a can kum a si;","title":"Jehoiachin Kha Babilon Khua Ah An Luatter I Upatnak An Pek (Jer 52.31-34)"},"28":{"text":"amah cu nem tein a chawnh i Babilon khua i amah sinah a ummi siangpahrang hna an ṭhutnak cung deuh ah khan ṭhutnak a pek."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah Jehoiachin nih khan a thongtla puan cu aa phoih. Cun a chan chung vialte siangpahrang cabuai ah cun rawl a ei lengmang ve;"},"30":{"text":"cun aa cawmnak cu siangpahrang nih khan, nifate in a nun chung paohpaoh, a rin zungzal."}}}}},"13":{"info":{"name":"1Chanrelnak","shortname":"1Chr","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Adam, Seth, Enosh,","title":"Adam Tefa Hna (Gen 5.1-32)"},"2":{"text":"Kenan, Mahalalel Jared,"},"3":{"text":"Enok, Methuselah, Lamek,"},"4":{"text":"Noah, Shem, Ham le Jafeth."},"5":{"text":"Jafeth fapa hna: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek le Tiras.","title":"Noah Shem, Ham Tefa Hna (Gen 10.1-32)"},"6":{"text":"Gomer fapa hna: Ashkenaz, Rifath, le Togarmah."},"7":{"text":"Javan fapa hna: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim le Rodanim."},"8":{"text":"Ham fapa hna: Kush, Izipt, Put le Kanaan."},"9":{"text":"Kush fapa hna: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, le Sabteka. Raamah fapa hna: Sheba le Dedan."},"10":{"text":"Kush cu Nimrod pa kha a si; amah cu vawlei cungah miṭhawng si hram aa thawk."},"11":{"text":"Izipt cu Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naftuh,"},"12":{"text":"Pathrus, Kasluh (Filistin mi chuahkehnak) le Kaftor mi hna pa a si."},"13":{"text":"Kanaan cu a hrin hmasa bik Sidon le Heth,"},"14":{"text":"le Jebus mi hna le Amor mi hna le Girgash mi hna le"},"15":{"text":"Hiv mi hna le Arki mi hna le Sin mi hna le"},"16":{"text":"Arvad mi hna le Zemari mi hna le Hamath mi hna pa a si."},"17":{"text":"Shem fapa hna: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether le Meshek."},"18":{"text":"Arpakshad cu Shelah pa a si i Shelah cu Eber pa a si."},"19":{"text":"Eber nih cun fapa pahnih a hrin hna: pakhat min cu Peleg a si (zeitintiah amah chan ah vawleicung mi kha an i ṭhen), cun a unau min cu Joktan a si."},"20":{"text":"Joktan cu Almodad, Shelef, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,"},"21":{"text":"Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,"},"22":{"text":"Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,"},"23":{"text":"Ofir, Havilah le Jobab pa a si, mah hna vialte hi Joktan fapa an si."},"24":{"text":"Shem in Abraham tiang: Shem, Arpakshad, Shelah;","title":"Shem Tefa Hna (Gen 11.10-26)"},"25":{"text":"Eber, Peleg, Re-u,"},"26":{"text":"Serug, Nahor, Terah le"},"27":{"text":"Abram (mah cucu Abraham a si)."},"28":{"text":"Abraham fapa hna: Isak le Ishmael.","title":"Ishmael le Keturah Tefa Hna (Gen 25.1-6 , 12-18)"},"29":{"text":"Mah hihi an ciruang an si: Ishmael fater cu Nebaioth; cun Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,"},"30":{"text":"Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,"},"31":{"text":"Jetur, Nafish le Kedemah. Mah hna hi Ishmael fapa an si."},"32":{"text":"Abraham nuchun Keturah fapa hna: amah nih cun Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak le Shuah a hrin hna. Jokshan fapa hna: Sheba le Dedan."},"33":{"text":"Midian fapa hna: Ephah, Efer, Hanok, Abida le Eldaah. Mah vialte hi Keturah hrinthlak an si."},"34":{"text":"Abraham cu Isak pa a si. Isak fapa hna cu: Esau le Israel.","title":"Esau Tefa Hna (Gen 36.1-43)"},"35":{"text":"Esau fapa hna: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam le Korah."},"36":{"text":"Elifaz fapa hna: Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna le Amalek."},"37":{"text":"Reuel fapa hna: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah le Mizzah."},"38":{"text":"Seir fapa hna: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer le Dishan."},"39":{"text":"Lotan fapa hna: Hori le Homam; cun Lotan far cu Timna a si."},"40":{"text":"Shobal fapa hna: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shefi le Onam. Zibeon fapa hna: Aiah le Anah."},"41":{"text":"Anah fapa hna: Dishon. Dishon fapa hna: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran le Kheran."},"42":{"text":"Ezer fapa hna: Bilhan, Zaavan le Jaakan. Dishan fapa hna: Uz le Aran."},"43":{"text":"Israel mi hna cungah siangpahrang ahohmanh an um hlanah mah hna hi Edom ram a rak pengtu siangpahrang cu an si: Beor fapa Bela, amah a khua min cu Dinhabah a si."},"44":{"text":"Bela a thih tikah, Bozrah khuami Zerah i a fapa Jobab cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"45":{"text":"Jobab cu a thih tikah, Teman mi hna ram mi Husham kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"46":{"text":"Husham kha a thih tikah, Moab ram chung i Midian mi hna a teitu Bedad i a fapa Hadad kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi i a khualipi min cu Avith a si."},"47":{"text":"Hadad cu a thih tikah, Masrekah mi Samlah kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."},"48":{"text":"Samlah cu a thih tikah, Zufrates tiva kam i a ummi Rehoboth khuami Shaul kha amah hmun ah cun bawi a cang."},"49":{"text":"Shaul cu a thih tikah, Akhbor fapa Baalhanan kha amah hmun ah cun a bawi."},"50":{"text":"Baalhanan a thih tikah amah hmun ah khan Hadad cu a hung bawi i a khualipi min cu Pai a si i a nupi min cu Mehetabel a si, amah cu Matred fanu a si, Matred cu Mezahab fanu a si."},"51":{"text":"Cun Hadad cu a thi. Edom bawi hna cu: Timna bawi, Aliah bawi, Jetheth bawi"},"52":{"text":"Oholibamah bawi, Elah bawi, Pinon bawi,"},"53":{"text":"Kenaz bawi, Teman bawi, Mibzar bawi,"},"54":{"text":"Magdiel bawi, le Iram bawi an si; mah hna hi Edom bawi cu an si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mah hna hi Israel fapa hleihnih cu an si: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar, Zebulun,","title":"Israel Fapa Hna (Gen 35.22-26)"},"2":{"text":"Dan, Josef, Benjamin, Naftali, Gad le Asher."},"3":{"text":"Judah fapa panga hna: Er, Onan, le Shelah; mah pathum hna hi Kanaan minu Bathshua nih khan a hrinpiak. Judah fater Er cu Bawipa mithmuh ah miṭhalo a si i a thah.","title":"Judah Tefa Hna"},"4":{"text":"A fapa nupi Tamar zong nih khan Perez le Zerah kha a hrinpiak. Judah nih a dihlak ah fapa panga a ngei."},"5":{"text":"Perez fapa pahnih hna: Hezron le Hamul."},"6":{"text":"A nau Zerah fapa hna: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Kalkol, le Dara, an dihlak ah panga."},"7":{"text":"Zerah tefa Karmi fapa Akhan kha Israel hna a hnawhtu, pekchanhmi thil a buartu a si;","ref":"Jos 7.1"},"8":{"text":"cun Ethan fapa cu Azariah a si."},"9":{"text":"Hezron nih a hrinmi fapa hna cu: Jerahmeel, Ram le Khelubai."},"10":{"text":"Ram cu Amminadab pa a si. Amminadab cu Judah fapa hna lak i an bawi Nahshon i a pa kha a si."},"11":{"text":"Nahshon cu Salma pa a si, Salma cu Boaz pa a si,"},"12":{"text":"Boaz cu Obed pa a si i Obed cu Jesse pa a si."},"13":{"text":"Jesse cu a fater Eliab le a pahnihnak Abinadab le a pathumnak Shimea le"},"14":{"text":"a palinak Nethanel le a panganak Raddai le"},"15":{"text":"a paruknak Ozem le a pasarihnak David hna pa kha a si;"},"16":{"text":"an farle hna cu Zeruiah le Abigail an si. Zeruiah fapa hna cu: Abishai, Joab, le Asahel, pathum an si."},"17":{"text":"Abigail nih Amasa a hrin i Amasa pa cu Ishmael mi Jether a si."},"18":{"text":"Hezron fapa Kaleb nih a nupi Azubah he Jerioth an hrin; cun mah hna hi a fapa cu an si: Jesher, Shobab le Ardon."},"19":{"text":"Azubah cu a thih tikah Kaleb nih cun Efrath kha a ṭhit i amah nih cun Hur kha a hrinpiak."},"20":{"text":"Hur cu Uri pa kha a si i Uri cu Bezalel pa kha a si."},"21":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Gilead pa Makhir i a fanu kha Hezron nih cun a kawmh i kum sawm ruk a ti ah a ṭhit Segub kha a hrinpiak."},"22":{"text":"Cun Segub cu Jair pa a si i Jair cu Gilead ram ah khua kul le thum a ngei."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Geshur le Aram nih Havothjair, Kenath le a khuate hna kha, khua sawm ruk an chuh hna. Mah vialte hna hi Gilead pa Makhir tefa kha an si."},"24":{"text":"Hezron thih hnuah, Kaleb nih a pa Hezron nupi Efrathah kha a kawmh i Tekoa pa Ashhur kha a hrinpiak."},"25":{"text":"Hezron fapa upa bik Jerahmeel fapa hna: a fater Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, le Ahijah."},"26":{"text":"Jerahmeel nih nupi dang zong a ngei, a min cu Atarah a si; amah cu Onam nu kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Jerahmeel fapa upa bik Ram fapa hna: Maaz, Jamin le Eker."},"28":{"text":"Onam fapa hna: Shammai le Jada. Shammai fapa hna: Nadab le Abishur."},"29":{"text":"Abishur nupi min cu Abihail a si; a mah nih Ahban le Molid a hrin hna."},"30":{"text":"Nadab fapa hna: Seled le Appaim; Seled cu fa ngei loin a thi."},"31":{"text":"Appaim fapa hna: Ishi. Ishi fapa hna: Sheshan. Sheshan fapa hna: Ahlai."},"32":{"text":"Shammai unau Jada fapa hna: Jether le Jonathan; Jether cu fa ngei loin a thi."},"33":{"text":"Jonathan fapa hna: Peleth le Zaza. Mah hna hi Jerahmeel tefa cu an si."},"34":{"text":"Sheshan cu fapa a ngei lo, fanu lawng a ngeih hna; asinain Sheshan nih cun Izipt mi sal pakhat a ngei i a min ah Jarha a si."},"35":{"text":"Cucaah Sheshan nih a sal Jarha cu a fanu kha a ṭhitter i Attai kha a hrin."},"36":{"text":"Attai cu Nathan pa a si i Nathan cu Zabad pa a si."},"37":{"text":"Zabad cu Eflal pa a si i Eflal cu Obed pa a si."},"38":{"text":"Obed cu Jehu pa a si Jehu cu Azariah pa a si."},"39":{"text":"Azariah cu Helez pa a si i Helez cu Eleasah pa a si."},"40":{"text":"Eleasah cu Sismai pa a si i Sismai cu Shallum pa a si."},"41":{"text":"Shallum cu Jekamiah pa a si i Jekamiah cu Elishama pa a si."},"42":{"text":"Jerahmeel unau Kaleb fapa hna: a hrin hmasa bik Mareshah, amah cu Zif pa a si. Mareshah fapa hna: Hebron."},"43":{"text":"Hebron fapa hna: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem le Shema."},"44":{"text":"Shema cu Raham pa a si, Raham cu Jorkeam pa a si; cun Rekem cu Shammai pa a si."},"45":{"text":"Shammai fapa cu Maon a si, cun Maon cu Beth-zur pa a si."},"46":{"text":"Kaleb nuchun Ephah zong nih Haran, Moza, le Gazez a hrin hna, cun Haran fapa a ngeih i a min Gazez a si."},"47":{"text":"Jahdai fapa hna: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, le Shaaf."},"48":{"text":"Kaleb nuchun Maakah nih, Sheber le Tirhanah a hrin hna."},"49":{"text":"Madmannah pa Shaaf le Makbenah le Gibea pa Sheva zong kha a hrin hna. Cun Kaleb fanu cu Akhsah a si."},"50":{"text":"Mah hna hi Kaleb tefa cu an si: A nupi Efratah he an hrinmi fater cu Hur a si. Hur i a fapa hna cu: Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal,"},"51":{"text":"Bethlehem pa Salma, le Beth-gader pa Haref;"},"52":{"text":"Kiriath-jearim pa Shobal cu Haroeh mi hna le Menuhoth mi hnarcheu hna hringsortu a si."},"53":{"text":"Cun Kiriath-jearim i a ummi innchungkhar hna cu: Ithra mi, Puth mi, Shumath mi, Misra mi an si; hi hna chung hin Zorah mi le Eshtaol mi kha an chuahkehnak a si."},"54":{"text":"Bethlehem tlatu Salma cu Netofah mi, Atroth-beth-joab le Manahath mi le Zor mi hna hringsortu a si; anmah cu Manahath i a ummi innchungkhar pahnih hna lak i pakhat kha an si."},"55":{"text":"(A tanglei innchungkhar hna hi caṭial le caṭialchin a thiam ngaingaimi an si i Jabez khua ah a ummi an si: Tirath mi, Shimeath mi le Sukath mi an si. Annih hi Ken mi, Rekhab mi he aa ṭhi-ummi kha an si. Rekhab mi hna pa cu Hammath a si.)"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mah hihi David nih Hebron ah a hrinmi a fapa hna cu an si: a fater Amnon cu Jezreel minu Ahinoam nih a hrinpiak; a pahnihnak Daniel cu Karmel minu Abigail nih a hrinpiak,","title":"David Fapa Hna (2Sam 3.2-5 ; 5.13-16 ; 1Cha 14.3-7 ; Mat 1.6-12)"},"2":{"text":"a pathumnak cu Absalom a si, a nu cu Maakah, Geshur siangpahrang Talmai fanu a si; a palinak cu Adonijah a si, a nu cu Haggith a si;"},"3":{"text":"a panganak cu Shefatiah a si, Abital nih a hrin; a paruknak cu Ithream a si, a nupi Eglah hrinpiakmi a si;"},"4":{"text":"kum sarih le thla ruk bawi a cannak Hebron khua ah khan paruk a hrin hna. Cun Jerusalem ah kum sawm thum le kum thum a bawi.","ref":"2Sam 5.4-5; 1Sia 2.11; 1Cha 29.27"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem i a nupi Bathsheba, Ammiel fanu nih a hrinmi cu mah hna hi an si: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan le Solomon,","ref":"2Sam 11.3"},"6":{"text":"cun fapa dang pakua a ngeih hna: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,"},"7":{"text":"Nogah, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"8":{"text":"Elishama, Eliada le Elifelet an si."},"9":{"text":"Mah vialte hi David fapa an si, a nupichun fapa hna lengah khan; Tamar cu an far a si."},"10":{"text":"Solomon tefa hna cu: Rehoboam, cu fapa ah Abijah, cu fapa ah Asa, cu fapa ah Jehoshafat,","title":"Solomon Tefa Hna"},"11":{"text":"cu fapa ah Joram, cu fapa ah Ahiziah, cu fapa ah Joash,"},"12":{"text":"cu fapa ah Amaziah, cu fapa ah Azariah, cu fapa ah Jotham,"},"13":{"text":"cu fapa ah Ahaz, cu fapa ah Hezekiah, cu fapa ah Manasseh,"},"14":{"text":"cu fapa ah Amon, cu fapa ah Josiah."},"15":{"text":"Josiah fapa hna cu: fater Johanan, a pahnihnak Jehoiakim, a pathumnak Zedekiah, a palinak Shallum."},"16":{"text":"Jehoiakim tefa hna cu: a fapa Jekoniah, cu fapa ah Zedekiah;"},"17":{"text":"cun ral tlaihmi Jekoniah i fapa hna cu: a fapa Shealtiel,"},"18":{"text":"Malkhiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hashama, le Nedabiah;"},"19":{"text":"Pedaiah fapa hna cu: Zerubbabel le Shimei; Zerubbabel fapa hna cu: Meshullam le Hananiah, Shelomith cu an far a si;"},"20":{"text":"cun Hashubah, Ohel, Berekhiah, Hasadiah le Jusshabhesed, panga an si."},"21":{"text":"Hananiah fapa hna: Pelatiah le Jeshaiah, cu fapa ah Refaiah, cu fapa ah Arnan, cu fapa ah Abadiah, cu fapa ah Shekaniah."},"22":{"text":"Shekaniah fapa hna: Shemaiah. Cun Shemaiah fapa hna: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, le Shafat, paruk an si."},"23":{"text":"Neariah fapa hna: Eli-o-enai, Hizkiah, le Azrikam, pathum an si."},"24":{"text":"Eli-o-enai fapa hna: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, le Anani, pasarih an si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah fapa hna: Perez, Hezron, Karmi, Hur le Shobal.","title":"Judah Tefa Hna"},"2":{"text":"Shobal fapa Re-aiah cu Jahath pa a si, Jahath cu Ahumai le Lahad pa a si. Mah hna hi Zorah mi innchungkhar hna cu an si."},"3":{"text":"Mah hna hi Etam fapa cu an si: Jezreel, Ishma, le Idbash; cun an farnu min cu Hazzelelponi a si,"},"4":{"text":"cun Penuel cu Gedor pa a si i Ezer cu Hushah pa a si. Bethlehem pa Efrathah i a fater Hur i a fapa hna cu mah hna hi an si."},"5":{"text":"Tekoa pa Ashhur nih nupi pahnih a ngei, Helah le Naarah an si;"},"6":{"text":"Naarah nih cun Ahuzzam, Hefer, Temeni, le Haahastari a hrinpiak. Mah hna hi Naarah fapa cu an si."},"7":{"text":"Helah fapa hna: Zereth, Izhar, le Ethnam."},"8":{"text":"Koz cu Anub, Zobebah le Harum fapa Aharhel innchungkhar hna pa kha a si."},"9":{"text":"Jabez cu a unau hna nakin upat awk tlak deuh a si; cun a nu nih a min cu, “Har lengmang in ka hrin caah,” tiin Jabez tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Jabez nih cun Israel Pathian cu a auh i, “Nangmah nih thluachuahnak ka pe law ka ramri kauhter law na kut cu ka sinah um seh law keimah cu harnak nih a ka tlunh nakhnga lo harnak chungin ka huppheng ko sawh,” tiah a ti. Cun Pathian nih a halmi kha a pek."},"11":{"text":"Shuhah unau Khelub cu Eshton pa Mehir pa kha a si."},"12":{"text":"Eshton cu Bethrapa, Paseah le Tehinnah pa a si, Tehinnah cu Ir-nahash pa a si. Mah hna hi Rekah mi an si."},"13":{"text":"Kenaz fapa hna: Othniel le Seraiah; Othniel fapa hna: Hathath le Meonothai."},"14":{"text":"Meonothai cu Ofrah pa a si; cun Seraiah cu Geharashim hna pa Joab pa a si, annih cu zungthiam an si caah Geharashim ti an si."},"15":{"text":"Jefunneh fapa Kaleb fapa hna: Iru, Elah, le Naam; cun Elah fapa hna: Kenaz."},"16":{"text":"Jehallelel fapa hna: Zif, Zifah, Tiria, le Asarel."},"17":{"text":"Ezrah fapa hna: Jether, Mered, Efer, le Jalon. Mah hna hi Mered nih a ṭhitmi Faro fanu Bithiah fapa hna cu an si; cun fa a pawi i Miriam, Shammai, le Ishbah a hrin hna, Ishbah cu Eshtemoa pa a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun a nupi Judah minu nih Gedor pa Jered, Soko pa Heber, le Zanoah pa Jekuthiel a hrin hna."},"19":{"text":"Naham far a simi Hodiah nupi fapa hna cu Gar mi Keilah le Maakath mi Eshtemoa pa an si."},"20":{"text":"Shimon fapa hna: Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, le Tilon. Ishi fapa hna: Zoheth le Benzoheth."},"21":{"text":"Judah fapa Shelah fapa hna cu: Lekah pa Er, le Beth-ashbea i puan hmangṭhia a sertu hna phun innchungkhar hna le Mareshah pa Laadah le"},"22":{"text":"Jokim le Kozeba, Joash le Saraf mi, Moab ram i uktu a rak si i Lehem i a kir ṭhanmi hna kha an si (atu cu an rak ṭialmi roca kha a hlun cang)."},"23":{"text":"Mah hna hi um sertu le Netaim le Gederah i a ummi hna kha an si; khika ah siangpahrang sinah khan a rianṭuan awkah an um."},"24":{"text":"Simeon fapa hna: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul","title":"Simeon Tefa Hna"},"25":{"text":"Shallum cu a fapa a si, Mibsam cu a fapa a si, Mishma cu a fapa a si."},"26":{"text":"Mishma fapa hna: a fapa Hammuel, cu fapa ah Zakkur, cu fapa ah Shimei."},"27":{"text":"Shimei cu fapa hleiruk le fanu paruk a ngei; sihmanhsehlaw a unau hna cu fa tampi an ngei lo, an chungkhar vialte zong Judah mi hna bantukin an karh lo."},"28":{"text":"Annih cu Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,","ref":"Jos 19.2-8"},"29":{"text":"Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,"},"30":{"text":"Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,"},"31":{"text":"Beth-markaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, le Shaaraim ah khua an sa. David a hung bawi tiang khan mah hna hi an khua an si."},"32":{"text":"Cun an khuate hna cu Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tokhen, le Ashan, khua panga,"},"33":{"text":"le hi khua hna pawngkam i a ummi khuate vialte, Baal tiangin, an si. Mah hna hi an umnak hmun an si i annih nih an chuahkehnak caṭial roca kha an i ken."},"34":{"text":"Meshobab, Jamlekh, Amaziah fapa Joshah,"},"35":{"text":"Joel, Jehu Joshibiah fapa, Joshibiah cu Seraiah fapa, Seraiah cu Asiel fapa,"},"36":{"text":"Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,"},"37":{"text":"Shifi fapa Ziza, Shifi cu Allon fapa, Allon cu Jedaiah fapa, Jedaiah cu Shimri fapa, Shimri cu Shemaiah fapa"},"38":{"text":"hi an min in chimmi hna hi an innchungkhar cio ah bawi an si i an pale innchungkhar cio hna cu tampi in an karh."},"39":{"text":"Annih nih Gedor i va luhnak ah khan, nelrawn nichuahlei kamah khan, an saṭil run hna ca i ram hno kawl awkah an kal,"},"40":{"text":"khika ah ram hno ram ṭha kha an va hmuh i hmun zong kha a rak kau ngaingai i a dai i hnangamnak hmun a si; zeitintiah khika i a rak um hmasami hna cu Ham tefa kha an rak si."},"41":{"text":"Hi an min in ṭialmi hna hi, Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah chan ah khan an ra i, an thlam hna le khika i khua a rak sami Meunim mi hna kha an hrawh hna i nihin ni tiang hin an hloh cikcek hna i an umnak ah khan anmah an um, zeicahtiah khika ah khan an saṭil run hna caah ram a um."},"42":{"text":"Cun annih lak i tlawmpal, Simeon mi za nga, hna cu Seir Tlang ah an kal i an hruaitu ah cun Ishi fapa hna Pelatiah, Neariah, Refaiah, le Uzziel kha an si;"},"43":{"text":"cun annih nih a luatmi Amalek mi a tang rihmi hna kha an hrawh hna i khika ah nihin ni tiangin khua an sa."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel fater Reuben i fapa hna (amah cu a fater a si, sihmanhsehlaw a pa ihkhun kha a thurhnawmhter caah a fater sinak cu Israel fapa Josef fapa hna sinah khan pek a si, cucaah chanrelnak ah khan a fater sinak ning khan khumh a si lo","title":"Reuben Tefa Hna","ref":"Gen 35.22; 49.3-4"},"2":{"text":"Judah cu a unau hna lakah a ṭhawngmi a hung si i amah chungin bawi a hung chuak nain, fater sinak tu cu Josef ta a si ko),","ref":"Gen 49.8-10"},"3":{"text":"Israel fater Reuben fapa hna: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, le Karmi."},"4":{"text":"Joel fapa hna: a fapa ah Shemaiah, cu fapa ah Gog, cu fapa ah Shimei,"},"5":{"text":"cu fapa ah Mikah, cu fapa ah Reaiah, cu fapa ah Baal,"},"6":{"text":"cu fapa ah Beerah, Assiria siangpahrang Tilgath-pilne-ser nih sal ah a kalpimi kha; amah cu Reuben mi lakah an bawi bik a si.","ref":"2Sia 15.29"},"7":{"text":"Cun a rualchan hna cu an innchungkhar cio ningin, an chan cio chanrelnak kha ṭial a si tikah hi bangin a si: upa bik Jeiel le Zekhariah,"},"8":{"text":"le Azaz fapa Bela an si; Azaz cu Shema fapa, Shema cu Joel fapa a si; annih cu Aroer ah Nebo le Baalmeon tiang khan an rak um."},"9":{"text":"Nichuahlei ah Zufrates tiva hi lei kam thetse ram luhnak tiang khan a um fawn, zeicahtiah Gilead ram ah an saṭil kha a karh."},"10":{"text":"Cun Saul chan ah khan Hag mi kha an doh hna i cu hna cu an kut in an va tei hna; cun Gilead in nichuahlei ram dihlak ah khan an thlam chungah cun khua an sa."},"11":{"text":"Gad fapa hna cu annih zawn ah khan Bashan ram chungah khan Salekah tiangin an um:","title":"Gad Tefa Hna"},"12":{"text":"Joel cu upa bik a si, a pahnihnak ah Shafam, cun Bashan i a ummi Janai le Shafat."},"13":{"text":"Cun an rualchan hna, anmah le an pale innchungkhar ning cio ah: Mikhael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia, le Eber, pasarih an si."},"14":{"text":"Hi hna hi Abihail fapa cu an si. Abihail cu Huri fapa, Huri cu Jaroah fapa, Jaroah cu Gilead fapa, Gilead cu Mikhael fapa, Mikhael cu Jeshishai fapa, Jeshishai cu Jahdo fapa, Jahdo cu Buz fapa;"},"15":{"text":"Guni fapa Abdiel i fapa Ahi cu an pale innchungkhar hna lakah bawi bik a si;"},"16":{"text":"annih cu Gilead le Bashan le a pawngkam khua vialte le Sharon ram chung i saṭil tlonnak hmun dihlak ah khan an ramri tiangin an um."},"17":{"text":"Hi hna vialte hi Judah siangpahrang Jotham le Israel siangpahrang Jeroboam chan ah khan an chuahkehnak ning in cazin khumh an si."},"18":{"text":"Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu hna nih khan phaw le nam aa putmi, li kuaih a thiam i ral tuknak ah a thiam ngaingaimi, aa tim ciami minung sang li le thong li le za sarih le sawm ruk an ngeih hna.","title":"Phun Hnih le A Cheu Hna An Tuanbia"},"19":{"text":"Annih nih Hag mi, Jetur mi, Nafish mi le Nodab mi kha an tuk hna;"},"20":{"text":"cun annih nih bawmhnak kha an hmuh tikah Hag mi hna le an sir i a ummi vialte hna kha an kut chungah cun pek an si, zeicahtiah raldohnak hmun chungah cun Pathian kha an auh i amah kha an i bochan caah an nawlnak kha a pek hna."},"21":{"text":"Annih nih an ṭilva kha an i kalpi hna: an kalauk sang nga, tuu sing hnih le sang nga, laa thong hnih, le a nung in mi thong za khat."},"22":{"text":"Raldohnak cu Pathian ta a si caah tampi an thah hna. Cun saltan caan tiang an umnak ah cun khua an sa."},"23":{"text":"Manasseh phun cheu chung mi hna kha ram chungah cun an um; Bashan in Baal-hermon, Senir, le Hermon Tlang tiang, an tam ngaingai."},"24":{"text":"Hi hna hi an pale innchungkhar cio an lu hna cu an si: Efer, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah le Jahdiel, a ṭhawngmi ralkap, min thang, an pale innchungkhar hna lu cio an si."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an pupa hna Pathian cungah khan an sual i an hmaiah Pathian nih a hrawhmi hna ram chung i a ummi pathian hna sinah khan hlawh an hlang."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah Israel Pathian nih khan Assiria siangpahrang Pul thinlung le Assiria siangpahrang Tilgath-pilne-ser thinlung kha a thawhter i amah nih cun Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu hna cu a kalpi hna i Halah, Habor, Hara, le Gozan tiva ah a phakpi hna, i nihin ni tiang hin an um ko.","ref":"2Sia 15.19,29; 17.6"}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Levi fapa hna: Gershom, Kohath, le Merari.","title":"Levi Tefa Hna"},"2":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel."},"3":{"text":"Amram fale hna: Aaron, Moses, le Miriam. Aaron fapa hna: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar cu Phinehas pa a si, Phinehas cu Abishua pa a si,"},"5":{"text":"Abishua cu Bukki pa a si, Bukki cu Uzzi pa a si,"},"6":{"text":"Uzzi cu Zerahiah pa a si, Zerahiah cu Meraioth pa a si,"},"7":{"text":"Meraioth cu Amariah pa a si, Amariah cu Ahitub pa a si,"},"8":{"text":"Ahitub cu Zadok pa a si, Zadok cu Ahimaaz pa a si,"},"9":{"text":"Ahimaaz cu Azariah pa a si, Azariah cu Johanan pa a si,"},"10":{"text":"Johanan cu Azariah pa a si (amah cu Jerusalem i Solomon nih inn a sakmi chung i tlangbawi a ṭuan mi kha a si)."},"11":{"text":"Azariah cu Amariah pa a si, Amariah cu Ahitub pa a si,"},"12":{"text":"Ahitub cu Zadok pa a si, Zadok cu Shallum pa a si,"},"13":{"text":"Shallum cu Hilkiah pa a si, Hilkiah cu Azariah pa a si,"},"14":{"text":"Azariah cu Seraiah pa a si, Seraiah cu Jehozadak pa a si;"},"15":{"text":"Nebukhadnezzar kut in Judah le Jerusalem cu saltannak chungah Bawipa nih a thlak tik hna ah Jehozadak cu saltannak chungah a kal."},"16":{"text":"Levi fapa hna: Gershom, Kohath, le Merari.","ref":"Exo 6.16-19"},"17":{"text":"Cun mah hihi Gershom fapa hna min cu an si: Libni le Shimei."},"18":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel."},"19":{"text":"Merari fapa hna: Mahli le Mushi. Mah hna hi Levi mi innchungkhar hna, an pupa hna ning cio ah an si."},"20":{"text":"Gershom fapa hna: a fapa cu Libni a si, cu fapa ah Jahath, cu fapa ah Zimmah,"},"21":{"text":"cu fapa ah Joah, cu fapa ah Iddo, cu fapa ah Zerah, cu fapa ah Jeatherai."},"22":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna: a fapa ah Amminadab, cu fapa ah Korah, cu fapa ah Assir,"},"23":{"text":"cu fapa ah Elkanah, cu fapa ah Ebiasaf, cu fapa ah Assir,"},"24":{"text":"cu fapa ah Tahath, cu fapa ah Uriel, cu fapa ah Uzziah, cu fapa ah Shaul."},"25":{"text":"Elkanah fapa hna: Amasai le Ahimoth,"},"26":{"text":"cu fapa ah Elkanah, cu fapa ah Zofai, cu fapa ah Nahath,"},"27":{"text":"cu fapa ah Eliab, cu fapa ah Jeroham, cu fapa ah Elkanah."},"28":{"text":"Samuel fapa hna: a fater cu Joel a si, a pahnihnak cu Abijah a si."},"29":{"text":"Merari fapa hna: a fapa ah Mahli, cu fapa ah Libni, cu fapa ah Shimei, cu fapa ah Uzzah,"},"30":{"text":"cu fapa ah Shimea, cu fapa ah Haggiah, cun cu fapa ah Asaiah."},"31":{"text":"Mah hna hi David nih Bawipa inn chungah, khika i kuang kha chiah a si hnuah, hla saknak rian tlaitu ah a chiahmi hna cu an si.","title":"David Nih A Thiahmi Biakinn Hlasa Pawl"},"32":{"text":"Solomon nih Bawipa inn kha Jerusalem ah a sak hlantiang, tonnak thlam puan biakinn hmaiah khan hla in rian an ṭuan; an rian cu aa chang lengmang tein an ṭuan."},"33":{"text":"Hi hna hi rian a ṭuanmi hna le an fapa hna cu an si. Kohath mi hna chungin: hla satu Heman, amah cu Joel fapa a si, Joel cu Samuel fapa a si,"},"34":{"text":"Samuel cu Elkanah fapa a si, Elkanah cu Jeroham fapa a si, Jeroham cu Eliel fapa a si, Eliel cu Toah fapa a si,"},"35":{"text":"Toah cu Zuf fapa a si, Zuf cu Elkanah fapa a si, Elkanah cu Mahath fapa a si, Mahath cu Amasai fapa a si,"},"36":{"text":"Amasai cu Elkanah fapa a si, Elkanah cu Joel fapa a si, Joel cu Azariah fapa a si, Azariah cu Zefaniah fapa a si,"},"37":{"text":"Zefaniah cu Tahath fapa a si, Tahath cu Assir fapa a si, Assir cu Ebiasaf fapa a si, Ebiasaf cu Korah fapa a si,"},"38":{"text":"Korah cu Izhar fapa a si, Izhar cu Kohath fapa a si, Kohath cu Levi fapa a si, Levi cu Israel fapa a si;"},"39":{"text":"cun a orhlei kamah a dirmi a unau Asaf, cu Asaf cu Berekhiah fapa a si, Berekhiah cu Shimea fapa a si,"},"40":{"text":"Shimea cu Mikhael fapa a si, Mikhael cu Baaseiah fapa a si, Baaseiah cu Malkhijah fapa a si,"},"41":{"text":"Malkhijah cu Ethni fapa a si, Ethni cu Zerah fapa a si, Zerah cu Adaiah fapa a si,"},"42":{"text":"Adaiah cu Ethan fapa a si, Ethan cu Zimmah fapa a si, Zimmah cu Shimei fapa a si,"},"43":{"text":"Shimei cu Jahath fapa a si, Jahath cu Gershom fapa a si, Gershom cu Levi fapa a si."},"44":{"text":"Kehlei kamah Merari fapa hna, an unau hna kha an um: Ethan, amah cu Kishi fapa a si, Kishi cu Abdi fapa a si, Abdi cu Malluk fapa a si,"},"45":{"text":"Malluk cu Hashabiah fapa a si, Hashabiah cu Amaziah fapa a si, Amaziah cu Hilkiah fapa a si."},"46":{"text":"Hilkiah cu Amzi fapa a si, Amzi cu Bani fapa a si, Bani, cu Shemer fapa a si."},"47":{"text":"Shemer cu Mahli fapa a si, Mahli cu Mushi fapa a si, Mushi cu Merari fapa a si, Merari cu Levi fapa a si;"},"48":{"text":"cun an unau hna Levi mi hna cu Pathian inn chung puan biakinn rian vialte kha ṭuan awkah thiah an si."},"49":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Aaron le a fapa hna nih khan, Pathian sal Moses nih nawl a rak chiahmi vialte ning khan, a thiang bik hmun rian vialte ca le Israel mi caah remnak ser awkah, khangh thawinak biakṭheng cungah le zihmui biakṭheng cungah pekchanhnak kha an tuah.","title":"Aaron Tefa Hna"},"50":{"text":"Hi hna hi Aaron fapa cu an si: a fapa ah Eleazar, cu fapa ah Phinehas, cu fapa ah Abishua,"},"51":{"text":"cu fapa ah Bukki, cu fapa ah Uzzi, cu fapa ah Zerahiah,"},"52":{"text":"cu fapa ah Meraioth, cu fapa ah Amariah, cu fapa ah Ahitub,"},"53":{"text":"cu fapa ah Zadok, cu fapa ah Ahimaaz."},"54":{"text":"Mah hihi an ramri chungah an umnak hmun cio ningin, khua an saknak hmun hna cu an si: Kohath chungkhar hna chung i Aaron fapa hna kha, camcawh fung khiah in an ta a si caah,","title":"Levi Mi Khua Hna (Jos 21.1-42)"},"55":{"text":"Judah ram chung i Hebron khua le a pawngkam saṭil tlonnak ram cu, annih cu pek an si,"},"56":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw khuapi pawngkam lo hna le khuate hna cu Jefunneh fapa Kaleb kha an pek."},"57":{"text":"Aaron fapa hna kha himnak khua kha an pek hna: Hebron, Libnah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna Jattir, Eshtemoa le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"58":{"text":"Hilen le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna Debir le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"59":{"text":"Ashan le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, le Beth-shemesh le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna;"},"60":{"text":"cun Benjamin phun chungin, Geba le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Alemeth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, le Anathoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna. An innchungkhar dihlak in an khua vialte hna cu hleithum an si."},"61":{"text":"Kohath mi a tang rihmi hna cu camcawh fung khiah in, phun cheu, Manasseh phun cheu chung khan, khua pahra pek an si."},"62":{"text":"Cun Gershon mi hna kha, an innchungkhar ning cio in, Issakhar phun le Asher phun le Naftali phun le Bashan i Manasseh phun chungin khua hleithum voh an si."},"63":{"text":"Merari mi hna cu, an innchungkhar ning cio in, Reuben phun le Gad phun le Zebulun phun chungin khua hleihnih voh an si."},"64":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi hna nih Levi mi hna cu khua kha an saṭil tlonnak ram hna he khan an pek hna."},"65":{"text":"Judah phun le Simeon phun le Benjamin phun chung zong hi khua an min in chimmi hna hi camcawh fung khiah in an pek hna."},"66":{"text":"Cun Kohath fapa hna i an innchungkhar a cheu hna nih khan an ram chung khua an comi cu Efraim phun comi ram chung khan an si."},"67":{"text":"Annih cu himnak khua kha pek an si: Efraim tlangram i a ummi Shekhem kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he, Gezer cu a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he,"},"68":{"text":"Jokmeam kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he, Beth-horon kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he,"},"69":{"text":"Aijalon kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he, Gathrimmon kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he,"},"70":{"text":"cun Kohath innchungkhar a tang rihmi hna caah Manasseh phun cheu chung khan Aner kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he, cun Bileam kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he pek an si."},"71":{"text":"Gershon mi hna cu hi ram hi pek an si; Manasseh phun cheu chung khan Bashan i Golan kha a saṭil tlonnak ram hna he, cun Ashtaroth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna;"},"72":{"text":"Issakhar phun chungin Kedesh le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Daberath le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"73":{"text":"Ramoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Anem le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna;"},"74":{"text":"Asher phun chungin Mashal le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Abdon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"75":{"text":"Hukok le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Rehob le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna;"},"76":{"text":"cun Naftali phun chungin Galilee i Kedesh le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Hammon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, le Kiriathaim le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna."},"77":{"text":"Merari mi a tang rihmi hna cu mah hihi pek an si: Zebulun phun chungin, Rimmono le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Tabor le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"78":{"text":"cun Jordan khattelei ral Jeriko zawnah, Jordan nichuahlei kamah Reuben phun chungin, ramlak i a ummi Bezer le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Jahzah le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"79":{"text":"Kedemoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna, Mefaath le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna;"},"80":{"text":"cun Gad phun chungin; Gilead i a ummi Ramoth le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna,"},"81":{"text":"Heshbon le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna le Jazer le a saṭil tlonnak ram hna."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Issakhar fapa hna: Tola, Puah, Jashub, le Shimron, pali an si.","title":"Issakhar Tefa Hna"},"2":{"text":"Tola fapa hna: Uzzi, Refaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, le Shemuel, annih hi an pupa Tola innchungkhar hna chung i lu cio an si, anmah chan i a ṭhawngmi ralkap an si i David chan ah khan sang hnih le thong hnih le za ruk an si."},"3":{"text":"Uzzi fapa hna: Izrahiah.
