Cun Izrahiah fapa hna cu, Mikhael, Obadiah, Joel, le Isshiah, panga, an dihlak in mi hruitu an si;"},"4":{"text":"cun an sin i rel chihmi, anmah le an chan ning cio in, an pupa hna innchungkhar ningin, raltu khomi ralkapbu minung sang thum le thong ruk an um, zeitintiah nupi tampi le fapa tampi an ngei."},"5":{"text":"An rualchan Issakhar phun vialte chung i a ummi hna cu an chuahkeh ningin minthlak in, an dihlak ah ralkap ṭhawng sang riat le thong sarih an si."},"6":{"text":"Benjamin fapa hna: Bela, Bekher, le Jediael, pathum an si.","title":"Benjamin Tefa Hna"},"7":{"text":"Bela fapa hna: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth le Iri, panga, an pale chungkhar hna lu cio, ralkap ṭhawng an si; cun an chuahkehning in cazin khumhning ah sang hnih le thong hnih, sawm thum le pali an si."},"8":{"text":"Bekher fapa hna; Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Eli-o-enai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, le Alemeth."},"9":{"text":"Mah hna hi Bekher fapa an si dih; cun an chuahkehnak ningin cazin khumhnak ah, an chan ningin an pale innchungkhar hna lu cio an sining khan, ralkap ṭhawng an si i sang hnih le za hnih an si."},"10":{"text":"Jediael fapa: Bilhan. Bilhan fapa hna: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Khenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, le Ahishahar."},"11":{"text":"Mah vialte hi Jediael fapa cu an si, an pale cio innchungkhar lu cio an si ning khan, annih cu ralkap ṭhawng, ral doh awk i timh cia in a ummi an si, sang khat thong sarih le za hnih an si."},"12":{"text":"Cun Shuppim le Huppim cu Ir fapa kha an si i Aher fapa hna cu Hushim a si."},"13":{"text":"Naftali fapa hna: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, le Shallum, Bilhah tefa kha an si.","title":"Naftali Tefa Hna"},"14":{"text":"Manasseh fapa hna: Asriel, amah cu a nupichun Aramean minu nih a hrin; amah nih cun Gilead pa Makhir kha a hrin.","title":"Manasseh Tefa Hna"},"15":{"text":"Cun Makhir nih Huppim le Shuppim cu nupi a ṭhitpiak hna. A farnu min cu Maakah a si. A pahnihnak min cu Zelofehad a si; cun Zelofehad nih fanu a ngeih hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun Makhir nupi Maakah nih fapa a hrin i a min ah Peresh a sak; cun a unau min cu Sheresh a si; cun a fapa hna cu Ulam le Rakem an si."},"17":{"text":"Ulam fapa cu Bedan a si. Hi hna hi Manasseh fapa Makhir i fapa Gilead i a fapa hna cu an si."},"18":{"text":"Cun a farnu Hammolekheth nih Ishhod, Abiezer le Mahlah a hrin hna."},"19":{"text":"Shemida fapa hna cu Ahian, Shekhem, Likhi, le Aniam an si."},"20":{"text":"Efraim fapa hna cu a chan chan in hihi an si. Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,","title":"Efraim Tefa Hna"},"21":{"text":"Zabad, Shuthelah. Shuthelah hleiah Efraim nih fapa dang pahnih a ngeih hna: Ezer le Elead an si; anmah cu cuka ram Gad mi hna saṭil an fir ruang i an rak thahmi hna kha an si."},"22":{"text":"Cun an pa Efraim nih ni tampi a ngai hna i amah hnemh awkah cun a unau hna kha an ra."},"23":{"text":"Cun Efraim cu a nupi sinah a vung lut i fa a pawi i fapa pakhat a hrin i a innchungkhar chungah ṭhat lonak a tlun caah a min ah Beriah a sak."},"24":{"text":"A fanu cu Sheerah a si, amah nih cun Beth-horon tangnung le Beth-horon cungnung le Uzzen-sheerah kha a ser hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun a fapa cu Refah a si, cu fapa cu Reshef, cu fapa cu Telah, cu fapa cu Tahan,"},"26":{"text":"cu fapa cu Ladan, cu fapa cu Ammihud, cu fapa cu Elishama,"},"27":{"text":"cu fapa cu Nun, cu fapa cu Joshua."},"28":{"text":"Annih nih an covo le an umnak cu Bethel le a pawngkam khua hna, nichuahlei ah Naaran le nitlaklei ah Gezer le a khua hna, Shekhem le a khua hna, Ayyah le a khua hna, an si;"},"29":{"text":"cun Manasseh mi hna ramri thluahmah zongah Beth-shean le a khua hna, Taanak le a khua hna, Megiddo le a khua hna, Dor le a khua hna an si. Hi hna chungah hin Israel fapa Josef i a fapa hna cu khua an sa."},"30":{"text":"Asher fapa hna: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah le an far Serah.","title":"Asher Tefa Hna"},"31":{"text":"Beriah fapa hna: Heber le Malkhiel, amah cu Birzaith pa a si."},"32":{"text":"Heber cu Jaflet, Shomer le Hotham le an far Shua pa a si."},"33":{"text":"Jaflet fapa hna: Pasak, Bimhal le Ashvath. Mah hna hi Jaflet fapa an si."},"34":{"text":"A unau Shomer fapa hna: Rohgah, Jehubbah le Aram."},"35":{"text":"A unau Hotham fapa hna: Zofah, Imna, Shelesh le Amal."},"36":{"text":"Zofah fapa hna: Suah, Harnefer, Shual, Beri, Imrah,"},"37":{"text":"Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Isthran le Bera."},"38":{"text":"Jether fapa hna Jefunneh, Pispa, le Ara."},"39":{"text":"Ulla fapa hna: Arah, Hanniel le Rizia."},"40":{"text":"Mah hna vialte hi Asher mi, an pale innchungkhar cio i an lu hna an hnatlakmi hna, ralkap ṭhawng bawi hna lak i upa bik an si. An chuahkehnak ningin raldohnak ca i minthlak tikah mi sang hnih le thong ruk an si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Benjamin cu a fater Bela, a pahnihnak Ashbel, a pathumnak Aharah,","title":"Benjamin Tefa Hna"},"2":{"text":"a palinak Nohah le a panganak Rafa a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bela nih fapa a ngeih hna: Addar, Gera, Abihud,"},"4":{"text":"Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,"},"5":{"text":"Gera, Shefufan le Huram an si."},"6":{"text":"Mah hna hi Ehud fapa cu an si (annih cu Geba i khua a sami hna an pale innchungkhar hna he an si i Manahath ah sal ah kalpi an si):"},"7":{"text":"Naaman, Ahijah le Gera, Gera cu Heglam kha a si, amah cu Uzza le Ahihud pa a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun Shaharaim nih a nupile Hushim le Baara kha a ṭhawl hna hnuah Moab ram chungah fapa a ngeih hna."},"9":{"text":"A nupi Hodesh in fapa a hrin hna: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malkam,"},"10":{"text":"Jeuz, Sakhia, le Mirmah. Mah hna hi a fapa an si, pale innchungkhar lu cio an si."},"11":{"text":"Hushim sin zongin fapa a ngeih hna: Abitub, le Elpaal."},"12":{"text":"Elpaal fapa hna: Eber le Misham, cun Ono le Lod an khua hna he a sertu Shemed"},"13":{"text":"cun Beriah le Shema (annih cu Gath i a ummi hna a ṭhiotu Aijalon i khua a sami hna pale hna innchungkhar hna i lu kha an si)."},"14":{"text":"cun Ahio, Shashak, le Jeremoth an si."},"15":{"text":"Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,"},"16":{"text":"Mikhael, Ishpah le Joha hna cu Beriah fapa an si."},"17":{"text":"Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,"},"18":{"text":"Ishmerai, Izliah, le Jobab hna cu Elpaal fapa an si."},"19":{"text":"Jakim, Zikhri, Zabdi,"},"20":{"text":"Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,"},"21":{"text":"Adaiah, Beraiah le Shimrath hna cu Shimei fapa an si."},"22":{"text":"Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,"},"23":{"text":"Abdon, Zikhri, Hanan,"},"24":{"text":"Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,"},"25":{"text":"Ifedeiah le Penuel hna cu Shashak fapa an si."},"26":{"text":"Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,"},"27":{"text":"Jaareshiah, Elijah le Zikhri hna cu Jeroham fapa an si."},"28":{"text":"Hi hna hi pale innchungkhar lu, anmah le an chan ning cio in, hruitu an si. Mah hna hi Jerusalem ah khua an sa."},"29":{"text":"Gibeon pa Jeiel cu Gibeon ah khua a sa i a nupi min cu Maakah a si.","title":"Saul Chuahkehnak Kong (1Cha 9.35-44)"},"30":{"text":"A fater cu Abdon a si, a hun changtu ah Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,"},"31":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zekher"},"32":{"text":"le Mikloth (amah cu Shimeah pa kha a si). Hi hna zong hi Jerusalem i a ummi an rualchan hna ralchan ah khan an rualchan hna he khua an sa."},"33":{"text":"Ner cu Kish pa a si, Kish cu Saul pa a si, Saul cu Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab le Eshbaal pa a si;"},"34":{"text":"cun Jonathan fapa cu Meribbaal a si; Meribbaal cu Mikah pa a si."},"35":{"text":"Mikah fapa hna: Pithon, Melek, Tarea, le Ahaz."},"36":{"text":"Ahaz cu Jehoaddah pa a si; cun Jehoaddah cu Alemeth le Zimri pa a si; Zimri cu Moza pa a si."},"37":{"text":"Moza cu Binea pa a si, a fapa ah Rafah, cu fapa ah Eleasah, cu fapa ah Azel."},"38":{"text":"Azel nih fapa paruk a ngeih hna i mah hihi an min a si. Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, le Hanan. Mah hna hi Azel fapa an si dih."},"39":{"text":"A unau Eshek fapa hna. A fater Ulam a pahnihnak Jeush, a pathumnak Elifelet."},"40":{"text":"Ulam fapa hna cu ralkap ṭhawng, li le thalkah thiam, fapa tampi le tufa tampi a ngeimi an si, za khat le sawm nga an si. Hi hna hi Benjamin mi an si dih."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi vialte cu an chuahkehnak ning cio in minthlak an si i mah cucu Israel Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah ṭial an si. Cun Judah cu zumhawktlak a si lo ruangah Babilon ah sal ah kalpi an si.","title":"Babilon In A Kirmi Hna (Neh 11.1-24)"},"2":{"text":"Cun an covo an khua hna chung i a um ṭhan hmasa bik hna cu Israel mi, tlangbawi hna, Levi mi hna, le biaknak inn i rianṭuantu hna kha an si.","ref":"Ezr 2.27; Neh 7.73"},"3":{"text":"Cun Judah mi tlawmpal, Benjamin mi tlawmpal, Efraim mi tlawmpal le Manasseh mi tlawmpal hna cu Jerusalem ah an um:"},"4":{"text":"Ammihud fapa Uthai, Ammihud cu Omri fapa, Omri cu Imri fapa, Imri cu Bani fapa, Bani cu Judah fapa Perez fapa hna chung i a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun Shilon mi hna chungin fater Asaiah le a fapa hna an si."},"6":{"text":"Zerah fapa hna chungin Jeuel le a rualchan an si, za ruk sawm kua an si."},"7":{"text":"Benjamin mi hna chungin Meshullam fapa Sallu, Meshullam cu Hodaviah fapa, Hodaviah cu Hassenuah fapa,"},"8":{"text":"Jehoram fapa Ibneiah, Uzzi fapa Elah, Uzzi cu Mikhri fapa, le Shefatiah fapa Meshullam, Shefatiah cu Reuel fapa, Reuel cu Ibnijah fapa;"},"9":{"text":"le an chan ning cio in an rualchan hna cu an si, za kua le sawm nga le paruk an si. Mah hna hi hi an pale innchungkhar ning cio in an pale innchungkhar hna lu an si."},"10":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna lakin Jedaiah, Jehoiarib Jakhin,"},"11":{"text":"le Azariah Hilkiah fapa, Hilkiah cu Meshullam fapa, Meshullam cu Zadok fapa, Zadok cu Meraioth fapa, Meraioth cu Ahitub fapa, Ahitub cu Pathian inn i bawi ngan bik a si;"},"12":{"text":"cun Adaiah, amah cu Jeroham fapa, Jeroham cu Pashhur fapa, Pashhur cu Malkhijah fapa, cun Maasai, amah cu Adiel fapa, Adiel cu Jahzerah fapa, Jahzerah cu Meshullam fapa, Meshullam cu Meshillemith fapa, Meshillemith cu Immer fapa,"},"13":{"text":"mah hna hi an rualchan an pale chungkhar hna i an lu hna lengah, thong khat za sarih le sawm ruk an si, Pathian inn rian ca i mi ṭhawng ngaingai an si."},"14":{"text":"Levi mi lakin: Shemaiah, Hasshub fapa, Hassub cu Azrikam fapa, Azrikam cu Merari fapa hna lak i Hashabiah fapa a si;"},"15":{"text":"cun Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal le Mattaniah, Mattaniah cu Mikah fapa; Mikah cu Zikhri fapa, Zikhri cu Asaf fapa;"},"16":{"text":"cun Obadiah, amah cu Shemaiah fapa, Shemaiah cu Galal fapa, Galal cu Jeduthun fapa, le Berekhiah an si, Berekhiah cu Netofah mi hna khuate i a ummi Elkanah fapa Asa i a fapa a si."},"17":{"text":"Kutka cawngtu hna cu: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, le an rualchan an si; (Shallum cu an bawi bik a si),"},"18":{"text":"annih cu hi hlanah cun nichuahlei kam i siangpahrang kutka ah khan chiah an si. Levi mi riahhmun hna kutka cawngtu cu mah hna hi an si."},"19":{"text":"Shallum, amah cu Kore fapa, Kore cu Ebiasaf fapa, Ebiasaf cu Korah fapa, cun a pa innchungkhar a rualchan hna, Korah mi hna nih biaknak rian zohkhenhtu le thlam innkahram zohkhenhtu an si, an pupa hna cu Bawipa riahhmun zohkhenhtu le luhnak zohkhenhtu an rak si bang khan."},"20":{"text":"Cun hlan ah cun annih a rak uktu hna cu Eleazar fapa Phinehas kha a si; amah sinah cun Pathian a um."},"21":{"text":"Meshelemiah fapa Zekhariah cu tonnak thlam luhnak ah kutka cawngtu a si."},"22":{"text":"Hi hna vialte, innkahram i kutka cawngtu ah thimmi hna cu za hnih le hleihnih an si. Annih cu an khua cio ah khan an chuahkehnak ningin minthlak an si. David le hmutu Samuel nih khan annih cu zumhawktlak an rian ah khan an fehter hna."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah anmah le an fapa hna nih khan Bawipa inn kutka hna cu an zohkhenh hna, mah cucu thlam inn kha a si, annih cu a cawngtu an si."},"24":{"text":"Kutka cawngtu hna cu a kam lei ah khan an um, nichuahlei, nitlaklei, chaklei, thlanglei kamah khan;"},"25":{"text":"cun an rualchan hna an khua cio i a ummi hna kha ni sarih dan lengmang ah, hi hna he um awkah an rat lengmang awk a si;"},"26":{"text":"zeicahtiah kutka cawngtu upa bik pali, Levi mi a simi hna kha, Pathian inn chung dal hna le chawhlawn hna zohkhenhtu kha an si."},"27":{"text":"Cun annih cu Pathian inn velchum ah khan an riak; zeicahtiah a cawngh le zingfate in innka hun cu anmah rian a si."},"28":{"text":"A cheu khat cu rianṭuannak umkheng zohkhenh kha an rian a si, zeicahtiah an rak put hna le an lak tik hna ah an rel hna awk a si."},"29":{"text":"Cheu khat hna cu ṭhutdan cabuai zohkhenhtu le a thiangmi umkheng vialte zohkhenhtu le, changvut dip zong a zohkhenhtu le, mitsur hang, chiti, zihmui, le rimhmui zohkhenhtu ah khan an thiah hna."},"30":{"text":"A dang pawl, tlangbawi fapa hna nih khan, rimhmui cawh awk kha an timhtuah,"},"31":{"text":"cun Levi mi pakhat Mattithiah kha changreu thlum a per tete tuah uktu a si, amah cu Korah mi Shallum fapa upa bik a si."},"32":{"text":"Cun Kohath mi an unau hna a cheu khat zong kha, Sabbath kip i timh awkah hun camcinmi changreu tuah cu an rian a si."},"33":{"text":"Hi hna hi hlasatu cu an si, annih cu Levi mi pale innchungkhar hna lu cio kha an si, annih cu biakinn chung dal ah khan an um, chun zan in rian thiah an si caah rian dang khan cun an luat."},"34":{"text":"Mah hna hi Levi mi pale hna innchungkhar lu, an chan ning cio in an si, hruaitu an si, i Jerusalem ah khan an um."},"35":{"text":"Gibeon ah Gibeon pa Jeiel kha a um, a nupi min cu Maakah a si,","title":"Saul Tefa Hna"},"36":{"text":"cun a fater cu Abdon a si, cu dih cun Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab."},"37":{"text":"Gedor, Ahio, Zekhariah, le Mikloth an si;"},"38":{"text":"cun Mikloth cu Shimeam pa a si; cun hi hna zong hi Jerusalem i a ummi an rualchan hna ralchan ah khan an rualchan hna he khua an sa."},"39":{"text":"Ner cu Kish pa a si, Kish cu Saul pa a si, Saul cu Jonathan, Malkhishua, Abinadab le Eshbaal pa a si:"},"40":{"text":"cun Jonathan fapa cu Meribbaal a si, i Meribbaal cu Mikah pa a si."},"41":{"text":"Mikah fapa hna: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea, le Ahaz;"},"42":{"text":"cun Ahaz cu Jarah pa a si, Jarah cu Alemeth Azmaveth le Zimri pa a si; Zimri cu Moza pa a si,"},"43":{"text":"Moza cu Binea pa a si; cun Refaliah cu a fapa a si, Refaliah fapa cu Eleasah a si, Eleasah fapa cu Azel a si."},"44":{"text":"Azel nih cun fapa paruk a ngeih hna i mah hihi an min cu an si: Azrikam, Bokheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, le Hanan; hi hna hi Azel fapa cu an si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih Israel mi cu an tuk hna i Filistin mi hna hmai cun Israel mi cu an zam i Gilboa Tlang ah khan an ril liangluang ko.","title":"Saul le A Fapa Hna An Thihnak (1Sam 31.1-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi nih Saul le a fapa hna kha an phak hna i Filistin mi hna nih cun Saul fapa Jonathan le Abinadab le Malkhishua kha an thah hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Saul cu heh tiah an nam i thal kah thiammi hna nih khan an phak ai; cun thal kah thiam hna nih khan an hliam."},"4":{"text":"Cun Saul nih a ralthuam putu sinah khan, “Na nam kha i zuh law tleng lak in ka chun, cu ti a si lo ahcun, cuarpartanlo pawl hi an ra lai i lentecelhnak ah an ka ser sual lai,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw a ralthuam putu nih khan a tuah duh lo; zeicahtiah a thin a phang ngaingai. Cucaah Saul nih amah vainam kha aa lak i a bawhkhuh."},"5":{"text":"Cun a ralthuam putu nih Saul kha a thi cang tiah a hmuh tikah amah zong nih a vainam kha a bawhkhuh ve i a thi."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun Saul cu a thi; amah le a fapa pathum hna le a innchungkhar vialte cu hmun khat ah an thi."},"7":{"text":"Cun nelrawn chungah a ummi Israel mi vialte nih ralkap kha an zam i Saul le a fapa hna kha an thi, ti an theih tikah, an khua kha an chuahtak hna i an zam; cun Filistin mi kha an ra i an khua kha an rawlh hna."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing ah Filistin mi hna nih a thimi kha an thilthuam hawh awk i an rat tikah, Saul le a fapa hna Gilboa Tlang i an thih kha an hmuh hna."},"9":{"text":"A thilthuam kha an hawh i a lu le a ralthuam kha an lak i an siasal hna le mi zapi hna sin i thawng ṭha cu kalpi awkah Filistin mi ram dihlak ah khan lamkal an thlah hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun a ralthuam cu an pathian hna biakinn ah khan an chiah i a lu cu Dagon biakinn chungah khan an tar."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jebesh-gilead mi vialte nih Saul cung i Filistin mi nih an tuahmi vialte kha an theih tikah"},"12":{"text":"ralṭha vialte cu an tho i Saul ruak le a fapa hna ruak kha an va lak hna i Jabesh ah an ratpi hna. Cun an ruh cu Jabesh i kuhthing toiah an vui hna i ni sarih rawl an ul."},"13":{"text":"Cuticun zumhawktlak a si lo ruangah Saul cu a thi; Bawipa sinah zumh tlak a si lonak cu Bawipa nawlbia a zulh lonak kha le","ref":"Lev 19.31; 20.6; 1Sam 13.8-14; 15.1-24; 28.7-8"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa sinin lam hmuhsaknak kawl loin khuavang thitlawnthiam sin tu in lam hmuhsaknak kha a kawl i a hal kha a si. Cucaah Bawipa nih a thah i pennak cu Jesse fapa David sinah khan a pek."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Israel phun vialte kha Hebron ah David sinah, hmunkhat ah an i pum i annih nih, “Zohhmanh, kannih cu na ruh le na sa kan si.","title":"David Cu Israel Siangpahrang A Cang (2Sam 5.1-5)"},"2":{"text":"Kan hnulei caan, Saul siangpahrang a si lio hmanh ah khan, Israel mi a chuahpitu le a luhpitu cu nangmah na si; cun Bawipa na Pathian nih nangmah cu, ‘Ka mi Israel mi hna cungah tuukhal na si lai i ka mi Israel mi hna cungah bawi na si lai,’ an ti,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi upa vialte kha siangpahrang sinah cun Hebron ah khan an ra; cun David nih annih he cun Bawipa hmaiah Hebron ah khan biakamnak a ser i annih nih Samuel sinin Bawipa bia a rami ning khan, David cu Israel mi siangpahrang ah chiti an thuh."},"4":{"text":"Cun David le Israel mi vialte cu Jerusalem ah an kal, mah cucu Jebus a si, cuka ah cun cuka ram i a ummi Jebus mi hna cu an um.","title":"David Nih Zion A Lak (2Sam 5.6-10)","ref":"Jos 15.63; Biac 1.21"},"5":{"text":"Jebus i a ummi hna nih cun David cu an thawh i, “Hika ah hin na ra lut lai lo,” an ti. Asinain David nih Zion ralhau cu a lak, mah cucu David khua timi cu a si."},"6":{"text":"David nih, “Jebus mi a tu hmasa bik paoh cu ralbawi bik a si lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Zeruiah fapa Joab cu a hung kal hmasa bik i cucaah ralbawi bik ah cun a cang."},"7":{"text":"Cun David cu ralhau chungah cun khua a sa; cucaah mah cucu David khua tiah ti a si."},"8":{"text":"Cun khua cu a velchum in, Millo thawk in a kulhnak tling tein a ser; cun Joab nih khua cu remh awk a tang rihmi kha a remh."},"9":{"text":"Cun David cu, ralkapbu Bawipa kha a sinah a um caah, a ngan chin lengmang."},"10":{"text":"Mah hna hi David miṭhawng hna upa bikbik cu an si, Israel mi kong i Bawipa bia ning khan, amah kha siangpahrang i ser awkah Israel mi vialte hna he hmunkhat ah a pennak chungah khan fak piin an bawmh.","title":"David Miṭhawng Hna (2Sam 23.8-39)"},"11":{"text":"Mah hihi David miṭhawng hna kong cu a si: Hakhmon mi Jashobeam hi pathum hna lak i haotu bik a si, amah nih minung za thum ṭum khat i a thahmi hna cungah khan fei a hman."},"12":{"text":"Cun miṭhawng pathum hna lak i amah a hun changtu cu Ahohimi Dodo i fapa Eleazar kha a si."},"13":{"text":"Filistin mi hna cu raldoh awk i Pas-dammim ah an i pumh tikah, khika ah amah cu David sinah khan a um. Khika ah hmun pakhat a um i barli in a khat i mi hna cu Filistin mi hna sin cun an zam."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu hmun laifang ah cun a dir hmun aa serh i cuka hmun cu a humhak i Filistin mi kha a thah hna; cun Bawipa nih teinak ngan piin a khamh hna."},"15":{"text":"Haotu bik sawm thum hna lak i pathum hna kha, Filistin ralkapbu cu Refaim nelrawn i an riah lioah, David sinah Adullam lungkua lungpi ah khan an vung kal."},"16":{"text":"Cu lioah cun David cu ralhruang chungah a um i Filistin mi ralvengtu ralkap hna cu Bethlehem ah an um."},"17":{"text":"Cun David nih ti kha a ngai ruangmang i, “Bethlehem tikhor, hauka pawng i a ummi ti kha din awkah a ka petu hei um hna seh law, ka hei duh hnga dah,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Khi tikah miṭhawng pathum hna nih khan Filistin mi hna riahhmun chung cun an va lan i Bethlehem tikhor, hauka pawng i a ummi chung khan ti cu an va than an va lak i David sinah an ratpi. Sihmanhsehlaw David nih din a duh lo; Bawipa hmaiah khan a bungh i,"},"19":{"text":"“Hi mi hna nunnak thi hi ka din ko hnga maw? Zeitintiah annih nih thih le thih ti in an rak putmi a si,” tiah a ti. Cucaah cun din cu a duh lo. Mah thil hna cu miṭhawng pathum hna nih khan an tuah."},"20":{"text":"Cun Joab unau Abishai kha sawm thum hna lak i haotu bik cu a si. Cun mi za thum hna cungah fei a hman i a thah hna i pathum hna sinah khan a thang aa chuah ve."},"21":{"text":"Amah cu sawm thum hna lakah khan cun min thang bik a si i an haotu ah a cang, sihmanhsehlaw pathum hna kha cu a khingkhang hna lo."},"22":{"text":"Jehoiada fapa Benaiah cu Kabzeel khuami miralṭha, thil lianngan a tuahtu a si; amah nih Moab ariel pahnih a thah hna. Cun hawhra a tlak ni ah khan a vung kal i chiandeih pakhat zong khor chungah a thah fawn."},"23":{"text":"Cun Izipt mipa pakhat, a ngan ngaingai i a tung dong nga a sangmi kha a thah. Izipt mipa nih cun thiam tlang bantuk a simi fei pakhat aa put; sihmanhsehlaw Benaiah nih cun thing thluan he a vun fuh i Izipt mipa cu a kut chungin fei kha a chuh i amah fei lila cun a thah."},"24":{"text":"Mah thil hna hi Jehoiada fapa Benaiah nih khan a tuah hna i miṭhawng pathum hna sinah khan a thang aa chuah ve."},"25":{"text":"Sawm thum hna lakah khan a min a thang ve, sihmanhsehlaw pathum hna kha cu a khingkhang hna lo. Cun David nih a pum ralvengtu haotu ah a chiah."},"26":{"text":"Ralkapbu hna chung i miṭhawng hna cu Asahel Joab unau, Bethlehem khuami Dodo fapa Elhanan,"},"27":{"text":"Harod khuami Shammoth, Pelon mi Helez,"},"28":{"text":"Tekoa khuami Ikkesh fapa Ira, Anathoth khuami Abiezer,"},"29":{"text":"Hushath mi Sibbekai, Ahohimi Ilai,"},"30":{"text":"Netofah khuami Maharai, Netofah khuami Baanah fapa Heled,"},"31":{"text":"Benjamin mi hna khua Gibeah mi Ribai fapa Ithai, Pirathon mi Benaiah,"},"32":{"text":"Gaash i tivarek hna mi Hurai, Arbath mi Abiel,"},"33":{"text":"Baharum mi Azmaveth, Shaalbon mi Eliahba,"},"34":{"text":"Gizon mi Hashem, Harar mi Shagee fapa Jonathan,"},"35":{"text":"Harar mi Sakher fapa Ahiam, Ur fapa Elifal,"},"36":{"text":"Mekherath mi Hefer, Pelon mi Ahijah,"},"37":{"text":"Karmel mi Hezro, Ezbai fapa Naarai,"},"38":{"text":"Nathan unau Joel, Hagri fapa Mibhar,"},"39":{"text":"Ammon mi Zelek, Beeroth khuami Naharai, amah cu Zeruiah fapa Joab hriamnam putu a si,"},"40":{"text":"Ithra mi Ira, Ithra mi Gareb,"},"41":{"text":"Hit mi Uriah, Ahlai fapa Zabad,"},"42":{"text":"Reuben mi Shiza fapa Adina, amah cu Reuben mi le amah sin i a ummi sawm thum haotu a si,"},"43":{"text":"Maakah fapa Hanan le Mithni mi Joshafat,"},"44":{"text":"Ashterath mi Uzzia, Aroer mi Hotham fapa Shama le Jeiel,"},"45":{"text":"Shimri fapa Jediael le a unau Joha, Tiz mi,"},"46":{"text":"Mahav mi Eliel, Elnaam fapa Jeribai le Joshaviah le Moab mi Ithmah,"},"47":{"text":"le Mezoba mi Eliel Obed le Jaasiel an si."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kish fapa Saul ruang i David cu duhduh in aa chawh aa leh khawh lo lioah khan mah hna hi David sin i Ziklag khua ah a ummi a mi cu an si; annih hi ral lio i amah a bawmtu miṭhawng hna lakah khan an i tel ve.","title":"Ziklag I David A Bawmtu Hna"},"2":{"text":"Li hman thiammi an si i thal kah siseh, lungherh cheh siseh, an orhlei kut he an kehlei kut he an thiam; annih cu Benjamin mi, Saul rualchan kha an si."},"3":{"text":"An haotu bik cu Ahiezer a si, a hun changtu cu Joash a si, an pahnih in Gibeah khuami Shemaah fapa an si; Azmaveth fapa Jeziel le Pelet zong; Berakah, Anathoth mi Jehu,"},"4":{"text":"Gibeon mi Ishmaiah, amah cu sawm thum hna lakah miṭhawng a si i sawm thum hna cung i haotu a si; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Gederah mi Jozabad,"},"5":{"text":"Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, Haruf mi Shefatiah,"},"6":{"text":"Elkanah, Isshiah, Azrel, Joezer, le Jashobeam, mah hna hi Korath mi an si;"},"7":{"text":"cun Gedor mi Jeroham fapa hna Joelah le Zebadiah."},"8":{"text":"Gad mi hna chungin a ṭhawng i a thiam ngaingaimi ralkap hna, phaw hman le fei hman a thiam ngaingaimi, an hmai chiandeih hmai a lo i tlang cung sazuk bantukin a mar a zaangmi hna kha David sinah ramlak i ralhruang ah khan an va kal."},"9":{"text":"Cu hna cu: Haotu bik Ezer, a pahnihnak Obadiah, pathumnak Eliab,"},"10":{"text":"palinak Mishmannah, panganak Jeremiah,"},"11":{"text":"paruknak Attai, pasarihnak Eliel,"},"12":{"text":"pariatnak Johanan, pakuanak Elzabad,"},"13":{"text":"pahranak Jeremiah, hleikhatnak Makbannai."},"14":{"text":"Hi Gad mi hna hi ralkap bawi an si, a hme deuh pawl hi za haotu an si i a ngan deuh pawl hi thong haotu an si."},"15":{"text":"Hi hna hi thla khatnak thla i Jordan tiva a kuang vialte a khah dih lio i a tantu, cun cu nelrawn chung i a ummi vialte nichuahlei le nitlaklei i a dawi dihtu kha an si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Benjamin mi tlawmpal le Judah mi tlawmpal cu David sinah ralhruang ah khan an ra."},"17":{"text":"Annih ton awkah khan David cu a va chuak i, “Hawikomhnak in keimah bawmh awkah nan rat a si ahcun, ka lung cu nannih sinah ṭhit chih a si lai; sihmanhsehlaw ka ral hna sinah, ka kut chungah zeihmanh sualnak a um lo nain, rawi awk i nan rat a si ahcun, kan pupa hna Pathian nih in hmu hna seh law in mawhchiat ko hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Khi tikah sawm thum hna lak i haotu bik Amasai cungah khan Thlarau a tlung i amah nih cun hi bangin a ti: “Kannih cu nangmah ta kan si, maw David; Maw Jesse fapa, nangmah sin tel kan si; Daihnak, daihnak cu na sinah um ko seh, Daihnak cu nangmah an bawmtu hna cungah um ko seh! Zeitintiah na Pathian nih an bawmh.” Khi tikah David nih tlun inn a onh hna i a ralkap hna haotu bawi ah khan a ser hna."},"19":{"text":"David cu Saul doh awkah Filistin mi hna he an rat tikah, Manasseh mi cheukhat cu a sinah khan an zam. A ngaingai ti ahcun, Filistin mi kha a bawm hna lo, zeicahtiah Filistin siangpahrang hna nih khan hmasa a bawipa Saul sinah khan a kan lei sual lai ti an phang i Ziklag ah an kirter."},"20":{"text":"Anih cu Ziklag i a kal ah khan hi Manasseh mi hna hi a sin i an zam cu a si: Cu hna cu Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu le Zillethai, Manasseh chung i a thong pawl haotu bik hna kha an si."},"21":{"text":"Annih nih David kha ralhranhtu bu hna doh kha an bawmh; zeitintiah annih cu miṭhawng ralṭha an si dih i ralkapbu haotu kha an si."},"22":{"text":"Ni fate ti awkin mi kha David sinah amah kha bawmh awkah an i fon i ralkapbu nganpi, Pathian ralkapbu bantuk ah a ralkapbu cu a cang."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa bia ningin, Saul pennak cu David kha pek awkah amah sinah Hebron khua ah a rami hriamnam a ngeimi ralkap hna an i cheuning cu mahtihin a si.","title":"Hebron Khua I David Ralkapbu"},"24":{"text":"Judah mi phaw le fei aa putmi hna cu hriamnam a ngeimi ralkap thong ruk le za riat an si."},"25":{"text":"Simeon mi hna chungin raldohnak ca i ralṭhami thong sarih le za khat."},"26":{"text":"Levi mi hna chungin, thong li le za ruk."},"27":{"text":"Aaron innchungkhar chung mi bawi Jehoiada le amah sin i a ummi thong thum le za sarih."},"28":{"text":"A ṭhawng i a ral a ṭhami tlangval Zadok le amah a pa innchungkhar chungin haotu pakul le pahnih."},"29":{"text":"Benjamin mi Saul rual chan hna chungin, thong thum, hi hlanah hin cun a tam deuh cu Saul innchungkhar sinah khan an ṭang."},"30":{"text":"Efraim mi chungin, sang hnih le za riat, an pale innchungkhar cio ah miṭhawng, ralṭha le minthang an si."},"31":{"text":"Manasseh phun cheu chungin sang khat le thong riat, annih cu rat i David kha siangpahrang i ser awkah fiang tein min chim an si."},"32":{"text":"Issakhar chungin, caan a hngalthiammi le Israel nih zeidah a tuah awk a si ti a hngalthiammi haotu bik za hnih hna le anmah nih an ukmi hna an phun hawi vialte."},"33":{"text":"Jebulun chungin, a fel taktakmi ralkap sang nga, annih cu David kha tinhmi pakhatte he bawmh awkah ral hriamnam in tling tein an i thuam."},"34":{"text":"Naftali chungin, ral bawi thong khat, an sinah cun ralkap phaw le fei he aa thuammi sang thum le thong sarih an um."},"35":{"text":"Dan mi chungin, raltuk awk i aa thuammi sang hnih le thong riat le za ruk."},"36":{"text":"Asher chungin, a fel taktakmi, raltuk awk i timh cia in a ummi sang li."},"37":{"text":"Jordan khattelei ral i a ummi Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheu hna chungin, sing khat le sang hnih, raldohnak hriamnam in tling tein aa thuammi."},"38":{"text":"Hi ralkap vialte hna, raldohnak hmun i chuah awkah timh cia tein a ummi hna cu, David kha Israel siangpahrang ah kan ser hrimhrim lai tiah i tim in Hebron ah an ra; cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Israel mi vialte hna zong cu David kha siangpahrang i ser awkah lungkhat tein an um."},"39":{"text":"Annih cu David sinah khan ni thum an um i an ei i an ding, zeicahtiah an unau hna nih khan an rak timhtuahpiak hna."},"40":{"text":"Cun an innpa hna zong nih khan, Issakhar le Zebulun le Naftali ram hna tiang i a ummi hna nih khan, laa in le kalauk in le khacer in le cawtum in rawl le ei awk phun tling, theipi car hlum hna, mitsur car bor hna, mitsur hang, chiti, cawtum hna le tuu hna kha an rak phorh hna, zeicahtiah Israel ram chungah lawmhnak a um."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David nih a thong pawl haotu hna le a za pawl haotu hna le haotu paohpaoh kha lungthin cheuh awk a hal hna.","title":"Biakam Kuang Jerusalem Ah An Ratpi"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih Israel mi aa pummi vialte cu a thawh hna i, “Nannih nih a ṭha tiah nan ruah i Bawipa kan Pathian duhnak a si ahcun, Israel ram chung i a um rihmi kan unau hna le an sin i a ummi tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna, saṭil tlonnak ram a ngeimi khua chung i a ummi hna kha, kan sinah i pumh ve awkah an rat nakhnga, hei sawm hna u sih."},"3":{"text":"Cun kan Pathian kuang kha kan sinah ratpi ṭhan u sih; zeicahtiah Saul chan lioah khan kannih nih kan rak daithlanh ai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Aa pummi vialte nih cu bantukin tuah awkah an hna a tla, zeicahtiah cu thil cu mi vialte mithmuhnak ah thil dik a si."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Israel mi vialte cu Izipt ram tiva Shihor in Hamath luhnak tiang Kiriath-jearim in Jerusalem Pathian kuang cu ratpi awkah, a pumh hna.","title":"David Cu Kuang Lakah Khan A Kal (2Sam 6.1-11)","ref":"1Sam 7.1-2"},"6":{"text":"Cun David le Israel mi vialte cu Baalah ah khan an hung kal, cucu Judah ta a simi Kiriath-jearim kha a si; cherubim hna cungah a ṭhumi Bawipa min in kawhmi Pathian kuang va lak awkah khan a si.","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"7":{"text":"Cun annih nih Abinadab inn khan Pathian kuang cu cawleng thar cungin an kalpi i Uzza le Ahio nih khan cawleng cu an mawngh."},"8":{"text":"Cun David le Israel mi vialte kha Pathian hmaiah cun an thazang dihlak le hla le tingtang le thonglawi le khuang tete le sumsel le muko he tiah thanuam in an um."},"9":{"text":"Cun Khidon phuhri an va phak tikah, cawtum cu an lumhrilh caah Uzza nih cun kuang kha tlaih awkah a kut in a hei banh."},"10":{"text":"Cun Bawipa thinhunnak cu Uzza cungah cun a alh i kuang kha a hei banh caah a thah i cuka ah cun Pathian hmaiah a thi."},"11":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Uzza cungah a thinhunnak a langhter caah David cu a thin a hung i cuka hmun cu nihin ni tiang hin Perez-uzza tiah ti a si."},"12":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian cu khi ni ah a ṭih i, “Zeitindah inn ah ka sinah Pathian kuang cu ka ratpi khawh lai?” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah David nih inn ah David khua chungah khan kuang cu a luhpi lo, sihmanhsehlaw Git mi Obededom inn ah khan a kalpi."},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian kuang cu Obededom inn chungah khan a innchungkhar hna he thla thum a um; cun Bawipa nih Obededom innchungkhar le a ngeihmi vialte cu thluachuah a pek hna.","ref":"1Cha 26.4-5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Tair siangpahrang Hiram nih David kha lamkaltu le sidar thing le lungremh thiam le zungthiam hna zong kha amah cu inn sakpiak awkah a kuat hna.","title":"Hiram Nih David Kha A Theihhngalh (2Sam 5.11-12)"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih, Bawipa nih Israel mi cungah siangpahrang ah a ka fehter cang, ti le a mi Israel mi hna ruangah ka pennak cu sangpi ah hlorh a si cang ti kha a hngalh."},"3":{"text":"Cun David nih Jerusalem ah khan nupi aa lak chap hna i David cu fapa tam chinchin le fanu tam chinchin a ngei.","title":"David Nih Jerusalem Ah A Hrinmi (2Sam 5.13-16 ; 1Cha 3.5-9)"},"4":{"text":"Mah hna hi Jerusalem ah a hrinmi a fale hna min cu a si: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,"},"5":{"text":"Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,"},"6":{"text":"Nogah, Nefeg, Jafia,"},"7":{"text":"Elishama, Beeliada, le Elifelet."},"8":{"text":"Filistin mi nih David kha Israel vialte cung i siangpahrang ah chiti thuh a si cang ti kha an theih tikah, Filistin mi vialte cu David kawl ah khan an hung kal; cun mah cucu David nih a theih i annih doh awkah khan a chuak ve.","title":"David Nih Filistin Mi A Tei Hna (2Sam 5.17-25)"},"9":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi cu an ra i Refaim nelrawn kha an hranh."},"10":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian kha a hal i, “Filistin mi hna doh awkah ka hung kal lai maw? Annih cu ka kut chungah na ka pe hna hnga maw?” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih amah cu. “Hung kal ko, annih cu na kut chungah kan pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Baal-perazim ah a hung kal i David nih khika ah a tei hna; cun David nih, “Pathian nih ka ral hna cu tilian aa sah phut bantukin a sah hna,” tiah a ti. Cucaah cuka hmun cu a min ah Baal-perazim ti a si."},"12":{"text":"Cun khika ah an pathian hna kha an kaltak hna i David nih nawl a pek hna i an khangh hna."},"13":{"text":"Filistin mi hna nih cun nelrawn cu an hranh ṭhan hoi."},"14":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian kha a hal ṭhan tikah, Pathian nih amah cu, “Na hung dawi hna hnga lo; i vel law balsam kung hna zawn khin chuahhnawh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun balsam thing par hna i kal thawng na theih tikah, khi tikah raldohnak hmun ah cun va chuak tuah; Pathian cu na hmaiah, Filistin mi ralkapbu tuk awkah a kal cang,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian nih nawl a pek bangin a tuah i Filistin ralkapbu cu Gibeon in Gezer tiang an thah hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun David minthannak nih cun ram vialte kha a cul dih i miphun vialte cungah amah ṭihnak kha Bawipa nih a tlunter."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David nih amah caah David khua chungah khan inn a sak hna i Pathian kuang caah khan hmun pakhat a timh i thlam pakhat a bunhpiak.","title":"Kuang Kha Jerusalem Ah An Ratpi (2Sam 6.12-23)"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Levi mi dah ti lo nih cun ahohmanh nih Pathian kuang cu i zawn hna hlah seh, zeitintiah annih cu Bawipa nih Bawipa kuang i zawnh awk le a rian ṭuan zungzal awkah a thim hna,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Deu 10.8"},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa kuang cu a ca i a timhmi hmun i hun kalpi awkah, David nih Israel mi vialte cu Jerusalem ah a pumh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun David nih Aaron fapa hna le Levi mi hna kha a pumh hna:"},"5":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna chung khan, haotu bik Uriel le a unau za khat le pakul;"},"6":{"text":"Merari fapa hna lakin, haotu bik Asaiah le a unau za hnih le pakul;"},"7":{"text":"Gershom fapa hna chungin, haotu bik Joel le a unau za khat le sawm thum;"},"8":{"text":"Elizafan fapa hna chungin, haotu bik Shemaiah le a unau za hnih;"},"9":{"text":"Hebron fapa hna chungin, haotu bik Eliel le a unau sawm riat;"},"10":{"text":"Uzziel fapa hna chungin, haotu bik Amminadab le a unau za khat le hleihnih."},"11":{"text":"Cun David nih tlangbawi Zadok le Abiathar le Levi mi Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel le Amminadab kha a kawh hna i,"},"12":{"text":"annih cu, “Nannih cu Levi mi hna chung i pale innchungkhar hna lu cio nan si; nannih nih Bawipa Israel Pathian kuang kha, ka timhpiakmi hmun ah cun nan hunpi nakhnga nan unau le he i thianh tuah u."},"13":{"text":"A voi hmasa bik ah khan nannih nih nan put lo caah Bawipa kan Pathian nih kan cungah a thinhunnak a langhter; zeicahtiah kannih nih hitin tuah awk a si lai ti i fehter ciami ning khan kan rak zohkhenh lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa, Israel Pathian kuang cu hun zawnh awkah tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna cu an i thianh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Moses nih Bawipa bia ningin nawl a pek bangin, Pathian kuang cu Levi mi hna nih a lang hna khan an liang in an i zawn.","ref":"Exo 25.14"},"16":{"text":"David nih Levi mi haotu bik hna kha, nannih nan unaule hna cu hlasatu lunglawmhnak thawng thanter awkah, aw dawh thilri fak piin a tum ding le tingtang le thonglawi le sumsel a tum dingah nan thiah hna lai, tiah a ti hna."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Levi mi hna nih cun mah hna hi an thiah hna: Joel fapa Herman le a unau hna Berekhiah fapa Asaf le an unau hna Merari fapa hna lakin Kushaiah fapa Ethan;"},"18":{"text":"cun anmah sinah cun an unau hna dot hnihnak pawl, Zekhariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Matti-thiah, Elifelehu, le Mikneiah, cun kutka cawngtu Obededom le Jeiel."},"19":{"text":"Hlasatu Herman le Asaf le Ethan cu dar sumsel tumtu ding an si;"},"20":{"text":"Zekhariah, Azeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, le Benaiah cu Alamoth aw in tingtang tumtu ding an si;"},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Mattithiah Elifelehu, le Mikneiah, Obededom, Jeiel le Azaziah hna cu Sheminith aw in thonglawi in hruaitu ding an si."},"22":{"text":"Levi mi hla ah a hruaitu hna Chenaniah nih hla cu a thiam caah a hruai awk hna a si lai."},"23":{"text":"Berekhiah le Elkanah cu kuang ca i kutka cawngtu an si lai."},"24":{"text":"Shebaniah, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekhariah, Benaiah le Eliezer, tlangbawi hna nih Pathian kuang hmaiah muko kha an tum hna lai. Obededom le Jehiah zong kuang ca i kutka cawngtu an si ve lai."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah David le Israel mi upa hna le a thong pawl haotu hna kha, Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu Obededom inn in lunglawmhnak he va lak awkah an kal."},"26":{"text":"Cun Bawipa biakamnak kuang a zawntu Levi mi hna cu Pathian nih a bawmh hna caah, annih nih cawtum pasarih le tuutum pasarih an thawi hna."},"27":{"text":"David cu lahmangṭhia angki fual in aa thuam, kuang a zawntu Levi mi vialte hna le hlasatu hna le hlasatu hna i an hla a hruaitu Khenaniah zong kha cu bantuk cun an i thuam ve; cun David cu laa in tahmi tlangbawi angki aa hruk."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun muko le saki le sumsel aw zulh cun Israel mi vialte nih au pah in Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu an hunpi i hla fak piin an sa i tingtang le thonglawi kha fak piin an tum hna."},"29":{"text":"Cun Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu David khua i a rat lioah khan, Saul fanu Mikhal nih khan thlalangawng in a hei zoh i David Siangpahrang a lam len ko le aa nuamh len ko kha a hei hmuh i a lung chungin a nihsawh."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Pathian kuang cu an luhpi i David nih a bunhpiakmi thlam chungah khan an chiah; cun Pathian hmaiah khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak kha an pekchanh."},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak pekchanh kha a dih tikah, mizapi cu Bawipa min in thluachuahnak a pek hna i,"},"3":{"text":"Israel mi vialte cu nu he pa he changreu hlum khat le sa zam khat le mitsur car hlum khat cio a phawt hna."},"4":{"text":"Cuhleiah Levi mi a cheukhat cu Bawipa kuang hmai i rianṭuantu ah, Bawipa, Israel Pathian sinah thlacam awk le lawmh awk le thangṭhat awkah, a thiah hna."},"5":{"text":"An haotu bik cu Asaf a si, a hun dottu ah Zekhariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obededom le Jeiel an si, annih cu tingtang le thonglawi tumtu ding an si; Asaf cu sumsel tumtu ding a si,"},"6":{"text":"cun tlangbawi Benaiah le Jahaziel cu Bawipa biakamnak kuang hmaiah muko a tum lengmang tu ding an si."},"7":{"text":"Cun khi ni ah khan David nih Bawipa sin i lawmhnak hla sak awkah Asaf le a unau rual cu a thiah hna.","title":"David Lawmhnak Thangṭhatnak Hla (Slm 96.1-13 ; 105.1-15 ; 106.47-48)"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa sinah lunglawmhnak bia chim tuah u, a min kha au tuah u, Mi zakip kha a tuahnak hngalhter hna u!"},"9":{"text":"Hla in hlawrh tuah u, hla in thangṭhat tuah u, Khuaruahhar a rianṭuannak vialte kha chim tuah u!"},"10":{"text":"A min thiang cu sunparnak ah hmang u, Bawipa a kawlmi hna lung kha i lawm hna seh!"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa le a ṭhawnnak kha kawl tuah u, A hmai kha kawl lengmang tuah u!"},"12":{"text":"A tuahmi khuaruahhar rian le khuaruahharnak a tuahmi hna le Biakhiahnak a chimmi hna cu philh hlah u,"},"13":{"text":"Maw a sal Abraham tefa hna, Jakob fapa a thimmi hna!"},"14":{"text":"Amah cu Bawipa, kan Pathian a si; A biakhiahnak cu vawlei khuazakip ah a um."},"15":{"text":"A biakamnak cu a hngalh zungzal A fehtermi a bia cu chan thong khat tiang a philh lo;"},"16":{"text":"Abraham he biakamnak a tuah, Isak sinah chiatser in bia a kam;","ref":"Gen 12.7; 26.3"},"17":{"text":"Jakob sinah nawlbia a fehter, Israel sinah zungzal hmunmi biakamnak a tuah;","ref":"Gen 28.13"},"18":{"text":"“Nangmah sinah Kanaan ram cu ro caah, Na covo ah kan pek lai,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Mi tlawmte an si i santlailo le khi ram chungah mipem an si i"},"20":{"text":"Miphun khat sinin phun khat sinah a vak i Ram khat in ramdang ah an kal tikah,"},"21":{"text":"Ahohmanh annih kha a hremter hna lo; Anmah ruangah siangpahrang kha a sik hna,","ref":"Gen 20.3-7"},"22":{"text":"“Chiti ka thuhmi hi tawng hna hlah u, Ka profet hna hi harnak pe hna hlah u,” a ti."},"23":{"text":"Vawlei vialte hna, Bawipa sinah hla hun sa tuah u! Nifate in amah khamhnak kha chim tuah u."},"24":{"text":"Miphun hna lakah a sunparnak kha thanh tuah u, Mi vialte hna lakah, khuaruahhar a tuahnak zong!"},"25":{"text":"Zeitintiah Bawipa cu a lianngan i fak piin thangṭhat awk a si, Mi hna pathian vialte hna nakin amah cu ṭih awk a si deuh."},"26":{"text":"Zeitintiah mi hna pathian vialte cu siasal an si, Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih van khi a ser hna."},"27":{"text":"Upatnak le lianngannak cu a hmaiah an um, Ṭhawnnak le lawmhnak cu a hmun chungah an um."},"28":{"text":"Maw mizakip chung i miphun vialte hna, Bawipa sinah pe ko u, Bawipa sinah sunparnak le ṭhawnnak pe ko u!"},"29":{"text":"Bawipa cu amah min he aa tlakmi sunparnak cu pe ko u, Pekchanh awk rak i put u law a hmaika ah ra chuak tuah u! Thuam thianghlim in i thuam in Bawipa cu bia tuah u,"},"30":{"text":"Vawlei vialte hna, amah hmaiah cun ther tuah u; Asi, vawlei cu fek tein a dir ko, aa hnin bal lai lo."},"31":{"text":"Van hna khi i lawm ko hna seh, vawlei hi a tha nuam seh, “ Bawipa nih a pen,” tiah miphun kip sinah chim hna seh."},"32":{"text":"Rili le a chungah a ummi thil vialte awn hna seh, Lo le a chungah a ummi thil vialte kha i lawm hna seh!"},"33":{"text":"Khi tikah ramlak thingkung vialte cu Bawipa hmaiah lawmhnak in hla an sa lai, Zeitintiah vawlei kha biaceih awkah amah cu a ra."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa cu lawm tuah u, zeitintiah amah cu a ṭha; Zeitintiah a fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun!","ref":"2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"35":{"text":"“Maw kan khamhnak Pathian kan chanh law Miphun hna chungin kan pum law kan khamh tuah, Zeitintiah na min thiang cu kan lawmh i Na thangṭhatnak cu kan i chawr nakhnga"},"36":{"text":"Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu, zungzal in zungzal tiang thangṭhat si ko seh!” ti tuah u. Cun mi vialte nih, “Amen!” tiah an ti. Bawipa kha an thangṭhat."},"37":{"text":"Cuticun David nih Asaf le a unau rual hna cu khika ah, Bawipa biakamnak kuang hmaiah cun, ni fate a herhnak bantukin rianṭuan zungzal awkah a chiahtak hna,","title":"Kuang Zohkhenhtu Levi Mi Thiahmi"},"38":{"text":"Obededom le a unau rual sawm ruk le pariat zong kha; Jeduthun fapa Obededom le Hosah tu cu kutka cawngtu caah khan an si."},"39":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Zadok le a unau hna tlangbawi hna kha Gibeon i a ummi khuahrum bo i Bawipa puan biakinn hmaiah khan a chiahtak hna,"},"40":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel mi nawl a pekmi hna phungbia chung i aa ṭialmi vialte ningin, annih nih zinglei he zanlei he khangh thawinak biakṭheng cungah khan Bawipa sin i khangh thawinak kha an pekchanh thluangthluan awk a si."},"41":{"text":"An sinah cun Heman le Jeduthun le, Bawipa cu a fekmi a dawtnak kha zungzal in a hmunh caah a sinah lawmhnak bia chim awk ca i thimmi hna le fiang tein min chimmi a cheu hna kha an um,"},"42":{"text":"Heman le Jeduthun nih hlasaknak caah khan muko le sumsel an ngeih hna i hla thiang caah khan hlasaknak thilri an ngeih hna. Jeduthun fapa hna cu kutka cawngh kha an thiah hna."},"43":{"text":"Cun mi vialte cu an inn cio ah an ṭin i David cu a inn ah a innchungkhar hna thluachuah pek awkah a kal.","ref":"2Sam 6.19-20"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David cu a inn ah khan a um i cu tikah, David nih cun profet Nathan cu a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, kei vial sidar thing inn chungah ka um i Bawipa biakamnak kuang tu cu puan thlam tangah a um,” tiah a ti.","title":"Pathian Nih David Sinah Biakamnak A Ser (2Sam 7.1-29)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Nathan nih David cu a thawh i, “Na lung chung a ummi paoh cu tuah ko, zeitintiah Pathian cu na sinah a um,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu zan ṭhiamṭhiam ah cun Bawipa bia cu Nathan sinah a ra i,"},"4":{"text":"“Va kal law ka sal David kha, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih a ti: Ka umnak dingah inn ka sakpiak hlah."},"5":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Israel kha ka hun hruai ni thawk in atu tiang inn chungah ka um lo, sihmanhsehlaw thlam khat in thlam khat ah, umnak hmun pakhat in umnak hmun dang pakhat ah ka kal lengmang."},"6":{"text":"Israel mi vialte he kaa chawhnak hmun dihlak ah, ka mi hna cawngh awk i nawl ka pekmi Israel mi biaceihtu hna aho sin tal ah, “Zeicahdah sidar inn na ka sakpiak lo?” tiah bia kaa khat tal ka chim maw? a ti,’ tiah va chim,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu ka sal David kha hi bangin na va chimh lai, ‘Hi bangin ralkapbu Bawipa nih a ti, Nangmah cu ka mi Israel mi cungah bawi si awkah, phong lak, tuu na zulhkhalh hnanak khan kan lak:"},"8":{"text":"cun na kalnak kip ah nangmah sinah ka um i na hmai in na ral vialte kha ka hloh dih hna; cun vawlei cung milianngan hna min bantukin min kan serpiak lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun ka mi Israel mi hna caah hmun pakhat ka tuah lai i anmah hmunte ah cun an um nakhnga le hnahnawh an si ti nakhnga lo, ka phun hna lai,"},"10":{"text":"hlan lio i ka mi Israel mi hna cungah biaceihtu ka rak chiah hna caan bantuk khan, zaang-en hmangmi hna nih an hrawkhral ti hna lai lo; cun na ral vialte cu kan teipiak lai. Cuhleiah Bawipa nih nangmah cu inn pakhat an serpiak lai tiah kan thanh."},"11":{"text":"Na pupa hna sin i um awkah na ni kha a tlin tikah, na hnuah na tefa, na fapa hna lak i pakhat cu a chan ka thawhter lai i a pennak cu ka fehter lai."},"12":{"text":"Keimah caah inn pakhat a sak lai i a bawi ṭhutdan cu zungzal in ka fehter lai."},"13":{"text":"Keimah cu a pa ka si lai i amah cu ka fa a si lai; nangmah hlan i a rak ummi sinin a fekmi ka dawtnak ka rak lak bantuk khan a sinin ka la lai lo;","ref":"2Kor 6.18; Heb 1.5"},"14":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ka inn chungah le ka pennak chungah amah cu ka fehter lai i a bawi ṭhutdan cu zungzal in a hmun lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Hi bia vialte ning le hi langhnak vialte ningin, Nathan nih David sinah cun a chim."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah David cu a lut i Bawipa hmaiah khan a ṭhu i, “Maw Bawipa, Pathian, keimah cu ahodah ka si i ka innchungkhar zong hi zeidah an si, hi tiang nangmah nih na ka hruai hi?"},"17":{"text":"Cun mah hi cu nangmah mit ah cun, a hmemi thil a si ko, maw Pathian; na sal innchungkhar kong zong hi hmailei caan saupi ca tiangin na rak chim chung cang i hmailei ciruang ding hna zong kha na ka hmuhsak cang, maw Bawipa, Pathian!"},"18":{"text":"Cun na sal upatnak pek awk caah hin David nih zeidah chim awk ka ngeih ti? Zeicahtiah na sal cu nangmah nih na hngalh ko."},"19":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na sal ruangah le nangmah na lungthin ning tein, hi thil lianngan vialte hngalhternak ah hin hi thil liannganpi hi na tuah."},"20":{"text":"Kannih nih kan hna in kan theihmi vialte ah nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo, maw Bawipa, nangmah hleiah Pathian dang an um ti lo."},"21":{"text":"Pathian nih amah mi si awk ca i tlanh awkah a kalhnawh hna i, thil lianngan le thil ṭihnung in nangmah caah min pakhat i ser i Izipt ram chungin na mi hna hmai in miphun hna kha na dawipiakmi na mi Israel mi hna bantuk hi vawlei cungah zei miphun dah a um ti?"},"22":{"text":"Cun nangmah nih na mi Israel mi hna cu zungzal in na mi si awkah na ser hna i maw Bawipa, nangmah cu an Pathian ah na cang cang."},"23":{"text":"Cun atu cu maw Bawipa, na salpa kong le a innchungkhar kong i na rak chimmi kha zungzal ca in fehter ko law na rak chim bangkhan tuah ko;"},"24":{"text":"cun ‘Ralkapbu Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu Israel i Pathian a si,’ tiin na min cu zungzal in fehter a si lai i thangṭhat a si lai i na sal David innchungkhar cu na hmaiah fehter a si lai."},"25":{"text":"Zeitintiah nangmah nih maw ka Pathian, na sal cu innchungkhar pakhat kan sakpiak lai tiah ka sinah na phuan cang caah na sal nih hin nangmah hmaiah thla ka cam ngam."},"26":{"text":"Cun maw Bawipa, nangmah cu Pathian na si i hi thil ṭha cu na sal kha na ka kamh cang;"},"27":{"text":"cucaah na sal innchungkhar hi nangmah hmaiah zungzal in a hmunh nakhnga, thluachuahnak pe ko sawh; zeitintiah maw Bawipa, nangmah nih thluachuah na pek cangmi cu zungzal in thluachuakmi a si ko,” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun mah hnuah cun David nih Filistin mi kha a tei hna i a tangchiah hna i Filistin mi hna kut chung cun Gath le a khuate hna kha a lak hna.","title":"David Nih A Pennak A Kauhter (2Sam 8.1-14)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Moab kha a tei, Moab mi hna cu David sal ah an cang i ngunkhuai an pek."},"3":{"text":"David nih Zufrates tiva i a lungphun bunh awk i a kalpah ah Hamath lei i a ummi Zobah siangpahrang Hadadezer zong kha a tei."},"4":{"text":"Cun David nih amah sin khan rangleng thong khat, rangcung ralkap thong sarih, le ke ralkap sang hnih a tlaih hna i David nih leng hnuktu rang vialte kha an tha a pheh dih hna, sihmanhsehlaw rangleng za khat ca i a za ding lawnglawng kha a nganh hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun Damaskas khuami Siria mi nih khan Zobah siangpahrang Hadadezer kha bawmh awkah an rat tikah, David nih khan Siria mi cu sang hnih le thong hnih a rak thah hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun David nih Damaskas i Siria ah khan ralvengtu ralkapbu a chiah hna i Siria mi cu David sal ah an cang i ngunkhuai kha an pek. Cun Bawipa nih David cu a kalnak kip ah khan teinak a pek lengmang."},"7":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer sinum hna nih an i putmi sui phaw kha David nih a lak hna i Jerusalem ah a rak phorh hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer khua a simi Tibaath le Kun in David nih dar tampi a lak; mah cu cun Solomon nih khan dar hmaihum kha le tungpi hna kha le dar umkheng hna kha a ser hna.","ref":"1Sia 7.40-47; 2Cha 4.11-18"},"9":{"text":"Hamath siangpahrang Tou nih, Zobah siangpahrang Hadadezer ralkapbu kha David nih a ning piin a tei dih hna ti kha a theih tikah."},"10":{"text":"Hadadezer kha a doh i a tei caah amah cu va biakchawnh awk le va conglawmh awkah Siangpahrang David sinah khan a fapa Hadoram kha a hei thlah; zeitintiah Hadadezer nih khan Tou kha a rak doh lengmang tawn. Cun amah nih cun sui in sermi thilri a phunphun ngun in sermi a phunphun le dar in sermi a phunphun kha a kuat;"},"11":{"text":"mah thil hna zong cu Siangpahrang David nih a teimi miphun vialte hna, Edom, Moab, Ammon mi hna, Filistin mi hna le Amalek sinin lakmi sui le ngun hna he khan hmunkhat ah Bawipa sinah a pekchanh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun Zeruiah fapa Abishai nih khan Cite Nelrawn ah Edom mi sang khat le thong riat a thah hna.","ref":"Slm 60 (A tlangpi)"},"13":{"text":"Cun Edom ram chungah ralvengtu ralkapbu kha a chiah hna i Edom mi vialte cu David sal ah an cang. Cun Bawipa nih David cu a kalnak kip ah teinak a pek lengmang."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Israel mi vialte cu a pen hna i a mi vialte cu biading le ruannak in a uk hna.","title":"David Bawi Hna (2Sam 8.15-18 ; 20.23-26)"},"15":{"text":"Cun Zeruiah fapa Joab cu ralkapbu haotu bik a si i Ahilud fapa Jehoshafat cu cazin ṭialtu a si;"},"16":{"text":"cun Ahitub fapa Zadok le Abiathar fapa Ahimelek cu tlangbawi an si; cun Shavsha cu caṭialtu a si;"},"17":{"text":"cun Jehoiada fapa Benaiah cu Khereth mi le Peleth mi hna cung i haotu a si i David fapa hna cu siangpahrang rian ah khuakhangtu upa bik an si."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun hi hnuah hin Ammon mi hna siangpahrang Nahash kha a thi i a fapa kha amah hmun ah khan a bawi.","title":"Ammon Mi le Siria Mi An Tei Hna (2Sam 10.1-19)"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih a thawh i, “Nahash fapa Hanun hi a pa nih ka cungah zumhawktlak tein a rak um caah khan a cungah zumhawktlak tein ka um ve lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David nih a pa kong ah khan amah cu va hnemh awkah lamkal a hei thlah hna. Cun David sinum hna cu Hanun sin kha Ammon mi hna ram chungah cun, amah cu va hnemh awkah, an va phan."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Ammon mi bawi hna nih khan Hanun cu an thawh i, “David nih nangmah sinah hnemtu a hun thlah hna caah hin na pa kha a upat tiin maw na ruah? A sinum hna nih hin kan ram hi thlokdah awk le tei awk le ngiatthlai awkah na sinah an ra ko lo mei?” tiah an ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Hanun nih David sinum hna cu an khahmul a meh hna i an khelbo zawn ah an puan cu a laifang in a tan hna i a kalter hna i an kal."},"5":{"text":"Cun David cu mi hna kong kha an chimh tikah, anmah don awkah mi a hei thlah hna, zeitintiah annih cu an ning a zak ngaingai ko. Cun siangpahrang nih cun, “Nan khahmul a corh ṭhan hlantiang Jeriko khua ah cam ko u, cun nan ra kir ṭhan te lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Ammon mi hna nih annih cu David huat kan phor cang ti kha an theih tikah, Hanun le Ammon mi hna nih khan Mesopotamia le Aram-maakah le Zobah ram in rangleng hna le rangcung ralkap hna hlan awkah ngun talen thong khat an kuat hna."},"7":{"text":"Rangleng sang thum thong hnih le Maakah siangpahrang le a ralkapbu, cu an hlan hna i Medeba hmaiah khan an riak. Cun Ammon mi hna cu an khua cio khan an pumh hna i raldohnak hmun ah khan an ra."},"8":{"text":"Mah cucu David nih a theih tikah Joab le a ṭhawngmi ralkapbu vialte kha a thlah hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun Ammon mi hna cu an ra chuak i khua luhnak ah khan raldoh awkah an i tiang i siangpahrang a rami hna cu anmah tein ramlak ah cun an um ve."},"10":{"text":"Joab nih hmailei he hnulei he an ka tuk lai ti kha a hmuh tikah, Israel mi chungin thim khunmi kha a thim hna i Siria mi dohtu dingah khan a ningcang tein ṭanhmun a khuarter hna;"},"11":{"text":"cun a taang rihmi a mi hna cu a unau Abishai kut tangah a chiah hna i Ammon mi hna dohtu dingah khan a ningcang tein ṭanhmun a khuarter hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun anih nih, “Siria mi hi ka caah an ṭhawn tuk ahcun na ka bawmh lai, sihmanhsehlaw Ammon mi hna kha na caah an ṭhawn tuk ah cun kan bawmh ve lai."},"13":{"text":"Ralṭha ngaiin um tuah, kan mi hna le kan Pathian khua hna caah hin pasal si u sih; cun Bawipa nih a ṭha a tining paoh in tuah ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Joab le a sin i a ummi hna nih cun tuk awkah Siria mi cu an hei fuh hna i an hmaiah cun an zaam."},"15":{"text":"Cun Ammon mi hna nih Siria mi an zam ti kha an hmuh tikah annih zong, cu bantukin Joab unau Abishai hmai khan an zam ve i khua chungah khan an lut. Cun Joab cu Jerusalem ah a tlung."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Siria mi hna nih Israel mi nih an kan tei ti kha an hmuh tikah, lamkaltu an thlah hna i Zufrates tiva ral ah a ummi Siria mi hna, Hadadezer ralkapbu ralbawi Shofak nih a hruimi hna kha an hun chuahpi hna."},"17":{"text":"Mah cucu David kha an chimh tikah Israel mi vialte kha hmunkhat ah a pumh hna i Jordan tiva kha an tan i an sin cu an phan i annih cu tuk awkah a ralkap cu a sersiam hna. Cun David nih Siria mi cu a tuk tik hna ah annih zong nih an tuk ve."},"18":{"text":"Cun Siria mi cu Israel mi hna hmai in an zam; cun David nih Siria mi hna chung khan rangleng thong sarih aa citmi hna le ke ralkap sang li a thah hna i an ralkapbu ralbawi Shofak zong kha a thah."},"19":{"text":"Cun Hadadezer sal hna nih khan Israel mi nih an tei ti kha an hmuh tikah, David he cun remnak an ser i a kut tangmi ah an cang. Cucaah Siria mi nih Ammon mi kha bawmh an duh ti hna lo."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ṭhal a hung chuak i siangpahrang hna nih raltuknak hmun i an kal tawn caan ah khan, Joab nih ralkapbu kha a kalpi hna i Ammon mi hna ram kha an hrawh i an ra i Rabbah kha an dum. Sihmanhsehlaw David cu Jerusalem ah a um ko. Cun Joab nih Rabbah cu a tuk i a tei.","title":"David Nih Rabbah A Lak (2Sam 12.26-31)","ref":"2Sam 11.1"},"2":{"text":"Cun David nih an siangpahrang bawi luchin cu a lu cung khan a lak; mah cucu talen pakhat a rih kha le a chung i lungvar man sung a um kha a hmuh; cun cucu David kha an chinh. Cun cu khua hranchaw kha a lak, a tam ngaingai ko."},"3":{"text":"Cun a chung i a ummi hna kha a chuah hna i hluah le turung le thir hreitlung in rian a ṭuanter hna; cu bangin Ammon mi hna khua vialte cungah khan a tuah dih. Cun David le a mi vialte cu Jerusalem ah an kir ṭhan."},"4":{"text":"Cun mah hnuah hin Filistin mi he i dohnak Gezer ah a tho ṭhan; Hushath mi Sibbekai nih mingan hna tefa a simi Sippai kha a thah;","title":"David Mi Hna Nih Mingan Pipi An Thah Hna (2Sam 21.18-22)"},"5":{"text":"cun Filistin mi he i dohnak a um ṭhan hoi; Jair fapa Elhanan nih Git mi Goliath unau Lahmi, a feihlung thiamtlang bantuk a simi cu a thah.","ref":"1Sam 17.4-7"},"6":{"text":"Cun Gath ah i dohnak a um ṭhan hoi; cuka ah cun mipa pakhat a pum a ngan ngaingaimi, a kut ah kutdong paruk veve le a ke ah kedong paruk veve, a dihlak ah kul le pali a ngeimi a um i amah zong cu mi ngan hna tefa kha a si ve."},"7":{"text":"Cun amah nih Israel mi kha a hauh hna tikah David u Shimea i fapa Jonathan nih khan a thah."},"8":{"text":"Hi hna hi Gath khua i a ummi mingan hna hrinthlak kha an si; David kut le a sinum hna kut in an thi."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Satan nih Israel mi kha a doh hna i David kha Israel mi cu rel awkah a forh.","title":"Milurel le Rai (2Sam 24.1-25)"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah David nih cun Joab le ralkapbu haotu hna kha a thawh hna i, “Va kal u law, Israel mi kha Dan in Beersheba tiang va rel hna u, cun zeizat an si kha ka hngalh nakhnga ka chim ṭhan u,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Joab nih a thawh i, “ Bawipa nih a mi hna cu atu i nak hin let za khat in chap ko seh! Siangpahrang ka bawipa, annih cu an dihlak tein ka bawipa sal an si ko lo maw? Zeicahdah ka bawipa nih mah hi cu na herh? Zeicahdah Israel mi cungah mawhnak na tlunter lai?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang bia nih Joab cu a tei. Cucaah Joab cu a kal i Israel ram vialte kha a ṭol dih i Jerusalem ah a ra kir ṭhan."},"5":{"text":"Cun Joab nih David kha minung a relmi hna a zat cu a pek. Israel ram chung dihlak ah vainam a tlai khomi nuai khat le sing khat an um, cun Judah ram chungah vainam tlai khomi sing li le sang sarih an um."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw relnak chungah khan Levi mi le Benjamin mi cu a khumh chih hna lo, zeicahtiah a siangpahrang nawl pekmi cu Joab nih khan a duh hrimhrim lo."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian cu hi thil cungah khan aa lawm lo i Israel mi kha a thah hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian sinah cun, “Hi thil ka tuahmi ah hin fak piin ka sual cang. Sihmanhsehlaw hruhnak piin ka tuah cang caah na salpa ka ṭhat lonak hi ka hlohpiak ko sawh, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun David ta a simi hmutu Gad kha Bawipa nih a chawnh i,"},"10":{"text":"“Va kal law David cu, ‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih, “Thil pathum kan pek i pakhat in i thim, cucu na cungah ka tuah lai,’ a ti,” tiah va chim,’ tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Gad cu David sinah khan a ra i David cu, “ Bawipa nih hi bangin a ti. Na duhmi i thim:"},"12":{"text":"Kum thum chung mangṭam maw, asiloah na ral nih nangmah kha thla thum chung hrawh maw, cu chungah cun na ral hna vainam nih nangmah cu an in phanh lai; asiloah Bawipa vainam ni thum chung hrem dik, cucu ram chungah rai tlun le Bawipa vancungmi nih Israel chung dihlak ah rawhnak tuah a si lai,” a ti. Cu Gad nih cun David cu, “A ka thlahtu sinah zei bialehnak dah ka kirpi lai, atu ah bia i khiak tuah,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun David nih Gad cu a thawh i, “Harnak nganpi chungah ka um; Bawipa kut cungah cun tla ko ning, zeitintiah anih cu a zaangfahnak a ngan ngaingai; sihmanhsehlaw minung kut chungah cun tla sawh hlah ning,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih Israel mi cungah rai kha a tlunter i Israel mi cu sang sarih an thi."},"15":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih vancungmi cu Jerusalem kha hrawh awkah a thlah; sihmanhsehlaw hrawh hnik a vun zalh ah khin Bawipa nih a hmuh i ṭhat lonak kha Bawipa cu aa ngaichih i hrawktu vancungmi sinah cun, “A za cang, na kut kha ṭhum cang,” tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa vancungmi cu Jebus mi Ornan phuhri pawngah khan a dir."},"16":{"text":"Cun David nih khua a hun zoh i van le vawlei karah Bawipa vancungmi a dir kha a hmuh, a kut in vainam phawi cia aa put i Jerusalem lei kha a sawh. Khi tikah David le upa hna cu buri an i aih i vawlei ah an bawk."},"17":{"text":"Cun David nih Pathian sinah. “Mi kha va rel hna u, tiah nawl petu cu keimah ka si lo mei? Sualnak a tuah i ṭhalo ngaiin a tuahtu cu keimah ka si. Sihmanhsehlaw hi tuu hna nih hin zeidah an tuah? Maw Bawipa, ka Pathian, na kut cu keimah le ka pa innchungkhar cungah si ko seh, rai cu na mi hna cungah tlung sawh hlah seh, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Bawipa vancungmi nih Gad cu, David kha hung kal seh law Jebus mi Ornan phuhri ah Bawipa caah biakṭheng pakhat in hung ser seh, tiin David cu chimh awkah nawl a pek."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa min in Gad nih a chimmi bia bangin David cu a hung kal."},"20":{"text":"Ornan cu changvut kha a rak cil len ko; aa mer i vancungmi kha a hmuh i amah sin i a ummi a fapa pali hna kha an i thup."},"21":{"text":"David cu Ornan sin lei i a rat lioah khan. Ornan nih cun a hei zoh i David kha a hmuh i phuhri cun a va chuak i vawlei lei hoih in David cu upatnak kha a pek."},"22":{"text":"Cun David nih Ornan cu a thawh i, “Rai hi mi sinin a kian nakhnga, Bawipa sin i biakṭheng saknak caah phuhri hmun hi ka pe tuah — a man tling tein ka hau ko,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun Ornan nih David cu, “I lak tuah; cun siangpahrang ka bawipa nih a ṭha a timi paoh kha tuah ko seh; zohhmanh cawtum hna cu khangh thawinak caah, cun rawl velhnak fung hna cu thing caah, cun changvut cu changvut thawinak caah kan pek. A dihlak in kan pek dih,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Siangpahrang David nih Ornan cu, “Asilo, a man tling tein kan cawk ko lai; Bawipa caah nangmah ta a simi cu ka la lai lo i a man zeihmanh ka liam lomi khangh thawinak zong ka pechan lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Ornan cu cu hmun caah cun sui shekel za ruk a thlai i a pek."},"26":{"text":"Cun khika ah David nih Bawipa caah biakṭheng a ser i khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak hna kha a pekchanh hna i Bawipa kha a auh i amah nih cun khangh thawinak biakṭheng cung i vancung in a tlami mei khan amah cu a leh."},"27":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih vancungmi kha nawl a pek i a vainam cu a kawng chungah a sawh ṭhan."},"28":{"text":"Khi caan ah khan, Jebus mi Ornan phuhri ah Bawipa nih a ka leh tiah David nih a hmuh tikah, khika ah a raithawinak hna kha a tuah.","title":"Biakinn Hmun"},"29":{"text":"Zeitintiah ramlak ah Moses nih a sermi Bawipa puan biakinn le khangh thawinak biakṭheng hna cu khi caan ah khan Gibeon i khuahrum bo ah khan an um ko;"},"30":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw David cu Bawipa kha va hal awkah a hmaiah cun a kal kho lo; zeicahtiah Bawipa vancungmi vainam kha a ṭih."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David nih, “Hika ah hin Bawipa Pathian inn cu a si lai i hika ah hin Israel mi ca i khangh thawinak biakṭheng cu a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"David nih Israel ram chung i ramdangmi a ummi hna kha i pumh awkah nawl a pek hna i Bawipa inn saknak caah lung attu hna kha lung a remhter hna.","title":"David Nih Biakinn Ca A Timh"},"3":{"text":"David nih kutka innka hna le kapza hna khenhnak thir caah khan thir tampi a rak chiah, cun dar cu thlai cawk loin a chiah i"},"4":{"text":"sidar thingah cu rel cawk loin a chiah; zeitintiah Sidon mi le Tair mi nih sidar thing tampi David sinah khan an rak phorh."},"5":{"text":"Cun David nih a thawh i, “Ka fapa Solomon hi a ngakchia i zeihmanh a hngal rih lo, cun Bawipa ca i sak dingmi inn cu rumra a um hringhranmi, a minthannak le a sunparnak ram vialte ah a thangmi a si awk a si; cucaah ka rak timhlamh chung lai,” tiah a ti. Cucaah David nih a thih hlanah thilri tampi a damhtak."},"6":{"text":"Cun a fapa Solomon cu a auh i Bawipa, Israel Pathian ca i inn sak cu a cungah a hluai."},"7":{"text":"David nih Solomon cu a thawh i, “Ka fapa, Bawipa ka Pathian min thangṭhatnak ca i inn sak cu ka lung chungin ka rak i ruahchihmi a si.","ref":"2Sam 7.1-16; 1Cha 17.1-14"},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa bia cu ka sinah a ra i, ‘Thisen tampi na chuah i ral ngan kha na doh hna; keimah hmaiah vawlei cungah thisen tampi na chuah caah ka min thangṭhatnak caah inn na sa lai lo."},"9":{"text":"Zohhmanh, fapa pakhat na hrin lai; amah cu daihnak mi a si lai. Amah cu a velchum i a ummi ral vialte hna lakin daihnak ka pek lai; zeitintiah a min cu Solomon a si lai i amah chan chungah cun Israel mi cu daihnak le remnak ka pek hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Amah nih cun ka min caah inn pakhat a sak lai. Amah cu ka fapa a si lai i keimah cu a pa ka si lai i a siangpahrang bawiṭhutdan cu Israel chungah zungzal in ka fehter lai,’ a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah ka fapa, nangmah kong ah a chimmi bia bangin Bawipa na Pathian ca i inn saknak ah cun na hlawhtlin nakhnga, Bawipa cu na sinah um ko seh."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah cu Israel mi zohkhenh awk ṭuanvo kha an pek tikah Bawipa na Pathian phungbia cu na zulh nakhnga, Bawipa nih fimnak le hngalhthiamnak in pe ko seh."},"13":{"text":"Khi tikah Bawipa nih Moses cu Israel mi caah a pekmi phunglam le nawlbia hna kha ṭha tein na zulh hna ahcun, na hlawh a tling lai. Ṭhawng ngai le ralṭha in um tuah. Ṭih hlah; na lung dong hlah.","ref":"Jos 1.6-9"},"14":{"text":"Har ngaiin Bawipa inn caah cun sui talen sing za khat, ngun talen nuai khat, dar le thir cu thlai cawk lo ka timh cang, a tam hringhran ko; thingah le lung zong ka timh cang. Mah vialte ah hin na chap awk a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Rianṭuantu tlamtling tein na ngei ko: lung attu, lung remhtu, inn sak thiam, zungthiam a phunphun rel cawk lo,"},"16":{"text":"sui siseh, ngun siseh, dar siseh thir siseh ser a thiammi na ngei ko hna. Tho law ṭuan colh ko! Bawipa cu na sinah um ko seh!” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"David nih Israel mi haotu vialte zong kha a fapa Solomon cu bawmh awkah nawl a pek hna i,"},"18":{"text":"“ Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan sinah a um lo mei? Cun amah nih kam kip ah daihnak an pe hna lo mei? Zeitintiah hi ram chung i a ummi hna cu nan kut chungah an pek hna i ram cu Bawipa le a mi hna hmaiah tei a si cang."},"19":{"text":"Atu cu Bawipa nan Pathian kha nan ruahnak le nan lungthin in biatak tein kawl tuah u. Bawipa biakamnak kuang le Pathian umkheng thiang hna cu Bawipa min ca i sakmi inn chungah khan luhpi an si nakhnga, tho u law Bawipa Pathian i hmunthiang cu sa tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun David cu a upa i a tar ngaingai tikah a fapa Solomon cu Israel mi siangpahrang ah a ser.","ref":"1Sia 1.1-40"},"2":{"text":"David nih Israel mi haotu vialte tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha a pumh hna.","title":"Levi Mi Le Tlangbawi Hna Rian Phawtnak"},"3":{"text":"Levi mi cu, kum sawm thum a timi le a cunglei kha an rel hna i an dihlak ah sang thum le thong riat an si."},"4":{"text":"David nih, “Hi hna chung hin sang hnih le thong li nih Bawipa innchung rianṭuan kha an ṭuanvo a si lai i thong ruk cu biaceihtu le bawi an si lai,"},"5":{"text":"thong li cu kutka cawngtu an si lai i thangṭhatnak caah ka sermi hlasaknak thilri in thong li nih Bawipa kha thangṭhatnak an pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun annih cu David nih Levi fapa Gershom, Kohath le Merari hna ning khan an bu an bu cio in a ṭhen hna."},"7":{"text":"Gershom fapa hna cu Ladan le Shimei an si."},"8":{"text":"Ladan fapa hna: haotu bik Jehiel, le Zetham le Joel, pathum an si."},"9":{"text":"Shimei fapa hna: Shelomoth, Haziel, le Haran, pathum an si. Mah hna hi Ladan innchungkhar hna lu cio kha an si."},"10":{"text":"Shimei fapa hna: Jahath, Zina le Jeush le Beriah. Hi pali hna hi Shimei fapa an si."},"11":{"text":"Haotu bik cu Jahath a si i a hun changtu cu Zizah a si; sihmanhsehlaw Jeush le Beriah cu fapa tampi an ngei lo, cucaah voi khat relnak ah pa pakhat i innchungkhar ah an cang."},"12":{"text":"Kohath fapa hna: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel, pali an si."},"13":{"text":"Amram fapa hna: Aaron le Moses. Aaron cu amah le a fapa hna nih zungzal in Bawipa hmaiah zihmui kha an khangh i amah rian kha an ṭuan i amah min in zungzal in thluachuah peknak an chim nakhnga, Aaron cu a thiang bikmi thil hna kha pekchanh awkah thleidan a si.","ref":"Exo 28.1"},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian mi Moses i a fapa hna kha cu Levi mi phun chungah khan rel an si."},"15":{"text":"Moses fapa hna: Gershom le Eliezer."},"16":{"text":"Gershom fapa hna: haotu bik Shebuel."},"17":{"text":"Eliezer fapa hna: haotu bik Rehabiah; Eliezer nih fapa dang a ngei hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw Rehabiah fapa cu an tam ngaingai."},"18":{"text":"Izhar fapa hna: haotu bik Shelomith, pahnihnak ah Amariah,"},"19":{"text":"pathumnak ah Jahaziel, palinak ah Jekameam."},"20":{"text":"Uzziel fapa hna: haotu bik Mikah le a pahnihnak Isshiah."},"21":{"text":"Merari fapa hna: Mahli le Mushi. Mahli fapa hna: Eleazar le Kish."},"22":{"text":"Eleazar cu fapa hring loin a thi, fanu lawnglawng a ngeih hna; an rualchan Kish fapa hna nih khan an ṭhit hna."},"23":{"text":"Mushi fapa hna: Mahli, Eder le Jeremoth, pathum an si."},"24":{"text":"Mah hna hi Levi fapa hna, an pale chungkhar ning cio ah an si; annih cu an pa le chungkhar hna lu cio, Bawipa inn rian kha ṭuan awkah, min thlak a simi kum kul ri in a cunglei hna kha an si."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah David nih hi bangin “ Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih a mi cu daihnak a pek cang hna; cun Jerusalem ah zungzal in a um."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah Levi mi hna nih puan biakinn kha siseh, a chung rianṭuannak ca i thilthuam si hna seh, an phorh a herh ti lo,” a ti;","ref":"Deu 10.8"},"27":{"text":"zeitintiah David bia a hmanung bik bangin, Levi mi kum kul ri in a cunglei hna cu mah zat hi an si."},"28":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw annih an rian cu Bawipa inn rianṭuannak i Aaron fapa hna bawmh kha a si lai, annih nih tual hna le innchung dal hna kha an zohkhenh lai, a thiangmi thil vialte kha an thianhhlimh lai. Pathian inn chung rian zeipaoh kha an ṭuan lai;","ref":"Nam 3.5-9"},"29":{"text":"cun hun camcinmi changreu le changvut thawinak ca i changvut le thilnu cawh lo changreu pan tete hna le rawhmi changreu thawinak le chiti he cawhmi thawinak hna timhtuahnak le a tam a tlawm lei tahnak ah siseh, a hmet a ngan lei tahnak ah siseh, annih nih an bawmh fawn hna lai."},"30":{"text":"Cun zing fate in an dir lai i Bawipa kha an lawmh lai i an thangṭhat lai, cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in zanlei zongah,"},"31":{"text":"cun Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak hna kha sabbath ni ah siseh, thla thar ah siseh, puai ni ah siseh, cu zat in nan tuah awk a si tining khan Bawipa hmaiah pekchanh camcin a si fate annih nih cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in an tuah lai."},"32":{"text":"Cuticun annih nih tonnak thlam le hmunthiang kha an zohkhenh hna lai i Bawipa inn rian ṭuannak ah khan an unau Aaron fapa hna kha an bawmh hna lai.”"}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Aaron fapa hna an i ṭhenning cu hi bangin a si. Aaron fapa hna: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar.","title":"Tlangbawi Hna Rian Phawtnak"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Nadab le Abihud cu an pa hlanah an thi i fa an ngei lo cucaah Eleazar le Ithamar cu tlangbawi an cang.","ref":"Lev 10.1-2"},"3":{"text":"Eleazar fapa hna chung i Zadok le Ithamar fapa hna chung i Ahimelek bawmhnak thawngin, David nih an rian ṭuan awkah an thiah ning hna bantuk khan rian a phawt hna."},"4":{"text":"Eleazar fapa hna lakah Ithamar fapa hna chung nakin mi upa an tam deuh caah Eleazar fapa hna chung cun innchungkhar haotu hleiruk an chiah hna i Ithamar fapa hna chungin pariat an chiah hna."},"5":{"text":"Annih cu an dihlak in aa lo cio ah, camcawhfung khiah in phawt an si, zeicahtiah Eleazar fapa hna le Ithamar fapa hna chungah khan Biakinn lei haotu hna le thlarau lei haotu hna kha an um veve."},"6":{"text":"Cun Levi mi Nethanel fapa Shemaiah, caṭialtu, nih khan, siangpahrang le bawi hna le tlangbawi Zadok le Abiathar fapa Ahimelek le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna chungkhar hna lu hna hmaika ah khan, cazin ah a khumh hna; Eleazar caah khan innchungkhar pakhat cu thim a si i Ithamar caah khan pakhat thim a si ve."},"7":{"text":"Camcawhfung hmasa bik cu Jehoiarib cungah a tla, pahnihnak cu Jedaiah cungah a tla,"},"8":{"text":"pathumnak cu Harim cungah a tla, palinak cu Seorim cungah a tla,"},"9":{"text":"panganak cu Malkhijah cungah a tla, paruknak cu Mijamin cungah a tla,"},"10":{"text":"pasarihnak cu Hakkoz cungah a tla, pariatnak cu Abijah cungah a tla,"},"11":{"text":"pakuanak cu Jeshua cungah a tla, pahranak cu Shekhaniah cungah a tla,"},"12":{"text":"hleikhatnak cu Eliashib cungah a tla, hleihnihnak cu Jakim cungah a tla,"},"13":{"text":"hleithumnak cu Huppah cungah a tla, hleilinak cu Jeshebeab cungah a tla,"},"14":{"text":"hleinganak cu Bilgah cungah a tla, hleiruknak cu Immer cungah a tla,"},"15":{"text":"hleisarihnak cu Hezir cungah a tla, hleiriatnak cu Happiz-zez cungah a tla,"},"16":{"text":"hleikuanak cu Pethahiah cungah a tla, pakulnak cu Jehezkel cungah a tla,"},"17":{"text":"kul khatnak, cu Jakhin cungah a tla, kul hnihnak cu Gamul cungah a tla,"},"18":{"text":"kul thumnak cu Delaiah cungah a tla, kul linak cu Maaziah cungah a tla."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa Israel Pathian nih nawl a pek bangin an pa Aaron nih an caah rianṭuan ningcang a rak chiahpiakmi hna ning khan, hi hna nih hin Bawipa inn chung i luh cu an rianṭuannak chung i thiahmi rian ah khan an i ngeih."},"20":{"text":"Cun Levi fapa a tang rihmi hna kha cu: Amram fapa hna lakah khan Shubael a si; Shubael fapa hna lakah khan Jehdeiah a si."},"21":{"text":"Rehabiah leiah cun: Rehabiah fapa hna lakah an haotu bik Isshiah."},"22":{"text":"Izhar mi hna lakah, Shelomoth; Shelomoth fapa hna lakah Jahath."},"23":{"text":"Hebron fapa hna: an haotu bik Jeriah, a hun dottu Amariah, a pathumnak Zahaziel, a palinak, Jekameam."},"24":{"text":"Uzziel fapa hna lakah Mikah; Mikah fapa hna lakah Shamir."},"25":{"text":"Mikah unau cu Isshiah a si; Isshiah fapa hna lakah Jekhariah."},"26":{"text":"Merari fapa hna: Mahli le Mushi. Jaaziah fapa hna: Beno."},"27":{"text":"Merari fapa hna: Jaaziah fapa ah Beno, Shoham, Zakkur le Ibri."},"28":{"text":"Mahli fapa ah: Eleazar a si, fapa a ngei lo."},"29":{"text":"Kish leiah, Kish fapa hna Jerahmeel."},"30":{"text":"Mushi fapa hna: Mahli, Eder le Jerimoth. Mah hna hi Levi mi fapa hna, an pale innchungkhar ning cio in an si."},"31":{"text":"Siangpahrang David, Zadok, Ahimelek le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna an pale innchungkhar lu cio hna hmaiah Aaron fapa an unau hna nih an tuah bang khan, pale innchungkhar i lu a si ciomi hna le an nau le cio nih khan, camcawhfung cu an zuh ve."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David le rianṭuannak i upa bikbik hna nih cun rianṭuannak ca dingah khan Asaf fapa hna le Heman fapa hna le Jeduthun fapa hna lak khan tingtang le thonglawi le sumsel hna he bia a chimtu dingah mi kha an thleidan hna. Cu rian a ṭuantu hna le an rian cazin cu mah hihi a si:","title":"Hlasa Pawl Rian Phawtning"},"2":{"text":"Asaf fapa hna lakin: Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah, le Ashrelah; annih cu Asaf fapa Asaf nih a hruaimi hna, siangpahrang nih a chimh hna ning bangin bia a chimmi kha an si."},"3":{"text":"Jeduthun chung cun, Jeduthun fapa hna: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, le Mattithiah, paruk an si, an pa Jeduthun nih a hruai hna i Bawipa lawmhnak le thangṭhatnak ah tingtang he annih nih bia an chim."},"4":{"text":"Heman chung cun, Heman fapa hna: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, le Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, le Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth an si."},"5":{"text":"Mah vialte hi Pathian nih Heman cu kan hlorh lai tiah bia a kam ningin Heman siangpahrang hmutu i a fapa hna cu an si; zeitintiah Pathian nih Heman cu fapa hleili le fanu pathum a pek."},"6":{"text":"Annih cu an dihlak in an pa nih a hruai hna i Bawipa inn chung i sumsel le tingtang le thonglawi he tiah Bawipa inn chung i rianṭuannak ah khan awdawh satu an si. Asaf, Jeduthun le Heman tu cu siangpahrang nawl tangah khan an um."},"7":{"text":"Annih cu an unaule, Bawipa thangṭhatnak hlasak i cawnpiakmi, a thiammi vialte he, za hnih sawm riat pariat an si."},"8":{"text":"Cun annih nih a hme a ngan in, cawnpiaktu he cawnpiakmi he, aa khat rep in, an rian caah khan camcawhfung an zuh cio."},"9":{"text":"Asaf ca i camcawhfung hmasa bik cu Josef cungah a tla; a pahnihnak cu Gedaliah le a unau hna le a fapa hna, pahleihnih hna cungah a tla;"},"10":{"text":"pathumnak cu Zakkur le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"11":{"text":"palinak cu Izri le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"12":{"text":"panganak cu Nethaniah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"13":{"text":"paruknak cu Bukkiah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"14":{"text":"pasarihnak cu Jesharelah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"15":{"text":"pariatnak cu Jeshaiah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"16":{"text":"pakuanak cu Mattaniah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"17":{"text":"pahranak cu Shimei le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"18":{"text":"hleikhatnak cu Azarel le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"19":{"text":"hleihnihnak cu Hashabiah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"20":{"text":"hleithumnak ah cun Shubael le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"21":{"text":"a hleilinak cu, Mattithiah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"22":{"text":"hleinganak cu, Jeremoth le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"23":{"text":"hleiruknak ah cun, Hananiah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"24":{"text":"hleisarihnak ah cun, Joshbekashah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"25":{"text":"hleiriatnak ah cun, Hanani le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"26":{"text":"hleikuanak ah cun, Mallothi le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"27":{"text":"pakulnak ah cun, Eliathah le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"28":{"text":"kul khatnak ah cun, Hothir le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"29":{"text":"kul hnihnak ah cun, Giddalti le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"30":{"text":"kul thumnak ah cun, Mahazioth le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla;"},"31":{"text":"kul linak ah cun, Romamtiezer le a fapa hna le a unau hna, hleihnih cungah a tla."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kutka cawngtu pawl an i phawtning cu hi bangin a si: Korah mi hna chungin, Meshelemiah; amah cu Kore fapa a si, Kore cu Asaf fapa hna lak i pakhat a si.","title":"Kutka Cawngtu Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun Meshelemiah nih fapa a ngeih hna: a fater cu Jekhariah a si, pahnihnak cu Jediael a si, pathumnak cu Zebadiah a si, palinak cu Jathniel a si,"},"3":{"text":"panganak cu Elam a si, paruknak cu Jehohanan a si, pasarihnak cu Elie-ho-enai a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun Obededom nih fapa a ngeih hna: a fater cu Shemaiah, a pahnihnak cu Jehozabad, pathumnak cu Joah, palinak cu Sakar, panganak cu Nethanel,","ref":"2Sam 6.11; 1Cha 13.14"},"5":{"text":"paruknak cu Ammiel, pasarihnak cu Issakhar, pariatnak cu Peullethai a si; zeitintiah Pathian nih thluachuahnak a pek."},"6":{"text":"A fapa Shemaiah zong nih khan an pale innchungkhar i uktu a si ciomi fapa hna kha a hrin hna, zeitintiah annih cu thil ti kho ngaimi an si."},"7":{"text":"Shemaiah
