fapa hna cu: Othni, Refael, Obed le Elzabad an si, an unau hna cu miṭhawng Elihu le Semakhiah an si."},"8":{"text":"Hi vialte hi an fapa hna le an unau hna he Obededom fapa cu an si, annih cu mi thil ti kho, rianṭuannak ca i a tlingmi an si; Obededom tefa cu sawm ruk le pahnih an si."},"9":{"text":"Cun Meshelemiah nih fapa hna le unau hna a ngeih hna, mi thil ti kho an si, hleiriat an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun Merari fapa hna lak i Hosah nih khan fapa a ngeih hna: upa bik ah Shimri, (amah cu fater a si lo nain a pa nih upa bik ah a ser),"},"11":{"text":"pahnihnak ah Hilkiah, pathumnak ah Tebaliah, palinak ah Zekhariah; Hosah fapa hna le a unau hna cu an dihlak ah hleithum an si."},"12":{"text":"Kutka cawngtu pawl an ṭhenmi hna nih hin, an upa bikbik hna zat khan, an unau hna nih Bawipa inn chung i rian an ngeih bantuk te khan annih zong nih rian an ngei ve."},"13":{"text":"Cun an kutka hna caah khan, a hme a ngan aa khat tein, an pale innchungkhar ning cio khan camcawhfung an zuh."},"14":{"text":"Nichuahlei ca i camcawhfung cu Shelemiah cungah a tla. Cun a fapa Zekhariah, fimchimtu a fim ngaingaimi caah khan camcawh fung an zuh i a camcawhfung cu chaklei caah khan a chuak."},"15":{"text":"Obededom camcawh fung cu thlanglei caah a chuak i a fapa hna cu thilchiahnak inn zohkhenh rian nih khan a kiah hna."},"16":{"text":"Shuppim le Hosah kha nitlaklei nih a kiah hna, cucu a hung kaimi lam i a ummi Shallekheth kutka ah khan a si. An cawnghning cu aa khat cio."},"17":{"text":"Nifate in nichuahlei ah cun paruk lengmang an um, chaklei ah cun nifate in pali lengmang, thlanglei ah cun ni fate in pali lengmang, cun thil chiahnak inn ah khan pahnih veve;"},"18":{"text":"cun nitlaklei i a ummi a innte caah khan, lam ah pali, cun a innte ah pahnih."},"19":{"text":"Mah hihi Korah mi hna le Merari fapa hna lak i kutka cawngtu hna an i ṭhenning cu an si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna lak khan, Ahijah nih khan Pathian inn chawhlawn kuang le pekchanhmi laksawng chawhlawn kuang kha a zohkhenh hna."},"21":{"text":"Ladan fapa hna, Ladan ta a simi Gershon mi fapa hna, Gershon mi a simi Ladan ta a simi an pale innchungkhar lu Jehieli."},"22":{"text":"Jehieli fapa Zetham le a unau Joel cu Bawipa inn chawhlawn kuang hna kha a zohkhenhtu an si."},"23":{"text":"Amram mi hna le Izhar mi hna le Hebron mi hna le Uzziel mi hna chung cun"},"24":{"text":"Moses fapa Gershom i fapa Shebuel cu chawhlawn kuang zohkhenhtu bawi ngan bik a si."},"25":{"text":"A unau hna cu: Eliezer chungin a chuakmi a fapa Rehabiah le a fapa Jeshaiah le a fapa Joram le a fapa Zikhri le a fapa Shelomoth an si."},"26":{"text":"Hi Shelomoth le a unau hna hi, siangpahrang David le an pale innchungkhar hna lu cio le a thong pawl haotu hna le a za pawl haotu hna le ralkapbu ralbawi hna nih pekchanhmi laksawng, an pekchanhmi chawhlawn vialte kha a zohkhenhtu an si."},"27":{"text":"Raltuknak hmun i an teimi hranchaw chung khan Bawipa inn zohkhenhnak caah laksawng kha an pekchanh hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun hmutu Samuel le Kish fapa Saul le Ner fapa Abner le Zeruiah fapa Joab nih an pekchanhmi thil vialte — pekchanhmi laksawng vialte hna cu Shelomoth le a unau hna nih an kilven hna."},"29":{"text":"Izhar mi hna chungin, Khenaniah le a fapa hna cu Israel ram a lenglei rian ah, bawi hna le biaceihtu hna ah thiah an si."},"30":{"text":"Hebron mi hna chungin, Hashabiah le a unau hna, mi thong khat le za sarih, thil ti kho ngaimi hna cu, Israel ram chung Jordan tiva in nitlaklei kha, Bawipa rian vialte ca le siangpahrang rian dihlak kha a zohkhenhtu an si."},"31":{"text":"Hebron mi hna chungah cun, an ciruang zei bantuk khum a si le an pale innchungkhar zei bantuk khum a si ah, Jerijah cu Hebron mi hna an upa bik a si. (David a bawi kum sawm linak kum ah mi kha an kawl hna i Gilead ram Jazer khua ah thil ti kho ngaingaimi kha an hmuh hna)."},"32":{"text":"Siangpahrang David nih amah le a unau hna, thil ti kho ngaimi mi thong hnih le za sarih, an pale chungkhar i lu cio a simi hna kha, Reuben mi hna le Gad mi hna le Manasseh phun cheumi hna cung i Pathian lei le siangpahrang rian he aa pehtlaimi zeizong vialte kongah, zohkhenhtu ah a chiah hna."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mah hihi Israel mi, an pale innchungkhar hna lu a si ciomi, a thongthong pawl a uktu hna le a zaza pawl a uktu hna le an bawi pawl hna, a chuak a lut lengmangmi bu pipi hna he aa pehtlaimi rian i thla khat hnu thla khat in kum chuak tiang siangpahrang cu a rian a ṭuanpiaktu hna cazin cu a si, bu khat cu sang hnih thong li an si:","title":"Ram Uktu Bawi Hna"},"2":{"text":"Zabdiel fapa Jashobeam cu thla khatnak thla ah pakhatnak bu kha a hruitu a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu Perez tefa a si i thla khatnak thla ah cun amah cu ralkapbu haotu vialte hna bawi bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Thla hnihnak thla bu cu Aho mi Dodai nih a hrui hna; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"5":{"text":"Ralbawi pathumnak, thla thumnak thla ca i cu Benaiah a si, amah cu tlangbawi Jehoiada fapa a si i haotu bik a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"6":{"text":"Hi Benaiah hi sawm thum hna lak i miṭhawng kha a si i amah nih sawm thum hna kha a hrui hna; amah bu a haotu hna cu a fapa Ammizabad kha a si."},"7":{"text":"Thla linak ca i a palinak cu Joab unau Asahel kha a si i a fapa Zebadiah nih khan a hun zulh; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"8":{"text":"Ralbawi panganak, thla nganak ca i cu Izrah mi Shamhuth a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"9":{"text":"Paruknak, thla ruknak ca i cu Ira a si, amah cu Tekoa mi Ikkesh fapa a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"10":{"text":"Pasarihnak, thla sarihnak ca i cu Efraim tefa Pelon mi Helez a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"11":{"text":"Pariatnak, thla riatnak ca i cu Zerah tefa Hushath mi Sibbekai a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"12":{"text":"Pakuanak, thla kuanak ca i cu Benjamin tefa Anathoth mi Abiezer a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"13":{"text":"Pahranak, thla hranak ca i cu Zerah tefa Netofah mi Maharai a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"14":{"text":"Hleikhatnak, thla hleikhatnak ca i cu Benjamin fapa hna tefa Pirathon mi Benaiah a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"15":{"text":"Hleihnihnak, thla hleihnihnak ca i cu Othniel tefa Netofah mi Heldai a si; a bu chungah cun sang hnih le thong li an um."},"16":{"text":"Israel mi phun hna chungah cun, Reuben mi hna caah Zikhri fapa Eliezer cu bawi upa bik a si; Simeon mi hna caah Maakah fapa Shefatiah a si;"},"17":{"text":"Levi caah Kemuel fapa Hashabiah a si; Aaron caah Zadok a si;"},"18":{"text":"Judah caah Elihu a si, amah cu David unau pakhat a si; Issakhar caah Mikhael fapa Omri a si;"},"19":{"text":"Zebulun caah Obadiah fapa Ishmaiah a si; Naftali caah Azriel fapa Jeremoth a si;"},"20":{"text":"Efraim mi hna caah Azaziah fapa Hoshea a si; Manasseh phun cheu caah Pedaiah fapa Joel a si;"},"21":{"text":"Gilead i a ummi Manasseh phun cheu caah Zekhariah fapa Iddo a si; Benjamin caah Abner fapa Jaasiel a si;"},"22":{"text":"Dan caah Jehoram fapa Azarel a si. Mah hna hi Israel mi phun a hruitu hna cu an si."},"23":{"text":"David nih kum kul toi kha cu a rel hna lo, zeicahtiah Bawipa nih Israel cu van i arfi zat ah khin ka ser lai tiah bia a kam cang.","ref":"Gen 15.5; 22.17; 26.4"},"24":{"text":"Zeruiah fapa Joab nih khan rel hram a thawk, sihmanhsehlaw a dih lo; asinain hi ruang ah hin Israel cungah thinhunnak a tlung i cu relnak cu Siangpahrang David chanrelnak chungah khumh a si lo.","ref":"2Sam 24.1-15; 1Cha 21.1-14"},"25":{"text":"Siangpahrang chawhlawn kuang hna a zohkhenhtu cu Adiel fapa Azmaveth a si; cun ram chung i a ummi le khua chung i a ummi le khuate chung le innsang chung i a ummi chawhlawn kuang hna a zohkhenhtu cu Uzziah fapa Jonathan a si;"},"26":{"text":"Vawlei kha leh awkah lo chung i rian a ṭuantu hna a zohkhenhtu cu Khelub fapa Ezri a si;"},"27":{"text":"mitsur dum a zohkhenhtu cu Ramath mi Shimei a si; cun mitsur dum chungin a chuakmi mitsur hang khonnak zohkhenhtu cu Shifmot mi Zabdi a si."},"28":{"text":"Shefelah i a ummi oliv thing le saikamor thing zohkhenhtu cu Geder mi Baalhanan a si; cun chiti khonmi a zohkhenhtu cu Joash a si."},"29":{"text":"Sharon i a tlongmi saṭil run a zohkhenhtu hna cu Sharon mi Shitrai a si; nelrawn i a tlongmi saṭil run zohkhenhtu hna cu Adlai fapa Shafat a si."},"30":{"text":"Kalauk a zohkhenhtu hna cu Ishmael mi Obil a si; laa a nu a zohkhenhtu hna cu Meronoth mi Jehdeiah a si. Tuurun a zohkhenhtu hna cu Hag mi Jaziz a si."},"31":{"text":"Hi vialte hna hi David Siangpahrang chaw kengtu an si."},"32":{"text":"David pacheu Jonathan cu fimchimtu a si, amah cu mifim le cazi a si; amah le Hakhmoni fapa Jehiel nih siangpahrang fapa kha an zohkhenh hna."},"33":{"text":"Ahithophel cu siangpahrang fimchimtu a si i Arki mi Hushai cu siangpahrang hawikom a si."},"34":{"text":"Ahithophel cu Jehoiada, Benaiah fapa le Abiathar nih an hun chaan. Joab cu siangpahrang ralkapbu haotu a si."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David nih Jerusalem ah Israel mi bawi vialte, an phun chung bawi hna, siangpahrang rian a ṭuanmi ralkapbu bawi hna, a thongthong pawl a haotu hna, a zaza pawl a haotu hna, siangpahrang le a fapa hna i an thilri le saṭil a cawngtu hna kha siangpahrang inn bawi hna le miṭhawng hna le ralkap ṭhawng vialte hna he khan hmunkhat ah a pumh hna.","title":"Biakinn Sak Rian Solomon A Hluai"},"2":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang David cu a dir i, “Ka unau hna le ka mi hna, ka bia ka ngai tuah u. Bawipa biakamnak kuang caah le kan Pathian ke chiahnak caah dinhnak inn pakhat kha sa ning law tiah ka lung chungin ka rak ti tawnmi a si i cu saknak caah cun timhtuahnak ka rak ngei.","ref":"2Sam 7.1-16; 1Cha 17.1-14"},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a ka thawh i, ‘Nang nih cun ka min caah inn na sa hnga lo, zeicahtiah nang cu ralkap na si i thisen na chuah,’ tiah a ka ti."},"4":{"text":"Asinain, Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih keimah cu ka pa innchungkhar vialte chung khan Israel cung i siangpahrang zungzal in si awkah a ka thim; zeitintiah Judah kha hruaitu ah a thim i Judah innchungkhar chungah ka pa innchungkhar kha a thim i ka pa fapa hna lakah keimah cu Israel mi vialte cung i siangpahrang ah ser awkah ka chungah lawmhnak a ngei."},"5":{"text":"Cun ka fapa vialte hna lakah (zeitintiah Bawipa nih fapa tampi a ka pek hna) ka fapa Solomon cu Israel cung i Bawipa pennak bawiṭhutdan cung i ṭhut awkah khan a thim."},"6":{"text":"Amah nih a ka thawh i, ‘Ka inn le ka tual a satu ding cu na fapa Solomon hi a si lai, zeitintiah amah cu ka fapa si awkah ka thim cang i keimah cu a pa ka si lai."},"7":{"text":"Nihin ah a tuah bantuk hin, ka nawlbia hna le ka phunglam hna kha fek tein a zulh lengmang hna ahcun, a pennak cu zungzal in ka hmunhter lai,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi vialte, Bawipa mibu aa pummi hmuhhngan le kan Pathian theihhngan ah hin, nannih nih Bawipa nan Pathian i nawlbia vialte cu zul u law kawl tuah u; zeitintiah nannih nih hi ram ṭha cu nan co i nan hnu i a ra dingmi nan tefa hna caah ro ah nan roh zungzal hna nakhnga."},"9":{"text":"“Cun nang, Solomon ka fapa, na pa i a Pathian hi hngal law lung ṭengnge lo te le a tha a thomi ruahnak he a rian ṭuan tuah; zeitintiah Bawipa nih cun lung vialte cu a purh dih ko i tinhmi le ruahnak vialte cu a hngalh dih. Amah cu na kawl ahcun na hmuh lai; sihmanhsehlaw amah cu na hlawt ahcun zungzal in an hlonh ko lai."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah i ralring tuah, zeicahtiah nangmah cu Bawipa nih a thiangmi hmun ca i inn sak awkah an thim cang; ṭhawng ngaiin um law ṭuan tuah,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih a fapa Solomon cu biakinn a tual le a inn hna le a chawhlawn chiahnak hna le a cunglei khaan hna le a chungchin dal hna ruam-am le velngeihnak ṭhutdan chiahnak a khaan ca i a ruam-am cu a pek;"},"12":{"text":"cun Bawipa inntual ca le a kulhtu khaan hna le Pathian inn chawhlawn khonnak hna le pekchanhmi laksawng chawhlawn khonnak ding ruam-am hna zong kha a pek;"},"13":{"text":"cun tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna a phu a phu in an umnak ding le Bawipa inn chung rianṭuannak ca rian vialte; Bawipa inn chung rianṭuannak ca i umkheng vialte ca le,"},"14":{"text":"rianṭuannak cio ca i sui umkheng hna ca i sui a rih zat rianṭuannak cio ca i a herhmi ngun a rih zat,"},"15":{"text":"sui meivannak tung hna le an meiinn hna an rihning, meivannak tung pakhat cio ca le a meiinn hna ca i a herhmi sui a rihning, meivannak tung ca le a meiinn hna ca i a herhmi ngun a rihning, rianṭuannak ca i a meivannak tung hna cu hman an sining cio in,"},"16":{"text":"hun camcinmi changreu cabuai cio hna ca i a herhmi sui a rihning, ngun cabuai ca i ngun a herhmi,"},"17":{"text":"keuṭe ca le hmaihum ca le hrai ca i a herhmi sui thiang; sui khengkuar hna le an rihning cio,"},"18":{"text":"ermi sui in an sermi rimhmui biakṭheng ca le a rihning i an ruam-am vialte a lung chung i aa chiahmi cu a pek; cun sui rangleng le an thla aa samh i Bawipa biakamnak kuang a zarhtu cherubim hna ca i a ruahmi an ruam-am zong kha a pek."},"19":{"text":"Cun David nih aa thawh i, “ Bawipa hrimhrim nih na tuah lai, tiah a ka fialmi tuahnak ding caah a ṭial in ṭialmi timhtuahnak chungah hi thil vialte hi an um dih,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah David nih a fapa Solomon cu a thawh i, “Ṭhawng ngai le ralṭha ngaiin um law ṭuan tuah. Ṭih hlah, na lung dong hlah; zeicahtiah Bawipa Pathian, keimah i ka Pathian hrimhrim cu na sinah a um. Bawipa inn chung rianṭuannak ca i rian vialte cu lim a si hlantiang amah nih cun an deuh lai lo i an hlaw fawn lai lo."},"21":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn rianṭuannak vialte ca i tlangbawi bu hna le Levi mibu hna hi zoh tuah hna; cun hi rian vialte ah hin zungthiammi paoh nih anmah le an thiamnak zawn rian paoh ah khan an in ṭanpi lai i bawi hna le mi vialte hna zong hi nangmah nawl tangah an um dih lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang David nih aa pummi cu a thawh hna i, “Ka fapa Solomon hi Pathian nih a timhmi cu a si. Asinain amah cu a no rih i a hmuhtonmi a tlawm; sihmanhsehlaw ṭuan ding vial cu rian nganpi a si ṭung, zeicahtiah sak ding inn hi minung ca siangpahrang inn a si lo i Bawipa Pathian ca a si.","ref":"1Cha 22.5"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah kan Pathian biakinn ca thilri cu ka ti khawh chungin ka damh hna. Sui thilri ca sui, ngun thilri ca ngun, dar thilri ca dar, thir thilri ca thir, thing thilri ca thing kha ka damh hna. Cuhleiah, ṭamhnak caah oniks lungvar tampi le lung tampi, cun antimoni lungvar, lung a mui a phunphun a simi hna, lung mansung a phunphun le marbal lung kha tampi ka damh hna."},"3":{"text":"Hi vialte hleiah hin keimah pumpak ta chungin sui le ngun kha kan Pathian inn ka ṭanh caah Pathian biakinn caah cun ka thawh hna:"},"4":{"text":"vampang nalhnak caah sui talen thong thum, Ofir sui dakmak, er ciami ngun talen thong sarih,"},"5":{"text":"cun zungthiam hna tuah awk a simi caah sui thilri caah sui, ngun thilri caah ngun kha ka thawh hna. Cucaah nihin ah hin Bawipa sinah mah le mah i pekchanh in lungtho tein ahodah siannak in a tho vemi nan si lai?” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun pale hna innchungkhar lu cio nih khan mah lungtho tein an thawhlawm cu an thawh hna i phun hruitu hna le a thongthong pawl haotu hna le a zaza pawl haotu hna le siangpahrang rian i bawi hna zong nih khan mah bantuk cun an tuah ve."},"7":{"text":"Pathian inn ca rianṭuannak caah cun sui talen thong nga le darik thong hra, ngun talen thong hra, dar talen thong hleiriat, thir talen sing khat an pek."},"8":{"text":"Cun lung mansung a ngeimi paoh nih khan Bawipa inn chawhlawn khonnak ah cun an lungvar kha an pek i mah cucu Gershon mi Jehiel nih khan a zohkhenh."},"9":{"text":"Cun mi cu an i lawm, zeicahtiah lungtho tein an pek, lung ṭengnge lo tein thawhlawm cu Bawipa sinah an pek i tampi an pek; siangpahrang David zong aa lawm."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah David nih Bawipa cu aa pummi vialte hmaiah cun a thangṭhat i David nih cun, “Maw Bawipa, kan pu Israel i Pathian, nangmah cu zungzal thluangthluan in thangṭhat na si ko.","title":"David Nih A Thangṭhat"},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, lianhngannak le ṭhawnnak le sunparnak le teinak le upatnak cu nangmah ta an si ko; zeitintiah vancung le vawlei cung i a ummi thil vialte cu nangmah ta an si dih; maw Bawipa, pennak cu nangmah ta a si i nangmah cu zeizong vialte cungah cungnung bik na si.","ref":"Mat 6.13"},"12":{"text":"Rumnak siseh upatnak siseh nangmah sinin a rami an si i nangmah nih zeizong vialte kha na uk dih. Na kut chungah hin ṭhawnnak le thazang an um i na kut chungah hin mi vialte nganter khawhnak le thazang pek khawhnak a um."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah kan Pathian, nangmah cu kan in lawmh i a sunglawimi na min cu kan thangṭhat."},"14":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw hi bantukin kannih nih lungtho tein kan in pekchanh khawh nakhnga caah hin keimah cu ahodah ka si i ka mi hna cu zeidah an si? Zeitintiah zeizong vialte cu nangmah sinin a rami an si i kan in pekmi hi nangmah ta lila a si ko."},"15":{"text":"Zeitintiah kannih cu, kan pupa vialte hna mipem an rak si bantuk khan, na hmaiah khual kan si; vawleicung i kan nunchung ni hna hi thladem bantuk men an si i ruahchannak zeihmanh a um lo."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan Pathian, na min thiang ca i inn pakhat saknak ah thil tampi kan damhmi vialte hna hi, nangmah kut chungin a chuakmi an si i nangmah ta an si dih."},"17":{"text":"Ka Pathian, nangmah nih lung kha na hneksak i dinnak kha na duhmi a si ti kha ka hngalh; ka lung dinnak in hi thil vialte hi lungtho tein kan pekchanh i atu cu hika i a ummi na mi hna nih lungthote le lunglawm tein an in pekchanh kha ka hmuh cang."},"18":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan pu Abraham, Isak le Israel i Pathian, hi bantuk thinlung le ruahnak hi na mi hna chungah hin chia zungzal law annih an lungthin cu nangmah leiah khan hruai ko hna."},"19":{"text":"Ka fapa Solomon nih hin lung ṭengnge lo tein na nawlbia hna le na hngalhternak bia hna le na phunglam hna kha a zulh hna i a tuah dih hna i ka timhlamh ciami biakinn hi a sak khawh nakhnga, nangmah nih amah cu bawm ko,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun David nih aa pummi vialte hna cu, “ Bawipa, nan Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u,” tiah a ti hna. Cun aa pummi vialte nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian cu an thangṭhat i an lu an khun i Bawipa cu an biak i siangpahrang cu hmaizahnak an pek.","title":"Solomon Nih David Kha A Chaan (2Sia 2.10-12)"},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa sinah khan raithawinak an tuah i, a thaituan ah cawtum thong khat le tuutum thong khat le tuufa thong khat cu, an thlet thawinak hna le an raithawinak hna he khan, Israel mi vialte caah duhdim tein i za in khangh thawinak ah Bawipa sinah cun an pekchanh hna;"},"22":{"text":"cun cu ni ah cun Bawipa hmaiah lunglawm ngaiin an ei i an ding. Cun David fapa Solomon cu siangpahrang ah a voi hnihnak an ser ṭhan i amah cu Bawipa ca i bawi ah chiti an thuh i Zadok cu tlangbawi caah chiti an thuh."},"23":{"text":"Cun Bawipa siangpahrang ṭhutdan ah cun Solomon cu a pa David can ah khan siangpahrang in a ṭhu i a hungcho i Israel mi vialte nih a bia kha an ngaih.","ref":"1Sia 2.12"},"24":{"text":"Haotu vialte le miṭhawng hna le Siangpahrang David fapa hna zong nih khan Siangpahrang Solomon sinah zumhawktlak in kan um lai tiah bia an i kam."},"25":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Israel mi vialte hna mithmuh ah Solomon cu upatnak ngan a pek i amah hlanah Israel mi chung i siangpahrang ahohmanh a rak pek hna lomi siangpahrang sunparnak kha amah cu a pek."},"26":{"text":"Cuticun Jesse fapa David nih Israel mi vialte cu a pen hna."},"27":{"text":"Israel mi a pen hna chung cu kum sawm li a si; Hebron ah kum sarih a bawi i Jerusalem ah kum sawm thum le kum thum a bawi.","ref":"2Sam 5.4-5; 1Cha 3.4"},"28":{"text":"Cun upa ngaingai, tartlung nung in, rumnak le upatnak he a thi; cun Solomon a fapa cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"29":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang David tuahsermi hna cu, a hmasa bik in a hmanung bik tiang, hmutu Samuel Chanrelnak ah le profet Nathan Chanrelnak ah le hmutu Gad Chanrelnak ah an i ṭial,"},"30":{"text":"a ukning kong le a ṭhawnnak le amah cung le Israel mi cung le ram dangdang hna cung i a tlungmi thil vialte hna kong zong kha an i tel ve."}}}}},"14":{"info":{"name":"2Chanrelnak","shortname":"2Chr","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David fapa Solomon cu a ram chungah khan fek tein a um i Bawipa a Pathian cu a sinah khan a um i fak piin a nganter.","title":"Solomon Nih Fimnak Caah Thla A Cam (1Sia 3.3-15)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon nih cun Israel mi vialte, a thongthong pawl haotu si hna seh, a zaza pawl haotu si hna seh, biaceihtu si hna seh, Israel ram chung i hruaitu a simi, innchungkhar lu a si ciomi vialte hna kha bia a chimh hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Solomon le a sinah aa pummi vialte hna cu Gibeon i a ummi khuahrum bo ah khan an kal; zeicahtiah Bawipa sal Moses nih ramlak ah a sermi Pathian tonnak thlam kha khika ah cun a um."},"4":{"text":"(Sihmanhsehlaw David nih Pathian kuang kha cu Kiriath-jearim in David nih hmun a serpiakmi, Jerusalem i thlam pakhat a bunhpiakmi ah khan a rak hunpi cang.)","ref":"2Sam 6.1-17; 1Cha 13.5-14; 15.25—16.1"},"5":{"text":"Cuhleiah Hur fapa Uri i fapa Bezalel nih a sermi dar biakṭheng kha khika ah cun Bawipa puan biakinn hmaiah a um. Cun Solomon le aa pummi nih khan Bawipa cu an kawl.","ref":"Exo 38.1-7"},"6":{"text":"Cun Solomon cu Bawipa hmai i a ummi dar biakṭheng, tonnak thlam i a ummi ah cun a hung kal i a cungah khangh thawinak thong khat a pekchanh."},"7":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun Pathian cu Solomon sinah a lang i amah cu a thawh i, “Zeidah kan pek lai, ka hal tuah,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih Pathian sinah cun, “Ka pa David cungah a fek i a nganmi dawtnak cu na langhter i amah hmun ah keimah cu siangpahrang ah na ka ser cang."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, ka pa David sinah bia na rak kammi cu atu ah hin tlinter ko, zeitintiah keimah cu vawleicung leidip zat in a tammi miphun hna cungah hin siangpahrang ah na ka ser cang.","ref":"Gen 13.16; 28.14"},"10":{"text":"Cucaah hi miphun hmai i chuahnak ca le luhnak caah hin fimnak le hngalhnak ka pe tuah, zeicahtiah hi na mi, a ngan hringhranmi hi aho nih dah a uk khawh hna lai?” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih Solomon cu a leh i, “Mah hihi na lung chungah a um i nangmah nih chawva siseh, rumnak siseh, upatnak siseh, nangmah an huatu hna thah awk kha siseh, nun saunak hmanh kha siseh, na ka hal lo i an cung i siangpahrang ah keimah nih kan chiahmi ka mi hna uknak ding caah khan nangmah caah fimnak le hngalhnak na ka hal caah,"},"12":{"text":"fimnak le hngalhnak cu kan pek. Nangmah hlan i a rak ummi siangpahrang hna nih an rak ngeih bal lo i nangmah hnu i a um laimi zong nih an ngeih bal lai lomi rumnak le chawva le upatnak zong kan pek fawn lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Gibeon i a ummi khuahrum bo, tonnak thlam hmai cun Solomon cu Jerusalem ah a ra. Cun Israel mi kha a pen hna."},"14":{"text":"Solomon nih rangleng le rangcung ralkap kha a pumh hna; amah nih cun rangleng thong khat za li le rangcung ralkap thong hleihnih a ngeih hna i annih cu rangleng khua hna le Jerusalem khua chung i a ummi siangpahrang sinah khan a chiah hna.","title":"Rang le Rangleng In Chaw A Let (1Sia 10.26 ; 2Cha 9.25-28)","ref":"1Sia 4.26"},"15":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih cun sui le ngun cu Jerusalem ah khan lungtekem tlukin a tamter i sidar thing cu Shefelah i saikamor thing zat in a tamter."},"16":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih a cawkmi rangtum hna cu Izipt le Kue in an si i siangpahrang chawlettu hna nih khan a man aa khat in Kue ah khan an cawk tawn hna.","ref":"Deu 17.16"},"17":{"text":"Izipt ram in rangleng pakhat cu ngun shekel za ruk in an cawk i rangtum pakhat cu shekel za le sawm nga in an cawk; cu bantukin anmah sin ṭhiamṭhiam cun Hit mi siangpahrang hna le Siria siangpahrang hna sinah khan zuarh an si ṭhan."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa min caah biakinn le amah caah siangpahrang inn sak kha Solomon cu aa tim.","title":"Solomon Nih Siangpahrang Huram He Hnatlaknak A Ser (1Sia 5.1-18 ; 7.13-14)"},"2":{"text":"Solomon nih thil phortu ah mi sang sarih, cun tlang ram i lung khoihtu ah sang riat, cun anmah a kilkawitu hna ah thong thum le za ruk a thiah hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih Tair ram siangpahrang Huram kha bia a cah i, “Ka pa David cungah na rak tuah i amah a umnak ding inn saknak caah sidar thing na rak kuat bantuk khan, keimah zong ka kua ve tuah."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ka Pathian upatnak caah biakinn sak kaa tim. Cu inn cu ka mi hna le keimah nih rimthaw zihmui khanghnak in Pathian kan biaknak hmunthiang a si lai. Cun Israel mi cu nan tuah zungzal lai tiah nawlpek a simi: hun camcinmi changreu kan pekchanh zungzalnak hmun le Bawipa kan Pathian upatnak caah zingfa zanfa, sabbath hna le thla thar puai hna le nizarh hna ah khangh thawinak kan pekchanhnak hmun a si lai."},"5":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu pathian vialte nakin a ngan deuh caah ka sak laimi inn cu a nganmi a si lai."},"6":{"text":"Asinain vancung, a sang bik vancung hmanh nih khin amah cu a tlum lo caah, aho nih dah inn cu a sakpiak khawh lai? Amah hmai i zihmui khanghnak hmun ca men ah dah ti lo ahcun, amah ca i inn sa dingah cun kei cu aho hen dah ka si i?","ref":"1Sia 8.27; 2Cha 6.18"},"7":{"text":"Cun ka pa David nih a rak i roihmi hna, Judah ram le Jerusalem i ka sinah a ummi zungthiam hna sin i a um dingah, sui le ngun le dar le thir lei i zung a thiammi, puan sendung, senpau le a dum lei zong i zung a thiammi, cun ṭamhnak zei ṭial paoh a thiammi pakhat in rak ka kua."},"8":{"text":"Sidar thing le saipres thing le algum thing zong Lebanon in rak ka kua, zeicahtiah na sinum hna nih Lebanon i thing ah an thiam kha ka hngalh. Cun ka sinum hna cu na sinum hna sinah,"},"9":{"text":"thingah kha tam piin a ka timhpiaktu dingah an um lai, zeicahtiah ka sak laimi inn cu a ngan i a ṭha ngaingai dingmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Na sinum hna, thing attu hna kha denmi changvut rel sang hnih, barli rel sang hnih, mitsur hang bath sang hnih le chiti bath sang hnih ka pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah Tair siangpahrang Huram nih Solomon cu ca in a leh i, “ Bawipa nih a mi kha a dawt hna caah nangmah cu siangpahrang ah an ser,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Huram nih cun hi ti zong hin a ti fawn, “ Bawipa, Israel Pathian, van le vawlei a ser i Bawipa caah biakinn le amah caah siangpahrang inn i saknak ding caah ruahnak fim le hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi fapa David Siangpahrang a petu cu thangṭhat si ko seh."},"13":{"text":"“Atu ah zungthiam, hngalh-thiamnak a ngeimi, Huram-abi cu kan kuat,"},"14":{"text":"amah cu Dan phun minu hna lak i pakhat nu fa a si, a pa cu Tair mi a si. Amah cu sui, ngun, dar, thir, lung le thing lei rian, cun puan sendung, a dum, a senpau le puan hmangṭhia, cun ṭamhnak zei ṭial paoh ah le thil muisam tuahnak paohpaoh ah zungthiam a si; na zungthiammi hna, na pa David ka bawipa zungthiam hna sinah cun a ra ṭuan ve lai."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah ka bawipa nih na chimmi changvut, barli, chiti le mitsur hang hna cu na sal hna hi hun kua hna;"},"16":{"text":"cun kannih nih na herhmi thing paoh cu Lebanon in kan rak in haupiak lai i rili in Joppa khua ah pum in kan ratpi lai i nang nih Jerusalem khua ah na hun kalpi hna lai,” a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih, a pa David nih a rak rel hna hnuah khan, Israel ram i a ummi ramdangmi vialte kha a rel hna i sing khat, sang nga, thong thum le za ruk an um."},"18":{"text":"Annih chung i sang sarih cu thil phorh a thiah hna, sang riat cu tlang ram i lung khoih a thiah hna, thong thum le za ruk cu mi kha rian ṭuanter awk caah zohtu ah a thiah hna."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih Jerusalem khua chung Moriah Tlang, a pa David sin i Bawipa a langhnak, David nih a timhtuahmi phuhri, Jebus mi Ornan ta a simi ah khan Bawipa inn cu sak hram a thawk.","title":"Solomon Nih Inn A Sak (1Sia 6.1-38)","ref":"Gen 22.2"},"2":{"text":"A bawi kum linak, thla hnihnak thla ah khan sak hram cu a thawk,"},"3":{"text":"Pathian inn saknak ca i Solomon nih a tahnak cu mah hihi an si: a sau, tahnak hlun dong in, dong sawm ruk a si, a kauh cu dong kul a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun inn ṭuangpi hmailei i innleng cu a inn vang can in dong kul a si; cun a sanlei cu dong za le dong kul a si. Cun a chunglei in sui thiang in a nalh."},"5":{"text":"Ṭuangpi cu saipres thing in a kamh i sui thiang in a nalh i a cungah tumkung le cikcin kha a cuanter hna."},"6":{"text":"Inn cu lungvar man sung in a ṭamh, a bunhnak tete a ser hna. Sui cu Parvaim sui a si."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun inn cu sui in a hut — a kaan le a innleng le a vampang hna le a innka khar hna kha; cun vampang hna ah khan cherubim a suai hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun a thiang bik hmun kha a ser; a saulei cu inn vang he aa khat in dong kul a si i a kauhlei cu dong kul a si; sui thiang talen za ruk in a hut.","ref":"Exo 26.33-34"},"9":{"text":"Thirkhenh ca hmanmi cu sui shekel sawm nga a si. Cun cung dot hna cu sui in a hut hna."},"10":{"text":"Hmun thiang bik ah khan thing in cherubim pahnih a ser hna i sui in a hut hna.","ref":"Exo 25.18-20"},"11":{"text":"Cherubim hna thla hna nih cun dong kul a zarh; pakhat thla pakhat, dong nga a simi nih khan, inn vampang kha a tongh i a thla dang, dong nga a simi nih khan, cherub dang pakhat thla kha a tongh;"},"12":{"text":"cun hi cherub thla pakhat, dong nga a si vemi nih hin, inn vampang kha a tawngh i a khattelei thla, dong nga ṭhiamṭhiam a simi kha, cherub pakhatnak thla ah khan aa peh."},"13":{"text":"Hi cherubim hna thla hna nih hin dong kul an zarh; cherubim cu an ke in an dir i ṭuangpi lei kha an hoih."},"14":{"text":"Cun puanzar a dum, sendung, le sen eu hna kha la hmangṭhia in a ser hna i an cungah cherubim kha a cuanter hna.","ref":"Exo 26.31"},"15":{"text":"Inn hmaiah cun tungpi pahnih, dong sawm thum le dong nga veve a sangmi a ser hna i an par ah cun luchin dong nga veve a sangmi a chinh hna.","title":"Dar Tungpi Pahnih (1Sia 7.15-22)"},"16":{"text":"Ṭhi bantuk cikcin a ser hna i tungpi par ah cun a ngerh hna; cun taleti za khat a ser hna i cikcin ah cun a thlaih hna."},"17":{"text":"Tungpi hna cu biakinn hmaiah, pakhat orhlei ah, pakhat kehlei ah a phun hna i orhlei i cu Jakhin tiah a ti i kehlei i cu Boaz tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dar biakṭheng pakhat a ser i dong kul a sau i dong kul a kau i dong hra a sang.","ref":"Exo 27.1-2"},"2":{"text":"Hmaihum a ser i a pum i khattelei tlang in khattelei tlang cu dong hra a si i dong nga a sang i a tlang velchum cu dong sawm thum a si."},"3":{"text":"A tangah cun umruang mui hri an um i dong sawm thum an sau i hmaihum cu a velchum in an kulh; umruang cu tlang hnih in an um i hmaihum an thlet ah khan an thlet chih hna."},"4":{"text":"Hmaihum cu cawtum hleihnih cungah a dir, pathum cu chaklei an hoih, pathum cu nitlaklei an hoih, pathum cu thlanglei an hoih i pathum cu nichuahlei an hoih; hmaihum cu an cungah cun khin a si i an hnulei cu a chunglei an chanh cio."},"5":{"text":"A chahlei cu zapar a si i a tlang cu hrai tlang bantukin an ser, lili pangpar bantuk a si; bath thong thum ring lo a tlum."},"6":{"text":"Kut ṭawlnak kheng pahra a ser fawn hna, panga cu thlanglei kamah a chiah hna i panga cu chaklei kamah a chiah hna. Hi hna chungah hin khangh thawinak ca a simi thil kha an tlengh hna i hmaihum cu tlangbawi hna an i ṭawlnak ding caah a si.","ref":"Exo 30.17-21"},"7":{"text":"Cun rak ruah cia bang khan, sui mei vannak tung pahra a ser hna i biakinn chungah khan a hun hna, thlanglei kamah panga a chiah hna i chaklei kamah panga a chiah hna.","ref":"Exo 25.31-40"},"8":{"text":"Cabuai zong pahra a ser hna i biakinn chungah khan, thlanglei kamah panga, chaklei kamah panga a chiah hna. Cun sui khengkuar za khat a ser hna.","ref":"Exo 25.23-30"},"9":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna tual le tual ngan le tual ca i innkhar kha a ser hna i an innkhar hna cu dar in a hut hna;"},"10":{"text":"cun hmaihum cu inn thlanglei-nichuahlei kamah khan a hun."},"11":{"text":"Huram nih um hna le cawhlek hna le khengkuar hna kha a ser hna. Cuticun Huram nih Bawipa inn ca i Siangpahrang Solomon a tuahpiakmi rian kha a lim:"},"12":{"text":"tungpi pahnih le kheng hna le tungpi dong i a ummi luchin pahnih hna; cun tungpi dong i a ummi luchin kheng khuhtu ding ca i sur bantukin sermi pahnih;"},"13":{"text":"cun tungpi dong i a ummi luchin kheng khuhtu hna ca i sur pahnih hna caah khan taleti za li, sur pakhat caah taleti rual hnih lengmang."},"14":{"text":"Cun hunnak hna le hunnak cung i ṭawlnak kheng hna le"},"15":{"text":"hmaihum pakhat kha le a tang i cawtum hleihnih hna zong kha a ser hna."},"16":{"text":"Um hna le cawhlek hna le keuṭe hna le hi hna ca i thilri vialte cu Huram-abi nih khan Siangpahrang Solomon caah Bawipa inn caah khan dar tleu in a ser hna."},"17":{"text":"Jordan nelrawn, Sukkoth le Zeredah karlak i tlak hmun ah khan siangpahrang nih a thlet hna."},"18":{"text":"Solomon nih hi thil vialte hna cu tam piin a ser hna i cucaah dar cu a khing zeizat a si kha hngalh khawh a si lo."},"19":{"text":"Cuticun Solomon nih Pathian inn chung i a ummi thil vialte cu a ser hna: sui biakṭheng, Hun Camcinmi changreu ca i sui cabuai,"},"20":{"text":"ruah cia ningin hmunthiang chungchin i van awk ca meiinn tung hna le an meiinn hna, sui thiang in sermi;"},"21":{"text":"sui thiang bik in sermi pangpar hna le meiinn hna le cengceh hna;"},"22":{"text":"sui thiang in sermi mei hmihnak hna, khengkuar hna, zihmui kheng hna le mei zahnak hna; cun hmun thiang bik luhnak chungchin innkhar hna le biakinn ṭuangpi innkhar hna ca i sui thiang in sermi biakinn kapza hna."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa inn caah Solomon nih a tuahmi rian vialte cu lim a si. Cun Solomon nih a pa David nih a rak pekchanh ciami thil hna kha a luhpi hna i Bawipa inn chung rokuang chungah khan ngun, sui le umkheng vialte kha a chiah hna.","ref":"2Sam 8.11; 1Cha 18.11"},"2":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih Israel mi upa hna le an phun cio lu hna kha le Israel mi an pale innchungkhar hna hruitu cio hna kha, David khua a simi Zion in Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu hun chuahpi awkah Jerusalem khua ah a pumh hna.","title":"Biakam Kuang Kha Biakinn Ah A Luhpi (1Sia 8.1-11)","ref":"2Sam 6.12-15; 1Cha 15.25-28"},"3":{"text":"Cun thla sarihnak thla i a simi puai ah khan Israel mi vialte cu siangpahrang hmaiah cun an i pum."},"4":{"text":"Cun Israel mi upa vialte kha an ra i Levi mi nih khan kuang kha an thawhpi."},"5":{"text":"Annih nih kuang le tonnak thlam le thlam chung i a ummi umkheng thianghlim vialte kha an kalpi; tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna nih khan an kalpi hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Solomon le Israel mi bu vialte amah hmai i aa pummi hna cu kuang hmaiah khan an um i annih nih an thawimi tuu le cawtum cu an tam tuk caah rel cawk le chim cawk an si lo."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun tlangbawi hna nih khan Bawipa biakamnak kuang cu a umnak ding hmun, inn chung chungchin hmunthiang, a thiang bik hmun, cherubim hna thla toiah khan an luhpi."},"8":{"text":"Kuang umnak hmun cungah khan cherubim hna nih khan an thla an zam caah cherubim hna nih cun kuang le a laang hna kha an thla cu an zarh hna."},"9":{"text":"Lang cu an sau caah chungchin hmunthiang hmai i a ummi hmunthiang khan an par le an par cu hmuh khawh an si; sihmanhsehlaw lenglei cun hmuh khawh an si lo; cuka ah cun nihin tiang hin an um ko."},"10":{"text":"Israel mi nih Izipt ram in an chuah tikah, Bawipa nih annih he biakamnak a tuahnak Horeb tlang i Moses nih biakamnak kuang chungah a khumhmi lungtlap pahnih hna dah ti lo kha cu, biakamnak kuang chungah cun a dang zeihmanh a um lo.","ref":"Deu 10.5"},"11":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi hna cu hmun thiang chung khan an hung chuah tikah (cuka i a ummi tlangbawi vialte hna cu an i thianh dih ko cang, an i ṭhenning kha cu ruah loin;"},"12":{"text":"cun Levi mi hlasa pawl vialte, Asaf, Heman le Jeduthun, an fapa hna le an rualchan hna kha puan hmang ṭhia in an i thuam i sumsel le tingtang le thonglawi he biakṭheng in nichuahlei ah khan muko tumtu tlangbawi za khat le pakul hna he khan an dir;)"},"13":{"text":"muko tumtu hna le hlasatu hna an rian cu Bawipa lawmhnak hla le thangṭhatnak hla kha aw khat tein thanter kha a si caah, muko hna le sumsel hna le awdawh tumnak thilri dang hna he cun: “Zeitintiah amah cu a ṭha, A fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” tiin Bawipa thangṭhat in hla cu an hun sak tikah, inn kha, Bawipa inn kha, minmei in a khah","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 116.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11; Exo 40.34-35"},"14":{"text":"caah tlangbawi hna cu rianṭuan awkah khan dir awk an si nain minmei ruangah cun an dir kho lo; zeicahtiah Pathian inn cu Bawipa sunparnak kha a khat."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi tikah Solomon nih aa thawh i, “ Bawipa nih a chahmi muihnak chungah ka um lai, tiah a ti.","title":"Biakinn Pathian Sin Pekchanhnak (1Sia 8.12-21)"},"2":{"text":"A sunglawimi inn kan sakpiak cang, Zungzal in na umnak ding caah,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu a hnulei aa mer i Israel mi aa pummi vialte cu an dir lioah, Israel mi aa pummi vialte cu thluachuah a pek hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Ka pa David sinah,","ref":"2Sam 7.1-13; 1Cha 17.1-12"},"5":{"text":"‘Ka mi Israel mi hna cu Izipt ram in ka chuahpi hna ni thawk in, Israel mi hna phun chung i khua zeihmanh kha, ka min umnak ding i inn saknak caah, ka thim lo i ka mi Israel mi hna cung i bawi caah ahohmanh ka thim hna lo;"},"6":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ka min cu khika ah a um nakhnga Jerusalem cu ka thim i David cu ka mi Israel mi hna cung i um awkah ka thim,’ tiin a ka in a chimmi a biakamnak kha a kut in a tlintertu Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa, Israel Pathian min ca i inn rak sak kha ka pa David lung chungah a rak um ko."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih ka pa David cu a thawh i, ‘Ka min ca i inn sak awk kha na lung chung i a um caah, mah cucu na lung chung i na umter cu a ṭha;"},"9":{"text":"asinain, nangmah nih cun inn cu na sa lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih na hrin laimi na fapa nih ka min ca inn cu a run sak te lai,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"Atu cu Bawipa nih a biakamnak a sermi kha a hun tlinter cang; zeitintiah ka pa David hmun ah khan ka kai cang i Bawipa biakam bang khan Israel mi bawi ṭhutdan cungah ka ṭhu i Bawipa, Israel Pathian min caah khan inn cu ka sak cang."},"11":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna he Bawipa nih biakamnak a tuahmi khumhnak kuang kha khika ah cun ka chiah cang,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Solomon cu Bawipa biakṭheng hmaiah khan Israel mi a pummi vialte hna hmuh ah cun a dir i a kut kha a phar hna.","title":"Solomon Thlacamnak (1Sia 8.22-53)"},"13":{"text":"Solomon nih dar in donhhlei pakhat, dong nga a sau, dong nga a kau i dong thum a sangmi kha tual ah khan a chiah i a cungah cun a dir. Cun Israel mi aa pummi vialte hna hmaiah cun a khuk aa bil i van leiah a kut a phar hna;"},"14":{"text":"cun aa thawh i, “Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, van ah siseh, vawlei ah siseh, nangmah bantuk Pathian zeihmanh an um lo, nangmah nih cun na hmai i an lungthin dihlak in a kalmi na salle hna cungah cun na biakamnak kha na zulh i a fekmi na dawtnak kha na langhter;"},"15":{"text":"na sal David, ka pa sinah na rak kamhmi cu na zulh; asi, a sinah na ka in na rak chim i mah cucu nihin ni ah hin na kut in na tlinter."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, na salpa David ka pa sin i, ‘Na fapale hna nih hin, nangmah nih ka hmaiah na rak kal bantuk khan ka nawlbia chung i kal hi an i ralrin ahcun, Israel mi bawi ṭhutdan cung i ka hmaiah a ṭhu dingmi na ṭhing lai lo,’ tiin bia na rak kammi kha tlinter ko.","ref":"1Sia 2.4"},"17":{"text":"Cun maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, na salpa David ka pa sin i na rak chimmi bia kha fehter ko."},"18":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih cun vawlei cungah cun minung sinah hin khua a sa taktak hnga maw? Zohhmanh, van le a sang bik van nih khin an in tlum lo; zeitindah hi keimah sakmi inn chinchin nih cun an tlum hnga!","ref":"2Cha 2.6"},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na salpa nih thla ka camnak le kan nawlnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko sawh, maw Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah hmaiah na salpa nih thla ka camnak le ka aunak cu ka theihpiak ko sawh;"},"20":{"text":"zeitintiah nangmah nih na min chiahnak caah bia na kammi hmun, hi inn leiah hin chun zan in na mit na chiah nakhnga le hi inn lei hoih in na salpa nih thla ka cammi hi na theih nakhnga.","ref":"Deu 12.11"},"21":{"text":"Cun na salpa le na mi Israel mi hna nih hi hmun lei hoih in thla kan cam tikah, kan in nawlnak cu kan theihpiak ko; asi, na umnak hmun van khin run thei ko law, cun na theih tikah kan ngaithiam ko."},"22":{"text":"“Mi pakhatkhat nih a innpa cungah a sual i chiat serter a si i a chiatsernak cu hi inn chung na biakṭheng hmaiah hin chimter a si ahcun,"},"23":{"text":"khi tikah nang nih van khin run thei law, run ṭuan law, na salle cu bia run khiak ko hna, a mawhtu cu amah lu lila ah a ziaza kha tlunter in sual run phaw law, a dingmi cu a dinnak ningin pek awkah thiam coter ko."},"24":{"text":"“Na mi Israel mi hna cu nangmah cung i an sual caah an ral hna hmaiah an sungh ahcun, annih nih an i mer ṭhan i na min kha an upat i nangmah kha hi inn chungah an in nawl i na sinah thla an cam tikah,"},"25":{"text":"van khin rak theihpiak hna law na mi Israel mi sualnak cu ngaithiam law, annih le an pupa hna sinah na pekmi ram ah cun kirpi ṭhan ko hna."},"26":{"text":"“Cun nangmah cung i an sual ruangah van cu a pih i ruah a sur lo tikah, hi hmun lei hoih in thla an cam i na min kha an upat i nangmah nih na hrem hna tikah an sualnak kha an mertak ahcun,"},"27":{"text":"nangmah nih an kalnak hnga ding lam ṭha kha na cawnpiak hna tikah, van ah khin rak thei law, na mi Israel mi, na sal hna an sualnak kha rak ngaithiam ko hna; cun na mi hna sinah ro caah na pekmi na ram cungah cun ruah cu surter ko."},"28":{"text":"“Ram chungah hin mangṭam a tlun ah siseh, rai a tlun ah siseh, rocarnak le theikung rai a tlun ah siseh, khaubawk le lunghmul an tlun ah siseh, an ral hna nih khan an khua pakhatkhat i an hren hna ah siseh, zei bantuk rai hmanh si ai kun, zei bantuk zawtnak hmanh si ai kun,"},"29":{"text":"Israel mi nih an dihlak in siseh, ahopaoh nih siseh, zei bantuk thlacamnak zong si ko seh, zei bantuk nawlnak zong si ko seh, an tuah i hremnak an in ciomi le an ngaihchiatnak cio kha an hngalh i hi inn leiah hin an kut an zao hna ahcun,"},"30":{"text":"khi tikah nang nih na umnak van khin rak theihpiak hna law, ngaithiam hna law, an zulhmi lam vialte ning cio ah an lungthin nangmah nih na hngalh komi hna cu pe ko hna, zeitintiah nangmah lawnglawng nih minung fa hna an lung cu na hngalh;"},"31":{"text":"kan pupa na rak pekmi hna ram ah hin khua an sak chung vialte nangmah kha an in ṭih i na lam kha an zulh hna nakhnga, theihpiak ko hna."},"32":{"text":"“Cu bantukin, na mi Israel mi a si lomi ramdangmi nih, na min ngan le a ṭhawngmi na kut le na samhmi na baan ruangah lam hlatpi ram in an rat i hi inn lei hoih in thla an cam ahcun,"},"33":{"text":"na umnak van khin rak theihpiak law, ramdangmi nih an in auhnak vialte ning in tuahpiak ko hna; zeitintiah vawleicung mi vialte nih na mi Israel mi bangin, na min kha an theih i nangmah kha an in ṭih i hi inn ka sakmi hi nangmah min in kawh a si kha an hngalh nakhnga, theihpiak ko hna."},"34":{"text":"“Cun na mi hna cu an ral doh awkah an kal ahcun, zei lam zongin na kalter hna a si ah, nangmah nih na thimmi khua hi le nangmah min caah ka sakmi inn lei hoih hin nangmah sinah thla an cam ahcun,"},"35":{"text":"khi tikah van khin an thlacamnak le an in nawlnak cu rak theihpiak hna law, annih an rian ah cun ṭanpi ko hna."},"36":{"text":"“Annih nih na cungah an sual ahcun — zeitintiah a sual lomi minung an um lo — cun an cungah na thin a hun i ral kut chungah annih cu na chanh hna i a naimi ram ah siseh, a hlami ram ah siseh, sal ah kalpi an si i"},"37":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw sal ah an kalpi hnanak ram ah cun, an lung a hung pem i an i ngaihchih i sal ah an tannak ram ah cun na sinah, ‘Kan sual cang, ding lo pi le ṭhalo piin thil kan tuah cang,’ tiin nawlnak an tuah ahcun,"},"38":{"text":"sal ah an kalpi hna i sal i an tannak ram ah cun an ruahnak dihlak le an lungthin dihlak in an i ngaihchih i an pupa hna sinah na rak pekmi an ram le nangmah nih na thimmi khua le na min caah ka sakmi inn lei hoih in nangmah sinah thla an cam ahcun,"},"39":{"text":"khi tikah na umnak van khin an thlacamnak le an in nawlnak cu rak theihpiak hna law an rian ah cun ṭanpi ko hna law nangmah cung i a sualmi na mi cu ngaithiam ko hna."},"40":{"text":"Maw ka Pathian, hi hmun thlacamnak hi run hmu ko sawh law, run thei ko sawh."},"41":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa Pathian, tho law na umnak hmun ah cun kal tuah, Nangmah le na ṭhawnnak kuang zong. Maw Bawipa Pathian, na tlangbawi hna cu khamhnak in thuam hna law, Na mithiang hna cu na ṭhatnak in lawmhter hna.","ref":"Slm 132.8-10"},"42":{"text":"Maw Bawipa Pathian, na chiti thuhmi cu hlaw hlah! Na sal David ca i a fekmi na dawtnak kha philh hlah,” tiah a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon nih thla a camnak a dih tikah, van in mei a rung tla i khangh thawinak le raithawinak hna kha a kangh hna i Bawipa sunparnak cu biakinn kha a khat.","ref":"Lev 9.23-24"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa sunparnak cu Bawipa inn kha a khah caah tlangbawi hna cu Bawipa inn ah khan an lut kho lo."},"3":{"text":"Israel fale vialte nih mei a rung ṭum le biakinn cung i Bawipa sunparnak kha an hmuh tikah, vawlei lei hoih in lung phahmi cungah khan an lu an i khun i Bawipa cu an biak i an lawmh i, “Zeitintiah amah cu a ṭha, A fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” tiah an ti.","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"4":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang le Israel mi vialte nih Bawipa hmaiah raithawinak kha an pekchanh."},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon nih raithawinak caah cawtum sang hnih le thong hnih le tuu sing khat le sang hnih a pekchanh. Cuticun siangpahrang le mi vialte nih khan Pathian inn cu an pekchanh."},"6":{"text":"Tlangbawi cu an umnak hmun cio ah khan Levi mi hna he hmaitonh in an dir. Levi mi hna cu Bawipa thangṭhatnak caah David nih a rak sermi aw dawh tumnak thilri hna he khan an dir i David nih an rian ah a rak thiah hna bang khan, “A fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” timi hla kha lawmhnak in an sa. Tlangbawi hna nih khan mi zapi an dir ah khan muko kha an tum hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih Bawipa inn hmai i a ummi tual laifang kha a thianter; Solomon nih a sermi dar biakṭheng nih khan khangh thawinak le changvut thawinak le a thau hna kha a tlum hna lo caah, khika ah khangh thawinak le daihnak thawinak thau hna kha an pekchanh hna."},"8":{"text":"Cu tan ah cun Solomon le a sin i a ummi Israel mi vialte, bu nganpi, Hamath khua luhnak in Izipt tivate tiang, cu hna nih cun puai cu ni sarih chung an tuah."},"9":{"text":"Cun a ni riatnak ni ah a thiangmi pumhnak an tuah; zeitintiah annih nih biakṭheng pekchanhnak kha ni sarih chung an tuah i puai kha ni sarih chung an tuah."},"10":{"text":"Thla sarihnak thla, a ni kul le ni thumnak ni ah mi cu an inn ah an tlunter hna i Bawipa nih David le Solomon le a mi Israel mi hna cung i ṭhatnak a langhtermi ruangah lunglawm le thanuam in an tlung."},"11":{"text":"Cuticun Solomon nih Bawipa inn le siangpahrang inn cu a lim hna; Solomon nih Bawipa inn chungah siseh amah a inn chungah siseh, tuah a timhmi vialte kha tling tein a lim dih hna.","title":"Solomon Sinah Voi Hnihnak A lang Ṭhan (1Sia 9.1-9)"},"12":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu Solomon sinah zan ah a lang i amah cu a thawh i, “Na thlacamnak cu ka theih cang i hi hmun cu raithawinak inn caah kaa thim cang."},"13":{"text":"Van cu ka phih hna i ruah a um lo tikah siseh, khaubawk hna cu vawlei ei awkah nawl ka pek hna tikah siseh, ka mi hna lakah rai ka tlunter tikah siseh,"},"14":{"text":"ka min in kawhmi ka mi hna nih khan an lung an ṭhumh i thla an cam i ka hmai kha an kawl i an lam ṭhalo khan an i mer ahcun, van khin ka run theih lai i an sualnak cu ka ngaihthiam hna lai i an ram cu ka damter lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun hi hmun i thla an cammi cu ka mit nih a hmuh lai i ka hna nih a theih lai."},"16":{"text":"Ka min cu zungzal in hika ah a um nakhnga hi inn cu ka thim cang i ka thianter cang; ka mit le ka lung cu hika ah an um camcin lai."},"17":{"text":"Cun nangmah kong ah cun, na pa David nih a rak kal bantuk khan ka hmaiah na kal i nawl kan pekmi vialte ningin na tuah i ka nawlbia hna le ka phunglam hna cu na zulh hna ahcun,"},"18":{"text":"khi tikah na pa David sinah, ‘Israel mi uktu dingah mi na ṭhing lai lo,’ tiin bia ka rak kam bang khan na siangpahrang bawi ṭhutdan cu ka fehter lai.","ref":"1Sia 2.4"},"19":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw na pial i na hmai i ka chiahmi ka nawlbia hna le ka phungbia hna cu na hlawt hna i na kal i pathian dang hna kha an rian na ṭuan hna i na biak hna ahcun,"},"20":{"text":"kan pekmi ram hin kan phawi lai i hi inn ka min ca i ka thiantermi hi ka mit hmuh phak lo ah khin ka hlonh lai i mi vialte lakah phungthluk bia le nihchuak capo bia ah ka ser lai."},"21":{"text":"Cun hi inn a sunglawimi ah hin a pawng i a kalmi paoh an khuaruah a har lai i, ‘Zeicahdah mahtihin Bawipa nih hi ram cung le hi inn cungah hin a tuah hnga?’ tiah an ti lai."},"22":{"text":"Khi tikah annih nih an i thawh lai i, ‘Zeicahtiah annih nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian, Izipt ram in a chuahpitu hna kha an hlawt i pathian dang kha an i tlaih i an biak hna i an rian an ṭuan hna caah a si; cucaah hi ṭhat lonak vialte hi an cungah a tlunter,’ an ti lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon nih Bawipa inn le amah inn a sak chung kum kul a donghnak ah khan,","title":"Solomon Nih Rian Dang A Ṭuanmi (1Sia 9.10-28)"},"2":{"text":"Huram nih a pekmi khua hna kha a ser ṭhan hna i an chungah Israel mi kha a umter hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun Solomon cu Hamath-zobah ah a va kal i a va lak."},"4":{"text":"Ramlak i Tadmor kha le Hamath i thil khonnak khua a sermi vialte kha a ser hna."},"5":{"text":"Kulhmi khua, hau le kutka le a hrenhnak a ngeimi Beth-horon Cungnung le Beth-horon Tangnung le"},"6":{"text":"Baalath le Solomon nih a ngeihmi thil khonnak khua vialte le a rangleng hna ca khua vialte le a rangcung ralkap hna ca khua hna le Solomon nih Jerusalem ah siseh, Lebanon ah siseh, a penmi ram chung paohpaoh ah siseh, sak a duhmi paohpaoh kha a sak fawn hna."},"7":{"text":"Hit mi hna le Amor mi hna le Periz mi hna le Hiv mi hna le Jebus mi hna chungin a tangmi vialte, Israel mi a si lomi hna kha,"},"8":{"text":"kha hna an tefa, kha ram chung i a tangmi hna, Israel mi nih an hrawh lomi hna kha — hi hna hi Solomon nih hnekmi rian ṭuantu bu ah a ser hna i nihin tiang hin an si ko."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Israel mi chung cun Solomon nih a rian ṭuantu caah sal a ser hna lo, annih cu ralkap le a bawi hna le a rangleng haotu hna le a rangcung ralkap an si."},"10":{"text":"Cun hi hna hi Siangpahrang Solomon bawi upa bik pawl an si, za hnih le sawm nga an si i, mi cung i nawl ngeitu an si."},"11":{"text":"Solomon nih Faro fanu cu David khua khan, amah ca i a sakmi inn ah a hunpi i, “ Bawipa biakamnak kuang a phanhnak hmun cu hmunthiang an si caah ka nupi cu Israel mi siangpahrang David inn chungah khan a um hnga lo,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun innleng hmai i a sakmi Bawipa biakṭheng cungah khan Solomon nih Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak kha a pekchanh hna,"},"13":{"text":"mah cucu Moses nih sabbath hna ca le thla thar hna ca le kum khat voi khat tuahmi puai — thilnu telh lo changreu puai, zarh hna puai le deu puai hna ca i nawl a chiah bangkhan, a ni cio rian nih a hlamning khan an pekchanh hna.","ref":"Exo 23.14-17; 34.22-23; Nam 28.9; 29.39; Deu 16.16"},"14":{"text":"A pa David nih a rak chiahmi phunglam ning khan, tlangbawi hna cu an rian cio caah khan a bubu in a thiah hna i ni fate rian nih a hlam cio ning khan Levi mi hna cu tlangbawi hna hmai i thangṭhatnak rian le rianṭuannak an tuah awk a simi ah khan a thiah fawn hna, cun kutka cawngtu pawl zong kha kutka hna caah khan an bubu in a thiah hna; zeitintiah cuticun Pathian mi David nawl pekning cu a si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna, zei thil paoh kong le chawhlawn khonnak kong ah nawl a pekmi hna cu annih nih an pialtak lo."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa inn a hram an dirh ri in an lim tiang, Solomon rian vialte cu, cuticun lim a si. Cucaah Bawipa inn cu an lim."},"17":{"text":"Cun Solomon cu Edom ram chung, rili kam i a ummi Ezion-geber le Eloth ah a kal."},"18":{"text":"Cun Huram nih, rili i a kal tawnmi a sinum hna le lawng hna kha a sinum hna in a hei kuat, cun annih cu Solomon sinum hna he khan Ofir ah an kal i cuka cun sui talen za li le sawm nga an rak phorh i Siangpahrang Solomon sinah khan an ratpi."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrangnu Sheba nih Solomon minthannak kha a theih tikah, amah cu a harmi biahalnak in hneksak awkah Jerusalem ah a ra; mizul tampi, zihmui phormi kalauk hna le sui tampi le lung mansung tampi aa phorh hna. Solomon sin a phak tikah a lung chung i a ummi vialte cu a chim dih.","title":"Siangpahrangnu Sheba (1Sia 10.1-13)","ref":"Mat 12.42; Luk 11.31"},"2":{"text":"Solomon nih a biahalnak vialte cu a leh dih; Solomon nih a sullam a chimh khawh lomi thil, Solomon sinin aa thupmi zeihmanh a um lo."},"3":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrangnu Sheba nih Solomon fimnak le a inn sakmi le"},"4":{"text":"a cabuai i rawl le a bawi pawl an ṭhut-umning le a sinum hna nih an tuammuai hna ning le an hnipuan le a hrai putu hna le an hnipuan le Bawipa inn i a pekchanhmi a khangh thawinak hna kha a hmuh tikah, a chungah thlarau a tang ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu a thawh i, “Ka ram chungin, na rian ṭuanning le na fimnak kong ka rak theihmi kha bia dik a si ko,"},"6":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an chimmi cu keimah hrim ka rat i keimah mit hrim nih a hmuh hlanah cun ka rak zum lo; zohhmanh, na fimnak a ngan ning a cheu hmanh an rak ka chimh ṭung lo; ka rak theihmi bia cu na lonh diam."},"7":{"text":"Na nupi hna hi an van a va ṭha dah! Hi na sinum hna, nangmah hmaiah a dir zungzal i na fimnak a theimi hna hi an van a va ṭha dah!"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa na Pathian, nangmah chungah lawmhnak a ngei i Bawipa na Pathian ca i siangpahrang ah a bawi ṭhutdan cungah an ṭhuttertu cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Na Pathian nih Israel mi cu a dawt hna i zungzal in hmunhter a duh hna caah, nangmah nih biading le dinnak kha na tuah nakhnga, an cung i siangpahrang ah an ser,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu sui talen za khat le kul le zihmui tampi le lungvar man sung hna kha a pek: Siangpahrangnu Sheba nih Siangpahrang Solomon a pekmi zihmui bantuk cu a dang a um ti lo."},"10":{"text":"Cuhleiah Huram sinum hna le Solomon sinum hna, Ofir in sui a rak phortu nih khan, algum thing le lungvar man sung an rak phorh hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih algum thing cun Bawipa inn hleihlak hna le siangpahrang inn hleihlak hna le hlasatu hna ca i tingtang hna le ruakhuang hna zongah a ser hna; Judah ram chungah cu bantuk cu hmuh an si bal lo."},"12":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Solomon nih siangpahrangnu Sheba cu a duhmi vialte, siangpahrang sin i a rak phorhmi hleiah a halmi vialte kha a pek dih. Cucaah aa let i a sinum hna he amah ram ah khan an tlung ṭhan."},"13":{"text":"Solomon sinah kum khat ah a lutmi sui a rih lei cu talen za ruk, sawm ruk le paruk a si,","title":"Solomon Rumnak le Minthannak (1Sia 10.14-29 ; 2Cha 1.14-17)"},"14":{"text":"mah hihi chawlet hna le chawdawr hna nih an luhpimi lengah a si; cun Arabia siangpahrang vialte le ram uktu bawi hna nih khan Solomon sinah sui le ngun kha an ratpi."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon nih phaw a nganmi za hnih, denmi sui in a ser hna; phaw pakhat ah denmi sui shekel za ruk cio a lut."},"16":{"text":"Cun denmi sui in phaw za thum a ser hna; sui shekel za thum cio phaw pakhat ah cun a lut; cun siangpahrang nih cun Lebanon Tupi Inn chungah khan a chiah hna."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih cun vuiho bawi ṭhutdan nganpi zong a ser i sui thiang in a hut."},"18":{"text":"Bawi ṭhutdan nih cun lamhbak paruk le sui in sermi kedanh a ngei i cu hna cu bawi ṭhutdan ah khan an i peh, ṭhutnak kam veve ah ban chiahnak an um i ban chiahnak pawng veve ah cun chiandeih pahnih an dir;"},"19":{"text":"lamhbak kam kip ah khan a lamhbak paruk in, chiandeih hleihnih an dir. Cu bantuk cu khuazei ram hmanh ah an ser bal lo."},"20":{"text":"Siangpahrang Solomon dinnak hrai vialte cu sui an si i Lebanon Tupi Inn umkheng vialte cu sui thiang an si; Solomon chan ah cun ngun cu zeihmanh ah an rak rel lo."},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Huram sinum hna he khan siangpahrang i a sangphawlawng cu Tarshish ah an kal tawn; kum thum ah voi khat lengmang Tarshish sangphawlawng nih sui, ngun, vui ho, zawng le awtaw kha an rak phorh tawn hna."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun Siangpahrang Solomon nih vawlei cung siangpahrang vialte cu rumnak le fimnak ah a lonh dih hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih a lung chung i a chiahmi fimnak theih awkah vawlei cung siangpahrang vialte hna nih cun Solomon cu an fuh."},"24":{"text":"Cun kumfate in, cu zat in tiin, an laksawng ngun in sermi thilri hna le sui in sermi thilri hna le, puan hna le mura le zihmui le rangtum hna le laa hna kha an rak put cio hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun Solomon nih cun rangtum hna le rangleng hna caah ranginn thong li a ngei i rangleng khua hna le Jerusalem i siangpahrang sinah a chiahmi rangcung ralkap sang khat thong hnih a ngeih hna.","ref":"1Sia 4.26"},"26":{"text":"Cun Zufrates tiva in Filistin mi hna ram tiang, cun Izipt ramri tiang, cuka i a ummi siangpahrang vialte kha a uk hna.","ref":"Gen 15.18; 1Sia 4.21"},"27":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Jerusalem ah ngun cu lungtekem tlukin a lenter i sidar thing cu Shefelah i saikamor thing bantukin a tamter."},"28":{"text":"Cun rangtum hna cu Solomon caah Izipt ram le ram kip ah an va cawk hna.","ref":"Deu 17.16"},"29":{"text":"Cun Solomon tuahsernak a tang rihmi cu, a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang, profet Nathan ṭialmi tuanbia chungah le Shilon mi Ahijah nih a chimmi bia ṭialnak cauk chungah le Nebat fapa Jeroboam kong i hmutu Iddo nih langhnak a hmuhmi ṭialnak cauk chungah khan an i ṭial lo mei?","title":"Solomon Thihnak (1Sia 11.41-43)"},"30":{"text":"Solomon nih Israel vialte cu Jerusalem in kum sawm li a pen hna."},"31":{"text":"Cun Solomon cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a pa David khua ah khan an vui; cun a fapa Rehoboam cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi vialte cu Rehoboam kha siangpahrang i ser awkah Shekhem ah an rat caah Rehoboam cu Shekhem ah a kal.","title":"Israel Ral An Tho (1Sia 12.1-24)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Nebat fapa Jeroboam nih a theih tikah (amah cu Solomon Siangpahrang sinin a zamnak khan Izipt ram ah a um ko) Jeroboam cu Izipt ram cun a hung kir."},"3":{"text":"Cun amah cu an hei cah i an kawh; cun Jeroboam le Israel mi vialte cu an ra i Rehoboam cu,"},"4":{"text":"“Na pa nih kan seihnam cu a rihter. Cucaah nang nih cun na pa nih kan cungah rian har le seihnam rit a kan khinhmi cu zanter law na rian kan ṭuan lai,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh hna i, “Ni thum chungah ka sinah ra ṭhan te u,” tiah a ti hna. Cucaah mi cu an kal."},"6":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Rehoboam nih cun, a pa Solomon a nun lio i a hmai i a rak dirmi tar hna kha ruahnak a hal hna i, “Hi mi hna hi zeitin va let hna ti ah dah nan ka ti?” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun annih nih an thawh i, “Hi mi hna cungah hin zaangfahnak na ngeih i na lawmhter hna i bia ṭha in na chawnh hna ahcun, annih cu a zungzal in na sal an si lai,” tiah an ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw upa hna nih fim an chimhmi kha a hlawt i amah ṭhirual a hmaiah a um tawnmi tlangval hna kha ruahnak cheuh a hal hna."},"9":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “ ‘Na pa nih kan cungah a kan khinhmi seihnam rit hi zanter tuah,’ tiah a ka timi hna hi zeitindah ka leh hna lai, zei ruahnak dah nan ka cheuh lai?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun amah ṭhirual tlangval hna nih khan amah cu, “ ‘Na pa nih cun kan seihnam kha a rihter ko, sihmanhsehlaw nang nih cun kan zaanterpiak ko,’ tiah na sinah a titu hna sinah cun hi bangin na chim lai, ‘Ka hngete cu ka pa tai nakin a chah deuh."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu ka pa nih nan cung i a ritmi seihnam a chiahmi ah khan kan chap chin hna lai. Ka pa nih fungfek in an chimhhrin hna, sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun tlang ngaikuang in kan chimhhrin hna lai,’ na ti lai,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nih, “Ni thumnak ni ah ka sinah ra te u,” tiah a ti bang khan, Jeroboam le mi vialte cu Rehoboam sinah ni thumnak ni ah an ra."},"13":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih cun hrang ngaiin a rak leh hna i upa hna nih fim an chimhmi kha hlawt in"},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam nih cun tlangval hna nih lungthin an cheuhmi ning khan annih cu a chawnh hna i, “Ka pa nih nan seihnam cu a rak rihter ko, sihmanhsehlaw nan seihnam cu ka rihter chin lai; ka pa nih fungfek in an chimhhrin hna, sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun tlang ngaikuang in kan chimhhrin hna lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nih mi cu an bia a ngai hna lo; zeitintiah Bawipa nih Shilon mi Ahijah kha hmang in Nebat fapa Jeroboam sinah bia a chimmi kha tlinter awk caah Pathian nih mahtihin thil kha a mersan."},"16":{"text":"Cun Israel mi vialte nih siangpahrang nih kan bia a ngai lo ti kha an hmuh tikah, mizapi nih cun siangpahrang cu an leh i, “David chungah zei covo dah kan ngeih? Jesse fapa chungah ro kan ngei lo. Maw Israel, nan thlam cio ah kal dih u! David, nangmahte nih na innchungkhar cu i zohkhenh ko,” an ti. Cucaah Israel mi vialte cu an thlam cio ah an tlung dih.","ref":"2Sam 20.1"},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Judah ram khua chung i a ummi Israel mi kha cu Rehoboam nih a uk hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun hnekmi rian zohkhenhtu a simi bawi Hadoram kha Siangpahrang Rehoboam nih a hei thlah i Israel mi nih khan thi lak in lung in an rak cheh. Cun Siangpahrang Rehoboam cu Jerusalem i zam awkah khulrang in a rangleng kha aa cit."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah Israel mi hna nih cun David innchungkhar cu nihin ni tiang hin an doh hna."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam cu Jerusalem ah a rat tikah, Judah le Benjamin innchungkhar chung khan ralkap thim ciammammi sang riat kha. Rehoboam pennak lak ṭhan awk ca i Israel mi doh awkah khan a pumh hna."},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian mi Shemaiah sinah khan Bawipa bia a ra i,"},"3":{"text":"“Judah siangpahrang Rehoboam, Solomon fapa le Judah le Benjamin ram chung i a ummi Israel mi vialte sinah khan,"},"4":{"text":"‘Hi bangin Bawipa nih, Nan hung kal awk a si lai lo i nan unau Israel mi cu a doh zong nan hung do hna lai lo. Hi thil cu keimah sinin a rami a si caah nan inn cio ah kir dih u, a ti,’ tiah va chim,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Bawipa bia cu an ngaih i an kir i Jeroboam cu an doh lo."},"5":{"text":"Rehoboam cu Jerusalem ah a um i i vennak caah Judah ram chungah khua a ser hna.","title":"Rehoboam Hunchonak"},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,"},"7":{"text":"Beth-zur, Soko, Adullam,"},"8":{"text":"Gath, Mareshah, Zif,"},"9":{"text":"Adoraim, Lakhish, Azekah,"},"10":{"text":"Zorah, Aijalon, le Hebron khua hna kha a ser hna, annih cu Judah le Benjamin ram chung i kulhnak a ngeimi khua an si."},"11":{"text":"An ralhruang hna cu fek tein an ser hna i an chungah ralbawi hna le rawl khonmi hna le chiti le mitsur hang a chiah hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun khua kip ah khan phaw le fei a chiah hna i khua fek ngaingai ah a ser hna. Cucaah Judah le Benjamin ram cu a co hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun Israel ram dihnak ah a ummi tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna nih khan amah cu an umnak hmun kip khan an fuh cio."},"14":{"text":"Levi mi hna nih an i hrawmmi ram hna le an thilri kha an kaltak hna, zeicahtiah Jeroboam le a fapale hna nih khan Bawipa tlangbawi rian an ṭuannak khan an dawi hna i"},"15":{"text":"a sermi khuahrum bo hna le mehehtum hna ca le cawfa hna caah khan amah a fapale hna kha tlangbawi ah a ser hna.","ref":"1Sia 12.31"},"16":{"text":"Cun Bawipa, Israel Pathian kha kawl awkah a lung in aa seh chihmi hna nih cun, Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian sin i raithawi awkah khan Israel phun vialte chungin annih cu an zulh hna."},"17":{"text":"Judah pennak cu an fehter i Solomon fapa Rehoboam cu kum thum chung an himter, zeicahtiah annih nih kum thum chung cu David le Solomon lam kha an zulh."},"18":{"text":"Rehoboam nih Mahalath kha nupi ah a ṭhit, amah cu David fapa Jerimoth le Jesse fapa Eliab i fanu Abihail i an fanu a si;"},"19":{"text":"cun fapa a hrinpiak hna: Jeush, Shemariah le Zaham an si."},"20":{"text":"Amah hnuah cun Absalom fanu Maakah kha a ṭhit i Abijah, Attai, Ziza le Shelomith a hrin hna."},"21":{"text":"Rehoboam nih Absalom fanu Maakah cu a nupi dang hna le a nuchun vialte hna lakah a dawt bik (nupi hleiriat le nuchun sawm ruk a ngei i fapa kul le pariat le fanu sawm ruk a ngeih hna);"},"22":{"text":"Rehoboam nih Maakah fapa Abijah cu siangpahrang i ser awkah a timh caah, a unau hna lak i amah changtu dingah a ser."},"23":{"text":"Fim tein khua a khan i Judah le Benjamin ram chung i a ummi kulhnak a ngeimi khua ah khan a fapale hna cu a ṭhenṭhek dih hna; cun tirawl tlamtling tein a pek hna i nupi tampi a ṭhitpiak cio hna."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Rehoboam uknak cu a feh i a ṭhawn tikah Bawipa phungbia cu a hlawt i amah sin ṭang Israel mi vialte zong nih khan an hlawt ve.","title":"Shishak Nih Judah A Tuk (1Sia 14.21-31)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam a bawi kum nganak ah, annih cu Bawipa sinah zumhawktlak an si ti lo caah, Izipt siangpahrang Shishak nih Jerusalem cu,"},"3":{"text":"rangleng thong khat za hnih le rangcung ralkap thong sawm ruk he a hunhnawh. Izipt ram in amah he a rami hna cu rel cawk lo an si — Libia mi, Sukkiim mi le Ethiopia mi an si."},"4":{"text":"Cun Judah ram chung i kulhnak a ngeimi khua kha a lak hna i Jerusalem tiang a ra."},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah profet Shemaiah kha, Jerusalem i Shishak ruangah aa pummi Rehoboam le Judah bawi hna sinah khan a ra i annih cu, “Hi bangin Bawipa nih, ‘Nan ka kaltak caah kei zong nih Shishak kut chungah kan kaltak ve hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Israel bawi hna le siangpahrang nih cun an lung an ṭhumh i, “ Bawipa cu a ding,” tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih an lung an ṭhumh kha a hmuh tikah Bawipa bia cu Shemaiah sinah khan a ra i, “Annih nih an lung an ṭhumh cang, cucaah ka hrawk hna lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw luatnak tlawmpal ka pek hna lai i Shishak kut in Jerusalem cungah ka thinhunnak cu thlet a si lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Asinain, annih cu a sal an si ko lai, zeicahtiah annih nih ka rianṭuan le ramdang hna pennak rianṭuan an i dan kha an hngalh nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cuticun Izipt siangpahrang Shishak nih Jerusalem cu a hung doh; Bawipa inn chung rothil le siangpahrang inn chung rothil kha a lak hna; zeizong vialte kha a lak dih hna. Solomon nih a sermi sui phaw vialte zong kha a lak hna i","ref":"1Sia 10.16-17; 2Cha 9.15-16"},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang Rehoboam nih anmah can ah cun dar phaw a ser hna i siangpahrang inn innka a cawngtu ralkap bawi hna kut chungah khan a chiah hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Bawipa inn chungah a luh fate, ralvengtu kha an ra i an rak put hna i ralvengtu hna khaan ah khan an kalpi ṭhan tawn hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun a lung a ṭhumh tikah, hloh hirhiar a si nakhnga lo, Bawipa thinhunnak cu a sin khan aa mer i Judah ram chungah thil umtuning a ṭha."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Siangpahrang Rehoboam cu Jerusalem ah cun aa fehter i khika in a pen hna. Rehoboam cu bawi hram aa thawk tikah khan kum sawm li le kum khat a si i Jerusalem ah kum hleisarih a bawi, cu khua cu Israel miphun dihlak chungin khika i a min chiah awkah Bawipa nih aa thimmi a si. A nu min cu Naamah a si, amah cu Ammon mi a si."},"14":{"text":"Cun ṭhat lonak kha a tuah i Bawipa kawl kha a lung in aa sehchih lo."},"15":{"text":"Rehoboam tuahsernak hna cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang, profet Shemaiah le hmutu Iddo chan relnak cauk ah khan an i ṭial lo mei? Rehoboam le Jeroboam karlak ah khan ral a um thluangthluan ko."},"16":{"text":"Cun Rehoboam cu a pupa hna sinah a it i David khua chungah khan an vui; cun a fapa Abijah kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Jeroboam a bawi kum hleiriat kum ah Abijah nih Judah ram kha pen hram a thawk.","title":"Abijah Pennak (1Sia 15.1-8)"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem ah kum thum a bawi. A nu min cu Mikaiah a si, amah cu Gibeah rammi Uriel fanu a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun Abijah le Jeroboam karlak ah khan ralnak a um. Abijah cu miralṭha ralkap thim khunmi thong za li he raldohnak hmun ah cun an kal i Jeroboam nih khan a ṭhawngmi ralkap thim khunmi thong za riat he a rak orh ve."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah Efraim tlang ram i a ummi Zemaraim Tlang ah khan Abijah cu a dir i, “Maw Jeroboam le Israel mi vialte hna, ka bia thei tuah u!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih Israel mi cung i siangpahrang sinak cu David le a fapa hna sinah zungzal ca in cite biakamnak in a pek cang ti kha hngalh awk nan si lo maw?"},"6":{"text":"Asinain, Nebat fapa Jeroboam, David fapa Solomon i a sal cu a tho i a bawipa kha a doh;"},"7":{"text":"cun Rehoboam cu a no i lungthin fek a ngeih rih hlanah khan, mizeiruaramlo le santlailo pawl kha a sinah an i ṭom i Solomon fapa Rehoboam cu an doh i anih nih a rak celh hna lo."},"8":{"text":"“Atu cu mi tampi nan si ca le Jeroboam nih pathian an serpiakmi hna sui cawfa kha nan sinah nan i chiah hna caah nannih nih David fapa hna kut chung i Bawipa pennak cu doh awkah nan ruah."},"9":{"text":"Nannih nih Bawipa tlangbawi hna, Aaron fapa hna le Levi mi hna kha nan dawi hna i ramdangmi hna bantukin tlangbawi nanmahte in nan i ser hna lo mei? Ahopaoh cawtum no in siseh tuukawng pasarih in siseh aa thianhmi paoh cu pathian a si ṭung lomi hna tlangbawi ah khan an cang ko."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kannih tu cu, Bawipa cu kan Pathian a si i amah cu kan hlaw lo. Bawipa rian a ṭuantu ah tlangbawi Aaron fapa hna kha kan ngei hna i an rian a ṭuantu ah Levi mi kha kan ngei hna."},"11":{"text":"Kannih nih cun Bawipa kan Pathian nawlbia kha kan zulh caah Bawipa sinah zinglei fate le zanlei fate khangh thawinak le rim thawmi zihmui kha an pekchanh i sui thiang cabuai cungah khan hun camcinmi changreu kha an hun i zanlei fate sui meivannak tung cu a meiinn kha an alh naklai an zohkhenh; Bawipa nih a kan fialmi kha kan tuah; sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih cun amah cu nan hlawt."},"12":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, kan hmaisuang ah Pathian cu a um i nannih doh awk i thawng thanhtu ah tlangbawi hna cu an raldohnak muko he an um. Maw Israel fale hna, Bawipa nan pupa hna Pathian cu doh hlah u, zeitintiah nan hlawhtling lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Jeroboam nih lamhruang ortu, an hnulei in a hun chuah hnawhtu ding hna kha a thlah hna; cucaah a ralkapbu hna cu Judah mi hna hmaiah an um i lamhruang ortu hna cu an hnulei in an um."},"14":{"text":"Cun Judah mi nih khua an zoh tikah, zohhmanh, ral cu an hmailei he an hnulei he an um; cun Bawipa kha an auh i tlangbawi nih khan muko an tum."},"15":{"text":"Khi tikah Judah mi hna cu raldohnak au khan an au. Cun Judah mi kha an au tikah Pathian nih Jeroboam le Israel mi vialte kha Abijah le Judah mi hna hmaiah a sunghter hna."},"16":{"text":"Israel mi cu Judah mi hmaiah an zaam i annih cu Pathian nih an kut chungah a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"Abijah le a mi hna nih khan tampi an thah hna; cucaah Israel mi thim ciammammi sing nga an thi."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun Israel mi hna cu khi tan ah khan an sung i Judah mi hna nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian kha an i bochan caah an tei hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun Abijah nih Jeroboam kha a dawi i a khua kha a chuh hna: Bethel le a pawngkam khuate hna, Jeshanah le a pawngkam khuate hna le Efron le a pawngkam khuate hna."},"20":{"text":"Abijah chan ah cun Jeroboam nih a ṭhawnnak kha a hmu ṭhan kho ti lo i Bawipa nih a tuk i a thi."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abijah cu a ṭhawng chin lengmang. Cun nupi hleili a ṭhit hna i fapa kul le pahnih le fanu hleiruk a ngeih hna."},"22":{"text":"Abijah tuahsernak a tang rihmi, a umtu ningcang hna le a chimmi hna cu profet Iddo ṭialmi tuanbia cauk chungah an i ṭial."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Abijah cu a pupa hna sinah a it i David khua ah an vui; a fapa Asa cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi. Amah chan ah cun ram cu kum hra him tein a um.","title":"Asa Pennak (1Sia 15.9-12)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Asa nih Bawipa a Pathian mithmuh i a ṭha le a ding kha a tuah."},"3":{"text":"Ram dang biakṭheng hna le khuahrum bo hna kha a hrawh hna i tung kha a chimh hna i Asherim kha a hau hna i"},"4":{"text":"Judah mi hna cu Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian kha kawl awkah le phungbia le nawlbia kha zulh awkah nawl a pek hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun Judah ram chung khua vialte hna chung khan khuahrum bo hna le zihmui biakṭheng hna kha a hrawh hna. Cun ram cu a kut tangah hnangam in a um."},"6":{"text":"Ram cu a daih caah Judah ram chungah khan kulh ngeimi khua a ser hna. Cu kum hna chungah cun Bawipa nih daihnak a pek caah ral a ngei lo."},"7":{"text":"Cun Judah mi cu a thawh hna i, “Hi khua hi ser hna u sih law vampang le innsang le kutka le kothrolh in kulh hna u sih; Bawipa kan Pathian cu kan kawl caah ram cu kanmah ta a si rih; kannih nih amah kha kan kawl i anih nih a kenkip ah daihnak a kan pek,” tiah a ti. Cuticun khua cu an ser hna i an hungcho."},"8":{"text":"Asa nih Judah in ralkapbu mi sing thum, phaw ngan pipi le fei in aa thuammi le Benjamin in phaw a thlir i likuk a kuaimi sing hnih le sang riat a ngeih hna; hi hna hi an dihlak tein ralṭha miṭhawng an si."},"9":{"text":"Ethiopia mi Zerah nih ralkap nuai khat le rangleng sing thum he a chuahhnawh hna i Mareshah tiang a ra phan."},"10":{"text":"Cun amah cu Asa nih a hei chuahhnawh ve i Mareshah i Zefathah nelrawn ah cun i doh awkah an i tiang."},"11":{"text":"Cun Asa nih Bawipa a Pathian kha a auh i, “Maw Bawipa, a ṭhawngmi le a dermi karlak ah, bawmtu nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo. Maw Bawipa kan Pathian, kan bawm ko sawh, zeitintiah nangmah kha kan in bochan i hi mibu nganpi hi nangmah min in kan chuahhnawh hna. Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu kan Pathian na si; minung nih nangmah cu in tei hna hlah seh,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih Ethiopia mi hna cu Asa le Judah mi hna hmaiah a tei hna i Ethiopia mi cu an zam."},"13":{"text":"Asa le a sin i a ummi hna nih khan Gerar tiang an dawi hna i Ethiopia mi cu a nung in pakhat hmanh an taan lo tiang an thi; zeitintiah annih cu Bawipa le a ralkapbu hmaiah cun an kuai dih. Judah mi nih cun hranchaw tampi an lak."},"14":{"text":"Gerar pawngkam khua vialte cu an tuk i Bawipa kha an ṭih caah an tei hna. Khua vialte kha an chungah hranchaw tampi an um caah an ramh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun saṭil a ngeimi hna thlam kha an tuk hna i tuu le kalauk kha tampi an i kalpi hna. Cun Jerusalem ah an kir."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian thlarau cu Oded fapa Azariah cungah a tlung i","title":"Asa Nih Remhnak A Tuah (1Sia 15.13-15)"},"2":{"text":"Asa ton awkah khan a kal i amah cu a thawh i, “Asa le Judah mi vialte le Benjamin mi vialte hna ka bia ngai tuah u: Amah sinah nan um chung cu Bawipa cu nan sinah a um. Nan kawl ahcun amah cu nan hmuh lai, sihmanhsehlaw nan hlawt ahcun an hlawt ve hna lai."},"3":{"text":"Caan saupi chung Israel cu Pathian ngaingai ngei lo le cawnpiaktu tlangbawi ngei lo le phungbia loin an um;"},"4":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an harnak chungin Bawipa, Israel Pathian leiah an i mer i an kawl tikah annih nih an hmuh ko."},"5":{"text":"Cu caan lioah cun a chuakmi caah siseh a lutmi caah siseh daihnak a um lo, zeitintiah hnahnawhnak ngan pipi nih ramchung mi vialte cu awlok a chonh hna."},"6":{"text":"Phun khat le phun khat, khua khat le khua khat an i do i an kek an kuai dih, zeicahtiah Pathian nih harnak phun zakip in harnak a pek hna."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu nan lung ṭhawng ko u! Nan kut kha derter hna hlah u, zeitintiah nan rian cu man a ngei lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Asa nih Oded fapa Azariah nih a chimmi bia hna cu a theih tikah, a ral a ṭha i Judah le Benjamin ram chung vialte le Efraim tlangram chung i a lakmi khua hna i a ummi fihnung siasal vialte kha a hlonh dih hna i Bawipa inn innleng hmai i a ummi biakṭheng kha a remh."},"9":{"text":"Cun Judah mi vialte le Benjamin mi vialte le Efraim, Manasseh le Simeon in a rami an sin i a pummi hna kha a pumh hna, zeitintiah Bawipa a Pathian kha a sinah a um ti an hngalh tikah Israel ram in mi tampi amah sinah khan an zam."},"10":{"text":"Annih cu Asa a bawi kum hleinganak, a thla thum thla ah khan Jerusalem ah an i pum."},"11":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun hranchaw an va lakmi chung khan Bawipa sinah cawtum za sarih le tuu thong sarih an thawi hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun annih nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian kha an lung dihlak le an nunnak dihlak in kawl awkah biakamnak chungah an lut;"},"13":{"text":"cun Bawipa, Israel Pathian a kawl duh lomi paoh cu mino a si ah, mitar a si ah, pa a si ah, nu a si ah, thah a si lai."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa sin chiatsernak cu aw thangpi le au le muko le saki tumnak he an tuah."},"15":{"text":"Cun Judah mi vialte cu an biakam chiatsernak ah cun an i lawm; zeicahtiah an lungtak tein chiatsernak cu an tuah i an duhnak dihlak in amah cu an kawl i amah cu an hmuh i an velchum ah Bawipa nih dinhnak a pek hna."},"16":{"text":"A nu Maakah hmanh kha Asherah caah fihnung siasal a ser caah, Siangpahrang Asa nih, siangpahrang bawinu a sinak khan a phuah. A siasal cu a hau i a den cikcek i Kidron varek ah a khangh."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khuahrum bo hna kha cu Israel ram chungin a hlo hna lo. Asinain Asa lungthin cu a chan chung vialte soisel awk um lo a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn chungah khan a pa biakamnak laksawng hna le amah biakamnak laksawng hna, ngun le sui le umkheng hna kha a rak put hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun Asa uknak a kum kum sawm thum le kum nganak tiang ral a um ti lo."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Asa a bawi kum sawm thum le kum ruknak ah Israel siangpahrang Baasha nih Judah cu a hung doh i Judah siangpahrang Asa sinah khan ahohmanh luhter lo le chuahter lo awkah Ramah khua kha a ser.","title":"Asa le Benhadad An Ṭangṭi (1Sia 15.16-24)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Asa nih Bawipa inn chung le siangpahrang inn chung i a ummi ro chung khan ngun le sui kha a lak hna i Siria siangpahrang Benhadad, Damaskas i a ummi kha a kuat i,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka pa le na pa karlak i a rak um bang khan, keimah le nangmah karlak ah ṭanṭinak um seh; zohhmanh, ngun le sui kan kuat; cucaah va kal law Israel siangpahrang Baasha nih hin a ka kirtak nakhnga, amah he nan ṭanṭinak kha va chat tuah,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun Benhadad nih Siangpahrang Asa kha a bia a ngaih i a ralkapbu haotu hna kha Israel mi khua doh awkah a thlah hna i Ijon, Dan, Abelmaim le Naftali i thil chiahnak khua vialte kha an tei hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun mah cucu Baasha nih a theih tikah Ramah khua ser kha a ngol i a rian kha a ṭhulh."},"6":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Asa nih Judah mi vialte kha aa kalpi hna i Baasha nih Ramah khua sernak i a hmanmi lung le thing kha an phorh hna i Geba le Mizpah khua sernak ah a hman hna."},"7":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun hmutu Hanani kha Judah siangpahrang Asa sinah cun a ra i, “Siria siangpahrang cu naa bochan i Bawipa na Pathian cu naa bochan lo caah, Siria siangpahrang ralkapbu cu na chuahter cang hna."},"8":{"text":"Ethiopia mi hna le Libia mi hna kha ralkapbu ngan ngaingai, rangleng tam hringhran le rangcung ralkap tam hringhran he a ummi an si lo maw? Asinain, Bawipa kha naa bochan caah annih cu na kut chungah amah nih an pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Zeitintiah vawlei cung dihlak ah hin Bawipa mit cu aa chawk dih i amah lei i an lung soisel awk a um lomi hna cungah a ṭhawnnak kha a langhter. Hi thil ah hin hrut piin na tuah cang; zeitintiah atu cun ral na ngei cang lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Khi tikah Asa cu hmutu cungah khan a thin a hung i hi kong ah a cungah a thin a hun caah thong chungah hreng a khenh.
