Cun Asa nih mi cheukhat cungah hi caan ah hin hremnak zong a tuah."},"11":{"text":"Asa tuahsernak hna cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang Judah le Israel Siangpahrang hna cauk chungah aa ṭial."},"12":{"text":"Asa cu a bawi kum sawm thum le kum kuanak kum ah a ke ah zawtnak a ing i a zawtnak cu a fak ngaingai; asinain a zawtnak hmanh ah cun Bawipa kha a kawl lo i sihmanhsehlaw sibawi hna sin tu khan bawmhnak a kawl deuh."},"13":{"text":"Cun Asa cu a pupa sinah a it, a bawi kum kum sawm li le kum khatnak kum ah a thi."},"14":{"text":"David khua chungah amah nih aa cawhmi thlan ah khan an vui. Zihmui ser thiam hna nih an sermi zihmui phun zakip in a khatmi ruakkuang ah khan an suan; cun amah hmaizahnak ah mei nganpi an tih."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A fapa Jehoshafat kha amah hmun ah cun a hung bawi i Israel mi he i dohnak ding caah khan a thazang aa ṭhawnter.","title":"Jehoshafat Pennak Fehter A Si"},"2":{"text":"Judah ram chung i kulhnak ngei khua vialte ah khan ralkap a chiah hna i Judah ram chung le a pa Asa nih Efraim khua a rak lakmi hna chungah khan ralvengtu ralkapbu a chiah hna."},"3":{"text":"A pa nih a hlan deuh i a rak zulhmi lam kha a zulh caah Bawipa cu Jehoshafat sinah a um; amah nih Baal kha a kawl hna lo,"},"4":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a pa Pathian kha a kawl i Israel mi nih an zulhmi lam si loin a nawlbia kha a zulh."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih pennak cu a kut chungah a fehter i Judah mi vialte nih Jehoshafat sinah ngunkhuai an thawh i a rum ngaingai i upatnak a hmu."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa lam leiah cun a lung kha a ral a ṭha i cuhleiah Judah ram chungin khuahrum bo hna le Asherim hna kha a ṭhial hna."},"7":{"text":"A bawi kum thumnak ah a bawi Benhail, Obadiah, Zekhariah, Nethanel le Mikaiah kha Judah ram chung khua hna ah cawnpiaktu ah a thlah hna;"},"8":{"text":"anmah sinah cun Levi mi Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah le Tobadonijah kha an i tel; cun hi Levi mi hna sinah hin tlangbawi Elishama le Jehoram an i tel."},"9":{"text":"Cun Judah ram chungah khan Bawipa phungbia cauk kha an i put i an cawnpiak hna; Judah ram chung khua vialte kha an ṭol i mi kha an cawnpiak hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun Judah ram pawngkam i a ummi ram vialte cungah khan Bawipa ṭihnak kha a tlung i Jehoshafat kha an do lo."},"11":{"text":"Filistin mi a cheukhat nih Jehoshafat cu laksawng an rak pek i ngunkhuai caah ngun an rak pek; cun Arab mi hna zong nih tuukawng thong sarih za sarih le mehehtum thong sarih le za sarih an rak pek."},"12":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat cu duhsah tein a ngan chin lengmang. Judah ram chungah ralhruang hna le thil khonnak khua hna kha a ser hna i"},"13":{"text":"Judah ram khua chungah khan thil tampi a khon hna. Jerusalem ah ralkap a ṭhawng i a ral a ṭhami a chiah hna."},"14":{"text":"Mah hihi an pale innchungkhar ning cio ah an i relnak cu a si: Judah chungin, a thong pawl hna haotu ah Adnah a si, amah sin ummi cu miṭhawngmi ralṭha sing thum an si,"},"15":{"text":"cun amah a hun dottu ah haotu Jehohanan a si, amah sin ummi cu sing hnih le sang riat,"},"16":{"text":"cun amah a hun changtu ah Zikhri fapa Amasiah a si, amah cu Bawipa rian caah mah lungtho tein aa pemi a si, amah sinah cun miṭhawng miralṭha sing hnih an um."},"17":{"text":"Benjamin chungin: mit:hawng mi ralṭha Eliada, amah sinah cun likuk le phaw a ngeimi sing hnih an um,"},"18":{"text":"cun a hun dottu ah Jehozabad a si i amah sinah cun raltuk awk i aa thuammi sing khat le sang riat an um."},"19":{"text":"Hi hna hi siangpahrang rianṭuantu cu an si, hi hna hleiah hin Judah ram chung dihlak kulhnak a ngeimi khua paoh i siangpahrang nih a chiahmi hna kha an um rih."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu a rum ngaingai i upatnak a hmu; cun Ahab he Ṭhitumnak lei in i pehtlaihnak a ser.","title":"Mikaiah Nih Ahab Le Jehoshafat An Sungh Lai Kha A Chimchung (1Sia 22.1-28)"},"2":{"text":"Kum tlawmpal hnuah khin Ahab sinah Samaria ah a vung kal. Cun amah le amah sin i a kalmi hna cu Ahab nih tuu le cawtum tampi a rak thah hna i Ramoth-gilead hung doh awkah khan a sawm khawh."},"3":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang Ahab nih cun Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “Ramoth-gilead ah na hun ka kalpi hnga maw?” tiah a ti. “Kei le nang hi mi khat kan si ko, ka mi cu na mi an si ve ko. Raldohnak ah cun na sinah kan si lai,” tiah amah cu a leh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat nih Israel siangpahrang cu, “ Bawipa bia cu dothlat hmasa rih tuah hen,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cu tikah Israel siangpahrang nih profet kha hmunkhat ah a pumh hna, za li an si, annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ramoth-gilead cu tuk awkah kan kal hnga maw, asiloah, kan i sum lai dah?” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih, “Hung kal ko, zeitintiah Bawipa nih siangpahrang kut chungah a pek,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jehoshafat nih, “Hika ah hin kan hal khawh ding Bawipa profet a dang pakhat tal an um ti lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “ Bawipa kan hal khawhnak ding mipa a dang pakhat a um rih, amah cu Imlah fapa Mikaiah a si; sihmanhsehlaw ka kong ah thil ṭha chim bal loin thil ṭhalo lawng kha a chim zungzal caah ka huat,” tiah a ti. Cun Jehoshafat nih cun, “Cuticun siangpahrang nih chim hlah seh,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih bawi pakhat a auh i, “Imlah fapa Mikaiah kha khulrang in ratpi tuah,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu an bawi ṭhutdan cungah an ṭhu i an puan in an i thuam; Samaria hauka luhnak i phuhri ah khan an ṭhu; cun profet vialte hna cu an hmaiah an rak chim dulmal ko."},"10":{"text":"Cun Khenaanah fapa Zedekiah nih thir ki aa ser hna i, “Hi bangin Bawipa, nih, ‘Siria mi cu an rawk dih tiang mah hi hin na suk hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in profet vialte nih cun an chim i, “Ramoth-gilead ah cun hung kal law hung tei ko; Bawipa nih siangpahrang na kut chungah an pek lai,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah kawh awk i an thlahmi lamkaltu nih khan amah sinah cun, “Zohhmanh, profet hna cu lungnge tein a ṭha lei in siangpahrang sinah an bia a si; nangmah na bia zong annih lak i pakhat i a bia bantuk si ve seh law an duhning lei in chim ve ko,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Mikaiah nih, “ Bawipa a nun bangin, Bawipa nih ka sin i a chimmi cu, mah cucu ka chim ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang sinah a phak tikah, siangpahrang nih cun a rak thawh i, “Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead cu hung tuk awkah kan kal lai maw, kan i sum lai dah?” tiah a ti. Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Hung kal u law hung tei hen u, annih cu nangmah kut chungah pek an si ko lai,” tiah a leh."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang nih a thawh i, “Biatak dah ti lo cu Bawipa min in ka sin i na chim lo awkah voi zeizat dah bia kan kamter lai?” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Israel mi vialte cu khaltu a ngei lomi tuu bantukin tlang cung i an i ṭhek dih kha ka hmuh; cun Bawipa nih, ‘Hi hna hi bawi an ngei lo, anmah le an inn cio ah dai tein kir hna seh,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Nam 27.17; Eze 34.5; Mat 9.36; Mar 6.34"},"17":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu, “Keimah kong ah cun ṭhatnak si loin chiatnak a chim lai, tiah kan ti ṭheo lo mei?” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih cun, “Cucaah Bawipa bia cu thei tuah: Bawipa cu a bawi ṭhutdan cungah a ṭhut i vancung ralkapbu vialte a orhlei le a kehlei ah an dir kha ka hmuh;"},"19":{"text":"cun Bawipa nih a thawh i, ‘Israel siangpahrang Ahab cu Ramoth-gilead ah hung kal i khika ah a thih naklai ahodah a lem lai?’ tiah a ti. Cun pakhat nih thil pakhat a chim i a dang pakhat nih thil dang pakhat a chim ve."},"20":{"text":"Cun thlarau pakhat cu a hung chuak i Bawipa hmaiah cun a dir i, ‘Keimah nih ka lem lai,’ tiah a ti. Cun Bawipa nih, ‘Zei in dah na lem lai?’ tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun anih nih, ‘Ka va kal lai i a profet vialte hna kaa chungah nal thlarau ka va si lai,’ tiah a ti. Cun anih nih, ‘Na va lem hrimhrim lai i na va lem khawh taktak lai; va kal law cu bangin va tuah,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah cun zohhmanh, Bawipa nih hi na profet hna kaa chungah hin nal thlarau a chiah cang; Bawipa nih nangmah kong ah ṭhat lonak a chim cang,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Khi tikah Khenaanah fapa Zedekiah kha a pawngah a ra i Mikaiah kha a biang ah a bengh i, “Zei lam in dah Bawipa thlarau cu nangmah sinah bia chim awkah ka sinin a chuah?” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, khi ni ah, innchung chungchin dal i i thuh awkah na kal tikah na hngalh te lai,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih cun, “Mikaiah kha tlai u law khua uktu Amon le siangpahrang fapa Joash sinah khan va kalpi u;"},"26":{"text":"cun siangpahrang nih hi bangin, ‘Hi pa hi thong ah rak thla u law rawl tlawmte le ti tlawmte lawng, daihnak in ka ra kir ṭhan hlantiang, rak pe u, a ti,’ tiah va chim hna u,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun Mikaiah nih a thawh i, “Daihnak in na kir ṭhan a si ahcun, Bawipa nih ka sinah bia kha a chim lo a si lai,” tiah a ti. Cun amah nih cun, “Nannih mi vialte hna, thei tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Israel siangpahrang le Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Ramoth-gilead ah khan an hung kal."},"29":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang nih Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “Ka mui kaa hleng lai i raldohnak chungah ka kal ve lai, sihmanhsehlaw nang cu na bawi puan kha i aih ko,” tiah a ti. Cun Israel siangpahrang cu a mui aa hleng i raldohnak chungah cun a kal."},"30":{"text":"Cun Siria siangpahrang nih cun a rangleng bawi hna cu, “Israel siangpahrang dah ti lo cu, ahohmanh a hme siseh, a ngan siseh, tu hna hlah u,” tiah nawl a pek hna."},"31":{"text":"Cun rangleng ralbawi hna nih khan Jehoshafat kha an hmuh tikah, “Amah hi Israel siangpahrang cu a si ko,” tiah an ti. Cucaah amah tuk awkah khan an i mer; cun Jehoshafat cu a au i Bawipa nih a bawmh."},"32":{"text":"Rangleng ralbawi hna nih khan amah cu Israel siangpahrang a si lo ti kha an hmuh tikah amah dawinak khan an i mer ṭhan caah Pathian nih a sinin kaa dang leiah a hnuh hna."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw pakhatpa nih tinh setsai loin a li cu a koih sawhsawh i Israel siangpahrang cu a thir ngaphaw angki le a ṭangphaw karlak ah a khen; cucaah a rangleng a mawngtu cu, “I mer law hi i tuknak chung hin ka chuahpi tuah, zeicahtiah an ka hliam ai,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun cu ni cu an i tuknak kha a fak ngaingai i Israel siangpahrang cu Siria mi hna lei hoih in a rangleng chungah khan zanlei tiang doh chom in a um; cun nitlak ah a thi."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu Jerusalem i a inn ah him tein a tlung ṭhan.","title":"Profet Jehu Nih Jehoshafat A Sik"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hmutu Hanani fapa Jehu nih amah cu ton awkah a kal i Siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu a thawh i, “Miṭhalo cu bawmh i Bawipa a huami hna cu dawt awk a si maw? Hi ruangah hin nangmah cungah Bawipa thinhunnak cu a chuak cang."},"3":{"text":"Asinain, Asherah hna cu ram chungin na hloh hna i Pathian kawl kha na lung in naa sehchih caah nangmah chungah ṭhatnak tlawmpal cu hmuh a si,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu Jerusalem ah khua a sa; cun Beersheba in Efraim tlangram tiang mi hna sinah khan a kal i an pupa hna Pathian, Bawipa sinah khan a ratpi ṭhan hna.","title":"Jehoshafat Nih Biaceihtu A Ser Hna"},"5":{"text":"Judah ram chung i kulhmi khua dihlak ah khan, khua khat hnu khua khat in, biaceihtu a chiah hna i,"},"6":{"text":"biaceihtu hna cu, “Nan tuahmi kha ṭha tein ruat u, zeitintiah bia nan ceihmi cu minung caah a si lo i Bawipa caah a si; nan biakhiahnak ah Bawipa cu nan sin ah aa tel lengmang ve."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa ṭihnak cu nan cungah um seh; nan tuahmi kha i ralring u, zeitintiah Bawipa kan Pathian sinah cun biading merh siseh, duhdanh ngeih siseh, ziknawh siseh, a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cuhleiah Jerusalem ah Jehoshafat nih Levi mi tlawmpal, tlangbawi tlawmpal le Israel mi innchungkhar hna lu tlawmpal kha Bawipa ca i biakhiahnak tuah awkah le i almi bia kha ceih awkah, a thiah hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun nawl a pek hna i, “Hi bangin Bawipa ṭih buin zumhawktlak tein, nan lung dihlak in nan tuah lai:"},"10":{"text":"khuazei khuami hmanh, thisen chuahnak kong ah siseh, phungbia le nawlbia kong ah siseh, an bia nan sin a phak tikah, annih nih Bawipa hmaiah mawhnak an ton nakhnga lo le nan cung le nan unau hna cungah thinhunnak a tlun nakhnga lo, nannih nih annih cu nan rak cawnpiak hna lai. Cu bantuk cun nan tuah lai i mawhnak nan tong lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh u, Bawipa lei thil vialte ah tlangbawi upa bik Amariah cu nan cungah a um; cun siangpahrang lei thil vialte ah Judah innchungkhar uktu Zebadiah, Ishmael fapa cu nan cungah a um; cun Levi mi hna cu nan biaceihtu bawi hme deuh an si lai. Ralṭha tein tuah u law Bawipa cu miding mi hna sinah cun um ko seh!” tiah a ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin Moab mi hna le Ammon mi hna cu Meunim mi a cheukhat hna he Jehoshafat tuk awkah an i thawh.","title":"Moab Mi le Ammon Mi A Tei Hna"},"2":{"text":"Mi zeimaw kha an ra i Jehoshafat kha an chimh i, “Nangmah doh awkah mibu nganpi Edom ram in, rili lengin an ra lio i zohhmanh, Hazazontamar ah an um” tiah an ti (mah cucu Engedi kha a si)."},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah Jehoshafat cu a thin a phang i Bawipa kawl awk kha aa tim i Judah ram chung vialte ah khan rawl ulhnak a thanh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Judah ram mi cu Bawipa sinin bawmhnak kawl awkah an i pum; Judah ram chung khua dihlak khan Bawipa kawl awkah cun an ra."},"5":{"text":"Cun Judah ram mi le Jerusalem mi aa pummi hna chungah cun; Jehoshafat cu Bawipa inn chungah, tual thar hmaiah khan a dir i,"},"6":{"text":"“Maw Bawipa, kan pupa hna Pathian, nangmah cu vancung i Pathian na si lo maw? Miphun hna ram vialte cu nangmah nih na uk lo maw? Nangmah na kut chungah lianhngannak le ṭhawnnak cu an um i ahohmanh nih an in celh lo."},"7":{"text":"Maw kan Pathian, nangmah nih hika ram mi hna cu na mi Israel mi hna hmai i na dawi hna i na hawi Abraham tefa hna sinah zungzal ca in na pe hna lo mei?","ref":"Isa 41.8; Jei 2.23"},"8":{"text":"Cu ram chungah cun khua an sa i na min caah hmunthiang pakhat an in sakpiak i,"},"9":{"text":"‘Kan cungah ṭhat lonak, vainam maw, biaceihnak maw, rai maw, mangṭam maw a tlun ahcun, hi inn hmaiah le nangmah hmaiah hin kan dir lai, zeicahtiah na min cu hi inn chungah hin a um i kannih nih kan harnak chungin nangmah cu kan in auh lai i nang nih na kan theihpiak lai i na kan khamh lai,’ tiah an ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun atu cu zohhmanh, Ammon mi hna le Moab mi hna le Seir Tlang mi hna, Israel mi hna nih Izipt ram in an chuah tikah tuk na thlauh hna ca i an hrial hna i an hrawh lomi hna nih khan","ref":"Deu 2.4-19"},"11":{"text":"zohhmanh nangmah nih co awkah na kan pekmi na ta chung hin kannih cu dawi i cuticun lehrulh an kan timh."},"12":{"text":"Maw kan Pathian, an cungah biaceihnak na tuah hnga lo maw? Zeitintiah kannih doh awkah a kan rathnawhtu hi bu nganpi hmaiah hin kannih cu santlailo kan si ko. Zei tuah awk kan hngal lo, sihmanhsehlaw kan mit lawng kha na cungah a um ko,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cu lioah cun Judah mi vialte hna cu an ngakchia hna le an nupi le an fale hna he, Bawipa hmaiah khan an dir."},"14":{"text":"Cun Bawipa thlarau cu aa pummi hna lak i a ummi Jahaziel cungah khan a tlung; amah cu Zekhariah fapa a si, Zekhariah cu Benaiah fapa a si, Benaiah cu Jeiel fapa a si, Jeiel cu Mattaniah fapa a si, Mattaniah cu Levi mi, Asaf fapa hna tefa kha a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh i, “Judah mi vialte le Jerusalem mi hna le Siangpahrang Jehoshafat hna, thei tuah u: Bawipa nih hi bangin nan sinah, ‘Hi mibu nganpi ruangah nan thinphang in nan lung dong hlah u; zeicahtiah hi raldohnak cu nanmah ta a si lo, Pathian i a si.","ref":"Deu 20.1-4"},"16":{"text":"Thaizing ah vung do hna u; zohhmanh, Ziz hung kainak khan an hung lai; nelrawn dongh, Jeruel ramlak nichuahlei ah khan nan hmuh hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Hi i tuknak chungah hin nannih nih nan tuk a hau lai lo; nan um hmun kha i tlaih u law dai tein dir ko u law nanmah ca i Bawipa nih teinak an tuahpiakmi hna kha zoh ko u, maw Judah le Jerusalem hna,’ a ti. Nan thinphang hlah u, nan lungdong hlah u; thaizing ah chuahhnawh hna u law Bawipa cu nan sinah a um lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 14.13-14"},"18":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat nih vawlei lei zoh in a lu a khun i Judah ram mi vialte le Jerusalem mi vialte kha Bawipa hmaiah an bawk i Bawipa kha an biak."},"19":{"text":"Cun Levi mi Kohath pawl hna le Korah pawl hna kha Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu aw thang piin thangṭhat awkah an dir."},"20":{"text":"Cun zingka tein an tho i Tekoa ramlak ah khan an va kal; cun an kal lioah khan Jehoshafat cu a dir i, “Judah ram mi hna le Jerusalem mi hna, ka bia thei tuah u! Bawipa nan Pathian cu zum u law fehter nan si lai; a profet hna kha zum hna u law nan hlawh a tling lai,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun mizapi kha ruahnak a hal hna hnuah, puan thiang i aih in ralkapbu hmai i an kal pah ah: “ Bawipa sinah lawmhnak bia chim tuah u, Zeitintiah a fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” tiin a titu ding, Bawipa sinah thangṭhatnak hla a satu ding le amah cu a hlorhtu ding kha a thiah hna."},"22":{"text":"Cun annih nih hlasak le thangṭhat kha an thawk tikah Bawipa nih Ammon, Moab le Seir Tlang mi, Judah tuk awk i a rami hna kha lamhruang a ahter hna i cucaah an sung dih."},"23":{"text":"Zeitintiah Ammon mi le Moab mi hna nih khan Seir Tlang mi kha an tuk hna i an hloh cikcek hna, cun Seir i a ummi hna cu an thah dih hna hnuah anmah le anmah cu an i nawng dih."},"24":{"text":"Judah mi cu ramlak i ralvennak innsang kha an phak tikah, mibupi cu an hei zoh hna i zohhmanh, annih cu an thi i vawlei ah khan an ril liangluang ko; pakhat hmanh an luat lo."},"25":{"text":"Cun Jehoshafat le a mi hna kha hranchaw lak awkah an rat tikah saṭil tampi, thilri, hnipuan man sungmi thilri, an hmuh hna i an i phorh khawh ti lo tiangin an i lak hna. Hranchaw laknak ah cun ni thum tiang an rau, a tam hringhran ko."},"26":{"text":"A ni linak ni ah Berakal Nelrawn ah an i pum i khika ah Bawipa kha an thangṭhat; cucaah cuka hmun min cu nihin tiangin Berakah Nelrawn tiah ti a si."},"27":{"text":"Cun annih cu, Judah ram mi le Jerusalem mi vialte cu, Jehoshafat nih a hmaisat hna i an tlung, Bawipa nih an ral hna cungah a lawmhter hna caah lunglawm in an tlung."},"28":{"text":"Jerusalem ah, tingtang, thonglawi le muko he, Bawipa inn ah khan an ra."},"29":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Israel mi hna i an ral cu a tuk hna ti an theih tikah ram kip mi nih Bawipa cu an ṭih."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah a Pathian nih a velchum in dinhnak a pek caah Jehoshafat pennak cu a dai."},"31":{"text":"Cuticun Jehoshafat nih Judah ram cu a pen. Pen hram a thawk ah kum sawm thum le kum nga a ti i Jerusalem in kum kul le kum nga a pen. A nu min cu Azubah a si, Shilhi fanu a si.","title":"Jehoshafat Pennak (1Sia 22.41-50)"},"32":{"text":"A pa Asa lam kha a zul i a pial tak lo; Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi kha a tuah."},"33":{"text":"Asinain khuahrum bo kha cu a hrawk hna lo; mi zapi nih khan an pupa hna Pathian cungah khan an lung an bunh rih lo."},"34":{"text":"Jehoshafat tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang, Hanani fapa Jehu ṭialmi chanrelnak chungah an um i cucu Israel Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah khumh a si."},"35":{"text":"Mah hi hnuah hin ṭhat lonak a tuahtu Israel siangpahrang Ahaziah he khan Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat cu an i kom."},"36":{"text":"Tarshish i a kal hnga ding tilawng kha an ser hna i tilawng cu Ezion-geber ah an ser hna."},"37":{"text":"Cun Mareshah i a ummi Dodavahu fapa Eliezer nih Jehoshafat ralchanh in profet bia a chim i, “Ahaziah he nan i komh caah na ser ciami cu Bawipa nih a hrawh lai,” tiah a ti. Cun tilawng hna cu an rawk i Tarshish ah khan an kal kho lo."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jehoshafat cu a pupa hna sinah a it i a pupa hna sinah David khua ah an vui; cun a fapa Jehoram cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi.","title":"Jehoram Pennak (2Sia 8.16-24)"},"2":{"text":"Unau a ngei hna, Jehoshafat fapa hna kha: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekhariah, Azariah, Mikhael le Shefatiah an si; an dihlak hin Judah siangpahrang Jehoshafat fapa an si."},"3":{"text":"An pa nih laksawng ngan pipi sui laksawng, ngun laksawng le man sungmi thilri laksawng kha Judah ram chung i kulhmi khua hna he tiah a pek hna; sihmanhsehlaw pennak cu Jehoram kha a pek zeicahtiah amah cu a fapa upa bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Jehoram cu a pa bawi ṭhutdan cung i a kai i a feh tikah, a unau vialte cu vainam in a thah hna i Judah ram bawi a cheukhat zong kha a thah hna."},"5":{"text":"Jehoram cu siangpahrang a can tikah kum sawm thum le kum hnih a si i Jerusalem in kum riat a uk."},"6":{"text":"Cun Ahab innchungkhar nih an tuah bantuk khan, Israel siangpahrang hna lam kha a zul; zeitintiah a nupi cu Ahab fanu a si. Cun Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah."},"7":{"text":"Asinain, David sin i biakamnak a sermi ruangah khan le amah le a fapa hna cu zungzal in meiinn kan pek lai tiah bia a kam caah Bawipa nih David innchungkhar kha hrawh a duh lo.","ref":"1Sia 11.36"},"8":{"text":"Amah chan ah cun Edom nih Judah uknak kha a doh i anmah tein siangpahrang an i chiah ve.","ref":"Gen 27.40"},"9":{"text":"Cun Jehoram le a ralbawi hna le a rangleng vialte hna cu an i chawk i amah le a rangleng ralbawi a kulhtu hna kha zan ah a tuk hna i an thah hna."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Edom nih Judah uknak cu nihin tiang hin a doh. Cun kha caan ah khan, Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian cu a hlawt caah Libnah zong nih khan a uknak kha a doh."},"11":{"text":"Cuhleiah Judah tlang ram ah khan khuahrum bo a ser hna i Jerusalem khuami kha zumhawktlak lo sinak chungah a luhpi hna i Judah mi kha lam a pialter hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun a sinah profet Elijah sinin ca pakhat a ra i, “Hi bangin, Bawipa, na pa David i a Pathian nih, ‘Na pa Jehoshafat lam kha na zulh hna lo i Judah siangpahrang Asa lam zong kha na zulh hna lo i,"},"13":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Israel siangpahrang hna lam kha na zulh hna i Ahab innchungkhar nih Israel mi an pialter hna bang khan nangmah nih Judah ram mi hna le Jerusalem mi hna kha na pialter hna i nangmah nakin a ṭha deuhmi na unau hna, na pa innchungkhar mi a simi hna kha na thah hna caah,"},"14":{"text":"zohhmanh, na mi hna le na fale hna le na nupi hna le na ngeihmi vialte cungah Bawipa nih rai nganpi a tlunter lai i"},"15":{"text":"nangmah cu paw fah zawtnak a fakmi na ngei lai i ni khat hnu ni khat in na ril cu cu zawtnak ruangah cun a chuak lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Ethiopia mi hna pawng i a ummi Filistin mi hna le Arab mi hna thinhunnak cu Jehoram cungah khan Bawipa nih a thawhter i"},"17":{"text":"Judah cu an hunhnawh i an chim i siangpahrang inn chung thil a si tiah an hmuhmi vialte le a fapa hna le a nupi hna zong kha an kalpi dih hna i a fapa hniang bik Jehoahaz dah ti lo kha cu fapa pakhat hmanh an nganh ta lo."},"18":{"text":"Cun mah hi thil vialte dih hin Bawipa nih a paw ah a dam kho lomi zawtnak a tlunter."},"19":{"text":"Cun kum hnih hnuah cu zawtnak ruangah cun a ril cu an chuak i nganfak ngaingai in a thi. A mi hna nih, a pupa hna ca i rak tuahmi meiphu bantuk kha an tuah lo."},"20":{"text":"Pen hram a thawk ah kum sawm thum le kum riat a si i Jerusalem in kum riat a pen; cun ahohmanh ngaihchiat loin a thi. David khua chungah khan an vui; sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang hna thlan ah khan cun an vui lo."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem khuami hna nih cun a fapa hniang bik Ahaziah kha amah hmun ah cun siangpahrang ah an ser; zeitintiah Arab mi hna he riahhmun i a rami hna nih khan a fapa upa deuh vialte kha cu an thah dih hna. Cucaah Judah siangpahrang Jehoram fapa Ahaziah cu bawi ah a cang.","title":"Ahaziah Pennak (2Sia 8.25-29)"},"2":{"text":"Ahaziah cu pen hram a thawk ah kum sawm li le kum hnih a si i Jerusalem in kum khat a pen. A nu min cu Athaliah a si, amah cu Omri tunu a si."},"3":{"text":"Amah zong cu Ahab innchungkhar lam kha a zul ve, zeicahtiah ṭhat lonak tuah i amah fim a chimtu cu a nu kha a si."},"4":{"text":"Ahab innchungkhar nih an rak tuah bang khan, amah zong nih Bawipa mithmuh i ṭhat lonak kha a tuah; a pa thih hnuah, anmah cu ṭhat lonak tuahnak leiah khan fim a chimtu an si."},"5":{"text":"An fimchimhning bang khan a zulh i Ahab fapa Joram, Israel siangpahrang sinah khan Siria siangpahrang Hazael cu tuk awkah Ramoth-gilead ah a kal. Cun Siria mi hna nih cun Joram cu an hliam i"},"6":{"text":"Siria siangpahrang Hazael he an i tuk tikah Ramah i hma an banhmi kha i conghhramh awkah Jezreel khua ah a kir ṭhan. Cun Ahab fapa Joram cu a zawt caah khan amah cu Jezreel khua i vung zoh awkah Jehoram fapa Ahaziah Judah siangpahrang cu a vung kal."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a rak ruahning ah hin Ahaziah ṭumchuknak cu Joram a vung tlawnnak hin tlung dingin a rak si. Zeitintiah khika a phak tikah Joram he khan an chuak i Bawipa nih Ahab innchungkhar hrawktu dingah chiti a thuhmi Jehu, Nimshi fapa kha an ton."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jehu nih Ahab innchungkhar cungah biakhiahnak kha a tlunter tikah khan, Judah ram bawi hna le Ahaziah unau hna fapa hna, Ahaziah a bultawltu kha a ton hna i a thah hna."},"9":{"text":"Ahaziah cu a kawl i Samaria i aa thuh lioah khan an va tlaih, Jehu sinah an ratpi i amah cu an thah. Amah cu an vui, zeicahtiah annih nih, “Amah cu Jehoshafat, Bawipa kha a lungthin dihlak in a kawltu tupa a si caah,” tiah an ti. Cun Ahaziah innchungkhar lakah ram kha a peng khotu ding an um lo."},"10":{"text":"Ahaziah nu Athaliah nih khan a fapa a thih kha a hngalh tikah, a tho i Judah innchungkhar siangpahrang chungle vialte kha a thah dih hna.","title":"Athaliah Nih Siangpahrang Ṭhutdan A Fir (2Sia 11.1-20)"},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang fanu Jehoshabeath nih Ahaziah fapa Joash kha aa lak i thah awk a simi siangpahrang fapa dang hna sin khan a zampi i amah le a cawngtunu cu ihnak dal chungah a chiah hna. Cuticun Siangpahrang Jehoram fanu Jehoshabeath, tlangbawi Jehoiada nupi a simi nih cun, amah cu Ahaziah far a si caah, Athaliah sin khan a thuh i cucaah a that lo;"},"12":{"text":"cun an sinah cun kum ruk a um, Pathian inn chungah khan an thuh ko; Athaliah nih khan ram cu a pen."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kum sarihnak kum ah Jehoiada cu a ral a hung ṭha i a zaza pawl haotu hna Jehoram fapa Azariah, Jehonan fapa Ishmael, Obed fapa Azariah, Adaiah fapa Maaseiah le Zikhri fapa Elishafat hna he khan biakamnak an tuah."},"2":{"text":"Cun Judah ram chungah khan an i chawk i Judah ram chung khua vialte khan Levi mi hna le Israel innchungkhar i lu a si ciomi hna kha an pumh hna i Jerusalem ah an ra."},"3":{"text":"Cun aa pummi vialte nih siangpahrang he Pathian inn chungah khan biakamnak an tuah. Cun Jehoiada nih a thawh hna i, “Zohhmanh u, siangpahrang fapa hi! Bawipa nih David fapa hna kong ah a chim bantuk khan amah hi ukter ko u.","ref":"2Sam 7.12"},"4":{"text":"Mah hihi nan tuah awk thil cu a si lai: Nannih tlangbawi le Levi mi sabbath ni i rian a ṭuanmi hna, cheu thum cheu khat cu kutka hngaktu nan si lai,"},"5":{"text":"cun cheu thum cheu khat cu siangpahrang inn ah nan um lai i cheu thum cheu khat cu Hram Kutka ah nan um lai; cun mi zapi vialte cu Bawipa inntual ah khan an um lai."},"6":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna le rian a ṭuantu Levi mi hna dah ti lo cu ahohmanh Bawipa inn chungah lut hlah u; annih cu an thian caah an lut kho lai; sihmanhsehlaw zapi vialte nih cun Bawipa nawl kha an zulh awk a si lai."},"7":{"text":"Levi mi hna nih an hriam kha i put cio in siangpahrang kha an kulh lai i inn chungah a lutmi paoh cu thah an si lai. Siangpahrang cu a luh a chuah tikah a sinah nan um lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Levi mi hna le Judah ram mi vialte hna nih khan tlangbawi Jehoiada nawl pek bang cun an tuah: an minung cio kha sabbath ni i rian a ngei ding he a ngei lo ding he khan an i ratpi hna; zeicahtiah Jehoiada nih khan rian thiahmi bu hna kha a ṭinter hna lo.","title":"Joash Cu Bawi Luchin An Chinh (2Sia 11.9-12)"},"9":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Jehoiada nih khan fei hna le phaw a ngan pawl le a hme pawl, Siangpahrang David ta a rak si i Pathian inn chungah an rak chiahmi hna kha, haotu pawl cu a pek hna;"},"10":{"text":"cun mizapi cu an dihlak in, an hriam kha i put cio ah, inn cu a thlanglei le a chaklei in kulh in, biakṭheng velchum le inn velchum ah cun, siangpahrang cawngtu ah a chiah hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang fapa cu a rak chuahpi i bawi luchin cu a chinh i hngalhternak bia kha a pek; cun siangpahrang a si tiah an thanh i Jehoiada le a fapa hna nih khan chiti an thuh i, “Siangpahrang cu saupi nung ko seh!” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Athaliah nih mi zapi cu an tlik an choipah in siangpahrang an thangṭhat kha a hmuh tikah, Bawipa inn chungah mi zapi sinah khan a vung lut;"},"13":{"text":"cun a hei zoh tikah luhnak ka ah khan siangpahrang cu a tungpi pawng i a dir i siangpahrang pawngah cun haotu pawl le muko tumtu hna an um le ramchung mi vialte cu an i lawm i muko an tum i an hlasatu pawl hna nih an awdawh tumnak thilri hna he conglawmh tuahnak cu an hrui hna kha a hmuh. Cun Athaliah nih a puan kha a thleh hna i, “Rawinak a si! Rawinak a si!” tiah a au."},"14":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Jehoiada nih ralkapbu cung i thiahmi haotu pawl kha a rak chuahpi hna i, “Amah cu ralkap hna lak khan rak chuahpi u; ahohmanh amah a zulmi cu vainam in thah a si lai,” tiah a ti. Zeitintiah tlangbawi nih cun, “Amah, cu Bawipa inn chungah cun that hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah an tlaih i siangpahrang inn Rang Kutka luhnak ah khan a lut i khika ah amah cu an thah."},"16":{"text":"Cun Jehoiada nih amah le mizapi hna le siangpahrang karlak ah khan, annih cu Bawipa mi si awkah biakamnak a ser."},"17":{"text":"Khi tikah mi vialte cu Baal inn ah khan an va kal i an ṭheh i a biakṭheng hna le a milem hna cu an khuai dih hna; cun Baal tlangbawi Mattan kha biakṭheng hna hmaiah cun an thah."},"18":{"text":"Cun Moses phungbia chungah aa ṭial bangin, lawmhpah le hlasak pah in David nawl pekning in Bawipa sin i khangh thawinak pekchanh awkah David nih Bawipa inn zohkhenhtu ah a chiahmi Levi tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kut tangah khan, Jehoiada nih Bawipa inn cawngtu kha a chiah hna."},"19":{"text":"Ahohmanh zei bantuk thian lonak hmanh in a thiang lomi paoh cu an luh nakhnga lo, Bawipa inn kutka ah khan kutka hngaktu a chiah hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun ralbawi pawl le tuavon pawl le mi a uktu hna le ramchung mi vialte kha a lak hna i annih nih siangpahrang cu Bawipa inn khan an runpi i cunglei kutka khan siangpahrang inn ah an ra. Cun siangpahrang cu siangpahrang bawi ṭhutdan cungah khan an ṭhutter."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah ram chungah mi vialte cu an i lawm; Athaliah kha vainam in an thah hnuah cun khua kha a dai."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Joash cu pen hram a thawk ah khan kum sarih a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm li a pen; a nu min cu Zibiah a si, amah cu Beersheba khuami a si.","title":"Joash Pennak (2Sia 11.21—12.21)"},"2":{"text":"Tlangbawi Jehoiada chan chung cu Joash nih Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi kha a tuah."},"3":{"text":"Jehoiada nih nupi pahnih a ṭhitpiak i fapa hna le fanu hna a ngeih hna."},"4":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin Joash nih Bawipa inn remh ṭhan kha a timh."},"5":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha a pumh hna i, “Judah ram chung khua ah khan va kal u law, Israel mi vialte sinin kum khat hnu kum khat nan Pathian inn cu remh awkah phaisa va khawl hna u; cun cu rian cu khulrang in va tuah u,” tiah a ti hna. Sihmanhsehlaw Levi mi hna kha an i rianranh hlei lo."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nih upa bik Jehoiada kha a auh i, “ Bawipa sal Moses nih Israel mi bu cu hngalhternak thlam caah nan thawh lai tiin a timi hna ngunkhuai cu, Judah ram le Jerusalem khuami kha thawhter hna u tiah zeicahdah Levi mi kha na fial hna lo?” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 30.11-16"},"7":{"text":"Zeicahdah tiah kha misual nu Athaliah fapa hna nih khan Bawipa inn kha an bauh i Bawipa inn chung i pekchanhmi thil vialte zong kha Baal caah an hman dih."},"8":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang nih nawlbia a ser i kuang pakhat an ser i Bawipa inn kutka lengah khan an chiah."},"9":{"text":"Cun Pathian sal Moses nih ramlak ah Israel mi cu nan thawh lai ti in a rak timi hna ngunkhuai kha Bawipa ca i rak put awkah, Judah ram le Jerusalem khua ah khan thawng an thanh hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun bawi vialte le mi vialte kha an lung aa lawm i an dih hlantiang an tangka cu an rak put hna i kuang chungah khan an sanh hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun Levi mi hna nih kuang cu siangpahrang i a bawi pawl sinah khan an rak put fate, annih nih a chungah tangka tampi a um ti an hmuh tikah, siangpahrang caṭialtu le tlangbawi upa bik i a bawi kha an ra i kuang kha an tlen i an lak i a umnak ah khan an chiah ṭhan tawn. Cuticun ni khat hnu ni khat an tuah i tangka tampi an khawmh."},"12":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang le Jehoiada nih khan Bawipa inn rian a latu hna sinah khan an pek hna i annih nih Bawipa inn remhnak caah cun lung lei zungthiam le zungthiam kha an lak hna, cun Bawipa inn remh awk caah khan thir lei zungthiam le dar lei zungthiam zong an lak fawn hna."},"13":{"text":"Cuticun rian ṭuan awk i fialmi hna nih khan an ṭuan i an kut chungah inn remhnak rian cu ṭha tein a kal i Bawipa inn cu a sining ding kha an siter ṭhan i an fehter."},"14":{"text":"Cun an lim tikah phaisa a tangmi kha siangpahrang le Jehoiada hmaiah khan an rak put i cu cun Bawipa inn ca i umkheng, biaknak ca le khangh thawinak ca i kha an ser hna i zihmui ca kheng tete le sui umkheng le ngun umkheng zong kha an ser hna. Cun Jehoiada chan chung cu Bawipa inn chungah khan khangh thawinak kha an pekchanh camcin ko."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jehoiada cu a tar, a upa i a thi; amah cu a thih ah kum za le kum sawm thum a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun Israel mi hna sin le Pathian le a inn caah thil ṭha a tuah caah David khua chungah, siangpahrang hna sinah khan an vui."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jehoiada thih hnuah khan Judah ram bawi hna cu an ra i siangpahrang sinah cun upatnak an tuah i siangpahrang nih an bia cu a ngaih hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun annih nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian inn kha an hlawt i Asherim le siasal kha an rian an ṭuan hna. Cun hi an mawhnak ruangah hin Judah le Jerusalem cungah thinhunnak a tlung."},"19":{"text":"Asinain, Bawipa sin i kirpi ṭhan awkah khan profet kha a thlahhnawh hna, sihmanhsehlaw zei ah an rel hna lo."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah tlangbawi Jehoiada fapa Zekhariah kha Pathian thlarau nih a tlunhnawh i mizapi cungah cun a dir i a thawh hna i, “Hi bangin Pathian nih, ‘Zeicahdah Bawipa nawlbia kha nan buar? Cucaah pei khua awng nan pemh khawh lo cu. Nannih nih Bawipa kha nan hlawt caah amah nih an hlawt ve hna,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 23.35; Luk 11.51"},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an rawi i siangpahrang nawl in amah cu Bawipa inn tual ah khan lung in an cheh."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun siangpahrang a simi Joash nih khan, Zekhariah pa Jehoiada nih a cung i zaangfahnak a rak tuahmi kha a hngal duh lo i a fapa kha a thah. Cun a thih lioah khan, “ Bawipa nih hmu seh law phuhlam ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cu kum a donghnak ah Siria ralkapbu nih khan Joash cu an hung tuk. Judah ram le Jerusalem khua ah khan an ra i mi zapi hna lak khan mi zapi i an bawi hna cu an thah hna i an hranchaw vialte cu Damaskas siangpahrang kha an kuat dih."},"24":{"text":"Siria ralkapbu cu mi tlawmte he an ra ko na in, annih kut chungah khan Bawipa nih ralkapbu nganpi cu a pek hna, zeicahtiah annih nih Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian kha an hlawt. Cuticun Joash cungah biaceihnak kha an tlunter."},"25":{"text":"Annih nih an tluntak tikah, hma fak ngaingai a ing in an kaltak, tlangbawi Jehoiada fapa thisen ruangah khan a sinum hna nih an rawi i a ihkhun cungah an thah. Cucaah a thi i David khua chungah an vui, sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang hna thlan ah khan cun an vui lo."},"26":{"text":"Amah a rawitu hna cu Ammon minu Shimeath fapa Zabad le Moab minu Shimrith fapa Jehozabad an si."},"27":{"text":"A fapa hna kong le amah ralchanh in chimmi bia tampi le Pathian inn sak ṭhannak kong cu Siangpahrang hna Cauk Fianternak cauk ah an i ṭial. Cun a fapa Amaziah cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amaziah cu pennak hram a thawk tikah kum kul le kum nga a si i Jerusalem in kum kul le kum kua a pen. A nu min cu Jeho-addan a si, amah cu Jerusalem khuami a si.","title":"Amaziah Pennak (2Sia 14.1-22)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa mithmuh ah a dikmi kha a tuah, asinain, soisel awk um lo lung he a si lo."},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang lianhngannak kha a kut chungah fek tein a um cangka, siangpahrang a pa a rak thattu a sinum kha a thah hna."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moses cauk chung i phungbia ah aa ṭialmi chung i, “Pale hna cu fale can ah thah an si lai lo i fale hna zong pale can ah thah an si lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw mahle sualnak ruang cio ah ahohmanh thah an si lai,” tiin Bawipa nawl pekmi ning khan, an fale cu a that hna lo.","ref":"Deu 24.16"},"5":{"text":"Cun Amaziah nih Judah rammi kha a pumh hna i Judah le Benjamin dihlak ca i a thong pawl haotu hna le a za pawl haotu hna tangah khan an pale chungkhar ning cio ah a chiah hna. Kum kul le a cunglei mi kha a pumh hna i annih cu thim khunmi sing thum, raldoh awk ca i aa tlakmi, fei le phaw a tlai kho an si kha a hmuh."},"6":{"text":"Cun ngun talen sing khat in Israel ram i a ṭhawng i ral a ṭhami sing khat zong a roih hna."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian mi pakhat a sinah a ra i, “Maw siangpahrang, Israel ralkapbu cu na sinah kalter hna hlah, zeicahtiah Israel mi, hi Efraim mi vialte hna sinah hin Bawipa a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nang nih hi lam hin raldohnak ah ka ṭhawng lai tiin na ruah ahcun, ral hmaiah khan Pathian nih nang cu an hlonh ko lai; zeitintiah Pathian nih cun bawmh khawhnak le hlonh khawhnak ṭhawnnak a ngei,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Amaziah nih Pathian mi cu a thawh i, “Sihmanhsehlaw Israel ralkapbu ka pek cangmi talen za khat tluk cu zeitindah ka tuah kun lai?” tiah a ti. Pathian mi nih cun a leh i, “Mah hi nak hin tam deuh pei Bawipa nih cun an pek khawh cu,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun Efraim in a sinah a rami ralkapbu kha, an inn i tlun ṭhan awkah Amaziah nih a phuah hna. Cucaah Judah cungah khan an thin a hung ngaingai i thin lin in inn ah khan an tlung."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Amaziah cu ralṭha in a um i a mi hna cu a hrui hna i Cite Nelrawn ah khan an kal i Seir mi sang khat an thah hna."},"12":{"text":"Judah mi nih a dang sang khat kha a nung in an tlaih hna i lungpang cungah an kaipi hna i lungpang cung cun an nam hna i an dihlak in an i som dih."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Amaziah nih a sinah raltuknak hmun ah kalter loin a kirtermi ralkapbu chung mi hna nih khan Judah ram khua cu Samaria in Beth-horon tiang an chim hna i cu khuami cu thong thum an thah hna i hranchaw tampi an lak."},"14":{"text":"Edom mi a thah hnanak khan a rat hnuah, Seir mi hna pathian kha a rak i phorh hna i a pathian ah aa chiah hna i a biak hna i an sinah pekchanhnak kha a tuah."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah Amaziah cungah Bawipa cu a thin a hung i profet pakhat a hei thlah i amah nih cun, “Zeicadah anmah an mi hmanh na kut chungin a chuahter kho lotu pathian, miphun dang hna pathian cu na fuhpanh hna?” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw bia a chim lioah cun siangpahrang nih khan a thawh i, “Nangmah cu siangpahrang fimchimtu ah maw kan in ser? Ngol ko! Zeicahdah thah na si lai?” tiah a ti. Cucaah profet nih cun a ngol, sihmanhsehlaw, “Mah hihi na tuah i kan chimhmi na ngaih lo caah, Pathian nih nangmah hrawk awk cu a ruah cang tiah ka hngalh,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Judah siangpahrang Amaziah nih cun khuakhannak a tuah i Israel siangpahrang Jehu fapa Jehoahaz fapa Jehoash sinah khan mi a thlah hna i, “Ra law, hmaitonh in kan i zoh tuah lai,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang Jehoash nih Judah siangpahrang Amaziah cu bia a hei cah i, “Lebanon tlang i hling pakhat nih Lebanon tlang i sidar thing pakhat sinah bia a cah i, ‘Na fanu cu ka fapa nupi caah ka pe,’ tiah a ti; cun Lebanon tlang i ramlak sahrang pakhat aa chawk i hling cu a naan dih."},"19":{"text":"Nang nih na thawh i, ‘Zohhmanh, Edom ka tei diam’, na ti i tluangkhawnnak in na lung cu aa porhlaw. Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu inn ah khan um ko; zeicahdah harnak kha thawhter i nangmah le, nangmah sinah Judah cu tlukter na duh?” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Amaziah nih a ngai duh lo; zeicahdah a si ti ahcun, anih nih Edom pathian hna kha a kawl hna caah a ral hna kut chung i pek ding kha Pathian nih a tuahmi a si."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah Israel siangpahrang Jehoash cu a hung kal i Judah siangpahrang Amaziah he cun Judah ram ta a simi Beth-shemesh khua ah khan hmaitonh in an um."},"22":{"text":"Cun Judah cu Israel nih khan a tei i anmahle an inn cio ah khan an zam dih."},"23":{"text":"Cun Israel siangpahrang Jehoash nih Ahaziah fapa Joash fapa Amaziah, Judah siangpahrang cu Beth-shemesh ah a tlaih i Jerusalem ah a kalpi i Jerusalem khua kulhnak vampang cu dong za li, Efraim Kutka in Kil Kutka tiang a chimh."},"24":{"text":"Cun sui le ngun vialte, Pathian inn chungah a ummi umkheng vialte kha a lak hna i Obededom kha a tlaih chih; siangpahrang inn i chawhlawn hna le hreng i a tang dingmi hna zong kha a tlaih hna i Samaria ah a tlung ṭhan."},"25":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang Joash fapa Amaziah cu Israel siangpahrang Jehoahaz fapa Jehoash thih hnuah kum hleinga a nung."},"26":{"text":"Amaziah tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang, Judah le Israel Siangpahrang hna Cauk ah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"27":{"text":"Bawipa sinin aa mer ri thawk khan Jerusalem ah amah rawinak kha an tuah i Lakhish ah a zam. Sihmanhsehlaw Lakhish ah cun mi an hei dawiter hna i khika ah khan an thah."},"28":{"text":"Cun rang cungin an ratpi i David khua chungah, a pupa hna sinah khan an vui."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Judah ram mi vialte nih khan kum hleiruk a timi Uzziah kha an lak i a pa Amaziah hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah an ser.","title":"Uzziah Pennak (2Sia 15.1-7)"},"2":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a pupa hna sinah a ih hnuah Eloth kha a sak i Judah ta ah a siter ṭhan."},"3":{"text":"Uzziah cu pen hram a thawk ah kum hleiruk a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm nga le kum hnih a pen. A nu min cu Jekoliah a si, Jerusalem mi a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun a pa Amaziah nih a rak tuahmi vialte bantuk khan, Bawipa mithmuh ah a dikmi kha a tuah."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihnak kha a cawnpiaktu Zekhariah chan ah khan, Pathian kawl kha aa sehchih i Bawipa a kawl chung vialte cu Pathian nih khua awng a pemhter."},"6":{"text":"A chuak i Filistin mi kha a doh hna i Gath kulhnak vampang le Jabneh kulhnak vampang le Ashdod kulhnak vampang kha a chimh dih hna; cun Ashdod ram chung le Filistin mi hna lak hmun dang ah khan khua a ser hna."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih, Filistin mi hna le Gurbaal i a ummi Arab mi hna le Meunim mi hna lakah khan amah cu a bawmh."},"8":{"text":"Ammon mi hna nih Uzziah cu ngunkhuai an pek i amah cu a ṭhawn ngaingai caah Izipt ramri tiang hmanh in a min a thang."},"9":{"text":"Cuhleiah Jerusalem ah cun Kil Kutka le Nelrawn Kutka le kulhnak vampang a kawinak ah khan innsang a sak hna i a kulh hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun chimram le nelrawn ah khan saṭil run tampi a ngeih caah ramlak ah khan innsang a sak hna i tikhor tampi a cawh hna, cun lothlawh a duh ngaingaimi a si caah tlangram le vawlei ṭhatnak hmun ah khan lothlo le mitsur nengtu kha a chiah hna."},"11":{"text":"Cuhleiah, Uzziah nih cun, siangpahrang ralbawi hna lak i pakhat Hananiah kut tang i a ummi ralkapbu, raltuk awk i a tlakmi, caṭialtu Jeiel le ralbawi Naaseiah nih an bu chung cio minung zat ningin an ṭhenmi hna cu a ngei."},"12":{"text":"Miṭhawngmi ralṭha hna, an pale innchungkhar hna an lu cio cu an dihlak ah thong hnih le za ruk an si."},"13":{"text":"Anmah kut tangah cun siangpahrang kha a ral hna tuk awkah a bawm khotu, raltuknak i a ṭhawng ngaingaimi ralkap sing thum thong sarih le za nga an um."},"14":{"text":"Cun Uzziah nih ralkap vialte caah cun phaw, fei, luchin, ngaphaw thir angki, li, le chehnak ah lung kha a timh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun thal le lung ngan pipi a kap khotu seh zungthiam pawl nih an sermi hna kha, Jerusalem ah cun innsang le a kil ah khan a chiah hna. Cun amah cu a ṭhawn tiang khuaruahhar in bawmh a si caah a min cu khuazakip ah a thang."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a hung ṭhawn tikah aa rawknak dingah a hun i porhlaw. Bawipa a Pathian sinah zumhtlak loin a um i zihmui biakṭheng i zihmui khangh awkah khan Bawipa biakinn ah cun a lut."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi Azariah nih Bawipa tlangbawi a ral a ṭhami sawm riat he a hnu in an zulh;"},"18":{"text":"cun Siangpahrang Uzziah cu an donh i, “Uzziah, nangmah nih Bawipa sinah zihmui khangh cu na tuah awk a si lo, sihmanhsehlaw Aaron fapa hna tlangbawi hna zihmui khangtu ding i thiantermi hna lawnglawng nih khan an tuah awk a si. Thil hmaan lo na tuah caah hmunthiang chung hin chuak tuah, cun hi nih hin Bawipa Pathian sinin upatnak zeihmanh an tlunh lai lo,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Exo 30.7-8; Nam 3.10"},"19":{"text":"Khi tikah Uzziah cu a thin a hung. Zihmui khanghnak ding cengceh pakhat aa put i tlangbawi hna cungah a thin a hun tikah khan, Bawipa inn chung, zihmui biakṭheng pawng, tlangbawi hna hmaika ah khan a cal ah thinghmui hma a chuak ko."},"20":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi upa bik Azariah le tlangbawi vialte nih khan amah cu an zoh i zohhmanh, amah cu a cal ah thinghmui zawtnak a ngei! Cun annih nih khulrang in an nam i amah zong kha chuah aa nam ve, zeicahtiah Bawipa nih a tuk cang."},"21":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Uzziah cu a thih ni tiang thinghmui a si lan, cun thinghmui a si caah khan Bawipa inn khan thlei a si i cucaah inn dang ah a um. Cun a fapa Jotham nih cun siangpahrang innchungkhar cu a zohkhenh i ram mi kha a uk hna."},"22":{"text":"Uzziah tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang profet Isaiah, Amoz fapa nih a ṭial."},"23":{"text":"Cun Uzziah cu a pupa hna sinah a it i, “Amah cu mithinghmui a si caah siangpahrang hna thlan ah vui loin siangpahrang hna thlanmual ah khan a pupa hna sinah an vui. Cun a fapa Jotham cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi.","ref":"Isa 6.1"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jotham cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum nga a ti i Jerusalem in kum hleiruk a pen. A nu min cu Jerushah a si, amah cu Zadok fanu a si.","title":"Jotham Pennak (2Sia 15.32-38)"},"2":{"text":"A pa Uzziah nih a tuahmi vialte ning khan Bawipa mithmuh ah thil dik kha a tuah — Bawipa biakinn bel kha a luhhnawh lo. Sihmanhsehlaw mi zapi nih khan ṭhat lonak kha an tuah lengmang ko."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa inn cunglei kutka kha a ser i Ofel vampang cungah khan inn tampi a sak."},"4":{"text":"Cuhleiah Judah tlangram ah khan khua a ser hna i thing hmawnnak tlang ah khan ralhruang le innsang a sak hna."},"5":{"text":"Ammon mi hna siangpahrang he khan an i do i a tei hna. Cun cu kum ah cun Ammon mi hna nih, ngun talen za khat le changvut phor thong hra le barli phor thong hra an pek. Ammon mi nih cu zat ṭhiamṭhiam cu a kum hnihnak le a kum thumnak ah an pek."},"6":{"text":"Jotham cu a kalning kha Bawipa a Pathian hmaiah a ningcang tein a tuah caah miṭhawng ah a cang."},"7":{"text":"Jotham tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a raldohnak vialte le a kalning hna cu, zohhmanh, Israel le Judah Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah an i ṭial."},"8":{"text":"Pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum nga a si i Jerusalem in kum hleiruk a pen."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jotham cu a pupa hna sinah a it i David khua ah an vui; cun a fapa Ahaz cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ahaz cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul a si i Jerusalem in kum hleiruk a pen. A hringsortu David bangin Bawipa mithmuh ah thil ding a tuah ve lo,","title":"Ahaz Pennak (2Sia 16.1-20)"},"2":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Israel siangpahrang hna lam tu kha a zul. Baal hna caah khan thletmi milem hmanh a ser hna;"},"3":{"text":"Hinnom fapa nelrawn ah khan zihmui a khangh i Bawipa nih Israel mi hna hmai in a dawimi miphun hna nih fihnung phunglam an tuahmi hna ning khan a fapale hna cu raithawinak ah a khangh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun khuahrum bo hna le tlang hna le thingkung hring tang kip ah raithawinak kha a tuah i zihmui kha a khangh."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa a Pathian nih amah cu Siria siangpahrang kut chungah a pek i amah nih cun a tei i a mi tampi hna cu sal ah a tlaih hna i Damaskas ah a kalpi hna. Israel siangpahrang kut chung zongah amah cu pek a si i Israel Siangpahrang nih cun a tei i tampi a thah hna.","ref":"Isa 7.1"},"6":{"text":"Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian kha an hlawt caah Remaliah fapa Pekah nih khan ni khatte ah Judah ram chungah cun sing khat le sang hnih a thah hna, an dihlak in miralṭha lawngte an si."},"7":{"text":"Cun Efraim miṭhawng Zikhri nih siangpahrang fapa Maaseiah le siangpahrang inn uktu Azrikam le nawl ngeihnak leiah siangpahrang a hun dottu Elkanah kha a thah hna."},"8":{"text":"Israel mi hna nih cun an rualchan hna chung cun nu le fapa le fanu hna sing hnih sal ah an tlaih hna; cun an sin cun hranchaw zong tampi an lak i hranchaw cu Samaria ah an kalpi."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khika ah khan Bawipa profet pakhat a rak um i a min cu Oded a si; Samaria i a kalmi ralkapbu ton awkah cun a chuak i annih cu a thawh hna i, “ Bawipa, nan pupa hna Pathian cu Judah cungah a thin a hun caah annih cu nan kut chungah an pek hna, sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih van tiang a phanmi thinhunnak in nan thah hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun atu cu nannih nih Judah mi hna le Jerusalem mi hna cu pa he nu he nan sal i zuat hna awkah nan i tim. Nannih tah Bawipa nan Pathian cungah nan sualnak a um ve lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"Cucaah ka bia ngai u, Bawipa thinhunnak ṭihnung cu nan cungah a um caah, nan rualchan hna chungin nan tlaihmi sal hna cu kua ṭhan hna u,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Efraim mi hna chung i bawi a cheu hna Johanan fapa Azariah le Meshillemoth fapa Berekhiah le Shallum fapa Jehizkiah le Hadlai fapa Amasa hna zong nih raltuknak in a rami kha an rak donh hna i,"},"13":{"text":"annih cu an thawh hna i, “Nan ral tlaihmi hna cu hika ah hin nan runpi hna hnga lo, zeicahtiah atu lio kan sualnak le mawhnak lengah hin nannih nih Bawipa cungah mawh phorhter chin nan kan timh. Kan mawhnak cu a ngan cang i Israel mi cungah thinhunnak ṭihnung a um cang,” tiah an ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah hriamnam aa putmi hna nih khan hrengtangmi hna le hranchaw hna cu bawi hna le aa pummi vialte hna hmaiah khan an kaltak hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun an min in an thiahmi hna nih khan an tho i hrengtangmi cu an lak hna i an lak i hnipuan lo i a ummi cu hranchaw chung khan hnipuan an aih hna; hnipuan an aih hna, kedan an pek hna, ei awk le din awk an pek hna i sathau an thuh hna; cun annih lak i a derthawmmi vialte kha laa an citter hna i ungkung khua an timi Jeriko khua ah cun an unau hna sinah an kalpi hna."},"16":{"text":"Khi caan ah cun Siangpahrang Ahaz nih Assiria siangpahrang sinah bawmhhal awkah mi a thlah hna."},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Edom mi nih Judah ram cu an chim ṭhan hoi i an tei hna i sal ah an i kalpi diam hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun Filistin mi hna nih Judah ram chung chimram le Negeb i a ummi khua hna kha an hranh hna i Beth-shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soko le a khuate hna, Timnah le a khuate hna, Gimzo le a khuate hna kha an lak hna i khika ah cun an um colh."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel siangpahrang Ahaz thawngin Judah cu a ṭumchukter, zeicahtiah Judah ram chungah khan thlahthlam in a um i Bawipa sinah khan zumhawktlak in a nung lo."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah Assiria siangpahrang Tiglath-pileser nih khan a rathnawh i ṭhawnter lei loin hremnak tu kha a pek."},"21":{"text":"Ahaz nih khan Bawipa inn le siangpahrang le bawi hna inn khan a ramh hna i Assiria siangpahrang kha ngunkhuai a pek; sihmanhsehlaw cu nih cun a bawm lo."},"22":{"text":"Hi Siangpahrang Ahaz ṭhiamṭhiam cu, a lung retheih caan ah hin Bawipa sinah khan zumhawktlak lo chinchin in a um."},"23":{"text":"Zeitintiah amah a teitu Damaskas pathian hna sinah khan rai a thawi i, “Siria siangpahrang hna pathian hna nih an bawmh hna caah, keimah zong an ka bawmh ve nakhnga an sinah raithawinak ka tuah lai,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu amah le Israel mi vialte rawhralnak an si."},"24":{"text":"Cun Ahaz nih Pathian inn i umkheng hna kha a khawmh hna i Pathian inn i umkheng hna cu a den dih hna i Pathian inn i innka hna cu a phih dih hna; cun Jerusalem khua a kenkip ah khan biakṭheng aa serh hna."},"25":{"text":"Judah ram chung khua kip ah khan pathian dang hna sin i zihmui khanghnak caah khuahrum bo a ser hna i Bawipa, a pupa hna Pathian cu a thin a phawh."},"26":{"text":"A tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a lam zulhmi vialte cu a hramthawk in a donghnak tiang Judah le Israel Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah an i ṭial."},"27":{"text":"Cun Ahaz cu a pupa hna sinah a it i khua chungah, Jerusalem khua chungah cun an vui; Israel siangpahrang hna thlan ah khan cun an ratpi lo. Cun a fapa Hezekiah cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi.","ref":"Isa 14.28"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hezekiah cu kum kul le kum nga a ti ah pen hram a thawk i Jerusalem in kum kul le kum kua a pen. A nu min cu Abijah a si, Zekhariah fanu a si.","title":"Hezekiah Pennak (2Sia 18.1-3)"},"2":{"text":"A pa David nih a rak tuah bantuk khan amah nih Bawipa mithmuh i a dingmi kha a tuah."},"3":{"text":"A bawi a kum khatnak, thla khatnak thla ah Bawipa inn i innka kha a hun hna i a remh hna.","title":"Hezekiah Nih Biakinn A thianh"},"4":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha a ratpi hna i nichuahlei kam tual ah khan a pumh hna i,"},"5":{"text":"annih cu a thawh hna i, “Levi mi hna, ka bia thei tuah u! Atu cu i thianh u law Bawipa nan pupa hna Pathian inn kha thianhhlimh tuah u, hmunthiang khan hmunthur kha hlonh u."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah kan pupa hna cu zumhtlak loin an um i Bawipa kan Pathian mithmuh ah a ṭha lomi thil kha an tuah; amah cu an hlawt i Bawipa umnak hmun cu kaa dang an hoihtak i an hnulei an chit."},"7":{"text":"Innleng innka zong kha an khar hna i meiinn kha an hmih hna i Israel Pathian sinah khan zihmui zong an khang lo i khangh thawinak zong an pechan lo."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa thinhunnak cu Judah le Jerusalem cungah a tlung i tuksapur, khuaruahhar le serhsat awk thil ah, nannih nih nan mit hrim i nan hmuh bang hin a ser hna."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah zohhmanh u, hi ruangah hin kan pupa hna cu vainam in an rak thi i kan fapa le kan fanu le kan nupi hna cu sal ah an rak tang."},"10":{"text":"Ṭih a nungmi thinhunnak cu kan sinin aa mer nakhnga, Bawipa, Israel Pathian sin i biakamnak ser cu atu cu ka lung i a ummi a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka fapale hna, atu cu thluarthlap in um hlah u, zeitintiah Bawipa nih nannih cu a hmai i dir awk le amah rianṭuan awk le amah rianṭuantu si awk le amah sinah zihmui khangh awkah an thim hna,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Khi tikah Levi mi cu an tho, Amasai fapa Mahath, Azariah fapa Joel, Kohath mi hna fapa hna; cun Merari fapa hna chungin, Abdi fapa Kish, Jehallelel fapa Azariah; cun Gershon mi hna chungin Zimmah fapa Joah, Joah fapa Eden;"},"13":{"text":"Elizafan fapa hna chungin, Shimri le Jeuel; cun Asaf fapa hna chungin, Zekhariah le Mattaniah;"},"14":{"text":"Heman fapa hna chungin, Jehuel le Shimei; Jeduthun fapa hna chungin, Shemaiah le Uzziel."},"15":{"text":"An unaule kha an pumh hna i anmah kha an i thianh i Bawipa bia in siangpahrang nih nawl a pek hna bangin, Bawipa inn thianh awkah cun an lut."},"16":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna cu Bawipa inn chungchin thianh awkah khan an lut i Bawipa biakinn chungah thurhhnawmhnak an hmuhmi vialte kha Bawipa inn inntual ah an chuahpi hna i Levi mi hna nih khan an lak i Kidron tivarek ah khan an kalpi."},"17":{"text":"Thianhhlimh cu thla khatnak thla a ni khat ni ah an thawk i cu thla ni riat ni ah cun Bawipa innleng kha an phan; cun ni riat chung Bawipa inn cu an thianh i cu thla ni hleiruk ni ah cun an lim."},"18":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Hezekiah sinah cun an va lut i, “ Bawipa inn kha kan thianh dih cang, khangh thawinak biakṭheng le a umkheng vialte, hun camcinmi changreu cabuai le a umkheng vialte, kan thianh dih hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun zumhtlaklo a si tikah Siangpahrang Ahaz nih a hlawtmi umkheng vialte kha kan timh dih hna i kan thianh dih hna; cun zohhmanh, Bawipa biakṭheng hmaiah an um,” tiah an ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Hezekiah cu zingka tein a tho i khua chung bawi kha a pumh hna i Bawipa inn ah khan a hung kal."},"21":{"text":"Cun ram le hmunthiang le Judah ca i sual thawinak caah cawtum pasarih, tuukawng pasarih, tuufa pasarih le mehehtum pasarih an rak put hna. Cun Aaron fapa tlangbawi hna kha Bawipa biakṭheng cung i pekchanh awkah nawl a pek hna."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah cawtum kha an thah hna i tlangbawi nih an thi kha an lak i biakṭheng kha an theh; cun tuukawng kha an thah hna i an thi khan biakṭheng kha an theh; cun tuufa kha an thah hna i an thi khan biakṭheng kha an theh."},"23":{"text":"Cun sual thawinak ca mehehtum kha siangpahrang le aa pummi hna sinah khan an ratpi hna i an cungah an kut an chuan i"},"24":{"text":"tlangbawi hna nih khan an thah hna i an thi cun Israel mi vialte ca i remnak sernak ah biakṭheng cungah khan sual thawinak an tuah. Zeitintiah siangpahrang nih khan khangh thawinak kha le sual thawinak kha Israel mi vialte caah tuah awk a si lai tiin nawl a pek hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun David le siangpahrang i a hmutu Gad le profet Nathan nawl peknak ning khan, Levi mi cu Bawipa inn chungah khan sumsel le tingtang le thonglawi he tiah a chiah hna; zeitintiah nawlbia cu Bawipa sinin a profet hna hmang in a ra."},"26":{"text":"Levi mi hna cu David thilri he khan an dir i tlangbawi hna cu muko he khan an dir."},"27":{"text":"Khi tikah Hezekiah nih, khangh thawinak cu biakṭheng cungah pekchanh si seh tiah nawl a pek. Cun khangh thawinak cu thawk a si tikah, Bawipa sin hlasak le muko tum cu David nih a sermi hlasaknak thilri he khan an thawk ve."},"28":{"text":"Aa pummi nih cun an zapi in an biak, hlasatu nih khan hla an sak, muko tumtu nih khan muko an tum; mah vialte hi khangh thawinak a dih hlantiang an tuah."},"29":{"text":"Cun pekchanhnak kha a dih tikah, siangpahrang le a sin i a ummi vialte nih khan an lu an khun i an biak."},"30":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang Hezekiah le bawi hna nih khan Levi mi hna cu David bia le hmutu Asaf bia in Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat u, tiah nawl an pek hna. Cun annih nih lunglawmhnak in thangṭhatnak hla kha an sak i an kun i an biak."},"31":{"text":"Khi tikah Hezekiah nih, “Nannih nih Bawipa sinah nan i thianh cang; ra u law raithawinak le lawmhnak thawinak cu Bawipa inn ah rak pu tuah hna u,” tiah a ti. Cun aa pummi nih raithawinak hna le lawmhnak thawinak hna kha an rak put i duhnak lungthin a ngeimi paoh nih khan khangh thawinak an rak put."},"32":{"text":"Aa pummi nih khangh thawinak an rak putmi cu cawtum sawm sarih, tuukawng za khat le tuufa za hnih an si; mah vialte hi Bawipa sin i khangh thawinak caah a si."},"33":{"text":"Cun thilthiang pekchanhmi cu cawtum za ruk le tuu thong thum an si."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi cu an tlawm tuk caah khangh thawinak sa vialte cu a phaw an hawk cawk hna lo, cucaah tlangbawi dang hna nih an i thianh hlantiang, an unau Levi mi hna nih khan rian cu a dih tiang an bawmh hna — zeicahtiah Levi mi hna cu lungthin ah tlangbawi hna nih an i thianhnak nakkhan an ding deuh."},"35":{"text":"Khangh thawinak tampi lengah cun daihnak thawinak ca i sathau le khangh thawinak ca i thletmi an um. Cuticun Bawipa inn i rianṭuannak cu umter ṭhan a si."},"36":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih mi zapi ca i a tuahmi caah khan Hezekiah le mi vialte cu an i lawm; zeicahtiah cu thil cu duak tiah a hung ummi a si ko."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, Israel Pathian i Lanhtak Puai cu ulh awkah annih nih Bawipa inn ah Jerusalem ah an rat nakhnga, Hezekiah nih Israel ram le Judah ram ah mi a thlah hna i Efraim le Manasseh ram zongah ca a kuat hna.","title":"Lanhtak Puai Tuahnak"},"2":{"text":"Zeicahtiah siangpahrang le a bawi pawl hna le Jerusalem i aa pummi vialte nih Lanhtak Puai cu thla hnihnak thla i ulh dingin bia an khiah —","ref":"Nam 9.9-11"},"3":{"text":"zeicahtiah tlangbawi hna kha a za in an i thianh kho lo i mi zong kha Jerusalem ah an i pumh lo caah a caan ah khan an ul kho lo —"},"4":{"text":"cu khuakhannak cu siangpahrang le aa pummi vialte nih a ding tiah an ruah."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Israel ram chung dihlak khan, Beersheba in Dan tiang thawng thanh i Jerusalem ah nan ra lai i Bawipa, Israel Pathian i Lanhtak Puai cu nan hman lai tiin mizapi kha thawngthanh awkah khan bia an chuah; zeicahtiah an tining bang khan tampi nih an hmang lo."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nawl peknak bang khan ca phortu kha Israel le Judah ram vialte ah khan siangpahrang le a bawi pawl hna ca kha an i phorh i an kal, siangpahrang nih cun, “Maw Israel mi hna, Bawipa, Abraham, Isak le Israel Pathian sinah cun kir ṭhan u law Assiria siangpahrang hna kut in a luatmi nannih a tangmi hna leiah hin aa mer ṭhan ve lai."},"7":{"text":"Nan pupa hna le nan unau hna, Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian sinah zumhtlaklo an si ca i nannih nih nan hmuh bangin, a hrawhmi hna bantuk hi si hlah u."},"8":{"text":"Nannih cu nan pupa hna bantuk khan hngawngṭhawng si hlah u, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa sinah khan i pe u law zungzal ca in a thiantermi a hmunthiang ah khan ra u, cun a thinhunnak ṭihnung cu nan sinin aa mer nakhnga Bawipa nan Pathian cu a rian ṭuan u."},"9":{"text":"Zeitintiah nannih nih Bawipa sinah khan nan kir ṭhan ahcun nan unau hna le nan fale hna nih khan annih a tlaitu hna sin khan zaangfahnak an hmuh lai i hi ram ah hin an kir ṭhan lai. Zeicahtiah Bawipa nan Pathian cu velngeih thiam le zaangfah thiam a si i amah sinah nan kir ṭhan ahcun nannih kha khuadang an hoitak hna lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah ca phortu hna cu khua khat hnu khua khat in Efraim le Manasseh ram ah cun, cun Zebulun ram tiangin an kal; sihmanhsehlaw an rak nihsawh hna i zeihmanh ah an rel hna lo."},"11":{"text":"Asher mi tlawmte, Manasseh mi tlawmte le Zebulun mi tlawmte lawng nih toidornak lungthin an ngei i Jerusalem ah cun an ra."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa bia in siangpahrang le a bawi pawl nih an chimhmi hna tuah awk i lungthin khat ngeih awkah Pathian kut cu Judah cungah khan a um fawn."},"13":{"text":"Cun thilnu telh lo changreu puai cu thla hnihnak thla i hman awkah Jerusalem ah mi tampi an ra, aa pummi cu an tam ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"Cun rian cu an thawk i Jerusalem i a ummi biakṭheng vialte kha an ṭhial i zihmui khanghnak biakṭheng vialte kha an lak hna i Kidron horkuang ah an hlonh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun Lanhtak tuufa kha thla hnihnak thla i ni hleili ni ah khan an thah. Cun tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna cu an ning a zak i cucaah an i thianh i Bawipa inn chungah khan khangh thawinak kha an rak put."},"16":{"text":"Pathian mi Moses phungbia ning khan annih nih an umnak tawn hmun ah khan an um; Levi mi kut in an hmuhmi thisen cu tlangbawi hna nih khan an hlonh."},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah aa pummi chungah khan aa thianh lomi tampi an um; cucaah a thiang lomi ca paoh ah khan Levi mi nih Lanhtak tuufa kha thah a herh, tuufa cu Bawipa sinah a thiang i ser awkah."},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mi tampi, Efraim mi, Manasseh mi, Issakhar mi le Zebulun mi tampi hna cu an i thianh lo i asinain a ningcang si lo khan lanhtak puai cu an ei ve ko. Zeitintiah Hezekiah nih annih cu thla a campiak hna i,"},"19":{"text":"“Pathian, Bawipa an pupa hna Pathian cu a lungthin in kawl aa timmi paoh cu, hmunthiang chung i i thianhnak phung ningin a tuah lo hmanh ah, a ṭhami Bawipa nih cun ngaithiam ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Hezekiah cu a theih i mi cu a damter hna."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem i a ummi Israel mi hna nih cun thilnu telh lo changreu puai cu ni sarih chung lunglawm ngaingai in an hman; cun Levi mi hna le tlangbawi hna nih khan Bawipa cu ni fate an thangṭhat i Bawipa cu an thazang dihlak in hla in an hlorh."},"22":{"text":"Cun Bawipa rian ṭuannak i thiamnak ṭha a langhtertu Levi mi kha Hezekiah nih a forh chin hna. Cucaah cu puai rawl cu mi zapi nih khan ni sarih an ei i Bawipa an pupa hna Pathian sinah khan daihnak thawinak an pekchanh i lawmhnak kha an pek."},"23":{"text":"Cun aa pummi nih cun an ningpi in puai cu a dang ni sarih tuah rih awk kha an hna a tla; cucaah lunglawmhnak in ni sarih an tuah rih."},"24":{"text":"Zeitintiah Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah nih aa pummi cu cawtum thong khat le tuu thong sarih, pekchanh awk caah a pek hna i bawi pawl nih aa pummi cu cawtum thong khat le tuu thong hra an pek hna. Cun tlangbawi kha tam piin an i thianh."},"25":{"text":"Judah mi aa pummi an ning piin, tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna he, cun Israel ram in a rami mipem hna, cun Judah ram i a ummi miphun hna cu an i lawm."},"26":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang David fapa Solomon chan hnu khan hi bantuk hi Jerusalem ah a um ti lo caah Jerusalem ah lunglawmhnak nganpi a um."},"27":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha an dir i mi kha bongmal an sawmh hna i an aw cu theih a si i an thlacamnak cu vancung i a umnak hmunthiang kha a phan."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun hi vialte hi a dih tikah, cuka i a ummi Israel mi vialte kha Judah ram khua an khan an kal i an dihlak in an hrawh dih hna hlantiang, Judah le Benjamin le Efraim le Manasseh ram chung dihlak i a ummi tung hna kha an den cikcek hna i Asherim kha an hau hna i khuahrum bo le biakṭheng kha an chimh hna. Cun Israel mi vialte cu an khua le an ram cio ah an tlung."},"2":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha a phuphu in a ṭhen hna, a phuphu in an rianṭuanning cio khan Levi mi hna le tlangbawi hna cu khangh thawinak ca le daihnak thawinak ca le Bawipa riahhmun kutka i rianṭuantu ding hna le lawmhnak le thangṭhatnak petu hna tiin a chiah hna.","title":"Hezekiah Nih Tlangbawi le Levi Mi Thil A Pekmi Hna"},"3":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih amah ngeihmi chungin a thawhmi cu, Bawipa phungbia chungah aa ṭial bangin, zingfate le zanleifate tuahmi khanghthawinak, thla thar le sabbath le caan ngeimi puai hna i pekchanhmi saṭil kha an si.","ref":"Nam 28.1—29.39"},"4":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha Bawipa phungbia ah an i pek khawh nakhnga, Jerusalem mi hna cu tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna nih an hmuh awk a simi kha nan pek hna lai tiah nawl a pek hna.","ref":"Nam 18.12-13,21"},"5":{"text":"Nawlbia cu ka kip ah an thanh tikah Israel mi nih tampi in rawl thar hmasa hna le mitsur hang le chiti le khuaihliti le lo in a chuakmi vialte kha an thawh i zeizong kip cheu hra cheu khat kha tam piin an rak put."},"6":{"text":"Cun Judah ram chung khua i a ummi Israel mi le Judah mi hna nih khan an caw le an tuu hna chung khan cheu hra cheu khat le Bawipa an Pathian sin i an pekchanhmi thil thiang kha an chuahpi hna i a bubu in an pon hna."},"7":{"text":"Thla thumnak thla ah khan pon hram an thawk hna i thla sarihnak thla ah khan an dih hna."},"8":{"text":"Hezekiah le bawi pawl kha an rat i thil pon kha an hmuh tikah, Bawipa le a mi Israel mi hna cu an thangṭhat hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha thil pon kong cu a hal hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun Zadok hrin a simi tlangbawi upa bik Azariah nih khan a leh i, “An thawhlawm cu Bawipa inn chungah ratpi an thawk in kannih nih kan rak ei i kan i za i tampi a hleimi kan ngei rih; Bawipa nih a mi cu thluachuahnak a pek hna caah, cucaah tampi a hleimi kan ngei,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah nih annih cu Bawipa inn chung i a dal hna kha timhtuah awkah nawl a pek hna i annih nih an timhtuah hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun annih nih zumhawktlak tein thawhlawm le cheuhra cheukhat le pekchanhmi thil kha an rak put hna. Annih a zohkhenhtu bawi upa bik cu Levi mi Konaniah a si i a unau Shimei cu amah dottu a si;"},"13":{"text":"cun siangpahrang le Pathian inn uktu upa bik Azariah nih an thiah hna bantukin Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakhiah, Mahath, le Benaiah cu Konaniah le a unau Shimei a bawmtu zohkhenhtu an si."},"14":{"text":"Cun Levi mi Imnah fapa Kore, nichuahlei kutka cawngtu kha Pathian sinah mah lungtho tein pekmi laksawng zohkhenhtu a si i amah nih cun Bawipa ca i kenretmi le a thiang bik pekchanhnak ca i kenretmi thawhlawm cu a ṭhen awk an si."},"15":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna khua ah khan, an u an nau hna, a tar siseh, a no siseh, an i cheu ning khan, an covo cio kha phawt awkah Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah le Shekaniah nih khan tling tein an bawmh,"},"16":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an chuahkehnak ningin min thlakmi, pa kum thum in a cunglei, an bawile nih an hrui hna ningin, an bu ning cio khan, an rian ṭuan awk caah ni fate rianṭuanning nih a kiah hna bangin Bawipa inn chungah a lutmi vialte kha cu phawt lo an si."},"17":{"text":"Tlangbawi pawl an min an thlak hna ning cu an pale innchungkhar ning cio khan a si i Levi mi, kum kul in a cunglei hna cu an bawi hna ningin, an bu an bu ning cio ah a si."},"18":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna cu an fale dihlak, an nupile hna le an fapa hna le an fanu hna, an dihlak khan minthlak an si, zeicahtiah anmah le anmah thiang tein i chiahnak ah khan zumhtlak tein an um."},"19":{"text":"Cun Aaron fapa hna, tlangbawi hna, an khua ta a si mizapi ram i a ummi hna caah khan, tlangbawi lak i pa paohpaoh le Levi mi paohpaoh minthlakmi hna kha an covo a phawtu dingah, min in thiahmi kha khua chung hna ah khan an um."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun Judah ram chung dihlak ah Hezekiah nih a tuah i Bawipa a Pathian hmai i a ṭha le a dik le zumhtlak a simi kha a tuah."},"21":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn rian le phungbia le nawlbia he aa tlak in a tuahmi rian vialte ah, Pathian a kawlnak ah, a lungthin dihlak in a ṭuan i khua awng a tong."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thil vialte le hi bantukin zumhtlak tein a tuahmi hnuah hin, Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib cu a ra i Judah cu a chim i kulhmi khua kha a riahhnawh hna i ka tei hna lai tiah aa ruah.","title":"Sennakherib Nih A Tuk Hna (2Sia 18.13-37 ; Isa 36.1-22)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Sennakherib cu a ra cang i Jerusalem tuk kha aa tim ti kha Hezekiah nih a hmuh tikah,"},"3":{"text":"khuapi leng i a ummi cerhti kha a bawi hna le a miṭhawng hna he phih aa tim, annih nih cun an bawmh."},"4":{"text":"Mi tampi kha an i pum i ram chung i a luangmi cerh hna le tiva tete hna kha an phih hna i, “Zeicahdah Assiria siangpahrang hna cu an rat lai i ti tampi an hmuh lai?” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Rianṭuan awkah khan lung fek tein aa tim i a cimmi vampang kha a remh i a cungah innsang a sak i a lengah vampang dang pakhat a ser ṭhan; cun David khua i Millo kha fek chin in a tuah. Cun hriamnam le phaw kha tampi a ser hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun mi zapi cungah khan raltuknak lei ralbawi a chiah hna i khua kutka i a ummi tual ah khan amah sinah cun a pumh hna i lung ṭhawnnak in bia a chimh hna i,"},"7":{"text":"“Ṭhawng u law nan ralṭha ko u. Assiria siangpahrang le a sinah a ummi mibu cu ṭih hna hlah u law nan lung zong dong hlah seh; zeicahtiah a ngan deuhmi pakhat a sin i a um lomi kan sinah a um."},"8":{"text":"Amah sin i a ummi cu titsa hriamnam a si, sihmanhsehlaw kan sin i a ummi cu Bawipa kan Pathian a si, amah nih a kan bawmh lai i kan ral hna cu a kan dohpiak lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah bia cun mi nih zumhnak an i lak."},"9":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin, Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib le a ralkap vialte hna cu Lakhish i an um lioah Jerusalem i a ummi Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah le Judah mi hna sinah cun sinum kha a hei thlah hna."},"10":{"text":"“Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib nih, ‘Zeidah nan i bochan i Jerusalem ah hin hrennak hi naa in ko?"},"11":{"text":"Hezekiah nih hin, “ Bawipa kan Pathian nih Assiria siangpahrang kut chungin a kan chuah lai,” tiin a ti tikah hin a pingah an hruai hna a si lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Hi Hezekiah ṭhiamṭhiam nih hin a si lo mei a khuahrum bo hna le a biakṭheng hna kha a hlonh hna i Judah le Jerusalem cu, “Biakṭheng pakhat hmaiah nan biak lai i cu cungah cun nan raithawinak hna kha nan khangh lai,” a ti kha."},"13":{"text":"Ramdang hna an mi cungah keimah le ka pupa hna nih zeidah kan tuah ti kha nan thei lo maw? Khi ram hna i a ummi miphun hna pathian hna nih khan an ram cu ka kut chungin an chanh khawh hna maw?"},"14":{"text":"Nan Pathian nih hin ka kut chungin an chuah khawh hna nakhnga ah hin, ka pa nih a hrawh cikcekmi miphun hna i an pathian hna lakah khan aho tal nih a miphun cu ka kut chungin a chuah kho hna maw?"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah Hezekiah cu hi bantukin i hlenter hlah u law a pingah i hruaiter hlah u, cun amah kha zum hlah u, zeicahtiah mi zei miphun pathian siseh, zei ram pathian siseh, ka pupa hna kut chungin siseh keimah kut chungin siseh a mi a chanh khotu hna an um lo. Zeitindah nan Pathian chinchin nih cun ka kut chung cun an chuah khawh hna lai!’ a ti,” tiah an ti."},"16":{"text":"A sinum hna nih khan Bawipa Pathian le a sal Hezekiah cu an bia in an ti chinchin rih hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun Bawipa, Israel Pathian kha nihsawh awk le zawmhtaih awkah ca a ṭial i, “Ram chung i a ummi miphun hna pathian hna, ka kut chungin an mi hna a chuah kho lotu hna bantuk khan Hezekiah Pathian nih hin a mi hna cu ka kut chungin a chuah kho hna lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Khua kulhnak vampang cung i a ummi Jerusalem mi hna kha an thin a phan i an tha a ther i khuapi cu an lak khawh nakhnga, mah cucu Judah holh in an auhnawh hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun vawlei cung miphun hna pathian, mi kut sermi a simi hna an ti hna bantuk khan Jerusalem khua Pathian cu an ti ve."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah Siangpahrang Hezekiah le Amoz fapa profet Isaiah kha hi ruangah hin thla an cam i van leiah an au.","title":"Nih Hezekiah A Khamh (2Sia 19.1-37 ; Isa 37.1-38)"},"21":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih vancungmi pakhat a thlah i Assiria siangpahrang riahhmun i a ṭhawngmi ralkap hna le haotu hna le bawi vialte hna kha a thah hna. Cucaah hmaichia in amah a ram ah a kir ṭhan. Cun a pathian inn chung i a luh tikah khan amah fapa hna lila nih khan vainam in an thah."},"22":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa nih Hezekiah le Jerusalem khuami hna cu Assiria siangpahrang Sennakherib kut chung le a ral vialte hna kut chung khan a khamh hna i a kenkip ah dinhnak a pek hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun mi tampi nih Bawipa sinah Jerusalem ah khan laksawng an rak put i Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah sinah khan thil man sung an rak put hna, cucaah cu caan thawk in hmailei ah cun miphun vialte hna mithmuh ah khan hlorh a si."},"24":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun Hezekiah cu a zaw i a thi dengmang i Bawipa sinah khan thla a cam; cun amah cu a leh i hmelchunhnak a pek.","title":"Hezekiah Zawtnak (2Sia 20.1-4 ; Isa 38.1-22)"},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Hezekiah cu a lung in aa porhlawt caah a cung i ṭhathnemnak a tuahmi caah khan aa lawm lo. Cucaah amah le Judah le Jerusalem cungah thinhunnak a tlung."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a lung porhlawtnak kha Hezekiah cu aa ṭhum ṭhan i amah he Jerusalem mi hna he an i ṭhumh caah Bawipa thinhunnak cu an cungah Hezekiah chan ah khan cun a tlung lo."},"27":{"text":"Hezekiah cu rumnak le upatnak tampi a ngei; cun ngun le sui le lung mansung le zihmui le phaw le a man a sungmi umkheng phun zakip caah chiahnak aa ser hna;","title":"Hezekiah Rumnak le Sunparnak (2Sia 20.12-19 ; Isa 39.1-8)"},"28":{"text":"rawl a chuakmi le mitsur hang le chiti ca i khonnak inn hna le caw phunphun caah caw inn hna le tuu kawm hna kha aa ser hna."},"29":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in khua kha aa serh hna i tuurun le cawrun cu tampi a ngeih hna zeicahtiah Pathian nih ngeihmi tampi a pek."},"30":{"text":"Hi Hezekiah ṭhiamṭhiam nih hin Gihon ti cunglei i a chuahnak kha a phih hna i David khua nitlaklei kamah khan a vun luanter hna. Cun Hezekiah cu a rian paoh ah khua awng a tong."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah Babilon bawi hna nih, ram chung i tuahmi hmelchunhnak va hlathlai awk i a sinah an thlahmi lamkal hna kong ah khan, amah cu hneksak awk le a lung chung i a ummi vialte hngalhnak ah, Pathian nih amah tein a thlah ko."},"32":{"text":"Hezekiah tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le thil ṭha a tuahmi hna cu, zohhmanh, Judah le Israel Siangpahrang hna Cauk chung i a ummi Amoz fapa profet Isaiah nih langhnak a hmuhmi hna chungah a ṭial.","title":"Hezekiah Thihnak (2Sia 20.20-21)"},"33":{"text":"Cun Hezekiah cu a pupa hna sinah a it i David fapa hna thlan kainak ah khan an vui; Judah ram mi vialte le Jerusalem mi hna nih khan a thih ah cun upatnak an pek. Cun a fapa Manasseh cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Manasseh cu pen hram a thawk ah kum hleihnih a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm nga le kum nga a pen.","title":"Manasseh Pennak (2Sia 21.1-18)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel mi hna hmai in a dawimi hna miphun hna phunglam fihnungmi ning khan Bawipa mithmuh ah ṭhat lonak a tuah.","ref":"Jer 15.4"},"3":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a pa Hezekiah nih a rak hrawhmi khuahrum bo kha a ser ṭhan hna i Baal caah khan biakṭheng a ser hna i Asherah hna kha a ser hna i van i a ummi thil vialte kha a biak hna i an rian a ṭuan hna."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “Jerusalem khua ah hin ka min cu zungzal in a um lai,” tiah a rak timi, Bawipa inn chungah khan biakṭheng a ser hna.","ref":"2Cha 6.6"},"5":{"text":"Cun Bawipa inn tual pahnih chungah khan vancung thil vialte caah khin biakṭheng a ser hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Hinnom fapa nelrawn ah khan a fapa hna cu raithawinak ah a khangh hna i khuavang kawh le litin le eih kha a lenh i thitlawnthiam le khuavang kha aa ruaih tawn hna. Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo tampi kha a tuah i a thin kha a phawh."},"7":{"text":"Cun amah nih a sermi siasal milem cu Pathian inn chungah khan a chiah. Cun inn kongah cun Pathian nih David le a fapa Solomon sinah khan, “Israel phun dihlak chungin ka thimmi Jerusalem le hi inn chungah hin zungzal in ka min cu ka chiah lai;","ref":"1Sia 9.3-5; 2Cha 7.12-18"},"8":{"text":"cun Israel mi nih Moses in nawl ka pekmi vialte hna le phungbia vialte hna le nawlbia hna le phunglam hna kha tuah awkah an i ralrin ahcun an pupa hna caah ka chiah cangmi ram chungah hin an ke kha ka ṭhial ti hna lai lo,” tiah a rak ti."},"9":{"text":"Manasseh nih Judah le Jerusalem mi cu a lem khawh hna caah Israel mi hmai i Bawipa nih a hrawhmi miphun hna nakkhan ṭhat lonak tam deuh an tuah."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nih Manasseh le a mi hna sinah khan bia a chim ko nain zeihmanh ah an rel lo."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih an cungah Assiria siangpahrang ralkapbu ralbawi kha a ratpi hna i annih nih Manasseh cu sio in an sio i dar hreng an khenh i Babilon ah an kalpi."},"12":{"text":"Cun harnak a phak tikah Bawipa a Pathian zaangfahnak kha a nawl i a pupa hna Pathian hmaiah khan fak piin a lung aa ṭhum."},"13":{"text":"Amah sinah khan thla a cam i Pathian nih a nawlnak kha a cohlan i a thlacamnak kha a theih i amah ram Jerusalem ah khan a kirpi ṭhan.
