Khi tikah Manasseh nih Bawipa cu Pathian a si kha a hngalh."},"14":{"text":"Cun a hnuah David khua lengah khan Gihon nitlaklei nelrawn ah, Nga Kutka luhnak tiangin vampang a ser i Ofel kha a kulhter i sangpi ah a cawi; cun Judah ram chung khua hna ah khan ralkapbu haotu a chiah fawn hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun ramdang pathian hna le siasal kha Bawipa inn khan a ṭhial hna i Bawipa inn umnak tlang le Jerusalem i a sermi biakṭheng vialte kha khua lengah a hlonh dih hna."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa biakṭheng zong kha a chiah ṭhan i a cungah cun daihnak thawinak hna le lawmhnak thawinak hna kha a pekchanh hna i Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu a rian nan ṭuan lai, tiah Judah mi kha nawl a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"Mi nih cun khuahrum bo hna ah khan rai cu an thawi ko rih, asinain, Bawipa an Pathian sin lawnglawng ah khan a si cang."},"18":{"text":"Manasseh tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le a Pathian sin i thla a camnak le Bawipa, Israel Pathian min in a sinah bia a chimtu hmutu hna bia cu, zohhmanh, Israel Siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak chungah an um."},"19":{"text":"A thlacamnak Pathian nih a nawlnak a cohlanpiakning le a lung a ṭhumh hlan i a sualnak vialte le zumhtlaklo a sinak le khuahrum bo a ser i Asherim le milem hna a chiahnak hmun hna kha, zohhmanh, Hmutu hna Chanrelnak chungah an i ṭial."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun Manasseh cu a pupa hna sinah a it i amah a inn ah khan an vui; cun a fapa Amon cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"21":{"text":"Amon cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum hnih a si i Jerusalem in kum hnih a pen.","title":"Amon Pennak (2Sia 21.19-26)"},"22":{"text":"A pa Manasseh nih a rak tuah bantuk khan Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah. A pa Manasseh nih a rak sermi milem dihlak sinah khan raithawinak a tuah i an rian a ṭuan hna."},"23":{"text":"A pa Manasseh nih a lung a ṭhumh bangkhan Bawipa hmaiah a lung a ṭhum lo i hi Amon nih hin cun mawhnak kha tam chin lengmang a tuah."},"24":{"text":"Cun a sinum hna nih an rawi i amah inn chungah an thah."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ramchung mi nih khan Amon a rawitu vialte kha an thah hna i ramchung mi nih khan a fapa Josiah cu amah hmun ah khan siangpahrang ah an ser."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah cu pen hram a thawk ah kum riat a si i Jerusalem in kum sawm thum le kum khat a pen.","title":"Josiah Pennak (2Sia 22.1-2)","ref":"Jer 3.6"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa mithmuh i a dikmi kha a tuah i a pa David lam kha a zulh hna; cun orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh aa mer lo."},"3":{"text":"Zeitintiah a bawi kum riatnak kum, tlangval note a si lioah khan, a pa David i Pathian kha kawl hram a thawk; cun a kum hleihnih kum ah Judah le Jerusalem chung i khuahrum bo hna le Asherim hna le suaimi milem hna le thletmi milem hna kha thianh hram a thawk hna.","title":"Josiah Nih Remhnak A Tuah (2Sia 23.4-20)"},"4":{"text":"Cun a mithmuh ah Baal biakṭheng hna kha a chimh hna; cun an cung i a dirmi zihmui biakṭheng hna kha a hau hna i Asherim le suaimi le thletmi milem hna kha a den cikcek hna i leidip ah a ser hna i an cung i rai a rak thawimi hna an thlan cungah khan a vorh hna.","ref":"2Sia 21.3; 2Cha 33.3"},"5":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna ruh zong kha an biakṭheng cungah cun a khangh hna i Judah le Jerusalem cu a thianh hna.","ref":"1Sia 13.2"},"6":{"text":"Cun Manasseh le Efraim le Simeon ram, cun Naftali ram tiangin, hi ram hna khua chung le an pawngkam i a rawkmi khua chungah hin,"},"7":{"text":"Israel ram chung dihlak ah, biakṭheng hna kha a chimh hna i Asherim le milem hna kha dip tein a rial hna i zihmui biakṭheng kha a hau hna. Cun Jerusalem ah a kir."},"8":{"text":"A bawi kum hleiriat kum ah ram le inn kha a thianh dih in, Azaliah fapa Safan le khua uktu Ma-aseiah le Joahaz fapa Joah, cazinṭialtu kha Bawipa a Pathian inn remh awkah khan a thlah hna.","title":"Phungbia Cauk An Hmuh (2Sia 22.3-20)"},"9":{"text":"Tlangbawi bik Hilkiah sinah khan an ra i innka luhnak cawngtu Levi mi hna nih Manasseh le Efraim le Israel mi a tangmi vialte le Jerusalem khuami hna sinin an kholhmi phaisa Pathian inn chungah an rak putmi kha an pek."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa inn a zohkhenhtu rianṭuantu hna sinah khan an pek i Bawipa inn chung i rian a ṭuanmi hna nih cun inn cu remh ṭhan le dawhter ṭhannak caah an hman."},"11":{"text":"Judah siangpahrang hna nih an rawhraltermi inn hna caah khan cawhmi lung hna le a tlang kamhnak ca thing hna le kaan hna cawknak ah zungthiam hna le inn satu hna cu an pek hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun rian cu zumhtlak tein an ṭuan. An cungah khan Merari fapa hna Levi mi Jahath le Obadiah, cun Kohath mi hna fapa hna chungin Zekhariah le Meshullam cu zohkhenhtu ah an chiah hna. Cun awdawh tumnak thilri i a thiammi Levi mi vialte hna kha,"},"13":{"text":"thil phortu hna zohkhenhtu an si i rian phun zakip a ṭuanmi hna kha hmuhsaktu an si; cun Levi mi a cheukhat cu caṭialtu le bawi le kutka cawngtu an si."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa inn chung i an rak putmi tangka kha an chuahpi lioah cun, Moses sinin pekmi Bawipa phungbia cauk cu tlangbawi Hilkiah nih a hmuh."},"15":{"text":"Cun Hilkiah nih cazin ṭialtu Safan sinah cun, “Phungbia cauk Bawipa inn chungah ka hmuh,” tiah a ti; cun Hilkiah nih cauk cu Safan kha a pek."},"16":{"text":"Safan nih cauk cu siangpahrang sinah a rak put i, “Na sinum hna sinah ṭuan awk tiin na pekmi vialte cu an ṭuan lio a si."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa inn chungah a ummi phaisa kha an chuah i rian zohtu hna le rian ṭuantu hna kha an pek hna,” tiah siangpahrang cu a chimh fawn."},"18":{"text":"Cun cazin ṭialtu Safan nih cun siangpahrang cu, “Tlangbawi Hilkiah nih cauk kha a ka pek,” tiah a ti. Cun Safan nih siangpahrang hmaiah khan a rel."},"19":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih phungbia chung bia kha a theih tikah, a puan kha a thleh hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Hilkiah le Safan fapa Ahikam le Mikah fapa Abdon le cazin ṭialtu Safan le siangpahrang sinum Asaiah kha nawl a pek hna i,"},"21":{"text":"“Va kal u law, keimah ca le Israel le Judah i a tang rihmi caah Bawipa kha, hi cauk an hmuhmi chung bia kong hi va hal tuah u; kannih kan pupa hna nih hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi dihlak ningin tuah awkah Bawipa bia kha an zulh lo caah kannih kan cung i a thletmi Bawipa thinhunnak cu a ngan ko,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah Hilkiah le siangpahrang nih a thlahmi hna kha profetnu Huldah sinah an ra i amah cu, cuticun an chimh; Huldah cu Shallum nupi a si, Shallum cu Tokhath fapa a si, Tokhath cu hnipuan chiahnak zohkhenhtu Hasrah fapa a si (Huldah cu Jerusalem ah Sang Pahnihnak ah khan a um)."},"23":{"text":"Cun anih nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Hi bangin Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih, ‘Nannih cu ka sinah an thlahtu hna mipa cu,"},"24":{"text":"Hi bangin Bawipa nih a ti, tiah va chim u, Zohhmanh, hi hmun le a chung i a ummi hna cungah hin ṭhat lonak, Judah siangpahrang hmai i kan relmi cauk chung i chiatserhnak vialte kha ka tlunter lai."},"25":{"text":"Annih nih an kut in an ṭuanmi rian vialte in ka thin an ka phawh i keimah kha an ka hlawt i pathian dang hna sinah zihmui an khangh caah, cucaah hi hmun cungah hin ka thinhunnak ka bungh lai i hmih khawh a si lai lo."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa hal awkah an thlahtu hna Judah siangpahrang sinah cun hi bangin nan va chim lai, Hi bangin Bawipa Israel Pathian nih a ti: Bia na theihmi hna kong ah cun,"},"27":{"text":"hi hmun le hi hmun i a ummi hna cung i a bia cu na theih tikah na lung in naa ngaihchih i Bawipa hmaiah na lung na ṭhumh i ka hmaiah na puan na thleh i na ṭah caah, kei zong nih na bia kan theihpiak, tiah Bawipa nih a ti."},"28":{"text":"Zohhmanh na pupa hna sinah kan pumh lai i daihnak in thlan khor na phan lai, cun hi hmun le a chung i a ummi hna cung i ṭhat lonak ka tlunter dingmi hi na mit nih a hmu lai lo, tiah va chim u,’ a ti,” tiah a ti. Cun annih nih bia cu siangpahrang sinah an ratpi ṭhan."},"29":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih mi a thlah hna i Judah le Jerusalem upa vialte kha a pumh hna."},"30":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu Judah ram mi vialte le Jerusalem khuami le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna le, mi vialte a ngan he a hme he, Bawipa inn ah cun an hung kal; cun Bawipa inn ah an hmuhmi biakamnak cauk chung bia vialte cu an theihhngan ah a relpiak hna."},"31":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu amah hmun ah khan a dir i, Bawipa kha zulh awk le a nawlbia hna le a hngalhternak bia hna le a nawl hna cu a lungthin dihlak le a nunnak dihlak in tuah awk le hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi biakamnak bia hna cu tuah awkah Bawipa hmaiah cun biakamnak a ser."},"32":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem khua le Benjamin ram i a ummi vialte hna kha mah cucu nan i tlaih lai tiah a ti hna. Cun Jerusalem khuami vialte nih Pathian, an pupa hna Pathian biakamnak bangin an tuah."},"33":{"text":"Josiah nih cun Israel mi hna ta a simi ram chung khan fihnung vialte kha a hlonh dih i Israel ram i a ummi vialte kha Bawipa, an Pathian rian cu a ṭuanter hna. Amah chan chung cu annih nih Bawipa an pupa hna Pathian zulhnak khan an pial lo."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Josiah nih Jerusalem ah Bawipa caah Lanhtak Puai a tuah i Lanhtak Puai tuufa cu thla khatnak thla ni hleili ni ah an thah.","title":"Josiah Nih Lanhtak Puai A Tuah (2Sia 23.21-23)"},"2":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna cu anmahle an rian cio ah khan a thiah hna i Bawipa inn rianṭuannak ah cun a forh hna."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi vialte kha a cawnpiak hna i Bawipa sinah a thiangmi Levi mi kha a thawh hna i, “Israel siangpahrang David fapa Solomon nih a sakmi inn chungah khan kuang thiang kha chia u, nan liang in nan i zawnh a hau ti lai lo. Atu cu Bawipa nan Pathian le a mi Israel mi an rian kha ṭuan tuah u."},"4":{"text":"Israel siangpahrang David hmuhsaknak le a fapa Solomon hmuhsaknak kha zul in nan pale chung cio ning le nan bu nan i cheuning khan i tim tuah u.","ref":"2Cha 8.14"},"5":{"text":"Cun nan unau hna mi sawhsawh an pale innchungkhar bu ning cio khan nannih cu hmunthiang ah khan dir u law an bu cio caah cun Levi mi hna chung i an pale innchungkhar a cheuchum um cio hna seh."},"6":{"text":"Cun Lanhtak tuufa kha that u law i thianh tuah u, Moses sinin Bawipa bia ningin tuah awkah nan unau hna kha timtuah hna u,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Josiah nih mi sawhsawh hna caah cun, a ummi vialte ca i Lanhtak Puai laksawng caah, a tuurun chungin tuufa le mehehfa sang thum le cawtum thong thum a thawh; mah hihi siangpahrang nih pumpak in a ngeih mi chungin an si."},"8":{"text":"Cun a bawi hna nih khan mi zapi ca le tlangbawi ca le Levi mi hna caah lungtho tein an thawh ve. Pathian inn chung i a bawi bik pawl Hilkiah, Zekhariah le Jehiel nih Lanhtak Puai i pekchanh awk caah tlangbawi cu tuufa le mehehfa thong hnih le za ruk le cawtum za thum an pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Levi mi lak i upa bik hna Konaniah le a unau Shemaiah le Nethanel, cun Hashabiah le Jeiel le Jozabad nih lanhtak puai i pekchanh awkah tuufa le mehehfa thong nga le cawtum za nga cu Levi mi kha an pek hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun rianṭuannak cu timhtuah a si tikah, siangpahrang nawl peknak bangin, tlangbawi cu an hmun ah khan an dir i Levi mi cu an i ṭhenning khan an dir."},"11":{"text":"Cun Lanhtak Puai tuufa kha an thah i tlangbawi nih khan an sinin an lakmi thisen cu an theh i Levi mi nih khan sa cu an phaw an hawh hna."},"12":{"text":"Moses cauk chungah aa ṭial bangin, Bawipa sin i pekchanh awkah, mi sawhsawh pawl cu an pale innchungkhar ning in ṭhenmi bu ning khan phawt cio awkah, khangh thawinak hna kha cu a dang tein an chiah hna. Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in cawtum zong kha an tuah hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun phunglam ningin lanhtak puai tuufa cu mei in an rawh; cun pekchanhmi thilthiang hna cu um le marlei le ukang in an chuan hna i mi sawhsawh pawl vialte kha khulrang in an pek hna.","ref":"Exo 12.8-9"},"14":{"text":"Cun a hnuah anmah ca le tlangbawi hna caah khan an timhtuah, zeicahtiah Aaron fapa hna tlangbawi hna kha khangh thawinak le a thau hna kha pekchanhnak ah khan zanṭim tiang an hna a hnawk; cucaah cun Levi mi hna nih anmah ca le tlangbawi hna ca i an timhtuahnak cu a si."},"15":{"text":"Cun David le Asaf le Heman le siangpahrang i a hmutu Jeduthun hna nawl peknak bangin, hlasatu, Asaf fapale hna cu an hmun ah khan an um; cun kutka cawngtu hna kha kutka ah cun an um cio; an unau Levi mi hna nih an timhtuahpiak hna caah an rianṭuannak khan an kal ta a herh lo.","ref":"1Cha 25.1"},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Siangpahrang Josiah nawl peknak bangin, lanhtak puai cu tuah awk le Bawipa biakṭheng cung i khangh thawi-nak pekchanh awkah Bawipa rianṭuannak ca i thil vialte cu khi ni ah timh dih a si."},"17":{"text":"Cun Israel mi a ummi hna nih cun khi caan ah Lanhtak Puai kha an tuah i thilnu telhlo changreu puai kha ni sarih an tuah.","ref":"Exo 12.1-20"},"18":{"text":"Profet Samuel chan hnuah cun cu bantuk cun Lanhtak Puai kha tuah a si bal ti lo; Josiah le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna le cuka i a ummi Judah ram mi le Israel ram mi vialte le Jerusalem khuami hna nih an tuahmi Lanhtak Puai bantuk cu Israel siangpahrang ahohmanh nih an tuah bal lo."},"19":{"text":"Hi Lanhtak Puai cu Josiah a bawi kum hleiriat kum ah tuah a si."},"20":{"text":"Hi thil vialte hnuah, Josiah nih biaknak inn cu a timhtuah dih tikah khan, Zufrates tiva i a ummi Karkhemish khua i i doh awkah Izipt siangpahrang Neko cu a hung kal i Josiah nih a rak chuahhnawh.","title":"Josiah Thihnak (2Sia 23.28-30)"},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a sinah lamkaltu a hei thlah hna i, “Judah siangpahrang, nangmah le keimah cu zeidah kan i ti awk a um? Nihin ah hin nangmah doh awkah ka ra lo, sihmanhsehlaw atu i a ka raltu innchungkhar he doh awkah ka ra; cun Pathian nih i khulranh tuah tiin nawl a ka pek. Ka sin i a ummi Pathian doh cu ngol tuah, zeicahtiah an hrawh sual lai,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Asinain Josiah nih hrial cu a duh lo i amah he i doh awkah cun a mui aa hleng. Pathian kaa chungin a chuakmi bia Neko bia cu a ngai lo i Megiddo nelrawn i i tuk awkah khan a kal."},"23":{"text":"Cun thalkah thiam hna nih Siangpahrang Josiah kha an kah i siangpahrang nih cun a sinum hna cu, “Ṭhalo tein an ka hliam caah ka kalpi u,” tiah a ti hna."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah a sinum hna nih cun rangleng chung khan an chuah i a rangleng pahnihnak in Jerusalem ah an tlunpi. Cun a thi i a pupa hna thlan ah khan an vui. Cun Judah mi dihlak le Jerusalem mi dihlak nih khan Josiah kha an ṭah."},"25":{"text":"Jeremiah zong nih ṭah hla a lawh i hlasak thiammi pa vialte le nu vialte nih nihin tiang hin Josiah cu an hla ah an cuanter. Mah hihi Israel mi lakah phunglam ah an ser hna; zohhmanh, Ṭah Hla chungah an i ṭial."},"26":{"text":"Josiah tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna, Bawipa phungbia ah aa ṭial ningin a tuahmi tuahsernak ṭha hna le"},"27":{"text":"a thil tuahmi hna, a hramthawk le a donghnak hna zong, zohhmanh Israel le Judah Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah an i ṭial."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu ram profet nih cun Josiah fapa Jehoahaz kha a lak i a pa hmun ah khan Jerusalem ah siangpahrang ah a ser.","title":"Jehoahaz Pennak le Ṭumchuknak (2Sia 23.31-35)"},"2":{"text":"Jehoahaz cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum thum a si Jerusalem in thla thum a pen."},"3":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem ah cun Izipt siangpahrang nih a phuah i ram cu ngunkhuai ngun talen za khat le sui talen pakhat a cawh."},"4":{"text":"Cun a unau Eliakim kha Judah le Jerusalem siangpahrang ah cun Izipt siangpahrang nih khan a ser i a min cu Jehoiakim ah a thlen; sihmanhsehlaw a unau Jehoahaz cu Neko nih khan a lak i Izipt ah a kalpi.","ref":"Jer 22.11-12"},"5":{"text":"Jehoiakim cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum nga a si i Jerusalem in kum hleikhat a pen. Bawipa a Pathian mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah.","title":"Jehoiakim Pennak (2Sia 23.36—24.7)","ref":"Jer 22.18-19; 26.1-6; 35.1-19"},"6":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar nih khan a hung doh i hreng a khenh i Babilon ah a kalpi.","ref":"Jer 25.1-38; 36.1-32; 45.1-5; Dan 1.1-2"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa inn chung i a ummi umkheng a cheu hna zong kha Nebukhadnezzar nih Babilon ah a kalpi hna i Babilon i a siangpahrang inn ah cun a chiah hna."},"8":{"text":"Jehoiakim tuahsernak a tang rihmi hna le fihnung a tuahmi le a ziaza ṭhalo hna cu zohhmanh, Israel le Judah Siangpahrang hna Cauk chungah an i ṭial i a fapa Jehoiachin cu amah hmun ah khan a hung bawi."},"9":{"text":"Jehoiachin cu pen hram a thawk ah kum riat a si i Jerusalem in thla thum le ni hra a bawi. Bawipa mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah.","title":"Jehoiachin Cu Babilon Ah Sal Ah An Kalpi (2Sia 24.8-11)"},"10":{"text":"Cun cu kum ṭhal ah Nebukhadnezzar Siangpahrang nih mi a thlah hna i amah cu Bawipa inn chung i umkheng mansung hna he cun Babilon ah an ratpi i a unau Zedekiah cu Judah le Jerusalem siangpahrang ah a ser.","ref":"Jer 22.24-30; 24.1-10; 29.1-2; 37.1; Eze 17.12,13"},"11":{"text":"Zedekiah cu pen hram a thawk ah kum kul le kum khat a si i Jerusalem in kum hlei khat a bawi.","title":"Zedekiah Pennak (2Sia 24.18-20 ; Jer 52.1-3)","ref":"Jer 27.1-22; 28.1-17"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, a Pathian mithmuh i thil ṭhalo kha a tuah. Bawipa kaa chungin a chuakmi bia a chimtu Jeremiah hmaiah khan a lung a ṭhum lo."},"13":{"text":"Cun Pathian min chalh in chiat a sertu Siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar zong kha a doh; Bawipa, Israel Pathian lei i i mer duh loin a hngawng kha a ṭhawnter i a lung kha a hahter.","ref":"Eze 17.15"},"14":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna lak i haotu deuhdeuh hna le mi zapi hna zong kha, cu bantuk cun zumhtlaklo ngaiin an um i miphun hna thil fihnung vialte kha an zulh ve; cun Jerusalem ah a thiantermi Bawipa inn kha a thurhhnawmh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa, an pupa hna Pathian nih khan a mi hna le a umnak hmun cungah khan zaangfahnak a ngeih caah lamkaltu kha ngol duh lo tein a thlahhnawh lengmang hna;"},"16":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa thinhunnak cu a mi hna cungah a thawh i remh ṭhan khawhnak a um ti lo tiangin Pathian lamkaltu hna cu an rak zawmhtaih lengmang hna i a bia kha zei ah an rel lo i a profet hna kha an nihsawh hna."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah an tlangval hna cu an hmunthiang inn chungah khan vainam in a that i, tlangval cungah siseh, upa cungah siseh, zaangfahnak a ngei lomi, Khaldi mi siangpahrang kha an cungah a ratpi; a kut chungah cun an dihlak in a chanh hna.","title":"Judah Saltannak (2Sia 25.1-21 ; Jer 39.8-10 ; 52.12-30)","ref":"Jer 21.1-10; 34.1-5"},"18":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn chung i a ummi umkheng vialte, a hme a ngan in, cun Bawipa inn rothil hna le siangpahrang le a bawi pawl rothil vialte hna cu an dihlak in Babilon ah an kalpi hna."},"19":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn cu an khangh i Jerusalem khua kulhnak vampang cu an chimh hna i a chung i siangpahrang inn vialte cu mei in an khangh hna i a umkheng mansung vialte cu an hrawh dih hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun vainam thahnak in a luatmi hna kha Babilon ah sal ah a kalpi hna i Persia pennak a feh hlantiang annih cu amah le a fapa hna sal ah an cang;"},"21":{"text":"mah hihi Jeremiah kaa in Bawipa bia a chuakmi, ram nih a sabbath hna cu aa lawmhpi dih hlantiang, timi tlinternak caah khan a si. Kum sawm sarih tlinternak caah khan rawkral in a um chung vialte sabbath kha a ul ko.","ref":"Jer 25.11; 29.10"},"22":{"text":"Jeremiah kaa in a langmi Bawipa bia cu a tlin nakhnga, Persia siangpahrang Sairas a bawi kum khatnak ah, Bawipa nih Sairas thlarau cu a hninhsaih i cucaah a pennak ram chung vialte ah thawng thanhnak a tuah i,","title":"Sairas Nih Thawng A Thanh (Ezr 1.1-4)"},"23":{"text":"“Hi bangin Persia siangpahrang Sairas nih, Bawipa, vancung Pathian nih vawleicung ram vialte cu a ka pek cang i mah caah Judah ram Jerusalem i inn pakhat sak awk kha a ka fial. Cucaah Pathian mi a simi nannih cu nan dihlak in cuka ah cun va kal u law Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan sinah um ko seh,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 44.28"}}}}},"15":{"info":{"name":"Ezra","shortname":"Ezra","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Persia siangpahrang Sairas a bawi kum khatnak ah, Jeremiah kaa in Bawipa nih a chimmi bia kha a tlin nakhnga, Persia siangpahrang Sairas lungthin cu Bawipa nih a thawhter i cucaah a ram dihlak ah khan thawngthanhnak a tuah i ca zongin a ṭial:","title":"Sairas Thawngthanhnak (2Cha 36.22-23)","ref":"Jer 25.11; 29.10"},"2":{"text":"“Hi bangin Persia siangpahrang Sairas nih a ti: Bawipa, vancung Pathian nih vawleicung ram vialte hi a ka pek dih cang i Judah ram i a ummi Jerusalem khua ah amah caah inn sak awk a ka fial.","ref":"Isa 44.28"},"3":{"text":"Nannih amah mi vialte hna, nan sin i a ummi paoh cu a sinah a Pathian kha um seh law, Judah ram i a ummi Jerusalem khua ah cun hung kal seh, cun Bawipa, Israel Pathian inn cu hung sa seh — amah cu Jerusalem i a ummi Pathian cu a si;"},"4":{"text":"cun a nung rihmi paohpaoh cu, khuazei ka i a um a si hmanh ah, a umnak mi hna nih cun ngun le sui le thilri le saṭil in, Pathian inn Jerusalem i a ummi ca i mah lungtho tein pekmi lengah khan, rak bawm hna seh,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah Judah phun le Benjamin phun chung i pale innchungkhar lu cio a simi hna le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna, Bawipa inn Jerusalem i a ummi sak ṭhan awkah Pathian nih an lungthin a canghtermi vialte kha an tho i,","title":"Saltangmi Jerusalem Ah An Kir"},"6":{"text":"an pawngkam i a ummi vialte hna nih khan ngun umkheng le sui le thilri le saṭil le a man a fakmi thilri khan, mah lungtho tein thawhmi thil ri lengah khan an bawmh hna."},"7":{"text":"Nebukhadnezzar nih Jerusalem i a rak kalpi i a pathian hna inn chungah a rak chiahmi Bawipa inn umkheng hna zong kha Sairas siangpahrang nih cun a chuah hna."},"8":{"text":"Cu thil hna cu Persia siangpahrang Sairas nih cun, a rak kengtu Mithredath kha a chuahter hna i Judah bawi Sheshbazzar kha rel ciammam tein a pek."},"9":{"text":"Cun hi vial hi an si: sui hmaihum sawm thum, ngun hmaihum thong khat, zihmui kheng kul le pakua,"},"10":{"text":"sui khengkuar sawm thum, ngun khengkuar za li le pahra, le umkheng dangdang thong khat an si;"},"11":{"text":"sui umkheng le ngun umkheng vialte cu a dihlak ah thong nga, za li an si. Saltangmi hna cu Babilonia in Jerusalem ah hunpi an si tikah hi thil vialte hna hi Shesh-bazzar nih a hun ken hna."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar nih Babilonia ah sal ah a kalpimi hna lakin, sal cannak chungin a kir ṭhanmi Judah ram mi cu mah hna hi an si; annih cu Jerusalem le Judah ah khan an kir, anmah le an khua cio ah khan an kir.","title":"A Kirmi Hna Cazin (Neh 7.5-73)"},"2":{"text":"Annih cu Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum le Baanah sin i a kirmi an si. Israel mi cu hi zat hi an si:"},"3":{"text":"Parosh hrinthlak hna cu thong hnih, za khat sawm sarih le pahnih an si."},"4":{"text":"Shefatiah hrinthlak hna cu za thum le sawm sarih le pahnih an si."},"5":{"text":"Arah hrinthlak hna cu za sarih le sawm sarih le panga an si."},"6":{"text":"Pahath-moab hrinthlak hna chung i Jeshua le Joab hrinthlak hna cu thong hnih, zariat le hleihnih an si."},"7":{"text":"Elam hrinthlak hna cu thong khat za hnih le sawm nga le pali an si."},"8":{"text":"Zattu hrinthlak hna cu za kua sawm li le panga an si."},"9":{"text":"Zakkari hrinthlak hna cu za sarih le sawm ruk an si."},"10":{"text":"Bani hrinthlak hna cu za ruk, sawm li le pahnih an si."},"11":{"text":"Bebai hrinthlak hna cu za ruk, kul le pathum an si."},"12":{"text":"Azgad hrinthlak hna cu thong khat, za hnih le kul le pahnih an si."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam hrinthlak hna cu za ruk, sawm ruk le paruk an si."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai hrinthlak hna cu thong hnih, sawm nga le paruk an si."},"15":{"text":"Adin hrinthlak hna cu za li sawm nga le pali an si."},"16":{"text":"Ater hrinthlak hna chung i Hezekiah hrinthlak hna cu sawm kua le pariat an si."},"17":{"text":"Bezai hrin hrinthlak hna cu za thum le kul le pathum an si."},"18":{"text":"Jorah hrinthlak hna cu za khat le hleihnih an si."},"19":{"text":"Hashum hrinthlak hna cu za hnih le kul le pathum an si."},"20":{"text":"Gibbar hrinthlak hna cu sawm kua le panga an si."},"21":{"text":"Bethlehem hrinthlak hna cu za khat le kul le pathum an si."},"22":{"text":"Netofah mi cu sawm nga le pa ruk an si."},"23":{"text":"Anathoth mi cu za khat le kul le pariat an si."},"24":{"text":"Azmaveth hrinthlak hna cu sawm li le pahnih an si."},"25":{"text":"Kiriath Jearim, Khefirah le Beeroth hrinthlak hna cu za sarih sawm li le pathum an si."},"26":{"text":"Ramah le Geba hrinthlak hna cu za ruk le kul le pakhat an si."},"27":{"text":"Mikmash mi cu za khat le kul le pahnih an si."},"28":{"text":"Bethel le Ai mi hna cu za hnih kul le pathum an si."},"29":{"text":"Nebo hrinthlak hna cu sawm nga le pahnih an si."},"30":{"text":"Magbish hrinthlak hna cu za khat le sawm nga le paruk an si."},"31":{"text":"Elam dang hrinthlak hna cu thong khat za hnih le sawm nga le pali an si."},"32":{"text":"Harim hrinthlak hna cu za thum le kul an si."},"33":{"text":"Lod, Hadid le Ono hrinthlak hna cu za sarih kul le panga an si."},"34":{"text":"Jeriko hrinthlak hna cu za thum sawm li le panga an si."},"35":{"text":"Senaah hrinthlak hna cu thong thum za ruk le sawm thum an si."},"36":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna: Jeshua hrin chung i Jedaiah tefa hna cu za kua le sawm sarih le pathum an si."},"37":{"text":"Immer tefa hna cu thong khat le sawm nga le pahnih an si."},"38":{"text":"Pashhur tefa hna cu thong khat za hnih sawm li le pasarih an si."},"39":{"text":"Harim tefa hna cu thong khat le hleisarih an si."},"40":{"text":"Levi mi hna: Hodaviah hrin Jeshua le Kadmiel tefa hna cu sawm sarih le pali an si."},"41":{"text":"Hlasatu hna: Asaf tefa hna cu za khat kul le pariat an si."},"42":{"text":"Kutka cawngtu tefa hna: Shallum tefa hna, Ater tefa hna, Talmon tefa hna, Akkub tefa hna, Hatita tefa hna le Shobai tefa hna cu an dihlak ah za khat le sawm thum le pakua an si."},"43":{"text":"Biakinn rianṭuantu hna: Ziha tefa hna, Hasufa tefa hna, Tabbaoth tefa hna,"},"44":{"text":"Keros tefa hna, Siaha tefa hna, Padon tefa hna,"},"45":{"text":"Lebanah tefa hna, Hababah tefa hna, Akkub tefa hna,"},"46":{"text":"Hagab tefa hna, Shamlai tefa hna, Hanan tefa hna,"},"47":{"text":"Giddel tefa hna, Gahar tefa hna, Reaiah tefa hna,"},"48":{"text":"Rezin tefa hna, Nekoda tefa hna, Gazzam tefa hna,"},"49":{"text":"Uzza tefa hna, Paseah tefa hna, Besai tefa hna,"},"50":{"text":"Asnah tefa hna, Meunim tefa hna, Nefesim tefa hna,"},"51":{"text":"Bakbuk tefa hna, Hakufa tefa hna, Hahur tefa hna,"},"52":{"text":"Bazluth tefa hna, Mehida tefa hna, Harsha tefa hna,"},"53":{"text":"Barkos tefa hna, Sisera tefa hna, Temah tefa hna,"},"54":{"text":"Neziah tefa hna, le Hatifa tefa hna."},"55":{"text":"Solomon sinum hna i tefa hna: Sotai tefa hna, Hassofereth tefa hna, Perusa tefa hna,"},"56":{"text":"Jaalah tefa hna, Darkon tefa hna, Giddel tefa hna,"},"57":{"text":"Shefatiah tefa hna, Hattil tefa hna, Pokhereth-hazzebaim tefa hna le Ami tefa hna."},"58":{"text":"Biakinn rianṭuantu hna le Solomon sinum hna tefa hna cu za thum sawm kua le pahnih an si."},"59":{"text":"Hi hna hi Israel mi an si le si lo hngalhnak ah an pale innchungkhar siseh, an chuahkehnak siseh an langhter kho lo nain, Tel-melah, Telharsha, Kherub, Addan le Immer in a hungmi hna cu an si:"},"60":{"text":"Delaiah tefa hna, Tobiah tefa hna, Nekoda tefa hna, za ruk le sawm nga le pahnih an si."},"61":{"text":"Tlangbawi tefa hna chung zong in: Habaiah tefa hna, Hakkoz tefa hna le Barzillai tefa hna kha an si. Barzillai hi Gilead ram mi a si i a fanu a ṭhitu i a tefa hna cu Barzillai phun in kawh an si."},"62":{"text":"Hi hna nih hin pupa chanrelnak i a min khumh a simi hna lakah khan an minthlaknak cu an kawl i sihmanhsehlaw an hmu lo, cucaah tlangbawi sinak chung khan a thianglo ah ruah an si caah chuah an si;"},"63":{"text":"uktu bawi nih khan annih cu a thawh hna i, Urim le Thummim hal awkah tlangbawi a um hlan paoh cu rawl thiang bik kha nan ei lai lo, tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Nam 27.21"},"64":{"text":"Aa pummi vialte cu an dihlak in sang li thong hnih za thum le sawm ruk an si,"},"65":{"text":"hi hleiah an sal hna le an salnu hna cu thong sarih za thum sawm thum le pasarih an um i hlasatu, nu he pa he, za hnih an ngei hna."},"66":{"text":"An rangtum cu za sarih sawm thum le paruk an si i an khacer cu za hnih sawm li le panga an si i"},"67":{"text":"an kalauk cu za li sawm thum le panga an si i an laa cu thong ruk za sarih le kul an si."},"68":{"text":"Chungkhar hna lu cio a simi a cheu hna nih khan Bawipa inn, Jerusalem i a ummi ah khan an rat tikah, a hmun i sak ṭhan awkah khan Pathian inn caah cun mah lungtho tein pekchanhnak an tuah;"},"69":{"text":"anmah le an ti khawh tawk cio in rianṭuannak tangka chungah khan sui darik sang ruk le thong khat, ngun mina thong nga le tlangbawi puan za khat an pek."},"70":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna le mi a cheukhat cu Jerusalem le a pawngkam ah khan an um; cun hlasatu hna le kutka cawngtu hna le biakinn rianṭuantu hna kha anmah khua cio ah an um, cun Israel mi vialte cu anmah khua cio ah an um.","ref":"1Cha 9.2; Neh 11.3"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thla sarihnak thla a hung chuah i Israel mi hna cu an khua ah an um tikah, mi cu Jerusalem ah mi pakhat bantukin an i pum.","title":"Biaknak An Tuah Ṭhan"},"2":{"text":"Khi tikah Jozadak fapa Jeshua cu a tlangbawi hawi hna he, cun Shealtiel fapa Zerubbabel cu a phun hawi hna he, an tho i, Pathian mi Moses cauk chungah aa ṭial bangin, a cung i khangh thawinak pekchanh awkah Israel Pathian i a biakṭheng cu an ser.","ref":"Exo 27.1"},"3":{"text":"Cun an pawngkam ram mi hna ruang ah cun an cungah ṭihnak a um caah, annih nih biakṭheng cu a hmun ah khan an chiah i a cungah cun Bawipa sinah khangh thawinak zinglei he zanlei he an pekchanh.","ref":"Nam 28.1-8"},"4":{"text":"Aa ṭial bangin deu puai cu an tuah i, a ni cio nih a herhning in a phunglam bantuk khan ni fate khangh thawinak cu, cu zat in pekchanh awk a si lai tining khan an pekchanh,","ref":"Nam 29.12-38"},"5":{"text":"cun cu hnuah cun pekchanh camcinmi khangh thawinak, thla thar i pekchanhnak le Bawipa ca i caan ngei in tuahmi puai hna i pekchanhnak le mah lungtho tein Bawipa sinah pekchanhmi thil hna kha an pekchanh hna.","ref":"Nam 28.11—29.39"},"6":{"text":"Thla sarihnak thla, a ni khat ni thawk in Bawipa sin i khangh thawinak pekchanh cu hram an thawk. Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa biakinn hram cu an bunh rih lo."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah lung lei zungthiam hna le lehtama hna kha phaisa an pek hna i, Persia siangpahrang Sairas nih a onh hna ningin, sidar thing kha Lebanon tlang in rili ah, Joppa khua ah, ratpi awkah, Sidon mi le Tair mi hna cu rawl le din awk le chiti kha an pek hna."},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem Pathian inn ah a ummi ah an rat a kum hnihnak, a thla hnihnak thla ah, Shealtiel fapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak fapa Jeshua nih an unau tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna, sal taannak chungin Jerusalem ah a ra cangmi vialte hna he khan, hramthawknak an tuah. Levi mi cu, kum kul ri in a cunglei kha Bawipa inn rianṭuannak i zohkhenhtu ah an thiah hna.","title":"Biakinn Hramlung An Bunh"},"9":{"text":"Cun Jeshua nih a fapa hna le a rualchan hna he, Kadmiel nih a fapa hna Judah fapa hna he cun, Pathian inn chung i rianṭuantu hna cu, Henadad fapa hna le Levi mi hna le an fapa hna le an rualchan hna he tiah an zohkhenh hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun inn satu hna nih Bawipa biaknak inn hram kha an bunh tikah, Israel siangpahrang David lam hmuhsaknak ningin, Bawipa cu thangṭhat awkah, tlangbawi hna kha an thilthuam in an i fam i muko he an hung chuak, cun Levi mi hna, Asaf fapa hna kha an sumsel he an hung chuak;","ref":"1Cha 25.1"},"11":{"text":"cun annih nih Bawipa cu an thangṭhat i an lawmh i, “ Bawipa sin i lunglawmhnak chim hi a ṭha; Zeitintiah a fekmi a dawtnak cu Israel leiah zungzal in a hmun,” tiin an i sak tonh. Bawipa inn hram cu bunh a si caah mi vialte nih Bawipa cu an thangṭhat tikah fak piin an au.","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi tampi hna le Levi mi tampi hna le pale innchungkhar lu a si ciomi tampi hna, tar pawl hmasa inn a rak hmutu hna kha cu, inn hram bunh an hmuh tikah khan, mi tampi cu lunglawm in fak piin an au nain, annih cu fak piin an ṭap i,"},"13":{"text":"cucaah lunglawmhnak au thawng le mi an ṭahnak thawng cu mi nih an thleidang kho lo; zeicahtiah mi cu fak piin an au i an au thawng cu lamhlat piin aa thei."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah mi le Benjamin mi an ral hna nih, saltang kir hna nih Bawipa, Israel Pathian inn kha an sa, ti an theih tikah,","title":"Ral Nih Rian Kha An Ngolter Hna"},"2":{"text":"Zerubbabel le pale innchungkhar lu a si ciomi kha an fuh hna i annih cu an thawh hna i, “Kan in sakpi hna lai; zeicahtiah nan Pathian cu nanmah bantukin kannih zong nih kan biak i Assiria siangpahrang Esarhaddon nih hika ah a kan ratpi thawk in atu tiang Pathian sinah cun rai kan thawi ve ko”, tiah an ti.","ref":"2Sia 17.24-41"},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Zerubbabel, Jeshua le Israel mi lak i pale innchungkhar lu cio hna nih khan, “Kan Pathian ca i inn saknak kongah nan i tel ve nakding lam a um lo; sihmanhsehlaw Persia siangpahrang Sairas nih nawl a kan pek bangin, kanmah lawng nih, Bawipa, Israel Pathian ca inn cu kan sak ko lai,” tiah an ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah cu ram mi hna nih cun Judah mi cu an tha an dorhter hna i inn sak cu an ṭihter hna,"},"5":{"text":"cun Persia siangpahrang Sairas nun chung vialte, Persia siangpahrang Darius a bawi tiangin, an i tinhmi cu a pelh khawh nakhnga annih nih fimchimtu kha an i roih hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Ahasuerus pen chung, pen aa domh kum ah khin, Judah le Jerusalem i a ummi hna sual puhnak ah ca an ṭial.","ref":"Est 1.1"},"7":{"text":"Cun Artazaksis chan ah Bishlam le Mithredath le Tabeel le an hawikom hna nih Persia siangpahrang Artazaksis sinah cun ca an ṭial; ca cu Aramaik holh in an ṭial i an leh."},"8":{"text":"Ralbawi Rehum le caṭialtu Shimshai nih Artazaksis siangpahrang sinah cun Jerusalem khua kongah a tanglei bang hin ca an ṭial —"},"9":{"text":"ralbawi Rehum, caṭialtu Shimshai le an hawikom hna, biaceihtu hna, uktu bawi hna, bawi hna, Persia mi hna, Erek mi hna, Babilon mi hna, Susa mi hna, cu hna cu Elam mi an si,"},"10":{"text":"cun a ngan i a ṭhami Osnappar nih Samaria ram chung khua hna le Tiva Ral ram a tangmi chung i a kalpi hna i a umtermi miphun hna nih khan ca cu an ṭial i"},"11":{"text":"mah hihi an kuatmi ca a khawpi cu a si — “Artazaksis siangpahrang sinah: Tiva Ral ram i a ummi na sal hna nih na kut kan in tlaih."},"12":{"text":"Nangmah sinin kan sinah a rami Judah mi hna kha Jerusalem ah an kal tiah siangpahrang nih rak hngal tuah. Ral thawh hmangmi le khua ṭhalo a simi kha an remh ṭhan i a kulhnak vampang hna cu an lim pah cang i a hram cu an remh lio."},"13":{"text":"Hi khua hi an remh ṭhan i a kulhnak vampang cu an lim hna ahcun, ngunkhuai le thil ngeih man le lam hman man kha an pe duh lai lo i siangpahrang tangka hmuhnak kha an donhkhanh lai ti kha siangpahrang nih rak hngal ko seh."},"14":{"text":"Kannih cu siangpahrang inn cite a eimi kan si i siangpahrang nih zeirellonak a hmuh ding cu kannih nih hmuh kan duh lo caah, siangpahrang cu ca kan in kuat i kan in thanh,"},"15":{"text":"na pupa hna cazin khumhnak cauk chung kha rak kawl u law, cazin khumhnak cauk chungah cun hi khua hi hlanlio piin ralthawh hmangmi khua, siangpahrang le ram ca i intuarnak petu, a chung i ral thawhnak tuah tawnnak a si kha na hmuh lai. Cucaah cun pei hi khua cu hrawh a rak si cu."},"16":{"text":"Hi khua hi remh ṭhan a si i a kulhnak vampang hna kha lim an si ahcun, Tiva Ral ram chungah hin ram na ngei ti lai lo ti kha siangpahrang cu kan in hngalhter,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih cun lehnak ca a kuat hna i, “Ralbawi Rehum le caṭialtu Shimshai le an hawikom Samaria le Tiva Ral ram i a ummi hna, nan kut kan tlaih hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun ca nan kan kuatmi kha ka hmaika ah fiang tein rel a si."},"19":{"text":"Cun nawl ka pek hna i an kawl i, hlanlio piin hi khua hi siangpahrang hna doh awkah ral a tho i a chungah hin dohnak le tuknak khuakhan a si tawn ti kha hmuh a si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Tiva Ral ram a ning piin a rak uk i, ngunkhuai, thil ngeih man le lam hman man an rak pekmi hna siangpahrang ṭhawngṭhawng kha Jerusalem uktu hi an rak si tawn."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah cun keimah nih nawlbia ka chuah hlantiang, hi mi hna hi ngolter an si i khua cu remh ṭhan a si nakhnga lo, nawlbia chuah tuah u."},"22":{"text":"Cun hi thil kongah hin thluarthlap in nan um nakhnga lo i ralring tuah u; zeicahdah siangpahrang cu harnak pek awkah rawhnak cu a ṭhan lai?” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Siangpahrang Artazaksis cakuat khawpi cu Rehum le caṭialtu Shimshai le an hawikom hna hmaiah khan rel a si tikah, Jerusalem i a ummi Judah mi sinah khan khulrang in an va kal i zaang-ennak le thazang in an ngolter hna."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa inn Jerusalem i a ummi i an ṭuannak cu ngol a si; cun Persia siangpahrang Darius a bawi kum hnihnak tiang ngol a si.","ref":"Hag 1.1; Zek 1.1"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Profet Haggai le Iddo fapa profet Zekhariah nih khan, Judah le Jerusalem i a ummi Judah mi hna sinah cun, an cung i a ummi Israel Pathian min khan bia an chim.","title":"Biakinn Remh an Thawk Ṭhan"},"2":{"text":"Khi tikah Shealtiel fapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak fapa Jeshua kha an tho i Pathian inn Jerusalem i a ummi kha remh ṭhan hram an thawk; cun an sinah cun Pathian profet kha an um i an bawmh hna.","ref":"Hag 1.12; Zek 4.6-9"},"3":{"text":"Cucaah cun Tiva Ral ram a uktu bawi Tattenai le Shethar-bozenai le an hawikom hna cu an sinah khan an ra i, “Aho nih dah hi inn le hi vampang hi sak awk le lim awkah nawl an pek hna?” tiah an ti hna."},"4":{"text":"“Hi inn a satu hna hi an min ahodah an si?” ti zongin an hal hna."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an Pathian mit cu Judah upa hna cungah khan a um i Darius sinah thawng theihternak a phak hlan le cu kong i lehnak ca in a kir hlantiang cu an ngolter kho hna lo."},"6":{"text":"Tiva Ral ram a uktu bawi Tattenai le Shethar-bozenai le Tiva Ral ram a uktu bawi an hawikom hna nih Darius siangpahrang sinah an kuatmi ca khawpi cu hi hi a si;"},"7":{"text":"thawng theihternak kha an kuat i a chungah hi bangin an ṭial: “Darius siangpahrang cungah daihnak vialte um ko seh."},"8":{"text":"Kannih nih Judah ram ah, a liannganmi Pathian inn ah kan va kal kha siangpahrang nih rak hngal tuah. Lung ngan pipi in an sak i a vampang ah thingah an chon lio a si; hi rian cu fel tein a kal i an rianṭuannak ah an hlawh a tling."},"9":{"text":"Cun kannih nih cu upa hna cu kan hal hna i, ‘Aho nih dah hi inn saknak le hi vampang limnak caah hin nawl an pek hna?’ tiin kan ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun nangmah theihter awkah an lu a simi hna min kha kan ṭial nakhnga an min zong kha kan hal hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun mah hihi an kan lehnak cu a si: ‘Kannih cu van le vawlei hna i an Pathian sal kan si i Israel siangpahrang a liannganmi pakhat nih a rak sak i a rak limmi inn, kan hnulei hlanpi i rak sakmi inn kha kan remh ṭhan."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kan pupa hna nih vancung Pathian cu a thin an phawh caah Khaldi mi Babilon siangpahrang Nebukhadnezzar kut chungah annih cu a rak chanh hna i amah nih cun hi inn hi a hrawh i mi cu Babilon ah a rak kalpi hna.","ref":"2Sia 25.8-12; 2Cha 36.17-20; Jer 52.12-15"},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Babilon uktu siangpahrang Sairas a bawi kum khatnak ah, Sairas siangpahrang nih cun hi Pathian inn hi remh ṭhan a si nakhnga nawlbia a chuah.","ref":"Ezr 1.2-11"},"14":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn chung i sui le ngun umkheng hna, Nebukhadnezzar nih Jerusalem khua i a ummi biakinn chungin a chuah i Babilon i a ummi biakinn chungah a kalpimi hna cu, hi thil hna cu Siangpahrang Sairas nih Babilon biakinn khan a chuah hna i amah nih uktu bawi ah a sermi mipa pakhat a min Sheshbazzar a simi sinah khan a pek;"},"15":{"text":"cun amah cu a thawh i, “Hi umkheng hna hi i lak hna law va kal law Jerusalem i a um mi biakinn ah khan va chia hna, cun Pathian inn cu a hmun ah khan sak ṭhan si seh,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah hi Sheshbazzar cu a ra i Pathian inn Jerusalem i a ummi hram kha a bunh; cu caan thawk in atu tiang sak lengmang a si ko i a dih rih lo,’ an ti."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang nih a ṭha tiah a ruah ahcun, Babilon i siangpahrang thilhlun khonnak ah khan rak kawl hna seh law, hi Pathian inn Jerusalem i a ummi sak ṭhannak caah hin Siangpahrang Sairas nih nawlbia a chuah maw chuah lo rak zoh hna seh. Cun siangpahrang nih hi kong i a duhnak kha kan kua seh,” tiah an ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Darius siangpahrang nih cun nawlbia a chuah i Babilonia i ca an chiahnak thilhlunkhonnak inn chung cu an kawl."},"2":{"text":"Cun Media ram khuapi a simi Ekbatana khua ah khan cazual pakhat an hmuh i cu cazual chungah cun mah hihi aa ṭial: “Ken awk."},"3":{"text":"Sairas siangpahrang a bawi kum khatnak ah, Sairas siangpahrang nih nawlbia a chuah: Jerusalem i a ummi Pathian kongah, raithawinak an pekchanhnak le khangh thawinak an rak putnak hmun inn cu sak ṭhan si seh; a san cu dong sawm ruk a si lai i a vang cu dong sawm ruk a si lai,"},"4":{"text":"lung ngan pipi tlar thum in an um lai i a thing cu tlar khat a si lai; cun a man cu siangpahrang tangka in pek si seh."},"5":{"text":"Cun Pathian inn chung i sui le ngun umkheng hna, Jerusalem i a ummi biakinn chungin Nebukhadnezzar nih a lak i Babilon ah a ratpimi hna zong kha khirh ṭhan si hna seh law, Jerusalem i a ummi biakinn ah khan anmah le an hmunte cio ah chiah ṭhan si hna seh; Pathian inn chungah khan nan chiah hna lai,” ti in a um."},"6":{"text":"“Cucaah Tattenai, Tiva Ral ram uktu bawi, Shethar-bozenai le nan hawikom Tiva Ral ram uktu bawi a simi hna, rak naih hna hlah u;"},"7":{"text":"hi Pathian biakinn rian hi dawnkhan hlah u; Judah mi uktu bawi le Judah mi upa hna nih hi Pathian inn hi amah hmun te ah khan sa ṭhan ko hna seh."},"8":{"text":"Cuhleiah hi Pathian inn sak ṭhannak caah hin Judah mi upa hna caah hin zeidah nan tuah awk a simi kongah nawlbia ka chuah cang; hi mi hna hi a man cu tling tein le rau lo tein, siangpahrang tangka, Tiva Ral ram nih ngunkhuai an thawhmi chung khan pek an si lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun annih nih vancung Pathian sinah khan raithawinak rim thaw kha an pekchanh i siangpahrang le a fapa hna nunnak caah thla an cam nakhnga, vancung Pathian sin i khangh thawinak caah a herhmi paoh cawtum no si hna seh, tuukawng si hna seh, tuu si hna seh, changvut si seh, cite si seh, mitsur hang si seh, chiti si seh, Jerusalem i tlangbawi hna nih an herh ningin nifate in pel lo tein nan rak pek hna lai.","merge":"10"},"11":{"text":"Cun hi nawlbia hi ahohmanh nih an thlen ahcun a thlengtu cu a inn chung i kaan pakhat kha zuh a si lai i cu kaan ah cun amah cu ṭem chih i fung in tuk a si lai; cu pinah a inn kha chuh a si lai, tiah nawl zong ka ser fawn."},"12":{"text":"Khika ah a min a umtertu Pathian nih hi thil hi thlen awkah le Jerusalem i a ummi Pathian inn kha hrawh awkah a kut a chuahtu cu ahohmanh, siangpahrang a si ah, miphun an si ah, hrawh dih si hna seh. Keimah Darius nih nawlbia hi ka chuah, fel tein tuah si seh,” a ti."},"13":{"text":"Khi tikah Darius siangpahrang nih bia a kuat hna ningin, Tattenai, Tiva Ral ram uktu bawi, Shethar-bozenai le an hawikom hna nih Darius siangpahrang nawl pekmi cu fel tein an tuah."},"14":{"text":"Cun profet Haggai le Iddo fapa Zekhariah chimnak thawngin Judah mi upa hna nih cun an sak i an hma a kal. Israel Pathian nawlbia le Persia siangpahrang Sairas, Darius, le Artazaksis nawl peknak thawngin, an inn sak cu an lim;","ref":"Hag 1.1; Zek 1.1"},"15":{"text":"cun hi inn cu Darius siangpahrang a bawi kum ruknak kum Adar thla ni thum ni ah lim a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun hi Pathian inn pekchanhnak cu Israel mi hna le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna le saltannak in a kirmi a dang hna nih khan lunglawm ngaiin an hman."},"17":{"text":"Hi Pathian inn pekchanhnak ah hin cawtum za khat, tuukawng za hnih le tuufa za li an pekchanh i Israel mi vialte sual thawinak caah Israel mi an phun ning zat in mehehtum hleihnih an pekchanh,"},"18":{"text":"cun Moses cauk chungah aa ṭial bangkhan, tlangbawi hna cu an i cheu ningin, Levi mi hna cu an phu an phu in, Jerusalem i Pathian rianṭuan awkah khan an thiah hna."},"19":{"text":"Thla khatnak thla, a ni hleili ni ah saltannak in a kirmi hna nih khan lanhtak puai kha an tuah.","ref":"Exo 12.1-20"},"20":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna kha an i thianh cang caah, an dihlak in an thiang. Cucaah saltannak in a kirmi vialte le an tlangbawi bawi hna le anmah caah khan lanhtak tuufa kha an thah;"},"21":{"text":"Israel mi saltannak in a kirmi hna le Bawipa, Israel Pathian biak awkah anmah sinah khan aa fon i cu ram mi hna thurhnawmhnak in aa thleidangmi vialte hna zong nih an ei ve."},"22":{"text":"Cun thilnu telh lo changreu puai kha ni sarih lunglawmhnak in an tuah; zeicahtiah Pathian nih an lung a lawmhter hna i Assiria siangpahrang lung cu anmah leiah khan a merter, cucaah anih nih khan Pathian, Israel mi hna Pathian inn rian ah khan, a bawmh hna."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun hi hnuah hin Persia siangpahrang Artazaksis chan ah Ezra cu Babilon in a hung kal; Ezra cu Seraiah fapa a si, Seraiah cu Azariah fapa a si, Azariah cu Hilkiah fapa a si;","title":"Ezra le A Phu Hna Jerusalem Ah An Ra"},"2":{"text":"Hilkiah cu Shallum fapa a si, Shallum cu Zadok fapa a si, Zadok cu Ahitub fapa a si,"},"3":{"text":"Ahitub cu Amariah fapa a si, Amariah cu Azariah fapa a si, Azariah cu Meraioth fapa a si,"},"4":{"text":"Meraioth cu Zerahiah fapa a si, Zerahiah cu Uzzi fapa a si, Uzzi cu Bukki fapa a si,"},"5":{"text":"Bukki cu Abishua fapa a si, Abishua cu Finehas fapa a si, Finehas cu Eleazar fapa a si, Eleazar cu tlangbawi bik Aaron fapa a si —"},"6":{"text":"hi Ezra cu Babilonia in a hung kal. Amah cu Bawipa, Israel Pathian nih a pekmi Moses phungbia i a thiam ngaingaimi a si; Bawipa, a Pathian kut cu a cungah a um caah, a halmi vialte kha siangpahrang nih a pek dih."},"7":{"text":"Cun Artazaksis a bawi kum sarihnak ah khan Israel mi tlawmpal, tlangbawi tlawmpal, Levi mi tlawmpal, hlasatu hna, kutka cawngtu hna le biakinn rianṭuantu hna kha Jerusalem ah amah he cun an hung kal."},"8":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang a bawi kum sarihnak a thla nganak thla ah khan Jerusalem cu an phan;"},"9":{"text":"thla khatnak thla a ni khatnak ni ah Babilonia in aa thawh i thla nganak thla a ni khatnak ni ah Jerusalem cu a phan, zeicahtiah a Pathian kut velngeihnak cu a cungah khan a um."},"10":{"text":"Ezra nih Bawipa phungbia kha cawn awk le tuah awk le a nawlbia hna le a phunglam hna kha Israel mi cawnpiak awk kha a lung in aa sehchih."},"11":{"text":"Cun mah hihi Siangpahrang Artazaksis nih Israel mi ca i Bawipa nawlbia hna le phungbia hna a thiam ngaingaimi cazi, tlangbawi Ezra sinah a pekmi ca a khawpi cu a si:"},"12":{"text":"“Siangpahrang hna siangpahrang Artazaksis nih vancung Pathian phungbia cazi, tlangbawi Ezra sinah:"},"13":{"text":"Atu cu keimah nih nawlbia ka chuah i ka ram chung i a ummi Israel mi ahopaoh si hna seh, an tlangbawi si hna seh, Levi mi si hna seh, Jerusalem ah mah lungtho tein kal a duhmi paoh cu nangmah sinah an kal kho lai."},"14":{"text":"Zeitintiah nangmah kut chung i a ummi na Pathian phungbia bangin Judah le Jerusalem kong kha va dothlat awkah, nangmah cu siangpahrang le a ruahnak petu pasarih hna nih kan in thlah,"},"15":{"text":"cun siangpahrang le a ruahnak petu hna nih Jerusalem i a ummi Israel Pathian caah mah lungtho tein an thawhmi ngun le sui le"},"16":{"text":"Babilonia ram i na hmuh laimi ngun le sui vialte le Jerusalem i a ummi an Pathian inn ca i mah lungtho tein biakamnak in mizapi hna le tlangbawi hna nih mah lungtho tein an thawhmi vialte zong kha na hei phorh lai."},"17":{"text":"Hi tangka hin fel tein cawtum hna le tuukawng hna le tuufa hna kha an changvut thawinak hna le an thlet thawinak hna he tiah na cawk hna lai i na Pathian inn Jerusalem i a ummi biakṭheng cungah cun na pekchanh hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun ngun le sui a tang rihmi hna cu nangmah le na unau hna nih a ṭha tiah nan ruahmi paoh, nan Pathian duhnak ningin, nan tuah lai."},"19":{"text":"Na Pathian inn rianṭuannak caah an in pekmi umkheng hna cu Jerusalem Pathian hmaika ah cun na va chiah hna lai."},"20":{"text":"Cun na Pathian inn caah thil dang a herh rihmi paohpaoh nangmah nih peknak caan na ngeihmi paoh cu, siangpahrang tangka chungin na rak pek ko lai."},"21":{"text":"“Cun keimah Artazaksis siangpahrang nih Tiva Ral ram i a ummi tangka kengtu vialte hna sinah nawlbia ka chuah cang i: Vancung Pathian phungbia cazi tlangbawi Ezra nih an halmi hna paoh cu,"},"22":{"text":"ngun talen za khat tiang, changvut phor za khat tiang, mitsur hang bath za khat tiang, chiti bath za khat tiang, cun cite cu zeizat tinak um loin, fel tein nan rak tuah lai."},"23":{"text":"Vancung Pathian nawl pekmi paoh cu, siangpahrang le a fapa hna pennak cungah hin a thinhunnak a tlun sual nakhnga lo, vancung Pathian inn caah tling tein tuah si seh."},"24":{"text":"Cun hi Pathian inn chung tlangbawi si hna seh, Levi mi si hna seh, hlasatu si hna seh, kutka cawngtu si hna seh, biakinn rianṭuantu si hna seh, rianṭuantu dangdang si hna seh, ahohmanh ngunkhuai siseh, thil ngeih man siseh, lam hman man siseh, thawhter cu a phung a si lai lo ti zong kha kan in theihter hna."},"25":{"text":"“Cun nang, Ezra, na Pathian fimnak na kut chung i a ummi ning khan, Tiva Ral ram i a ummi vialte, na Pathian phungbia a hngalmi vialte kha bia a ceihtu dingah uktu bawi le biaceihtu kha na chiah hna lai; cun phungbia a hngal lomi kha nan cawnpiak hna lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun na Pathian phungbia le siangpahrang nawlbia a ngai lomi paoh cu thah awk siseh, ram chungin ṭhawl awk siseh, a thil chuh awk siseh, thong thlak awk siseh, a cungah biakhiahnak kha fek tein tuah a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Ezra nih, “ Bawipa, kan pupa hna Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh. Bawipa inn Jerusalem i a ummi kha dawhter awkah hi thil hi amah nih siangpahrang lung chungah khan a chiah i"},"28":{"text":"amah nih siangpahrang le a ruahnak petu hna hmai le siangpahrang bawi a ṭhawngmi vialte hna hmaiah khan a fekmi a dawtnak cu ka cungah a chuan. Bawipa, ka Pathian kut cu ka cungah a um caah ka ral a ṭha i Israel mi hna lakin keimah sin i kal awkah hruitu deuhdeuh kha ka thim hna,” a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Artazaksis a bawi lio i Babilonia in keimah sinah a hung kal vemi hna cu pale chungkhar lu cio kha an si i mah hihi an tefa hna cu an si:"},"2":{"text":"Finehas tefa hna chungin Gershom. Ithamar tefa hna chungin Daniel. David tefa hna chungin Shekaniah fapa Hattush,"},"3":{"text":"Parosh tefa hna chungin Zekhariah, amah sinah cun pa za khat le sawm nga minthlak an si."},"4":{"text":"Pahath-moab tefa hna chungin Zerahiah fapa Eliehoenai, amah he cun pa za hnih."},"5":{"text":"Zattu tefa hna chungin, Jahaziel fapa Shekaniah, cun amah he cun pa za thum."},"6":{"text":"Adin tefa hna chungin, Jonathan fapa Ebed, cun amah he cun pa sawm nga."},"7":{"text":"Elam tefa hna chungin, Athaliah fapa Jeshaiah, amah he cun pa sawm sarih."},"8":{"text":"Shefatiah tefa hna chungin, Mikhael fapa Zebadiah, cun amah he cun pa sawm riat."},"9":{"text":"Joab tefa hna chungin, Jehiel fapa Obadiah, cun amah he cun pa za hnih le hleiriat."},"10":{"text":"Bani tefa hna chungin, Josifiah fapa Shelomith, cun amah he cun pa za khat le sawm ruk."},"11":{"text":"Bebai tefa hna chungin, Bebai fapa Zekhariah, cun amah he cun pa pakul le pariat."},"12":{"text":"Azgad tefa hna chungin Hakkatan fapa Johanan, cun amah he cun pa za khat le pahra."},"13":{"text":"Adonikam tefa hna chungin, annih cu hnu deuh i a ra mi an si, an min cu Elifelet, Jeuel, le Shemaiah an si, cun anmah he pa sawm ruk."},"14":{"text":"Bigvai tefa hna chungin Uthai le Zakkur, cun anmah he pa sawm sa rih."},"15":{"text":"Ahava khua i a va luangmi tiva ah ka pumh hna i khika ah zan thum kan riak. Mi zapi hna le tlangbawi hna kha ka zoh ṭhan hna tikah khika ah Levi fapa hna chung mi pakhat hmanh ka hmu hna lo."},"16":{"text":"Cun mi hruitu Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah, le Meshullam le mifim Joiarib le Elnathan kha ka cah hna i"},"17":{"text":"Kasifia hmun i hruitu a simi Iddo sinah khan ka thlah hna. Annih cu Kasifia i a ummi Iddo le a unau biakinn rianṭuantu hna sin i va chim awk kha ka chimh hna, cucu zeidah a si tiah, kan Pathian inn i rianṭuantu an kan kuat hna nakhnga ding kha a si."},"18":{"text":"Cun kan cung i a ummi kan Pathian kut velngeihnak thawngin, Israel fapa Levi fapa Mahli fapa hna chungin mifim ngaingai a simi Sherebiah le a fapa hna le a rualchan hna, hleiriat kha ka sinah an ratpi hna;"},"19":{"text":"Hashabiah zong Merari fapa hna chung i Jeshaiah le a rualchan hna le a fapa hna, pakul hna he tiah an ratpi;"},"20":{"text":"cu lengah David le a bawi pawl nih Levi mi hna bultawltu ah an rak thleidanmi hna biakinn rianṭuantu za hnih le kul zong kha an ratpi hna. Hi hna hi an min tein ṭial an si dih."},"21":{"text":"Cun kan Pathian sinin kanmah ca le kan fale hna ca le kan thilri vialte ca i lam ding kawl awkah amah hmaiah cun kan lung kan i ṭhumh khawh nakhnga Ahava tiva ah cun rawl ulhnak kan thanh."},"22":{"text":"Cun kannih nih, “Kan Pathian kut cu amah a kawltu hna cung paoh ah cun ṭhatnak caah a um i amah a hlawtu hna paoh cu a thinhunnak ṭhawnnak kha a chuahhnawh hna,” tiin siangpahrang kha kan rak chimh cang caah, kan lam i kan ral hna sinin a kan vengtu dingah ralkap bu khat le rangcung ralkap kha siangpahrang cu hal awkah ka ning a zak."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah cun rawl kan ul i kan Pathian cu kan hal i kan nawlnak cu a kan ngaihpiak."},"24":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi upa bikbik hleihnih, Sherebiah, Hashabiah le an unau hna pahra kha a dang tein ka chiah hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang le a fim chimtu hna le a bawi hna le khika i a ummi Israel mi vialte nih, kan Pathian inn ca i an thawhmi ngun le sui le umkheng hna cu an sinah ka thlai i ka pek hna;"},"26":{"text":"an kut chung i ka thlai i ka pekmi hna cu hihi an si: ngun talen za ruk le sawm nga, ngun umkheng talen za khat man, sui talen za khat,"},"27":{"text":"sui khengkuar pakul, darik thong khat man, cun sui man sung tlukin a man a fakmi dar tleu um pahnih."},"28":{"text":"Cun annih cu ka thawh hna i, “Nannih cu Bawipa caah nan thiang i umkheng zong hi an thiang ve; cun ngun le sui hna cu Bawipa nan pupa hna Pathian ca i mah lungtho tein thawhmi thawhlawm an si."},"29":{"text":"Tlangbawi bik hna le Levi mi hna le Israel mi lak i pale innchungkhar cung i lu cio a simi hna hmaiah Jerusalem ah Bawipa inn chung dal chungah nan thlai hna hlan cu nan ven hna lai i nan ken hna lai,” tiah ka ti."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah Jerusalem i kan Pathian inn i kalpi awkah tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna nih ngun le sui le umkheng hna cu an lak hna."},"31":{"text":"Cun kannih cu Jerusalem i kal awkah cun thla khatnak thla a ni hleihnih ni ah cun Ahava tiva cun kan i thawh; kan Pathian kut cu kan cungah a um i kan ral hna kut chung le lam i lamhruang a rak kan ahtu hna kut chungin a kan khamh."},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem cu kan phan i khika ah ni thum kan cam."},"33":{"text":"A ni linak ni ah cun, kan Pathian inn chungah khan, ngun le sui le umkheng hna cu Uriah fapa tlangbawi Meremoth kut chungah khan kan thlai hna i kan pek hna, amah sinah cun Finehas fapa Eleazar kha a um i an sinah cun Levi mi Jeshua fapa Jozabad le Binnui fapa Noadiah kha an um."},"34":{"text":"A ningpi cun rel a si i thlai a si i zeipaoh a rih ning kha ṭial a si dih."},"35":{"text":"Khi caan ah khan, sal taannak in a kir cangmi, sal chuak pawl nih khan Israel Pathian sinah cun khangh thawinak, Israel mi vialte caah cawtum hleihnih, tuukawng sawm kua le paruk, tuufa sawm sarih le pasarih, cun sual thawinak caah mehehtum hleihnih an pekchanh; mah vialte hi Bawipa sin i pekchanhmi khangh thawinak a si."},"36":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih a chiahmi bawi upa hna le Tiva Ral ram uktu bawi hna sinah cun siangpahrang nawlbia ca zong cu an pek hna i annih nih mi hna le Pathian inn cu an bawmh hna."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi thil hi tuah dih an si tikah, bawi hna nih cun an ka fuh i, “Israel mi hna le tlangbawi hna le Levi mi hna nih hin hi ram miphun Kanaan mi hna le Hit mi hna le Periz mi hna le Jebus mi hna le Ammon mi hna le Moab mi hna le Izipt mi hna le Amor mi hna le an thil fihnung hna sin khan an i thleidang lo.","title":"Ezra Sualphuan Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"An fanu hna kha nupi caah le an fapale hna nupi caah an lak hna i cucaah phun thiang cu hi ram mi hna he hin cawh a si cang. Cun hi zumhtlak loin umnak ah hin bawi hna le upapa hna kha an zualhma,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Mah hi ka theih tikah ka puan hna le ka angki kha ka thleh hna i ka lu sam le ka khahmul kha ka bawh hna i awlokchong in ka ṭhu."},"4":{"text":"Cun salchuak pawl zumhtlak loin an um ruang i Israel Pathian bia ah a thermi hna cu, zanlei raithawinak tiang khuaruahhar in ka ṭhut ko lioah khan ka sinah an rak i pum."},"5":{"text":"Cun zanlei raithawinak caan ah khan ka puan le ka angki tlek he cun rawl ka ulhnak khan ka hung tho i ka khuk kaa bil i Bawipa ka Pathian sinah cun ka kut ka samh hna i:"},"6":{"text":"“Maw ka Pathian, nangmah lei hoih hi ka ning a zak i ka hmai a sen ko, zeicahtiah kan ṭhat lonak nih kan lu a lonh i kan mawhnak cu van a tawng."},"7":{"text":"Kan pupa hna chan in nihin tiang mawhnak nganpi kan tuah lengmang ko; cun kan ṭhat lonak caah cun kanmah le kan siangpahrang hna le kan tlangbawi hna cu ramdang siangpahrang hna kut chungah pek kan si i vainam le saltannak le ramhnak le mualphonak cu nihin i bang hin rak in lengmang kan si."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu caan tawite chung kha Bawipa kan Pathian nih zaangfahnak kan cungah a langhter, kannih cu Pathian nih kan mit kha a ceuter i kan saltannak chungah khan nun ṭhannak tlawmte a kan pek nakhnga, a tangmi a kan nganhpiak i a hmunthiang chungah a himmi hmun a kan pek."},"9":{"text":"Kannih cu sal kan si ko, sihmanhsehlaw sal kan sinak chungah hin kan Pathian nih a kan philh lo i kan Pathian inn cu dirh ṭhan awk le a rawhnak kha remh awk le Judea ram le Jerusalem khua ah kannih cu huhphenhnak pek awk le nun ṭhannak kannih cu pek awkah Persia siangpahrang hna hmaiah cun a fekmi a dawtnak tu kha a kan pek."},"10":{"text":"“Maw kan Pathian, atu cu mah hnuah hin zeidah kan chim ti lai? Zeicahtiah na nawlbia,"},"11":{"text":"na sal profet hna sinin na kan pek i, ‘Va co awkah nan va luhhnawh laimi ram cu, cu ram i a ummi hna thian lonak thawngin a thurhnawm i khattelei kam in khattelei kam tiang an fihnunnak le an thian lonak in a khatmi ram a si."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah nan fanu hna cu an fapa hna kha pe hna hlah u law, an fanu hna zong nan fapa hna caah la hna hlah u, cun kan ṭhawng lai i ram chung thil ṭha cu kan ei hna lai i kan tefa hna cu zungzal ca in ro ah kan roh hna lai tiin annih he remnak siseh, rumnak siseh kawl hlah u,’ tiah na timi kha kan hlawt hna.","ref":"Exo 34.11-16; Deu 7.1-5"},"13":{"text":"Cun kan ṭhat lonak le kan mawhnak a nganmi ruang i kan cung i a tlungmi thil vialte hna hnuah hin, kan Pathian, kan ṭhat lonak nih a hmuh awk hnga nakin tlawm deuh in nangmah nih dan na kan tat i hi bantuk a tangmi hi na kan pek ti kha kan hmuh caah"},"14":{"text":"na nawlbia hna kha buar ṭhan in hi thil fihnung a tuahmi hna he hin kan i ṭhi-um ko rih lai maw? A tangmi siseh, a luatmi siseh, kan um lo tiangin kannih kha hrawh dih awkah kan cungah na thin a hung lai lo maw?"},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, Israel Pathian, nihin ah a si bang hin, kannih cu a luatmi a tangmi na kan nganh caah nangmah cu na ding ko. Na hmaiah misual si ko hmanh u sih law, kan zoh ko rih, zeicahtiah kan sualnak ruangah cun na hmaiah a dir khomi ahohmanh kan um lo,” tiah ka ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ezra cu thla a cam i sual phuannak a tuah i a ṭah i Pathian inn hmaiah cun a rilh ko lioah khan, mibu nganpi, nu he ngakchia he Israel mi chungin amah sinah khan an i pum i mi cu lunghno ngaiin an ṭap.","title":"Ramdangmi An Nupi Hna le An Fale Hna Kha An Dawi Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun Elam fapa hna chung i Jehiel i a fapa Shekaniah nih khan Ezra cu a chawnh i: “Kannih nih kan Pathian cungah zumhawktlak loin kan um i hi ram mi hna chung hin ramdang nu kha nupi ah kan i ṭhit hna, sihmanhsehlaw atu hmanh ah hin hitihin thil a si ko nain ruahchannak a um ko rih."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah ka bawipa ruahnak cheuhning in le kan Pathian nawlbia ah a thermi hna ruahnak cheuhnak bangin, hi kan nupi vialte hna le an fale hna hi hlawt awkah kan Pathian sinah biakamnak ser u sih; cun phungbia ningin tuah si seh."},"4":{"text":"Mah cucu na rian a si caah tho law, tuah ko, ṭih hlah, na sinah kan ṭang,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Ezra cu a tho i tlangbawi hna lak i hruitu deuhdeuh hna kha le Levi mi hna le Israel mi vialte kha an chim cang bantuk khan tuah awkah chiat a serter hna. Cucaah chiat cu an ser."},"6":{"text":"Cun Ezra cu Pathian inn hmai khan a tho i Eliashib fapa Jehohanan khaan chungah khan a va kal i khika ah cu zan cu rawl zong ei lo ti zong ding loin a riak; zeicahtiah salchuak pawl zumhtlak loin an um ruangah khan a ngaih a chia."},"7":{"text":"Cun Judah ram dihlak le Jerusalem ah khan, Jerusalem ah nan i pum lai tiin, salchuakmi vialte sinah cun thawng thanhnak an tuah i"},"8":{"text":"ni thum chung i a chuak lomi paoh cu bawi hna le upa hna nawl in a thil vialte chuh a si lai i amah cu salchuak pawl bu chung luh kha donh a si lai, tiah ti a si."},"9":{"text":"Khi tikah Judah le Benjamin mi vialte cu ni thum chungah Jerusalem ah an i pum; thla kuanak thla, a ni kul ni ah a si. Cun mi vialte cu Pathian inn hmai i tual ah cun an i pum i hi thil kong ah hin le ruah tampi a sur caah an ther ko."},"10":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi Ezra cu a dir i a thawh hna i, “Nannih nih nan palh cang i ramdang nu kha nan ṭhit hna i cuticun Israel mawhnak kha nan karhter cang."},"11":{"text":"Atu cu nan pupa hna Pathian, Bawipa sinah khan sual phuannak tuah u law, amah duhnak kha tuah tuah u; hi ramchung mi hna le ramdang nu hna sin khan i ṭhen ko u,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun aa pummi vialte nih aw thang piin, “A si taktak ko; na chim bangin kan tuah lai."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi hi an tam i ruah fak piin a sur caan a si fawn; lengah hitihin kan dir kho lo. Cun hi rian hi ni khat ni hnih rian zong a si fawn lo; zeicahtiah hi kongah hin fak piin kan buar cang."},"14":{"text":"Kan bawi hna cu aa pummi bu dihlak caah hin dir hna seh; cun kan khua cio i ramdangmi nupi a ngeimi paoh cu, hi kong i kan Pathian thinhunnak ṭihnung cu kan cungin a ṭian hlantiang, an khua cio i upa hna le biaceihtu hna he a caan tinhmi ah cun ra hna seh,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Asahel fapa Jonathan le Tikvah fapa Jahzeiah lawnglawng nih mah hihi an al i Meshullam le Levi mi Shabbethai nih annih cu an bawmh hna."},"16":{"text":"Cu bang cun salchuak pawl nih cun an tuah. Tlangbawi Ezra nih khan mi cu a thim hna, annih cu pale innchungkhar ning cio ah lu a simi an si i an min cio ah thiah an si. Thla hranak thla, a ni khat ni ah cu kong cu ruah awkah an i pum;"},"17":{"text":"cun thla khatnak thla a ni khat ni ah, ramdang nu a ṭhimi vialte hna donghnak cu a phan."},"18":{"text":"Tlangbawi fapa hna lakah ramdang nu a ṭhimi hna cu Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, le Gedaliah an si, annih cu Jozadak fa Jeshua le a unau hna i fapa chung mi an si."},"19":{"text":"An nupile cu hlawt awk kha bia an i kam i an phungbuar thawinak cu tuurun chungin tuukawng pakhat, an mawhnak caah cun a si."},"20":{"text":"Immer tefa hna chungin; Hanani le Zebadiah."},"21":{"text":"Harim tefa hna chungin: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, le Uzziah."},"22":{"text":"Pashhur tefa hna chungin: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad le Elasah."},"23":{"text":"Levi mi hna chungin: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, (cucu Kelita a si), Pethahiah, Judah le Eliezer."},"24":{"text":"Hlasatu hna chungin: Eliashib. Kutka cawngtu hna chungin: Shallum, Telem le Uri."},"25":{"text":"Israel mi chungin: Parosh tefa hna chungin: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkhijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah le Benaiah."},"26":{"text":"Elam tefa hna chungin: Mattaniah, Zekhariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, le Elijah."},"27":{"text":"Zattu tefa hna chungin: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad le Aziza."},"28":{"text":"Bebai tefa hna chungin: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai le Athlai an si."},"29":{"text":"Bani tefa hna chungin Meshullam, Malluk, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal le Jeremoth an si."},"30":{"text":"Pahathmoab tefa hna chungin: Adna, Khelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, le Manasseh."},"31":{"text":"Harim tefa hna chungin: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malkhijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,"},"32":{"text":"Benjamin, Malluk, le Shemariah."},"33":{"text":"Hashum tefa hna chungin: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Elifelet, Jeremai, Manasseh le Shimei."},"34":{"text":"Bani tefa hna chungin: Maadai, Amram, Uel."},"35":{"text":"Benaiah, Bedeiah, Kheluhi,"},"36":{"text":"Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,"},"37":{"text":"Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu."},"38":{"text":"Binnui tefa hna chungin: Shimei,"},"39":{"text":"Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,"},"40":{"text":"Makhnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,"},"41":{"text":"Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,"},"42":{"text":"Shallum, Amariah le Josef."},"43":{"text":"Nebo tefa hna chungin: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel le Benaiah."},"44":{"text":"Hi vialte nih hin ramdang nu hna kha an ṭhit hna i an nupi le cu an fale hna he khan an kalter hna."}}}}},"16":{"info":{"name":"Nehemiah","shortname":"Neh","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hakaliah fapa Nehemiah bia. Kum kulnak kum, Khislev thla i Susa khuapi chungah ka um lioah,","title":"Jerusalem Caah Nehemiah Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"ka unau Hanani cu Judah ram chung mi cheukhat he an ra; cun a nung rihmi Judah mi salchuak hna kong le Jerusalem khua kong kha ka hal hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun annih nih an ka thawh i, “Saltannak chungin a luatmi khika ram i a nung rihmi hna cu harnak nganpi chung le ningzahnak chungah an um ko; Jerusalem kulhnak vampang hna cu an cim dih i a kutka hna cu mei nih a hrawh dih hna,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Hi bia cu ka theih tikah ka ṭhu i ka ṭap i saupi ngaihchia in ka um i vancung Pathian hmaiah khan rawl ul lengmang le thlacam lengmang in ka um."},"5":{"text":"Cun kaa thawh i, “Maw Bawipa, vancung Pathian, nangmah an dawtu le na nawlbia a ulmi hna cung i biakamnak le a fekmi na dawtnak a hmunhtertu a lian a ngan i ṭih a nungmi Pathian,"},"6":{"text":"Israel mi hna nih nangmah cungah kan sual cang i cu sualnak cu phuang in na sal Israel mi hna caah chun zan in nangmah hmaiah thla ka cammi hi theih awkah na hna in ka ngaihpiak law, na mit in ka hmuhpiak ko sawh. Asi, keimah le ka pa innchungkhar hna cu kan sual cang."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah cungah ṭhat lonak kan tuah i na sal Moses sinah na pekmi na nawlbia le phungbia le phunglam hna kha kan zul hna lo."},"8":{"text":"Na sal Moses sinah nawl na pek i, ‘Zumhawktlak loin nan um ahcun miphun hna lakah kan ṭhek hna lai;","ref":"Lev 26.33"},"9":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ka sinah nan kir i ka nawlbia kha nan zulh hna i nan tuah hna ahcun, nan mi aa ṭhekmi hna cu a hlatnak bik vanhramdeng khi phan hna hmanh seh law, khika khan ka pumh hna lai i ka min chiahnak ah ka thim cangmi hmun ah cun ka pumh hna lai,’ ti in na timi kha philh hin hlah.","ref":"Deu 30.1-5"},"10":{"text":"Annih cu nangmah nih na ṭhawnnak a nganmi le a ṭhawngmi na kut in na tlanhmi hna na sal le na mi an si."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa na sal ka thlacamnak hi ka ngaihpiak ko sawh; cun na sal hi nihin ah ka hlawh ka tlinter ko law hi mipa hmaiah hin zaangfahnak ka pe ko,” tiah ka ti. Cu lioah cun kei cu siangpahrang hrai putu ka rak si."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nisan thla, Artazaksis Siangpahrang a bawi kum kulnak ah, a hmaika i mitsur hang a um tikah, mitsur hang cu ka lak i siangpahrang kha ka pek. Hi hlan ah cun a hmaiah khan ka ngaih a chia bal lo.","title":"Nehemiah Cu Jerusalem Ah Thlah A Si"},"2":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih khan a ka thawh i, “Zeicahdah na hmai a chiat? Na zawt fawn ṭung lo? Zeidang si loin, na lung chungin na ngaih a chia i a si ko hih,” tiah a ti. Cun kei cu ka thin a phang ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu ka thawh i, “Siangpahrang cu zungzal in nung ko seh! Ka pupa hna thlan umnak khuapi cu a rawh ko i a kutka hna cu mei nih a kangh dih hna tikah hin, zeicahdah hmaichia loin ka um hnga,” tiah ka ti.","ref":"2Sia 25.8-10; 2Cha 36.19; Jer 12.14"},"4":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih cun a ka thawh i, “Zeidah na ka hal duhmi a si?” tiah a ti. Cucaah vancung Pathian sinah khan thla ka cam."},"5":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang cu ka thawh i, “Siangpahrang duhnak a si i na hmaiah na sal nih hin mithmai ṭha ka hmuh a si ahcun, ka va remh nakhnga, Judah ram ka pupa hna thlan umnak khuapi ah cun ka kalter tuah,” tiah ka ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih cun a ka thawh i (siangpahrang bawinu cu a pawngah khan a ṭhu), “Zei can dah na rauh hnga, cun zei tikah dah na ra kir ṭhan hnga?” tiah a ti. Cuticun siangpahrang nih keimah kalter kha a duhmi a si i kei nih caan cu ka tuk."},"7":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang sinah cun, “Siangpahrang duhnak a si ahcun, Tiva Ral ram a uktu hna cu va pek awkah, Judah ram ka phak tiangin an ka lanhter lengmang nakhnga, ca ka pe;"},"8":{"text":"cun biakinn kulhnak kutka ca kaan le khua kulhnak vampang caah le keimah umnak ding inn caah thing a ka pek nakhnga, siangpahrang tupi uktu Asaf cu va pek awkah ca pakhat in ka pe fawn,” tiah ka ti. Cun ka Pathian velngeihnak cu ka sinah a um caah ka halmi cu siangpahrang nih a ka pek."},"9":{"text":"Cun Tiva Ral ram a uktu bawi hna sinah cun ka va phan i siangpahrang ca cu ka pek hna. Siangpahrang nih keimah sinah cun ralkapbu ralbawi hna le rangcung ralkap hna kha a kalter hna."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Horon mi Sanballat le a sinum Tobiah, Ammon mi kha, Israel fale hna kha an nunnuamhnak kawlpiak awkah mi a ra, ti an theih tikah lungnuam lo ngaiin an um."},"11":{"text":"Cuticun Jerusalem khua cu ka phan i khika ah ni thum ka um.","title":"Kulhnak Vampang Remhnak"},"12":{"text":"Cun zan ah keimah sin i a ummi mi tlawmpal he khan ka tho; sihmanhsehlaw Jerusalem khua ca i tuah awkah Pathian nih ka lung chungah a chuahtermi tu cu ahohmanh ka chim hna lo. Kaa citmi saṭil dah ti lo cu ka sinah saṭil zeihmanh an um lo."},"13":{"text":"Zan ah kaa chawk i Nelrawn Kutka in Cenghngia Tikhor tiang, cun Hnawmpon Kutka tiang ka kal i Jerusalem kulhnak vampang a cimmi hna le mei nih a hrawhmi a kutka hna cu ka zoh hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun Cerhti Kutka le Siangpahrang Tili tiang kha ka va kal, sihmanhsehlaw kaa citmi saṭil caah khan lanh khawhnak lam a um lo."},"15":{"text":"Cun zan ah cun nelrawn kam cun ka hung kal i kulhnak vampang kha ka zoh; cun hnulei ah kaa mer i Nelrawn Kutka khan ka lut i ka kir."},"16":{"text":"Cun bawi pawl nih khan khuazei i ka kal siseh, zei ka tuah siseh, an hngal lo; cun rian a ṭuan hnga ding Judah mi le tlangbawi hna le tuavon hna le bawi hna le midang hna kha ka chim rih fawn hna lo."},"17":{"text":"Annih cu ka thawh hna i, “Zei bantuk harnak chungah dah kan um i zeitindah Jerusalem cu a rawk ningin a um ko i a kutka hna cu an kangh dih ti kha nan hngalh. Kannih nih ningzah hmaichiat kan in ti nakhnga lo, ra u law, Jerusalem kulhnak vampang cu remh hna u sih,” tiah ka ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun ka Pathian kut ka cung i ṭhatnak caah a ummi le siangpahrang nih ka sinah a chimmi bia hna kha annih cu ka chimh hna. Cun annih nih an i thawh i, “Tho u si law sa u sih,” an ti. Cuticun rian ṭha ṭuan awk caah cun an kut cu an i ṭhawnter."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Horon mi Sanballat le Ammon mi Tobiah, a sinum le, Arab mi Geshum nih mah cucu an theih tikah an kan nihsawh i an kan serhsat i, “Mah hi nan tuahmi hi zeidah a si? Siangpahrang maw nan doh?” tiah an kan ti."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah kei nih ka leh hna i, “Vancung Pathian nih khua awng a kan pemhter lai i kannih a sal hna nih hin kan tho lai i kan sak lai; sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu Jerusalem ah hin covo siseh, tinvo siseh, hngalh camcinnak siseh, nan ngei lai lo,” tiah ka ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi tikah tlangbawi ngan Eliashib kha a unau tlangbawi hna he khan an tho i Tuu Kutka kha an remh. An thianter i a innka kha an bunh hna; Za Innsang timi tiang khan an hei remh, Hananel Innsang timi tiang khan, cun an thianter.","title":"Remh Awkah An I Phawt Ciomi"},"2":{"text":"Eliashib a hun changtu ah khan Jeriko mi hna nih khan an remh i cu hna a hun chuangtu ah cun Imri fapa Zakkur kha a si."},"3":{"text":"Cun Hassenaah fapa hna nih khan Nga Kutka timi kha an remh; a kaan kha an khaan i a innkhar hna le a hrenhnak awng hna le a hrenhnak fung hna kha an bunh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cun anmah a hun changtu ah cun Hakkoz fapa Uriah i fapa Meremoth nih khan a remh. Cun cu hna a hun changtu ah cun Meshezabel fapa Berekhiah fapa Meshullam nih khan a remh. Cun anmah a hun changtu ah cun Baana fapa Zadok nih khan a remh."},"5":{"text":"Cun anmah a hun changtu ah cun Tekoa mi nih khan an remh; sihmanhsehlaw an bawi hna nih khan cun an Bawipa rian ah khan an lu an hlinh lo."},"6":{"text":"Cun Paseah fapa Joiada le Besodeiah fapa Meshullam nih khan Kutka Hlun kha an remh; a kaan hna cu an khan hna i a innkhar hna le a hrenhnak awng hna le a hrenhnak fung kha an bunh hna."},"7":{"text":"Anmah changtu ah cun Gibeon mi Melatiah le Meronoth mi Jadon le Tiva Ral ram uktu uknak chung i a ummi Gibeon mi hna le Mizpah mi hna nih an remh."},"8":{"text":"Anmah a hun changtu ah Harhaiah fapa sui soser hna lak in pakhat a min Uzziel nih a remh. Amah a hun changtu ah zihmui sertu hna lak i Hananiah nih a remh; cun Jerusalem cu Vampang Kau tiang khan an remh."},"9":{"text":"Anmah a hun changtu ah cun Jerusalem peng hnarcheu a uktu Refaiah, Hur fapa nih khan a remh."},"10":{"text":"Anmah a hun changtu ah cun, Harumaf fapa Jedaiah nih khan amah inn zawn kha a remh; cun amah a hun changtu ah Hashabneiah fapa Hattush nih khan a remh."},"11":{"text":"Harim fapa Malkhijah le Pahath-moab fapa Hasshub nih Changreu Rawhnak Innsang khattelei kam kha an remh."},"12":{"text":"Cun amah a hun changtu ah, Hallohesh fapa Shallum, Jerusalem peng hnarcheu a uktu le a fanule hna nih khan an remh."},"13":{"text":"Hanun le Zanoah khuami hna nih khan Nelrawn Kutka kha an remh; an ser ṭhan i a innkhar hna le a hrenhnak awng hna le a hrenhnak fung hna kha an bunh hna, cun kulhnak vampang kha dong thong khat, Hnawmpon Kutka tiang an remh."},"14":{"text":"Rekhab fapa Malkhijah, Beth-hakkherem peng a uktu nih khan Hnawmpon Kutka kha a remh; amah nih cun a ser ṭhan i a innkhar hna le a hrenhnak awng hna le a hrenhnak fung hna kha a bunh hna."},"15":{"text":"Cun Kolhozeh fapa Shallum, Mizpah peng a uktu nih khan Cerhti Kutka kha a remh; amah nih cun a ser ṭhan i a khuh i a innkhar hna le a hrenhnak awng hna le a hrenhnak fung hna kha a bunh hna; cun amah nih cun siangpahrang dum chung i Shelah Tidilnak vampang cu David Khua i a vung kalmi lamhbak tiang khan a remh."},"16":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ah cun Azbuk fapa Nehemiah, Beth-zur peng hnarcheu a uktu nih khan, David thlan zawn tiang le serchommi tidil le miṭhawng hna inn tiang khan a remh."},"17":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ahcun Levi mi nih an remh: Bani fapa Rehum; amah a hun changtu ah cun Keilah peng hnarcheu a uktu Hashabiah nih amah peng caah khan a remh."},"18":{"text":"Amah a hun changtu ah cun a unau pa nih khan a remh: Amah cu Henadad fapa Bavvai, Keilah peng hnarcheu uktu kha a si;"},"19":{"text":"amah a hun changtu ah Jeshua fapa Ezer, Mizpah uktu nih vampang chunglei ah aa kuaihnak i ral hriamnam chiahnak zawn i a ummi tan kha a remh."},"20":{"text":"Amah a hun changtu ah cun Zabbai fapa Baruk nih khattelei tan, vampang chunglei ah aa kuaihnak in tlangbawi ngan Eliashib inn i innka tiang kha a remh."},"21":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ah cun Hakkoz fapa Uriah i fapa Meremoth nih Eliashib inn innka in khattelei tan kha Eliashib inn dongh tiang a remh."},"22":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ah cun Nelrawn mi tlangbawi hna nih khan an remh."},"23":{"text":"Anmah a hun chang ah cun Benjamin le Hasshub nih an inn zawn kha an remh. Anmah a hun chang ah cun Ananiah fapa Maaseiah i fapa Azariah nih amah inn pawng kha a remh."},"24":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ah cun Henadad fapa Binnui nih khattelei tan, Azariah inn in vampang chunglei ah aa kuaihnak le"},"25":{"text":"lenglei ah a hei i kuaihnak kil tiang kha a remh. Uzai fapa Palal nih vampang chunglei ah aa kuaihnak hmun le ralvengtu hna hmun i siangpahrang inn cungnung in a hung chuakmi innsang zawn kha a remh. Amah chang ah cun Parosh fapa Pedaiah le"},"26":{"text":"Ofel i a ummi biakinn rian ṭuantu hna nih khan nichuahlei i Ti Kutka le a hung fongmi innsang zawn tiang kha an remh."},"27":{"text":"Amah a hun chang ah cun a hung fongmi innsang nganpi zawn i a ummi tan kha Ofel vampang tiang Tekoa mi nih an remh."},"28":{"text":"Rang Kutka chak ah khan tlangbawi hna nih anmahle an inn zawn cio kha an remh."},"29":{"text":"Anmah chang ah cun Zadok fapa Immer nih khan amah inn zawn kha a remh. Amah chang ah cun Shekaniah fapa Shemaiah, Nichuahlei Kutka a cawngtu nih khan a remh."},"30":{"text":"Amah chang ah cun Shelemiah fapa Hananiah le Zalaf fapa paruknak Hanun nih tan dang kha an remh. Amah chang ah cun Berekhiah fapa Meshullam nih amah khaan zawn kha a remh."},"31":{"text":"Amah chang ah cun suiser a si vemi Malkhijah nih Pumhnak Kutka zawn i a ummi biakinn rian ṭuantu hna inn le chawdawr hna inn le vampang lenglei i aa kuaihnak i a ummi cungdot tiang khan a remh."},"32":{"text":"Cun vampang lenglei i aa kuaihnak le Tuu Kutka karlak kha suiser hna le chawdawr hna nih an remh."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sanballat nih vampang kan remh kha a theih tikah a thin a phawh i a thinhun in Judah mi hna cu nehsawh serhsat in a ti hna.","title":"Rianṭuantu Hna Kha Ral An I Veng Pah"},"2":{"text":"A unau hna le Samaria ralkapbu hna um hngan ah khan aa thawh i, “Hi Judah mi santlailo rual nih hin zei kan tuah an hei ti hnga dah? Thil kha an remh ṭhan hna lai maw? Raithawinak kha an tuah lai maw? Ni khat ah an lim hnga maw? Hnawmpon chung lung, khangh ciami lung hna kha an nunter ṭhan hna hnga maw?” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Ammon mi Tobiah kha a pawngah cun a um i, “Asi, an sakmi cu — an sakmi lung vampang cu cenghngia nih hun kainak seh law a cim ko lai hen pei!” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Maw kan Pathian, kannih cu an kan zawmhtaih caah hin kan thlacamnak cu rak kan theihpiak ko, an kan serhsatnak cu anmah lu cung lila ah kirter law saltannak ram chungah nihsawh awk mi ah canter ko hna."},"5":{"text":"Annih nih khua remhtu hna cu lang hngan in an thin an phawh hna caah an mawhnak cu khuhpiak hna hlah law an sualnak cu cazin chungin hlohpiak hna hlah."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun vampang cu a dihlak in a sanlei a canceo tiang cu aa tlai thliahmah in kan remh hna, hihi cu zeitindah a si khawh ti ah cun mi nih khan rian ṭuan duhnak lungthin an ngeih caah a si."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Sanballat le Tobiah le Arab mi hna le Ammon mi hna le Ashdod mi hna nih, Jerusalem kulhnak vampang remhnak cu hma a kal i a kehkuainak hmun hna kha phih an si pah lengmang cang ti kha an theih tikah an thin a hung ngaingai;"},"8":{"text":"cucaah Jerusalem kha doh awk le a chungah hnahnawhnak tuah awkah an dihlak in hmunkhat ah khua an khang."},"9":{"text":"Cun kannih nih kan Pathian sinah thla kan cam i annih sinin a kan vengtu dingah chunzan in ralveng pakhat kan chiah."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Judah mi hna nih an i thawh i, “Rian ṭuantu hna kha an thazang a ṭum i hmunthur khuahnawm tam tuk a um rih fawn;
