Cun Esther nih Mordekai cu Haman inn zohkhenhtu ah khan a chiah."},"3":{"text":"Cun Esther nih siangpahrang sinah cun bia a chim ṭhan; a ke hram ah khan a bawk i Agag mi Haman nih Judah mi cungah a ṭha lomi khuakhannak a ruahmi le rawinak a timhmi let ṭhan awkah khan mitthli he a nawl."},"4":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih sui bawifung kha Esther leiah cun a hei hler;"},"5":{"text":"cun Esther cu a tho i siangpahrang hmaiah cun a dir. Cun aa thawh i, “Siangpahrang na duhnak a si i na hmaiah mithmai ṭha ka hmuh i siangpahrang na hmaiah hi thil hi ahmaanmi a si i na mit ka tlin a si ahcun, siangpahrang ram chung peng dihlak i a ummi Judah mi hna hrawhnak ding ca i Agag mi Haman, Hammedatha fapa nih a rak ṭialmi ca letnak caah khan nawlbia pakhat in ṭial si seh."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah, zeitindah ka miphun cung i a tlung ding harnak hmuh cu ka in khawh lai? Zeitindah ka rualchan hna hrawh dih an si hmuh cu ka in khawh lai?” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang Ahasuerus nih Siangpahrang Esther le Judah mi Mordekai cu a thawh hna i, “Zohhmanh u, Haman inn cu Esther kha ka pek cang i Judah mi kha thah a duh hna caah amah cu thlainak ah an thlai cang."},"8":{"text":"Cun Judah mi kong ah cun siangpahrang min in nan duh bantukin ca nan ṭial lai i siangpahrang kutdong hrolh in nan khenhchih lai; zeicahtiah siangpahrang min in ṭial i siangpahrang kutdong hrolh in khenh chihmi nawlbia cu let khawh a si ti lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Thla thumnak thla, Sivan thla, a ni kul le ni thum ni ah, khi caan ah siangpahrang caṭialtu kha an auh i Mordekai nawl peknak ning paoh khan, India ram in Ethiopia ram tiang siangpahrang kut tang bawi hna le ram uktu hna le bawi dangdang hna sinah khan, Judah mi kong cu ca in an kuat hna, peng za khat le peng kul le peng sarih an si, peng kip ah anmah le an ca cio in le miphun kip sinah anmahle an holh cio in an kuat hna, cun Judah mi hna zong cu anmahle an ca le an holh in an kuat ve hna."},"10":{"text":"An ṭialmi cu Siangpahrang Ahasuerus min in a si i siangpahrang kutdong hrolh in an khenh chih; cun ca hna cu siangpahrang rang an zuatnak hmun in a chuakmi, siangpahrang rian caah hmanmi rang lek mu kha aa citmi caphortu hna nih khan an kalpi hna."},"11":{"text":"Cun cu ca cun siangpahrang nih khan khua kip i a ummi Judah mi hna kha i pumh i an nunnak i runven i mi zei miphun hmanh an si ah, zei peng hmanh an si ah, anmah a dohtu hna paoh cu an ngakchia hna le an nu hna he rak tuk ve rak thah ve i an ci rak hmih ve i an chawva rak ramh ve ding kha nawl a onh hna;"},"12":{"text":"mah cucu ni khat nite ah Siangpahrang Ahasuerus ram chung dihlak ah, thla hleihnihnak thla, Adar thla, a ni hleithum ni ah tuah ding a si."},"13":{"text":"An ṭialmi ca ṭial chinmi cu peng kip ah khan nawlbia caah mi kip sinah thanh awkin pek a si lai i an ral hna cung i phuhlamnak tuahnak ding caah khan Judah mi hna cu cu ni ah cun i timh awk an si lai."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang rian ca i hman tawnmi rang lek mu hna cu i cit in caphortu hna cu khulrang in, siangpahrang nawlbia nih a fial hna bangin an chuak; cun nawlbia kha Susa khuapi chungah khan an thanh."},"15":{"text":"Susa khuapi cu lunglawmhnak in a au len lioah khan Mordekai cu, siangpahrang puan a dum le a rang kha aa aih i sui luchin kha aa chinh i la hmangṭhia le sendung puan kha i aih in siangpahrang hmai cun a hung chuak."},"16":{"text":"Judah mi hna nih cun ceunak le lawmhnak le thanuamnak kha an hmuh."},"17":{"text":"Cun peng kip le khua kip ah khan, siangpahrang nawlbia le biakhiahnak a phaknak paoh ah Judah mi hna caah cun lawmhnak le thanuamnak a um i rawldanghnak an tuah i i dinh ni kha an ser. Cun Judah mi ṭihnak kha an cungah a tlun caah cuka ram mi miphun hna chung cun mi tampi nih Judah mi ka si tiah an i ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun thla hleihnihnak thla, Adar thla, a ni hleithum ni, siangpahrang nawl pekmi le biakhiahmi tuah awk a simi, Judah mi hna cu an ral pawl nih kan uk hna lai ti i an i ruahchan ni, sihmanhsehlaw Judah mi tu nih anmah a dohtu hna kha an uk hna ni i aa thleng ṭhanmi ni ah cun,","title":"Judah Mi Nih An Ral Kha An Hrawh Hna"},"2":{"text":"Judah mi hna cu Siangpahrang Ahasuerus peng dihlak chung i an khua cio ah khan, anmah harnak pek a timtu hna kha tlaih awkah an i pum. Ahohmanh nih an derh kho hna lo, zeicahtiah mi hna cungah khan anmah ṭihnak cu a tlung."},"3":{"text":"Peng uktu bawi hna le siangpahrang kut tang bawi hna le ram uktu bawi hna le siangpahrang rianṭuantu bawi hna zong nih khan Judah mi cu an bawmh hna, zeicahtiah Mordekai kha an ṭih."},"4":{"text":"Mordekai cu siangpahrang inn chungah khan mingan a si i peng dihlak ah khan a min cu a thang chin lengmang i Mordekai cu nawl a ngei chin lengmang."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Judah mi nih an ral hna cu vainam in an tuk, an thah, an hrawh hna i anmah a huatu hna kha an duhduh in an tuah hna."},"6":{"text":"Susa khuapi chung hrimhrim ah khan Judah mi nih za nga an thah hna i an hrawh hna,"},"7":{"text":"cun Parsandatha le Dalfon le Aspatha le"},"8":{"text":"Poratha le Adalia le Aridatha le"},"9":{"text":"Parmashta le Arisai le Aridai le Vaizatha zong kha an thah hna,"},"10":{"text":"annih cu Hammedatha fapa Haman, Judah mi hna ral i a fapa pahra kha an si; sihmanhsehlaw a ramh cu ahohmanh an ramh hna lo."},"11":{"text":"Susa khuapi chungah cun zeizat dah an thah hna ti kha cu ni hrimhrim ah cun siangpahrang sinah khan an thanh."},"12":{"text":"Cun siangpahrang nih Siangpahrangnu Esther cu a thawh i, “Susa khuapi chungah Judah mi nih mi za nga an thah hna i Haman fapa pahra zong kha an i tel. A si ahcun, siangpahrang i a peng a dang hna ah khan zeitindik an hei tuah hnga. Atu cu zeidah na ka nawlmi a si rih? Pek na si lai. Zeidah hal na ka duhmi a si rih? Tlinter a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun Esther nih a thawh i, “Siangpahrang na duhnak a si ahcun, Susa khua chung i a ummi Judah mi hna hi nihin nawl pekmi bantuk hin thaizing zong tuah onh si rih hna seh. Cun Haman fapa pahra hna hi thlainak ah thlai si hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cucaah mah cucu tuah awkah siangpahrang nih nawlbia a ser i Susa khua chungah cun biakhiahnak a chuah i Haman fapa pahra hna cu an thlai hna."},"15":{"text":"Susa khua i a ummi Judah mi hna cu Adar thla a ni hleili ni zongah khan an i pum i Susa khua chungah khan mi za thum an thah hna; sihmanhsehlaw a ramh cu an ramh hna lo."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang peng chung i a ummi Judah mi a dang hna zong kha an nunnak i runven awkah an i pum i an ral hna sin khan himnak an hmu i anmah a huatu hna kha sang sarih le thong nga an thah hna; sihmanhsehlaw a ramh cu ahohmanh an ramh hna lo.","title":"Purim Puai"},"17":{"text":"Mah cucu Adar thla ni hleithum ni ah khan a si i a ni hleili ni ah cun an i din i cu ni cu puai ni le lunglawmhnak ni ah an ser."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Susa khua chung i a ummi Judah mi hna cu ni hleithum ni le ni hleili ni ah an i pum i ni hleinga ni ah an i din, cu ni cu puai ni le lunglawmhnak ni ah an ser."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah khuate i a ummi, kulhnak a ngei lomi khua i a ummi Judah mi hna nih cun Adar thla ni hleili ni cu lunglawmhnak le puai le dinh ni ah an ser i cu ni cu pakhat le pakhat kha laksawng a ṭhaṭha i kuatnak ah an hman."},"20":{"text":"Cun hi thil hi Mordekai nih ca chungah a khumh hna i Ahasuerus Siangpahrang peng chung dihlak i a ummi Judah mi kha, a hlat i a ummi he a nai i a ummi he, ca a kuat hna i"},"21":{"text":"kum khat hnu kum khat Adar thla ni hleili ni le ni hleinga ni kha nan ulh hna lai,"},"22":{"text":"zeicahtiah hi ni hna ah hin Judah mi nih an ral hna sinin himnak an hmuh i hi thla hi an caah ngaihchiatnak in lunglawmhnak ah, ṭahnak in dinhnak ni ah aa thlen thla a si; cun nannih nih hi ni hna cu puai tuahnak le lunglawmhnak ni le laksawng ṭhaṭha i kuatnak le sifakmi hna laksawng peknak ni ah nan hman lai tiin nawl a pek hna."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Judah mi hna nih cun an rak thawk bantuk le Mordekai nih ca a kuat hna bantuk khan an tuah."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Agag mi Haman, Hammedatha fapa, Judah mi ral nih khan Judah mi hna cu hrawh awkah khua a khan i annih kha hloh le hrawh awkah Pur kha a rak khiah cang, Pur cu camcawhfung a si;","ref":"Est 3.7"},"25":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Esther cu siangpahrang hmaiah a rat tikah, Judah mi hna cung i ṭhat lonak khua a khan mi kha amah lu cungah tla in amah le a fapa hna cu thlainak ah thlai an si nakhnga, caṭial in nawlbia kha a chuah."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah hi ni hna cu Pur ti bia zulh in Purim tiah an ti hna. Cucaah cu ca chung i aa ṭialmi vialte le hi kong ah annih nih an tonmi vialte le an cung i a tlungmi thil vialte ruangah,"},"27":{"text":"Judah mi hna nih cun an fehter i anmah le an tefa hna le anmah a fonhtu vialte hna keng cungah khan an i chonh i hi ni hnih hi pel lo tein, hi ca ṭialning te le a caan khiah ni ah hin kumfate in kan ulh lai, an ti;"},"28":{"text":"Cun hi ni hnih hna cu, kan tefa hna nih an chan kip ah le kan innchungkhar hna nih an dihlak in, peng kip le khua kip i an umnak ah, hngal camcin hna seh law, hi Purim ni hna hi Judah mi nih hman loin an um hrimhrim nakhnga lo, kan tefa hna lakah hi ni hna hngalh camcinnak cu dong hlah seh, an ti."},"29":{"text":"Khi tikah Abihail fanu Siangpahrangnu Esther le Judah mi Mordekai nih khan ca ṭial nawl ngeihnak in Purim kong i ca pahnih cu an fehter."},"30":{"text":"Ahasuerus ram chung i peng za le peng kul le peng sarih ah khan, Judah mi vialte sinah daihnak bia le biatak in ca an kuat hna i,"},"31":{"text":"hi Purim ni hna hi an caan khiahpiakmi caan ah, Judah mi Mordekai le Siangpahrangnu Esther nih Judah mi hna cu an fial hna bantuk le anmah le an tefa hna caah an rawl ulhnak kong le an ṭahnak kong i phung an sermi bantukin ulh si hna seh, an ti."},"32":{"text":"Siangpahrangnu Esther nawlbia nih Purim tuahnak ningcang cu a fehter i mah cucu ca in ṭial a si."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Ahasuerus nih a ram le rili kam ram hna cu ngunkhuai a thawhter hna.","title":"Mordekai Ngannak"},"2":{"text":"Cun a lianhngannak in a tuahmi vialte le a ṭhawnnak le Mordekai cu upatnak a sangmi ah siangpahrang nih a chiahnak kong vialte cu Media le Persia siangpahrang hna Chanrelnak Cauk chungah an i ṭial lo mei?"},"3":{"text":"Judah mi Mordekai cu Siangpahrang Ahasuerus changtu a si i a miphun hna ṭhathnemnak kha a kawl i a mi vialte hna sinah khan daihnak bia a chim caah Judah mi lakah khan mingan a si i a unau hna mi tampi lakah khan zapi duhmi a si."}}}}},"18":{"info":{"name":"Job","shortname":"Job","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uz ram ah hin mipa pakhat a min Job a simi a rak um; cu pa cu soisel awk um lo, miding, Pathian a ṭih i ṭhat lonak kha a hrialmi a si.","title":"Job Dinnak Kha Hneksak A Si"},"2":{"text":"Amah nih cun fapa pasarih le fanu pathum a hrin hna."},"3":{"text":"Cun tuu thong sarih, kalauk thong thum, cawtum tuah za nga, cun laapi za nga le sinum tam ngaingai a ngei; cucaah hi pa cu nichuahlei mi vialte lakah a lianngan bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Cun anmahle an inn cio ah a fapa hna nih khan, an ni cio ah, rawl danghnak kha i chawng lengmang in an tuah tawn i an sin i ei awk le din awkah an farle pathum kha an sawm tawn hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun an puai kha a dih tikah Job nih khan a auh hna i a thianh hna; zingkate in a tho i an milu tlingte khan khangh thawinak a pekchanhpiak tawn hna; zeicahtiah Job nih cun aa thawh i, “Ka fapale hna nih hin sualnak an tuah ko hnga i an lung chungin Pathian kha an vawlhpamh ko hnga,” tiah a ti. Cuticun Job nih a tuah lengmang tawn."},"6":{"text":"Cun Pathian fapa hna cu Bawipa hmai i an chuah ni a hung phan i Satan zong an sinah cun a ra ve.","ref":"Gen 6.2"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Khuazei in dah na rat?” tiah a ti. Satan nih cun a leh i, “Vawlei cung khuazakip i kaa chawhnak le kaa lehnak in,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Ka sal Job hi na ruat bal maw? Vawlei cungah hin amah bantuk soisel awk um lo, miding, Pathian a ṭih i ṭhat lonak a mertakmi hi an um lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Khi tikah Satan nih Bawipa cu a leh i, “Job nih hin Pathian cu a lak in maw a ṭih?","ref":"Biat 12.10"},"10":{"text":"Amah le a inn le a ngeihmi vialte cu hau in na kulh hna lo maw? Nangmah nih a kut rianṭuannak cu thluachuah na pek i ram chungah hin a ngeihmi thil cu an karh."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu na kut hei chuah law a ngeihmi thil vialte khi tawng tuah ngat, na hmai hrimhrim ah an vawlhpamh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, a ngeihmi vialte cu nangmah kut chungah an um; amah taktak belte na kut cun tawng hlah,” tiah a ti. Cucaah Satan cu Bawipa hmaika cun a chuak."},"13":{"text":"Ni khat cu a fapale hna le a fanule hna cu an upa bik inn ah rawl an ei i mitsur hang an ding;"},"14":{"text":"cun zualko pakhat kha Job sinah cun a ra i, “Cawtum hna cu lei an thuang i laa hna cu an pawngah an tlong;"},"15":{"text":"cun Seba mi hna nih an chuahhnawh hna i an lak hna i na sinum hna kha vainam in an thah hna; cun keimah lawnglawng hi nangmah chimtu dingah ka luat,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun bia a chim lengmang lioah cun a dang pakhat a ra i, “Pathian mei cu van in a rung tla i tuu le sinum kha a kangh hna i a thah hna; keimah lawnglawng hi nangmah chimtu dingah ka luat,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun bia a chim lengmang lioah cun a dang pakhat a ra ṭhan i, “Khaldi mi hna cu bu thum in an i ser riangmang i kalauk kha an nam hna i an lak hna i sinum hna kha vainam in an thah hna; cun keimah lawnglawng hi nangmah chimtu dingah ka luat,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cun bia a chim lengmang lioah cun a dang pakhat a ra ṭhan hoi i, “Na fapa hna le na fanu hna cu an upa bik inn ah rawl an ei i mitsur hang an din lioah"},"19":{"text":"zohhmanh, ramlak lei khin thli fakpi a hung hrang i inn cu a ki li in a den i seino pawl cungah cun a tla i an thi dih; cun keimah lawnglawng hi nangmah chimtu dingah ka luat,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Khi tikah Job cu a tho i a puan kha a thleh i a lu aa kawngh i vawlei ah a bawk i Pathian kha a biak."},"21":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Ka nu paw chungin taklawng in ka chuak i taklawng in ka kir ṭhan lai; Bawipa nih a ka pek i Bawipa nih a lak ṭhan; Bawipa min cu thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Hi vialte ah hin Job nih sualnak a tuah lo i Pathian cu a mawhchiat lo."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian fapa hna cu Bawipa hmai i an chuah ṭhan ni a hung phan ṭhan i Satan zong cu Bawipa hmai i chuah ve awkah, an sinah cun a ra ve.","title":"Satan Nih Job Kha A Hneksak Ṭhan"},"2":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Khuazei in dah na rat?” tiah a ti. Satan nih cun Bawipa cu a leh i, “Vawlei cung khuazakip i kaa chawhnak le kaa lehnak in,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Ka sal Job hi na ruat bal maw? Vawlei cungah hin amah bantuk soisel awk um lo, miding, Pathian a ṭih i ṭhat lonak a mertakmi hi an um lo. Amah cu zei ruang lo ah hrawh awkin na ka canghter cang nain, a tlinnak cu fek tein aa tlaih peng ko,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah Satan nih Bawipa cu a leh i, “Cuar caah cuar! Mi nih cun a ngeihmi vialte cu a nunnak caah cun a sian ko lai ta."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu na kut hei chuah law a ruh le a sa kha tawng tuah hna ngat, na hmai hrimhrim ah an vawlhpamh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Satan cu a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, amah cu na kut chungah a um, a nunnak bel zuah ko,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa hmaika cun Satan cu a chuak i fih a nungmi hma in Job cu a kechik in a luthlung tiang a hrem."},"8":{"text":"Cun amah le amah i huahnak ah peipahau kha aa lak i vutcam lakah a ṭhu."},"9":{"text":"Cun a nupi nih amah cu a thawh i, “Na tlinnak cu fek tein naa tlaih peng ko rih lai maw? Pathian cu vawlpam law thi ko cang,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah cu a thawh i, “A hrutmi nu bantukin pei bia na chim cu. Pathian kut in ṭhatnak kan hmuh i ṭhat lonak zong kan hmuh awk a si hnga lo maw?” tiah a ti. Hi thil vialte ah hin Job nih a kaa in sualnak a chim lo."},"11":{"text":"Cun hi ṭhat lonak vialte a cung i a tlungmi kha a hawile pathum, Teman mi Elifaz; Shuh mi Bildad le Naamath mi Zofar nih khan an theih tikah, anmahle an umnak cio khan an ra. Amah kha hramh ding le hnangamter awkah khua an khang ṭi hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun annih nih lamhlat piin an hei hmuh tikah an hngal kho lo i an ai thluahmah i an ṭap; cun an puan kha an thleh hna i van lei ah vutcam kha an vorh i an lu cungah an i phulh."},"13":{"text":"Cun amah cu vawlei ah khan ni sarih le zan sarih an ṭhutpi i a temhinnak kha a fak ngaingai ti an hmuh caah ahohmanh nih bia ka khat hmanh in an chawn lo."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin Job nih a ka a pau i a chuah ni kha chiat a serh.","title":"Job Nih Hrin A Si Ni Kha A Ṭah","ref":"Jer 20.14-18"},"2":{"text":"Cun Job nih aa thawh i,"},"3":{"text":"“Ka chuah ni cu rawkral ko seh, ‘Fapa cu pawi a si cang,’ an ti zan zong kha, rawkral ko seh."},"4":{"text":"Kha ni kha muihnak si ko seh! Cung um Pathian nih kawl hlah seh, Ceunak zong nih ceuh hlah seh."},"5":{"text":"Muihnak le muih khemkhumnak nih kan ta a si, ti hna seh. Minmei nih zel camcin seh law chunmui nih ṭhih seh."},"6":{"text":"Kha zan kha — a chahmi muihnak nih tlai seh! Kum chung lawmhnak ni hna lakah i tel hlah seh, Thla relnak zongah i tel hlah seh."},"7":{"text":"Kha zan kha zan ṭhing si ko seh; Lawmhnak thawng zeihmanh leng hlah seh."},"8":{"text":"Kha ni kha eihthiammi hna nih chiatserh hna seh, Limkeng, a ṭhanghter khomi hna nih khan chiat cu serh hna seh."},"9":{"text":"Kha zan i zinglei arfi hna cu mui hna seh, Ceunak kha i ruahchan awk zeihmanh um hlah seh."},"10":{"text":"Ngaihchiatnak le harnak a ka phakter caah A ka chuahtertu zan kha chiatserh si ko seh."},"11":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka chuah ah khan ka rak thih ko lo? Paw chungin ka chuah ah khan ka thaw a rak dongh ko lo?"},"12":{"text":"Zeicahdah phei cungah an rak ka pom i Ka dawp awkah hnuk an rak ka hmuah?"},"13":{"text":"Kha lioah khan rak thi ning law, atu cu kaa din diam cang hnga."},"14":{"text":"Hlanlio siangpahrang inn hna a remh ṭhantu siangpahrang hna le bawi hna bang khan kaa hngilh diam cang hnga."},"15":{"text":"Cun an inn sui le ngun in a khahtertu bawi hna sinah khan ka hei i din diam cang ko hnga."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahdah thla tling loin a chuakmi ngakchia bantuk le Ceunak a hmu bal lomi bawhte bantukin ka rak loh ko lo?"},"17":{"text":"Khika ah cun miṭhalo hna nih harnak tuah an ngol i Retheimi hna cu an i din."},"18":{"text":"Khika ah cun thongtla hmanh nih dinhnak an hmuh i Rianṭuan a hnektu hna aw kha an thei ti lo."},"19":{"text":"Khika ah mihme mingan an um ṭi i sal cu a bawipa sinin a luat cang."},"20":{"text":"“Harnak chungah a um i a lung chungin a ngaih a chiami,"},"21":{"text":"Thihnak a duh nain a hmu kho lo i Thuhmi chawhlawn nakin thihnak co a duh deuhtu hna,","ref":"Biat 9.6"},"22":{"text":"Thlan an hmuh tik i aa lawm hringhran i a tha a nuammi hna cu, Zeicahdah ceunak pek an si ee?"},"23":{"text":"Pathian nih a velchum in a hren i a lam a pitmipa sinah cun Zeicahdah ceunak cu pek a si ee?"},"24":{"text":"Ka aihramnak cu ka rawl a si i Ka hrum-ainak cu ti luan in a luang."},"25":{"text":"Ka phanmi thil cu ka cungah an tlung dih i Ka ṭihmi thil nih an ka tlunhnawh."},"26":{"text":"Ka thabat a dam lo i dai tein ka um kho hlei lo; Dinh ka hmu lo, harnak a dong lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi tikah Teman mi Elifaz nih khan a leh i,","title":"Elifaz Nih Job Kha A Mawhchiat"},"2":{"text":"“Na sinah bia kaa khat in chim ning law, na thin a hung hnga maw? Asinain, ahodah chim loin a um kho hnga?"},"3":{"text":"Zohhmanh, nangmah nih mi tampi na rak cawnpiak hna i Kut a dermi cu na rak ṭhawnter hna."},"4":{"text":"A ril lengmangmi cu na bia nih a tun hna i A derthawmmi khuk cu nangmah nih na fehter hna."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu nangmah cungah harnak tlun caan a phan i na thin a tawi, Nangmah cu an tawngh i na lung a dong."},"6":{"text":"Pathian na ṭihnak cu naa bochanmi a rak si lo maw? Na ziaza tlinnak cu naa hngatchanmi a si lo maw kha?"},"7":{"text":"Atu hi ruat hmanh, zeihmanh a sual lomi cu a rawkral bal maw? Khuazei tal ah miding cu hloh an si bal maw?"},"8":{"text":"Keimah ka hmuhning ah cun ṭhat lonak lei a thuangtu hna le Harnak a tuhtu hna nih cun, cu ṭhiamṭhiam cu an zun tawn."},"9":{"text":"Pathian thaw in an rawk i A thinhunnak in a chem hna thawngin an kang dih."},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna cu chiandeih bantukin an ngur i an awn, Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a daihter hna i an ha a thlongh hna."},"11":{"text":"Seh awk le ei awk a hmu ti lomi chiandeih bantukin an thi i An fale cu an i ṭhek dih."},"12":{"text":"“A thli tein ka sinah bia a phan i Ka hna nih an i ceih sepmapmi cu a theih."},"13":{"text":"Mi an i hngilh hluahmah lio i zan i langhnak ka hmuhmi ka ruah tikah.","ref":"Job 33.15"},"14":{"text":"Ṭihnak le thathernak kha ka cungah a tlung i Ka ruh vialte kha a therter dih hna."},"15":{"text":"Thaw nih ka hmai kha a ka chem i ka hmulthi a ling;"},"16":{"text":"Mui thluamthlam cu khika ah a dir ko, sihmanhsehlaw a mui kha ka hliah kho lo; Thil pakhat ka hmaiah a hung lang i Thawng pakhat, a aw a kua ngaimi cu ka theih:"},"17":{"text":"‘A thi khomi minung hi Pathian hmaiah cun a ding kho maw? Minung hi a Sertu hmaiah a thiang kho maw?"},"18":{"text":"Pathian nih a sinum hna hmanh kha a zum kho hna lo i A vancungmi hna hmanh kha, nan palh, tiah a ti hna;"},"19":{"text":"Cucaah tlak inn ah khua a sa i a hram cu leidip a si i Pelep bangin a man khomi cu zeitluk in dah a ti chinchin hna lai."},"20":{"text":"Zinglei le zanlei karlak ah an rawk dih; Ahohmanh i theihhngalh set loin an lo lan."},"21":{"text":"An thlam hri cu an lakin cat lakin hnuh a si ahcun, Fimnak ngei loin an thi men ko lo maw?"}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Au tuah hna, an lettu ding an um hnga maw? Mithiang aho cu dah na fuh bik hna lai?"},"2":{"text":"Asi taktak ko, thinhunnak nih mihrut kha a thah hna i Nahchuahnak nih lungthin tlawmmi kha a nawn hna."},"3":{"text":"Mihrut nih ngeihchiah hram an thlak kha ka hmuh, Sihmanhsehlaw an umnak cu chiat ka serh colh."},"4":{"text":"An fale hna cu an him deng naisai lo i Hauka ah khan lamh chih an si, Annih chanhtu ding kha ahohmanh an um lo."},"5":{"text":"An rawl ṭuanmi cu rawlṭammi nih an ei i Hling lak hmanh kha an lak; Cun tihalmi nih an chawva kha an chuh hna."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah temhinnak cu leidip chungin a ra lo i Harnak cu vawlei in a kheu lo;"},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw meici cu cunglei ah a choi phung a si bantukin, Minung cu harnak hmu dingin hrin a si."},"8":{"text":"“Kei cu, nang ka si ahcun, Pathian kha ka fuh ko hnga i Amah sinah khan ka konglam cu ka chiah ko hnga;"},"9":{"text":"Amah nih thil lianngan hna le ruah phak lomi thil hna le khuaruahharmi thil kha rel cawk loin a tuah hna:"},"10":{"text":"Vawlei cungah ruah a surter i Lo chungah ti kha a luanter hna;"},"11":{"text":"Minauta cu cungsang ah a chiah hna i Ngaihchiami cu himnak ah a cawi hna."},"12":{"text":"Mizer hna khuakhannak cu pakpalawng ah a canter, Cucaah an kut nih an i tinhmi cu an tlinter kho hna lo,"},"13":{"text":"Mifim hna cu anmah zernak lila ah khan a foih hna i Mihrokhrawl hna timhtuahnak cu khulrang in a dong.","ref":"1Kor 3.19"},"14":{"text":"Chun ah muihnak he an i tong i Chunlai ah zan bantukin an i dap lengmang."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ngakṭah hna cu an kaa chung khan a khamh hna i Mipam hna cu a ṭhawngmi hna kut chung khan a khamh hna;"},"16":{"text":"Cucaah sifakmi nih ruahchannak an ngei i Biadinglo nih khan a kaa a cip."},"17":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, Pathian nih a chimhhrinmi cu lunglawmmi a si; Cucaah Lianngan Bik chimhhrinnak cu zeirello in um hlah.","ref":"Phut 3.11; Heb 12.5-6"},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah nih hriamhma an inter, Asinain amah lila nih an men ṭhan; Amah nih cun an tuk, sihmanhsehlaw a kut nih an damter ṭhan.","ref":"Hos 6.1"},"19":{"text":"Amah nih harnak paruk chungin an chuah lai, Pasarih chung zongah ṭhat lonak zeihmanh nih an tawng lai lo."},"20":{"text":"Mangṭam a tlun tikah amah nih thihnak chungin an khamh lai, Ral chungah vainam ṭhawnnak chungin an tlanh lai."},"21":{"text":"Congoihnak a um tikah a phaw an chonkanh lai i Rawhralnak kha a rat tikah na ṭih awk a herh lai lo."},"22":{"text":"Rawhralnak le mangṭam an tlun tikah na ni lai i Vawleicung sahrang kha na ṭih hna lai lo."},"23":{"text":"Lo chung lung hna nih cun hna an in hnawh lai lo i lo chung sahrang hna he cun rem tein nan um lai."},"24":{"text":"Na thlam cu a him kha na hngalh lai i Na kawm kha na zoh lai i zeihmanh a bau lai lo."},"25":{"text":"Na tefa hna cu tampi an si lai kha le Na hrinsor hna cu vawlei i ram bantuk an si lai kha na hngalh fawn lai."},"26":{"text":"Rawl phal tommi cu amah caan te ah phuhri a phanh bantukin. Chan tling cikcek tein thlan khor na phan lai."},"27":{"text":"Zohhmanh, mah hihi kan dothlat cikcek i ahmaanmi a si, Biatak a si caah na ca i a ṭha dingah i lak tuah,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih A Hawile Kha A Sik Hna"},"2":{"text":"“Ka thinlinhnak hi a khing thlai hei si seh law, Ka vanchiatnak hi a cuai thlai hei si seh law ka hei duh hnga dah!"},"3":{"text":"Rili thetse nakin a rit deuh ko hnga, Cucaah cun pei ka bia hi a bultan cu."},"4":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Lianngan Bik nih a thal in a ka kah i A sivai nih ka thlarau cu a ciah. Pathian ṭihnunnak nih cun hmaitonh in an ka tianhnawh."},"5":{"text":"Ramlak laa cu ram a ṭam lioah a awn bal maw? Cawtum tah ramrawl a ei lioah a paw bal maw?"},"6":{"text":"Thawtnak a ngei lomi rawl, cite phulh lomi cu aho nih dah an ei khawh? Arti hawng ah khin zeital thawtnak a um maw?"},"7":{"text":"Cu bantuk rawl cu ka duh hna lo i ka caah fihnung an si."},"8":{"text":"“Ka halmi cu hei hmu ning law, Pathian nih ka duhmi cu hei ka pe seh law,"},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih hei ka rial cikcek dih seh law, A kut kha hei samh seh law hei ka lek ko seh law, ka hei duh hnga dah!"},"10":{"text":"Mah hihi ka hnangamnak a si ko hnga; Zawnruahnak ngei lo fahnak ah cun kaa lawm ko hnga; Zeicahtiah Mi Thiang bia cu ka hlaw hna lo."},"11":{"text":"Hngah rih khawhnak ding caah thazang ka ngei ti hnga maw? Zei donghnak i ruahchan in dah lungsau in ka um rih hnga?"},"12":{"text":"Ka thazang cu lung thazang maw a si? Ka titsa cu dar dah a si?"},"13":{"text":"Biatak tein, keimah chungah hin bawmtu zeihmanh a um lo, Thazang petu paohpaoh cu ka sinin an zam dih."},"14":{"text":"“Mahle hawi cung i zaangfahnak a ngei lomi cu Lianngan Bik ṭihnak a hlawmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Ka unaule hna cu tivacek bantuk hlen hmangmi an si, Tivate a kuang a liammi bantuk an si;"},"16":{"text":"An chungah tikhal a um caah an nak i An chungah hawhra tlang kha an i thup."},"17":{"text":"A linh caan a phak tikah an lo, A sat tikah an umnak hmun in an lo."},"18":{"text":"A run in khual a tlawngmi hna nih an hun pialhnawh hna, Ramlak ah cun an hun luhhnawh hna i an thi tawn."},"19":{"text":"Tema khualtlawng run hna nih ti cu an kawl, Sheba khualtlawng mi hna nih an an i ruahchan."},"20":{"text":"An rak i zumh caah khan an hnabei a dong, Cuka cu an phan i an lung a ar."},"21":{"text":"Cu bantuk ah cun ka caah hin nan i cang, Ka chiatnak kha nan hmuh i nan ṭih."},"22":{"text":"‘Laksawng ka pe tuah u,’ ka ti maw? Asiloah, ‘Nan chawva chungin zik ka nawhpiak tuah u,’ ka ti dah?"},"23":{"text":"Asiloah, ‘Hi ral kut chung hin ka chuah u,’ ka ti maw? Asiloah, ‘Hremtu hna kut chungin ka tlan u,’ ka ti dah?"},"24":{"text":"“Ka cawnpiak u law, dai tein ka um ko lai; Zeitindah ka palhnak a si kha ka hngalhter tuah u."},"25":{"text":"Fimnak in ṭha tein chimh ahcun ka lung a pem sawk hnga, Sihmanhsehlaw nan chimmi cu pakpalawng a si."},"26":{"text":"Ka bia cu leh nan ka duh maw? A hnabei a dong cangmipa nih a chimmi cu thli lawng pei a si ko cu."},"27":{"text":"Ngakṭah hna sal i lak awkah camcawhfung hmanh nan khiah ko hnga i Nan hawi ṭha bik hmanh cu chawlehnak ah nan hman ko hnga."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu ka zoh hnik u, Nan hmaiah ka lih hrimhrim lai lo."},"29":{"text":"Ruat rih hmanh u, dinlonak cu ka cungah tuah si hin ti hlah seh, Cun ka ṭhatnak cu zumh lo bantukin um a si caah hin, ruat rih hmanh u."},"30":{"text":"Ka leiah hin palhnak zeital a um maw? A ding le a dinglo kha thleidang kho loin maw ka um?"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Vawleicung ah hin mi nih rian har a ngei a si lo mei? Cun a ni hna hi hlanchom sinum ni bantuk an si ko lo maw?","title":"Job Nih Pathian He Bia An I Al"},"2":{"text":"Thladem tang i dinh a duh ngaingaimi sal bantuk le A ṭuan man hmuh awkah a ngangnganmi hlanchom sinum bantuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Cu bantuk cun thla tampi rian pakpalawng ka ṭuan i Zanfate ngaihchiatnak kha ka hmu."},"4":{"text":"Ka vung ih tikah, Zeitik ah dah ka thawh lai, ka ti. Sihmanhsehlaw zan cu a sau i zinglei tiang kaa lawngvang lengmang ko."},"5":{"text":"Ka titsa cu tholung le hmunthur nih an tuam i Ka cuar cu a car i a kek ṭhan tawn."},"6":{"text":"Ka ni hna cu thiamtaktu thiampheifung nakin an khul a rang deuh i An donghnak cu ruahchannak zeihmanhlo he an phan."},"7":{"text":"“Ka nunnak cu thaw menmen a si kha hngal camcin ko; Ka mit nih hin ṭhatnak zeihmanh a hmu ṭhan ti lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Atu ah cun na ka hmuh, sihmanhsehlaw na ka hmu ṭhan ti lai lo, Ka kawl hmanh law, ka rak lo diam cang lai."},"9":{"text":"Minmei a ṭian i a loh bangin, Cu bang cun Sheol i a vung kalmi cu a hung ṭhan ti lai lo."},"10":{"text":"A inn ah a kir ṭhan ti lo, A hmun zong nih amah kha a rak hngal ti lo."},"11":{"text":"“Cucaah ka kaa cu kaa sum lai lo; Lungthin fak ngaiin ka chim ko lai, Lungfak hringhran in ka zai ko lai."},"12":{"text":"Keimah cu rili maw ka si i rili chung rulpi hen dah ka si, A ka cawngtu dingah vengtu na chiah cu?"},"13":{"text":"‘Ka ihkhun nih a ka nuamhter lai, ka zaunak nih ka zainak hi a nemter lai,’ ka ti tikah."},"14":{"text":"Mang in na ka ṭhih i langhnak in ka thin na ka phanter."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah hngawng dih le thih cu ka ruh hna nakin thim ka duh deuh hna."},"16":{"text":"Ka hnabei a dong, nun hi ka duh ti lo. Hnahnawh lo tein keimah te lawng in um ko ning, ka nunnak cu tikhu men a si ko."},"17":{"text":"Minung hi zeidah a si i hi ti ko hin biapi ah na rel i A cungah na ruahnak na chiah i","ref":"Slm 8.4; 144.3"},"18":{"text":"Zingfate in na veh i zeitik paoh ah na hneksak lengmang?"},"19":{"text":"Zei can dah khuadang hoitak loin na ka um lai i Ka cil ka dolh hlantiang keimah um i umter ko loin na ka um lai?"},"20":{"text":"Ka sual a si ahcun, nang minung lungthin a zohtu, Na cungah zei fahnak dah ka tuah? Zeicahdah keimah cu naa chingchiahmi ah na ka ser? Zeicahdah keimah cu na ca i thilrit ah ka can?"},"21":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka phungbuarnak cu na ka ngaihthiam ko lo i, Ka ṭhat lonak cu na ka hlonhpiak ko lo? Zeicahtiah atu cu vawlei chungah ka it lai; Na ka kawl lai, sihmanhsehlaw ka rak um ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Shuh mi Bildad nih a leh i:","title":"Bildad Nih Pathian Dinnak Ṭanh In A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Zei can dah hi thil hna hi na chim lengmang hna lai i Tar tlawhciar in na tlawhciar lengmang ko lai?"},"3":{"text":"Pathian nih biading cu a merh bal maw? Asiloah, Lianngan Bik nih a dikmi cu a merh bal maw?"},"4":{"text":"Na fale hna nih a cungah an sual caah An ṭhat lonak dantatnak kha an cungah a tlunter."},"5":{"text":"Pathian kha na kawl i Lianngan Bik kha na kawl i,"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah cu na thian i na din ahcun, Na caah aa hlau hrimhrim lai i a dingmi naa tinhnak cu a tlinter lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun naa thawknak cu hme hmanh seh law, na donghnak lei cu a ngan lai."},"8":{"text":"“Zeicahtiah a liam ciami chan hna kha hal hna law, Kan pupa hna nih zeidah an hmuhmi a si kha ruat hmanh;"},"9":{"text":"Kannih cu nizan mi ceote kan si ko i zeihmanh kan hngal lo, Zeicahtiah vawleicung kan ni hna cu thladem men an si ko."},"10":{"text":"Annih nih nangmah cu an in cawnpiak in an in chim in, an hngalhnak cu an in chim hnga lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"“Cerh um lonak hmun ah papairi kung cu a ṭhang kho maw? Ti um lonak hmun ah phaikung cu a ṭha kho maw?"},"12":{"text":"An par liopi le pheh an cut hlanah Ramkung dang hna hlanah tuan deuh ah an car."},"13":{"text":"Pathian a philhmi hna cu an dihlak in cu bantuk cu an si; Pathian zei ah a rel lomi hna cu an nunnak hri a cat."},"14":{"text":"Anmah le anmah an i bochannak cu manmarang aa zammi bantuk a si i An hngatchanmi cu sawmpalak bu men a si."},"15":{"text":"A inn kha aa hngauh, sihmanhsehlaw a inn cu a dir kho lo; A tlaih, sihmanhsehlaw a tlu ṭhiamṭhiam."},"16":{"text":"A thingkung cu hring dutmat in nitlang ah khan a ṭhang i A nge hna cu dum lengah khan an chuak."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a hram nih lungpon a ngerh i lungtlap kha an i ton."},"18":{"text":"Cun mi pakhat nih a umnak hmun khan a phawi i A umnak hmun nih cun, ‘Nangmah cu kan hngal bal lo,’ tiin a hlawt."},"19":{"text":"Mahticun a nunnak cu a uai i Vawlei chung khan thingkung dang kha an hung chuak."},"20":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, Pathian nih cun soisel awk um lomi cu a hlaw lai lo, ṭhat lonak a tuahmi hna kha a domh fawn hna lai lo."},"21":{"text":"Na ka cu nihnak in a khahter te ko rih lai i Na hmur cu lawmhnak aunak in a khahter te ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah an huami cu ningzahnak in thuamh an si lai i Miṭhalo hna thlam cu a um ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih A Leh"},"2":{"text":"“Biangai tein, mah cucu cu bantukin a si tiah ka hngalh ko, Sihmanhsehlaw minung cu zeitindah Pathian hmaiah cun a din khawh lai?","ref":"Job 4.17"},"3":{"text":"Amah he khan bia al a duh ahcun, voi thong khat chungah voi khat hmanh a let kho lai lo."},"4":{"text":"Pathian cu a lungthin in a fim i a thazang in a ṭhawng Aho nih dah an doh khawh lai?"},"5":{"text":"Tlang cu a ṭhial hna i a thinhun in a leh hna tikah an hngal lo;"},"6":{"text":"Vawlei cu a umnak hmun khan a hninh i a tung hna cu an i hnin;"},"7":{"text":"Ni cu nawl a pek i chuak loin a um, Arfi cu a kharkhumh hna."},"8":{"text":"Amah nih van cu a samh hna i rili tilet hna cu a lamh hna."},"9":{"text":"Amah nih cun Fizang le Likuk canthum le Firuk le Thlanglei arfi hna kha a ser hna;","ref":"Job 38.31; Amo 5.8"},"10":{"text":"Amah nih cun hngalh phak lomi thil lianngan le Khuaruahharmi thil relcawklo a ser hna."},"11":{"text":"Zohhmanh ka pawngah a kal, sihmanhsehlaw ka hmu lo; a lan i ka hngal lo."},"12":{"text":"Amah nih cun a lak ko, aho nih dah an dawnh khawh lai? Aho nih dah, ‘Zeidah na tuah?’ an ti lai?"},"13":{"text":"“Pathian nih cun a thinhunnak hna cu a let ṭhan lai lo, A kehram ah Rahab bawmtu hna kha an kun."},"14":{"text":"A si ahcun, zeitindah keimah chinchin nih cun amah cu ka leh khawh lai? Zeitindah amah he i alnak dingah bia cu ka hmuh khawh lai?"},"15":{"text":"Ka sual lo i sual a ka phawtu sinah khan zaangfahnak ka hal nain Zeihmanh lehnak ka hmu lo."},"16":{"text":"Zung ah khin hei chuahpi in amah nih khan rak ka let ko hmanh seh law, Ka nawlnak bia cu a ka ngaihpiak hnga tiah ka zum hlei lo."},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah thil hme tete kongah fak piin a ka tongh i Sullam ngei loin ka cungah tuknak cu ruah sur in a surter."},"18":{"text":"Ka thaw hmanh a ka dawpter manh lo i ngaihchiatnak in a ka khahter."},"19":{"text":"Thazang zuamkhawnnak a si ahcun, zohhmanh, amah cu a ṭhawng bik a si ko! Cun biading kong ah a si ahcun, aho nih dah, a bia cu ngaihpiak ko, tiah an ti khawh lai?"},"20":{"text":"Suallo si hmanh ning law, keimah kaa lila nih sual a ka phawt ko lai; Soi awk um lo si hmanh ning law, amah nih cun lamtlau a ka ti khawh ko lai."},"21":{"text":"Soi awk um lo ka si ko, sihmanhsehlaw ka caah zeidah a ṭhahnem? Nun hi a ka nor tuk cang."},"22":{"text":"Kan sual ah, kan thiam ah, zeihmanh aa dang lo, Pathian nih a kan hrawh ding a si ko."},"23":{"text":"A sual lomi kha a thih tikah Pathian cu a ni ko."},"24":{"text":"Pathian nih vawlei cu miṭhalo hna kut chungah a pek; Biaceihtu vialte kha mitcaw ah a ser hna. Cucu Pathian nih a tuah lo ahcun, aho nih dah a tuah kun?"},"25":{"text":"“Ka ni hna cu a tlimi nakin an khul a rang deuh, An liam i ṭhatnak zeihmanh an hmu lo."},"26":{"text":"Vokkuanglawng khulrang ngai bantukin an kal, Muvanlai nih a sa a vun zuanhnawh bantuk khin an khul a rang."},"27":{"text":"Ka phunzainak hi ka philh lai i Ngaihchia muihmai ka putmi hi ka hlawt lai i Lunglawm in ka um lai, ka ti ah,"},"28":{"text":"Nganfahnak ka in dingmi hi a ṭih in ka ṭih, Zeicahtiah nangmah nih suallo ah na ka rel lai lo, ti kha ka hngalh."},"29":{"text":"Sualphawt ka si ko ding ṭung ah cun, Zeicahdah pakpalawng in ka ṭuan len ko lai?"},"30":{"text":"Chatphiat in i kholh hmanh ning law, ka kut cu cangal in i ṭawl hmanh ning law,"},"31":{"text":"Nawncek chungah cun na ka thlak ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai i Keimah ka thilthuam lila nih fihnung ah an ka ser ding a si ko."},"32":{"text":"Pathian cu keimah nih leh khawh awkah le biaceihnak hmun i chuahpi awkah Keimah bantukin minung a si ṭung lo."},"33":{"text":"Kan karlak ah biaceihtu le kan pahnih tein nawl a kan petu um hna seh law ka hei duh hnga dah."},"34":{"text":"Cu ti a si ahcun Pathian nih ka keng cung hin a ṭhiangṭhunh kha a ṭhial hnga i Amah ṭihnak nih khan ka thin a ka phanter ti hnga lo."},"35":{"text":"Cu tikah amah ṭihnak um lo tein bia ka chim khawh hnga, Zeicahtiah a ka ruah ning bantuk cu ka si lo, ti kha ka hngalh."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka nunnak hi ka fih; Ka phunzainak hi i sum hin loin ka chim ko lai; Lungfak hringhran in ka chim ko lai.","title":"Job Nih A Umtuning Kha A Ṭah"},"2":{"text":"Pathian cu ka thawh lai i, ‘Sual ka phaw hlah; Zeicahdah na ka ralchanh hi a si, ka hngalhter."},"3":{"text":"Mi kha rialchih i nangmah kut nih a sermi kha nautat i Miṭhalo hna khuakhannak hnatlakpi cu, a ṭha tiah na ruah maw?"},"4":{"text":"Titsa mit maw na ngeih? Mi hmuh bantukin maw na hmuh?"},"5":{"text":"Na ni hna cu minung ni bantuk maw an si? Na kum hna cu minung hna kum bantuk dah an si?"},"6":{"text":"Cucaah cun maw, keimah cu a sual lo, ti na hngal ko na le, Na kut chungin chuah khotu ahohmanh a ngei hna lo ti na hngal ko nain, Ka ṭhat lonak cu na hlat i ka sualnak cu na kawl?","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Na kut in na ka ser i na ka siam; Cun maw naa mer i na ka hrawh."},"9":{"text":"Tlak in na ka ser kha philh hlah; Leidip ah maw na ka canter ṭhan lai?"},"10":{"text":"Nangmah nih cawhnuk bangin na ka thlet i cawhnuk khal bangin na ka khalter lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"Nangmah nih cuar le tit in na ka tuam in ruh le tha in na ka phiar lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Nangmah nih nunnak le a fekmi dawtnak na ka pek i Na zohkhenhnak nih ka thlarau kha a nunter."},"13":{"text":"Asinain, ka caah a thli tein tinhmi pakhat na ngeih kha ka hngalh."},"14":{"text":"Sual seh law, a sualnak kha ngaihthiam duh loin umning, tiah na ka ngiat."},"15":{"text":"Ka sual cangka in na sinin harnak ka hmuh, Sihmanhsehlaw dinnak ka tuah tikah zeihmanh thangṭhatnak ka hmu hlei ṭung lo. Kei cu harnak a ingmi ka si i ningzahnak nih a ka tuam."},"16":{"text":"Chiandeih bantukin ka hun i porhlawt ah Na ka kawl i ka cungah khuaruahharmi thil kha na tuah ṭhan;"},"17":{"text":"Keimah ralchanhtu tehte kha na ngei zungzal hna, Ka cung i na thinhunnak cu na karhter; Ralkapbu thar thar kha keimah doh awkah na ratpi hna."},"18":{"text":"“Zeicahdah paw chung khan na rak ka chuahter? Ahohmanh nih an ka hmuh hlanah khan rak thi ning law, ka hei duh hnga dah."},"19":{"text":"A um bal lomi bantuk ka si ko hnga i paw in thlan ah kalpimi bantuk ka hei si ko hnga."},"20":{"text":"Ka nun chung ni hi an tlawm ko lo maw? Ka va kal i ka kir ti lonak ding thihnak thladem le a thukmi muihnak ram i ka kal hlanah hin, Hnangamnak tlawmte tal ka hmuh nakhnga, keimah um tein ka umter ko tuah.","merge":"21"},"22":{"text":"Cu ram cu thihnak thladem umnak le zeizong vialte sullam ngei lo i an umnak hmun, Ceunak cu muihnak a sinak hmun a si, ka ti lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Naamath mi Zofar nih a leh i:","title":"Zofar Nih Job Kha Sual A Phawt"},"2":{"text":"“Bia tampi hi leh loin maw um a si lai? Mi biatam paoh hi maw thiamco zungzal a si lai?"},"3":{"text":"Dong loin na chim lengmang komi nih hin mi kha holh loin a umter hna lai maw? Cun pakpalawng bia na chim lengmang ko tikah hin, aho tal nangmah situ an um lai lo maw?"},"4":{"text":"Zeicahtiah naa thawh i, ‘Ka ruahnak hi ahmaan, Pathian mithmuh ah ka thiang,’ na ti."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih hun in let seh law ka hei duh hnga dah!"},"6":{"text":"Fimnak hi thap tampi a um i Minung fimnak nih a phak khawh lomi thil thuk an um ti kha an chimh hnga. Pathian nih na sualnak a cheu cu hmu duh loin an umpiak kha hngal tuah."},"7":{"text":"Pathian thil thuk hna cu na hmuh khawh hna maw? Lianngan Bik ṭhawnnak a donghnak cu na hmuh khawh maw?"},"8":{"text":"Van nakkhin a sang deuh — zeidah na tuah khawh lai? Sheol nakin a thuk deuh — zeidah na hngalh khawh lai?"},"9":{"text":"Vawlei velchum nakin a sau deuh i rili nakin a kau deuh."},"10":{"text":"Pathian nih an tlaih i biaceihnak ah an chuahpi ahcun, Aho nih dah amah cu a dawnh khawh lai?"},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih cun aho hi dah zeiruaramlomi a si ti kha a hngalh hna, An ṭhat lonak vialte kha a hmuh dih."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ramlak laa fa cu minung in a chuah tik ceo ah Mihrut cu an fim te lai."},"13":{"text":"“Na lungthin kha ding tein chia law Amah leiah khan na kut zao tuah."},"14":{"text":"Na kut chungah ṭhat lonak a um ahcun, lamhlatpi ah va hlonh tuah, ṭhat lonak cu na thlam chungah umter hlah."},"15":{"text":"Khi tikah dotlak lonak um loin na hmai cu na langh lai; Him tein na um lai i na ning a ṭi lai lo."},"16":{"text":"Na harnak cu na philh lai i tilian a lanmi bantuk ceo khin na cinken lai."},"17":{"text":"Cun na nunnak cu chun nakin a ceu deuh lai, A muihnak cu zingka bantuk a si lai."},"18":{"text":"Cun ruahchannak a um caah hnangam tein na um lai Pathian nih an huhphenh lai i him tein naa din lai."},"19":{"text":"Na it lai i ahohmanh nih na thin an in phanter lai lo, Mi tampi nih an in nawlpat lai."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu mitcawtnak nih khan a tlakhnawh lai i Luatnak lam vialte kha a thlau hna lai, An i ruahchanmi cu, an thaw hmanung bik chuah kha a si ko lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih A Leh"},"2":{"text":"“Biangai tein, nanmah hi pei mifim cu nan rak si hi, Fimnak tling cu nanmah nih pei nan rak ngeih hi!"},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hngalhthiamnak cu nanmah tlukin ka ngei ve ko, Zeihmanh ah nanmah tluk ka si lonak a um lo. Nan chimmi hi ahopaoh nih an hngalh cio ko."},"4":{"text":"Ka hawile hmanh nih an ka nihsawh, Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a ka leh caan cu a um ve ko; Miding le soi awk um lo ka si nain an ka nihsawh."},"5":{"text":"Harnak nan tong lo i nan ka nihsawh, a ril dengmangmi kha nan ka ṭhuat chih,"},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mifir le Pathian zei i a rel lomi hna cu dai tein khua an sa i Pathian thin a phoktu hna cu himte le dai tein an um."},"7":{"text":"Van i a zuangmi va hna le saram hna nakin pei nan hngalhnak a tlawm deuh hi. Annih nih an in cawnpiak khawh hna ding tampi a um."},"8":{"text":"Vawlei i a ummi saram hna le rili chung i a ummi thilnung hna cu an fimnak kha hal tuah hna u."},"9":{"text":"Annih nih an dihlak in Pathian sermi kan si ti kha an hngalh."},"10":{"text":"A sermi thil vialte an nunnak a uktu cu Pathian a si i Minung thaw cu a kut chungah a um."},"11":{"text":"Dang nih rawl cu a teh bantukin hna nih bia cu a hneksak ve hna lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Fimnak cu tar nih an ngeih, Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih cun fimnak le ṭhawnnak a ngeih; Hngalhthiamnak cu chan saumi nih an ngeih, Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih cun hngalhthiamnak le thil ti khawhnak a ngeih.","merge":"13"},"14":{"text":"Pathian nih a ṭheh ahcun, ahohmanh nih an sa ṭhan kho ti lo, Amah nih mi cu a kharkhumh ahcun, ahohmanh nih an hunpiak ṭhan kho ti lo."},"15":{"text":"Ti kha a tlaih hna ahcun an kao ko, a thlah hna ahcun vawlei kha an khuh dih."},"16":{"text":"Amah sinah cun ṭhawnnak le fimnak kha a um, Hlenmi hna le hlengtu hna cu amah kut tang ummi an si."},"17":{"text":"Fimchimtu pawl kha mihrut bantukin a umter hna, Biaceihtu pawl kha mihrut ah a ser hna."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a ṭhumh hna i thongtla ah a ser hna."},"19":{"text":"Tlangbawi pawl cu puan loin a kalpi hna i A ṭhawngmi cu a thluk hna."},"20":{"text":"Zumhmi mifim hna kha holh kho loin a tuah hna i Upa kha thil thleidan khawhnak fimnak kha a chuh hna."},"21":{"text":"Bawi kha ningzahnak a toih hna i a ṭhawngmi cu an taisawm kha a dorh."},"22":{"text":"Muihnak chungin thilthuk kha a hun langhter i A thukmi muihnak chungah khan ceunak a ratpi."},"23":{"text":"Miphun kha mingan ah a ser hna i amah nih a hrawh ṭhan hna, Miṭhawng ah a ser hna i amah nih a ṭhumh ṭhan hna."},"24":{"text":"An hruaitu hna cu an fimnak kha a lakpiak hna i Lam um lonak ramlak ah khan a vaihter hna."},"25":{"text":"Mei lakah cun ceunak um loin an i dap lengmang i zuri bantukin an vai."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, ka mit in mah vialte hi ka hmuh cang hna i Ka hna in ka theih hna i ka hngalh hna.","title":"Job Nih A Sual Lonak Kha A Chim"},"2":{"text":"Nanmah nih nan hngalhmi cu kei zong nih ka hngalh ve ko, Zeihmanh ah nanmah tluk ka si lonak a um lo."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw bia i ruah ṭi ka duhmi cu nanmah he si loin Lianngan Bik kha a si, Pathian he cun ka kong hi i al ka duh."},"4":{"text":"Nannih nih biatak cu lih in a lenglei kha nan nalh tawn, Nannih cu nan dihlak in lih ṭawn hmangmi nan si."},"5":{"text":"Dai ziar in um u law ka hei duh dah, mah cucu nan fimnak a si hnga!"},"6":{"text":"Ka ruahnak kalning hi thei u law Ka hmur nih a chimmi nawlnak bia hi ngai tuah u."},"7":{"text":"Zeicahdah lih nan chim? Nan lih chimmi nih cun Pathian cu a bawmh lai tiah nan ruah maw?"},"8":{"text":"Pathian cu a tuah ding kha nanmah nih maw nan tuahpiak lai i A bia cu nanmah nih maw nan chimrelpiak lai?"},"9":{"text":"Nannih kha an zoh hna tikah, a ṭha in an hmu hna lai maw? Mi nan hlen hna bantukin amah cu nan hlen lai maw?"},"10":{"text":"Nannih nih a thli tein duhdanhnak kha nan ngeih ahcun an sik hrimhrim hna lai."},"11":{"text":"A lianhngannak nih khan nan thin an phanter hna lo maw? Amah ṭihnak nih cun an tlunhnawh hna lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Nan phungthlukbia hna cu vutcam phungthlukbia an si, Nan i runvennak hna cu tlak runvennak men an si."},"13":{"text":"“Dai tein um u law ka chim ve lai, zei khom hmanh ka cungah tlung ai kun."},"14":{"text":"Ka sa cu ka ha in kaa seh lai i ka nunnak cu ka kut in kaa put lai."},"15":{"text":"Ruahchannak zeihmanh ka ngei ti lo, cucaah Pathian nih a ka thah zong ah zeidah a poi? A hmai hrimhrim ah ka bia cu ka va chim ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"16":{"text":"Pathian zei ah a rel lomi cu a hmaiah an chuak ngam lai lo, ti tal hi cu ka khamhnak a si ṭheo lai."},"17":{"text":"Ka bia cu ṭhate in ngai hna u law, Ka fianternak bia hi nan hna chungah um hna seh."},"18":{"text":"Mah hihi fiang tein hngal tuah u: ka bia cu ka chim hnu hnuah cun ka luat lai ti kha ka hngalh ko."},"19":{"text":"Pathian, nangmah maw a ra lai i sual a ka phaw lai? Cu ti na tuah a si ahcun, kei cu dai tein ka um lai i ka thi ko lai."},"20":{"text":"Thil pahnih lawnglawng hal kan duh, Na ka pek dingah cun na hmai in kaa thup lai lo:"},"21":{"text":"Ka sin hin na kut cu la ṭhan law Na ṭihnunnak nih hin ka thin ka phanter hlah seh."},"22":{"text":"Cun ka au law, kan leh lai, Asiloah, bia ka chimter law, nang nih ka let."},"23":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak le sualnak hna hi, zeizat hi dah nangmah tuahmi an si, ti ka si? Ka phungbuarnak le ka sualnak cu ka hngalhter ko hna."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahdah na hmai kha na thuh i kei cu na ral ah na ka rel?"},"25":{"text":"Thli nih a choihmi thinghnah cu na dawi lai maw? Favai ro tah na dawi lai maw?"},"26":{"text":"Nangmah nih ka dantatnak ding cu na ṭial hna i Ka tlanval lio ka ṭhat lonak rocotu ah khan na ka ser."},"27":{"text":"Ka ke ah hreng na khenh hna i ka lam cu na cawngh dih hna; Ka keneh hmanh kha ṭha tein na ngiat hna.","ref":"Job 33.11"},"28":{"text":"Amah cu a ropmi saphaw bantuk, Rungrul nih a eimi puan bantuk a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Nu hrinmi minung paoh cu a chan a tawi i harnak in a khat.","title":"Job Nih A Nun Chung Caan Tawite Kong Kha A Ruat"},"2":{"text":"Pangpar bangin a hung par i a uai ṭhan ko; Thladem bangin a tli i aa peh lo."},"3":{"text":"Cu bantuk mi cungah cun maw na mit na chiah i nangmah he biaceihnak ah na luhpi?"},"4":{"text":"Cu bantukin a thiang lomi minung chung cun a thiangmi zeihmanh a chuak kho bal lai lo."},"5":{"text":"A ni hna cu relpiak an si i A thla hna cu zeizat an si kha nangmah nih na hngalh; Nangmah nih a lonh khawh lomi ramri kha na serpiak."},"6":{"text":"Amah cu mertak ko law amah um tein umter ko, Kuli ṭuanmi bantukin a ni hna cu aa nuamhpi khawh ah i nuamhpi ko seh."},"7":{"text":"“Thing caah cun ruahchannak a um, Hau a si hmanh ah, a corh ṭhan lai i a nge hna cu an dong lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Vawlei chungah a hram cu tar in vawlei ah a hmui cu thi hmanh seh law,"},"9":{"text":"Ti rim a theih cangka a corh ṭhan lai i thing langno bantukin a nge an borh ṭhan ko lai."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw minung cu a thi i an vui, Mi nih cun a thaw hmanung bik a chuah i khuazei ah dah a um ti."},"11":{"text":"Ti cu tili chungin a kao bantuk le tiva cu a reu i a car bantukin,"},"12":{"text":"Minung cu a it i a tho ṭhan ti lo, Van hna khi an um ti lo hlan lo cu aa ṭhang lai lo. Mi cu a thih ahcun a nung ṭhan kho lai maw? Aa hngilhnak in aa hlau bal ti lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Pathian, Sheol ah khin ka thup law ka duh; Na thinhunnak a daih tiangin ka thup tuah, Khika ah cu tiangin na um lai tiah caan ka khiahpiak law Cun ka hngal ṭhan te tuah!"},"14":{"text":"Cucaah ka rian cu zeitluk in a sau hmanh ah ka lung a dong lai lo i Ka luatnak ding cu ka rak hngah ṭhiuṭheo ko lai."},"15":{"text":"Na ka auh lai i kan leh lai, na kut tuahmi thil cu, hmuh na ka duh lai."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah ka kekar cu na rel hna lai i Ka sualnak cu na ngia peng ti lai lo;"},"17":{"text":"Ka phungbuarnak cu zal chungah khumh an si lai i Ka ṭhat lonak cu nangmah nih na khuh hna lai."},"18":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw tlang cu an cim i an ril dih, Lungpi cu a umnak hmun khan ṭhial a si;"},"19":{"text":"Ti nih lung cu an ziah hna i vawlei ṭha cu tihrang nih a fenh hna, Cu bantuk cun minung ruahchannak cu na hrawh."},"20":{"text":"Amah cu a zungzal in na tei i a lo dai ko; A muihmai kha na thlen i na kalter diam."},"21":{"text":"A fapa hna nih upatnak an hun hmu, asinain a hngal lo; Annih cu ṭhumh an rung si, sihmanhsehlaw a hngal hlei lo."},"22":{"text":"Amah pum fahnak lawng kha aa hngal i amah lawng kha aa ṭah ko,” tiah a ti."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Teman mi Elifaz nih a leh i:","title":"Elifaz Nih Job Kha A Sik"},"2":{"text":"“Thli lawng a khatmi fimnak in maw mifim nih a leh awk a si hnga? Nichuahlei thli in maw aa khahter ko lai?"},"3":{"text":"A ṭhahnem lomi bia le santlai lomi bia alnak kha maw a lehhlum lengmang ko lai?"},"4":{"text":"Mi cu Pathian ṭih kha na thlauh i a sin i thlacam kha na dawnh."},"5":{"text":"Na ṭhat lonak nih na chimmi bia hi an chimter i Hlennak hi naa thimmi holh a si."},"6":{"text":"Keimah nih si loin, nangmah kaa hrimhrim nih nangmah cu sual an phawt, Nangmah hmur hrimhrim nih an mawhchiat."},"7":{"text":"“Nangmah hi minung vialte lakah hrin hmasa bikmi na si maw? Asiloah, tlang hna an sem hlanah hin dah na chuah?"},"8":{"text":"Pathian pumhnak chung biathli cu na thei bal maw? Nangmah lawng hi maw minung fimnak a ngeimi cu na si?"},"9":{"text":"Kan hngalh lomi zeidah na hngalh? Kan fian lomi zeidah na fian hlei?"},"10":{"text":"Ṭuakparmi hna le tar hna cu kan sinah an um, Na pa nakin a upa deuhmi an si."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih an hnemhnak bia, na sinah nem tein chimmi cu naa za lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Zei nih dah cu tluk lawmmam in na ral an ṭhatter i Na mit au na kan renghhnawh len ko?"},"13":{"text":"Zei nih dah na thinhunnak kha Pathian cungah an chuahnawhter i Cu bantuk bia hna cu na kaa in na chuahter len hna?"},"14":{"text":"Minung cu zeidah a si i a thian khawh lai cu? Nu hrinmi fa cu zeidah a si i a din khawh lai cu?","ref":"Job 25.4-6"},"15":{"text":"Pathian nih a mithiang hna hmanh kha a zum hna lo i Van hna hmanh kha a hmaiah suallo an si lo ahcun,"},"16":{"text":"Zeitindah fihnung a si i a thu a man i ṭhat lonak cu ti bangin a dingmi minung chinchin cu, a si khawh lai?"},"17":{"text":"“Kan hmuhsak lai, ka ngai hmanh, ka hmuhmi thil cu kan chimh lai;"},"18":{"text":"(Mifim mi nih an rak chimmi, an upa hna nih thup lo tein an rak chimhmi hna biatak cu kan chimh lai."},"19":{"text":"An ram chungah cun ramdangmi an rak um lo i Pathian sinin a tlautertu hna zong an rak um lo)."},"20":{"text":"Mi a rial lengmangmi miṭhalo cu a nun chung paohpaoh ah harnak a tong zungzal ko lai."},"21":{"text":"Ṭihnak thawng kha a hna chungah an au lai i Him tein ka um tiah aa ruah lioah, mifir nih an chuahhnawh lai."},"22":{"text":"Muihnak chungin luatnak ding ruahchannak a um lo, Amah cu vainam nih khan hmun khatkhat in a orh peng ko."},"23":{"text":"Langta hna rawl caah hlonh a si i, Cu bantuk mi nih cun, ka rawhnak ding kha a fiang, tiah a hngalh."},"24":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah muihnak ni nih cun a tlun hnawh i Harnak le lungretheihnak nih a ṭhawngmi siangpahrang bantukin amah cu tuk awkah an bawh ko."},"25":{"text":"Amah nih cun Pathian kha a kuttum a chuahhnawh i Lianngan Bik cu zeirello in a um;"},"26":{"text":"A lu aa khun riangmang i a phaw laipawng chahpi he cun a zuanhnawh."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu khuapi kha a latu hna le A ngeitu nih an tliktak cangmi inn a tlaitu kha a si,"},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu khua hna le inn hna cu ral nih a hrawh ṭhiamṭhiam hna lai."},"29":{"text":"Sau a rum lai lo i a chawva nih sau an nguh lai lo, Vawlei chung zongah hram a thla lai lo;"},"30":{"text":"Muihnak in a luat lai lo i meizik nih a nge kha a hrem dih hna lai i Thli nih a par kha a choih dih hna lai."},"31":{"text":"A rian a nganmi kha i bochan in amah le amah i hleng hlah seh, Zeicahtiah a rianṭuanmi cu pakpalawng ah a cang lai."},"32":{"text":"A ungkung hna cu a caan lopi ah an uai lai i a nge hna cu an hring lai lo."},"33":{"text":"An hmin hlanah a thei a ṭhilmi mitsur ruang bantuk a si lai i A par a thlongmi oliv kung bantuk a si lai."},"34":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian zei ah a rel lomi hna cu an dihlak in an car i Ziknawhmi thil in an sakmi an inn cu mei nih a kangh hna lai;"},"35":{"text":"Mi ṭhat lonak ding kha fapawi in an i pawi i ṭhat lonak kha an hrin, An paw chungin a chuakmi fa cu hlennak kha a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Pathian Nih A Cungah A Tluntermi Ruangah Job A Zai"},"2":{"text":"“Mah bantuk cu tampi ka theih cang; Nan ka hnemhnak cu hremnak lehlam a si."},"3":{"text":"Hitihin maw na chim thluangthluan ko lai? Nangmah bia in donghter kha maw na duh zungzal ko lai?"},"4":{"text":"Nang le kei hi umhmun aa thleng ding si u si law nangmah bantuk hin kei zong nih ka chim khawh ve ko hnga. Bia cun kan ṭhuat len ko hnga i ka lu zong kan hrilhhnawh len ko hnga."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thazang peknak biatu kha ka chim lai i Nangmah hnemhnak bia ka chimmi cu tiva bangin a luang lai."},"6":{"text":"Ka holh ah ka fahnak a dai hlei lo, Daite i ka um ah a ka kaltak hlei lo."},"7":{"text":"Pathian, nangmah nih na ka batter hrimhrim ko cang; Ka hawikom vialte cu na ṭhio dih hna."},"8":{"text":"Sawng ṭiamṭuam in na ka tuah i mah cucu ka cung i tehte a si; Ka ruh lawng a taan caah hin, ka dernak cu a sual caah a si, an ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Na thin hun in na ka thleh i na ka bauh, Na hacang na ka rialhnawh; Na thinhunnak cu fiang tein a lang."},"10":{"text":"Mi nih keimah seh awkah an kaa an ka anhnawh, An ka pumhhnawh i ka bel ah zawmhtaih ngaingai in an ka bengh."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih Pathian zei i a rel lomi hna sinah khan a ka chanh i Miṭhalo hna kut chungah khan a ka hlonh."},"12":{"text":"Dai tein ka um ko, Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih ka orpareng in a ka dih i a ka khawn chih len i a ka tengh; A hmuichon selnak ah a ka hman i"},"13":{"text":"A kam kip in a thal cu ka cungah ruah sur in an sur. Zaangfahnak ngei loin ka kal cu a hlai hna i ka hnit cu vawlei ah a thlet."},"14":{"text":"A ka khuai a ka hmal chin lengmang ko; A thin a hun tuk i a molh in a molh cangmi ralkap bantukin a ka zuanhnawh."},"15":{"text":"Ka cuar huhnak caah puanchia kaa ṭhit i ka samtom cu leidip chungah ka nawh."},"16":{"text":"Ka ṭahnak ah ka hmai a sen i ka mitcuar zong nak khiamkhuam in an um dih;"},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka kut nih zaang-ennak kha an tuah hna lo i Ka thlacamnak a thiang ko."},"18":{"text":"“Maw vawlei, ka thisen cu khuh hlah, Dinnak ca i ka aunak hi dai hin hlah seh."},"19":{"text":"Zohhmanh, ka tehte cu vancung khin a um i Cung sangpi ah khin ka bia a ka chimpiaktu ding cu a um ko.","ref":"Job 19.25"},"20":{"text":"Pathian nih ka mitthli cu ka hmuhpiak seh law, Ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak ko seh."},"21":{"text":"Mi nih a hawipa caah nawlnak a tuah bantukin, Pathian a ka nawlpiaktu um seh law ka duh ko,"},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah ka kir ṭhan ti lai lo nakding lam ka zulhnak dingah hin Kum tlawmte lawnglawng a duh ko."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka lungthin cu a kuai cang, ka ni cu rel an si cang; Thlan nih a ka hngah ko cang."},"2":{"text":"Kaa mernak paoh ah mi nih an rak ka nihsawh, Ka thin an ka phawhnak cu ka mit nih a hmuh zungzal ko."},"3":{"text":"Pathian, ka lih ka chim lo, ka bia cu ka cohlanpiak ko, Ka chimmi cu, ahmaan, tiah a titu ding an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Hngalhthiamnak an ngeih nakhnga lo, an lung cu na phih hna i Ka cungah diriam in umter hna hlah."},"5":{"text":"Phungthluk bia hlun ah, mi pakhatkhat nih tangka ruangah a hawipa kha a rawi ahcun, A fale mit kha a caw lai, ti a si."},"6":{"text":"Hi phungthluk bia cu keimah cungah an hman i Mi nih an theih i an ra i ka hmai ah cil an ka chak."},"7":{"text":"Ngaihchiatnak in ka mit cu a mui cang i Ka kutke vialte hi thladem bantuk ceo an si cang."},"8":{"text":"Miding ka si, aa timi hna cu an khuaruah a har i Pathian zei i a rel lomi ah an ka chiah."},"9":{"text":"Hmaizah awk tlak ka si, aa timi hna nih cun, Kanmah hi kan hmaan, tiah an i ruat chin lengmang ko."},"10":{"text":"Asinain, ka hmaiah an dihlak in ra dir hna seh law, An lakah mifim pakhat hmanh an um lo kha ka hmuh ko lai."},"11":{"text":"“Ka ni cu an liam cang, ka timhmi cu an rawk cang, Ka ruahchannak cu a lo cang."},"12":{"text":"Chun cu zan ah a cang cang, zingka ceunak cu ka hmaiah a mui cang."},"13":{"text":"Ruahchannak zeihmanh ka ngei ti lo, Sheol hi ka umnak ding inn a si ko, Khika ah ka it lai: mui lakah cun ka it ko lai."},"14":{"text":"Thlan cu, ka pa na si, ka ti lai i A ka eitu rungrul cu, ka nu le ka far nan si, ka ti hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Khuazei ah dah ruahchannak cu ka ngeih? A ka hmuhpiaktu aho tal an um maw?"},"16":{"text":"Keimah he vui ṭi awk le Sheol i vung kal ṭi awkah, Aa timmi aho tal an um maw?” tiah a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Shuh mi Bildad nih a leh i:","title":"Bildad Nih Miṭhalo Hna Umtuning A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Zei can dah bia cu na kawl rih lai? Ruat hmanh law kannih nih kan chim lai."},"3":{"text":"Zeicahdah kannih cu saṭil bantuk ah na kan rel? Zeicahdah kannih cu a hrutmi saram bantuk ah na kan hmuh?"},"4":{"text":"Nangmah nih cun, keimah hi ka hmaan, na ti; Hi na timi hi ahmaan taktak ti nakding caah, Vawlei hi chuahtak dih i lung hna hi an umnak hmun in ṭhial dih maw a herh lai?"},"5":{"text":"“Sihlah, a ceunak hmih a simi cu miṭhalo a si i A mei cun meizik a chuak ṭhan ti lai lo.","ref":"Job 21.17"},"6":{"text":"A thlam chungah ceunak cu a mui i a chung i a meiinn cu a mit."},"7":{"text":"A kehlan cu a rak fek, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu a ther, Amah khuakhannak lila nih khan a thluk;"},"8":{"text":"Sur chungah khan a lut i tlung kha aa lamh."},"9":{"text":"Rap nih a kedil in a foih i a val nih khan fek tein a hren."},"10":{"text":"Vawlei ah hri kha an valhhnawh, lam ah rap kha an chiahhnawh."},"11":{"text":"Ṭihnak nih a kenkip in an chuahhnawh i a hnulei in an dawi lengmang."},"12":{"text":"A rak ṭhawng ngaingai nain, atu cu ṭihnak in a zeng ko. A pawng in vanchiatnak nih a dirhnawh ko."},"13":{"text":"Zawtnak ṭha lo nih a pum cu a zual dih i a kutke hna cu an thu dih."},"14":{"text":"A inn chung i him tein a umnak hmun khan an hnuh i Thihnak Siangpahrang ṭihnung hmaiah khan an chuahpi."},"15":{"text":"A innchung ah khan zeihmanh a tang ti lo. A umnak ah khan kaat a phulh."},"16":{"text":"A hram cu tanglei ah a car i an nge cu cunglei ah a ro;"},"17":{"text":"Amah hngalh camcinnak kha vawlei in a lo i vawlei cungah min a chia ta lo."},"18":{"text":"Amah cu ceunak in muihnak ah nam a si i minung umnak vawlei cungin dawi a si."},"19":{"text":"A mi hna lakah tefa siseh, ciruang siseh, a ngei hna lo; A rak umnak tawn vawlei ah khan a nung in a rohmi an um lo."},"20":{"text":"Nitlaklei mi hna nih a kong an theih tikah an tuk a sum i Nichuahlei mi hna cu an thlakawk a bar hna."},"21":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak a tuahmi hna khuasaknak hmun cu cu bantuk cu a si i Pathian zei ah a rel lomi hna umnak hmun cu mah bantuk cu a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Pathian Nih Thiam A Ka Coh Lai Tiah Job Nih A Zumh"},"2":{"text":"“Zei can dah bia in nan ka hrem lai i nan ka tongh lai?"},"3":{"text":"Atu le atu ka ningzahnak nan tuah lengmang i Ka cungah ningzak loin ṭhat lonak kha nan tuah lengmang."},"4":{"text":"A palh hmanh hei palh ning law ka palhnak cu keimah cungah pei a si ko lai cu."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu keimah nak ṭha deuh ah nan i ruat i Harnak ka inmi hi, a sual ruangah a si, nan ti."},"6":{"text":"Pathian hi ka cungah a ding lo i, Amah nih a sur in a ka khuh ti hi nan hngal kho lo maw?"},"7":{"text":"Mah hihi lainawn a si, tiin ka au ah, ahohmanh nih an ka let lo, Ka bawm u, tiah ka ti ah, dinnak zeihmanh ka hmu lo."},"8":{"text":"Ka lam kha vampang a ka chonkanh i cucaah ka lan kho lo, Ka lam ah muihnak kha a chiah."},"9":{"text":"Ka sunparnak cu a ka hlih i ka bawi luchin cu ka lu cungin a lak."},"10":{"text":"A kamkip in a ka den i ka lo cang, Ka thlam hri cu thingkung bangin a phawi."},"11":{"text":"A thinlinhnak cu ka cungah a alh in a alh i, A ral ah a ka chiah."},"12":{"text":"A ralkap hna cu keimah tuk awkah a rak thlah hna, Kahcham kha an i cawh i ka thlam velchum in an ka riahhnawh."},"13":{"text":"“Ka unau hna nih an ka hlawt, Ka theihhngalh hna cu mising rumro ah an cang."},"14":{"text":"Ka phunhawi le ka hawikom ṭha nih an ka deuh;"},"15":{"text":"Ka inn chung i ka hawileng hna nih khan an ka philh, Ka salnu hna nih khan khual ah an ka chiah, Kei cu an mithmuh ah ramdangmi ka si ko cang."},"16":{"text":"Ka sinum kha ka auh, sihmanhsehlaw a ka let lo; A nawl i ka nawl hmanh ah a ka let duh lo."},"17":{"text":"Ka thawchuah cu ka nupi caah hnahnawk a si i Ka unau hrimhrim hna caah khan fihnung ka si cang."},"18":{"text":"Ngakchia no tete hmanh nih an ka serhsat, ka thawh tikah an ka nihsawh."},"19":{"text":"Ka hawikom ṭha vialte nih an ka fih i ka dawtmi hna nih an ka ral."},"20":{"text":"Ka ruh cu ka cuar lengah an fong i ka ha vun in ka luat."},"21":{"text":"“Ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei tuah u, Ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei tuah u, maw nannih ka hawile hna, Zeicahtiah Pathian kut nih a ka tawngh cang."},"22":{"text":"Zeicahdah nannih nih Pathian nih a ka dawi bantukin nan ka dawi? Zeicahdah ka sa cu nan vuai cang ko lo?"},"23":{"text":"Ka bia hi ṭial si hna seh law ka hei duh dah! Cauk chungah ṭial si hna seh law ka hei duh dah."},"24":{"text":"Zungzal a hmun dingin thir cafung le suan in Lung cungah khenh si hna seh law ka hei duh dah!"},"25":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a ka Tlanhtu a nun kha ka hngalh i Ni hmanung bik ah cun vawlei cungah hin a dir lai;"},"26":{"text":"Cun ka cuar cu hrawh a si dih tikah ka titsa in Pathian cu ka hmuh lai."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu ka mit hrimhrim in ka hmuh lai i Midang nih si loin keimah hrimhrim nih ka hmuh lai."},"28":{"text":"“Nannih nih nan i thawh i, Harnak a rualrual in a cungah aa tlunter khih! Hi harnak an hram cu amah chungah khin pei a um cu,’ nan ti tikah hin ka lung a dong."},"29":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak vialte a thianhtu vainam, nanmah lei a sawhmi kha ṭih tuah u, Khi tikah nannih nih Dingthlu Lairel a um ko, ti kha nan hngalh lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Naamath mi Zofar nih a leh i:","title":"Zofar Nih Miṭhalo Hna Kong A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Ka lungre a theih caah kan leh i cucaah khulrang in ka chim zaunak cu a si."},"3":{"text":"Na chimmi cu keimah zawmhtaihnak caah a si i nangmah lehnak cu ka hngalh ve ko lai."},"4":{"text":"Hlanlio piin mah bantuk hin a si zungzal ko i Vawlei ah minung a um hramthawk in, hi bantukin a si zungzal ko ti kha na hngalh:"},"5":{"text":"Miṭhalo lawmhnak cu tawite lawng a si i Pathian zei ah a rel lomi thanuamnak cu caan tawite lawng a si."},"6":{"text":"A sanlei cu van tawng in, a lu nih vanrang khi phan hmanh seh law,"},"7":{"text":"Amah ek bantukin a lo ṭhan ko lai; Amah a rak hmumi hna nih khan, ‘Khuazei ah dah a um?’ an ti lai."},"8":{"text":"Mang bantukin a lo lai, zan i langhnak hmuhmi bantukin a lo lai."},"9":{"text":"A rak hmutu mit nih khan an hmu ti lai lo, Amah a hmun zong nih khan a hmu ti lai lo."},"10":{"text":"A fale hna nih khan, sifakmi hna sinin a firmi kha an cham ṭhan lai, A kut hrimhrim nih a lakmi chawva cu an khirh ṭhan hna lai."},"11":{"text":"A ruh cu tlangval ṭhawnnak in a khat ko, Sihmanhsehlaw leidip ah a cang zau lai."},"12":{"text":"“Ṭhat lonak cu a kaa chungah a thlum in a thlum i a lei tangah aa chiah,"},"13":{"text":"Cun mah cucu chak duh loin a ka chungah aa hmawm,"},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a rawl cu a paw chungah cun aa thleng i, a pum chungah cun rul sivai a khaa ngaimi ah a cang."},"15":{"text":"Rumnak cu a dolh i a luak ṭhan, Pathian nih a paw chungin a chuah ṭhan."},"16":{"text":"A dolhmi cu rul sivai bantuk a si; Cu nih cun ping-er cuk bantukin a thah."},"17":{"text":"Khuaihliti le cawhnuk khal in a luangmi tiva hna cu anih din awk an si lai lo."},"18":{"text":"A rianṭuan man theitlai hna cu dolh manh loin a khirh ṭhan hna lai i A chawlehnak miakmi in nuamhnak zeihmanh a hmu lai lo."},"19":{"text":"Zeicahtiah sifakmi kha a rial hna i a hrem hna, Amah nih a sak lomi inn kha a chuh hna."},"20":{"text":"“A duhfahnak cu a riamh khawh lo caah A duhmi thil ah cun thlachiat a ruat kho lo."},"21":{"text":"A ei dih hna ah cun a tangmi zeihmanh a um ti lo, Cucaah a rumnak nih cun sau a nguh lai lo."},"22":{"text":"A rum siling te ah a thaw a pit lai, harnak ṭhawnnak vialte cu a cungah an tlung lai."},"23":{"text":"Pathian nih a cungah a thinhunnak cu a tlunter ciammam i Harnak cu ruah sur in a surter."},"24":{"text":"Vainam khan luat aa zuam tikah dar cantiang nih khan a rak thil lai;"},"25":{"text":"Tleu ziarzuar in a ummi a hna cu a hnit in a keng ah a tleng."},"26":{"text":"A khonmi thil vialte kha a lo dih, Minung kaumi a si lomi mei nih amahle a innchungkhar vialte cu a kangh dih hna."},"27":{"text":"Van nih khin a ṭhat lonak cu an phuan lai i Vawlei nih hin amah sualphawt awkah a tho lai."},"28":{"text":"A inn chung i a ngeihmi thilri vialte cu tilian nih a fenh dih hna lai, Pathian thinhun ni ah cun an loral dih lai."},"29":{"text":"Mah hihi miṭhalo nih Pathian sinin a hmuhmi covo cu a si, amah ca i ro a ruahpiakmi cu a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih Miṭhalo An Nun A Nuam Ko, A Ti"},"2":{"text":"“Ka bia hi ṭha tein ka ngaihpiak hna u law, Mah cucu nannih nih nan ka hnemhnak cu si seh."},"3":{"text":"Hong ka ing ko u law ka chim lai, Cun ka chim dih hnuah, nan duh ahcun nan ka nihsawh te lai."},"4":{"text":"Kei cu ka phunzainak hi minung cungah maw a si? Zeicahdah thintawi loin ka um lai?"},"5":{"text":"Ka zoh u law nan khuaruah har u, nan kaa kha nan kut in i hup u."},"6":{"text":"Ka cung i a tlungmi hi ka ruah tikah ka lung a dong i ka tha a ther,"},"7":{"text":"Zeicahdah miṭhalo hi an chan a sau i an tar zongah an ngan a dam, an lian an ngan i an ṭhawn?"},"8":{"text":"An tefa hna cu innlo fek in an um kha an hmuh hna i An hrinsor hna cu an mithmuh ah an ṭhangcho."},"9":{"text":"An innchungkhar hna cu fek ṭhepṭhup le him tein khua an sa i Pathian dinnak ṭhiangṭhunh nih cun a phan hna lo."},"10":{"text":"An cawtum nih lak loin ci an thlak hna i An cawpi nih fa an hrin hna i an hrulh bal lo."},"11":{"text":"An ngakchia tete cu tuurun bangin an chuak i an lam."},"12":{"text":"Tingtang le thonglawi tum in hla an sa i lawi aw ah cun an i lawm."},"13":{"text":"Rumnak in an chan cu an hman i daihnak in Sheol ah cun an vung kal."},"14":{"text":"Pathian sinah cun, ‘Kan sinin i ṭhen ko, na lam hngalh kha kan duh lo,’ an ti."},"15":{"text":"Lianngan Bik cu an i thawh i, ‘Ahodah na si i na rian kan ṭuan hnga cu? Na sin i thla kan cam ah zei miaknak dah kan hmuh?’ an ti."},"16":{"text":"Annih nih, kanmah thazang tein kan hlawh a tling, an ti, Sihmanhsehlaw annih ruahning cu ka cohlang kho lo."},"17":{"text":"“Miṭhalo cu a mei a mit bal maw? Vanchiatnak an tong bal maw?"},"18":{"text":"Pathian nih a thinhun in miṭhalo cu dan a tat hna in, thlitu nih a choihmi capawl le thlichia nih a choihmi leidip bantuk ah a ser bal hna maw?"},"19":{"text":"Nannih nih cun, ‘An pale ṭhat lo ruangah Pathian nih an fale cu dan a tat hna,’ nan ti, Sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun, ‘A sualmi cu Pathian nih anmahte kha dantat ko hna seh law, cucu an sual caah a si, ti kha langhter ko seh,’ ka ti."},"20":{"text":"An rawhnak cu anmah mit hrimhrim nih hmu seh law Lianngan Bik thinlinhnak cu anmah nih ding hrim ko hna seh."},"21":{"text":"Minung cu a nunnak a dongh tikah cun, a fale an run i lawmh le lawmh lo cu zei ah a rel taktak ti hnga maw?"},"22":{"text":"Vancung i a ummi hna hmanh bia a ceihtu Pathian cu, Aho tal nih dah an cawnpiak khawh hnga?"},"23":{"text":"“Mi pakhat cu a rum saling ah, i nuam ngai le hnangam ngaiin a um lioah,"},"24":{"text":"A pum cu thau in a khah i a ruh chung thlek hna cu an hnin lioah a thi."},"25":{"text":"Cun a dang pakhat cu, ngaihchia ngaiin, ṭhatnak kha tep bal loin a thi."},"26":{"text":"Leidip chungah bangrep in an it i cangcel nih an khuh hna."},"27":{"text":"“Na ruahmi le zeitindah a bia cu ka al khawh lai tiin bia alnak ding na timh cuahmahmi cu ka hngalh ko."},"28":{"text":"‘Atu hi minganpa inn kha khuazei ah dah a si? Miṭhalopa inn kha tah zeidah a can cang hnga?’ tiin bia na ka hal lai cu ka hngalh ko."},"29":{"text":"Khualtlawngmi kha na hal bal hna lo maw? Annih nih an chimmi kha na hngal lo maw?"},"30":{"text":"Pathian cu a thin a hun i mi kha dan a tat hna tikah, a luatmi cu miṭhalo ṭheo an si ko."},"31":{"text":"Miṭhalopa cu, aho nih hmaitonh in, na ṭha lo, an ti lo i a tuahmi kha aho nih an lehrul lo."},"32":{"text":"Thlan i zawnh a si tikah, Mi tampi nih a hnulei he a hmailei he an zulh; Leidip kha a caah cun a thlum i Mi thong tampi nih a thlan cu an ven.","merge":"33"},"34":{"text":"Cucaah hnemhnak nan ka chimhmi hi, zeitluk in dah pakpalawng a si? Nan chimmi hi lih lawngte an si!” tiah a ti."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Teman mi Elifaz nih a leh i:","title":"Elifaz Nih Job Cu Na Sual Ngaingai A Ti"},"2":{"text":"“Minung hi Pathian caah san a tlai khomi an um hnga maw? A fimmi hmanh hi Pathian ca i san a tlaimi an um hnga maw?","ref":"Job 35.6-8"},"3":{"text":"Na din ah, na dinnak nih cun Lianngan Bik cu zeital a bawm maw? Na ziaza cu soi awk um lo a si ah tah, cu nih cun zeital a ṭhathnem maw?"},"4":{"text":"Ka din caah a ka chimhhrin rua tiah i ruat hlah, Hi ruangah hin a ka hneksak rua ti zongah i ruat hlah."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah cu miṭhalo ngai na si i na sualnak hi dongh a hngalh lo."},"6":{"text":"Na unau nih an cawimi tangka ruangah khan a puan kha na chuh i aih awk zeihmanh ngei loin na chiah."},"7":{"text":"Tha baami kha din awkah ti na pe hna lo i rawl ṭammi kha rawl na sianh hna lo."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah vawlei hi miṭhawng mi hna ta lawng maw a si? Hmaizahmi mi tlawmte hna ram lawng dah a si?"},"9":{"text":"Nuhmei cu kutro in na kalter hna i Ngakṭah hna cu chanhtu ngei loin na tuk hna."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah na velchum in rap a um i ṭihnak nih an tlunhnawh cu khuaruahhar awk a si lo."},"11":{"text":"Ceunak cu mui ah canter a si i cucaah khua na hmu kho lo, tilian nih an khuh."},"12":{"text":"“Pathian cu van ah khin a sannak bik ah a um a si lo maw? A sang bik arfi hmanh khi chuk zoh in a vun zoh hna."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nang nih cun naa thawh i, ‘Pathian nih zeidah a hngalh? Muihnak nih a tuam i biaceih khawhnak ah khua a hmu kho lai lo;"},"14":{"text":"A chahmi khuadawm cu a mit nih a hlan kho hna lo i Van kuai cungah khin a kenkip ah aa chawk len ko,’ na ti."},"15":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna nih an zulhmi lam kha ruat hmanh,"},"16":{"text":"An caan a tlin hlanah lak an si i an hram cu tilian nih a fenh hna."},"17":{"text":"Hi hna nih hin Pathian cu an thawh i, ‘Kanmah tein um ko u sih, Lianngan Bik nih cun kan cungah zeidah a tuah khawh lai?’ an ti."},"18":{"text":"Asinain, an inn hna cu thil ṭhaṭha in a khahtertu cu amah a si Annih i an i tinhmi le anih i aa tinhmi cu an i dang ngaingai."},"19":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna cu dantat an si tikah Miding mi hna cu an i lawm i a sual lomi hna cu an ni."},"20":{"text":"An ngeihmi thil vialte cu an rawk dih i An chawva vialte hna cu mei nih a kangh dih hna."},"21":{"text":"“Atu cu, Job, Pathian he khan remnak ser law, na ral ah rel ti hlah law thluachuahnak na hmuh lai."},"22":{"text":"Cawnpiaknak kha a ka in i lak law a bia cu na lung chungah i khon hna."},"23":{"text":"Lianngan Bik sinah na kir ṭhan i na lung na ṭhumh i Na inn chungin dinlonak kha na dawi i"},"24":{"text":"Sui kha leidip bantuk ah na rel i Ofir sui kha tiva lung tekem bantuk ah na rel ahcun,"},"25":{"text":"Lianngan Bik hrimhrim cu na sui a si lai i Amah cu a chonh in aa chonhmi na ngun a si lai."},"26":{"text":"Khi tikah Lianngan Bik cu naa bochan zungzal lai i Amah cu naa lawmhnak a hram a si kha na hngalh lai."},"27":{"text":"A sinah thla na cam lai i an theih lai; Cun na biahrennak kha na tlinter hna lai."},"28":{"text":"Ka tuah lai, tiah na timi paoh ah na hlawh a tling lai i Na lam ah ceunak a tlang lai;"},"29":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian nih aa porhlawmi kha a ṭhumh hna i toidormi kha a khamh hna."},"30":{"text":"Zeihmanh a sual lomi kha a chuah hna, Na kut a thian caah nangmah zong an chuah lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih A Bia Kha Pathian Hmai Chuahpi A Duh"},"2":{"text":"“Nihin zong ka phunzainak cu a fak ko, Aihram loin ka um kho lo."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu khuazei ah dah a um ti kha hngal kho in, A umnak ah khan zeitindah fuh khawh a si hnga ti kha hngal ning law cu"},"4":{"text":"A hmaiah khan ka bia cu ka va chim hnga i Ka bia cu tlamtling tein ka va chim ko hnga."},"5":{"text":"A ka lehnak ding bia kha ka theih hnga i Ka sinah a chim ding bia kha ka hngalh hnga."},"6":{"text":"Keimah cu nam chih awkah a ṭhawnnakpi cu a hmang hnga maw? A hmang lai lo, ka bia cu a ka ngaihpiak deuh ko lai."},"7":{"text":"A hmaiah cun miding mi cu thiam an co tawn i Ka bia a ka ceihtu bawi sin cun luatnak taktak ka hmuh ve ko lai."},"8":{"text":"Hmailei i ka kal ah, khika ah a um lo, Hnulei i ka kal ah ka hmu kho fawn lo;"},"9":{"text":"Kehlei i ka kawl ah ka hmu kho lo, Orhlei i kaa mer ah ka hmu kho fawn lo."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka ṭuan ah siseh, kaa dinh ah siseh, a ka hngalh ko, A ka hneksak dih tikah, sui ka si kha a lang."},"11":{"text":"A lam kha ka ke nih fek tein an zulh, a lam kha ka zulh i ka pial lo."},"12":{"text":"A hmur in a chuakmi nawlbia kha zeirello in ka um hna lo i Ka lung chungah a kaa chuak bia kha ka khon hna."},"13":{"text":"Amah cu thlen khawh lo a si i aho nih dah an mer khawh lai? A duhmi cu a tuah ko."},"14":{"text":"Ka ca i aa tinhmi cu a tlinter lai, Cu bantuk tinhmi tampi cu a lung chungah a um."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah amah ton cu ka ṭih i amah kong ka ruah tikah ka thin a phang."},"16":{"text":"Pathian nih ka lung kha a ka derter, Lianngan Bik nih ka thin a ka phanter."},"17":{"text":"Muihnak kha ka mit a ka cawttertu a si nain, ka thin a ka phantertu cu muihnak kha si loin Pathian kha a si."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zeicahdah Lianngan Bik nih biaceih caan cu a khiah lo i amah a rianṭuantu hna caah dinnak in biaceih ni kha a chiah lo?","title":"Pathian Nih Ṭhat Lonak Kha Zei Ah A Rel Lo Tiin Job Kha A Zai"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih ramri lung kha an ṭhial i tuu kha an fir hna i anmah tuurun chungah an fonh hna."},"3":{"text":"Ngakṭah kha an laa an chuh hna i nuhmei kha an leiba a cham hlantiang an cawtum kha an hren."},"4":{"text":"Sifakmi kha lamthlang ah an en hna, mirethei kha an zam i an i thup."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah misifak cu thetse ram ah rawl kawl in a vak lengmangmi laa bantukin tuan tein a tho, Sihmanhsehlaw khuamuih tiang a ṭuan nain a fale cu rawl ṭam in an um ko."},"6":{"text":"Anmah ta a si lomi lo ah khan rawl an ṭuan i Miṭhalopa dum chungah khan mitsur thei lawh rian an ṭuan."},"7":{"text":"Zan khuadei taklawng in puan loin an it, Khuasik ah vorh awk puan an ngei lo."},"8":{"text":"Tlang cung ruah nih a surh hna i an cin dih, Dornak a um lo caah lungpi ah an i bek."},"9":{"text":"Ngakṭah kha miṭhalo nih sal ah an ser hna i Misifakpa a fa kha a leiba caah an tlaihpiak."},"10":{"text":"Pumlawng in, puan loin, rianṭuannak ah an kal, Rawlṭam in faphal kha an thiar;"},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna oliv kung tlar lakah khan oliv chiti an sur, Mitsur cu an nen, sihmanhsehlaw an ti a hal."},"12":{"text":"A thi cuahmahmi hna cu khuapi chungin an hrum an ai i Hliammi hna cu bawmhnak hal in an au; Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih an thlacamnak cu zeihmanh ah a relpiak hna lo."},"13":{"text":"Chun ceunak kha a doh i a lam kha a hngal lo i Ceunak lam ah khan a um duh lomi an um."},"14":{"text":"Lainawng cu sifak le retheimi kha thah awkah ceu hlan in a tho;"},"15":{"text":"Mi nupi a sualtu nih cun khuamuih kha aa caan i, ‘Aho nih an ka hmu lo,’ tiah a ruah."},"16":{"text":"Zan ah mifir cu a vak i a hmai cu hlennak in aa khuh, Chun i aa chingchiah ciami inn kha zan ah cun a bauh hna. An dihlak in ceunak a hngal lomi an si,"},"17":{"text":"A muimi zan cu an caah zingka a si, Zeicahtiah annih cu a thukmi muihnak hawikom kha an si."},"18":{"text":"“Cu bantuk mi hna cu ti cung i buanbara bantuk an si; An comi hmun cu chiatserhmi hmun a si i an mitsur lo ah ahohmanh an kal duh lo."},"19":{"text":"Carnak le linhnak nih hawhra ti cu an kaoter hna, Cu bantukin a sualmi cungah Sheol nih a tuah ve."},"20":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih amah cu an hngal ti lo, a nu hmanh nih a hngal ti lo; Tholung nih an ei i a rawk dih cikcek."},"21":{"text":"Zeicahdah hi bantukin a si ti ahcun, nuhmei kha a bawm duh hna lo i fahring lo nu kha a zaangfah hna lo caah a si."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a ṭhawnnak in a ṭhawngmi kha a thah hna i Pathian nih a ṭuan tikah cun miṭhalo mi cu an thi."},"23":{"text":"Pathian nih him tein khua a sakter ko hna, Sihmanhsehlaw ṭha tein a ngiat zungzal hna."},"24":{"text":"Caan tawite chung miṭhalo cu hlorh an hung si, sihmanhsehlaw an lo zau; Pangpar bantukin an car i an ziam; rawl vui bantukin hleh an si."},"25":{"text":"Mah hihi a si lo, tiah a ti khotu aho tal an um maw? Ka bia cu ahmaan lo, tiah a ti khotu an um maw?” tiah a ti."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Shuh mi Bildad nih a leh i:","title":"Pathian Hmaika Ah Mi Cu Thiam A Co Kho Lai Lo"},"2":{"text":"“Pathian cu zeizong vialte tuah khotu a si, A pennak vancung ah khin daihnak a umter."},"3":{"text":"A ralkapbu hna cu aho nih dah an rel cawk hna lai? Pathian ceunak nih a ceuh lomi hmun a um maw?"},"4":{"text":"A si ahcun, zeitindah Pathian hmaiah minung cu a din khawh lai?
