Nu chungin a chuakmi cu zeitindah a thian khawh lai?"},"5":{"text":"Zohhmanh, a mithmuh ah thlapa hmanh khi a tling lo i arfi hna hmanh khi sual lo an si lo;"},"6":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah tholung ceo a simi minung cu a si chinchin lai i, Cangcel ceo a simi mifapa cu a si chinchin lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a leh i:","title":"Job Nih Pathian Cu Uktu A Sinak Kha A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Ṭhawnnak a ngei lomi cu na hei ka bawmh thiam dah! Thazang a ngei lomi cu na hei ka luatter thiam dah!"},"3":{"text":"Zei ti awk a hngal ti lomi cu na hei ka fimter thiam dah, Na ruahnak cheuhmi cu mihrut mi caah a hei ṭha thiam dah!"},"4":{"text":"Aho nih dah mah bantuk bia chim cu an forh i Na chimmi bia ah cun aho thlarau dah a lang?"},"5":{"text":"Tanglei vawlei ah cun thladem hna cu a ther in an ther i Ti le a chung i a ummi thil vialte hna cu an thin a phang."},"6":{"text":"Sheol cu Pathian hmaiah cun taklawng in a um i Abaddon cu a khuhnak a chin kha hun a si."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih van puan cu pakpalawng cungah khin a zam i Vawlei cu zeihmanhlo chungah a thlai."},"8":{"text":"A chahmi khuadawm chungah ti cu a fun hna i a rit nain khuadawm cu an i cheu lo."},"9":{"text":"Thlapa hmai cu a huh i a cungah cun a khuadawm kha a zamter."},"10":{"text":"Ti cungah khan, ceu le mui ramri ah khan, a bial in a rin."},"11":{"text":"Van tung hna cu an ther, a sik hna i ar koin an um."},"12":{"text":"A ṭhawnnak in rili rulpi kha a cheu, a thiamnak in Rahab kha a thah."},"13":{"text":"A thaw in van kha a thianter i a zammi rulpi cu a kut in a chunh."},"14":{"text":"Zohhmanh, mah hihi a ṭhawnnak tlangri ceo an si rih, Amah kong kan theihmi cu zeitluk in dah a tlawm! A ṭhawnnak khuari chinchin cu aho nih dah a hngalh khawh lai?” tiah a ti."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a biachimmi kha a thawh ṭhan i:","title":"Job Nih Miṭhalo Hna Covo Kong A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Dinnak a ka phaw duh lo i lungretheihnak in a ka khahtertu Lianngan Bik Pathian min in chiat ka ser:"},"3":{"text":"Ka thaw cu ka chungah a um i Pathian thaw kha ka hnar chungah a um chung paoh ah cun,"},"4":{"text":"Ka hmur nih ahmaan lomi bia kha an chim lai lo i ka lei nih hlennak bia kha a chim lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah cu na dik, tiah kan tinak ding kha, Pathian nih ka kham ko seh; Ka thih tiangin, ka sual lo, ka tinak kha ka ngol bal lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Ka bia a ding ti kha fek tein kaa tlaih lai i, ka thlah bal lai lo; Ka nun chung paohpaoh ahcun, kaa thleng bal lai lo."},"7":{"text":"“Ka ral cu miṭhalo hna nih an tonmi bantuk kha tong ko seh, Keimah a ka dohtu cu miding lo nih an tonmi bantuk rawhnak kha tong ko seh."},"8":{"text":"Pathian nih Pathian zei i a rel lomi cu a thah tikah, Pathian nih a nunnak a lakpiak tikah khan, A caah zei ruahchannak dah a um?"},"9":{"text":"Harnak nih a tlunhnawh tikah Pathian nih a thlacamnak cu a ngaihpiak lai maw?"},"10":{"text":"Lianngan Bik cu aa bochan hnga maw? Pathian cu a au camcin hnga maw?"},"11":{"text":"“Pathian thil ti khawhnak kha kan chimh lai, Lianngan Bik nih aa tinhmi cu ka thup lai lo."},"12":{"text":"Nanmah hrim nih hi thil hi nan dihlak in nan hmuh cang hna ahcun, Zeicahdah pakpalawng bia hi nan chim lengmang kun?"},"13":{"text":"“Pathian nih miṭhalo covo ah a chiahmi cu hihi a si, Thlachiat ruat lomi nih Lianngan Bik sinin an hmuhmi ro cu:"},"14":{"text":"Fa cu a ngeih ko hna lai, sihmanhsehlaw vainam in an thi lai; Cun a tefa hna cu rawlṭam in khua an sa lai."},"15":{"text":"Amah hnuah a nung rihmi hna cu thlan ah rai nih a vui hna lai i nuhmei ahohmanh nih an ṭah hna lai lo."},"16":{"text":"Ngun cu leidip bantukin a pon ko hna lai i, Thilpuan cu a ponpon in a chiah ko hna lai nain,"},"17":{"text":"Aa hruk-aihtu cu miding kha an si lai i, Sualnak a ngei lomi nih a ngun cu an i phaw lai."},"18":{"text":"A sakmi inn cu sawmpalak bu bantuk a si i, Ralvengtu nih an sakmi deu bantuk a si."},"19":{"text":"Ni khat cu rum ngaiin a it, sihmanhsehlaw cu bantuk cu a si ṭhan bal ti lo; A mit cu a hun i au i a chawva cu an lo dih cang."},"20":{"text":"Harnak nih tilian bangin a phanh, zan ah phuchim nih a choih."},"21":{"text":"Nichuahlei thli nih a choih i a lo, a inn in lamhlapi ah khan a choih;"},"22":{"text":"Zaangfahnak um loin a hranh i a ṭhawnnak nih khan heh tiah a den chih."},"23":{"text":"A kut a benghhnawh i a umnak hmun kip ah khan therphang in a umter."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ngun cawhnak khor an um i mi nih sui an ernak hmun a um;","title":"Mi Nih Fimnak An Kawl"},"2":{"text":"Thir cu vawlei in an lak i dar cu lung chungin an tit."},"3":{"text":"A thap a donghnak cu a muihnak tiang a phan i a dongh khitkhet tiangin an kawl."},"4":{"text":"Mi umnak hmun in a hlami nelrawn ah khor an cawh hna; Annih cu khualtlawngmi nih an philh hna, Mi he aa hlatnak ah an i thlai i khattelei in khattelei ah an i vawr."},"5":{"text":"A cung i vawlei in rawl kung an kho i a tang vawlei cu mei a kangh bantukin aa let."},"6":{"text":"A lung chung cun lapis lazuli lungvar kha an chuak i sui pan tete nih khan a tuam hna."},"7":{"text":"“Cuka lei kalnak lam cu cawihmang va zeihmanh nih an hngal lo i mupi mit zong nih a hmu bal lo;"},"8":{"text":"Aa porhlawmi saram nih an lam lo i rul nih a tan bal lo."},"9":{"text":"“Minung nih ṭeklung pipi cu an kuai hna i tlang pipi cu a hram in an leh dih hna."},"10":{"text":"Lungpang chungah khan kahcham an cawh hna i a sungmi lungphun kip kha an mit nih a hmuh."},"11":{"text":"Tiva kha an kham hna i vawlei tang i a ummi thil kha lengah an chuah hna."},"12":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw khuazei ah dah fimnak cu hmuh khawh a si lai? Hngalhthiamnak a hram cu khuazei ah dah a si?"},"13":{"text":"Cuka kalnak lam cu mi nih an hngal lo i a nungmi ram ah hmuh a si lo."},"14":{"text":"Rili thuk nih, ‘Ka chungah a um lo,’ a ti, Rili te nih, ‘Ka sinah a um lo,’ a ti."},"15":{"text":"Sui in cawk khawh a si lo i a man cu ngun in thlai khawh a si lo."},"16":{"text":"Ofir sui in a man tuak khawh a si lo i Oniks le lapis lazuli lungvar zongin tuak khawh a si lo."},"17":{"text":"Sui le thlalang nih an tluk kho lo i Sui thiang hlawn zong nih a thleng kho lo."},"18":{"text":"Koral lungvar le alabaster lungvar hna cu chim awk tlak an si lo; Fimnak cu lungvar man sung nakin a cungnung deuh."},"19":{"text":"Ethiopia ram topaz lungvar nih a tluk kho lo i Sui thiang zongin a man tuak khawh a si lo."},"20":{"text":"“A si ahcun, fimnak cu khuazei in dah a rat kun? Hngalhthiamnak a hram cu khuazei ah dah a si kun?"},"21":{"text":"Vawlei cung i a nungmi thil ah a hmu khotu an um lo i Thli lak i a zuangmi va hna zong nih an hmu kho lo."},"22":{"text":"Thihnak le Rawhralnak nih an i thawh i, ‘A kong hi biachawkvai lawngin kan theih,’ an ti."},"23":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw cuka kalnak lam cu Pathian nih a hngalh i Amah lawnglawng nih a hram cu a hngalh."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah vawlei deng tiang khan a hmuh khawh i Van tang i a ummi thil vialte kha a hmuh dih hna."},"25":{"text":"Thli cu a rihnak a pek i ti cu tahnak in a tah hna i"},"26":{"text":"Ruah caah phung le lam kha a ser hna i Khuari nimtlau cu lam a serpiak hna tikah khan;"},"27":{"text":"Kha caan hmanh ah khan fimnak cu a rak hmuh cang i A man a rak tuak cang i a rak thlai cang."},"28":{"text":"Cun minung cu a thawh i, ‘Zohhmanh, Pathian ṭih hi fimnak cu a si, ṭhat lonak hrial hi hngalhthiamnak cu a si,’ tiah a ti,” a ti.","ref":"Slm 111.10; Phut 1.7; 9.10"}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Job nih a biachimmi cu a thawh ṭhan i:","title":"Job Nih Hmasa Aa Nuamhnak Kha A Ruat Ṭhan"},"2":{"text":"“Maw, hlan lio thla hna chung i ka rak um bantuk khan um ning law ka hei duh dah! Pathian nih a rak ka zohkhenh lio caan i ka rak um bantuk khan;"},"3":{"text":"Ka lu cung i a meiinn a rak ceu i cu ceunak thawng i mui lak i ka rak kal khawh bantuk khan;"},"4":{"text":"Ka chan lailing i ka rak si bantuk khan; Pathian nih ka inn cu a rak huhphenh i"},"5":{"text":"Lianngan Bik cu ka sinah a rak um i ka salle hna cu ka pawngkam ah an um i,"},"6":{"text":"Ka lam cu cawhnuk in an luan i Lung chungin chiti an rak puut lio bantuk kha si kho ning law ka hei duh dah!"},"7":{"text":"Khua hauka i ka va kal i zapi ṭhutnak hmun i ka va ṭhut tikah khan,"},"8":{"text":"Tlangval hna kha an ka hmuh tikah an kim i upa hna kha an tho i an dir;"},"9":{"text":"Bawi hna kha holh an i sum i an kut in an kaa an i hup;"},"10":{"text":"Tuavon hna aw kha a dai i mi kip nih holh loin an um."},"11":{"text":"“Ka kong a theimi paoh nih ka ṭhatnak lei in an rak chim, A ka hmumi paoh nih ka ṭhatnak tehte ṭha an rak si."},"12":{"text":"Sifakmi kha bawmh herh in an au tikah ka bawmh hna i, Chanhtu ngei lomi ngakṭah kha ka chanh hna."},"13":{"text":"A thi dengmangmi nih a thangṭhatmi cu keimah ka rak si i, Nuhmei, lunglawmhnak in hla a saktertu cu keimah ka rak si."},"14":{"text":"Dinnak cu puan bantukin kaa aih i, Biading cu ka caah puan le ludomh bantuk an rak si."},"15":{"text":"Mitcaw hna caah mit ka rak si i, Kebai hna caah ke ka rak si."},"16":{"text":"Sifakmi caah an pa ka rak si i, Khual kha an bia ka rak chimpiak hna."},"17":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna cu an hao kha ka rak thlongh hna i, An ha in an i sehmi kha ka rak chuh hna."},"18":{"text":"Khi tikah, ‘Ka lianhngannak cu zor lo tein ka thi lai i, Ka chan chung ni hna cu thetse zat in relcawklo an si lai;"},"19":{"text":"Ka hram cu ti leiah khan a zam lai i ka nge cungah khan dapti an um lai;"},"20":{"text":"Kaa tlaihmi ka likuk cu a thar zungzal lai i, Ka kut chungah thal cu timh cia in an um zungzal lai,’ tiah ka rak ruah."},"21":{"text":"“Zeidah a chim lai ti tein an ka ngaih i, A ruahnak kha zeidah a si hnga tiin dai tein an ka ngan."},"22":{"text":"Ka chim hnuah ahohmanh nih an chim ṭhan ti lo, Ka bia cu an cungah nem tein a tla."},"23":{"text":"Ka bia cu ruah an hngah bantukin an hngah i, Ṭhal ruah an din bantukin an din"},"24":{"text":"Ka merhhnawh hna tikah an lung a ṭhawng i, Ka mithmai ceu kha an hmuh tikah an hmaichiatnak kha a lo."},"25":{"text":"An haotu bik ah ka ṭhu i an kalnak ding lam kha ka khan, Ralkap hna he a riakmi siangpahrang bantukin khan. Ngaihchiami hna a hnemtu bantuk zong ka si."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu keimah nakin a no deuhmi hna nih cawhdeh awkah an ka nih, An pale hna cu ka tuurun cawngtu uico hna tluk fang i ka rak relmi an hei si ko ṭung hnga.","title":"Job Nih Atu A Harnak Kha A Ṭah"},"2":{"text":"Annih cu an tha a ṭum cang caah a ṭhawngmi an baan cu ka caah zeidah an ṭhathnem?"},"3":{"text":"Rawlṭam in der fialfual in thetse ram i thinghram kha an teuh;"},"4":{"text":"Rawl caah cite kung le hlingkung hnah kha an ṭawh hna i hmunphiah kung hram kha an cawh hna."},"5":{"text":"Minung sinin dawi an si i mifir bantukin auhnawh an si;"},"6":{"text":"Horkuang chung le vawlei kua chung le lungpang kua chungah khua an sa."},"7":{"text":"Saram bantukin burbuk chungah an ai i hlingbur toiah an i pum,"},"8":{"text":"Zeiruaramlo tefa rual, minung sinin ṭhawlmi an si."},"9":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu hi hna hi hla a ka sakhnawhtu kha an si cang i Khua chung i mi kip ceihmi i a ka sertu cu an si."},"10":{"text":"An ka huat i an ka hrial, ka hmaiah cil hmanh an ka chak ngam."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih ka liza cu a dorh i a ka ṭhumh caah, Ka hmai i an i sum tawnnak kha an hlonh cang."},"12":{"text":"Ka orhlei kam in a bu in an ka nam cutmat, Raltuknak chuntlung an ka serhnawh,"},"13":{"text":"Keimah hrawh awkah ka ralhau kha an chimh hna i dawntu zeihmanh um loin an ka kaihnawh."},"14":{"text":"A awnnakpi cun an rung lut i a ril in an rung ril lulhmalh."},"15":{"text":"Ṭihnung nih khan an ka tlunhnawh chin luaimai i Kaa ruahchihmi kha thlitu choih bangin a choi i Teinak kaa ruahchanmi cu minmei bangin a ṭian."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah ka si a vang i ni fate in harnak nih a ka tlaih."},"17":{"text":"Zan ah fahnak nih ka ruh a ka ṭam i a ka teuhtu fahnak kha dinh a hngal lo."},"18":{"text":"Ka puan in fak piin a ka tlaih i ka angki hngawng in thaw chuah kho loin a ka reh."},"19":{"text":"Pathian hrimhrim nih nawncek chungah a ka hlonh i leidip le vutcam bantuk ah ka cang."},"20":{"text":"“Nangmah cu kan auh i na ka let lo, Zaangfah hal awkah kan dirhnawh i, zeihmanh ah na ka rel fawn lo."},"21":{"text":"Ka cung i harnak tuah awkah na ka merhnawh i Huatnak in ka cung i harnak tuah awkah na ka zulh lengmang;"},"22":{"text":"Na ka tlaih i thlitu lakah na ka ṭhutter i Thlichia nih heh tiah a ka den."},"23":{"text":"Minung a simi paohpaoh ca i na chiahmi hmun, thihnak ah cun na ka kalter lai ti kha ka hngalh."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kut a zaomi awkhlawh ka bawmh lomi hna an um lo."},"25":{"text":"Harnak a tongmi hna caah khan ka ṭap tawn lo maw? Sifakmi caah khan ka ngaih a chia tawn lo maw?"},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ṭhatnak ka kawl tikah chiatnak a ra, Ceunak ka hngah tikah muihnak tu a ra."},"27":{"text":"Ka thin hi a vamh in aa vam i a dai ziar bal lo; Harnak ni hna cu keimah ton awkah an ra."},"28":{"text":"Hnabeidong le hawikom zeihmanh ngei loin kaa chawk ko, Mi zapi pumhnak ah ka dir tikah, bawmhnak hal ceo ah a si ko."},"29":{"text":"Ram ui cu ka unau a si ko cang, ostrik va cu ka hawi a si ko cang."},"30":{"text":"Ka cuar cu an nak dih i an kok, ka pum cu ni lin nih a ka kangh."},"31":{"text":"Ka tingtang cu ngaihchiatnak hlasaknak ah an cang i Ka thonglawi cu a ṭapmi hna aw he aa tlak in tum a si cang."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka mit kha, ngaknu na ngia hrimhrim lai lo, tiah ka ti.","title":"Job Nih A Sual Lonak Kha A Chim"},"2":{"text":"Cunglei i a ummi Pathian sinin ka covo cu zeidah a si lai i Cungsang i a ummi Lianngan Bik sinin ka ro cu zeidah a si lai?"},"3":{"text":"Vanchiatnak nih hin miding lomi a tlunhnawh hna lo maw? Chiatnak nih hin ṭhat lonak a tuahtu a tlunhnawh hna lo maw?"},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian hrimhrim nih ka lam kha a zoh hna in ka ke hlan vialte kha a rel dih hna lo maw?"},"5":{"text":"“Lih in rian ṭuannak ah kaa tel lo i hlennak lam kha ka zul lo,” tiah chiat ka ser."},"6":{"text":"Pathian nih dinnak cuaithlainak ah cun ka thlai seh law ka sual lo kha a hngalh ko lai."},"7":{"text":"Lam khan ka ke hlan cu a pial i ka lung nih ka mit kha a zulh i ka kut ah hin hnawm aa benh ahcun,"},"8":{"text":"Ka tuhmi cu midang nih ei hna seh law ka cinthlakmi cu phawi si ko seh."},"9":{"text":"Cun nu dang nih ka lungthin kha a ka lak i ka innpa innka in ka hngah ko a si ahcun,"},"10":{"text":"Ka nupi cu midang sal ah cang seh law midang nih ihpi ko hna seh."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cucu thil ṭha lo, phung hmai i sualnak,"},"12":{"text":"Ka cinthlakmi vialte a kangh i a hrawk dihtu ding mei a si."},"13":{"text":"Ka salpa siseh, ka salnu siseh, ka cung i an phunzai tikah an bia ka lakpiak hna lo ahcun,"},"14":{"text":"Pathian a langh tikah zeidah ka tuah kun lai? Biahalnak a ser tikah zei in dah ka leh lai?"},"15":{"text":"Paw chung i a ka sertu nih cun anmah cu a ser ve hna lo maw? Pathian pakhat nih paw chungah a kan ser cio a si lo maw?"},"16":{"text":"Sifakmi nih a duhmi kha sian loin ka um i nuhmei mit kha ka zetter i,"},"17":{"text":"Ngakṭah kha pek ve loin keimah lawng nih ka rawl kha ka ei i —"},"18":{"text":"A ngakchiat lio tein a ka upatmi ngakṭah, a chuahka in ka zohkhenhmi kha —"},"19":{"text":"Puan ngeih lo ruangah a thimi ka hmuh i, i aih awk a ngei lomi misifak ka hmuh i,"},"20":{"text":"Cu pa cu ka tuuhmul in lumnak a hmuh lo caah amah nih cun thluachuahnak hmu ko, a ka ti lo ahcun,"},"21":{"text":"Zung ah mi nih an ka bawmh sawk lai tiin ngakṭah cungah ka kut ka hler ahcun,"},"22":{"text":"Ka liang hi a hram in tlong seh law Ka ban cu a hliahhlok in i phawi seh."},"23":{"text":"Pathian ṭihnak cu ka cungah a um i a lianhngannak cu ka ṭih caah hi thil cu ka tuah ngam hna lo."},"24":{"text":"Rumnak kha kaa bochan bal lo i, thilri in ka rumnak ah uarthlarnak zong ka ngei lo."},"25":{"text":"Ka chawva a tam caah le ka rumnak a karh caah kaa lawm i"},"26":{"text":"Ni cu a tlan tikah ka zoh i thlapa cu a sunparnak in a kal tikah ka zoh i,"},"27":{"text":"Ka lung cu a pingah kalpi a si i anmah upatnak in ka kut ka hler hna ahcun,"},"28":{"text":"Hi hna hi, biaceihtu hna nih dan an tat awk ṭhat lonak an si ko hnga, Zeicahtiah cunglei Pathian sinah zumh awk tlak loin ka rak um a si hnga."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral nih fahnak an in tikah kaa lawm bal lo, rawhralnak an ton tikah, diriam in ka um bal lo;"},"30":{"text":"An thih nakhnga tiin thlacamnak in sualnak ka tuah bal lo."},"31":{"text":"Ka sin i rian a ṭuanmi dihlak nih, khualtlung ka donh bal hna lo le"},"32":{"text":"Khualtlawngmi kha ka inn chungah ka riahter hna i khualak lam ah ka riahter bal hna lo kha an hngalh."},"33":{"text":"Zapi congoih kha ṭih in ka minung hawi nihsawh kha ka phan caah Midang nih ṭhat lonak an tuahmi an thuh bangin ka thup bal maw? Ka sualnak cu keimah theih awk lawngah ka chia bal maw?","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Keimah chanhtu dingah tehte pakhat lawngin i kawh ko ning. Lianngan Bik nih taza a ka cuainak cu chim ko seh. Sual a ka puhtu nih a ka puhnak bia kha ca in rak ṭial seh law cu, dai tein ka rak um hnga lo i inn chungah ka rak i benh ko hnga lo."},"36":{"text":"Ka liang in ka rak i put hnga i bawi luchin bantukin ka rak i chinh hnga;"},"37":{"text":"Ka rak umtuning vialte kha ka chim hnga i Cucu zung ah khan keimah chanhnak ding caah ka chim hnga."},"38":{"text":"Ka vawlei nih khan keimah cu a ka chalh i a lei rinkuar hna nih khan an ṭahpi i, Man pek loin a chung chuakmi thil kha ka ei hna i"},"39":{"text":"Tangka a ka coihtu kha lungsi loin ka tuah hna ahcun,"},"40":{"text":"Changvut can ah hling kho hna seh law barli can ah belh kho ko hna seh,” tiah a ti. Job bia cu an dong."}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Job nih amah aa hmuhnak ah cun miding ka si aa ti peng caah hi mi pathum hna nih hin a bialeh cu an ngol.","title":"Elihu Nih Job Kha A Leh"},"2":{"text":"Khi tikah Buz mi Barakhel fapa Elihu, Ram innchungkhar chung mi a simi kha a thin a hung. Job cungah cun a thin a hung, zeicahtiah Pathian nakin amah kha a ding deuh ah aa ruat i cun"},"3":{"text":"Job hawile pathum hna cung zongah khan a thin a hung, zeicahtiah Job cu na palh tiah an ti nain lehnak an hngal lo i Pathian lehlam kha a palh an lawhter."},"4":{"text":"Annih cu amah nakin upa deuh an si caah Job sin i bia an chim ah khan Elihu cu chim loin aa sum."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an pathum in an let kho lo ti kha a hmuh tikah a thinhunnak kha aa sum kho ti lo."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Buz mi Barakhel fapa Elihu nih cun aa thawh i, “Kei cu kum in a nomi ka si i nannih cu upa nan si, Cucaah kaa sum i nan hmai i ka hngalhnak langhter kha ka ṭih."},"7":{"text":"Keimah le keimah cu, ‘Kum le khua a saumi nih chim ko hna seh, chan a saumi nih chim ko hna seh,’ kaa ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian thlarau cu minung chungah a um i Lianngan Bik thaw nih hngalhnak cu a pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Upa lawng hi a fimmi an si lo i a dik a hngalmi hi a tarmi an si theng lo."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah cun, ka bia hi ngai tuah u, kei zong ka ruahnak ka chimter ve tuah u, ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, chim awk nan i dahhriah lengmang lioah khan nan bia kha kan ngan hna i Nan ruahnak aphichuak zeidah a si lai ti kha ka ngaih."},"12":{"text":"Aphi nan chuahmi kha ṭha tein ka rak ngaih, Sihmanhsehlaw Job cu a dong khotu nan um lo i a bia a let khotu zong nan um lo."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah kanmah nih fimnak cu kan hmuh cang, ti hlah u. Minung nih si loin Pathian nih a leh lai."},"14":{"text":"Nanmah bantukin bia thiam kaa tim lai lo, nan lehning in leh zong kaa tim lai lo."},"15":{"text":"Hi mi hna hi an hnabei a dongh i let kho ti loin an um i zeihmanh chim awk ngei loin an um i,"},"16":{"text":"Holh awk an theih ti lo caah hin, chim loin maw ka um rih ko lai? An dir ko i an leh ti lo caah ka ngan ko lai maw?"},"17":{"text":"Kei zong leithuan awk ka ngei ve, ka ruahnak cu ka langhter ve lai."},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah bia in a khah in ka khat i ka chung thli nih a tawn in a ka tawn."},"19":{"text":"Zohhmanh, ka lung cu thawchuahnak awng a kawlmi mitsur hang bantukin a um i Saphaw zucua thar bangin keh hnik aa zal."},"20":{"text":"Damnak ka hmuh nakhnga ka chim lai, Ka ka cu ka an lai i ka leh lai."},"21":{"text":"Duhdanhnak kha aho cung hmanh ah ka ngei lai lo i Pathian siseh, minung siseh, ahohmanh ka fak hna lai lo."},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fak cu ka thiam ṭung lo i a ka Sertu nih a ka donghter zau sual hnga."}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Atu cu Job, ka chimmi hi thei tuah, ka bia vialte hi ṭha tein ngai tuah hna.","title":"Elihu Nih Job A Mawhchiat"},"2":{"text":"Zohhmanh, nangmah lehnak cu timh cia in ka um ko; Bia cu ka lei par ah an um ko."},"3":{"text":"Hngalh bu tein ka chim kha ka lung nih a hngalh i Ka hmur nih an hngalhmi cu hmaan tein an chim."},"4":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian thlarau nih a ka ser i Lianngan Bik thaw nih nunnak a ka pek."},"5":{"text":"Na ka leh khawh ahcun ka let tuah, Ka hmaiah na bia cu a ningcang tein tiang tuah hna; Na dir hmun i serh tuah."},"6":{"text":"Pathian mithmuh ahcun, kei zong nangmah bantukte ka si ko; Tlak pei khat ceo ka si ve ko."},"7":{"text":"Na ka ṭihnak nih na thin an phanter awk a herh lai lo, Ka kut nih an nenhnak zong na cung i a rih awk a herh lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Na chim awk hnga vialte cu na chim cang i ka theih cang; Na bia thawng cu ka theih cang hna:"},"9":{"text":"‘Ka thiang, sualpalhnak ka ngei lo, soiselnak ka ngei lo i ṭhat lonak ka chungah a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a palh ah a ka chiah tawn i a ral ah a ka rel;"},"11":{"text":"Ka ke cu hreng a khenh hna i ka tuahmi vialte cu a ngiat dih hna,’ na ti.","ref":"Job 13.27"},"12":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, hihi kan lehnak a si lai: Na palh. Pathian cu mi nakin a ngan deuh;"},"13":{"text":"Zeicahdah, ka bia cu zeihmanh a ka let lo, tiin amah cu na mawhchiat len ko?"},"14":{"text":"Amah cu a let khomi ahohmanh an um ṭung lo. Asi, Pathian nih voi khat a chim hnuah cun, cu a chimmi fehter ṭhannak caah a voi hnihnak a chim ṭhan ti ṭung lo."},"15":{"text":"Mang ah, zan i langhnak an hmuhmi ah, Mi cung i mitkuh thu a tlun tikah, An ihkhun cung i an i hngilh hluahmah lioah,","ref":"Job 4.13"},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah mi cu Pathian nih an hna kha a hunpiak hna i Ralrinnak a pekmi hna nih an thin a phanter hna."},"17":{"text":"A thi khomi minung cu aa porhlawtnak kha kham awkah le Khor chung i vung tlak ding khan tlaih awkah le Thihnak tiva tan donh awkah khan Nuncan ṭhalo i a nunnak khan a merter.","merge":"18"},"19":{"text":"Minung cu a ihkhun cung i fahnak a inmi le A ruh chung i fahnak a hmuhmi zongin chimhhrin a si tawn;"},"20":{"text":"Rawl kha a fih i a mertak i A or nih rawl thaw bikbik hmanh kha a duh hna lo."},"21":{"text":"A titsa cu uai hnianghnuang in a um i a ruh hna cu an i liklok dih."},"22":{"text":"A thlarau cu Khor a phan dengmang i A nunnak cu thihnak a phortu hna sin kha a phan dengmang."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah caah vancungmi pakhat, thong khat lak i pakhat, Pathian le minung karlak i remnak sertu a um i, Minung nih ṭhatnak a tuahmi kha a langhter i,"},"24":{"text":"A thi khomi minung cu a co awk hnga kha petu ding a um ahcun, ‘Leet ṭhan ko, Khor chungah cun vun kalter hlah, A tlanhnak man cu ka hmuh cang,’ a titu a um ahcun,"},"25":{"text":"Cu pa cu a tlanval lio nakkhan a titsa a ṭha deuh lai i a ṭhawn siling te ah khan a kir ṭhan lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun Pathian kha ka zaangfah ko tiah a nawl i Na hmai kha ka hmuhter law lawmhnak in ka au lai, tiah a nawl ahcun,"},"27":{"text":"Cun mi vialte hmaiah, ‘Ka sual cang, Dinnak kha dinlonak ah ka ser cang i cucu ka rak ruat bal lo,’ a ti ahcun,"},"28":{"text":"Khor chung i vung kalnak khan aa khamh i a nung i ceunak kha a hmu."},"29":{"text":"Hi thil vialte hi Pathian nih minung cungah a tuah lengmang tawn ko,"},"30":{"text":"Nunnak ceunak tling cu hmuh awkah Khor chungin a chuah ṭhan tawn hna,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"“Maw Job, na hna chi tuah, ka bia kha ngai tuah; Dai tein um law ka chim lai."},"32":{"text":"Chim awk zei na ngeih ahcun ka let tuah; Chim tuah, zeicahtiah nangmah kha thiamcoh kan duh."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw chim awk zeihmanh na ngeih lo ahcun ka bia ngai tuah; Dai tein um law, fimnak kan cawnpiak lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Elihu nih a bia cu a peh i:","title":"Elihu Nih Pathian Cu Thiam A Phawt"},"2":{"text":"“Ka bia hi thei tuah u, nannih mifim hna, Nan hna ka chit tuah u, nannih saupi hngalhnak a ngei cangmi hna;"},"3":{"text":"Dang nih rawl kha a teh bantukin hna nih bia kha an hneksak ve hna.","ref":"Job 12.11"},"4":{"text":"A dikmi kha kanmah tein i hneksak u sih, A ṭha taktakmi kha kannih nih i khiak sih."},"5":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Job nih aa thawh i, ‘Kei cu sualnak ka ngei lo i Pathian nih ka dinnak kha a ka lakpiak;"},"6":{"text":"Ka ding ko nai kei cu lihchim ah rel ka si; Ka hma cu damh khawh ding a si lo, phungbuarnak zeihmanh ka tuah lo nain,’ a ti."},"7":{"text":"Job bantuk hi mi zeital an um bal maw? Holh dawh lo kha tihal in a haal i"},"8":{"text":"Hawikom ṭhalo he khual tlawn a duh i miṭhalo hna he a kal ṭi tawnmi kha?"},"9":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah nih cun aa thawh i, ‘Pathian cung i i lawmh nih hin minung caah zeihmanh ṭhathnemnak a tuah lo,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"“Cucaah ka bia thei tuah u, nannih hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi hna, Pathian nih cun ṭhat lonak a tuah naisai lai lo i Lianngan Bik nih cun palhnak a tuah naisai lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mi cu an rianṭuanning bantukin a lehrulh hna i An ziaza ning bantukin an cungah a tlunter.","ref":"Slm 62.12"},"12":{"text":"Biangai tein, Pathian nih ṭhat lonak a tuah lo i Lianngan Bik nih dinnak cu a merh lo."},"13":{"text":"Aho nih dah amah cu vawlei hi na zohkhenh lai tiah nawl an pek i a cungah vawlei pumpi hi an khinh?"},"14":{"text":"A thlarau kha amah sinah a kirter ṭhan i nunnak petu thaw kha sinah a kawh ṭhan ahcun,"},"15":{"text":"Titsa vialte cu hmunkhat ah an rawk dih lai i minung cu leidip ah a kir ṭhan ko lai."},"16":{"text":"“Cucaah Job, hngalhthiamnak na ngeih zinpan ahcun, mah hi thei tuah; ka chimmi cu ngai tuah."},"17":{"text":"Dinnak a huatu nih cun uktu a si kho bal hnga maw?"},"18":{"text":"A ukning a ṭhat tuk caah, bawi hmanh kha, ‘Santlai lo,’ a ti kho i, Tuavon hmanh kha, ‘Zei ṭhahnem lo,’ tiah an hmai hrimhrim ah a ti ngam i,"},"19":{"text":"Bawi kha a duhdanh hna lo i mirum kha misifak hna nakin a upat hlei lomi siangpahrang cu, Nangmah nih sual na phawt ko maw? Zeicahtiah annih cu an dihlak in Pathian sermi an si,"},"20":{"text":"Hmakhatte ah zanṭim ah a thi khomi an si; A tawngh hna tikah mirum cu an lo ko, Miṭhawng hna cu minung kut in si loin an lo ko."},"21":{"text":"A mit in minung an lam cu a zoh i an kehlan vialte cu a hmuh dih."},"22":{"text":"Thil ṭhalo tuahtu hna an i thuh khawhnak dingah Thihnak thladem a um lo i a thukmi muihnak zong a um lo."},"23":{"text":"Pathian hmai i biaceih awk i chuah awk ah minung ca i tinhmi ni a um lo."},"24":{"text":"Dothlatnak kha zeihmanh a tuah lo, sihmanhsehlaw a ṭhawngmi kha a hrawh hna i an hmun ah midang a chiah hna."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah an tuahmi vialte kha pakpalawng ah a canter i Zan ah khan a merhnawh hna i an kuai dih."},"26":{"text":"An ṭhat lo ruangah a tuk hna i zapi hmuh hngan ah a chimhhrin hna."},"27":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah nawl ngaih kha an ngol i a lam kha zei ah an rel lo."},"28":{"text":"Khi tikah sifakmi aunak kha a hna chungah a phan i hremmi hna aunak kha a theih."},"29":{"text":"Dai tein a um zongah aho nih dah sual an phawt khawh lai? A hmai kha a thuh tikah aho nih dah an mawhchiat khawh lai? Lung a khongmi miphun le a mi vialte hna cungah, Pathian zei i a rel lomi siangpahrang kha an bawi i a ser bel ah zeitindik a si hnga?","merge":"30"},"31":{"text":"“Abiana ah, Pathian cu hei i thawh law, Ka luan cang, ṭhat lonak cu ka tuah ti lai lo;"},"32":{"text":"Santlai lomi misual ka si ko, nangmah nih lam ka hruai, Ṭhat lonak ka tuahmi paohpaoh kha zeihmanh ka tuah ti lai lo,’ hei ti law"},"33":{"text":"Hi na bia thawng hin amah na hlawtnak cu an ngaihthiam lai maw? Keimah nih si loin, nangmah nih naa khiah awk a si; Sihmanhsehlaw zeitindah na leh khawh lai?"},"34":{"text":"Mifim mi nih cun hitin an ti lai i Ka chimmi a theitu mifim hna nih cun hitin an chim lai."},"35":{"text":"‘Job nih hin hngalhnak ngei loin a chim, a chimmi ah hin sullam a um lo."},"36":{"text":"Bialehnak a chimmi hi miṭhalo mi hna bialehnak bantuk a si ve caah hin Zawnruah lo tein hneksak si ko seh."},"37":{"text":"Zeicahtiah sualnak ah hin ralthawhnak a chapchih i Pathian kha dong loin a thangchiat,’ ” tiah a ti."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Elihu nih a bia cu a peh ṭhan i:"},"2":{"text":"“Naa thawh i, ‘Zei ṭhathnemnak dah ka hmuh? Rak sual hmanh ning law, atu ah hin tah cu nakcun ṭhathnemnak zei ka hmu hlei kun maw?’ na ti tikah hin, Mah hihi a ṭhami bia a si tiah ruat in Pathian hmaiah ka ding ko, tiah na ti maw?","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah le na sin i a ummi na hawile hna cu keimah nih kan leh tuah hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Van khi hei zoh law ruat tuah, Nangmah cungpi i a ummi khuadawm khi zoh tuah hna."},"6":{"text":"Na sual a si ah, zeidah amah ralchanh in na tuah khawh? Cun na phungbuarnak cu a tam chin zongah, amah cu zeitindah na ti khawh hlei?","ref":"Job 22.2-3"},"7":{"text":"Na din a si ah, amah cu zei ṭhatnak dah na pek? Asiloah, na kut in amah nih a hmuhmi zeidah a um?"},"8":{"text":"Na ṭhat lonak nih cun nangmah bantuk mi lawng hi pei a tongh khawh ko hna cu, Na dinnak zong nih mi fapa hna lawng hi pei a ṭhathnem khawh ko hna cu."},"9":{"text":"“Rialnak a tam tuk caah mi cu an au, A ṭhawngmi hna baan ruangah bawmhnak hal in an au."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh nih, ‘A ka Sertu Pathian, zan ah him tein a kan zohkhenh i,"},"11":{"text":"Vawlei cung saram nakin fimnak tam deuh a kan pe i Van i a zuangmi va nakin fim deuh in a kan sertu kha khuazei ah dah a um?” an ti lo."},"12":{"text":"Annih cu anmah nawl lawng kha a duh i aa porhlawmi an si caah An au tikah a let hna lo."},"13":{"text":"Pathian nih au sawhsawhnak cu a thei lo i Lianngan Bik nih mah cucu zeihmanh ah a rel lo."},"14":{"text":"‘A ka hmu lo,’ tiah na ti tikah hin na caah a ṭha lo chinchinmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu, Pathian cu a thin a hung lo i mi kha dan a tat hna lo i Hruhnak cu zeirello in a lanhter ko caah"},"16":{"text":"Job nih bia lolak chim in a ka aa an i hngalh set ṭung loin bia kha a karhter luaimai ko hna,” a ti."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Elihu nih khan a peh i:","title":"Elihu Nih Pathian Lianhngannak Kha A Thangṭhat"},"2":{"text":"“Tlawm tein ka ing rih law ka hmuhsak lai, Pathian lei kap in tlawmte chim awk ka ngei rih."},"3":{"text":"A ka Sertu a ding tinak kha ka chim tikah hin Ka bia bawmtu hi lamhlat piin ka va khawmh hna lai."},"4":{"text":"Ka chimmi ah hin lih a um lo, na hmai i a dirmi hi hngalhnak a ngeimi ka si."},"5":{"text":"“Pathian nih a sangmi le a ṭhawngmi cu a hrawh hna i Miṭhalo cu thluachuahnak a pe hna lo."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw sifakmi le retheimi cu an hmuh awk hnga a simi kha a pek hna i Harnak a ingmi hna cu an hmuh awk hnga kha a pek hna, ka ti."},"7":{"text":"An bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi siangpahrang hna khi zoh hna hmanh: Pathian nih lianhngannak ṭhawnnak a pek hna tikah an lung a puam."},"8":{"text":"Cun na hmuh nolh hna tikah cun hreng khenh an si i sal cikcin in khih an si."},"9":{"text":"An ziaza a ṭha lomi kha a mawhchiat hna i An sualnak cu ruamkainak le mi tei duhnak an si kha a hmuhsak hna."},"10":{"text":"An hna chungah ralrinnak bia kha a pek hna i An ṭhat lonak lam khan kir ṭhan awkah a kawh hna."},"11":{"text":"A bia an ngaih i a rian an ṭuan ahcun, An ni hna cu thluachuak in an hman i an kum hna cu nuamhnak in an hman."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an ngaih lo ahcun, vainam in an pam i thihnak tiva kha an tan."},"13":{"text":"Mi lungpuam nih cun an thinhun kha an chuahhnawh i Annih kha a ṭem hna tikah bawmhnak hal an duh lo."},"14":{"text":"Tlanval lioah an thi i an nunnak cu ningzahnak in a dong."},"15":{"text":"Hremnak a ingmi hna cu hremnak an inmi kha hmang in a chuah hna i, Vanchiatnak kha hmang in an hna a awnter hna."},"16":{"text":"“Harnak kha nuamhnak in thlen awk na hmuh tikah, i ralring tuah, Zeicahtiah na hmaiah thil tampi hunh na si i, Cabuai cung i hunmi rawl cu thau in a khatmi a si;"},"17":{"text":"Biaceihnak rian na ṭuan lioah mirumpa rawl kha khim tein na ei ahcun."},"18":{"text":"Zu thawthaw kha a pingah i hruaiter hna hlah law Ziknawh kha na biakhiahnak kawiter hlah."},"19":{"text":"Na rumnak cu zeitluk hmanh in a ngan ah, cu nih cun zeidah an ṭhathnem lai? Na dir hmun a sangmi zong nih zeidah an ṭhathnem lai?"},"20":{"text":"“Ṭih a nungmi zan ah, miphun hna cu an umnak hmun in an loh tikah na thinphang hlah."},"21":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak tuah awkah naa mernak hnga lo i ralring tuah, Zeicahtiah cu ruangah cun pei harnak in hneksak na si cu."},"22":{"text":"Pathian cu kan cungah lianhnak in a um ko, Amah bantukin ahodah a nganmi ṭhawnnak a ngei?"},"23":{"text":"Aho nih dah a lam cu an ruahchungpiak i Aho nih dah, na palh, tiah an ti khawh?"},"24":{"text":"Mi nih hla in an thangṭhat zungzalmi a rian cu thangṭhat awkah va philh hlah."},"25":{"text":"Mi vialte nih amah cu an zoh cio, mi nih lamhla piin an cuanh."},"26":{"text":"Zohhmanh, Pathian cu a ngan tuk i kan hngal kho lo; A kum zeizat a si kha kan rel khawh leng a si."},"27":{"text":"Tidor tete cu rili in cunglei ah a hnuh hna i minmei cu ruah ah a canter;"},"28":{"text":"Mah cucu van khin ruah in an rung sur i minung cungah tam piin an tla."},"29":{"text":"Aho tal nih khuadawm an zamning khi a hngal kho maw? A khuadawm chung i khuari hna khi a hngal khotu an um maw?"},"30":{"text":"Minmei cu ti cungah a zamter hna i rili hram hna cu a khuh hna."},"31":{"text":"Cuticun miphun cu a cawm hna i rawl tampi a pek hna."},"32":{"text":"Ṭek chungah cun mei a khumh i aa tinhmi kha khen awkah nawl a pek."},"33":{"text":"A thinhun in thlichia kha a thawhter i Thlichia a ra lio ti hngalhtertu lamkaltu cu khuari a si."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Hi zong nih hin ka lung kha a therter i a suk in aa su."},"2":{"text":"Pathian aw khuari thawng le a kaa chungin a chuakmi aw thawng cu ngai tuah."},"3":{"text":"Van pumpi toiah a kalter i a nimtlau cu vawlei kil kip a phan;"},"4":{"text":"Lianhngannak aw in khuarit in a rit caah a awn hluahmahmi aw nih a hun zulh."},"5":{"text":"Pathian aw cu a rianṭuannak ah khuaruahhar a si, Kan hngalhnak nih a phak lomi thil lianngan kha a tuah hna."},"6":{"text":"Hawhra cu a thawh i, ‘Vawlei ah tla,’ a ti; Cun ruahpi kha, ‘Fak piin sur,’ a ti."},"7":{"text":"A aw kha an theih tikah ruahpi cu tampi in a sur thluahmah. Mi kip kha inn chungah a hrenhkhumh hna i a sermi vialte kha zeihmanh tuah loin an dir sawhsawh ko."},"8":{"text":"Saram cu an bu chungah an lut i an kua chungah him tein an bawk."},"9":{"text":"Thlanglei inndal chungin thlichia cu a ra i Chaklei thli nih kihnak kha a ratpi."},"10":{"text":"Pathian thaw nih tikhal a umter i ti kaupi cu thir bangin an khal."},"11":{"text":"Khuadawm chah pipi cu an chungah ti a rawn hna; Khuadawm nih a minmei cu khuazakip ah a ṭhek hna."},"12":{"text":"Amah nih nawl a pekmi hna kha um khawhnak vawlei cungah hin tuah awkah, Amah hruainak thawngin an i hel lengmang."},"13":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak caah maw, a ram ṭhatnak ding caah maw, dawtnak caah dik, Amah nih mah cucu a umter ko."},"14":{"text":"“Maw Job, mah hi bia hi thei tuah, Dir ta rih law, Pathian nih khuaruahhar thil a tuahmi cu ruat tuah hna."},"15":{"text":"Zeitindah annih cu Pathian nih an rian kha a ṭuanter hna i, Zeitindah a khuadawm chungin nimtlau kha a lekter ti cu na hngal maw?"},"16":{"text":"Zeicahdah khuadawm cu cunglei ah i nge tein a zam ti kha na hngal maw? Thiamnak a tlingmi a rianṭuan khuaruahhar a si cu na hngal maw?"},"17":{"text":"Cun thlanglei thli a hung hran tikah vawlei cu a lin a sa i na thlan hripi he naa ciah kha, zeitindah a si tiah na hngal maw?"},"18":{"text":"Amah bantukin van khi na samh kho maw? Thlalang a timi thletmi bantukin a hakmi khi zeitindah a si na hngal kho maw?"},"19":{"text":"Amah sin chim ding bia cu kan cawnpiak tuah ngat, Kannih cu, zeizong vialte kha a muih dih caah kan ruahnak kan pumkhawl kho lo hi ta."},"20":{"text":"Pathian cu, cu tik kha tikah bia na chim awk a si, tiah minung aho tal nih an ti kho maw? Thawng na thanh awk a si, tiah tah nawl an pe kho maw?"},"21":{"text":"Voi khat cu ceunak cu hmuh khawh loin a um, Minmei le ruah nih khan an phenh;"},"22":{"text":"Cun thli a hung hrang i a chem hna i chaklei in sui bantuk ceunak a hung chuak; Pathian cu ṭihnung lianhngannak in aa thuam."},"23":{"text":"Lianngan Bik cu kannih nih kan hmu kho lo; Amah a ṭhawnnak cu kannih nih kan hngalh khawh leng a si, A dinnak cu biading tuah awkah khan a khul a nuar lo."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah mi nih amah cu an ṭih; Amah le amah ka fim, tiah aa timi cu zei ah a rel hna lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih phuchim chungin Job cu a leh i:","title":"Bawipa Nih Job A Hruhnak Kha A Langhter"},"2":{"text":"“Hngalhnak aa tel lomi bia in fim chimhnak a muihtertu hi ahodah a si?"},"3":{"text":"Na tai i sawmh law pa bantukin dir tuah, bia kan hal lai i na ka leh tuah lai."},"4":{"text":"Vawlei hram ka rak ser lioah hin khuazei ah dah na rak um? Na hngalh i na theih ahcun ka chim tuah."},"5":{"text":"A hmet a ngan zei ngaw si seh ti kha aho nih dah a khiah? Cucu na hngalh awk a si. Asiloah, tahnak hri kha a cungah aho nih dah a zam?"},"6":{"text":"A dohtu a tung pipi hna cu zei cungah dah an dir? Deirel arfi hna cu hmunkhat ah hla an sak i Pathian fapa vialte hna lunglawm in an au tikah khan, Aho nih dah a killung kha a bunh?","merge":"7"},"8":{"text":"Rili cu tilian in paw chungin a chuah tikah khan aho nih dah a rak zoh?","ref":"Jer 5.22"},"9":{"text":"Rili cu khuadawm in puan zual in ka rak zual i minmei chungah khan ka rak tuam i,"},"10":{"text":"A ramri ka serpiak i hrenhnak le innka ka chiah hna i,"},"11":{"text":"‘Hi tiang hi na ra lai, hi pin hi cu na kal ti lai lo, Cun hika ah hin aa porhlawmi na tilet hna cu an dong lai,’ ka ti."},"12":{"text":"“Na chuahka in, fingrei cah cu, na caan a si cang tiah na ko bal i Zinglei cu hihi nang hmun a si, tiah na hmuhsak bal maw?"},"13":{"text":"Vawlei kha a tlang in i tlaih i fizang cu a umnak hmun khan thin awkah, Zinglei cu na cawnpiak bal maw?"},"14":{"text":"Tlak cu minkhenhnak in nam tikah a cungah a mui a hung langh bantukin, Zeizong vialte cu puan bil bantukin an langh ve tiang vankam cu a hun ceuh tikah,"},"15":{"text":"Fizang cu a ceunak kha a lo i arfi cu pakhat hnu pakhat in an lo."},"16":{"text":"Rili a hna ah na lut bal cang maw? A thuknak hmun tah na phan cang maw?"},"17":{"text":"Thihnak kutka hna cu na sinah phuan an si cang maw? A thukmi muihnak kutka a cawngtu hna cu na hmu bal hna maw?"},"18":{"text":"Vawlei a kauhning hi na hngal maw? Hi vialte hi na hngalh ahcun, ka chim tuah."},"19":{"text":"Khuazei ah dah ceunak umnak hmun i va kalnak lam cu a si?"},"20":{"text":"Nangmah nih annih cu an ram leiah na kalpi kho hna maw? An inn lei lam ah cun na zul kho hna maw?"},"21":{"text":"Na hngalh ṭheoṭheo lai, cu caan ah cun na rak chuah cang cu ta, Na chan a sau hringhran cang hi ta!"},"22":{"text":"“Hawhra khonnak inn kha na lut bal maw? Rial khonnak inn kha na hmu bal maw?"},"23":{"text":"Mah cucu harnak ni caah ka khonmi an si i I doh le i tuk ni caah ka chiah hna."},"24":{"text":"Zei lam in dah linhnak cu khuazakip ah ṭhek a si i Nichuahlei thli nih vawlei cungah a kalpi dih hna?"},"25":{"text":"“Aho nih dah ruahpi kha kahcham a cawhpiak i Aho nih dah ṭotho caah khan lam a sial?"},"26":{"text":"Mi an um lonak ram i ruah surter awkah le, Mi an um lonak thetse ram i ruah cu surter awkah;"},"27":{"text":"Cun ram car le ram king hninhnoter awkah le, Vawlei ro ah ram hring chuahter awkah khan,"},"28":{"text":"Ruah nih hin pa a ngei maw? Dapti dor hi tah aho nih dah a hrin?"},"29":{"text":"Aho paw chungin dah tikhal cu an chuah i van in a tla tawnmi hawhra hi aho nih dah a hrin?"},"30":{"text":"Ti cungah khan lung bantukin aa phah i a thukmi cungah khan a khal."},"31":{"text":"“Firuk ṭemnak hri cu na ṭem kho maw? Asiloah, Likuk-canthum hri cu na phoih kho maw?","ref":"Job 9.9; Amo 5.8"},"32":{"text":"Mazzaroth cu an caan te ah na hruai kho hna maw? Fizang cu an fale hna he lam na hmuhsak kho hna maw?"},"33":{"text":"Van a uktu phung hna khi nangmah nih maw na ser hna? Vawleicung thil umtuning a uktu phung hna hi nangmah nih dah na chiah hna?"},"34":{"text":"Nangmah cu ruahpi ban ngaw nih an surh nakhnga, khuadawm khi nawl na hun pe kho hnga maw?"},"35":{"text":"Nimtlau cu, kal tuah, tiah na ti ahcun, ‘Ka kal lai,’ tiah an ti hnga maw?"},"36":{"text":"Aho nih dah khuadawm chungah khin fimnak a chiah i minmei cu hngalhnak a pek hna?"},"37":{"text":"Vawlei cu thir bantukin a hah i leitlang hna cu pakhat le pakhat an i sengh dih tikah, Ahodah ruah kha kawh khawhnak dingah le vancung ti khonnak cu phongh khawhnak dingah, fimnak a ngei?","merge":"38"},"39":{"text":"An kua ah an bawh i ram bur lakin seh ding sa an bawh lioah, Chiandeihpi cu a sa ei ding kha na kawlpiak kho in Chiandeih no hna cu an paw na khimter kho hna maw?","merge":"40"},"41":{"text":"Lang-ak cu a fano hna kha rawl lo ruangah an onh lengmang tikah, Aho nih dah rawl a pek hna?"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Tlang cung sathar hna nih zeitik ah dah fa an hrin kha na hngal maw? Sazuk nih zeitik dah fa a hrin kha na ngia maw?"},"2":{"text":"An pawi chung kha thla zeizat dah a si na rel kho maw? Cun an hrin caan kha na hngal maw?"},"3":{"text":"Zeitik ah dah an bawh i an fale cu an hrin hna i an fale cu an chuah kha na hngal maw?"},"4":{"text":"An fano tete cu an hung ṭhan i ramlak sawhsawh ah khan an tlon i an kal i kir ṭhan ti loin an tlah kha zeitik ah dah a si na hngal maw?"},"5":{"text":"Siria ram i ramlak laa hna cu aho nih dah an duhduh in a tlonter hna? Arabia ram i ramlak laa hna cu aho nih dah luatnak a pek hna?"},"6":{"text":"Thetse ram cu an umnak ding caah ka pek hna i Cite nelrawn cu an khuasaknak caah ka pek hna."},"7":{"text":"Khuapi chung rihaw kha an rem lo i mawngtu au len thawng kha ngaih an duh lo."},"8":{"text":"An tlonnak cu tlang cungah khan a si i a hringmi thil kip kha an kawl."},"9":{"text":"“Fungtum nih na rian ṭuan a duh lai maw? Na saṭil inn ah a riak duh lai maw?"},"10":{"text":"Amah cu lei rinkuar rinnak ah hri na banh khawh lai maw? Na hnu in lei rinkuar cu leitlang den in a run ngetter hna lai maw?"},"11":{"text":"Amah cu a thazang a ṭhawng ko nain naa bochan khawh lai maw? Na rian cu amah kha na rinh khawh lai maw?"},"12":{"text":"Amah cu a ra kir lai i na phuhri ah na rawl cu a rak phorh hna lai, tiah na zumh maw?"},"13":{"text":"“Ostrik va nih porhlaw ngaiin a thla a khawn, A thla le a hmul kha an tlawm tuk caah,"},"14":{"text":"Leidip nih run lumh te ko hna seh tiin vawlei ah a ti cu a kaltak hna."},"15":{"text":"Ke nih kuai lak in a lamh sual hna lai i Ram sa nih an cilnan sual hna lai ti kha a philh."},"16":{"text":"A fale cu amah fale lo bangin a ṭhuat a den hna. A ṭuannak cu pakpalawng a si sual lai tiah phannak a ngei lo."},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah cu Pathian nih fimnak kha a pe lo i Hngalhthiamnak kha a tinter lo."},"18":{"text":"Hmunsang ah arhli bantukin aa chawk i Rangtum le a cung i aa citmi kha zeihmanh ah a rel hna lo."},"19":{"text":"“Rangtum cu a ṭhawnnak kha nangmah nih na pek maw? A hngawng kha a tuang in na thuamh maw?"},"20":{"text":"Khaubawk bangin na pehter maw? A hnar tum thawng cu ṭihnung a si."},"21":{"text":"Nelrawn ah khan a ke a chaih i aa cer, Hriamnam he a rak ummi kha a thazang dih-umnak in a hei nam hna."},"22":{"text":"Ṭihnung kha a nihsawh men ko i lung dongh a hngal lo; Vainam hmaiah khan a con in a kim lo."},"23":{"text":"A cungah cun thal bawm kha aa khawng i a tleumi fei le feikawl kha an i lek."},"24":{"text":"A zit in aa zi i aa chaih i muko aw thawng a theih tikah a chak tlaih khawh a si ti lo."},"25":{"text":"Muko thawng a rin tikah a hnar a phit i, I tuknak cu a rim in a theih i haotu pawl an au le an hawhawt cu a theih."},"26":{"text":"“Mupi nih cungsangpi ah a zuan i a thla thlanglei ah a zam cu nangmah nih maw na cawnpiak?"},"27":{"text":"Langta nih cunglei ah a zuan i cung sangpi ah a bu a ser khi nangmah nawl pek in maw a si?"},"28":{"text":"Lungpang cungah a um i a chengmi lungpang himnak hmun ah a bu kha a ser."},"29":{"text":"Khika hmun cun cawi awk kha a ngiat hna; Lamhlatpi ah khin a mit nih a hei hmuh khawh hna;"},"30":{"text":"A fale cu thisen in a cawm hna; Saruak umnak hmun ah, khika ah langta cu a um,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 24.28; Luk 17.37"}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Job cu a thawh i:"},"2":{"text":"“Minung nih Lianngan Bik he bia an i al tikah hin lungṭhawng in um awk a si maw? Pathian he bia aa almi nih hin a leh ṭhan awk a si hnga maw?” a ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Job nih Bawipa cu a leh i:"},"4":{"text":"“Zei rel awktlak a si lomi kei nih hin nangmah cu zeitindah ka leh khawh lai? Ka kut in ka ka kaa huh ah a ṭha deuh lai."},"5":{"text":"Voi khat ka chim cang i ka chim ti lai lo; Voi hnih ka chim cang i cu bantukin ka chim ṭhan ti lai lo,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Job cu phuchim chungin a leh i:","title":"Pathian Ṭhawnnak A Langhnak"},"7":{"text":"“Na tai i sawmh law pa bantukin dir tuah; Bia kan hal lai i na ka leh lai."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah cu na ding lo na ka ti ngam lai maw? Asiloah, nangmah cu na din nakhnga keimah cu na palh na ka ti lai maw?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian kut bantuk kut na ngei maw? Amah aw bantukin khuarit in na ri kho maw?"},"10":{"text":"“Lianhngannak le hmaizahnak in i fam law Sunparnak le rumra in i thuam tuah."},"11":{"text":"Na thinhunnak cu chuahter law aa porhlawmi paoh cu zoh hna law ṭhum hna."},"12":{"text":"Aa porhlawmi paoh cu zoh hna law tangah ṭhum ko hna; Cun miṭhalo hna cu an dirnak ah khan lam hna."},"13":{"text":"Leidip lakah khan hmunkhat ah thup dih hna; Hngalh lomi thlan ah khan thup men hna."},"14":{"text":"Khi tikah nangmah cu, nangmah orhlei kut lila nih an khamh khawh ti kha kan hngalhpi lai."},"15":{"text":"“Tisartlam, saram vialte bawi khi ruat hmanh, Saṭil cu ram bantukin a ei hna."},"16":{"text":"A tai i a thazang le a paw tit i a ṭhawnnak khi zoh hna hmanh."},"17":{"text":"A mei cu sidar thing bantukin a ṭhom i A phei thahri cu a phiar in an i phiar."},"18":{"text":"A ruh hna cu dar peng an si, a kutke hna cu thir tluan an si."},"19":{"text":"“Amah cu Pathian sermi thil hna lakah pakhatnak a si; Amah tluk a simi kha a uk hna."},"20":{"text":"Tlang cung i a tlongmi saṭil kha a rawl ah a seh hna i Ramlak saram vialte cu a khai dih hna."},"21":{"text":"Tumpu bur tangah a bawk, phaikung tang le cerh ah aa thup."},"22":{"text":"Tumpu bur nih thladem a demh i tivate inhliam kung nih an kulh."},"23":{"text":"Tiva cu a hung lenh zongah a thin a phang lo; Jordan Tiva nih a ka tiang phan hmanh seh law a duh in aa chawk ko."},"24":{"text":"Aho tal nih sio in an sio kho maw? A hnar ah rap hri in an thil kho maw?"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Leviathan cu nga sio in na hnuk kho hnga maw? Asiloah, hrihrual in a lei na khit hnga maw?","ref":"Slm 74.14; 104.26; Isa 27.1"},"2":{"text":"A hnar cu hri in na thil kho hnga maw? A kha chungah sio na banh kho hnga maw?"},"3":{"text":"Ka zaangfah ko tiah an nawl hnga maw? Bianem in, ka nunnak cu ka zuah ko, tiah an lem hnga maw?"},"4":{"text":"Zungzal in na sal a si nakhnga dingah, nangmah he biakamnak a tuah lai maw?"},"5":{"text":"Vate bantukin lente naa celhpi khawh lai maw? Asiloah, hlasak thiammi vate bantukin, na nu hna caah na khih khawh lai maw?"},"6":{"text":"Chawlettu hna nih amah cu an i cuh lai maw? Chawdawr pawl hna nih an i ṭhenphaw lai maw?"},"7":{"text":"A cuar cu fei in na chun kho lai maw? A lu cu nga tlaihnak fei in nan chun kho lai maw?"},"8":{"text":"Amah cu na tlaih sual a si ahcun, nan i sual len ding kha ruat hmanh; Mah cucu na tuah ṭhan duh ti bal ding a si lo."},"9":{"text":"“Amah tlaih timh cu hnabei dong a si, pathian hna hmanh nih an hmuh ah an khuaruah a har lo maw?"},"10":{"text":"A thawh cang ahcun, zeitluk in dah ṭihnung a si, Ahodah a dir-onh ngam lai?"},"11":{"text":"Amah a dotu paoh cu, ahodah hmapu loin a um hna? Van kaupi tangah hin pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"12":{"text":"“A kutke kong si seh, a ṭhawngmi a thazang kong siseh, a tungtai dawhnak kong siseh, ka chim rih tuah lai."},"13":{"text":"Aho nih dah a puan a leng thuah kha a hawh khawh lai? A thir angki thuah hnih cu aho nih dah a chunh i a hlanh khawh lai?"},"14":{"text":"Aho nih dah a hmai innka cu a hun khawh lai? A ha tian cu ṭihnung a si."},"15":{"text":"A keng cu a thuah in aa thuahmi phaw bantuk a si, Ṭeklung vampang in kulhmi bantuk a si."},"16":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat cu an i naih tuk caah an karlak ah khan thli a lut kho lo."},"17":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat kha an i peh dih, an i tlai dih i ṭhen khawh an si lo."},"18":{"text":"A hachiau tikah ceunak an choi ukmak i A mit hna cu zinglei ceu bantuk khi an si."},"19":{"text":"A kaa chungin aa hliau duakmakmi mei-alh an chuak i meici an pet lulhmalh."},"20":{"text":"A tlok hluahmahmi um chung bantuk le a kang hluahmahmi phaiphawk bantukin, A hnar chungin meikhu a chuak."},"21":{"text":"A thaw nih cun lung meihol kha a alhter khawh i a kaa chungin meizik a chuak."},"22":{"text":"A hngawng ah khan ṭhawnnak a um i a hmai ah khan ṭihnak a laam."},"23":{"text":"A paw cuar cu a chah i zeihmanh nih a khoihverh kho lo."},"24":{"text":"A lung cu lung bantukin a hak, Fangrialnak lung a tanglei u bantukin a hak."},"25":{"text":"A hung thawh tikah miṭhawng hna kha an thin a phang, A mei a hun vuak tikah, a umtu awk an hngal lo."},"26":{"text":"Vainam nih a phan nain zeihmanh a ṭhahnem lo, Fei zong nih, thal zong nih, feipi zong nih, a zei an poih hlei lo."},"27":{"text":"Thir cu capawl tluk ah a rel i dar cu thing mot tluk ah a rel."},"28":{"text":"Cantiang nih a tei lo, Lungherh chehnak lung hna cu a caah favai tluk men an si."},"29":{"text":"Anih caah cun tanbo cu phaikung men a si i Feipi a awnh vungmang cu a nih men ko."},"30":{"text":"A paw cuar cu peipahau kuai haar bantuk a si, Rawl velhnak sobulpi bantukin nawncek lakah cun a lawn."},"31":{"text":"Ti thuk cu um bantukin a tlawhter, Tibual cu kheng chung zihmui hngerh bantukin a hngerh."},"32":{"text":"A kal tikah hin a hnulei in ti a lehmi cu a ceu pah thluahmah i Ti thuk cungah khin, tuuhmul raang vuan lulh hna seh law cu ko cu a lo."},"33":{"text":"Ṭihnak zeihmanh ngei loin ser a si caah vawlei cungah hin amah tluk zeihmanh an um lo."},"34":{"text":"Sermi thil vialte, a sang bikbik hna hmanh kha a zawmhtaih hna, Aa porhlaw vemi saram vialte lakah amah cu siangpahrang a si."}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi tikah Job nih Bawipa cu a leh i:","title":"Job Nih Aa Phuannak le Pathian Nih A Cohlannak"},"2":{"text":"“Nangmah nih zeizong vialte na tuah khawh i Na tinhmi cu dawnh khawh a si lo ti kha ka hngalh."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka hngalh lomi thil lianngan kha ka chim hna i Kei i hngalh awkah khuaruahhar tuk a simi kha ka chim hna.","ref":"Job 38.2"},"4":{"text":"‘Ngai law ka chim lai, bia kan hal lai i na ka chimh lai.’","ref":"Job 38.3"},"5":{"text":"Hna theihnak lawngin nangmah cu ka rak in theih, Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu ka mit in kan hmuh cang;"},"6":{"text":"Cucaah keimah le keimah cu kaa hua i leidip le vutcam lakah ṭhu in kaa ngaihchih,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih Job sinah bia a chim dih tikah, Teman mi Elifaz kha a thawh i “Nangmah le na hawile pahnih cungah ka thin a hung, zeicahtiah ka kong kha nan chim awk hnga bangin ka sal Job nih a chim bantukin nan chim lo."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah cawtum pasarih le tuukawng pasarih in i lak hna u law ka sal Job sinah va kal u law nan caah khangh thawinak va pechan u; cun ka sal Job nih thla an campiak hna lai, zeicahtiah ka sal Job nih ka kong ah a dikmi bia a chim bantukin nannih nih nan chim lo ruangah nan hruhnak bantukin nan cungah ka tuah nakhnga lo amah thlacamnak cu ka cohlan lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Teman mi Elifaz le Shuh mi Bildad le Naamath mi Zofar cu an kal i Bawipa nih a chimhmi hna cu an tuah i Bawipa nih Job thlacamnak cu a cohlan."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih Job cu a vanṭhatnak kha a pek ṭhan i a ngeihmi kha a let hnih in a pek ṭhan.","ref":"Job 1.1-3"},"11":{"text":"Cun a sinah cun a unau vialte le a farle vialte le hlanlio i amah theihhngalh a rak simi vialte kha an ra i a inn ah cun amah he khan rawl an ei ṭi; cun a cung i Bawipa nih ṭhat lonak a tluntermi vialte ruangah khan annih nih amah cu an hramh i an hnemh; cun tuu pakhat le sui kutdonghrolh pakhat cio an pek.","title":"Job Cu A Rum Ṭhan"},"12":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih Job cu a chan a donghlei kha a thawk lei nakkhan thluachuahnak tam deuh in a pek i tuu thong hleili, kalauk thong ruk, cawtum tuah thong khat le laapi thong khat a ngei."},"13":{"text":"Fapa pasarih le fanu pathum zong a ngeih hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun upa bik nu cu Jemimah, pahnihnak cu Keziah, a pathumnak cu Kerenhappuk tiah min a sak hna."},"15":{"text":"Vawlei cung dihlak ah Job fanu tlukin aa dawhmi nu an um lo i an pa nih khan an ṭale sinah ro a pek ve hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun hi hnuah hin Job cu kum za khat le kum sawm li a nung i a fapa hna le a fapa hna i fapa hna kha a hmuh hna, chan li tiang."},"17":{"text":"Cun Job cu tar ngaiin, chan tling cikcek in a nung i a thi."}}}}},"19":{"info":{"name":"Salm","shortname":"Ps","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna khuakhannak ah aa tel lo i Misual hna lam zong a zul lo i Pathian a nihsawhmi hna sinah a ṭhu lomi cu Thluachuakmi an si.","title":"BU KHATNAK (Slm 1 in 41 tiang) David Hla Lawmhnak Taktak"},"2":{"text":"An i lawmhnak cu Bawipa nawlbia tu ah khan a si i cu nawlbia cu chunzan in an ruat."},"3":{"text":"Tiva kamah a khomi thingkung, a caan hmaan tein a thei a tlai i a hnah a uai bal lomi bantuk an si. An tuahmi thil kip ah khua awng an tong.","ref":"Jer 17.8"},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu hi bangin an si lo, Thli nih a chawihmi favai bantuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah miṭhalo hna cu Pathian nih sual a phawt hna lai, misual mi cu miding mi bu chungah an i tel kho lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih miding cu an lam kha a hngalh, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu an lam kha a rawk lai."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zeicahdah miphun hna nih ral thawhnak khua an khan i An mi hna nih thil ṭhahnem lo dohnak khua an ruah?","title":"Thimmi Siangpahrang (Lam 4.23-31)","ref":"Lam 4.25-26"},"2":{"text":"An siangpahrang hna le an uktu bawi hna nih Bawipa le Bawipa nih a thimmi siangpahrang doh awk khua an khan."},"3":{"text":"An i thawh i, “An kan ṭemnak hri kha chat u si law hlonh u sih,” an ti."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih vancung i a bawiṭhutdan cung khin a run nih hna i capo ah a saih hna."},"5":{"text":"Thinhung ngaiin an sinah bia a chim i a thinhunnak nih cun an thin a phanter hna."},"6":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Zion ka tlang thiang cungah ka siangpahrang cu ka chiah cang,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa nih a chimmi cu ka thanh lai,” tiah siangpahrang nih a ti. Cu a chimmi cu hihi a si: “ Bawipa nih a ka thawh i, ‘Nangmah cu ka fapa na si, nihin ni ah hin kan hrin.","ref":"Lam 13.33; Heb 1.5; 5.5"},"8":{"text":"Ka hal law, miphun vialte hi nangmah kan pek dih lai; vawlei hi a dihlak in nangmah ta a si lai."},"9":{"text":"Thirfung in na uk hna lai i tlak um bangin na khuai dih hna lai,” a ti.","ref":"Biat 2.26-27; 12.5; 19.15"},"10":{"text":"Cucaah siangpahrang hna, ka bia ngai tuah u, uktu bawi hna, hngal cang tuah u."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu ṭih bu tein a rian ṭuan tuah u, therphang in um u law"},"12":{"text":"a hmaiah kun tuah u. Cu ti a si lo ahcun, a thinhunnak kha khulrang in a alhmi a si caah, a thin a hung lai i nan thi sual lai. Amah chungah aa dormi cu thluachuakmi an si."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka ral an tam tuk hringhran, a ka dohtu an tam tuk hringhran.","title":"Zinglei Thlacamnak David Thlacamnak: A Fapa Absalom Sinin A Zam Lio Hla"},"2":{"text":"An ka thangchiat i, “Pathian nih a bawm lai lo,” an ka ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa, nangmah nih phaw bantukin na ka huhphenh zungzal i teinak kha na ka pek i ka lung na ka ṭhawnter ṭhan."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa kha ka auh i a tlang thiang cungin a ka leh."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih a ka thlim i kaa hngilh, Bawipa nih a ka ven caah him tein kaa hlau ṭhan."},"6":{"text":"A ka kulhtu ka ral thong tampi hi ka ṭih hna lo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa, ra ko sawh! Ka Pathian, ka khamh ko! Ka ral vialte cu na tei dih hna i miṭhalo vialte cu na hrawh dih hna."},"8":{"text":"Khamhnak cu Bawipa sinin a rami a si, Bawipa nih a mi cu thluachuah pe ko hna seh.”"}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka au tikah ka let tuah, maw Pathian a ka chanhtu, Harnak chung i ka um tikah nangmah nih na ka bawmh tawn. Atu zong ka zaangfah law ka thlacamnak hi ka theihpiak tuah.","title":"Zanlei Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nannih minung hna, zei can dah na ka serhsat lai? Zei can dah santlailo thil kha nan duh lai i lihbia kha nan dawi lai? Selah"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa nih amah ta si awkah a ka thim i ka auh tikah a ka theih ti kha philh hlah u."},"4":{"text":"Ṭihnak ngei u law nan sualnak kha ngol hna u; hi thil hi nanmah lawng tein nan inn khaan chungah thuk piin ruat tuah u. Selah","ref":"Efe 4.26"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu a hmaanmi raithawinak kha pe u law amah cu i bochan tuah u."},"6":{"text":"“Thluachuahnak hmu u si law kan hei duh hringhran dah,” a timi tampi an um. Maw Bawipa, kan cungah zaangfahnak run ngei ko."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah nih lawmhnak na ka pekmi cu, din awk zu tampi a ngeimi le ei awk rawl tampi a ngeimi hna an i lawmhnak nakin a ngan deuh."},"8":{"text":"Hnangam tein ka it lai i kaa hngilh fawn lai, Bawipa, nangmah lawnglawng nih him tein na ka umter."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka bia hi ka ngaihpiak hna law ka aihramnak hi ka theihpiak tuah hna.","title":"Huhphenhnak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka Siangpahrang le ka Pathian, ka thlacamnak hi ka ngaihpiak tuah. Bawipa nangmah sinah thla ka cam lai;"},"3":{"text":"Zinglei ah ka aw kha na ka theihpiak: nichuak kate ah na sinah thla ka cam tawn i na ka lehnak kha ka hngah tawn."},"4":{"text":"Nang cu ṭhat lonak tuahnak ah aa lawmmi Pathian na si lo i na hmaika ah ṭhat lonak umter kha na duh lo."},"5":{"text":"Miporhlaw cu na ing kho hna lo i miṭhalo cu na huat hna."},"6":{"text":"Lihchim mi cu na hrawh dih hna i mipuarhrang le mihlenhmang cu na nautat hna."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu na dawtnak a nganmi thawngin na inn chungah ka ra lut kho; a thiangmi na biakinn chungah nangmah kan bia kho i na hmaiah ka kun kho."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, ral tampi ka ngei, na duhnak tuah awkah ka hruai law na lam cu ka zulh khawh nakhnga ka hmaiah na lam cu pheiter ko."},"9":{"text":"Ka ral nih an chimmi bia cu zeitikhmanh ah zumh khawhmi bia an si lo, Zeicahtiah annih cu mi hrawh lawnglawng kha an duh; an kaa cu chilh lomi thlan bantuk a si i an bia cu hlennak bia le nal bia lawnglawng an si.","ref":"Rom 3.13"},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, annih cu sual phaw hna law dantat hna, an i timhmi thil ṭhalo cu tlinter hlah. An sualnak a tam ca le nangmah an in doh caah annih cu na hmaika in ṭhawl hna."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah ah himnak a hmumi cu an i lawm lai i lawmhnak in hla an sa zungzal lai. Nangmah an dawmi cu na huhphenh hna, nangmah thawngin lawmhnak taktak an hmu."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, na nawl a ngaimi cu thluachuah na pek hna, na zaangfahnak nih phaw bantukin a huhphenh hna."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, na thinhung hlah law, ka si hlah! Na thinhun in dan ka tat hlah.","title":"Harnak Caan Thlacamnak David Hla","ref":"Slm 38.1"},"2":{"text":"ka baat cang caah ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei ko, ka tha a dih cang caah thazang thar ka pe ko sawh,"},"3":{"text":"ka nunnak hi a ning piin a fak, zei can dah hitihin ka um lai, maw Bawipa ?"},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka khamh tuah; na ka dawt caah thihnak chungin ka khamh tuah."},"5":{"text":"Mithi khua ah ahohmanh nih an in hngal lo, Sheol ah ahohmanh nih an in thangṭhat kho lo."},"6":{"text":"Lungfahnak in ka baa tuk hringhran cang; zanfate ka ṭahnak ah ka ihkhun cu a cin dih i ka chantling cu ka mitthli nih a ciah."},"7":{"text":"ka ṭah tuk caah ka mit an phing dih i khua hmanh ṭha tein ka hmu kho ti lo — hi ti i ka umnak cu ka ral hna ruangah a si."},"8":{"text":"Nannih ṭhat lonak a tuahmi hna, ka kaltak ko u, Bawipa nih ka ṭahnak kha a theih cang;","ref":"Mat 7.23; Luk 13.27"},"9":{"text":"bawmh hal in ka aunak kha a theih i ka thlacamnak kha a ka leh."},"10":{"text":"Ka ral cu an sung lai i vansang au in an um lai, lungmit in chikkhatte ah an zam lai."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah cu ka himnak na si; a ka dawitu vialte hna sin hin ka khamh law ka chanh tuah.","title":"Luatnak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Cu ti na ka khamh lo ahcun ahohmanh khamhtu ngei loin, chiandeih bantukin an ka hnuh lai i an ka thleh an ka baoh dih ko lai."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa ka Pathian, mi cungah ṭhat lonak tuah le"},"4":{"text":"hawikom rawi le zei ruangah ti awk um set loin ral cungah ṭhat lonak tuah hi, hi hna lakah hin pakhatkhat ka tuah a si ahcun,"},"5":{"text":"Ka ral nih ka dawi hna seh law ka tlai hna seh, ka tu hna seh law ka that hna seh, vawlei ah nunnak ngei loin ka hril ta hna seh! Selah"},"6":{"text":"Na thinhun in tho tuah, maw Bawipa, ka ral hna thinhunnak kha doh awkah dir tuah. I hlau law ka bawm tuah, zeicahtiah na duhmi cu ding tein biaceih kha a si."},"7":{"text":"Mi vialte kha na velchum ah pumhter hna law annih cu cunglei khan run uk hna."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu mi vialte biaceihtu bawi na si. Kei cu miṭha le a sual lomi ka si caah keimah lei ṭanh in biakhiahnak kha tuah ko."},"9":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna ṭhat lonak cu kham law miṭha cu laksawng in lehrul ko hna. Nang cu a dingmi Pathian na si i minung lungthin le duhnak vialte a hngal dihtu na si.","ref":"Biat 2.23"},"10":{"text":"A ka hupphengtu cu Pathian a si, amah nawl a ngaimi cu a khamh hna."},"11":{"text":"Pathian cu a dingmi biaceihtu a si, miṭhalo kha sual a phawt zungzal hna."},"12":{"text":"Mi cu an i ngaihchih lo ahcun Pathian nih a nam aa tat lai. A likuk kha aa hruai i kah colh dingin aa tim;"},"13":{"text":"A hmual a fak ngaimi a hriam kha aa lak hna i meialh bantuk a simi a cantiang kha aa tinh hna."},"14":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih thil ṭhalo a tuaktanning kha ruat hmanh; harnak chuahter ding kha khua a khan i hlennak kha a tuah."},"15":{"text":"Vawlei ah khan khor thukpi a cawh i amah lila kha a cawhmi khor ah cun a tla."},"16":{"text":"Cuticun amah ṭhat lonak lila nih khan harnak a pek i amah puarhrannak lila nih khan fahnak a pek."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu dinnak a tuahmi ruangah ka lawmh lai, Cung Nung Bik Bawipa cu hla in ka thangṭhat lai."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan Bawipa, Na lianhngannak cu vawleicung dihlak ah hin a lang ko! Nangmah thangṭhatnak hi van tiang a phan i;","title":"Pathian Sunparnak le Minung Lianhngannak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"ngakchia le bawhte nih hla in an sak. Na ral hna khamkanhnak ah ralhruang na ser i, na ral le nangmah an huatu hna rak donhnak ah ralhau na ser.","ref":"Mat 21.16"},"3":{"text":"Nangmah na sermi van le an hmun ciote ah na chiahmi thlapa le arfi hna khi ka zoh tikah,"},"4":{"text":"minung hi zeidah a si i na hnakkar ah na tenh? Minung menmen a simi hi zeidah a si i a zawn na ruah? ti hi ka ruat.","ref":"Job 7.17-18; Slm 144.3; Heb 2.6-8"},"5":{"text":"Nangmah lawnglawng hi a cungah a ummi na si i sunparnak le upatnak cu a lu ah na chinh."},"6":{"text":"Na sermi thil vialte a uktu ah na ser i zeizong vialte hna dihlak cungah khan na chiah:","ref":"1Kor 15.27; Efe 1.22; Heb 2.8"},"7":{"text":"tuu le caw le ramlak saram hna,"},"8":{"text":"va le nga le rili chung thilnung vialte zong, an dihlak in a tangah na chiah hna."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan Bawipa, na lianhngannak cu vawleicung dihlak ah hin a lang ko!"}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, ka lungthin dihlak in nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai, nangmah nih khuaruahhar thil na tuahmi vialte cu ka chim lai.","title":"Pathian Ṭhawnnak le Dinnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah thawngin lunglawm in hla ka sa lai, maw Cung Nung Bik, nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah na langh tikah ka ral cu an i let, an tlu i an thi."},"4":{"text":"A dingmi biaceihtu bawi bantukin na bawiṭhutdan cungah na ṭhu i keimah lei ṭanh in biakhiahnak kha na tuah cang."},"5":{"text":"Lawkihmi kha sual na phawt hna i miṭhalo kha na hrawh hna, annih cu hngalh ṭhan, ti a um ti lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Kan ral cu an dih cang, an khua cu na hrawh cang hna i a philh in philh an si dipdep cang."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa cu zungzal in siangpahrang a si ko; biaceihnak tuah awkah a bawiṭhutdan cungah cun a ṭhu."},"8":{"text":"Dinnak in vawlei kha a uk i biading in mi kha an bia a ceih hna."},"9":{"text":"Hremnak a ingmi hna caah Bawipa cu himnak hmun a si i harnak caan ah ralhruang fek a si."},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah an hngalmi nih cun an in bochan lai, nangmah sinah a rami cu ahohmanh na dawn bal hna lo."},"11":{"text":"Zion ah a ummi Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat u, a tuahmi thil kha miphun kip chim hna u."},"12":{"text":"Pathian nih hremnak a ingmi kha a philh hna lo i an aunak kha a philh lo: an cung i ṭhat lonak a tuahtu kha dan a tat hna."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka zaangfah ko! A ka huatu nih zeitluk in dah ka cungah ṭhat lonak an tuah kha ka hmuhpiak tuah. Bawipa, thihnak chungin ka chuah law"},"14":{"text":"Jerusalem khuami hna hmaiah ka dir lai i nangmah kha zei ruangah dah kan thangṭhat ti vialte kha ka chimh hna lai. Nangmah nih na ka chuah caah ka lung aa lawm lai."},"15":{"text":"Lawkihmi nih khor an cawh i anmah an tla; rap an chiah i anmah an i foih."},"16":{"text":"Ding tein bia a ceihnak ah khan Bawipa cu amah le amah aa phuang i miṭhalo hna cu anmah tuahnak lila ah khan an i foih. Higgaion. Selah"},"17":{"text":"Miṭhalo vialte hna le Pathian a hlawmi vialte an donghnak cu thihnak a si."},"18":{"text":"Mipam cu hrelh an si zungzal lai lo i hremmi cu ruahchan awk ngei lo an si zungzal lai lo."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa, ra tuah, mi nih zeirello in in um hna hlah seh! Lawkihmi cu na hmaiah chuahter hna law an bia ceih hna."},"20":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, annih cu an thinphanter hna, minung menmen an si kha hngalhter hna. Selah"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, zeicahdah lamhla tuk ah na um? Zeicahdah harnak caan ah naa thuh?","title":"Luat Halnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu an ruam a kai i misifak kha an hrem hna; anmah nih an chiahmi rap ah khan i foih hna seh."},"3":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih a duhnak ṭhalo kha aa porhlaw i hakkaumi nih Bawipa kha a vawlhpamh i a hlawt."},"4":{"text":"A ruam a kai caah miṭhalo nih cun aa thawh i, “Pathian nih cun dan a ka tat lai lo, ka duhnak ṭhalo kha a zeihmanh a poi lem lai lo,” a ti. Miṭhalopa nih a ruahmi cu cucu a si."},"5":{"text":"A rianṭuannak ah a hlawh a tling. Pathian biaceihning kha a hngalthiam lo; a ral kha a nih in a nihsawh hna."},"6":{"text":"Amah le amah cu, “Ka sung bal lai lo; harnak ka tong bal lai lo,” aa ti."},"7":{"text":"A bia cu chiatserhnak le lih le hronak in a khat; huat awk bia le bia ṭhalo chim ah khan a khul a rang.","ref":"Rom 3.14"},"8":{"text":"Khuate ah khan aa thup riangmang i a sual lomi kha a nawn hna. Thah a duhmi kha aa ngiat hna i;"},"9":{"text":"chiandeih bantukin a bawh hna, a rap in a foih hna i a kalpi hna."},"10":{"text":"Vanchiapa cu a ril ko, miṭhawngpa nih a thah."},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalopa nih cun aa thawh i, “Pathian cu a zeihmanh a poi lai lo, a mit aa chinh i a ka hmu bal lai lo,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ra law ka khamh tuah! Hremmi kha philh sawh hna hlah, Pathian."},"13":{"text":"Zeitindah miṭhalo hna nih cun Pathian cu zeirello in an um khawh lai i? “Dan a kan tat bal lai lo,” an ti khawh lai?"},"14":{"text":"Nang nih cun na hmuh ko hna; temhinnak le ngaihchiatnak a ingmi cu na hngalh ko hna i bawmh awkah naa tim zungzal ko. Bawmhnak a herhmi kha na bawmh zungzal hna caah vanchiami nih nangmah kha an in fuh."},"15":{"text":"Miṭhalo le misual cu an ṭhawnnak kha hrawk hna law an ṭhat lonak ruangah khan tling khitkhet in dantat hna."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa cu zungzal in zungzal tiang siangpahrang a si i a ram chung hin lawkihmi cu an lo lai."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa, minauta cu an thlacamnak kha na ngaihpiak hna i lungṭhawnnak na pek hna."},"18":{"text":"Hremmi hna le ngakṭah cu an aunak kha na theihpiak hna i anmah lei ṭanh in bia na ceih, cucaah a thi khomi minung nih hin thil ṭihnung kha an umter ti lai lo."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka himnak dingah Bawipa cu kaa bochan. Nang nih naa thawh i, “Va bantukin tlang ah zuang tuah,","title":"I Bochannak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"zeicahtiah miṭhalo nih an likuk kha an i hruai i muihnak i a ummi miṭha kha kah awkah an cantiang cu an i tinh."},"3":{"text":"Thil aa nincan lo tikah hin miṭha nih an tuah khawhmi zeihmanh a um lo,” tiah na ka ti tikah hin zeitluk in dah na hruh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu a biakinn thiang chungah a um ko i a bawiṭhutdan cu van ah khin a um ko. Mi vialte kha a zoh hna i an tuahmi vialte kha a hngalh dih."},"5":{"text":"Miṭha zong, miṭhalo zong ṭha tein a dothlat hna; zaang-ennak a duhmi kha a thinlung dihlak in a huat hna."},"6":{"text":"Miṭhalo cungah meiṭil le kaat kha a surter; a alhmi mei in dan a tat hna."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ding i tuahsernak ding kha a duh, mi dingmi nih a hmai kha an hmuh lai."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka khamh tuah, maw Bawipa ! Miṭha an um ti lo i lihchim lomi an um ti lo.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat an i hleng i hlepar faknak hmur le lung hnih ngei in bia an chim."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, hlepar fak thiam lei cu daihter law tluang a khawng lengmangmi kaa cu phit hna."},"4":{"text":"Annih nih an i thawh i, “Kan duhmi paoh kan chim ko lai, ahohmanh nih an kan kham kho lai lo. Aho nih dah, cucu nan chim awk a si, tiah an kan chimh khawh lai?” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih aa thawh i, “Sifakmi cu an hrem hna i retheimi cu aihram lengmang in an tuah hna caah atu cu ka ra lai i an ngaihmi himnak cu ka pek hna lai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa biakamnak cu zumhawktlak an si; somei chungah voi sarih tiang erletmi ngun tlukin an thiang."},"7":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu a kenkip ah an um i mi zeipaoh nih thilṭhalo kha an hlawrh, Maw Bawipa, hi mi hna sin hin kan kilveng law him tein kan umter zungzal ko.","merge":"8"}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zei can dah na ka philh lai, maw Bawipa ? Na ka philh zungzal ko lai maw? Zei can dah na ka thuh tak rih lai?","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Zei can dah fahnak hi ka in lai? Zei can dah ngaihchiatnak in ka lung hi chun he zan he a khah lai? Zei can dah ka ral hi ka cungah a lek in an i lek lai?"},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, ka zoh law ka let tuah. ka thih nakhnga lo, ka thazang kha ka pe ṭhan tuah."},"4":{"text":"Cu ti na ka tuah ahcun ka ral nih, “Amah cu kan tei cang,” an ti kho lai lo i ka sunghnak ah khan an di a riam kho lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a fekmi na dawtnak kha kaa bochan i na ka khamh lai ti ka zumh caah kaa lawm lai."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka cungah a ṭhat zungzal caah amah cu hla in ka thangṭhat lai."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun an i thawh i, “Pathian a um lo,” an ti. An dihlak in an thu, thil ṭhalo kha an tuah; ahmaanmi thil a tuahmi ahohmanh an um lo.","title":"Minung Sualning (Slm 53)","ref":"Rom 3.10-12"},"2":{"text":"Minung lakah hin a fimmi le keimah a ka biami an um hnga maw ti hngalh duh ah Bawipa nih vancung khin a run zoh hna."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an dihlak in an tlau cang, an dihlak in an chiatnak aa tluk dih, Pakhat hmanh thil hmaan a tuahmi an um lo, pakhat taktak hmanh an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “An hngal hnga lo maw? Ṭhat lonak a tuahmi vialte hi mihrut maw an si dih hnga? ka mi kha an ramh hna i cucu an i cawmnak, ka sinah thla an cam bal lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian cu a nawl a ngaimi hna sinah a um caah annih cu an thin a phang ngaingai lai."},"6":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna nih sifakmi an khuakhannak cu dawnkhan hna hmanh seh law a humhaktu hna cu Bawipa a si ko."},"7":{"text":"Israel khamhnak cu Zion in ra seh ti ka hei duh hringhran dah! Bawipa nih a mi cu luatnak a pek ṭhan hna tikah, Jakob tefa cu an lung aa lawm lai, Israel mi cu an tha a nuam lai."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, na biakinn chungah ahodah a lut lai? Na tlang thiang Zion cungah ahodah a um lai?","title":"Pathian Duhnak Tuah Zeidah A Si David Hla"},"2":{"text":"A um ding cu, zeizong vialte ah Pathian nawl a zul i a hmaanmi thil a tuah zungzal i a bia biahmaan le biatak a si i"},"3":{"text":"mi congoih a hmang lo i hawikom cungah ṭhat lonak a tuah lo i a innpa a congoih lo i"},"4":{"text":"Pathian nih a hlawtmi kha zeirello in a um i Bawipa nawl a zulmi cu a upat i Zeitluk in a har hmanh ah a biakam ningin a tuah zungzal i"},"5":{"text":"a karh la loin mi tangka a cawih i a sual lomi hna sual phawt awkah ziknawh pek khawh lomi cu an si. Hi thil a tuahmi hna cu an i hnin bal lai lo."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah cu kan fuh ko, ka huppheng ko sawh.","title":"Hnangamnak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka thawh i, “Nangmah cu ka Bawipa na si; thil ṭha ka ngeihmi vialte hi nangmah sinin ka hmuhmi an si,” ka ti."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa mi, zumhawktlak a simi hna cu, zeitluk in dah an ṭhat! Anmah he um ṭi cu kaa lawmhnak ngan bik a si."},"4":{"text":"Pathian dang a zuan lengmangmi nih cun, an cungah harnak an i tlunter. An raithawinak ah kaa tel duh lai lo i an pathian cu ka bia hna lai lo."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah dah ti lo cu ka ngeihmi dang zeihmanh a um lo, maw Bawipa, ka herhmi vialte cu nangmah nih na ka pek, ka nunnak cu na kut chungah a um."},"6":{"text":"Laksawng na ka pekmi cu zeitluk in dah khuaruahhar an si, zeitluk in dah an ṭhat!"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih a ka hruai caah amah cu ka thangṭhat, zan ah ka lungthin nih ralrinnak a ka pek."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa ka sinah a um cu ka hngalh zungzal, amah cu keimah he naihte ah a um i zeihmanh nih an ka hnin kho lo.","ref":"Lam 2.25-28"},"9":{"text":"Cucaah lawmhnak le thanuamnak in ka khat i him tein ka um zungzal."},"10":{"text":"Cu ti ka si cu Mithi khua ah khan na ka kaltak lai lo le na dawtmi cu Khor Thuk chungah na ka chiahtak lai lo caah a si.","ref":"Lam 13.35"},"11":{"text":"Nunnak lei kalnak lam cu na ka hmuhsak lai; ka sinah na um caah lawmhnak in ka khat i na ka bawmh caah nuamhnak ka hmu zungzal."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan nawlnak a dingmi hi ngai tuah, nangmah bawmh hal in ka aunak hi ka theihpiak tuah. Ka chungah hlennak zeihmanh a um lo caah ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak ko.","title":"A Sual Lomi Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ahmaanmi thil kha nangmah nih na hngalh caah keimah lei ṭanh in bia na ceih lai."},"3":{"text":"Ka lung cu na hngalh, zan ah ka sinah na ra. Ṭha tein na ka hneksak cikcek i ka chungah duhnak ṭhalo zeihmanh a um lo kha na hmuh."},"4":{"text":"Midang bantukin ṭhat lonak bia zeihmanh ka chim lo, na nawl kha ka zulh i puarhrannak lam kha ka zul lo."},"5":{"text":"Na lam kha ka zulh zungzal i zeitikhmanh ah ka pialtak bal lo."},"6":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na sinah thla ka cam i na ka leh: cucaah atu zongah hin keimah leiah i mer law ka bia cu ka ngaihpiak ko."},"7":{"text":"Maw Khamhtu Bawi, na dawtnak khuaruahhar cu langhter ko; na kiang kan um ahcun kan ral hna kut chungin kan him."},"8":{"text":"A ka dohtu miṭhalo hna sin hin Na mitfang bantukin ka veng law Na thlazung in ka hup tuah. Huatnak in a khatmi ka ral nih khan an ka dum,","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"zaangfahnak zeihmanh an ngei lo i"},"11":{"text":"kaa mernak lei paoh ah khan an rak um dih, keimah thluk khawhnak ding caan ṭha kha an bawh."},"12":{"text":"Chiandeih bantuk an si i thleh dih le baoh dih kha an ka duh, an i thuhnak hmun in chiandeih no bantukin an ka bawh."},"13":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ra law ka ral hi do hna law tei hna! Miṭhalo hna kut chung hin na vainam in ka chanh tuah,"},"14":{"text":"na ṭhawnnak in an kut chungin ka khamh tuah, hi vawlei cung nun chung i an duhmi thil vialte tling tein a ngei khomi hna kut chung hin ka khamh tuah. An caah na khonmi dantatnak kha an cungah tlunter law an tefa hna ca zongah i za seh law an tefa hna tefa chin hna ca zongah i za rih seh."},"15":{"text":"Kei tu nih cun ka sual lo caah na hmai kha ka hmuh lai i cun ka hun i hlauh tikah nangmah ka sin i na um caah lunglawmhnak in ka khat lai."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka ṭhawnnak, nangmah cu kan dawt hringhran ko! Nangmah cu a ka chanhtu na si.","title":"David Teinak Hla (2Sam 22.1-51)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka khamhtu a si, amah cu a fekmi ka ralhruang a si. Ka Pathian cu a ka hupphengtu a si, amah sinah cun him tein ka um. Phaw bantukin a ka huhphenh, a ka ven i him tein a ka umter."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka auh i ka ral hna kut chungin a ka khamh. Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u."},"4":{"text":"Thihnak nih a hri in a ka ṭem, rawhralnak tilian nih a ka tlunhnawh."},"5":{"text":"Thihnak nih a hri in a ka ṭem, thlan nih a rap kha a ka chiahhnawh."},"6":{"text":"Ka harnak chungin Bawipa cu ka auh; bawmhnak hal in ka Pathian cu ka auh. A biakinn chungin ka aw kha a theih, bawmhnak ka halnak ka aw cu a hna a phan."},"7":{"text":"Cun Pathian cu a thin a hun caah vawlei cu aa hnin i a ther; tlang hram hna cu an i hnin i an i sai dih."},"8":{"text":"A hnar chungin meikhu an chuak i a kaa chungin a hliau in aa hliaumi meizik an chuak."},"9":{"text":"Van khi a run baoh i a rung ṭum, a ke tang i a ummi khuadawm nakpi he a rung ṭum."},"10":{"text":"Cherubim kha aa cit hna i a rung zuang, thlitu kha a thla in aa cit i khulrang in a choi."},"11":{"text":"Muihnak in amah le amah cu aa tuam, ti a khatmi khuadawm nakpi nih khan a zulh."},"12":{"text":"A hmai i aa lekmi nimtlau chungin rial le meiṭil an tla, khuadawm nakpi chung khan an rung tla."},"13":{"text":"Cun Bawipa cu vancung in khuari bantukin a rung ri i Cung Nung Bik aw cu a rung thang."},"14":{"text":"A thal cu a thlah hna i a ral cu a ṭhek hna; ṭek kha a tlakter i an zaam dih."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah nih na ral cu na sik hna i na thinhun in na onhhnawh hna tikah rili tawne cu a lang i vawlei hram cu a chin kha aa hung."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nih vancung khin a run ka banh i a ka tlaih; ti thuk chungin a ka chuah."},"17":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi ka ral hna kut chungin a ka chuah, a ka huami vialte hna kut chungin a ka chuah — annih cu ka caah a ṭhawng tukmi an si."},"18":{"text":"Harnak ka ton tikah an ka doh, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun a ka huhphenh."},"19":{"text":"Ṭihnung chungin a ka chuah; ka cungah a lung a tlin caah a ka khamh."},"20":{"text":"Ka din caah Bawipa nih laksawng a ka pek, a sual lomi ka si caah thluachuah a ka pek."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa nawlbia cu ka zulh; ka Pathian cu ka doh lo,"},"22":{"text":"A phunglam vialte kha ka zulh i a nawlbia kha zul loin ka um hna lo."},"23":{"text":"Palhnak ka tuah lo kha a hngalh, thil ṭhalo ka hrial kha a hngalh."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka din caah khan laksawng a ka pek i ka sual lo a hngalh caah khan ṭuan man a ka pek."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa, nang cu zumhawktlak a simi sinah zumhawktlak in na um ve i a ṭhami sinah na ṭha ve."},"26":{"text":"A thiangmi sinah na thiang i asinain miṭhalo cu na huat hna."},"27":{"text":"Mi toiah aa dormi cu na khamh hna i miruamkai cu na ṭhumh hna."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa nih ceunak a ka pek, ka Pathian nih muihnak cu a ka dawipiak."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral hna doh khawhnak thazang a ka pek, an ralhau baoh khawhnak ṭhawnnak a ka pek."},"30":{"text":"Hi Pathian hi, zeitluk in dah a tuahmi kha a tlin i zeitluk in dah a bia kha i bochan awk an si!
