A huhphenhnak a kawlmi hna caah cun phaw bantuk a si."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa lawnglawng hi Pathian cu a si, Pathian lawnglawng hi kan ralhau cu a si,"},"32":{"text":"Amah hi a kan ṭhawntertu Pathian cu a si, kan kalnak lam a himtertu cu a si."},"33":{"text":"Sazuk ke bantukin ka ke cu a khul a ranter i tlang cungah him tein a ka umter.","ref":"Hab 3.19"},"34":{"text":"Raltuk a ka cawnpiak i cucaah a ṭhawng bikmi likuk hmanh kha ka hman khawh."},"35":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih na ka huhphenh i, na ka khamh; na ka zohkhenhnak nih mingan ah a ka ser i na dawtnak nih him tein a ka umter."},"36":{"text":"Nangmah nih na ka huhphenh caah an ka tlai kho lo i a tluk zong ka tlu bal lo."},"37":{"text":"Ka ral cu ka dawi hna i ka tlaih hna, Ka tei hna hlantiang ka ngol hna lo,"},"38":{"text":"Ka tuk hna i an tho kho ti lo, ka kehram ah an ril ko."},"39":{"text":"Raltuknak hmun caah thazang na ka pek i ka ral hna teinak ah ṭhawnnak na ka pek."},"40":{"text":"Ka ral hna cu keimah hnulei chit in na zamter hna i a ka huatu cu ka hrawh hna."},"41":{"text":"Bawmhnak hal in an ai, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh nih an khamh kho hna lo; Bawipa kha an auh, sihmanhsehlaw a let hna lo."},"42":{"text":"Dip cikcek in ka rial hna i thli nih a choihmi leidip bantuk ah an cang, lam i leicet bantukin ka lamh hna."},"43":{"text":"Ral thawh hmangmi miphun chungin na ka khamh i miphun hna uktu ah na ka ser: ka hngalh bal lomi kha ka kut tangah an um."},"44":{"text":"Ka bia an theih tikah ka nawl an ka zulh, ramdangmi kha ka hmaiah an kun."},"45":{"text":"An hnabei a dong i an ralhau chung khan ther lengmang in an ra."},"46":{"text":"Bawipa cu a nungmi Pathian a si, ka khamhnak lungpi cu thangṭhat ko u! Pathian cu ka khamhtu a si, a lianhngannak kha thanh tuah u!"},"47":{"text":"ka ral hna teinak kha a ka pek i miphun tampi kha ka kut tangah a chiah hna:"},"48":{"text":"Ka ral hna kut chungin a ka khamh. Bawipa, nangmah nih ka ral hna teinak cu na ka pek i mipuarhrang mi hna kut chungin na ka huhphenh."},"49":{"text":"Cucaah miphun kip sinah nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai i na thangṭhatnak cu hla in ka sak lai.","ref":"Rom 15.9"},"50":{"text":"Pathian nih a siangpahrang cu teinak nganpi a ka pek; a fekmi a dawtnak kha a thimmi keimah David le Ka tefa hna cungah zungzal in a langhter."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Van nih khin Pathian sunparnak a langhter i a tuahmi thil kha a kan hmuhsak.","title":"Pathian Sunparnak A Sermi Thil Ah A Lang David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Chun nih a hun changtu chun sinah khan a chim i zan zong nih a hun changtu zan sinah khan a nolh ve."},"3":{"text":"Bia siseh holh siseh an hmang lo, aw thawng zong zeihmanh theih a um lo;"},"4":{"text":"asinain an aw cu vawlei khuazakip ah a thang i an bia cu vanhramdeng a phan. Bawipa nih ni cu van ah khin thlam a sakpiak i","ref":"Rom 10.18"},"5":{"text":"nupi ṭhi tlangval a inn in a hung chuah bantuk khin a hung chuak, tlik aa zuammi tlik zuamnak i an hung chuah bantuk khin a hung chuak."},"6":{"text":"Vanhramdeng khattelei khin aa thawk i khattelei ah a kal. A linhnak in aa thup khomi thil zeihmanh an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa phung cu a ṭhat a tling, nunnak thar petu a si. Bawipa nawlbia cu bochan awk a tlak, fimnak a baumi fimnak petu a si.","title":"Nawlbia"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa phunglam cu ahmaanmi an si, cu phunglam a zulmi cu an lung aa lawm. A nawlbia cu dinnak leiah a tlingmi an si i hngalhthiamnak lungthin pe khotu an si,"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa biak cu a ṭha, cu biaknak cu zungzal in a hmun lai. Bawipa biakhiahnak cu an ding, zungzal in ahmaanmi an si."},"10":{"text":"Sui nakin duh deuh awk an si, sui thiang bik phun nak hmanh in duh deuh awk an si, Khuaihliti nakin an thlum deuh, khuaihliti thiang bik nakin an thlum deuh."},"11":{"text":"Na sal hi hngalhnak an ka pek i ka zulh hna caah laksawng ka hmu."},"12":{"text":"Ahohmanh amah sualnak aa hmu khomi an um lo; a thli tein ka tuahmi ka sualnak chungin ka thianh tuah."},"13":{"text":"Lenglang sualnak chung zongah ka luh nakhnga lo ka kham law cu sualnak cu keimah uktu siter hna hlah; cu tikah ṭhatnak leiah mitling ka si lai i sualnak ṭihnung chungin ka luat lai."},"14":{"text":"Ka kaa chung bia hna le ka lung chung ruahnak hna cu, nangmah cohlan awk tlak si ko hna seh, maw Bawipa, ka lungpi le ka tlantu."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Harnak na ton ni ah Bawipa nih in let ko seh. Jakob Pathian nih in huppheng ko seh!","title":"Teinak Ca Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"A biakinn chungin bawmhnak in pe seh law Zion Tlang cungin in pe ko seh."},"3":{"text":"Na pekchanhmi thil vialte kha in cohlanpiak seh law na raithawinak vialte nih khan a lungtong ko seh. Selah"},"4":{"text":"Na duhmi kha in pe seh law na timhmi vialte kha tlinter ko seh."},"5":{"text":"Cun teinak na hmuhmi ruangah khan lunglawm in kan au lai, teinak na hmuhmi cu kan Pathian thangṭhat in kan conglawmh lai Na halmi vialte cu Bawipa nih in pe ko seh."},"6":{"text":"Atu cu Bawipa nih a thimmi siangpahrang kha teinak a pek ti ka hngalh cang; a thiangmi a vancung khin a run leh i a ṭhawngmi a lianhngannak in teinak kha a pek."},"7":{"text":"Mi a cheu nih an raltuknak rangleng kha an i bochan; a cheu nih an rangtum kha an i bochan hna; sihmanhsehlaw kannih cu Bawipa kan Pathian ṭhawnnak kha kan i bochan."},"8":{"text":"Annih cu an ril i an tlu lai. sihmanhsehlaw kannih cu kan tho lai i, fek tein kan dir lai."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, siangpahrang cu teinak pe ko; kan auh tikah Bawipa nih a kan leh lai."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih thazang na pek caah siangpahrang cu aa lawm; teinak na pek caah lawmhnak in a khat.","title":"Teinak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"A duhmi kha na pek i an halnak kha na leh. Selah"},"3":{"text":"Thluachuahnak tampi he na len i a lu ah suiluchin na chinh."},"4":{"text":"Nunnak an hal i na pek, nun sau le chan sau na pek."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah nih na bawmh caah a sunparnak cu a ngan, minthannak le lianhngannak na pek,"},"6":{"text":"na thluachuahnak cu a hmuh zungzal hna i nangmah a sin i na um caah lawmhnak in a khat."},"7":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih Cung Nung Bik cu aa bochan i Bawipa dawtnak a fekmi thawngin siangpahrang a si zungzal lai."},"8":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih a ral kha a tlaih dih hna lai i a huatu vialte kha a tlaih dih hna lai."},"9":{"text":"A hung chuah tikah meizik bantukin a hrawh dih hna lai. Bawipa nih a thinhun in a kangh dih hna lai i mei nih a kangh dih hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih an fale kha a thah dih hna lai i an tefa kha a nawn dih hna lai."},"11":{"text":"A cung i ṭhat lonak tuah kha an i tim lai i khua an khang lai, sihmanhsehlaw an khuakhanmi le an timhnak cu an tling kho lai lo."},"12":{"text":"A thal in a kah hna lai i an i mer lai i an thi lai."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, na ṭhawnnak he ra tuah. na ṭhawnnak cu hla in kan thangṭhat lai."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, zeicahdah na ka hlawt? Ka bawm ko sawh, tiah fak piin ka au, sihmanhsehlaw bawmhnak cu a ra hlei lo.","title":"Lungfah Ainak le Thangṭhatnak Hla David Hla","ref":"Mat 27.46; Mar 15.34"},"2":{"text":"Chun ah nangmah cu kan auh, maw ka Pathian, sihmanhsehlaw na ka let lo; zan zongah kan auh, sihmanhsehlaw dinh ka hmu kho hlei lo."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah cu Israel Mi Thiang, Israel mi nih an thangṭhatmi na si i na bawiṭhutdan cungah khan na ṭhu."},"4":{"text":"Kan pupa nih an in bochan, nangmah cu an in bochan i na khamh hna."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah kha an in auh i ṭih awk chungin an luat, nangmah kha an in bochan i na khel hna lo."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu minung ka si ti lo, cangcel ka si ko cang; mi vialte nih an ka serhsat i an ka nihsawh."},"7":{"text":"A ka hmumi paoh nih capo ah an ka saih, an lei an ka chakhnawh i an lu an ka thinhnawh.","ref":"Mat 27.39; Mar 15.29; Luk 23.35"},"8":{"text":"An i thawh i, “ Bawipa naa bochan ṭung, zeicahdah an khamh kun lo? Bawipa nih an dawt ahcun, zeicahdah an bawmh kun lo?” an ti.","ref":"Mat 27.43"},"9":{"text":"Him tein a ka chuahtertu cu nangmah na si i bawhte ka si lioah ṭha tein a ka zohkhenhtu cu nangmah na si."},"10":{"text":"Ka chuah ri in nangmah cu kan bochan zungzal i ka chuah ri in ka Pathian na si zungzal ko."},"11":{"text":"Hung ka hlaat sawh hlah! Harnak nih a ka naih i a ka bawmtu ahohmanh an um lo."},"12":{"text":"Ka ral nih cawtum bantukin an ka kulh, Bashan ram cawtum ṭihnung pipi bantuk nih khan an ka kulh."},"13":{"text":"Chiandeih bantukin an kaa an ka anhnawh, an awn i an kaa balh hiamhuam in an i an."},"14":{"text":"Ka thazang a dih cang, vawlei i thletmi ti bantukin a dih cang. Ka ruh vialte kha ka hliahhlok in an pong dih, ka lung cu ka chungah a timi khuailul bantuk a si."},"15":{"text":"Ka hrom cu leidip ro in a ro, ka lei cu ka dang cunglei ah aa beh. Leidip lak i hung thi dingah na ka kaltak."},"16":{"text":"Miṭhalo bu nih an ka kulh, uico run bantukin an ka zuanhnawh; ka kut le ka ke ah an ka seh."},"17":{"text":"Ka ruh vialte an lang dih. Ka ral nih khan an ka zoh i an di a riam;"},"18":{"text":"ka hnipuan kha an i phaw i ka puan caah khan voihfung an zuh.","ref":"Mat 27.35; Mar 15.24; Luk 23.34; Jhn 19.24"},"19":{"text":"Ka hlaat sawh hlah, maw Bawipa ! Khulrang in ra law ka bawm tuah, maw ka Khamhtu!"},"20":{"text":"Vainam chungin ka khamh law kha uico hna sin khan ka nunnak cu khamh ko,"},"21":{"text":"Kha chiandeih hna sin khan ka khamh ko; kha cawtum hrang hna hmaiah khan kei cu zeihmanh a tuah khomi ka si lo."},"22":{"text":"Na tuahmi kha ka mi cu ka chimh hna lai, an i pumhnak ah kan thangṭhat lai.","ref":"Heb 2.12"},"23":{"text":"Annih cu ka thawh hna lai i, “ Bawipa sal hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u! Jakob tefa hna, amah cu upat tuah u. Israel mi hna, amah cu bia tuah u."},"24":{"text":"Sifakmi kha anih nih cun a hrelh hna lo i an nganfahnak kha zeirello in a um lo; annih kha a hlaat hna lo i bawmhnak hal in an aunak kha a leh hna,” ka ti lai."},"25":{"text":"Aa pummi dihlak hmaiah, nangmah cu na tuahmi ruangah kan thangṭhat lai; nangmah nawl zulmi an dihlak hmaiah kaa kammi raithawinak kha kan pekchanh lai."},"26":{"text":"Sifakmi nih an duh zat in an ei lai, Bawipa sinah a rami nih Bawipa cu an thangṭhat lai. Zungzal in thluachuak in um ko hna seh."},"27":{"text":"Miphun vialte nih Bawipa cu an hngalh camcin lai, vawleicung khuazakip in amah leiah an i mer lai; miphun zakip nih an biak lai."},"28":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si i amah nih miphun vialte cu a uk hna."},"29":{"text":"Miporhlaw vialte kha a hmaiah an kun lai, a thi khomi minung, a thi ding a si komi vialte hna kha a hmaiah an kun lai."},"30":{"text":"Hmailei chan mi nih a rian an ṭuan lai; a ra lai ding chan sinah Bawipa kong cu mi nih an chim lai."},"31":{"text":"A chuak rih lomi minung kha, “ Bawipa nih mi a khamh hna,” tiah an chimh hna lai."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu tuukhal bantukin a ka vengtu a si, ka herhmi vialte kha a ka pek dih.","title":"Kan Tuukhal David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ramhring lakah a ka bawhter, dinh hmun ti pawngah a ka hruai.","ref":"Biat 7.17"},"3":{"text":"Thazang thar kha a ka pek i a rak ka kamh bantukin ahmaanmi lam ah a ka hruai."},"4":{"text":"A thuk bikmi muihnak horkuang chungin kal hmanh ning law, Bawipa, zeihmanh ka ṭih lai lo, zeicahtiah nangmah nih na ka umpi. Na ṭhiangṭhunh le na tanbo nih ka hna an ka ngamter."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral hna hmaika ah rawl na ka dangh, ka lu ah chiti na ka toih i ka hrai cu a liam in a liam."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhatnak le na dawtnak nih ka nun chung vialte an ka umpi lai i na inn cu a zungzal in ka inn a si lai."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vawlei le a chung i a ummi thil vialte hi Bawipa ta an si, vawlei le a cung i a ummi minung vialte zong hi amah ta kan si dih.","title":"Sunparnak Siangpahrang David Hla","ref":"1Kor 10.26"},"2":{"text":"Rili cungah vawlei cu a dirter i a hram cu rili thuk chungah khan a bunh."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa tlang ah ahodah a kai kho lai? A biakinn thiang chungah ahodah a lut kho lai?"},"4":{"text":"Tuahnak le lungthin in a thiang i siasal kha a bia lo i hlennak biakam a tuah lomi kha an kai kho lai i an lut kho lai.","ref":"Mat 5.8"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih thluachuah a pek hna lai i annih a khamhtu hna Pathian nih, nan sual lo, a ti hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Cu bantuk mi cu Pathian sin i a ra khomi an si, Jakob Pathian hmaika i a chuak khomi an si. Selah"},"7":{"text":"Kutka hna, kau piin i hung u, zungzal in a ummi innka hna, kau piin i hung u; a liannganmi siangpahrang cu a lut lai."},"8":{"text":"A liannganmi siangpahrang cu ahodah a si? A liannganmi siangpahrang cu a ṭhawng i a lian a nganmi, raltuknak hmun in teitu a simi Bawipa kha a si."},"9":{"text":"Kutka hna kau piin i hung u, zungzal hmunmi innka hna, kau piin i hung u; a liannganmi siangpahrang cu a lut lai."},"10":{"text":"A liannganmi siangpahrang cu ahodah a si? Amah cu ralkapbu Bawipa, a liannganmi siangpahrang kha a si! Selah a si! Selah"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah sinah thla ka cam, ka Pathian, nangmah cu kan bochan.","title":"Hruainak le Huhphenhnak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Sungh ningzahnak chung khan ka khamh law ka ral cu ka cungah an di riamhter hna hlah."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah an bochanmi cu an sung lo i, asinain nangmah doh ah a khul a rangmi cu sunghnak kha an phan."},"4":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na lam kha ka cawnpiak hna law ka hngalhter hna."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka khamhtu na si caah na biatak ningin nun cu ka cawnpiak tuah. Chun nitlak in nangmah kha kan bochan."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, hlan piin ka cungah na rak langhter tawnmi na dawtnak fek le na zaangfahnak cu philh hna hlah."},"7":{"text":"Ka tlanval lio ka sualnak le ka palhnak kha ka ngaithiam ko hna. A fekmi na dawtnak le na ṭhatnak ruangah keimah cu ka philh hlah, Maw Bawipa ."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ding i a ṭha: misual mi kha an zulh awk a simi lam cu a cawnpiak hna."},"9":{"text":"Mi toi i aa dormi kha lamding in a hruai hna i a duhnak kha a cawnpiak hna."},"10":{"text":"A biakam le nawlbia a zulmi vialte cu, dawtnak in a hruai hna i zumhawktlak tein a kalpi hna."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka sualnak cu zeitluk hmanh in ngan seh law, na min ruangah ka ngaithiam ko."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nawl a zulmi nih an zulh awk hnga lam kha an hngalh lai."},"13":{"text":"Nun nuam tein an um lai i an fale cu hi ram chungah hin him tein khua an sa lai."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu a nawl a zulmi hna hawikom a si i a biakam kha a cawnpiak hna."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa cu kaa bochan zungzal i thil ṭihnung chungin a ka chuah."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, keimah lei hoi law, ka zaangfah tuah, zeitintiah ka um a har i ka thazang a der."},"17":{"text":"Ka lung retheihnak vialte cu ka chawng law ka harnak dihlak chungin ka khamh tuah."},"18":{"text":"Ka retheihnak vialte le ka innak vialte kha ka ruahpiak hna law Ka sualnak vialte cu ka ngaithiam ko hna."},"19":{"text":"Ka ral vialte hi zoh tuah hna, zeitluk in dah an ka huat hi hmu tuah."},"20":{"text":"Ka huppheng law ka khamh tuah, himnak hmuh duh ah nangmah cu kan fuh caah mualpho in ka umter sawh hlah."},"21":{"text":"Nangmah kha kan bochan caah ka ṭhatnak le ka lih chim lonak nih ka huppheng ko hna seh."},"22":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na mi cu kan harnak chung hin kan khamh ko!"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah kha ka lung a dih-umnak in kan bochan i a dingmi thil kha ka tuah caah, misual lo ka sinak kha ka thanhpiak tuah.","title":"Miṭha Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka hneksak law ka hlathlai cikcek tuah, Maw Bawipa, ka lung duhnak le ruahnak hi zoh tuah hna."},"3":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak nih lam a ka hmuhsak i zumhawktlak na sinak nih a ka hruai zungzal."},"4":{"text":"Hlen hmangmi kha ka kom hna lo i mihrokhrawl zong kha ka kom hna lo."},"5":{"text":"Miṭhalo bu kha ka huat hna i ṭhat lonak a tuahmi kha ka hrial hna."},"6":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka sual lo langhnak caah ka kha kaa ṭawl i nangmah biak awkah na biakṭheng velchum ah kaa chawk."},"7":{"text":"Lunglawmhnak hla kha ka sa i khuaruahhar thil na tuahmi vialte kha ka chim hna."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, na umnak inn kha ka tlaihchan i na sunparnak a umnak hmun kha ka duh."},"9":{"text":"Misual hna sinah ka thah chih hlah, lainawngmi hna sinah ka hlonh chih hlah —"},"10":{"text":"annih cu ṭhat lonak kha zungzal in a tuah i nawhthuh pek aa tim zungzalmi an si."},"11":{"text":"Kei tu cu ahmaanmi thil kha ka tuah; ka zaangfah law ka khamh tuah."},"12":{"text":"Him tein hmun rawn ah ka dir i zapi pumhnak ah Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat!"}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka ceunak le ka khamhnak a si; ahohmanh ka ṭih hna lai lo. Bawipa cu a ka hupphengtu ralhruang a si, ka thin a phang lai lo.","title":"Thangṭhat Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih an ka doh i thah an ka zalh tikah, an ril tawn i an tlu tawn."},"3":{"text":"Ralkapbu nganpi nih ka kulh hna hmanh seh law ka thin a phang lai lo; ka ral nih ka doh hna hmanh seh law Pathian cu kaa bochan ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu thil pakhat ka hal, ka duhmi thil cu pakhat lawnglawng a si ko; cucu ka nun chung vialte Bawipa inn chung i um le a ṭhatnak kha khuaruahhar in zoh le amah kha lam ka hruai tuah tiin hal cu a si."},"5":{"text":"Harnak caan ah him tein a thla tangah a ka dorter; a biakinn chungah him tein a ka chiah i a sangmi lungpi cungah a ka chuan."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah ka velchum i a ummi ka ral cu ka tei hna lai. Lunglawmhnak au thawng he a biakinn chungah ka raithawinak cu ka pekchanh lai; hla ka sa lai i Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat lai!"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah kan auh tikah ka bia ka theihpiak tuah, ka zaangfah law kan halnak cu ka let tuah."},"8":{"text":"“Ka sinah ra tuah,” tiah na ti. Bawipa, na sinah ka ra lai;"},"9":{"text":"keimah cu ka thuhtak sawh hlah. Ka cungah na thinhung hlah, na sal hi ka ṭhawl sawh hlah. Maw Pathian, ka Khamhtu, nangmah cu a ka bawmtu na si, ka kaltak hlah, ka chia ta sawh hlah."},"10":{"text":"Ka nu le ka pa hmanh nih khin hei ka hlaw hna seh law, Bawipa nih cun a ka zohkhenh ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"11":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka ral an um caah hin, a himmi lam in ka kalpi law na duhnak kha ka cawnpiak ko."},"12":{"text":"Lih le hro in a ka tlerh lengmangmi ka ral hna lakah hin ka chia ta hlah."},"13":{"text":"A mi hna cung i Bawipa a ṭhatnak hi ka hmuh hrimhrim lai tiah ka zumh ko."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu i bochan u! Zumhnak ngei u, nan lung dong hlah u! Bawipa cu i bochan ko u!"}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu kan auh, ka himnak lungpi, ka aunak cu ka theihpiak tuah. Na ka leh lo ahcun mithi khua i a kalmi hna bantuk ka si ve sual lai.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah bawmhhal awkah ka au i na biakinn thiang lei hoih in ka kut ka hler tikah ka aunak kha ka theihpiak tuah."},"3":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna, thil ṭhalo a tuahtu hna sinah khan sual ka phaw hlah — annih cu a bia a thlum ṭung i an lungthin vial huatnak in a khatmi an si."},"4":{"text":"An tuahmi thil ruangah khan dantat hna, thil ṭhalo an tuahmi vialte ruangah khan, dantat hna. An rianṭuanning in lehrul ko hna hmuh awk an i tlakmi kha pe ko hna.","ref":"Biat 22.12"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil kha zeihmanh ah an rel lo i a sermi thil zong kha zeihmanh ah an rel lo; cucaah dan a tat hna lai i zungzal in a hrawh hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u; bawmh hal in ka aunak kha a theih cang!"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih a ka huh i a ka phenh; amah cu kaa bochan ko. A ka bawmh i kaa lawm, cucaah amah thangṭhatnak hla ka sa."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi kha a huhphenh hna; a thimmi a siangpahrang kha a chanh i a khamh."},"9":{"text":"Na mi cu khamh ko hna, Maw Bawipa ; nangmah ta a simi cu thluachuah pe ko hna. An tuukhal si law zungzal in veng ko hna."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nannih pathian hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u; a sunparnak le a lianhngannak cu thangṭhat u.","title":"Thlichia Chungah Aw David Hla","ref":"Slm 96.7-9"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa min sunglawi cu thangṭhat u, A Thiangmi Bawipa cu a langh tikah a hmaiah kun u."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa aw cu rili cungah a thang, a sunglawimi Pathian cu khuari bantukin a ri i a aw cu rili cungah khan a thang dih."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa aw cu a than khawh chung le a ṭhawn khawh chungin a thang!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa aw nih cun sidar thing kha a khiah dih hna, Lebanon tlang sidar hmanh kha a khiah dih hna."},"6":{"text":"Lebanon tlang cu cawfa bantukin a pehter hna i Hermon Tlang cu fungtum no bantukin a choiter."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa aw nih ṭek kha a tlakter."},"8":{"text":"A aw nih thetse ram kha a hninh hna, Kadesh thetse ram kha a hninh in a hninh."},"9":{"text":"“Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u,” tiin a biakinn chungah an au lioah, Bawipa aw nih cun sakhi kha fa a hrinter hna i thingkung kha an hnah vialte a choih dih hna."},"10":{"text":"Rili thuk pipi kha Bawipa nih a uk hna, siangpahrang bantukin zungzal in a uk hna."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi cu thazang a pek hna i thluachuah daihnak a pek hna."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah nih na ka khamh i ka ral kha ka cungah diriam in na umter hna lo caah kan thangṭhat.","title":"Lawmhnak Thlacam"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa, ka Pathian, nangmah sinah bawmhnak hal in ka au i na ka damter."},"3":{"text":"Mithikhua in na ka kirter ṭhan. Khor Thukpi chung i a vung kalmi hna sinah kaa tel ve nain, ka nunnak cu na ka pek ṭhan."},"4":{"text":"Nannih a mithiang hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u; A Thiangmi Pathian nih a tuahmi kha philh hlah u law amah kha lawm u."},"5":{"text":"A thinhun cu caan tawite chung lawng a si; a ṭhatnak tu nih cun chantlung a nguh. Zan ah mitthli tlaknak um hmanh seh law zinglei ah cun lawmhnak a ra ṭhan ve."},"6":{"text":"Him tein ka um kha ka hngalh i “Ahohmanh nih an ka tei bal lai lo,” ka ti."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa, ka cungah na ṭha ko; tlang cungah a ummi ralhruang a him bantukin him tein na ka umter. Sihmanhsehlaw na ka thuhtak tikah ṭihnak in ka khat."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu kan auh, a bawm ko sawh, tiah kan nawl."},"9":{"text":"Ka thihnak cun zei ṭhatnak dah a chuak lai? Thlan i ka va kalnak cun zei miaknak dah a chuak lai? Mithi nih an in thangṭhat khawh maw? A dong lomi na ṭhatnak cu an chim khawh maw?"},"10":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, Ka bia cu ka theihpiak law ka zaangfah tuah! Bawipa, ka bawm tuah!"},"11":{"text":"Ka ngaihchiatnak cu lunglawmh lamnak ah na ka thlenpiak cang, ka mithi ngaihnak puan cu na ka lakpiak i lunglawmhnak puan kha na ka pek."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah dai tein ka um lai lo; nangmah cu kan thangṭhat ko lai. Bawipa, nangmah cu ka Pathian na si, a zungzal in kan thangṭhat lai."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himnak hmuh duh ah kan fuh, Maw Bawipa, ka sunghter sawh hlah. Nangmah cu a dingmi Pathian na si, ka khamh ko sawh, tiah kan nawl.","title":"Pathian Bochan Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak law ka khamh ko sawh; ka himnak lungpi si law ka khamhnak ding caah a fekmi ralhau si ko."},"3":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka lungpi le ka ralhruang na si, bia na ka kamh bangkhan lam ka hmuhsak law ka hruai tuah."},"4":{"text":"An ka chiahhnawhmi rap khan ka veng ko; nangmah cu ka himnak hmun na si."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah kut chungah ka thlarau ka chiah, Bawipa, nangmah nih na ka khamh lai, nang cu zumhawktlakmi Pathian na si.","ref":"Luk 23.46"},"6":{"text":"Siasal santlailo a biami cu na huat hna, asinain kei cu nangmah kha kan bochan."},"7":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak ruangah ka lung aa lawm lai i ka tha a nuam lai. Ka temhinnak kha na hmuh i ka harnak kha na hngalh."},"8":{"text":"Ka ral hna kut chungah na ka phakter lo, himte tu in na ka zohkhenh."},"9":{"text":"Harnak chung i ka um caah, Maw Pathian ka zaangfah ko; ka ṭah tuknak ah ka mit zong a phing dih i ka tha zong a dih cikcek cang."},"10":{"text":"Ka nun chung kum hna cu ngaihchiatnak in a liam i hrum ainak in an khat, Harnak tam tuk ka inmi ruangah ka thazang cu a lo dih i ka ruh hna cu an rop thluahmah."},"11":{"text":"Ka ral nih capo ah an ka saih, ka innpa nih an ka nihsawh; a ka hngalmi nih an ka ṭih i lam i an ka hmuh tikah an ka lektak."},"12":{"text":"Rak thi cang ning law cu bang, mi vialte nih an ka philh i hlonhmi thil bantuk ka si."},"13":{"text":"Ka ral tampi nih a thli tein an ka congoih, ṭihnak nih a dum in a ka dum. ka loh nakhnga ding khua kha an khan i keimah thahnak ding khua kha an ruat lengmang."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kaa bochanmi cu nangmah na si, maw Bawipa ; nangmah cu ka Pathian na si."},"15":{"text":"Ka caan cu na kut chungah a um dih, ka ral hna kut chungin ka khamh law a ka hremtu hna kut chungin ka khamh tuah."},"16":{"text":"Kei cu na sal ka si, ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei ko; a fekmi na dawtnak ruangah ka khamh tuah!"},"17":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah kha kan auh; ka sunghter sawh hlah! Miṭhalo cu sung hna seh, mithikhua ah dai tein um hna seh."},"18":{"text":"Lihchimmi kha daihter hna — annih cu miporhlaw, miruamkai, bia songpuam in miding mi kong ceih a hmangmi an si."},"19":{"text":"Nangmah an ṭihtu hna caah na chiahmi thil ṭha cu zeitluk in dah khuaruahhar an si. Mi kip hmuh ah na tuahmi thil ṭha cu zeitluk in dah khuaruahhar a si, nangmah an bochanmi cu na huhphenh hna."},"20":{"text":"Mi nih thah an timh hna caah na thlam chungah khan na thuh hna i an ral pawl nih an nihsawh khawh hna nakhnga lo na thla tangah na chiah hna."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u! Ka ral nih an ka kulh i an ka tuk tikah a dawtnak cu khuaruahhar in ka cungah a langhter."},"22":{"text":"ka thin a phang i na sinah umter ti loin na ka dawi cang rua tiah ka ruah. Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah sinah bawmhnak hal in ka au tikah ka aunak kha na rak theih."},"23":{"text":"Nannih a mithiang vialte hna, Bawipa cu daw ko u! Bawipa nih zumhawktlakmi cu a huhphenh hna, sihmanhsehlaw miporhlaw cu fak piin dan a tat hna."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa cungah a ruahchannak a chiami vialte hna, lungṭhawng le thazang ṭhawng in um ko u!"}}},"32":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A sualnak ngaihthiam a si i a palhnak maimilh a simi cu a lung aa lawm.","title":"Sualphuannak le Ngaihthiamnak","ref":"Rom 4.7-8"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih, sual a phawt lomi le a lung chungah hlennak a ngei lomi cu a lung aa lawm."},"3":{"text":"Ka sualnak kha ka phuan hna lo tikah chun nitlak in ka ṭap."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, chunzan in dan na ka tat i ka thazang cu a dihlak in a zor, ṭhal ni lin nih khua a roter bantuk khin ka thazang cu a ro dih. Selah"},"5":{"text":"Khi tikah ka sualnak cu nangmah sinah ka phuan hna; ṭhat lonak ka tuahmi cu ka thup hna lo. Nangmah sinah khan ka phuan dih hna i ka nawlbuarnak vialte cu na ka ngaihthiam dih. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Cucaah zumhawktlak a simi vialte hna nih cun, herhnak caan an ton tikah na sinah thla an cam awk a si; tilian a tlun tikah a phan hna lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah cu kaa thuhnak hmun na si, harnak chungin na ka khamh lai. Nangmah nih na ka huhphenh caah fak piin na khamhnak cu hla in ka thangṭhat. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “Na zulh awk hnga lam kha kan hmuhsak lai, kan cawnpiak lai i lungthin kan cheuh lai."},"9":{"text":"Na duhnak zulhter awkah chak le kaahlawmh a haumi rang le laa bantukin hrut hlah,” a ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun temhnak an in a hau ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa aa bochanmi cu a dawtnak fek nih khan a huhphenh hna."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil ruangah, miding vialte hna, i lawm u law thanuam in um tuah u. Amah a nawl a zulmi vialte hna, lunglawm in au tuah u!"}}},"33":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miding vialte hna, Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil ruangah i lawm tuah u; amah a nawl a zulmi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat tuah u.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Tingtang in Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u, hri hra ngeimi tingtang in thangṭhat u."},"3":{"text":"Hla thar in thangṭhat u, dawh ngaiin hri hra tingtang cu tum u law fak piin hla sa u."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa bia cu biatak an si, a ṭuanmi rian cu zumhawktlak an si dih."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih dinnak le ṭhatnak cu a duh; vawlei cu a fekmi a dawtnak in a khat."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih a nawlbia in van khi a ser hna, ni le thlapa le arfi khi a bia in a ser hna."},"7":{"text":"Rili vialte kha hmunkhat ah a pumh hna; a thukmi rilipi cu thil khonnak inn chungah a khumh hna."},"8":{"text":"Vawlei vialte, Bawipa cu ṭih tuah; vawleicung mi vialte hna, Bawipa cu ṭih tuah u."},"9":{"text":"Bia a chim i vawlei cu a hung um, nawl a pek i zeizong vialte an hung chuak."},"10":{"text":"Miphun dang nih tuah an i timhmi kha Bawipa nih pakpalawng ah a canter i tling kho loin a umter hna."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah khuakhanmi cu zungzal in a hmun i amah timhmi cu zungzal in a fek."},"12":{"text":"An Pathian ah Bawipa a simi miphun cu lunglawmmi miphun an si, Bawipa nih a mi ah a thimmi hna cu lunglawmmi an si."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih vancung khin a run kan zoh i minung vialte hi a kan hmuh dih."},"14":{"text":"A uknak hmun khin a run kan zoh i vawleicung mi vialte hi a kan hmuh dih."},"15":{"text":"Kan ruahnak vialte hi amah sermi an si dih i kan tuahmi vialte cu a hngalh dih."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih a ral a tei hna cu ralkapbu ṭhawngmi a ngeih caah a si lo ralkap nih a ral a tei cu a thazang a ṭhawn caah a si lo."},"17":{"text":"Ral teinak caah ral tuknak rang hi san an tlai lo. a nganmi an ṭhawnnak nih a khamh kho hna lo."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih amah a ṭihmi cu a zohkhenh hna i a fekmi a dawtnak aa bochanmi cu him tein a umter hna."},"19":{"text":"Thihnak chungin a khamh hna i mangṭam tlun caan ah a nunter hna."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan i bochan, amah cu a kan bawmtu le kan phaw a si."},"21":{"text":"Amah thawngin kan lung aa lawm i a min thiang cu kan i bochan."},"22":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu kan in bochan caah, a fekmi na dawtnak cu kan sinah um ko seh."}}},"34":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu a zungzal in ka lawmh lai, amah thangṭhat cu a ngol in ka ngol lai lo.","title":"Pathian Thangṭhatnak (1Sam 21.13-15)"},"2":{"text":"A tuahmi thil ruangah khan ka thangṭhat lai; hremnak a ingmi nih thei u law i lawm tuah u."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa lianhngannak cu chim ṭi u si law a min cu thangṭhat ti u sih."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa sinah cun thla ka cam i a ka leh; ka ṭihmi thil vialte in a ka luatter."},"5":{"text":"Hremnak a ingmi nih amah cu an zoh, zeitikhmanh ah a deuh hna lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Santlai lomi nih amah cu an auh i a leh hna; an harnak chungin a khamh dih hna."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihmi cu a vancungmi nih khan an zoh hna i ṭihnak chungin an luatter hna."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa hi zeitluk in dah a ṭhat ti kha nanmah tein va kawl cio hmanh u, amah chungah him tein a ummi cu a lung aa lawm.","ref":"1Pet 2.3"},"9":{"text":"A mi vialte hna, Bawipa cu ṭih tuah u, amah a ṭihmi nih cun an herhmi thil vialte kha an hmuh."},"10":{"text":"Chiandeih hmanh hi rawl hmu loin an um tawn i rawlṭam in an vak tawn, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nawl a zulmi cu zeihmanh an baumi a um bal lo."},"11":{"text":"Ka hawile mino hna, ra u law, ka bia ngai tuah u; Bawipa ṭihzah ning cu kan cawnpiak hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Nun nuam tein nun le chan saupi le lunglawm in nun cu nan duh maw?","ref":"1Pet 3.10-12"},"13":{"text":"Nan duh ahcun, bia ṭhalo chim kha i sum u, lih kha chim hlah u."},"14":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha hrial u law ṭhatnak kha tuah u; daihnak kha duh u law nan hmuh khawh nakhnga fak piin i zuam u."},"15":{"text":"A dingmi cu Bawipa nih a zohkhenh hna i an aunak kha a theih;"},"16":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak a tuahmi kha cu a ral hna i cucaah anmah mi lila hmanh nih khan an philh hna."},"17":{"text":"Miding mi nih cun Bawipa kha an auh i an bia kha a ngaihpiak hna, an harnak chungin a chuah hna."},"18":{"text":"Lung a dongmi kha Bawipa nih a umpi hna i ruahchannak a ngei lomi kha a khamh hna."},"19":{"text":"Miṭha nih harnak tampi a in tawn, sihmanhsehlaw harnak a inmi chung khan Bawipa nih a khamh;"},"20":{"text":"Bawipa nih him tein a zohkhenh i a ruh pakhat hmanh a kiak lo.","ref":"Jhn 19.36"},"21":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu ṭhat lonak nih a thah hna lai, miding mi a huami hna cu dantatnak an ing lai."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih a sal cu a khamh hna lai; amah tangah aa dormi cu him tein an um lai."}}},"35":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A ka dohmi kha do ve hna law a ka tumi kha tu ve hna, Maw Bawipa .","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Na phaw le na ralthuam in i thuam law keimah bawmh ah i thawh tuah."},"3":{"text":"A ka dawitu hna kha na fei le na hreitlung in rak kham hna. Ka Khamhtu na si kha nangmah nih keimah cu ka hngalhter."},"4":{"text":"Thah a ka zalmi kha sung hna seh law ningzahnak phan hna seh. Keimah thah awkah khua a khangmi hna kha an khuakhanmi cu pakpalawng ah cang seh law"},"5":{"text":"thli nih a choihmi capawl bantuk si hna seh, Bawipa vancungmi nih a dawimi bantuk si hna seh."},"6":{"text":"An lam cu mui in nal seh law Bawipa vancungmi nih cun deng len hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Sullam zeihmanh um loin keimah foihnak ding caah rap an chiah i keimah tlaknak ding caah khor thukpi an cawh."},"8":{"text":"Asinain anmah nih an hngalh hlanah rawhnak nih a phanh hna lai i anmah chiahmi rap ah khan an i foih lai, anmah cawhmi khor ah khan an tla lai."},"9":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa ruangah cun kei cu kaa lawm lai i a ka khamh caah ka tha a nuam lai."},"10":{"text":"Ka lungthin dihlak in Bawipa cu ka thawh lai i, “Nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo! A dermi kha a ṭhawngmi hna kut chungin na huhphenh hna i sifakmi le retheimi kha mi hrem mi hrem hmangmi hna kut chungin na khamh hna,” ka ti lai."},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih sual an ka phawt i ka hngalh hrimhrim lomi sualnak kha an ka puh."},"12":{"text":"Ṭhatnak cu chiatnak in an ka lehrulh i ka hnabei a dong cikcek."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih an zawt tu ah cun ngaihchiatnak thuam kaa hruk i rawl hmanh ka ei lo; ka hawikom ca le ka unau caah lu fakpi khun in thla ka cam tawn bantukin, annih ca zongah cun ka cam."},"14":{"text":"A nu thih a ngaimi bantukin lukhun le ngaihchia in kaa chawk."},"15":{"text":"Harnak ka ton tikah an i lawm i an ka dum i nihchuak ah an ka saih; khuai nih khan heh tiah ngol loin an ka tuk."},"16":{"text":"Harnak kha an ka phakter i an ka nihsawh, an hacang lawng an ka rialhnawh."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa, zei can dah na zoh ko rih hna lai? An kut chungin ka chuah law hi chiandeih hna kut chung hin ka nunnak khamh ko."},"18":{"text":"Cun mizapi pumhnak ah kan lawmh lai i mizapi hmaiah cun kan thangṭhat lai."},"19":{"text":"Khi milihchim hna, ka ral hna khi, ka sungh ruangah an di riamhter hna hlah; sullam um loin a ka huami hna khi ka ngaihchiatnak an hmuh ruangah mit diriam in umter hna hlah.","ref":"Slm 69.4; Jhn 15.25"},"20":{"text":"Hawikom bantukin bia an chim lo, daihnak a duhmi hna kha lih a phunphun an puh lehlam hna."},"21":{"text":"Annih nih an au i, “Na tuahmi kha kan hmuh,” an ti."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa, nangmah nih hihi cu na hmuh cangmi a si. Cucaah dai tein um hlah, Maw Bawipa ; lamhlatpi ah um sawh hlah."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa, i hlau law ka chanh tuah; ka Pathian, tho law ka bia ka chimpiak tuah."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa, nang cu na ding, cucaah misual lo ka si kha ka thanhpiak tuah; ka Pathian, ka ral cu ka cungah diriam in umter hna hlah."},"25":{"text":"“A cungah tlung seh, ti kan duhmi te kha a cungah a tlung cang,” titer hna hlah. “Amah cu kan tei diam cang,” titer hna hlah."},"26":{"text":"Ka nganfah innak i a di a riammi kha sung cikcek hna seh law khuaruahhar vansang au in um hna seh; amah nakin kan ṭha deuh aa timi kha ningzahnak le hmaichiatnak nih zual hna seh."},"27":{"text":"Ka luat caah a lung aa lawmmi cu lawmhnak in au hna seh law, “ Bawipa cu a lianngan ko, a sal nih hlawhtlinnak a hmuh i amah cu a lawmhpi,” tiah chim lengmang hna seh."},"28":{"text":"Cun na dinnak kha ka thanh lai i chun nitlak in kan thangṭhat lai."}}},"36":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sualnak nih miṭhalo cu a lungchung thukpi ah bia a chimh i Pathian kha a hlawt i a ṭih lo.","title":"Minung Sualning David Hla","ref":"Rom 3.18"},"2":{"text":"Amah le amah sang tuk i aa ruah caah cun Pathian nih ka sualnak kha a hmu lai lo i sual a ka phaw lai lo tiah a ruah."},"3":{"text":"A kaa chuak bia cu bia ṭha lo le lih lawng an si i mifim si i thil ṭha tuah kha a ngol cang."},"4":{"text":"Ihkhun cung i a zau lio hmanh ah thil ṭha lo lawng kha a tuak, a tuahmi kha thil ṭha a um lo i thil ṭha lo kha a hua hna lo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, a fekmi na dawtnak cu van a tawng i zumhawktlak na sinak cu van a phan.","title":"Pathian Ṭhatnak"},"6":{"text":"Na dinnak cu tlang nganpi bantukin a fek i na biakhiahnak cu rilipi bantukin a thuk. Bawipa, nangmah nih minung le saram cu na zohkhenh hna."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, zeitluk in dah na dawtnak hi a sun! Na thla tangah mi nih dornak an hmuh."},"8":{"text":"Na inn in a chuakmi rawl kha duhdim tein an ei i na ṭhatnak tiva chung khan ti na pek hna."},"9":{"text":"Nang cu nunnak vialte hram na si; nangmah ceunak thawngin kannih nih ceunak kha kan hmuh."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah an hngalmi kha daw zungzal ko hna law a dingmi cungah khan ṭhatnak tuah zungzal ko."},"11":{"text":"Miruamkai nih khan ka tu hna hlah seh, miṭhalo nih khan ka zamter hna hlah seh."},"12":{"text":"Miṭhalo an rilhnak kha zohhmanh! Khika ah khin an ril, an tho kho ti lo."}}},"37":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna ruangah awlokchong in um hlah, ṭhat lonak a tuahmi kha hngar hna hlah;","title":"Miṭhalo Hna le Miṭha Hna Donghnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"a romi ramkung bantukin an lo lai i belhhring bantukin an uai lai."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu i bochan u law ṭhatnak kha tuah u; ram chungah hin um u law him tein khuasa u."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa kha i bochan u law nan lungthli tum kha an pek hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Na nunnak kha Bawipa pe tuah, amah kha i bochan law amah nih an bawmh lai."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhatnak kha ceunak bantukin a ceuter lai i na dinnak kha chunlai bantukin a ceuter lai."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa hmaiah cun dai tein um ko law zeidah a tuah lai ti kha lungsau in hngak ko; thil ṭhalo an i tinhmi a tuah kho lengmangmi hna le an rian ṭuannak ah a hlawh a tlingmi hna kong ah zei poi loin va um ko."},"8":{"text":"Thinhung in um hlah u, hrut sual hlah u! Lung rethei in um hlah u! Cu nih cun zeihmanh an ṭhathnem hna lai lo."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa aa bochanmi cu him tein ram chungah hin an um ko lai; sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu ṭhawl an si lai."},"10":{"text":"Luklak ah miṭhalo cu an lo ko lai, na kawl hna hmanh ah na hmu kho hna lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi toiah aa dormi cu ram chungah hin him tein an um lai i daihnak kha tlamtling tein an hmuh lai.","ref":"Mat 5.5"},"12":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih miṭha hrawhnak ding khua kha a khan i a hacang a rialhnawh."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun miṭhalopa cu a nihsawh men ko, zeicahtiah luklak ah a rawh lai kha a hngalh."},"14":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun an nam kha an i zuh i an likuk kha an i hruai i sifak le retheimi kha thah le miṭha mi nawn kha an duh;"},"15":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw anmah nam lila nih an keng ah a chunh hna lai i an likuk cu an kiak dih lai."},"16":{"text":"Miṭha nih a ngeihmi thil tlawmte cu miṭhalo nih a khonmi thil tampi nakin a ṭha deuh;"},"17":{"text":"zeicahtiah miṭhalopa cu Bawipa nih a thazang a chuh lai i miṭha cu a huhphenh lai."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih a nawl a zulmi cu a zohkhenh hna i ram cu anmah ta a si zungzal lai."},"19":{"text":"Caan ṭhalo a tlun tikah sifah an ing lai lo, mangṭam a tlun tikah ei awk a za an ngei lai."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu an thi lai; Bawipa ral cu ramlak pangpar bantuk in an lo lai; meikhu bantukin an ṭian lai."},"21":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun thil a cawi hna tikah a cham ṭhan ti hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭha cu vel a ngei i nun a siang."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih thluachuah a pekmi cu ram ram chungah hin him tein an um lai, sihmanhsehlaw chiat a serhmi cu ṭhawl an si lai."},"23":{"text":"Minung hi a kalnak ding lam a hmuhsaktu cu Bawipa a si, Amah duhnak a tuahmi cu a huhphenh hna."},"24":{"text":"A tluk sual zongah a ril lan lo, zeicahtiah Bawipa nih a kut in a thawh ṭhan."},"25":{"text":"Ka rak no i atu cu ka tar cang, asinain hi vialte chungah hin miṭha cu Bawipa nih a hlawt kha ka hmu bal lo i a fale zong rawl hal in an vah kha ka hmu bal lo."},"26":{"text":"Siang tein mi kha a pek zungzal hna i a coih zungzal hna, cun a fale kha thluachuahnak an si."},"27":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha mertak u law ṭhatnak kha tuah u; cun hi ram chungah hin nan um zungzal lai;"},"28":{"text":"zeicahtiah a hmaanmi thil kha Bawipa nih a duh i zumhtlak a simi a mi kha a kaltak bal hna lo. Annih cu a huhphenh zungzal hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo mi hna an tefa cu ṭhawl an si lai."},"29":{"text":"A dingmi cu ram chungah him tein an um lai i ram cu zungzal in anmah ta a si lai."},"30":{"text":"Mifim nih cun fimnak bia an chim i ahmaanmi bia kha an ka in a chuak."},"31":{"text":"A Pathian nawlbia kha a lung chungah aa chiah i zeitikhmanh ah a kaltak lo."},"32":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun miṭha kha aa ngiat aa ngiat i thah a zalh;"},"33":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih a ral kut chungah khan miṭha cu a kaltak lo, tazacuai a si zongah khan sual phawtnak a phakter lo."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa cu i bochan u law a nawl kha zul tuah u; ram kha co awkah thazang an pek hna lai i miṭhalo cu pawnchuah an si kha nan hmuh lai."},"35":{"text":"Miṭhalopa pakhat, mipuarhrang ngai a si i Lebanon sidar thingkung bantukin mi vialte a iap dih hna kha ka rak hmuh;"},"36":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw tlawmpal ah khin cuka ah cun ka va kal ṭhan i cu pa cu a rak um ti lo; ka kawl len nain ka hmu kho ti lo."},"37":{"text":"Miṭha khi zohhmanh u, miding khi zohhmanh u; daihnak mi cu tefa an ngei;"},"38":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw misual cu hrawh an si dih, an tefa cu hloh an si."},"39":{"text":"Bawipa nih miding cu a khamh hna i harnak caan ah a huhphenh hna."},"40":{"text":"A bawmh hna i a chuah hna; annih nih huhphenhnak hmuh awkah an fuh caah miṭhalo hna kut chung khan a khamh hna."}}},"38":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, na thinhung hlah law, ka si hlah. Na thinhun in dan ka tat hlah.","title":"Temhnak A Ingmipa Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Dan cu na ka tat cang i na ka hrem cang; na ka tuk cikcek cang."},"3":{"text":"Na thin a hun caah ṭhalo tein ka zaw; ka sual ruangah ka pum cu a dihlak in a zaw."},"4":{"text":"Ka sualnak tilet chungah ka pil i ka sualnak cu an rih caah tangah an ka hnuh."},"5":{"text":"Ka hruh caah ka hma cu a thu i a man."},"6":{"text":"Ka keng zong a kul dih i ka ril ko; chun nitlak ngaihchia in ka um."},"7":{"text":"Ka tak cu fak piin a lin i zual ngaiin ka zaw."},"8":{"text":"Ka tha a dih cikcek i ka ril ko, lungrethei le sivang in ka hram."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa, ka duhmi cu na hngalh; ka hramnak vialte cu na theih dih."},"10":{"text":"Ka lung a tor, ka tha a dih i ka mit a maw."},"11":{"text":"Ka hma le ka rung ruangah, ka hawi le ka innpa nih a naih hmanh an ka duh lo; ka chungkhat hmanh nih an ka hrial."},"12":{"text":"Thah a ka duhmi nih rap an ka chiahhnawh i ka cungah fahnak tlunter a duhmi nih khan, kan in hloh cang lai, tiah an ka tlerh; keimah hrawhnak ding kha chun nitlak in an tim."},"13":{"text":"Hnachet bantuk ka si i khua ka thei kho lo, holh aa bantuk ka si i ka holh kho lo;"},"14":{"text":"khua a theih lo ca i an chawnh tikah zeihmanh a let kho lomi hna bantuk ka si."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah kha kan bochan; Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah nih na ka leh lai."},"16":{"text":"Harnak ka in ruangah ka ral hna hi diriam in umter hna hlah, ka tluk hi an i porhlawtnak ah canter hlah."},"17":{"text":"Ka tlu dengmang i ka nganfahnak nih hin a ka tlaih peng ko."},"18":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu ka phuan hna. asinain lungrethei in ka um ṭhiamṭhiam."},"19":{"text":"Ka ral cu ngandam le thazang ṭhawng in an um ṭung; sullam um loin a ka huami an tam tuk."},"20":{"text":"Ahmaanmi thil kha tuah kaa zuam caah ṭhatnak cu chiatnak in a lehrulmi pawl nih khan an ka doh."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa, ka hlawt sawh hlah, ka Pathian, ka kaltak sawh hlah."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa ka khamhtu, atu ah ka bawm ko!"}}},"39":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Ka tuahmi ah khan kaa ralring lai ka lei kha sualnak ka tuahter lai lo; miṭhalo kha lamnai i an um lioah zeihmanh ka chim lai lo,” ka ti.","title":"Nganfahnak A Ingmipa Sual Phuannak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Holh loin ka um i bia pakhat hmanh ka chim lo, a ṭhami thil kong hmanh ka chim lo. Sihmanhsehlaw ka nganfah cu a karh chin i"},"3":{"text":"ka lungthin cu khuaruahharnak in a khat. Ka ruah deuh paoh ah ka lungretheihnak kha a zual chin,"},"4":{"text":"“ Bawipa, zei can dah ka nun rih lai? Zei tikah dah ka thih lai? Zeitluk tuan ah dah ka nunnak hi a dongh lai ka chim tuah,” ti hi hal loin ka um kho lo."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi zabok can men ah na ser! Nang na mit ah cun ka nun chung hi zei karlote bantuk a si ko. Minung hi voi khat thaw chem tluk men an si dih taktak ko;"},"6":{"text":"thlahawm menmen an si ko. An tuahmi vialte hi pakpalawng an si dih; chaw le va kha heh tiah an khon, sihmanhsehlaw a cotu ding cu aho an si kha an hngal lo."},"7":{"text":"Cu ti a si caah cun, Bawipa, zeidah kaa ruahchan khawhmi a um? Nangmah lawnglawng hi kaa ruahchanmi na si."},"8":{"text":"Ka sualnak vialte chung hin ka khamh law mihrut nih capo ah ka sai ti hna hlah seh."},"9":{"text":"Hi tlukin nganfahnak na ka inter caah dai tein ka um lai i bia pakhat hmanh ka chim lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Dan cu ka tat ti sawh hlah, na dantatnak in ka thi dengmang cang."},"11":{"text":"Minung cu a sualnak kha dantat awkah na sik tikah. a iang vialte kha a lo dih, minung hi thaw menmen a si taktak ko. Selah"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak tuah, kan nawlnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko; nangmah kan auh tikah dai tein ka umtak hlah. Ka pupa vialte hna bantukin, kei cu caan tawite chung lawng na khualpa cu ka si ko."},"13":{"text":"Thlan mual ka liam i ka um ti lo hlanah hin lunglawmhnak tlawmpalte tal ka hmuh nakhnga hnahnawk lo tein run ka umter ko."}}},"40":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa bawmhnak cu ka hngak lengmang i a donghnak ah ka aunak cu a ngaih i a theih.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla (Slm 70.1-5) David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ṭih a nungmi khor chung khan a ka chuah. nawncek khor chung khan a ka chuah Him tein lungpi cungah khan a ka ṭhutter i fek tein a ka umter."},"3":{"text":"Hla thar kha a ka cawnpiak, ka Pathian thangṭhatnak hla kha a ka cawnpiak. Hi thil cu mi tampi nih an hmuh lai i Bawipa kha an i bochan lai."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa kha aa bochan i siasal leiah aa mer lo i pathian taktak a si lomi a biami hna sinah aa fon lomi cu lunglawmmi an si."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah nih kan caah thil tampi na tuah; nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo. Nangmah nih lam ṭhaṭha tampi khua na kan khanpiak. An dihlak in chim i tim ning law a chim hmanh ka chim cawk hna hnga lo."},"6":{"text":"Raithawinak le pekchanhmi thil hi na duhmi an si lo, biakṭheng cungah a pum in khanghmi thawinak sa hi na kan halmi a si lo, kan sualnak thianhnak ca i raithawinak tuah zong hi na kan halmi an si lo, asinain nangmah nih khan na bia kan theih khawh nakhnga ding caah hna tu kha na kan pek i","ref":"Heb 10.5-7"},"7":{"text":"cucaah cun, “Hika ah hin ka um ko; keimah cawnpiaknak ding caah na chiahmi cu Nawlbia cauk chungah an um ko."},"8":{"text":"Ka Pathian, zeitluk in dah na duhnak tuah cu ka duh! Na cawnpiaknak cu ka lung chungah kaa chiah hna,” tiah kan leh."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa na mi an i pumhnak ah, na kan khamhnak thawng ṭha kha ka chim. A chim cu a ngol in ka ngol bal lai lo, ti kha na hngalh."},"10":{"text":"Khamhnak thawngṭha hi keimah ca lawngah kaa chiah bal lo, zumhawktlak na sinak le na kan bawmhnak hi ka chim zungzal. Na dawtnak a fekmi le zumhawktlak na sinak hi na mi vialte an i pumhnak ah chim loin ka um bal lo."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa, ka cungah na zaangfahnak a dong lai lo ti kha ka hngalh. Na dawtnak le zumhawktlak na sinak nih him tein an ka umter zungzal lai."},"12":{"text":"Harnak tam tuk nih an ka dum — a rel in rel cawk an si lo. Ka sualnak nih a ka phak cang i khua ka hmu kho ti lo; ka lu cung sam nakin ka sualnak cu an tam deuh, ka lung ṭhawnnak a dih cang.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam (Slm 70)"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, ka khamh ko sawh, atu ah ka bawm ko!"},"14":{"text":"Thah a ka zalmi kha sung cikcek hna seh law i tuai dih hna seh. Harnak ka inmi ruangah aa lawmmi cu an hnulei ah i let hna seh law ningzak in um hna seh."},"15":{"text":"A ka nihsawhtu pawl kha an sunghnak nih khan lungdong cikcek in umter hna seh!"},"16":{"text":"Nangmah sinah a rami vialte cu lunglawm le thanuam in um hna seh. Na khamhnak a duhmi vialte nih, “ Bawipa cu a lianngan hringhran ko,” ti zungzal hna seh."},"17":{"text":"Kei cu ka si a fak i ka re a thei, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa, nangmah nih na ka ruah ko. Nangmah cu ka Khamhtu le a ka Bawmtu na si — rau sawh hlah, Maw ka Pathian!"}}},"41":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sifak zawn a ruatmi cu lunglawmmi a si, harnak chung i a um tikah Bawipa nih a bawmh lai.","title":"A Zawmipa Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih a huhphenh lai i a nunnak kha a zuah lai; ram chungah lunglawm in a umter lai i a ral hna kut chungah a kaltak lai lo."},"3":{"text":"A zawt tikah Bawipa nih a bawmh lai i a damter ṭhan lai."},"4":{"text":"“Nangmah cungah ka sual cang, Bawipa ; ka zaangfah law ka damter ko,” ka ti."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral nih an ka congoih. An i thawh i, “Zeitik dah a thih lai i philh a si lai,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Keimah zoh i a rami kha lung thiang in an ra lo, ka thangchiatnak lawng kha an hlat i an chuah tikah a kenkip ah an chim."},"7":{"text":"A ka huami nih khan a thli tein an ka congoih, ka ca i a ṭha lo bik ding kha an ruat."},"8":{"text":"An i thawh i, “A zawt a zual ko, a ihkhun in a tho bal ti lai lo,” an ti."},"9":{"text":"Ka hawi ṭha bik, ka zumh bikmi, rawl a ka hrawng lengmangmi hmanh kha ka ral ah a cang.","ref":"Mat 26.23; Mar 14.18; Luk 22.21; Jhn 13.18"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa, ka zaangfah law damnak ka pe ṭhan ko; cun ka ral cu teirul ka cham ṭhan hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Cu tikah ka cungah na lung aa lawm ti le ka ral nih an ka tei lai lo ti kha ka hngalh lai."},"12":{"text":"Ahmaanmi kha ka tuah caah na ka bawmh lai; na hmaika ah a zungzal in na ka umter lai."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu thangṭhat u sih! Atu le a zungzal in thangṭhat u sih? Amen! Amen!","ref":"Slm 106.48"}}},"42":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sazuk nih rial tidai a ngaih bantukin Maw Pathian nangmah cu kan ngai.","title":"BU HNIHNAK (Slm 42 in 72 tiang) Sal I A Tangmi Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Maw a nungmi Pathian, nangmah cu tihal in kan hal; zeitik ah dah na umnak ah ka hun khawh lai i kan biak khawh lai?"},"3":{"text":"Chun nitlak zan khuadei in ka ṭap i ka mitthli lawng kha ka rawl cu a si ko; ka ral nih, “Na Pathian cu khuazei ah dah a si kun?” tiah atu le atu an ka ti lengmang."},"4":{"text":"Hlanlio kong kha ka ruah tikah ka lung a leng; Pathian inn i mi zapi he kan rak kal i kan kal tikah keimah i ka rak hrui hna i Pathian thangṭhat in lunglawm le thanuam in hla kan rak sak i kan rak au kha ka ruah tikah ka lung a leng hringhran."},"5":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka ngaih a chiat? Zeicahdah ka lungre a theih? Pathian cu kaa bochan ṭhan lai i ka Khamhtu le ka Pathian cu ka thangṭhat ṭhan lai."},"6":{"text":"Ka lungre a thei, cucaah cun amah cu ka hngalh ṭhan; kaa thuhnak Jordan tiva hrawn, Hermon Tlang le Mizar tlang pawngah amah cu ka hngalh ṭhan lai."},"7":{"text":"Tithuk nih tithuk kha a chawnh; Pathian tisor cu a huk in an huk! Annih cu ka nunnak a leh chihtu ngaihchiatnak tilet an si."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih a dawtnak fek cu nifa kan sinah langhter ko seh! Amah cu zan fate in hla in thangṭhat ning law ka nunnak a ka pe ṭhantu Pathian sinah cun thlacam ko ning."},"9":{"text":"Pathian ka lungpi cu ka thawh i, “Zeicahdah na ka philh? Ka ral nih an ka hremnak hi zeicahdah ka in zungzal ko lai?"},"10":{"text":"An ka nihsawhnak nih a ka hrilh cang, annih nih, ‘Khuazei ah dah na Pathian cu a um kun?’ tiah an ka ti chih lengmang,” ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka ngaih a chiat? Zeicahdah ka lungre a theih? Pathian cu kaa bochan ṭhan lai i ka Khamhtu le ka Pathian cu ka thangṭhat ṭhan lai."}}},"43":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian, ka sual lo kha ka thanhpiak law Pathian zei i a rel lomi hna lakah hin ka bia ka chimpi tuah; lihchim hmangmi le miṭhalo hna kut chung hin ka chuah tuah.","title":"Sal I A Tangmi Thlacamnak (Slm 42 peh)"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah cu a ka hupphengtu Pathian na si; zeicahdah na ka kaltak? Ka ral nih an ka hremnak hi zeicahdah ka in zungzal ko lai?"},"3":{"text":"Na ceunak le na biatak cu run thlah hna law, ka hruai hna seh na tlang thiang Zion ah cun ka kalpi ṭhan hna seh law na umnak na biakinn ah cun ka hruai hna seh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Pathian, nangmah nih lunglawmhnak le thanuamnak na ka pek caah, na biakṭheng ah cun ka hung kal lai; ka tingtang cu kaa tum lai i nangmah thangṭhatnak cu hla in ka sa lai, Maw Pathian, ka Pathian."},"5":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka ngaih a chiat? Zeicahdah ka lungre a theih? Pathian cu kaa bochan ṭhan lai i ka Khamhtu le ka Pathian cu ka thangṭhat ṭhan lai."}}},"44":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, hlan lio pi ah na rak tuah bantukin kan pupa hna chan ah thil lianngan na tuahmi kha kan hna hrimhrim in kan theih i kan pupa hna zong nih an kan chimh:","title":"Huhphenhnak Ca Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Cu thil lianngan na tuahmi hna cu, zeitindah nangmah hrimhrim nih hi ram chung lawkihmi kha na dawi hna i an ram ah cun na mi kha nan umter hna ti le zeitindah phundang mi cu dan na tat hna i na mi tu cu na ṭhanchoter hna, ti hi a si."},"3":{"text":"Hi ram cu na mi nih an nam in an teimi a si lo, anmah ṭhawnnak in an teimi zong a si lo; nangmah lianhngannak le ṭhawnnak in a si i nangmah nih na dawt hna langhternak caah an sin i na umhnawh hnanak tu nih khan hi ram cu a tei."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka siangpahrang le ka Pathian na si; nangmah nih na mi cu teinak na pek hna."},"5":{"text":"Na ṭhawnnak in kan ral cu kan tei hna; nangmah nih na kan umpinak thawngin kan ral cu kan tei hna."},"6":{"text":"Keimah Khamhtu dingah ka li kha kaa bochan lo i ka thal zong kaa bochan lo"},"7":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih kan ral hna sinin na kan khamh i a kan huatu kha na kan teipiak hna."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan in thangṭhat zungzal ko lai i kan in lawmh zungzal ko lai."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu maw Pathian, na kan hlawt cang i kan ral nih khan an kan tei cang; kan ralkap hna kha na kalpi ti hna lo."},"10":{"text":"Kan ral hna hmaiah na kan zamter i kan thil kha an i lak."},"11":{"text":"Tuu an thah hna bantukin an kan thah i ram dang ah na kan ṭhek dih."},"12":{"text":"Na mi cu man tlawmte ah na kan zuar i cu na kan zuarnak ah cun na miakmi zeihmanh a um lo."},"13":{"text":"Kan cung i na tuahmi kha kan innpa nih an hmuh i an kan nihsawh i capo ah an kan saih."},"14":{"text":"Miphun hna lakah zahpi awk thil ah na kan ser; kanmah serhsatnak ah an lu kha an ka thinhnawh."},"15":{"text":"Kan ral hna le a kan huatu hna nih an ka nihsawhnak le an ka zawmhtaihnak ka theihmi ruangah hin, hmaichia in ka um zungzal i ningzahnak nih a ka khuh zungzal.","merge":"16"},"17":{"text":"Kannih nih cun kan in philh lo na le kanmah he na sermi na biakamnak kha kan rawk lo nain. hi thil vialte hi kan cungah a tlung."},"18":{"text":"Na sinah zumhawktlak loin kan um lo, Na nawl ngai loin kan um fawn lo."},"19":{"text":"Asinain sahrang lakah na kan kaltak i a thuk bik muihnak chungah na kan chiahtak ṭhiamṭhiam."},"20":{"text":"Kan Pathian kha biak kan in ngol i ramdang pathian sinah thla kan cam a si ahcun,"},"21":{"text":"nangmah nih na hmuh ṭheoṭheo hnga, zeicahtiah minung lungthin chung biathli cu na hngalh dih."},"22":{"text":"Asinain thah kan si thluangthluan cu nangmah ruangah a si i thah awk tuu bantukin tuah kan si cu nangmah ruangah a si.","ref":"Rom 8.36"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa, i hlau tuah! Zeicahdah naa hngilh? Tho tuah, a zungzal in kan hlawt hlah."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahdah na kan thuhtak? Kan inmi temhnak le harnak kha philh hlah."},"25":{"text":"Vawlei ah na kan hrilh cang; leidip lakah kan ril ko."},"26":{"text":"Tho law kan bawm tuah! A fekmi na dawtnak ruangah kan khamh tuah!"}}},"45":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi hla siangpahrang ka phuah ah hin, ka lungthin cu holh dawh in a khat; ka lei cu ca ṭial thiammi cafung bantuk a si.","title":"Siangpahrang Ṭhitumnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Pa vialte lakah pa dawh bik na si, bia chim a thiam ngaingaimi na si; Pathian nih zungzal in thluachuahnak an pek!"},"3":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi siangpahrang, na vainam kha i bei tuah; nang cu a ṭhawngmi le a liannganmi siangpahrang na si."},"4":{"text":"Biatak le biading kha hmunhter awkah na tei tiang lianhngannak in hmailei ah kal tuah. Na ṭhawnnak nih teinak ngan pipi an hmuhpiak lai."},"5":{"text":"Na thal cu an hriam i na ral cu an lung tiang a taih hna; miphun kip kha na hmaiah an tlu."},"6":{"text":"Pathian nih an pekmi bawiṭhutdan cu zungzal in a hmun lai! Na ram cu dinnak in na uk;","ref":"Heb 1.8-9"},"7":{"text":"a hmaanmi thil ṭha kha na duh i a ṭha lomi thil kha na huat. Cucaah cun Pathian, na Pathian nih khan a rak in thim i midang nakin tam deuh in lunglawmhnak kha an toih."},"8":{"text":"Mura zihmui le aloes zihmui le kassia zihmui in na puan cu na namter hna i vui ho in sakmi siangpahrang inn ah khan hla dawh tum thiam nih an in conglawmh."},"9":{"text":"Na inn i a ummi bawinu hna lakah khan siangpahrang fanu zong an um, cun na bawiṭhutdan orhlei kamah khan siangpahrang bawinu cu a dir, sui ṭha bik in sermi hlawn in aa ṭamh."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang bawipa i a ngaknu, ka chimmi hi ngai tuah — na mi le na rualchan kha philh ta hna."},"11":{"text":"Naa dawh caah siangpahrang nih an duh lai, amah cu na bawi a si, a nawl kha va ngai tuah."},"12":{"text":"Tair mi nih laksawng an in put lai, mirum nih na lung tluanter an i zuam lai."},"13":{"text":"Siangpahrang fanu cu siangpahrang inn chungah cun a um — a vaa dawh hringhran dah, A puan cu sui la in an tah."},"14":{"text":"A puan dawh ngaimi he cun siangpahrang sinah khan an hei kalpi, a mawle nih khan an zulh i anmah zong cu siangpahrang sin tiang an kal ve."},"15":{"text":"Lunglawm le thanuam in an ra i siangpahrang bawipa inn ah cun an lut."},"16":{"text":"Ka siangpahrang bawipa, nangmah nih fapa tampi na ngeih hna lai i na pupa hna cu an hmun an rolh hna lai; nangmah nih vawlei dihlak uktu ah khan na ser hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Na minthannak cu ka hla nih a nunter zungzal lai i mi kip nih zungzal thluangthluan in an in thangṭhat lai."}}},"46":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu kan i dornak le kan thazang a si, harnak caan ah a kan bawm zungzaltu a si.","title":"Pathian He Kan Umṭi"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah cun vawlei cu i hnin in tlang cu rili chungah tla hna hmanh seh law ka thin a phang lai lo;"},"3":{"text":"rili tilet cu tho in awn hmanh seh, tlang zong i hnin dih hna hmanh seh law ka thin a phang lai lo."},"4":{"text":"Pathian khua, Cung Nung Bik Pathian inn thiang ah lawmhnak a ratpitu tiva pakhat a um."},"5":{"text":"Pathian cu khuapi chungah cun a um i zeihmanh nih a hrawk bal lai lo; zingka tein amah bawmh awkah a ra lai."},"6":{"text":"Miphun cu a ther in an ther, pennak ram cu an i hnin, Pathian aw cu a thang i vawlei cu ti ah a cang dih."},"7":{"text":"Lian Ngan Bawipa nih a kan umpi, Jakob Pathian cu kan himnak a si. Selah"},"8":{"text":"Ra law zohhmanh, Bawipa i a tuahmi hi; Zohhmanh zeitluk khuaruahhar thil hna dah leicung ah hin a tuah."},"9":{"text":"Hi vawleicung pumpi ah ral cu a daihter dih ko hna, likuk cu a khiah hna i fei cu a hrawh dih hna, phaw hna cu mei in a khangh dih hna."},"10":{"text":"“Raldohnak kha ngol u” a ti hna, “Cun keimah cu Bawipa ka si hi hngal tuah u, miphun vialte hna a uktu cu ka si i, vawlei pumpi ah a ngan bikmi cu ka si,” a ti."},"11":{"text":"Lianhngannak he a khatmi Bawipa cu kan sinah a um; Jakob Pathian cu kan himnak a si. Selah"}}},"47":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi vialte hna, lunglawm in nan zapei beng tuah u, hla dawhdawh in Pathian cu thangṭhat u!","title":"Uktu Bawipa Ngan Bik"},"2":{"text":"Cung Nung Bik Bawipa cu ṭih awk a si, amah cu a liannganmi siangpahrang vawlei cung vialte uktu a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi kip kha kan tangah a chiah hna i miphun hna uknak kha a kan pek."},"4":{"text":"Kan umnak ram hi amah nih a kan thimpiakmi a si; a dawtmi a mi nih kan i porhlawt ngaimi ram a si."},"5":{"text":"Pathian cu a bawiṭhutdan cungah cun a hung kai; Bawipa a hung kai lioah cun lunglawmhnak au thawng le muko tum thawng a thang."},"6":{"text":"Pathian cu hla in thangṭhat tuah u, kan siangpahrang cu thangṭhat tuah u."},"7":{"text":"Pathian cu vawlei cung dihlak siangpahrang a si; amah cu hla in thangṭhat tuah u."},"8":{"text":"A thiangmi a bawiṭhutdan cungah Pathian cu a ṭhu, miphun kip kha a uk hna."},"9":{"text":"Miphun dang hna an uktu bawi hna cu, Abraham Pathian mi hna bang khan hmunkhat ah an i pum. Ralkap vialte hna phaw cu Bawipa ta an si; amah nih zeizong vialte kha a uk dih."}}},"48":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu a lian a ngan i fak piin thangṭhat awk a si; kan Pathian khualipi chungah le a tlang thiang cungah thangṭhat awk a si.","title":"Pathian Khualipi Zion"},"2":{"text":"Pathian tlang Zion cu a sang i aa dawh; a liannganmi siangpahrang khuapi nih vawlei cung vialte kha lawmhnak a pek hna.","ref":"Mat 5.35"},"3":{"text":"Pathian cu a chungah a um caah a ralhau chungah khan himnak a um."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang kha an i pum i Zion Tlang tuk awkah an ra."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an hmuh tikah an lau i an thin a phang i an zam."},"6":{"text":"Ṭihnak le lungretheihnak nih a tlaih hna i nau nganfah a ingmi nu bantukin an um."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih nichuahlei thli in lawng ngan pipi kha a hrawh hna."},"8":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Bawipa kan Pathian khualipi chungah, Pathian nih a tuahmi thil cu a theih in kan rak theih. asinain atu cu a hmuh in kan hmuh cang; khuapi cu him tein a zohkhenh zungzal lai."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, a fekmi na dawtnak kong kha, na biakinn chungah kan ruat."},"10":{"text":"Khuazakip ah nangmah cu an in thangṭhat i na minthannak nih vawlei cung kha a cul dih. Dinnak in na uk hna;"},"11":{"text":"Zion mi cu i lawm hna seh! Na biakhiahnak cu ahmaanmi an si, Judah ram chung khua ah lawmhnak um hna seh."},"12":{"text":"Zion tlang ah khan i chawk u law a inn sang kha rel hna u,"},"13":{"text":"a vampang kha ngia hna u law a ralhau kha ṭha tein zoh hna u; cu ti nan zoh i nan ngiat ahcun, nanmah nan tefa hna kha"},"14":{"text":"Pathian cu a zungzal in kan Pathian a si i hmailei i a ra ding caan vialte ah a kan hruai lai, tiah nan chimh khawh hna lai."}}},"49":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi vialte hna, hihi thei tuah u, Khuazakip i a um mi hna, ngai tuah u,","title":"Rum I Bochan Pakpalawng A Si"},"2":{"text":"a hme a ngan, a rum sifak, nan dihlak in ngai tuah u."},"3":{"text":"Ahmaanmi khua ka ruat lai i a fimmi bia ka chim lai."},"4":{"text":"Bia thuk kha ka ruat hna lai i tingtang tum pah in a sullam kha ka fianter hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Ka ral miṭhalo hna, an rumnak aa bochan i an chawva aa porhlawmi nih an ka dum tikah ka thin a phang lo.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Minung nih cun zeitikhmanh ah amah le amah aa tlan kho lo; a nunnak man kha Pathian a cham kho lo;"},"8":{"text":"zeicahtiah minung nunnak man cu a sung tuk. A pek khawhmi cu"},"9":{"text":"thlan chungin a luattertu le zungzal in a nuntertu ah a zaa bal lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Hihi philh hlah: mifim zong mihrut bantukin an thi ve ko lai i an chaw le an va cu an fale kha an roh ve ko hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Thlan cu zungzal in an umnak ding hmun a si ko lai i cuka ah cun a zungzal in an um ko lai. Hmun le ram kha an rak ngei ko lai nain an chaw le an va cu midang sin i an kaltak a hau ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"12":{"text":"Mi cu a lianhngannak nih thihnak in a khamh kho lo; saram bantukin a thi ve ko lai."},"13":{"text":"Anmah le anmah aa bochanmi, an rumnak cung i a hna a ngammi hna khi an cungah zeidah a tlung ti kha zoh hmanh u."},"14":{"text":"Tuu bantukin a thi dingin ruah an si cang i an tuukhal cu thihnak a si lai. Miding mi nih khan zinglei ah an tei hna lai i mithi hna ram ah an pum cu a thu a man lai, cuka cu an inn in aa hlatmi hmun a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu Pathian nih a ka khamh lai; thihnak ṭhawnnak chungin a ka chuah lai."},"16":{"text":"Mizeimaw nih a rum i a chawva kha a ṭhan chin lengmang tikah, na thinphang hlah;"},"17":{"text":"a thih tikah zeihmanh aa phorh kho hlei lai lo, a chawva nih thlan ah an zul kho lai lo."},"18":{"text":"Hi vawleicung a nun chungah hin saduhthah in nung kho hmanh seh law khua awng a ton ruangah thangṭhatnak hmu hmanh seh law"},"19":{"text":"a thi cangmi a pupa hna sinah khan a kal ve ko lai i cuka cu zungzal in muihnak a umnak hmun a si ko."},"20":{"text":"Mi cu lianhngannak nih thihnak in a khamh kho lo; saram bantukin a thi ve ko lai."}}},"50":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Pathian Bawipa nih bia a chim; vawlei cu a dihlak in nichuahlei in nitlaklei tiang a auh.","title":"Biaknak Taktak"},"2":{"text":"Pathian cu Zion in ni bangin a rung tlang, dawhnak ah a tlingmi khua chung cun a rung tlang."},"3":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu a ra lio, sihmanhsehlaw dai tein a rat cu a si lai lo, a alh hluahmahmi mei a hmaiah khan a um i ṭih a nungmi thlichia nih a zual."},"4":{"text":"A mi kha bia a ceih hna i van le vawlei kha tehte ah a auh hna."},"5":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Zumhawktlak a simi keimah sinah raithawinak in biakamnak a tuahmi ka mi hna kha ka sinah pum hna u,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Van nih khin, “Pathian cu a ding, amah hrimhrim kha biaceihtu a si,” tiah an chim."},"7":{"text":"“Ka mi hna, ka bia ngai u law bia ka chim lai; Israel, nangmah cu fiang tein kan hngalhter lai. Pathian cu keimah hi ka si i keimah cu na Pathian ka si."},"8":{"text":"Nan ka pek zungzalmi raithawinak le khanghthawinak ruangah kan sik hna a si lo."},"9":{"text":"Nan lo chung nan cawtum hna le nan meheh run chung meheh hna kha ka herhmi an si lo,"},"10":{"text":"zeicahtiah ramlak i a ummi saram vialte hi keimah ta an si dih i tlang thong khat cung i a tlongmi saṭil vialte khi keimah ta an si dih."},"11":{"text":"Ramlak i a ummi va vialte cu keimah ta an si i lo lak i a ummi thilnung vialte zong keimah ta an si dih."},"12":{"text":"“Ka rawl ṭam seh law kan chim hna lai lo, zeicahtiah vawlei le a cung i a ummi thil vialte cu keimah ta an si dih."},"13":{"text":"Cawtum sa cu ka ei hna maw? Meheh thi cu ka din maw?"},"14":{"text":"Pathian sinah lawmhnak chim cu nan raithawinak si seh law Lianngan Bik cu kan in pek lai tiah nan i kammi pekchanh awk vialte kha pechan ko u."},"15":{"text":"Harnak a phak tikah ka au u, kan khamh hna lai i nan ka thangṭhat lai,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih miṭhalo cu a thawh hna i, “Zeicahdah ka nawlbia cu nan ciah len ko? Zeicahdah ka biakamnak kong cu nan chim len ko?"},"17":{"text":"Kan chimhhrin hna lai, ka ti tikah nan duh ṭung lo, ka nawlbia kha nan hlawt ko ṭung hna."},"18":{"text":"Mifir nan hmuh tikah a hawi ah nan i cang i vacung pa duhmi hna he nan i kom."},"19":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak bia chim kha nan i tim zungzal i lihchim kha a sum in nan i sum lo."},"20":{"text":"Nanmah nan unau congoih kha nan i tim zungzal, midang sual kawl lawng kha nan duh."},"21":{"text":"Hi vialte hi nan tuah i keimah nih cun zeihmanh ka chim lo, cucaah nanmah bantuk ah nan ka ruah. Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu kan sik cang hna lai i thil kha fiang tein kan hngalhter cang hna lai."},"22":{"text":"“Zei i a ka rel lomi hna, hihi ngai tuah u, nan ngaih lo ahcun kan hrawh hna lai i ahohmanh nih an in khamh kho hna lai lo."},"23":{"text":"Lawmhnak chim hi keimah upatnak thawinak cu a si, ka nawl a ngaimi cu ka khamh hrimhrim hna lai,” a ti."}}},"51":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian, a fekmi na dawtnak ruangah ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei ko; na zaangfahnak a ngan caah ka sualnak cu ka thianhpiak ko hna.","title":"Ngaihthiamnak Thlacam (2Sam 12.1-15)"},"2":{"text":"Ka ṭhat lonak cu ka ṭawlpiak hna law ka sualnak cu ka thianhpiak ko hna."},"3":{"text":"Ka palhnak cu kaa hngal i ka sualnak cu kaa thei zungzal ko."},"4":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu, nangmah cungah, nangmah cung hrimhrim ah a si i a ṭhalo ah na ruahmi kha ka tuah. Cucaah cun bia na ka ceih tikah na hmaan ko i sual na ka phawt tikah na ding ko.","ref":"Rom 3.4"},"5":{"text":"Sual cia in hrin ka si, ka nu nih a ka pawi ah khan, misual ka si cang."},"6":{"text":"Zumhawktlak lungthin hi na duhmi a si, ka lung chung hi na fimnak in khahter ko."},"7":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu ka hnawhpiak law ka thiang lai, ka ṭawl law hawhra nakin ka rang deuh lai."},"8":{"text":"Lunglawmhnak le thanuamnak aw thawng cu ka theihter law na ka khiah i na ka hrilh cang nain ka lung aa lawm ṭhan lai."},"9":{"text":"Ka sualnak cu na mit chinhkanh ko hna law ka ṭhat lonak vialte cu ka hnawhpiak dih ko hna."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka chungah hin lungthin thar ka serpiak law a thar le zumhtlak a simi ruahnak ka chungah chia ko."},"11":{"text":"Na umnak hmun khan ka ṭhawl hlah, na thiang thlarau kha ka lakkanh hlah."},"12":{"text":"Na khamhnak chungin a chuakmi lawmhnak kha ka pe ṭhan law ka lungthin cu nangmah nawl zulh duhmi ah ser ko."},"13":{"text":"Cu tikah misual mi kha na nawlbia cu ka cawnpiak hna lai i nangmah leiah an i mer ṭhan lai."},"14":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka khamhtu, ka nunnak hi ka zuah ko sawh law, na dinnak hi lunglawm tein ka thanh lai."},"15":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, biachim ka bawm law nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai."},"16":{"text":"Raithawinak hi na duhmi an si lo, rak si hna seh law cu ka rak in pek ko hnga; na lawmhmi cu khangh thawinak zong hi a si lo."},"17":{"text":"Ka raithawinak cu toidornak lungthin hi a si, maw Pathian, toidornak lungthin le nawl ngaimi lungthin hi na hlaw lai lo."},"18":{"text":"Maw Pathian, Zion cu zaangfah law bawm tuah; Jerusalem kulhnak vampang cu remh ṭhan hna."},"19":{"text":"Khi tikah ahmaanmi raithawinak le khangh thawinak hna ah cun naa lawm lai i na biakṭheng cungah cawtum cu an thawi hna lai."}}},"52":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi liannganpa, zeicahdah ṭhat lonak na tuahmi cu naa porhlawt? Pathian dawtnak cu a fek ko.","title":"Pathian Biaceihnak le Velngeihnak (1Sam 22.9-10)"},"2":{"text":"Midang hrawhnak ding caah khua na khang lengmang, na lei cu a harmi nam bantuk a si, lih lawng kha na chim ṭualmal ko."},"3":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha ṭhatnak nakin na duh deuh i biatak chim nakin lih chim kha na duh deuh."},"4":{"text":"Na bia in mi fahnak pek kha na duhmi a si, nang cu milip na si."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih an hrawh zungzal cang lai; an tlaih lai i na thlam chungin an chuah lai, a nungmi hna ram in an dawi lai."},"6":{"text":"Miding nih hihi an hmuh lai i an ṭih lai, an in nihsawh lai i,"},"7":{"text":"“Himnak hmuhnak caah Pathian aa bochan lomipa hi zohhmanh u, Pathian kha i bochan loin a rumnak pi tu kha aa bochan i a ṭhat lonak tu ah khan himnak a um, tiin a ruah,” an in ti lai."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu Pathian inn pawng i a khomi oliv kung bantuk ka si; a fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in kaa bochan zungzal."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na tuahmi thil ruangah kan lawmh zungzal lai; na mi hna lakah nangmah ṭhatnak kha ka chim zungzal lai."}}},"53":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun an i thawh i, “Pathian a um lo,” an ti. An dihlak in an thu, thil ṭhalo kha an tuah, ahmaanmi thil a tuahmi ahohmanh an um lo.","title":"Minung Sualning (Slm 14) David Hla","ref":"Rom 3.10-12"},"2":{"text":"Pathian nih vancung khin minung kha, Aho tal a fim i Pathian a kawlmi an um hnga maw tiin a run zoh."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an dihlak in an pial cang, an dihlak in an chiatlei ah an i tluk; pakhat hmanh thil hmaan a tuahmi an um lo, pakhat taktak hmanh an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Pathian nih, “An hngal hnga lo maw? Ṭhat lonak a tuahmi hi mihrut maw an si dih ko hnga? Ka mi kha an ramh hna i cucu an i cawmnak ah an hman, ka sinah thla an cam lo,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih nan ral hna cu an ruh kha a ṭhek dih hna caah an thin a phang ngaingai lai; hmasa i an thin a rak phan tawnning bantuk sawhsawh kha si loin atu cu an thin a phang taktak lai. Annih cu a hlawt cang hna caah an sung cikcek lai."},"6":{"text":"Israel khamhnak cu Zion in ra seh ti ka hei duh hringhran dah! Pathian nih a mi cu rumnak a pek ṭhan hna tikah Jakob tefa cu an lung aa lawm lai, Israel mi cu an tha a nuam lai."}}},"54":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na ṭhawnnak in ka khamh ko; na thazang in ka luatter ko.","title":"Ral Kut Chungin Himnak Ca Thlacamnak David Hla (1Sam 23.19 ; 26.1)"},"2":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thlacamnak hi ka theihpiak tuah, ka chimmi bia hi ka ngaihpiak tuah,"},"3":{"text":"Mi lungpuam hna cu keimah doh awkah an ra, mipuarhrang hna nih thah an ka zalh — Pathian zei i a rel lomi hna nih khan thah an ka zalh."},"4":{"text":"Pathian cu a ka bawmtu a si kha ka hngalh, Bawipa cu a ka chanhtu a si kha ka hngalh."},"5":{"text":"Pathian nih ka ral cu anmah ṭhat lonak lila khan dantat ko hna seh! Amah cu zumhawktlak a si caah a hrawh hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu na ṭhat caah lunglawm tein thawinak cu kan pek lai i na sinah lawmhnak ka langhter lai."},"7":{"text":"Ka harnak vialte chungin na ka chuah i ka ral an sungh cu ka hmuh hna."}}},"55":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak law kan nawlnak cu ka hlonhpiak hlah.","title":"Leirawi Hmangmi Ruang Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka bia kha ka ngaihpiak law ka let tuah; lungrethei in ka baa tuk hringhran cang."},"3":{"text":"Ka ral nih an ka tlerhnak le miṭhalo nih an ka hremnak nih ka lungre an ka theihter. Ka cungah harnak an tlunter; ka cungah an thin a hung i an ka huat."},"4":{"text":"Ka lung cu ṭihnak in a khat, an ka thah sual lai ti kha ka phang tuk."},"5":{"text":"Ka ṭih tuk ah a ther in ka ther i ka luthlung in ka kechik tiang ka ther dih."},"6":{"text":"“Ṭhuro bangin thla cu ngei ning law ka zuang hnga i ka vaa din hnga!"},"7":{"text":"Lamhlapi ah khin ka zuang hnga i ramlak ah inn ka vaa sak hnga."},"8":{"text":"Thlichia le ruahpi chung hin dornak hmun kha khulrang in ka hmuh ko hnga,” ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa, annih cu hrawk hna law an biachimmi cu tuainak ah canter; khuapi chungah ka hmuhmi thil cu zaang-ennak le i tuainak a si."},"10":{"text":"Chunzan in khuapi cu a kulhnak hau cungin an chawhhnawh lengmang; harnak le thil ṭhalo tuahnak in a khat."},"11":{"text":"A kenkip ah rawhnak a um, a chung lam hna cu pakhat le pakhat i hremnak le hlennak in a khat."},"12":{"text":"A ka nihsawhtu hi ka ral si seh law cu, ka in khawh ko hnga, ka cung i tluang a khawng lentu hi a ka dohtu kha si seh law cu, a ka hmuh khawh lonak hmun ah ka thuhtak diam ko hnga;"},"13":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw hi bantukin ka cungah rian a ṭuantu cu ka hawi, ka rianṭuan hawi le keimah he aa naih ngaimi ka hawikom na si tikah hin a fak tuk hringhran in ka thei."},"14":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat bia ṭhaṭha kha kan rak i ruah i hawi zapi he hmunkhat ah biakinn ah kan rak kal ṭi tawn."},"15":{"text":"Ka ral hna cungah cun thihnak kha khulrang in tlung seh law mithi khua ah khan a nung in vung kal hna seh. An inn chung le an lung chungah ṭhat lonak a um."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa Pathian cu ka bawm tuah tiah ka auh i a ka khamh lai."},"17":{"text":"Ka ainak le ka hramnak cu zing siseh, chun ah siseh, zan ah siseh, amah sinah an kai zungzal ko i ka aw cu a ka theihpiak ṭheo lai."},"18":{"text":"Ka ral tampi hna he kan i tuknak hmun in him tein a ka kirpi ṭhan ko lai."},"19":{"text":"Zungzal in uktu a simi Pathian nih ka bia cu a ka theihpiak lai i annih cu a sunghter hna lai; annih nih amah cu an ṭih lo caah an tuah khawhmi zeihmanh a um lai lo."},"20":{"text":"Hlanlio ka hawi nih khan a hawi lila cu a tuk hna; a biakam cu a zul lo."},"21":{"text":"A chimmi bia cu thawhpat nakin a nal deuh sihmanhsehlaw a lung chungah cun huatnak a um; a bia cu chiti bantukin a nem, sihmanhsehlaw nam bantukin mi a chun."},"22":{"text":"Na thilri cu Bawipa sinah ṭhum ta law amah nih an bawmh lai; miṭha cu zeitikhmanh ah a sunghter bal lai lo."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa, nangmah nih lainawng mi hna le lihchim mi hna cu vawlei tang khor thukpi ah khin an chan ṭim hlanah na thlak hna lai. Kei tu nih cun nangmah kha kan bochan lai."}}},"56":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ral nih an ka hrem thluangthluan i an ka cil lengmang caah hin Maw Pathian, ka zaangfah ko sawh.","title":"Pathian I Bochan (1Sam 21.13-15)"},"2":{"text":"A ka dohtu nih hin chun nitlak in an ka hrem i annih hi an tam hringhran ko."},"3":{"text":"Ka thin a phan tikah, Maw Cungnung Bik, nangmah cu kan bochan."},"4":{"text":"Pathian cu kaa bochan i a biakam cu ka thangṭhat; amah cu kaa bochan i ka thin a phang lo. Minung menmen nih cun zeidah an ka ti khawh lai?"},"5":{"text":"Ka ral nih cun ka tuahmi thil kip ah harnak an ka pek, zeitindah a cungah fahnak kan tlunter khawh lai ti kha an ruat zungzal."},"6":{"text":"Mi hmuh lonak hmun ah khan an i thup i ka tuahmi paohpaoh kha an ka ngiat dih, zeitindah kan thah khawh lai ti kha an i ruahchih."},"7":{"text":"An ṭhat lo ruangah cun, Maw Pathian, dantat ko hna; hi mi hna hi na thinhun in raltuknak ah cun, sunghter ko hna."},"8":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah harnak ka in kha na hngalh; ka mitthli cu na thawl chungah na rawn hna, na cauk chungah na ṭial hna a si lo mei?"},"9":{"text":"Nangmah kan auh ni ah ka ral cu an kir lai, mah hi fiang tein ka hngalh — Pathian cu keimah leiah a um."},"10":{"text":"Pathian cu kaa bochan i a biakam cu ka thangṭhat, Bawipa biakamnak cu ka thangṭhat lai."},"11":{"text":"Amah cu kaa bochan i ka thin a phang lo, minung menmen nih cun zeidah an ka ti khawh lai?"},"12":{"text":"Pathian, na sinah ka rak i kammi kha kan pek lai, thangṭhat thawinak cu kan pek lai,"},"13":{"text":"zeicahtiah nangmah nih thihnak chungin na ka chuah i ka ke kha rilhnak chungin na khamh. Cucaah Pathian hmaika ah cun kaa chawk i minung cungah a ceumi a ceunak chungah cun ka um."}}},"57":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka zaangfah ko, Maw Pathian, ka zaangfah ko, himnak hmuh duh ah nangmah cu ka fuh. Thlichia ṭihnung a dih hlantiang, na thlazung in ka huppheng ko.","title":"Hremnak Chungah Hnangamnak (Slm 108.1-5)","ref":"1Sam 22.1; 24.3"},"2":{"text":"Cung Nung Bik Pathian cu ka auh, ka herhnak vialte a ka petu Pathian cu ka kawh."},"3":{"text":"Vancung khin a run ka leh lai i a ka khamh lai; a ka dohtu kha a sunghter hna lai. Pathian nih cun a fekmi a dawtnak le zumhawktlak a sinak kha ka cungah a langhter lai."},"4":{"text":"Mi seh hmang chiandeih hna lakah ka it, an ha cu fei le thal bantuk an si, an lei cu kawngthun har bantuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na lianhngannak cu van ah khin langhter law na sunparnak cu vawlei cung dihlak ah hin langhter ko."},"6":{"text":"Ka ral nih keimah foihnak ah sur rap an chiah, lungretheihnak nih a ka tei; ka kalnak lam ah khor an cawh, sihmanhsehlaw anmah tu an tla."},"7":{"text":"Ka lung a hmun ko, maw Pathian, ka lung a fek ko; nangmah thangṭhatnak hla ka sa lai."},"8":{"text":"Ka nunnak, i hlau tuah, ka tingtang le ka thonglawi hna, i hlau tuah u. Zinglei cu ka ṭhangh lai."},"9":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, miphun hna lakah kan lawmh lai, mi vialte hna lakah kan thangṭhat lai."},"10":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak cu vancung tiang a phan, zumhawktlak na sinak cu van a tawng."},"11":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na lianhngannak cu van ah khin langhter law na sunparnak cu vawleicung dihlak ah hin langhter ko."}}},"58":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nannih uktu bawi hna, bia nan ceih tikah ding tein nan ceih taktak maw? Mi vialte kha aa ruang tein nan ceih hna maw?","title":"Miṭhalo Cu Dantat Ko Hna David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nan ceih hna lo.
