Ṭhat lonak tuah nan duhmi lawng kha nan ruat i ram chungah khan mithahnak le lainawnnak nan umter."},"3":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu an chan chung vialte palhnak a tuahmi an si, an chuah ni in lihchim an i thawk."},"4":{"text":"Rul bantukin sivai an ngei, rawchok hnachet bantuk an si, zeihmanh an thei lo,"},"5":{"text":"rawchok hnachet nih cun rul camhthiam aw kha a thei kho lo."},"6":{"text":"Maw Pathian, an ha cu khiak dih hna, Maw Bawipa, hi ṭihnung chiandeih hna hi an ho phawi dih hna!"},"7":{"text":"Tlang pang i a luangmi ti a loh bantukin lo hna seh, lam i lamh chihmi belh bantukin lo hna seh."},"8":{"text":"Nawncek chungah a lo ralmi cengkeuh bantuk si hna seh, ni a hmu bal lomi fa rawk bantuk si hna seh."},"9":{"text":"An hngalh manh hlanah Pathian nih burbuk sam in a sam hna lai, an nun ko lioah Pathian nih a thinhun in thli choih in a choih hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Misual mi nih dantatnak an hmuh kha miding mi nih an hmuh tikah an i lawm lai, miṭhalo mi hna thi cu ti tan bantukin an tan lai."},"11":{"text":"Mi nih an i thawh lai i, “Miding mi cu laksawng an hmu taktak ko; vawleicung ah hin Dingthlu Lairel Pathian a um taktak ko,” an ti lai."}}},"59":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka ral hna sin hin ka khamh tuah, ka Pathian; a ka dohtu hna kut chung hin ka huppheng tuah.","title":"Luatnak Ca Thlacam David Hla (1Sam 19.11)"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna kut chung hin ka khamh law lainawng hna kut chung hin ka chuah tuah."},"3":{"text":"Zohhmanh, keimah cu thah awkah an ka bawh, keimah doh awkah mipuarhrang pawl cu an i pum."},"4":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak le sualnak ka tuah ruangah si loin ka sual ca le ka palh ca zongah si loin, Maw Bawipa, an ka bawhnak hmun ah khan khulrang in an va tli."},"5":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa, tho law ka bawm tuah; maw Israel Pathian, nangmah hrimhrim nih ra zoh tuah. I hlau law miphun kha dantat hna, mi rawi hmang, miṭhalo mi hi, zaangfah hna hlah."},"6":{"text":"Zanlei fate an ra kir i uico bantukin an au i khua chungah an i chawk."},"7":{"text":"An chimmi bia cu ngai tuah! An lei cu an kaa chungah vainam bantuk an si nain an i thawh i, “Aho nih dah a kan theih lem lai?” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Maw Bawipa, nang nih cun na nihsawh ko hna; miphun vialte cu capo men ah na saih ko hna."},"9":{"text":"Maw a ka Vengtu, nangmah nih na ka huhphenh; Maw Pathian, nangmah cu ka ralhruang na si."},"10":{"text":"A ka dawtu ka Pathian nih a ka don lai, ka ral cu a ka teipiak hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Annih cu that hna hlah, ka mi hna nih an philh sual ai hnga, na ṭhawnnak in ṭhek hna law hrawk hna, Maw Bawipa kannih kan phaw!"},"12":{"text":"An kaa chungah sualnak a um an bia cu bia sual lawngte an si; an i porhlawtnak ah cun anmah lila i foih hna seh. Annih cu chiatserhnak bia a chimmi le lihchimmi an si caah"},"13":{"text":"na thinhun in hrawk dih hna, hrawk dih cikcek hna. Cu tikah Israel uktu cu Pathian a si i vawleicung vialte zong a uk chih dih ti kha an hngalh lai."},"14":{"text":"Ka ral cu zanlei fate an ra kir i uico bantukin an au i khua chungah an i chawk."},"15":{"text":"Rawl kawl ah an vak i a za an hmuh lo tikah an zai."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei tu cu na ṭhawnnak kha hla in ka thangṭhat lai; zing fate in a fekmi na dawtnak kong kha hla in ka sa lai. Nangmah cu ka caah himnak na si, harnak caan ah dornak lungpi na si."},"17":{"text":"Maw a ka Vengtu, nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai; Pathian cu ka ralhruang na si, a ka dawtu Pathian cu ka himnak na si."}}},"60":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na kan hlawt cang i kan ralhau kha na chim dih cang hna; kan cungah na thin a hung — sihmanhsehlaw atu cu kanmah leiah i mer ko sawh.","title":"Phung Ning Luatnak Ca Thlacam (Slm 108.6-13)","ref":"2Sam 8.13; 1Cha 18.12"},"2":{"text":"Vawlei kha na hninhter i na kahter; atu cu a hma kha damter ṭhan ko, zeicahtiah kuai dih aa zal cang."},"3":{"text":"Na mi cu temhnak tampi na kan inter, a kan rittertu zu kha na kan dinter."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah an ṭihmi hna caah hmelchunhnak na phun, sihmanhsehlaw an i let i an ral hna sin khan an zam ṭhiamṭhiam."},"5":{"text":"Na ṭhawnnak in kan khamh tuah; kan thlacamnak kha kan let tuah, cuticun na dawtmi hna hi kan luat kho lai."},"6":{"text":"Pathian nih a hmunthiang chungin aa thawh i, “Shekhem cu ka tei lai i ka cheu lai, cun Sukkoth Nelrawn cu ka mi kha ka phawt hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Gilead cu keimah ta a si, Manasseh zong keimah ta a si, Efraim cu ka luchin a si i Judah cu ka bawifung a si."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moab cu ka kut ṭawlnak kheng ah ka hman lai i Edom cu ka kedan chiahnak kuang ah ka hman lai. Filistin nih hin, amah cu ka tei lai i ka au lai, tiin aa ruah dahra?” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, aho nih dah ralhau a ngeimi khua chungah a ka luhpi lai? Aho nih dah Edom ah a ka kalpi lai?"},"10":{"text":"Na kan hlawt taktak ko cang maw? Kan ralkap cu na kalpi ti hna lai lo maw?"},"11":{"text":"Minung bawmhnak cu zeihmanh a ṭhathnem lo caah kan raldohnak ah hin nangmah nih kan bawm ko."},"12":{"text":"Pathian kan sinah a ṭan caah kan tei hna lai; kan ral cu amah nih a kan teipiak hna lai."}}},"61":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka aunak cu ka theihpiak ko, ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko","title":"Huhphenhnak Ca Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Inn in hlapi ah ka um i khuaruahhar vansang au in ka umnak hmun hin nangmah cu kan auh."},"3":{"text":"Himnak hmun ah ka kalpi tuah, nangmah cu keimah nakin a sang deuhmi lungpi na si, ka ral hna sinin a ka hupphengtu a fekmi innsang na si."},"4":{"text":"Na thlam chungah a zungzal in ka umter tuah, na thla tangah him tein i dor ko ning."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah nih bia kaa kammi kha na theih i nangmah an upatmi hna ro kha na ka pek."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a nunnak ah kum tampi bet ko, sau piin nunter ko."},"7":{"text":"Pathian, na hmaika ah cun zungzal in uktu si seh law a fekmi na dawtnak le zumhawktlak na sinak khan amah cu kilveng ko."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah ni khat hnu ni khat, na sinah bia kaa kammi ka tlinter pah in nangmah thangṭhatnak cu hla in ka sa zungzal lai."}}},"62":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian lawnglawng kaa bochan, amah sinin ka khamhnak cu a ra.","title":"Pathian Lawng Bochan Awk David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Amah lawnglawng hi a ka hupphengtu le ka Khamhtu a si, amah cu ka ralhruang a si i ahohmanh nih an ka tei bal lai lo."},"3":{"text":"Aa sawnmi vampang bantuk le baohmi hau bantuk a simi pa cu, nannih nih nan dihlak in zei can dah nan doh lai i thah nan i zuam lai?"},"4":{"text":"Nan duhmi cu upatnak hmun i a ṭhutnak khan ṭhumh hi a si ko i lihchim zong hi nan duh hringhranmi a si fawn. Nan kaa cun thluachuahnak bia nan chim, sihmanhsehlaw nan lungchung cun chiat nan serh."},"5":{"text":"Pathian lawnglawng kha kaa bochan, amah lawnglawng kha kaa ruahchan."},"6":{"text":"Amah lawnglawng hi a ka hupphengtu le Khamhtu a si, amah cu ka ralhruang a si i ahohmanh nih an ka tei bal lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Khamhnak ka hmuhmi le upatnak ka hmuhmi cu amah thawng lawnglawng in a si; amah cu a ṭhawngmi lungpi ka him a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka mi hna, Pathian cu i bochan zungzal u! Amah cu kan himnak a si caah nan harnak vialte kha chim dih u."},"9":{"text":"Mi vialte hi thaw bantuk menmen an si, a thi khomi minung hi zeihmanh an man lo. Cuaithlainak cungah chia hna u law zeihmanh an tlai lai lo, thaw nak hmanh in an zaang deuh."},"10":{"text":"Zaangṭhawnnak le puarhrannak hi i bochan hlah u, mi thil chuh khawh hi i ruahchan hlah u; na rumnak hi karh lengmang hmanh seh law i bochan hlah."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih, ṭhawnnak cu keimah ta a si i dawtnak ka ngeihmi cu a fek,"},"12":{"text":"a ti kha voi khat nak tam ka theih. Bawipa, nangmah hrimhrim nih mi cu, an rianṭuanning in na lehrulh ko hna.","ref":"Job 34.11; Jer 17.10; Mat 16.27; Rom 2.6; Biat 2.23"}}},"63":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah cu ka Pathian na si, nangmah cu kan ngai. Ka nunnak nih hin an hlam i ka thlarau nih tihal in an hal; vawlei ro nih ti a duh bantuk khin an duh.","title":"Pathian Ka Ngai (1Sam 23.14) David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Hmunthiang ah cun in hmu ning law zeitluk in dah na lianhngan le na sunpar kha in hngal ning, ti ka duh."},"3":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak cu nunnak nakin a ṭha deuh, cucaah cun nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai."},"4":{"text":"Ka nun chung paohpaoh cu kan lawmh lai; nangmah leiah ka kut ka hler lai i thla ka cam lai."},"5":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu rawldangh bantukin aa dang lai i a khim lai, cun nangmah thangṭhat lawmhnak hla kha ka sa lai."},"6":{"text":"Ihkhun cung i ka ih tikah nangmah cu kan thei, zan khuadei nangmah kha kan ruat,"},"7":{"text":"zeicahtiah nangmah cu a kan bawmtu na si zungzal. Na thla tangah lawmhnak in hla ka sa."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah kha kan tlaihchan i na kut nih him tein an ka umter."},"9":{"text":"Keimah thah a ka zalmi kha mithi khua ah an kal lai;"},"10":{"text":"raltuknak hmun ah khan an thi lai i an ruak cu cenghngia nih an ei hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Pathian thawngin siangpahrang cu aa lawm lai; Pathian min in biakamnak a tuahmi vialte hna cu an i lawm lai, sihmanhsehlaw milihchim hna cu an kaa phih a si lai."}}},"64":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, harnak ka tong, ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak tuah! Ka thin a phang, ka ral hna kut chungin ka khamh tuah!","title":"Himnak Ca Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna khuakhannak chungin ka khamh law misual bu hna sinin ka huppheng ko."},"3":{"text":"An lei kha nam bantukin an i tat i bia ṭhalo kha thal bantukin an kah."},"4":{"text":"Miṭha kha lamhruang an ah hna i chikkhatte ah i sumṭhen loin an thal cun an kah hna."},"5":{"text":"Thil ṭhalo tuahnak ding khua an khanmi ah khan, pakhat le pakhat thazang an i pe, khuazei ah dah kan rap kha kan chiah hna lai tiah an i ceih. “Kan rap cu ahohmanh nih hmu hna hlah seh,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Ṭhatlo tuahnak ding khua cu an khan i “Ṭhatlo tuahnak ding khua kan khanmi cu a ṭha tuk,” an ti. Minung lungthin le ruahnak hi khuaruahharmi thil thuk a si hrimhrim ko."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a thal in a kah ciammam hna i chikkhatte ah khin hma an pu ko."},"8":{"text":"An bia nih khan rawhnak a phakpi hna lai i a hmumi paoh nih an lu an thinhnawh hna lai."},"9":{"text":"An dihlak in an thin a phang lai; Pathian nih a tuahmi kha an chim lai i a tuahmi kong cu an ruat hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil ruangah khan miding mi vialte cu an i lawm lai; Bawipa chungah cun himnak an hmuh lai i miṭha vialte nih amah cu an thangṭhat lai."}}},"65":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nang cu kan thlacamnak a kan lettu na si caah","title":"Lawmhnak le Thangṭhatnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Zion ah kan in thangṭhat lai i na sinah bia kan i kammi kha kan in pek lai."},"3":{"text":"Mi vialte nih an sualnak cu na hmaiah an phuan lai: kan sualnak cu kan caah a rit tuk hringhran, nangmah lawnglawng nih na kan thianhpiak khawh."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah nih na thimmi hna cu an lung aa lawm, na hmunthiang ah na umtermi hna mi lunglawm an si! Na inn chung i a ummi thil ṭha cu kan khim lai i a thiangmi na biakinn chung thil ṭha cu kan i zaa lai."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan Khamhtu, thla kan cam tikah na kan leh i khuaruahhar thil na tuahmi in na kan khamh. Vawleicung mi vialte le a hla bik rili ral i a ummi hmanh nih an in bochan."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhawnnak in tlang pipi hna cu an umnak hmun ah khan na umter hna i a ṭhawngmi na lianhngannak cu na langhter."},"7":{"text":"Rili thawng cu na daihter i tilet thawng cu na nemter; mi au thawng cu na daihter."},"8":{"text":"Thil lianngan na tuahmi hna ruangah vawlei cu a dihlak in a thin a phang. Vanhramdeng in vanhramdeng tiang na tuahmi thil kha mi nih an thangṭhat i an lawmh."},"9":{"text":"Ram cu na dawt caah a cungah ruah na surter; na rumter i a vawlei na ṭhatter. A chung i na umtermi tiva cu an kao bal lo, cu tiva hna nih cun rawl a phunphun an chuahter — cucu nangmah tuahmi a si."},"10":{"text":"An thuanmi lo cu ruah ti na pek i ciap tein ruah nih cun a surh; vawlei cu na nemter i thlaikho kha na ṭhanter hna."},"11":{"text":"Na ṭhatnak nih kum ṭha a vuiter. Na kalnak paoh ah rawl tampi a um."},"12":{"text":"Saṭil tlonnak hmun cu saṭil run in an khat i tlangpang hna cu lawmhnak in an khat."},"13":{"text":"Ram hnonak hmun cu tuu in an khat i nelrawn cu facang in an khat; lunglawmhnak in an au i hla an sa."}}},"66":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi vialte hna, Pathian cu lunglawmhnak in thangṭhat tuah u!","title":"Thangṭhatnak le Lawmhnak Hla David Hla"},"2":{"text":"A sunglawimi a min kha hla in thangṭhat u, sunparnak in thangṭhat u."},"3":{"text":"Pathian sinah cun, “Na tuahmi thil hi zeitluk in dah khuaruahhar an si. Na lianhngannak kha a ngan tuk caah na ral cu na hmaiah therphang in an kun."},"4":{"text":"Vawlei cungmi vialte nih an in biak i hla in an in thangṭhat, na min kha hla in an thangṭhat,” tiah chim u."},"5":{"text":"Ra u law Pathian nih a tuahmi thil hi zoh hna hmanh u, minung sinah a tuahmi thil khuaruahhar hi zoh hna hmanh u."},"6":{"text":"Rili cu vawlei ro ah a canter i kan pupa hna nih tiva cu an ke in an tan. Cuka ah cun, a tuahmi thil ruangah khan kan i lawm.","ref":"Exo 14.21; Jos 3.14-17"},"7":{"text":"A ṭhawnnak in a uk zungzal i miphun hna cu a ngiat zungzal hna. Ahohmanh amah doh awkah ral tho hna hlah seh."},"8":{"text":"Miphun vialte hna, kan Pathian cu thangṭhat tuah u; nan thangṭhatnak cu thanter u."},"9":{"text":"Amah nih nung dam tein a kan umter i tlu loin a kan umter."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah nih na kan hneksak; ngun cu mei in an thianh bantukin kannih zong na kan hneksak ve."},"11":{"text":"Rap ah na kan foihter i kan keng ah thilrit na kan khinh."},"12":{"text":"Kan ral nih khan an kan lamh beh; tilian le meisul lakah na kan kalter, asinain atu cu himnak hmun na kan phakter."},"13":{"text":"Na inn ah khangh thawinak kha ka rak put lai; bia kaa kammi kha kan pek lai."},"14":{"text":"Harnak chung ka rak um lio i kan pek lai ka timi kha kan pek lai."},"15":{"text":"Biakṭheng cung i khangh awkah tuu kha ka rak put hna lai, meheh khanghmi rim thaw kha aa zel lai i, cawtum le meheh kha raithawinak ah kan pek chanh hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Pathian a upatmi vialte hna, ra u law ra ngai tuah u; Pathian nih ka ca i a tuahmi kha kan chimh hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Pathian cu bawmhnak duh ah ka rak auh; amah cu hla in ka rak thangṭhat."},"18":{"text":"Ka sualnak kha rak thup ning law ka thlacamnak cu a rak ka ngaihpiak hnga lo."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih cun a ka theihpiak i ka thlacamnak cu a ka ngaihpiak."},"20":{"text":"Pathian nih ka thlacamnak kha a ka hlawtpiak lo i a fekmi a dawtnak kha ka sinin ṭhial loin a um caah, amah cu ka thangṭhat."}}},"67":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, vawleicung mi vialte nih na duhnak kha an hngalh i","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla David Hla"},"2":{"text":"miphun vialte nih na khamhnak kha an hngalh nakhnga, kan zaangfah law thluachuahnak kan pe ko, kan cungah na hmai tlanter ko."},"3":{"text":"Maw Pathian, miphun kip nih in ṭhangṭhat hna seh, miphun vialte nih in thangṭhat hna seh."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah nih miphun vialte cu dinnak in bia na ceih hna i mi vialte cu na hruai hna caah miphun vialte cu i lawm hna seh law lunglawmhnak in hla sa hna seh."},"5":{"text":"Mi kip nih in thangṭhat hna seh, Maw Pathian; miphun vialte nih in thangṭhat ko hna seh."},"6":{"text":"Vawlei nih rawl kha a chuahter cang, Pathian kan Pathian nih thluachuah a kan pek cang."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih thluachuah a kan pek; vawleicung mi zakip nih upat hna seh."}}},"68":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu tho seh law a ral kha ṭhek dih hna seh! Amah a huatu cu zam dih hna seh.","title":"Ral Tei Thangṭhatnak Hla David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Meikhu kha thli nih a choih bantukin a choih dih hna lai, khuailul kha mei nih a emh tikah a tit bantukin miṭhalo cu Pathian hmaika ah an rawk lai."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miding mi cu an i lawm lai i a hmaiah khan an tha a nuam lai; lunglawm ngaingai in an um lai."},"4":{"text":"Pathian cu hla in thangṭhat u, a min cu thangṭhat u; khuadawm aa citmi caah cun lam kha ser tuah u. Amah a min cu Bawipa a si — amah hmaiah cun i lawm tuah u!"},"5":{"text":"A biakinn thiang chungah a ummi Pathian nih, ngakṭah le nuhmei kha an zawn a ruah hna."},"6":{"text":"Lungleng le umhar in a ummi kha umnak inn a pek hna i thongtla kha luatnak lawmhnak chungah a chuahpi hna; sihmanhsehlaw ralthawh hmangmi cu ramcar ah an um lai."},"7":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na mi na hruai hna tik le thetse ram tan in na kalpi hna tikah khan"},"8":{"text":"vawlei cu aa hnin i van in ruahpi a sur; cu bantukin a si cu Sinai Tlang Pathian a rat ca le Israel Pathian a rat ruangah a si.","ref":"Exo 19.18"},"9":{"text":"Ruah tampi in na surter i a fe cangmi na ram kha na ṭhatter ṭhan."},"10":{"text":"Cuka ah cun na mi nih innlo an khuar i na ṭhatnak thawngin sifakmi kha rawl ei awk na pek hna."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih nawlbia cu a chuah i cu thawng cu nu tampi nih an kalpi:"},"12":{"text":"“Siangpahrang hna le an ralkap hna cu an zam cang,” an ti. Inn i a ummi nu hna nih khan, hranchaw an tlaihmi kha an rak i phaw;"},"13":{"text":"cu hranchaw hna cu ngun in tuammi ṭhuro milem tete an si, an thla cu sui bantukin a tleu. (Zeicahdah a cheu cu raldoh ni ah tuu kawm chungah nan um ko?)"},"14":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Pathian nih siangpahrang hna cu Zalmon Tlang ah a ṭhek dih hna tikah khika ah hawhra kha a surter."},"15":{"text":"Bashan tlang hi zeitluk in a nganmi tlang dah a si! Tlang zum tampi a ngeimi tlang a si."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahdah cu bantuk tlang ngan, tlang zum tampi a ngeimi tlang nih, Pathian nih umnak ah aa thimmi tlang cu na nihsawh? Cuka ah cun Pathian cu, zungzal in a um ko ṭung lai!"},"17":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi a rangleng thong tampi he Bawipa cu Sinai Tlang in a ra i a hmunthiang ah cun a lut."},"18":{"text":"Tlang sang par ah cun a hung kai i sal tlaihmi tampi aa hruaih hna; amah a dohtu hna nih khan amah cu laksawng an pek. Cuka ah cun Bawipa Pathian cu a um lai.","ref":"Efe 4.8"},"19":{"text":"Ni khat hnu ni khat kan thilrit a kan changtu Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u, amah cu a kan khamhtu Pathian a si."},"20":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu mi a khamhtu Pathian a si, amah cu Bawipa kan Bawipa, thihnak chungin a kan chuahtu a si."},"21":{"text":"Pathian nih a ral pawl cu an lu a khuai hrimhrim hna lai, an sualnak lam a zul pengmi hna cu."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih, “Nan ral cu Bashan in ka rak kirpi ṭhan hna lai; rili thukmi chungin ka rak kirpi ṭhan hna lai i"},"23":{"text":"an thisen chungah cun nan i chawk lai i nan uico nih an duh chungin an liah hna lai,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Maw Pathian, teinak in na kal cu mi vialte nih an hmuh, Pathian ka siangpahrang a hmunthiang chung i a luh cu an hmuh dih."},"25":{"text":"Hlasatu pawl kha hmaisuang ah an um, aw dawh tum thiam pawl kha hnulei ah an um, an karlak ah khan khuang tumtu nu pawl kha an um."},"26":{"text":"“A mi an i pumhnak ah Pathian cu thangṭhat u; Israel tefa vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u.”"},"27":{"text":"A hmasa ah an lak i phun hme bik Benjamin kha a ra, cun Judah phun hruaitu pawl kha an mi hna he cun an ra i Zebulun le Naftali phun hruaitu pawl nih khan an zulh hna."},"28":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na ṭhawnnak langhter ko, kan ca i na hmanmi na ṭhawnnak kha langhter ko."},"29":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih laksawng an in putnak Jerusalem khua chung i na biakinn khan langhter ko."},"30":{"text":"Izipt cu mawhchiat ko, phaikung lak i a tlongmi sahrang kha mawhchiat ko, miphun cu chimhring ko hna, an fale he a ummi cawtum hna kha; annih nih na hmaiah an kun i an ngun cu an in pek hlantiang annih cu chimhring ko hna. Ral thawh a duhmi kha ṭhek ko hna."},"31":{"text":"Izipt ram in cozah nih thlahmi lamkaltu an ra lai; Ethiopia mi nih Pathian sinah thlacam in an kut an hler lai."},"32":{"text":"Vawleicung ram hna, Pathian cu hla in thangṭhat u, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u."},"33":{"text":"Van a citmi, a hlunmi van aa citmi cu thangṭhat u. Aw thang piin a au cu ngai tuah u."},"34":{"text":"Pathian ṭhawnnak cu thanh tuah u a lianhngannak cu Israel mi cungah a um, a ṭhawnnak cu van ah khin a um."},"35":{"text":"Pathian, Israel Pathian, a hmunthiang chung in a rami cu zeitluk in dah ṭihnung a si! A mi cu ṭhawnnak le lianhngannak a pek hna. Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u!"}}},"69":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka khamh ko sawh! Ti nih ka hngawng tiangin a ka phum cang.","title":"Harnak Caan Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"A thukmi nawncek chungah ka pil cuahmah i lamh awk a fekmi hmun a um lo. A thuhnak hmun ka phan cang i tilet nih an ka phum dengmang cang."},"3":{"text":"Ka bawm tuah tiin ka aunak ah ka baa cang i ka or zong a fak dih cang; bawmhnak a ka pe lai maw tiin ka mithram cat in kan zoh."},"4":{"text":"Zei ruang lo ah a ka huatu hna cu ka lu cung sam nakin an tam deuh, ka ral an sinak kongah lih a chimmi hna cu an ṭhawng i thah an ka duh. Ka fir lomi thil kha an ka chamter.","ref":"Slm 35.19; Jhn 15.25"},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka sualnak cu nangmah sinin an i thup kho lo; zeitluk in dah ka hruh cu na hngalh ko."},"6":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Pathian Bawipa, nangmah an bochantu hna cungah ningzahnak ka tlunter nakhnga lo ka bawm. Maw Israel Pathian, nangmah an biatu hna cungah hmaichiatnak ka tlunter nakhnga lo ka bawm."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah ruangah nihsawhnak ka hmuh hi a si i nangmah ruangah ningzahnak nih a kan khuh hi a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka unau hna sinah khual ah ka cang i ka nufale hna sinah ramdangmi ah ka cang."},"9":{"text":"Na biakinn ka ṭanhnak hi ka chungah mei bantukin a alh i nangmah an in nihsawhnak kha keimah cungah a tla.","ref":"Jhn 2.17; Rom 15.3"},"10":{"text":"Rawl ulhnak in toidornak lungthin ngeih kaa zuam i asinain mi nih an ka nihsawh ṭhiamṭhiam."},"11":{"text":"Zuun ngaihnak thuam in kaa thuam i capo ah an ka saih."},"12":{"text":"Zatlang lam ah ka kong an ka ceih i zuri nih hla an ka phuah"},"13":{"text":"Asinain kei cu na sinah thla ka cam ko lai, Maw Bawipa ; a nganmi na dawtnak ruangah ka let law, kan khamh lai tiah na ka kammi ruangah ka let ko sawh, na duh tik caan ah nangmah nih ka let ko, Maw Pathian."},"14":{"text":"Nawncek chung ka tlaknak khan ka chuah ko, ka ral hna kut chungin ka huppheng ko law a thukmi ti chungin him tein ka chuah ko."},"15":{"text":"Tilian cu ka fenhter sawh hlah; a thukmi ti chungah cun ka pilter sawh hlah, thlan chungah cun ka tlakter sawh hlah."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, a fekmi na dawtnak ṭhatnak thawngin ka thlacamnak cu ka let law, zawnruahnak ngan na ngeihmi thawngin keimah leiah i mer ko."},"17":{"text":"Na sal hi ka thuhtak hlah; harnak nganpi ka tong — atu hrimhrim ah ka let ko sawh!"},"18":{"text":"Ra ka zuanhnawh law ka khamh tuah; ka ral hna kut chungin ka chuah tuah."},"19":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah an ka nihsawh i hmaichiatnak le ningzahnak ka huah kha na hngalh; ka ral cu na hmuh dih ko hna."},"20":{"text":"An ka serhsat tuk caah ka lung zong a rawk dih; zeihmanh ka tuah kho ti lo. An ka zaangfah rua lai tiah ka rak ruah, sihmanhsehlaw zaangfahnak zeihmanh ka hmu lo; a ka hnemtu an um rua lai tiah ka rak ruah, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh an um lo."},"21":{"text":"Ka rawl a ṭam tikah sivai tu an ka pek, ka ti a hal tikah ti thor an ka dinh.","ref":"Mat 27.48; Mar 15.36; Luk 23.36; Jhn 19.28-29"},"22":{"text":"An puai cu anmah rawhnak ah cang seh law an i nuamhnak cu anmah tluknak ah cang ko seh.","ref":"Rom 11.9-10"},"23":{"text":"An mit cawtter hna law khua hmu kho hna hlah seh; an keng cu derthawm zungzal hna seh."},"24":{"text":"Na thinhunnak cu toih hna law na thinlinhnak nih phan hna seh."},"25":{"text":"An riahhmun cu chuahtak hna seh law an thlam chungah a nungmi pakhat hmanh tang hna hlah seh.","ref":"Lam 1.20"},"26":{"text":"Dan na tat cangmi kha an hrem chinchin hna i nganfahnak na inter cangmi hna kha an thangchiat hna."},"27":{"text":"An sualnak kha cazin chungah i khumh dih law na khamhnak chungah covo zeihmanh ngei hna hlah seh."},"28":{"text":"An min cu a nungmi minung cazin khan hloh si hna seh; na mi hna min cazin chungah i tel hna hlah seh.","ref":"Exo 32.32; Biat 3.5; 13.8; 17.8"},"29":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu harnak chung le temhinnak chungah ka um i cucaah cun ka cawi law ka khamh tuah, Maw Pathian."},"30":{"text":"Pathian cu hla in ka thangṭhat lai, a lianhngannak cu ka thanh lai i amah cungah kaa lawmhnak cu ka chim lai."},"31":{"text":"Hi nih hin Bawipa cu cawtum pekchanh nakin a lawmhter deuh lai i cawtum kum tlingmi pekchanhnak hmanh in a lawmhter deuh lai."},"32":{"text":"Cu thil cu serhsatnak a ingmi nih an hmuh tikah an i lawm lai; Pathian a biami cu lung ṭhawnnak thar an hmu lai."},"33":{"text":"Sifahnak le retheihnak a ingmi hna thlacamnak cu Bawipa nih a ngaih i thong chungah a ummi hna kha a philh hna lo."},"34":{"text":"Van le vawlei hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u, rili le a chung i a ummi thil vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u."},"35":{"text":"Zion cu a khamh lai i Judah ram chung khua cu a remh ṭhan hna lai; a mi cu cuka ah cun khua an sa lai i ram cu an co lai;"},"36":{"text":"a sal hna an tefa nih an co lai i amah a dawmi kha cuka ah cun an um lai."}}},"70":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka khamh tuah, Maw Bawipa, atu ah ka bawm tuah.","title":"Luat Halnak Thlacam (Slm 40.13-17) David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Thah a ka zalmi kha sung hna seh law i tuai dih hna seh. Harnak ka inmi ruangah aa lawmmi cu an hnulei ah i let hna seh law ningzak in um hna seh."},"3":{"text":"A ka nihsawhtu pawl kha an sunghnak nih khan lungdong cikcek in umter hna seh."},"4":{"text":"Nangmah sinah a rami vialte cu lunglawm le thanuam in um hna seh. Na khamhnak a duhmi vialte nih, “ Bawipa cu a lianngan hringhran ko,” ti zungzal hna seh."},"5":{"text":"Kei cu ka thazang a der i zeihmanh ka tuah kho lo; cucaah run ka zuanhnawh ko, Maw Pathian. Nangmah cu a ka bawmtu le Khamhtu na si — rau sawh hlah, Maw Bawipa! rau sawh hlah, Maw Bawipa!"}}},"71":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu kaa dornak hmun na si, zeitikhmanh ah ningzahnak ka phakter hlah!","title":"Tarpa Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Na din caah ka hram law ka chanh ko, ka bia ka ngaihpiak law ka khamh tuah."},"3":{"text":"Ka caah himnak lungpi si law a fekmi ralhruang a ka hupphengtu si ko; nangmah cu ka himnak lungpi le ka ralhruang na si."},"4":{"text":"Ka Pathian, miṭhalo hna kut chungin ka khamh tuah, mipuarhrang le miding lo hna kut chungin ka khamh ko."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cungah ka ruahchannak vialte kha ka chiah, ka no lio tein nangmah cu kan bochan zungzal."},"6":{"text":"Ka nun chung vialte nangmah cu kan hngatchan; ka chuahka in nangmah nih na ka huhphenh zungzal; nangmah cu a zungzal in kan thangṭhat lai."},"7":{"text":"Ka nunnak hi mi tampi caah cun khuaruahhar a si, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah cu a ṭhawngmi a ka hupphengtu na si."},"8":{"text":"Chun nitlak in kan thangṭhat i na sunparnak cu ka chim."},"9":{"text":"Atu cu a tar cang aipat tiin ka hlaw sawh hlah, san a tlai ti ualpat lo tiin ka kaltak hlah."},"10":{"text":"Ka ral nih cun thah an ka duh, an i ceih i keimah thahnak ding khua kha an khaan."},"11":{"text":"An i thawh i, “Pathian nih a hlawt cang, dawi u sih law tlai u sih; zeicahtiah a chanhtu ding ahohmanh an um lo,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Maw Pathian, lamhlatpi ah ka umtak hlah; ka Pathian, atu ah ka bawm ko."},"13":{"text":"A ka dohtu pawl kha sung hna seh law rawk hna seh. Ka cungah fahnak tlunter aa zuammi kha ningzahnak le hmaichiatnak phan hna seh."},"14":{"text":"Nangmah cungah ka ruahchannak vialte cu ka chiah dih ko lai, nangmah cu kan thangṭhat chin lengmang lai."},"15":{"text":"Na dinnak kong kha ka chim lai i na khamhnak kha chun nitlak ka thanh lai; na khamhnak cu ka hngalh khawh leng a si nain ka thanh lai."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, na ṭhawnnak cu ka thangṭhat lai, na dinnak, nangmah dinnak lawnglawng kha ka thanh lai."},"17":{"text":"Ka no lio tein nangmah nih na ka cawnpiak i atu tiangin khuaruahhar na tuahmi kha ka chim lengmang ko."},"18":{"text":"Atu cu a tar i a sam a par cang aipat tiin ka kaltak hlah, maw Pathian. Hmailei chan a ra ding vialte sinah na ṭhawnnak le na lianhngannak ka chimnak dingah hin nangmah nih ka umpi ko."},"19":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na dinnak cu van khi a phan. Thil lianngan tampi na tuah hna, nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo."},"20":{"text":"Ka cungah harnak le nganfahnak kha na tlunter, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih ka thazang kha na ka pek ṭhan lai i thlan chungin na ka khamh lai."},"21":{"text":"Hmasa nakin a ngan chinchin ah na ka ser lai, nangmah nih hnangamnak na ka pek ṭhan lai."},"22":{"text":"Tingtang in nangmah cu kan thangṭhat lai, Ka Pathian, zumhawktlak na sinak cu ka thangṭhat lai. Maw Israel Mi Thiang, ka tingtang in nangmah thangṭhatnak hla cu ka sa lai."},"23":{"text":"Nangmah thangṭhat in tingtang ka tum pah in lunglawm in ka au lai, nangmah nih na ka khamh caah ka minung sinak a dihlak in kan thangṭhat lai."},"24":{"text":"Chun nitlak in na dinnak kha ka chim lai, zeicahtiah harnak pek a ka duhmi kha an sung cang i ningzahnak an phan cang. ningzahnak an phan cang."}}},"72":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, siangpahrang nih hin bia ka ceih tikah na dinnak kha ka hman nakhnga, ka cawnpiak ko;","title":"Siangpahrang Ca Thlacamnak Solomon Hla"},"2":{"text":"cun na mi cu dinnak in ka uk hna nakhnga le sifakmi kha ding tein an bia ka ceihpiak hna nakhnga na dinnak kha keimah cu ka hrawm ko."},"3":{"text":"Ram nih hin rumnak i lawmhpi seh law dinnak kha a chungah leng seh."},"4":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih khan sifakmi kha an bia duhdanh lo tein ceihpiak hna seh law retheimi kha bawm hna seh law mi hremtu kha tei hna seh."},"5":{"text":"Ni a ceu chung paoh le thla a ceu chung paoh cu na mi nih a zungzal in in bia hna seh."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu lo a surhtu ruah bantuk si seh law vawlei a cawmtu ruah bantuk si seh."},"7":{"text":"A chan chungah dinnak kha karh seh law thlapa a ceu chung paoh cu siṭhatnak kha hmun ko seh."},"8":{"text":"A penmi ram cu rili pakhat in rili pakhat tiang a si lai i Zufrates tiva in vanhramdeng tiang a si lai.","ref":"Zek 9.10"},"9":{"text":"Thetse ram mi kha a hmaiah an kun lai i a ral kha leidip lakah an bawk lai."},"10":{"text":"Spain ram siangpahrang le tikulh ram siangpahrang hna nih khan laksawng an rak put lai; Arabia ram siangpahrang le Ethiopia ram siangpahrang hna nih khan laksawng an ra ṭhenh lai."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang vialte kha a hmaiah an kun lai i miphun vialte nih a rian an ṭuan lai."},"12":{"text":"Amah a autu sifakmi hna le retheimi hna, mi nih zei ah an rel lomi hna kha, a chanh hna."},"13":{"text":"A dermi le sifakmi cungah zaangfahnak a ngei i retheimi kha an nunnak kha a khamh hna."},"14":{"text":"Hremnak chung le serhsatnak chungin a khamh hna; an nunnak kha a caah thil sung a si."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu saupi nung ko seh! Arabia ram in sui rak pe hna seh; a zungzal in thlacampiak hna seh; Pathian nih a zungzal in thluachuahnak pe seh."},"16":{"text":"Ram chungah rawl tam piin um ko seh; Lebanon tlang i a ummi rawl kung ṭha bantuk nih tlang vialte cu tuam dih hna seh. Ramlak i a khomi ram bantukin khuapi cu minung in khat hna seh."},"17":{"text":"A min cu zeitikhmanh ah philh si ti hlah seh; a minthannak cu ni a um chung paohpaoh dai loin um zungzal ko seh. Miphun zakip nih amah cu thangṭhat hna seh, mi vialte nih Pathian cu, siangpahrang thluachuah na pek bantukin kannih zong ka pe ve, tiin nawl hna seh."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa Israel Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u, amah lawnglawng cu, hi thil khuaruahhar a tuah khotu a si."},"19":{"text":"A sunglawimi a min cu zungzal in thangṭhat ko u, a sunparnak cu vawleicung dihlak ah khat seh. Amen, Amen."},"20":{"text":"Hihi Jesse fapa David thlacamnak an donghnak a si."}}},"73":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian hi Israel mi hna cungah a ṭha taktak ko, lung thiang a ngeimi hna cungah a ṭha taktak ko.","title":"BU THUMNAK (Slm 73 in 89 tiang) Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu ka rak tlu dengmang, ka rak nal dengmang;"},"3":{"text":"zeicahtiah miṭhalo hna an huncho kha ka hmuh i an i porhlawt kha ka theih tikah cu nih cun ka nah a ka chuahter."},"4":{"text":"Annih cu fahnak zeihmanh an ing lo, an ngan a dam i an ṭhawng."},"5":{"text":"Midang bantukin harnak zeihmanh an tong lo, midang bantukin temhinnak zeihmanh an hmu lo."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah cun ruamkai kha ṭhi bantukin an i oih i puarthau cu puan bantukin an i aih;"},"7":{"text":"An mit pawt lellul pipi in an um i an lungthin cu ṭhat lonak khuaruahnak in a khat."},"8":{"text":"Midang kha zeihmanh ah an rel hna lo i thil ṭhalo lawng kha an ceih. An ruam a kai i zeitindah midang kha kan hrem khawh hna lai ti lawng kha an ceih."},"9":{"text":"Vancung i a ummi Pathian kha an thangchiat i vawleicung i a ummi minung kha an duhduh in an ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah cun Pathian mi hmanh nih an merhnawh hna i an chimmi paoh kha an zumh dih."},"11":{"text":"An i thawh i, “Pathian nih cun a hngal lai lo, Cungnung Bik nih cun a hmu lem lai lo,” an ti."},"12":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi cu hi bantuk hi an si ko. Thil tampi an ngei i an ngei chin luaimai."},"13":{"text":"A si kun ahcun, thiang tein nun kaa zuam i ka kut in sualnak tuah lo kaa sum hi pakpalawng maw a si ko lai?"},"14":{"text":"Pathian, chun nitlak in harnak na ka inter i zing fate in dan na ka tat."},"15":{"text":"Cu bantuk bia cu rak chim ning law na mi hna cungah rawitu ka rak si ṭung hnga."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah cun hihi hngalh a har tuk ko nain, hngalh awkah kaa zuam;"},"17":{"text":"na biakinn chung i ka luh tik ceo ah miṭhalo hna cungah zeidah a tlung lai ti kha ka hngalh."},"18":{"text":"Lam nal ah na chiah taktak hna i rawhralnak chungah na tlakter hna."},"19":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah an rawk i an donghnak cu ṭihnung ngaingai a si."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa, annih cu zanmang bantuk an si, na hun i hlauh tikah annih cu an lo colh."},"21":{"text":"Ka cekne tiangin a ka runh i ka thin a ka khenh tikah;"},"22":{"text":"Ka hrut i zeihmanh ka hngalthiam lo; na cung i ka umtuning cu saram umtuning bantuk a si."},"23":{"text":"Asinain nangmah sin ṭhiamṭhiam ah khan ka um i ka kut in na ka hruai."},"24":{"text":"Ka kalnak dingah khan lungthin na ka cheuh i a donghnak ah cun upatnak he na ka cohlan lai."},"25":{"text":"Vancung ah khin nangmah hlei in ahodah ka ngeih? Nangmah kan ngeih cang caah vawlei ah hin zeidah ka herhmi a um?"},"26":{"text":"Ka pum le ka ruahnak cu zorchuk hna hmanh seh law Pathian kha ka thazang a si; amah lawnglawng kha ka herhmi cu a si ko."},"27":{"text":"Nangmah an hlawmi cu an thi hrimhrim lai, nangmah cungah zumhawktlak in a um lomi cu na hrawh hna lai."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei ca tu ah cun, Pathian pawng um le, Bawipa Pathian chungah i dor le a tuahmi thil thanh hi a va nuam hringhran dah!"}}},"74":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zeicahdah hitihin na kan hlawt, Maw Pathian? Na mi cungah hin zungzal in maw na thin a hun lai?","title":"Phun Ning Khamhnak Ca Thlacamnak Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Hlanlio piin na mi si awkah na kan thimmi hi kan philh hlah. Na rak umnak Zion Tlang zong kha philh hlah."},"3":{"text":"Ra law kan thil a rawkmi hi na ke hrimhrim in ra pal, kan ral nih biakinn chung thil vialte an hrawh dih."},"4":{"text":"Na hmunthiang chungah na ral kha an au, biakinn kha an lak cang."},"5":{"text":"Hreitlung in thing a hautu pawl nih thing an hau bantukin,"},"6":{"text":"thingphel vialte kha an hreitlung le an sobul in an khuai dih hna."},"7":{"text":"Na biakinn kha an khangh; nangmah kan in biaknak hmun kha an thurhhnawmh; a dihlak in an hrawh dih!"},"8":{"text":"Kanmah kha a rial in rial cikcek an kan duh, ram chung hmunthiang paoh kha an khangh dih hna."},"9":{"text":"Kan thil thiang kha an lo dih, profet an um ti lo, hi bantukin thil kha zei can dah a um ti kha ahohmanh nih an hngal lo."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan ral nih hin zei can dah an kan nihsawh lai? Na min hi a zungzal in maw an nihsawh ko lai?"},"11":{"text":"Zeicahdah bawmh na kan duh lo? Zeicahdah na kut cu na hnulei ah na chiah hna?"},"12":{"text":"Pathian, a hramthawk tein nangmah cu kan siangpahrang na si i vawlei cungah hin nangmah nih ral kha na tei hna."},"13":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi na thazang in rili kha na cheu i rili chung rulpi kha an lu na den dih hna.","ref":"Exo 14.21"},"14":{"text":"Leviathan rulpi lu kha na den hna i a ruak cu thetse ram mi kha ei awkah na pek hna.","ref":"Job 41.1; Slm 104.26; Isa 27.1"},"15":{"text":"Cerhti le tiput cu na luanter hna i tiva ngan cu na carter hna."},"16":{"text":"Chun le zan cu nangmah nih na ser hna, ni le thlapa cu an umnak hmun cio ah khan na chiah hna."},"17":{"text":"Vawlei cu a donghnak ri kha nangmah nih na ser hna i ṭhal caan le khuasik caan cu na ser hna."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw maw Pathian, na ral nih an in serhsat kha philh hlah; annih cu mihrut an si i nangmah cu zei ah an in rel lo."},"19":{"text":"Santlailo na mi hna hi a puarhrangmi an ral hna kut chungah kaltak hna hlah; hremnak a ingmi na mi hi philh hna hlah."},"20":{"text":"Kanmah he biakamnak na tuahmi kha philh hlah. Kan ram chung a muihnak hmun paoh hi zaang-ennak in a khat."},"21":{"text":"Hremmi kha sunghter hna hlah law sifak le rethei nih in thangṭhat ko hna seh."},"22":{"text":"Maw Pathian, tho law na bia kha chim tuah! Nangmah zei ah an rel lomi nih chun nitlak in nihchuak i an in saih kha philh hlah."},"23":{"text":"Na ral nih thinhun in an au len cu philh hlah, an dotu hna nih hnahnawhnak thawng an umter zungzalmi cu philh hlah."}}},"75":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan in thangṭhat, Maw Pathian, nangmah cu kan in thangṭhat. Zeitluk in dah na lianhngan kha kan thanh i khuaruahharmi thil na tuahmi kha kan chim.","title":"Pathian Cu Biaceihtu A Si Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Pathian nih, “Biaceihnak dingah caan ka khiah cang i aa buaktlak tein ka ceih hna lai."},"3":{"text":"Vawlei le a cung i a ummi minung vialte hi lo dih hna hmanh seh law vawlei hram cu fek tein ka umter lai."},"4":{"text":"Miruamkai kha i porhlaw hlah u ka ti hna i miṭhalo kha nan lung puam hlah u, ka ti hna;"},"5":{"text":"i leksuai ti hlah u ka ti hna i i fak len ti hlah u ka ti hna,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Biaceihnak hi nichuahlei in siseh nitlaklei in siseh a ra lo, chaklei in siseh thlanglei in siseh a ra lo;"},"7":{"text":"bia a ceihtu cu Pathian a si i a cheu kha a ṭhumh hna i a cheu kha a cawi hna,"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih a kut in hrai pakhat aa put, cu hrai cu zu hrim, a ṭhawng ngaingaimi in a khat, a thlet i miṭhalo vialte kha a dinter hna, a ne zongin an khawn dih."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu Jakob Pathian kong chim kha ka bang lai lo i amah thangṭhatnak hla sak zong kha ka ngol bal lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna ṭhawnnak cu a hrawh lai, sihmanhsehlaw miding mi ṭhawnnak kha cu a karh chin lai."}}},"76":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu Judah ram chungah an hngalh ngaingai i Israel ram ah a min a thang.","title":"Teitu Pathian Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"A umnak inn cu Jerusalem ah khan a si i Zion Tlang cungah khan khua a sa."},"3":{"text":"Cuka ah cun ral pawl an cantiang kha a khiah dih hna i an phaw le an nam zong kha a hrawh dih hna — an hriamnam vialte kha a hrawh dih."},"4":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na sunparnak cu a lianhngan, maw Pathian! Na ral na tei hnanak tlang in na ra kir tikah khan, zeitluk in dah na rumra kha a ngan!"},"5":{"text":"An ralkap ralṭha pawl cu an hranchaw kha na chuh hna i atu cu thihnak hngilh in an i hngilh cang; an hriamnam a run hmangtu dingah a tangmi pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhih hna tikah maw Jakob Pathian, an rangtum vialte le an rangcung ralkap vialte cu an ril dih!"},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah cu mi nih an in ṭih hringhran ko! Na thin a hun ahcun ahodah na hmaiah a dir ngam lai?"},"8":{"text":"Vawleicung i hremnak a ingmi vialte hna khamh awkah; nangmah nih na biakhiahnak cu thanh awk i na thawh tikah, na biakhiahnak cu vancung khin na run langhter i vawlei cu a thin a phang i dai tein a um.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Minung thinhunnak nih cun nangmah thangṭhatnak tu kha a karhter chin lehlam; ral chungin a nung in a tangmi hna nih na puai kha an tuah hna lai."},"11":{"text":"Kan in pek lai tiah nan i kammi kha Bawipa nan Pathian cu pe u; kan pawngkam i a ummi miphun hna, Bawipa cu laksawng ra pe u. Pathian nih minung cu amah ṭih dingin a ser hna,"},"12":{"text":"a ruam a kaimi bawi kha a ṭhumh hna i siangpahrang nganngan kha therphang lengmang in a umter hna."}}},"77":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian cu fak piin ka auh, fak piin ka auh i a ka theih.","title":"Harnak Caan Chung I Hnangamnak Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Harnak caan ah Bawipa sinah cun thla ka cam; zan khuadei thlacam in ka kut cu ka hler hna, sihmanhsehlaw hnangamnak ka hmu kho lo."},"3":{"text":"Pathian kha ka ruat i ka hram, khua ka ruat i ka lung a dong. Selah"},"4":{"text":"A ka hngilhter lo, ka lungre a thei tuk i zeihmanh ka chim kho lo."},"5":{"text":"A liam ciami ni kha ka ruat hna i a luan ciami kum kha ka hngalh ṭhan hna."},"6":{"text":"Zan khuadei fak piin khua ka ruat; khua ka ruat lengmang i keimah le keimah kaa halmi cu hihi a si:"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih hin a zungzal in maw a ka hlawt ko lai? Ka cungah hin lawmhnak a ngei ṭhan ti lai lo maw?"},"8":{"text":"Daw ti loin maw a ka um ko lai? Bia a ka kammi cu pakpalawng maw a si ko lai?"},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih hin minung cung i zaangfahnak ngeih kha a philh ko hnga maw? Minung cung i zawnruahnak a ngeih tawnmi kha a thinhunnak nih dahra a hloh dih?” ka ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun kaa thawh i, “Ka lungfah bikmi cu — Pathian cu zeizong vialte tuah khotu a si ti lo,” ti hi a si, ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa, thil lianngan na tuahmi kha ka philh hna lai lo i kan hnulei caan i khuaruahharmi thil na tuahmi kha ka lung ah an hung pem ṭhan lai."},"12":{"text":"Na tuah ciami thil vialte kha ka ruat ṭhan hna lai i ka lung chungin ka tuaktan hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na tuahmi thil vialte hi an thiang dih! Nangmah tlukin a nganmi pathian zeihmanh an um lo."},"14":{"text":"Nang cu khuaruahharmi thil a tuahtu Pathian na si; na ṭhawnnak cu miphun hna lakah khan na langhter."},"15":{"text":"Na lianhngannak in na mi cu na khamh hna, na mi Jakob tefa hna le Josef tefa hna cu na khamh hna. Selah"},"16":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ti nih an in hmuh tikah an thin a phang i rili tawne hna cu an ther."},"17":{"text":"Khuadawm nih ruah a surter, van in khua a ri i nimtlau kha a kenkip ah an lek."},"18":{"text":"Khuari thawng cu a tor in a tor i nimtlau nih vawlei kha a ceuh dih; vawlei cu a hninh in aa hnin."},"19":{"text":"Rili cungah na ke in na kal, a thukmi rilipi cu na tan, sihmanhsehlaw na ke neh cu hmuh khawh an si lo."},"20":{"text":"Na mi cu tuukhal bangin na hruai hna, Moses le Aaron kha na cawnghter hna."}}},"78":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka mi hna, kan cawnpiakmi hna kha ngai tuah u, ka chimmi bia kha ṭha tein ngai tuah u.","title":"Pathian le A Mi Hna"},"2":{"text":"Nan sinah bia ka chim lai i hlanlio thil khuaruahhar kha a sullam kan chimh hna lai.","ref":"Mat 13.35"},"3":{"text":"Cu thil cu kan rak theihmi le kan rak hngalhmi kha an si, kan pupa hna nih an kan chimhmi kha an si."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa ṭhawnnak le amah nih thil lianngan a tuahmi hna le, thil khuaruahhar a tuahmi hna kha, kan fale cu chim loin kan um hna lai lo, kan hmai chan mi kha kan chimh hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Israel mi kha nawlbia a pek hna, Jakob tefa kha nawlbia a pek hna. Ka nawlbia cu nan fale kha nan cawnpiak hna lai, tiin kan pupa kha a fial hna."},"6":{"text":"Cuticun hmai chan mi nih an hngalh ve lai i an fale kha an cawnpiak ve hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun Pathian zong kha an i bochan lai i a tuahmi thil kha an philh hna lai lo, a nawlbia kha an zulh zungzal hna lai."},"8":{"text":"Annih cu a hringsortu hna bantuk kha an si lai lo, kha hna kha cu ralthawh hmang, nawl ngai lomi, Pathian fek tein aa bochan lomi, Pathian sinah zumhawktlak in a um bal lomi an si."},"9":{"text":"Li le thal in ral a tu tawnmi Efraim mi kha raltuk taktak ni ah cun an zam."},"10":{"text":"Pathian sinah bia an i kammi kha an zul lo, a nawlbia kha ngaih an duh lo."},"11":{"text":"A tuahmi thil kha an philh hna i khuaruahharnak a langhtermi kha an i cinken lo."},"12":{"text":"An pupa hna mithmuh hrimhrim ah khan Pathian nih khuaruahharmi thil pakhat a tuah, Zoan lo ah, Izipt ram ah khan a tuah.","ref":"Exo 7.8—12.32"},"13":{"text":"Rili kha a cheu i a chungin a hruai hna; ti cu vampang bantukin a dirter hna.","ref":"Exo 14.21-22"},"14":{"text":"Chun ah khuadawm in a hruai hna i zan ah mei ceu in a hruai hna.","ref":"Exo 13.21-22"},"15":{"text":"Ram car chungah khan lung ngan pipi kha a khuai hna i rili ti zat in din awk ti a pek hna;","ref":"Exo 17.1-7; Nam 20.2-13"},"16":{"text":"lungpang chung khan tiva a chuahter hna i ti cu tiva bangin a luanter."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian cungah cun sualnak an tuah lengmang ko i Cung Nung Bik kha ramcar chungah cun an doh zungzal ko."},"18":{"text":"Kan duhmi rawl cu na kan pek hrimhrim lai tiin Pathian cu an hneksak.","ref":"Exo 16.2-15; Nam 11.4-23,31-35"},"19":{"text":"Pathian cu an thangchiat i, “Pathian nih cun ramcar ah cun cabuai cu a hung kho ngai hnga maw?"},"20":{"text":"Lungpi cu a tuk i ti cu a chuak hluahmah taktak, asinain rawl cu a kan pe kho ngai hnga maw? A mi cu sa a kan pe kho ngai hnga maw?” an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cu an chimmi cu Pathian nih a theih tikah an cungah a thin a hung; a mi cu mei in a hrem hna i an cung i a thinhunnak kha a ṭhang,"},"22":{"text":"zeicahtiah amah kha an i bochan duh lo i a kan khamh lai, tiah an zum duh lo."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw van kha bia a chimh i a innka kha a hunter;"},"24":{"text":"vancung cun rawl a run pek hna, an ei awk manna changreu kha a run thlak hna."},"25":{"text":"Cuticun vancungmi rawl kha an ei. Pathian nih an ei khawh chung ei awkin a pek hna."},"26":{"text":"Cun nichuahlei thli kha a hranter i a ṭhawnnak in thlanglei thli kha a thawhter,"},"27":{"text":"cun leidip zat in va kha a thlak hna, rili kam thetse zat in a thlak hna;"},"28":{"text":"an riahhmun laifang ah khan an tla, an thlam velchum ah khan an tla."},"29":{"text":"Cuticun mi nih khan an ei hna i an khim; Pathian nih an duh zat in a pek hna."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an ei lio, a khim hmanh an khim hlanah khan,"},"31":{"text":"Pathian cu an cungah a thin a hung i an miṭhawng bikbik kha a thah hna, Israel tlangval ṭha bikbik kha a thah hna!"},"32":{"text":"Hi vialte khuaruahharnak a tuah ko nain mi cu an sual lengmang ko i a zumh in an zum duh lo;"},"33":{"text":"cucaah cun an ni cu thaw bantukin a donghter hna, an nunnak cu chikkhatte ah thil ṭhalo nih a tlunhnawh hna i a dong."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a cheu a thah hna tikah khan, a cheu cu amah leiah an i mer ve; an i ngaichih i amah sinah thla fak piin an cam."},"35":{"text":"Annih a hupphengtu hna cu Pathian a si kha an hun hngalh i annih a khamhtu hna cu Cungnung Bik a si kha an hun theih."},"36":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an bia cu lih lawngte a si i an chimmi paoh cu hlennak lawngte a si."},"37":{"text":"Amah sinah khan zumhawktlak in an um lo, amah sin i bia an i kammi kha an zul lo."},"38":{"text":"Asinain Pathian cu a mi hna cungah khan zaangfahnak a ngei, an sualnak kha a ngaihthiam hna i a hrawk hna lo. Thinhun kha voi tampi aa sum i a thinlinhnak kha voi tampi chuahter loin a um."},"39":{"text":"Minung an si kha a philh lo, a hung hrang i a lo ṭhan komi thlitu bantuk men an si kha a philh lo."},"40":{"text":"Voi zeizat riamruam dik amah kha ramcar chungah khan an doh; voi zeizat riamruam dik a ngaih an chiatter!"},"41":{"text":"Atu le atu Pathian kha an hneksak, atu le atu Israel Mi Thiang kha a thin an hunter."},"42":{"text":"A liannganmi a ṭhawnnak kha an philh; an ral hna kut chungin a khamh hna kha an philh,"},"43":{"text":"Izipt ram Zoan lo lak i a liannganmi thil le khuaruahharmi thil a tuahmi kha an philh."},"44":{"text":"Tiva kha thi ah a canter hna i Izipt mi nih khan tiva ti cu an ding kho lo.","ref":"Exo 7.17-21"},"45":{"text":"Tho kha a thlahhnawh hna i awlok an chonh hna, utlak kha a thlahhnawh hna i an lo kha an hrawhpiak dih hna.","ref":"Exo 8.1-6,20-24"},"46":{"text":"An rawl kung eitu ah lunghmul a thlahhnawh hna i an lo hrawktu ah khaubawk a thlahhnawh hna.","ref":"Exo 10.12-15"},"47":{"text":"An mitsur ruang cu rial in a thah hna i an theipi kung cu hawhra in a thah hna.","ref":"Exo 9.22-25"},"48":{"text":"An caw cu rial in a thah hna i an tuurun cu ṭek in a thah hna."},"49":{"text":"Ṭih a nungmi a thinhunnak kha an cungah a thlet hnawh hna i hrawktu vancungmi a thlahhnawhmi hna nih khan harnak tampi an pek hna."},"50":{"text":"A thin kha a sum lo i an nunnak zong kha a zuah hna lo; rai in a thah dih hna."},"51":{"text":"Izipt ram chung innchungkhar dihlak an fapa upa bik kha a thah dih hna.","ref":"Exo 12.29"},"52":{"text":"Cun tuukhal bangin a mi cu a chuahpi hna i ramcar chungah khan lam a hruai hna.","ref":"Exo 13.17-22"},"53":{"text":"Him tein a kalpi hna i zeihmanh an ṭih lo, sihmanhsehlaw an ral hna cu rili nih a vui hna.","ref":"Exo 14.26-28"},"54":{"text":"A ram thiang chungah cun a luhpi hna, amah hrimhrim nih a teimi tlang ah cun a phakpi hna.","ref":"Exo 15.17; Jos 3.14-17"},"55":{"text":"A mi pawl cu hmailei i an hung fon deuh lengmang tikah khan cuka i a rak ummi hna kha a dawi hna; ram cu Israel miphun kha a cheuh hna i cuka ah cun an thlam chung cio ah khan khua a sakter hna.","ref":"Jos 11.16-23"},"56":{"text":"Asinain Lianngan Bik Pathian kha an doh i an hneksak. A nawlbia kha zulh an duh lo i","ref":"Biac 2.11-15"},"57":{"text":"an pu an pa hna bantuk khan ral thawh hmang le zumh awk tlak loin an um ve, aa merhmi likuk in kahmi thal cu a ka a kheng khomi a si lo caah i bochan khawh ding a si lo bantukin annih zong bochan awk a tlakmi an si ve lo."},"58":{"text":"Lawkih biaknak hmun an sermi nih khan a thin a hunter i an serchommi siasal hna nih khan a nah an chuahter."},"59":{"text":"Cucu Pathian nih a hmuh tikah a thin a hung i cucaah a mi cu a hlawt hna."},"60":{"text":"Shiloh khua i a ummi an thlam cu a kaltak, minung sin i a umnak a inn cu a kaltak.","ref":"Jos 18.1; Jer 7.12-14; 26.6"},"61":{"text":"Biakamnak kuang kha kan ral pawl cu a tlaihter hna. a lianhngannak le a sunparnak an umnak kuang cu a tlaihter hna.","ref":"1Sam 4.4-22"},"62":{"text":"Amah a mi hna lila cungah cun a thin a hung i an ral kha annih cu a thahter hna."},"63":{"text":"Ral ah tlangval cu an thi lengmang i ngaknu pawl cu vat awk an ngei ti lo."},"64":{"text":"Tlangbawi cu vainam in an thi i an nupile nih khan a ngaih hmanh an ngai kho hna lo."},"65":{"text":"A donghnak ah Bawipa cu hngilh i hun i hlauh bantuk khin a hun i hlau; zu nih a tha a pawttermi ralkap ṭhawng bantuk khi a si."},"66":{"text":"A ral cu a khirh hna i a tei cikcek hna, ningzak in a thawh in tho kho ti loin a tei hna."},"67":{"text":"Josef tefa kha a hlawt hna i Efraim phun kha a thim hna lo."},"68":{"text":"Judah phun tu kha a thim i a duh ngaingaimi Zion Tlang tu kha a thim."},"69":{"text":"Cuka ah cun a biakinn kha a sak, vancung i a inn bantuk a si; vawlei bantuk fek in a ser i zungzal him dingin a tuah."},"70":{"text":"A sal David kha a thim i tuu a khalhnak le tuu a cawnghnak khan a lak.","ref":"1Sam 16.11-12; 2Sam 7.8; 1Cha 17.7"},"71":{"text":"Amah cu Israel siangpahrang ah a ser, Pathian mi hna tuukhal ah a ser."},"72":{"text":"David nih cun a lungthin a dih-umnak in a zohkhenh hna i fimnak in a hruai hna. in a zohkhenh hna i fimnak in a hruai hna."}}},"79":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, lawkihmi nih na mi hna kan ram hi an rung chim; na biakinn thiang cu an thurhhnawmh i Jerusalem cu an hrawh dih.","title":"Na Miphun Hi Kan Luatter Ko Asaf Hla","ref":"2Sia 25.8-10; 2Cha 36.17-19; Jer 52.12-14"},"2":{"text":"Na mi hna an ruak cu langta ei awkah an hlonh hna i na sal hna an ruak cu saram ei awkah an hlonh hna."},"3":{"text":"Na mi hna an thisen cu ti bantukin an luanter, Jerusalem khua pumpi ah thi cu ti bantukin a luang, ruak vuitu ding ahohmanh an um lo."},"4":{"text":"Kan pawngkam i a ummi miphun hna nih capo ah an kan saih, an kan nihsawh i an kan zawmhtaih;"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, zei can dah kan cungah na thin a hun lai? Zungzal in maw a hun ko lai? Na thinhunnak cu zungzal in maw mei bantukin a alh ko lai?"},"6":{"text":"Nangmah an bia lomi miphun cu na thinhunnak kha toih hna law nangmah an hlawmi cu na thinhunnak kha langhhnawh ko hna."},"7":{"text":"Annih nih kan mi kha an thah hna i kan ram kha an hrawh dih."},"8":{"text":"Kan pupa hna nih sualnak an tuahmi ruangah cun kannih cu dan kan tat hlah, ruahchan awk zeihmanh kan ngeih ti lo caah zaangfahnak tu kan cungah ngei ko."},"9":{"text":"Na min upatnak ding caah kan bawm tuah, Maw Pathian kan Khamhtu; kan chuah law kan sualnak cu kan ngaithiam ko."},"10":{"text":"Zeicahdah miphun dang hna nih, “Nan Pathian cu khuazei ah dah a um kun?” tiah an kan ti lai? Na sal kha an thi an luanter hna caah miphun dang pawl dan na tat hna cu kan mit hrimhrim nih hmu seh."},"11":{"text":"Thongtla pawl cu an aihramnak kha theihpiak ko sawh hna, thah awkin biakhiah cangmi cu a liannganmi na ṭhawnnak in luatter ko hna."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, miphun dang pawl cu, nangmah an in zawmhtaih ruangah khan a let sarih in rul hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun kannih na mi, na tuurun chung tuu hna nih hin, zungzal in kan in lawmh lai i kan hmailei hna."}}},"80":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Israel Tuukhal, kan bia kan ngaihpiak tuah, Josef kha tuurun bantukin a hruaitu, kan thlacamnak kan theihpiak tuah. Cherubim cungah bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi,","title":"Na Miphun Hi Kan Tungmer Ṭhan Ko Asaf Hla","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"2":{"text":"na dawtnak cu kan cungah langhter ko; Efraim le Benjamin le Manasseh phun cungah langhter ko! Na ṭhawnnak cu kan hmuhter, ra law kan khamh tuah."},"3":{"text":"Kan kirpi ṭhan ko, Maw Pathian! Na dawtnak kha kan cungah langhter law kannih nih khamhnak kan hmuh lai."},"4":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian, zeitik tiang dah na mi hna kan thlacamnak hi let duh loin na kan um lai?"},"5":{"text":"Mitthli hi ni fate kan ei awk rawl ah na ser i hrai nganpi khat in kan din awkah na kan chiahpiak ko."},"6":{"text":"Kan khua chingchan hna hmaiah ningzak in na kan umter i kan ral nih an lung diriam tein an kan nihsawh."},"7":{"text":"Kan kirpi ṭhan ko, Maw Lianngan Bik Pathian, na dawtnak kha kan cungah langhter law kannih nih khamhnak kan hmuh lai."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram in mitsur ruang pakhat na chuahpi; miphun dang kha na ṭhawl hna i an ram ah cun cu mitsur ruang cu na phun."},"9":{"text":"A ṭhan khawh nakhnga hmun kha na thianhpiak i cucaah a hram cu thukpi an pil kho i a ruang cu an zam i ram vialte kha an huh dih."},"10":{"text":"Tlang cu thladem a demh hna i sidar kung ngan pipi cu a nge nih a huh dih hna."},"11":{"text":"A nge cu an zam lengmang i Mediterranean Rili an phan, Zufrates Tiva tiang an phan."},"12":{"text":"Zeicahdah a kulhnak hau vialte cu na bauh dih? Atu cu aa chawkmi paoh nih a thei kha an fir;"},"13":{"text":"ngal nih an nan dih i saram vialte nih an ei."},"14":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Pathian, kanmah leiah i mer ko! Vancung khin run kan zoh law ra law na mitsur ruang hi rung khamh ko."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah hrimhrim nih na cinmi mitsur ruang hi ra khamh tuah; hi tluk ṭhawng in na ṭhantermi mitsur ruang no hi ra khamh tuah!"},"16":{"text":"Kan ral nih mei in an khangh i an sam dih; na thinhun in zoh hna law hrawk hna."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah nih na thimmi miphun cu kan huppheng law kan zohkhenh ko, nangmah nih hi tluk ṭhawng in na ṭhantermi miphun cu kan zohkhenh ko!"},"18":{"text":"Nangmah cu zeitikhmanh ah kan in mertak ti lai lo; nungdam in kan umter law kan in thangṭhat lai."},"19":{"text":"Kan kirpi ṭhan ko, Maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian! Na dawtnak kha kan cungah langhter law kannih nih khamhnak k zeitikhmanh ah kan in mertak ti lai lo; nungdam in kan umter law kan in thangṭhat lai."}}},"81":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A kan chanhtu Pathian cu lunglawmhnak in hla in thangṭhat u; Jakob Pathian cu hla in thangṭhat u!","title":"Puai Caan Hla Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Hla dawh sak cu thawk u law khuang cu tum hna u; tingtang le thonglawi in aw dawhdawh cu tum hna u."},"3":{"text":"Thla thar caan le thla lai caan ah, kan puai ah tuu ki cu tum hna u.","ref":"Nam 10.10"},"4":{"text":"Hihi Israel ram ah kan phung a si, Jakob Pathian nih tuah a kan fialmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Izipt ram doh awkah aa thawh tikah, Israel mi kha nawlbia ah a pek hna. Ka theih bal lomi aw pakhat kha ka theih i cu aw nih cun,"},"6":{"text":"“Nan keng cung thilrit pipi kha kan lakpiak cang hna i nan rianṭuannak bawm kha kan chiahter cang hna."},"7":{"text":"Harnak nan in tikah nan ka auh i kan khamh hna. Khuadawm chung i kaa thuhnak hmun khin ka run in leh hna; Meribah cerh ah khan kan hneksak hna.","ref":"Exo 17.7; Nam 20.13"},"8":{"text":"“Ka mi hna, ralrinnak kan pekmi hna hi ngai tuah u; Israel, ka bia hi ngai ko sawh!"},"9":{"text":"Ramdang pathian kha bia hrimhrim hna hlah u, keimah dah ti lo cu a dang zeihmanh bia hna hlah u.","ref":"Deu 5.6-7"},"10":{"text":"Keimah cu Bawipa nan Pathian ka si, keimah nih Izipt ram in kan chuahpi hna; nan ka ang u law rawl kan pek hna lai."},"11":{"text":"“Asinain ka mi nih ka bia ngaih nan duh lo; Israel nih ka nawl zulh na duh lo."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah nan lung ṭhawn ning bantukin nan lam kha kan zulhter hna i nan duhmi paoh kha kan tuahter hna."},"13":{"text":"Ka mi nih hin ka bia ngai u law zeitluk in dik ka hei i lawmh hnga! Ka nawl zul u law, zeitluk in dik ka lung a va si hnga!"},"14":{"text":"Nan ral kha khulrang tein kan teipiak ko hna hnga."},"15":{"text":"A ka huami cu ka hmaiah therphang in an kun lai, dantatnak an inmi cu zungzal in a hmun lai."},"16":{"text":"Changvut ṭha bik in ka"}}},"82":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vancung biaceihnak hmun ah Pathian cu a dir i pathian pawl an i pumhnak ah biakhiahnak hi bantukin a tuah;","title":"Uktu Ngan Bik Cu Pathian A Si Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"“Ding loin biaceih hi ngol hrimhrim cang u, miṭhalo duhdanh kha ngol cang u."},"3":{"text":"Sifakmi le ngakṭah kha an bia ceihpiak hna u, rethei le bawmtu ngei lo kha hmaan tein ruahpiak hna u."},"4":{"text":"Sifak le retheimi kha chuah hna u, miṭhalo hna kut chung khan khamh hna u."},"5":{"text":"“Nan va hrut thiam dah, nan va fim lo thiam dah! Khuamui chungah nan um i vawlei cungah hin dinnak zeihmanh a um ti lo."},"6":{"text":"Nannih cu pathian nan si, Cungnung Bik fapa nan si, kan ti hna.","ref":"Jhn 10.34"},"7":{"text":"Asinain minung bantukin nan thi lai, siangpahrang fapa an thih bantukin nan thi ve lai,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ra law vawlei hi uk tuah; miphun vialte hi nangmah ta an si."}}},"83":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Pathian, um sawhsawh ko hlah; dai zirziar le holh loin um hlah, maw Pathian!","title":"Israel Mi An Ral Teinak Ca Thlacamnak Asaf Hla"},"2":{"text":"Zohhmanh, na ral cu an cawl an cang i nangmah an huatu cu nangmah doh awkah an i tim len ko."},"3":{"text":"Na mi hna tuknak dingah a thli in khua an khang i nangmah nih na huhphenhmi hna doh awk kha an i tim."},"4":{"text":"An i thawh i, “Israel hi a phun hloh in hlo u sih, zungzal in philh si seh,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"An khuakhanmi ah cun lungkhat in an um i nangmah doh awkah cun an ṭang ṭi."},"6":{"text":"Cu hna cu, Edom mi, Ishmael mi; Moab mi, Hagri mi,"},"7":{"text":"Gebal mi, Ammon mi, Amalek mi, Filistia mi le Tair mi an si;"},"8":{"text":"Assiria zong kha an sinah aa ṭom ve, an dihlak in Lot tefa cu an bawmh hna."},"9":{"text":"Midian mi cungah na tuahmi bantuk kha annih cung zongah tuah ve, Kishon Tiva ah Sisera le Jabin cung i na tuahmi bantuk kha an cungah tuah ko;","ref":"Biac 4.6-22; 7.1-23"},"10":{"text":"Sisera le Jabin cu Endor ah na sunghter hna i an ruak cu vawlei ah a rop."},"11":{"text":"Oreb le Zeeb cungah na tuahmi bantuk kha an ralbawi hna cungah cun tuah ko; Zebah le Zalmunna na sunghter hna bantuk khan, an uktu bawi vialte cu sunghter ko hna;","ref":"Biac 7.25; 8.12"},"12":{"text":"cu uk bawi pawl nih cun an rak i thawh i, “Pathian ram a simi cu kanmah caah kan i lak lai,” an rak ti."},"13":{"text":"Ka Pathian, annih cu leidip bangin ṭhek ko hna, thli nih a choihmi capawl bangin ṭhek dih hna."},"14":{"text":"Mei nih tupi kha a kangh i meizik nih tlang cu a hliau bantukin"},"15":{"text":"annih cu ṭotho in dawi hna law thlichia in ṭhih ko hna."},"16":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na min lianngan kha an phuan hlantiang, ningzahnak cu an lu cungah khinh luaimai ko hna."},"17":{"text":"Sung hna seh law therphang zungzal in um hna seh, ningzak hmaichia in thi hna seh."},"18":{"text":"Nangmah lawnglawng hi Bawipa na si le vawlei dihlak uktu, Cungnung Bik na si kha hngal hna seh!"}}},"84":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa, zeitluk in dah na biakinn cu ka duh!","title":"Pathian Inn Ngaih Korah Hla"},"2":{"text":"Cuka i um cu ka duh hringhran! Bawipa biakinn chung tual cu ka ngai hna. A nungmi Pathian cu ka nunnak dihlak in hla in ka thangṭhat."},"3":{"text":"Pithlung hmanh nih bu an i sak i pele hmanh nih anmah innte an ngei; an fano cu na biakṭheng pawngah an chiah hna, maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa, kan siangpahrang le kan Pathian."},"4":{"text":"Na biakinn chungah a ummi cu zeitluk in dah an i lawmh, nangmah thangṭhatnak hla a sa zungzalmi hna cu zeitluk in dah an tha a nuam!"},"5":{"text":"Nangmah sinin thazang a hmumi hna cu zeitluk in dah an i lawmh, Zion Tlang i va kal a duhmi hna cu zeitluk in dah an i lawmh."},"6":{"text":"A ro a carmi nelrawn kha an tan tikah cerhti put tamnak hmun ah a cang; ruahter nih khan tidil in a khahter."},"7":{"text":"An kal tikah an ṭhawng chin lengmang; Zion Tlang ah pathian hna Pathian cu an hmuh lai."},"8":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian, ka thlacamnak kha ka theihpiak tuah, Jakob Pathian, ka thlacamnak kha ka ngaihpiak tuah."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan siangpahrang cu thluachuahnak pe ko, nangmah nih na thimmi siangpahrang cu thluachuahnak pe ko."},"10":{"text":"Na biakinn chungah ni khat um cu hmun dang i ni thong khat um nakin a ṭha deuh. Miṭhalo mi hna inn chung i um nakcun ka Pathian inn kutka hram dir hmanh ka duh deuh."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa cu a kan hupphengtu le a sunglawimi kan siangpahrang a si, amah nih thluachuah a kan pek i vel le thangṭhatnak kan hmuh. A dingmi thil a tuahtu paoh cu thil ṭha kha pe loin a um hna lo."},"12":{"text":"Maw Lianngan Bik Pathian, nangmah an bochanmi cu lunglawmmi an si."}}},"85":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, na ram cu na zaangfah ko, Israel cu a kumvui na ṭhatter ṭhan.","title":"Ram Ṭhatnak Ca Thlacam Korah Hla"},"2":{"text":"Na mi hna an sualnak kha na ngaihthiam hna i an palhmi vialte kha na maimilh hna."},"3":{"text":"An cung i na thinhunnak kha na damter i na thinlinhnak kha na daihter."},"4":{"text":"Maw Pathian, kan Khamhtu, kan kirpi ṭhan law kan cungah lungsi loin um ti hlah."},"5":{"text":"Kan cungah zungzal in maw na thin a hun ko lai? Na thin cu a dam bal lai lo maw?"},"6":{"text":"Thazang thar kan pe law, na mi nih kan in thangṭhat lai."},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, a fekmi na dawtnak cu kan hmuhsak ko, na khamhnak zong kan pe fawn."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian i a chimmi bia cu ka ngai lai, hruh lam a simi lam, kan lam kha kan zulh ṭhan lo caah a mi kannih hi daihnak kha a kan kamh."},"9":{"text":"Amah a upatmi khamh awkah khan aa tim zungzal ko i kan ram chungah hin a sunparnak cu a um zungzal lai."},"10":{"text":"Dawtnak le zumhawktlak sinak cu an ra ṭi lai; dinnak le daihnak cu an i tong lai."},"11":{"text":"Minung nih zumhawktlak a sinak kha van leiah a kai lai i Pathian dinnak nih vancung khin a run zoh lai."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih kumvui ṭha a kan pek lai i kan ram nih rawl tampi a chuahter lai."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa hmaiah khan dinnak cu a kal lai i a lam kha a rak sialpiak lai."}}},"86":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A derthawmmi le santlai lomi ka si caah ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak law ka let tuah, Maw Bawipa .","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam David Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah kha an tlaihchanmi ka si caah thihnak in ka khamh ko; nangmah sal ka si ca le nangmah an bochanmi ka si caah ka khamh ko sawh."},"3":{"text":"Nang cu ka Pathian na si caah ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei ko, Maw Bawipa ; chun nitlak in na sinah thla ka cam."},"4":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu na sinah a kai lengmang caah na salpa hi ka lung ka lawmhter ko."},"5":{"text":"Nangmah sin i thla a cammi hna cungah cun na ṭha i ngaihthiamnak le a fekmi dawtnak in na khat, Maw Bawipa ."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa, ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak law nangmah bawmh hal in ka aunak hi ka theihpiak tuah."},"7":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak kha na ka leh tawn caah harnak caan ah nangmah kha kan auh lengmang."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah bantuk pathian dang ahohmanh an um lo, nangmah tuahmi bantuk a tuah khomi pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"9":{"text":"Nangmah nih na sermi miphun vialte hi an chuak lai i na hmaiah an kun lai. Na lianhngannak kha an thangṭhat lai,","ref":"Biat 15.4"},"10":{"text":"zeicahtiah Pathian, nangmah lawnglawng hi a ṭhawngmi na si, nangmah lawnglawng hi khuaruahhar a tuah khotu na si."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa, tuah seh ti na ka duhmi kha ka cawnpiak law na nawl kha fel tein ka zulh lai; ka lungthin a dih umnak in na rian ka ṭuan nakhnga ka cawnpiak ko."},"12":{"text":"Ka lungthin dihlak in kan thangṭhat lai, Maw Bawipa ka Pathian; na lianhngannak cu a zungzal in ka chim lai."},"13":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak cu zeitluk in dah ka caah a ngan! Thlan tawne in na ka khamh."},"14":{"text":"Maw Pathian, miruamkai pawl nih an ka fuh, nangmah zei i an rel lomi miṭhalo pawl nih thah an ka zalh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa, nang cu zaangfahnak le dawtnak in a khatmi Pathian na si; thin a fual i zaangfahnak a ngei zungzal i zumhawktlak a si zungzalmi na si."},"16":{"text":"Keimah leiah i mer law ka zaangfah tuah; ka nu nih a rak in biak bantukin kei zong nih kan biak ve caah, thazang ṭhawnnak ka pe law ka khamh tuah."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa, na ṭhatnak kha ka cungah langhter ko, cu tikah keimah a ka huami hna nih khan hnangamnak le bawmhnak na ka pek kha an hmuh lai i an ning a zak lai."}}},"87":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian nih tlang thiang cungah a khualipi kha a sak;","title":"Jerusalem Thangṭhatnak Hla Korah Hla"},"2":{"text":"Jerusalem khua cu, Israel ram chung i hmun dang vialte nakin a dawt deuh."},"3":{"text":"Pathian nih nangmah kong ah a chimmi bia sunglawi cu ngai tuah, Maw Pathian khualipi; Selah"},"4":{"text":"“Ka nawl a ngaimi miphun hna cazin kha ka ṭial tikah, Izipt le Babilon kha ka telh chih hna lai; cun Filistia le Tair le Ethiopia zong kha, Jerusalem ta nan si tiah ka ti hna lai,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Zion kong ah cun, miphun vialte kha Zion ta an si dih ti a si lai i Cungnung Bik nih a ṭhawnter lai."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih miphun hna cazin kha a ṭial lai i annih cu Jerusalem khuami hna chungah khan a telh chih hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Hlasa mi pawl le milam mi pawl nih khan an dihlak in na thangṭhatnak hla kha an sak lai. Selah"}}},"88":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa Pathian, ka khamhtu, chun nitlak in ka au i zan ah na hmaika ah ka ra.","title":"Bawmhnak Halnak Aunak Korah Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak ko sawh law nangmah bawmhnak hal in ka aunak cu ka ngaihpiak ko sawh!"},"3":{"text":"Harnak tam tuk nih an ka tlunhnawh i thlankhor an ka phakpi dengmang."},"4":{"text":"Thihnak a phan dengmangmi hna bantuk kha ka si ve i ka thazang vialte a lo dih cang."},"5":{"text":"Mithi hna lakah khan kaltak ka si ko; ral kut in a thimi an thlan chung i a it komi hna bantuk ka si, annih cu na philh diam cang hna i bawmh khawh a si in an si ti lo."},"6":{"text":"Thlan khor a thuhnak ka ah khan na ka hlonh, a thuk bik le a mui bik khor chungah khan na ka thlak."},"7":{"text":"Na thinhunnak nih rit ngaiin a ka nenh i na thinhunnak tilet nih khan a ka khuh."},"8":{"text":"Ka hawikom kha na ka chuh hna i annih nih a fih in an ka fih."},"9":{"text":"Kei cu thong ah ka tla i ka luat kho lo; harnak ka in ruangah ka mit zong a rawk dih. Bawipa, ni fate in kan auh i nangmah sinah thlacam in ka kut ka hler."},"10":{"text":"Khuaruahhar na tuahmi hna cu mithi caah maw an si? Mithi cu maw a tho hna in nangmah an thangṭhatmi cu an si?"},"11":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak cu thlan chungah maw chim a si i zumhawktlak na sinak cu rawhralnak hmun ah cun dah chim a si?"},"12":{"text":"Khuaruahharmi thil na tuahmi cu muihnak hmun ah cun maw hmuh an si i na ṭhatnak cu rawhralnak hmun ah cun dah hmuh a si?"},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, ka bawm ko sawh, tiin kan auh; zing fate in na sinah thla ka cam."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa, zeicahdah na ka hlawt? Zeicahdah na ka thuhtak?"},"15":{"text":"Ka ngakchiat lio tein temhnak ka ing lengmang i thihnak ka naih zungzal; dan na ka tatmi ka phorhnak ah hin ka ba cikcek cang."},"16":{"text":"Ṭih a nungmi na thinhunnak nih khan a ka khuh i na mi tuknak nih khan holh kho loin a ka tuah;"},"17":{"text":"chun nitlak in tilian bang an ka kulh; a kenkip in an ka chuahhnawh."},"18":{"text":"Ka hawikom ṭha bik hna hmanh nih khan an ka chuahtak; ka ca i a tangmi hawikom cu muihnak lawnglawng kha a si ko."}}},"89":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, a fekmi na dawtnak cu hla in ka sak zungzal ko lai i zumhawktlak na sinak cu ka chim thluangthluan ko lai.","title":"Pathian Cu Zumhawktlak A Si (1Sia 4.31)"},"2":{"text":"Na dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun lai ti kha ka hngalh, zumhawktlak na sinak cu van tlukin a fek."},"3":{"text":"Naa thawh i, “Ka thimmi sinah bia kaa kam cang; ka sal David cu bia ka kam i,"},"4":{"text":"‘Na tefa pakhat cu siangpahrang a si zungzal lai; na pennak cu zungzal in ka hmunhter lai,’ ka ti,” na ti. Selah","ref":"2Sam 7.12-16; 1Cha 17.11-14; Slm 132.11; Lam 2.30"},"5":{"text":"Vancung pathian hna nih khin khuaruahharmi thil na tuahmi hna cu hla in an sak hna; Bawipa, zumhawktlak na sinak cu hla in an thangṭhat."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa, vancung i a ummi khi nangmah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo, pathian hna lakah hin ahohmanh nangmah tluk an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Nangmah cu pathian hna nih an khuakhannak bu chungah khan an in upat i na kiang i a ummi vialte nih khan an in ṭih dih."},"8":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian, ahohmanh nangmah tluk i a ṭhawngmi an um lo; zeizong vialte ah nang cu zumhawktlak na si, Bawipa ;"},"9":{"text":"nangmah nih rilipi cu na uk i a tilet cu na daihter hna."},"10":{"text":"Limkeng Rahab cu na tei i na thah; a liannganmi na ṭhawnnak in na ral cu na tei hna."},"11":{"text":"Vawlei hi na ta a si, van zong khi na ta a si ko; vawlei le a cung i a ummi thil vialte hi na sermi an si;"},"12":{"text":"nangmah nih Chaklei le Thlanglei kha na ser hna, Tabor Tlang le Hermon Tlang nih lunglawmhnak in hla in an in thangṭhat."},"13":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na lianhngan! Zeitluk in dah na ṭhawn!"},"14":{"text":"Na pennak cu dinnak le biading cungah a hram bunh a si, na tuahmi thil kip chungah hin dawtnak le zumhawktlak sinak an um."},"15":{"text":"Hla in nangmah an biami cu milunglawm an si, na zaangfahnak ceunak chung i a ummi cu lunglawmmi an si."},"16":{"text":"Nangmah thawngin chun nitlak an i lawm i na ṭhat ruangah nangmah cu an in thangṭhat."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah nih teinak ngan pipi na kan pek, na zaangfahnak thawngin teinak cu kan hmu,"},"18":{"text":"cu ti kan hmuhnak cu a kan hupphengtu kha nangmah thimmi a si caah a si; nangmah Israel Mi Thiang nih kan siangpahrang cu na kan pek."},"19":{"text":"Zumhawktlak a simi na sal hna sinah hlan liopi ah langhnak in bia na chim i, “Ralkap min thang pakhat cu bawiluchin ka chinh cang; mizapi hna chungin thimmi kha bawiṭhutdan cu ka pek cang.","title":"Pathian Nih David Bia A Kamh"},"20":{"text":"Ka sal David cu ka thim cang i nan siangpahrang ah ka ser cang.","ref":"1Sam 13.14; Lam 13.22; 1Sam 16.12"},"21":{"text":"Ka thazang cu a sinah a um zungzal lai i ka ṭhawnnak nih a ṭhawnter lai."},"22":{"text":"A ral nih zeitikhmanh ah an tei lai lo i miṭhalo nih an tei bal lai lo."},"23":{"text":"A ral cu ka rial dih hna lai i amah a huatu cu ka thah hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Amah cu ka dawt zungzal lai i a cungah zumhawktlak in ka um zungzal lai; ral teinak kha ka pek zungzal lai."},"25":{"text":"A penmi a ram cu Mediterranean Rili in Zufrates Tiva tiang ka phakter lai."},"26":{"text":"Keimah cu a ka thawh lai i, ‘Nangmah cu ka pa le ka Pathian na si; a ka hupphengtu le ka khamhtu na si,’ a ka ti lai."},"27":{"text":"Amah cu ka fater ah ka ser lai i siangpahrang vialte lak i a ngan bik ka siter lai.","ref":"Biat 1.5"},"28":{"text":"A sin i bia kaa kammi cu ka tuah zungzal lai i amah he kan biakamnak cu zungzal in a hmun lai."},"29":{"text":"A tefa pakhat cu siangpahrang a si zungzal lai; a bawiṭhutdan cu van a hmunh chung paoh a hmun ve lai."},"30":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw a tefa hna nih khan ka nawlbia an zulh duh lo i ka phung ningin an nun lo i"},"31":{"text":"ka cawnpiakmi hna kha zei ah an rel lo i ka chimhmi hna kha an zulh lo ahcun,"},"32":{"text":"an sualnak ruangah khan dan ka tat hna lai i palhnak an tuahmi ruangah khan fungfek in ka tuk hna lai."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw David dawt kha cu ka ngol lai lo, bia ka kamhmi zong kha ka tlolh lai lo."},"34":{"text":"Amah he bia kan i kamnak kha ka hrawk lai lo, amah sin i bia ka kammi cu pakhatte hmanh ka let ṭhan lai lo."},"35":{"text":"“Voi khat ah zungzal ca in bia kaa kam; cu kaa kammi cu: ‘David cu ka hleng bal lai lo,’ ti hi a si."},"36":{"text":"Tefa a ngei zungzal hna lai i ni a tlan chung paoh cu a pennak kha keimah nih ka cawnghpiak lai."},"37":{"text":"Thlapa cu van ah khin zumhawktlak tehte a si bantukin cu thlapa bantuk cun a pennak cu a fek lai,” na ti. Selah"},"38":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na thimmi siangpahrang cungah cun na thin a hung i amah cu na kaltak i na hlawt cang.","title":"Siangpahrang A Sungh Ṭahnak Hla"},"39":{"text":"Na sal sin i bia na kammi cu na hrawh i a bawiluchin cu leidip lakah na hlonh."},"40":{"text":"A khua kulhnak cu na chimh dih hna i a ralhau cu rawk relrul in na kaltak hna."},"41":{"text":"Aa chawkmi paoh nih a thil kha an fir i a innpa pawl nih an nihsawh."},"42":{"text":"Teinak cu a ral hna tu kha na pek hna i annih cu lunglawm in na umter hna."},"43":{"text":"A hriamnam cu santlailo ah na ser hna i raltuknak hmun ah na sunghter."},"44":{"text":"A bawifung kha na lakpiak i a bawiṭhutdan cu vawlei ah na hrilh."},"45":{"text":"A kum nih a phak hlanah na tarter i hmaichiatnak nih a zual in a zual. Selah"},"46":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, zei can dah naa thuh lai? Zungzal in maw naa thuh lai? Na thinhunnak cu mei bangin zei can dah a alh lai?","title":"Khamhnak Ca Thlacamnak"},"47":{"text":"Bawipa, minung cu a nunnak hi zeitluk in dah a tawi ti kha philh hlah; mi vialte cu a thi dingin na kan ser dih kha philh hlah!"},"48":{"text":"Ahodah thi loin a nung zungzal kho lai? Zeitindah mi nih cun thlan cu a hrial khawh lai? Selah"},"49":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, hlanlio i na dawtnak na rak langhtermi hna kha khuazei ah dah an si dih? David bia na rak kamhmi kha tah, khuazei ah dah an um kun?"},"50":{"text":"Na sal nih nihsawhnak ka in kha philh hlah law Pathian zei i a rel lomi hna nih an ka serhsatnak kha philh sawh hlah."},"51":{"text":"Bawipa, na thimmi siangpahrang hi na ral pawl nih an zawmhtaih hringhran ko! A kalnak kip ah khan an nihsawh."},"52":{"text":"Bawipa cu zungzal in thangṭhat si ko seh! Amen! Amen!"}}},"90":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah cu kan inn na si zungzal!","title":"BU LINAK (Slm 90 in 106 tiang) Pathian le Minung Kong Moses Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Tlang an sem hlan le vawlei kha na ser hlan in nangmah cu zungzal in, hramthawknak zong um lo donghnak zong um loin Pathian na si."},"3":{"text":"Minung cu an rak sining ah khan kir ṭhan u na ti hna, vawlei ah na canter ṭhan hna."},"4":{"text":"Kum thong khat hi nang caah cun ni khat bantuk a si; a dih cangmi nizan bantuk kha a si ko, zan khat chung i suimilam caan tawite pakhat bantuk khi a si ko.","ref":"2Pet 3.8"},"5":{"text":"Tilian bantukin minung cu na fenh hna; zan mang bantuk men an si ko."},"6":{"text":"Zinglei ah a hung keo i a hung ṭhang i a par i zanlei ah cun a carmi belh bantuk men an si ko."},"7":{"text":"Na thinhunnak nih a kangh in a kan kangh i na thinlinhnak nih kan thin a kan phanter."},"8":{"text":"Kan sualnak cu na hmaiah na chiah hna, a thli tein kan sualnak cu na hmuh dih ko hna."},"9":{"text":"Na thinhunnak nih kan chan a kan tawiter; kan nunnak cu fifik bantuk men in donghnak a phan."},"10":{"text":"Kan chan cu kum sawm sarih a si ko, kan thazang a ṭhawn deuh le sawm riat a si; cu hmanh ah retheihnak le harnak lawng kha kan ing, kan nunnak cu a dih zau i kan lo."},"11":{"text":"Na thinhunnak hmual cu aho nih dah fiang ngaingai in an hngalh? Na thinlinhnak nih zei bantuk thil ṭihnung dah a chuahter khawh ti kha aho nih dah an hngalh?"},"12":{"text":"Kan nunnak hi zeitluk in dah a tawi ti kha kan hngalhter law cuticun kan fim deuh lai."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, zei can dah kan cungah lung ṭhul loin na um lai? Na sal hna kan cungah hin zaangfahnak ngei ko."},"14":{"text":"Zing fate in a fekmi na dawtnak in kan khahter, cuticun hla kan sa lai i kan nun chung vialte kan i lawm lai."},"15":{"text":"Harnak kan in lio caan le kum chungah kan cungah na rak tluntermi ngaihchiatnak zat khan atu cu lunglawmhnak kan pe tuah."},"16":{"text":"Kannih na sal rual hi khuaruahharmi thil na tuahmi cu kan hmuhter law kan tefa hna nih a liannganmi na ṭhawnnak cu hmu ve hna seh."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian, kan cungah na thluachuahnak cu um seh law kan thil timi kip ah khua awng kan pemhter ko! Kan thil timi kip ah khua awng kan pemhter ko!"}}},"91":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Himnak hmuh duh ah Cung Nung Bik kha a fuhmi le Lianngan Bik huhphenhnak chung ah aa dormi nih cun,","title":"A Kan Hupphengtu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"“ Bawipa, nangmah cu a ka chanhtu le a ka hupphengtu na si! Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si; nangmah cu kan bochan,” an ti lai."},"3":{"text":"Hmuh lomi thil ṭihnung vialte le thihnak zawtnak vialte chungin him tein an huhphenh hrimhrim lai."},"4":{"text":"A thla in an huh lai i him tein na um lai; zumhawktlak a sinak nih khan an huhphenh lai i him tein an umter lai."},"5":{"text":"Zan i a chuakmi ṭihnung kha na ṭih hna lai lo, chun ah ruahpak loin a chuakmi cantiang zong kha na ṭih lai lo;"},"6":{"text":"mui lak i a ummi rai zong kha na ṭih lai lo i chun ceu i mi a that cuahmahmi ngal-eu zong kha na ṭih lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Na pawng ah mi thong khat an thi ko lai, na velchum ah thong hra zong an thi ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw nang cu zeihmanh nih an tawng lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu zeitindah dantatnak a in kha na zoh lai i na hmuh lai."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu chanhtu ah naa ser i Cungnung Bik cu hupphengtu ah naa ser caah"},"10":{"text":"harnak zeihmanh nih an tlunhnawh kho lai lo i vanchiatnak zeihmanh na inn a phan lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Na kalnak kip i nangmah zohkhenhtu dingah Pathian nih a vancungmi kha a chiah hna lai.","ref":"Mat 4.6; Luk 4.10"},"12":{"text":"An kut in an in dawmh lai i lung ah na ke kha naa khawng lai lo.","ref":"Mat 4.6; Luk 4.11"},"13":{"text":"Chiandeih le rul kha na lamh hna lai, chiandeih ṭih nungnung le rul sivai ṭhawngṭhawng kha na lamh chih len hna lai.","ref":"Luk 10.19"},"14":{"text":"Pathian nih, “A ka dawmi cu ka khamh hna lai i a ka hngalmi cu ka huhphenh hna lai."},"15":{"text":"An ka auh tikah ka leh hna lai i harnak an in tikah ka umpi hna lai. Ka chuah hna lai i ka upat hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Laksawng ah nun sau ka pek hna lai i ka khamh hrimhrim hna lai,” a ti."}}},"92":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa sinah lawmhnak hla sak cu zeitluk in dah a nuamh! Cungnung Bik Pathian, nangmah min upat in hlasak cu zeitluk in dah a nuamh!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Hri tampi a ngeimi tingtang le thonglawi aw dawh he, a fekmi na dawtnak thangṭhat in zingfate in hlasak le zumhawktlak na sinak zanfate in thanh cu a nuam hringhranmi a si.","merge":"3"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, thil lianngan na tuahmi nih ka lung an ka lawmhter, na tuahmi thil ruangah cun lawmhnak in hla ka sa."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na tuahmi thil cu zeitluk in dah an ngan!
