Na ruahnak cu zeitluk in dah a thuk!"},"6":{"text":"Mihrut nih an hngalh khawh lo i lungtlawmmi nih an theihthiam khawh lomi cu,"},"7":{"text":"miṭhalo kha belh bantukin an ṭhan i thil ṭhalo a tuahmi hna kha thluachuah an hmuh hi a si; sihmanhsehlaw rawhralnak an hmu ko lai,"},"8":{"text":"zeicahtiah Bawipa, nangmah cu uktu ngan bik kha zungzal in na si."},"9":{"text":"Na ral cu an thi lai i miṭhalo vialte cu raldohnak ah an sung lai i an i ṭhek dih lai ti kha kan hngalh."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah nih fungtum bantuk ṭhawng ah na ka ser; thluachuahnak na ka pek i ka lung aa lawm."},"11":{"text":"Ka ral an sungh kha ka hmuh i miṭhalo pawl an ai len kha ka theih."},"12":{"text":"Miding mi cu tumkung bantukin an hninghno lai i Lebanon tlang sidar thingkung bantukin an ṭhang lai."},"13":{"text":"Annih cu Bawipa inn chungah cinmi thing bantuk, Bawipa biakinn chungah hninghno ngaiin a um i"},"14":{"text":"an tar tik hmanh ah thei a tlai lengmang i a zungzal in hring dildel in a um i a ṭhawng ngaimi bantuk an si."},"15":{"text":"Hi nih hin Bawipa cu a ding ti le a ka chanhtu ka lungpi chungah cun palhnak zeihmanh a um lo, ti kha a langhter."}}},"93":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si! Rumra in aa thuam i a tai cu thazang in aa sawmh. Vawlei cu a umnak hmun ah khan fek tein a chiah i a hninh in hninh khawh a si lo.","title":"Pathian Siangpahrang"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa, na bawiṭhutdan cu a hramthawk tein a fek i nangmah cu caan thawk hlan in na rak um cang."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa, rilipi cu a awn, a tilet cu an awn hluahmah ko."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu vancung ah khin uktu ngan bik a si, rilipi aw thawng nakin a ngan deuh rili tilet nakin a ṭhawng deuh."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, na phunglam cu zungzal in an hmun, na Biakinn cu zungzal in zungzal tiang a thiang taktak."}}},"94":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, nang cu phuhlamtu Pathian na si, na thinhunnak kha langhter tuah.","title":"Zeizong Vialte Biaceihtu Pathian"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah cu mi vialte bia a ceihtu na si, tho law miporhlaw kha hmuh awk an i tlakmi dantatnak kha pe hna."},"3":{"text":"Miṭhalo pawl hi zei can dah an i lawmh lai? Zei can dah an i lawmh ko rih lai, Maw Bawipa ."},"4":{"text":"Zei can dah ṭhat lonak a tuahtu pawl hi ruamkai in an um rih lai i sualnak an tuahmi kha an i porhlawt rih lai?"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, na mi kha an rial hna, nangmah ta a simi kha an hrem hna."},"6":{"text":"Nuhmei le ngakṭah kha an thah hna i kan ram chungah a ummi khual kha an nawn hna."},"7":{"text":"An i thawh i, “ Bawipa nih cun a kan hmuh lem lai maw? Bawipa nih cun a hngalh lem lai maw?” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Ka mi hna, zeitindah cu tluk cun nan hruh khawh? Zeitik ah dah nan hngalh khawh te lai?"},"9":{"text":"Kan hna a sertu cu Pathian a si, zeitindah hna sertu Pathian nih cun thei loin a um khawh lai? Kan mit a sertu cu Pathian a si, zeitindah mit sertu nih cun hmu loin a um khawh lai?"},"10":{"text":"Miphun vialte cu amah ukmi an si, dantat loin a um hna hnga maw? Mi vialte a cawnpiaktu cu amah a si, hngal loin a um kho hnga maw?"},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih an ruahmi cu a hngalh dih ko; zeitluk in dah an ruahnak pakpalawng a si ti cu a hngalh dih ko.","ref":"1Kor 3.20"},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih na chimhhrinmi, na phunglam na cawnpiakmi hna cu lunglawmmi an si,"},"13":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi caah thlan cawh a si hlantiang, harnak caan ah dinhnak na pek hna."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi cu a hlaw hna lai lo, amah ta a simi cu a zamtak hna lai lo."},"15":{"text":"Biaceihnak hmun ah dinnak kha a um ṭhan lai i miding paohpaoh nih an zulh lai."},"16":{"text":"Ahodah miṭhalo a ka dohpitu kha nan si? Ahodah ṭhat lonak a tuahmi hna a ka dohpitu kha nan si?"},"17":{"text":"Bawipa nih rak kan bawm hlah seh law, mithi khua kha khulrang tein kan rak phan diam ko hnga."},"18":{"text":"Ka ke kha an nal cuahmah tikah, Bawipa, na dawtnak nih a ka tlaih."},"19":{"text":"Khuaruahhar vansang au in ka um tikah na ka hnemh i ka lung na ka lawmhter."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa, ziknawh a eimi biaceihtu hna he cun zeitinhmanh in nan i tlak kho lo, dinlonak kha dinnak ah a ser i"},"21":{"text":"miṭha kha a rawi a phiar i a sual lomi kha thih dantatnak a pemi hna he cun a komh in nan i kom kho lo."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu Bawipa nih na ka huhphenh i ka Pathian nih him tein na ka umter."},"23":{"text":"Annih cu an ṭhat lo ruangah dan na tat hna lai i an sual ruangah na hrawh hna lai; Bawipa kan Pathian nih na hrawh hna lai."}}},"95":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ra u law Bawipa cu thangṭhat u sih. Kannih a kan khamhtu Lungpi cu lunglawmhnak in hla in thangṭhat u sih.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Lunglawmhnak in amah hmaiah chuak u sih law lawmhnak le thangṭhatnak hla sa u sih."},"3":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Bawipa cu a ṭhawngmi Pathian a si, pathian dang vialte cung siangpahrang ṭhawng a si."},"4":{"text":"Vawleicung vialte hi amah nih a uk dih, lungkua thuk bik in tlang sang bik tiang a uk dih hna."},"5":{"text":"Amah nih a sermi rili kha a uk i amah nih a sermi vawlei zong kha a uk fawn."},"6":{"text":"Ra tuah u, kun u sih law bia u sih; a kan Sertu Bawipa hmaiah cun kan khuk i bil u sih!"},"7":{"text":"Amah cu kan Pathian a si, kannih cu a kan zohkhenhmi kan si, a kan cawmmi tuurun kan si. A chimmi kha nihin cu ngai tuah u; a bia cu hihi a si:","ref":"Heb 3.15; 4.7; Heb 3.7-11"},"8":{"text":"“Nan pupa hna kha Meribah ah lung hak in an rak um bang khan nannih cu um hlah u,","ref":"Exo 17.1-7; Nam 20.2-13"},"9":{"text":"an ca i ka tuahmi kha an hmu ko nain khaka ah khan an ka hneksak i an ka zuamcawh."},"10":{"text":"Kum sawm li chung awlok an ka chonh i, “Annih cu ka nawlbia a ngai duh lo i ka cungah zumhawktlak in a um duh lomi an si,’ ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Ka thin a hung i, “Dinhnak ka pek hnanak ding ram chungah cun an lut hrimhrim lai lo,’ tiin chiatser in bia ka chim,” a ti.","ref":"Nam 14.20-23; Deu 1.34-36; 12.9-10; Heb 4.3-5"}}},"96":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu hla thar in thangṭhat u, vawlei mi vialte hna, Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat u!","title":"Pathian Lianngan Bik Siangpahrang (1Cha 16.23-33)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat u, a kan khamhnak thawng ṭha kha nifate in chim u."},"3":{"text":"Miphun hna sinah a sunparnak kha thanh u, mi vialte kha thil lianngan a tuahmi cu chim hna u."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa cu a lian a ngan i sang piin thangṭhat awk a si; pathian dang vialte nakin ṭih awk deuh a si."},"5":{"text":"Miphun dang hna pathian cu siasal men an si, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun van khi a ser hna."},"6":{"text":"Sunparnak le rumra cu a velchum ah an um i lianhngannak le dawhnak cu a biakinn chungah an um."},"7":{"text":"Vawleicung mi vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u, a sunparnak le a ṭhawnnak kha thangṭhat u.","ref":"Slm 29.1-2"},"8":{"text":"A min he aa tlakmi sunparnak kha Bawipa cu pe u, raithawinak kha rak i put u law a biakinn chungah ra lut u."},"9":{"text":"A Thiang Mi cu a hung chuah tikah a hmaiah khan kun u; vawleicung mi vialte hna, a hmaiah cun a ther in ther u."},"10":{"text":"Miphun vialte kha, “ Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si, Vawlei cu a umnak hmun ah hninh khawh loin fek tein a bunh, mi vialte kha dinnak in bia a ceih hna lai,” tiah chim hna u."},"11":{"text":"Vawlei le van, i lawm tuah u. Rili le a chung i a ummi thilnung vialte hna, awn u;"},"12":{"text":"lo le a chung i a ummi thil vialte hna, i lawm u! Cun tupi chung i a ummi thingkung hna cu lunglawm in Bawipa hmaiah an au lai,"},"13":{"text":"zeicahtiah vawlei uk awkah a ra cang; vawleicung mi vialte kha dingte le i ruang tein a uk hna lai. ruang tein a uk hna lai."}}},"97":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si, maw vawlei i lawm tuah! Rili chung i a ummi tikulh vialte hna, i lawm u!","title":"Pathian Lianngan Bik Uktu"},"2":{"text":"Khuadawm le muihnak kha a velchum in an um; a pennak cu dinnak le biading cungah a hram a bunh."},"3":{"text":"A hmaiah mei cu a kal i a velchum i a ummi a ral kha a kangh dih hna."},"4":{"text":"A nimtlau nih vawlei kha a ceuh dih, vawlei nih cun a hmuh i a ther."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa hmaiah tlang cu khuaiseng bantukin an ti. vawlei cung dihlak Bawipa hmaiah cun khuaiseng bantukin an ti."},"6":{"text":"Van nih khin a dinnak kha an chim i mi vialte nih a sunparnak kha an hmuh."},"7":{"text":"Siasal a biami vialte kha an ning a zak dih, an siasal aa porhlawmi vialte kha an ning a zak dih; pathian vialte cu a hmaiah an kun dih."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih na tuahmi biathlehnak ruangah, Zion mi cu an lung aa lawm i Judah ram khua hna cu an tha a nuam."},"9":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Bawipa, nangmah cu vawleicung dihlak a uktu na si; pathian vialte hna nakin a let tam piin na ngan deuh."},"10":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak a huami kha Bawipa nih a dawt hna, a mi kha a huhphenh hna i miṭhalo mi pawl kut chung khan a chuah hna."},"11":{"text":"Ceunak cu miding mi hna cungah khan a tlang i lunglawmhnak cu miṭha mi hna cungah khan a tlang."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil ruangah, a dingmi nannih vialte i lawm tuah u. Mi Thiang nih a tuahmi kha philh hlah u law amah kha lawmhnak in thangṭhat u. amah kha lawmhnak in thangṭhat u."}}},"98":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu hla thar in thangṭhat tuah u, khuaruahharmi thil kha a tuah hna! A ṭhawnnak le a thiangmi a thazang in ral kha a tei hna.","title":"Vawlei Uktu Pathian Thangṭhat U"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun ral a tei hnanak thawng kha a thanh i a khamhnak ṭhawnnak kha miphun vialte a hngalhter hna."},"3":{"text":"Israel mi bia a kamhmi hna kha a zulh i an cungah a fekmi dawtnak a ngei i zumhawktlak in a um. Kan Pathian nih ral a teinak kha mi vialte nih khuazakip ah an hmuh."},"4":{"text":"Vawlei mi vialte hna, lunglawm in Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat tuah u; lawmhnak hla in thangṭhat u law a au in au u!"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa thangṭhatnak hla cu sa u, thangṭhatnak hla cu tingtang he ṭhuan hna u."},"6":{"text":"Muko le tuukawng ki tum hna u law Bawipa, siangpahrang hmaiah cun lunglawm in au u."},"7":{"text":"Rili le a chung i a ummi thilnung vialte hna, awn tuah u! Vawlei le a cung i a ummi thilnung vialte hna, hlasa tuah u!"},"8":{"text":"Maw rilipi hna, nan kut beng tuah u; maw tlang hna, Bawipa hmaiah cun lunglawm in hlasa tuah u,"},"9":{"text":"zeicahtiah amah cu vawlei uk awkah a ra cang. Vawleicung mi vialte cu dinnak le ruannak in a uk hna lai."}}},"99":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu siangpahrang a si, mi vialte cu an ther dih; cherubim cung i a bawiṭhutdan cungah khan a ṭhu, vawlei cu aa hnin dih.","title":"Pathian Siangpahrang Ngan Bik","ref":"Exo 25.22"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu Zion ah lianngan ngaiin a um, miphun vialte kha a uk dih hna."},"3":{"text":"A lian a ngan i rumra a ngeimi a min cu mi vialte nih an thangṭhat lai. Amah cu Mi Thiang a si."},"4":{"text":"A liannganmi Siangpahrang, nang cu ahmaanmi thil a duhmi na si; Israel mi cungah ding tein le a tlari in thil na tuah."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian cu thangṭhat u; a bawiṭhutdan hmaiah khan amah cu bia u, amah cu Mi Thiang a si."},"6":{"text":"Moses le Aaron cu a tlangbawi an si, Samuel cu a sinah thla a rak cammi pakhat a si; Bawipa cu an auh i a leh hna."},"7":{"text":"Khuadawm tom chungin a chawnh hna, a pekmi hna nawlbia le phunglam kha an zulh.","ref":"Exo 33.9"},"8":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian, na mi nih na sinah thla kan camnak kha na kan leh; nangmah cu sualnak a ngaithiam khotu Pathian na si kha na kan hngalhter i kannih cu a sual lo ah na kan rel."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian cu thangṭhat u, a tlang cungah cun amah cu bia u. Bawipa kan Pathian cu Mi Thiang a si!"}}},"100":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vawlei mi vialte hna, lunglawm in Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat u!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa cu lunglawm tein bia u law lunglawmhnak hla he a hmaiah cun ra chuak u."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu Pathian a si kha zeitikhmanh ah philh hlah u! A kan sertu cu amah a si i kannih cu amah ta kan si; a mi kan si i a tuurun kan si."},"4":{"text":"A kutka chungah cun lawmhnak he lut tuah u, a tual ah cun thangṭhatnak hla he lut tuah u; amah cu lawm u law thangṭhat tuah u."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭha; a fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun, zumhawktlak a sinak cu chan vialte tiangin a hmun.","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"}}},"101":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka hla cu dinnak le zumhawktlak sinak kong a si, cu hla cu kan sakpiak lai, Maw Bawipa .","title":"Siangpahrang Biakamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka cungah zei khom hmanh tlung seh law, fimnak le soi awk um lo a simi lam kha zulh kaa zuam lai. Ka inn chungah hin lungthiang in khua ka sa lai."},"3":{"text":"A thurmi tinhmi zeihmanh ka ngei lai lo; zumhtlaklo si kha a huat in ka huat lai."},"4":{"text":"Hrokhrawlnak lungthin kha ka hlawt dih lai i ṭhat lonak kha a ruah hmanh ruat loin ka um lai."},"5":{"text":"Mi congoih a hmangmi kha daihter kaa zuam hna lai i miporhlaw hna le miruamkai hna he cabuai i ṭhut ṭi cu ka hrial lai."},"6":{"text":"Zumhawktlak bikbik kha ka hawikom ah kaa thim hna lai i ka sal cu an nunning soi awk a um lomi kha an si lai."},"7":{"text":"Ka inn chungah mi thangchiat hmangmi kha ahohmanh an um kho lai lo, ka hmuh khawhnak hmun ah mi lihchim hmang cu an dir kho lai lo."},"8":{"text":"Ni khat hnu ni khat in miṭhalo cu ka daihter hna lai i Ṭhat lonak a tuahtu vialte cu Bawipa khuapi chungin ka dawi dih hna lai."}}},"102":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka thlacamnak cu ka ngaihpiak law nangmah bawmhnak hal ah ka aunak cu ka theihpiak ko.","title":"Harnak A Ingmipa Thlacamnak"},"2":{"text":"Harnak ka in tikah hin ka thuhtak hlah! Ka aunak cu ka ngaihpiak law khulrang in ka let tuah."},"3":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu meikhu bangin a lo, ka pum cu mei bangin a kang."},"4":{"text":"Ram car bangin ka nunnak cu a uai, rawl ei duhnak zeihmanh ka ngei lo."},"5":{"text":"Fak piin ka hrum i ka ai, ka ruh le ka cuar lawng ka si ko."},"6":{"text":"Thetse ram i a ummi va bantuk khi ka si, chuahtakmi khua rop i chimbu bantuk ka si."},"7":{"text":"Hngilh kho loin ka um, inncung va, amah lawngin a um i a ci a haimi bantuk ka si."},"8":{"text":"Chun nitlak in ka ral nih an ka nihsawh, nihchuak capo i a ka saitu pawl nih ka min cu chiatsernak ah an hman."},"9":{"text":"Ka rawl cu vutcam a si i ka dinmi cu mitthli he aa cawh,"},"10":{"text":"zeicahtiah ka cungah na thin a hun caah a si. Na ka cawi i na ka hlonh."},"11":{"text":"Ka nunnak cu zanlei sang thladem bantuk men a si; Kei cu ram bantuk ka si ko."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa, nangmah cu siangpahrang na si zungzal ko; chan vialte nih an in philh lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Na tho lai i Zion cu na zaangfah lai, a cung i zaangfah ngeih caan cu a phan cang; atu hi cu caan cu a si cang."},"14":{"text":"Hrawh dih cikcek a si ko nain na salle nih kan duh ṭhiamṭhiam, a rawk dih ko nain a cungah zaangfahnak kan ngei ṭhiamṭhiam."},"15":{"text":"Miphun kip nih Bawipa cu an ṭih lai, vawlei cung siangpahrang vialte nih a ṭhawnnak cu an ṭih lai."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nih Zion kha a remh ṭhan tikah Bawipa lianhngannak cu a lang lai,"},"17":{"text":"Kaltak cia a mi kha an thlacamnak a ngaihpiak hna lai i a theihpiak hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil kha a ra lai ding chan caah ṭial tuah u, cuticun a chuak rih lomi nih amah kha an thangṭhat khawh lai."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih a sangmi a hmunthiang khin a run cuanh, vancung khin vawlei cu a run cuanh,"},"20":{"text":"cu a run cuanh cu thongtla pawl an aihramnak theih awk le thah awk i biaceih cangmi hna luatter awkah a si."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa min cu mi nih Zion ah an chim lai i Jerusalem ah amah cu an lawmh lai;"},"22":{"text":"cucu zeitik ah dah a si lai ti ahcun, miphun hna le pennak hna kha hmunkhat ah an i pumh i Bawipa kha an biak tikah a si lai."},"23":{"text":"Ka chan ṭim hmanh ti hlanah Bawipa nih ka thazang a ka derter i ka nunnak kha a tawiter."},"24":{"text":"Ka Pathian, atu cu ka la rih hlah, ka tar hlanah cun ka la rih hlah! Bawipa, nang cu zungzal in a ummi na si,"},"25":{"text":"hlanpi ah vawlei cu na rak ser cang, Nangmah nih na kut hrimhrim in van khi na ser hna.","ref":"Heb 1.10-12"},"26":{"text":"Van le vawlei cu an lo dih lai, sihmanhsehlaw nang cu na hmun lai; annih cu puan bangin an ṭet lai. Puan bangin na thlen hna lai i an lo lai;"},"27":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw nang cu zungzal in nangmah bon na si ko i na nunnak a dong lo."},"28":{"text":"Kan fale cu him tein khua an sa lai i an tefa hna cu nangmah nih zungzal in na huhphenh hna lai."}}},"103":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah! Ka sining vialte, a min thiang cu thangṭhat tuah u!","title":"Pathian Dawtnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat law zeitluk in dah zaangfahnak a ngeih kha philh hlah."},"3":{"text":"Ka sualnak vialte kha a ka ngaihthiam i ka zawtnak vialte kha a ka damter;"},"4":{"text":"thlan chungin a ka khamh i dawtnak le zaangfahnak he thluachuah a ka pek;"},"5":{"text":"ka nunnak cu thil ṭha in a khahter i cucaah ka no peng i mupi bantukin ka ṭhawng."},"6":{"text":"Hremnak a ingmi kha biaceih tikah Bawipa nih a ṭanh hna i an hmuh awk hnga a simi kha a pek hna."},"7":{"text":"Moses kha aa tinhmi cu a chimh i Israel mi kha thil lianngan a tuahmi cu a hmuhter hna."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu zaangfahnak le dawtnak in a khat, a thin a fual i a fekmi dawtnak in a khat.","ref":"Jei 5.11"},"9":{"text":"Mawhchiat chih lengmang kha a hmang lo i thinhung zungzal in a um lo."},"10":{"text":"Hmuh awk kan i tlakning in dan a kan tat lo, kan sualnak le ṭhat lonak kan tuahmi ning zongin a kan lehrul lo."},"11":{"text":"Van cu vawlei nakin a san deuh ngaingai bantukin a dawtnak cu amah a ṭihmi hna caah cun a ngan ve."},"12":{"text":"Nichuahlei le nitlaklei an i hlat tluk khin kan sualnak cu kanmah he i hlat ah a kan ṭhialpiak."},"13":{"text":"Pale nih an fale an zaangfah hna bantuk khin Bawipa nih amah a ṭihmi cu a zaangfah hna."},"14":{"text":"Zei in dah ser kan si kha a hngalh i leidip men kan si kha a philh lo."},"15":{"text":"Minung cu a nunnak hi ram bantuk men a si ko; a hung ṭhang i ramlak pangpar bangin a hung par."},"16":{"text":"Cun thli a hung hrang ciammam i a lo ai, ahohmanh nih an hmu ṭhan ti lo."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih amah a upatmi hna a dawtnak hna cu, zungzal in a hmun i a ṭhatnak nih chan vialte tiang a nguh,"},"18":{"text":"a biakamnak a zulmi le a nawlbia a ngaimi hna cungah cun Bawipa ṭhatnak cu cu bantuk cun a si."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih a bawiṭhutdan cu vancung ah khin a hun; zeizong vialte cungah siangpahrang a si."},"20":{"text":"Nannih a ṭhawng i a liannganmi vancungmi hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u; a nawlbia kha a ngai i a chimmi a tuahmi vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u!"},"21":{"text":"Vancung i a ummi ṭhawnnak vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u, a duhnak a tuahmi a sal vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u,"},"22":{"text":"A sermi thil vialte hna, a pennak chung hmun zakip ah Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah u! Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah!"}}},"104":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah! Bawipa ka Pathian, zeitluk in dah na lianhngan! Sunparnak le lianhngannak in naa thuam i","title":"Sertu Pathian Thangṭhatnak (Gen 1.1-31)"},"2":{"text":"ceunak in naa tuam. Van khi puan thlam bantukin na samh hna i"},"3":{"text":"cunglei i a ummi ti cungah khin na inn cu na sak. Khuadawm cu rangleng ah na hman hna i thlitu cu an thla cung cit awkah na hman hna."},"4":{"text":"Thlitu cu na lamkaltu ah na hman hna i nimtlau cu na sal ah na hman hna.","ref":"Heb 1.7"},"5":{"text":"Vawlei cu a umnak hmun ah khan fek tein na bunh i ahohmanh nih an ṭhial kho lo."},"6":{"text":"Vawleicung cu rili in puan bangin na khuh i a tlang cu ti nih a khuh hna;"},"7":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ti cu na sik hna tikah an le na au thawng kha an theih tikah an zam."},"8":{"text":"Tlang cung khan nelrawn ah an vung luang i an ca i na sermi hmun ah khan an um;"},"9":{"text":"an lonh khawh lomi ramri kha na chiah i vawlei kha an khuh ṭhan kho ti lo."},"10":{"text":"Nelrawn ah cerh kha na putter hna i ti cu tlang le tlang karah an luang."},"11":{"text":"Ramlak saram kha ti din awk an pek hna i ramlak laa nih khan an tihal riam in an din hna;"},"12":{"text":"an pawngkam thingkung cungah vate nih bu an i ser i hla an sa."},"13":{"text":"Vancung khin tlang cungah ruah na run surter i vawlei cu na thluachuahnak in a khat."},"14":{"text":"Saṭil caah ram na khohter, minung hman awk caah thing na khohter cucaah minung nih cun ti-rawl kha an cin khawh hna i"},"15":{"text":"an lung a lawmhtertu dingah mitsur hang kha an chuahter; an tha an nuamtertu dingah oliv chiti kha an chuahter i thazang a petu dingah rawl an chuahter."},"16":{"text":"Lebanon Tlang sidar thingkung cu ruah tampi an hmu, annih cu Bawipa nih amah caah aa cinmi thingkung an si."},"17":{"text":"Cuka ah cun vate nih bu an i ser i vaca nih farkung ah bu an i ser ve."},"18":{"text":"Sathar kha tlang sang ah an um i sahniar cu lungpang ah an i thup."},"19":{"text":"Thla relnak ah thlapa na ser, ni nih khin tlak caan amah tein aa hngalh."},"20":{"text":"Zan kha na ser i mui ah saram kha an chuak."},"21":{"text":"Chiandeih no kha rawl an kawlpah in an awn, Pathian nih a pekmi hna rawl kha an kawl."},"22":{"text":"Ni a chuah in an kir i an kua chungah khan an bawk."},"23":{"text":"Cun mi cu an rianṭuan awkah an chuak i zanlei tiang an ṭuan."},"24":{"text":"Bawipa, na sermi thil hi an tam hringhran ko! An dihlak in fimnak in na ser hna. Vawlei cu na sermi thil in a khat."},"25":{"text":"A ngan ngaingai i a kau ngaingaimi rilipi kha na ser, a chungah thilnung a hme he a ngan he a rel rel cawk loin an um;"},"26":{"text":"a cungah sangphawlawng kha an kal i a chungah Leviathan rulpi kha lente aa celh, Leviathan cu rili chung rulpi nangmah nih na sermi kha a si.","ref":"Job 41.1; Slm 74.14; Isa 27.1"},"27":{"text":"An herhmi an rawl hmuhnak ah, an dihlak in nangmah kha an in bochan."},"28":{"text":"Nang nih na pek hna i an ei, rawl cu na pek hna i an khim,"},"29":{"text":"Naa mer tikah an awlok a chong, na thaw kha na tlaihkanh hna tikah an thi i an chuahkehnak vawlei ah khan an kir ṭhan."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thaw na pek hna tikah an nung; vawlei cu nunnak thar na pek."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa sunparnak cu zungzal in hmun ko seh, a sermi thil cungah Bawipa cu i lawm ko seh."},"32":{"text":"Vawlei kha a zoh tikah vawlei cu a ther in a ther, tlang kha a tawngh tikah meikhu kha a chuak."},"33":{"text":"Ka nun chung vialte Bawipa cu hla in ka thangṭhat lai; ka nunnak a um chung ka Pathian thangṭhatnak hla cu ka sa lai."},"34":{"text":"Pathian nih lunglawmhnak a ka pek zat in, ka thangṭhatnak hla nih amah cu a lunglawmhter ve seh."},"35":{"text":"Misual mi cu vawleicung hin hloh si hna seh, miṭhalo cu um ti hna hlah seh. Ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko! Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko!"}}},"105":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa sinah lawmhnak bia chim u, a lianhngannak kha thanh u; cun a tuahmi thil kha miphun vialte chim hna u.","title":"Pathian le A Mi Hna (Exo 7.8—11.10 ; 1Cha 16.8-22)"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu hla in thangṭhat u, thangṭhat u! A tuahmi thil khuaruahhar vialte kha chim u!"},"3":{"text":"Kannih cu amah mi kan si caah kan i lawm, Bawipa rian a ṭuanmi vialte i lawm u."},"4":{"text":"Bawmhnak hmuh awkah amah cu va fuh u, a hmaika ah khan va um zungzal u."},"5":{"text":"A sal Abraham tefa hna, Pathian nih a liannganmi khuaruahhar a tuahmi le biakhiahnak a tuahmi kha philh hna hlah u, a thimmi Jakob tefa hna, philh hlah u.","merge":"6"},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu kan Pathian a si; a nawlbia cu vawlei cung dihlak caah a si."},"8":{"text":"Biakamnak a sermi cu zungzal in a zulh lai, a biakamnak cu chan thong khat tiang a zulh lai,"},"9":{"text":"Abraham le Isak he a tuahmi biakamnak kha a zulh hna lai.","ref":"Gen 12.7; 17.8; 26.3"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nih Israel he zungzal a hmunmi biakamnak cu a ser, Jakob he a biakamnak in aa ṭem chih i,","ref":"Gen 28.13"},"11":{"text":"“Kanaan ram cu kan pek lai, cu ram cu nangmah ta a si lai,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Pathian mi cu an rak tlawm i cu ram ah cun khual an rak si."},"13":{"text":"Ram khat in ram khat ah an vai, peng khat in peng dang ah an pem,"},"14":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw annih cu ahohmanh kha a hremter hna lo i anmah ruangah siangpahrang kha a sik hna.","ref":"Gen 20.3-7"},"15":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Ka thimmi ka sal cu tawng hna hlah u, ka profet cu fahnak pe hna hlah u,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"An ram ah Bawipa nih mangṭam a tlunter i an rawl vialte kha a lakpiak dih hna tikah,","ref":"Gen 41.53-57"},"17":{"text":"mi pakhat kha an hmaiah a rak thlah, cu mipa cu sal i an zuarmi Josef kha a si.","ref":"Gen 37.28; 45.5"},"18":{"text":"A ke ah hreng an khenh i a hngawng ah hngawngkual an bunh.","ref":"Gen 39.20—40.23"},"19":{"text":"A rak chim chungmi kha a tlin hlantiang, Bawipa nawl in hneksaknak kha a ing."},"20":{"text":"Cun Izipt siangpahrang nih khan a chuahter, miphun tampi uktu nih khan a luatter.","ref":"Gen 41.14"},"21":{"text":"A ram uknak nawl kha a pek i a ram vialte uktu ah khan a ser;","ref":"Gen 41.39-41"},"22":{"text":"siangpahrang kut tang bawi vialte hna cungah khan nawl a ngei i siangpahrang lungthin cheutu hna cung zongah khan cawnpiaknak nawl a ngei."},"23":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu Izipt ram ah khan a vung kal i cuka ah cun a vung um.","ref":"Gen 46.6; 47.11"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi hna cu fa tampi a ngeihter hna i an ral hna nakin ṭhawng deuh ah a ser hna.","ref":"Exo 1.7-14"},"25":{"text":"Izipt mi cu a mi kha a huatter hna i a sal hna cungah khan hlennak in rian a ṭuanter hna."},"26":{"text":"Cun a sal Moses le a thimmi Aaron kha a thlah hna.","ref":"Exo 3.1—4.17"},"27":{"text":"Pathian hmelchunhnak kha an tuah i Izipt ram ah cun khuaruahharmi thil kha tampi an tuah."},"28":{"text":"Ram cungah cun muihnak an tlunter, sihmanhsehlaw Izipt mi nih khan a nawl an ngai duh lo.","ref":"Exo 10.21-23"},"29":{"text":"An tiva cu thisen ah a canter hna i an nga cu a thah dih hna.","ref":"Exo 7.17-21"},"30":{"text":"An ram ah cun utlak an khat, siangpahrang inn chung hmanh ah khan an khat.","ref":"Exo 8.1-6"},"31":{"text":"Pathian nih nawl a pek hna i fikfa le hmaisem nih an ram cu a zual in an zual.","ref":"Exo 8.16-17,20-24"},"32":{"text":"An ram ah khan ruah surter loin rial le ṭek lehlam kha a tlakter hna.","ref":"Exo 9.22-25"},"33":{"text":"An mitsur ruang le theipi kung kha a hrawh hna i thingkung kha a khiah dih hna."},"34":{"text":"Nawl a pek hna i khaubawk kha an hung chuak, a rel rel cawk loin an hung chuak;","ref":"Exo 10.12-15"},"35":{"text":"an ram chung thil hring vialte kha an ei dih, rawl kung zong kha an ei dih."},"36":{"text":"Izipt mi innchungkhar cio i a chuak hmasa bik fapa paoh kha a thah dih hna.","ref":"Exo 12.29"},"37":{"text":"Cun Israel mi kha a chuahpi hna, sui le ngun kha an i phorh, an dihlak in an ṭhawng i an ngan a dam.","ref":"Exo 12.33-36"},"38":{"text":"Izipt mi nih khan annih cu an ṭih hna caah an kal tikah khan Izipt mi cu an i lawm."},"39":{"text":"A mi hna cungah cun khuadawm a zar i zan ah ceunak petu dingah mei a pek hna.","ref":"Exo 13.21-22"},"40":{"text":"An hal i nimte a pek hna, vancung in rawl khim tein a pek hna.","ref":"Exo 16.2-15"},"41":{"text":"Lungpi kha a khuai i ti a chuak, thetse ram ah cun tiva bantukin a luang.","ref":"Exo 17.1-7; Nam 20.2-13"},"42":{"text":"A sal Abraham sinah a sermi a biakam thiang kha a philh lo."},"43":{"text":"Cuticun a mi cu hlasak pah in a chuahpi hna i lunglawmh au thawng he a thimmi cu a kalpi hna."},"44":{"text":"Ramdangmi an rak umnak ram kha a pek hna i an lo kha a coter hna,","ref":"Jos 11.16-23"},"45":{"text":"zeicahdah cuticun a tuah ti ahcun, ka mi nih ka nawl kha ngai hna seh law ka phunglam kha zul hna seh ti a duh caah a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u!"}}},"106":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u! Bawipa sinah lawmhnak bia chim tuah u, zeicahtiah amah cu a ṭha, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","title":"A Mi Hna Cungah A Ṭha","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 107.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Aho nih dah thil lianngan a tuahmi vialte cu a chim cawk lai? Aho nih dah zaa lak in an thangṭhat khawh lai?"},"3":{"text":"Amah nawl a zulmi cu mi lunglawm an si, a dingmi thil a tuahmi cu mi lunglawm an si!"},"4":{"text":"Na mi hna na bawmh hna tikah ka philh hlah, Maw Bawipa , na khamh hna tikah kei zong ka telh ve."},"5":{"text":"Na mi hna an ṭhancho cu ka hmuhter law na miphun an i lawmhnak ah cun ka telter ve, nangmah ta a simi hna an hmaihngalnak ah cun kei zong ka hmai ka hngalter ve."},"6":{"text":"Kan pupa hna an rak sual bantuk khan kannih zong kan sual ve, palhnak kha kan tuah ve i ṭhat lonak kha kan tuah ve."},"7":{"text":"Izipt ram i a rak ummi kan pupa hna nih khan Pathian tuahmi thil khuaruahhar kha an hngalthiam lo, an cungah a dawtnak voi tampi a langhter kha an philh i Lianngan Bik cu Rili Sen ah khan an doh.","ref":"Exo 14.10-12"},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw bia a kamh hna bangkhan a khamh hna, cu a khamh hna cu a liannganmi a ṭhawnnak langhternak caah a si."},"9":{"text":"Rili Sen cu nawl a pek i a ro, cun a mi cu vawlei ro cung kal bantukin a kalpi hna.","ref":"Exo 14.21-31"},"10":{"text":"A huatu hna kut chung khan a khamh hna i an ral kut chung khan a chuah hna."},"11":{"text":"An ral cu ti nih khan a phum dih hna i pakhat hmanh an tang lo."},"12":{"text":"Cu tikah a mi nih khan a biakam cu an zumh i hla in an thangṭhat.","ref":"Exo 15.1-21"},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a tuahmi kha an philh ṭhan zau i amah ruahnak hal hmasa loin rian an ṭuan:"},"14":{"text":"thetse ram ah khan an duhnak nih a tei hna caah Pathian kha hneksak an del;","ref":"Nam 11.4-34"},"15":{"text":"cucaah an halmi kha a pek hna i asinain rai ṭhalo kha an cungah a tlunter."},"16":{"text":"Thetse ram ah cun Moses kha an nahchuah, Bawipa sal thiang Aaron zong kha an nahchuah;","ref":"Nam 16.1-35"},"17":{"text":"Cu tikah vawlei nih khan a kaa a an i Dothan kha a dolh; Abiram le a innchungkhar kha a phum hna;"},"18":{"text":"anmah a zultu pawl kha mei nih a tlak hna i cu miṭhalo pawl cu mei nih cun a kangh dih hna."},"19":{"text":"Horeb tlang ah sui cawfa kha an ser i cu siasal cu an biak;","ref":"Exo 32.1-14"},"20":{"text":"Pathian sunparnak cu ram a eimi saram mui ah an thlen."},"21":{"text":"Izipt ram chungah khuaruahharmi thil a tuahmi thawngin Pathian nih a khamh hna, asinain cu Pathian cu an philh."},"22":{"text":"Cuka ah cun khuaruahharmi thil tampi a tuah, Rili Sen ah cun thil ṭihnung tampi a tuah hna."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih cun ka mi cu ka hrawh hna lai a ti; asinain a thimmi a sal Moses nih khan Pathian cu a thlauh i a thinhunnak nih khan a that hna lo."},"24":{"text":"Ram nuam kha zeirello in an um i bia a kamhmi hna kha an zum lo;","ref":"Nam 14.1-35"},"25":{"text":"an thlam chungah khan an um i an zai, Bawipa bia kha an ngai duh lo."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah a fakmi ralrinnak kha a pek hna i, “Thetse ram chungah hin ka thah hna lai,"},"27":{"text":"cun nan tefa cu lawkihmi hna lakah ka ṭhek hna lai i ramdang ah ka thihter hna lai,” a ti.","ref":"Lev 26.33"},"28":{"text":"Cun Pathian mi pawl nih khan Peor ah cun Baal kha an biak ve i nunnak a ngei lomi pathian hna sinah rai an thawimi sa kha an ei ve.","ref":"Nam 25.1-13"},"29":{"text":"An thil tuahmi nih cun Bawipa cu a thin a phawh i rai ṭhalo nih a tlunhnawh hna;"},"30":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Finehas kha a dir riangmang i a sualmi kha dan a tat hna caah rai cu a ṭian."},"31":{"text":"Cu a tuahmi cu a caah dinnak ah relpiak a si i hmailei caan tiang zongin a si zungzal ko lai."},"32":{"text":"Bawipa cu a mi nih Meribah Cerh ah khan a thin an hunter i anmah ruangah cun Moses cu a awlok a chong.","ref":"Nam 20.2-13"},"33":{"text":"Moses cu a thin an hunter tuk hringhran caah a chim awk a si lomi tiang zong khan a chim phah."},"34":{"text":"Bawipa nih a fial hna bang khan tuah loin lawkihmi cu an that hna lo,","ref":"Biac 2.1-3; 3.5-6"},"35":{"text":"an ṭhit an vat lehlam hna i an ziaza kha an i cawn."},"36":{"text":"Pathian mi nih cun siasal kha an biak hna i cucu an rawhnak a chuahtertu kha a si."},"37":{"text":"An fapale le an fanule kha lawkih pathian sinah rai ah an thawi hna;","ref":"2Sia 17.17"},"38":{"text":"a sual lomi an fanule le an fapale hna cu an thah hna i Kanaan mi siasal hna sinah khan raithawinak ah an pek hna; hi ti an thah hnanak nih hin vawlei kha a thurter.","ref":"Nam 35.33"},"39":{"text":"An thil tuahmi nih hin anmah cu a thurhnawmhter hna i Pathian sinah khan zumhawktlak in khua an sa lo."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu a mi hna cungah khan a thin a hung i a fih in a fih hna.","ref":"Biac 2.14-18"},"41":{"text":"Annih cu Pathian bia lomi hna kut tangah khan a kaltak hna i an ral nih khan an uk hna."},"42":{"text":"An ral nih cun an rial hna i cawlcang kho loin an kut tangah cun an chiah hna."},"43":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi pawl cu voi tampi a khamh ko hna, sihmanhsehlaw amah doh tu kha an duhmi cu a si i sualnak chungah khan thuk chin lengmang in an pil."},"44":{"text":"Asinain Bawipa nih cun an auh tikah khan a theih hna i an temhinnak kha a hmuhpiak hna."},"45":{"text":"A biakamnak kha a hngalh camcinpiak hna i a nganmi a dawtnak ruangah a lung kha a thlen."},"46":{"text":"Thong i a thlatu hna kha an cungah zaangfahnak a ngeihter hna."},"47":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan Pathian, kan khamh tuah, miphun tampi lak i kan i ṭheknak in kan khawm ṭhan law na min thiang kha kan thangṭhat lai i nangmah lawmhnak bia chim in kan i lawm lai.","ref":"1Cha 16.35-36"},"48":{"text":"Bawipa Israel Pathian cu thangṭhat u sih; atu ah thangṭhat u sih law"}}},"107":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu lawm tuah u, zeicahtiah amah cu a ṭha. a fekmi a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","title":"BU NGANAK (Slm 107 in 150 tiang) Pathian Ṭhatnak Thangṭhatnak","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 118.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih a khamhmi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u sih. Nan ral kut chungin an chuah hna i"},"3":{"text":"ram dang in an tlunpi hna, nichuah, nitlak, chaklei, thlanglei in an tlunpi hna."},"4":{"text":"A cheu cu sul le lam a um lonak thetse ram ah khan an vai i an umnak ding khua kalnak lam kha an i hmuh kho lo;"},"5":{"text":"an rawl a ṭam, an ti a hal i an hnabei a dong cikcek."},"6":{"text":"An harnak chung cun Bawipa kha an auh i an harnak chung khan a khamh hna."},"7":{"text":"A hruai hna i an umnak ding khua ah khan a kalpi hna."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu, an cung i thil ṭha a tuahmi caah khan le a fekmi a dawtnak ruangah khan, an lawmh hrimhrim awk a si."},"9":{"text":"Ti a halmi kha an ti hal a riamhter hna i rawl a ṭammi kha thil ṭha in an paw a khimter hna."},"10":{"text":"A cheu cu lungdong in khuamui lakah an um, thir cikcin he nganfah a ingmi thongtla an si."},"11":{"text":"zeicahdah hi bantukin an si ti ahcun, Lianngan Bik Pathian nawl zulh kha an duh lo i a cawnpiak hnanak kha an al caah a si."},"12":{"text":"Rian hrang an ṭuannak ah khan an ba i an rilh tikah ahohmanh nih an hlawm duh hna lo."},"13":{"text":"Cu bantuk harnak chung cun Bawipa cu an auh i an temhinnak chung cun a khamh hna."},"14":{"text":"Khuamui lakah lungdong in an umnak chung cun a chuah hna i an thir cikcin cu a chahpiak hna."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu, an cung i thil ṭha a tuahmi caah khan le a fekmi a dawtnak ruangah khan, an lawmh hrimhrim awk a si."},"16":{"text":"Dar innkhar kha a khuai dih hna i thirfung kha a tan dih hna."},"17":{"text":"A cheu cu an sual ruangah an zaw, ṭhat lonak an tuah ruangah temhnak an ing;"},"18":{"text":"rawl kha a mui hmuh hmanh an duh lo i an thi dengmang."},"19":{"text":"An harnak chungin Bawipa kha an auh i temhnak an inmi chung cun a khamh hna."},"20":{"text":"A nawlbia in a damter hna i thlan chungin a khamh hna."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu, an cung i thil ṭha a tuahmi ruangah khan le a fekmi a dawtnak ruangah khan, an lawmh hrimhrim awk a si."},"22":{"text":"Raithawinak in an lawmh awk a si i a tuahmi thil vialte kha lunglawmhnak hla in an thanh awk a si."},"23":{"text":"A cheu cu rili cungah khan sangphawlawng in an kal i cuticun an paw an i cawm;"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil kha an hmuh i rili cungah a tuahmi thil khuaruahhar kha an hmuh hna."},"25":{"text":"Nawl a pek i thlichia a hrang i tilet a tho."},"26":{"text":"Sangphawlawng cu sang pipi ah a cawi hna i thuk pipi ah a ṭhumh hna; cu bantuk ṭihnung chungah cun mi cu an hnabei a dong;"},"27":{"text":"zuri bantukin an sawn i an tlu; an thiamnak vialte cu zeihmanh san a tlai lo."},"28":{"text":"An harnak chung khan Bawipa cu an auh i an temhinnak chung khan a khamh hna."},"29":{"text":"Thlichia cu a daihter i tilet cu an dai."},"30":{"text":"Tilet a daih caah khan an i lawm i kal an duhnak lawng dinhnak ah khan him tein a phakter hna."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa cu, an cung i thil ṭha a tuahmi ruangah khan le a fekmi a dawtnak ruangah khan, an lawmh hrimhrim awk a si."},"32":{"text":"A mi hna an i pumhnak ah khan a lianhngannak cu an chim awk a si i upa hna an i pumhnak ah khan amah cu an thangṭhat awk a si."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa nih tiva cu a kaoter hna i cerh cu a roter hna."},"34":{"text":"Vawlei ṭhatnak hmun cu, cite vawlei, vawlei ṭhalo ah a canter, zeicahtiah cuka i a ummi hna cu an ṭha lo."},"35":{"text":"Thetse ram kha tili ah a canter hna i ramcar kha cerhti put ah a canter hna."},"36":{"text":"Cuka ah cun rawl a ṭammi kha a umter hna i khuasaknak ah khuapi pakhat an ser,"},"37":{"text":"lo ah khan thlaici an tuh i mitsur ruang kha an phun hna i rawl tampi an vuiter."},"38":{"text":"A mi kha thluachuah a pek hna i fa tampi an ngei, an saṭil run kha a lohtlauter hna lo."},"39":{"text":"Pathian mi hna cu, raltuknak ah an sungh i ningzahnak an huah tikah, hremnak le harnak an in tikah,"},"40":{"text":"anmah a hremtu hna kha ningzahnak a phakter hna i sul le lam a um lonak thetse ram ah khan a vaihter hna."},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw sifak retheimi kha an harnak chungin a chuah hna i an tefa cu saṭil run bantukin a karhter hna."},"42":{"text":"Miding mi nih mah hihi an hmuh i an i lawm, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu cipkhap ti ngam loin an um."},"43":{"text":"A fimmi nih cun hi thil hi ruat hna seh; Bawipa dawtnak fek cu ruat zungzal hna seh."}}},"108":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka lung a hmun ko, maw Pathian, ka lung a fek ko! Nangmah thangṭhatnak hla ka sa lai. Ka nunnak i hlau tuah,","title":"Ral Teinak Ca Thlacam (Slm 57.7-11 ; 60.5-12) David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka tingtang le ka thonglawi hna i hlau tuah u! Zinglei cu ka ṭhangh lai."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, miphun hna lakah kan lawmh lai, mi vialte hna lakah kan thangṭhat lai."},"4":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak cu vancung tiang a phan, zumhawktlak na sinak cu van a tawng."},"5":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na lianhngannak cu van ah khin langhter law na sunparnak cu vawleicung dihlak ah hin langhter ko."},"6":{"text":"Na ṭhawnnak in kan khamh tuah; kan thlacamnak kha kan let tuah, cuticun na dawtmi hi kan luat kho lai."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih a hmunthiang chungin aa thawh i, “Shekhem cu ka tei lai i ka cheu lai, cun Sukkoth Nelrawn cu ka mi ka phawt hna lai."},"8":{"text":"Gilead cu keimah ta a si. Manasseh zong keimah ta a si, Efraim cu ka luchin a si i Judah cu ka bawifung a si."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Moab cu ka kut ṭawlnak kheng ah ka hman lai i Edom cu ka kedan chiahnak kuang ah ka hman lai; Filistia cu ka tei lai i ka au lai,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Maw Pathian, aho nih dah ralhau ngeimi khua chungah a ka luhpi lai? Aho nih dah Edom ah a ka kalpi lai?"},"11":{"text":"Na kan hlawt taktak ko cang maw? Kan ralkap cu na kalpi ti hna lai lo maw?"},"12":{"text":"Minung bawmhnak cu zeihmanh a ṭhathnem lo caah kan raldohnak ah hin nangmah nih kan bawm ko."},"13":{"text":"Pathian kan sinah a ṭan caah kan tei hna lai; kan ral cu amah nih a kan teipiak hna lai."}}},"109":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka thangṭhatmi Pathian, dai tein um hlah.","title":"Harnak A Ingmipa Zainak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Miṭhalo le milihchim pawl nih an ka tlakphuat i lih in ka thang an ka chiat."},"3":{"text":"An ka congoih, thil dawhcah lo ka tuahmi zeihmanh a um lo nain sual an ka puh."},"4":{"text":"Ka daw ko hna na le an caah thla ka cam ko nain an ka doh."},"5":{"text":"Ṭhatnak kha chiatnak in an ka lehrulh i dawtnak kha huatnak in an ka cham."},"6":{"text":"Ka ral cu a bia a ceihpiaktu dingah mihrokhrawl kha thimpiak, cun amah ral lila pakhatkhat nih sual puh hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Biaceihnak kha ing seh law, “Na sual,” ti hna seh. A thlacam hmanh kha sual ah relpiak hna seh."},"8":{"text":"A nunnak kha dong zau seh law, midang nih a rian kha co hna seh!","ref":"Lam 1.20"},"9":{"text":"A fale cu ngakṭah si hna seh law, a nupi cu nuhmei si seh."},"10":{"text":"A fale cu inn ngei loin a vak lengmangmi rawlhal si hna seh; thilchia hlonhnak ah khan um hna seh law, cu an umnak hmun hmanh cun ṭhawl si rih hna seh."},"11":{"text":"Tangka a rak cawihtu hna nih khan a ngeihmi thil vialte cu, lakpiak dih hna seh law, a rianṭuanmi vialte cu khual nih chut dih hna seh."},"12":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih a cungah zaangfahnak ngei hna hlah seh, ngakṭah a fale kha aho zohkhenh hmanh tong hna hlah seh."},"13":{"text":"A tefa vialte cu thi dih hna seh law hmai chan ah cun a min cu philh dipdep si seh."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nih a pupa hna sualnak kha philh hlah seh law a nu sualnak kha ngaithiam hlah seh."},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nih an sualnak cu hngal zungzal ko seh, anmah belte philh dipdep si ko hna seh."},"16":{"text":"Cu pa nih cun mi zaangfah ruam hi a ruah in a ruat bal lo; sifak, rethei le santlailo mi kha a hrem hna i a thah hna."},"17":{"text":"Mi chiatserh kha a duhmi thil a si — amah cu chiatserh si ve seh."},"18":{"text":"Angki hruk a fawi tluk hin a caah chiatserh cu a fawi, a chiatserhnak bia nih cun amah kha ti bantukin ciah seh law a ruh kha chiti bantukin ciah hna seh."},"19":{"text":"A chiatserhnak bia nih cun amah kha puan bangin men seh law taisawm bangin khimh peng seh."},"20":{"text":"Bawipa nih ka ral cu hitihin dantat hna seh, ka thang a ka chiattu ka ral hna cu hitihin tat hna seh."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, bia na ka kamh bang khan ka bawm ko, na dawtnak a ṭhat ruangah ka chuahter ko."},"22":{"text":"Kei cu sifak le rethei ka si; ka lung a fak tuk hringhran."},"23":{"text":"Zanlei thladem a loh zau bang khin loh kaa zal cang, khaubawk thlitu nih a choih bang khin choih ka si cang."},"24":{"text":"Rawl khim ei awk ka ngeih lo caah ka khuk cu a ther in an ther i ka pum cu der hrianghruang in a um."},"25":{"text":"Mi nih an ka hmuh tikah an ka nihsawh, keimah serhsatnak ah an lu lawng an thing ko.","ref":"Mat 27.39; Mar 15.29"},"26":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, ka bawm tuah; a fekmi na dawtnak ruangah ka khamh tuah."},"27":{"text":"A ka khamhtu cu nangmah na si kha, ka ral cu hngalhter hna."},"28":{"text":"Annih nih cun chiat an ka serh lai, sihmanhsehlaw nang nih cun thluachuah na ka pek lai. A ka hremtu cu sung hna seh law na sal kei tu cu lunglawm in umning."},"29":{"text":"Ka ral cu ningzahnak nih a khuh in khuh hna seh; hmaichiatnak cu puan bangin i aih hna seh."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa cu fak piin ka thangṭhat lai, mi an i pumhnak hmun ah amah cu ka hlawrh lai,"},"31":{"text":"zeicahtiah sifakmi a chanhtu hna cu amah a si i thah awkin an bia a ceihtu hna kut chungin a chuahtu hna cu amah a si."}}},"110":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih siangpahrang ka Bawipa cu a thawh i, “Na ral cu na ke tangah ka chiah hna hlantiang, ka orhlei kamah hin ṭhu tuah,” tiah a ti.","title":"le A Thimmi Siangpahrang (Mat 22.44) David Hla","ref":"Mat 22.44; Mar 12.36; Luk 20.42-43; Lam 2.34-35; 1Kor 15.25; Efe 1.20-22; Kol 3.1; Heb 1.13; 8.1; 10.12-13"},"2":{"text":"Zion in a rami Bawipa nih, uknak nawl cu an pek tikah, “Na ral cu uk hna,” an ti lai i na nawl ngeihnak cu hmun dang tiangin a karh lai."},"3":{"text":"Na ral kha na tuk hna ni ah, na mi nih anmah lungtho tein an in chuahhnawh lai. Na tlangval hna cu zinglei dap bantukin, na sinah tlang thiang ah khan an ra chuak lai."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih a fekmi biakamnak a tuah i a let ṭhan lai lo, “Nang cu zungzal in tlangbawi na si lai, Melkhizedek tlangbawi a sining in na si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Heb 5.6; 6.20; 7.17,21"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu na orhlei kamah a um ko; a thin a hun ni ah siangpahrang kha a tei hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Miphun kha an bia a ceih hna lai i raltuknak hmun kha miruak in a khahter lai; vawlei cung dihlak ah siangpahrang kha a tei hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Lam pawng i a luangmi tiva kha siangpahrang nih cun a din lai, a tha aa hrim lai i teitu a si lai."}}},"111":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Bawipa cu a mi hna an i pumhnak ah ka lungthin a dih umnak in ka lawmh lai.","title":"Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil cu zeitluk in dah khuaruahhar a si! A tuahmi thil cung i aa lawmmi hna nih cun an sullam kha hngalh an duh."},"3":{"text":"A tuahmi thil cu upatnak le lianhngannak in a khat; a dinnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih thil khuaruahhar a tuahmi hna kha philh loin a kan umter; amah cu mi cungah vel a ngei i zaangfah a thiam."},"5":{"text":"Amah a ṭihtu kha rawl in a cawm hna, bia aa kammi kha zeitikhmanh ah a philh lo."},"6":{"text":"A ṭhawnnak cu a mi hna sinah khan a langhter, ramdangmi hna ram cu a mi kha a pek hna."},"7":{"text":"A tuahmi thil kip ah zumhawktlak le miding a si; a nawlbia kha i bochan awk tlak an si;"},"8":{"text":"zungzal in an hmun; biatak le dinnak in pek an si."},"9":{"text":"A mi cu khamhnak a pek hna i zungzal hmunmi biakamnak kha an sinah a ser. Amah cu a thiang i a ṭhawngmi a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ṭih hi fim hram i thawh cu a si; cu bantukin a nungmi cu hngalhnak ah an ṭhang, Bawipa cu zungzal in thangṭhat si ko seh.","ref":"Job 28.28; Phut 1.7; 9.10"}}},"112":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Bawipa a ṭihmi cu mi lunglawm an si. A nawlbia zulh a nuam in a theimi cu mi lunglawm an si.","title":"Miṭha Lunglawmhnak"},"2":{"text":"Cu bantuk mi hna fale cu ram chungah hin miṭhawng an si lai, miṭha mi hna fale cu thluachuah hmumi an si lai."},"3":{"text":"An innchungkhar hna cu an rum an lian lai i khua awng an pem zungzal lai."},"4":{"text":"Miṭha mi hna caah cun muihnak chungah khan ceunak a tlang, mi cungah vel a ngeimi le mi zaangfah a thiammi le miding mi hna caah cun ceunak kha a tlang."},"5":{"text":"Mi chaw a cawih hna tikah siang ngaiin a cawih i a rian a ṭuannak ah lihchim lo tein a ummi cu milunglawm an si."},"6":{"text":"Miṭha cu an sung bal lai lo, philh an si bal lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Thawng chia theih kha a ṭih lo. a zumhnak a ṭhawng i Bawipa kha aa bochan."},"8":{"text":"Lungrethei le thinphang in a um lo; ka ral cu an sung hrimhrim lai ti kha a hngalh."},"9":{"text":"A herh a baumi kha siang ngaiin a pek hna, mi cung i zaangfahnak a ngeihmi cu zungzal in a hmun; amah cu a ṭhawng lai i hmaizah a si ko lai.","ref":"2Kor 9.9"},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo pawl nih khan hihi an hmuh i an ing a puang, an hacang lawng an rial ko; an rak i ruahchanmi kha pakpalawng ah a can dih bantuk khan annih zong an lo ve."}}},"113":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u! Bawipa salle hna, Bawipa min cu thangṭhat u.","title":"Ṭhatnak Thangṭhatnak"},"2":{"text":"A min cu thangṭhat si ko seh, atu in zungzal tiang thangṭhat si ko seh!"},"3":{"text":"Nichuahlei in nitlaklei tiang, Bawipa min cu thangṭhat si ko seh."},"4":{"text":"Miphun vialte cu Bawipa nih a uk hna, a sunparnak nih van khi a lonh dih hna."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian bantuk hi ahohmanh an um lo, vancung ah siseh, vawlei ah siseh, amah bantuk ahohmanh an um lo, a bawiṭhutdan cu cung sangpi ah khin a hun,"},"6":{"text":"asinain van le vawlei run zoh awkah hin a rung kun."},"7":{"text":"Sifakmi kha leidip lak i an umnak khan a cawi hna, retheimi kha an retheihnak chungin a chuah hna i"},"8":{"text":"siangpahrang fale hawikom ah khan a ser hna; a mi hna siangpahrang fale hawikom ah khan a ser hna."},"9":{"text":"Fa a ngei kho lomi nu kha upatnak a pek hna i fa a ngeimi lunglawmmi nu ah a ser hna. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! a ser hna. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"114":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel mi nih Izipt ram in an chuah tikah, Jakob tefa pawl nih cu ram cun an chuah tikah,","title":"Lanhtak Puai Hla (Exo 14.1-31)","ref":"Exo 12.51"},"2":{"text":"Judah cu Bawipa mithiang ah a cang, Israel cu amah ta ah a cang."},"3":{"text":"Rili Sen nih a rak zoh hna i an zamtak hna, Jordan Tiva cu luang loin a rak um.","ref":"Exo 14.21; Jos 3.16"},"4":{"text":"Tlang cu meheh bantukin an i hlok i tuu bantukin an pet i an choi."},"5":{"text":"Rili, zei nih dah an zamter? Jordan Tiva, zeicahdah luang loin na um?"},"6":{"text":"Tlang hna zeicahdah meheh bantukin nan i hlawh? Fing hna, zeicahdah tuu bantukin nan peh i nan choi?"},"7":{"text":"Maw vawlei, Bawipa a rat caah cun ther ko, Jakob Pathian hmaiah cun ther ko."},"8":{"text":"Amah nih cun lungpi kha tili ah a canter hna i lungpang kha cerhti put ah a canter hna.","ref":"Exo 17.1-7; Nam 20.2-13"}}},"115":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kanmah si loin, na min lawnglawng hi sunparnak pek awk cu na si, Bawipa, zeicahtiah na dawtnak cu a fek i zumhawktlak na si.","title":"Pathian Taktak Pakhat"},"2":{"text":"Zeicahdah miphun dang hna nih, “Nan Pathian cu khoika ah dah a um?” tiah an kan hal lai?"},"3":{"text":"Kan Pathian cu vancung ah khin a um i a duhmi paoh kha a tuah ko."},"4":{"text":"Annih pathian tu cu sui le ngun in sermi an si, minung kut nih a sermi an si.","ref":"Slm 135.15-18; Biat 9.20"},"5":{"text":"Kaa cu an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw an holh kho lo, mit cu an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw an hmu kho lo."},"6":{"text":"Hna an ngei, asinain khua an thei lo, hnar an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw rim an thei lo."},"7":{"text":"Kut an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh an tawng kho lo, ke an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw an kal kho lo; an hrom nih aw zeihmanh a ser kho lo."},"8":{"text":"Siasal a sertu hna le siasal aa bochanmi hna cu an sermi siasal bantuk cu si ve hna seh!"},"9":{"text":"Maw Israel mi hna, Bawipa cu i bochan u, amah nih an bawmh hna lai i an huhphenh hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Pathian tlangbawi hna, Bawipa cu i bochan u, amah nih an bawmh hna i an huhphenh hna."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihmi vialte hna, amah cu i bochan u, amah nih an bawmh hna i an huhphenh hna."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa nih a kan philh lo i thluachuah a kan pek lai; Israel mi le Pathian tlangbawi vialte kha thluachuah a pek hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Amah a ṭihmi vialte cu thluachuah a pek hna lai, a hme a ngan thleidang loin a pek hna lai.","ref":"Biat 11.18; 19.5"},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nih nangmah le na fale cu, tefa in pe ko hna seh!"},"15":{"text":"Van le vawlei a sertu Bawipa nih cun, thluachuahnak in pe ko hna seh!"},"16":{"text":"Vancung khi Bawipa ta a si, sihmanhsehlaw vawlei hi cu, mi kha a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa a thangṭhattu cu mithi an si lo, holh lo i dai tein umnak hmun ah a vung kalmi nih an thangṭhat kho lo,"},"18":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw kannih a nungmi nih amah cu kan lawmh lai, atu in zungzal tiang kan lawmh lai. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"116":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih ka thlacamnak kha a ka ngaihpiak i a ka theihpiak caah Bawipa cu ka dawt.","title":"Thihnak Chungin Khamhmi Nih Pathian A Thangṭhat"},"2":{"text":"Amah ka auh fate a ka theihpiak zungzal."},"3":{"text":"Thihnak nih a hri in a ka ṭem, Sheol nih a kut in a ka khimh. Ṭihnak le lung retheihnak in ka khat."},"4":{"text":"Cu tikah Bawipa cu ka auh i, “ Bawipa, ka khamh ko sawh,” tiah ka nawl."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa cu velngeimi le miṭha a si, kan Pathian cu mi zaangfah thiammi a si."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih a awlok a chongmi kha a huhphenh hna, ṭihnung chung i ka um tikah a ka khamh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka cungah a ṭhat caah, maw ka nunnak, hnangam tein um ko."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa nih thihnak chungin a ka khamh, ka mitthli kha a ka hnawh i raltuknak ah a ka sunghter lo."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah cun Bawipa hmaiah kaa chawk kho i, a nungmi hna sinah khua ka sa rih."},"10":{"text":"“Ka lo dimdiam ko cang,” ka ti lio hmanh ah, a zumh cu ka zumh peng ko,","ref":"2Kor 4.13"},"11":{"text":"Ka thin a phan tuk cang i, “Ahohmanh bochan awk tlak an um lo,” ka ti lio zongah, ka zumh peng ṭhiamṭhiam ko."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka cung i a ṭhatnak vialte ruangah hin zeidah ka pek khawh lai?"},"13":{"text":"A ka khamh caah khan Bawipa cu din awk thawinak ka pekchanh lai."},"14":{"text":"A mi vialte an i pumhnak ah khan bia kaa kammi kha ka pek lai."},"15":{"text":"A mi pakhatkhat an thih tikah Bawipa caah zeitluk in dah a fah!"},"16":{"text":"Bawipa, kei cu na sal ka si; ka nu nih na rian a rak in ṭuanpiak bang khan kei zong nih ka ṭuan ve."},"17":{"text":"Lawmhnak chimnak raithawinak cu kan pek lai i na sinah thla ka cam lai."},"18":{"text":"Na mi vialte an i pumhnak, Jerusalem khua na Biakinn tual ah cun, na sinah bia kaa kammi kha kan pek lai. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!","merge":"19"}}},"117":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miphun vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Mi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!","title":"Thangṭhatnak Caah","ref":"Rom 15.11"},"2":{"text":"A kan dawtnak fek cu a ṭhawng i zumhawktlak a sinak cu zungzal in a hmun. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"118":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭhat i a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmunh caah lawm tuah u!","title":"Ral Tei Lawmhnak Ca Thlacam","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 136.1; Jer 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Israel mi nih, “A dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” ti hna seh."},"3":{"text":"Pathian tlangbawi hna nih, “A dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” ti hna seh."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihmi vialte nih, “A dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun,” ti hna seh."},"5":{"text":"Lung sivang in ka umnak chungin Bawipa cu ka auh; ka auhnak cu a ka leh i a ka luatter."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka sinah a um caah zeihmanh ka ṭih lo; minung nih cun ka cungah zeidah an tuah khawh lai?","ref":"Heb 13.6"},"7":{"text":"A ka bawmtu cu Bawipa a si caah, ka ral kha an sungh cu ka hmuh lai."},"8":{"text":"Minung i bochan nakcun Bawipa i bochan cu a ṭha deuh;"},"9":{"text":"bawi i bochannak cun Pathian i bochan kha a ṭha deuh."},"10":{"text":"Ral tampi nih an ka kulh, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa ṭhawnnak thawngin ka tei dih hna!"},"11":{"text":"A kaa kip in an ka kulh, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa ṭhawnnak thawngin ka tei dih hna!"},"12":{"text":"Khuai zelh in an ka zelh, sihmanhsehlaw hlingbur kangh in an kang, Bawipa ṭhawnnak thawngin ka tei dih hna."},"13":{"text":"Fak piin an ka tuk i an ka tei ciaomau, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih a ka bawmh."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka himnak le ka ralhruang a si, amah cu a ka chuahtu a si.","ref":"Exo 15.2; Isa 12.2"},"15":{"text":"Pathian mi hna thlam chung i ral teinak au thawng cu ngai hmanh: Bawipa ṭhawnnak a liannganmi nih kan ral cu a tei hna,"},"16":{"text":"a ṭhawnnak nih teinak a kan pek, a ṭhawnnak a liannganmi nih raltuknak hmun ah teinak a kan pek!” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Ka thi lai lo, ka nung ko lai i Bawipa nih a tuahmi thil kha ka chim hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Fak piin dan a ka tat, sihmanhsehlaw thih ngaingai cu a ka siang lo."},"19":{"text":"Biakinn kutka cu ka hunpiak hna u, ka lut lai i Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat lai."},"20":{"text":"Hihi Bawipa kutka cu a si, miding mi lawng an lut kho lai."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih ka thlacamnak na ka theihpiak i teinak na ka pek caah; nangmah cu kan thangṭhat!"},"22":{"text":"Inn satu pawl nih santlailo ah an rel i an hlawtmi lung cu, santlai bik lung a rak si ziar ko!","ref":"Luk 20.17; Lam 4.11; 1Pet 2.7; Mat 21.42; Mar 12.10-11"},"23":{"text":"Cucu Bawipa tuahmi a si, zeitluk in dah aa dawh!"},"24":{"text":"Bawipa nih a kan pekmi ni hi zeitluk in dah a ṭhat; hi ni ah hin i lawm u si law i nuam u sih."},"25":{"text":"Kan khamh tuah, Maw Bawipa kan khamh tuah. Bawipa, thluachuahnak kan pe ko!","ref":"Mat 21.9; Mar 11.9; Jhn 12.13"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa min in a rami cu Pathian nih thluachuah a pek hna. Bawipa biakinn chungin kannih nih thluachuah kan rak in pek hna.","ref":"Mat 21.9; 23.39; Mar 11.9; Luk 13.35; 19.38; Jhn 12.13"},"27":{"text":"Bawipa cu Pathian a si; kan cungah a ṭha. Nan kut in thing nge kha i put in puai cu thawk u law biakṭheng kha vel u."},"28":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si i kan lawmh; na lianhngannak cu ka thanh lai."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭhat caah lawm tuah u, a dawtnak fek cu zungzal in a hmun."}}},"119":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"An nunning ah soisel awkj mi lunglawm an si.","title":"Nawlbia"},"3":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha an tuah lo, Bawipa lam kha an zulh."},"4":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha na kan pek i zumhawktlak tein nan zulh lai na kan ti."},"5":{"text":"Na kan pekmi phunglam cu zumhawktlak tein zul kho ning law zeitluk in dik ka va lunghmuih hnga!"},"6":{"text":"Na nawlbia vialte kha ṭha tein kaa zohchih hna ahcun ningzahnak ka phan lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Na biakhiahnak a dingmi kha ka hngalh hna lai i lung thiang in kan thangṭhat lai."},"8":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna lai, zeitikhmanh ah ka kaltak hlah."},"9":{"text":"Zeitindah tlangval nih thiang tein a um lai? Na nawl ngaihnak thawngin thiang tein a um lai.","title":"Nawl Ngaih Awk A Si"},"10":{"text":"Ka lungthin a dih umnak in na rian ṭuan kha kaa zuam; na nawlbia kha zul loin ka umnak hnga lo ka bawm."},"11":{"text":"Nangmah cungah sualnak ka tuah nakhnga lo na nawlbia cu ka lung chungah kaa chiah."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu kan ṭhangṭhat, na phunglam cu ka cawnpiak ko hna."},"13":{"text":"Na kan pekmi nawlbia vialte cu, fak piin ka chim lengmang hna lai."},"14":{"text":"Chawva tampi ngeih nakin na nawlbia zulh cu ka duh deuh."},"15":{"text":"Na kan hmuhsakmi thil kha ṭha tein ka ngiat hna i na kan cawnpiakmi thil kha ka dothlat hna."},"16":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu kaa lawmhnak an si, na phunglam cu ka philh hna lai lo."},"17":{"text":"Na sal cungah hin ṭhatnak tuah ko, cuticun ka nung lai i na cawnpiaknak kha ka zulh hna lai.","title":"Nawlbia Zulh Cu Lawmhnak A Si"},"18":{"text":"Na nawlbia chung i a ummi khuaruahhar biatak kha ka hmuh khawh nakhnga, ka mit ka auter ko."},"19":{"text":"Vawlei cungah hin caan tlawmte lawng ka um lai, cucaah na nawlbia kha ka thuhkanh hna hlah."},"20":{"text":"Na biakhiahnak kha ka lung nih chun zan in a ngai ko."},"21":{"text":"Mi porhlaw kha na chimhhrin hna; na nawlbia a pialtakmi cu chiatserhmi an si."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah phunglam kha ka zulh hna caah an ka serhsatnak le an ka nihsawhnak cun ka luatter ko."},"23":{"text":"Uktu bawi hna nih khan, keimah hrawhnak khua cu khang ṭi lengmang hna hmanh seh law, kei na sal cu na nawlbia tu kha ka ruat camcin ko lai."},"24":{"text":"Na ka cawnpiaknak nih lawmhnak a ka pek; fim a ka chimtu a si."},"25":{"text":"Leidip lakah ka ril ko cang, bia na ka kamh bang khan ka nunter ṭhan ko.","title":"Nawlbia Ka Zulh Lai"},"26":{"text":"Ka tuahmi vialte kha na sinah ka phuan dih i na ka leh; na nawlbia kha ka cawnpiak tuah hna."},"27":{"text":"Na phunglam zulhning kha ka cawnpiak law na cawnpiaknak khuaruahhar cu ka ruat hna lai."},"28":{"text":"Ngaihchiatnak nih a ka hrilh, bia na ka kamh bang khan thazang ka pe ṭhan tuah."},"29":{"text":"Lam ping zulh ka dawn law na ṭhatnak thawngin na phunglam kha ka cawnpiak tuah."},"30":{"text":"Na nawl zulh awkah ka lung kaa thlek cang; na phunglam kha ṭha tein ka ruat hna."},"31":{"text":"Bawipa, lam na ka hmuhsakmi kha ka zulh hna, hnabei dong in ka umter hlah."},"32":{"text":"Nangmah nih hngalhthiamnak tam chinchin in na ka pek lai caah, na nawlbia cu lunglawm tein ka zulh hna lai."},"33":{"text":"Na phunglam an sullam kha ka cawnpiak hna law zeitikhmanh ah ka zulh zungzal hna lai.","title":"Nawlbia Hngalhthiamnak Ca Thlacamnak"},"34":{"text":"Na phunglam kha fiang tein ka chim law ka zulh lai; ka lungthin a dih umnak in ka zulh lai."},"35":{"text":"Na nawlbia chungah khan lunglawmhnak ka hmuh caah na nawlbia lam cu ka zulhter ko."},"36":{"text":"Rumnak nakin na nawlbia zulh kha ka duhter deuh."},"37":{"text":"Santlailo thil kha biapi i ka rel sual nakhnga lo ka bawm, bia na ka kamh bang khan ka cungah ṭhatnak tuah ko."},"38":{"text":"Nangmah an ṭihtu hna sinah biakamnak na tuahmi cu, na sal keimah cung zongah hin tlinter ko."},"39":{"text":"Ka ṭihmi thangchiatnak khan ka khamh ko; zeitluk in dah na nawlbia cu a ṭhat!"},"40":{"text":"Nangmah cu na din caah na nawlbia zulh kha ka duh hna; ka cungah ṭhatnak tuah ko."},"41":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na ka dawt kha ka hmuhsak law bia na ka kamh bang khan ka khamh tuah, Maw ka Bawipa .","title":"Nawlbia I Bochannak"},"42":{"text":"Cun na bia kha kaa bochan caah, a ka nihsawhtu kha bia ka leh khawh hna lai."},"43":{"text":"Ka rak i ruahchanmi cu na biakhiahnak kha a si zungzal caah biatak cu ka chim zungzal khawh nakhnga ka bawm."},"44":{"text":"Na phunglam cu ka zulh zungzal lai, zungzal in zungzal tiang ka zulh lai."},"45":{"text":"Na nawlbia zulh kha kaa zuam caah luat ngaiin ka nung lai."},"46":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu siangpahrang kha ka chimh hna lai i cu tuah cu ka ning a zak lai lo."},"47":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu ka duh hna caah na nawlbia zulh cu ka caah a nuam."},"48":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu ka upat hna i ka duh hna; na cawnpiaknak cu ka ruat camcin hna lai."},"49":{"text":"Na sal bia na ka kamhmi kha philh hlah, na biakamnak cu ka ruahchannak hrampi a si.","title":"Nawlbia Ruahchannak Hrampi"},"50":{"text":"Nganfah ka in hmanh ah ka hna a ngam, zeicahtiah na biakamnak nih nunnak a ka pek."},"51":{"text":"Mi porhlaw hna nih an ka zawmhtaih, sihmanhsehlaw kei cu na phunglam kha ka kaltak lo."},"52":{"text":"Bawipa, hlan i na rak ka cawnpiakmi kha ka philh hna lo, kha nih khan an ka lawmhter."},"53":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih na phunglam an hrawh ka hmuh tikah ka thin a hung."},"54":{"text":"Ka inn in lamhlatpi i ka umnak hmun ah na nawlbia kha hla in ka hlawi hna."},"55":{"text":"Bawipa, zan ah nangmah kha kan ruat i, na phunglam kha ka zul."},"56":{"text":"Na nawlbia ka zulh hna hi kaa lawmhnak a si."},"57":{"text":"Nangmah lawnglawng hi kan duhmi na si ko, Maw Bawipa ; na phunglam zulh awkah bia kaa kam.","title":"Nawlbia Ka Tlaihchan"},"58":{"text":"Ka lungthin dihlak in kan nawl, bia na ka kamh bangin ka zaangfah tuah!"},"59":{"text":"Ka ziaza kha ṭha tein kaa ruat i na nawlbia zulh kha bia kaa kam."},"60":{"text":"Rau loin, khulrang in na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna."},"61":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih an hri in an ka ṭem, sihmanhsehlaw na phunglam kha ka philh lo."},"62":{"text":"Na biakhiahnak an din ruangah khan zanṭim i ka hun i hlauh tikah nangmah cu kan thangṭhat."},"63":{"text":"Na rian a ṭuanmi hna cu ahohmanh an si ah ka hawikom an si, na phunglam a zulmi hna i an hawikom ka si."},"64":{"text":"Bawipa, vawlei hi a fekmi na dawtnak in a khat; na nawlbia cu keimah kha ka cawnpiak tuah hna."},"65":{"text":"Bawipa, na biakam kha na zulh i na sal ka cungah hin na ṭha ko.","title":"Nawlbia A Ṭhathnemnak"},"66":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha kaa bochan hna caah fimnak le hngalhnak ka pe ko."},"67":{"text":"Dan na ka tat hlanah cun a pingah ka kal tawn, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu na bia kha ka ngaih."},"68":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na ṭhat i zeitluk in dah vel na ngeih! Na nawlbia cu ka cawnpiak tuah hna."},"69":{"text":"Mi porhlaw hna nih lih in ka thang an ka chiat, sihmanhsehlaw kei nih cun ka lungthin dihlak in na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna."},"70":{"text":"Hi mi hna cu hngalhnak a ngei lomi an si, sihmanhsehlaw kei cu na nawlbia ah kaa lawm."},"71":{"text":"Dantatnak ka inmi cu ka caah a ṭha, zeicahtiah na nawlbia kha a ka hngalhter."},"72":{"text":"Na ka pekmi nawlbia cu ka caah vawlei cung tangka vialte nakin a ṭha deuh."},"73":{"text":"Nangmah nih na ka ser i nangmah nih him tein na ka umter; na nawlbia kha ka hngalh khawh hna nakhnga hngalhthiamnak ka pe ko.","title":"Nawlbia Cu A Ding"},"74":{"text":"Na biakamnak kha kaa bochan caah nangmah an ṭihmi nih an ka hmuh tikah an lung aa lawm lai."},"75":{"text":"Bawipa, na nawlbia kha an ding ti ka hngalh i zumhawktlakmi na si caah dan na ka tat cu a si."},"76":{"text":"Kei na sal hi bia na ka kamh bantukin a fekmi na dawtnak nih cun ka lung ka lawmhter ko seh."},"77":{"text":"Na phunglam kha kaa lawmhnak a si caah ka cungah zaangfahnak ngei law ka nung lai."},"78":{"text":"Lih in sual an ka puh caah miporhlaw pawl cu, ningzahnak phan hna seh, kei tu cu na nawlbia kha ka ruat ko hna lai."},"79":{"text":"Nangmah an ṭihmi le na nawlbia a hngalmi cu ka sinah ra hna seh."},"80":{"text":"Ral tuknak i sungh ningzahnak khan ka luat nakhnga, na nawlbia cu tlamtling tein ka zulhter ko."},"81":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na khamhnak ka hngahnak ah hin ka ba tuk hringhran cang; na bia cu kaa bochanmi a si.","title":"Luatnak Ca Thlacam"},"82":{"text":"“Zeitik ah dah na ka bawmh lai?” ti lengmang in ka um i na ka kamhmi ka cuanhnak ah hin ka mithram a fak tuk cang."},"83":{"text":"Kei cu an hlonhmi saphaw cua bantukin santlailo ka si, asinain na nawlbia cu ka philh hna lo."},"84":{"text":"Zei can dah ka ngan a herh rih lai? A ka hremtu kha zeitik ah dah dan na tat hna lai?"},"85":{"text":"Na nawlbia a zul duh lomi miruamkai pawl nih khan, ka tlaknak dingah khor an cawh."},"86":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu zumhawktlak an si dih, mi nih lih in an ka hrem, ka bawm tuah!"},"87":{"text":"An ka thah khawh ciaomau, sihmanhsehlaw na nawlbia kha ka daithlanh hna lo."},"88":{"text":"Na dawtnak fek ruangah ka cungah ṭha ko, cuticun na phunglam kha ka zulh khawh hna lai."},"89":{"text":"Bawipa, na bia cu zungzal in a hmun lai; vancung ah khin fek tein a um.","title":"Nawlbia Zumhawktlak A si"},"90":{"text":"Zumhawktlak na sinak cu chan vialte tiangin a hmun, vawlei cu a umnak ah na chiah i cuka ah cun a um peng ko."},"91":{"text":"Nangmah nawlbia thawngin zeizong vialte hi nihin ni tiang an hmun, zeicahtiah zeizong vialte cu an dihlak in na sal an si."},"92":{"text":"Na nawlbia hi kaa lawmhnak hram rak si hlah seh law, ka dantatnak inmi ah hin ka thi diam cang hnga."},"93":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu ka daithlanh bal hna lai lo, zeicahtiah anmah nih cun pei an ka nunter cu."},"94":{"text":"Kei cu nangmah ta ka si, ka khamh ko sawh. Na nawlbia zulh kha kaa zuam lengmang ko."},"95":{"text":"Miṭhalo pawl nih thah awkah an ka bawh ko, sihmanhsehlaw kei cu na phunglam kha ka ruat ko hna lai."},"96":{"text":"Zei thil hmanh hi a tlingmi a um lo ti kha ka hngalh cang, asinain na nawlbia cu donghnak a ngei lo."},"97":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na phunglam cu ka duh, chun nitlak cu lawng cu ka ruat ko.","title":"Nawlbia Ka Duh"},"98":{"text":"Na nawlbia nih a ka umpi zungzal i ka ral vialte hna nakin a ka fimter deuh."},"99":{"text":"Na cawnpiaknak kha ka ruah hna caah, ka sayate vialte nakin ka hngal deuh."},"100":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna caah tar nakin fimnak ka ngei deuh."},"101":{"text":"Na bia zulh kha ka duh caah ziaza ṭhalo vialte kha ka hrial hna."},"102":{"text":"Na cawnpiaknak kha zeirello in ka um hna lo, zeicahtiah a ka cawnpiaktu cu nangmah na si."},"103":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na nawlbia cu an thlum, khuaihliti nakin an thlum deuh."},"104":{"text":"Na nawlbia in fimnak ka hmuh, cucaah ziaza ṭhalo vialte kha ka huat hna."},"105":{"text":"Na bia cu ka ke caah meiinn a si, ka lam ah ceunak a si.","title":"Nawlbia Ceunak A Si"},"106":{"text":"Na ka cawnpiaknak a dingmi, ka zulh hna lai tiah bia kaa kammi kha, ka zulh taktak hna lai."},"107":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka temhinnak hi a fak tuk hringhran, bia na ka kamh bangin ka nunter ko sawh."},"108":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, ka lunglawmhnak thlacamnak cu ka cohlang law, na nawlbia kha ka cawnpiak tuah hna."},"109":{"text":"Nifate thinphang zungzal in ka um ko, sihmanhsehlaw na nawlbia cu ka philh lo."},"110":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih keimah foihnak caah rap an chiah, sihmanhsehlaw na nawl zul loin ka um lo."},"111":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu zungzal ka ro an si, ka lung a ka lawmhtertu an si."},"112":{"text":"Ka thih ni tiangin na nawlbia cu ka zulh zungzal ko hna lai."},"113":{"text":"Na sinah zumhawktlak in a um lomi cu ka huat hna, sihmanhsehlaw kei cu na phunglam kha ka duh.","title":"Nawlbia Himnak A Si"},"114":{"text":"Nangmah cu a ka khamhtu le a ka hupphengtu na si, na biakam cu kaa bochan."},"115":{"text":"Nannih misual mi hna, ka kaltak u, kei cu ka Pathian nawlbia kha ka zul lai."},"116":{"text":"Bia na ka kamh bangin thazang ka pe law ka nung lai. kaa ruahchannak ah hin hnabeidong in ka umter hlah."},"117":{"text":"Ka domh law ka him lai, na nawlbia cu zungzal in ka ruat hna lai."},"118":{"text":"Na phunglam a zul duh lomi vialte kha na hlawt hna, zernak in khua an khanmi vialte cu pakpalawng a si."},"119":{"text":"Nang na mit hmuh ah cun vawleicung miṭhalo vialte hi hmunthur men an si dih, cucaah kei cu na nawlbia kha ka duh."},"120":{"text":"Nangmah kan ṭih caah a ther in ka ther, na biakhiahmi hmaiah cun khuaruahhar in ka dir."},"121":{"text":"A dingmi le a ṭhami thil kha ka tuah, ka ral hna sinah ka chia ta hlah.","title":"Nawlbia Zulh Awk A Si"},"122":{"text":"Na sal kha, kan bawmh lai, tiah biakamnak ka pe tuah, miruamkai hna nih hin harnak ka pe hna hlah seh."},"123":{"text":"Na khamhnak hi ka mit hram fak in ka cuan, na ka kamhmi luatnak cu."},"124":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak ningin ka cungah ṭuan law na nawlbia cu hung ka cawnpiak ko hna."},"125":{"text":"Kei cu na sal ka si, cucaah cun hngalhthiamnak ka pe law na ka cawnpiakmi kha ka hngalh khawh hna lai."},"126":{"text":"Mi nih na phunglam kha an zulh duh ti lo caah atu caan hi na cawlcangh caan a si awk a hau."},"127":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu sui nakin ka duh deuh hna, sui ṭha bik nakin ka duh deuh hna."},"128":{"text":"Cucaah cun na cawnpiaknak kha ka zulh hna i lam hmaanlo vialte kha ka huat hna."},"129":{"text":"Na kan cawnpiaknak cu khuaruahhar an si; ka lungthin a dih umnak in ka zulh hna.","title":"Nawlbia Zulh Ka Duh"},"130":{"text":"Na kan cawnpiaknak fianternak nih khan ceunak a chuahpi, hngalhnak a tlawmmi kha fimnak a pek hna."},"131":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha ka duh tuk hna caah, ka kaa kaa an i ka thaw aa su."},"132":{"text":"Na dawtmi hna cu na merhnawh hna i an cungah zaangfahnak na ngeih bantukin kei zong ka merhnawh ve law ka zaangfah ve ko sawh."},"133":{"text":"Bia na ka kamh bantukin tlu loin ka khamh law ṭhat lonak nih khan ka tei sawh hlah seh."},"134":{"text":"A ka hremtu hna kut chung khan ka khamh tuah, cuticun na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna lai."},"135":{"text":"Na sal cungah hin na hmai kha tlanter law, na phunglam kha ka cawnpiak ko."},"136":{"text":"Mi nih na phunglam kha zulh an duh lo caah an mitthli cu tiva bangin a luang."},"137":{"text":"Bawipa, nang cu na ding i na nawlbia zong a ding.","title":"Nawlbia Cu Nawlbia Ding A Si"},"138":{"text":"Nangmah pekmi nawlbia cu an hmaan i an ding."},"139":{"text":"Ka ral nih na nawlbia cu zei ah an rel hna lo caah ka thin cu meialh in a alh."},"140":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na biakam cu a hmaan! Zeitluk in dah na sal nih ka duh!"},"141":{"text":"Kei cu santlailo le zeirello mi ka si, sihmanhsehlaw na nawlbia cu ka daithlanh hna lo."},"142":{"text":"Na dinnak cu zungzal in a hmun lai, na phunglam cu ahmaan zungzal ko."},"143":{"text":"Harnak le lung retheihnak in ka khat, sihmanhsehlaw na nawlbia nih an ka lawmhter."},"144":{"text":"Na kan cawnpiaknak cu zungzal in a ding, hngalhthiamnak ka pe law ka nung lai."},"145":{"text":"Ka lungthin dihlak in nangmah cu kan auh, Maw Bawipa ka let law na nawlbia cu ka zulh hna lai.","title":"Luatnak Ca Thlacam"},"146":{"text":"Nangmah kha kan auh, ka khamh law na nawlbia kha ka zulh hna lai."},"147":{"text":"Ni a chuah hlanah nangmah cu bawmhnak hal duh ah kan auh, na biakamnak kha kaa bochanmi cu a si."},"148":{"text":"Zan khuadei mit cungtang chin loin ka um, cucu na cawnpiakmi ka ruahnak ah a si."},"149":{"text":"A fekmi na dawtnak thawngin, maw Bawipa, ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak ko, na ṭhatnak thawngin ka nunnak cu ka zuahpiak ko."},"150":{"text":"A ka hremtu mipuarhrang hna nih khan an ka naih chin lengmang, annih cu na phunglam a zul duh bal lomi kha an si."},"151":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Maw Bawipa, nang nih cun lam nai tein na ka umpi i na biakamnak cu a si taktakmi an si."},"152":{"text":"Na kan cawnpiaknak cu hlanlio piin ka rak hngalh cang, zungzal hmun dingin na ser hna."},"153":{"text":"Ka temhinnak hi ka zohpiak law ka khamh tuah, zeicahtiah na phunglam cu zeirello in ka um hna lo.","title":"Khamhnak Ca Thlacam"},"154":{"text":"Ka bia ka chimpiak law ka luatter tuah, bia na ka kamh bang khan ka khamh tuah."},"155":{"text":"Na nawlbia kha miṭhalo mi nih cun an zulh hna lo caah annih cu khamhnak an hmu lai lo,"},"156":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa na zaangfahnak cu a ngan caah na biakhiahnak bantukin ka khamh ko."},"157":{"text":"Ral tampi le hremtu tampi ka ngei, ka luak an chuak, zeicahtiah na nawlbia kha an zul duh lo."},"158":{"text":"Khi mirawitu hna khi ka zoh hna tikah ka luak an chuak, zeicahtiah na nawlbia kha an zul duh lo."},"159":{"text":"Bawipa, zeitluk in dah na cawnpiaknak ka duh cu hngal ko. A fekmi na dawtnak thawngin ka khamh ko!"},"160":{"text":"Na phunglam a chung muru cu biatak a si, a dingmi na nawlbia vialte cu zungzal in an hmun."},"161":{"text":"Miṭhawng nih ding lo piin an ka serhsat, sihmanhsehlaw na phunglam cu ka hmaizah.","title":"Nawlbia Zulh Ka Duh"},"162":{"text":"Bia na kammi thawngin zeitluk in dah ka lung aa lawmh, ro chaw aa hmuhmi bantukin kaa lawm."},"163":{"text":"Lih cu ka huat hna i ka fih hna, sihmanhsehlaw na phunglam cu ka duh."},"164":{"text":"A dingmi na biakhiahnak ruangah ni khat ah voi sarih lengmang ka lawmh."},"165":{"text":"Na phunglam a duhmi cu him tein khua an sa i a tlukter khotu hna zeihmanh a um lo."},"166":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, na khamhnak cu kaa ruahchan i nawl na ka pekmi cu ka tuah hna."},"167":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu ka zulh hna; ka lungthin dihlak in ka duh hna."},"168":{"text":"Na nawlbia le na cawnpiaknak cu ka zulh hna; ka tuahmi vialte cu na hmuh dih."},"169":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah bawmh hal in ka aunak cu na sin phakter ko. Bia na ka kamh bangin hngalhnak ka pe ko.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam"},"170":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu na hmaika phan seh law bia na ka kamh bangin ka khamh tuah."},"171":{"text":"Na phunglam cu na ka cawnpiak hna caah kan thangṭhat zungzal ko lai."},"172":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu an din caah na phunglam cu hla in ka sak lai."},"173":{"text":"Na nawlbia cu ka zulh hna caah a zungzal in ka bawm ko."},"174":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah na khamhnak hmuh cu ka duh, Maw Bawipa ! Na phunglam zulh hi kaa lawmhnak a si."},"175":{"text":"Kan thangṭhat khawh nakhnga, nunnak ka pe tuah! Na cawnpiaknak nih ka bawm hna seh."},"176":{"text":"Tuu tlau bantukin ka vai; cucaah ra law na sal hi ka kawl tuah, zeicahtiah na phunglam cu zeirello in ka um hna lo."}}},"120":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Harnak chung ka um tikah Bawipa cu ka auh i a ka leh.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, lihchim hmangmi hna le hlen hmangmi hna sin hin ka khamh ko."},"3":{"text":"Nannih milihchim hna, nan cungah Pathian nih zeidah a tuah lai? Zeitindah dan an tat hna lai?"},"4":{"text":"Ralkap cantiang le meiṭil sen in dan an tat hna lai."},"5":{"text":"Nannih lak um cu Meshek khua um tluk in a har, Kedar mi hna lak um tluk a si."},"6":{"text":"Daihnak a huami hna sinah sau tuk ka um cang!"},"7":{"text":"Kei nih daihnak ka chim paoh ah, annih nih dohnak an duh"}}},"121":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tlang khi ka hei cuan hna i, khuazei in dah bawmhnak ka hmuh lai? ka ti.","title":"A Kan Hupphengtu Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawmhnak ka hmuh dingmi cu Bawipa sinin a ra lai, van le vawlei sertu a simi sin cun a ra lai."},"3":{"text":"A ka hupphengtu cu i ṭhang peng ko seh law, ka tlukter sawh hlah seh:"},"4":{"text":"Israel hupphengtu cu a ngu bal lo i aa hngilh bal lo,"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih an ven ko lai, nangmah huhphenh awkah na pawngin an umhnawh ko."},"6":{"text":"Chun ah ni nih harnak an pe lai lo i zan ah thlapa zong nih harnak an pe ve lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa nih ṭihnak chungin an huhphenh lai i him tein an chiah lai."},"8":{"text":"Atu in zungzal tiang, na chuahlei siseh, na luhlei siseh, an zohkhenh zungzal lai."}}},"122":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“ Bawipa inn ah kal u sih,” an ka ti tikah khan ka rak i lawm.","title":"Jerusalem Thangṭhatnak Caah Kainak Hla, David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Atu cu maw Jerusalem, na kutka chungah kan dir cang!"},"3":{"text":"Jerusalem cu i rem ṭhipṭhep le i dawh cikcek in sakmi khua a si."},"4":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Bawipa sin i lawmhnak bia chim awkah, Israel miphun cu an kal tawn, cu lawmhnak bia chim cu Bawipa nih a fialmi hna a si."},"5":{"text":"Cuka ah cun David chung bawiṭhutdan hna cu, an hun hna."},"6":{"text":"Jerusalem daihnak caah thla cam u! “Nangmah an duhmi cu an thluachuak hna seh!"},"7":{"text":"Na kulhnak vampang chunglei ah daihnak um seh law na siangpahrang inn hna chungah himnak um seh."},"8":{"text":"Ka rualchan hna le ka hawikom hna ruangah, Jerusalem cu, “Na chungah daihnak um seh,” ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa kan Pathian inn ruangah, na ṭhatnak ding caah thla ka cam."}}},"123":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah lawng kei cu kan cuan ko, na umnak hmun van lei lawng ka zoh ko.","title":"Zaangfahnak Ca Thlacam Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Sal nih a bawipa aa bochan bantuk le salnu nih a bawinu aa bochan bantukin, Bawipa kan Pathian, nangmah lawng kan hun in zoh ko, kan cungah zaangfahnak na ngeih hlantiang kan in zoh ko lai."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kan zaangfah ko sawh, kan zaangfah ko sawh; an kan serhsat tuk hringhran!"},"4":{"text":"Mirum nih sau tuk an kan zawmhtaih cang i miporhlaw nih sau tuk an kan nihsawh cang."}}},"124":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa kha kanmah leiah rak ṭang hlah seh law, zei huah dah kan rak huah hnga, Israel mi hna ka let tuah u!","title":"Pathian Cu A Mi Hna Khamhtu A Si Kainak Hla, David Hla"},"2":{"text":"“Kan ral nih an kan tuk ah khan, Bawipa kha kanmah leiah rak ṭang hlah seh law"},"3":{"text":"kan nung in an kan dolh dih hnga, an thinhun ling ah khan an rak kan dolh dih hnga."},"4":{"text":"Kha tikah tilian nih khan a rak kan fenh diam hnga i ti nih khan a rak kan phum diam hnga."},"5":{"text":"a hlonh in aa hlonhmi tilian nih khan a rak kan phum diam hnga.”"},"6":{"text":"Kan ral nih hrawh awkah a kan siang lotu Bawipa cu lawm ko u sih."},"7":{"text":"Rap chiahtupa rap in a luatmi va bantukin kan luat; rap cu a hrawh i kannih cu kan luat."},"8":{"text":"Bawmhnak kan hmuhnak cu Bawipa sinin a si, amah cu van le vawlei a sertu a si."}}},"125":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa aa bochanmi cu Zion Tlang bantuk an si; Zion Tlang, hninh khawh zong a si lo i ṭhial khawh zong a si lomi bantuk an si.","title":"Pathian Mi Hna Himnak Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Tlang nih Jerusalem khua kha an kulh bangin, Bawipa nih a mi cu a kulh hna, atu thawk in zungzal tiang a kulh hna."},"3":{"text":"Pathian mi hna ram cu miṭhalo nih an uk zungzal lai lo, an uk ahcun, Pathian mi hna hrimhrim hmanh nih khan, ṭhat lonak an tuah sual hnga."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, ṭhatnak a tuahmi hna cungah ṭhatnak tuah ve ko, na nawl a ngaimi hna cungah ṭhatnak tuah ko."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anmah lam, lam ṭhalo a zulmi hna cu, miṭhalo dan na tat hna tikah khan, dantat ve ko hna. Israel cungah daihnak um ko seh."}}},"126":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih Zion i a kan kirpi ṭhan ah khan, kan mang bantuk a rak si!","title":"Lawmhnak Thlacamnak Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Zeitluk in dah kan nih kan kheh i zeitluk in dah lunglawmhnak hla kan sak kha!
