Kha tikah khan miphun dang hna nih, “An caah Bawipa nih thil lianngan a tuah,” an kan ti."},"3":{"text":"Kan caah thil lianngan a tuah taktak hna; zeitluk in dah kan rak i lawmh!"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, kan ram ah kan kirpi ṭhan ko, a carmi tiva ah ruah nih ti a chuahpi ṭhan bangin, kan kirpi ṭhan ko."},"5":{"text":"Mitthli he thlaici a tuhmi nih, lunglawmh aunak he an zun lai;"},"6":{"text":"Ṭah buin thlaici aa phorhmi hna nih lunglawmhnak hlasa le facang phal i put in an ra kir lai!"}}},"127":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa nih inn cu a sak lo ahcun, a satu hna rianṭuannak cu santlailo a si; Bawipa nih khua kha a ven lo ahcun, a vengtu hna hngilh loin an umnak cu santlailo a si.","title":"Innchungkhar Ca Thluachuahnak Kainak Hla, Solomon Hla"},"2":{"text":"Khuasak tintuknak caah fak tuk in rianṭuan le tuan tein thawh i tlaipi ah ih lengmang hi santlailo a si, zeicahtiah Bawipa nih a dawtmi cu, an i hngilh karah, an herhmi kha a pek ko hna."},"3":{"text":"Fale hi Bawipa sinin kan hmuhmi ro an si, thluachuah a kan pekmi an si."},"4":{"text":"Mipa nih a no lioah a ngeihmi fapa hna cu ralkap kut chung cantiang bantuk an si."},"5":{"text":"Cu bantuk cantiang a thalbawm khat in a ngeimi cu mi lunglawm a si! Biaceihnak hmun ah a ral kha a ton hna tikah a sung bal lai lo."}}},"128":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭihmi cu mi lunglawm an si, a nawl a ngaimi cu mi lunglawm an si.","title":"Bawipa Nawlbia Zulh A Ṭhathnemnak Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Rian na ṭuan tikah nangmah pawcawmnak khim na hmuh lai i na lung aa lawm lai i khua awng na pem lai."},"3":{"text":"Na nupi cu na inn chungah a thei a ṭhami mitsur ruang bantuk a si lai, na fapale nih oliv thing tuaino bantukin na cabuai kha an kulh lai."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nawl a ngaimi cu hi bantukin thluachuahnak an hmu hrimhrim lai."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih Zion Tlang in thluachuahnak in pe ko hna seh! Nan nun chung vialte, Jerusalem rumnak cu co ve ko u."},"6":{"text":"Nan tufa nan hmuh hna tiangin nung ko u. Israel cungah daihnak um ko seh."}}},"129":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Israel, na no lio tein na ral nih zeitluk in dah an rak in hrem kha, chim tuah!","title":"Israel Mi Ral Hna Teinak Ca Thlacamnak Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"I thawh law, “Ka no lio tein ka ral nih fak piin an ka hrem zungzal, sihmanhsehlaw an ka tei lo."},"3":{"text":"Ka keng cu leithuan in an thuan, leikuang rinkuar sau pipi in an tuah bantuk khin an tuah."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a dingmi Bawipa nih saltannak chung cun a ka luatter,” tiah chim tuah."},"5":{"text":"Zion a huatu vialte hna cu sung hna seh law kir dih hna seh!"},"6":{"text":"Inn cungah a khomi ram, hleh cut hlan i a carmi bantuk khi si hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Cu bantuk ram cu ahohmanh nih pumh awkah an sak hna lo i a tom in i phorh awkah an rel hna lo."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah an pawng i a kalmi ahohmanh nih, “ Bawipa nih thluachuah in pe hna seh, Bawipa min in thluachuah kan in pek hna,” an ti hna lai lo."}}},"130":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka awlok a chon caah nangmah cu kan auh, Maw Bawipa !","title":"Bawmhnak Halnak Thlacam Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka aunak cu ka theihpiak law bawmh kan halnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko!"},"3":{"text":"Kan sualnak kha cazin chungah na kan khumhpiak ahcun ahodah sual phawtnak cu a luat khomi a um lai?"},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih kan sualnak cu na kan ngaihthiam, cucaah nangmah cu kan in hmaizah."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa bawmhnak cu i hngahhlang ngaiin ka hngak ko, a bia cu kaa bochan."},"6":{"text":"Ralvengtu pawl nih khuadei lai an i ngaih nak hmanh khin Bawipa hon lai cu kaa ngaih deuh."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu a dawtnak kha a fek i mi tlanh kha a duh zungzalmi a si caah, Maw Israel, amah cu i bochan ko."},"8":{"text":"A mi Israel mi vialte kha an sualnak chungin a khamh hna lai.","ref":"Mat 1.21; Tit 2.14"}}},"131":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, kaa porhlawtnak kha ka hlawt cang, ka ruamkainak kha ka chuahtak cang. Thil lianngan kha biapi ah ka ruat ti hna lo, ka ca i a har tukmi thil kha zei ah ka rel ti hna lo.","title":"Pathian Bochan In Thlacamnak Kainak Hla, David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka hna a ngam i ka lung a dai ko. Ngakchia cu a nu ṭang ah dai tein a ih bantukin ka lung cu ka chungah dai tein a um ko."},"3":{"text":"Israel, atu in zungzal tiang, Bawipa cu i bochan ko."}}},"132":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, David kha philh hlah, a rianṭuanmi vialte zong kha philh hlah.","title":"Hmunthiang Thangṭhatnak Caah Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa, bia aa kammi kha philh hlah, Israel Pathian Lianngan Bik, na sinah chiat aa serhmi kha philh hlah."},"3":{"text":"Cu a biakamnak cu hitihin a si: “ Bawipa caah hmun pakhat ka ser khawh hlan lo, Israel Pathian Lianngan Bik caah umnak inn pakhat ka tuah khawh hlan lo, inn chung zongah ka lut lai lo i a ih zong ka it lai lo, a dinh zong kaa din lai lo i a hngilh zong kaa hngilh lai lo,” a ti.","merge":"4"},"6":{"text":"Bethlehem khua ah biakamnak kuang kong kha kan theih i Jaar lo lakah khan cu kuang cu kan hmuh.","ref":"2Cha 6.41-42"},"7":{"text":"“ Bawipa inn ah khan kal u sih, a bawiṭhutdan hmaiah khan amah cu bia u sih,” kan ti."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, biakamnak kuang he cun naa dinhnak hmun ah khan ra tuah, na ṭhawnnak hmelchunhnak a simi kuang he cun ra law zungzal in um tuah."},"9":{"text":"Na mi na khamh hna kha tlangbawi nih thanh hna seh law na mi cu an dihlak in lunglawm in au hna seh."},"10":{"text":"Na sal David kha bia na rak kamh, na thimmi siangpahrang kha hlaw hlah, maw Bawipa ."},"11":{"text":"David sinah biakamnak fek pakhat, na let ṭhan lo dingmi kha na rak ser, cu na biakamnak cu hihi a si: “Na fapa pakhat cu siangpahrang ah ka ser lai i na hnuah amah cu uktu bawi a rung si lai.","ref":"2Sam 7.12-16; 1Cha 17.11-14; Slm 89.3-4; Lam 2.30"},"12":{"text":"Na fapale hna nih khan ka biakamnak kha an zulh i nawl ka pekmi hna kha an tuah ahcun, an fapale hna zong cu nangmah hnu zulh in siangpahrang an si zungzal lai.”"},"13":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Bawipa nih Zion cu aa thim cang i khika ah a umnak inn kha ser a duh."},"14":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Hika hi zungzal ka umnak a si lai; hika hmun hi ka uknak ka chiahnak hmun ca i ka duhmi a si."},"15":{"text":"Zion cu a herhbaumi vialte kha tlamtling tein ka pek lai i a misifak hna cu rawl khim tein ka pek hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Keimah nih ka khamh hna kha a tlangbawi pawl ka thanhter hna lai i a mi pawl kha lunglawm in hla ka sakter hna lai i ka auter hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Hika hmun ah hin Siangpahrang David tefa pakhat cu siangpahrang ngan pakhat ah ka ser lai, hika hmun ah hin ka thimmi siangpahrang uknak cu ka hmunhter lai.","ref":"1Sia 11.36"},"18":{"text":"A ral pawl cu ningzahnak in ka khuh hna lai, asinain anih cu a cer in a cermi suiluchin kha ka chinh l ai."}}},"133":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Unau rual i rem tein khuasak ṭi hi zeitluk in dah a ṭhat i a nuamh!","title":"Unau Rual I Dawtnak Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Aaron luthlung in a khabe ah, a khabe in a angki hngawng ah a vung luangmi oliv chiti bantuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Hermon Tlang dap, Zion tlang cung i a tlami bantuk a si. Zion Tlang ah cun thluachuahnak kan pek hna lai, tiah Bawipa nih bia a kan kam, zungzal nunnak cu."}}},"134":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa sal vialte hna, ra u law Bawipa cu thangṭhat u sih, zan i a biakinn chung i rian a ṭuanmi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u sih.","title":"Pathian Thangṭhat U Sih Kainak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Thlacam in a biakinn chungah nan kut hler u law Bawipa cu thangṭhat u."},"3":{"text":"Van le vawlei a sertu Bawipa nih, Zion in thluachuah in pe ko hna seh."}}},"135":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u. Bawipa sal hna, a min cu thangṭhat u,","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla (Slm 115)"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa inn chungah a dirmi hna, kan Pathian hmunthiang chungah a ummi hna, a min cu thangṭhat u."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭhat caah thangṭhat u zaangfah thiammi a si caah a min cu hla in thangṭhat u."},"4":{"text":"Jakob cu amah minung si awkah amah nih aa thim, Israel mi cu amah mi si awkah amah nih aa thim hna."},"5":{"text":"Kan Bawipa cu a liannganmi a si kha ka hngalh, pathian dang vialte hna nakin a ngan deuh."},"6":{"text":"Vancung ah siseh, vawlei cungah siseh, rili chungah siseh, rili tangah siseh, a duhmi paoh kha a tuah ko."},"7":{"text":"Vanhramdeng in khuadawm kha a ratpi hna, thlichia chungin ṭek kha a chuahter i a thil khonnak inn chungin thli kha a chuahter."},"8":{"text":"Izipt ram ah fater paohpaoh kha a thah hna, minung fater he saram fater he a thah hna."},"9":{"text":"Faro le a bawi pawl dantatnak ah khuaruahharmi thil le hmelchunhnak kha a ser hna."},"10":{"text":"Miphun tampi kha a hrawh hna i siangpahrang ṭhawngṭhawng kha a thah hna."},"11":{"text":"Cu hna cu: Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon, Bashan siangpahrang Og le Kanaan siangpahrang dihlak an si."},"12":{"text":"An ram cu a mi kha a pek hna, Israel mi kha a pek hna."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu Pathian na si kha mi nih an hngalh zungzal ko lai; chan vialte nih a philh in an philh lai lo."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi cu a zaangfah hna lai, a sal cu a luatter hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Miphun dang nih an biakmi siasal cu sui le ngun in sermi an si; minung nih an kut in an sermi an si."},"16":{"text":"Kaa cu an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw an holh kho lo, mit cu an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw khua an hmu lo."},"17":{"text":"Hna an ngei, asinain khua an thei lo, an kaa chungah thaw a um lo."},"18":{"text":"Cu siasal a sertu hna le cu siasal aa bochanmi hna cu, an sermi siasal bantuk ah cun an i cang lai!"},"19":{"text":"Israel mi hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u; Pathian tlangbawi hna, amah cu thangṭhat u."},"20":{"text":"Nannih Levi mi hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u. amah a ṭihmi vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu Zion ah thangṭhat u, a inn Jerusalem ah thangṭhat u. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u."}}},"136":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu a ṭhat caah lawm tuah u, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","title":"Lawmhnak Hla","ref":"1Cha 16.34; 2Cha 5.13; 7.3; Ezr 3.11; Slm 100.5; 106.1; 107.1; 118.1; Jer 33.11"},"2":{"text":"Lawm tuah u, pathian hna Pathian cu, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"3":{"text":"Bawi vialte Bawipa cu lawm tuah u, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"4":{"text":"Amah lawng nih khuaruahhar thil lianngan a tuah khawh, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"5":{"text":"A fimnak in van khi a ser hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Gen 1.1"},"6":{"text":"A thukmi ti cungah vawlei kha a sak, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Gen 1.2"},"7":{"text":"Nika le thlapa kha a ser hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Gen 1.16"},"8":{"text":"Ni cu chun uktu ah a ser, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"9":{"text":"Thlapa le arfi cu zan uktu ah a ser hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"10":{"text":"Izipt mi an fapa upa bik kha a thah hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Exo 12.29"},"11":{"text":"Israel mi kha Izipt ram chungin a chuahpi hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Exo 12.51"},"12":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi a kut le a ban in a chuahpi hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"13":{"text":"Rili Sen kha a cheu, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Exo 14.21-29"},"14":{"text":"A mi cu rili chung khan a hruai hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"15":{"text":"Faro le a ralkap bu kha rili chungah a paih hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"16":{"text":"Thetse ram chungah khan a mi kha amah nih a hruai hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"17":{"text":"Siangpahrang ṭhawngṭhawng kha a thah hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang min thangthang kha a thah hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"19":{"text":"Amor mi siangpahrang Sihon kha a thah, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Nam 21.21-30"},"20":{"text":"Bashan siangpahrang Og kha a thah, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun.","ref":"Nam 21.31-35"},"21":{"text":"An ram cu a mi kha a pek hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"22":{"text":"Israel a sal kha an ram cu a pek, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"23":{"text":"Kan sungh tikah khan a kan philh lo, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"24":{"text":"Kan ral hna kut chungin a kan chuah, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"25":{"text":"Minung le saram kha rawl a pek dih hna, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."},"26":{"text":"Vancung Pathian hi lawm tuah u, a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun. a dawtnak cu zungzal in a hmun."}}},"137":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Babilon tiva hna kamah cun kan ṭhu i Zion kan ruah chel paoh ah kan ṭap tawn.","title":"Israel Mi Babilon Ram I An Ṭahnak"},"2":{"text":"Kan pawng i a ummi inhliam kung hna ah cun kan tingtang kha kan bah tawn hna."},"3":{"text":"A kan tlaitu nih khan hlasak an kan fial i, “Kan i nuamh nakhnga, Zion hla kan sakpiak u,” an kan ti."},"4":{"text":"Zeitindah Bawipa hla cu miphun dang ram ah kan sak khawh lai?"},"5":{"text":"Jerusalem, nangmah kha kan philh a si ahcun, ka orhlei kut hi car seh,"},"6":{"text":"nangmah kha kan hngalh camcin lo i kaa lawmhnak sang bik ah kan chiah lo ahcun, ka lei hi ka dang ah i beh seh."},"7":{"text":"Jerusalem an tlaih ni ah, Edom mi nih an tuahmi kha philh hlah, Maw Bawipa, “Hrawk dih cikcek u law a hram tiangin kalh dih u,” an ti kha philh hin hlah."},"8":{"text":"Babilon, hrawh na si cang lai! Kan cung i na tuahmi ruangah, teirul an chamtu cu an i lawm lai,","ref":"Biat 18.6"},"9":{"text":"nan ngakchia no tete aa lak riangmang i lung cung i a dengtu hna cu, an i lawm lai."}}},"138":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah cu ka lungthin dihlak in kan lawmh; nangmah cu pathian hna hmaiah kan ṭhangṭhat.","title":"Lawmhnak Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Na biakinn thiang hmaiah ka kun i na min kha ka thangṭhat, zeicahtiah na dawtnak cu a fek i zumhawktlak na si, nangmah le na nawlbia cu a sang bik nan si kha na langhter."},"3":{"text":"Kan auh tikah na ka leh, na ṭhawnnak in na ka ṭhawnter."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, vawlei cung siangpahrang vialte nih, na biakamnak kha an theih caah an in thangṭhat lai."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa nih na tuahmi thil kong kha hla in an sak lai i a liannganmi na sunparnak kha hla in an thangṭhat lai."},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu hi tluk hin a sang hringhran ko nain minauta kha an zawn a ruah hna i miruamkai kha a hmuh lonak ah an i thup kho lo."},"7":{"text":"Harnak nih a kulh in a ka kulh hmanh ah, him tein na ka umter ko, a thin a linh in a linmi ka ral kha na doh hna i na ṭhawnnak in na ka khamh."},"8":{"text":"Na ka kamhmi thil vialte kha tlinter ko hna, Bawipa, na dawtnak cu zungzal in a fek ko; na thawk ciami rian cu liim ko."}}},"139":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, na ka kawl dih hirhiar i na ka hngalh dih cikcek!","title":"Pathian Nih A Hngalh Dih"},"2":{"text":"Ka tuahmi vialte cu na hngalh dih, lamhlatpi khin ka ruahnak vialte cu na hngalh dih ko hna."},"3":{"text":"Rian ka ṭuan ah siseh, kaa dinh ah siseh, na ka hmuh, ka tuahmi vialte kha na hngalh dih."},"4":{"text":"Ka chim hlan in ka chim ding vialte kha na hngalh dih."},"5":{"text":"Ka hnulei le ka hmailei in na ka cawngh i ka cungah na kut na zar."},"6":{"text":"Na ka hngalhnak hi a thuk tuk hringhran, ka ruahnak nih a phak khawh leng a si."},"7":{"text":"Na thlarau sin hin khuazei ah dah ka zam khawh lai? Na hmaika hin khuazei ah dah kaa thuh khawh lai?"},"8":{"text":"Vancung ah khin hung kai ning tiah, cuka ah cun na rak um ko lai, mithi khua ah khin vung it ning tiah, cuka zongah cun na rak um ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"9":{"text":"Nichuahlei ha khin lo diam in hei zuang hnik ning law, asiloah nitlaklei a hlatnak bik hmun zongah khin hei um hnik ning law,"},"10":{"text":"cuka zongah cun a ka hruaitu dingah nangmah na rak um ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai, a ka bawmtu dingah na rak um ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"11":{"text":"Muihnak kha, ka thup tuah, ka hei ti ko hnga, asiloah, ka velchum i ceunak kha, zan ah cang ka hei ti ko hnga,"},"12":{"text":"asinain cucu zeihmanh a ṭhahnem hlei hnga lo, zeicahtiah muihnak cu nang caah cun a mui lo i zan hmanh kha chun tlukin a ceu ko. Nang caah cun muihnak le ceunak cu zeihmanh an i dang lo."},"13":{"text":"Ka pum chung thil vialte hi nangmah sermi an si dih; ka nu pawchung i a ka semtertu cu nangmah na si."},"14":{"text":"Hi bantuk thil thuk le khuaruahharmi thil ruangah hin nangmah cu kan lawmh: keimah kong i khuaruahhar a simi thil le nangmah nih na tuahmi thil khuaruahhar a simi hna kong ah hin kan lawmh. Nangmah nih na ka hngalh dih cikcek ko;"},"15":{"text":"Ka pum hi nang caah cun khuaruahhar awk a si lo, zeitindah a thli tein muisam ka hun ken le ka nu pawchung ah zeitindah ka hung ṭhan ti kha nang na caah cun khuaruahhar a si lo."},"16":{"text":"Ka chuah hlan in na rak ka hmuh diam cang. Ka ca i na sermi ni hna cu na cauk chungah an rak i khumh diam cang, hram an i thawk hlan hmanh khan an i ṭial diam cang."},"17":{"text":"Maw Pathian, na ruahnak cu ka caah zeitluk in dah hngalh a har, na ruahnak cu a tam tuk ah a dongh in a dong kho lo."},"18":{"text":"Rel tim hnik hna ning law thetse nak tam an si ṭung; an dihlak in rel dih dingah cun, nangmah chan can nun a hau hnga!"},"19":{"text":"Maw Pathian, miṭhalo kha cu that ko hna, ti ka duh. Mipuarhrang pawl nih hin ka kaltak hna seh, ti ka duh hringhran ko."},"20":{"text":"Nangmah kong ah thil ṭhalo lawng an chim i na min chiatnak lawng kha an chim lengmang."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa nangmah an huatu cu ka huat ve hna, nangmah an dohtu cu zei ah ka rel ve hna lo."},"22":{"text":"Huat taktak in ka huat hna i ka ral ah ka rel hna."},"23":{"text":"Maw Pathian, ka pur cikcek law ka lungthin hi hngal ko; ka hneksak law ka ruahnak hi hmu ko."},"24":{"text":"Ka chungah hlenthawinak a um sual hnga maw? a um sual ahcun ka hmuhpiak law zungzal hmunmi lam ah khan ka hruai ko."}}},"140":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, miṭhalo hna kut chung khan ka khamh ko; mipuarhrang hna sin khan him tein ka umter ko.","title":"Huhphenhnak Ca Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak khua lawng kha an khang zungzal ko, siknak lawng kha an chuahter zungzal ko."},"3":{"text":"An lei cu rul lei bantuk a si i an bia cu rawchok sivai bantuk a si. Selah","ref":"Rom 3.13"},"4":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna kut chung khan ka huppheng law, maw Bawipa, ka tluknak ding lawng a tuaktan lengmangmi hna mipuarhrang hna sin khan him tein ka umter ko."},"5":{"text":"Miruamkai pawl nih khan rap an ka chiahhnawh, mihrokhrawl pawl nih khan sur rap cu an chiah i lam ah khan keimah foihnak dingah cun an phah. Selah"},"6":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka thawh i, “Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si,” ka ti. Bawipa, nangmah bawmhnak hal in ka aunak cu ka theihpiak ko!"},"7":{"text":"Maw Bawipa ka Pathian, nangmah cu ka khamhtu ṭhawng na si, raltuknak hmun ah na ka huhphenh."},"8":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, miṭhalo cu an duhmi thil kha hmuhter hna hlah; thil ṭhalo an khanmi kha tlinter hlah. Selah"},"9":{"text":"Ka ral kha teitu siter hna hlah, an ka tlerhnak cu anmah cung lila ah tlakter."},"10":{"text":"Meiṭil sen nih tlak hna seh law, chuak kho ti loin khor thuk chungah tla hna seh."},"11":{"text":"Lih in midang sual a puhmi cu, mi sual an puhnak hna ah khan thluachuak hna hlah seh; mipuarhrang cu ṭhat lonak nih khan tlak hna seh law hrawk hna seh."},"12":{"text":"Bawipa, nangmah nih misifak cu na ṭanpi hna i mirethei cu an hmuh awk hnga a simi kha na hmuhter hna, ti kha ka hngalh."},"13":{"text":"Miding nih cun an in thangṭhat taktak lai, na hmaika ah khan khua an sa zungzal lai."}}},"141":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, nangmah kha kan auh, khulrang in ka bawm tuah! Nangmah kan auhnak ka aw hi ka ngaihpiak ko.","title":"Zanlei Thlacamnak David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Ka thlacamnak cu zihmui bangin ka cohlanpiak law ka kut ka hlermi cu zanlei raithawinak sa bangin ka cohlanpiak ko.","ref":"Biat 5.8"},"3":{"text":"Bawipa, ka kaa ah hin ralvengtu ka chiahpiak law ka hmur ah hin cawngtu ka chiahpiak ko."},"4":{"text":"Thil ṭhalo tuah duhnak ka ngeih sual nakhnga lo le miṭhalo hna thil ṭhalo tuahnak ah kaa tel ve nakhnga lo, ka lungthin hi nangmah nih kham ko; an puai ah cun a tel in i tel hlah ning!"},"5":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun dawtnak in ka si hna seh law dan ka tat ko hna seh, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih cun ka lu ah sathau ka thuh hna hlah seh, zeicahtiah cu bantukin ka cungah an tuah ahcun, thil ṭhalo an tuahmi i aa tel vemi ah an ka ser khawh sual ai hnga."},"6":{"text":"An uktu bawi hna kha lungpang cungin hlonh an si tikah, mi nih ka bia ahmaan kha an hngalh lai."},"7":{"text":"Mi nih an tan an cheu i a pel le a pawi ah a cang dihmi thing bantukin, an ruh cu thlanka kamah khan ṭhek dih si hna seh."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa Pathian, kei nih cun kan bochan i nangmah chungah dornak kha ka kawl; ka thihter sawh hlah!"},"9":{"text":"Keimah foihnak dingah an chiahmi rap cun ka huppheng law thil ṭhalo a tuahtu hna chiahmi thang khan ka luatter ko."},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu anmah rap lila ah khan i foih hna seh, kei bel harnak zeihmanh tong loin kal ko ning."}}},"142":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawmhnak hmuhduh ah Bawipa cu ka auh i amah cu ka nawl.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam (1Sam 22.1 ; 24.3)"},"2":{"text":"Ka harnak vialte kha amah ka chimh dih i ka retheihnak vialte kha ka hngalhter."},"3":{"text":"Ka thlarau kha ka chungah a bat tikah, zeidah ka tuah awk a si kha nangmah nih na hngalh. Ka kalnak lam ah khan ka ral nih rap an ka chiahhnawh."},"4":{"text":"Ka pawngkam kha ka zoh tikah, a ka bawmtu ding ahohmanh ka hmu hna lo, a ka hupphengtu ding ahohmanh an um lo, ahohmanh ka zawn a ka ruattu an um lo."},"5":{"text":"Bawipa, bawmhnak duh ah nangmah cu kan auh, Bawipa nangmah cu a ka hupphengtu na si; ka nun chungah hin ka duhmi le ka herhmi cu nangmah lawnglawng na si ko."},"6":{"text":"Hnabei donghnak chungah khan a pil in ka pil cang caah ka bawm ko sawh, tiin kan auhnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko. Keimah nakin a let tampi in a ṭhawng deuhmi, ka ral hna kut chungin ka khamh tuah."},"7":{"text":"Na min cu ka thangṭhat khawh nakhnga thong chung hin ka chuah ko sawh. Ka hmuh awk hnga a simi laksawng kha na ka pek tikah a dingmi hna nih cun pangpar ṭhi kha an ka oih lai."}}},"143":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, ka thlacamnak cu ka theihpiak law kan nawlnak cu ka ngaihpiak ko. Nang cu na ding i zumhawktlak na si caah Ka thlacamnak cu ka let tuah.","title":"Bawmh Halnak Thlacam David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Keimah na salpa hi na hmaika i biaceihnak ah ka phakter hlah; na hmaiah hin ahohmanh a sual lomi an um lo.","ref":"Rom 3.20; Gal 2.16"},"3":{"text":"Ka ral nih a ka hrem i a ka tei cikcek. A muimi thonginn chungah a ka khumh i hlanpi ah a thi cangmi hna bantuk kha ka si."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah ka celh ti lo i ka hnabei a dong."},"5":{"text":"A liam ciami ni kha ka hun thei ṭhan hna; nangmah nih na tuahmi thil vialte kha ka hun ruat ṭhan hna i na tuahmi thil vialte kha ka hun hngal ṭhan hna."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah leiah thlacam in ka kut cu ka hler hna; vawlei car nih ti a ngaih bantuk khin ka nunnak nih nangmah cu an ngai."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa, atu ah ka let ko sawh, ruahchannak zeihmanh ka ngei ti lo! Ka thuh tak hlah, na ka thuh tak ahcun mithi khua i a vung kalmi bantuk ka si ko lai."},"8":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan bochan ko; zinglei ah a fekmi na dawtnak kha ka hngalhter ṭhan ko. Ka thlacamnak cu nangmah sinah an kai, ka kalnak ding lam cu ka hmuhsak ko."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa, huhphenhnak hmuh duh ah nangmah cu kan fuh; ka ral hna kut chung hin ka chanh ko."},"10":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka Pathian na si; cucaah na duhnak tuah kha ka cawnpiak ko. Na velngeihnak thawngin himnak lam ah ka hruai tuah."},"11":{"text":"Bia na ka kam bang khan ka khamh tuah, Maw Bawipa ; na ṭhatnak thawngin ka harnak chung khan ka chuahter ko."},"12":{"text":"Na ka dawt caah ka ral cu that hna law a ka dohtu vialte kha hrawk hna, zeicahtiah keimah cu na sal k a si."}}},"144":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa, ka lungpi cu thangṭhat si ko seh! Amah nih raltuknak kha a ka cawnpiak i ka kutdong kha raldoh a thiamter hna.","title":"Siangpahrang Nih Ral Teinak A Hmuh Caah Pathian Kha A Lawmh David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu a ka hupphengtu lungpi ka ralhruang a si, a fekmi ralvenbuk le himnak hmun a si, kaa bochanmi phaw a si. Miphun dang kha ka ke tangah amah nih a chiah hna."},"3":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, minung hi zeidah a si i a zawn na ruah? Minung fapa hi zeidah a si i biapi ah na rel?","ref":"Job 7.17-18; Slm 8.4"},"4":{"text":"Minung cu thaw bantuk men a si ko, a nun chung ni hna cu a liam zaumi thladem bantuk men an si ko."},"5":{"text":"Maw Bawipa, van kha run ṭhum hna law kan sinah rung ṭum tuah, tlang kha run tawng hna law meikhu chuah hna seh."},"6":{"text":"Nimtlau kha a kenkip ah lekter hna law na ral kha ṭhek dih hna; na thal in kap hna law zam dih hna seh!"},"7":{"text":"Cunglei khan run ka banh law a thukmi ti chung hin ka chuah tuah; ramdangmi hna ṭhawnnak chung hin ka khamh tuah;"},"8":{"text":"annih cu biatak a chim bal lomi, biatak ka chim lai tiah chiat i serh hnu hmanh ah lih a chim ṭhiamṭhiammi an si."},"9":{"text":"Maw Pathian, nangmah cu hla thar in kan thangṭhat lai, tingtang kha kaa tum lai i kan thangṭhat lai."},"10":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu teinak kha na pek hna i na sal David cu na khamh."},"11":{"text":"A puarmi ka ral hna kut chung khan ka khamh ko, ramdangmi hna ṭhawnnak chung hin ka khamh tuah, annih cu biatak a chim bal lomi, biatak ka chim lai tiah chiat i serh hnu hmanh i lih a chim ṭhiamṭhiammi an si."},"12":{"text":"Kan fapale hna cu an tlanval lioah, a ṭhawngmi thingkung bantuk si hna seh law, kan fanule hna cu bawi inn ṭamhnak tung bantuk si hna seh."},"13":{"text":"Kan rawl inn hna cu rawl a phunphun in khat hna seh, kan lo lak i a ummi tuu hna nih fa a thongthong in hring hna seh."},"14":{"text":"Kan caw nih fa tampi hring hna seh law a lotlaumi le a rawkmi pakhat hmanh um hna hlah seh. Kan khuachung lam ah lungfah ṭahnak thawng zeihmanh leng hlah seh."},"15":{"text":"Hi bantukin a ummi miphun cu aa lawmmi miphun an si; an Pathian ah Bawipa a simi hna cu, lunglawmmi an si."}}},"145":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka Pathian le ka siangpahrang, na lianhngannak cu ka thanh lai i nangmah cu a zungzal in kan lawmh lai.","title":"Khamhtu Pathian Thangṭhatnak Caah David Hla"},"2":{"text":"Nifate in kan thangṭhat lai i a zungzal in kan lawmh lai."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa cu a lian a nganmi a si, fak piin thangṭhat awk a si; a lianhngannak cu kan hngalh khawh leng a si."},"4":{"text":"Na tuah sernak cu chan khat hnu chan khat thangṭhat a si lai, thil khuaruahhar na tuahmi cu aupi an si lai."},"5":{"text":"Mi nih na sunparnak le lianngannak kha an chim lai, kei nih thil khuaruahhar na tuahmi kha ka ruat hna lai."},"6":{"text":"Mi nih thil khuaruahhar na tuahmi kha an chim hna lai, kei nih na lianhngannak kha ka thanh lai."},"7":{"text":"Annih nih na ṭhatnak kha an chim lai, na velngeihnak kha hla in an sak lai."},"8":{"text":"Bawipa cu dawtnak a ngeimi le mi zaangfah thiammi a si, thinhun a har i a fekmi dawtnak in a khatmi a si."},"9":{"text":"Aho cung paoh ah a ṭha i a sermi hna an dihlak cungah zaangfahnak a ngei."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa, na sermi thil vialte nih an in thangṭhat lai, na sermi hna nih an in lawmh lai!"},"11":{"text":"Na pennak a sunpar ning kha an chim lai i na ṭhawnnak kha an thanh lai."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah mi vialte nih thil khuaruahhar na tuahmi kha an hngalh lai i na pennak a sunpar ning le a lianhngan ning kha an hmuh lai."},"13":{"text":"Na pennak cu zungzal in a hmun lai i nangmah cu zungzal in siangpahrang na si lai. Pathian nih cun biakamnak a tuahmi kha zumhawktlak tein a zulh i a tuahmi thil paoh kha an ṭha dih."},"14":{"text":"Harnak a ingmi kha a bawmh hna i ṭhumhnak a tongmi kha a cawi hna."},"15":{"text":"Ruahchannak he na sermi thil nung vialte nih an in zoh i an herhmi rawl kha an herh caan te ah a pek hna."},"16":{"text":"Na kut na samh i an dihlak in an herhmi kha tling tein an hmuh."},"17":{"text":"Bawipa cu thil a tuahnak paoh ah hin ding tein a tuahmi a si, rian a ṭuannak paoh ah hin zaangfahnak a ngeimi a si."},"18":{"text":"A autu vialte hna cu an pawng khin an umhnawh hna, lungtak in a autu vialte hna cu."},"19":{"text":"Amah a ṭihmi paoh cu an herhmi vialte kha a pek hna i an aunak kha a theih i a khamh hna."},"20":{"text":"Amah a dawtu cu an dihlak in a huhphenh hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu a hrawh dih hna lai."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa cu ka thangṭhat lai, thilnung vialte nih a min thiang cu zungzal in thangṭhat hna seh!"}}},"146":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Maw ka nunnak, Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko!","title":"Khamhtu Pathian Thangṭhatnak Caah"},"2":{"text":"Ka nun chung vialte amah cu ka thangṭhat lai; nunnak ka ngeih chung paohpaoh ka Pathian cu hla in ka thangṭhat lai."},"3":{"text":"Bawi kha i bochan hna hlah u, nanmah an khamh kho ṭung hna lomi kha i bochan hna hlah u."},"4":{"text":"An thih tikah leidip ah an kir ko; cu ni ah cun an khuakhannak vialte cu an dong fawn ko."},"5":{"text":"Jakob Pathian kha bawmtu ah aa serhmi cu mi lunglawm an si, Bawipa a Pathian kha aa hngatchanmi cu mi lunglawm an si;"},"6":{"text":"amah nih cun van le vawlei le rili le an chung i a ummi thil vialte kha a ser hna.","ref":"Lam 4.24; 14.15"},"7":{"text":"A biakam kha a tlolh bal lo; hremmi hna ṭanh in bia kha a ceih i rawl a ṭammi kha rawl a pek hna. Bawipa nih thongtla kha a luatter hna i"},"8":{"text":"mitcaw kha khua hmuhnak a pek hna. Ṭhumhnak a ingmi kha a cawi hna i a dingmi a mi kha a dawt hna."},"9":{"text":"Hi ram chungah a ummi ramdangmi kha a huhphenh hna; nuhmei le ngakṭah kha a bawmh hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo pawl khuakhannak cu a hrawh."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa cu zungzal in siangpahrang a si ko lai! Zion, na Pathian cu zungzal in uktu a si lai. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"147":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Kan Pathian cu hla in thangṭhat hi a ṭha; amah thangṭhat hi a nuam i ahmaan.","title":"Lianngan Bik Pathian Thangṭhatnak Caah"},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih Jerusalem cu a remh ṭhan lai, saltang mi kha a kirpi ṭhan hna lai."},"3":{"text":"Lungkuai mi kha a damter hna i an hma kha a menpiak hna."},"4":{"text":"Arfi kha a rel dih hna i an dihlak in min a bunh hna."},"5":{"text":"Kan Bawipa cu a lian a ngan i ṭhawnnak in a tling, thil a hngalhning hi tah khawh a si lo."},"6":{"text":"Mi toi i aa dormi cu a cawi hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu vawlei ah a rial hna."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa cu hla in thangṭhat tuah u, kan Pathian cu tingtang aw dawh in thangṭhat u."},"8":{"text":"Van ah khin minmei a zamter; vawlei kha ruah in a cawm i tlang cungah ram a khohter hna."},"9":{"text":"Saram kha rawl a pek hna i lang-ak no nih an awnh tikah rawl a pek hna."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa nih rangtum ṭhawngṭhawng hi biapi ah a ruahmi an si lo, ralkap ralṭhami hi a lawmhmi an si fawn lo;"},"11":{"text":"asinain a lung a tongmi cu amah a ṭihmi le a fekmi a dawtnak aa bochanmi kha an si."},"12":{"text":"Jerusalem, Bawipa cu thangṭhat tuah! Zion, na Pathian cu thangṭhat tuah!"},"13":{"text":"Amah nih na kutka kha a fehter hna, na mi kha thluachuahnak a pek hna."},"14":{"text":"Na ramri kha him tein a umter hna i changvut ṭha bikbik in na paw an khimter."},"15":{"text":"Vawlei ah a nawlbia kha a thlah i khulrang in a ra phan."},"16":{"text":"Sahmul tluk chah in hawhra kha a tlakter i leidip bangin dappar kha a ṭhek."},"17":{"text":"Rial cu lung tekem bangin a tlakter; kihnak a run thlahmi cu ahohmanh nih an celh lo."},"18":{"text":"Cun nawlbia kha a vun chuah i hawhra cu a ti; thli kha a hranter i ti cu a luang."},"19":{"text":"Jakob cu a bia kha a chimh, Israel cu a nawlbia le a phunglam kha a pek."},"20":{"text":"Miphun dang hna caah cun mah hihi a tuah hna lo, a phunglam kha an hngal hna lo. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"148":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Cung sangpi i a ummi hna, Bawipa cu vancung khin run thangṭhat u!","title":"Van le Vawlei Hna Pathian Thangṭhat U"},"2":{"text":"A vancungmi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u, a vancung ralkap vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat tuah u!"},"3":{"text":"Ni le thla hna, amah cu thangṭhat u! A ceumi arfi hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!"},"4":{"text":"Van sang bik hna, amah cu thangṭhat u, vancung i a ummi ti hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!"},"5":{"text":"An dihlak in Bawipa min cu thangṭhat hna seh! Bia a chim i annih cu ser an si;"},"6":{"text":"amah nawl pekmi thawngin annih cu an umnak hmun cio ah khan zungzal in an um i a nawl ngai loin an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Rili chung thil ṭihnung hna le rilipi thuk hna, Bawipa cu vawlei ah hin thangṭhat u!"},"8":{"text":"Nimtlau le rial, hawhra le khuadawm, a nawl a ngaimi thlichia, nannih nih Bawipa cu thangṭhat ko u!"},"9":{"text":"Fing le tlang hna, thingthei kung le tupi hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!"},"10":{"text":"Saram vialte hna, inn zuat saṭil le ramlak saram hna, a paw in a lawnmi le vate vialte hna, nan dihlak in amah cu thangṭhat u."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang vialte le mi vialte hna, uktu le bawi vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!"},"12":{"text":"Tlangval le ngaknu hna, tar le no le ngakchia vialte hna, amah cu thangṭhat u!"},"13":{"text":"An dihlak in Bawipa min cu thangṭhat hna seh! A min cu min dang vialte nakin a ngan deuh; a sunparnak nih van le vawlei a lonh hna."},"14":{"text":"A miphun kha miphun ṭhawng ah a ser hna, cucaah a mi vialte nih an thangṭhat, a dawt ngaingaimi Israel mi nih khan an thangṭhat. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"149":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Bawipa cu hla thar in thangṭhat u; a mithiang an i pumhnak ah amah cu thangṭhat u.","title":"Thangṭhatnak Hla"},"2":{"text":"Israel, nangmah an sertu ruangah cun i lawm tuah, Zion mi hna, nan siangpahrang ruangah cun i lawm tuah u!"},"3":{"text":"Nan lamnak ah khan a min cu thangṭhat u, amah cu khuang le tingtang in thangṭhat u."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi cu a zaangfah hna i santlai lomi kha teinak a pek hna."},"5":{"text":"An teinak ah cun Pathian mi cu i lawm hna seh law rawl danghnak an tuahmi ah cun lunglawm in hla sa hna seh."},"6":{"text":"Vainam a harmi i put in Pathian an thangṭhatnak ah cun a au in au hna seh."},"7":{"text":"Cu vainam cun miphun dang kha tei hna seh law lawkihmi kha dantat hna seh;"},"8":{"text":"an siangpahrang hna kha khit hna seh law thir cikcin in hreng hna seh;"},"9":{"text":"Pathian nawlbia bangin miphun dang cu dantat hna seh. Pathian mi nih an hmuhmi teinak cu hihi a si. Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}},"150":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Pathian cu a biakinn chungah khan thangṭhat u; a ṭhawnnak cu vancung ah khin thangṭhat u!","title":"Cu Thangṭhat U"},"2":{"text":"Thil lianngan a tuahmi ruangah amah cu thangṭhat u! A sang bik a lianhngannak cu thangṭhat u!"},"3":{"text":"Muko in thangṭhat u! Tingtang le thonglawi in thangṭhat u!"},"4":{"text":"Khuang le lam in thangṭhat u, tingtang le thonglawi in thangṭhat u!"},"5":{"text":"Sumsel in thangṭhat u! A aw a thangmi sumsel in thangṭhat u!"},"6":{"text":"Thilnung vialte hna, Bawipa cu thangṭhat u! Bawipa cu thangṭhat u!"}}}}},"20":{"info":{"name":"Phungthlukbia","shortname":"Prov","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David fapa Solomon, Israel siangpahrang phungthlukbia:","title":"Phungthlukbia Ṭhathnemnak","ref":"1Sia 4.32"},"2":{"text":"Hi phungthlukbia thawng hin Mi nih fimnak le cawnpiaknak kha an hngalh lai i Ruahnak thuk bia kha an hngalhthiam lai i"},"3":{"text":"Umtuzia thiamnak le dinnak le biading ca le i ruannak ding ca i cawnpiaknak kha an hmuh lai."},"4":{"text":"Lungtlawm mi nih fimnak an hmuh lai i Seino mi nih hngalhnak le ruahthiamnak an hmuh lai."},"5":{"text":"Cun mifim zong nih an ngaih ahcun an fimnak a ṭhang lai i Hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi nih thiamnak an hmuh chin lai i"},"6":{"text":"Phungthluk bia hna le tahchunhnak bia hna le Mifim mi hna an bia le an biahar kha an hngalh khawh hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Bawipa ṭih hi hngalhnak hramthawknak a si; Sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun fimnak le cawnpiaknak kha zei ah an rel lo.","title":"Seino Lungthin Cheuh","ref":"Job 28.28; Slm 111.10; Phut 9.10"},"8":{"text":"Ka fapa, na pa cawnpiaknak cu ngai law Na nu ṭhithruainak cu hlaw hlah."},"9":{"text":"Zeicahtiah na lu caah aa dawhmi pangpar ṭhi rual an si lai i Na hngawng caah pumṭek ṭhi an si lai."},"10":{"text":"Ka fapa, misual mi nih an in lem ahcun, na hna tlakpi hna hlah."},"11":{"text":"Annih nih an in thawh i, “Kan sinah ra ve, thisen chuah awkah bawh hna u sih, A sual lomi cu thlachiat ruat loin lamhruang ah hna u sih;"},"12":{"text":"Sheol bantukin an nung na bu in dolh hna u sih; Sualnak an ngei lo nain khor chung i a vung kalmi hna bantuk khi si hna seh."},"13":{"text":"Thil man sung vialte cu kan lak dih hna lai i Kan inn cu hranchaw in kan khahter hna lai;"},"14":{"text":"Kan sinah i tel ve ko, Tangka bawm kan i hrawm lai,” an in ti tikah,"},"15":{"text":"Ka fapa, an sinah cun kal ve hlah, An lam kha zul hlah;"},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah an ke cu ṭhat lonak leiah a tlik in an tli i Thisen chuah awkah a nam in an i nam."},"17":{"text":"Vate hmuhhngan i chiahmi rap cu pakpalawng a si tawn."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi mi hna nih an bawhmi cu anmah thisen lila kha a si i Lamhruang an ahmi cu anmah nunnak lila kha a si ko."},"19":{"text":"Zaang-ennak in miaknak hmuh a duhmi hna lam cu hi bantuk hi a si. Hakkauhnak nih an nunnak kha a hloh tawn."},"20":{"text":"Khuachung lam ah khan fimnak cu a au, Chawdawrnak hmun ah khan a au;","title":"Fimnak Nih Sawmnak","ref":"Phut 8.1-3"},"21":{"text":"Kulhnak vampang cung khan a au i Khua chung luhnak kutka hna ah khan bia a chim:"},"22":{"text":"“Zei can dah maw mihrut rual hna, hruh kha nan duh rih ko lai? Zei can dah, mi nihsawh hmangmi hna, mi nihsawh kha a nuam nan ti lai i mihrut nih fimnak kha nan huat lai?"},"23":{"text":"Kan chimhhrin hnanak kha nan ngaih ahcun ruahnak kha kan cheuh hna lai i Ka bia kha kan cawnpiak hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kan kawh hna i ngaih nan duh lo, Ka kut kha ka samh i ahohmanh nih zei ah nan rel lo."},"25":{"text":"Fim kan chimhmi hna vialte kha nan hnon i Kan chimhhrin hnanak vialte cu zeihmanh nan duh lo caah,"},"26":{"text":"Kei zong nih vanchiatnak nan ton ni ah le Launak nih an den hna tikah kan nihsawh men ve hna lai."},"27":{"text":"Launak nih thlichia bangin an den hna tik le Nan vanchiatnak cu phuchim bangin a rat i Harnak le vansang aunak nih an tlunhnawh hna tikah, a nih in kan nih men ko hna lai."},"28":{"text":"Khi tikah cun an ka auh lai, sihmanhsehlaw ka let hna lai lo; An ka kawl len lai, sihmanhsehlaw an ka hmu lai lo."},"29":{"text":"Annih nih hngalhnak kha an huat i Bawipa ṭihnak kha an i thim lo caah"},"30":{"text":"Lungthin ka cheuhmi hna kha pakhat hmanh an cohlang duh lo i Ka chimhhrin hnanak cu zeihmanh ah an rel lo."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah annih nih an ziaza theitlai cu an ei lai i Anmah khuakhannak lila nih cun a nor cikcek hna lai."},"32":{"text":"Zeicahtiah lungtlawm pawl cu anmah pialnak nih khan a thah hna i Mihrut hna cu zei ruat khak loin an umnak nih khan a hrawh hna,"},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka bia a ngaimi cu him tein an um lai i Vanchiatnak zeihmanh ṭih loin, zalong tein an um lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa ka bia kha naa lak hna i ka nawlbia kha na lung chungah naa khon hna i","title":"Fimnak Kawl Man"},"2":{"text":"Fimnak leiah na hna na chit i hngalhthiamnak leiah na lungthin na pek ahcun,"},"3":{"text":"Ahmaan le hmaanlo thleidan khawhnak lungthin kha na auh i hngalhthiamnak kha na kawh ahcun,"},"4":{"text":"Ngun bantukin na kawl i thuhmi ro bantukin na kawl ahcun,"},"5":{"text":"khi tikah Bawipa ṭihnak cu na hngalh lai i Pathian hngalhnak cu na hmuh lai."},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Bawipa nih cun fimnak kha a pek hna i hngalhnak le hngalhthiamnak kha a cawnpiak hna."},"7":{"text":"Miding mi hna caah fimnak ṭha kha a khon i ding tein a kalmi hna caah amah cu phaw a si i"},"8":{"text":"Biading lam kha a ven i a mithiang mi hna lam kha a congh."},"9":{"text":"Khi tikah dinnak le biading cu na hngalh lai i miṭha mi hna lam kha na zulh lai;"},"10":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fimnak cu na lung chungah a lut lai i na lungthin caah hngalhnak cu a nuammi a si lai."},"11":{"text":"Fimnak nih an ven lai, hngalhthiamnak nih an zohkhenh lai;"},"12":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna lam chung khan an khamh lai i holh ṭhalo hmangmi hna sin khan an luatter lai."},"13":{"text":"Annih cu muihnak lam zulh awkah dinnak lam a hlawt i"},"14":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak tuah ah aa lawm i hlenthawinak ah cun aa nuammi an si;"},"15":{"text":"Annih lam cu a kawi i an thil tining ah midepde an si."},"16":{"text":"Nu zuangzam sinin an khamh lai i nu ralṭha, bia thlumthlum a hmang i"},"17":{"text":"A no lio caan a hawikom kha a hlawt i a Pathian biakamnak a philhmi sin khan an khamh lai."},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a lam cu thihnak leiah a vung kal i mithi mi hna ram leiah khan a vung lan."},"19":{"text":"A sin i a va kalmi paoh cu ahohmanh an kir ti lo, nunnak lam zong an hmu ṭhan ti lo."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah miṭha mi hna lam cu zul law miding mi hna lam cu i tlaih tuah."},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah miding mi hna cu hi ram chungah hin khua an sa kho lai i ding tein khua a sami hna cu hi ram chungah hin an um lai."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna cu ram chung khan hlonh an si lai i mi rawi hmangmi hna cu ram chung cun phawi an si lai."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, kan cawnpiaknak cu philh hlah, Sihmanhsehlaw na lung nih ka nawlbia cu i cinken ko hna seh;","title":"Nawlngaih Forhnak"},"2":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nun saunak le chan saunak le duhdim nunnuamhnak cu an in pek lai."},"3":{"text":"Felnak le zumh awk tlakmi sinak kha i chuahtakter hna hlah, Na hngawng ah i ngerh hna law na lung tlap cungah i ṭial hna."},"4":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian le minung mithmuh ah Mithmai ṭha le thangṭhatnak na hmuh lai.","ref":"Luk 2.52"},"5":{"text":"Bawipa kha na lung chung dihlak in i bochan law Nangmah fimnak kha i rinh hlah."},"6":{"text":"Na kalnak lam kip ah amah kha hngal law Amah nih na lam kha a tluanter hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Mah mithmuh i a fimmi va si hlah; Bawipa kha ṭih law ṭhat lonak kha mertak ko.","ref":"Rom 12.16"},"8":{"text":"Na taksa caah damnak a si lai i na ruh caah si a si lai."},"9":{"text":"Bawipa cu na chawva le na thilri theitlai hmasa bik hna in upat tuah;"},"10":{"text":"Cun na rawl inn cu khat thluahmah in an um lai i Na mitsur nennak khor cu mitsur hang in an liam lai."},"11":{"text":"Ka fapa, Bawipa chimhhrinnak cu zei rel loin um hin hlah. An mawhchiatnak nih cun in nor hlah seh,","ref":"Job 5.17; Heb 12.5-6"},"12":{"text":"Zeicahtiah pa nih a duhmi a fapa cu a chimhhrin bangin Bawipa nih a dawtmi kha a chimhhrin ve hna.","ref":"Biat 3.19"},"13":{"text":"Fimnak a hmumi cu a lung aa lawm, hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi zong aa lawm ve;"},"14":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fimnak cu ngun nakin a ṭha deuh i miaknak a chuahpimi cu sui nakin a ṭha deuh."},"15":{"text":"Fimnak cu rubi lungvar man sungmi nakin a sung deuh, na hlawn vialte ah amah tluk zeihmanh an um lo."},"16":{"text":"Nun saunak cu a orhlei kut chungah a um i a kehlei kut ah rumnak le upatnak an um."},"17":{"text":"A lam cu lam nuam an si i rumnak phakpitu lam an si."},"18":{"text":"Amah aa tlaihmi hna caah cun nunnak thingkung a si i amah kha fek tein aa tlaihmi cu him tein an um."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih fimnak in vawlei kha a rak dirh; hngalhthiamnak in van kha a hmunhter hna;"},"20":{"text":"A thiamnak thawngin ti thuk hna cu an i sat i khuadawm nih dap kha a thlak hna."},"21":{"text":"Ka fapa, fimnak ṭha le ruahthiamnak cu i ken hna, na mit hmuhnak chungin liamter hna hlah;"},"22":{"text":"Annih cu na thlarau caah nunnak an si lai i na hngawng caah ṭamhnak an si lai."},"23":{"text":"Khi tikah himbawm tein na kal lai i na ke cu an i chuihpah lai lo;"},"24":{"text":"Na ṭhut ah na thin a phang lai lo, na ih tikah na mitkuh a thaw lai."},"25":{"text":"Mihrut mi hna cung i a tlungmi launak ruangah khan na thin va phang hlah; miṭhalo cung i a tlungmi rawhralnak ruang zongah khan na thin va phang hlah;"},"26":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Bawipa cu na hnangamnak a si lai i na ke cu aa awh nakhnga lo amah nih an zohkhenh lai."},"27":{"text":"Nangmah kut chungah ṭhatnak tuah khawhnak kha a um tikah, a hmu hnga ding a simi sinin ṭhatnak kha va kham hlah."},"28":{"text":"Nangmah sinah naa chiah ko nain, “Va kal law ra ṭhan te, thaizing ah kan pek lai,” tiah na hawi kha ti hna hlah."},"29":{"text":"Nangmah kha bochan in na pawngah khua a sa khirkhiarmi na innpa caah ṭhat lonak khua va khang hlah."},"30":{"text":"Na cungah ṭhat lonak zeihmanh a tuah lo ahcun, zei ruang lo ah aho he hmanh vaa si len hlah."},"31":{"text":"Zaang en hmangmi cu va hngar hna hlah, a lam zong kha zeihmanh vaa thim hlah;"},"32":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mi lungthin ṭhalo cu Bawipa caah fihnung an si i miding mi cu Pathian nih a zumhmi an si."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa chiatserhnak cu miṭhalo mi hna inn cungah a tlung i sihmanhsehlaw miding mi hna umnak cu thluachuahnak a pek."},"34":{"text":"Mi zei ah a rel lomi hna cu zei ah a rel ve hna lo i mi toiah aa dormi hna cu duhdawtnak a pek hna.","ref":"Jei 4.6; 1Pet 5.5"},"35":{"text":"Mifim mi nih upatnak cu an co lai, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut mi nih zohchuknak kha an hmuh lai."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Maw ka fapale hna, nan pa cawnpiaknak hi ngai u law, hngalhnak nan ngeih khawh nakhnga ṭha tein ngai tuah u;","title":"Fimnak Ṭhathnemnak"},"2":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nunchimhnak kan pekmi hna cu a ṭhami nunchimhnak an si i Kan cawnpiaknak hna hi hlaw hlah u."},"3":{"text":"Ka pa caah ngakchia ka rak si i ka nu caah fapa dawt, a nomi ka rak si tikah khan,"},"4":{"text":"Ka pa nih cun a ka cawnpiak i, “Ka bia hi na lung in fek tein i tlaih hna, ka nawlbia hi zul hna law nung tuah;"},"5":{"text":"Ka chimmi bia hi philh hna hlah law i theihter duh loin um hna hlah."},"6":{"text":"A hmasa bik ah a herhmi cu fimnak hmuh hi a si; hngalhthiamnak kha na ngeihmi vialte na hloh dih ding a si zongah i cawk."},"7":{"text":"Fimnak cu hlaw hlah, amah nih cun him tein an zohkhenh lai; amah cu daw law an huhphenh lai;"},"8":{"text":"Na lung chungah i chiah law sangpi ah an cawi lai, i pom law upatnak an phakter lai."},"9":{"text":"Aa dawhmi pangpar rual na lu cungah a chiah lai i nangmah cu sunparnak luchin an pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka bia cu ngai law pom hna, na nunkhua a sau lai."},"11":{"text":"Fimnak lam kha kan cawnpiak lai i dinnak lam ah khan kan hruai lai."},"12":{"text":"Na kal tikah na ril lai lo i na tlik zongah zeihmanh nih an tlukter lai lo."},"13":{"text":"Cawnpiaknak kha i tlaih peng law thlah hlah; Cucu zul peng tuah, na nunnak a si."},"14":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna lam ah cun lut hlah, miṭhalo hna lam cu zul hlah;"},"15":{"text":"Hrial law a cungah cun kal hlah, pialtak law kaltak ko."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah annih cu thil sual pakhat tal an tuah lo ahcun an it kho lo i mi pakhat tal an tlukrilhter hna lo ahcun an i hngilh kho lo."},"17":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak changreu kha an ei i zaang-ennak zu kha an din."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miding mi hna lam cu zingka ceunak, chun laicer tiangin a ceu chin lengmangmi bantuk a si."},"19":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna lam cu zan muihnak bantuk a si, Zei cungah dah kan tluk i kan rilh ti kha an hngal lo."},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa ka bia cu ngai hna law ka chimmi cu na hna chi tuah hna."},"21":{"text":"Na lung chungah i chiah hna law lohter hna hlah."},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah aa hmuhmi caah cun nunnak an si i a pum dihlak damnak an si."},"23":{"text":"Na lung kha ṭha tein veng tuah, Zeicahtiah cuka cun nunnak cerhti kha a put."},"24":{"text":"Hrokhrawl bia cu na kaa chungin chuahter hna hlah law Depdetnak bia cu hlaw diam ko hna."},"25":{"text":"Na mit nih ding tein hmailei kha zoh ko hna seh, Na hmai i a ummi thil cu fek tein i zohchih ko."},"26":{"text":"Na ke nih a lamhmi lam kha ṭha tein zoh law cuticun him tein na kal kho lai.","ref":"Heb 12.13"},"27":{"text":"Orhlei ah siseh, kehlei ah siseh, pial hlah; Ṭhat lonak vialte kha hrial dih hna."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka fimnak kha ṭha tein i ngaih law lungthin kan cheuhmi kha ṭha tein na hna chi tuah;"},"2":{"text":"Ruahthiamnak kha na ngei kho lai i na chimmi cu hngalhnak in chimmi a si lai."},"3":{"text":"Nu zuangzam hmur in khuaihliti dor an tla i a biachimmi cu chiti nakin a nal deuh."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak ah cun anfangkha bantukin a kha i kap hnih har nam bantukin a har."},"5":{"text":"A ke cu thihnak ah an vung kal i a kehlan cu Sheol lei lam kha an zul;"},"6":{"text":"Nunnak lei lam kha zei ah a rel lo; a lam cu a kenkip ah an vak i cucu a hngal lo."},"7":{"text":"Atu cu, ka fapa, ka bia kha ngai law ka kaa chung chuak bia hi zeirel lo in um hna hlah."},"8":{"text":"Nu zuangzam kha lamhlat piin hrial law a inn innka pawngah va kal hlah."},"9":{"text":"Hmaizahnak na hmuhmi kha midang mithmuh ah na thlau sual lai i zaangfahnak ngei lomi hna sinah na upatnak kha na hloh sual lai;"},"10":{"text":"Ramdangmi kha na ṭhawnnak in an khim sual lai i na rianṭuanmi man cu na hngalh lomi miding innchungkhar sinah a kal sual lai;"},"11":{"text":"A donghnak ah cun rawlṭam in na um lai i na ruh lawngin khua na sa lai."},"12":{"text":"Khi tikah naa thawh lai i, “Zeicahdah chimhhrinnak kha ka rak huat i mawhchiatnak kha ka lung nih a rak duh hnga lo."},"13":{"text":"Ka sayate aw kha ka rak ngai lo i a ka cawnpiaktu hna an bia kha zei ah ka rak rel hna lo."},"14":{"text":"Aa pummi mibu chungah khan, minchiatnak ka rak hmu ciaomau ko lo mei?” na ti lai."},"15":{"text":"Nangmah tikuang ti te ding law na tikhor chungin a luangmi ti te kha ding tuah."},"16":{"text":"Na tiput hna cu a kenkip ah ṭhekter hna hlah law khualak lam ah tiva cu i ṭhek hna hla seh."},"17":{"text":"Annih cu nangmah ca lawngah si ko hna seh, na sin i a ummi khual hna caah cun si chih hna hlah seh."},"18":{"text":"Na tikhor cu thluachuahnak hmu seh law na tlanval lio i na nupi ah khan i lawm ko;"},"19":{"text":"Amah cu sazuk duhnung ngai le aa dawhmi sakhi bantuk a si; a hnuk nih cun zeitik paoh ah na lung in riamhter seh law a dawtnak nih cun in lawmhter zungzal ko seh."},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa, zeicahdah mi zuangzam cu na duh i nu ralṭha cu na pom?"},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mi nih a zulhmi a lam vialte cu Bawipa nih a hmuh dih ko i Bawipa nih cun a lam vialte cu a zoh dih ko."},"22":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu amah ṭhat lonak ah aa foih i a sual rianṭuannak ah khan a tang."},"23":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak a um lo caah a thi i a hruhnak a ngan caah a tlau."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, na innpa caah biahrennak i na can i Khualpa caah aamahkhannak na tuahpiak i","title":"Thathut le Lihchim A Ṭhat Lonak"},"2":{"text":"aa bia chimmi ah naa foih i na kaa in a chuakmi bia ah na tan ahcun,"},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah, ka fapa, nangmah cu na innpa kut chungah na tlak cang caah Mah hihi tuah law i khamh tuah: Khulrang in va kal law mipa cu va nawl hranhram ko."},"4":{"text":"Na mit cu ihter hlah, na mit cuar zong cu hngilhter hlah;"},"5":{"text":"Sakap kut chungin sazuk a luat bantuk le mihriam kut chungin vate a luat bantukin nangmah kha i khamh tuah."},"6":{"text":"Maw zaangthupa, hngerhte sinah khin va kal tuah; an umtuzia khi va ruat hna law fimnak i lak tuah."},"7":{"text":"Bawi le upa le uktu zeihmanh an ngei lo nain,"},"8":{"text":"Ṭhal caan ah an rawl kha a timh hna i rawl ṭuan caan i an i cawmnak ding kha an pumh an khawmh hna."},"9":{"text":"Maw zaangthupa, zei can dah na ih ko lai? zeitik ah dah na ihnak in na thawh lai?"},"10":{"text":"Tlawm tein it ko rih ning, tlawm tein i hngilh ko rih ning, ka kut cu i dinh awkah tlawm tein i sih ko rih ning, na ti lengmang caah.","ref":"Phut 24.33-34"},"11":{"text":"Pamnak nih mifir bantukin an tlunhnawh lai i herhbaunak nih hriamnam aa putmipa bantukin an chuahhnawh lai."},"12":{"text":"Hrokhrawl bia he aa chawkmi cu mizeiruaramlo, miṭhalo an si;"},"13":{"text":"An mit kha an ṭheh depmap i an ke in bia an chim i an kutdong in an sawh i"},"14":{"text":"An lungthin a kawi caah ṭhat lonak khua kha an khan lengmang i rem lonak thlaici kha an tuh thluangthluan;"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah chikkhatte ah ṭhat lonak nih a tlunhnawh hna lai i damter khawh ti loin an rawk lai."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa nih a huatmi thil paruk a um, A fihmi thil pasarih an um:"},"17":{"text":"Porhlawtnak mit, lihchim hmangmi lei, a sual lomi thisen chuahtu kut,"},"18":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak khua a khangtu lungthin, ṭhat lonak lei i khulrang in a tlimi ke,"},"19":{"text":"Lih a chim lengmangmi tehte le U le nau karlak i rem lonak thlaici a tuhtu."},"20":{"text":"Ka fapa, na pa nawlbia kha zul hna law na nu cawnpiaknak kha hlaw hna hlah:","title":"Mah Ta A Si Lomi Sin Ṭhat Lonak"},"21":{"text":"Na lung ah i hren chih zungzal hna law na hngawng ah i khih hna."},"22":{"text":"Na kal tikah an in hruai lai, na ih tikah an in ven lai, naa hlauh tikah bia an in ruah lai."},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nawlbia cu meiinn a si i cawnpiaknak cu ceunak a si,"},"24":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak cu nu ṭhalo sinin na him nakhnga ding caah le nu ralṭha lei nal sinin khamh na si nakhnga ding caah a si."},"25":{"text":"Aa dawhnak cu na lung chungin duh hlah, a mithmul nih nangmah cu in hreng hlah seh;"},"26":{"text":"Zeicahtiah hlawhhlangnu cu changreu hlum khat in hlan khawh a si ko, sihmanhsehlaw a va cungin pa aa duhmi nih cun mipa nunnak hrimhrim kha tlaih aa tim."},"27":{"text":"Mi nih a puan kang loin a ṭang ah meiṭil kha a pom kho maw?"},"28":{"text":"Asiloah a linmi meiṭil cungah a ke duah loin aho tal a kal khomi an um maw?"},"29":{"text":"Cu bantuk cu a innpa nupi sin i a va kalmi cu a si; Ahohmanh amah a tawngtu cu dantat loin an luat lai lo."},"30":{"text":"Mifir nih a rawl a ṭam tikah a rawl ṭamnak damter awkah thil a fir ahcun, Mi nih an nihsawh ṭhiamṭhiam lo mei?"},"31":{"text":"Cun amah cu tlaih a si ahcun a let sarih in a liam lai; A innchung i a ngeihmi thil vialte cu a pek dih lai."},"32":{"text":"Mi nupi he a sualmi cu ruahnak ngei lomi a si; Cu a tuahtu cu amah le amah aa hrawk ko."},"33":{"text":"Hma le minchiatnak kha a hmuh lai i a thangchiatnak kha a lo lai lo."},"34":{"text":"Zeicahtiah lunghrinnak nih hin mi cu an thin a phawh hna i Teirul an i cham tik ciammam ah cun zeihmanh an i ngan hna lo."},"35":{"text":"Chamnak cu an i cohlanpiak duh lai lo i Laksawng tampi i pek hmanh ah an thin a dam hlei lai lo."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka bia cu i ken hna law ka nawlbia cu na sinah i chiah hna;","title":"Hlawhhlangnu Milem Thiamnak"},"2":{"text":"Ka nawlbia cu i ken hna law na nung lai, kan cawnpiaknak cu na mit falai bangin i ken hna;"},"3":{"text":"Na kutdong ah i khih hna law na lung tlap ah i ṭial hna."},"4":{"text":"Fimnak cu, “Ka far na si,” tiah ti law, hngalhnak cu, “Ka hawikom ṭha na si,” tiah ti tuah;"},"5":{"text":"Amah nih cun nu zuangzam sin khan an khamh lai i nu ralṭha, a bia a nal ngaimi sin khan an khamh lai."},"6":{"text":"Ka inn i thlalangawng khan ka hei zoh i"},"7":{"text":"Seino lungmawng rual hna lakah khan, ruahnak a ngei lomi tlangval pakhat kha ka hmuh;"},"8":{"text":"Zanlei sang, mui chupchap, zan caan le muih caan ah cun, Hlawhhlangnu umnak lei zalam ah cun a kal i an inn lei lam cu a hei tlai.","merge":"9"},"10":{"text":"Cun zohhmanh, minu pakhat nih a rak don; Cu nu cu hlawhhlangnu thuam in aa thuam i hmaikhuh puan kha aa khuh."},"11":{"text":"Inn tang loin chawh lengmang a duhmi nu a si, Lamṭe kip khan mi kha a bawh hna."},"12":{"text":"Atute ah khan zalam ah a um, atute ah khan chawdawrnak hmun ah a um."},"13":{"text":"Tlangvalpate cu a tlaih i a hnamh i ningzah hngal loin amah cu,"},"14":{"text":"“Raithawinak pekchanh awk ka ngei i nihin ah hin ka biahrennak ka tlinter cang lai;"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah ton awkah le nangmah cu hngahhlang ngaiin kawl awkah ka ra chuak i atu cu kan hmuh cang."},"16":{"text":"Ka ihkhun ah ihphah dawh ngai ka phah i Izipt ram la hmangṭhia in ṭamhmi ihphah khuh dawh ngaiin ka khuh;"},"17":{"text":"Ka ihkhun cu mura le aloes le nakzik zihmui in ka thuh cang hna."},"18":{"text":"Ra law zinglei tiang cim tein dawtnak ah cun i phum u sih; dawtnak in i nuam u sih."},"19":{"text":"Zeicahtiah ka va cu inn ah a um lo, lamhlapi ah khual a tlawng."},"20":{"text":"Tangka zal khat in aa phorh i thlapa a lai tik ceo ah khin inn ah cun a tlung te lai,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Lemsoinak bia tam piin a lem i a biathlum in a hnek khawh."},"22":{"text":"Mihrut bantukin a zulh i cawtum thahnak hmun i a kalmi bantuk khi a si."},"23":{"text":"Nengpi, rap ah aa foihmi bantuk, vate rap coktarh a vun zuanhnawhmi bantuk, a si; ka nunnak a ka hlotu a si lai, ti kha a hngal lo."},"24":{"text":"Atu cu, maw ka fapale hna, ka bia ngai tuah u, ka ka chungin a chuakmi bia kha ṭha tein ngai tuah hna u."},"25":{"text":"Minu lam lei kha nan lung nih hoih hlah seh, A lam chungah khan va tlau sual hlah u;"},"26":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mi tampi a tlakter hna i a thahmi cu tampi an si."},"27":{"text":"A inn cu Sheol i vung kalnak lam, thihnak khan chung i a vung lutmi a si."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fimnak cu a au i hngalhthiamnak nih a kui kha ngai tuah.","title":"Fimnak Cu A Ṭha I Zungzal In A Hmun","ref":"Phut 1.20-21"},"2":{"text":"Lam pawng hmun sang ah khan, lam tonnak ah khan a dir;"},"3":{"text":"Khua hauka kutka pawngah, luhnak kutka ah khan a au i,"},"4":{"text":"“Maw mi hna, nanmah cu kan auhmi hna nan si, mi vialte, nan dihlak in kan nawlmi hna cu nan si:"},"5":{"text":"Maw mihrut rual hna, fimnak cawng tuah u; maw lungtlawmmi hna, ṭha tein ngai tuah u."},"6":{"text":"Ngaihmanh u, thil ṭha kha ka chim lai, ka hmur in ahmaanmi bia kha a chuak lai;"},"7":{"text":"Ka kaa nih biatak a chim lai, holh ṭha lo hi ka hmur caah fihnung a si."},"8":{"text":"Ka kaa chungin a chuakmi bia vialte cu a dingmi bia an si dih; bia cikngerh le hrokhrawl bia pakhat hmanh an um lo."},"9":{"text":"A hngalthiammi caah cun biading an si dih i hngalhnak a ngeimi caah cun ahmaanmi bia an si."},"10":{"text":"Keimah cawnpiaknak cu ngun nakin i lak deuh u, hngalhnak cu sui ṭha nakin i lak deuh u;"},"11":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fimnak cu lungvar nakin a ṭha deuh i na duhmi vialte nih khan an tluk naisai lai lo."},"12":{"text":"Kei cu fimnak ka si i fimnak kha ka pek hna hngalhnak le ruahthiamnak lam kha ka hmuhsak hna."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihzah cu sualnak huat khi a si. Porhlawtnak, ruamkainak le sualnak lam le biadik lo kha ka huat hna."},"14":{"text":"Hngalhthiamnak le ṭhawnnak zong keimah ta an si."},"15":{"text":"Keimah thawngin siangpahrang nih uktu bawi an si i keimah thawngin uktu hna nih a dingmi phunglam kha an ser hna."},"16":{"text":"Keimah thawngin bawi nih bawi bantukin an um kho i vawleicung uktu bawi a simi vialte hna nih khan uktu bantukin an um kho."},"17":{"text":"A ka dawmi cu ka dawt hna i fel tein a ka kawlmi nih cun an ka hmuh."},"18":{"text":"Rumnak le upatnak kha ka sinah an um, a tlomi chaw le duhdimnak hna zong kha an um fawn."},"19":{"text":"Ka theitlai cu sui nakin a ṭha deuh, sui thiang nak hmanh in a ṭha deuh, ka chuahpimi theitlai cu ngun ṭha phun nakin a ṭha deuh."},"20":{"text":"Dinnak lam ah khan ka kal i biading lam ah khan ka kal,"},"21":{"text":"A ka dawmi cu rumnak ka pek hna i an ngun kuang ka khahter."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih a rian hramthawknak ah a ka ser, hlanlio i a tuahmi hna lakah hmasa bik ka si.","ref":"Biat 3.14"},"23":{"text":"Hlan lio piin a ka hmunhter cang, vawlei hramthawk hlanah, a hmasa bik ah a ka ser."},"24":{"text":"Ti thuk pipi an um hlanah khan a ka ser, ti a khatmi cerhti an rak um rih hlanah khan a ka ser cang."},"25":{"text":"Fing le tlang a ser hna hlanah keimah cu ka chuak cang;"},"26":{"text":"Vawlei le a chung i a ummi lo hna a ser hna hlan le Vawlei cung leidip hmasa bik a um hlanpi ah khan a ka ser diam cang."},"27":{"text":"Van hna khi a fehter hna tikah khan ka rak um cang, ti thuk cung i a kual, a pum in a rin tikah khan ka rak um ko cang;"},"28":{"text":"Cunglei van hna khi fek tein a ser hna tikah le ti thuk cerhti hna cu a fehter hna tikah khan"},"29":{"text":"Ti nih khan a nawlbia cu an buar nakhnga lo rili cu ri a serpiak hna; vawlei hram kha a hmelchunh tik ah khan,"},"30":{"text":"A pawngah khan rian thiam ngaimi bantukin ka rak um; keimah cu nifate in aa lawmhnak ka rak si i amah hmaiah khan kaa lawm zungzal."},"31":{"text":"Vawlei kha a ser dih tikah a cungah lente kaa celh i kaa nuamhnak cu minung hna chungah khan a si."},"32":{"text":"Atu cu ka fapale hna, ka bia ngai tuah u: Ka lam a zulmi cu lunglawmmi an si."},"33":{"text":"Cawnpiaknak kha ngai u law fim tuah u, cun zeirello in um hlah u."},"34":{"text":"Ka bia kha a ngai i ka kutka ah nifa a um i ka innka pawngin a ka hngakmi cu milunglawm an si."},"35":{"text":"Zeicahtiah keimah a ka hmutu nih cun nunnak kha a hmuh i Bawipa sinin duhdawtnak kha a hmuh;"},"36":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw keimah a ka hmu lomi nih cun amah le amah kha aa hliam ko; a ka huatu vialte cu thihnak he aa duhmi an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fimnak nih a inn kha a sak cang, a tung pasarih kha a phun cang hna.","title":"Fimnak le Hruhnak Nih Sawmnak"},"2":{"text":"A sa kha a thah cang hna i a mitsur hang zong kha a cawh cang hna i a cabuai zong kha a ser cang hna."},"3":{"text":"Khuachung hmun sang bikbik khan au awkah a sinum kha a thlah hna i,"},"4":{"text":"“Lungthin a tlawm deuhmi paoh cu hika ah hin ra tuah u,” an ti. Ruahnak a ngei set lomi cu a thawh hna i,"},"5":{"text":"“Ra u law changreu kha ei u law mitsur hang ka cawhmi kha ding tuah u."},"6":{"text":"Hruhnak lam kha kaltak u law nung cang tuah u, fimnak lam kha zul tuah u,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Miruamkai a chimhringtu nih cun rak nihsawhnak kha a in tawn, miṭhalo nun a chimtu nih cun hma a in tawn."},"8":{"text":"Miruamkai cu nun chim hlah, an huat sual lai, mifim cu nun chim law an dawt lai."},"9":{"text":"Mifim cu cawnpiak law a fim chin lai, miding cu cawnpiak law a thiamnak aa chap lai."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa ṭih cu fimnak hramthawknak a si, A Thiangmi Mi hngalh cu a thukmi thil hmuh khawhnak a si.","ref":"Job 28.28; Slm 111.10; Phut 1.7"},"11":{"text":"Zeicahtiah keimah thawngin na ni hna cu an karh lai i na nunnak ah kum tampi chap an si lai."},"12":{"text":"Na fim ahcun nangmah ca ṭhatnak a si ko, miruamkai na si ahcun mawhchiat awk cu nangmah na si ko."},"13":{"text":"Nu hrut cu a lung duh ning paoh khan a um i ngakchia bantuk a si i zeihmanh a hngal lo."},"14":{"text":"A inn innka ah khan a ṭhu, khua chung hmun sang bik hmun i ṭhutdan ah khan a ṭhu i,"},"15":{"text":"Lam i a kalmi, anmah lamte i ding tein a kal komi hna kha,"},"16":{"text":"“Lungthin a tlawm deuhmi paoh cu hika leiah hin ra tuah u,” a ti hna. Ruahnak a ngei set lomi kha a thawh hna i,"},"17":{"text":"“Firmi ti cu a thlum i a thli tein eimi changreu cu a thaw,” tiah a ti hna."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khika ah thihnak a um ti kha an hngal lo i a sawmmi a hawile hna cu Sheol a thuknak i a ummi an si kha an i hngal lo."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Solomon phungthluk bia hna: Fapa fim nih a pa a lawmhter, sihmanhsehlaw fapa hrut cu a nu caah ngaihchiatnak a si.","title":"Miding le Miṭhalo An I Dannak"},"2":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak in hmuhmi chawva cu a miak lo, sihmanhsehlaw dinnak cu thihnak chungin chuahtertu a si."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa nih miding cu rawlṭam in umter a siang hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo duhnak cu a donh tawn."},"4":{"text":"Kut thathu nih cun pamnak a chuahter, sihmanhsehlaw miteima kut nih cun rumnak a chuahter."},"5":{"text":"Ṭhal caan lioah thil aa khonmi cu fapa fim a si, sihmanhsehlaw rawlṭuan caan lio i a it komi fapa cu ningzahnak a chuahtertu a si."},"6":{"text":"Thluachuahnak cu miding hna lu cungah a um, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna kaa nih cun zaang-ennak kha an i hmawm."},"7":{"text":"Miding cu thluachuahnak an si tiin hngalh camcin an si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna min cu philh zau a si."},"8":{"text":"A fimmi nih cun nawlbia kha a lung chungah aa ken, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut mikatam cu ngaihchiatnak a phan lai."},"9":{"text":"Ding tein a kalmi cu him tein a kal, sihmanhsehlaw a lam kha a ningcang loin a tuahmi cu a langh lai."},"10":{"text":"Palhnak a um tikah tla dedep tein a mit a ṭhepmi cu harnak chuahtertu a si, sihmanhsehlaw ralṭhat in mi a chimhringmi cu daihnak umtertu a si."},"11":{"text":"Miding kaa cu nunnak cerhti a si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna kaa nih cun zaang-ennak kha an i hmawm."},"12":{"text":"Huatnak nih rem lonak kha a thawhter, sihmanhsehlaw dawtnak nih cun i tisualnak vialte kha a khuh dih.","ref":"Jei 5.20; 1Pet 4.8"},"13":{"text":"Hngalhthiamnak a ngeimipa hmur ah cun fimnak a um, sihmanhsehlaw fungfek cu ruahthiamnak a ngei lomipa keng caah a si."},"14":{"text":"Mifim nih cun hngalhnak kha an i khon, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih bia an chim hluahmah tikah khan rawknak kha a nai."},"15":{"text":"Mirum hna an ralhruang cu an chawva a si, misifak hna an rawhnak cu an sifahnak hi a si."},"16":{"text":"Miṭha nih an hmuhmi laksawng cu nunnak a si, sihmanhsehlaw sualnak nih cun sualnak lawng a chuahpi lengmang."},"17":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak a ngaimi paoh cu an nung lai, sihmanhsehlaw ka palh a ti duh lomi cu lamping ah an kal."},"18":{"text":"Huatnak a paw chungah a thupmi nih a hmur in lih a chim, hawi thangchiatnak a chimmi cu mihrut an si."},"19":{"text":"Bia tam deuh na chim paoh ah tam deuh in na sual ve sual ko lai, cucaah na fim ahcun bia naa sum lai."},"20":{"text":"Miṭha hna bia cu ngun ṭha bantuk an si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna lungthin cu hnawmtam bantuk an si."},"21":{"text":"Miṭha bia nih cun mi tampi a cawm hna, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut cu a hruh ruangah a thi tawn."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa thluachuahnak cu rumtertu a si i ngaihchiatnak zeihmanh a ratter chih hna lo."},"23":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak tuah hi mihrut caah cun lentecelh bantuk a si i sihmanhsehlaw hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi caah cun fimnak hi a nuammi a si."},"24":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu a ṭihmi thil kha a cungah a tlung lai, sihmanhsehlaw miding nih cun a saduhthah kha a co lai."},"25":{"text":"Thlichia nih miṭhalo cu a choih hna, sihmanhsehlaw miding cu an him."},"26":{"text":"Ha ca i a thormi bantuk le mit ca i meikhu bantuk khi mithathu cu a bawipa caah a si."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihnak nih hin chan a sauter, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna chan cu a tawi."},"28":{"text":"Miding hna ruahchannak cu lunglawmhnak a phan, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna nih an i ruahchihmi cu pakpalawng ah a cang."},"29":{"text":"Bawipa nih a sual lomi cu a huhphenh hna, sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak a tuahmi cu a hrawh hna."},"30":{"text":"Miding cu hlonh an si bal lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu ram chungah hin khua an sa kho lai lo."},"31":{"text":"Miding kaa nih cun fimnak kha a chim, sihmanhsehlaw lei ṭhalo cu tan a si lai."},"32":{"text":"Miding nih cun hi caan he hin zei bia hi dah chim awkah aa tlak ti kha an hngalh, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih cun mi ca i fahnak a chuahtertu bia lawnglawng kha a chim zungzal."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuai deu a hmangmi cu Bawipa nih a huat hna, sihmanhsehlaw tahnak khing ahmaanmi cu a lawmhmi a si."},"2":{"text":"Aa porhlawmi nih cun mi nihsawhnak tuan ah an hmuh lai. Cucaah mi toidorte i um a ṭha deuh."},"3":{"text":"Miding cu an dinnak nih a hruai hna, sihmanhsehlaw mihrokhrawl cu an hrokhrawlnak nih a hrawh hna."},"4":{"text":"Thihnak nih aan phak ni ah cun rumnak hi a ṭhahnem lo, sihmanhsehlaw dinnak cu thihnak chungin michuahtu a si."},"5":{"text":"Miṭha cu a dinnak nih khan a lam kha a fawiter, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu amah ṭhat lonak nih khan a tlukter."},"6":{"text":"Dinnak nih miding cu a chuah hna, sihmanhsehlaw mirawi hmang cu anmah duhfahnak lila ah khan an i foih"},"7":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu a thih tikah aa ruahchanmi vialte cu amah sinah khan an lo, rumnak i bochan cu zeihmanh a ṭhahnem lo."},"8":{"text":"Miding cu harnak chungin chuah a si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu cu chungah cun a paih in an i paih."},"9":{"text":"Pathian zei ah a rel lomi hna an bia nih mi kha a hrawh tawn hna, sihmanhsehlaw miding hna fimnak nih cun a khamh hna."},"10":{"text":"Miding hna huncho tikah khua cu aa lawm, miṭhalo hna an thih tikah lawmhnak au thawng a um."},"11":{"text":"Miding hna an um thawngin khua cu a lianngan, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna bia nih khua cu a hrawh tawn."},"12":{"text":"A innpa a zawmhtaihmi cu mihrut a si, sihmanhsehlaw hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi cu dai tein a um tawn."},"13":{"text":"Aa chawk lengmangmi mihmursau cu biathli phuan hmangmi an si, sihmanhsehlaw zumh awk tlak a simi nih cun thil kha a lung chungah a thuh hna."},"14":{"text":"Hruainak a um lo tikah miphun kha an tlu tawn, sihmanhsehlaw fimchimtu tamnak hmun ah cun himnak kha a um."},"15":{"text":"Na hngalh lomipa kha a leiba champiak awkah bia naa kam ahcun na lungre a thei lai, naa tel lo ahcun na caah a ṭha deuh lai."},"16":{"text":"Vel a thiammi nu cu hmaizahnak a hmu, sihmanhsehlaw ziaza a thiang lomi cu ningzahnak a si. Chawlehnak le chawhrawlnak ah na ral a chiat ahcun awkhlawh na si ko lai, na ral a ṭhat ahcun na rum ko lai."},"17":{"text":"Zaangfah a thiammi na si tikah nangmah le nangmah ṭhatnak naa pek a si, cun na puar ahcun nangmah le nangmah harnak naa pe ko."},"18":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih ahmaan loin miaknak a hmuh tawn, ṭhatnak a tuhtu nih cun laksawng taktak cu a hmuh lai."},"19":{"text":"Dinnak tuah awk aa rialchih pengmi cu a nung lai, sihmanhsehlaw dinlonak tuah aa sehchih pengmi cu a thi lai."},"20":{"text":"Lungthin ṭhalo a ngeimi cu Bawipa nih a huat hna, sihmanhsehlaw dinnak a tuahmi cu a lawmh hna."},"21":{"text":"Hnadai tein um ko, miṭhalo cu dantatnak hmu loin a um lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw miding hna le an tefa hna cu an luat lai."},"22":{"text":"Aa dawh ngai nain ruah thiamnak a ngei lomi nu cu vok hnar sui tumbul tonh bantuk a si."},"23":{"text":"Miṭha duhnak cu ṭhatnak ah a chuak tawn, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih an duhmi kha an hmuh tikah mi vialte an thin a hung dih."},"24":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih siang tein a ṭhenh lengmang hna i a rum chin, a dang pakhat nih tinsih in a um i herhbaunak lawng kha aa miak ko."},"25":{"text":"Nun va siang law na rum lai, midang kha va bawm hna law an in bawmh ve lai."},"26":{"text":"A rawl kha zuar a siang lomi cu mi nih chiat an serh, sihmanhsehlaw zuar a siangmi cu mi nih thluachuahnak an pek."},"27":{"text":"Naa tinhmi kha an ṭhat ahcun hmaizahnak na hmuh lai, Sihmanhsehlaw hnahnawhnak kha na kawl ahcun na hmuhmi cu cucu a si ko lai."},"28":{"text":"A rumnak kha aa bochanmi cu a ṭil lai, sihmanhsehlaw miding cu thinghnah hring bantukin an hninghno lai."},"29":{"text":"Amah innchungkhar cungah harnak a tluntermi cu a donghnak ah cun zeihmanh a ngei lai lo, mihrut cu mifim hna sinum an si zungzal lai."},"30":{"text":"Dinnak theitlai cu nunnak thingkung a si, sihmanhsehlaw zaang-ennak cu nunnak thah kha a si."},"31":{"text":"Miding hna nih vawlei cungah hin an hmuh awk hnga kha an hmuh ahcun miṭhalo hna le misual hna nih cun zeitluk in dah an hmuh chinchin lai.","ref":"1Pet 4.18"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hngalhnak a duhmi nih cun a palh tikah na palh tiah chimh kha a duh, palhnak chimh huat cu hruh a si."},"2":{"text":"Bawipa nih miṭha cu a lawmh hna, sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak khua a khangtu cu sual a phawt hna."},"3":{"text":"Mi hi ṭhat lonak nih a fehter kho lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭha hna hram cu ṭhial khawh lomi hram an si."},"4":{"text":"Nupi ṭha cu a va caah bawi luchin a si, sihmanhsehlaw ningzahnak a tluntertu nupi cu ruh chung i khensar zawtnak bantuk a si."},"5":{"text":"Miding hna tinhmi cu mi cung i ding tein tuah kha a si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna khuakhannak cu hlennak in a khat."},"6":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna bia nih cun thisen chuah ding kha a bawh, sihmanhsehlaw miṭha hna bia nih cun khamhnak kha a umter."},"7":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu an tla i cucu an donghnak a si, sihmanhsehlaw miding hna tefa cu an i peh lengmang."},"8":{"text":"Na fim ahcun thangṭhatnak na hmuh lai, na hruh ahcun mi nih an in zohchuk lai."},"9":{"text":"Mah nunnak caah rian a ṭuan ciahmahmi, mi sawhsawhte si cu, mingan bantuk i um i rawlṭam ṭung nakcun a ṭha deuh."},"10":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun an saṭil kha an zawn an ruah hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu an saṭil cungah cun an puar."},"11":{"text":"Amah a lote a thlo lengmangmi cu ei awk a za in a ngei, sihmanhsehlaw san a tlai lomi rian i caan pakpalawng i hman cu hruh a si."},"12":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna ralhau cu tlak bantukin a cim, sihmanhsehlaw miding hna hram cu fek tein a dir."},"13":{"text":"Mi ṭhalo cu amah chimmi bia lila nih khan rap ah a foihter, sihmanhsehlaw miding cu harnak chungin an luat."},"14":{"text":"Mi cheukhat nih an bia thawngin hlawh tlinnak an hmuh, sun a cheu nih an kut rian ṭuannak thawngin an hmuh awk hnga kha an hmuh ve."},"15":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun ka ding tiah a ruah zungzal, lungthin cheuhmi a ngaimi cu mifim an si."},"16":{"text":"Mihrut thinhun cu aa hngal zau, sihmanhsehlaw mifim nih cun serhsatnak kha zei ah rel duh loin a umtak men ko."},"17":{"text":"Biatak a chimmi nih cun ding tein tehte a khan, sihmanhsehlaw tehte ding lo cu hlennak bia in a khat."},"18":{"text":"Ruah set loin chimmi bia nih cun nam chunh bangin mi a chunh, sihmanhsehlaw mifim bia nih cun hma kha a damter."},"19":{"text":"Biatak cu zungzal in amah ningte a si ko, sihmanhsehlaw lih cu caan tawite lawnglawng a nung."},"20":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak khua a khangtu hna cu anmah le anmah an i hleng ko, sihmanhsehlaw zapi ca ṭhatnak a kawlmi hna caah cun lunglawmhnak a um."},"21":{"text":"Miding hna cungah cun ṭhat lonak a tlung lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna nih cun harnak lawnglawng kha an hmuh."},"22":{"text":"Bawipa nih lihchim hmangmi cu a huat hna, Sihmanhsehlaw miding cu a lawmh hna."},"23":{"text":"Mifim nih cun a fimnak kha a langhter lo, Sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun a hruhnak kha a thanh in a thanh."},"24":{"text":"Miteima cu uktu an si lai, sihmanhsehlaw mithathu cu an thathutnak nih mi sal ah a canter hna lai."},"25":{"text":"Lung retheihnak nih minung cu lunglawm loin a tuah, Sihmanhsehlaw dawtnak bia nih cun lunglawmhnak in a khahter."},"26":{"text":"Miding nih cun ṭhat lonak kha an hrial, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih cun a pialtertu hna lam kha an zulh."},"27":{"text":"Ramvai thathu nih sa an kap kho bal lo, Sihmanhsehlaw teimami nih cun a sungmi chawva kha an hmuh lai."},"28":{"text":"Dinnak cu nunnak lei kalnak lam a si, Hruhnak cu thihnak lei kalnak lam a si."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Fapa fim nih cun a pa nih a chimhhrinnak kha a ngaih, Sihmanhsehlaw mi lungpuam nih cun ka palh tiah a ti bal lo."},"2":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun dinnak theitlai kha an ei, sihmanhsehlaw mirawihmang hna nih cun zaang-ennak kha buh le sa tlukin an duh."},"3":{"text":"Na biachimmi kha i ralring law na nunnak kha naa veng kho lai, ralrin loin bia a chimmi nih cun amah lila kha aa hrawk ko."},"4":{"text":"Mizaangthu pa nih cun zeilo pakhatkhat kha a duh ngaingai ko hnga, sihmanhsehlaw cucu a hmu bal lai lo, rian fak piin a ṭuanmi tu nih cun a duhmi paohpaoh kha a hmuh lai."},"5":{"text":"Miding nih cun lihbia kha an huat; Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna rian ṭuannak cu fihnung le ningzak an si."},"6":{"text":"Dinnak tuahnak nih khan miding cu a ven hna, sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak cu mi sual mi hna tluknak a si."},"7":{"text":"Mi a cheukhat cu mirum bantukin an i umter, sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh an ngei lo, a cheukhat cu sifak bantukin an i um ter, sihmanhsehlaw chawva tampi an ngei."},"8":{"text":"Mirum nih a nunnak khamh awkah tangka hman a hau. Sihmanhsehlaw misifak cu ahohmanh nih an tlerh lo."},"9":{"text":"Miding hna cu ceu ngaiin a ceumi meiceu bantuk an si. Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu a mit cuahmahmi meiinn bantuk an si."},"10":{"text":"Uahfaihnak nih cun rem lonak lawng kha a chuahter. Sihmanhsehlaw aa nawl thiammi hawikom hna bu chungah cun fimnak a um."},"11":{"text":"Khulrang in hmuhmi rumnak cu a ziam zau, sihmanhsehlaw tlawmpal, tlawmpal tein khonmi cu a karhcho."},"12":{"text":"Ruahchannak cu a nikhua rauhter tikah hin lung a fak, sihmanhsehlaw saduhthahmi cu a tlin tikah hin nunnak thingkung a si."},"13":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak bia zei ah a rel lomi nih amah cungah harnak a tlunter, sihmanhsehlaw a zulmi nih cun laksawng a hmuh lai."},"14":{"text":"Mifim hna cawnpiaknak cu nunnak cerhti a si, mah cucu thihnak rap chungin an luatter khotu a si."},"15":{"text":"Fimnak ṭha nih duhdawtnak a hlawh, Sihmanhsehlaw hlennak cu rawhralnak lei lam kalnak a si."},"16":{"text":"Mifim cu a fim i zei thil paoh kha a thuhphenh, Sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun a hruhnak kha a zar in a zar."},"17":{"text":"Lamkaltu ṭhalo nih harnak chungah a luhpi tawn hna, Sihmanhsehlaw zumh awk tlak lamkaltu nih cun zeizong vialte kha an ṭhatter ṭhan tawn."},"18":{"text":"Cawnpiaknak zei ah a rel lomi cu sifahnak le ningzahnak nih a phak hna, sihmanhsehlaw chimhhrinnak zei ah a relmi cu upatnak an hmu."},"19":{"text":"Saduhthah tlin hi zeitluk in dah a ṭhat! Sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak mertak hi mihrut caah cun fihnung a si."},"20":{"text":"Mifim hna sinah i chawk ve lengmang law na fim lai, mihrut hna he i kom law a ping ah an in hruai lai."},"21":{"text":"Misual mi cu vanchiatnak nih a zulh hna, sihmanhsehlaw miding cu ṭhatnak laksawng an hmu lai."},"22":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun an fa fa chin tiangin ro an chiahpiak hna, sihmanhsehlaw misual mi nih an pumh luaimaimi chawva cu miding hna sinah a kal ko lai."},"23":{"text":"Thlawh lomi vawlei nih misifak mi hna caah rawl a za in a chuah ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw cu zong cu dinlonak thawngin a lo dih ko lai."},"24":{"text":"Na fa cu dan na tat lo ahcun na huat a si, na dawt ahcun amah kha chimhring tuah."},"25":{"text":"Miding cu ei awk a za in an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu an rawl a ṭam zungzal ko."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Nu fim nih an inn kha an sak, sihmanhsehlaw nu hrut nih anmah kut lila in an ṭheh dih hna."},"2":{"text":"Miding nih cun Bawipa kha an ṭih, sihmanhsehlaw midepde nih cun zei ah an rel lo."},"3":{"text":"Mihrut biachimmi cu amah keng ca fungfek a si, sihmanhsehlaw mifim cu an hmurka nih a huhphenh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cawtum um lonak ah cun buk cu a lawngin an um ko, sihmanhsehlaw cawtum thazang chungin rawl tampi a chuak."},"5":{"text":"Zumh awk tlakmi tehte nih cun lih kha a chim lo, sihmanhsehlaw tehte dinglo nih cun lih kha a thaw ah aa chuahchih."},"6":{"text":"Miporhlaw nih cun fimnak kha a kawl nain a hmu lo, sihmanhsehlaw hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi caah cun fimnak cu a fawitemi thil a si ko."},"7":{"text":"Mihrut cu hrial ko hna, zeihmanh an in cawnpiak khawh ding a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Zeicahdah mifim cu a fim? Zeidah ka tuah lai ti kha aa hngalh caah a fim. Zeicahdah mihrut cu a hruh? Ka hngalh tiah aa ruah caah a hrut."},"9":{"text":"Mihrut cu an sual ah an zei a poi lo, sihmanhsehlaw miṭha nih cun ngaihthiamnak hmuh kha an duh."},"10":{"text":"Na lunglawmhnak cu nangmah tate a si, na ngaihchiatnak zong nangmah tate a si, Ahohmanh na hrawm kho hna lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalo inn cu hrawh a si lai, sihmanhsehlaw miding inn cu a hungcho lai."},"12":{"text":"Lam dik tiah na ruahmi kha thihnak lei kalnak lam a si kho ko.","ref":"Phut 16.25"},"13":{"text":"Minung cu a nih len ko zongah a lungchung tein a ngaih a chia ko hnga, lunglawmhnak a loh cang ahcun, ngaihchiatnak a um zungzal ko."},"14":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih a hmuh awk hnga a simi kha a hmuh lai, miṭha nih a tuahmi thawng khan laksawng a hmuh lai."},"15":{"text":"Mi lungthin tlawm nih cun zei paoh kha a zumh, sihmanhsehlaw mifim nih cun a lamh ding kha ṭha tein a zoh."},"16":{"text":"Mifim cu ralring tein a um i ṭhat lonak kha a hrial, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut cu aa ralring lo i khulrang tuk in a tuah tawn."},"17":{"text":"Mi thin tawi nih cun thil hrut kha an tuah tawn, sihmanhsehlaw mifim deuhmi cu an lung a sau."},"18":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun an hruhnak nih a hmuh awk hnga a simi kha an co.
