Mifim cu hngalhnak kha bawi luchin ah chinhter an si."},"19":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu miṭha hna hmaiah khan an bawk, miṭhalo cu miding hna kutka ah khan an kun."},"20":{"text":"Misifak cu ahohmanh nih an duh lo, sihmanhsehlaw mirum cu hawikom tampi a ngei."},"21":{"text":"Lunglawmmi si na duh ahcun misifak kha va zaangfah hna, mi zeihmanh zeirello i um kha sualnak a si."},"22":{"text":"Ṭhatnak caah rian na ṭuan ahcun mi nih an in zumh lai i an in upat lai, sihmanhsehlaw chiatnak caah na tuah ahcun na palh hrimhrim ko."},"23":{"text":"Rianṭuan harnak nih hin ṭhathnemnak a chuahpi, kaa chim men lawng nih cun sifahnak lawng a chuahpi ko."},"24":{"text":"Mifim hna bawi luchin cu thil a chunglei an hmuh khawhnak hi a si, mihrut hna pangpar ṭhirual cu an hruhnak hi a si."},"25":{"text":"Biatak a chimmi tehte nih nunnak kha a khamh, sihmanhsehlaw lih a chimmi cu mi rawitu a si."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihnak aa bochanmi miṭhawng cu, A tefa hna caah himnak a si."},"27":{"text":"Thihnak in luat na duh maw? Bawipa ṭihnak hi nunnak cerhti a si."},"28":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu ukmi tampi a ngeih tikah a lianngan, ukmi a ngeih lo ahcun a bawinak cu a lo ko."},"29":{"text":"Dai tein a um khomi cu mifim a si, sihmanhsehlaw mithintawi nih cun zeitluk in dah a hruh ti lawng kha a langhter."},"30":{"text":"Lung daihnak nih pum kha a ngan a damter, sihmanhsehlaw nahchuahnak cu khensar zawtnak bantuk a si."},"31":{"text":"Misifak kha nan serhsat hna ahcun anmah a Sertu Pathian nan serhsat kha a si, nan zaangfah hna ahcun cucu Pathian biak a si."},"32":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu amah ṭhat lonak nih a thluk, sihmanhsehlaw miding cu a dinnak nih khan a huhphenh."},"33":{"text":"Fimnak a ngeimi hna lung chungah cun fimnak cu nuam tein a cam, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut hna lung chungah cun aa nuam lo."},"34":{"text":"Miphun a lianhngantertu cu dinnak a si, sualnak cu zei miphun paoh caah ningzahnak a si."},"35":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih a felmi rianṭuantu kha an lawmh hna, sihmanhsehlaw an rian a tlolhmi cu dan a tat hna."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lehnak nem nih thinhunnak a damter, sihmanhsehlaw biahrang nih cun thin a phawh."},"2":{"text":"Mifimpa lei nih hngalhnak kha a karhter, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun pakpalawng bia kha a chim."},"3":{"text":"Bawipa nih khuazei ka i thil a ummi hmanh kha a hmuh dih, ṭhatnak kan tuah ah siseh, chiatnak kan tuah ah siseh, a kan hmuh dih ko."},"4":{"text":"Bia nem cu nunnak thingkung a si, sihmanhsehlaw ṭhat lonak a tuahtu lei nih lungthin kha a khuai tawn."},"5":{"text":"Mihrut nih a pa chimhhrinnak kha zei ah a rel lo, sihmanhsehlaw mawhchiatnak zei ah a relmi cu mifim a si."},"6":{"text":"Miding nih an chawva kha an i chiah khawh, sihmanhsehlaw harnak caan a phak tikah miṭhalo nih cun an thlau hna."},"7":{"text":"Mifim hmurka nih hngalhnak kha an ṭhanter, mihrut lungthin tu cu, cu bantuk a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna raithawinak cu Bawipa caah fihnung a si, sihmanhsehlaw miṭha hna thlacamnak cu a lawmhmi a si."},"9":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna ziaza cu Bawipa caah fihnung a si, sihmanhsehlaw dinnak a kawlmi kha a dawt hna."},"10":{"text":"Palhnak kha na tuah ahcun fak piin dantatnak na hmuh lai, chimhhrinnak kha na duh lo ahcun na thi lai."},"11":{"text":"Sheol le Abaddon hmanh Bawipa hmaiah cun an lang ko, minung lungthin chinchin cu zeitluk in dah a langh lai!"},"12":{"text":"Miporhlaw nih cun chimhhrinnak kha a duh lo, mifim hna sinah khan ruahnak va hal awkah a kal bal lo."},"13":{"text":"Lungchung lawmhnak nih hmai a panhter, sihmanhsehlaw lungfahnak nih lungthin a khuai tawn."},"14":{"text":"Mifim nih cun hngalh chin lengmang kha an duh, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut cu an hruhnak ah khan an i za ko."},"15":{"text":"Harnak a ingmi hna caah cun nifate hi ni har an si dih ko, sihmanhsehlaw lung aa lawmmi hna caah cun nunnak hi a nuam zungzal ko."},"16":{"text":"Bawipa ṭih bu tein tlawmte ngeih hi tampi ngeih i hnahnawk ngai i um nakin a ṭha deuh."},"17":{"text":"Dawtnak aa telnak zanriah cu an hringso he lawng hmanh siseh law, a thaumi caw sa in tuahmi zanriah, huatnak aa telmi nakin a ṭha deuh."},"18":{"text":"Thintawi nih siknak a chuahter, sihmanhsehlaw lungsaunak nih rem lonak a damter."},"19":{"text":"Mithathu lam cu hling nih a buathnawh, sihmanhsehlaw teimami lam cu lampheipi a si."},"20":{"text":"Fapa fim nih a pa kha a lawmhter, sihmanhsehlaw a hrutmi mino nih a nu kha a nehsawh."},"21":{"text":"Mihrut cu an hruhnak ah khan an i lawm ko, sihmanhsehlaw mifim nih cun ahmaanmi thil kha an tuah."},"22":{"text":"Ruahnak i cheuhnak a um lo ahcun khuakhannak kha a pingah a kal tawn, sihmanhsehlaw ruahnak cheutu an tam ahcun a hlawh a tling tawn."},"23":{"text":"Mipa nih a lehnak kha a lunghmuih ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw a caan he ahmaanmi bia fang khat cu zeitluk in dah a ṭhat deuh!"},"24":{"text":"Mifim cu nunnak lam leiah khin an hung kal, thihnak lam leiah cun an vung kal lo."},"25":{"text":"Bawipa nih aa porhlawmi inn cu a ṭheh, sihmanhsehlaw nuhmei thilri kha a humhak hna."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa nih miṭhalo hna ruahnak cu a huat, mithiang hna bia cu a lawmhmi an si."},"27":{"text":"A hak a kaumi nih a innchungkhar cungah harnak a tlunter, sihmanhsehlaw nawhthuh a duh lomi cu saupi a nung lai."},"28":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun bialehnak an tuah hlanah an ruah hmasa, miṭhalo nih cun khulrang in an leh, sihmanhsehlaw an lehnak nih cun harnak a chuahter."},"29":{"text":"Miṭha nih thla an cam tikah Bawipa nih a ngaihpiak hna, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu zei ah a rel hna lo."},"30":{"text":"Hmaipanh nih mi a lawmhter, thawngṭha nih mi a lawmhter chinchin."},"31":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak a ṭhami kha ṭha tein a ruatmi cu mifim hna bu chungah khan aa tel ve lai."},"32":{"text":"Chimhhrinnak zei ah na rel lo ahcun nangmah le nangmah harnak naa pe, sihmanhsehlaw chimhhrinnak kha na cohlan duh ahcun na fim chin lai."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa ṭih hi fimnak ding caah cawnpiaknak a si, upatnak phaknak lam cu toidornak a si."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Minung nih khua cu an khan ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak bia a ngeitu cu Pathian a si."},"2":{"text":"Na tuahmi cu a ṭha dih in na ruah ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih naa tinhnak na lungthin cu a hngalh dih."},"3":{"text":"Na tuahmi vialte cu Bawipa sinah pe law Na khuakhannak cu a tling kho lai."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa nih zeizong vialte hi anmah ca i tinh ciomi caah khan a ser hna, miṭhalo hna hmanh hi, harnak ni caah a ser hna."},"5":{"text":"Miruamkai cu Bawipa caah fihnung an si, hnadai tein um ko, dantatnak hmu loin an um lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Pathian leiah felte le zumhawktlak tein um ko law na sualnak cu an ngaihthiam lai. Cun Bawipa kha ṭih law ṭhat lonak nih an tlunhnawh lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Mi cu a umtuning kha Bawipa duhning a si ahcun, a ral hna hmanh kha amah he i rem tein a umter hna."},"8":{"text":"Dinlonak in hmuhmi thil tampi nakcun dinnak in hmuhmi tlawmte a ṭha deuh."},"9":{"text":"Minung nih hin a khualtlawnnak ding khua kha a khan, sihmanhsehlaw a kephau a hruaitu cu Bawipa a si."},"10":{"text":"Pathian chimhmi biakhiahnak cu siangpahrang hmur ah cun a um, biaceih tikah a kaa nih sualnak a tuah lo."},"11":{"text":"A dikmi tahnak le khing hna cu Bawipa duhmi an si, zal chung i a ummi cuaithlainak lung vialte hna zong amah nih a tuahmi an si."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang caah cun ṭhat lonak tuah hi fihnung a si, zeicahtiah bawi ṭhutdan cu dinnak in fehter a si."},"13":{"text":"Bia hmaan chim cu siangpahrang lawmhmi a si, cun biatak a chimmi cu a dawt hna."},"14":{"text":"Mifim nih cun siangpahrang cu a lung lawmhter aa zuam, siangpahrang cu a thin a hun ahcun pakhatkhat thah an si sual lai."},"15":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmai ceunak chungah nunnak a um, cun a zaangfahnak cu ṭhal ruah a hun ratpitu khuadawm bantuk a si."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak ngeih hi sui nakin a ṭha deuh, hngalhthiamnak ngeih hi ngun nakin thim deuh awk a si."},"17":{"text":"Miding hna nih cun ṭhat lonak a hrialtu lam kha an zulh, cucaah khuazei i na kal kha zoh tuah, na nunnak an khamh khawh lai."},"18":{"text":"Porhlawtnak nih hin rawknak ah mi a kalpi tawn i uanthlarnak lungthin nih hin tluknak ah a hruai tawn hna."},"19":{"text":"Misifak hna he toidornak lungthin in um cu, miporhlaw hna he hranchaw i ṭhenh nakin a ṭha deuh."},"20":{"text":"An in cawnpiakmi kha ṭha tein ruat law khuaawng na tong lai, Bawipa kha i bochan law na lung aa lawm lai."},"21":{"text":"A fim i nutling patling lungthin a ngeimi cu, thil a thleidang khomi ti a si i a awka a thlum deuh paoh ah mi a lem khawh chin hna."},"22":{"text":"Fimnak cu a ngeitu caah cun nunnak cerhti a si, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut cu a hruhnak nih dantatnak a inter."},"23":{"text":"Mifim nih cun bia a chim hlanah a ruah hmasa, cucaah a chimmi cu hmual a ngei."},"24":{"text":"Biathlum cu khuaihliti bantuk a si, nunnak caah a thlum i pum caah damnak a si."},"25":{"text":"Na ruahnak i lam ding a si na timi kha thihnak lei kalpitu lam a si ko hnga.","ref":"Phut 14.12"},"26":{"text":"Rianṭuantu cu a rawl duhnak nih khan fak deuh in a ṭuanter, zeicahtiah a rawlṭamnak kha daihter a duh."},"27":{"text":"Mizeiruaramlo nih, congoihnak kha a vahpi, a bia cu kanghtu mei bantuk a si."},"28":{"text":"Mi lungthin ṭhalo nih rem lonak kha an karhter i Mi dupdap nih hawikom ṭha kha an ṭhen hna."},"29":{"text":"Zaang-ennak a hmangmi nih a innpa kha a hlen i A ṭhalo lam ah khan a kalpi."},"30":{"text":"A mit curcudup in aa aumi cu a lungthin chung i dawtnak a ngei lomi a si, a hmur aa iapmi nih cun thil ṭhalo kha a tlunter tawn."},"31":{"text":"Ṭuakpar hi sunparnak bawiluchin a si, nun a dingmi nih an hmuh."},"32":{"text":"Thinhun leiah a khul a nuarmi cu thazang a ṭhawngmi nakin a ṭha deuh. A lungthin aa uk khomi cu khuapi a latu nakin a ṭha deuh."},"33":{"text":"Camcawhfung cu phei cungah hrilh a si tawn, sihmanhsehlaw biakhiahnak taktak cu Bawipa sin lawnglawng in a si."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"I sik lengmang bu i puai tuahnak inn i um nakcun daite i buhṭhing pei khat ei a ṭha deuh."},"2":{"text":"A fimmi sal nih a bawipa fapa, zeiruaramlo a simi kha a uk lai i unau pakhat ve bantukin ro kha a co ve lai."},"3":{"text":"Sui le ngun cu mei in hneksak an si, minung lung cu Bawipa nih a hneksak."},"4":{"text":"Mihrokhrawl cu hrokhrawl bia lawng kha a thlingthla, lihchim hmang nih cun thangchiatnak bia lawng kha a ngai."},"5":{"text":"Misifak nihsawh cu a Sertu nehsawh kha a si, Mi nih van chiat an ton tikah a di a riammi cu dantat loin a luat lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Tu le fa hi tar hna bawiluchin an si, Fapa hna an sunparnak cu an pale hi an si."},"7":{"text":"Bia ṭha chim le mihrut an i tlak lo, bia lih chim le bawi an i tlak lo chinchin."},"8":{"text":"Mi a cheu nih, nawhthuh nih cun camh bantukin rian a ṭuan khawh, tiah an ruah, zeipaoh a tuah khawh tiah an zumh."},"9":{"text":"Midang sualnak a thup khotu nih kha pa dawtnak kha a hmuh lai. Sihmanhsehlaw kha thilte kha hlasak in a sa lengmangmi nih cun hawikom he ṭhennak a ser."},"10":{"text":"Mihrut voi za khat tuk nakin, mifim voi khat chimhhrin cu thuk deuh a pil."},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun ralthawhnak lawng kha an kawl, annih cu a puarmi lamkaltu kha an thlahhnawh hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Mihrut a hruh lio i ton nakcun a fa chuhmi vompi ton a ṭha deuh."},"13":{"text":"Mi nih ṭhatnak cu ṭhat lonak in a lehrulh ahcun, ṭhat lonak cu a inn chungin aa ṭhial bal lai lo."},"14":{"text":"Sik hram i thawk hi ti khamnak a pem hramthawk bantuk khi a si. A kauh chin hlanah ngol ko."},"15":{"text":"Miṭhalo thiamcoh le miding sualphawt hi, an pahnih in Bawipa mithmuh ah fihnung an si veve."},"16":{"text":"Mihrut caah cun tangka hi zei san dah a tlaih? Fimnak a ngeih lo ahcun fimnak cu a cawk khawh lai maw?"},"17":{"text":"Hawikom nih cun zei tik paoh ah dawt zungzal a si, u le nau cu harnak i hrawm awkah hrin kan si."},"18":{"text":"Midang caah aamah aa khaang i biakamnak caah aa pemi cu mihrut a si."},"19":{"text":"Remlonak a duhmi nih cun sualnak a duh, a inn kulhnak innka sang piin a sermi nih cun rawhralnak kha a sawm ko hna."},"20":{"text":"Ruahnak kawi a ngeimi cu khuaawng an pem lo, lei ṭhalo a ngeimi cu vanchiatnak chungah an tla tawn."},"21":{"text":"Fapa hrut cu a pa caah ngaihchiatnak a si, a pa cu lunglawmhnak a ngei lo."},"22":{"text":"Lungthin lawmh hi si ṭha a si, sihmanhsehlaw lungthin ngaihchia nih ruh kha a roter."},"23":{"text":"Biaceihtu ṭhalo nih ziknawh an lak tawn i dinnak in bia an ceih lo."},"24":{"text":"Lungthin a tlamtling cangmi nih cun thil ṭha tuah awk kha an hngalh, sihmanhsehlaw a tlam a tling lomi nih cun an lungthin an thlek kho lo."},"25":{"text":"Fapa hrut nih cun a pa kha awlokchong in a tuah i a hringtu a nu caah lungretheihnak a si."},"26":{"text":"Miding mi dantat cu a ṭha lo, miṭha mi hna fung in tuk cu palh a si."},"27":{"text":"Amah aa zum vemi nih cun bia tampi a chim lo, dai tein a ummi cu thil thuk piin a hmu khomi an si."},"28":{"text":"Mihrut hmanh hi daite in a um ahcun mifim ah rel a si, a hmur aa cip peng ahcun mifim ah ruah a si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi dang he aa rem lomi cu amah duhnak lawng zulh a duhmi a si, midang nih a hmaan an timi paoh kha a hnatlakmi a um lo."},"2":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun a hngalh set le hngalh set lo kha biapi in a ruat lo, zeitluk in dah ka fim ti langhter lawng kha a duh."},"3":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak le ningzahnak cu a kal ṭimi an si, upatnak kha na thlau ahcun nihsawhnak kha na hmuh ko lai."},"4":{"text":"Minung holh hi fimnak hram a si kho, rili bantukin a thuk kho i a luang lengmangmi tiva bantukin a thar lengmang kho."},"5":{"text":"Miṭhalo sin i duhdanh ngeih cu a ṭha lo, miding mi biading coh lo zong a ṭha lo."},"6":{"text":"Mihrut mi hmur nih cun siknak a chuahpi, a kaa nih fung tuknak a sawm."},"7":{"text":"Mihrut cu a kaa kha amah rawhnak a si, a hmur kha amah lila caah rap a si."},"8":{"text":"Mi congoihnak bia chim cu a thlummi changreu bantukin a thaw i pum chung chungchin ah khan kan lemh riahmah ko hna."},"9":{"text":"Mahle rian ah a daithlangmi cu hrawkhraltu unau a si."},"10":{"text":"Bawipa min cu a fekmi innsang a si, miding cu khika ah khan an va tli i an him."},"11":{"text":"Mirum mi nih a chawva cu, a fekmi khua le a sangmi ralhau a si tiah a ruah."},"12":{"text":"Harnak phak hlanah cun mi cu an lung a puam tawn, sihmanhsehlaw upatnak phaknak lam cu toidornak a si."},"13":{"text":"Bia na leh hlanah ngai hmasa, cu ti na tuah lo ahcun na hruh a si hleiah bia na lehmipa zei i na rel lo zong a si."},"14":{"text":"Mi cu lungthin ṭhawng nih a zawt lio ah thazang a pek khawh, sihmanhsehlaw lungthin cu hma a in ahcun, aho nih dah a tuar khawh lai?"},"15":{"text":"Ruahnak a fimmi nih cun hngalhnak kha an i lak chin lengmang i mifim mi nih an hna in hngalhnak kha an kawl."},"16":{"text":"Laksawng nih laksawng petu caah khan lam a hun i mingan hna sinah khan a phakpi."},"17":{"text":"Biaceihnak zung ah bia a chim hmasami paoh cu a hmaan a lo zungzal, sihmanhsehlaw cu a lawhnak cu a dang a rat ve i amah kha a vun hlathlai tiang lawng khi a si tawn."},"18":{"text":"Pa ṭhawng pahnih cu biaceihnak zung ah bia an i al ahcun, camcawhfung lawng nih an bia kha a khiah khawh."},"19":{"text":"U le nau i bawmh hi a fekmi khua bantuk a si, sihmanhsehlaw i sik cu ralhau kharkanh bantuk a si."},"20":{"text":"Mi cu a kaa chungin a chuakmi bia theitlai in a khim tawn, a hmur in a chuakmi in cawmnak kha a hmuh."},"21":{"text":"Lei nih hin thah khawhnak le nunh khawhnak ṭhawnnak a ngei, cucaah na bia chimmi theitlai cu na co a herh lai."},"22":{"text":"Nupi aa hmuhmi cu thil ṭha aa hmuhmi a si, Bawipa cu na cungah a ṭha ti kha a langhter."},"23":{"text":"Misifak nih cun bia an chim ah a nawl tein an nawl tawn hna, sihmanhsehlaw mirum nih cun an leh hna tikah a hrilh in an hrilh."},"24":{"text":"Hawikom a cheu khat cu pakpalawng biachim lawngah an ṭhahnem, sihmanhsehlaw unau nakin a fek deuhmi hawikom zong an um ve."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungthin a ṭhami misifak cu hrokhrawl in bia a chimmi mirum nakin a ṭha deuh."},"2":{"text":"Hngalhnak um ṭung lo duhnak lawng hi a ṭha lo, Namhnaw in a kalmi nih a lam kha a thlau tawn."},"3":{"text":"Minung cu a hruhnak nih khan rawhnak ah a phakter i Cu tikah Bawipa cungah khan a lung chungin a thin a hung."},"4":{"text":"Rumnak nih hawi thar tampi a chuahpi, Sihmanhsehlaw misifak cu a hawi cia nih khan an chuahtak."},"5":{"text":"A dinglo tehte cu dantat loin a luat lai lo, Lih a chimtu cu a luat ve lai lo."},"6":{"text":"Mi tampi nih mi lian he hawikom sinak kha an kawl, Laksawng a pe lengmang tu caah cun aho paoh hawikom an si ko."},"7":{"text":"Misifak cu a unau vialte nih an huat tawn, Zeitluk in dah a hawile chinchin nih cun hrial loin an um lai."},"8":{"text":"Fimnak ngeih hi mah le mah dawt a si, Cun na hngalhmi kha i chingchiah law khuaawng na tong lai."},"9":{"text":"A dinglo tehte cu dantat loin a luat lai lo, Lih lawng a chim lengmangmi cu a rawk lai."},"10":{"text":"Mihrut cu nunnuam in um awkah aa tlak lo, Sal nih bawi uk cu aa tlak lo chinchin."},"11":{"text":"Lungsau thinfual hi fim a si, Palhnak i hmaimilh cio hi minung sunparnak a si."},"12":{"text":"Siangpahrang thinhunnak cu chiandeih ngur bantuk a si, Sihmanhsehlaw a duhdawtnak cu ram cung i a tlami dap bantuk a si."},"13":{"text":"Fapa hrut nih a pa cu rawhnak ah a phakpi, Nupi phunzai cu ruah-it khuachiat bantuk a si."},"14":{"text":"Inn le chawva cu pale sinin hmuhmi ro an si, Sihmanhsehlaw nupi fim cu Bawipa sinin hmuhmi laksawng a si."},"15":{"text":"Thathutnak nih mitkuh thu chungah a paih tawn hna, Mithathu cu rawlṭamnak a ing lai."},"16":{"text":"Nawlbia kha zul hna law sau deuh na nung lai, zeirello in um hna law na thi lai."},"17":{"text":"Misifak cungah zaangfahnak na ngeih ahcun Bawipa kha chaw na coih bantuk a si. Bawipa nih tling tein an cham lai."},"18":{"text":"Na fale cu an no rih lioah chimhring hna, cu ti na tuah lo ahcun an rawhnak dingah na bawmh hna a si."},"19":{"text":"Minung cu a ingchiatnak nih khan dantatnak a inter tawn, harnak chungin voi khat na chuahter zongah, na tuah ṭhan a hau ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai."},"20":{"text":"Lungthin cheuhnak le cawnpiaknak kha ngai tuah, ni khatkhat cu na fim ve te ko lai."},"21":{"text":"Minung lung chungah khuakhannak tampi a um ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw Pathian tinhmi lawng kha a hmun lai."},"22":{"text":"Hakkauh hi ningzahnak a si, misifak si hi lihchimmi sinak in a ṭha deuh."},"23":{"text":"Bawipa ṭihnak hi nunnak a si, cuti in na um ahcun, hnangam tein na um lai i harnak nih an tawng lai lo."},"24":{"text":"Mithathu nih cun a kut kha kheng chungah hnim i a kaa i hun i tuh hmanh kha a zuam lo."},"25":{"text":"Miporhlaw cu na velh ahcun mihrut bantukin an huat lai, hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi tu cu chimhring law na duhnak kha a hngalh lai."},"26":{"text":"A pa kha a vel i a nu kha a dawimi cu, ningzahnak a chuahtertu le hmaichiatnak a phortu a si."},"27":{"text":"Ka fapa, cawnnak kha na ngol ahcun na hngalh ciami kha na philh zau ko lai."},"28":{"text":"Tehte ṭhalo nih biading kha zei ah a rel lo, miṭhalo mi hna bia nih ṭhat lonak kha a chuahter."},"29":{"text":"Miporhlaw mi hna caah fungfek cu chiah cia a si ko i Mihrut hna keng caah tuknak cu timhcia a si ko."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zu hi nihsawhnak mi a phorhtu a si, Ritnak zu hi i siknak a si; zu rit cu hruh a si."},"2":{"text":"A thin a hungmi siangpahrang cu a ngur hluahmahmi chiandeih bantukin ṭih tuah, amah a thin hunter cu mah le mah i thah a si ko;"},"3":{"text":"Mihrut aho paoh nih siknak kha a thawhter khawh, sihmanhsehlaw siknak hrial cu upat awk tlak thil a si."},"4":{"text":"Mi thathu nih cun leithuan caan ah lei a thuang lo, rawlṭuan caan a phak tikah a kawl i zeihmanh a hmu lo."},"5":{"text":"Minung nih a lung chung i a ngeihmi ruahnak cu a thukmi tikhor ti bantuk a si, sihmanhsehlaw thuk piin a hmu khomi nih cun a than khawh lai."},"6":{"text":"Mi kip nih zumh awk tlak ka si an ti cio, sihmanhsehlaw hei hneksak tuah hna law, aho fang khi dik zumh awk tlak taktak cu an hei si!"},"7":{"text":"Mipa cu a nunning kha a din i a ṭhat ahcun, a hnu i a tefa hna cu thluachuakmi an si."},"8":{"text":"Biaceihnak ṭhutdan cungah a ṭhumi siangpahrang nih cun ṭhat lonak vialte kha a thleidan khawh dih."},"9":{"text":"Aho tal nih, “Ka lung cu ka thianter i ka sualnak in ka thiang cang,” an ti kho lai maw?"},"10":{"text":"Cuai deu le rel deu hman hi Bawipa caah fihnung an si."},"11":{"text":"Ngakchia hmanh nih a tuahmi a ṭhat le a din kha a tuahnak in amah lila nih a langhter ko."},"12":{"text":"Theihnak hna hna le hmuhnak mit hna hi Bawipa sermi an si dih."},"13":{"text":"Ih hi duh hlah, sifahnak na phan sual lai, na mit i au law rawl tampi na ngei ko lai."},"14":{"text":"Thil cawtu nih cun a man a fak tuk, a ti zungzal, sihmanhsehlaw a kal hnuah cun ka det khawh tiah aa porhlaw ṭhan ṭung."},"15":{"text":"Sui tampi a um ko, a man a tammi lung zong tampi an um ko, sihmanhsehlaw fimnak bia cu a tlawmte i a man a sung cikmi lungvar a si."},"16":{"text":"Hngalh lomipa leiba caah amah le amah aamahkhan tiangin a hrutmi cu, a thilri kha aamahkhannak ah cun tlaih a si lai."},"17":{"text":"Lihchim in hmuhmi rawl cu a thlum, sihmanhsehlaw luklak ah a kaa ah lungtekem bantuk an si."},"18":{"text":"Lungthin i cheuhnak in khuakhanmi kha a hmun, i timh ciammam loin raltuknak hmun chungah lut cutmat hlah."},"19":{"text":"Mi hmursau nih biathli kha a phuan tawn, Cucaah a holh tukmi cu kom hlah."},"20":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih a nu siseh a pa siseh a vawlhpamh hna ahcun, Muihnak a rat tikah a mei-inn kha a mit lai."},"21":{"text":"Khulrang tuk in hmuhmi chawva cu, a donghnak ah thlua a chuak lai lo."},"22":{"text":"“Ṭhat lonak cu ṭhat lonak in ka rulh lai,” tiah va ti hlah, Bawipa kha va hngak law, amah nih an bawmh lai"},"23":{"text":"Cuai deu cu Bawipa caah fihnung a si, tahnak deu cu a ṭha lo."},"24":{"text":"Minung lam a kan hruaitu cu Bawipa a si, zeitindah mi nih a lam cu a hngalh khawh lai?"},"25":{"text":"Pathian sin pek awk laksawng naa kam hlanah ṭha tein ruat hmasa, a hnuah naa ngaichih sual lai."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang fim nih cun miṭhalo kha a hngalh hna i zaangfahnak ngei loin dan a tat hna."},"27":{"text":"Bawipa nih ruahnak le a chia le a ṭha thleidan khawhnak lungthin a kan pek. Kanmah sinin kan i thup kho lo."},"28":{"text":"Zumhawktlak sinak le zumhnak ṭha nih siangpahrang cu a kilven i a bawi ṭhutdan cu dinnak nih a dirter."},"29":{"text":"Tlangval hna an sunparnak cu an thazang hi a si, tar hna an i dawhnak cu an sam par hi a si."},"30":{"text":"A zei maw caan ahcun, kan ziaza i thlen awkah harnak ton kha a herh tawn."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang lungthin cu Bawipa kut chungah a ummi a si, tilaknak tilam bantukin a duhnak lei paoh ah a mermi a si."},"2":{"text":"Mi kip nih mahle umtuning cio hi mahle mit cio ah cun a dik in hmuh a si, Sihmanhsehlaw lungthin cuai a thlaitu cu Bawipa a si."},"3":{"text":"Dinnak le biading tuah kha, raithawinak nakin Bawipa nih a cohlan deuhmi a si."},"4":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu ruamkainak le porhlawtnak nih a uk hna i hihi sual a si."},"5":{"text":"Teimaknak le a hlankan in ṭha tein thil rak ruahchungnak nih duhdimnak kha a chuahter i cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in namchan in thil a timi paoh cu sifahnak an tong hrimhrim ve ko lai."},"6":{"text":"Lihchim in hmuhmi chawva cu a zuangmi tikhu le thihnak rap an si."},"7":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu anmah nih an tuahmi zaang-ennak chung lila ah khan an i foih, zeicahtiah a dingmi thil tuah kha an duh lo."},"8":{"text":"A sualmi nih cun lam kawi kha an zulh, sihmanhsehlaw a sual lomi nih cun a hmaanmi kha an tuah."},"9":{"text":"Mi phunzai nupi he innpi i hrawm nakcun, inncung a ken ken khatte i um a ṭha deuh."},"10":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun ṭhat lonak kha a duh zungzal ko, A innpa cungah zaangfahnak a ngei lo."},"11":{"text":"Miporhlaw cu dantat a si tikah mihrut kha an lung a fim, Mifim cu cawnpiak an si tikah, hngalhnak kha an i chap."},"12":{"text":"Miding mi nih cun miṭhalo mi nih zei an ruah le zei nih dah an tluknak kha a chuahter ti kha an hngalh."},"13":{"text":"Misifak hna an au tikah a hna aa chehmi cu, amah a au ve tikah ahohmanh nih an theihpiak ve lai lo."},"14":{"text":"A thli tein pekmi laksawng nih thinhunnak kha a damter, puan tangin pekmi nawhthuh nih thinlinhnak ṭhawngpi kha a daihter."},"15":{"text":"Bia cu ding tein ceih a si tikah miding mi hna caah lawmhnak a si, sihmanhsehlaw thil ṭhalo tuahtu hna caah cun vansang auhnak a si."},"16":{"text":"Hngalhthiamnak lam zul loin a pialmi cu thihnak nih a bawh ko."},"17":{"text":"Nuamhnak a duhmi cu misifak a si lai, zu le sa a duhmi cu a rum bal lai lo."},"18":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih miṭha hna cungah temhnak tlunter an timhmi kha, anmah cung lila ah an tlunter tawn."},"19":{"text":"Nu phunciar sik duh he um nakcun, thetse ram i va um ziar khi a ṭha deuh."},"20":{"text":"Mifim umnak ah cun ro le rah kha a tang, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun nih cun a sawksam dih."},"21":{"text":"Dinnak le zaangfahnak zulh aa zuammi nih cun Nunnak le upatnak a hmuh lai."},"22":{"text":"A fimmi ralbawi nih cun miṭhawng hna khuapi kha a lak khawh i An i bochanmi ralhruang kha a chimh khawh."},"23":{"text":"A ka le a lei aa veng khomi cu harnak chungin aa veng khomi a si."},"24":{"text":"Aa porhlaw i a ruam a kai i ninghngal in mi zei ah a rel lomi cu a min ah “Nihsawhtu” ti a si."},"25":{"text":"Rianṭuan zuam loin a ummi mithathu cu amahle amah kha aa that ko."},"26":{"text":"Chun nitlak in a ruahmi cu zei khi dah hei ngei ning law ti lawng khi a si ko. Sihmanhsehlaw miding nih cun mi kha a pek hna i sianh loin a um hna lo."},"27":{"text":"Miṭhalo raithawinak cu Bawipa, caah fihnung a si, Tinhmi ṭhalo he a rak put ahcun zeitluk in dik fihnung a si chinchin."},"28":{"text":"Tehte deu cu a rawk lai, Sihmanhsehlaw thil ṭha tein a ruat dildelmi pa bia cu cohlanpiak a si lai."},"29":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih cun miralṭha hmai aa putter, Sihmanhsehlaw miding nih cun cun amah le amah kha aa zum ko."},"30":{"text":"Fimnak siseh, hngalhnak siseh, chunglei thil purh khawhnak siseh, Bawipa hmaiah cun zeihmanh an si lo."},"31":{"text":"Raltuknak ni caah rangtum cu timh a si, Sihmanhsehlaw teinak cu Bawipa sinin a rami a si."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Min ṭhat maw chawva tampi dah naa thim lai, ti na si ahcun, min ṭhat kha vaa thim deuh."},"2":{"text":"Mirum le misifak hna cu an i dang lo zeicahtiah Bawipa sermi cio an si."},"3":{"text":"Mifim nih cun harnak a rat kha a hmuh tikah hrial khawhnak aa zuam, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun a pahchih thluahmah ko i a hnuah aa ngaichih."},"4":{"text":"Bawipa kha ṭih, mi toiah i dor law rumnak le upatnak le nunsaunak kha na hmuh lai."},"5":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi hna lam ah cun hling le rap an um; aa ralringmi nih cun a hrial in a hrial hna."},"6":{"text":"A zulh awk a simi lam kha ngakchia cu cawnpiak law, a upat tikah mah cucu a pialtak ti lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Mirum nih misifak kha an uk hna, cawitu cu coihtu sal a si."},"8":{"text":"Dinlonak thlaici kha na tuh ahcun harnak kha na zun lai i na rian theitlai cu fungfek kha a si lai."},"9":{"text":"Siannak lungthin a ngeimi cu thlua a chuak lai, zeicahtiah a rawl kha sifakmi a hrawm hna."},"10":{"text":"Mi lungpuam kha dawi u law rem lonak a lo lai, siknak le holh ṭhalo a dong lai."},"11":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu faknak in na hawikom ah na ser khawh lai, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih lungthiangmi kha a duh hna."},"12":{"text":"Lihchimmi bia kha lih an si tiah Bawipa nih a langhternak thawngin biatak cu him tein a kilven."},"13":{"text":"Mithathu cu inn ah aa benh ko, lengah ka chuah ahcun chiandeih nih a ka seh lai, a ti."},"14":{"text":"Va cungin pa aa duhmi bia cu khor thuk bantuk a si, Bawipa nih chiat a serhmi hna cu cuka ah cun an tla lai."},"15":{"text":"Ngakchia nih hin hruhnak thil le thil ṭhalo hi an tuah tawn phung a si, Sihmanhsehlaw chimhhrinhnak fung nih cun ṭha deuh in a cawnpiak hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Sifak mi hrem cu miaknak a si sawk ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw mirum sin, i ser cu sifahnak a si."},"17":{"text":"Na hna chi law mifim mi bia hi kan cawnpiak lai. Cun na lungthin cu ka fimnak na hmuh nakhnga caah hmang tuah;","title":"Nunchimhnak le Ralrin Peknak Bia Sawm Thum"},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah na lung chung i chiah cu a nuammi a si lai i Na duh chel paoh ah khan na vun lak khawh hna lai."},"19":{"text":"Bawipa kha i bochan tiah nangmah cu kan duh caah Nihin ah hin hi thil hna hi nangmah ca ṭhatnak ding caah kan chimh."},"20":{"text":"Hika ah hin nangmah caah fimnak bia sawm thum kan ṭialpiak, hi bia hna cu hngalhnak in a khatmi le lungthin cheuhnak ṭha in a khatmi an si."},"21":{"text":"Cu bia hna nih cun biatak kha zeidah a si taktak ti kha an in cawnpiak lai i nangmah an fialtupa sinah khan ahmaanmi bia cu na kirpi ṭhan khawh lai."},"22":{"text":"Sifakmi cu sifak an si ruangah zeitikhmanh ah va ramh hna hlah, Retheimi zong zung chungah va hrial hlah."},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah annih cu Bawipa nih a dirpi hna lai i anmah an nunnak ca i a simi an thilri a lakpiaktu hna kha an thilri a chuh ve hna lai."},"24":{"text":"Thinhun a hmang lengmangmi cu va kom hlah, thin tawimi zong va kom hlah,"},"25":{"text":"A lam kha naa cawn sual lai i nangmah le nangmah rap ah naa foih lai."},"26":{"text":"Mi leiba ruangah aamah vaa khang hlah,"},"27":{"text":"Na cham khawh lo sual ahcun na ihkhun zong an in lakpiak lai."},"28":{"text":"Nan pupa hna nih an rak chiahmi ramri tung kha ṭhial hna hlah."},"29":{"text":"Amah a rian ah a thiammipa cu siangpahrang hna hmaiah a dirmi a si lai, mi sawhsawh hna hmai men ah a dirmi a si lai lo."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Uktu bawi hna he rawl ei ah na ṭhut tikah, aho an si kha ṭha tein va ruat."},"2":{"text":"Cun pawkaumi na si ahcun na or kha i sum."},"3":{"text":"An in pekmi rawl thawthaw kha hakkau tuk in ei hna hlah, Zeicahtiah hlen an in timh a si kho ko."},"4":{"text":"Rumnak hmuh awkah i hre tuk hlah, ngol awkah fimnak a za ngei tuah."},"5":{"text":"Na tangka cu mitṭhep ah an lo kho ko, Thla kha i serh duak in mupi bangin an zuang kho ko."},"6":{"text":"A khiar mipa zanriah cu va ei hlah, a rawl thawthaw zong kha na mit va thi hna hlah;"},"7":{"text":"“Ei tuah hen, ding tuah hen,” an ti lai, Sihmanhsehlaw cucu a chim duh taktakmi a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Amah cu na hrom ah sam bantuk ah a cang lai i Na eimi vialte kha na luak dih lai i na faknak bia vialte cu santlailo ah a cang lai."},"9":{"text":"Mihrut theihhngan ah cun bia va chim len hlah, Fimnak bia na chimmi cu zeihmanh ah a rel ṭung lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Hlanlio ramri tung kha ṭhial hna hlah, Ngakṭah kha an lo chut hna hlah;"},"11":{"text":"Zeicahtiah annih nih a ṭhawngmi hupphengtu an ngei i Amah nih cun nangmah kha taza an in cuai tikah an bia a chimpiak hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Na saya nih an cawnpiakmi kha ṭha tein ngai law Fimnak kha naa lak khawh chungin i lak tuah."},"13":{"text":"Ngakchia chimhhrin cu i sum hlah, fung in na tuk ahcun a thi lai lo,"},"14":{"text":"Bia ngaingai ti ahcun, Sheol chungin na khamh a si lai."},"15":{"text":"Ka fapa mifim na si ahcun keimah zong ka lung aa lawm lai."},"16":{"text":"Fimnak bia na chim kha ka theih tikah keimah zong ka rak i lawm ngaingai lai."},"17":{"text":"Misual kha tluk i zuam hna hlah, nifate in Bawipa a ṭihmi bel kha hngar ko hna;"},"18":{"text":"Cu bantukin na tuah ahcun hmailei ah ceunak na hmuh lai i na nun khua zong a sau lai."},"19":{"text":"Ka fapa, ngai law fim tuah, ahmaanmi lam zulh awk kha i sehchih tuah."},"20":{"text":"Zuri hna he i kom hlah, sarammi hna he zong i kom hlah;"},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah zurimi le sarammi cu sifahnak an phan lai, ei le ih lawng na rianh ahcun puanchia he na vak tuan ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Nangmah an hringtu na pa kha a bia va ngai, na nu kha a tar tikah va serhsat hlah."},"23":{"text":"Biatak kha vaa cawk law zuar ti hlah, fimnak, cawnpiaknak le hngalhthiamnak kha i cawk hna."},"24":{"text":"Miṭha mi hna an pa cu aa lawm ngaingai lai; fapa fim a hringmi pa cu a fapa hna cungah khan aa lawm lai."},"25":{"text":"Na nu le na pa cu lawmhter hna, nangmah an hringtu cu lawm tein um seh."},"26":{"text":"Ka fapa, ka bia cu i chingchiah hna law ka nunning hi i zohchunh tuah."},"27":{"text":"Hlawhhlangnu cu khor thuk a si, ralṭha nu cu a bimi tikhor a si."},"28":{"text":"Mifir bangin mi a bawh hna i a va kha pa pakhat hnu pakhat sinah a rawi lengmang."},"29":{"text":"Ahodah chimpit vansang in a um tawn? Ahodah a ngaih a chia tawn? Ahodah mi he aa si tawn? Ahodah bia a ngei tawn? Ahodah zei ruang lo ah hma a ing tawn? Ahodah mit sen remrum in a um tawn?"},"30":{"text":"Zu a camhmi, rim thar he cawhmi zureu a hneksak lengmangmi kha an si."},"31":{"text":"Hrai chungah sen kirker tein a um i tleu dildel tein a lang i vun dolh ah nal ngaiin lanh dawh a simi zu khi va zoh hlah."},"32":{"text":"A donghnak ah cun rul bantukin mi a cu i ping-er sivai bantukin mi a henh."},"33":{"text":"Khi tikah na mit nih thil khuaruahhar a hmuh hna lai i. Fiang tein khua na ruat kho lai lo i aa ningcang loin bia na chim lai."},"34":{"text":"Rili ah lawngin a kal i a rimi bantukin na um lai i aa hnin lengmangmi lawng puanzar ah khin i awk law cu ko cu na lo lai."},"35":{"text":"“An ka tuk an ka den i a si ṭheo lai, sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh ka hngal lo, Zeicahdah kaa hlauh khawh lo ee? Din ṭhan ka herh rih i a si ko hi ta,” na ti lai."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna tluk kha i zuam hlah, annih cu hawikom i i ser zong kha i zuam hlah."},"2":{"text":"Zeicahtiah annih an ruahmi cu zaang-ennak lawng kha a si i an kaa an an paoh ahcun pakhatkhat cungah harnak an tlunter zungzal."},"3":{"text":"Fimnak nih inn cu a sak, hngalhthiamnak nih a fehter;"},"4":{"text":"Hngalhnak nih a khaan vialte hna cu a sungmi le aa dawhmi thilri in a khahter."},"5":{"text":"Mifim cu miṭhawng nakin a ṭhawng deuh, hngalhnak a ngeimi cu thazang a ngeimi nakin a ṭhawng deuh;"},"6":{"text":"Zeicahtiah ral cu ṭha tein khuakhannak thawngin tei a si i saupi timhtuahnak theitlai cu teinak a si."},"7":{"text":"Fimnak hi mihrut caah cun a sang tuk i a hngalh khawhmi a si lo, thil pipa ceih tikah zeihmanh chim awk a hngal lo."},"8":{"text":"Ṭhatlo tuahnak khua a khang lengmangtu cu a min ah Harnak Sertu ti a si lai,"},"9":{"text":"Mihrut nih khua an khanmi cu sualnak kha a si tawn i mi nihsawh a hmangmi cu huatnak kha an tong zungzal."},"10":{"text":"Harnak caan i na der a si ahcun na der taktak a si."},"11":{"text":"Thah awk i an kalpi liomi hna cu va chanh hna, Thah awk i an hnuhchih lenmi hna cu va khamh hna."},"12":{"text":"Naa thawh i, “Hi pa hi ka rak hngalh bal ṭung lo,” na ti ahcun, na lungthin a hngaltu Pathian nih khan an chingchiah lai. Nangmah an zohkhenhtu Pathian nih a hngalh kha hngal ko law mi cu an tuahning khan a cham cio ko hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Ka fapa, khuaihliti cu ei tuah, a thaw; a thlar chungin a tlami khuaihliti cu na lei cungah a thlum bangin"},"14":{"text":"Fimnak le hngalhnak cu na nunnak caah an ṭha. cucu na ngeih hna ahcun hmailei ah ceunak na hmu lai i na nunkhua a sau lai."},"15":{"text":"Miṭha mi cu a inn ah miṭhalo nih an bawh bangin va bawh hlah, a lo zong kha va chut hlah;"},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah miṭha mi cu voi sarih tiang tlu hmanh seh law a tho ṭhan zau lai, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo cu vanchiatnak nih a hrawh hna."},"17":{"text":"Na ral kha a tluk tikah i lawm hlah, a rilh tikah na di riam hlah,"},"18":{"text":"Cu bantukin na um ahcun Bawipa nih a hngalh lai i na cungah a lung aa lawm lai lo i amah kha dantatnak in a luatter sual lai."},"19":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak tuahtu hna kha zuam hna hlah, miṭhalo kha tluk i tim hna hlah;"},"20":{"text":"Zeicahtiah miṭhalo cu i ruahchanmi hmailei caan an ngei lo i an meiinn kha hmih an si lai."},"21":{"text":"Ka fapa, Bawipa le siangpahrang cu ṭih hna, anmah a dohtu hna he khan i kom hlah;"},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah cu bantuk mi hna cu chikkhatte ah an rawk kho i Annih nih zei bantuk rawhnak dah an chuahter lai kha aho nih dah a hngalh lai."},"23":{"text":"Mah hihi mifim mi hna bia a dang an si rih: biaceih i duhdanh ngeih cu a ṭha lo,"},"24":{"text":"A sual komi, a sual lo, tiah a titu biaceihtu bawi cu miphun zakip nih chiat an serh i mi vialte nih an huat."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo sual a phawtu biaceihtu bawi hna cu khua awng an tong lai i an cungah thluachuahnak ṭha a um lai."},"26":{"text":"Lihchim lo tein bia i leh cu hawikom ṭha taktak sinak langhnak a si."},"27":{"text":"Lenglei thil vialte kha ṭha tein tim dih hmasa hna, Cun na lo kha sersiam hna law cu hnuah cun nupi ṭhit le innlo khuasak tintuk cu a si lai."},"28":{"text":"Zei ruang setsai lo ah na innpa cungah tehte va si hlah, Amah kong ah thil a ping i a kalter khotu ding bia zong va chim hlah."},"29":{"text":"“Ka cungah a tuah bantukin ka tuah ve lai, a tuahmi kha ka lehrulh ve lai,” ti hlah."},"30":{"text":"Mizaangthupa lo kha ka tan i ruahnak ruahnak a ngei lomipa mitsur dum kha ka pal,"},"31":{"text":"Zohhmanh, hling nih a zual dih i vawlei cu thahau nih a khuh dih, a kulhnak lung hau cu an cim dih."},"32":{"text":"Cun ṭha tein cucu ka zoh i khua ka ruat i hi cawnpiaknak hi kaa hmuh:"},"33":{"text":"Cu cawnpiaknak kaa hmuhmi cu hihi a si: “Tlawm tein it ko rih ning, tlawm tein i hngilh ko rih ning, tlawm tein ka kut cu i din ko rih seh ti chungah hin,","ref":"Phut 6.9-11"},"34":{"text":"Sifahnak cu mifir bantuk le herhbaunak cu hriam aa putmi miramhtu bangin na cungah a phan lai.”"}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi zong hi Solomon phungthluk bia, Judah siangpahrang Hezekiah mi hna nih an ṭial chinmi cu an si.","title":"Ziaza Kong Cawnpiaknak le Tahchunhnak"},"2":{"text":"Pathian nih thil a thuh hi a sunparnak a si; Sihmanhsehlaw siangpahrang hna sunparnak tu cu thil fianter hi a si."},"3":{"text":"San leiah van, thuh leiah rili, cu bantuk cun siangpahrang lungthin cu purh khawh lo a si."},"4":{"text":"Ngun kha a ek hlonh law cu tikah zungthiam nih thil dawh ah a ser lai;"},"5":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmaika in miṭhalo cu ṭhial hna u law a bawiṭhutdan cu dinnak in a fek lai."},"6":{"text":"Siangpahrang hmaika ah vaa hmanh len hlah, Mi ngan hna sin zongah va ṭhu hlah;","ref":"Luk 14.8-10"},"7":{"text":"Zeicahtiah “Hika ah hin hung kai,” ti cu “Nangmah nakin a ngan deuhmi kha ṭhutnak kian tuah,” ti nakin a ṭha deuh."},"8":{"text":"Na mit nih a hmuhmi kha khulrang in zung ah chuahpi hlah, Zeicahtiah tehte dang nih na palhnak kha a hnuah a langhter khawh ahcun zeitindah na um lai?"},"9":{"text":"Na innpa he nan ruahnak aa dan ahcun cucu nanmah pahnih i ceih hmasa u, Sihmanhsehlaw midang biathli bel kha phuang hlah;"},"10":{"text":"Na phuan ahcun a theih tikah taza an cuai lai i Naa chuahsualnak kha let ṭhan khawh a si ti lai lo."},"11":{"text":"A caan hmaante ah chimmi bia fang bia khat cu ngun bawm chung i sui theitlai bantuk a si."},"12":{"text":"Chimhringtu a fimmi cu, a bia ngaih a duhmi caah cun, Sui kutdonghrolh le sui hlawn bantuk a si."},"13":{"text":"Zumh awk tlak a simi lamkaltu cu, a thlahtu hna caah, facang ṭuan caan i a kikmi hawhra bantuk a si, A bawile lungthin kha a hrimhter."},"14":{"text":"Laksawng kan pek lai a ti lengmang i a pe taktak ṭung lomi cu Ruahti pawi lo khuadawm le thli bantuk a si."},"15":{"text":"Thinfualnak in uktu bawi cu lem khawh a si lai, Awka nem nih ruh hmanh a khiah khawh."},"16":{"text":"Khuaihliti kha tam tuk in ei hlah, na luak sual lai."},"17":{"text":"Na innpa inn ah leng tuk hlah, na nor lai i an huat sual lai."},"18":{"text":"A hawikom cungah a hmaan lomi tehte a simi cu thingtan le vainam le a harmi cantiang bantuk a si."},"19":{"text":"Harnak caan i zumhtlak lomi zumh cu, ha ṭhalo in rawl khai bantuk le a fakmi ke in kal i zuam bantuk a si."},"20":{"text":"Ngaih a chiami caah cun hlasak thiam bik hna hmanh khi Khuasik ni i puan i phoih bantuk le hma i a thormi thuh bantuk a si."},"21":{"text":"Na ral kha a rawl a ṭam ahcun ei awk rawl va pe, A ti a hal ahcun din awk ti va pe;","ref":"Rom 12.20"},"22":{"text":"Cu ti na tuah ahcun a lu cungah meiṭil kha na pumh hna a si lai i Bawipa nih nangmah cu an rulh lai."},"23":{"text":"Chaklei thli nih ruah a ratpi, congoihnak nih thinhunnak a chuahpi."},"24":{"text":"Mi sik duh nupi he innpi i hrawm nakcun, Inncung a ken ken khatte i um a ṭha deuh."},"25":{"text":"Ram hla piin theihmi thawngṭha cu, na ti a hal, na dang a car i tikik na vun din bantuk khi a si."},"26":{"text":"Miṭhalo mi lam a piantu miding cu, a nawimi tikhor bantuk, a thurmi tiput bantuk a si."},"27":{"text":"Khuaihliti tam tuk ei cu a ṭha lo, cu bantukin mi sinin thangṭhatnak tam tuk hmuh i timh cu thilrit a si."},"28":{"text":"A thin aa sum kho lomi cu, Baohmi khua, kulhnak vampang a ngei ti lomi bantuk a si."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ṭhal caan i hawhra bantuk le rawlṭuan caan i ruah bantukin, upatnak cu mihrut caah cun aa tlak lo."},"2":{"text":"Hram ngei loin chimmi chiatserhnak cu, aa chawk lengmangmi pithlung bantuk le a zuang lengmangmi vanva bantuk a si, chiatserhmi kha a futhnawh kho lo."},"3":{"text":"Tuknak fung cu rang caah a si, chak cu laa caah a si, fungfek cu mihrut keng caah a si."},"4":{"text":"Mihrut cu a hruhning in let hlah, amah bantuk na si ve sual lai."},"5":{"text":"Mihrut cu a hruhnak nih hmuh awkah aa tlakning in let tuah, cu ti a si lo ahcun, ka fim tiah aa ruat sual lai."},"6":{"text":"Mihrut kha lamkal a fialtu cu amah ke aa tanmi bantuk a si, harnak kha aa sawm a si ko."},"7":{"text":"Phungthluk bia cu mihrut kaa chungah cun, kebeimi ke aa thlai sawhsawh bantukin aa thlai sawhsawh ko."},"8":{"text":"Mihrut kha upatnak pek cu, chai i lungpum tete ṭem chih bantuk khi a si ko."},"9":{"text":"Mihrut nih phungthluk bia a vun lak i a chim ve cu, Zuri nih a kut i a chuntu hling coih aa zuam bantuk khi a si."},"10":{"text":"Mihrut siseh, zuri siseh, rianṭuan ah aa sawmmi cu, A rami paoh a rak kap tawntu thalkah thiam bantuk a si."},"11":{"text":"A hruhnak a nolh ṭhan lengmangmi mihrut cu, A luak a kirhnawh ṭhantu uico bantuk a si."},"12":{"text":"Amah aa hmuhnak ah ka fim aa timi nakcun, mihrut caah ruahchannak a um deuh."},"13":{"text":"Mithathu cu zeicahdah a inn in chuah a duh lo? Zeidah a ṭihmi an si? Chiandeih an si maw?"},"14":{"text":"Innka nih a kapza ah aa mer lengmang bantukin mithathu zong a ihkhun cungah aa let lengmang ve."},"15":{"text":"Mithathu nih cun a kut kha kheng chungah a hnim, a kaa i hun i tuh zong kha a zuam lo."},"16":{"text":"Fim tein bia lehnak a chim khomi minung pasarih nakin, Mithathu cu amah aa ruahnak ahcun a fim deuh."},"17":{"text":"Aa thlak ve awk a si lomi siknak ah aa thlakmi cu a kal liomi uico a hnakhaw in a tlaimi bantuk a si."},"18":{"text":"Mi kha a hleng i, “Kan capo ko hen cu,” a timi cu, mei alh tom le thal le thihnak hriamnam hna he lente aa celhmi mimolh bantuk a si.","merge":"19"},"20":{"text":"Thing a um lo ahcun mei cu a mit, a thli tein a chim depmaptu um lonak hmun ah cun siknak a dai."},"21":{"text":"Meihol cu meiṭil a vaamtertu le thing cu mei a nuntertu a si bantukin, Hnahnawhnak chuahtertu cu rem lonak mei kautu a si."},"22":{"text":"Din tein bia a chim depmaptu bia cu rawl thaw bantuk a si, pum chung chungchin ah khan a lut kho."},"23":{"text":"Hmurka thlum i lungthin ṭha ṭung lo cu, tlak-um cung i nalhmi sinal bantuk a si."},"24":{"text":"Na ral nih cun a kaa cun na thangṭhatnak a chim ko lai. sihmanhsehlaw a lung chung cun hlennak aa pawi."},"25":{"text":"Cu pa nih cun, ṭha ngaiin bia a chim tikah zum hlah, zeicahtiah a lung chungah cun fihnungmi thil pasarih an um."},"26":{"text":"A lung chung i huatnak a ummi cu hlennak in a thup lai nain a ṭhat lonak cu zapi pumhnak ah a lang lai."},"27":{"text":"Midang tlaknak caah khor a comi cu cuka ah cun amah a tla lai. Midang nenhnak caah lung a hriltu cu lung nih cun amah cu a nenh lai."},"28":{"text":"Lihchim hmangmi lei nih cun a sual lomi kha a sual a lawhter hna, Nalbia nih cun rawhralnak lawng kha a chuahpi."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Thaizing kong kha i porhlaw hlah, cu ni nih zei a chuahpi lai kha na hngal lo.","ref":"Jei 4.13-16"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah kaa nih si loin midang tu nih in thangṭhat deuh hna seh, nangmah hmur nih si loin khual tu nih in thangṭhat deuh hna seh."},"3":{"text":"Lung hi a rit i thetse zong hi a khing a rit ko, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih hnahnawhnak an chuahpimi cu cu hna pahnih nakcun a rit deuh."},"4":{"text":"Thinhunnak hi a puar i thinlinhnak hi a hrang ko, sihmanhsehlaw nahchuahnak he cun tahchunh awk tlak hmanh an si lo."},"5":{"text":"Thuhmi dawtnak nakin lenglang sik a ṭha deuh."},"6":{"text":"Kan hawikom nih cun an kan hliam sual hmanh ah kan ca i ṭhatnak an duh ruangah a si, sihmanhsehlaw ral nih an kan hnamh cu leirawi duh ah a si."},"7":{"text":"A vuai cangmi nih cun khuaihliti kha a fih, sihmanhsehlaw a rawl a ṭammi caah cun a kha mi thil hmanh kha an thlum dih."},"8":{"text":"A inn in a tlaumipa cu a bu in a tlaumi va bantuk a si."},"9":{"text":"Chiti le zihmui nih lung an lawmhter, sihmanhsehlaw harnak nih lungthin kha a cheu a hmal dih tawn."},"10":{"text":"Na hawikom siseh, na pa hawikom siseh, hlaw hna hlah; na vanchiat ni ah na unaupa kha bawmh hal hlah, lam hlat i a ummi unau nakin lamnai i a ummi innpa nih an bawmh khawh deuh lai."},"11":{"text":"Ka fapa, fim law ka lung ka lawmhter tuah, cuticun a ka soitu kha ka leh khawh hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Mifim nih cun harnak a rat kha a hmuh tikah hrial khawh aa zuam, sihmanhsehlaw mihrut nih cun a pahchih thluahmah ko i a hnuah aa ngaihchih."},"13":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih khual pakhatkhat caah biahrennak a tuah tikah a puan kha va tlai, cun cu puan cu hngalh lomipa ca aamahkhannak caah khan va tlai ko."},"14":{"text":"Zingka tein na thawh i na innpa kha aw thang tuk in thluachuahnak na pek ahcun, chiatserhnak bantuk ah an relpiak sual lai."},"15":{"text":"Ruah it ni i a tla thliahmah lengmangmi ruah le nu phunciar cu ang khat an si."},"16":{"text":"Cu nu kham timh cu thli kham timh bantuk a si, orhlei kut in chiti hum bantuk a si."},"17":{"text":"Thir nih thir a harter, mi zong nih midang fimnak kha a harter ve."},"18":{"text":"Theipi kung a zohkhenhtu nih a thei a ei lai. A bawipa a kilvengtu nih upatnak a hmuh lai."},"19":{"text":"Ti chungah hmai cu hmai in a langh bantukin, Minung cu a lungthin nih khan zei bantuk mi dah a si ti kha a langhter."},"20":{"text":"Sheol le Abaddon cu zeitikhmanh ah an vuai bal lo. Minung mit zong zeitikhmanh ah a vuai bal ve lo."},"21":{"text":"Titnak um cu ngun caah a si, somei cu sui caah a si, Cu bantukin mi cu thangṭhatnak a hmuhmi in hneksak a si lai."},"22":{"text":"Mihrut cu sum ah sumkhal in su hmanh law a hruhnak cu a thlah hlei lai lo."},"23":{"text":"Na tuurun an umtuning kha ṭha tein hngal law na cawrun kha ṭha tein zohkhenh hna;"},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah rumnak hi zungzal in a hmun lo i Bawi luchin zong hi chan vialte tiangin a hmun kho lai lo."},"25":{"text":"Ram cu an hung thi i an hung lo, ramhno cu an hung corh, Cun tlang cung ram hna cu pumh an si tikah,"},"26":{"text":"Tuufa nih na hnipuan ca kha an in rin lai i meheh nih lo man ca kha an in rin lai;"},"27":{"text":"Cun na rawl caah a za ding le na innchungkhar hna rawl caah le na ngaknu hna caah a za ding meheh hnuk cu a um lai."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu ahohmanh nih dawi loin an zam, sihmanhsehlaw miding mi cu chiandeih bantukin an ral a ṭha.","title":"Miṭhalo le Miding"},"2":{"text":"Ram cu a fimmi le khuaruah a thiammi hruaitu a ngeih hna tikah saupi a dir kho, sihmanhsehlaw uktu kha atu le atu an i thlen lengmang cu ram kha a sual caah a si."},"3":{"text":"Misifak a hremtu hna bawi cu, rawl zeihmanh a ngan lotu ruah bantuk a si."},"4":{"text":"Phung a zul lomi nih cun miṭhalo kha an thangṭhat hna, sihmanhsehlaw phung kha a zulmi nih cun an doh hna."},"5":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih biading hi zeidah a si kha an hngal lo, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa a kawlmi hna nih cun tling tein an hngalh cikcek."},"6":{"text":"Sifak te i nun i lihchim lo tein um hi lihchim i rum nakin a ṭha deuh."},"7":{"text":"Phungbia a zulmi cu fapa fim a si, sihmanhsehlaw ei din leiah sumnak a ngei lomi hna hawikom a simi cu a pa caah ningzahnak a si."},"8":{"text":"A miak le a karh in a rumnak a chap chintu nih, misifak hna cung i zaangfahnak a ngeimi pa caah khan a khon a si."},"9":{"text":"Phungbia kha ngai duh loin a mertakmi cu a thlacamnak hmanh kha fihnung a si."},"10":{"text":"Miding mi kha ṭhat lonak lei kal awkah a lemtu cu, amah nih a cawhmi khor lila ah khan a tla lai; Lihchim lomi nih cun a ṭhami ro kha a hmuh lai i Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih cun zeihmanh an hmu lai lo."},"11":{"text":"Mirum nih cun ka fim tiah an i ruat zungzal, sihmanhsehlaw hngalhthiamnak a ngeimi misifak nih khan anmah nakin a hngalh deuh."},"12":{"text":"Miding mi nih uknak an co tikah conglawmhnak tampi a um, sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo an kai tikah mi cu an i thup dih."},"13":{"text":"A palhnak kha a thupmi cu khua-awng a tong lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw a phuang i a hlawmi nih cun zaangfahnak a hmuh lai."},"14":{"text":"Bawipa a ṭih zungzalmi cu mi thluachuak an si, sihmanhsehlaw a lung a hahtermi cu vanchiatnak chungah an tla lai."},"15":{"text":"Uktu ṭhalo cu misifak hna caah, a rawl a ṭammi chiandeih le a ti a halmi vom bantuk a si."},"16":{"text":"Thil ruahning a thiam lomi uktu cu mihremtu a si tawn, ai hmanh seh law dinlonak kha a huami cu a chan a sau tawn."},"17":{"text":"Mi thisen a chuahtu cu tlaihnak luatnak caah tikhor chung hmanh ah khan a zuang lai."},"18":{"text":"Ningcang tein khua a sami cu him tein an um lai, sihmanhsehlaw ningcang loin khua a sami cu lam khatkhat in a sung ṭhiamṭhiam lai."},"19":{"text":"A vawlei ṭha tein a thlomi cu rawl tampi a ngei lai, sihmanhsehlaw santlailo rian pakpalawng a dawi lengmangmi cu a si a fak lai."},"20":{"text":"Zumh awk tlakmi cu thluachuahnak tampi a hmu lai, sihmanhsehlaw khulrang in rum aa zuammi cu dantatnak hmu loin a um lai lo."},"21":{"text":"Duhdanh ngeih hi a ṭha lo, sihmanhsehlaw changreu tlang khat ruangah mi nih ṭhat lonak kha an tuah ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Mikhiar nih cun khulrang in rum aa hnawh, sihmanhsehlaw herhbaunak nih a ka tlunh lai ti kha a hngal lo."},"23":{"text":"A lei in mi a fakmi nakin a situ nih khan hmailei ah cun duhdawtnak a hmuh deuh lai."},"24":{"text":"Nu le pa thil fir cu a poi lo a timi cu mifir taktak he zeihmanh an i dannak a um lo."},"25":{"text":"Hakkauhnak nih cun rem lonak lawng kha a chuahter ko, cucaah Bawipa i bochan cu a ṭha deuh suaumau."},"26":{"text":"Mah ruahnak i rinh cu hruh a si, sihmanhsehlaw fimnak lam a zulmi cu him tein a lan ko lai."},"27":{"text":"Sifakmi a pechan lengmangmi cu a chambau bal lai lo, sihmanhsehlaw a mit a chinhkanhtu hna cu chiatserhnak tampi a hmu lai."},"28":{"text":"Miṭhalo nih uknak an tlaih tikah mi cu an i thup dih, sihmanhsehlaw an loh tikah miding mi nih khan uknak cu an co ve."}}},"29":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu le atu chimhhrin a si ko nain a lung a ṭhawng rih komi cu, Damh khawh ti loin chikkhatte ah a kiak lai."},"2":{"text":"Miding mi hna cu nawl ngeimi an si tikah mi cu an i lawm, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo hna kha uktu an si tikah mi cu an hrum tawn."},"3":{"text":"Fimnak a duhmi nih a pa cu a lawmhter, Sihmanhsehlaw hlawhhlangnu a kommi nih cun a chaw kha a hlohlak tawn."},"4":{"text":"Dinnak thawngin siangpahrang nih ram cu a fehter, Sihmanhsehlaw hneknak in tangka hmuhnak kha a ruah tikah a ram cu a rawk tawn."},"5":{"text":"A innpa a fakmi cu a ke caah sur rap a chiahpiak a si."},"6":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu amah sualnak nih khan a foih, Sihmanhsehlaw miding cu an i lawm i an luat."},"7":{"text":"Miṭha nih cun, sifakmi hna nih zeidah an covo si awk a si ti kha a hngalh, Sihmanhsehlaw miṭhalo nih cun cu bantuk zawnruahnak cu a hngal lo."},"8":{"text":"Mi nihsawh hmangmi nih khua chungah mei an thawhter tawn, Sihmanhsehlaw mifim mi nih cun mi thinlinhnak kha an daihter."},"9":{"text":"Mifim nih mihrut kha taza a cuai ahcun, Mihrut cu a thin lawng a hung lai i a nih lawng a chuak men lai i daihnak zeihmanh a um hlei lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Thisen chuah a duhmi hna nih cun a sual lomi kha an huat, Sihmanhsehlaw miding mi nih cun a nunnak kha an humhakpiak."},"11":{"text":"Mihrut nih cun a thinhunnak kha a langhter, Sihmanhsehlaw mifim nih cun dai tein a um i aa sum."},"12":{"text":"Uktu nih lihbia kha a ngaih ahcun, a kut toi ummi bawi vialte kha miṭhalo an si lai."},"13":{"text":"Misifak le anmah a hremtu hna nih khan aa khat in an ngeihmi cu hihi a si: Bawipa nih an pahnih in mit a pek veve hna."},"14":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih misifak hna bia zong kha ruannak in a ceih ahcun a bawi ṭhutdan cu zungzal in a hmun lai."},"15":{"text":"Fungfek le chimhhrinnak nih fimnak an pek, sihmanhsehlaw ngakchia anmah duh in thlahdorhmi nih cun an nule kha ningzahnak an phorh hna."},"16":{"text":"Miṭhalo hna nawl ngeitu an si tikah sualnak a karh, sihmanhsehlaw an tluk kha miding mi hna nih cun an hmuh lai."},"17":{"text":"Na fapa cu chimhring law hnangamnak an pek lai; na lung an lawmhter lai."},"18":{"text":"Pathian nih a hruai lomi miphun cu ningcang loin khua an sa. Pathian nawlbia a zulmi cu lunglawmmi an si."},"19":{"text":"Bia lawngin sinum cu nunchimh khawh a si lo, a hngal ko nain zei ah a rel lai lo."},"20":{"text":"Ruah hmasa loin bia a chim zauzaumi nakcun, mihrut caah ruahchannak a um deuh."},"21":{"text":"Na sinum kha a ngakchiat lio in a duhmi paoh na pek ahcun ni khatkhat cu nangmah thil kha an chuh dih te ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Thin a tawimi nih rem lonak an chuahter, Thin aa sum lomi nih palhnak an tuah zungzal tawn."},"23":{"text":"Mi cu aa porhlawtnak nih tangah a ṭhumh lai, sihmanhsehlaw toi dornak lungthin a ngeimi cu upatnak a hmu lai."},"24":{"text":"Mifir hawikom a simi cu amah le amah kha a ral cu a si ko, a hmaanmi kha a chim ahcun dantatnak a hmuh lai, a chim lo ahcun Pathian nih chiat a serh lai."},"25":{"text":"Midang nih zeitindah an ka ruah hnga ti hi thil ṭihnung a si, sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa i bochan hi himnak a si."},"26":{"text":"Mi kip nih uktu bawi duhdawtnak hmuh kha an duh, Sihmanhsehlaw mi nih biading cu Bawipa sin lawngin an hmuh."},"27":{"text":"Miding mi nih miding lomi kha an huat hna, miṭhalo nih miding mi kha an huat ve hna."}}},"30":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Massa khuami Jakeh fapa Agur bia: Hi pa bia cu hitin a si: Ka re a thei tuk, maw Pathian, ka re a thei tuk i ka ba tuk cang;","title":"Agur Bia"},"2":{"text":"Holh thiam lomi saram men ka si ko, minung hmanh ka si lo; minung nih hngalhthiamnak an ngeihmi hi ka ngei lo."},"3":{"text":"Fimnak hi ka cawng bal lo i A Thiang Mi sinin hngalhnak zeihmanh ka hmu bal lo."},"4":{"text":"Van ah khin ahodah a hung kai i a ṭum ṭhan? Aho nih dah a kut chungah thli kha a hum hna? Aho nih dah ti kha a puan in a fun hna? Aho nih dah vawlei cu a ramri kha a ser hna? A min cu ahodah a si i a fapa min cu ahodah a si? Na hngalh ahcun chim tuah."},"5":{"text":"Pathian nih biakamnak a sermi paohpaoh cu biatak a si tiah a fiang cang; amah chung i aa dormi hna caah cun amah cu phaw a si."},"6":{"text":"A bia zeihmanh chap hlah, an sik sual lai i lihchim na sinak kha a lang sual lai."},"7":{"text":"Thil pahnih kan hal, ka thih hlanah pe loin ka um sawh hna hlah:"},"8":{"text":"Lihchim le hrokhrawl cu ka sinin lamhlapi ah ṭhial ko hna; Chamhbaunak siseh, rumnak siseh, ka pe hlah; ka ca i a herhmi rawl in ka cawm ko."},"9":{"text":"Zeicahtiah tam tuk ka ngeih ahcun kan hlawt sual lai i, “ Bawipa cu aho hen dah a si?” ka ti sual lai; ka si a fah ahcun ka fir sual lai i ka Pathian min cu ka thurhhnawmh sual lai."},"10":{"text":"Sinum cu a bawipa sinah congoih hlah, chiat an serh sual lai i mawh na phor sual lai."},"11":{"text":"An pale kha chiat a serh i an nule kha a thangṭhat lomi an um tawn,"},"12":{"text":"Anmah an i hmuhnak ah cun a thiang i, an fihnunnak aa thianh ṭung lomi an um fawn;"},"13":{"text":"A ṭha hringhran i aa ruatmi zong an um, aize, a ṭha tuk hringhran ah khin pei an i ruah cu!"},"14":{"text":"Sifakmi kha ṭam dih awkah le chambaumi kha ei dih awkah, a ha vainam a si i a khabe ah kawngthun aa bunhmi an um."},"15":{"text":"Cangvat nih fanu pahnih a ngeih hna; pakhat nih, “Ka pe,” a ti i a dang pakhat nih, “Ka pe,” tiah a ti ve. thil pathum cim hngal lo an um; thil pali “A za cang” a ti bal lomi an um:"},"16":{"text":"Cu hna cu Sheol le a cingmi chul le a ti a hal zungzalmi vawlei le “A za cang,” a ti bal lomi mei an si."},"17":{"text":"a pa kha a nihsawh i a nu kha a tar tikah zei ah a rel lomi cu, a mit kha nelrawn langak nih an khoih lai i langta nih an ei lai."},"18":{"text":"Ka caah khuaruahhar tuk a simi thil pathum an um; Ka hngalh khawh lomi thil pali an si:"},"19":{"text":"Cu hna cu van i a zuangmi mupi lam, lung cung i a kalmi rul lam, rili cung i a kalmi sangphawlawng lam le pa nih ngaknu he an kalnak lam an si."},"20":{"text":"Zumh awk tlak lomi nupi lam cu mah hihi a si: a ei i vaibar lote bangin, “Thil sual zeihmanh ka tuah lo,” a ti."},"21":{"text":"Thil pathum ruangah vawlei hi a ther tawn; thil pali hna hi, in khawh lomi an si:"},"22":{"text":"Cu hna cu sal siangpahrang ah a can le Mihrut a duhduh in ei awk a hmuh le"},"23":{"text":"Duh lomi nu nih va a ngeih le Sinum nu nih a bawinu ro a co hi an si."},"24":{"text":"Thil hme tete pali vawlei cungah hin an um, Sihmanhsehlaw cu hna cu, a fim bikmi nak hmanh in an fim deuh:"},"25":{"text":"Cu hna cu hihi an si: Hngerhte, a ṭhawngmi an si lo na i an rawl ṭhal caan i aa khonmi;"},"26":{"text":"Saveh, a der ngaimi a si ko na i lungkua chung i a inn a sami;"},"27":{"text":"Khaubawk, siangpahrang ngei a si lo na i a rualrual in a kalmi;"},"28":{"text":"Ṭekral, kut in tlaih khawh a si ko na i siangpahrang inn ah khua a sami."},"29":{"text":"Hi thil pathum hna hi an kephau ah rumra an ngei, Hi thil pali hna hi an kal ah rumra an ngei:"},"30":{"text":"Saram lak i a ṭhawng bik chiandeih, zeihmanh a ṭih lomi,"},"31":{"text":"I zum ngaiin aa chawkmi arhli, mehehtum le a mi hna hmai i aa chawkmi siangpahrang."},"32":{"text":"Na rak hruh i na rak i porhlawt i holh fihnung a rak duhmi na si ahcun, na lei cu i sum."},"33":{"text":"Zeicahtiah hnuk hang cu cawh lengmang ahcun a khal i hnar cu thongh ahcun thisen a chuak, Cu bantukin thinhunnak cu chuahter lengmang ahcun rem lonak a chuak."}}},"31":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Massa siangpahrang Lemuel bia, a nu nih a cawnpiakmi:","title":"Siangpahrang Ca I Chimhhrinnak"},"2":{"text":"Nangmah cu ka dawtmi ka fapa, ka thlacamnak lehnak i ka hmuhmi ka fapa na si, zeidah kan chimh lai?"},"3":{"text":"Na thazang cu nu sinah va pe hlah, siangpahrang a hrawktu hna kha va kom hna hlah."},"4":{"text":"Maw Lemuel, siangpahrang nih cun zu din awk a si lo, uktu bawi hna caah cun zureu hi din awk a si lo;"},"5":{"text":"Annih nih an din tikah upadi kha an philh i harnak a ingmi hna nih an hmuh awk hnga thil a simi kha zeirello in an um."},"6":{"text":"A lung a dong cang i ngaihchia lungrethei in a ummi kha zu cu pe hna u,"},"7":{"text":"Ding hna seh law an sifahnak kha i philh hna seh, an harnak kha hngal ti loin um hna seh."},"8":{"text":"Aa chim kho lomi kha chimpiak hna, bawmtu a ngei lomi kha humhak hna;"},"9":{"text":"Annih cu an bia chimpiak hna law an caah a dingmi biaceihtu va si ko; sifakmi le retheimi kha dirkamh hna."},"10":{"text":"Nupi ṭha cu hlawn nakin tampi in a sung deuh, cu bantuk mi hmuh bel cu a har hringhran!","title":"Nupi Ṭha Thangṭhatnak"},"11":{"text":"A va nih aa bochan i a va cu a si a fak bal lai lo."},"12":{"text":"A nupi nih cun a nun chung vialte a va caah khan chiatnak si loin ṭhatnak kha a tuah."},"13":{"text":"Tuuhmul le khumla in puan kha a tah lengmang hna."},"14":{"text":"Thilri in a khatmi sangphawlawng nih thilri an rak phorh bantukin lamhlat piin rawl kha a rak phorh hna."},"15":{"text":"Dei hlan in a tho i a innchungkhar caah khan rawl a chuan i a sinum ngaknu hna kha rian a chimh hna."},"16":{"text":"Ṭha tein a ruah hnuah mitsur dum caah tangka a hmuhmi in lo pakhat kha a cawk."},"17":{"text":"Thazang tlung ngaiin le lungtho ngaiin rian kha a ṭuan i a ngan zong a dam."},"18":{"text":"A rianṭuanmi a hlawhtling ti kha a hngalh i zan ah a mei inn kha a mit bal lo."},"19":{"text":"Amahte nih laa kha aa kher i amahte nih puan kha aa tah."},"20":{"text":"Sifak retheimi sinah nun a siang."},"21":{"text":"Hawhra a tlak tikah a lungre a thei lo, Zeicahtiah a innchungkhar mi cu tling tein thil lum an ngei cio."},"22":{"text":"Puanbu aa ser hna i a thilpuan cu lahmangṭhia le maimaw in tahmi an si."},"23":{"text":"A va cu ram chung upa hna sinah a ṭhut tikah, hauka ah khan theihhngalhmi a si."},"24":{"text":"La hmangṭhia puan kha a tah hna i taisawm kha a ser hna i chawlettu sinah khan a zuar tawn hna."},"25":{"text":"Amah cu a ṭhawngmi a si i hmaizahmi a si i hmailei caan kha a ṭih lo."},"26":{"text":"A kaa cu fimnak in a pau i a lei cungah zaangfah cawnpiaknak kha a um."},"27":{"text":"A innchungkhar umkalning kha ṭha tein a zoh i an herh an baunak kha ṭha tein a hmuh."},"28":{"text":"A fale nih khan, thluachuak nu, an ti i a va zong nih khan a ti ve i a thangṭhat i,"},"29":{"text":"“Nupi ṭha tampi an um, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah nih na lonh dih hna,” a ti."},"30":{"text":"Iang hi hlen a hmang, dawh hi a ziam kho, Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa a ṭihmi nu cu thangṭhat awk a si."},"31":{"text":"Amah cu a kut theitlai ruangah khan thangṭhat u, Hauka ah khan amah cu a rianṭuannak nih khan upatnak hmuhter seh."}}}}},"21":{"info":{"name":"Phungchimtu","shortname":"Eccl","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"David fapa, Jerusalem i a ummi siangpahrang Phungchimtu bia:","title":"Nunnak Hi Pakpalawng Men A Si"},"2":{"text":"Pakpalawng lawngte, pakpalawng lawngte! Zeizong vialte hi pakpalawng an si ko, tiah Phungchimtu nih a ti."},"3":{"text":"Minung nih hin nilin lak le khuasa lak i a ṭuanmi rian hin zeidah a miak a hmuh?"},"4":{"text":"Chan khat cu a liam, a dang chan khat a hung chuak ve, sihmanhsehlaw vawlei cu a sining ṭhiamṭhiam khan a hmun zungzal ko."},"5":{"text":"Ni cu a chuah kel in a chuak ṭhiamṭhiam ko, a tlakning in a tla ṭhiamṭhiam ko; A chuahnak hmun ah khan a hram in i thawk ṭhan awkah a kir ṭhan lengmang ko."},"6":{"text":"Thli cu thlanglei ah a vung hrang, cun chaklei ah a hun i let ṭhan; aa kual lengmang i aa thawknak ah khan a kir ṭhan."},"7":{"text":"Tiva vialte cu rili chungah an vung luang, sihmanhsehlaw rili cu a khat hlei lo; ti cu tiva an i thawknak ah khan a kir ṭhan i a hram in aa thawk ṭhan ko."},"8":{"text":"Zeizong vialte hi thadi le zaangbang an si dih, holh in chim khawh hmanh an si lo; mi nih hin hmuh hi cim ti a ngei lo i hna nih hin theih hi khim ti a ngei ve lo."},"9":{"text":"A rak si cangmi kha a si ṭhan ko lai, tuah lengmangmi hi tuah lai dingmi cu a si fawn ko lai; vawlei cungah hin zeihmanh a thar a um lo."},"10":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, mah hihi a thar a si,” an ti; sihmanhsehlaw cucu hlanpi ah, kan chuah hlanpi ah a rak um diam cangmi a si."},"11":{"text":"Hlanlio thil kha ahohmanh nih an hngal camcin hna lo, cun hmailei ah atu le cu caan karlak i thil a um dingmi zong hi ahohmanh nih an hngal camcin hna lai lo."},"12":{"text":"Phungchimtu keimah hi Jerusalem khua ah Israel mi hna siangpahrang ka rak si.","title":"Phungchimtu Nih A Hmuh A Tonmi"},"13":{"text":"Vanrang toiah mi nih an tuahmi thil vialte hi ka hneksak hna lai i a sullam hngalh kaa zuam hna lai. Pathian nih minung kan cungah thil a kan khinhmi hi a nuam lo ngaimi a si ko."},"14":{"text":"Vawlei cung i an tuahmi thil vialte hi ka hmuh dih, an dihlak in pakpalawng men a si ko, thlitu dawi bantuk men khi an si ko."},"15":{"text":"A kawimi cu na dinter kho lai lo, a um lomi cu rel khawh a si lo."},"16":{"text":"Keimah le keimah cu, “Mingan ka si cang, keimah hlan i Jerusalem a rak uktu hna nakkhan a let tam piin ka fim deuh. Fimnak le hngalhnak hi zeidah an si, ti kha ka hngalh hna,” ka ti.","ref":"1Sia 4.29-31"},"17":{"text":"Cun fimnak le hruhnak, thil hngalhthiam khawh lonak le hngalh thiam khawhnak an i dannak hi hngalh kaa zuam hrimhrim lai, ka ti. Sihmanhsehlaw cucu ka caah thlitu dawi tluk ceo kha a rak si ko ti cu ka hngalh ṭhan."},"18":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fimnak cu a tam deuh paoh ah lungretheihnak tam deuh ngeih a si ve ko, Cun thil tam deuh hngalh paoh ah tam deuh temhinnak hmuh a si ve fawn ko."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Kaa nuam tuah lai, lunglawmh timi hi a sullam zeidah a si ka kawl tuah lai, ka ti. Sihmanhsehlaw hi zong hi pakpalawng men a si ko."},"2":{"text":"Nih hi hruh a si, i nuamhnak nih hin zeihmanh ṭhatnak a kan pe kho lo ti kha ka hngalh."},"3":{"text":"Ka pum cu zu in ka lawmhter lai i ka lungthin in fimnak cu ka kawl lai ka ti. Cucu minung nih vawlei cung i caan tawite a nun chungah hin a tuah khawhmi thil ṭha bik a si rua lai, tiah ka ruah."},"4":{"text":"Rian ngan pipi cu ka lim hna, inn ka sak hna i mitsur dum kaa ser hna;","ref":"1Sia 10.23-27; 2Cha 9.22-27"},"5":{"text":"dum le tlonlennak hmun kha kaa ser hna i an chungah thingthei kung a phunphun ka cin hna."},"6":{"text":"Ti toihnak ding caah tili ka ser hna."},"7":{"text":"Salnu hna he salpa hna he kaa cawk hna i ka inn chung i a chuakmi sal zong ka ngei hna; keimah hlanah Jerusalem i a rak ummi nih a ngeihmi nak tam deuh in cawrun hna le tuurun hna kha tampi ka ngeih hna.","ref":"1Sia 4.23"},"8":{"text":"Cun ka ukmi hna ram siangpahrang hna rothil chung khan sui le ngun kaa pumh hna; hlasatu nu he pa he kaa chiah hna i ka duh zat in nu kha kaa ngeih hna.","ref":"1Sia 10.10,14-22"},"9":{"text":"Ka ngan taktak ko, Jerusalem khua i a rak ummi aho nak hmanh khan ka ngan deuh ko i ka fim ngaingai fawn.","ref":"1Cha 29.25"},"10":{"text":"Ka duhmi paoh kha ka hmuh khawh, nuamhnak kha zeihmanh ka tlolhmi a um lo. Thil ka tuahmi paoh nih khan thangṭhatnak an ka pek i cucu ka laksawng a si."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah ka tuahmi vialte kha ka zoh hna i ka tuahnak hna ah khan zeitluk in dah ka re a theih ti kha ka ruah tikah, zeihmanh an rak si lo ti kha ka vun hngalh. Thlitu dawi bantuk ceo kha a rak si ko i zeihmanh ṭhathnemnak a um lo."},"12":{"text":"A ngaingai ti ahcun, siangpahrang nih a tuah khawhmi hi amah hlan i a rak ummi siangpahrang hna nih an tuahmi kha an si ko ee. Cucaah fim ti le ralrin lo ti le hruh ti hna hi an sullam zeidah an si ti kha ka ruat ṭhan."},"13":{"text":"Fimnak cu hruhnak nakin a ṭha deuh ti cu ka hngalh, ceunak cu muihnak nakin a ṭhat deuh bantukin."},"14":{"text":"Mifim nih cun khuazei ah dah kan kal ti kha an hmuh khawh, mihrut nih cun an hmu kho lo. Sihmanhsehlaw kan donghnak cu aa khat ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai ti kha ka hngalh ṭhan."},"15":{"text":"Mihrut cung i a tlungmi thil kha keimah cung zongah a tlung ve ko lai. Cucaah ka fim hi zei ṭhathnemnak a um hlah i? ka ti. Zeihmanh ṭhathnemnak a um lo, a um hrimhrim lo."},"16":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih mifim kha an hngal camcin hna lo, ahohmanh nih mihrut kha an hngal camcin ve hna lo. Hmailei ah cun kan dihlak in philh kan si ko lai. Kan dihlak in kan thi lai — a fim he a hrut he kan thi dih ko lai. 1"},"17":{"text":"Cucaah nunnak hi ka caah sullam zeihmanh a ngei lo. Zeicahtiah harnak dah ti lo cu zeihmanh a ka pekmi a um lo. Pakpalawng men a rak si ko. Thlitu men ka rak dawi ko."},"18":{"text":"Ni toi i rethei ngaiin ka ṭuanmi ka rian vialte le ka hmuhmi thil vialte hi ka caah sullam zeihmanh an ngei lo; ka hnu i a rung um ding hna ca i ka chiahtak ding men an si kha ka hngalh;"},"19":{"text":"cun mah pa cu mifim a si lai le mihrut a si lai kha aho nih dah a hngalh? A zei a si hmanh ah rethei ngaiin ka ṭuanmi le ni toiah ka fimnak ka hmanmi thil vialte cungah amah cu bawi a si ko lai. Mah zong hi pakpalawng a si ko."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah ka rak ṭuanmi rian vialte kha kaa ngaihchih hna."},"21":{"text":"Na fimnak vialte le na hngalhnak vialte le na thiamnak vialte kha hmang in thil pakhatkhat na tuah i cucu zeihmanh a tuah ṭung lo mipa caah khan na kaltak ko. Cucu pakpalawng a si i ahmaan zong ahmaan lo."},"22":{"text":"Rethei le zaangbang in ni toiah na ṭuanmi vialte chung hin zeidah na ngeih?"},"23":{"text":"Na nun chung paohpaoh ah cun na tuahmi thil paoh nih hin lungfahnak le lung retheihnak dah ti lo cu zeihmanh an pekmi a um lai lo. Zan hmanh ah na ruahnak kha na dinhter kho lo. Mah zong hi pakpalawng a si ko.","ref":"Job 5.7; 14.1"},"24":{"text":"Minung nih hin a ṭha bik a tuah khawhmi cu zeidah a si ti ahcun, ei i din i a hmuhmi paoh kha i nuamhpi hi a si ko. Asinain mah zong hi Pathian kut in a rami a si kha ka hngalh;","ref":"Phuc 3.13; 5.18; 9.7; Luk 12.19; 1Kor 15.32"},"25":{"text":"zeicahtiah amah tel loin aho nih dah ei awk an hmuh khawh i aho nih dah nuamhnak an hmuh khawh?"},"26":{"text":"Pathian nih a lung a tongtu hna kha cu, fimnak le hngalhnak le lawmhnak a pek hna; sihmanhsehlaw misual hna kha cu, rian a ṭuanter hna, an ṭuan man cu a hmuhter hna i a khonter hna, sihmanhsehlaw cucu a lung a tong deuhtu kha a pek hna. Mah zong hi pakpalawng le thlitu dawi men a si ko.","ref":"Job 32.8; Phut 2.6"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zeizong vialte caah hin caan a um cio i vanrang tang i a ummi thil vialte nih hin caan an ngei dih:","title":"Zeipaoh Nih Hin Caan An Ngei Cio"},"2":{"text":"Hrin caan a um, thih caan a um; cin caan a um, phawi caan a um;"},"3":{"text":"Thah caan a um, damter caan a um; ṭheh caan a um, sak caan a um;"},"4":{"text":"Ṭah caan a um, nih caan a um; ngaihchiat caan a um, lam caan a um;"},"5":{"text":"Nu le pa si caan a um, si lo caan a um; i pom caan a um, i pom lo caan a um;"},"6":{"text":"Kawl caan a um, thlau caan a um; chiah caan a um, hlonh caan a um;"},"7":{"text":"Thleh caan a um, belh caan a um; dai tein um caan a um, chim caan a um;"},"8":{"text":"Huat caan a um, dawt caan a um; i doh caan a um, i rem caan a um;"},"9":{"text":"Rianṭuantu nih rethei ngaiin a ṭuanmi chung hin zeidah a miak a hmuh?"},"10":{"text":"Pathian nih kan cung i a kan khinhmi rian cu ka hngalh cang."},"11":{"text":"Zeizong vialte hi anmahle an caan te a serpiak cio hna; cun hmailei thil hngalh duhnak kha minung kan lungthin chungah a chiah i asinain Pathian nih a tuahmi kha tling tein hngalh khawhnak kha cu a kan pe lo."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah minung nih a ṭha bik a tuah khawhmi cu a nun rih lioah i lawmh le a ṭha bik a timi kha a tuah khawh chungin tuah kha a si ko."},"13":{"text":"Kan dihlak in ei u sih law ding u sih law kan ṭuan man kha i nuamhpi u sih. Cucu Pathian laksawng a si ko."},"14":{"text":"Pathian nih a tuahmi paoh cu zungzal in a hmun ti kha ka hngalh; zeihmanh chap khawh an si lo i zeihmanh zuh khawh zong an si lo; minung nih a hmaiah ṭihnak a ngeih nakhnga Pathian nih cu bantuk cun a tuah."},"15":{"text":"A um liomi hi a um cangmi an si dih ko; a um dingmi hi hlanah a rak um diam ding cangmi kha an si; Pathian nih a um ciami thil kha a um ṭhanter lengmang hna."},"16":{"text":"Cuhleiah vanrang tangah hin ṭhat lonak nih dinnak le a hmaanmi thil kha an hmun a rolh lengmang hna ti kha ka hmuh.","title":"Vawlei Cungah Dinlonak A Tam Tuk"},"17":{"text":"Ka lung chungin Pathian nih miding le miṭhalo cu aa khat rep in bia a ceih ko hna lai, zeicahtiah kan hmailei vawlei zong hmanh ah khin zeizong vialte hi anmahle an caan te cio ah an tling cio ko lai, ka ti."},"18":{"text":"Minung hi saram nakin zeihmanh kan si hlei lo ti hngalhnak caah Pathian nih minung hi a hneksak hna ti kha ka hngalh."},"19":{"text":"A ngaingai ti ahcun, minung le saram hi kan donghnak aa khat ko. Saram cu minung bantukin a thi i minung zong cu saram bantukin a thi ve ko. An pahnih in nunnak thaw a ngeimi an si. Nunnak hi minung caah siseh, saram caah siseh, sullam a ngeih lo caah minung hi saram nakin zeihmanh a si hlei lo."},"20":{"text":"An pahnih tein an fuhmi hmun cu aa khat ko — leidip kha a si ko. An pahnih in cuka cun an chuak i an pahnih in cuka ah cun an kir ṭhan lai."},"21":{"text":"Minung thlarau cu cunglei ah a kai i saram thlarau cu tanglei ah vawlei ah a lut tiah aho nih dah fiang tein an hngalh khawh lai?"},"22":{"text":"Cucaah minung nih a ṭha bik a tuah khawhmi cu a ṭuan man a hmuhmi i nuamhpi hi a si ti kha ka hngalh. Cu pinah a tuah khawhmi dang zeihmanh a um lo. A thih hnuah zeidah a hung um te lai ti a hngalh khawhnak lam zeihmanh a um lo."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun hi vawlei cung i a um lengmangmi dinlonak hi ka zoh ṭhan. Hremmi hna cu an ṭap lengmang, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh nih an bawm hna lo. Anmah a hremtu hna kha thil ti khawhnak a ngeimi cu an si caah ahohmanh nih an bawm duh hna lo."},"2":{"text":"A thi i a lomi kha ka hngar deuh hna; a nung rihmi nakin an caah a ṭha deuh."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu hna pahnih nakin a ṭha deuh chinchinmi cu a nun in a nung bal lomi kha an si, hi vawlei cung i a um lengmangmi dinlonak a hmuh in a hmu bal lomi kha an si."},"4":{"text":"Zeicahdah minung nih hin tlamtlinnak ding caah fak piin rian a ṭuan ti zong kha ka hngalh cang: hawi nakin tam deuh ngeih an duh caah a si. Cucu pakpalawng a si ko, thlitu dawi men kha a si ko."},"5":{"text":"Kut i sih i rawlṭam in thih ko cu hruh a si, an ti."},"6":{"text":"A si zong a si men ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw tlawmte lawng hmanh ngeih ko i lung dai tein um hi kut a pahnih hnih in rian ṭuan zungzal ko i thlitu tlaih i zuamnak nakcun a ṭha deuh."},"7":{"text":"Kan nunnak ah hin pakpalawng a simi thil pakhat ka hmuh ṭhan hoi:"},"8":{"text":"Mipa pakhat cu amah lawng tein khua a sa. Fapa a ngei lo, unau zong a ngei lo, sihmanhsehlaw rian a ṭuan zungzal i a hmuhmi chawva kha zeitikhmanh ah kaa za cang ti a ngei kho lo. Aho ca ko ah hen cu ti lawmmam cun a ṭuan i a nuamh hmanh i nuam ngam lote in a um? Mah hihi pakpalawng a si fawn ko, aa nuam lo ngaimi minung a si ko."},"9":{"text":"Pahnih cu pakhat nakin an ṭhahnem deuh, zeicahtiah an ṭuanmi rian khan tam deuh an hmuh khawh."},"10":{"text":"Pakhat kha a tluk sual ahcun pakhat nih khan a bawmh khawh. Sihmanhsehlaw mi pakhatkhat cu amah lawng a si i a tluk sual ahcun a poi ngaingai ko amah a bawmtu ahohmanh an um ti lo."},"11":{"text":"Khua a sih tikah pahnih in hmunkhat ah nan ih ahcun nanmah le nanmah kha nan i lumh kho, sihmanhsehlaw nangmah lawng cun zeitindah naa lumh khawh lai?"},"12":{"text":"Pakhat lawng a teitu ral kha pahnih nih cun an rak doh khawh lai. Thumthlak hrihrual cu chah a harmi a si."},"13":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat cu sifak te a si nain a ṭhang lengmang i an ram siangpahrang ah a cang, asiloah thonginn in siangpahrang ṭhutdan ah a kai, sihmanhsehlaw cu pa nih cun a tar tikah ruahnak cheuhmi kha a duh lo ahcun, a si a fak nain a fimmi tlangval kha cu pa nakcun a ṭha deuh.","merge":"14"},"15":{"text":"Vawlei cung i a ummi minung vialte hna kong hi ka ruat i an lak ah hin siangpahrang hmun a co kho dingmi an um ti kha ka hngalh."},"16":{"text":"Siangpahrang nih a ukmi hna hi rel cawk lo an si ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw a thih tikah cun a rak tuahmi thil ruangah khan a cung i a lawmmi ahohmanh an um hlei lo. Hihi pakpalawng a si fawn ko, thlitu dawi men cu a si ko."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Biaknak inn na kal ah hin i ralring. Cu ka i na va kal tikah zeidah kaa cawn khawh lai ti kha ruat deuh, cucu ahmaanmi thil le ahmaan lo mithil a thleidang kho lomi mihrut hna nih an pekchanhmi raithawinak nakin a ṭha deuh.","title":"Ruah Set Loin Biakamnak Ser Hlah"},"2":{"text":"Bia na chim hlanah i ruat hmasa, cun Pathian sinah hnawnam in biakamnak ser hlah. Pathian cu vancung ah a um i nang cu vawlei ah na um, cucaah a herhmi hlei in zeihmanh va chim hlah."},"3":{"text":"Na lungre a theih deuh paoh ah mang chia na manh deuh ko lai, cu bantukin tam deuh bia na chim paoh ah hruhnak bia kha tam deuh na chim sual ko lai."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian sin i bia kamnak na tuah tikah khulrang in cucu zul ko. Pathian nih mihrut cu zeihmanh ah a herh hna lo. Ka tuah lai tiah naa kammi kha va tuah ko.","ref":"Slm 66.13-14"},"5":{"text":"Bia i kam ṭung i tuah lo nakcun rak i kam lo lawlaw kha a ṭha deuh."},"6":{"text":"Nangmah bia lila kha sualnak chung i an luhpitu siter hlah, Pathian tlangbawi cu, khakha ka ti duhmi a si lo, tiah chimh awk herh in um hlah, zeicah Pathian cu na cungah a thin na hunter lai? Zeicahdah na rak tuahmi cu na hrawhter lai?"},"7":{"text":"Mang cu manh len ko, cun na tuahmi rian zong cu pakpalawng si koin na chimmi bia cu tam ko hna hmanh seh law Pathian cu na ṭih ṭhiamṭhiam awk a si."},"8":{"text":"Acozah pakhatkhat nih misifak kha an hrem hna i dinnak le an hmuh awk a simi kha an pe hna lo, ti na hmuh tikah na khuaruahhar hlah; bawi paohpaoh cu an cung i a ummi bawi cio nih khan an huhphenh hna i cu hna zong cu anmah nakin a sang chin deuhmi bawi nih khan an huhphenh chin ve hna.","title":"Nunnak Hi Pakpalawng Men A Si Ko"},"9":{"text":"Ram pakhatkhat nih a herh tawnmi cu lo thlawhnak lei i lungthin a ngeimi siangpahrang a si."},"10":{"text":"Tangka duhmi na si ahcun, zeitikhmanh ah kaa za cang na ti kho bal lai lo; rum a duhmi na si ahcun, na duhmi vialte kha cu na hmu kho bal lai lo. Pakpalawng a si ko."},"11":{"text":"Na rum deuh paoh ah na cawm awk kha an tam chin lengmang ko lai i naa miakmi cu ka rum ti naa hngalh lawng kha a si ko lai."},"12":{"text":"Rian hrang a ṭuanmi cu ei awk a zaa a ngeih caan a um lai, a ngeih lo caan zong a um lai, sihmanhsehlaw zan tal ah ṭha tein aa hngilh; sihmanhsehlaw mirum cu tampi a ngei ko nain a lungretheihnak nih khan hngilh lo in a umter."},"13":{"text":"Mah hihi thil ṭhalo ngai a si, sihmanhsehlaw vawlei cungah hin ka hmuh cangmi a si: mi nih hin an tangka hi an herh caan caah an khon tawn,"},"14":{"text":"cun zei maw tiin rian pakhatkhat ah an hloh dih sual i an fale roh awk kha zeihmanh a tang lo."},"15":{"text":"Hi vawlei hi kan hung luh bantukte khan kan chuahtak ṭhan lai — zeihmanh lo tein. Zeicahtiah kan tuahmi vialte hi pakhat hmanh kan i kalpi khawh ding a um lo.","ref":"Job 1.21; Slm 49.17; 1Tim 6.7"},"16":{"text":"Mah hihi thil ṭhalo ngai a si ko, kan ratning te khan kan kal ṭhan ko. Rian heh tiah kan ṭuan, thlitu tlaih kha kan i zuam, sihmanhsehlaw zeidah kan hmuh?"},"17":{"text":"Muihnak chung le ngaihchiatnak chungah hin lungrethei le thinhung le ngandam loin kan nun a herh ko."},"18":{"text":"Hihi ka va hmuhmi thil a si. Mi nih hin a ṭha bik a tuah khawhmi cu ei i din i Pathian nih nunnak tawite a pekmi chung i a rianṭuanmi chungin a hmuhmi kha i nuamhpi hi a si ko; cucu minung kan covo cu a si ko."},"19":{"text":"Pathian nih mi pakhat khat cu rumnak le thilri a pek i cucu a nuamhpiter hna ahcun, Pathian sinah aa lawmh awk a si ko i a ṭuanmi cu aa nuamhpi awk a si ko. Cucu Pathian laksawng pei a si cu."},"20":{"text":"Pathian nih lunglawm tein umnak nawl kha a pek caah a nunnak zeitluk in dah a tawi kha cu, a lungre aa theihpi lai lo."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vawlei cungah hin dinlonak nganpi minung cungah tuah a si ti kha ka hmuh."},"2":{"text":"Pathian nih mi pakhatkhat cu rumnak, upatnak le thilri kha a pek, a duhmi paohpaoh kha a pek ko. Sihmanhsehlaw cu hna cu i lawmhpi awk kha a sianh fawn ṭung lo. Midang pakhat khat tu nih khan a hun i lawmhpi ko hna. Cucu pakpalawng a si i a din zong a ding lomi thil a si."},"3":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih fa za khat a ngeih ko hnga i kum saupi a nung ko hnga, sihmanhsehlaw zei caan a nun hmanh ah lunglawmhnak kha a ngeih lo i hmaizahnak tein vuinak kha a hmuh lo ahcun, cu pa nakcun a thi cia i a chuakmi ngakchia kha a ṭha deuh."},"4":{"text":"Ngakchia caah chuah kha zeihmanh ṭhathnemnak a um lo; muihnak chungah khan a lo i cuka ah cun philh a si ko."},"5":{"text":"Chun ceu kha a hmu bal lo, nunnak zong hi zeidah a lawh ti kha a hngal lo, sihmanhsehlaw anih cu dinhnak tal kha a hmu —"},"6":{"text":"mi pakhatkhat cu kum thong hnih hmanh a nung ko hnga i a nun chungah nuamhnak hmu ṭung lomi a si ahcun, cu pa nakcun ngakchia kha dinhnak kha a hmu deuh. A donghnak ah cun an pahnih in hmun khat ah pei an va kal ko lai cu."},"7":{"text":"Mi nih heh tiah rian a ṭuan cu ei awk hmuhnak ding caah a si ko, sihmanhsehlaw kaa za cang ti cu a um kho hlei lo."},"8":{"text":"Zeitindah mifim mi cu mihrutpa nakin ṭhathnemnak a hmuh hlei? Zeitindah kan nun awk a si ti hngalh nih hin misifak cu zeidah a ṭhathnem?"},"9":{"text":"Pakpalawng a si ko, thlitu dawi bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam a si ko.
