Keimah ruangah mi vialte nih an in huat hna lai.","ref":"Mat 10.22"},"10":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun mi tampi nih an zumhnak kha an hlawt lai i pakhat le pakhat an i rawi lai i pakhat le pakhat an i hua lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun nal profet tampi an chuak lai i mi tampi an hlen hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Ṭhat lonak kha a karh tuk lai caah mi tampi cu an dawtnak kha a dai lai."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a dongh tiangin a fekmi cu khamh an si lai.","ref":"Mat 10.22"},"14":{"text":"Cun miphun vialte hna ca i tehte si awkah Vancung Pennak kong Thawng Ṭha hi khuazakip ah chim a si lai — cun cu hnu lawngah cun donghnak cu a si lai!"},"15":{"text":"“Cun profet Daniel nih, ‘Ṭhiotu Fihnung,’ a timi kha hmunthiang i a dir cu nan hmuh lai. (A reltu hna, hi a sullam hi i hngalh u).","title":"Ṭhiotu Fihnung (Mar 13.14-23 ; Luk 21.20-24)","ref":"Dan 9.27; 11.31; 12.11"},"16":{"text":"Cun Judea ram i a ummi kha tlang ah zam hna seh."},"17":{"text":"A inncung i a ummi cu a innchung i a ummi thilri lak awkah ṭum hlah seh.","ref":"Luk 17.31"},"18":{"text":"Lo i a ummi cu a puan lak awkah tlung hlah seh."},"19":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun fapawi nu hna le nau no ngeimi nu hna caah a har hringhran lai."},"20":{"text":"Nan zam caan hi khuasik caan le Sabbath ni ah a si sual nakhnga lo, Pathian sinah thlacam u."},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah khi caan ah cun vawlei hramthawk in nihin ni tiangah a ummi harnak a zeihmanh nakin a let tampi in a fak deuhmi harnak kha a um lai. Cu bantuk harnak cu a um zong a um ti lai lo.","ref":"Dan 12.1; Biat 7.14"},"22":{"text":"Cu caan cu Pathian nih rak tawiter hlah seh law ahohmanh a nungmi an um hnga lo. Asinain Pathian nih a mithim mi hna caah, cu caan cu a tawiter lai."},"23":{"text":"“Cun ahohmanh nih, ‘Messiah cu hika ah a um, khika ah a um,’ in ti ai kun hna, va zum hna hlah u."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nal messiah le nal profet kha an chuak lai i Pathian mithim hna hmanh kha a si khawh ahcun hlen khawhnak ding caah hmelchunhnak le khuaruahhar nganngan an ser hna lai."},"25":{"text":"Ngai hmanh u. A hlankan in hihi kan chimchung hna hih."},"26":{"text":"“Cun mi nih, ‘Ramlak ah a um,’ an in ti hna ahcun va kal hlah u; ‘Hika ah aa thup ko,’ an in ti hna zongah vaa lun hlah u.","ref":"Luk 17.23-24"},"27":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Mi Fapa cu van ah nichuahlei in nitlaklei tiang aa lekmi nimtlau bantukin pei a rat lai cu."},"28":{"text":"“Saruak umnak hmun ah langta an i pum tawn.”","ref":"Luk 17.37"},"29":{"text":"“Cu caan harnak cu a dongh cangka in ni cu a mui lai i thlapa cu a ceu ti lai lo, arfi cu van in an tla lai i vancung ṭhawnnak cu an i hnin lai.","title":"Mi Fapa Ratnak (Mar 13.24-27 ; Luk 21.25-28)","ref":"Isa 13.10; 34.4; Eze 32.7; Joe 2.10,31; 3.15; Biat 6.12-13"},"30":{"text":"Cun Mi Fapa hmelchunhnak kha van ah a lang lai; khi tikah vawlei cung miphun vialte kha an ṭap lai i Mi Fapa cu lianhngannak le sunparnak he vancung in a rat kha an hmuh lai.","ref":"Dan 7.13; Zek 12.10-14; Biat 1.7"},"31":{"text":"Muko nganpi cu an tum lai i a vancungmi kha vawlei kil li ah a thlah hna lai i vanrang toi khuazakip in a mithim hna kha a pumh hna lai."},"32":{"text":"“Theipi kung nih hin thil pakhat in cawnpiak hna seh: A nge cu an hung hrin i an hung no i a hnah an hung corh tikah ṭhal caan cu a nai cang, ti kha nan hngalh.","title":"Theipi Kung Hmelchunhnak (Mar 13.28-31 ; Luk 21.29-33)"},"33":{"text":"Cu bantukin hi thil vialte hi nan hmuh hna tikah, caan cu a nai cang, aa thawk dengmang cang, ti kha nan hngalh lai."},"34":{"text":"Mah hihi philh hlah u: Hi thil vialte hi atu i a nung lio mi an thih dih hlanah hin a tlung ko lai."},"35":{"text":"Van le vawlei cu an rawk lai; sihmanhsehlaw ka bia cu zeitikhmanh ah a rawk lai lo."},"36":{"text":"“Asinain, cu ni le cu caan cu zeitik ah dah a si lai, ti kha ahohmanh nih an hngal lo; vancung mi zong nih an hngal lo, Fapa zong nih a hngal hlei lo, Pa lawnglawng nih a hngalh.","title":"Ahohmanh Nih A Ni le A Caan An Hngal Lo (Mar 13.32-37 ; Luk 17.26-30 , 34-36)"},"37":{"text":"Mi Fapa a rat cu Noah chan i thil umtuning bantuk kha a si lai.","ref":"Gen 6.5-8"},"38":{"text":"Tilian a tlun hlan, Noah lawng chung i a luh ni tiang kha, an ei an ding an i ṭhi an i um i"},"39":{"text":"tilian a hung tlun taktak i a fenh dih hna hlantiang kha cu, zeihmanh an hngal lo. Mi fapa a rat tikah cun cu bantuk cun a si lai.","ref":"Gen 7.6-24"},"40":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun mi pahnih lo ah rian a ṭuanmi hna lakah pakhat cu kalpi a si lai i pakhat cu nganhta a si lai."},"41":{"text":"Nu pahnih sum a sumi hna lakah pakhat cu kalpi a si lai i pakhat cu nganhta a si lai."},"42":{"text":"Cucaah nan Bawipa a rat lai ni nan hngalh lo caah ralring tein um ko u."},"43":{"text":"Hihi philh hlah u: Inn ngeitu nih mifir a rat lai caan kha hngal seh law, hngilh lo tein a rak um hnga i mifir kha a inn chungah a luhter hnga lo.","ref":"Luk 12.39-40"},"44":{"text":"Cu ruangah cun nannih zong timh cia tein nan um zungzal awk a si, zeicahtiah Mi Fapa cu nan i rin lo caan ah khin a ra ko lai."},"45":{"text":"“Cu a si caah aho cu dah zumh awk a tlakmi le a fimmi sal cu a si? Cu bantukin zumh awk a tlak i a fimmi sal cu, a Bawipa nih a sal hawi zohkhenhtu dingah, a caan hmaan tein an rawl a petu dingah, a chiahmi kha a si.","title":"Zumhtlak le Zumhtlaklo Sal (Luk 12.41-48)"},"46":{"text":"A bawipa nih a tlun tikah, a rian a rak ṭuan liote ah a run tanhmi sal caah cun lunglawmh awk a va si dah!"},"47":{"text":"Cu sal cu a bawipa nih a ngeihmi thil vialte zohkhenhtu ah a chiah hrimhrim lai, tiah kan chimh hna."},"48":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu pa cu miṭhalo a si ahcun, ‘Ka bawipa cu a ra chom rih lai lo,’ tiah a lung chungin a ti lai i"},"49":{"text":"a sal hawi kha a ṭhuat a den hna lai i zuri pawl hna he khan an ei an ding ṭi lai."},"50":{"text":"Cun a bawipa cu ni khatkhat cu aa rin lo caan le a hngalh lo caan ah a ra tlung lai i"},"51":{"text":"a bawipa nih cun a sam cikcek lai i midepde pawl umnak hmun ah khan a umter ve lai. Cuka ah cun a ṭap lai i a hacang a rial lai."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Cun Vancung Pennak cu hi bantuk hi a si lai, voi khat cu ngaknu pahra an um i nupi ṭhi tlangval kha don awkah an meiinn cio he an i thawh.","title":"Ngaknu Pahra Bianabia","ref":"Luk 12.35"},"2":{"text":"Panga cu an hrut i panga cu an fim."},"3":{"text":"A hrutmi nih cun an meiinn cu an i put ko nain zinan kha a hlei in an i ken lo."},"4":{"text":"A fimmi tu nih cun an meiinn he khan, zinan khat tein an rawnmi thawl kha an i ken chih cio."},"5":{"text":"Nupi ṭhi tlangval cu a rauh caah ngaknu hna cu an ngu i an i hngilh."},"6":{"text":"“Zanṭimpi ah khin mi an hung au i, ‘Nupi ṭhi tlangval cu a ra cang. Ra chuak u law ra tong u,’ tiah an ti."},"7":{"text":"Ngaknu pahra cu an hun i hlau i an meiinn cu an hun timhtuah hna."},"8":{"text":"Khi tikah a hrutmi hna nih khan a fimmi hna cu, ‘Kan meiinn an mit cuahmah ai, nan zinan kan ṭhen ve tuah u,’ an ti hna."},"9":{"text":"A fimmi hna nih cun, ‘A si kho lai lo. Nanmah ca he kanmah ca he cun kan ngeihmi hi a za lai lo. Chawdawr ah va kal u law vaa cawk ko u; tiah an leh hna."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah a hrutmi ngaknu hna cu zinan cawk awkah khan chawdawr ah cun an va kal i cu karah nupi ṭhi tlangvalpa cu a rak phan. Timh cia tein a ummi ngaknu panga hna cu nupi ṭhit rawldanghnak chungah khan amah sinah cun an lut i innka kha an khar."},"11":{"text":"“Hnu deuh ah khin ngaknu dang zong kha an ra phan ve. ‘Bawipa, bawipa, innka hung kan hunh tuah,’ tiah an au.","ref":"Luk 13.25"},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nupi ṭhi tlangvalpa nih cun, ‘Kan hngal hrimhrim hna lo,’ tiah a leh hna."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah cun, a ni siseh, a caan siseh, nan hngalh ṭung lo caah ralring tein um ko u."},"14":{"text":"“Vancung Pennak cu khualtlawn i aa thawhmipa bantuk a si. A salle kha a kawh hna i a thilri kha nan rak zohkhenh lai, tiah a ti hna.","title":"Sal Pathum Hna Bianabia (Luk 19.11-27)","ref":"Luk 19.11-27"},"15":{"text":"Anmahle an thil ti khawh ning cio khan ngun tangka a pek hna: pakhat cu thong nga, pakhat cu thong hnih a pek i pakhat cu thong khat a pek. Cun khualtlawn ah cun aa thawh."},"16":{"text":"Thong nga a hmumi sal nih khan cu tangka cun chaw a let zau i a dang thong nga a miak a hmuh."},"17":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in thong hnih a hmu mipa zong nih khan a dang thong hnih a miak a hmuh ve."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thong khat a hmutu pa nih khan cun, vawlei a cawh riangmang i a bawipa tangka kha a va thuh."},"19":{"text":"“Caan saupi hnuah khin an bawipa cu a ra tlung ṭhan i an tangka hmannak kong kha felfai in a tuahpi hna."},"20":{"text":"Thong nga a hmumi sal kha a ra lut i a dang thong nga a rung pek. Aa thawh i, ‘Bawipa, tangka thong nga na rak ka pek. Atu cu zohhmanh, a dang thong nga zong ka rak chuahpi,’ tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A bawipa nih cun, ‘Sal ṭha, zumhawktlak sal, na tuahmi cu a ṭha ngaingai. Tangka tlawmte na lehthalnak ah zumhawktlak na si, cucaah tangka tampi tawngthamtu ah kan chiah lai. Ra lut law ka lunglawmhnak hi i hrawm ve,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun tangka thong hnih a pekmi kha a ra lut i, ‘Bawipa, tangka thong hnih na rak ka pek. Atu cu zohhmanh, a dang thong hnih zong ka rak chuahpi,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"A bawipa nih cun, ‘Salṭha, sal zumhawktlak, tangka tlawmte lehthalnak ah zumhawktlak na si, cucaah tangka tampi tawngthamtu ah kan chiah lai. Ra lut law ka lunglawmhnak hi i hrawm ve,’ tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun tangka thong khat a hmumipa kha a ra lut i, ‘Bawipa, nang cu mikhepkha na si kha ka hngalh. Na cin lonak hmun ah khan theitlai na lawh tawn i na tuh lonak hmun ah khan tirawl na ṭuan tawn."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah kan ṭih i na tangka cu vawlei chungah ka va thuh. Zohhmanh na ta kha a ningte in, hihi a si ko,’ tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"A bawipa nih cun, ‘Mi zaangthu, sal ṭhalo, ka phun lonak hmun ah theitlai ka lawh tawn le ka tuh lonak hmun ah tirawl ka ṭuan tawn cu na hngalh a si lo mei?"},"27":{"text":"Cu ti na hngalh ṭung ahcun ka tangka cu beng ah pei na rak chiah awk a si cu, ka ra kir tikah hin ka tangka he a karh he ka hmu hnga lo maw?"},"28":{"text":"Cucaah tangka cu a sin khan la u law tangka thong hra a ngeimipa kha pe u."},"29":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a ngeimi cu chap chin an si lai i a hleivuang an ngeih tiangin an ngei lai; sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh a ngei lomi cu a ngeihmi hnihchunte hmanh kha chuh a si lai.","ref":"Mat 13.12; Mar 4.25; Luk 8.18"},"30":{"text":"Cun hi sal santlai lopa hi a leng khuamui lakah va hlonh u; khika ah va ṭap seh law a hacang va rial len seh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 8.12; 22.13; Luk 13.28"},"31":{"text":"“Mi Fapa cu Siangpahrang in vancungmi vialte hna he a rat tikah a bawiṭhutdan cungah cun a ṭhu lai i","title":"Miphun Hna Biaceihnak","ref":"Mat 16.27; 19.28"},"32":{"text":"vawleicung mi vialte cu a hmaiah pumh an si lai. Cun tuukhal nih tuu cu meheh sinin a ṭhen hna bantuk khan miphun vialte cu bu hnih ah a ṭhen hna lai;"},"33":{"text":"tuu cu a orhlei ah a chiah hna lai i meheh cu a kehlei ah a chiah hna lai."},"34":{"text":"Cun a orhlei i a ummi cu Siangpahrang nih cun a thawh hna lai i, ‘Nannih, ka Pa nih thluachuah a pekmi hna, ra tuah u. Ra u law vawlei ser ri in nan caah timh a simi pennak cu ra co tuah u."},"35":{"text":"Ka rawl a ṭam i rawl nan ka pek, ka ti a hal i ti nan ka pek; khual ka si i nan inn ah nan ka tlunter."},"36":{"text":"Puan aih awk ka ngei lo i puan nan ka pek; ka zaw i nan ka zohkhenh; thong ka tla i nan ka len,’ tiah a ti hna lai."},"37":{"text":"Khi tikah miding mi hna nih cun, ‘Bawipa, zeitik ah dah na rawl a ṭam i rawl kan in pek, na ti a hal i ti kan in pek,"},"38":{"text":"khual na si i kan in tlunter, puan aih awk ngei loin na um i puan kan in pek,"},"39":{"text":"na zawt i kan in zoh, thong ah na tlak i kan in len?’ tiah an leh lai."},"40":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang nih cun, ‘Hihi kan chimh hna: Ka unau pakhatkhat cungah, zeitluk hmanh in sifak le nauta si seh law, nan tuahmi thil paoh hi ka cung i nan tuah a si,’ tiah a leh hna lai."},"41":{"text":"“Cun a kehlei i a ummi hna cu, ‘Nannih, Pathian nih chiat a serhmi hna, kal ko u, Khuachia le a vancungmi hna ca i timh a simi zungzal mit lo mei chungah cun va kal ko u."},"42":{"text":"Ka rawl a ṭam ah rawl nan ka pe lo, ka ti a hal ah ti nan ka pe duh lo,"},"43":{"text":"khual ka si ah nan ka tlunter duh lo, puan aih awk ka ngeih lo ah puan nan ka pe duh lo, ka zawt i thong i ka tlak ah nan ka zohkhenh duh lo,’ a ti hna lai."},"44":{"text":"Khi tikah annih nih, ‘Zeitik te ah khan dah na rawl a ṭam, na ti a hal, puan aih awk ngei loin na um, khual na si, na zawt, thong ah na tlak i kan in hramh duh lo cu a si?’ tiah an leh lai."},"45":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang nih khan, ‘Hihi kan chimh hna: misifak hramh nan duh hna lo paoh ah khan nan ka hramh duh lo a si,’ tiah a leh ṭhan ve lai."},"46":{"text":"Hi hna cu zungzal hremhmun ah khan kalter an si lai: a dingmi cu zungzal nunnak ah khan an kal lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Dan 12.2"}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih hi bia vialte cu a chimh dih hna tikah a zultu pawl kha a thawh hna i,","title":"Jesuh An Rawinak (Mar 14.1-2 ; Luk 22.1-2 ; Jhn 11.45-53)"},"2":{"text":"“Nan hngalh bantukin, hi hnu ni hnih ah, Lanhtak Puai kha a si cang lai, cun Mi Fapa cu vailam tahnak i khenhchih awkah tlaihter a si lai,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Exo 12.1-27"},"3":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi upa pawl le Judah mi upa hna kha Tlangbawi Ngan Kaiafas innpi ah cun an i pum i"},"4":{"text":"a thli tein Jesuh kha tlaih i thah ding kha khua an khang."},"5":{"text":"“Puai chungah cun kan tuah lai lo, mizapi an i tuai sual lai,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh cu Bethani khua i thinghmui Simon inn i a um lioah khan,","title":"Jesuh Chiti A Thuh (Mar 14.3-9 ; Jhn 12.1-8)"},"7":{"text":"nu pakhat a ra i lungrang thawl khatte in zihmui a man a fak ngaingaimi kha a rak i put i rawl a ei lioah khan a lu ah a toih.","ref":"Luk 7.37-38"},"8":{"text":"A zultu hna nih khan cucu an hmuh tikah an thin a hung i, “Zeicahdah hi thil hi hitihin a sawksam ee?"},"9":{"text":"Hi zihmui hi tangka tampi ah zuar i tangka cu misifak hna kha pek khawh ding a si ṭung,” an ti."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh nih an i ceihmi cu a theih i, “Zeicahdah hi nu hi nan hnahnawh? A ka tuahpiakmi hi thil ṭha le thil dawh pei a si hi."},"11":{"text":"Misifak cu zungzal in pei nan sinah an um ko lai cu, kei cu zungzal in nan sinah ka um ṭung lai lo.","ref":"Deu 15.11"},"12":{"text":"Zihmui ka pum i a ka toih hi vui awk ca i a ka timhtuah pei a si cu."},"13":{"text":"Hihi philh hlah u: hi thawngṭha hi vawlei cung khuazakip i an chimnak hmun paoh ah, a tuahmi thil hi amah philh lonak ah chim a si zungzal ve lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun zultu pahleihnih lak i pakhat, Judas Iskariot timi kha, tlangbawi upa pawl sinah khan a va kal i","title":"Judas A Hna A Tla (Mar 14.10-11 ; Luk 22.3-6)"},"15":{"text":"“Jesuh cu nan kut chung i kan chanh hna ahcun zeidah nan ka pek lai?” tiah a va ti hna. Cucaah ngun tangka sawm thum kha an rel i an pek.","ref":"Zek 11.12"},"16":{"text":"Cu ri cun Judas nih khan Jesuh rawinak ding caan rem kha a bawh."},"17":{"text":"Thilnu Cawh Lo Changreu Puai a ni hmasa bik ah khan, a zultu kha Jesuh sinah cun an ra i, “Khuazei ah dah Lanhtak Puai Zanriah cu va tim u ti na kan duh?” tiah an ti.","title":"Jesuh le Zultu Hna Lanhtak Rawl An Ei (Mar 14.12-21 ; Luk 22.7-14 , 21-23 ; Jhn 13.21-30)"},"18":{"text":"Annih cu, “Khua chung i mipa pakhat sinah va kal u law, kan Sayapa nih, ‘Ka caan a phan cang, ka zultu hna he na inn ah Lanhtak Zanriah ei kan duh,’ a ti tiah va chim u,” tiah a ti hna."},"19":{"text":"A zultu pawl nih khan Jesuh nih a chimh hna bang cun Lanhtak Zanriah cu an timh."},"20":{"text":"Zanlei sang a hung si tikah Jesuh le a zultu hleihnih hna cu rawl ei awkah khan an ṭhu"},"21":{"text":"Rawl an ei lioah cun, “Nan lak i pakhat nih hin nan ka rawi lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"22":{"text":"A zultu pawl cu an awlok a chong i pakhat hnu pakhat in, “Na ti duhmi cu kei cu ka si lo, a si lo mei?” tiah an ti duahmah cio."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Ka changreu ka hnimnak kheng i a changreu a hnim vemi nih hin a ka lei lai.","ref":"Slm 41.9"},"24":{"text":"Mi Fapa cu Cathiang nih a thi lai a tining khan a thi lai, sihmanhsehlaw Mi Fapa a rawitu caah cun ngaihchia a si ko. Cu pa cu chuak loin rak um seh law a caah a ṭha deuh hnga,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Leitu Judas nih khan a hun i thawh i, “Saya, keimah na ka ti duhnak cu a si i mei?” tiah a hal. Jesuh nih cun, “Na chim ko cu ta,” tiah a leh."},"26":{"text":"Zanriah an ei lioah cun Jesuh nih khan changreu kha a lak i thla a cam dih in a cheu i a zultu kha a pek hna. “I lak u law ei u; hihi ka pum a si,” tiah a ti.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah (Mar 14.22-26 ; Luk 22.14-20 ; 1Kor 11.23-25)"},"27":{"text":"Cun hrai kha a lak i Pathian sinah lawmhnak bia a chim dih in, annih cu a pek hna i, “Nan dihlak in ding u."},"28":{"text":"Hihi ka thi a si, biakam fehternak thisen, sual ngaihthiamnak ca i mi tampi ca i thletmi cu a si.","ref":"Exo 24.8; Jer 31.31-34"},"29":{"text":"Hihi kan chimh hna: Ka Pa Pennak chungah nanmah he a thar in ka din ṭhan hlantiang hi mitsur hang hi ka ding ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun hla an sa i Oliv tlang ah khan an kal."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Cathiang nih, ‘Pathian nih tuukhal kha a thah lai i tuurun chung tuu kha an i ṭhek dih lai,’ a ti caah, tuzan hrimhrim ah hin nan dihlak in nan ka zamtak lai.","title":"Peter Nih A Hlawt Lainak (Mar 14.27-31 ; Luk 22.31-34 ; Jhn 13.36-38)","ref":"Zek 13.7"},"32":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nunter ṭhan ka si tikah nan hmaiah Galilee ah ka rak kal chung lai,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 28.16"},"33":{"text":"Peter nih khan Jesuh cu a hun thawh i, “Midang vialte nih in zamtak hna hmanh seh law, kei cu kan zamtak bal lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih Peter cu, “Hihi va philh hlah: Tuzan i ar a khuan hlan ah amah cu ka hngal lo, tiah voi thum na ka ti lai,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Peter nih cun, “Na sin i ka thih ve ding a si hmanh ah, amah cu ka hngal lo, kan ti bal lai lo,” tiah a leh. Cu bantuk cun zultu dang vialte zong nih khan an ti cio."},"36":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Gethsemane an timi hmun ah khan a zultu hna he khan an kal i annih cu, “Khika i thla ka va cam kar ah khin, hika ah hin rak ṭhu u,” tiah a ti hna.","title":"Gethsemane Dum Ah Thla A Cam (Mar 14.32-42 ; Luk 22.39-46)"},"37":{"text":"Peter le Zebedi fapa pahnih hna kha aa kalpi hna. A ngaih a chia i a awlok a chong."},"38":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka lungre a thei tuk hringhran i ka thi sual lai. Cucaah cun hika ah hin rak um u law hngilh lo tein rak ka hngak u,” tiah a ti hna."},"39":{"text":"Hmailei ah khin tlawmpal a va kal i vawlei ah a bawk i, “Ka Pa, a si khawh ahcun hi hrai hi ka ṭhialpiak ko. Sihmanhsehlaw keimah duhmi cu si hlah seh, nangmah duhmi tu si ko seh,” tiah thla a cam."},"40":{"text":"Cun a ra kir i a zultu pathum hna cu an rak i hngilh kha a hmuh hna; cun Peter kha, “Suimilam pakhat hmanh hngilh loin nan ka hngak kho lo maw?"},"41":{"text":"Tukforhnak chungah nan luh nakhnga lo hngilh lo tein um u law thlacam tuah u. Thlarau nih cun a huam ko, sihmanhsehlaw titsa cu a der,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu a va kal ṭhan i, “Ka Pa, hi hrai hi din loin hrial khawh a si lo ahcun, nangmah duhnak bangin si ko seh,” tiah thla a cam."},"43":{"text":"A zultu hna sinah khan a ra kir ṭhan i an rak i hngilh ṭhan; an mit a au in an au kho lo."},"44":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a kaltak ṭhan hna i a voi thumnak thla a cam ṭhan, a chim cia kha a chim ṭhan."},"45":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna sinah khan a ra kir ṭhan i, “Nan i hngilh i nan i din ko rih maw? Zohhmanh u, Mi Fapa cu misual mi hna kut chung i chanhnak caan kha a phan cang."},"46":{"text":"Tho u law, kal u sih. A ka rawitu kan sin a phan cang,” tiah a ti hna."},"47":{"text":"Bia a chim lengmang lioah cun a zultu hleihnih lak i a rak i tel vemi Judas kha a ra phan. Tlangbawi upa pawl le Judah upa hna nih an thlahmi mi runpi kha nam le thingtan i put in aa ratpi hna.","title":"Jesuh Tlaihnak (Mar 14.43-50 ; Luk 22.47-53 ; Jhn 18.3-12)"},"48":{"text":"Rawitu nih cun mizapi cu hmelchunhnak a rak pek cia hna i, “Ka hnamhmi cu tlaih nan duhmi kha a si lai i nan tlaih colh lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"49":{"text":"Judas nih cun a phak cangka tein Jesuh cu a hei fuh i, “Saya, na cungah daihnak um ko seh,” tiah a ti i a hnamh colh."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Ka kawi, khulrang in tuah ko kun,” tiah a leh. Cun an hung chuak i Jesuh cu an tlaih i fek tein an khih."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh sin i a ummi pakhat nih khan a nam aa zuh i Tlangbawi Ngan sal hnakhaw kha pet lakin a tuk."},"52":{"text":"Jesuh nih anih cu, “Na nam cu a kawng ah sawh ṭhan ko, zeicahtiah hriamnam a lami cu hriamnam in an thi lai."},"53":{"text":"Ka pa kha bawmhnak ka hal khawh ko i khulrang in vancungmi ralkap bu hleihnih a run ka thlah khawh ko ti kha na hngal lo maw?"},"54":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu ti a si ahcun, zeitindah hi bantukin a si lai, tiah a rak chimtu Cathiang bia cu a tlin khawh kun hnga?” tiah a ti."},"55":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih mibupi cu a thawh hna i, “Kei cu damiah hei si ning law cu bang, zeicahdah tlaih awkah nam le thingtan he nan ka fuh? Nifate in pei Biakinn ah ka ṭhu i kan cawnpiak lengmang ko hna cu, nan ka tlaih ṭung lo.","ref":"Luk 19.47; 21.37"},"56":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi thil vialte hi bantukin a sinak cu profet nih Cathiang chungah an rak ṭialmi kha a tlinnak ding caah a si,” a ti. Cun a zultu hna nih khan an dihlak in an zamtak i an le dih."},"57":{"text":"Jesuh cu a tlaitu hna nih khan Tlangbawi Ngan Kaiafas inn ah khan an kalpi i cuka ah cun Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le upa hna kha an rak i pum.","title":"Biaceihtu Bu Hmaiah An Chuahpi (Mar 14.53-65 ; Luk 22.54-55 , 63-71 ; Jhn 18.13-14 , 19-24)"},"58":{"text":"Peter nih lamhlat nawn khin a zulh i Tlangbawi Ngan inntual tiang kha a va kal. Inntual chungah khan a va lut i zeitindah thil a hung umtuning a si lai ti hngalh duh ah ralveng pawl sinah khan a ṭhu."},"59":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa pawl le biaceihtu pawl nih khan an thah khawhnak hnga, an dihlak in a sual an kawl,"},"60":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an hmu kho lo. Lihchimmi tehte tampi an hung chuak nain an hmu kho hlei lo. A donghnak ah pahnih an hung chuak i,"},"61":{"text":"“Hi pa nih hin ‘Pathian Biakinn hi ka ṭheh lai i ni thum chungah ka sak ṭhan dih lai,’ a ti,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Jhn 2.19"},"62":{"text":"Tlangbawi Ngan kha a hung dir i Jesuh cu, “Hi hna nih sual an in puhmi hi na let kho hna maw?” tiah a ti."},"63":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh cu dai tein a um ko. Cun Tlangbawi Ngan cu a hun i nolh ṭhan i, “A nungmi Pathian min chalh in, na chim hrimhrim lai, kan ti: Pathian fapa Messiah cu na si maw si lo, chim,” tiah a ti."},"64":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Na chim ko cu ta. Sihmanhsehlaw nan dihlak in hihi kan chimh hna: Atu ri hin cun Mi Fapa hi, Cung Nung Bik orhlei i a ṭhut le khuadawm cungin a rat kha nan hmuh lai,” tiah a leh hna.","ref":"Dan 7.13"},"65":{"text":"Cu bia a theih tikah cun Tlangbawi Ngan nih khan a puan kha a thleh i, “Cucu Pathian thangchiat a si. Tehte dang ahohmanh kan herh ti hna lo. Pathian thangchiatnak bia a chimmi cu nanmah nih nan theih ko cang.","ref":"Lev 24.16"},"66":{"text":"Zeitindah nan ruah?” tiah a ti. Annih nih, “A sual, thih awk a tlak,” tiah an leh."},"67":{"text":"Cun a hmaiah cil an chak i an tuk; cun a bengtu hna nih khan an thawh i,","ref":"Isa 50.6"},"68":{"text":"“Messiah cu pei na si fam cu, ahodah an beng, kan chim tuah ngat?” an ti."},"69":{"text":"Peter cu lengah, inntual ah khan a ṭhu. Tlangbawi Ngan salnu pakhat kha a ra i, “Nangmah zong hi Galilee ram mi Jesuh sin i a rak um tawnmi na si ve ko,” tiah a ti.","title":"Peter Nih Jesuh A Hlawt (Mar 14.66-72 ; Luk 22.56-62 ; Jhn 18.15-18 , 25-27)"},"70":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an dihlak hmaiah cun Peter nih khan aa pheh. “Na chimmi kong hi ka hngal lo,” tiah a leh i"},"71":{"text":"tual kutka leiah khan a va chuak. Sinum ngaknu dang pakhat nih a rak hmuh ṭhan i, “Hi pa zong hi Nazareth khuami Jesuh sin i a rak ummi a si ve,” tiah cuka i a ummi kha a chimh hna."},"72":{"text":"Peter nih aa pheh ṭhan i, “Cu pa cu ka hngal lo tiah chiatser in ka chim,” tiah a leh."},"73":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cuka i a dirmi hna nih khan Peter cu an hei fuh i, “Phehthuh hau loin nang cu an sin i a rak i tel vemi na si hrimhrim ko. Na aw cawi nih an phuan,” tiah an ti."},"74":{"text":"Cun Peter nih cun chiatser in, “Biatak ka chim lo a si ahcun Pathian nih dan ka tat seh. Cu pa cu ka hngal hrim lo,” tiah a ti. Cu caan te ah cun ar a hung khuang i"},"75":{"text":"Peter nih cun Jesuh nih, “Ar a khuan hlanah ‘Amah cu ka hngal lo,’ tiah voi thum na ka ti lai,” tiah a rak chimmi kha a lung ah a hung pem. A chuak i fak piin a ṭap."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Zingkate ah tlangbawi upa pawl vialte hna le Judah upa hna cu an i pum i Jesuh thahnak ding khua kha an khang.","title":"Jesuh Cu Pilat Hmaiah An Chuahpi (Mar 15.1 ; Luk 23.1-2 ; Jhn 18.28-32)"},"2":{"text":"Cikcin in an khih i an hei kalpi i Mangki bawi Pilat sinah khan an pek."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh a leitu Judas nih khan Jesuh cu thah awkah sual an phawt ti kha a hngalh tikah a sualnak kha aa ngaihchih i ngun tangka sawm thum kha aa lak i tlangbawi upa pawl le Judah upa hna kha a va pek ṭhan hna.","title":"Judas Thihnak (Lam 1.18-19 ; Zek 11.12-13)","ref":"Lam 1.18-19"},"4":{"text":"“A sual lomi thihnak ka phakter kha ka sual,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih cun an rak thawh i, “Cucu kan zeidah a poi? Nangmah nih naa tuahnak in vaa tuah ko,” tiah an rak leh."},"5":{"text":"Judas nih tangka cu hmunthiang chungah khan a vun hlonh i a kaltak; cun a chuak i a vaa awk."},"6":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa hna nih cun tangka cu an char i, “Hi tangka hi thisen man tangka a si, cucaah Biakinn Tangka chiahnak i chiah ve cu kan Phung he aa ralchanh,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"An i ceih dih hnuah tangka cu Um Sertu Lo timi cawknak ah khan an hman i cu lo cu ramdang mi hna thlan mual ah a cang."},"8":{"text":"Cu nih cun Thisen Lo timi sullam kha a fianter i cu hmun cu nihin ni tiang hin Thisen Lo ti cun auh a si."},"9":{"text":"Cuticun profet Jeremiah nih a rak chimmi kha a hung tling. A chimmi cu: “Israel mi hna nih, cu pa man cu cu zat in si seh, tiah an khiahmi ngun tangka sawm thum kha an i lak i","ref":"Zek 11.12-13"},"10":{"text":"um sertu lo cawknak ah khan, Bawipa nih a ka fial bangin, an hman,” ti hi a si."},"11":{"text":"Mangki bawi hmaiah cun Jesuh cu a dir i mangki bawipa nih cun, “Judah siangpahrang cu na si maw? tiah a hal. “Na chim ko cu ta,” tiah Jesuh nih a leh.","title":"Pilat Nih Jesuh Bia A Hal (Mar 15.2-5 ; Luk 23.3-5 ; Jhn 18.33-38)"},"12":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa pawl le Judah upa hna nih sual an puhmi tu cu zeihmanh a let hna lo."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah Pilat nih cun a thawh i, “Sual an in puhmi vialte hi na thei lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih bia kaa khat hmanh a let duh lo i mangki bawipa cu a khuaruah a har ngaingai."},"15":{"text":"Lanhtak Puai caan ah hin Mangki bawipa nih cun, mi zapi nih chuak seh ti an duhmi thongtla pakhat kha a chuahpiak tawn hna.","title":"Jesuh Thah Awk Bia An Khiah (Mar 15.6-15 ; Luk 23.13-25 ; Jhn 18.39—19.16)"},"16":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun thongtla pakhat, zapi nih an hngalh ngaimi a um i a min cu Jesuh Bar-Abbas a si."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah mi zapi cu an hun i pumh tikah khan Pilat nih cun, “Jesuh Bar-Abbas le Jesuh Messiah ah hin, aho deuh hi dah in chuahpiak hna ning law nan duh?” tiah a hal hna."},"18":{"text":"Pilat nih khan Jesuh ka kut chung i an ka pek hi an nahchuah caah a si ti kha fiang tein a hngalh."},"19":{"text":"Pilat cu biaceihnak khaan chung i a ṭhut lioah khan a nupi nih bia a hun cah i, “Kha mipa, sualnak zeihmanh a tuah lomi kha zei ti hmanh in rak ti hlah; zeicahtiah zahan ah ka mang in kha pa ruangah khan sifahnak tampi ka in,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa pawl le upa hna nih khan mizapi cu Pilat kha, Bar-Abbas kan thlahpiak, tiah nan hal lai i Jesuh kha that, tiah nan ti lai, tiah an lem khawh hna."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mangki bawipa nih cun, “Hi hna pahnih lakah hin, aho hi dah kan thlahpiak seh, ti nan ka duh?” tiah a hal hna. Annih nih Bar-Abbas tiah an leh."},"22":{"text":"Cun Pilat nih cun, “Khrih timi Jesuh cu zeitindah ka tuah kun lai?” tiah a hal hna. Annih nih, “Vailam ah khenh chih ko,” tiah an leh."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pilat nih cun, “Zei sualnak dah a tuah?” tiah a vun hal hna. Cu tikah fak piin an au ciammam i, “Vailam ah khenhchih ko,” an ti."},"24":{"text":"Pilat nih cu ti i ti lengmang cu zeihmanh san a tlai ti lo i mizapi nih hnahnawhnak lam an chuahter lai ti kha a hmuh tikah, ti kha aa lak i mizapi hmaiah cun a kut aa ṭawl i, “Hi misual lopa thihnak kong ah hin kei cu ka thiang, nanmah tuahmi a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Deu 21.6-9"},"25":{"text":"Mizapi nih cun an dihlak in, “Hi pa thahnak ruang i dantatnak cu kanmah le kan tefa hna cungah tlung ko seh,” an ti."},"26":{"text":"Cu tikah Pilat nih Bar-Abbas cu a thlahpiak hna i Jesuh cu fung in a tukter hna i vailam thing i thir in khenh awkah a pek hna."},"27":{"text":"Cun Pilat ralkap pawl nih khan Jesuh cu mangki bawi innpi chungah khan an luhpi i an kampani dihlak in an kulh.","title":"Ralkap Nih Jesuh An Cawhdeh (Mar 15.16-20 ; Jhn 19.2-3)"},"28":{"text":"A puan kha an phoih i puan sen an aih."},"29":{"text":"Cun hling nge in bawi luchin kha an phiar i a lu ah an chinh. A orhlei kut ah fung an putter. Cun a hmaiah an kun i an cawhdeh i, “Judah Siangpahrang cu saupi nung ko seh,” tiah an au;"},"30":{"text":"cil an chak i fung cu an chuh i a lu ah khan an tuk nak."},"31":{"text":"An cawhdeh dih hnuah puan sen kha an phoih i amah puan kha an aihter ṭhan i vailamtahnak i khenh chih dingah an chuahpi."},"32":{"text":"Cun lam ah khan Sairin khuami Simon kha an ton i a vailam tahnak thing kha hramhram in an putter.","title":"Jesuh Thing Ah An Khenhchih (Mar 15.21-32 ; Luk 23.26-43 ; Jhn 19.17-27)"},"33":{"text":"Golgotha an timi hmun kha an va phan i (Golgotha ti a sullam cu Lu Ruh Hmun tinak a si),"},"34":{"text":"mitsur hang, hnitkha he cawhmi, kha an pek; a vun teh i a ding duh lo.","ref":"Slm 22.18"},"35":{"text":"Vailam ah cun an khenh chih i a thilpuan kha phe ah an i kah i an i ṭhen."},"36":{"text":"Cun an ṭhu i an cawngh."},"37":{"text":"A lu cungah cun sual an phawtnak bia an ṭialmi kha an benh. Cu bia cu: “Hihi Jesuh, Judah Siangpahrang cu a si,” ti hi a si."},"38":{"text":"Cun Jesuh sinah cun mifir pahnih an tah ve hna; pakhat a orhlei ah pakhat a kehlei ah."},"39":{"text":"Cun aa chawkmi paoh nih khan an lu an thinhnawh i an bia-eng in,","ref":"Slm 22.7; 109.25"},"40":{"text":"“Biakinnpi hmanh pei ka ṭheh lai i ni thum ah ka sak ṭhan dih lai, na rak ti kha. Pathian Fapa na si ahcun nangmah cu i khamh kun ngat. Vailamtahnak cung khan ta, na rung ṭum kun,” an ti.","ref":"Mat 26.61; Jhn 2.19"},"41":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le upa hna nih khan an cawhdeh ve i"},"42":{"text":"“Midang cu a khamh ṭung hna, amah vial aa khamh kho ṭung lo. Israel Siangpahrang cu a si kun lo maw? Vailam tahnak cung khan atu te ah hin rung ṭum seh law pei kan zumh hnga cu."},"43":{"text":"Pathian kha aa bochan i Pathian Fapa ka si a ti. Pathian nih a khamh le khamh lo kan zoh fam lai ta!” an ti.","ref":"Slm 22.8"},"44":{"text":"A sin i mifir an tah vemi hna hmanh nih khan cu bantuk cun an nihsawh ve."},"45":{"text":"Chun in zanlei suimilam pathum tiang cu ram cu a dihlak in muihnak nih a khuh i","title":"Jesuh Thihnak (Mar 15.33-41 ; Luk 23.44-49 ; Jhn 19.28-30)"},"46":{"text":"suimilam pathum tluk ah khin Jesuh cu a au i, “Eli, Eli, lema sabakthani,” a ti, a sullam cu, “Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, zeicahdah na ka kaltak,” ti a si.","ref":"Slm 22.1"},"47":{"text":"Cu ka i a dirmi a cheukhat nih khan an theih i, “Elijah a auh cuh,” an ti."},"48":{"text":"Pakhatpa cu khulrang in a va tli i puanchia kha aa lak i mitsur hang ah a hnim i fung par ah a ṭemh i dawpter a hun zalh.","ref":"Slm 69.21"},"49":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a dang nih khan, “Um rih, amah kha khamh awkah Elijah cu a rat le rat lo kan zoh rih lai,” an ti."},"50":{"text":"Jesuh cu fak piin a au ṭhan i a cat colh."},"51":{"text":"Khi tikah Biakinn chung puanzar kha a lu in a taw tiang aa cheu. Vawlei kha aa hnin, lung kha an i cheu i","ref":"Exo 26.31-33"},"52":{"text":"thlan kha an i hung; Pathian mi a rak thi ciami tampi kha an tho ṭhan."},"53":{"text":"Thlan khan an chuak i Jesuh cu thihnak in a thawh ṭhan hnuah Khua Thiang chungah khan an lut i mi tampi nih an rak hmuh hna."},"54":{"text":"Jesuh a cawngtu ral bawi le a sin i a ummi ralkap hna nih khan lihnin le thil dang a ummi vialte kha an hmuh tikah an thla a hlauh hna i, “Hi mi hi Pathian Fapa a si hrimhrim ko,” an ti."},"55":{"text":"Galilee ram mi Jesuh a rak zul tawnmi hna le a rak bawm tawntu nu tampi nih khan a langin an cuanh.","ref":"Luk 8.2-3"},"56":{"text":"Cu hna lakah cun Mary Magdalin, Jeim le Josef nu Mary le Zebedi fapa hna i an nu kha an i tel."},"57":{"text":"Zanlei sang a si tikah khin Arimathea khua mirumpa pakhat a ra phan. A min cu Josef a si i amah zong cu Jesuh zultu pakhat a si ve.","title":"Jesuh Vuinak (Mar 15.42-47 ; Luk 23.50-56 ; Jhn 19.38-42)"},"58":{"text":"Pilat sinah khan a vung lut i Jesuh ruak kha a hal. Pilat nih Jesuh ruak cu Josef kha pe u, tiah a ti hna."},"59":{"text":"Cucaah Josef nih cun a lak i khiangrang puan tharte in a tuam i"},"60":{"text":"amah thlan ca i lungkua ah a cawhmi thlan tharte ah cun a vui. Cun lung nganpi kha thlan khar ah cun a khar i a kal."},"61":{"text":"Mary Magdalin le Mary dang pakhat kha, cuka ah cun, thlan lei hoih khan an ṭhu."},"62":{"text":"A thaizing ah, (cucu Cawnningani a hun changtu ni ah khan) tlangbawi upa pawl kha le Farasi mi hna nih khan Pilat kha an va ton i,","title":"Thlan Cawngtu Hna"},"63":{"text":"“Bawipa, hi milihchim pa nih hin a nun lioah, ‘Ni thum hnuah thawhter ka si ṭhan lai,’ a rak ti kha kan hngalh.","ref":"Mat 16.21; 17.23; 20.19; Mar 8.31; 9.31; 10.33-34; Luk 9.22; 18.31-33"},"64":{"text":"Cucaah cun thlan kha ni thum tiang ṭha tein cawng hna seh; cu ti a si lo ahcun, a zultu hna nih khan an va kal riangmang lai i a ruak kha an va fir lai i, thihnak in thawhter a si cang, tiah mi kha an chimh ko hna lai i a donghnak i a kan hlennak hi a hmasa i a kan hlennak nakkhan a chia deuh sual lai,” an ti."},"65":{"text":"Pilat nih cun, “Ralvengtu nan ngeih ko hna kha ta. Va kal u law a him khawh chung him in va tuah ko ngat u,” tiah a ti hna."},"66":{"text":"Cucaah an va kal i thlan cu him tein an cawnghter hna; lung kha ca an khenh i ralvengtu pawl kha, run veng u, an ti hna."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni cu aa lim cang i zarh khat chung ni hmasa bik ni khuadei kate ah khin, Mary Magdalin le a dang Mary kha thlan va zoh awkah cun an kal.","title":"Thawhṭhannak (Mar 16.1-10 ; Luk 24.1-12 ; Jhn 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah khin li aa hnin i Bawipa vancungmi pakhat vancung in a rung ṭum i thlankhar kha a thawn i a cungah cun a ṭhu."},"3":{"text":"A mui cu nimtlau bantuk a si i a hnipuan cu hawhra bantukin an rang."},"4":{"text":"Ralveng pawl cu an thin a phang tuk hringhran i a therh hna i mithi bantukin an um."},"5":{"text":"Vancungmi nih khan nu cu a thawh hna i, “Nan thinphang hrimhrim hlah u. Vailam tahnak thing i khenhchihmi Jesuh nan kawl ti kha ka hngalh."},"6":{"text":"Amah cu hika ah hin a um ti lo, a chim bantukte khan, a tho cang. Ra u law an chiahnak hmun hi ra zoh hmanh u."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah khulrang in va kal u law a zultu hna kha, ‘Thihnak in thawhter a si cang i atu cu nan hmaiah Galilee ram ah a rak kal chung cang; khika ah nan va hmuh lai,’ tiah va chim hna u. Cun kan chimhmi hna hi philh hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah i hnawnam ngaiin thlan khan an kir, an thin a phangpah, an i lawmpah i a zultu hna va chimh awkah khan an le."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh nih, duak tiah a vun ton hna i, “Nan sinah daihnak um ko seh,” tiah a ti hna. Amah cu an hun zuanhnawh i a ke an i tlaih i an biak."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Nan thinphang hlah u; ka unau pawl kha, Galilee ah va kal u, tiah va chim hna u, khika ah an ka hmuh lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"11":{"text":"Nu pawl cu an kir lioah khan thlan cawngtu ralveng pawl a cheukhat kha khuapi chungah an va kal i tlangbawi upa pawl kha thil a cangmi vialte cu an va chimh hna.","title":"Ralvengtu Pawl Chimmi"},"12":{"text":"Upa pawl he khan an i ton i khua an khan dih hnuah, tlangbawi upa pawl nih cun ralkap pawl kha ṭhalo tein zik an nawh hna i"},"13":{"text":"“A zultu pawl kha zan ah an ra i kan i hngilh karah a ruak kha an ra fir, nan ti lai."},"14":{"text":"Cun hi kong hi mangki bawipa nih thei ai kun, kanmah nih a ṭhat khawhnak chungin kan tuah lai i nannih cu zeihmanh fahnak nan ing lai lo,” tiah an ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Ralvengtu pawl nih khan tangka cu an i lak i cuticun nan tuah lai tiah an timi hna kha an tuah. Nihin ni tiang hin, Judah mi nih an vahtermi bia cu, hi bia hi a si."},"16":{"text":"A zultu pahleikhat hna cu Galilee ram ah khan an kal i Jesuh nih a chimhmi hna tlang ah khan an kai.","title":"Jesuh Cu A Zultu Hna Sinah A Lang (Mar 16.14-18 ; Luk 24.36-49 ; Jhn 20.19-23 ; Lam 1.6-8)","ref":"Mat 26.32; Mar 14.28"},"17":{"text":"An hmuh tikah an biak, sihmanhsehlaw a cheu cu lung awṭawm in an um."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a hun naih hna i, “Vancung le vawlei cung i a ummi nawl ngeihnak vialte cu pek ka si cang."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah khuazakip ah va kal u law miphun vialte kha ka zultu ah va ser hna u; Pa le Fapa le Thiang Thlarau min in tipilnak va pe hna u law,","ref":"Lam 1.8"},"20":{"text":"kan fialmi vialte hna hi an zulh nakhnga va cawnpiak hna u. Cun hihi philh hlah u: nan sinah a zungzal in, caan dongh tiangin ka um lai,” tiah a ti hna."}}}}},"41":{"info":{"name":"Marka","shortname":"Mark","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Pathian Fapa Jesuh Khrih kong Thawngṭha cu hitihin aa thawkning a si.","title":"Tipil Petu Johan Phungchimnak (Mat 3.1-12 ; Luk 3.1-18 ; Jhn 1.19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Profet Isaiah nih, “Pathian nih, ‘Ka tlangau cu na hmaiah ka thlah lai i na lam kha an sialpiak lai,’ a ti bantuk le","ref":"Mal 3.1"},"3":{"text":"Cun mi pakhat kha ramlak ah a au i, ‘Bawipa lam kha rak remh tuah u, A kalnak ding lam kha ding tein rak ser u,’ a ti,” bantuk kha a si taktak.","ref":"Isa 40.3"},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Johan cu ramlak ah khan a hung chuak i mi kha tipilnak a pek hna i phung kha a chimh hna. “Nan lung i thleng u law tipilnak kha ing tuah u; cun Pathian nih nan sualnak kha an ngaihthiam hna lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"5":{"text":"Judea ram le Jerusalem khua i a ummi hna nih khan amah cu an fuh luaimai i an sualnak kha an i phuang i Jordan tiva ah khan tipilnak kha a pek hna."},"6":{"text":"Johan cu kalauk hmul in tahmi hnipuan kha aa hruk i a tai ah saphaw taisawm aa sawmh, khaubawk le khuaihliti in aa cawm.","ref":"2Sia 1.8"},"7":{"text":"Mizapi cu a thawh hna i, “Ka hnu in a ra lai ding pa hi keimah nakin tampi in a ngan deuhmi a si; a kedan hri a phoihtu ding hmanh ah kei cu kaa tlak lo."},"8":{"text":"Kei nih cun tiin tipilnak kha kan pek hna, sihmanhsehlaw anih nih cun Thiang Thlarau in tipilnak cu an pek hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun Jesuh cu Galilee ram Nazareth khua khan a ra i Johan nih khan Jordan tiva ah cun tipilnak kha a pek.","title":"Jesuh Tipil Innak le Tukforh Innak (Mat 3.13—4.11 ; Luk 3.21-22 ; 4.1-13)"},"10":{"text":"Ti chungin a hung thawh dih kate ah khan, van kha aa cheu i Thlarau cu ṭhuro bantukin a cung i a run i fut kha Jesuh nih cun a hmuh."},"11":{"text":"Cun van in aw pakhat kha a theih i, “Nangmah hi ka Fapa dawt cu na si. Na cungah ka lung a tling ngaingai,” tiah aw nih cun a ti.","ref":"Gen 22.2; Slm 2.7; Isa 42.1; Mat 3.17; 12.18; Mar 9.7; Luk 3.22"},"12":{"text":"Hmakhatte ah Thlarau nih cun ramlak ah a kalter i"},"13":{"text":"khika ah ni sawm li a va um i Satan nih khan a rak tukforh. Cuka ah cun saram zong kha an rak um ve, sihmanhsehlaw vancungmi kha an ra i an rung hramh."},"14":{"text":"Johan kha thong i thlak a si hnuah Jesuh cu Galilee ram ah khan khual a tlawng i Pathian sinin a rami Thawngṭha kha a chimh hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Ngatlaitu Pali A Kawh Hna (Mat 4.12-22 ; Luk 4.14-15 ; 5.1-11)"},"15":{"text":"“A caan kha a phan cang. Pathian Pennak cu a phan dengmang cang. Nan sualnak kha kaltak hna u law Thawngṭha kha zum tuah u,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 3.2"},"16":{"text":"Galilee Rili kam i aa chawh lengmang lioah khan Jesuh nih cun ngatlai pahnih, Simon le a nau Andru kha a hmuh hna i annih cu sur in nga kha an rak tlai len ko."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh hna i, “Ka zul tuah u, mi tlaitu ah kan ser hna lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"18":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah an sur kha an kaltak i amah kha an zulh colh."},"19":{"text":"A va kal deuh i a dang unau pahnih zong kha a hmuh hna, annih cu Zebedi fapa Jeim le Johan kha an si. Annih cu an sur kha an rak tholh len ko."},"20":{"text":"A hei hmuh cangka hna khan Jesuh nih cun a auh hna i an pa Zebedi cu nihlawh phalhmi ngatlaitu hna he khan lawngah khan an kaltak i Jesuh cu an zulh."},"21":{"text":"Kapernaum khua kha a va phan i Sabbath ni ah cun Jesuh cu pumhnak inn ah khan a kal i a cawnpiak hna.","title":"Khuavang A Ngeimi Mipa (Luk 4.31-37)"},"22":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl nih an cawnpiak hna bantuk khan si loin hmual ngei ngaiin a cawnpiak hna caah an khuaruah a har.","ref":"Mat 7.28-29"},"23":{"text":"Cu liote ah cun khuavang nih a tuahmi mipa pakhat kha pumhnak inn chungah cun a rung lut i"},"24":{"text":"“Nazareth khuami Jesuh, zeidah na kan duhnak a um? Kanmah hrawh duh ah maw na rat? Nangmah cu Pathian lamkaltu a thiangmi na si kha kan hngalh ko ṭung!” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh nih khuavang cu, “Dai tein um, mipa chung khan chuak,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Khuavang nih cun mipa cu fak piin a thin a thin tak i fak piin a au i mipa chung cun a chuak."},"27":{"text":"Mizapi cu an khuaruah a har tuk hringhran i, “Mah hihi zeidah a si ee? Cawnpiaknak thar phun khatkhat maw a si? Hi pa nih hin khuavang kha chuak u, a ti hna i an ngaih ko dah ngai” tiah an ti lengmang."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh thawngpang cu Galilee ram hmun kip ah khan a thang."},"29":{"text":"Pumhnak inn khan khuazei hmanh ah pialpah loin Simon le Andru inn ah khan an kal i Jeim le Johan zong kha an sinah cun an kal ve.","title":"Jesuh Nih Mi A Damter Hna (Mat 8.14-17 ; Luk 4.38-41)"},"30":{"text":"Simon nupi nu kha a rak zaw i ihkhun ah a rak ril ko. Jesuh cu a phak cangka in an chimh."},"31":{"text":"Amah sinah cun a va kal i a kut in a va thawh. A tak linh cu a dai i annih kha a bultawl hna."},"32":{"text":"Zanlei, ni a tlak hnuah khan Jesuh sinah cun a zawmi vialte le khuavang nih a tuahmi vialte hna kha an ratpi hna i"},"33":{"text":"inn hmaiah cun cu khua mi vialte cu an i pum."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun zawtnak a phunphun in a zawmi mi tampi kha a damter hna i khuavang tampi kha a ṭhawl hna. Khuavang nih khan Jesuh cu ahodah a si kha an hngalh caah Jesuh nih cun a holh in a holhter hna lo."},"35":{"text":"A thaizing cu zingkate in, ni a chuah hlanpi ah, Jesuh cu a tho i khua leng hmun king ah thlacam awkah a kal.","title":"Galilee Ram Ah Phung A Chim (Luk 4.42-44)"},"36":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Simon le a hawile hna nih cun amah kha an va kawl."},"37":{"text":"An va hmuh tikah, “Mi kip nih an in kawl lengmang dahkaw,” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Hika hrawng i a ummi khua dang hna zong hi ka tlawn awk an si. Annih zong kha phung ka chimh ve hna awk a si, zeicahtiah anmah phung chimh awkah cun pei ka rat cu,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cucaah Galilee peng kha a tlawn dih i pumhnak inn ah khan phung a chimh hna i khuavang kha a ṭhawl hna.","ref":"Mat 4.23; 9.35"},"40":{"text":"Jesuh sinah cun thinghmuimi pakhat kha a ra i a khuk aa bil i, “Na duh ahcun na ka thianter khawh,” tiah bawmhnak kha a hal.","title":"Mithinghmui A Thianter (Mat 8.1-4 ; Luk 5.12-16)"},"41":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a zaang a fak ngaingai i a hei banh i a hei tongh. “Nangmah thianter kha ka duh, va thiang cang,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah thinghmui zawtnak nih khan cu pa cu a kaltak i a thiang."},"43":{"text":"Khi tikah Jesuh nih cun aw hrang ngaiin a thawh i,"},"44":{"text":"“Ngai hmanh, hi kong hi ahohmanh va chim hna hlah. Tlangbawi sin tu ah khan ding teomao in va kal law rak in zoh seh. Cun mi nih a thiang cang ti kha an in hngalh nakhnga, Moses nih tuah awk a timi raithawinak kha va tuah,” tiah a ti i a kalter.","ref":"Lev 14.1-32"},"45":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mipa nih cun a kalnak paoh ah khan cu kong cu a chimh hna i tam tuk in a chim caah Jesuh cu khua chungah khan langhngan in a lut kho ti lo. Hmunking tu ah khan a um i cuka ah cun a kenkip khan mi nih an rak fuh."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnu ni tlawmpal ah khan Jesuh cu Kapernaum khua ah khan a ra ṭhan i a inn ah a um ti thawng kha a thang.","title":"Jesuh Nih A Zengmi A Damter (Mat 9.1-8 ; Luk 5.17-26)"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah mi cu an ra chuak ciammam i a inn chungah cun a lawnnak pakhat hmanh um loin, innka hmai innleng zong khan an khat dih. Jesuh nih cun Pathian bia kha a chimh hna i"},"3":{"text":"cu lioah cun mi pali nih a zengmipa pakhat kha an rak zawnh."},"4":{"text":"Asinain mi an tam tuk caah Jesuh sin kha an phakpi kho lo. Cucaah Jesuh cung zawn inncung kha an baoh i mipa cu a ihphah cung i a ih bu khan an vun thlak."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh nih an ka bochan hringhran ti kha a hmuh tikah, “Ka fa, na sualnak cu kan ngaihthiam,” tiah mizengpa cu a ti."},"6":{"text":"Khika i a rak ṭhu vemi Phungbia saya a cheukhat hna nih cun,"},"7":{"text":"“Zeitindah hitihin, Pathian ralchanh in bia chim a ngamh hnga? Pathian dah ti lo nih aho nih dah sualnak a ngaihthiam khawh?” tiah an lung chungin an ti."},"8":{"text":"A thli tein an lung chung i an ruahmi cu chikkhatte ah Jesuh nih a hngalh i cucaah cun, “Zeicahdah cu bantuk thil cu nan ruah?"},"9":{"text":"Hi mizengpa sinah hin, ‘Na sualnak kan ngaihthiam,’ ti maw a fawi deuh, ‘Tho tuah, na ihphah kha i put law kal,’ ti dah a fawi deuh?"},"10":{"text":"Cucaah hmuhsak kan duhmi hna cu, Mi Fapa nih hin vawlei cungah sual ngaihthiamnak nawl a ngei, ti hi a si,” tiah a ti. Cucaah mizengpa cu a thawh i,"},"11":{"text":"“Tho tuah, na ihphah kha i lak law va ṭin, kan ti,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"An dihlak in an zoh ko lioah khan mipa cu a tho i a ihphah cu aa lak i khulrang in a kal. An dihlak in khuaruahhar in ar koin an um i Pathian kha an thangṭhat i, “Hi bantuk thil hi zeitikhmanh ah kan hmu bal lo,” tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee Rili kamah khan a va kal ṭhan. Mi nih khan an rak fuh i a rak cawnpiak hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Levi Kha A Kawh (Mat 9.9-13 ; Luk 5.27-32)"},"14":{"text":"Aa chawhpah ah khan ngunkhuai khawltu pakhat a zung i a rak ṭhut ko kha a hmuh. Cu pa cu Alfeas fapa Levi kha a si. Jesuh nih cun Levi cu, “Ka zul,” tiah a ti i a tho i a zulh colh."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh cu Levi inn ah cun rawl a hrawng. Ngunkhuai khawltu hna le misual tampi hna nih khan amah cu an zulh i tlawmpal nih khan Jesuh le a zultu hna cu rawl kha an dumpi hna."},"16":{"text":"Phungbia saya a cheukhat, Farasi mi a simi hna nih khan Jesuh cu misual hna le ngunkhuai khawltu hna he rawl a ei kha an hmuh tikah, a zultu kha an thawh hna i, “Zeicahdah ngunkhuai khawltu hna le misual hna he rawl a ei?” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh nih a theih hna i, “A dammi nih cun sibawi an herh ṭung lo, a zawmi lawng nih pei an herh ko cu; miding mi hna kawh awkah ka ra lo, misual mi hna kawh awk tu ah ka ra,” tiah a ti hna."},"18":{"text":"Voi khat cu Tipil petu Johan zultu hna le Farasi mi hna cu rawl an ul. Mi cheukhat kha Jesuh sinah khan an ra i. “Zeicahdah na zultu hna hi rawl an ulh lo?” Tipil petu Johan zultu hna le Farasi mi zultu hna nih cun an ulh ṭung?” an ti.","title":"Rawl Ulhnak Kong (Mat 9.14-17 ; Luk 5.33-39)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Nupi ṭhit rawldanghnak ah an sawmmi hna cu rawl loin an um hnga, tiah nan ruat maw? Um hlah. Nupi ṭhitupa kha an sinah a um chung paoh cu rawl loin an um hrimhrim lai lo."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nupi ṭhitu nih a kaltak hna caan a phan te lai i cu caan a phak tikah cun rawl cu an ul ve te ko lai."},"21":{"text":"“Angki hlun belhnak ah puanchia thar ahohmanh nih an hmang bal lo. An hman ahcun puanchia thar nih khan a hlunmi cu a thleh chin lai i a pemnak kha a kau chin lai."},"22":{"text":"Cun mitsur hang hriim kha a hlun mi saphaw cua chungah ahohmanh nih an rawn bal lo. An rawn ahcun mitsur hang nih khan saphaw cua cu a pah lai i a mitsur hang he a saphaw cua he an rawk dih lai. Mitsur hang hriim cu saphaw cua a tharmi ah rawn ding a si ko,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Voi khat cu Jesuh le a zultu hna kha khual an tlawnnak ah sabbath ni ah facang lo kha an tan pah hna. An kalpah ah cun a zultu hna nih khan favui kha an sih pah lengmang hna.","title":"Sabbath Kong (Mat 12.1-8 ; Luk 6.1-5)","ref":"Deu 23.25"},"24":{"text":"Cucaah Farasi mi hna nih khan Jesuh cu an thawh i, “Zohhmanh, na zultu hna nih sabbath ni ah an tuahmi hi kan Phung he aa ralchanhmi a si,” an ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “David le a mi hna nih khan, zeihmanh ei awk an ngeih lo i an rawl a ṭam tikah khan, zeidah an tuah, ti kha nan rel bal lo maw?"},"26":{"text":"Abiathar tlangbawi a si lioah pei Pathian inn chungah khan a lut i Pathian hunhmi changreu a ei kha. Cu changreu cu tlangbawi dah ti lo nih cun ahohmanh nih ei phung a si ṭung lo. Cun pei, a mi hna hmanh kha a pek ve hna kha,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"1Sam 21.1-6; Lev 24.9"},"27":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun, “Sabbath cu minung caah pei ser a si cu, minung cu sabbath caah ser an si ṭung lo,"},"28":{"text":"cucaah Mi Fapa cu sabbath Bawi zong a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu pumhnak inn ah khan a va kal ṭhan i cuka ah cun a kut a zengmipa pakhat a rak um.","title":"A Kut A Zengmipa (Mat 12.9-14 ; Luk 6.6-11)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh cu zeitindah sual kan phawt khawh lai ti a bawhmi kha an rak um i cu hna nih cun sabbath ni ah hin aho tal a damter hna lai maw ti kha ṭha tein an rak ngiat."},"3":{"text":"A kut a zengmipa cu Jesuh nih cun a thawh i, “Hmailei ah hin ra chuak tuah,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Cun mizapi cu a thawh hna i, “Kan Phung nih sabbath ni ah zeidah tuah a kan onh? Ṭhatnak nan tuah lai, a ti maw ṭhat lonak nan tuah lai, a ti dah?” tiah a ti hna. Sihmanhsehlaw bia kaa khat hmanh an chim lo."},"5":{"text":"Cu tlukin an lung a hah le an palh kha a hmuh hna tikah a thin a hung a ngaih a chia i mipa cu a thawh i, “Na kut kha samh,” a ti. A samh i a dam ai!"},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Farasi mi hna cu pumhnak inn khan an chuak i Herod minung hna he khan zeitindah Jesuh hi kan thah khawh lai, tiah khua an khang."},"7":{"text":"Jesuh le a zultu hna cu Galilee Rili ah khan an va kal i mi tampi nih an zulh hna. Cu hna cu Galilee ram in, Judea ram in,","title":"Rili Kamah A Cawnpiak Hna"},"8":{"text":"Jerusalem khua in, Idumea peng in, Jordan tiva ral ram in, le Tair le Sidon khua pawngkam i a ummi khua hna in a rami an si. Hi hna nih hin Jesuh nih a tuahmi thil kha an theih caah amah an fuhnak cu a si."},"9":{"text":"Mi cu an tam tuk hringhran i an ka naan sual lai ti kha a phan caah Jesuh nih cun a zultu hna kha lawng pakhat in ka timhpiak tuah u tiah a ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Mi tampi kha a damter hna i a zawmi paoh nih cun amah an tongh khawh nakhnga heh tiah an i zuam.","ref":"Mar 4.1; Luk 5.1-3"},"11":{"text":"Cun khuavang a ngeimi paoh nih amah an hmuh tikah khan a hmaiah cun an tlu, “Pathian Fapa na si,” tiah fak piin an au."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh nih thlarau ṭhalo hna cu, aho a si kha, ahohmanh nan chim hna lai lo, tiah fek tein a ti hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu tlang cungah a kai i a duhmi kha a kawh hna. A sinah khan an ra i","title":"Lamkal Hleihnih A Thim Hna (Mat 10.1-4 ; Luk 6.12-16)"},"14":{"text":"hleihnih kha a rak thim hna i annih cu lamkaltu tiah min a rak sak hna. A thawh hna i, “Ka sin i um awkah kan thim hna. Cun phung chim awkah kan thlah hna lai i"},"15":{"text":"khuavang ṭhawl khawhnak ṭhawnnak nan ngei lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"16":{"text":"A thimmi hleihnih cu hi hna hi an si: Simon, (Jesuh nih a min ah Peter a sakmi);"},"17":{"text":"Zebedi fapa Jeim le Johan, (Jesuh nih hi hna hi Boanerges tiah min a sak hna, a sullam cu Khuari Fa tinak a si);"},"18":{"text":"Andru, Filip, Bartholomew, Matthai, Thomas, Alfeas fapa Jeim, Thaddaius le phunṭanh Simon le"},"19":{"text":"Bawi Jesuh leitu Judas Iskariot kha an si."},"20":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu inn ah a tlung. Mi nih khan a zual in an zual ṭhan hoi caah Jesuh le a zultu hna cu rawl einak caan hmanh an ngei lo.","title":"Jesuh le Beelzebul (Mat 12.22-32 ; Luk 11.14-23 ; 12.10)"},"21":{"text":"Cucu le mi nih, “A hrut cang,” an ti kha a chungle nih an theih tikah, kan va hnuh lai, tiah an i thawh."},"22":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya cheu khat Jerusalem in a rami hna nih khan, “A chungah Beelzebul aa hrolh, Khuavang ṭhawl khawhnak a petu hi khuachia bawi cu a si,” an ti.","ref":"Mat 9.34; 10.25"},"23":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih mi kha, ka sinah ra u, tiah a ti hna i tahchunhnak bia a chimh hna. A thawh hna i, “Zeitindah Satan nih Satan cu a ṭhawl khawh lai?"},"24":{"text":"Ram pakhatkhat cu a bubu in aa ṭhen i anmah le anmah kha an i doh ahcun, zeitindah cu ram cu a dir khawh lai?"},"25":{"text":"Innchungkhar khar khat cu a bubu in an i ṭhen i an i doh ahcun a dir kho lai lo."},"26":{"text":"Cu bantukin Satan pennak zong cu a bubu in aa ṭhen i an i doh ahcun a hmun kho ve lai lo, a dong ko lai."},"27":{"text":"“A ṭhawngmi pa kha a kut le a ke ṭem hmasat lo ahcun ahohmanh nih an luhhnawh kho in a thil an chut kho lai lo; cu ti ṭem hnu lawnglawng ah a inn cu an ramh khawh lai."},"28":{"text":"“Hihi va philh hlah u. Minung hi an sualnak vialte le thil ṭhalo an chimmi vialte ngaihthiam khawh an si ko lai,"},"29":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Thiang Thlarau ralchanh in bia ṭha lo a chimmi cu zeitikhmanh ah ngaihthiam khawh an si lai lo, zeicahtiah zungzal in a hmunmi sualnak kha an tuah cang,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Luk 12.10"},"30":{"text":"(Jesuh kha, “Thlarau ṭhalo a chungah aa hrolh,” tiah an ti caah khan Jesuh nih hi bia a chimnak cu a si)."},"31":{"text":"Cun Jesuh a nu le a naule kha an ra. Inn lengah khan an dir i innchung ah cun bia an vun cah.","title":"Jesuh Nu le A Unau Hna (Mat 12.46-50 ; Luk 8.19-21)"},"32":{"text":"Jesuh cu mizapi nih khan an dum i, “Na nu le na naule kha inn lengah an um i ton an in duh,” tiah an chimh."},"33":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Ahodah ka nu cu a si? Ahodah ka naule cu an si?” tiah a ti hna."},"34":{"text":"A pawng i a ṭhumi kha a zoh hna i, “Zohhmanh u, hika ah hin ka nu le ka naule hna cu an um."},"35":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian nih tuah hna seh, tiah, a duhmi thil a tuahmi paoh cu ka nau, ka far le ka nu an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih Galilee Rili kamah khan a cawnpiak ṭhan hna. A velchum i aa pummi cu an tam tuk caah lawng chungah khan a lut i a ṭhu. Lawng cu ticung pi ah khan a va um i mi cu tikam ah cun ti ri le ri lo tiang khan an um.","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Bianabia (Mat 13.1-9 ; Luk 8.4-8)","ref":"Luk 5.1-3"},"2":{"text":"Cun thil tampi kha bianabia in a cawnpiak hna. A thawh hna i,"},"3":{"text":"“Ngai hmanh u. Thlaici vorh awkah mipa pakhat cu aa thawh."},"4":{"text":"Lo chung i thlaici a vorh ah khan a cheu cu lamhril ah an tla i va nih an char hna."},"5":{"text":"A cheu cu vawlei tlawmnak lung tamnak hmun ah khan an tla. Vawlei kha a chah lo caah thlaici kha khulrang in a keuh zau."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ni a hung chuah i thlaici keuh ka tete cu a hun emh hna tikah an hram kha a thuh lo caah an car zau."},"7":{"text":"Thlaici a cheu cu hling lakah an tla, hling cu an ṭhang i an ṭem hna i theipar an ngei kho lo."},"8":{"text":"Asinain thlaici a cheu cu vawlei ṭhatnak ah an tla, an hung keu, an hung ṭhang i theipar an ngei: a cheu let sawm thum in an karh, a cheu let sawm ruk in an karh, a cheu let za khat in an karh,” tiah a ti"},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun, “Theihnak hna nan ngeih ahcun, i theih ko uh,” tiah a ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh cu amah lawngin a um tikah khan, a bia a theimi hna le a zultu hleihnih hna kha a sinah an ra i bianabia sullam cu kan chim tuah, tiah an ti.","title":"Cu Bianabia Sullam (Mat 13.10-17 ; Luk 8.9-10)"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Pathian Pennak biathli cu nannih cu pek nan si cang, sihmanhsehlaw lenglei i a ummi hna cu bianabia lawnglawng in cawnpiak an si."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Cathiang nih a chim bantukin, an zoh lengmang ko lai nain zeihmanh an hmu lai lo; an thei lengmang ko lai nain zeihmanh an hngal lai lo, zeicahtiah an hmuh i an hngalh sual ahcun Pathian lei ah an i mer sual lai i an sualnak kha a ngaihthiam sual ai hna hnga,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 6.9-10"},"13":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih annih cu, “Hi bianabia hi nan hngal kho lo maw? Hi hmanh nan hngalh khawh lo ah zeitindah bianabia dang cu nan hngalh khawh kun lai?","title":"Jesuh Nih Bianabia A Fianter (Mat 13.18-23 ; Luk 8.11-15)"},"14":{"text":"Thlaici vorhtu nih a vorhmi cu Pathian bia a si."},"15":{"text":"Micheu cu lam kam i a tlami bantuk an si. Bia kha an theih cangka Satan kha a ra i an chung bia kha a kalpi."},"16":{"text":"A dang cu lung tamnak i a tlami bantuk an si. Bia cu an theih cangka lunglawm in an cohlan."},"17":{"text":"Asinain an chungah khan thuk a pil lo i cucaah sau an rau lo. Cu bia ruang i hremnak siseh, harnak siseh, an hung um tikah an i ngol zau."},"18":{"text":"Cun a dang cu hlingbur i a tlami thlaici bantuk a si. Hi hna hi Pathian bia kha a theih cu a thei i"},"19":{"text":"asinain lungretheihnak le rum duhnak le duhnak dangdang kha an hung chuah tikah, kha hna nih khan Pathian bia cu an ṭemṭawn caah, theipar zeihmanh a ngei lomi kha an si."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi a cheu cu vawlei ṭha i a tlami thlaici bantuk an si. Pathian bia kha an theih i an cohlan i thei an tlai: a cheu cu a let sawm thum in, a cheu cu a let sawm ruk in, a cheu cu a let za khat in,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Aho tal nih meiinn kha nan i luhpi tikah kho tangah siseh, ihkhun tangah siseh, nan chia bal maw? Meifar vannak hmun ah khan nan chiah tawn a si lo maw?","title":"Kho Tang Meiinn Chiah (Luk 8.16-18)","ref":"Mat 5.15; Luk 11.33"},"22":{"text":"A ken i thuh a simi vialte kha a langhnak hmun ah chuahpi an si dih lai, a chin khuh a simi thil vialte kha hun an si dih lai.","ref":"Mat 10.26; Luk 12.2"},"23":{"text":"Cucaah theihnak hna nan ngeih ahcun thei ko u,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun hi zong hi a chimh hna: “Nan theihmi kha ṭha tein ruat u. Nan tah hna ning tein tah nan si ve lai i tam deuh hmanh chap nan si lai.","ref":"Mat 7.2; Luk 6.38"},"25":{"text":"A ngeimi kha chap an si lai i a ngei lomi cu a ngeih ciami hmanh kha chuh an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 13.12; 25.29; Luk 19.26"},"26":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Pathian Pennak cu hi bantuk hi a si: Mipa pakhat nih thlaici kha a lo ah a tuh.","title":"A Ṭhangmi Thlaici Bianabia"},"27":{"text":"Zan ah a it, zing ah a tho i rian a ṭuan i cu chung vialte ah khan thlaici cu an rak keuh i an rak ṭhang, sihmanhsehlaw zeitindah cuticun an si ti kha cu a hngal lo."},"28":{"text":"Vawlei nih khan thlai kheu cu a ṭhanter hna i thei a tlaiter hna, a hmasa bik ah a hnah zimno tete kha an hung chuak, cun an hung vui i an hung zaa."},"29":{"text":"Cun an hung hmin tikah ṭuan caan a cut cang caah a ṭuantupa nih a facang hlehnak fa-ah in a hleh hna,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Joe 3.13"},"30":{"text":"“Pathian Pennak cu zei he dah aa lo, kan ti lai? A sullam langhternak dingah zei tahchunhnak dah kan hman lai?","title":"Anṭam Ci Bianabia (Mat 13.31-32 ; Luk 13.18-19)"},"31":{"text":"Vawlei cung thlaici lak i a hme bikmi anṭam ci bantuk a si. Mi nih an i lak i vawlei ah an tuh;"},"32":{"text":"cun tlawmpal hnuah a hung ṭhang i thlaihring kung lak i a ngan bik ah a cang. A nge kha a ngan pipi an si caah vate kha an ra i a thladem ah bu kha an ser,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Hi bantuk bianabia tampi kha hmang in, Jesuh nih an hngalh khawh tawk in, Pathian bia kha a chimh hna."},"34":{"text":"Annih cu tahchunhnak hmang loin a chim hna lo, sihmanhsehlaw a zultu he lawng an um tikah cun zeizong vialte kha an sullam fiang tein a chimh hna."},"35":{"text":"Cu ni zanlei ah cun Jesuh nih a zultu hna kha, “Rili khattelei ral ah khin va kal u sih,” tiah a ti hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Thlichia A Daihter (Mat 8.23-27 ; Luk 8.22-25)"},"36":{"text":"Cucaah mizapi kha an kaltak hna. Jesuh a rak ṭhutnak lawng chungah khan an lut i Jesuh cu an kalpi. Cuka ah cun lawng dang zong kha an um ve."},"37":{"text":"Cun thlichia a tho ciammam i tilet cu lawng chungah khan an lut cuahmah ko i an lawng cu ti kha a khat dengmang."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng hnulei ah khan a um i chantling cungah khan a rak i hngilh. A zultu hna nih khan an va hlauh i, “Saya, kan thih dengmang cang ṭung, zei poi loin maw na um ko?” an ti."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh cu a tho i thlitu cu, “Hrang ti hlah,” tiah nawl a pek i tilet cu, “Dai tuah,” tiah a ti. Thli cu a dai zuahmah i rili cu dai zirziar tein a um."},"40":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih annih cu, “Zeicahdah cu ti hringhran in nan thin a phan? Zeicahdah zumhnak nan ngeih lo?” tiah a ti hna."},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu an thin a phang tuk hringhran i pakhat le pakhat cu, “Hi pa hi mi zei ko dah a si hnga? Thlitu le tilet hmanh nih dahngai a bia an ngaih ko hi,” an ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cuticun Galilee Rili ral, Gerasa mi hna ram cu an va phan.","title":"Jesuh Nih Khuavang Ngeimipa A Damter (Mat 8.28-34 ; Luk 8.26-39)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng chungin a chuah cangka khan, mithi an vui hnanak lungkua i a um tawnmi mipa pakhat nih a rak ton."},"3":{"text":"Hi pa hi khuavang nih a molhter i thlan ah khan khua a sami a si. Ahohmanh nih thir cikcin zongin an hreng kho ti lo;"},"4":{"text":"voi tampi cu a kut le a ke kha an ṭem tawn, sihmanhsehlaw an ṭem fate thir cikcin cu a chah dih hna i a ke hreng an khenhnak thir cu a khiah dih hna. Ahohmanh nih an tei kho lo."},"5":{"text":"Chun he zan he thlan lakah cun le tlang hna ah cun aa chawk lengmang i a au i lung khan aa cum aa deng lengmang."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh a hei hmuh ah khan lamhlat nawn ah khin a um, cucaah a va tli i a hmaika ah khan a khuk aa bil i"},"7":{"text":"fak piin a au i, “Cung Nung Bik Pathian Fapa Jesuh, zeidah na ka duhnak a um? Zei kan ti hnga, dan cu ka tat sawh hlah,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"(Hi bia a chimnak cu, Jesuh nih khan, “Thlarau ṭhalo, hi pa chung hin chuak,” tiah a rak ti caah a si.)"},"9":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih amah cu, “Na min zeidah a si?” tiah a hal. Mipa nih cun, “Tampi kan si caah ka min cu ‘Bupi’ a si,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun thlarau ṭhalo hna cu cu ram chung cun thawl sawh hna hlah, tiah heh tiah Jesuh cu a nawl."},"11":{"text":"An pawngah cun vok run nganpi pakhat a um i tlang cungah khan an tlong."},"12":{"text":"Thlarau nih cun Jesuh cu, “Vok sinah khin kan kalter law an chungah khin kan luhter tuah,” tiah an nawl."},"13":{"text":"Cucaah a kalter hna. Thlarau ṭhalo cu mipa chung khan an chuak i vok chungah khan an lut. Vok cu an dihlak in lungpang cung khan rili chungah an zuang ciammam i an thi dih, thong hnih tluk an si."},"14":{"text":"Vok a cawngtu hna cu an zam i cu thawng cu khua chungah le lo lakah khan an thanh hna. Cu ti thil a ummi zoh awkah cun mi kha an va kal."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh sin cu an va phan i a sinah cun a chung i thlarau ṭhalo bupi a um tawnmipa kha, hnipuan i hruk le lungfim in a rak ṭhut ko kha an va hmuh i an dihlak in an thla a hlauh hna."},"16":{"text":"Cu thil a hmutu hna nih cun mihrutpa cu zeitindah a dam i vok cungah khan zeidah a tlung ti kha mizapi cu an chimh hna."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh cu, kan ram in chuak ko, tiah an nawl."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng chung i a luh lioah khuavang a rak ngeimipa nih khan, “Na sinah kal ve ko ning,” tiah a nawl."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a onh lo. “Inn tu ah va tlung law Bawipa nih zeizat riamruam dah na ca i a tuahmi kha a si le zeitluk in dah an zaangfah kha, na chungle kha va chim deuh hna,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah mipa cu a kal i Khua Hra peng timi kha a tlawng i Jesuh nih a tuahpiakmi kha a chimh hna; cun a theimi vialte cu an khuaruah a har dih."},"21":{"text":"Jesuh cu Rili khattelei ral ah khan a ra kir than. Rilikam ah cun mi tampi nih a zual in an zual.","title":"Jairu Fanu Damnak le Jesuh Puanki A Tawngminu (Mat 9.18-26 ; Luk 8.40-56)"},"22":{"text":"Pumhnak inn uktu a simipa pakhat a min Jairu a simi kha a hung i Jesuh kha a hmuh tikah a ke hramah a bawk i a si khawh chungin a nawl:"},"23":{"text":"“Ka fanute cu a zaw i a zual ngaingai ko. Zaangfahnak tein ra law a cungah na kut ra chia ko sawh, cu ti na tuah ahcun a dam lai i a nung ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu amah sinah cun a kal. A zultu cu an tam tuk caah a kenkiplo in an hnursuan len ko."},"25":{"text":"Cu hna lakah cun nu pakhat, thichuahnak in kum hleihnih a zaw cangmi a um."},"26":{"text":"Sibawi tampi nih an thlop i cu thlopnak ahcun a ngeihchiah vialte zong a hmang dih cang nain a ṭha deuh hlei lo; a zual in a zual chin."},"27":{"text":"Mi nih Jesuh kong an chim lengmang cu a rak theih ve i"},"28":{"text":"a puan ka tawngh hmanh ah ka dam lai, tiah a ti. Cucaah zapi lakah cun hnulei in a ra i a puan kha a tawngh."},"29":{"text":"Cu ka hmun le cu caan te ah cun a thi chuah cu a dam i ka zawtnak in ka dam cang, ti kha aa hngal."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh nih a chungin ṭhawnnak a chuah kha chikkhatte ah a hngalh i zapi lakah cun aa mer i, “Ahodah ka puan a tawng?” tiah a ti hna."},"31":{"text":"A zultu nih cun, “Mi hi zat nih an in hnursuan len cu na hngalh ko tung, zeicahdah ahodah a ka tawng? na ti?” an ti."},"32":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih cun ahodah a ka tawngtu kha a si hnga, tiah a zoh lengmang ṭhiamṭhiam ko."},"33":{"text":"Minu nih khan a cung i a tlungmi cu a hngalh i cucaah ther lengmang le phang lengmang in a ra i a ke hramah a bawk i a kong kha a chimh dih."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Ka fanu, na zumhnak nih an damter cang. Dai tein va kal law na zawtnak cun va dam ko cang,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cu bia cu Jesuh nih a chim lioah khan Jairu inn cun zualko an ra i, “Na fanu cu a thi cang, sayapa cu hnahnawh ti hlah,” tiah an rak chimh."},"36":{"text":"Jesuh nih an chimmi cu zeihmanh ah rel duh loin a um i, “Na thinphang hlah, a zumh bel zum ko,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin cun Peter le Jeim le a nau Johan dah ti lo kha cu, ahohmanh aa zulhter duh ti hna lo."},"38":{"text":"Pumhnak inn uktu inn kha an va phan i Jesuh nih cun an i tuai len ko le an ṭah le an ai kha a hmuh hna,"},"39":{"text":"A vung lut i, “Zeicahdah hitihin nan i tuai len ko? Zeicahdah nan ṭah len ko? Ngakchia cu a thih ṭung lo, aa hngilh i pei a si ko cu,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Annih nih cun a nih in an nih i cucaah an dihlak in a chuahter hna i ngakchianu a nu le a pa le a zultu pathum hna kha aa kalpi hna i ngakchianu an suannak khaan chungah cun an va lut."},"41":{"text":"A kut in a vun tlaih i, “Talitha koum,” tiah a ti; cu a sullam cu, “Ngakchianute, tho, kan ti,” tinak a si."},"42":{"text":"Hmakhatte ah a tho i aa chawk colh. (Amah cu kum hleihnih mi a si). Cu thil an hmuh tikah an khuaruah a har tuk i a molh dengmang hna."},"43":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih ahohmanh nan chim hna lai lo, tiah fek tein nawl a pek hna i, “Ei awk pe tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih cuka hmun cun aa thawh i a chuahkehnak khua ah khan a zultu hna he an kal.","title":"Jesuh Nazareth Ah An Hlawt (Mat 13.53-58 ; Luk 4.16-30)"},"2":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah khan pumhnak inn ah cun a cawnpiak hna. Aa pummi cu an tam ngaingai i a chimmi an theih tikah khan an khuaruah a har dih. “Hi vialte hi khuazei ah dah a va hmuh hnga? Hi bantuk fimnak hi zeitindah a va hmuh hnga? Zeitindah hi khuaruahharnak hna hi a tuah khawh hna hnga!"},"3":{"text":"Mary fapa, lehtama kha a si lo maw? Jeim le Joses le Judas le Simon hna u kha a si lo maw? A farle zong kha hika ah an um ko lo maw?” an ti. Cucaah cun zei ah an rel lo."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun annih cu a thawh hna i, “Profet hi amah a chuahkehnak khua le a sahlawh a rualchan hna lakah dah ti lo ahcun hmaizahnak a hmu ve ko hen pei,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jhn 4.44"},"5":{"text":"Khika ah khan khuaruahhar zeihmanh a tuah kho lo, a zawmi tlawmte lawng an cungah a kut a chuan i a damter hna."},"6":{"text":"Zumhnak an ngeih lo caah a khuaruah a har ngaingai. Cun Jesuh cu, cuka hrawng khua kha a tlawng hna i mi kha a cawnpiak hna."},"7":{"text":"A zultu pahleihnih kha hmunkhat ah a kawh hna i pahnih pahnih in a thlah hna. Khuachia tei khawhnak nawl kha a pek hna i,","title":"Jesuh Nih Hleihnih A Thlah Hna (Mat 10.5-15 ; Luk 9.1-6)"},"8":{"text":"“Nan khualtlawnnak dingah hin, ṭhiangṭhunh dah ti lo cu zeihmanh i ken hlah u; riahcaw siseh, zal siseh i phorh hlah u, nan angki zal ah phaisa zong i sanh hlah u."},"9":{"text":"Phanah i danh u law angki a khethuan i hruk hlah u,” a ti hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun annih cu, “Khua nan va phak tikah, ‘Kan tlung u,’ a rak in timi hna inn ah cuka khua in nan chuah hlantiang va um ko u."},"11":{"text":"Cun tluninn an in dawnh hna i nan bia an ngaih duh lo ahcun, cuka hmun cu nan kebeh va khawnhnawhtak u law va chuahtak u. Cucu an caah ralrin peknak a si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Luk 10.4-11; Lam 13.51"},"12":{"text":"Cucaah an chuak i, nan sualnak in i mer u, tiah mi kha an chimh hna."},"13":{"text":"Khuachia tampi an ṭhawl hna i a zawmi tampi kha chiti an thuh hna i an damter hna.","ref":"Jei 5.14"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh thawngpang cu khuazakip ah a than caah Siangpahrang Herod zong nih cu kong cu a rak theih ve. Mi a cheu nih an i thawh i, “Tipil petu Johan kha a nung ṭhan. Cucaah cun pei hi ṭhawnnak a ngeih hi a si cu,” an ti.","title":"Tipil Petu Johan Thihnak (Mat 14.1-12 ; Luk 9.7-9)"},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a cheu nih cun, “Elijah a si,” an ti. Cun a cheu nih cun, “Hlanlio profet ngan pakhatkhat hna bantuk khan profet a si ve ko,” an ti.","ref":"Mat 16.14; Mar 8.28; Luk 9.19"},"16":{"text":"Cucu Herod nih a theih tikah, “Hi pa hi Tipil petu Johan kha a si ko. A lu kha ka rak tanter hna. Sihmanhsehlaw a nung ṭhan ko hi ta!” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Herod hrimhrim nih khan Johan cu nan tlaih lai i nan khih lai i thong ah nan thlak lai, tiah a rak ti hna. Herod nih hi thil a tuahnak cu Herodias kha a nau Filip nupi a si nain nupi ah aa ṭhit caah a si."},"18":{"text":"Tipil petu Johan nih khan, “Na nau nupi nangmah ca i ṭhit cu a ṭha lo,” tiah a rak chimh lengmang i","ref":"Luk 3.19-20"},"19":{"text":"cucaah cun Herodias nih khan Johan cu a lung chung tein a uam ziar i thah a duh; sihmanhsehlaw Herod nih a dawnh caah a that kho lo."},"20":{"text":"Herod nih cun Johan kha a ṭih ngaingai, zeicahtiah mi ṭha le mi thiang a si kha a hngalh i him tein a umter ko. A bia a theih fate lung sivang in a um tawn ko nain a chimmi ngaih kha cu a duh ko."},"21":{"text":"A hmanung bik ah Herodias nih caan rem kha a hmuh. Cu caan cu Herod chuah ni ah khan a si i Herod nih cun uknak lei a tlaitu bawi vialte hna le ralkap lei bawi hna le Galilee ram upa hna caah khan puai a tuah."},"22":{"text":"Herodias fanute kha a rung lut i a laam i Herod le a sawmmi bawi hna cu an lung a ton ngaingai hna. Cucaah siangpahrang nih cun ngakchianute cu a thawh i, “Zeidah na duh hnga? Na duhmi paoh kan pek lai,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun bia tiangin aa kam i, “Na ka halmi paoh cu kan pek hrimhrim lai, ka ram hnarcheu tiang hmanh in kan pek lai,” tiah chiatserh tein a chim."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah ngakchianu cu a chuak i a nu kha, “Zeidah ka hal lai?” tiah a va hal. A nu nih cun, “Tipil petu Johan lu,” tiah a leh."},"25":{"text":"Ngakchianu cu siangpahrang sinah khan khulrang in a va kir ṭhan i, “Tipil petu Johan lu kha atu hrimhrim ah dar kheng in ka pe law ka duh,” tiah a va ti."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang cu a awlok a chong ko, sihmanhsehlaw a sawmmi upa hna hmaiah khan, kha ti khan bia aa kam laklawh cang ṭung caah, a al kho lo."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah ralvengtu ralkap pakhat kha a hei thlah i Johan lu cu na rak put lai, tiah nawl a pek. Ralkappa cu a chuak i thonginn ah khan a va kal i Johan lu cu a va tan;"},"28":{"text":"dar kheng cun a rak put i ngakchianu kha a pek i ngakchianu nih a nu kha a pek chin."},"29":{"text":"Johan thihnak kong cu a zultu hna nih khan an theih tikah an ra i a ruak kha an lak i thlan ah an vui."},"30":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna kha an ra tlung i Jesuh he khan an i tong i an tuahmi vialte le an cawnpiakmi hna vialte kha an chimh.","title":"Mi Thong Nga Rawl A Pek Hna (Mat 14.13-21 ; Luk 9.10-17 ; Jhn 6.1-14)"},"31":{"text":"A tlung kal an tam tuk hringhran caah Jesuh le a zultu hna cu rawl einak caan hmanh an hmu lo. Cucaah annih cu a thawh hna i, “Kanmah lawng tein kan um khawh nakhnga le a dinh zong nan i dinh nakhnga, kanmah lawngin kaa khatkhat ah kal tuah u sih,” tiah a ti hna."},"32":{"text":"Cucaah anmah lawng cun hmunking i kal awkah an i thawh."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi tampi nih an kal kha an hmuh ṭhiamṭhiam hna i hmakhatte ah ahodah an si kha an hngalh fawn caah a khua kip khan an chuak i tlang lam khan an rak kalkanh hna i Jesuh le a zultu hna an phak hlanah khan a hmun kha an rak phan."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh cu lawng chung khan a hung chuak i mi cu vialte a hmuh hna tikah khan a zaang an fak ngaingai, zeicahtiah khaltu a ngei lomi tuu bantuk an si. Cucaah thil tampi a cawnpiak hna.","ref":"Nam 27.17; 1Sia 22.17; 2Cha 18.16; Eze 34.5; Mat 9.36"},"35":{"text":"Khua a hung tlai zualmal tikah a zultu hna cu a sinah khan an ra i, “Atu hi a tlai ngaingai cang i hi hmun hi mi um lonak hmun a si."},"36":{"text":"Cucaah mi hi kalter hna law kan pawngkam lo hna le khua hna ah hin ei awk vaa cawk hna seh,” tiah an ti."},"37":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh hna i, “Nanmah nih ta ei awk cu nan pek hna,” tiah a ti hna. Annih nih, “A si ahcun, ngun tangka za hnih in rawl va cawk i anmah kha pek maw, na kan duhmi cu a si?” an ti."},"38":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih khan annih cu, “Changreu tlang zeizat dah nan ngeih? Va kal u law va zoh tuah u,” tiah a ti hna. An va zoh dih in, “Tlang nga le nga pahnih,” tiah an ti."},"39":{"text":"Khi tikah Jesuh nih cun a zultu hna cu, mi kha a bubu in ram hring cungah khan nan ṭhutter hna lai, tiah a ti hna."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah mi cu a tlangtlang in an ṭhu i bu khat ah za khat, bu khat ah sawm nga, tiin an um."},"41":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih khan changreu tlang nga le nga pahnih cu a lak hna i van kha a zoh i Pathian sinah lunglawmhnak bia a chim. Changreu cu a cheu hna i a zultu kha a pek hna i mizapi kha pe hna u, tiah a ti hna. Cun nga pahnih zong kha an dihlak in a phawt hna."},"42":{"text":"An dihlak in an ei i an khim dih."},"43":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna nih khan changreu ṭiltlawt le nga ṭiltlawt cu sei hleihnih khat an char."},"44":{"text":"Changreu a eimi cu pa thong nga an si."},"45":{"text":"Cucu a dih cangka in Jesuh nih a zultu hna cu lawng chungah a luhter hna i rili khattelei ral i a ummi Bethsaida khua ah khan ka hlan ah rak kal u, tiah a ti hna; anih tu cu mizapi kha a run thlahtak hna.","title":"Jesuh Ti Cungah A Kal (Mat 14.22-33 ; Jhn 6.15-21)"},"46":{"text":"A zultu kha a kalter dih hna hnuah anih cu thlacam awkah tlang cungah a kai."},"47":{"text":"Khua a muih tikah lawng cu rili laifang kha a phan i Jesuh tu cu amahte lawngin tlang ah khan a um ko."},"48":{"text":"Thli kha anmah lei hoih in a hran caah a zultu hna nih khan an lawng zah cu an i harh ngai, ti kha a hei hmuh hna. Cucaah zinglei suimilam pathum le paruk kar hrawngah khin an sinah ti cung cun a ra i lonh hnek khi a zalh hna."},"49":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ti cung i a kal cu"},"50":{"text":"an dihlak in an hmuh i an thin a phang i, mithla a si, tiah an ruah i an ai. Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih cun khulrang tein a hei chawnh hna i, “Nan thin phang hlah u, keimah ka si,” tiah a ti hna."},"51":{"text":"Cun lawng chungah cun an sinah khan a vung lut i thlitu cu a dai. A zultu hna cu an khuaruah a har tuk hringhran i an lung a ar ko,"},"52":{"text":"zeicahtiah changreu sullam kha an rak hngal kho lo, an lung a rak pem kho lo."},"53":{"text":"Rili cu an tan i Genesaret ah lawng cun an ṭum i khika ah an lawng cu an hren.","title":"Genesaret ah Mizaw A Damter Hna (Mat 14.34-36)"},"54":{"text":"Lawng chungin an chuah cangka khan Jesuh a um kha mi nih cun an hngalh colh."},"55":{"text":"Cucaah cuka ram ah cun khulrang in an kal i a um an theihnak paoh ah a zawmi kha lang in an hei put hna."},"56":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu a kalnak kip ah khan, khuate ah siseh, khuapi ah siseh, lo ah siseh, mi nih an mizaw hna cu chawdawrnak hmun ah khan an rak chuahpi cio hna i, a zawmi hna nih hin na puanki tal in tawng hna seh, tiah an nawl; cun a tawngmi paoh cu an dam."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Farasi mi bu khat le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya tlawmpal Jerusalem in a rami hna nih khan Jesuh cu an va leng.","title":"Pupa Cawnpiaknak (Mat 15.1-9)"},"2":{"text":"A zultu cheukhat cu kut ṭawl loin rawl an ei kha an hmuh hna — a sullam cu Farasi mi hna nih cuticun nan kut nan i ṭawl awk a si, an tining in an i ṭawl lo tinak a si."},"3":{"text":"Farasi mi hna le Judah mi hna nih cun an pupa nih an cawnpiakmi hna phung kha ṭha tein an zulh: cuticun nan kut nan i ṭawlning a si lai, timi ning in an i ṭawl lo ahcun rawl an ei lo;"},"4":{"text":"cun chawdawr i an va cawkmi thil zong kha a ningcang tein an ṭawl hna lo ahcun an ei fawn hna lo. Cuticun an pupa hna nih an chimhmi hna phung dangdang zong an zulhmi tampi a um, a biana ah hrai ṭawlning tehna, um ṭawlning tehna, darkheng ṭawlning tehna le ihkhun ṭawlning tehna an si."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Farasi mi hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih khan Jesuh cu an thawh i, “Zeicahdah na zultu hna nih hin kan pupa hna cawnpiaknak ningin zul loin kut ṭawl loin rawl an ei?” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Nannih kong a rak chim tikah hin Isaiah hi a va hmaan dah! A ṭial bantuk tein miziathiam nan si taktak ko. A ṭialmi cu hitihin a si: ‘Pathian nih aa thawh i, Hi mi hna nih hin an bia cun an ka upat ko, Asinain an lung cun an ka hlat taktak.","ref":"Isa 29.13"},"7":{"text":"Annih nih minung serchommi nawlbia kha Pathian nawlbia taktak bantukin mi an cawnpiak hna caah An ka biak hi an caah zeihmanh a ṭhahnem lo,’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Nannih nih cun Pathian nawlbia kha nan chiah riangmang i minung cawnpiaknak tu kha nan zulh deuh,” tiah a ti hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun a thawh ṭhan hna i, “Nanmah cawnpiaknak tu kha fehter i Pathian nawlbia hlawt kha cu nan thiam ngai ko."},"10":{"text":"Zeitindah a si tiah, Moses nawl pekning ah khan, ‘Na nu le na pa na upat hna lai i a nu siseh a pa siseh a vawlpammi cu thah a si lai,’ ti a si.","ref":"Exo 20.12; 21.17; Lev 20.9; Deu 5.16"},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih cun nan i thawh zau i, ‘Mi pakhatkhat nih a nu le a pa cu, “Nanmah bawmhnak caah ka timi ka thil kha Korban a si ai,” a ti hna ahcun,"},"12":{"text":"cu pa cu a nu le a pa bawmh kha a luat,’ nan ti. (Korban ti a sullam cu Pathian ta a si, tinak a si)."},"13":{"text":"Hi bantuk i nannih nih midang nan cawnpiak chin lengmangmi hna nih hin Pathian bia kha a vaivuanhter. Cun hi bantukin nan tuahmi thil a dang tampi a um rih,” tiah a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih mizapi kha a auh ṭhan hna i, “Nan dihlak in ka bia hi ngai u law hngal tuah u.","title":"Zei Nih Dah Mi Cu A Thurter? (Mat 15.10-20)"},"15":{"text":"Mi cu lenglei in chunglei ah a lutmi thil nih a thurter lo. A chungin a chuakmi thil tu nih a thurter."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah theihnak hna nan ngeih ahcun thei ko u,” tiah a ti hna."},"17":{"text":"Mizapi kha a kaltak hna i inn chung i a luh tikah khan a zultu nih hi bianabia kong kha an hal."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Midang nakin nan fim hlei lo hi ta! Nan hngal kho hrim lo maw?
