Minung cu lenglei in a chungah a lutmi thil nih cun a thurter lo."},"19":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a lung chungah lut loin a paw chung tu ah a lut i a pum lengah a chuak ṭhan ko” tiah a ti hna. (Hitihin Jesuh nih a ti tikah hin rawl zeipaoh hi ei awkah aa tlakmi an si ko a ti duhnak a si)."},"20":{"text":"Cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Minung a thurhnawmhtertu cu a chungin a chuakmi hi an si."},"21":{"text":"Zeicahtiah ṭhat lonak ziaza a tuahtertu ruahnak ṭhalo kha chunglei in a lung chungin a chuakmi an si: nu le pa sualnak tehna, fir tehna, mi thah tehna,"},"22":{"text":"va cung pa duh tehna, hakkauh tehna, ṭhat lonak a phunphun tuah tehna, lihchim tehna, zuanzam tehna, mi nahchuah tehna, mi congoih tehna, lungpuam tehna, ningcang lo khuasak tehna —"},"23":{"text":"hi thil ṭhalo vialte hi minung chunglei in a chuakmi an si i minung a thurtertu cu hi hna hi an si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun cuka cun Jesuh cu a chuak i Tair peng ah khan a kal. Inn pakhat chungah a lut i ahohmanh nih ka um hi hngal hna hlah seh ti a duh, sihmanhsehlaw aa thup kho lo.","title":"Foinisia Minu Zumhnak (Mat 15.21-28)"},"25":{"text":"Nu pakhat, a fanu khuavang nih a tuahmi nih khan Jesuh thawng cu a theih i khulrang tein a sinah cun a ra i a ke hramah a bawk."},"26":{"text":"Cu nu cu Jentail mi, Siria ram Foinisia khua i a chuakmi a si. Jesuh cu, ka fanu chung i a ummi khuachia cu ka ṭhawlpiak tuah, tiah a nawl."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih cun a thawh i, “Rawl cu fale kha pe hmasa hna u sih, fale rawl cu i lak zau i uico pek cu a hmaan deuh lo,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun minu nih cun, “A si ko, Bawipa, sihmanhsehlaw fale rawl ṭilṭawt cu cabuai tang i a ummi uico hmanh nih an ei ve tawn ko,” tiah a leh."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih cun, “Cu bantukin na ka leh caah na inn ah va ṭin ko, na fanu chungin khuachia kha a chuak cang,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cucaah inn ah cun a ṭin i a fanu cu ihkhun cung i a rak ih ko kha a va hmuh; khuachia nih cun a rak chuahtak taktak cang."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh cu Tair peng khan a chuak i Sidon pal pah in Galilee Rili ah khan a kal; Khua Pahra timi ram kha a tan.","title":"Hnachet Holh Thiam Lo A Damter"},"32":{"text":"A sinah mipa pakhat an ratpi i cu pa cu a hna a chet i a holh zong a holh kho set lo, Jesuh cu a cungah na kut chia ko, tiah an nawl."},"33":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih cun zapi sin khan lamhla nawn ah khin amah lawngin aa kalpi i a hnakhaw chungah cun a kutdong a sawh i a cil a chak i mipa lei cu a tongh."},"34":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu van a cau i fak piin a hrum i mipa cu, “Effatha,” tiah a ti, a sullam cu, “I hung tuah,” tinak a si."},"35":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah mipa cu a hna kha an awng i a lei cu a luat i ṭha tein a holh kho."},"36":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih khan, hi kong cu ahohmanh nan chim hna lai lo, tiah a thlauh hna; sihmanhsehlaw tam deuh in a thlauh hna paoh ah tam deuh in an chim chin."},"37":{"text":"Cun a theimi paohpaoh cu an khuaruah a har dih. “A tuahmi thil hi an va ṭha hringhran dah! Hnachet kha an hna a awnter hna i a holh kho lomi zong kha holh kho in a tuah hna,” tiah an thangṭhat."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun mi tampi an i pum ṭhan i ei awk zeihmanh an ngeih ti lo tikah Jesuh nih a zultu kha a kawh hna i,","title":"Thong Li Rawl A Pek Hna (Mat 15.32-39)"},"2":{"text":"“Hi hna hi ka sinah ni thum an um cang i atu cu ei awk zeihmanh an ngei ti lo, ka zaang an fak ko."},"3":{"text":"Rawl ei loin ka tlunter hna ahcun lampi ah an buhri lai, a cheu cu lamhla piin a rami an si fawn,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"A zultu nih cun an thawh i, “Hi ramlak ah hin aho nih dah minung hi zat cu rawl a pek khawh hna lai?” an ti."},"5":{"text":"“Changreu tlang zeizat dah nan ngeih?” tiah a hal hna i, “Tlang sarih,” tiah an leh."},"6":{"text":"Mizapi cu vawlei ah khan ṭhu u, tiah a ti hna. Cun changreu tlang sarih kha aa lak i Pathian sinah lawmhnak bia a chim hnuah a beoh hna i mizapi kha phawt awkah a zultu kha a pek hna; cun a zultu hna nih cun mizapi cu an phawt hna."},"7":{"text":"Nga hme tete tlawmpal zong an ngei. Jesuh nih cun nga ca zongah cun lawmhnak bia kha Pathian sinah a chim i a zultu hna cu, phaw hna u, tiah a ti hna."},"8":{"text":"An dihlak in an ei i an khim dih, minung cu thong li tluk an si."},"9":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna nih khan a ṭiltlawt sei sarih an char. Jesuh nih mizapi cu a kalter hna i"},"10":{"text":"khulrang in a zultu hna he lawng chungah an lut i Dalmanutha peng ah an kal."},"11":{"text":"Farasi mi kha an ra chuak i bia an i al. Amah kha hneksak an duh caah, “Pathian thlahmi na si si lo hngalhnak ah khuaruahhar pakhat in tuah tuah,” an ti.","title":"Farasi Mi Nih Khuaruahhar Tuah An Fial (Mat 16.1-4)","ref":"Mat 12.38; Luk 11.16"},"12":{"text":"Jesuh cu fak piin a hrum i, “Zeicahdah tu chan mi nih hin khuaruahharnak tuah nan ka fial? Ka tuah lai lo, cu bantuk hmelchunhnak cu tu chan mi hi kan pe hrimhrim hna lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 12.39; Luk 11.29"},"13":{"text":"Cuticun a kaltak hna i lawng chungah cun a lut ṭhan i rili khattelei kamah khan an kal."},"14":{"text":"A zultu hna nih khan changreu phorh an philh i lawng chungah cun tlang khat lawng an ngei.","title":"Farasi Mi Thilnu I Ralring U (Mat 16.5-12)"},"15":{"text":"Annih cu Jesuh nih khan a thawh hna i, “Farasi mi hna thilnu le Herod thilnu kha i ralring u,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Luk 12.1"},"16":{"text":"Cu tikah annih nih, “Changreu kan ngeih lo caah pei hitin a kan ti ko hi,” tiah an i ceih."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh nih an i ceihmi cu a hngalh i cucaah, “Zeicahdah changreu nan ngeih lonak kong cu nan i ceih len ko? Nan thei kho in nan hngal kho rih hrim lo maw?"},"18":{"text":"Cuticun maw nan lung a pin ko? Mit nan ngeih ko ṭung, nan hmu kho lo maw? Hna nan ngeih ko ṭung, nan thei kho lo maw?","ref":"Jer 5.21; Eze 12.2; Mar 4.12"},"19":{"text":"Minung thong nga ca i changreu tlang nga ka cheu kha nan philh manh maw? A ṭiltlawt kha sei zeizat dah nan char kha?” tiah a ti hna. Annih nih, “Sei hleihnih,” tiah an leh."},"20":{"text":"“Cun minung thong li ca i tlang sarih ka cheu ah khan tah sei zeizat dah a ṭiltlawt nan char kha?” tiah a ti i, “Sei sarih,” tiah an leh."},"21":{"text":"Cun “Nan hngal kho bal rih hrim lo maw?” tiah a hal hna."},"22":{"text":"Bethsaida khua kha an phan i Jesuh sinah cun mitcawpa pakhat an ratpi i a rak tawngh nakhnga an nawl.","title":"Bethsaida Ah Mitcawpa A Damter"},"23":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun mitcawpa cu a kut in aa hruai i khua lengah a chuahpi. Mipa mit cu a cil a chak hnuah Jesuh nih cun a cungah a kut a chuan i, “Zei tal na hmu kho maw?” tiah a hal."},"24":{"text":"Mipa cu van a hun cau i, “Mi ka hmuh khawh hna, sihmanhsehlaw thingkung khi i chawk hna seh law, cu ko cu an lo,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih mipa mit cu a kut in a tongh ṭhan i mipa nih cun fak piin a hun zoh i khua a hun hmu kho i zeizong vialte kha fiang tein a hmuh hna."},"26":{"text":"Jesuh nih inn ah a ṭinter i, “Nan khuachung mi ahohmanh va chim hna hlah,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh le a zultu hna cu Sisaria Filipi peng khuate tlawn ah an i thawh. Lampi ah cun a thawh hna i, “Mi nih, aho a si, an ka ti dah, ka chim tuah u,” tiah a ti hna.","title":"Peter Nih Messiah Na Si, A Ti (Mat 16.13-20 ; Luk 9.18-21)"},"28":{"text":"Annih nih, “A cheu nih, Tipil petu Johan a si, an in ti. A cheu nih Elijah a si, an in ti. A cheu nolh nih, profet pakhatkhat a si, an in ti,” tiah an leh.","ref":"Mar 6.14-15; Luk 9.7-8"},"29":{"text":"Cun annih cu, “Nannih nih tah, aho a si, nan ka ti dah?” tiah a ti hna i Peter nih, “Messiah na si,” tiah a leh.","ref":"Jhn 6.68-69"},"30":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih, “Ka kong hi ahohmanh chim hna hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a zultu kha a cawnpiak hna i, “Mi Fapa nih hin temhinnak tampi ka huah lai, upa hna le tlangbawi upa pawl hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih an ka hlawt lai. Thihnak ka huah lai i ni thum hnuah ka tho ṭhan lai,” tiah a chimh hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih A In Lainak Kong Le A Thih Lainak Kong A Chim (Mat 16.21-28 ; Luk 9.22-27)"},"32":{"text":"Hihi fiang tein a chimh hna caah Peter nih kaa dang deuh ah khin a hei i kalpi i a mawhchiat."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh cu aa mer i a zultu hna lei kha a zoh i Peter cu a mawhchiat ve i, “Ka sinin kal ko, Satan; zeicahtiah na ruahning hi minung ruahning a si, Pathian ruahning a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih mizapi le a zultu hna kha a auh hna i, “Zulh a ka duhmi paoh cu mah zawn aa ruat lomi nan si lai. Cun nan vailamtahnak kha nan i put lai i nan ka zulh lai.","ref":"Mat 10.38; Luk 14.27"},"35":{"text":"Zeicaahtiah a nunnak khamh a duhmi cu a nunnak kha a sung lai i keimah ruang le thawngṭha bia ruang i a nunnak a sungmi nih a nunnak kha a khamh lai.","ref":"Mat 10.39; Luk 17.33; Jhn 12.25"},"36":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih vawlei hi a ning piin co seh law, a nunnak sung ṭung seh law, zeital a miak hnga maw? Miak hlah!"},"37":{"text":"Cun a nunnak cu zeital in a caw ṭhan kho hnga maw? Caw ṭhan kho hlah."},"38":{"text":"Atu chan, Pathian zei ah a rel lo i chan ṭhalo a simi chan ah hin, keimah le ka cawnpiaknak a ka zahpimi cu, Mi Fapa hi ka Pa sunparnak in vancung mithiang mi hna he ka rat tikah, ka zahpi ve hna lai,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun a thawh hna i, “Biatak kan chimh hna, hika i a dirmi lakah hin, Pathian pennak a ṭhawnnak he a rat nan hmuh hlan cu, a thi lo dingmi tlawmpal nan um,” tiah a ti hna."},"2":{"text":"Cun ni ruk hnuah Jesuh nih cun Peter le Jeim le Johan kha aa kalpi hna i anmah lawngin tlang sang pakhat ah aa kaipi hna. Annih nih an zoh ko lioah khan a hun i thleng i","title":"Jesuh Muihmai Thlennak (Mat 17.1-13 ; Luk 9.28-36)","ref":"2Pet 1.17-18"},"3":{"text":"a thilpuan cu a tleu in an tleu i an rang ngaingai; cu tluk rang cun vawlei cung mi ahohmanh nih an su kho lai lo."},"4":{"text":"Cun zultu pathum hna nih cun Elijah le Moses kha Jesuh he bia an i ruah len ko cu an hmuh hna."},"5":{"text":"Peter nih cun a hun thawh i Jesuh cu, “Saya, hika kan um hi thil ṭha a si. Deu pathum in kan sak lai, nang caah pakhat, Moses caah pakhat, Elijah caah pakhat,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Peter le a hawile cu an thin a phang tuk hringhran i zeihmanh chim awk an hngal lo."},"7":{"text":"Minmei a hung zam i a hun zelh hna i minmei chung cun aw pakhat a hung chuak i, “Hihi ka dawtmi ka Fapa a si, a bia kha ngai u,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 3.17; Mar 1.11; Luk 3.22"},"8":{"text":"Khulrang in an pawngkam cu an zoh i midang ahohmanh an hmu hna lo, Jesuh lawng kha an sinah cun a um ko."},"9":{"text":"Tlang cungin an ṭum pah ah khan Jesuh nih, “Mi Fapa hi thihnak in ka thawh hlanah cun nan hmuhmi kha ahohmanh chim hna hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"10":{"text":"A nawl cu an zulh, sihmanhsehlaw anmah le anmah cu an i ceih i, “ ‘Thihnak in thawh’ timi hi a sullam zeidah a si ee?” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu, “Zeicahdah Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl nih, ‘Elijah a rat hmasa awk a si,’ an ti?” tiah an hal.","ref":"Mal 4.5; Mat 11.14"},"12":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Zeizong vialte rak timh chung awkah Elijah cu a ra hmasa taktak ko. Asinain, zeicahdah Cathiang nih, Mi Fapa nih temhinnak tampi a huah lai i a hlawt zong hlawt a si lai, tiah a ti hnga?"},"13":{"text":"A chimh cu kan chimh ko hna lai, Elijah cu a ra ko cang i Cathiang nih a chim bantukte khan mi nih an duh bantuk tein a cungah an ṭuan ko cang,” tiah a leh hna."},"14":{"text":"A zultu dang hna sin kha an va phak tikah, mi tampi an rak um kha an hmuh hna. Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya a cheu khat kha a zultu hna he cun bia an rak i al len ko.","title":"Thlarau Ṭhalo Nih A Tlakmi Ngakchiapa A Damter (Mat 17.14-21 ; Luk 9.37-43a)"},"15":{"text":"Mizapi nih khan Jesuh cu an hmuh cangka in an lau i an va tli i an va don."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh nih a zultu hna cu, “Zeidah nan i al?” tiah a ti hna."},"17":{"text":"Mizapi lak cun pakhat pa nih a hun leh i, “Saya, ka fapa cu khuavang nih a tuah i a holh khawh lo caah na sinah ka ratpi."},"18":{"text":"Khuavang nih a chuahhnawh fate vawlei ah khan a thluk i a buanbara a tawh i a hacang aa rial i a ṭhom dih. Na zultu kha khuavang ṭhawl cu ka fial hna nain an ṭhawl kho lo,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun, “Nan va zum lo hringhran dah! Zei can dah nan sinah hin ka um a herh rih lai? Zei can dah kaan in hna lai? Ngakchiapa cu ratpi u,” tiah a ti hna."},"20":{"text":"Cun a sinah cun an ratpi. Khuachia nih khan Jesuh kha a hmuh cangka in ngakchiapa cu mah hngal loin a tuah i vawlei ah a hrilh i heh tiah aa let len i a buanbara zong a tawh dih."},"21":{"text":"“Hi ti a umnak hi zei can dah a si cang?” tiah Jesuh nih cun a pa kha a hal. “A ngakchiate in,” tiah a pa nih cun a leh."},"22":{"text":"Cun a pa nih cun, “Mei chung hawi hna ah a paih, ti chung hawi hna ah a thlak i voi tampi a thah dengmang tawn. Zei kan ti hnga, na kan bawmh khawh ahcun kan bawm hram ko sawh,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Na kan bawmh khawh ahcun na ti maw? Asi, zumhnak a ngeimi caah cun zei paoh a si kho ko,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cun a pa cu a au i, “Ka zumh ko, sihmanhsehlaw a za lo, ka bawm tuah!” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun zapi nih an naih chin lengmang hna kha a hmuh tikah, thlarau ṭhalo cu, “A hna zong a chet i a holh zong a holh kho lomi thlarau, ngakchiapa chung khan chuak law a luh zong lut ṭhan ti hlah, kan ti,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Khuavang nih cun ngakchiapa cu mah hngal loin a vun tuahtak i cun a chuak. Ngakchiapa cu miruak bantuk a si ko, cucaah aho paoh nih, “A thi,” an ti."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih khan ngakchiapa cu a kut in a vun thawh i a hung dir."},"28":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu inn chungah a luh hnuah a zultu hna nih khan a thli tein, “Zeicahdah kannih nih kha khuachia kha kan ṭhawl khawh lo?” tiah an hal."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Hi bantuk phun hi cu thlacamnak dah ti lo nih cun zeihmanh nih a ṭhawl kho lo,” tiah a leh hna."},"30":{"text":"Cuka hmun cun an chuak i Galilee ram ṭol pah thluahmah in an kal. Jesuh nih a zultu pawl kha a cawnpiak lio hna a si caah, a umnak kha ahohmanh nih hngal hna hlah seh ti a duh.","title":"Jesuh Nih A Thihnak Ding Kong A Chimh Ṭhan Hna (Mat 17.22-23 ; Luk 9.43-45)"},"31":{"text":"Zeitindah a cawnpiak hna tiah, “Mi Fapa hi mi kut chungah chanh ka si lai i cu hna nih cun an ka thah lai. Sihmanhsehlaw ni thum hnuah ka tho ṭhan lai,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Cu cawnpiaknak cu a sullam an hngal lo, sihmanhsehlaw an hal ngam lo."},"33":{"text":"Kapernaum khua kha an phan i inn chung i an luh hnuah, Jesuh nih a zultu hna cu, “Lampi ah khan zeidah nan i al?” tiah a hal hna.","title":"Ahodah A Ngan Bik? (Mat 18.1-5 ; Luk 9.46-48)"},"34":{"text":"Lampi i an i almi cu, kan lakah hin ahodah a ngan bik, ti kha a si caah an let ngam lo.","ref":"Mat 5.30"},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cu a ṭhu i zultu hleihnih hna cu a auh hna i, “A ngan bik si a duhmi cu nauta bik ah le mi vialte sal ah aa chiah hrimhrim awk a si lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"36":{"text":"Ngakchia pakhat kha a lak i an hmaiah a dirter. Ngakchiapa cu a kuh i annih cu,"},"37":{"text":"“Ka min in hi bantuk ngakchia pakhat khat a cohlangmi paoh cu keimah a ka cohlan a si; cun keimah a ka cohlangmi paoh cu keimah lawng kha a ka cohlan si loin a ka thlahtu zong kha a cohlan a si,” tiah a ti hna."},"38":{"text":"Johan nih a thawh i, “Saya, na min in khuachia a ṭhawlmi pakhat kan hmuh i kan bu chungmi a si lo caah, tuah ti hlah, kan ti,” tiah a chimh.","title":"Kan Ral Si Loin Kan Hawi A Si (Luk 9.49-50)"},"39":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Tuah ti hlah, ti hlah u, zeicahtiah ka min in khuaruahhar mi thil a tuahmi nih cun ka thang cu a ka chiat kho lai lo."},"40":{"text":"A kan doh lomi cu a kan bawmmi an si.","ref":"Mat 12.30; Luk 11.13"},"41":{"text":"Nannih cu Messiah zultu nan si ruangah mi nih ti hrai khat zong an in pek hna ahcun, cu hna cu laksawng hmu loin an um hrimhrim lai lo, ti kha va philh hlah u,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 10.42"},"42":{"text":"Keimah a ka zummi, hi ngakchia tete hna lak i pakhat hmanh hi, ka lam in a pialtertu cu, a hngawng ah facang rialnak lung tumpi thlaih i rili chung i thlak kha a caah a ṭha deuh.","title":"Tukforhnak (Mat 18.6-9 ; Luk 17.1-2)"},"43":{"text":"Cucaah nan kut nih an pialter hna ahcun, tan ko u! Kut pahnih he a mit lomi hell chung i tlak nakin kut loin nunnak chung i luh kha nan caah a ṭha deuh.","ref":"Mat 5.30"},"44":{"text":"Cuka ah cun an tholung kha an thi ti lo i mei kha a mit ti lo."},"45":{"text":"Cun nan ke nih an pialter hna ahcun, tan ko u! Ke pahnih he hell chung i tlak nakin ke loin nunnak chung i luh kha nan caah a ṭha deuh."},"46":{"text":"Cuka ah cun an tholung kha an thi ti lo i mei kha a mit ti lo."},"47":{"text":"Cun nan mit nih an pialter hna ahcun khoih ko u! Mit pahnih he hell chung i tlak nakin mit pakhat he lawng Pathian Pennak chung i luh kha nan caah a ṭha deuh."},"48":{"text":"Cuka ah cun an tho lung kha an thi ti lo i mei kha a mit ti lo.","ref":"Isa 66.24"},"49":{"text":"“A mi kip kha mei in cite bantukin alter an si lai."},"50":{"text":"Cite hi a ṭha. Sihmanhsehlaw a alnak kha a loh ahcun zeitindah na alter ṭhan khawh ti lai? Nan chungah cite kha i ngeih u law pakhat le pakhat kha i rem tein um u,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 5.13; Luk 14.34-35"}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu cuka hmun cun a chuak i Judea ram ah khan a kal i Jordan tiva kha a tan. Cun mi tampi nih khan a zual in an zual hoi i a cawnpiak tawn zungzal hna bang khan a cawnpiak hna.","title":"Nupi Maknak Kong (Mat 19.1-12 ; Luk 16.18)"},"2":{"text":"Farasi mi kha an ra i foih an ra timh. “Kan phung nih nupi mak hi a kan onh maw onh lo, kan chim tuah,” tiah an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh nih biahalnak in a leh hna i, “Moses nih zei phung dah an pek hna?” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Annih nih, “Moses nih a kan pekmi ah cun, mipa nih a nupi kha maknak ca a pek ahcun a mak khawh ko, ti a si,” tiah an leh.","ref":"Deu 24.1-4; Mat 5.31"},"5":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh hna i, “Moses nih hi nawlbia an ṭialpiak hna cu, nannih kha cawnpiak nan har tuk hringhran caah a si."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a hramthawk, thil ser lio caan ah khan cun, cathiang nih, ‘Pathian nih nu le pa in a ser hna i","ref":"Gen 1.27; 5.2"},"7":{"text":"cu ruangah cun pa nih a nu le a pa kha a kaltak hna lai i a nupi he an i komh lai i,"},"8":{"text":"an pahnih cun pakhat ah an cang lai,’ a ti bang khan a si. Cucaah pahnih an si ti lo, pakhat lawng an si cang.","ref":"Gen 2.24"},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih a fonhmi hna cu minung nih ṭhen awk a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Inn chung i an luh ṭhan tikah khan Jesuh cu a zultu hna nih hi kong cu an hal."},"11":{"text":"Annih cu, “A nupi kha a ma i nu dang a ṭhimi cu a nupi cungin nu dang duh sualnak a tuah a si;"},"12":{"text":"cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in a va kha a kirtak i midang a vami cu va cungin pa aa duh a si ve,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 5.32; 1Kor 7.10-11"},"13":{"text":"Jesuh sinah khan, a kut in rak tawng hna seh, tiah ngakchia tete kha an ratpi hna, sihmanhsehlaw a zultu hna nih khan cu hna cu an rak sik hna.","title":"Ngakchia Thluachuah A Pek Hna (Mat 19.13-15 ; Luk 18.15-17)"},"14":{"text":"Cucu Jesuh nih a hmuh tikah a thin a hung i a zultu hna cu, “Ngakchia cu ka sinah ratter ko hna u. Pathian Pennak cu hi bantuk mi hna ta hi a si caah, annih cu kham hna hlah u."},"15":{"text":"Mah hi philh hlah u. Pathian Pennak kha ngakchia nih an cohlan bantukin a cohlang lomi cu, ahohmanh Pathian Pennak chungah cun an lut lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 18.3"},"16":{"text":"Cun ngakchia cu a pom hna i an cungah a kut a chuan i thluachuahnak a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu khual tlawn ah aa thawh ṭhan i cu lioah cun mipa pakhat a hung tli i a hmaiah a khuk aa bil i, “Saya, nangmah cu mi ṭha na si. Zungzal nunnak hmuh awkah zeidah ka tuah lai?” tiah a hal.","title":"Mirumpa Kong (Mat 19.16-30 ; Luk 18.18-30)"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Zeicahdah, saya ṭha, na ka ti? Pathian dah ti lo cu ahohmanh a ṭhami an um ṭung lo."},"19":{"text":"Nawlbia kha na hngalh ko ṭung hna: ‘Lai va nawng hlah; nupi cung le va cungin midang cungah sual hlah, fir hlah, lih chim hlah, mi va hleng hna hlah, na nu le na pa va upat hna!’ ti pei an si kha,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 20.12-16; Deu 5.16-20"},"20":{"text":"Cu pa nih cun, “Saya, hi nawlbia vialte hi cu ka ngakchiat lio in ka zulh lengmang ko cang hna,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Dawtnak lungthin he Jesuh nih dengteo in a vun zoh i, “Pakhat lawnglawng na bau, va kal law na ngeihmi thil vialte kha va zuar law tangka cu sifakmi kha va ṭhen hna, cun vancung ah rothil na ngei lai; cun ra law ka zul,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cu bia cu mipa nih khan a theih tikah a hmai a chia i ngaihchia ngaiin a kir; zeicahtiah a rum ngaingaimi a si."},"23":{"text":"Jesuh nih a zultu kha a zoh hna i, “Mirum mi caah cun Pathian Pennak chung luh hi a va har lai dah!” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cu a chimmi bia an theih tikah a zultu hna cu an khuaruah a har ko. Asinain Jesuh nih a thawh ṭhan hna i, “Ka fale hna, Pathian Pennak chung luh hi zeitluk in dah a har!"},"25":{"text":"Kalauk ṭhim kaa chung luh hi mirum Pathian Pennak chung luh nakin a fawi deuh,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Hi bia an theih tikah a zultu hna cu an khuaruah a har tuk hringhran i, “Ahodah khamhnak cu a hmu kho kun lai?” tiah pakhat le pakhat kha an i hal."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun dengteo in a zoh hna i, “Hihi minung caah cun a si kho lo, sihmanhsehlaw Pathian caah cun a si kho ko, zeicahtiah Pathian nih a tuah khawh lomi zeihmanh a um lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"28":{"text":"Cun Peter nih, “A si ahcun, kannih hi tah? Zeizong vialte kaltak in kan in zulh ṭung,” tiah a hun ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “A inn siseh, a lo siseh, a unau si hna seh, a farle si hna seh, a nu siseh, a pa siseh, a fale si hna seh, keimah le ṭhawngṭha ruangah a kaltakmi nih cun,"},"30":{"text":"tam chinchin in atu chan ah hin a hmuh hrimhrim lai. Inn siseh, lo siseh unau si hna seh, far siseh, nu siseh, fa siseh; a let za khat in an hmuh lai; cun hremnak zong an hmuh lai; cun a ra dingmi chan ah hin zungzal nunnak an hmuh lai."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu i a hmasa bik a simi hi, mi tampi cu a hmanung bik an si lai i atu i hmanung bik a simi hi, mi tampi cu hmasa bik an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 20.16; Luk 13.30"},"32":{"text":"Jerusalem khua leiah khan an hung kal i Jesuh cu an hmaiah khan a kal i a zultu hna kha an khuaruah a har; cun an hnu in a hun zul vemi midang hna kha an thin a phang. Jesuh nih cun zultu pahleihnih hna kha a dang ah aa kalpi ṭhan hna i a cung i a tlung dingmi thil kong kha a chimh hna.","title":"A Thihnak Kong A Chim Voi Thumnak (Mat 20.17-19 ; Luk 18.31-34)"},"33":{"text":"A thawh hna i, “Jerusalem khua kan hung phan lai i Mi Fapa hi tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl hna kut chungah khan an chanh lai. Annih nih cun, thih awktlak a si, tiin sual an phawt lai i, cun Jentail mi hna kut ah an chanh chin lai."},"34":{"text":"Cu hna nih cun an cawhdeh lai, cil an chak lai, fung in an tuk lai i an thah lai. Cun ni thum hnuah a tho ṭhan lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"35":{"text":"Khi tikah Zebedi fapa Jeim le Johan kha Jesuh sinah cun an ra i, “Saya, na kan tuahpiak awk kan duhmi thil a um,” an ti.","title":"Jeim le Johan Nih An Halmi (Mat 20.20-28)"},"36":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Zeidah kan tuahpiak seh ti nan ka duhmi cu a si?” tiah a ti hna."},"37":{"text":"Annih nih, “A sunglawimi na Pennak chung i na bawiṭhutdan cung i na ṭhut tikah na sinah kan ṭhutter ve law kan duh, pakhat na orhlei kamah, pakhat na kehlei kamah,” tiah an ti."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh hna i, “Nan ka halmi hi nan hngal lo. Ka din dingmi hrai hi nan din khawh lai maw? Tipil ka in ding ning hin nan in khawh ve lai maw?” tiah a ti.","ref":"Luk 12.50"},"39":{"text":"Annih nih, “Kan ti khawh ko lai,” tiah an leh. Jesuh nih cun, “Ka din dingmi hrai hi nan din khawh ve taktak ko lai i ka in dingmi tipil inning hi nan in khawh ve taktak ko lai."},"40":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka orhlei kam i ṭhut le ka kehlei kam i ṭhut cu keimah pek khawhmi a si lo. Hi hmun cu Pathian nih a timhpiakmi hna kha a pek ko hna lai,” tiah a leh hna."},"41":{"text":"Hi kong kha a dang zultu pahra hna nih khan an theih tikah Jeim le Johan cungah cun an thin a hung."},"42":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh nih an dihlak in a auh hna i, “Vawlei cungah cun uktu bawi hna nih an ukmi michia hna cu, a lal in an lalhnawh tawn hna i hruaitu hna nih a uk in an uk tawn hna ti cu nan hngalh.","ref":"Luk 22.25-26"},"43":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu hi bantukin nan si awk a si lo. Mi ngan si a duhmi cu nan sinum a si awk a si,"},"44":{"text":"bawi cem si a duhmi cu nan dihlak sal a si awk a si.","ref":"Mat 23.11; Mar 9.35; Luk 22.26"},"45":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Mi Fapa hmanh hi, rian ṭuanpiakmi si awkah ka rat ṭung lo, midang rian ṭuanpiaktu si awk le mi tampi tlanhnak ding ca i ka nunnak pek awkah pei ka rat cu,” tiah a ti hna."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh le a zultu hna le mibupi cu Jeriko khua kha an phan. Jeriko khua cun an i thawh lioah khin lam pawngah mitcaw Bartimu, Timau fapa kha a ṭhu i thil a hal hna.","title":"Mitcaw Bartimu A Damter (Mat 20.29-34 ; Luk 18.35-43)"},"47":{"text":"Nazareth khuami Jesuh a si ti kha a theih tikah, “Jesuh, David Fapa, ka zaangfah tuah,” tiah a au."},"48":{"text":"Mi tampi nih an sik i dai tein um ko, tiah an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw thang chinchin in, “David Fapa, ka zaangfah tuah,” tiah a au chin."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh cu a dir i, “Hei au u,” tiah a ti. Cucaah mitcawpa cu an hei auh i, “Na thanuam ko, tho, an kawh cuh,” an ti."},"50":{"text":"A puan kha a hlonh duak i a pet i Jesuh sinah cun a ra."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Zeidah in tuahpiakning law na duh?” tiah a hal. Mitcawpa nih cun, “Saya, khua hmuh ṭhan ka duh,” tiah a leh."},"52":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Va kal kun, na zumhnak nih an damter cang,” tiah a ti. Chikkhatte ah khin khua cu a hun hmu i lam ah cun Jesuh cu a zulh."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jerusalem khua kha an hei naih cang i Oliv Tlang i a ummi Bethfeih le Bethani khua kha an phak tikah, Jesuh nih a zultu pahnih kha a thlah hna i","title":"Sunparnak In Jerusalem Ah A Lut (Mat 21.1-11 ; Luk 19.28-40 ; Jhn 12.12-19)"},"2":{"text":"“Nan hmai khua ah khin va kal u law nan va luh kate ah, ahohmanh nih an i cit bal lomi laa fate, hri in aa hreng komi kha nan hmuh lai. Va phoih u law hika ah hin ratpi u."},"3":{"text":"Cun mi nih, ‘Zeicahdah mah khakha nan tuah?’ tiah an in hal hna ahcun. ‘Kan Bawipa nih a herh i kan rak in pek ṭhan zau hna lai,’ tiah nan ti lai,” a ti hna."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah an rak kal i khua chung zalam ah cun inn pakhat innka pawngah laa fate pakhat a rak i hren ko cu an va hmuh. An phoih lioah khan"},"5":{"text":"an pawng i a dirmi micheu nih khan, “Zeidah nan tuah? Laa fate hri maw nan phoih?” tiah an hal hna."},"6":{"text":"Jesuh nih a chimh hna bantuk khan an leh hna i, i kalpi ko u, tiah an ti hna."},"7":{"text":"Laa cu Jesuh sinah khan an ratpi i an puan kha a keng ah an danh i Jesuh nih aa cit."},"8":{"text":"Mi tampi nih an puan kha lam ah khan an phah, cun a cheu nih lo lak i thingnge kha an va sam hna i lam ah cun an phah hna."},"9":{"text":"“Hosanna! Bawipa min in a rami cu Pathian nih thluachuahnak pe ko seh.","ref":"Slm 118.25-26"},"10":{"text":"Kan pu David pennak a ra liomi cu thluachuahnak hmu ko seh! Hosanna! A sang bik van ah khin Pathian cu thangṭhat si ko seh,” tiah an ti."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem khua ah khan a lut, Biakinn ah khan a va lut i zeizong vialte a va zoh dih. Sihmanhsehlaw cu ni cu a tlai cang caah Bethani khua ah khan a zultu hleihnih hna he khan an kir ṭhan."},"12":{"text":"A thaizing, Bethani khua in an ra kirpah ah khan, Jesuh cu a rawl a ṭam.","title":"Jesuh Nih Theipi Kung Chiat A Serh (Mat 21.18-19)"},"13":{"text":"Lamhlat nawn khin a hnah a ṭha ngaimi theipi kung pakhat a hei hmuh i a tlai a um hnga maw tiah a hei fuh; sihmanhsehlaw a hei phak tikah, cu caan cu theipi tlai tik a si lo caah, a hnahpi lawng a rak si kha a va hmuh."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun theipi kung cu, “Na thei ahohmanh nih in ei ti hna hlah seh,” tiah a ti. Cucu a zultu hna nih khan an theih."},"15":{"text":"Jerusalem kha a va phak tikah Jesuh cu Biakinn ah khan a va kal i Biakinn chung i chaw a dawrmi le chaw a cawmi kha a ṭhawl dih hna. Tangka thlengtu pawl cabuai le laileng zuartu pawl ṭhutdan kha a leh dih hna i","title":"Jesuh Cu Biakinn Ah A Kal (Mat 21.12-17 ; Luk 19.45-48 ; Jhn 2.13-22)"},"16":{"text":"Biakinn tual kha thilri i chawhpinak ah hmang ti hlah u, tiah a thlauh hna."},"17":{"text":"Cun mizapi kha a cawnpiak hna i, “Ca Thiang chungah, Pathian nih, ‘Ka inn cu miphun vialte hna thlacamnak inn a si lai,’ a ti, tiah aa ṭial. Sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih cun mifir kua ah nan ser cang,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Isa 56.7; Jer 7.11"},"18":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih khan cucu an theih i cucaah amah thahnak dingah khan lam an kawl. Mizapi cu an dihlak in a cawnpiaknak nih khan an lung a ton tuk hna caah tlangbawi le saya pawl nih khan amah cu an ṭih."},"19":{"text":"Zanlei sang khuamui deng ah khin, Jesuh le a zultu hna cu khuapi chung khan an chuak."},"20":{"text":"A thaizing zingkate ah, an kal pah ah khin, theipi kung kha an hei zoh. A rak thi i a hram tiangin a car dih.","title":"Theipi Kung Kha A Thi (Mat 21.20-22)"},"21":{"text":"Peter cu thil a rak ummi kha a lung a hung pem i, “Saya, zohhmanh, chiat na serhmi theipi kung kha a thi diam ko,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Pathian kha zum ko u."},"23":{"text":"Biatak kan chimh hna, ahohmanh nih hi tlang hi, ‘Tho law rili ah khin vaa paih,’ tiah zumh lonak zeihmanh um loin nan ti i, kan chimmi hi a tling lai, tiah nan zumh ahcun, tuahpiak nan si ko lai.","ref":"Mat 17.20; 1Kor 13.2"},"24":{"text":"Cucaah cun, thlacam in nan halmi thil paoh kha, kan hmuh cang, tiah zum u law nan halmi paoh cu nan hmuh ko lai."},"25":{"text":"Cun thlacam in nan dir tikah, an cung i thinhunnak nan ngeihmi paoh kha, ngaithiam hna u, vancung nan Pa zong nih nan sualnak kha an ngaihthiam khawh ve hna nakhnga,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Midang kha an sualnak nan ngaihthiam hna lo ahcun vancung i a ummi nan Pa zong nih nan sualnak an ngaithiam ve hna lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 6.14-15"},"27":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem khua ah khan an ra ṭhan. Jesuh cu Biakinn chung i aa chawh lioah khan tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le upa hna nih khan an fuh i,","title":"Aho Nawl In Dah Na Tuah Tiah An Hal (Mat 21.23-27 ; Luk 20.1-8)"},"28":{"text":"“Aho nawl in dah hi thil hi na tuah hna? Aho nih dah hi thil tuahnak nawl hi an pek?” tiah an hal."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun an bia cu a leh hna i, “Bia pakhat tein kan hal ve tuah hna lai. Ka let u law, aho nawl in dah hi thil hi ka tuah hna ti kha kan chimh ve hna lai."},"30":{"text":"Johan nih tipil a pek hna kha, Pathian sinin maw nawl kha a hmuh, minung sinin dah?” tiah a ti hna."},"31":{"text":"Anmah le anmah cu an i al i, “Zeitindah kan ti lai? ‘Pathian sinin,’ kan ti ahcun, Zeicahdah Johan cu nan zumh kun lo? a kan ti lai."},"32":{"text":"‘Minung sinin,’ kan ti ahcun …,” an ti. (Mizapi nih khan Johan cu profet a si ti kha an zumh caah mizapi kha an ṭih fawn ṭung hna.)"},"33":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh cu, “Kan hngal lo,” tiah an leh. Cun Jesuh nih annih cu, “Aho nawl in dah hi thil hi ka tuah hna, ti cu kei zong nih kan chim ve kun hna lai lo,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih tahchunhnak bia in a chimh hna. Aa thawh i, “Mipa pakhat a rak um i cu pa nih cun mitsur dum pakhat a rak ser; a kulh i mitsur nennak caah khor a cawh i ralvennak inn pakhat a sak. Cun a dum cu mi kha a hlanh hna i khualtlawn ah a kal.","title":"Dum Rianṭuantu Hna Bianabia (Mat 21.33-46 ; Luk 20.9-19)","ref":"Isa 5.1-2"},"2":{"text":"Mitsur thei kha lawh a cut tikah a co hnga ding a simi va lak awkah a sal pakhat kha a thlah."},"3":{"text":"Dum a hlanhmi hna nih cun an rak tlaih i an rak velh i zeihmanh pe loin an kirter."},"4":{"text":"Cu tikah dum ngeitu nih khan sal dang pakhat a thlah ṭhan; a lu ah an rak tuk i ningzak ngaiin an rak tuah."},"5":{"text":"Dum ngeitu nih cun sal dang pakhat a thlah ṭhan i an rak thah; cun a dang tampi kha cu bantuk cun an rak tuah hna, a cheu cu an tuk an den hna i a cheu cu an thah hna."},"6":{"text":"Thlah dingah a taangmi cu dum ngeitu fapate a dawt ngaingaimi lawng kha a si cang. A hmanung bik ah a fapa cu dum a hlanhmi hna sinah cun a hei thlah i, ‘Ka fapa hi cu an hmaizah ṭheo lai,’ tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw dum a hlanhmi hna nih khan, ‘Hi pa hi dum ngeitu fapa a si. That u sih, dum hi kanmah ta a si lai,’ an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah a fapa cu an tlaih i an thah i a ruak kha dum lengah an hlonh."},"9":{"text":"“A si ahcun, dum ngeitu nih khan zeitindah a tuah hna lai? A ra tlung lai i a thah hna lai i dum kha midang a hlanh hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Cathiang chungah: ‘Inn satu hna nih, santlailo tiin an hlawtmi lung cu santlai bik ah a cang."},"11":{"text":"Cu a tuahtu cu Bawipa a si i khuaruahhar a si kha kan hmuh,’ tiah aa ṭialmi hi nan rel bal lo maw?” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Slm 118.22-23"},"12":{"text":"Judah upa pawl nih khan, hi bianabia cu kanmah a kan chimhnawhchan ti kha an hngalh caah Jesuh cu tlaih an timh, sihmanhsehlaw mizapi kha an ṭih hna caah an kaltak."},"13":{"text":"Farasi mi tlawmpal le Herod mi tlawmpal kha, Jesuh cu a bia in tlaih i zuam awkah an hei thlah hna.","title":"Ngunkhuai Peknak Kong (Mat 22.15-22 ; Luk 20.20-26)"},"14":{"text":"A sinah cun an ra i, “Saya, nang cu lihchim hmang lomi na si i mi hme mi ngan ahohmanh an mithmai na zoh hna lo. Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian duhnak tu kha a ning tein na cawnpiak hna, ti kha kan hngalh. Cucaah cun Rom Siangpahrang sin i ngunkhuai pek hi kan phung he aa ralchanh maw ralchanh lo kan chim tuah, ngunkhuai cu kan pe lai maw pe lo dah?” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Hlen an timh kha a hngalh i, “Zeicahdah foih nan ka timh len ko? Ngun tangka phar khat in rak pu u law ka zoh tuah lai,” tiah a leh hna."},"16":{"text":"Pakhat an rak pek i, “Aho hmai le aho min dah mah hihi an si?” tiah a hal hna. Annih nih, “Siangpahrang hmai le min,” tiah an leh."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih, “A si ahcun, Siangpahrang ta a simi cu Siangpahrang cu va pe ko u, Pathian ta a simi cu Pathian kha va pe ko u,” tiah a ti hna i an ar ṭhup ko."},"18":{"text":"Cun Sadusi mi kha an ra. (Annih cu thihnak in thawhṭhannak a um lo, a timi an si).","title":"Thihnak In Thawhṭhannak Kong (Mat 22.23-33 ; Luk 20.27-40)","ref":"Lam 23.8"},"19":{"text":"An i thawh i, “Saya, Moses nih phung a kan ṭialpiakmi ah: Mipa pakhatkhat cu fa ngei loin a thih ahcun fa a hrinpiak nakhnga a unau nih khan a rohmi a nupi cu a ṭhit awk a si lai, ti a si.","ref":"Deu 25.5"},"20":{"text":"Voi khat cu unau pasarih an um i an upa bik nih cun nupi a ṭhit, sihmanhsehlaw fa ngei loin a thi."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah a hun changtu nih khan a rohmi cu a ṭhit, asinain amah zong cu fa ngei loin a thi ve. Cuticun a pathumnak zong kha a si i"},"22":{"text":"a dang zong cu an si cio: an pasarihte cun cu nu cu an ṭhit i fa ngei loin an thi dih. Cun a hmanung bik ah cu nu zong cu a thi ve."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah thawh ṭhan ni ah mithi vialte kha thawhter an si ahcun, cu nu cu aho nupi dah a si kun lai? An pasarih tein an ṭhit cio ṭung?” an ti."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Nan hei palh hringhran dah! Cun zeicahdah kan palh ti nan hngal maw? Cathiang siseh, Pathian ṭhawnnak siseh nan hngalh lo caah a si."},"25":{"text":"Mithi cu thawhter an si tikah vancungmi bantuk pei an si lai cu, an i ṭhi in an i um ti lai lo."},"26":{"text":"Mithi mi thihnak in thawhter ṭhan an si lai le si lai lonak kong cu, Moses cauk chungah khan, burbuk a kangmi kong kha nan rel bal lo maw? Khaka ah khan Pathian nih Moses cu a thawh i, ‘Kei cu Abraham Pathian, Isak Pathian, Jakob Pathian ka si,’ a ti, tiah aa ṭial ṭung.","ref":"Exo 3.6"},"27":{"text":"Cucu a nungmi hna Pathian a si, a thimi hna Pathian a si lo, tinak a si. Nan palh cikcek!” tiah a ti hna."},"28":{"text":"Cuka ah cun bia an i almi a rak theitu Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pakhat a rak um. Jesuh nih Sadusi mi hna cu ṭhalo tein a leh hna ti kha a hngalh tikah a ra i, “Nawlbia lakah hin zeidah a biapi bik?” tiah a hal.","title":"Nawlbia Ngan (Mat 22.34-40 ; Luk 10.25-28)","ref":"Luk 10.25-28"},"29":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh i, “ ‘Israel mi hna ngai tuah u; Bawipa kan Pathian lawnglawng hi Bawipa a si."},"30":{"text":"Bawipa nan Pathian cu nan lungthin dihlak le nan nunnak dihlak le nan ruahnak dihlak le nan thazang dihlak in nan dawt lai,’ ti hi a biapi bik cu a si.","ref":"Deu 6.4-5"},"31":{"text":"Cun a pahnihnak cu, Na innpa kha nangmah naa dawt bantukin na dawt lai, ti hi a si. Hi hna pahnih nakin a biapi deuhmi nawlbia dang an um ti lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lev 19.18"},"32":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya nih cun Jesuh cu a leh ve i, “A ṭha ngaingai, saya! Na chimmi cu a hmaan, Bawipa lawnglawng hi Pathian cu a si taktak i pathian dang zeihmanh an um ti lo.","ref":"Deu 4.35"},"33":{"text":"Cucaah mi nih hin Pathian cu kan lungthin dihlak le kan ruahnak dihlak le kan thazang dihlak in kan dawt awk a si i kan innpa cu kanmah bantukin kan dawt awk hna a si. Hi nawlbia pahnih zulh hi Pathian sin i khangh raithawinak le raithawinak dangdang zong pekchanhnak nakin a ṭha deuh,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih a bialehnak cu a ṭha ngai ti kha a hmuh i, “Pathian Pennak in naa hlat lo,” tiah cu pa cu a ti. Hi hnuah hin cun ahohmanh nih Jesuh kha bia an hal ngam ti lo."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh nih Biakinn chung i a cawnpiak lio hna ah khan hi biahalnak hi a hal hna: A thawh hna i, “Zeitindah Messiah cu David hrinsormi a si te lai, tiah Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya nih an ti khawh?","title":"Messiah Kong (Mat 22.41-46 ; Luk 20.41-44)"},"36":{"text":"Thiang Thlarau nih pei David cu: Bawipa nih ka Bawipa cu, Na ral hna kha na ke tangah ka chiah hna hlantiang ka orhlei kamah hin ṭhu ko, tiah a chimter cu.","ref":"Slm 110.1"},"37":{"text":"David hrimhrim nih Messiah cu ‘Bawipa’ tiah a ti ahcun, zeitindah David hrinsor cu a si khawh lai?” tiah a ti hna. Mizapi nih cun Jesuh bia cu lunglawm ngaiin an ngaih."},"38":{"text":"A cawnpiak lio hna ah cun, “Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl hi i ralring hna u. Annih cu an puan fual pipi he i chawh i chawdawr tlang ah mi nih upatnak in kan biachawn hna seh, ti a duhmi an si.","title":"Phungbia Saya Hi I Ralring Hna U (Mat 23.1-36 ; Luk 20.45-47)"},"39":{"text":"Pumhnak ah ṭhutdan a ṭha khunmi i ṭhut kha an duh i zapi rawl danghnak ah upatnak hmun i ṭhut kha an duh."},"40":{"text":"Nuhmei kha an ei an hmuar hna i an inn an lo kha an chuh hna. Cun zapi nih kan hmu hna seh tiin thla kha sau pipi in an cam. Hi hna hi cu an dantatnak kha a fak chinchin men ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn tangka chiahnak pawngah khan a ṭhu i tangka a sanhmi kha a zoh hna. Mirum tampi nih khan tangka tampi an sanh lengmang.","title":"Nuhmeinu Thawhlawm (Luk 21.1-4)"},"42":{"text":"Khi lioah khan a si a fakmi nuhmei pakhat a ra ve i pia hra tluk a man a simi dar tangka pahnih a sanh ve."},"43":{"text":"Jesuh nih khan a zultu kha a kawh hna i, “Hi a si a fakmi nuhmeinu nih hin tangka kuang ah midang vialte nakin tam bik a sanh."},"44":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a dang nih cun an ngeih hlei kha an sanh, sihmanhsehlaw hi nu hi cu sifak ngai a si ko nain a ngeihmi vialte kha a sanh dih — a nunnak ca i a hman dingmi kha a thawh dih,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn in a kalpah ah khin a zultu pakhat nih a thawh i, “Saya, zohhmanh, hi lung ṭhaṭha hna le inn ṭhaṭha hna hi!” tiah a ti.","title":"Biakinn Rawhnak Kong A Chim (Mat 24.1-2 ; Luk 21.5-6)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Hi inn ngan pipi hi na hmuh hna a si lo mei? Pakhat hmanh an umnak hmun i a ummi an um te lai lo; an dihlak hin chimh an si dih lai,” tiah a leh."},"3":{"text":"Biakinn hmai zawn i a ummi Oliv Tlang khan Jesuh cu a ṭhu i Biakinn kha a cuan i cu lioah cun Peter le Jeim le Johan le Andru kha a sinah a thli in an ra.","title":"Harnak le Hremnak (Mat 24.3-14 ; Luk 21.7-19)"},"4":{"text":"Amah cu an thawh i, “Hihi zeitik ah dah a si lai? Cun hi thil vialte hi a tlung cang lai, ti hngalhnak ah zei hmelchunhnak dah a um lai, kan chim tuah,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a cawnpiak hna i, “I ralring u. Ahohmanh i hlenter hna hlah u."},"6":{"text":"Ka min i put in mi tampi an ra lai i, ‘Amah ka si,’ an ti lai i mi tampi kha an hlen hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun lamnai i raltuknak thawng nan theih ah siseh, lamhla i nan theih ah siseh, nan awlok chong hlah u. Cu bantuk cu a um awk a si ko, sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak a phan cang, tinak a si lo."},"8":{"text":"Ram khat le ram khat an i do lai, peng khat le peng khat an i tu lai. A kenkip ah lihnin a um lai i mangṭam a tlung lai. Hi thil hna hi nau nganfah hramthawk bantuk khi an si."},"9":{"text":"“Nannih cu i ralring u. Zeicahtiah mi nih an in tlaih hna lai i zung ah an in chuahpi hna lai, pumhnak inn ah khan an in tuk hna lai i an in den hna lai, uktu bawi le siangpahrang hna hmaiah, annih cu Thawngṭha chimh awk le keimah ruangah an in chuahpi hna lai.","ref":"Mat 10.17-20; Luk 12.11-12"},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw caan donghnak a phak hlanah Thawngṭha Bia cu miphun kip sinah chim hmasa a si lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun an in tlaih hna i zung i an in chuahpi hna tikah, zeidah kan chim lai, tiah a hlankan in nan lungre rak thei hlah u; a caan a phak tikah chim awk ding cu pek nan si te ko lai, cucu chim te ko u. Zeicahtiah nan chimmi bia cu nanmah bia a si lai lo, Thiang Thlarau nih an pekmi hna bia a si lai."},"12":{"text":"U le nau kha thihnak phak tiangin an i rawi lai, pale nih an fale kha cu bantuk cun an tuah hna lai i an fale zong nih an nule an pale kha an doh hna lai i thahnak an inter hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Keimah ruangah mi kip nih an in huat hna lai. Sihmanhsehlaw a dongh tiang a hmunmi cu khamh nan si lai.","ref":"Mat 10.22"},"14":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw ‘Ṭhiotu Fihnung’ cu a dirnak ding a si lomi hmun ah a dir kha nan hmuh tikah (A reltu nih hi a sullam cu hngal u!) khi tikah Judea ram i a ummi cu tlang leiah nan zam awk a si lai.","title":"Ṭhiotu Fihnung (Mat 24.15-28 ; Luk 21.20-24)","ref":"Dan 9.27; 11.31; 12.11"},"15":{"text":"Inncung i a ummi cu innchung ah i phorh ding thil lak awkah ṭum hlah seh;"},"16":{"text":"cun lo i a ummi zong a angki vaa lak awkah inn ah tlung hlah seh.","ref":"Luk 17.31"},"17":{"text":"Cu caan cu fapawi nu le ngakchia no a ngeimi nu hna caah cun a har hringhran ko lai."},"18":{"text":"Hi thil a tlun hi khuasik caan ah a si nakhnga lo, Pathian sinah thla va cam tuah u."},"19":{"text":"Zeicahtiah hi a tlung dingmi harnak hi Pathian nih vawlei a ser hramthawk in atu tiangah a um bal lomi thil, ṭih a nung bikmi harnak a si lai. Hmailei zongah cu bantuk cu a um ti lai lo.","ref":"Dan 12.1; Biat 7.14"},"20":{"text":"Bawipa nih cu caan cu rak tawiter hlah seh law cu, khamhmi ahohmanh an um hnga lo. Sihmanhsehlaw a thimmi a mi hna caah cun, cu caan cu a tawiter."},"21":{"text":"“Cun nannih cu ahohmanh nih, ‘Messiah cu hika ah a um,’ an in ti hna ah siseh, ‘Khika ah a um,’ an in ti hna ah siseh, va zum hna hlah u."},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Messiah deu le nal profet hna kha an chuak lai. Pathian thimmi hna hmanh kha, a si khawh chungin hlen khawhnak dingah hmelchunhnak le khuaruahharnak an ser hna lai."},"23":{"text":"Ralring tein um ko u. A hlankan in zeizong vialte kan chimh dih cang hna hih,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"“Cu harnak caan hnuah cun ni cu a mui lai i thlapa cu a vang ti lai lo,","title":"Mi Fapa Ratnak (Mat 24.29-31 ; Luk 21.25-28)","ref":"Isa 13.10; Eze 32.7; Joe 2.10,31; 3.15; Biat 6.12"},"25":{"text":"van in arfi cu an tla lai i van ṭhawnnak cu an i hnin lai.","ref":"Isa 34.4; Joe 2.10; Biat 6.13"},"26":{"text":"Mi Fapa cu a lang lai i khuadawm chung khin lianhngannak le sunparnak he a ra lai.","ref":"Dan 7.13; Biat 1.7"},"27":{"text":"Vawlei kil li ah khan a vancungmi kha a thlah hna lai i vawlei khattelei deng in khattelei deng tiang Pathian thimmi minung kha an pumh hna lai."},"28":{"text":"“Theipi kung ah hin cawnpiaknak i lak u. A nge an hung hrin i an hung no i a hnah kha an hung corh tikah, ṭhal caan a nai cang, ti kha nan hngalh.","title":"Theipi Kung In Ralrinnak (Mat 24.32-35 ; Luk 21.29-33)"},"29":{"text":"Cu bantukin hi thil hna an hung um kha nan hmuh tikah, a caan kha a nai cang, innka a phan cang, ti kha nan hngalh lai."},"30":{"text":"Mah hihi philh hlah u: Hi thil vialte hi, atu i a nungmi hna an thih dih hlanah hin a tlung lai."},"31":{"text":"Van le vawlei cu an rawk lai nain ka bia cu a rawk lai lo."},"32":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw cu ni le suimilam caan cu ahohmanh nih an hngal lo, vancung i a ummi vanmi zong nih an hngal lo, Fapa zong nih ka hngal lo, Pa lawnglawng nih a hngalh.","title":"A Ni Siseh, A Suimilam Caan Siseh, An Hngal Lo (Mat 24.36-44)","ref":"Mat 24.36"},"33":{"text":"Cu caan cu zeitik ah a si lai kha nan hngalh lo caah i ralring te le fimhring tein um ko u."},"34":{"text":"Zei he dah aa lawh lai ti ahcun, khualtlawn ah a kal i a sinum hna kha, nan rian cio kha ṭha tein rak ṭuan u, tiah a ti i innka cawngtupa kha, ṭha tein rak cawng, tiah bia a riah tatu inn bawi he aa lo lai.","ref":"Luk 12.36-38"},"35":{"text":"Inn ngeitu kha zeitik i a kir lai nan hngalh lo caah ṭha tein hngak ko u. Zanlei ah a si kho, zanṭim ah a si kho, khuadei hlanah a si kho, nichuak ah a si kho."},"36":{"text":"Duak tiah a rat sual ahcun i hngilh hluahmah in, in tanh hna hlah seh."},"37":{"text":"Nan sin ka chimmi hi mi dihlak sin i ka chim a si: Hngilh loin hngak ko u,” tiah a ti hna."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Atu cu Lanhtak Puai le Thilnu Cawh Lo Changreu Puai kha ni hnih lawng a duh cang. Tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl hna kha, Jesuh cu a thli tein tlaih i thah khawhnak ding lam kha an kawl.","title":"Jesuh Rawinak Khua An Khan (Mat 26.1-5 ; Luk 22.1-2 ; Jhn 11.45-53)","ref":"Exo 12.1-27"},"2":{"text":"“Puai lio i kan tuah ahcun a ṭha lai lo, mi an i tuai tuk sual lai,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu Bethani khua i Simon, thinghmuipa inn ah khan rawl a hrawng. Rawl an ei lioah khan minu pakhat a rung lut i lungrang thawl khat tein zihmui a ṭha bik phun kha a rak i put. Thawl kha a khuai i zihmui cu Jesuh lu ah khan a bungh.","title":"Jesuh Bethani Ah Chiti A Thuh (Mat 26.6-13 ; Jhn 12.1-8)","ref":"Luk 7.37-38"},"4":{"text":"Cuka i a ummi a cheu cu an thin a hung i, “Zeicahdah mah ti khin zihmui khi a hlohlak hnga?"},"5":{"text":"Fawi tein tangka za thum ah zuar khawh a si ṭung hnga. Cun cu tangka cu misifak pe hna seh law a ṭha deuh hnga lo maw?” an ti i minu cu fak piin an mawhchiat."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Ngol ko u! Amah nan ti lengmangnak zei um hlah. Ka ca i a tuahmi hi aa dawhmi le a ṭhami thil a si ko."},"7":{"text":"Sifak cu nan sinah pei an um zungzal ko lai cu, bawmh nan duh tik hna paoh ah nan bawmh khawh ko ṭung hna. Kei cu nan sinah ka um zungzal ṭung lai lo.","ref":"Deu 15.11"},"8":{"text":"A tuah khawh tawk pei a tuah cu: ka pum zihmui in a ka toih cu vui awk ca i a hlankan in a rak ka timh chung pei a si cu."},"9":{"text":"Hihi philh hlah u: Vawlei cung khuazakip i thawngṭha an chimnak paoh ah hi nu nih a tuahmi hi amah philh lonak caah an chim camcin lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Zultu pahleihnih hna lak i aa tel vemi Judas kha, tlangbawi upa hna sinah a va kal i Jesuh cu nan kut chungah kan pek hna lai, tiah a va ti hna.","title":"Judas Nih Jesuh Rawi A Duh (Mat 26.14-16 ; Luk 22.3-6)"},"11":{"text":"A chimmi kha an theih tikah an lung aa lawm ngaingai i tangka kan in phalh lai, tiah bia an kam. Cucaah Judas cu Jesuh rawi khawhnak ding caah khan, caan rem a kawl."},"12":{"text":"Thilnu Telhlo Changreu Puai, a ni khat ni, Lanhtak Puai rawldanghnak ca i tuufa an thah hna ni ah khan, Jesuh cu a zultu hna nih khan, “Khuazei ah dah Lanhtak Puai Zanriah ka timhpiak u, ti na kan duh?” an ti.","title":"Jesuh le A Zultu Hna Lanhtak Puai Zanriah An Ei Ṭi (Mat 26.17-25 ; Luk 22.7-14 , 21-23 ; Jhn 13.21-30)"},"13":{"text":"Khi tikah an lak i pahnih kha a thlah hna i, “Khuapi chungah va lut u law ti-um aa putmipa pakhat nih a rak in ton hna lai."},"14":{"text":"A luhnak inn tiang khan hei zul u law, cu inn ngeitupa cu, ‘Khuazei ah dah Sayapa nih, ka zultu hna he Lanhtak Zanriah kan einak ding khaan cu a si, a ti,’ tiah nan va ti lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun cungdot ah thil tlingte le ṭha tein an timh cia dildelnak khaan kaupi pakhat an hmuhsak hna lai i cuka ah cun zanriah cu nan va timh lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"16":{"text":"A zultu cu an kal i khuapi chungah cun an va lut i Jesuh nih a chimh hna ningte khan zeizong vialte cu an va hmuh; cun Lanhtak Puai Zanriah cu an va timh."},"17":{"text":"Ni a tlak hnuah Jesuh le zultu hleihnih cu an ra."},"18":{"text":"Cabuai i rawl an ei lioah khan Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Nan lak i pakhat nih hin nan ka rawi lai, ka sin i rawl a eimi nih hin,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 41.9"},"19":{"text":"A zultu cu an awlok a chong i pakhat hnu pakhat in, “Kei cu ka si hnga i mei?” tiah an ti cio."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Nannih hleihnih lak i pakhat hi nan si lai, kheng chung i keimah he a changreu a hnimṭitu hi nan si ko lai."},"21":{"text":"Cathiang nih a chimning in Mi Fapa cu a thi ko lai, sihmanhsehlaw Mi Fapa a rawitu ding cu, a caah a va poi hringhran dah! Cu pa cu chuak lo lawlaw in rak um seh law a caah a ṭha deuh hnga,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Annih nih zanriah cu an ei lioah khan Jesuh nih changreu kha aa lak i lunglawmhnak in thla a cam hnuah a cheu i a zultu kha a pek hna. “Ei u, hihi ka pum a si,” a ti hna.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah (Mat 26.26-30 ; Luk 22.14-20 ; 1Kor 11.23-25)"},"23":{"text":"Cun hrai kha aa lak i Pathian sinah lawmhnak a chim hnuah a zultu kha a pek hna i an dihlak in an din."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Mi tampi ca i ka thletmi ka thi a si. Pathian biakamnak a fehtertu ka thi a si.","ref":"Exo 24.8; Jer 31.31-34"},"25":{"text":"Pathian Pennak chungah a thar in ka din ṭhan hlan cu, hi mitsur hang hi ka ding ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cun hla fung khat an sak dih in Oliv Tlang ah khan an kal."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun annih cu, “Cathiang chungah, ‘Pathian nih tuukhal cu a thah lai i tuu cu an i ṭhek dih lai,’ tiah aa ṭial bangin, nan dihlak in nan ka zamtak lai.","title":"Peter Nih A Hlawt Lainak, Jesuh Nih A Chim (Mat 26.31-35 ; Luk 22.31-34 ; Jhn 13.36-38)","ref":"Zek 13.7"},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thihnak in thawh ṭhanter ka si hnuah, nan hmaiah Galilee ah ka rak kal lai,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 28.16"},"29":{"text":"Peter nih, “A dang nih an dihlak in in zamtak hna hmanh seh law, kei cu kan zamtak hrimhrim lai lo,” tiah a hun leh."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh nih Peter cu, “Hihi philh hlah, ar voi hnih a khuan hlanah, ka hngal lo, tiah voi thum tiang na ka ti lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Peter nih cun ṭhawng chinchin in a leh i, “Nangmah sin i ka thih ve a herh zongah, nangmah cu, ka hngal lo, kan ti bal lai lo,” tiah a ti. Cun zultu dang vialte zong nih khan cuticun an ti cio."},"32":{"text":"Gethsemane an timi hmun kha an phan i Jesuh nih a zultu hna cu, “Thla ka cam karah nannih cu hika ah hin rak ṭhu u,” tiah a ti hna.","title":"Gethsemane Ah Thla A Cam (Mat 26.36-46 ; Luk 22.39-46)"},"33":{"text":"Cun Peter le Jeim le Johan kha aa kalpi hna. Khuaruahhar vansang au in a um i"},"34":{"text":"annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka lungre a thei tuk hringhran. Cucaah hika ah hin rak um u law hngilh loin rak ka hngak u,” tiah a ti hna."},"35":{"text":"Hmailei ah tlawmpal a va kal i vawlei ah a bawk i, a si khawh ahcun harnak khan a luat khawh nakhnga, thla a cam."},"36":{"text":"“Ka Pa, ka Pa, nangmah nih cun zeizong vialte na tuah khawh dih ko. Hi hrai hi ka lakpiak ko. Sihmanhsehlaw keimah duhnak bantuk cun si hlah seh, nangmah duhnak bantukin si ko seh,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cun a ra kir i a zultu kha an pathum in an rak i hngilh. Cun Peter cu a thawh i, “Suimilam pakhat chung hmanh hngilh loin na um kho lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cun annih cu, “Nan dihlak in hngilh loin um u law tukforhnak chungah nan tlak nakhnga lo, thla cam u, thlarau nih cun a duh ko, sihmanhsehlaw titsa cu a thazang a tlawm,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"A va kal ṭhan i thla a va cam ṭhan."},"40":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna sinah khan a ra ṭhan i an rak i hngilh ṭhan kha a hmuh hna; an mit kha a au in an au kho lo. Cun zeiti chawnh awk an hngal lo."},"41":{"text":"A voi thumnak a rat tikah khan a thawh hna i, “Nan i hngilh ko rih maw? Nan i din ko rih maw? A za cang! A caan a phan cang. Zohhmanh u, Mi Fapa cu misual mi hna kut chungah pek a si cang."},"42":{"text":"Tho u law, kal u sih. Zohhmanh u, keimah a ka rawitu cu hika a phan cang,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Cu ti i bia a chim lengmang lioah cun zultu hleihnih hna chung i aa tel vemi Judas kha a ra phan. Tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le upa hna nih an fialmi hna mibu kha nam le thingtan i put in a sinah cun an ra.","title":"Jesuh An Tlaih (Mat 26.47-56 ; Luk 22.47-53 ; Jhn 18.3-12)"},"44":{"text":"A rawitu nih cun annih kha hmelchunhnak a pek cia hna i, “Ka hnamhmi cu tlaih nan duhmi kha a si lai. Amah cu nan tlaih lai i nan kalpi lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"45":{"text":"Judas nih cun a ra phak cangka in Jesuh cu a hei fuh colh i, “Saya,” a ti i a hnamh."},"46":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh cu an tlaih i fek tein an khih."},"47":{"text":"Cuka i a dirmi pakhat nih a nam kha aa zuh i Tlangbawi Ngan salpa hnakhaw kha pet lakin a tuk."},"48":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Kei cu mifir hei sining law cu bang, nam le thingtan he tlaih awkah nan ka fuh."},"49":{"text":"Nifate nan sinah ka um i Biakinn ah kan cawnpiak lengmang ko ṭung hna, nan ka tlaih ṭung lo. Sihmanhsehlaw Cathiang chung bia a tlin cu a herh ko,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Luk 19.47; 21.37"},"50":{"text":"Khi tikah a zultu vialte nih khan an zamtak."},"51":{"text":"Cu lioah cun tlangval pakhat, puan lawng aa aihmi nih Jesuh cu a zulh. Amah cu tlaih an timh i"},"52":{"text":"a puan cu a lektak i a taklawng in a tli."},"53":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Tlangbawi Ngan inn ah khan an kalpi i khika ah khan tlangbawi upa vialte hna le upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna kha an rak i pum.","title":"Biaceihtu Hna Hmaiah Jesuh (Mat 26.57-68 ; Luk 22.54-55 , 63-71 ; Jhn 18.13-14 , 19-24)"},"54":{"text":"Peter nih khan lamhlatpi khin a zulh i Tlangbawi Ngan inntual ah cun a va lut. Cuka ah cun ralveng pawl sinah khan a ṭhu i mei a to."},"55":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa hna le biaceihtu hna nih cun Jesuh cu thihnak daan pek khawhnak ding caah a sual kawl an i zuam, sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh an hmu kho lo."},"56":{"text":"Tehte tampi nih Jesuh kong ah khan lih an chim len cio, sihmanhsehlaw an bia kha an i kheng kho lo."},"57":{"text":"Cun mi tlawmpal khi an hung dir i,"},"58":{"text":"“ ‘Minung sakmi Biakinn hi ka ṭheh lai i minung nih sakmi a si lomi biakinn ni thum chungah ka sak ṭhan lai,’ tiah a chim kan theih,” tiin lih an puh.","ref":"Jhn 2.10"},"59":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anmah hmanh cu an bia aa khat kho lo."},"60":{"text":"An dihlak hmaiah cun Tlangbawi Ngan cu a dir i, “Sual an in phawtmi cu a lehnak zei tal na ngei lo maw?” tiah Jesuh cu a hal."},"61":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh cu dai tein a um ko i zeihmanh a let lo. Cun Tlangbawi Ngan nih cun, “A Liannganmi Pathian Fapa Messiah cu na si maw?” tiah a hal ṭhan."},"62":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Ka si. Cun Mi Fapa cu A Liannganmi Pathian orhlei kamah ka ṭhut i vancung khuadawm he ka rat kha na ka hmuh te lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Dan 7.13"},"63":{"text":"Tlangbawi Ngan nih cun a puan kha a thleh i, “Tehte dang kan herh ti maw?"},"64":{"text":"Bia ṭhalo a chimmi cu nan theih cio ko. Zeitindah nan ruah?” tiah a ti. Jesuh cu a sual i thih awk a tlak, tiin an zapi an hna a tla.","ref":"Lev 24.16"},"65":{"text":"Cun mi cheukhat nih Jesuh cu cil an chak i a mit an huh i an bengh. “Ahodah an beng, kan chim tuah,” an ti. Cun ralvengtu pawl nih khan an kalpi i an bengh."},"66":{"text":"Peter cu inntual i a um lioah khan Tlangbawi Ngan sinumnu ngakchia pakhat kha a ra i amah cu a hmuh tikah,","title":"Jesuh Kha Peter Nih A Hlawt (Mat 26.69-75 ; Luk 22.56-62 ; Jhn 18.15-27)"},"67":{"text":"“Nangmah zong hi, Nazareth khuami Jesuh he a rak um ṭimi na si ko,” tiah a ti."},"68":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih cun aa pheh i, “Ka hngal lo. Na chimmi hi a kong zeihmanh ka hngal lo,” tiah a leh. Cun kutka lei kalnak lam ah khan a hei i thawn. Cu caan te ah cun ar a khuang."},"69":{"text":"Ngakchia nu nih khan cuka ah cun a va hmuh ṭhan i a pawng i a dirmi hna sinah cun, “Hi pa hi anmah lak i aa telmi a si,” tiah a ti."},"70":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih cun aa pheh ṭhan. Cun tlawmpal ah khin cuka i a dirmi hna nih khan Peter cu, “Anmah lak i aa telmi na si cu naa pheh kho bal lai lo, Galilee mi pei na si ko hi,” an ti."},"71":{"text":"Cun Peter nih cun chiat a ser i, “Biatak ka chim lo ka chim lo ahcun Pathian nih dan ka tat seh. Nan chim lengmangmi pa hi ka hngal hrimhrim lo,” tiah a ti."},"72":{"text":"Cu caan te ah cun ar kha a khuang ṭhan i Peter nih cun Jesuh i, “Ar voi hnih a khuan hlanah voi thum na ka hlawt lai,” a rak timi kha a lung ah a hung chuak. Cun a ṭap."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"A thaizing zingkate ah tlangbawi upa hna cu haotu upa hna le phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le biaceihtu vialte hna he khan hnawhsare in an i pum i khua an khang. Jesuh cu thir cikcin in an khih i an kalpi i Pilat kut chungah khan an pek.","title":"Pilat Hmaiah Jesuh (Mat 27.1-2 , 11-14 ; Luk 23.1-5 ; Jhn 18.28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Pilat nih, “Judah mi siangpahrang cu na si maw?” tiah a hal. Jesuh nih, “Na chim bangin ka si,” tiah a leh."},"3":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa hna nih khan Jesuh cu bia tampi an puh."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Pilat nih cun a hal ṭhan i, “Na let hna lai lo maw? An in puhmi hi a tam ṭung,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Jesuh cu holh loin a um i Pilat cu a khuaruah a har."},"6":{"text":"An Lanhtak Puai paoh ah khan Pilat nih an duhmi thongtla pakhat kha a chuahpiak tawn hna.","title":"Jesuh Thah Awk Bia An Khiah (Mat 27.15-26 ; Luk 23.13-25 ; Jhn 18.39—19.16)"},"7":{"text":"Cu lioah cun ral a thomi, midang hna he ral an thawhnak i lai a nawngmipa Barabbas kha thong chungah cun a um."},"8":{"text":"Mizapi nih khan, voi dang i na kan tuahpiak tawnmi kha kan tuahpiak rih tuah, tiah an ra hal tikah,"},"9":{"text":"Pilat nih cun a rak thawh hna i, “Judah mi siangpahrang hi kan chuahpiak seh, ti nan ka duhmi cu a si maw?” tiah a rak hal hna."},"10":{"text":"Jesuh ka kut chung i an ka pek hi, tlangbawi upa nih an nahchuah caah a si, ti kha Pilat nih ṭha tein a hngalh."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tlangbawi upa pawl nih cun mizapi kha, Barabbas na kan chuahpiak lai, tiah Pilat kha nan hal lai, tiah an forh hna."},"12":{"text":"Pilat nih mizapi cu a thawh ṭhan hna i, “A si ahcun, Judah siangpahrang nan timi pa hi tah zeitindah ka tuah kun lai?” tiah a ti hna."},"13":{"text":"“Vailam ah tah ko,” tiah an au."},"14":{"text":"Pilat nih cun, “Zei sualnak dah a tuah?” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw fak chinchin in an au i, “Vailam ah tah ko,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Mizapi kha Pilat nih an lung ton a duh hna caah Barabbas cu a thlahpiak hna. Cun Jesuh cu fung in a tukter hna i vailam i tah awkah a pek hna."},"16":{"text":"Ralkap nih Jesuh cu Mangki bawi inntual ah khan an luhpi i an hawidang zong kha an auh hna.","title":"Ralkap Nih Jesuh An Dehcawh (Mat 27.27-31 ; Jhn 19.2-3)"},"17":{"text":"Jesuh cu puan sen kha an aih i hling in an phiarmi bawiluchin kha a lu ah an chinh."},"18":{"text":"Salaam kha an pek i, “Judah mi Siangpahrang hi saupi nung ko seh!” an ti."},"19":{"text":"A lu ah cun fung in an tuk i an cil an chak i an khuk an i bil i a hmaiah cun an kun."},"20":{"text":"Cu ti i an cawhdeh dih in puan sen kha an hawh i amah puan kha an aihter ṭhan. Cun vailam i tah awkah an chuahpi."},"21":{"text":"Lampi ah mipa pakhat a min Simon a simi, khuate lei in Jerusalem leiah a kalmi kha an ton. Amah cu Jesuh vailam tahnak thing kha an hnek i an putter. (Hi Simon hi Sairin khuami Alekzandar le Rufas pa kha a si).","title":"Vailam Ah An Tah (Mat 27.32-44 ; Luk 23.26-43 ; Jhn 19.17-27)","ref":"Rom 16.13"},"22":{"text":"Jesuh cu Golgotha hmun kha an phakpi, Golgotha a sullam cu Luruh Hmun tinak a si."},"23":{"text":"Mitsur zu, Mura an timi he an cawhmi kha an hun tuh i a ding duh lo."},"24":{"text":"Cuticun vailam ah cun an khenh chih i a puan kha an i phaw i aho nih dah a zei zawn hi a co lai tinak caah, camcawh fung in an zuh.","ref":"Slm 22.18"},"25":{"text":"Vailam i an khenh chih kha zinglei suimilam pakua ah a si."},"26":{"text":"Sual an phawtnak ca cu, “Judah mi hna Siangpahrang,” tiah an ṭial."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh sinah cun a orhlei kamah pakhat, a kehlei kamah pakhat, mifir pahnih an tah ve hna."},"28":{"text":"Cuticun Cathiang nih, “Misual hna sinah telh chih a si,” a timi cu a tling.","ref":"Isa 53.12"},"29":{"text":"Aa chawkmi hna nih khan Jesuh cu an lu an thinhnawh i an nihsawh: “Biakinn cu na ṭheh dih i ni thum chungah na sak dih ṭhan taktak hi ta!","ref":"Slm 22.7; 109.25; Mar 14.58; Jhn 2.19"},"30":{"text":"Atu cu nangmah kha vailam cung khan rung ṭum law i khamh tuah ngat,” an ti."},"31":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih khan Jesuh cu an nihsawh i, “Midang khamh ṭung in amah vial aa khamh kho ṭung lo hi ta!"},"32":{"text":"Israel mi siangpahrang Messiah cu, atu hrimhrim ah hin vailam tahnak cung hin rung ṭum seh law pei kan hmuh hnga i kan zumh khawh hnga cu!” an ti. Cun a sin i vailam an tahmi pahnih hna zong nih khan an nihsawh ve."},"33":{"text":"Chun ah cu ram cu a dihlak in muihnak nih suimilam pathum chung a khuh.","title":"Jesuh Thihnak (Mat 27.45-56 ; Luk 23.44-49 ; Jhn 19.28-30)"},"34":{"text":"Zanlei suimilam pathum ah Jesuh cu fak piin a au i, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabakthani,” tiah a ti, a sullam cu, “Ka Pathian, ka Pathian, zeicahdah na ka kaltak,” ti a si.","ref":"Slm 22.1"},"35":{"text":"Cuka i a ummi a cheukhat nih cu ti i a au cu an theih i, “Ngai hmanh u, Elijah a auh cuh!” an ti."},"36":{"text":"Pakhat pa cu a va tli i puanchia kha mitsur zu thor chungah khan a hnim i fung par ah a ṭemh i Jesuh cu a hmur ah khan a hun tuh. “Amah kha vailamtahnak cungin ṭhumh awkah Elijah kha a rung ṭum hnga maw, zoh hnik u sih,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 69.21"},"37":{"text":"Jesuh cu fak piin a au i a cat."},"38":{"text":"Biakinn chung i aa zarmi puan kha a lu in a taw tiang cheu hnih ah aa cheu.","ref":"Exo 26.31-33"},"39":{"text":"Vailamtahnak hmai i a dirmi ralbawipa nih khan, Jesuh a au le a cah kha a hmuh tikah, “Hi pa cu Pathian Fapa a si hrimhrim ko,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Cuka ah cun nu tlawmpal an um i lamhlat nawn in an cuanh. Cu hna lakah cun Salome le. Mary Magdalin le Jeim ngakchia deuh le Joses i an nu Mary kha an um ve."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh cu Galilee i an um lioah khan an rak zulh tawn i an rak bawmh tawn. Amah he Jerusalem ah a rami nu tampi zong cuka ah cun an um ve.","ref":"Luk 8.2-3"},"42":{"text":"Zanlei sang tlai nawn a si cang i Arimathea khuami Josef kha a ra phan.","title":"Jesuh Vuinak (Mat 27.57-61 ; Luk 23.50-56 ; Jhn 19.38-42)"},"43":{"text":"Amah cu biaceihtu bu chung i an upatmi pakhat a si ve i Pathian Pennak a rat lainak aa ruahchihmi a si. Cu ni cu cawnningani a si (cucu Sabbath ni a nizan kha a si). Cucaah Josef cu ralṭha ngaiin Pilat sinah khan a vung lut i Jesuh ruak kha a hal."},"44":{"text":"Pilat nih Jesuh cu a thi cang, ti kha a theih tikah a khuaruah a har ngai. Ralbawipa kha a auh i Jesuh cu a thi cang maw, tiah a hal."},"45":{"text":"Ralbawi chimmi bia kha a theih hnuah Pilat nih Josef cu, Jesuh ruak kha na lak khawh, tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Josef nih cun khiangrang puan pakhat a cawk i a ruak cu a ṭhumh hnuah puan cun a zual i lung an vihmi thlan chungah a vui. Cun thlanka ah cun lung nganpi a khar."},"47":{"text":"Mary Magdalin le Joses nu Mary nih khan cucu an zoh i Jesuh an phumnak hmun kha an hmuh."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sabbath ni kha a dih tikah Mary Magdalin le Jeim nu Mary le Salome nih khan Jesuh ruak thuh awk caah cun zihmui kha an i cawk.","title":"Thawhṭhannak (Mat 28.1-8 ; Luk 24.1-12 ; Jhn 20.1-10)"},"2":{"text":"Zarhpi Ni zingkate, nichuah kate ah khin, thlan ah cun an va kal."},"3":{"text":"Lam ah cun pakhat le pakhat kha. “Thlan khar lung kha ahodah a kan thawnpiak te lai,” tiah an i ceih."},"4":{"text":"(A khar cu lung nganpi a si). Cun an hun zoh i lung kha a rak i thawn cang."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah thlan chungah cun an lut i puan rang aa aih i orhlei kam i a rak ṭhumi tlangval pakhat an hmuh i an lau ngaingai."},"6":{"text":"Cu pa nih cun, “Nan thinphang hlah u. Vailam ah an tahmi Jesuh, Nazareth khua mi kha nan kawl ti kha ka hngalh. Sihmanhsehlaw hika ah hin a um ti lo — a tho cang! An vuinak hmun hi zoh hmanh u."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah cun va kal u law a zultu hna kha le Peter kha, ‘Amah nih an chimh hna bantuk te khan nan hlanah Galilee ah a kal i cuka ah cun nan va hmuh lai,’ a ti tiah va chim hna u,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 26.32; Mar 14.28"},"8":{"text":"Cucaah an chuak i an thin a phang i an ning a ṭih caah thlan cun an le. An thin a lau tuk caah ahohmanh an chim hna lo. ["},"9":{"text":"Jesuh cu thihnak in a thawh hnuah Zarhpi ni zingkate ah khan Mary Magdalin sinah khan a lang hmasa bik. Cu nu cu a chungin khuachia pasarih a chuahpiakmi nu kha a si.","title":"MARKA THAWNGṬHA DONGHNAK SAU DEUH Mary Magdalin Sinah A Lang"},"10":{"text":"Mary cu a kal i a hawile kha a chimh hna. An ngaih a chia, an rak ṭap i,"},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu a nung i ka hmuh, tiah a chimh hna tikah khan an zum lo."},"12":{"text":"Hi hnuah hin zultu pahnih hna cu khuate lei i an kal lioah khan an sinah Jesuh cu a lang.","title":"Zultu Pahnih Sinah A Lang (Luk 24.13-35)"},"13":{"text":"An kir i a dang kha an chimh hna, sihmanhsehlaw an zum hna lo."},"14":{"text":"A hmanung bik ah Jesuh cu a zultu pahleikhat hna sinah khan rawl an ei lioah a lang. Zumhnak an ngeih lo ruang le a nung in a hmumi hna chimmi kha an zumh khawh lo ruangah a sik hna.","title":"Zultu Hleikhat Sinah A Lang (Mat 28.16-20 ; Luk 24.50-53 ; Jhn 20.19-23 ; Lam 1.6-8)"},"15":{"text":"A thawh hna i, “Vawlei cung khuazakip ah va kal u law miphun kip kha thawngṭhabia va chim hna u.","ref":"Lam 1.8"},"16":{"text":"A zum i tipilnak a ingmi paoh nih khamhnak an hmuh lai, a zum lomi paoh nih sual phawtnak an hmuh lai."},"17":{"text":"A zummi pawl cu hi ṭhawnnak hmelchuhnak hi pek an si lai: ka min in khuachia an ṭhawl khawh hna lai, holh theih loin an holh lai,"},"18":{"text":"rul kha an tlaih hna i sivai an din zongah zeiti hmanh in an um lai lo; mizaw cungah an kut an chuan lai i an dam lai,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Jesuh nih bia a ruah dih hna cun vancung ah a kai i Pathian orhlei kamah khan a hung ṭhu.","title":"Van Ah A Kai (Luk 24.53 ; Lam 1.9-11)","ref":"Lam 1.9-11"},"20":{"text":"A zultu kha khuazakip ah an kal i thawngṭhabia kha an chim; Pathian nih an sinin rian a ṭuan i an phungchimmi kha ahmaan, tiah ṭhawnnak hmelchunhnak a pekmi hna thawngin a langhter.] [ 9 Nu hna kha Peter le a hawile sinah khan an va kal i vancungmi nih a rak chimhmi hna kha a tawinak in an chimh hna. 10 Cu hnuah cun Jesuh hrimhrim nih, nichuahlei in nitlaklei tiang, zungzal a hmunmi khamhnak kong bia nung le bia thiang cu a zultu hna thawng khan a thanh.]"}}}}},"42":{"info":{"name":"Luka","shortname":"Luke","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Theofilas Bawipa, Mi tampi nih kan lak i thil a cangmi kong hi an thiam khawh chungin ṭial an rak i zuam cio."},"2":{"text":"Cu an ṭialmi cu a hramthawk lio i an mit in a rak hmumi hna nih an kan chimhmi le hi bia a rak chimtu hna nih an rak chimning khan a si."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa, kei zong nih hi thil vialte hi a hramthawk tein ṭha tein ka dothlat cikcek hnuah na sinah aa tlai thliahmah in ṭial ah a ṭha tiah ka ruah."},"4":{"text":"A chimh zong an in chimh len cangmi kong biatak kha a ningcang tein na hngalh khawh nakhnga, tiin hi ca hi kan kuat."},"5":{"text":"Herod kha Judea Siangpahrang a si lioah, Abijah tlangbawi phu chungah aa telmi tlangbawi pakhat a min Zekhariah an timi kha a rak um. A nupi min cu Elizabeth a si i amah zong cu tlangbawi hrinthlak a si ve.","title":"Tipil Petu Johan Hrinnak","ref":"1Cha 24.10"},"6":{"text":"An pahnih in Pathian hmaiah nuncan ṭha in a nung i Bawipa nawlbia vialte le phunglam vialte tlamtling tein a zulmi an si."},"7":{"text":"Elizabeth cu a cin caah fa pakhat hmanh an ngei lo. An pahnih in an tar ngaingai cang."},"8":{"text":"Ni khat cu Zekhariah kha, nifate an rianṭuannak ah a caan a hung phan ve i Pathian hmaiah khan tlangbawi rian cu a ṭuan."},"9":{"text":"Tlangbawi hna nih an zulhmi phungning in, biakṭheng cung i rimhmui khangh awkah khan amah cu camcawhfung zuh in an thim. Cucaah Bawipa Biakinn chungah khan a vung lut."},"10":{"text":"Cu caan cu rimhmui khangh lio i mi zapi Biakinn leng i thla an cam caan kha a si."},"11":{"text":"A sinah Bawipa vancungmi pakhat a rung lang i rimhmui an khanghnak biakṭheng orhlei kamah khan a dir."},"12":{"text":"Amah cu Zekhariah nih khan a hmuh tikah a lau i a thin a phang."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw vancungmi nih cun a thawh i, “Zekhariah, na thinphang hlah! Pathian nih na thlacamnak kha a theih i na nupi Elizabeth nih fapa an hrinpiak lai. A min ah Johan na sak lai."},"14":{"text":"Amah cu a chuah tikah naa lawm hringhran lai i midang tampi zong an i lawm ngaingai ve lai."},"15":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah cu Bawipa hmaiah mi ngan a si lai. Zu siseh, zureu siseh, zeihmanh a ding lai lo. A chuahka hrimhrim in Thiang Thlarau in a khat lai;","ref":"Nam 6.3"},"16":{"text":"Israel mi mi tampi kha Bawipa an Pathian sinah a kirpi ṭhan hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Amah cu Pathian thlahmi lamkaltu a si lai i profet Elijah bantukin a fekmi le a ṭhawngmi a si lai. Pale hna le fale hna kha hmunkhat ah a fonh ṭhan hna lai i nawl a ngai lomi hna kha miding mi hna ruahnak lam leiah a hruai ṭhan hna lai. Bawipa mi hna cu Bawipa ca i aa tlakmi minung si awkah a rak timh hna lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mal 4.5-6"},"18":{"text":"Zekhariah nih vancungmi cu a thawh i, “Cucu a si kho lai tiah zeitindah ka zumh khawh lai? Zeicahtiah kei cu ka tar cang i ka nupi zong a tar ve fawn,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun a leh i, “Kei cu Gabriel, hi thawngṭha nangmah chimh awkah a ka thlahtu Pathian hmai i a dirmi cu ka si.","ref":"Dan 8.16; 9.21"},"20":{"text":"Ka bia cu na ka zum lo, asinain a caan a phak tikah cun a tling ṭhiamṭhiam te ko lai. Na zumh lo caah holh kho loin na um lai i kan chimhmi thil kha a tlin ni a phak hlantiang bia pakhat hmanh na chim kho lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cu chung cu zapi nih khan Zekhariah cu an rak hngah ko i zeicahdah Biakinn chungah cu cancan cu a rauh hnga, tiah an khuaruah a har."},"22":{"text":"A hung chuah tikah a chawn kho hna lo — cucaah Biakinn chungah langhnak a hmu ti kha an hngalh. A kut in hmelchunhnak kha a tuah i cuticun a chawnh hna, bia pakhat hmanh a chim kho lo."},"23":{"text":"Biakinn chung i a rianṭuannak caan kha a dih tikah Zekhariah cu inn ah a ṭin."},"24":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun a nupi Elizabeth cu nau kha a hun pawi i thla nga chung leng chuak loin a um."},"25":{"text":"A thawh i, “Atu cu a donghnak ah Bawipa nih hi tlukin maw a ka bawmh! Zapi hmai i ka ningzahnak cu a ka lakpiak cang,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Elizabeth pumlawnglo in a um thla ruknak ah, Pathian nih vancungmi Gabriel cu Galilee ram khua pakhat Nazareth timi ah cun a thlah.","title":"Jesuh Hrinnak Kong"},"27":{"text":"Siangpahrang David hrinsor a simipa Josef an timi he kan i ṭhi lai tiah bia aa kammi ngaknu kha bia na va chimh lai tiah a fial. Cu ngaknu cu a min ah Mary a si.","ref":"Mat 1.18"},"28":{"text":"Vancungmi kha a sinah cun a ra i. “Na cungah daihnak um ko seh. Bawipa cu na sinah a um i thluachuahnak tam piin an pek,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Vancungmi bia kha a theih tikah Mary cu a lau ngaingai i a bia kha a sullam zeidah a si hnga tiah a khuaruah a har."},"30":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun a thawh i, “Mary, na thinphang hlah. Zeicahtiah Pathian nih nangmah cu vel an ngeih."},"31":{"text":"Nau na pawi lai i fapa na hrin lai i a min ah Jesuh na sak lai.","ref":"Mat 1.21"},"32":{"text":"Amah cu milian mingan a si lai i Cungnung Bik Pathian fapa tiah ti a si lai. Amah a hringsortu Siangpahrang David bawiṭhutdan kha Pathian nih amah cu a pek i","ref":"2Sam 7.12,13,16; Isa 9.7"},"33":{"text":"Jakob tefa hna siangpahrang zungzal in a si lai, a pennak cu zeitikhmanh ah a dong lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Mary nih vancungmi cu a thawh i, “Ngaknu thiang ka si ṭung, zeitindah hihi cu a si khawh lai?” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun a leh i, “Thiang Thlarau kha na cungah a phan lai i Pathian ṭhawnnak cu na cungah aa fu lai. Hi ruangah hin a thiangmi fa cu Pathian Fapa tiah ti a si lai."},"36":{"text":"Hi hleiah na rualchan Elizabeth kha a tar leiah fa a pawi i a cing ti i rak ti tawnmi kha atu hi a thla ruknak a si cang,"},"37":{"text":"zeicahtiah Pathian nih a tuah khawh lomi thil zeihmanh a um lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 18.14"},"38":{"text":"Mary nih a thawh i, “Kei cu Bawipa salnu ka si ko, na chim bang cun ka cungah si ko seh,” tiah a ti i vancungmi nih cun a kaltak."},"39":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah Mary cu aa tim i Judah tlangram i a ummi khua pakhat ah khan khulrang in a hung kal.","title":"Mary Cu Elizabeth A Tlawng"},"40":{"text":"Zekhariah inn ah khan a vung lut i Elizabeth cu a vun biak."},"41":{"text":"Elizabeth nih Mary i a vun chawnhnak bia kha a theih tikah a paw chung i a fate cu a rak cawl. Elizabeth cu Thiang Thlarau in a khat i,"},"42":{"text":"aw thangpi in, “Nangmah cu nu vialte lakah thluachuak bik nu na si. Na hrin laimi na fa zong hi fa thluachuak a si."},"43":{"text":"Zeicahdah ka Bawipa nu nih hin kei tehna hi na hung ka tlawn?"},"44":{"text":"Na ka biakchawnhnak ka theih cangka khan pei ka chung i ka fate cu lunglawmhnak in aa hlawh len cu."},"45":{"text":"Bawipa bia na sinah a rami kha a tling taktak lai ti zumh cu na caah lunglawmh awk a va si hringhran dah,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Mary nih aa thawh i: “Thanh tuah, ka lungthin, Bawipa lianhngannak cu.","title":"Mary Sakmi Thangṭhatnak Hla","ref":"1Sam 2.1-10"},"47":{"text":"I lawm tuah, ka nunnak, Bawipa na khamhtu cungah;"},"48":{"text":"A salnu hi hi tluk minauta ka si nain a ka philh lo. Nihin thawk in hmailei ah cun mi vialte nih thluachuaknu an ka ti lai;","ref":"1Sam 1.11"},"49":{"text":"Bawipa, a ṭhawngmi Pathian nih ka cungah khuaruahhar tuk in rian a ṭuan. A min cu a thiang;"},"50":{"text":"Amah a ṭihmi vialte kha chan khat hnu chan khat in a zaangfah hna."},"51":{"text":"A ṭhawngmi a ban kha a samh i miruamkai hna kha an khuakhanmi he a ṭhek dih hna."},"52":{"text":"Siangpahrang ṭhawngṭhawng kha an bawiṭhutdan cungin a ṭhumh hna i Minauta kha a cawi hna.","ref":"Job 5.11; 12.19"},"53":{"text":"Rawl a ṭammi kha thil ṭhaṭha in a khimter hna i Mirum kha kut lawngin a kalter hna."},"54":{"text":"Kan pupa hna sinah a rak sermi biakamnak kha a zulh hna; A sal Israel kha bawmh awkah a ra i"},"55":{"text":"Abraham le a tefa vialte hna sinah zungzal in zaangfahnak langhter ding kha a philh lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 17.7"},"56":{"text":"Mary cu thla thum tluk Elizabeth sinah khan a um i cun inn ah a tlung ṭhan."},"57":{"text":"Elizabeth cu a nithla a hung tling i fapate a hrin.","title":"Tipil Petu Johan Hrinnak Kong"},"58":{"text":"Bawipa cu zeitluk in dah a cungah a ṭhat ti kha a innpa hna le a rualchan hna nih an theih tikah amah tluk te cun an dihlak in an i lawm."},"59":{"text":"Ngakchiate cu zarh khat a hung ti ah khin a cuarpar tan awkah an kalpi; annih nih a pa min Zekhariah in kan auh lai, tiah an ti.","ref":"Lev 12.3"},"60":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a nu nih khan, “Asilo, a min cu Johan a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"61":{"text":"Annih nih amah cu an thawh i, “Nan sahlawh nan rualchan lakah cu min a ngeimi pakhat hmanh an um ṭung lo,” tiah an ti."},"62":{"text":"Cun a pa kha kut zaoh in an chawnh i ngakchiapa kha a min zeidah sak na duh, tiah an hal."},"63":{"text":"Zekhariah nih cun caṭialnak catlap a hal hna i, “A min cu Johan a si,” tiah a ṭial."},"64":{"text":"Cu cangka cun Zekhariah cu a holh kho ṭhan i Pathian kha a hun thangṭhat."},"65":{"text":"A innpa hna cu an khuaruah a har i hi thil kong cu Judea ram tlang cung vialte ah khan a thang dih."},"66":{"text":"A theimi paoh kha an lung a suk hna i. “Hi fa hi zei ko dah a can te lai?” tiah an ti cio. Zeicahtiah Bawipa ṭhawnnak cu a cung i a um kha a fiang ko."},"67":{"text":"A pa Zekhariah cu Thiang Thlarau in a khat i, Pathian bia kha a chim:","title":"Zekhariah Chimmi Bia"},"68":{"text":"“Bawipa, Israel Pathian cu thangṭhat u sih. A mi hna bawmh awkah a ra cang i a luatter cang hna."},"69":{"text":"Kan caah a ṭhawngmi Khamhtu kha a chuahter cang. Amah cu a sal David tefa kha a si."},"70":{"text":"Hlanliopi ah a profet thiang hna sinin,"},"71":{"text":"‘Kan ral hna kut chungin le kanmah a kan huatu vialte hna sin khan, khamh awkah bia a kan kam."},"72":{"text":"Kan pupa hna cu, nan cungah zaangfahnak ka ngei lai, a ti hna i a thiangmi a biakamnak kha ka philh lo,’ tiah a ti hna."},"73":{"text":"Kan ral hna kut chungin luatter awkah le Amah cu ṭihnak um loin a rian kan ṭuan nakhnga, Kan pu Abraham sinah chiatser in bia aa kam i","merge":"74"},"75":{"text":"cucu kan nunchung vialte, amah hmaiah thianghlim le ding tein kan um nakhnga caah a si."},"76":{"text":"Nang, ka fa, nangmah hi Cungnung Bik Pathian profet tiah ti na si lai; Amah lam kha rak sersiam chung awkah Bawipa hmaiah cun na rak kal chung lai.","ref":"Mal 3.1"},"77":{"text":"A mi hna kha, nan sual ngaihthiam nan si thawngin khamhnak nan hmu lai, tiah na chimh hna lai."},"78":{"text":"Zeicahtiah, kan Pathian cu zaangfah thiammi le minunnem a si: Khamhnak khuaceu ṭha cu kan cungah a tlunter lai i"},"79":{"text":"Thihnak thladem mui lak i a ummi hna kha vancung in a vun ceuh hna lai; Kannih cu daihnak lam ah a kan hruai lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 9.2"},"80":{"text":"Ngakchia cu a hung ṭhang i thlarau in a ṭhawngmi a si; Israel mi zapi sinah a hun i langh hlantiang, thetse ram ah cun a um."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi caan ah Siangpahrang Awkastas nih nawlbia a chuah i, ‘Ram chung i a ummi vialte nih milu relnak caah nan min nan i thla dih lai,’ tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh Hrinnak Kong (Mat 1.18-25)"},"2":{"text":"Hi milu relnak hmasa bik a hung um ah hin Kuirinias cu Siria ram uktu a rak si."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah min i thlak awkah a mi paohpaoh in anmahle an khua cio ah khan an kal."},"4":{"text":"Josef cu Galilee ram i Nazareth khua in Judea ram i Bethlehem khua an timi, Siangpahrang David chuahnak khua ah khan a kal. Josef kha khika i a kalnak cu amah kha David hrinsor a si caah a si."},"5":{"text":"Cun minthlak awk i a kal ah khan a hammi Mary kha a sinah aa kalpi. A nithla kha a tling dengmang i"},"6":{"text":"Khika i an um lioah khan a hrin caan kha a phan, fapate kha a hrin i cucu a fater a si."},"7":{"text":"Puan in a zual i caw rawl einak kuang chungah khan a thlim — riahnak khualbuk ah khan an caah hmun a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Cuka hrawngah cun, an tuurun a zohkhenh i ramlak i a riakmi tuukhal hna kha an um.","title":"Tuukhal Hna le Vancungmi Hna"},"9":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi cu an sinah a lang i Bawipa sunparnak cu an velchum in a ceu.
