Annih cu an thin a phang tuk hringhran,"},"10":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw vancungmi nih cun a thawh hna i, “Nan thinphang hlah u; zeicahtiah nan sin i ka ratnak cu nan ca i thawngṭha he a si, cu thawngṭha nih cun mi vialte sinah lunglawmhnak a tlunter lai."},"11":{"text":"Tu zan hrimhrim ah hin David khua chungah nan Khamhtu kha a chuak cang — Khrih Bawipa cu!"},"12":{"text":"Cun hihi nan ca i hmelchunhnak cu a si lai: ngakchiate pakhat kha puan in an zual i caw rawl einak kuang chung i an thlim kha nan va hmuh lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Cu cangka cun vancung ralkapbu nganpi cu vancungmi sinah khan an rung lang i Pathian kha hla in an thangṭhat:"},"14":{"text":"“A sang bik van ah khin Pathian cu sunparnak hmu ko seh, Cun a dawtmi hna umnak vawlei ah hin remnak um ko seh,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun vancungmi hna cu annih sinin vancung i an kir ṭhan tikah khan tuukhal hna cu pakhat le pakhat kha, “Bethlehem khua ah cun va kal u si law Bawipa nih a kan chimhmi thil cu va zoh tuah u sih,” an i ti."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah khulrang in an kal i Mary le Josef cu an va ton hna i ngakchiate cu caw rawl einak kuang chung i a rak ih ko kha an va hmuh."},"17":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl nih ngakchia cu an hmuh tikah amah kong i vancungmi nih a chimmi kha an chimh hna"},"18":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl nih an chimmi a theimi paoh cu an khuaruah a har dih."},"19":{"text":"Mary nih hi thil vialte hi aa cinken hna i thuk piin a ruah hna."},"20":{"text":"Tuukhal pawl cu an kir i an va hmuhmi le an theihmi ruangah khan Pathian cu an thangṭhat; vancungmi nih a chimh hna bantukte khan a si taktak ko."},"21":{"text":"Cu hnu zarh khat ah, ngakchia cu cuarpartan caan a phak tikah khan, a min ah Jesuh an sak — cu min cu a nu nih a pawi hlan i vancungmi nih a rak sak cangmi kha a si.","title":"Jesuh Cu Min An Sak","ref":"Lev 12.3; Luk 1.31"},"22":{"text":"Moses Nawlbia nih nan tuah lai tiah a timi i thianh caan kha Josef le Mary caah cun a phan. Cucaah annih nih ngakchia cu Bawipa hmai i chanh awkah Jerusalem khua ah khan an i kalpi.","title":"Jesuh Biakinn Ah An Chuahpi","ref":"Lev 12.6-8"},"23":{"text":"Bawipa nawlbia chungah cun, Nan fater, pa a simi hna paoh kha Bawipa sinah nan pekchanh hna lai, tiah aa ṭial.","ref":"Exo 13.2,12"},"24":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nawlbia nih, Ṭhuro tuah khat, asiloah, laileng no pahnih, raithawinak ah nan pekchanh hna lai, a ti bantukin annih nih raithawinak kha an pekchanh."},"25":{"text":"Jerusalem khua ah khan mipa pakhat, a min Simeon a simi a rak um. Amah cu miṭha le Pathian a ṭihmi kha a si i Israel khamhnak ding a rak hngakmi kha a si. Thiang Thlarau nih khan a umpi i"},"26":{"text":"Thiang Thlarau nih cun Bawipa biakamhmi Messiah na hmuh hlanah cun na thi lai lo, tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Thlarau nih a hruainak thawngin Simeon cu Biakinn chungah cun a lut. Ngakchia Jesuh cu a nu le a pa nih, phung nih tuah awk a si tiah a tining in, Biakinn chungah an run luhpi tikah,"},"28":{"text":"Simeon nih cun a rak pom i Pathian cu a thangṭhat i:"},"29":{"text":"“Nihin ah hin, maw Bawipa, nangmah nih na salpa cu dai tein ka rian na ka limter cang, Atu cu nangmah na biakamnak kha a tling cang."},"30":{"text":"Zeicahtiah miphun vialte zohchih in khamhnak ding na rak timhmi cu ka mit hrimhrim in ka hmuh cang;","merge":"31"},"32":{"text":"Cucu Jentail mi hna caah na lam a langhtertu a simi ceunak le na mi Israel mi hna ca i sunparnak cu a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 42.6; 49.6; 52.10"},"33":{"text":"Simeon nih ngakchiapa kong a chimmi nih cun a nu le a pa kha an lung a sukhai ngaingai hna."},"34":{"text":"Simeon nih cun thluachuahnak a pek hna i a nu Mary kha a thawh i, “Hi ngakchia cu Pathian nih Israel mi lakah mi tampi an rawk nakhnga le khamh an si nakhnga caah a thimmi a si. Amah hi Pathian sinin a rami hmelchunhnak, mi tampi nih an doh laimi a si i"},"35":{"text":"an dohnak thawng cun mi tampi an lungthin chunglei kha a lang lai. Cun ngaihchiatnak nih vainam bantukin na lungthin kha a chunh lai,” a ti."},"36":{"text":"Profet nu pakhat, a min Anna an timi zong kha a um ve, amah cu Asher phun chung mi Fanuel fanu kha a si. Amah cu a tar ngaingai cang, a va he kum sarih lawng an rak um ṭi manh i atu cu"},"37":{"text":"kum sawm riat le kum li a si cang. Biakinn kha a kaltak bal lo i chun he zan he Pathian kha rawl ulh le thlacam in a biak."},"38":{"text":"Amah zong cu, cu caan te ah cun a ra ve i Pathian cu a thangṭhat i Pathian nih Jerusalem cu a tlanh ṭhan lai tiah a hngakmi vialte hna sinah khan ngakchiapa kong kha a chim."},"39":{"text":"Bawipa nawlbia nih nan tuah awk a si tiah a timi vialte kha an tuah dih in Galilee ram i an umnak khua Nazareth khua ah khan an kir ṭhan.","title":"Nazareth Khua Ah An Kir Ṭhan","ref":"Mat 2.23"},"40":{"text":"Ngakchia cu a hung ṭhang i a hung ṭhawng; fimnak in a khat i Pathian thluachuahnak kha a cungah a um."},"41":{"text":"Lanhtak Puai paoh ah khan, kum fate in, Jesuh nu le pa hna cu Jerusalem ah khan an kal lengmang.","title":"Ngakchiapa Jesuh Biakinn Chungah","ref":"Exo 12.1-27; Deu 16.1-8"},"42":{"text":"Jesuh kha kum hleihnih a si tikah voi dang bantukin puai ah cun an kal ṭhan."},"43":{"text":"Puai ni kha a dih tikah inn lei tlun ah khan an i thawh, sihmanhsehlaw ngakchiapa Jesuh kha Jerusalem khua ah cun a tang. Cucu a nu le a pa nih an hngal lo;"},"44":{"text":"annih ruahnak ah cun an hawile sinah khan a um rua, an ti i cucaah chun nitlak hlam loin an kal. An sahlawh pawl le an hawikom hna sin i an va kawl tikah khan an hmu ti lo."},"45":{"text":"Cucaah amah kawl awkah cun Jerusalem ah khan an kir ṭhan."},"46":{"text":"A ni thumnak ni ah Biakinn chungah khan an va hmuh i cawnpiaktu Judah mi hna sinah khan a rak ṭhu i an bia kha a rak ngai i bia a rak hal len ve ko hna."},"47":{"text":"A bia a theimi paoh cu a fimning le a bia lehning ah khan an khuahruah a har."},"48":{"text":"An va hmuh tikah a nu le a pa zong cu an khuaruah a har ve. A nu nih cun a thawh i, “Ka fa, zeicahdah hi bantukin na kan tuah? Na pa le na nu nih awlokchong in pei kan in kawl cu,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Annih cu “Zeicahdah nan ka kawl? Ka Pa inn ah ka um awk a si ti kha nan hngal lo maw?” tiah a ti hna."},"50":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih a chimhmi hna kha a sullam an hngal lo."},"51":{"text":"Cuticun Jesuh cu an sinah Nazareth khua ah khan a kir i a nu le a pa kut tangah nawl ngai tein a um: Hi thil vialte hi a nu nih a lung chungah aa ken dih."},"52":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu pum lei in siseh, fimnak lei in siseh, a hung ṭhang i Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah mithmai ṭha a hmu.","ref":"1Sam 2.26; Phut 3.4"}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Siangpahrang Tiberius kha a bawi kum, kum hleinganak kum a si, Pontius Pilat kha Judah ram mangki a si, Herod kha Galilee uktu a si i a nau Filip cu Iturea le Trakhonitis peng uktu a si; Lisanias cu Abilen uktu a si i","title":"Tipil Petu Johan Phungchimnak (Mat 3.1-12 ; Mar 1.1-8 ; Jhn 1.19-28)"},"2":{"text":"Annas le Kaiafas cu tlangbawi ngan an si. Cu caan lioah cun Zekhariah fapa Johan sinah ramcar chungah khan Pathian bia cu a phan."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah Jordan tiva hrawn hrawngah khan Johan cu aa chawk i, “Nan nun ṭhin u law tipilnak ing u. Cun Pathian nih nan sualnak an ngaihthiam hna lai,” a ti hna i"},"4":{"text":"Profet Isaiah nih a cauk chungah a rak ṭial bang khan a hung si. A ṭialmi cu hitin a si: “Mizeimaw cu ramcar chungah khan a au i, ‘Bawipa lam kha rak remh u, A kalnak ding lam kha ding tein rak ser u.","ref":"Isa 40.3-5"},"5":{"text":"A kuarhnak hmun vialte kha rak chilh hna u law Tlang sang le fing bo kip kha rak rawnhter hna u; Lam aa ngerhmi kha rak dinter hna u, Lam bingbo vialte kha rak tlorhnalh hna u;"},"6":{"text":"Cun minung phun paohpaoh nih Pathian khamhnak kha an hmuh lai,’ a ti,” tiah aa ṭialmi kha a hung tling."},"7":{"text":"Johan sinah khan mi cu a bubu in tipil in awkah khan an hung chuak lulhmalh. A rak thawh hna i, “Rul hna, Pathian thinhunnak a ra liomi sin cun nan luat kho lai tiah aho nih dah aan chimh hna?","ref":"Mat 12.34; 23.33"},"8":{"text":"Nan nun nan ṭhinh cu nan thil timi ah khan langhter u. ‘Abraham pei a kan hringsortu cu a si tiah,’ ti len hlah u. Pathian nih cun a duh ahcun hi lung hi a lak hna lai i Abraham tefa ah cun a ser khawh ko hna.","ref":"Jhn 8.33"},"9":{"text":"Thingkung cu hau awkah a hram ah hreitlung kha chiah a si cang; thei ṭha a tlai lomi kung paoh cu hau an si lai i mei chungah paih an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 7.19"},"10":{"text":"Mizapi nih cun an thawh i. “A si kun ahcun zeidah kan tuah kun lai?” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Anih nih, “Angki pahnih a ngeimi nih a ngei lomi kha pakhat ṭhen seh, cun rawl a ngeimi nih a ngei lomi kha hrawm seh,” a ti."},"12":{"text":"Ngunkhuai khawltu pawl kha tipil in awkah an ra i, “Saya, kannih hi tah zeidah kan tuah awk a si lai?” tiah an hal.","ref":"Luk 7.29"},"13":{"text":"A thawh hna i, “Khawlh awk timi nak tam in va khawl hna hlah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"Ralkap zong kha an ra i, “Kannih tah zeitin? Zeidah kan tuah awk cu a si ve lai?” an ti. Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ahohmanh hramhram in tangka va chut hna hlah u; va tlerhkhonh fawn hna hlah u. Nan lahkhah ah khan nan lung va tling ko u,” tiah a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Mizapi cu an i ruahchannak kha a hung ṭhang i Johan hi aho ko dah a si hnga, amah hi Messiah cu a si sual hnga maw, tiah an ruat lengmang."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Johan nih cun an dihlak in a thawh hna i, “Kei nih cun tiin tipilnak kan pek hna, sihmanhsehlaw keimah nakin a ngan deuh ngaingaimi a ra lio. A kedan hri phoihtu hmanh ah kei cu kaa tlak lo. Amah nih cun Thiang Thlarau le mei in tipilnak an pek hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Amah nih cun a ṭalawn kha aa put i rawl kha a zah hna lai; a fang ṭha cu buk chungah a rawn hna lai, sihmanhsehlaw a hi cu a mit lomi mei chungah a khangh hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"A phunphun in Johan nih cun mizapi cu Thawng Ṭha kha a chimh hna."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw uktu bawi Herod nih khan a nau nupi Herodias kha a ṭhit caah le thil dang a ṭha lomi tampi a tuah caah amah cu Johan nih khan a sik i","ref":"Mat 14.3-4; Mar 6.17-18"},"20":{"text":"cu ruangah cun Herod nih cu nakin a ṭhalo chinchinmi kha a tuah: Johan cu thong ah a thlak."},"21":{"text":"Mi dang vialte kha tipil a pek dih hna in Jesuh zong kha tipil cu a pek ve. Thla a cam lioah khan van cu aa hung i","title":"Jesuh Tipilinnak (Mat 3.13-17 ; Mar 1.9-11)"},"22":{"text":"Thiang Thlarau cu a pum in ṭhuro bantukin a cungah cun a rung ṭum. Cun vancung in aw pakhat a rung thang i, “Nangmah cu kan dawtmi ka fapa na si. Na cungah ka lung a tling,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 22.2; Slm 2.7; Isa 42.1; Mat 3.17; Mar 1.11; Luk 9.35"},"23":{"text":"Jesuh nih a rian ṭuan hram a thawk tikah amah cu kum sawm thum hrawng a si, amah cu Josef fapa a si tiah mi nih an ruah. Josef cu Heli fapa a si,","title":"Jesuh Chuahkehnak (Mat 1.1-17)"},"24":{"text":"Heli cu Matthat fapa a si, Matthat cu Levi fapa a si, Levi cu Melkhi fapa a si, Melkhi cu Jannai fapa a si, Jannai cu Josef fapa a si,"},"25":{"text":"Josef cu Mattathias fapa a si, Mattathias cu Amos fapa a si; Amos cu Nahum fapa a si, Nahum cu Esli fapa a si, Esli cu Naggai fapa a si,"},"26":{"text":"Naggai cu Maath fapa a si, Maath cu Mattathias fapa a si, Mattathias cu Semein fapa a si, Semein cu Josek fapa a si, Josek cu Joda fapa a si,"},"27":{"text":"Joda cu Joanan fapa a si, Joanan cu Resa fapa a si, Rhesa cu Zerubbabel fapa a si, Zerubbabel cu Shealtiel fapa a si; Shealtiel cu Neri fapa a si;"},"28":{"text":"Neri cu Melkhi fapa a si; Melkhi cu Addi fapa a si. Addi cu Kosam fapa a si, Kosam cu Elmadam fapa a si, Elmadam cu Er fapa a si,"},"29":{"text":"Er cu Joshua fapa a si, Joshua cu Eliezer fapa a si, Eliezer cu Jorim fapa a si, Jorim cu Matthat fapa a si, Matthat cu Levi fapa a si;"},"30":{"text":"Levi cu Simeon fapa a si, Simeon cu Judah fapa a si. Judah cu Josef fapa a si, Josef cu Jonam fapa a si, Jonam cu Eliakim fapa a si,"},"31":{"text":"Eliakim cu Melea fapa a si, Melia cu Menna fapa a si, Menna cu Mattatha fapa a si, Mattatha cu Nathan fapa a si, Nathan cu David fapa a si,"},"32":{"text":"David cu Jesse fapa a si, Jesse cu Obed fapa a si, Obed cu Boaz fapa a si, Boaz cu Sala fapa a si, Sala cu Nahshon fapa a si,"},"33":{"text":"Nahshon cu Amminadab fapa a si, Amminadab cu Admin fapa a si, Admin cu Arni fapa a si, Arni cu Hezron fapa a si, Hezron cu Perez fapa a si, Perez cu Judah fapa a si,"},"34":{"text":"Judah cu Jakob fapa a si, Jakob cu Isak fapa a si, Isak cu Abraham fapa a si, Abraham cu Terah fapa a si, Terah cu Nahor fapa a si,"},"35":{"text":"Nahor cu Serug fapa a si, Serug cu Reu fapa a si, Reu cu Peleg fapa a si, Peleg cu Eber fapa a si, Eber cu Shelah fapa a si,"},"36":{"text":"Shelah cu Kainan fapa a si, Kainan cu Arpaksad fapa a si, Arpaksad cu Shem fapa a si, Shem cu Noah fapa a si, Noah cu Lamek fapa a si,"},"37":{"text":"Lamek cu Methuselah fapa a si, Methuselah cu Enok fapa a si, Enok cu Jared fapa a si, Jared cu Mahalaleel fapa a si, Mahalaleel cu Kainan fapa a si,"},"38":{"text":"Kainan cu Enosh fapa a si, Enosh cu Seth fapa a si, Seth cu Adam fapa a si, Adam cu Pathian fapa a si."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Thiang Thlarau he khat in Jordan tiva khan a ra kir i Thlarau nih ramcar chungah khan a kalpi.","title":"Jesuh Tukforh Innak (Mat 4.1-11 ; Mar 1.12-13)"},"2":{"text":"Khika ah Khuachia nih ni sawm li chung a rak tukforh. Cu chung vialte cu rawl a ei lo caah cu caan a dih tikah a rawl a ṭam ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Khuachia nih cun a thawh i, “Nangmah cu Pathian Fapa na si ahcun, hi lung hi changreu ah i cang tiah ti tuah ngat,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh i, “Cathiang nih pei, ‘Minung nunnak hi rawl lawngin a si lo,’ a ti cu,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Deu 8.3"},"5":{"text":"Cun Khuachia nih cun a hun kaipi i chikkhatte ah khin vawleicung ram vialte kha a hmuhsak dih."},"6":{"text":"Khuachia nih cun a thawh i, “Hi lianhngannak vialte le hi chawva vialte hi kan pek lai. A dihlak hin keimah pek ka si cang i ka duhmi paoh ka pek khawh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah ka hmaiah na khuk i bil law hi vialte hi na ta an si dih ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Cathiang nih pei, ‘Bawipa na Pathian cu na biak lai i amah rian lawng kha na ṭuan lai,’ a ti cu,” tiah a leh.","ref":"Deu 6.13"},"9":{"text":"Cun Khuachia nih cun Jerusalem ah khan a kalpi i Biakinn parpahlek ah khan a ṭhutter. Cun a thawh i, “Nangmah cu Pathian Fapa na si ahcun hika hin vung zuang tuah ngat."},"10":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Cathiang nih pei, ‘Pathian nih nangmah kha ṭha tein zoh khenh awkah a vancungmi kha a fial hna lai,’ tiah a ti kha.","ref":"Slm 91.11"},"11":{"text":"Cu pinah, ‘An kut in an in cawi lai i lung ah na ke hmanh an i khawng lai lo,’ tiah a ti fawn,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 91.12"},"12":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh i, “Cathiang nih pei, ‘Bawipa na Pathian cu va hneksak hlah,’ a ti ve kha,” tiah a leh.","ref":"Deu 6.16"},"13":{"text":"Khuachia nih Jesuh cu a phunphun in a tukforh dih hnuah caan tlawmpal chung cu a kaltak."},"14":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Galilee ah khan a ra kir i Thiang Thlarau cu a sinah khan a um. Cuka hrawng vialte cu amah kong kha a thang dih.","title":"Jesuh Nih Galilee Ah Rianṭuan Aa Thawk (Mat 4.12-17 ; Mar 1.14-15)"},"15":{"text":"An i pumhnak inn ah khan a cawnpiak hna i a mi kip nih an thangṭhat."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh cu a rak tlonlennak Nazareth khua ah khan a va kal i Sabbath ni ah cun hmasa i a rak tuah tawn bantuk khan pumhnak inn ah a kal. Cathiang rel awkah khan a hung dir i","title":"Jesuh Cu Nazareth Khua Ah An Rak Hlawt (Mat 13.53-58 ; Mar 6.1-6)"},"17":{"text":"profet Isaiah cazual kha an pek. Cazual cu a vun samh i,"},"18":{"text":"“Bawipa Thlarau cu ka cungah a um. Sifakmi hna sin i Thawngṭha chim awkah chiti a ka thuh i Saltangmi hna sin i luatnak thanh awkah a ka thlah. Mitcaw mi hna sin i khuahmuh ṭhannak pek awk le Hremmi hna luatter dingah a ka thlah,","ref":"Isa 61.1-2"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa nih a mi hna a khamh hna lai ding kum cu va thanh awkah a ka thlah!” tiah aa ṭialnak hmun kha a rel."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh nih cazual cu a zual ṭhan i a zohkhenhtu kha a pek ṭhan i a ṭhu. Pumhnak inn i a ummi vialte nih amah cu ṭhep loin an zoh dih."},"21":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Hika Cathiang cang hi, nannih nih ka rel tikah nan theih bantukin nihin ni ah hin a tling cang,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"An lung a hmuh ngaingai hna i bia dawhdawh a chimmi nih khan an khuaruah a harter dih hna. An i thawh i, “Amah hi Josef fapa kha a si lo hlah i?” an ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun anih nih a thawh hna i, “ ‘Sibawipa, nangmah le nangmah i damter,’ timi phungthlukbia kha nan ka chimhnawh te lai, tiah fiang tein ka hngalh ko. Cun nan i thawh fawn lai i, ‘Kapernaum khua ah na tuah tiah kan theihmi thil cu na chuahkehnak khua zongah hin tuah ve hna,’ ti zongah nan ka ti fawn lai."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah hihi kan chimh hna: Profet cu amah chuahkehnak khua ah cun conglawmh a tong bal lo.","ref":"Jhn 4.44"},"25":{"text":"Cucaah ka bia hi ngai hmanh u. Elijah chan i kum thum le a cheu khua a khen i Israel ram chung dihlak ah pam a tlun ah khan, cu ram chungah nuhmei tampi an rak um taktak ko,","ref":"1Sia 17.1"},"26":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw cu hna sinah cun Elijah kha thlah si loin Sidon ram Zarefath khua nuhmei sin tu ah khan thlah a si deuh.","ref":"1Sia 17.8-16"},"27":{"text":"Profet Elisha chan ah Israel ram ah thinghmuimi tampi an rak um ko, sihmanhsehlaw Siria mi Naaman dah ti lo cu ahohmanh damtermi an um lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"2Sia 5.1-14"},"28":{"text":"Hi bia an theih tikah pumhnak inn chung i a ummi vialte cu an thin a hung dih."},"29":{"text":"An tho i Jesuh cu khualeng ah an hnuh i lungpang cungin thlak awkah, khua a ṭhutnak tlang a par ah khan an kalpi."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zapi lak khan aa zuk i a lan."},"31":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu Galilee ram i khua pakhat, Kapernaum khua ah khan a kal i khika ah sabbath ni ah khan a cawnpiak hna.","title":"Thlarau Ṭhalo A Ngeimipa (Mar 1.21-28)"},"32":{"text":"A cawnpiakning hna kha an khuaruah a har, zeicahtiah a bia cu hmual a ngei ngaingai.","ref":"Mat 7.28-29"},"33":{"text":"Cuka pumhnak inn ah cun khuachia thlarau a ngeimi pa pakhat a rak um; fak piin a au i,"},"34":{"text":"“Nazareth khuami Jesuh, zeidah na kan duhnak a si? Kanmah hrawh awkah maw hika ah hin na rat? Nangmah cu aho na si kha kan hngalh ko — Pathian lamkaltu a thiangmi na si ko,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh nih thlarau cu, “Dai tein um law, mipa chung khan chuak,” tiah a ti. Khuachia nih cun mipa cu an dihlak hmaika ah khan a thluk i a cungah zeihmanh ṭhat lonak tuah loin a kaltak."},"36":{"text":"An dihlak in an khuaruah a har i pakhat le pakhat cu, “Hi bia hi zei bantuk bia dah a si? Hi mipa nih hin nawlngeihnak le ṭhawnnak in thlarau ṭhalo kha nawl a pek hna i an chuak ko,” tiah an i ti."},"37":{"text":"Cun Jesuh kong cu cu ram chung khuazakip ah khan a thang."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh cu pumhnak inn khan a chuak i Simon inn ah a kal. Simon nupi nu cu a rak zaw i a tak a lin ngaingai i cu kong cu Jesuh kha an chimh.","title":"Mi Tampi A Damter Hna (Mat 8.14-17 ; Mar 1.29-34)"},"39":{"text":"Jesuh cu a va kal i a ihkhun pawngah khan a dir i a zawtnak cu a sik. A taklin nih cun a thlah i chikkhatte ah a tho i a bultawl hna."},"40":{"text":"Ni tlak hnuah, mizaw a ngeimi paoh nih khan, zawtnak a phunphun in a zawmi an mizaw hna kha Jesuh sinah cun an ratpi hna; an lu cungah khan a kut a chuan diahmah i an dihlak in a damter hna."},"41":{"text":"Mi tampi chungin khuachia zong kha an chuak i an chuahpah ah cun, “Nangmah cu Pathian Fapa na si,” tiah an au. Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu a sik hna i holh a thlauh hna, zeicahtiah Messiah a si kha an hngalh."},"42":{"text":"Khuadei kate ah Jesuh cu khuachung khan a chuak i hmunking ah a kal. Sihmanhsehlaw mizapi nih khan an kawl i a umnak an va phak tikah khan, kan kaltak ti hlah, tiah an hnek.","title":"Judea Ram Ah Phung A Chim (Mar 1.35-39)"},"43":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thawh hna i, “Pathian Pennak kong Thawngṭha kha khua dang zongah ka chim hrimhrim awk a si, cu chim ah cun pei Pathian nih a ka thlah cu,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cucaah Judea ram chung i pumhnak inn hna ah khan Thawngṭha cu a chim hna."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat cu Genesaret Tilikam ah Jesuh cu a dir lioah khan mi tampi nih Pathian bia theih awkah amah cu an buthnawh.","title":"Zultu Hmasa Bik Pawl A Auh Hna (Mat 4.18-22 ; Mar 1.16-20)","ref":"Mat 13.1-2; Mar 3.9-10; 4.1"},"2":{"text":"Ti kam i an hrenmi lawng pahnih kha a hmuh hna; ngatlai pawl cu an lawng khan an chuak i titlang ah khan an sur cu an rak su len ko."},"3":{"text":"Cu ka i a ummi lawng pakhat, Simon ta ah cun Jesuh cu a lut i tikam cun tlawm tein hei nam deuh u tiah a ti. Jesuh cu lawng chungah cun a ṭhu i mizapi kha a cawnpiak hna."},"4":{"text":"Bia a chim dih in Simon cu a thawh i, “Ti thuhnak leiah khin na lawng hi hei thawn deuh law nangmah le na hawile nih khan nan sur khan nga kha chep hna u,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Simon nih cun, “Bawipa, zan khuadei kan vorh ṭualmal ko nain zeihmanh kan tlai lo. Sihmanhsehlaw ti ko u, na ti ahcun sur cu kan cheh rih ko lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jhn 21.3"},"6":{"text":"Sur cu an vun cheh hna i nga cu tam tuk hringhran an tlaih hna caah an sur cu tleh dih hnek aa zal.","ref":"Jhn 21.6"},"7":{"text":"Cucaah lawng dang i a ummi an hawile kha, ra kan bawm u, tiah an kut an hei zaoh hna. An ra i lawngah cun a khat tein an sanh hna, an khah tuk caah lawng cu an pil dengmang."},"8":{"text":"Simon Peter nih cucu a hmuh tikah Jesuh hmaiah cun a khuk aa bil i, “Bawipa, ka kaltak ko, kei cu misual ka si,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Amah le a sir i a ummi hna cu an tlaihmi nga kha a tam tuk caah an khuaruah a har."},"10":{"text":"Simon hawile hna Jeim le Johan, Zebedi fapa hna zong kha, cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun an um. Jesuh nih Simon cu a thawh i, “Na thinphang hlah, atu thawk in mi na tlai cang hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Lawng cu tikam ah an hnuh i zeizong vialte kha an kaltak i Jesuh kha an zulh."},"12":{"text":"Voi khat cu khua pakhat ah hin Jesuh cu a um i cuka ah cun thinghmui zawtnak nih a tuam in a tuammipa pakhat a rak um. Jesuh kha a hmuh tikah a hmaiah khan a bawk i, “Bawipa, na duh ahcun na ka thianter khawh,” tiah a nawl.","title":"Thinghmuimi A Damter (Mat 8.1-4 ; Mar 1.40-45)"},"13":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a kut a hei samh i a hei tawngh. “Damter kan duh, thiang ko,” tiah a ti. Chikkhatte ah thinghmui zawtnak nih cun a kaltak."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Mah hihi ahohmanh chim hna hlah, tlangbawi sin bel ah khan va kal zau law rak in zoh seh; na thiang cang ti langhternak ah Moses nawlbia ningin raithawinak kha va tuah,” tiah a fial.","ref":"Lev 14.1-32"},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh thawng cu a thang chinchin i mirun tampi nih a bia ngaih awkah le an zawtnak in damter awkah an fuh."},"16":{"text":"Hnathiannak hmun ah khan a kaltak tawn hna i khika ah khan thla a va cam tawn."},"17":{"text":"Ni khat cu Jesuh nih a cawnpiak hna lioah khan Farasi mi tlawmpal hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna, Galilee ram le Judea ram khuazakip in le Jerusalem khua in a rami hna kha a pawngah cun an ṭhu. A zawmi damternak ding caah khan Bawipa ṭhawnnak cu Jesuh sinah khan a um.","title":"Mizengmi A Damter (Mat 9.1-8 ; Mar 2.1-12)"},"18":{"text":"Mi tlawmpal nih khin a zengmipa pakhat kha a ihkhun in an hun zawnh i an ra. Inn chungah khan vun luhpi i Jesuh hmaika i vun chiah kha an i tim."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi an tam tuk caah zei ti hmanh in an luhpi kho lo. Cucaah inncung ah an kaipi i inn cihmi lungtlap kha an ṭhial hna hnuah a ihkhun cun mizapi laifang ah cun Jesuh hmaika ah khan an vun thlak."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh nih zeitluk in dah an zumh ti kha a hmuh tikah mipa cu a thawh i, “Ka kawi, na sualnak cu ngaihthiam na si cang,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cu tikah Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le Farasi mi hna cu anmah le anmah kha, “Pathian a thangchiatmi pa hi ahodah a si? Ahohmanh nih sual thlahpiak khawh a si ṭung lo, Pathian lawng nih pei thlahpiak khawh a si ko cu,” tiah an i ceih."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh nih an ruahnak cu a hngalh hna i, “Zeicahdah cu bantuk thil cu nan ruah?"},"23":{"text":"‘Na sualnak cu ngaihthiam na si cang,’ ti maw a fawi deuh, ‘Tho law kal tuah,’ ti dah a fawi deuh?"},"24":{"text":"Cucaah vawlei cungah hin Mi Fapa nih sual ngaihthiam khawhnak nawl a ngei ti kha nannih sinah ka langhter lai,” tiah a ti hna. Cucaah mizengpa cu a thawh i, “Tho law na ihkhun kha i cawi law inn ah va ṭin,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun an hmaika ah cun hmakhatte ah a tho i a ihnak ihkhun cu aa cawi i Pathian thangṭhat pah in inn ah a ṭin."},"26":{"text":"An dihlak in an khuaruah a har ko. Ṭihnak in an khat i Pathian cu an thangṭhat i, “Nihin i kan hmuhmi thil cu khuaruahhar an va si dah!” tiah an ti."},"27":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Jesuh cu a va chuak i ngunkhuai khawltu Levi kha, a zung i a rak ṭhut ko cu a hmuh. Jesuh nih cun a thawh i, “Ra ka zul,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh Nih Levi A Kawh (Mat 9.9-13 ; Mar 2.13-17)"},"28":{"text":"Levi cu a tho i, zeizong vialte kha a kaltak i a zulh."},"29":{"text":"A hnuah Levi nih khan a inn ah cun Jesuh kha rawl danghnak nganpi a tuahpiak i ngunkhuai khawltu tampi hna le midang hna kha an sinah cun an ṭhu."},"30":{"text":"Cun Farasi mi tlawmpal hna le anmah bu chung um a simi Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna kha Jesuh zultu sinah cun an zai i, “Zeicahdah ngunkhuai khawltu hna le misual mi hna he rawl nan ei ṭi?” an ti.","ref":"Luk 15.1-2"},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “A dammi nih sibawi an herh lo, a zawmi lawnglawng nih an herh."},"32":{"text":"Sualnak kan ngei lo tiah aa ruatmi hna kha i ngaihchih u ti awkah ka ra lo, misual mi tu kha, i ngaichih u tiin kawh awkah ka ra,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Jesuh cu mi a cheukhat nih an thawh i, “Johan zultu pawl cu atu le atu rawl an ul i thla an cam, cun Farasi mi hna zultu pawl zong nih khan cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun an tuah; sihmanhsehlaw nang na zultu hna cu an ding an ei ko,” tiah an ti.","title":"Rawl Ulhnak Kong (Mat 9.14-17 ; Mar 2.18-22)"},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Nupi ṭhit rawl danghnak ah, nupi ṭhitupa cu an sin i a um chungah khan sawmmi hna cu rawl ulhter awk a si, tiah nan ruat maw? Nan ruat hrimhrim lai lo."},"35":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nupi ṭhitupa an sin in a chuah caan kha a phan ko lai i cu tikah cun rawl cu an ul te ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Jesuh nih hi bianabia zong hi a chimh hna: “Thil hlun kha thil thar thlehmi in ahohmanh nih an belh bal lo. Cu bantukin an tuah ahcun thil thar kha a tlek lai i a thar thlehmi thil pelpawi kha a hlun he khan aa tlak lai lo."},"37":{"text":"Cun ahohmanh nih mitsur hang rawnnak saphaw thawl a hlunmi chungah mitsur hang thar kha an rawn bal lo. Cuti an rawn ahcun, mitsur hang thar nih khan saphaw thawl kha a kheh lai i mitsur hang cu a tle dih lai i saphaw thawl kha a rawk lai."},"38":{"text":"Cuticun ahohmanh nih an tuah lai lo. Mitsur hang thar cu saphaw thawl a tharmi chungah rawn awk a si."},"39":{"text":"Cun mitsur hang a hlunmi din hnuah ahohmanh nih a thar kha an duh lo. ‘A hlun kha a thar nakin a thaw deuh,’ an ti,” tiah a ti."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voi khat cu Sabbath ni ah hin Jesuh cu khual a tlawng i changvut lo kha a palpah hna. A zultu hna nih khan changvut vui cu an sihpah hna i an kut in an hnuai hna i a fang kha an ei hna.","title":"Sabbath Ni Kong I Biahalnak (Mat 12.1-8 ; Mar 2.23-28)","ref":"Deu 23.25"},"2":{"text":"Farasi mi a cheukhat nih an i thawh i, “Zeicahdah kan Phung nih Sabbath ni ah nan tuah kho lo a timi nan tuah?” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i. “David le a hawile kha an rawl a ṭam tikah zeidah David nih a tuah; ti kha nan rel bal lo maw?","ref":"1Sam 21.1-6"},"4":{"text":"Pathian inn chungah pei a lut i Pathian hunhmi changreu kha a lak i a ei i a hawile zong a pek hna kha. Khati a tuahmi kha kan Phung he aa ralchanhmi a si ṭung, zeicahtiah cu changreu cu tlangbawi lawnglawng nih pei ei phung a si kha,” tiah a ti hlei ah,","ref":"Lev 24.9"},"5":{"text":"“Mi Fapa hi Sabbath Bawi pei a si cu,” tiah a ti hna."},"6":{"text":"Sabbath ni dang pakhat ah khan Jesuh cu pumhnak inn ah a lut i a cawnpiak hna. Cuka ah cun a orhlei kut a zengmipa a rak um.","title":"Kut Zengmipa (Mat 12.9-14 ; Mar 3.1-6)"},"7":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le Farasi mi a cheu khat hna nih khan Jesuh cu thil ṭhalo a tuah tiah zeitindah sual kan phawt khawh lai ti kha an kawl; cucaah cun sabbath ni ah hin aho tal a damter hna lai maw, tiah ṭha tein an ngiat."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih an ruahnak kha a hngalh i a kut a zengmipa cu a thawh i, “Dir law hmaiah hin ra chuak tuah,” tiah a ti. Mipa cu a tho i a dir."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih annih cu a thawh hna i. “Bia kan hal hna: kan Phung nih sabbath ni ah zei tuah dah a kan onh? Ṭhatnak tuah maw ṭhat lonak tuah dah? Mi nunnak khamh maw mi nunnak hrawh dah?” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Annih cu a mit in a zoh duahmah hna i, cu hnuah mipa kha a thawh i, “Na kut kha samh,” tiah a ti. A kut cu a samh i a dam."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu an thin a khenh hna i Jesuh hi zeitindah kan hrawh khawh lai ti kha an i ceih."},"12":{"text":"Cu caan lioah cun ni khat cu tlang cungah thlacam awkah a kal i zan khuadei Pathian sinah thla a cam.","title":"Jesuh Nih Lamkaltu Hleihnih A Thim Hna (Mat 10.1-4 ; Mar 3.13-19)"},"13":{"text":"Khua a dei tikah a zultu kha a kawh hna i hleihnih a thim hna i lamkaltu tiah a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"An min cu hihi an si: Simon (Peter ti zongah timi) le a nau Andru; Jeim le Johan, Filip le Bartholomew,"},"15":{"text":"Matthai le Thomas, Alfeas fapa Jeim le phunṭanh tiah an kawhmi Simon,"},"16":{"text":"Jeim fapa Judas le rawitu ah a cangmi Judas Iskariot."},"17":{"text":"Tlang cung cun an sinah a rung ṭum hnuah Jesuh cu hmunrawn pakhat ah a zultu mi tampi hna sinah khan a dir. Cuka ah cun mi tampi an um i cu hna cu Judea ram khuazakip le Jerusalem khua le rilikam khua a simi Tair le Sidon khua in a rami an si;","title":"A Cawnpiak Hna I A Damter Hna (Mat 4.23-25)"},"18":{"text":"annih an ratnak cu a bia theih duh le an zawtnak damnak hmuh duh ah a si. Thlarau ṭhalo nih awlok a chonhmi hna zong kha an ra i a damter hna."},"19":{"text":"A chungin ṭhawnnak kha a chuah caah mi nih cun an dihlak in amah tawngh kha an i zuam i an dihlak in a damter hna."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh nih a zultu kha a zoh hna i a thawh hna i, “Nannih sifakmi hna i lawm u, Pathian Pennak cu nanmah ta a si.","title":"Lunglawmhnak le Ngaihchiatnak (Mat 5.1-12)"},"21":{"text":"Nannih atu i rawl a ṭammi hna i lawm u, Nan paw a khim lai. Nannih atu i a ṭapmi hna i lawm u, Nan ni lai."},"22":{"text":"Mi Fapa ruangah mi nih an in huat hna i an in hlawt hna i an in serhsat hna i miṭhalo an in ti hna tikah i lawm ko u.","ref":"1Pet 4.14"},"23":{"text":"Cu ni ah cun i lawm u law a lam in lam u, zeicahtiah nan caah vancung ah laksawng nganpi chiahpiak nan si. Cu bantuk te cun pei an pupa hna nih khan profet hna kha an rak tuah hna cu.","ref":"2Cha 36.16; Lam 7.52"},"24":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw nannih atu i a rummi, nan caah cun ngaihchia a va si dah! Nan nun nuamhnak kha nan hmuh cang."},"25":{"text":"Atu i a paw a khimmi nan caah cun ngaihchia a va si dah! Rawlṭam in nan vak lai. Atu i a ni lengmangmi nan caah cun ngaihchia a va si dah! Ngaihchia in nan ṭap lai!"},"26":{"text":"Mi vialte nih, an in chimthiam hna tikah nan caah ngaihchia a va si dah; zeicahtiah cuti te cun pei an pupa hna nih khan nal profet kha an rak ti hna cu,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"“Nannih ka bia a theimi hna, nan ral kha va daw hna u, an huatu hna cungah khan ṭhatnak va tuah u,","title":"Nan Ral Nan Dawt Hna Lai (Mat 5.38-48 ; 7.12a)"},"28":{"text":"chiat an serhtu hna kha thla va campiak hna u."},"29":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih na bel ah an bengh ahcun khattelei bel zong i chit rih; pakhatkhat nih na angkileng an chuh ahcun na angki chungnawh zong va pe rih."},"30":{"text":"Thil zeimaw an halmi paohpaoh kha va pe hna, cun mi pakhatkhat nih na ta a simi kha aa lak ahcun va hal ṭhan ti hlah."},"31":{"text":"Ka tuahpiak hna seh ti na duhmi kha mi va tuahpiak hna.","ref":"Mat 7.12"},"32":{"text":"“Nangmah an dawmi lawng kha na dawt hna ahcun zeicahdah thluachuah hmuh cu naa ruah? Misual mi hmanh nih anmah a dawtu hna cu an dawt ve ko ṭung hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun na cung i ṭhatnak a tuahmi cung lawng i ṭhatnak na tuah ve ahcun, zeicahdah thluachuah hmuh cu naa ruahchan? Misual mi hna zong nih misual vemi hna sinah khan an cawihmi hna zat hmuh ṭhan dingah cun an coih ve ko ṭung hna.","merge":"34"},"35":{"text":"Cuticun nan tuah awk a si lo. Nan ral kha daw hna u, an cungah khan ṭhatnak tuah u, chaw kha mi va cawih hna u law ka hmuh ṭhan lai, tiah ruahchannak ngei hlah u. Laksawng tampi nan hmuh lai i Cung Nung Bik Pathian fa nan si lai, zeicahtiah amah cu miṭhalo mi hna le lawmh hmanh a duh lomi hna cung hmanh ah a ṭha."},"36":{"text":"Nan Pa cu mi zaangfah thiam a si bantukin nannih zong mi zaangfah thiammi si ve u,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"“Midang kha va soi hna hlah u law nannih zong Pathian nih an soi ve hna lai lo; midang kha sual va phaw hna hlah u law nannih zong Pathian nih sual an phaw ve hna lai lo; midang kha an sualnak va ngaithiam hna u law nannih zong Pathian nih nan sualnak an ngaihthiam ve hna lai.","title":"Midang Kha Va Soi Hna Hlah (Mat 7.1-5)"},"38":{"text":"Midang kha thil va ṭhen hna u, nannih zong Pathian nih an ṭhenh ve hna lai: liam thluahmah in, nan i chap khawh chungin, nan zawi khawh le khawh loin nan kut chungah an thlet hna lai. Midang ca i nan hmanmi tahnak rel kha Pathian nih nanmah ca zongah a hman ve lai,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Cun hi tahchunhnak bia hi Jesuh nih a chimh hna: “Mitcaw nih mitcaw kha lam a ṭhi kho lai lo, a ṭhit a si ahcun an pahnih in hor ah an tla lai.","ref":"Mat 15.14"},"40":{"text":"Siangngakchia cu a saya nakin a ngan deuh lo, sihmanhsehlaw siangngakchia nih a cawnnak kha a dih tikah cun a saya bantuk a si lai.","ref":"Mat 10.24-25; Jhn 13.16; 15.20"},"41":{"text":"“Na mit chung i a ummi thingtan kha ruat ṭung loin zeicahdah na unau mit i mithnawm pelte a ummi cu zoh na duh?"},"42":{"text":"Na mit chung i a ummi thingtan cu hmu ṭung loin zeitindah na unaupa cu, “Ka nau, na mithnawm kha in cawihpiakning,” na ti khawh? Mi depde. Na mit chung i thingtan kha chuah hmasa law pei na unau hna mit chung i a ummi mithnawm hme tete cu na hmuh khawh lai i na cawih khawh lai cu,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"“A ngan a dammi thingkung nih thei chia a tlai lo, thingkung ṭhalo zong nih thei ṭha a tlai ve lo.","title":"Thingkung le A Tlai (Mat 7.16-20 ; 12.33-35)"},"44":{"text":"Thingkung paohpaoh cu an theitlai in hngalh khawh an si; hlingbur in theipi nan lo bal lo, theihmung bur in mitsur thei nan lo bal fawn lo.","ref":"Mat 12.33"},"45":{"text":"Miṭha nih a lung chung i thil ṭha a khonmi chung khan ṭhatnak a chuahter; miṭhalo nih a lung chung i thil ṭhalo a khonmi chung khan chiatnak a chuahter. Zeicahtiah mi nih a kaa in a chimmi hi a lung chung i a khatmi kha a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 12.34"},"46":{"text":"“Zeicahdah nannih nih, ‘Bawipa, Bawipa,’ nan ka ti len ko i kan chimhmi hna cu nan tuah ṭung lo?","title":"Inn Satu Pahnih (Mat 7.24-27)"},"47":{"text":"Ka sinah a ra i ka bia a ngai i a zulmi cu zei he dah aa lawh ti kha kan hmuhsak hna lai."},"48":{"text":"Amah cu inn a sami bantuk a si: thuk piin a cawh i a hram kha lungpi cungah a bunh. Tiva cu a hung lian i inn cu a hun den, sihmanhsehlaw fek tein sak a rak si caah a hninh in a hnin kho lo."},"49":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka bia a thei i a zul ṭung lomi cu a hram ṭha tein ser hmasa loin inn a sa menmi bantuk a si; tilian nih cu inn cu a hun den tikah chikkhatte ah a pur i a tlu ruangmang ko,” a ti."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi bia vialte hi mizapi kha a chimh dih hna in Jesuh cu Kapernaum khua ah khan a kal.","title":"Rom Ralbawi Sal A Damter (Mat 8.5-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cuka i a ummi Rom ralbawi pakhat nih sinum pakhat a ngei i a sinumpa cu a dawt ngaingai; cu pa cu a zaw i a thi dengmang."},"3":{"text":"Cu ral bawipa nih Jesuh thawng kha a theih tikah, a sinumpa kha a ra damter nakhnga amah cu va nawl awkah Judah mi upa kha a hei thlah hna."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh sin kha an va phan i biatak tein an va nawl. “Hi pa hi bawmh awk aa tlak taktakmi a si."},"5":{"text":"Kan miphun hi a kan dawt i amah hrimhrim nih pumhnak inn a kan sakpiak,” an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh cu anmah he cun a va kal. Inn khin lamhla a si ti lonak hmun a phak tikah, ralbawipa nih cun a hawikom kha a hun thlah hna i, “Bawipa, na re i theih hlah, nangmah luhnak dingah ka inn hi aa tlak lo;"},"7":{"text":"Keimah nih ka pum in ka hung in dong lai ka ti ah, cu an dong ding zongah cun aa tlak in kaa hmu fawn lo. Nangmah nih, ‘Dam seh,’ hei ti law ka salpa cu a dam ko lai."},"8":{"text":"Keimah zong hi bawi ngan deuh kut tang i a ummi ka si, cun keimah kut tang zongah cun ralkap an um ve. Hi pa cu, Kal, ka ti ah a kal ko i khi pa cu, Ra, ka ti ah a ra ko; cun ka sal zong cu, Hihi tuah, ka ti ah a tuah ko, a ti tiah va chim u,” a ti hna."},"9":{"text":"Hi bia a theih tikah Jesuh cu a khuaruah a har i a hnulei ah aa mer i a zultu zapi hna cu, “Hi bantuk zumhnak hi dah ka hmuh bal lo, Israel mi hna lak hmanh ah,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna cu ralbawipa inn ah khan an va kir i a sinumpa a rak dam kha an va hmuh."},"11":{"text":"A thaizing ah Jesuh cu Nain an timi khua ah a kal; a zultu hna le mi tampi nih khan an zulh.","title":"Nuhmeinu Fapa A Thawhter"},"12":{"text":"Khua hauka a hei phak ah khin ruak vui awk i a kalmi mirun kha an hung chuak ve. A thimipa cu nuhmeinu fapa a si i amah lawngte cu a fa a si, mi tampi nih khuachung cun nuhmeinu cu an kalpi."},"13":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun amah cu a hmuh tikah a zaang a fak ngaingai i, “Ṭap hlah,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Cun a va kal i ruak kuang kha a tawngh i a zawntu hna cu an dir. Jesuh nih cun, “Tlangvalpa, tho tuah, kan ti,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Mithipa cu a hung ṭhu i bia a hun chim i Jesuh nih a nu sinah khan a pek ṭhan."},"16":{"text":"An dihlak in ṭihnak in an khat i Pathian kha an thangṭhat. “Kan lakah profet nganmi a chuak cang i Pathian nih a mi hna khamh awkah a ra cang,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh thawngpang cu Judea ram vialte le a pawngkam ram ah khan a thang dih."},"18":{"text":"Johan zong cu hi kong kha a zultu hna nih khan an chimh ve. Johan nih cun an lak i pahnih kha a auh hna i","title":"Tipilpetu Johan Thlahmi Lamkaltu Hna (Mat 11.2-19)"},"19":{"text":"Bawipa sinah cun a hei thlah hna i, “ ‘Nangmah hi a ra lai timi cu na si maw; asiloah a dang dah kan orh rih lai?’ tiah va hal u,” a ti hna."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh sin an phak tikah an i thawh i, “Tipil petu Johan nih a kan thlah i nangmah cu, ‘A ra lai tiah timi cu na si maw, asiloah a dang dah kan orh rih lai,’ tiah va hal u, a kan ti,” an ti."},"21":{"text":"Cu caan lio thengte ah cun Jesuh nih mi tampi kha an zawtnak le an nganfahnak, thlarau ṭhalo nih a tuah hnanak khan a damter hna i mitcaw tampi kha khua a hmuhter hna."},"22":{"text":"Johan zultu pawl cu a leh hna i, “Va kir u law nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi: mitcaw nih khua an hmuhnak le, kebei nih an kal khawhnak le thinghmuimi nih thiannak an hmuhnak le hnachet nih khua an theihnak le a thimi hna nunter ṭhan an sinak le sifakmi hna sinah Thawngṭha chim a sinak kong kha Johan cu va chim u.","ref":"Isa 35.5-6; 61.1"},"23":{"text":"Keimah kong ah lung awṭawm in a um lomi cu an caah lunglawmh awk a va si dah,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna kha an kal dih in Jesuh nih Johan kong kha mi zapi cu a chimh hna. Ramlak i Johan nan hei fuhpanh tikah khan zeidah kan hmuh lai tiah nan rak ruah? Phaikung thli nih a chem diahmahmi hna kha maw?"},"25":{"text":"A si lai lo. Cucu a si ṭung lo ahcun zeidah zoh awkah nan chuahhnawh kun? Thilpuan ṭhaṭha aa hrukmi zoh awkah maw? A taktak ti ahcun cu bantukin aa thuam i nunnuam ngaingai in a ummi hna cu siangpahrang inn chungah pei an um tawn cu."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zei ko cu dah zoh nan va duhmi cu a si kun? Profet maw? Asi, profet nakin a ngan deuhmi pei nan hmuh ko hi."},"27":{"text":"Zeicah ti ahcun Johan cu Cathiang nih, ‘Hika ah hin ka tlangautu kha a um i amah cu na hmaiah ka thlah lai; amah nih cun na lam kha an sialpiak lai,’ tiah Pathian nih a ti, a timi kha pei a si cu,","ref":"Mal 3.1"},"28":{"text":"Kan chimh hna, nu hrinmi fa lakah Johan nakin a ngan deuhmi ahohmanh an um lo, sihmanhsehlaw Pathian Pennak chung i a ummi hna lak i a hme bik hmanh Johan nakcun a ngan deuh,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Mi zapi le ngunkhuai khawltu hna nih khan a bia cu an theih; anmah cu Pathian bia kha a ngai i tipilnak a ingmi cu an si.","ref":"Mat 21.32; Luk 3.12"},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Farasi mi le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih khan cun an ca i Pathian nih a tinhmi kha an duh lo i Johan tipil peknak kha an cohlang duh lo."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh i, “Tuchan mi hi zei he dah ka tahchunh hna hnga? Zei he dah an i lawh hnga?"},"32":{"text":"Chawdawrnak hmun ah a ṭhu i bu khat le bu khat kha: Thonglawi kan in tumpiak hna, sihmanhsehlaw nan lam duh lo; Mithi hla kan in sakpiak hna, sihmanhsehlaw nan ṭap duh lo; tiah aa timi ngakchia bantuk an si."},"33":{"text":"Tipil petu Johan kha a hung chuak i rawl a ul i zu zeihmanh a ding lo, sihmanhsehlaw nan i thawh i, khuavang a ngei, nan ti."},"34":{"text":"Cun Mi Fapa kha a hung chuak ve i a ei a ding i nannih nih nan i thawh i, “Hi pa hi zohhmanh u, misaram le mizuram, ngunkhuai khawltu hna le misual hna kawi a si,’ nan ti."},"35":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian fimnak cu ahmaan taktak ko ti kha a rak cohlangmi vialte nih an langhter,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Farasi mi pakhat nih Jesuh cu zanriah ei ah a sawm. Jesuh cu a inn ah cun a va kal i rawl ei awkah khan an ṭhu.","title":"Farasi Mi Simon Inn Ah Jesuh A leng"},"37":{"text":"Cu khua ah cun a sualminu pakhat a rak um. Farasi mipa inn ah Jesuh cu rawl a hrawng ti kha a theih i cucaah lungrang thawl pakhat a khat tein zihmui a ummi kha a rak i put i","ref":"Mat 26.7; Mar 14.3; Jhn 12.3"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh hnulei ah cun a kehram ah khan a dir, a ṭap i a mitthli in a ke kha a cinter. Cun a ke i a mitthli cu a sam khan a hnawh i a hnamh hna i zihmui kha a toih hna."},"39":{"text":"Jesuh rawlhrawn a sawmtu Farasi mi nih khan mah cucu a hmuh tikah a lung chungin, “Hi pa hi profet a si taktak ahcun amah a tawngtu nu hi ahodah a si i zeitluk a sualminu dah a si ti kha a hngalh lai,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh nih a hun i thawh i, “Simon, zeilo thil pakhat chimh awk kan ngei,” tiah a ti. Simon nih cun, “Asi, saya, ka chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Tangka cawihtupa sinah lei a bami pahnih an um. Pakhat nih ngun tangka za nga a bat i a dang pakhat nih sawm nga a bat."},"42":{"text":"An pahnih tein an cham kho veve lo, cucaah a ngaihthiam hna. A si ahcun, aho nih khan dah amah cu a dawt deuh lai?” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Simon nih cun a thawh i, “Ka ruahnak ah, tam deuh a ngaihthiammi nih khan ta a dawt deuh lai,” tiah a leh. “Na hmaan,” tiah Jesuh nih a ti."},"44":{"text":"Cun minu lei kha a hei hoih i Simon cu a thawh i, “Hi nu hi na hmu maw? Na inn chungah ka ra lut i sihmanhsehlaw ka ke ṭawlnak caah ti naa ka pe lo, sihmanhsehlaw amah nih hin cun ka ke kha a mitthli in a ṭawl hna i a sam in a hnawh hna."},"45":{"text":"Ka rat tikah na rak ka hnam lo, sihmanhsehlaw ka rat ri in atu tiang ka ke hnamh kha a ngol lo."},"46":{"text":"Ka lu i thuh awkah chiti zeihmanh na ka pe lo, sihmanhsehlaw anih nih cun ka ke kha zihmui in a culh."},"47":{"text":"Cucaah hihi kan chimh, dawtnak nganpi a langhtermi nih khan a sualnak tampi a simi cu ngaihthiam an si cang, ti kha a langhter. An sualnak tlawmte lawng ngaihthiam a simi hna nih cun dawtnak tlawmte lawng an langhter ve,” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih minu cu a thawh i, “Na sualnak cu ngaihthiam na si,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cabuai i a ṭhu vemi hna nih khan, “Sualnak hmanh a ngaithiamtu hi ahodah a si?” tiah an i ceih."},"50":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih minu cu a thawh i, “Na zumhnak nih khan an khamh cang, dai tein va kal ko,” tiah a ti."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun Jesuh cu khuapi he khuate he a tlawng duahmah hna i Pathian Pennak kong Thawngṭha kha a chimh hna. Lamkaltu pahleihnih hna nih khan an zulh i","title":"Jesuh A Zultu Hna"},"2":{"text":"an zawtnak le thlarau ṭhalo nih a tuah hnanak in a damtermi hna nih khan an zulh ve. Cu hna cu a chungin thlarau ṭhalo pasarih a chuahpiakmi Mary (Magdalin timi) le","ref":"Mat 27.55-56; Mar 15.40-41; Luk 23.49"},"3":{"text":"Herod zung i bawi a simi Khuza nupi Joanna le Susanna le Jesuh le a zultu hna kha an ngeihmi thil in a rak bawmtu hna, nu dang tampi kha an si."},"4":{"text":"Jesuh sinah cun khua pakhat hnu pakhat in mi an ra chin luaimai i mi tampi an i pumh tikah Jesuh nih hi bianabia hi a chimh hna:","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Tahchunhnak (Mat 13.1-9 ; Mar 4.1-9)"},"5":{"text":"“Mipa pakhat cu thlaici vorh awkah aa thawh. Lo chung i thlaici a vorh tikah cun a cheu cu lam hril ah an tla i mi nih an lamh hna i vate nih an char hna."},"6":{"text":"A cheu cu lung lakah an tla, an hung keuh tikah vawlei a hnawn lo caah an car dih."},"7":{"text":"Thlaici a cheu cu hling lakah an tla, hling he cun an kho ṭi i hling nih cun a thah hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun thlaici a cheu cu vawlei ṭha ah an tla; an hung ṭhang i theifang let za khat cio an vui,” tiah a ti. Hi bia a chim ah hin, “Theihnak hna nan ngeih ahcun thei ko u,” tiah a auhnawh hna."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh cu a zultu hna nih khan, hi tahchunhnak bia hi a sullam zeidah a si, tiah an hal.","title":"Tahchunhnak Bia Sullam (Mat 13.10-17 ; Mar 4.10-12)"},"10":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Pathian Pennak kong biathli hngalhnak cu nannih cu pek nan si cang; sihmanhsehlaw midang cu tahchunhnak bia lawngin chimh an si lai, cucaah cun an zoh len lai nain an hmu lai lo, an ngai len lai nain an hngal lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 6.9-10"},"11":{"text":"“Hi tahchunhnak bia a sullam cu hihi a si: thlaici cu Pathian bia a si.","title":"Thlaici Vorhtu Bianabia A Sullam (Mat 13.18-23 ; Mar 4.13-20)"},"12":{"text":"Lam i a tlami thlaici cu, a theih cu a theimi an si ko: asinain khuachia nih a rathnawh hna i an lung chungin thlaici kha a chuahpiak ṭhan hna caah a zum lo i khamhnak a hmu lomi kha an si."},"13":{"text":"Lung lakah a tlami thlaici cu bia kha a thei i lunglawm ngaiin a cohlang i sihmanhsehlaw an chung i thuk a pil lomi kha an si. Caan tlawmte chung lawng kha an zumh i tukforhnak a rat tikah an tlu ṭhan."},"14":{"text":"Hling lakah a tlami thlaici cu hi mi hna bantuk hi an si: Pathian bia cu an theih nain khuaruahhar vansannak le rumnak le nuamhnak nih a rialdip hna tikah an thei a hmin kho lomi kha an si."},"15":{"text":"Vawlei ṭha ah a tlami thlaici cu bia kha lungtho tein a thei i an lung chungah ṭha tein aa cinken i a thei a tlai tiangin aa zuammi cu an si,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"“Ahohmanh nih meiinn kha an van tikah kho an khuh bal lo, ihkhun tang zongah an chia bal lo. Mi nih inn chung i an rung luh tikah ceunak kha an hmuh nakhnga mei vannak cungah khan an van tawn.","title":"Kheng Khuhmi Ceunak (Mar 4.21-25)","ref":"Mat 5.15; Luk 11.33"},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah thuhmi kha a lang lo dingmi zeihmanh a um lo i biathli zong hngalh lo dingmi le ceunak ah chuahpi lo dingmi zeihmanh a um lo.","ref":"Mat 10.26; Luk 12.2"},"18":{"text":"“Cucaah nan ngaihning kha i ralring u; zeicahtiah a ngeimi kha chap chin an si lai i a ngei lomi kha ka ngeih tiah an i ruahmi thil tlawmte hmanh kha lakpiak an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 25.29; Luk 19.26"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh a nu le a naule kha a sinah an ra, sihmanhsehlaw mi an tam tuk caah a sin an phan kho lo.","title":"Jesuh A Nu le A Naule Hna (Mat 12.46-50 ; Mar 3.31-35)"},"20":{"text":"“Na nu le na naule kha lengah an dir ko, ton an in duh,” tiah an chimh."},"21":{"text":"Annih cu Jesuh nih, “Ka nu le ka naule cu maw — ka nu le ka naule cu Pathian bia kha a thei i an theih bantukin a tuahmi paoh kha an si ko,” tiah a leh hna."},"22":{"text":"Ni khat cu Jesuh kha a zultu hna he lawng chungah an lut i annih cu a thawh hna i, “Tili khattelei ral ah khin va kal u sih,” tiah a ti hna. Cucaah an i thawh.","title":"Jesuh Nih Thlichia A Daihter (Mat 8.23-27 ; Mar 4.35-41)"},"23":{"text":"Lawng in an kal lioah cun Jesuh cu aa hngilh. Thlitu fak ngai tili cungah cun a rung hrang ciammam i lawng cu ti khah hnik aa zal i an thin a phang ngaingai."},"24":{"text":"A zultu hna cu Jesuh sinah khan an ra i an hlauh i, “Saya, saya, kan thi dengmang ko hih,” an ti. Jesuh cu a hung tho i thlitu le tilet cu a caak hna. Thlichia cu a dai i zeizong vialte cu dai zirziar in a um."},"25":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna cu a thawh hna i, “Khuazei ah dah nan zumhnak cu a um kun?” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu an khuaruah a har i an thin a phang i pakhat le pakhat cu, “Hi pa hi aho hen a si? Thlichia le tilet kha nawl a pek hna i an ngaih ko dahngai,” tiah an i ceih."},"26":{"text":"Galilee ram in tili ralchan i a ummi Gerasa mi hna ram ah khan lawng in an va kal.","title":"Khuachia Tuahmipa A Damter (Mat 8.28-34 ; Mar 5.1-20)"},"27":{"text":"Jesuh cu titlang a hei lamh ah khin cu ka khua i a ummi mipa pakhat, a chungah khuachia nih an luhhnawh mipa nih khan a rak ton. Caan saupi puan loin a um cang i inn ah um duh loin mithi vuinak lungkua ah khan a um:"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh cu a hmuh tikah fak piin a ai i a hmaiah a bawk i aw thang piin, “Jesuh, Cung Nung Bik Pathian Fapa, ka cungah zeidah tuah na duh? Dan ka tat sawh hlah, tiah kan nawl,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh nih thlarau ṭhalo kha a chungin chuak tiah nawl a pek caah hitihin a tinak cu a si. Thlarau ṭhalo nih khan voi tampi a tlaih tawn i kan tuahhmawh sual lai kaw tiah a kut le a ke kha thir cikcin in an ṭem tawn nain cikcin cu a chah dih hna i ramlak ah cun khuachia nih cun a lohpi tawn."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh i, “Na min ahodah a si?” tiah a ti. “Ka min cu Mi Bupi a si,” tiah a leh — zeicahtiah a luhhnawhtu khuachia cu tampi an si."},"31":{"text":"Khuachia nih khan Jesuh cu dongh hngal lo khor thukpi chungah khan kan thla sawh hlah tiah an nawl."},"32":{"text":"An pawngah cun tlangpang ah khan vok a runpi in an tlong lulhmalh ko. Khuachia nih khan Jesuh cu vok chungah khin kan luhter ko tiah an nawl i a luhter hna."},"33":{"text":"Cucaah khuachia cu mipa chung cun an chuak i vok chungah cun an lut; an run ningpi in lungpang hrap cun tili chungah khan an zuang i an thi dih."},"34":{"text":"Vok a zohkhenhtu hna nih khan cu ti i thil a um cu an hmuh i cucaah an tli i khua chung le lo lakah khan thawng cu an thanh hna."},"35":{"text":"Cu ti i thil a hung ummi zoh awkah mi cu an va kal. Jesuh sinah khan an va phan i khuachia nih an chuahtak cangmi pa kha a kehram ah puan i aih le lungfim tein a ṭhut kha an va hmuh i an dihlak in an thin a phang."},"36":{"text":"Cu thil a rak hmu cangtu hna nih khan zeitindah mipa nih damnak a hmuh ti kha an rak chimh hna."},"37":{"text":"Cu tikah Gerasa ram i a ummi hna nih cun an ṭih ngaingai caah an zapi in Jesuh cu, kal ko tiah an nawl. Cucaah Jesuh cu lawng chungah khan a lut i a kal."},"38":{"text":"Khuachia nih an chuahtak cang mipa nih khan Jesuh cu a nawl i, “Na sinah kal ve ko ning,” a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a donh i,"},"39":{"text":"“Inn ah va tlung law Pathian nih na caah a tuahmi tu kha va chim hna,” tiah a ti. Mipa cu khua chungah khan aa chawk i a caah Jesuh nih a tuahmi kha a chimh hna."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh cu tili khattelei kam i a va kir tikah khan mibu nih khan an rak lawmh, zeicahtiah amah cu an rak hngah ko.","title":"Jairu Fanu le Jesuh Puan Ki A Tawngmi Nu Kong (Mat 9.18-26 ; Mar 5.21-43)"},"41":{"text":"Khi tikah mipa pakhat a min Jairu a simi kha a ra; amah cu cuka hrawng pumhnak inn i hruaitu pakhat a si. Jesuh ke hramah cun a bawk i ka inn ah ra ko sawh, tiah a nawl,"},"42":{"text":"zeicahtiah fanu pakhat te lawng a ngeihmi, kum hleihnih a simi kha a cat lengmang. Jesuh cu a kal lioah khan mibu nih cun a zual in an zual."},"43":{"text":"Cuka ah cun nu pakhat thichuah zawtnak in kum hleihnih a zaw cangmi a um i a ngeihmi vialte kha sibawi phalh awkah a hmang dih cang nain ahohmanh nih an damter kho lo."},"44":{"text":"Zapi lak cun Jesuh hnulei khan a ra i a puan kite kha a hei tongh i chikkhatte ah a thi cu a pit."},"45":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun aa thawh i, “Ahodah a ka tawng?” tiah a ti. Ahohmanh nih kan in tawng lo, tiah an ti; cun Peter nih aa thawh i, “Saya, mi nih cun pei a zual in an in zual i a but in an in buthnawh cu,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih, “Aho nih dik an ka tawngh ko, zeicahtiah ka chungin ṭhawnnak a chuah pei ka hngalh ko cu,” tiah a ti."},"47":{"text":"Minu nih cun a ka hngalh cang ti kha a hngalh tikah ther lengmang in a ra chuak i Jesuh ke hramah cun a bawk. Mi zapi hmaiah cun zeicahdah amah kha a tawngh i zeitindah chikkhatte ah damnak a hmuh kha a chimh."},"48":{"text":"Jesuh nih amah cu a thawh i, “Ka fanu, na zumhnak nih an damter, dai tein va kal ko,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Cu bia cu Jesuh nih a chim lioah khan pumhnak inn zohkhenhtu inn cun zualko pakhat a ra i, “Na fanu cu a thi cang, saya cu hnahnawh ti duh hlah,” tiah a chimh."},"50":{"text":"Cu bia cu Jesuh nih a theih i Jairu cu a thawh i, “Na thinphang hlah, zum ko law a dam ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Inn kha an va phak tikah Peter le Jeim le Johan le ngakchianu a nu le a pa dah ti lo cu amah he inn chung i luh ding kha a dang ahohmanh a onh hna lo."},"52":{"text":"Khika i a ummi vialte nih ngakchia cu an ṭah. Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Ṭap hlah u, ngakchia hi a thi lo, aa hngilh i pei a si ko cu,” tiah a ti hna."},"53":{"text":"A thi ko ti kha an hngalh caah an nih a chuak."},"54":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a kut khan a vun tlaih i, “Tho tuah, ka fanu,” tiah a vun auh."},"55":{"text":"A nunnak cu a hung kir ṭhan i hmakhatte ah a tho; cun Jesuh nih ei awk pe u, tiah a ti hna."},"56":{"text":"A nu le a pa cu an khuaruah a har ngaingai, sihmanhsehlaw hi kong cu ahohmanh chim hna hlah u, tiah Jesuh nih a thlauh hna."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih pahleihnih hna kha hmunkhat ah a auh hna i khuachia ṭhawl khawhnak le zawtnak damter khawhnak ṭhawnnak le nawlngeihnak kha a pek hna.","title":"Lamkal Hleihnih A Thlah Hna (Mat 10.5-15 ; Mar 6.7-13)"},"2":{"text":"Cun Pathian Pennak kong chim awk le mizaw damter awkah a thlah hna."},"3":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Atu khual nan tlawn lainak ding caah hin zeihmanh i phorh hlah u: ṭhiangṭhunh siseh, zal siseh, riahcaw siseh, tangka siseh, angki khethuan siseh, zeihmanh i phorh hlah u.","ref":"Luk 10.4-11; Lam 13.51"},"4":{"text":"Tluninn an in onh hnanak inn paoh ah, cu khua in nan chuah hlan tiang va um ko u;"},"5":{"text":"tluninn an in onh duh hna lonak khua paoh cu, nannih nih va kaltak ko u law annih kha ralrinnak peknak caah nan ke beh leidip kha va khawnhnawh hna u,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Zultu hna cu an i thawh i khua kip kha an tlawng i hmun kip ah Thawngṭha kha an chim i a zawmi kha an damter hna."},"7":{"text":"Galilee ram a uktu Herod nih khan hi bantukin thil a ummi vialte kha a theih ve; hi kong ah hin a lung aa tuai ngaingai, zeicahtiah mi a cheu nih, “Tipil petu Johan kha a nung ṭhan,” an ti.","title":"Herod A Lung Aa Tuai (Mat 14.1-12 ; Mar 6.14-29)","ref":"Mat 16.14; Mar 8.28; Luk 9.19"},"8":{"text":"Midang nih, Elijah kha a hung lang cang, an ti i a dang nih hlan lio pi i a rak ummi profet pakhatkhat a hung nung ṭhan, an ti."},"9":{"text":"Herod nih cun, “Johan cu a lu ka tanter ṭung hna, a thawng ka theih lengmangmi mipa hi ahodah a si kun?” tiah a ti. Cun Jesuh hmuh ding kha heh tiah aa zuam lengmang."},"10":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna cu an ra tlung i an tuahmi vialte kha Jesuh cu an chimh dih. A sinah aa kalpi hna i anmah lawng tein Bethsaida timi khua ah khan an kal.","title":"Mi Thong Nga Rawl A Pek Hna (Mat 14.13-21 ; Mar 6.30-44 ; Jhn 6.1-14)"},"11":{"text":"Cu thawng cu mizapi nih khan an theih tikah an zulh. A rak lawmh hna i Pathian Pennak kong kha a rak chimh hna i damnak a herhmi kha a damter hna."},"12":{"text":"Nitlak aa timh tikah khin pahleihnih kha a sinah cun an ra i, “Mizapi hi kalter hna law hika hrawng khua hna le lo hna ah hin rawl le riahnak kawl awkah kal hna seh, zeicahtiah kan umnak hmun hi mi um lonak hmun a si ṭung,” an ti."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a rak thawh hna i, “Nanmah nih ta ei awk cu nan pek ko hna,” tiah a ti. Annih nih, “Kan ngeihmi cu dihlak ah changreu hlum nga le nga pahnih pei a si ko cu. Mizapi caah hin rawl cawk fial maw na kan duh?” an ti."},"14":{"text":"(Cuka i a ummi cu upa thong nga hrawng an si). Jesuh nih a zultu hna cu, “Mi kha sawm nga hrawng duahmah in a bu a bu in ṭhutter hna u,” tiah a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Cu bantuk cun a zultu hna nih cun an tuah i an dihlak in an ṭhutter hna."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh nih changreu hlum nga le nga pahnih cu a lak hna i van lei a zoh i Pathian kha a lawmh hnuah a cheu hna i mizapi phawt awkah khan a zultu kha a pek hna."},"17":{"text":"An dihlak in an ei i an khim dih; an nganhmi cu a zultu hna nih khan an khawmh hna i bawm hleihnih khat a si."},"18":{"text":"Voi khat cu Jesuh kha amah lawng tein thla a cam lioah a zultu hna kha a sinah an ra i, “Mi nih aho a si an ka ti dah?” tiah a hal hna.","title":"Peter Nih Jesuh Kong A Chimnak (Mat 16.13-19 ; Mar 8.27-29)"},"19":{"text":"“A cheu nih Tipilpetu Johan a si, an in ti. Cun a dang nih, Elijah a si, an in ti. Cun a dang nih hlanlio i a rak ummi profet pakhatkhat kha a nung ṭhan, an in ti,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Mat 14.1-2; Mar 6.14-15; Luk 9.7-8"},"20":{"text":"Cun annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nannih tah zeitin? Nannih nih tah aho a si nan ka ti dah?” tiah a hal hna. Peter nih a vun leh i, “Nangmah cu Pathian Messiah na si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jhn 6.68-69"},"21":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih ka kong cu ahohmanh nan chim hna lai lo tiah fek tein a ti hna i,","title":"A Innak Ding le A Thihnak Ding Kong A Chim (Mat 16.21-28 ; Mar 8.31—9.1)"},"22":{"text":"“Mi Fapa nih hin temhinnak tampi ka in hrimhrim lai; upa hna le tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna nih an ka hlawt lai. An ka thah lai i ni thumnak ni ah thawhter ka si ṭhan lai,” tiah a chimh hna."},"23":{"text":"Cun annih cu an dihlak in a thawh hna i: “Ahohmanh nih zulh nan ka duh ahcun mah zawnruahnak kha nan ngol lai i ni fa tein nan vailam kha nan i put lai i nan ka zulh lai.","ref":"Mat 10.38; Luk 14.27"},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mah himnak lawng a ruatmi cu a nunnak kha a sung lai sihmanhsehlaw keimah ruangah a nunnak a sungmi cu khamhnak kha a hmu lai.","ref":"Mat 10.39; Luk 17.33; Jhn 12.25"},"25":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih vawlei hi a dihlak in co seh law amah cu lotlau ṭung seh law, asiloah rawkral ṭung seh law, zeital a miak hnga maw? Miak hlah."},"26":{"text":"Ahohmanh keimah le ka cawnpiaknak kha a kan zahpimi cu, Mi Fapa nih ka sunparnak le ka Pa le a thiangmi vancungmi hna sunparnak he ka rat tikah, ka zahpi ve hna lai."},"27":{"text":"Cun nannih nih hika ah hin, Pathian Pennak an hmuh hlan tiang a thi lo dingmi an um tiah kan chimhmi hna hi i cinken u,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Hi bia a chim hnu zarh khat tluk ah Jesuh nih Peter le Johan le Jeim kha thlacam awkah tlang ah aa kaipi hna.","title":"Jesuh Muihmai Thlennak (Mat 17.1-8 ; Mar 9.2-8)","ref":"2Pet 1.17-18"},"29":{"text":"Thla a cam lioah khan a hmai cu aa thleng i a hnipuan cu rang cercur in an um."},"30":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah khan mi pahnih nih bia an hung ruah. Annih cu Moses le Elijah kha an si."},"31":{"text":"Vancung sunparnak in an i thuam i Jerusalem khua i a thihnak thawng in Pathian nih a timhmi a tlinter lainak kong kha Jesuh he cun an i ruah."},"32":{"text":"Peter le a hawile hna cu thu hluahmah in an rak i hngilh, sihmanhsehlaw an hun i hlau i Jesuh sunparnak le a sinah a dirmi pahnih kha an hmuh hna."},"33":{"text":"Mi nih khan Jesuh cu an kaltak lioah khin Peter nih a thawh i, “Saya, hika i kan um hi thil ṭha a si. Deu pathum in kan sak lai, pakhat nangmah caah, pakhat Moses caah, pakhat Elijah caah,” tiah a ti. (Ka chimmi hi zei a si ti a hngal ngaingai lo)."},"34":{"text":"Bia a chim lengmang lioah cun minmei a hung kai i a hun zelh hna, cun a zultu hna cu an ning a ṭi."},"35":{"text":"Minmei chung cun aw pakhat nih, “Amah hi ka thimmi ka Fapa a si, a bia kha ngai u,” tiah a run chim.","ref":"Isa 42.1; Mat 3.17; 12.18; Mar 1.11; Luk 3.22"},"36":{"text":"Aw kha a daih tikah Jesuh cu amah lawng tein a um ko kha an hmuh. Dai tein an um i an hmuhmi kha ahohmanh an chim hna lo."},"37":{"text":"A thaizing ah tlang cung cun an vung ṭum i mi tampi nih Jesuh cu an rak ton.","title":"Thlarau Ṭhalo A Ngeimi Ngakchiapa A Damter (Mat 17.14-18 ; Mar 9.14-27)"},"38":{"text":"Mizapi lak cun mipa pakhat a hung au i, “Saya, ka fapa hi ka zohpiak hmanh, amah lawnglawng hi fa ka ngeihmi a si."},"39":{"text":"Thlarau nih a luhhnawh ciammam tawn i a au a khuang i a ther thluahmah i a buanbara zong a tawh dih tawn; atu le atu cuticun a tuah i a kal in a kaltak duh lo."},"40":{"text":"Na zultu hna kha, hung ka ṭhawlpiak ko sawh u, tiah ka nawl hna i sihmanhsehlaw an ṭhawl kho fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh i, “Nan hei zum loin nan hei palh thiam dah. Zei can riamruam hen kan umpi hna a herh lai? Zei can dah kan in hna lai?” tiah a ti. Cun mipa cu aa thawh i, “Hika ah hin na fapa cu ratpi tuah,” tiah a ti."},"42":{"text":"Ngakchiapa cu a rat lioah khan khuachia nih cun vawlei ah a thluk ciammam i i let cukmak in a tuah. Jesuh nih thlarau ṭhalo cu a sik i ngakchiapa cu a damter i a pa sinah khan a pek ṭhan."},"43":{"text":"Pathian ṭhawnnak kha an hmuh tikah mi vialte cu an khuaruah a har dih. Jesuh nih a tuahmi thil kong ah mi hna cu khuaruah har in an um ko lioah khan a zultu hna cu a thawh hna i,"},"44":{"text":"“Kan chimh dingmi hna hi philh hlah u. Mi Fapa hi minung ṭhawnnak ah chanh a si lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh Nih A Thihnak Kong A Chim Ṭhan (Mat 17.22-23 ; Mar 9.30-32)"},"45":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cucu a sullam zeidah a si ti kha an hngal lo. An hngalh nakhnga lo thuhkanh an si i cu kong cu amah hal kha an ngamh fawn lo."},"46":{"text":"A zultu hna lakah cun bia alnak pakhat a hung chuak i cucu an lakah ahodah a ngan bik ti kha a si.","title":"Ahodah A Ngan Bik (Mat 18.1-5 ; Mar 9.33-37)","ref":"Luk 22.24"},"47":{"text":"Jesuh nih an ruahnak kha a hngalh i cucaah ngakchiate pakhat kha a lak i a pawngah a dirter i"},"48":{"text":"annih cu, “Ka min in hi ngakchiate tluninn a onhtu nih keimah tluninn a ka onh a si, cun keimah tluninn a ka onhtu nih keimah a ka thlahtu tluninn a onh kha a si. Zeicahtiah nan lak i a hme bikmi cu a ngan bikmi a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 10.40; Luk 10.16; Jhn 13.20"},"49":{"text":"Johan nih a hun i thawh i, “Saya, nangmah min in khuachia a ṭhawlmipa pakhat kan hmuh i kanmah bu chungmi a si lo caah kan thlauh,” tiah a ti.","title":"An Dotu Hna A Si Lomi Cu An Bawmtu Hna A Si (Mar 9.38-40)"},"50":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh i, “Thlauh hna hlah u, zeicahtiah an dotu hna a si lomi paoh cu an bawmtu hna an si,” tiah a ti."},"51":{"text":"Jesuh cu vancung i laknak caan kha a nai cuahmah tikah a lung aa thlek i Jerusalem khua lei kal awkah khan aa thawh.","title":"Samaria Mi Hna Khua Pakhat Nih Jesuh An Donh"},"52":{"text":"A hmaiah khan lamkal a thlah hna i cu hna cu an rak kal i Samaria mi hna khua pakhat ah khan zeizong vialte rak timh chung awkah an rak lut."},"53":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jerusalem i a kal lai kha a fian ko caah cuka khuami hna nih cun tluninn kha onh an rak duh lo."},"54":{"text":"Cu thil cu a zultu hna Jeim le Johan nih khan an hmuh tikah, “Bawipa, hi mi hna hrawhnak ding caah hin vancung in mei au u tiah na kan duh maw?” an ti.","ref":"2Sia 1.9-16"},"55":{"text":"Jesuh cu aa mer i a sik hna i"},"56":{"text":"khua dang ah khan an lan."},"57":{"text":"Annih nih an kal lengmang lioah khan pakhatpa nih a thawh i, “Na kalnak paoh ah kan zulh lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"Jesuh Zulh A Duhmipa (Mat 8.19-22)"},"58":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Cenghngia nih kua an ngei i vate nih bu an ngei, sihmanhsehlaw Mi Fapa cu riahnak hmun hmanh ka ngei lo,” tiah a ti."},"59":{"text":"A dang pakhat tu cu a thawh i, “Ka zul,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw cu pa nih cun, “Bawipa, ka pa kha va vui ta ning,” a ti."},"60":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh i, “Mithi nih an mithi kha va vui ko hna seh. Nang tu cu va kal law Pathian Pennak kong kha va chim ko,” tiah a ti."},"61":{"text":"A dang pakhat nih a thawh ve i, “Bawipa kan zulh lai, sihmanhsehlaw ka chungle kha dam tein, va ti ta hna ning,” tiah a ti.","ref":"1Sia 19.20"},"62":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh i, “Ahohmanh leithuan aa ot i hnulei a zoh peng ṭungmi cu Pathian Pennak caah santlaihnak a ngei lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Bawipa nih a dang sawm sarih le pahnih kha a thim hna i amah a kalnak ding khua le hmun paoh ah khan a hmaiah pahnih pahnih in a thlah hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Sawm Sarih le Pahnih A Thlah Hna"},"2":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Rawl ṭuan awk a tampi ko nain a ṭuantu tlawmte lawng an si. Cucaah rawl a ṭuantu dingah mi tam deuh a thlah hna nakhnga lo ngeitu sinah khan thla va cam tuah u.","ref":"Mat 9.37-38"},"3":{"text":"Atu ah i thawh u law kal u. Nannih cu cenghngia lak i tuufa thlah bantukin kan thlah hna.","ref":"Mat 10.16"},"4":{"text":"Phaisa bawm siseh, zal siseh, kedan siseh i phorh hlah u; lampi ah ahohmanh biakchawnh awkah dircon hlah u.","ref":"Mat 10.7-14; Mar 6.8-11; Luk 9.3-5"},"5":{"text":"Inn pakhatkhat ah nan luh tikah a hmasa bik ah, “Hi inn chungah daihnak um ko seh,” va ti u."},"6":{"text":"Daihnak a duhmipa a rak um a si ahcun, daihnak na cungah um seh, tiin nan biakchawnhnak cu a cungah hmun seh; sihmanhsehlaw cu ti a si lo ahcun daihnak in nan biakchawnhnak cu nan sinah kir ṭhan seh."},"7":{"text":"Cu inn ah cun um ko u law an in pekmi hna paoh kha va ding u law va ei ko u; zeicahtiah rianṭuantu cu a ṭuan man a hmuh awk a si. Inn khat hnu inn khat in i thawn lengmang hlah u.","ref":"1Kor 9.14; 1Tim 5.18"},"8":{"text":"Khua pakhatkhat ah nan luh i tluninn an rak in onh hna fate, an in hunhmi hna paoh kha va ei u law,"},"9":{"text":"cuka khua i a ummi mizaw kha va damter hna u law, cuka khuami hna cu, ‘Pathian Pennak cu nan pawngte a phan cang,’ tiah va chim hna u."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tluninn an rak in onh hna lonak khua paoh cu an khuachung lam ah khan i chawk u law lai i,","ref":"Lam 13.51"},"11":{"text":"‘Kan ke i aa behmi nan khua chung leidip hmanh hi kan in thinhnawh tak hna; sihmanhsehlaw hi tu hi cu run philh hlah u: Pathian Pennak nan pawngte a phan cang hih,’ nan ti hna lai."},"12":{"text":"Mah hihi kan chimh hna, Biaceih Ni ah cun hi khua nak hin Pathian nih Sodom khua kha a zaangfah deuh lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 19.24-28; Mat 11.24; 10.15"},"13":{"text":"“Maw Khorazin khua, na caah zeitluk ṭihnung dah a si? Bethsaida zong, na caah zeitluk ṭihnung dah a si ve? Na chung i ka tuahmi khuaruahharnak hna hi Tair le Sidon khua ah khan rak tuah hna ning law khika i a ummi minung hna cu, an nunning an i thlen langhternak caah puanchia aih in le vutcam i phulh in an ṭhu diam cang hnga!","title":"A Zum Duh Lomi Khua Hna (Mat 11.20-24)","ref":"Isa 23.1-18; Eze 26.1—28.26; Joe 3.4-8; Amo 1.9-10; Zek 9.2-4"},"14":{"text":"Biaceih Ni ah cun nanmah nakin Tair le Sidon kha Pathian nih a zaangfah deuh te hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun maw Kapernaum, vancung i hun i hlorh khi na duh mu? Hell chungah khin vun hlonh na si lai,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 14.13-15"},"16":{"text":"A zultu kha a thawh hna i, “Nan bia a ngaimi paoh nih ka bia an ngaih a si, an hlawmi hna paoh nih keimah an ka hlawt a si, keimah a ka hlawmi paoh nih a ka thlahtu kha an hlawt a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 10.40; Mar 9.37; Luk 9.48; Jhn 13.20"},"17":{"text":"Sawm sarih le pahnih kha thanuam ngaiin an ra kir i, “Bawipa, nangmah min in kan thawl hna tikah khuachia hmanh nih kan nawl an ngaih,” an ti.","title":"Sawm Sarih le Pahnih Kha An Hung Kir"},"18":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Satan kha van in nimtlau bantukin a tlak kha ka hmuh."},"19":{"text":"Ngai hmanh u: rul le tlangngaikuang hmanh lamh khawhnak ṭhawnnak le nan Ral ṭhawnnak tei khawhnak kan pek hna caah zeihmanh nih an ti kho hna lai lo;","ref":"Slm 91.13"},"20":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thlarau ṭhalo nih nan nawl an in ngaih hna caah khan i lawm hlah u, vancung i nan min ṭial a si ca tu ah khan i lawm tuah u,” a ti hna."},"21":{"text":"Khi tikah khan Jesuh cu Thiang Thlarau nih lawmhnak in a khahter i, “Maw ka Pa, van Bawi le vawlei Bawi a simi, mifim le mithiam hna sinin na rak thuhmi kha fimnak le thiamnak a ngei lomi hna sinah na langhter caah hin nangmah cu kan lawmh. Asi, ka Pa, hi thil na tuahnak cu nangmah duh tein le nangmah nih naa thimning tein a si ko.","title":"Jesuh Aa Lawm (Mat 11.25-27 ; 13.16-17)"},"22":{"text":"“Ka Pa nih zeizong vialte kha a ka pek cang: Pa nih dah ti lo nih cun ahohmanh nih Fapa kha ahodah a si, ti awk an hngal lo, Fapa le an sinah Fapa nih Pa a phuan duhmi hna dah ti lo nih cun Pa kha ahodah a si ti awk ahohmanh nih an hngal lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jhn 3.35; 10.15"},"23":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu a zultu hna leiah khan a hei i mer i anmah bing tein, “Nan hmuhmi thil nan hmuh caah hin zeitluk in dah nan caah lunglawmh awk a si."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fiang tein kan chimh hna, profet tampi hna le siangpahrang hna nih nan hmuhmi hi hmuh an rak duh ko nain an hmu kho lo, theih an rak duh ko nain an thei kho lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"25":{"text":"Cun Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pakhat a ra i amah kha foih a hung zalh, aa thawh i, “Saya, zungzal nunnak hmuh awkah zeidah ka tuah lai?” tiah a ti.","title":"Samaria Miṭha Bianabia","ref":"Mat 22.35-40; Mar 12.28-34"},"26":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh i, “Cathiang nih zeitindah an chim i an chimmi cu zeitindah a sullam naa lakning a si?” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Mipa nih cun a leh i, “ ‘Bawipa na Pathian cu na lungthin dihlak le na nunnak dihlak le na thazang dihlak le na ruahnak dihlak in na dawt lai i na innpa zong kha nangmah naa dawt tlukin na dawt lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lev 19.18; Deu 6.5"},"28":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Na bialehnak ahmaan; cucu va tuah law na nung lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lev 18.5"},"29":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Phungbia cawnpiaktu sayapa nih cun thiam hun i coh kha a duh i, “Ahodah ka innpa cu a si?” tiah Jesuh kha a hal."},"30":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh i, “Voi khat cu mipa pakhat kha Jerusalem in Jeriko khua leiah a vung kal: Cu a vung kal lioah cun damiah nih an rak tlaih i a puan an phoih i an tuk i thilo nunglo in an kaltak."},"31":{"text":"Cu lioah cun tlangbawi pakhat hi cuka lei lam ah cun a vung kal ngelcel; mipa cu a hei hmuh tikah lam khattelei kam cun a hrial."},"32":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Levi mi pakhat zong cuka ah cun a va kal ve, mipa cu a hei kalhnawh i a hei bih tak i khattelei kam cun a kaltak ve."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Samaria mipa pakhat, cuka lei lam i khual a tlawngmi cu, cu pa umnak kha a va phan; amah kha a hmuh tikah a zaang a fak ngaingai.","ref":"2Cha 28.15"},"34":{"text":"A hei fuh i a hma ah cun chiti le mitsur hang kha a thuh hna i a men hna; cun mipa cu a saṭil cungah khan a chuan i khual riahnak inn pakhat ah a kalpi i cuka ah cun a zohkhenh."},"35":{"text":"A thaizing ah ngun tangka phar hnih aa chuah i riahnak inn hngaktupa cu a pek i, ‘Amah hi ṭha tein rak zohkhenh law amah caah na liauheumi vialte cu hi lei ka ra kir ṭhan tikah kan pek ṭhan lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun aa thawh i, “Hi mi pathum hna lakah hin aho hi dah damiah nih an tlaih mipa innpa kha a si tiah na ruah?” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya nih cun, “Amah a zaangfahtu kha,” tiah a leh. Jesuh nih, “Va kal law cu bantuk cun va tuah ve,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Jesuh le a zultu hna cu khual an tlawn lioah khan khua pakhat an va phan i cuka ah cun minu pakhat a min Martha a simi nih a inn ah a rak tlunter hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Martha le Mary Kha A Tlung Hna","ref":"Jhn 11.1"},"39":{"text":"Nau pakhat a ngei i a min cu Mary a si. Mary cu Bawipa ke hram ah cun a ṭhu i a cawnpiaknak kha a ngai."},"40":{"text":"Martha cu a rian a tam caah khan a ing a puang i, “Bawipa, ka nau nih keimah lawng rianṭuan a ka rinh hi na zei a poi lo maw? Va bawm tiah hun chim” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a leh i, “Martha, Martha, thil tam tuk kong ah na lungre a thei i na ing a puang,"},"42":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a herh taktakmi cu pakhat lawng a si ko. Mary nih ahmaanmi thil cu aa thim cang i cucu ahohmanh nih an chut lai lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voi khat cu Jesuh kha kaa khat ah thla a cam. A thlacam cu a dih tikah a zultu pakhat nih aa thawh i, “Bawipa, Johan nih a zultu hna a cawnpiak hna bangin kannih zong thlacam kan cawnpiak ve,” tiah a ti.","title":"Thlacamnak Kong Ah Jesuh Cawnpiaknak (Mat 6.9-13 ; 7.7-11)"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Hitihin thla cu nan cam awk a si lai: ‘Kan Pa, Na min thiang cu upat si ko seh, Na Pennak cu tlung ko seh."},"3":{"text":"Kan herhmi rawl ni fate in kan pe ko."},"4":{"text":"Kan cung i a sualmi hna kha kan ngaihthiam hna caah Kan sualnak kha kan ngaithiam. Cun a harmi hneksaknak kan phakter hlah,’ nan ti lai,” a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih a zultu cu a thawh hna i, “A biana ah nannih lak i pakhatkhat cu zanṭim ah a hawipa inn ah a va kal i, ‘Ka kawi, changreu hlum thum in ka cawi ta ko."},"6":{"text":"Ka kawipa pakhat khual a tlawng i ka inn ah atute ah khan a ra chuak i pek awk zeihmanh ka ngei lo,’ tiah a va ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun a hawipa nih cun a inn chung cun, ‘Hna ka hnawh hlah, innka ka hrenh cang i ka fale he kan it cang, nangmah thil pek awkah ka tho kho ti lo,’ a ti."},"8":{"text":"A si ahcun zeitindah a tuah kun lai? Amah cu na hawi a si ruangah a tho in na herhmi changreu kha an pe lai lo nain ningzak loin na hal peng hrat caah khan, na herhmi paoh cu an pek ko lai."},"9":{"text":"Cucaah hihi kan chimh hna: Hal u law pek nan si lai; kawl u law nan hmuh lai; king u law innka cu hunpiak nan si lai."},"10":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a halmi paoh cu pek an si lai i a kawlmi paoh nih an hmuh lai, a kingmi paoh cu innkhar kha hunpiak an si lai."},"11":{"text":"Nannih hringtu pa hna lakah, nan fale nih nga an in hal hna ah, rul a pemi nan um hnga maw?"},"12":{"text":"Arti an in hal hna ah tah tlangngaikuang nan pe hna hnga maw?"},"13":{"text":"Hi tluk i nan ṭhalo ko na hin nan fale kha thil ṭha pek cu nan hngalh ahcun, vancung i a ummi nan Pa nih cun amah kha Thiang Thlarau a halmi cu zeitluk in dah a pek chinchin hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh nih a holh kho lomi khuachia kha a ṭhawl i cu khuachia cu a chuah tikah mipa cu holh hram aa thawk. Mizapi cu an khuaruah a har ko,","title":"Jesuh le Beelzebul (Mat 12.22-30 ; Mar 3.20-27)"},"15":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a cheu nih an i thawh i, “Khuachia ṭhawl khawhnak ṭhawnnak a petu cu khuachia hna lak i an bawi bik Beelzebul kha a si,” an ti.","ref":"Mat 9.34; 10.25"},"16":{"text":"A dang nih amah kha foih an rak duh ve, cucaah na tuahmi hi Pathian hnatla a si le si lo hngalhnak ah khuaruahharnak pakhat in ser tuah, an ti.","ref":"Mat 12.38; 16.1; Mar 8.11"},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih an ruahnak kha a hngalh i, “Ram zeihmanh, anmah le anmah aa domi bu ah aa ṭhen ahcun sau a dir lai lo, anmah le anmah aa domi innchungkhar cu an i ṭhen."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah Satan pennak zong cu a chungah anmah le anmah aa domi bu an um ahcun zeitindah a dir khawh lai? Nannih nih nan i thawh i Beelzebul nih ṭhawnnak a pek caah khuachia kha a ṭhawl khawh hna, nan ka ti."},"19":{"text":"Ka ṭhawlning hna cu hitihin a si ahcun, nanmah nan zultu hna nih khan tah zeitindah an ṭhawl kun hna? Nanmah nan zultu hna lila nih pei nan palh diam ti kha an langhter ko cu."},"20":{"text":"Beelzebul ṭhawnnak in khuachia kha ka ṭhawl hna a si ṭung lo, Pathian ṭhawnnak in pei a si deuh cu, cu nih cun Pathian Pennak kha nan sin a phan cang ti kha a langhter."},"21":{"text":"“A ṭhawngmipa nih a hriamnam dihlak he a inn kha a ven tikah a ngeihmi thil vialte kha a him tawn."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah nakin a ṭhawng deuhmipa nih a hung doh i a hung tei tikah inn ngeitupa nih aa bochanmi hriamnam vialte kha aa kalpi dih hna i a firmi thil kha midang a phawt hna."},"23":{"text":"“Keimah a ka ṭanh lomi cu a ka dohtu an si; pumh a ka bawm lomi cu ṭhektu an si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mar 9.40"},"24":{"text":"“Thlarau ṭhalo pakhat kha minung chungin a chuah tikah dinhnak hmun kawl awkah ram rocar chungah khan a kenkip ah aa chawk. A hmuh khawh lo caah khan aa thawh i, ‘Ka chuahtakmi inn ah khan ka kir ṭhan lai,’ a ti.","title":"Thlarau Ṭhalo An Kir Ṭhan (Mat 12.43-45)"},"25":{"text":"Cucaah a va kir i inn cu thiangte le tlahirhiar tein a rak um ko kha a va hmuh."},"26":{"text":"Cun a va chuak i amah nakin a chia chinchinmi thlarau pasarih kha aa ratpi hna i cuka ah cun aa umpi hna. Cucaah a donghnak ah cun kha mipa kha a hramthawk i a sining nakkhan a umtuning a chia deuh,” a ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh nih hi bia a chim dih tikah hin mizapi lak cun minu pakhat a hung au i, “Nangmah a rak in hring i a rak in cawmtu nu hi zeitluk in dik aa lawmh,” tiah a ti.","title":"Lawmhnak Taktak"},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a thawh i, “Pathian bia kha a thei i a ngaimi caah cun zeitluk in dik lunglawmhnak a si chinchin,” tiah a leh."},"29":{"text":"Mi nih Jesuh kha an zual lulh ko lioah khan a thawh hna i, “Tuchan mi hi miṭhalo an va si hringhran dah. Pathian hnatlaknak a si ti hngalhnak caah khuaruahhar kan hmuhsak tuah, an ti, sihmanhsehlaw Jonah khuaruahharnak kha dah ti lo cu zeihmanh hmelchunhnak pek an si lai lo.","title":"Khuaruahhar Tuah An Hnek (Mat 12.38-42)","ref":"Mat 16.4; Mar 8.12"},"30":{"text":"Profet Jonah cu Nineveh khuami hna caah hmelchunhnak a rak si bantuk khan Mi Fapa zong hi tuchan mi hna caah hin hmelchunhnak a si ve lai.","ref":"Jon 3.4"},"31":{"text":"Biaceih Ni ah cun Chimlei Siangpahrangnu kha a dir te lai i atu chan mi hna hi sual a phawt te hna lai, zeicahtiah Solomon fimnak bia ngaih duh ah khan anih cu lamhla piin a ra i asinain hika ah hin Solomon nakin a ngan deuhmi a um ko ṭung.","ref":"1Sia 10.1-10; 2Cha 9.1-12"},"32":{"text":"Biaceih Ni ah cun Nineveh khuami cu an dir lai i nannih kha sual an in phawt hna lai, zeicahtiah annih cu Jonah bia chimmi an theih tikah khan an ziaza an i thleng, asinain hika ah hin Jonah nakin a ngan deuhmi a um ko ṭung,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Jon 3.5"},"33":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih meiinn a van tikah a thuh in a thup bal lo, kho zong a khuh bal lo, sihmanhsehlaw mei vannak tu ah khan a van i mi an rung luh tikah khua an hmu kho.","title":"Pum Ceunak (Mat 5.15 ; 6.22-23)","ref":"Mat 5.15; Mar 4.21; Luk 8.16"},"34":{"text":"Nan mit cu nan pum caah meiinn bantuk a si; nan mit a fian tikah nan pum cu ceunak in a khat, sihmanhsehlaw nan mit a ṭhat lo tikah nan pum cu a dihlak in muihnak chungah a um."},"35":{"text":"Cucaah nan chung i ceunak a ummi cu muihnak a si nakhnga lo i ralring tuah u."},"36":{"text":"Cun nan pum cu a dihlak in ceunak in a khah i a zeika zawn hmanh kha muihnak chungah a um lo ahcun, meiinn nih a ceunak in an ceuh hna bantuk khin a ceu lai."},"37":{"text":"Bia a chim dih tikah Jesuh cu Farasi mi pakhat nih rawl hrawn a sawm; cucaah a va kal i rawl ei awkah khan a ṭhu.","title":"Jesuh Nih Farasi Mi le Phungbia Cawnpiaktu Hna Kha Sual A Phawt Hna (Mat 23.1-36 ; Mar 12.38-40)"},"38":{"text":"Jesuh nih rawl ei hlanah a kut aa ṭawl lo kha Farasi mi nih cun a hmuh tikah a khuaruah a har."},"39":{"text":"Cucaah Bawipa nih cun amah cu a thawh i, “Nannih Farasi mi nih kheng le hrai kha a lenglei cu nan ṭawl tawn hna, sihmanhsehlaw a chunglei ah cun hakkauhnak le ṭhat lonak in nan khat."},"40":{"text":"Mihrut hna!
