A lenglei a sertu Pathian nih khan a chunglei zong cu a ser lo maw?"},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nan hrai chung le nan kheng chung i a ummi thil kha misifak va pe hna u law nan caah zeizong vialte a thiang ko lai."},"42":{"text":"“Farasi mi hna, nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah! Pathian sinah, tihang ṭamhnak puṭinan tehna, khamhmuai tehna, anthor tehna le a dangdang kha cheu hra ah cheu khat lengmang nan pek ko, sihmanhsehlaw biading le Pathian dawtnak kha nan thlahdorh. A dang kha thlahdorh hlei loin pei hi hna hi nan tuah awk a si cu.","ref":"Lev 27.30"},"43":{"text":"“Farasi mi hna, nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah! Pumhnak i ṭhutdan a dang tein chiahpiakmi i ṭhut cu nan duh i chawdawrnak hmun i upatnak in kuttlaih cu nan tlaihchan."},"44":{"text":"Nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah. Nannih cu hmelchunhnak tuah lomi thlan, a cung i mi nih hngalh loin an kal tawnnak bantuk cu nan si,” a ti."},"45":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pakhat nih a hun thawh i, “Saya, hi bantukin na chim tikah hin kannih zong na kan thangchiat a si ve,” tiah a ti."},"46":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh i, “Nannih Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna zong, nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah! Nanmah nih nan kutdong hmanh in nan tawngh duh ṭung lomi thilrit kha mi nan khinh hna."},"47":{"text":"Nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah. Profet hna caah khan thlan ṭhaṭha nan ser hna, cu profet hna cu nan pu le nan pa hna nih an rak nawnmi hna kha an si."},"48":{"text":"Cucaah nanmah hrimhrim nih nan pupa hna nih an rak tuahmi nan hnatlakpi hnanak kha nan langhter; annih nih profet kha an nawn hna i nannih nih an thlan kha nan ser hna."},"49":{"text":"Hi ruangah hin pei Pathian Fimnak nih, ‘Annih cu profet le lamkaltu kha ka thlahhnawh hna lai, a cheu an thah hna lai i a cheu an hrem hna lai’ a ti cu."},"50":{"text":"Cucaah tuchan mi hna hi vawlei ser hramthawknak in profet an thahmi vialte hna ruangah khan dantat an si lai,"},"51":{"text":"Abel an nawnnak thawk in biakṭheng le hmunthiang karlak ah an thahmi Zekhariah tiangin. Asi, kan chimh hna, atu chan mi hi, cu mi vialte hna ruangah cun dantat an si lai.","ref":"Gen 4.8; 2Cha 24.20-21"},"52":{"text":"“Nannih Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna, nan caah ṭihnung a va si dah. Hngalhnak innka hunnak tawh kha nannih nih nan ken, nanmah cu nan lut duh ṭung lo i luh aa zuammi hna zong kha nan dawnh fawn ṭung hna,” tiah a ti."},"53":{"text":"Cuka hmun in a chuah tikah Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le Farasi mi hna nih khan zeimaw ti tal in kan tlai kho hnga maw tiah thil tampi kongah biarap an chiah i ṭha tein an bawh;"},"54":{"text":"zei maw ti tal in bia a chim sualmi a um kho in a chim sualmi lila ah cun kan tlai kho hnga maw tiin thil tampi kong ah bia an hal lengmang."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Mi cu a thongthong in an i pum i, i pah lulhmalh in an um tikah, Jesuh nih a hmasa bik ah a zultu kha a thawh hna i, “Farasi mi thilnu kha i ralring u, ka chim duhmi cu midepde an sinak hi a si.","title":"Titer Hmannak Kong Ralrin Peknak (Mat 10.26-27)","ref":"Mat 16.6; Mar 8.15"},"2":{"text":"Khuhmi thil paoh hi hun an si dih lai i biathli paohpaoh hi hngalh an si dih lai.","ref":"Mar 4.22; Luk 8.17"},"3":{"text":"Cucaah mui lakah nan chimmi cu chun ceu ah theih an si lai, cun innka nan i khar khumhnak khaan chungah a thli tein nan chimmi cu inncung in aupi an si lai,” tiah a ti."},"4":{"text":"“Kan chimh hna, ka duale, pum cu a that kho nain a hnuah cu nak ṭhalo deuh zeihmanh a tuah kho ti lomi cu ṭih hna hlah u.","title":"Ahodah Ṭih Awk A Si? (Mat 10.28-31)"},"5":{"text":"Ṭih awk cu ahodah a si kha kan hmuhsak hna lai: Thah hnu i hell zong i thlak khawhnak nawl a ngeimi Pathian hi a si. Asi, amah cu va ṭih u, tiah kan chimh hna."},"6":{"text":"“Pithlung panga cu pia hnih ah an zuar hna a si lo maw? Asinain an lak i pakhat hmanh khi Pathian nih a philhmi hna an um lo."},"7":{"text":"Nan lu cung samfa hmanh kha a rel dih hna. Cucaah nan thinphang hlah u: pithlung tampi nakin pei nan sun deuh cu!” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Hihi kan chimh hna: mizapi hmaiah a ka ṭanhmi cu Mi Fapa nih, Pathian vancungmi hna hmaiah, a ṭanh ve hna lai.","title":"Minung Hmaiah Khrih Phuan (Mat 10.32-33 ; 12.32 ; 10.19-20)"},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nangmah ta ka si lo tiah zapi hmaiah aa phehmi cu, Pathian vancungmi hna hmaiah Mi Fapa zong nih, ka ta nan si lo, tiah a ti ve hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Mi Fapa a thangchiattu cu ahohmanh ngaihthiam an si lai, sihmanh-sehlaw Thiang Thlarau a thangchiattu cu ngaihthiam an si lai lo.","ref":"Mat 12.32; Mar 3.29"},"11":{"text":"“Pumhnak inn ah siseh, mangki bawi hmai le uktu bawi hmaiah tazacuai awkah an in chuahpi hna tikah, zeitindah kaa runven lai i zei bia dah ka chim lai, tiah nan khuaruah va har hlah u.","ref":"Mat 10.19-20; Mar 13.11; Luk 21.14-15"},"12":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Thiang Thlarau nih khi caan ah nan chim awk cu an chimh ko hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Zapi lakin mipa pakhat nih a hun thawh i, “Saya, ka pa nih a kan rohmi thilri kha a ka cheuh ve naklai ka unaupa kha ka chimhpiak tuah,” tiah a ti.","title":"Mirum Hrut Bianabia"},"14":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a vun leh i, “Mipa, aho nih dah nan pahnih karlak i biathlektu ding le ro ṭhentu dingah nawl a ka pek?” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun annih cu an dihlak in a vun thawh hna i, “Ralring tein um u, hakkauhnak kha i veng u; zeicahtiah mi a nunnak taktak cu, zeitluk hmanh in rum seh law, a thilri hi a si lo,” tiah a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chimh hna. Aa thawh i, “Mirumpa pakhat nih hin, rawl a vui ngaimi lo pakhat a ngei."},"17":{"text":"Cu tikah a lungchung in, ‘Ka rawl vialte chiahnak ding hmun ka ngeih ti ṭung lo. Zeidah ka tuah ah a ṭha hnga?"},"18":{"text":"Aa, hihi ka tuah lai: Ka rawlruk kha ka ṭheh hna lai i anmah nakin a ngan deuhmi kha ka sak hna lai. Cuka ah cun ka rawl le ka thilri dang vialte kha ka chiah hna lai."},"19":{"text":"Cun keimah le keimah cu kaa thawh lai i, Mivanṭha pa! Kum tampi caah a za in thil ṭha vialte cu na ngeih cang. Cucaah nuam tein um ko cang, ei law ding law i nuam ko, ka ti lai,’ a ti."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a thawh i, ‘Mihrutpa, tuzan hrimhrim ah hin na nunnak cu an in lakpiak a hau lai; cucaah nangmah ca i na khonmi thilri vialte hi aho nih dah a co kun lai?’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun a biadonghnak ah, “Hitihin pei anmah ca lawng i chawva a khong cuahmah i Pathian hmuhnak i a rum ṭung lomi cu an si cu,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih a zultu kha a thawh hna i, “Hi caah hin pei nunnak ca i nan herhmi rawl le nan pum ca i nan herhmi hnipuan kong ah nan lungrethei hlah u kan ti hna cu.","title":"Pathian I Bochan U (Mat 6.25-34)"},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nunnak hi rawl nakin biapi deuh ngaingai a si i pum hi hnipuan nakin biapi deuh ngaingai a si."},"24":{"text":"Langak khi zoh hmanh hna ngat u, thlaici an tuh lo, rawl zong an ṭuan lo, rawl chiahnak buk zong an ngei lo, rawl khonnak ruk zong an ngei lo; asinain Pathian nih a cawm ko hna. Nannih cu va nakin a let tampi in pei nan sun deuh cu."},"25":{"text":"Nan lakah aho tal, a lungretheihnak thawngin a nunnak ah suimilam pakhat tal zong a chap khomi nan um maw?"},"26":{"text":"Cu bantuk thil hmete hmanh nan tuah khawh ṭung lo ahcun zeicahdah thil dang kong ah cun lungrethei in nan um?"},"27":{"text":"Ramlak pangpar khi zeitindah an ṭhan ti khi zoh hna ngat u: rian an ṭuan lo, hnipuan zong an i tah fawn lo. Sihmanhsehlaw hihi kan chimh hna: Solomon hmanh kha, kha tluk khan a rum nain hi pangpar hna pakhat tluk i aa dawhmi thilthuam a ngei lo.","ref":"1Sia 10.4-7; 2Cha 9.3-6"},"28":{"text":"A kho sawhsawhmi ram, nihin ah a nung i a thaizing ah meiphu i an paihmi ram a thuamhtu hi Pathian a si ahcun, nannih chinchin cu zeitluk in dah an thuamh hna lai — nannih zumhnak a hmemi hna!"},"29":{"text":"Cucaah ei awk le din awk rumro kha ruat in lungrethei in um hlah u."},"30":{"text":"(Zeicahtiah hi thil hna hi cu vawlei mi nih an kawlhawl tawnmi hna an si ko). Nan Pa nih hi thil hi nan herh hna ti cu a hngalh ko."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah amah Pennak cu biapi bik ah ruat u law nan herhmi thil vialte hi an pek ko hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"“Tuurun hmete hna, nan thinphang hlah u! Zeicahtiah nan Pa nih Pennak cu nanmah kha pek an duh hna.","title":"Vancung Rumnak (Mat 6.19-21)"},"33":{"text":"Nan ngeihmi thil kha zuar hna u law tangka cu mi kha ṭhen hna u. A ṭet kho lomi phaisa bawm kha i zalh u law vancung ah nan ro kha khong hna u, khika ah cun mifir nih an fir kho hna lo i rungrul nih an ei khawh hna lo caah a zor lei an panh bal lai lo."},"34":{"text":"Cun nan ro umnak ah nan lung zong a um zungzal ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"“Zei thil paoh tlung ai kun, tiin nan taisawm kha fek tein i sawmh le nan meiinn kha i van in ralring tein um u;","title":"Ralring In A Ummi Sal Hna","ref":"Mat 25.1-13"},"36":{"text":"nupi ṭhitnak puai in a ra ṭinmi an bawipa a hngak i a hung phak i innka a hun kingh tikah hmakhatte ah hunpiak awkah timhcia tein a rak ummi a sal hna bantuk khan um u.","ref":"Mar 13.34-36"},"37":{"text":"An bawipa nih inn a phak tikah i hlau le ralring tein a rak ummi a sal hna caah cun lunglawmh awk a va si dah! Hihi kan chimh hna: a taisawm kha aa sawmh lai i a ṭhutter hna lai i a bultawl hna lai."},"38":{"text":"Zanṭim i a ra ṭin a si ah, cu nak tlai deuh i a ra ṭin a si zongah, timhcia tein an um kha a ra hmuh hna cu, an caah zeitluk lawmh awk dah a si."},"39":{"text":"Cun nannih nih hihi i cinken u: Inn ngeitu nih mifir a rat lai caan kha a hngalh ahcun mifir kha a inn cu a bauhter lai lo."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah nannih zong i ralring ve u, zeicahtiah a ra lai tiah nan zumh lo caan ah khin Mi Fapa cu a ra ko lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 24.43-44"},"41":{"text":"Peter nih a thawh i, “Bawipa, hi bianabia hi kanmah maw na kan chimh, asiloah mizapi caah dah na ti?” tiah a ti.","title":"Zumhtlak le Zumhtlak Lo Sal (Mat 24.45-51)"},"42":{"text":"Bawipa nih a leh i, “A si ahcun, aho cu dah zumhawktlak le a fimmi sal cu a si? Zumhawktlak le a fimmi sal cu a bawipa nih a innchungkhar zohkhenhtu ah a chiah i sal dang kha anmah le an caan te cio ah an co awk hnga rawl a pemi hna cu a si."},"43":{"text":"A bawipa cu inn i a hung tlun tikah cu ti i a rak tuah a hmuhmi a sal caah cun zeitluk in dah lunglawmh awk a si."},"44":{"text":"Hihi kan chimh hna, cu pa cu a bawipa nih a thilri vialte zohkhenhtu ah a chiah hrimhrim lai."},"45":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ‘Ka bawipa cu saupi a rau ko rih lai,’ a ti i sal dang pawl kha nu he pa he a tu a vel, a ei a ding i, rihai in a ummi sal cu,"},"46":{"text":"a bawipa cu a ra phan lai ti i a ruah lo ni le a hngalh lo caan ah khan a ra phan lai i cu sal cu a bawipa nih cun a sam cikcek lai i nawl ngai lomi hna tinvo kha a coter ve lai."},"47":{"text":"“A bawipa duhnak a hngal ko na i cu a duhmi a tuah duh lomi sal cu a fakmi tuknak a in lai."},"48":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a bawipa duhnak a hngal lo i asinain tuk awk tlak a simi thil a tuahmi cu a dinmi tuknak a in lai. Tampi pekmi cu tampi hal ṭhan a si ve lai; tam deuh pek a simi cu tam deuh hal ṭhan a si ve ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"“Vawlei hi mei in duah awkah pei ka rat cu, alh hluahmah cang seh law ka hei duh dah!","title":"Jesuh Cu Ṭhentertu A Si (Mat 10.34-36)"},"50":{"text":"Tipil in awk pakhat ka ngei i cucu a dih hlanah cun ka lungre a va thei dah."},"51":{"text":"Vawlei cungah hin remnak tlunter awkah a ra ti ah dahra nan ka ruah? Remnak si loin ṭhennak tu tlunter awkah ka ra."},"52":{"text":"Atu ri hin cun innchungkhar pakhat chung i a ummi mi panga hna cu an i ṭhen lai i pathum nih pahnih an doh hna lai pahnih nih pathum an doh hna lai,"},"53":{"text":"an pale nih an fapa hna kha an doh hna lai i an fapale nih an pale hna kha an doh lai; an nule nih an fanule kha an doh hna lai i an fanule nih an nule kha an doh hna lai; fapale nupi hna nih vale nule kha an doh hna lai i fapale nupi hna kha fapale nu hna nih an doh hna lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mik 7.6"},"54":{"text":"Jesuh nih mizapi cu a thawh ṭhan hna i, “Nitlaklei in khuadawm a thawh kha nan hmuh tikah hmakhatte ah, ‘Ruah a sur lai,’ nan ti i a sur taktak.","title":"Khuacaan Hngalhnak (Mat 16.2-3)"},"55":{"text":"Cun Chimlei thli a hung hran nan pum nih a theih tikah, ‘Khua a sa lai,’ nan ti i a lin taktak."},"56":{"text":"Midepde hna, van le vawlei kha nan zoh i an sullam zeidah an si ti kha nan hngalh khawh; a si kun ahcun zeicahdah caan sullam hi nan hngalh khawh kun lo?” a ti."},"57":{"text":"“Zeicahdah ahmaanmi thil tu kha tuah awkah nan lung nan i thlek ko lo?","title":"Na Ral He Vaa Rem U (Mat 5.25-26)"},"58":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih tazacuai an duh i zung ah an chuahpi ahcun, lam i nan kal lioah khan nan bia cu na remter khawh nakhnga vaa zuam tuah; cu ti na tuah khawh lo ahcun biaceihtu bawi hmaiah khan an chuahpi lai i biaceihtu bawi nih khan palik sinah an chanh lai i palik zong nih khan thong ah an in thlak lai."},"59":{"text":"Na tlak vekvek a si ahcun, dan an in tatmi na liam dih cikcek hlan cu na chuak hrimhrim lai lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun Jesuh cu, Pilat nih Galilee mi hna Pathian sinah raithawinak an pekchanh lio i a thahmi hna kong kha an rak chimh.","title":"Nan Sual I Ngaihchih U, Nan Thi Sual Lai"},"2":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Cu Galilee mi hna cu cu bantukin thihnak an in caah Galilee mi a dang hna nakin a sual deuhmi an si tiah nan ruah maw?"},"3":{"text":"Asilo, nannih zong nan nunning nan ṭhinh lo ahcun anmah thih bantukin nan thi ve lai."},"4":{"text":"Siloam i innsang nih a nenhmi pahleiriat hna kha tah? Hiti an thihnak nih hin annih kha Jerusalem khua chung i a ummi midang vialte hna nakin an sual deuh tiah a langhter tiah nan ruah maw?"},"5":{"text":"A si hrimhrim lo, nannih zong nan nun nan ṭhinh lo ahcun anmah thih bantukin nan thi ve lai,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih hi bianabia hi a chimh hna: Aa thawh i, “Mipa pakhat nih a dum chungah theipi kung pakhat a cin. A tlai maw tlai lo ti a va zoh tikah zeihmanh a rak tlai lo.","title":"A Tlai Lomi Theipi Kung Bianabia"},"7":{"text":"Cucaah a dum zohkhenhtupa kha a thawh i, “Zohhmanh, kum thum chung theipi kung hi a tlai maw tlai lo, tiah zoh awkah ka ra lengmang i a tlai zeihmanh ka hmu rih lo. Cucaah hau ko. Zeicahhen vawlei dah tu kha a ei lengmang lai?’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw dum cawngtu nih khan a leh i, “Bawipa, hi kum khatte hi cu zuah ko rih, a velchum in ka cawh lai i non ka toih lai."},"9":{"text":"Cun kumvoi ah a tlai ahcun a ṭha ko, a tlai lo le na hauter te ko hna lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah voi khat cu Jesuh nih pumhnak inn ah a cawnpiak hna.","title":"Kebei Minu Jesuh Nih A damter"},"11":{"text":"Cuka ah cun minu pakhat a chungah thlarau ṭhalo a ngeimi a um i thlarau nih cun kum hleiriat chung a zawtter cang i a keng kha a kul dih i a ding kho ti lo."},"12":{"text":"Jesuh nih a hmuh tikah a hei auh i, “Minu, na zawtnak in na luat cang,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"A cungah khan a kut a chuan i cu cangka cun ding tein a dir kho i Pathian kha a thangṭhat."},"14":{"text":"Pumhnak inn zohkhenhtu cu Jesuh nih Sabbath ni ah mi a damter caah khan a thin a hung i, “Rianṭuannak dingah ni ruk pei a um ko cu; cucaah cun cu ni ruk chungah cun tah nan rat i nan rak i damter; Sabbath ni ah hin cun ti hlah ngat u,” tiah mizapi cu a hun ti hna.","ref":"Exo 20.9-10; Deu 5.13-14"},"15":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a leh i, “Mi depde hna. Aho paoh nih Sabbath ni ah nan caw siseh nan la siseh an inn in nan thlah hna i ti dinh awkah nan kalpi ko ṭung hna."},"16":{"text":"Atu hika i a ummi nu Abraham fanu, Satan nih kum hleiriat chung a hrenmi hi Sabbath ni ah hin phoih awk a si hnga lo maw?” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Bia a lehnak nih cun a ral vialte hna cu ningzak in a umter dih hna i khuaruahhar a tuahmi cungah khan mizapi cu an i lawm."},"18":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh i, “Pathian Pennak hi zei he dah aa lawh? Zei he dah ka tahchunh khawh lai?","title":"Anṭam Ci Bianabia (Mat 13.31-32 ; Mar 4.30-32)"},"19":{"text":"Mipa nih a lo ah a tuhmi anṭam ci he aa lo; anṭam cu a hung ṭhang i thingkung ah a cang i a nge ah khan vate nih bu an sak,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh ṭhan i, “Pathian Pennak cu zei he dah ka tahchunh lai?","title":"Thilnu Bianabia (Mat 13.33)"},"21":{"text":"Minu nih thilnu aa lak i changvut rel khat chungah a phulh i cu thilnu nih cun changvut cu a thawhter dih. Cu thilnu bantuk cu a si,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem i a kalpah ah khan khua kha a pal duahmah hna i a cawnpiak pah lengmang hna.","title":"Innka Bi (Mat 7.13-14 , 21-23)"},"23":{"text":"Mi a cheukhat nih bia an hal i, “Bawipa, mi hi tlawmte lawng maw khamh an si lai?” an ti."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Kutka bi chung khan lanh i zuam ko u, zeicahtiah hihi kan chimh hna: mi tampi cu luh an i zuam lai nain an lut kho lai lo."},"25":{"text":"“Inn ngeitu cu a tho lai i kutka cu a khar lai; cun nannih cu a leng i nan dir i kutka khar cu nan kingh i, ‘Bawipa, innka kan hunh tuah,’ nan ti tikah, ‘Khuazei in dah nan rat kha ka hngal lo,’ tiah an leh hna lai."},"26":{"text":"Cun nannih nih nan leh ve lai i, ‘Na sinah pei rawl kan ei i ti kan din kha, kan khua ah pei na kan cawnpiak kha,’ nan ti lai."},"27":{"text":"Anih nih an thawh hna lai i, ‘Khuazei in nan rat kan hngal lo. Nannih ṭhat lonak a tuahmi vialte hna, ka sinin kal ko u,’ a ti hna lai.","ref":"Slm 6.8"},"28":{"text":"Nannih vial cu lengah nan um lai i Abraham le Isak le Jakob le profet vialte hna cu Pathian Pennak chungah khan nan hmuh hna lai, cu tikah nan ṭap len lai i nan hacang nan i rial sek te lai.","ref":"Mat 22.13; 25.30; Mat 8.11-12"},"29":{"text":"Nichuah, nitlak, chaklei, thlanglei, in mi kha an ra lai i Pathian Pennak cabuai ah khan an ṭhu lai."},"30":{"text":"Cu tikah cun atu i a hmanung bik hi a hmasa bik an si lai i atu i a hmasa bik hi a hmanung bik an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 19.30; 20.6; Mar 10.31"},"31":{"text":"Cu lioah cun Farasi mi tlawmpal kha Jesuh sinah khan an ra i, “Herod nih thah an duh caah hika hin na chuah a hau,” tiah an chimh.","title":"Jesuh Nih Jerusalem A Dawt (Mat 23.37-39)"},"32":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Va kal u law, cu cenghngia cu, ‘Nihin le thaizing ah khuachia kha ka ṭhawl hna lai i damnak kha ka tuah lai, cun a ni thum ni ah ka rian cu ka lim lai,’ a ti, tiah va chim u."},"33":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nihin le thaizing le kiptuh cu ka kal ko rih lai, zeicahtiah profet cu Jerusalem khuachung dah ti lo ahcun khuazei hmanh ah thah phung a si ṭung lo."},"34":{"text":"“Maw Jerusalem, Jerusalem, profet kha na thah hna i Pathian nih na sinah lamkaltu a rak thlahmi kha lung in na rak cheh hna. Arpi nih a fale cu a thla tangah a huh hna bantukin voi zeizat te dik na chung mi cu ka kut in huh kan timh hna i na duh lo."},"35":{"text":"Zohhmanh, na biakinn cu Pathian nih a hlawt cang. Cun hihi kan chimh, nangmah nih, ‘Bawipa min in a rami cu a cungah thluachuahnak um ko seh,’ na ti caan a phak hlan cu na ka hmu ti lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Slm 118.26; Jer 22.5"}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voi khat cu Sabbath ni ah hin Jesuh cu Farasi mi hna lak i haotu pakhat inn ah rawl a hrawng i mi nih khan fel tein an ngiat.","title":"Jesuh Nih A Zawmipa A Damter"},"2":{"text":"Mipa pakhat, a ke le a kut a phingmipa cu Jesuh sinah khan a ra i"},"3":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le Farasi mi hna cu a thawh hna i, “Kan Phung nih Sabbath ni i mi damter hi a onh maw onh lo,” tiah a hal hna."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih zeihmanh an chim lo. Jesuh nih mipa cu aa lak i a damter i a kalter."},"5":{"text":"Cun annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nan lak i pakhatkhat hi a fa maw, asiloah a caw maw Sabbath ni ah tikhor ah tla seh law, Sabbath ni a si ai tiah chuah loin maw nan um ko hnga,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 12.11"},"6":{"text":"Hi kong ah hin zeihmanh an let kho lo."},"7":{"text":"Rawl hrawn kawh tikah mi a cheu cu ṭhutnak hmun ṭha bikbik an i thim tawn kha Jesuh nih a hmuh hna caah hi tahchunhnak bia hi an dihlak in a chimh hna:","title":"Puai Zawh le Toidornak"},"8":{"text":"“Nupi ṭhit rawldanghnak puai ah pakhatkhat nih an in sawm hna ahcun ṭhutnak ṭha bik kha i cuh hlah. Zeicahtiah nangmah nakin a biapi deuhmi midang kha an sawm khawh i","ref":"Phut 25.6-7"},"9":{"text":"nan pahnih in an sawmtu hna nih khan, nangmah cu an thawh lai i, ‘Hi hmun hi kian tuah,’ tiah an ti sual lai. Cu tikah cun a niam bik hmun i na vung ṭhut tikah khan na ning a zak lai."},"10":{"text":"Cu nakin rawlhrawn an in sawm tikah va kal law a niam bik hmun ah khan va ṭhu deuh. Zeicahtiah an sawmtupa kha na sinah a ra lai i, ‘Hung kai tuah, ka kawi, hmun ṭha deuh ah hin,’ an ti lai. Hi nih hin sawmmi vialte hna hmaiah khan hmaihngalnak an pek lai."},"11":{"text":"Amah le amah a ngan ah aa chiami cu nauta ah chiah a si lai i mi tangah aa dormi cu mi ngan ah ser a si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 23.12; Luk 18.14"},"12":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih rawlhrawn a sawmtu cu a thawh i, “Chuncaw ei siseh, zanriah ei siseh, na sawm hna tikah na hawi na kom le na unau hna le na sahlawh na rualchan hna le na innpa mi rumrum kha va sawm hna hlah. Zeicahtiah anmah zong nih an in sawm ve lai i na tuahmi kha cham na si ko lai."},"13":{"text":"Rawl danghnak na tuah tikah, misifak, kutzeng, kezeng le mitcaw kha va sawm hna law"},"14":{"text":"annih nih an in cham khawh lai lo caah thluachuahnak na hmu lai. Miṭha mi kha thihnak in an thawh ṭhan tikah Pathian nih an cham lai,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cabuai i a ṭhu vemi pakhat nih cu bia cu a rak theih i, “Pathian Pennak chung rawl danghnak i aa tel vemi cu zeitluk in dik an i lawmh lai,” tiah Jesuh cu a ti.","title":"Rawl Danghnak Bianabia (Mat 22.1-10)"},"16":{"text":"Jesuh nih amah cu a thawh i, “Voi khat ah hin mipa pakhat a rak um i cu pa nih cun rawl danghnak nganpi pakhat a rak tuah i cu rawl danghnak ah cun mi tampi a sawm hna."},"17":{"text":"Rawldanghnak caan cu a cut tikah a sinum kha, ‘Ra cang u, zeizong vialte timh a si dih cang,’ tiah a sawmmi hna cu va ti hna, tiah a thlah."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an dihlak in pakhat hnu pakhat sonhtarhnak kha an rak kawl cio. A hmasa bik nih a sinumpa cu a rak thawh i, ‘Ka ngaithiam ko, lo ka caw ngelcel i ka va kal i ka va zoh lo ahcun a si kho lo,’ tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"A pahnihnak nih aa thawh i, ‘Cawtum tuah nga ka cawk hna i atu hi ka hneksak hna lai ka ti, cucaah cun ka ngaithiam ko,’ a ti."},"20":{"text":"A pathumnak nih aa thawh i, ‘Atute kha nupi ka ṭhi i ka ra thiam lai lo,’ tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"A sinumpa kha a bawipa sinah cun a va kir ṭhan i cu vialte cu a chimh dih. Inn ngeitupa cu a thin a hung i a sinum cu a thawh i, ‘Khulrang in zatlang lam ah siseh, inn le inn karlak lam ah siseh, va kal law sifakmi si hna seh, kutzeng kezeng si hna seh, mitcaw si hna seh hunpi hna,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun tlawmpal ah khin a sinum nih cun a thawh i, ‘Bawipa, na nawl bangin tuah a si cang, sihmanhsehlaw hmun a lawng ko rih,’ tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cucaah a bawipa nih khan a sinumpa cu a thawh i, ‘Khua le khua kar i lam ngan ah siseh, lam hme ah siseh, va kal law ka inn a khah nakhnga mi kha ratter hna."},"24":{"text":"Hi hi kan chimh hna, ka sawmmi hna nih khan cun ahohmanh nih ka zanriah hi an tep lai lo,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Jesuh sinah cun mi tampi an kal ve. Aa mer i a thawh hna i","title":"Zultu Si Man (Mat 10.37-38)"},"26":{"text":"“Ahohmanh ka sinah a rami cu a pa siseh, a nu siseh, a nupi siseh, a fale si hna seh, a unau si hna seh, a farle si hna seh, amah le amah siseh, aa huat lo ahcun a ka zultu a si kho lo.","ref":"Mat 10.37"},"27":{"text":"A vailam tahnak kha aa put i a ka zul lomi cu a ka zultu a si kho lo.","ref":"Mat 10.38; Mar 8.34; Luk 9.23"},"28":{"text":"Nannih lak i pakhatkhat nih inn sak aa timh tikah, ka rian hi a dih tiangin ka phaisa nih a ka zo lai maw zo lai lo ti hngalhnak dingah a ṭhu hmasa i pei zeizat dah a dih lai ti kha a tuak hmasa cu."},"29":{"text":"Cu bantukin a tuak hmasa lo ahcun a inn cu a hram a thawk hnuah dih kho ṭung loin a um lai i a hmumi paoh nih nihchuak ah an saih lai."},"30":{"text":"‘Hi pa nih hin sak a hei i ot i a dih khawh ṭung lo hen hi,’ an ti lai."},"31":{"text":"Siangpahrang pakhatkhat nih, amah tuk awkah ralkap thong kul he a rami siangpahrang kha, a ralkap thong hra he rak doh awkah a hei chuahhnawh ahcun, a ṭhu hmasa lai i pei, kha siangpahrang kha ka do kho lai maw do kho lo tiah aa tuak hmasa lai cu."},"32":{"text":"Ka do kho lai lo tiah a hngalh ahcun, siangpahrang cu lamhlapi i a rat lioah khan va don i remnak ser awkah lamkal a thlah hna lai."},"33":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in nannih zong, nan ngeihmi vialte kha nan hlawt dih lo ahcun, ka zultu nan si kho lai lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"34":{"text":"“Cite hi a ṭha, sihmanhsehlaw a alnak kha a loh ahcun zeitin hmanh in alter khawh a si ti lo.","title":"Santlai Lomi Cite (Mat 5.13 ; Mar 9.50)"},"35":{"text":"Vawlei ṭhatternak caah a ṭhahnem lo, ek pon ca zongah a ṭhahnem lo; a hlonh in hlonh awk lawnglawng a si ko. Cucaah hna nan ngeih ahcun, thei ko u!” tiah a ti hna."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Voi khat cu ngunkhuai khawltu pawl le misual pawl kha a sinah tampi an ra i a bia kha an ngai.","title":"Tuu Tlau Kong (Mat 18.12-14)","ref":"Luk 5.29-30"},"2":{"text":"Farasi mi hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna cu an zai i, “Hi pa hi misual mi kha a rak pomhlawm hna i rawl zong a eipi hna,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah cun Jesuh nih hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chimh hna:"},"4":{"text":"“A biana ah pakhatkhat nih tuu za khat hei ngei u law pakhat va tlau seh law, cu tikah zeitindah nan tuah lai? Tuu sawm kua le pakua kha an tlonnak hmun ah cun kaltak in a tlaumi cu a hmuh hlan loin a kawl lai lo maw?"},"5":{"text":"A va hmuh tikah a lung aa lawm tuk i cucaah a liang ah aa khinh i"},"6":{"text":"inn ah a tlunpi. Cun a hawikom hna le a innpa hna kha a auh hna i, ‘Ra ka lawmhpi tuah u, zeicahtiah a tlaumi ka tuu kha ka hmuh ṭhan cang,’ a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in, ngaihchih a herh lomi miding sawm kua le pakua hna nakin aa ngaichihmi misual pakhat ruangah vancung khua ah lunglawmhnak tam deuh a um lai,” tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"“Asiloah, tangka phar hra a ngeiminu nih pakhat kha a thlau ahcun zeidah a tuah? Meiinn a van i pei a inn kha a phiah i a hmuh hlan tiang a ken le a kawi zong kha a kawl cikcek cu.","title":"Tangka Tlau Kong"},"9":{"text":"A hmuh tikah a hawikom hna le a innpa hna kha a auh hna i, ‘Ka lawmhpi u, zeicahtiah ka thlaumi ka tangka kha ka hmuh ṭhan cang,’ a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in, aa ngaihchihmi misual pakhat ruangah Pathian vancungmi hna cu an i lawm,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a thawh ṭhan hna i, “Voi khat ah fapa pahnih a ngeimipa a rak um.","title":"Fapa Tlau"},"12":{"text":"A ngakchia deuh pa nih khan a pa cu a thawh i, ‘Ka pa, atu hin ka co hnga a simi ro cu ka pe ko,’ a ti. Cucaah an pa nih an unau cun ro cu a cheuh hna."},"13":{"text":"Ni tlawmpal hnuah khin ngakchia deuh pa nih cun a thilri cu a zuarh i a man tangka cu aa lak i an inn cun a kal. A hla ngaingaimi ram ah a kal i khika ah khan duhduh in khua a va sa i a tangka cu a va sawksam dih."},"14":{"text":"A ngeihmi vialte cu a hloh dih. Cun cu ram ah cun mangṭam a tlung ciammam i a tawro in a ṭhu."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah cuka ram mipa pakhat sinah khan kuli va ṭuan awkah a kal i cu pa nih cun vok cawngh awkah a lo ah a rak kalter."},"16":{"text":"Vok nih an eimi bekawng hmanh kha ṭam lenning ti a duh, asinain ahohmanh nih ei awk zeihmanh an pe lo."},"17":{"text":"A donghnak ah cun a lung a hung fim i, ‘Ka Pa kuli vialte hmanh nih ei cawk loin ei awk an ngei, kei vial hika ah hin rawlṭam in ka thi cuahmah."},"18":{"text":"Ka tho lai i ka pa sinah ka kal lai i, “Ka pa, Pathian sin le na sinah ka sual cang."},"19":{"text":"Na fa ti awk ka tlak ti lo; na kuli pakhat bantukin ka chia ve ko,” ka ti lai,’ a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah a tho i a pa sinlei kir ah cun aa thawh. “Lamhlatpi i a rat lio kha a pa nih cun a rak hmuh; a zaang a fak ngaingai i a hei tlikhnawh i a kuh i a hnamh."},"21":{"text":"A fapa nih cun, ‘Ka pa, Pathian sin le nangmah sinah ka sual cang. Na fapa ti awk ka tlak ti lo,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a pa nih khan a sinum kha a auh hna i, ‘Khulrang in puan ṭha bik kha rak pu u law aih u. A kutdong ah kutdonghrolh hrolh u law a ke ah kedan danh u."},"23":{"text":"Cun va kal u law cawfa a thau bik kha va la u law va that u, lunglawm ngaiin puai tuah u sih."},"24":{"text":"Zeicahtiah hi ka fapa hi a rak thi, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu a nung ṭhan; a rak tlau, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu ka hmuh ṭhan cang,’ a ti. Cun cuticun puai tuah hram cu an thawk."},"25":{"text":"“Cu lioah cun a fapa upa u kha lo ah a um. A hung tlun i inn a hun naih tikah khin hlasak thawng le lam thawng cu a theih."},"26":{"text":"An sal pakhat kha a auh i, ‘Zeidah an tuah?’ tiah a hal."},"27":{"text":"An salpa nih cun, ‘Na naupa kha inn ah a ra tlung ṭhan i dam te le him tein inn a phak ṭhan caah na pa nih caw thaute khan a thlathlauh,’ tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Fapa upa u cu a thin a hung tuk i inn chungah khan a lut duh lo; cucaah a pa kha a va chuak i, ra lut ko, tiah a lem."},"29":{"text":"A pa cu a thawh i, ‘Zohhmanh, kum hi zat riangruang, sal bantukin na rian ka ṭuan i voi khat hmanh na nawl ngai loin ka um bal lo. Zeidah na ka pek? Ka hawikom he i nuamhnak caah meheh pakhat hmanh na ka pe lo."},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi na fapa, thilri vialte hlawhhlangnu sin i a hlolak dihtu hi inn i a hung tlun ṭhan tikah caw thaute kha na thahpiak!’ tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Cun a pa nih cun a leh i, ‘Ka fapa, nang cu inn ah a zungzal in na um i ka ngeihmi vialte cu na ta an si dih."},"32":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na nau cu a rak thi i pei atu cu a nun ṭhan cu, a rak tlau i pei atu cu hmuh ṭhan a si cu, cucaah kan thlathlauh i kan i lawmh awk a si hrim ko,’ tiah a leh,” tiah a ti."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih a zultu kha a thawh hna i, “Mirumpa pakhat a rak um i cu mirumpa nih cun thil zohkhenhtu pakhat a ngei i a thil zohkhenhtu nih cun a tangka kha a duhduh in pakpalawng ah a hman tiah an chimh.","title":"Thil Zohkhenhtu Mihrokhrawl"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu a kawh i, ‘Nangmah kong i ka theihmi hi zeidah a si? Ka thilri na tuahtonak cazin kha tlamtling tein ka pe tuah, zeicahtiah ka thil zohkhenhtu na si kho ti lo,’ tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Mipa nih cun a lungthli in, ‘Ka bawipa nih hin ka rian in a ka phuah ko lai, Zeidah ka tuah kun lai? Vawlei cawh le ka celh lo, mi thil hal le ka ning a zak fawn."},"4":{"text":"A! Atu cu zeidah ka tuah lai ti kha ka hngalh cang! Cu ti ka tuah ahcun ka rian a dih tikah an inn ah a ka umter duhtu hawikom ka ngei hna lai,’ a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah a bawipa lei a bami vialte kha a auh hna. A hmasa bikpa kha, ‘Ka bawipa cu zeizat dah nang na bat?’ tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Anih nih, ‘Oliv chiti pung za khat,’ tiah a leh. Thil zohkhenhtu pa nih cun, ‘Hihi na cazin siseh, ṭhu law sawm nga in ṭial,’ tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"A dang pakhat cu, ‘Nang tah zeizat dah na bat?’ tiah a ti. ‘Changvut rel thong khat,’ tiah a leh. ‘Hihi na cazin siseh, za riat in ṭial,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cu thil zohkhenhtu mihrokhrawlpa cu a bawipa nih khan cu bantukin fim ngaiin thil a ti caah a thangṭhat; zeicahtiah hi vawlei cung mi hna hi an thil tining ah ceunak mi hna nakin an fim deuh,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun, “Cucaah hitin kan chimh hna: vawlei cung chawva in hawikom i ser hna u, zeicahtiah chawva cu a dih tikah zungzal inn ah an umter hna lai."},"10":{"text":"Thil hmete ah zumhawktlak a simi cu thil ngan zongah zumhawktlak an si tawn, thil hmete ah a hrokhrawlmi cu thil ngan zongah an hrokhrawl tawn."},"11":{"text":"Vawlei cung thil tuahtoning i zumhawktlak lo nan si ahcun zeitindah rumnak taktak cu pek khawh nan si lai?"},"12":{"text":"Cun midang thil a simi ah zumhawktlak nan si lo ahcun aho nih dah nanmah ta a simi thil cu an in pek hna lai?"},"13":{"text":"“Sinum pakhat cu bawi pahnih sal a si kho lo: pakhat kha a huat lai i pakhat kha a dawt lai; pakhat sinah zumh awktlak tein a um lai i pakhat kha zei ah a rel lai lo. Pathian le chawva cu nan bawi ah an pahnih in nan kemh kho hna lai lo,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 6.24"},"14":{"text":"Farasi mi nih hi a chimmi vialte cu an theih tikah, annih cu tangka a duhmi an si caah, amah kha an nihsawh.","title":"Jesuh Chimmi Bia Dangdang (Mat 11.12-13 ; 5.31-32 ; Mar 10.11-12)"},"15":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Nannih hi minung mithmuh i miding aa lawhtermi pawl nan si, sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih cun nan lungthin cu a hngalh ko. Zeicahtiah minung nih man sung ngai i an ruahmi cu Pathian mithmuh ah cun pakpalawng a si ko."},"16":{"text":"“Moses Phungbia le profet ṭialmi ca hna cu Tipil petu Johan chan tiang caah khan an si; cu ri cun Pathian Pennak Thawngṭha cu chim a si i a mi kip cu heh tiah an lut.","ref":"Mat 11.12-13"},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Phungbia chung i a deh hme bikte hmanh a loh nakin van le vawlei loh hmanh kha a fawi deuh lai.","ref":"Mat 5.18"},"18":{"text":"“Ahohmanh a nupi a ma i nu dang a ṭhimi cu a nupi cungin sualnak a tuah a si; cun makmi nu a ṭhimi cu sualnak a tuah a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 5.32; 1Kor 7.10-11"},"19":{"text":"Voi khat cu mirum pakhat hi a rak um i puan man sung bikbik in aa thuam i nifate in nuam ngaingai in khua a sa.","title":"Mirumpa le Lazaruh Kong"},"20":{"text":"Cun misifak pakhat, a min Lazaruh an timi zong kha a um ve i hma nih a pumpuluk in a tlunh."},"21":{"text":"Mirumpa cabuai in a tlami rawl ṭiltlawt kha ka khim lai ti i ruahchan in mirumpa innka hram ah khan an ratpi tawn. Cun uico kha an ra i a hma kha an liahpiak tawn."},"22":{"text":"Misifakpa cu a thi i vancungmi nih vancung puai tuahnak ah khan an zuanpi i Abraham pawngah khan an ṭhutter. Mirumpa zong cu a thi ve i an vui."},"23":{"text":"Mirumpa cu Hell chungah a tla i nganfak ngaiin a um; cunglei hi a hun zoh i lamhlapi ah khin Abraham le a pawng i Lazaruh kha a hun hmuh hna."},"24":{"text":"Cucaah a hun kawh i, “Ka pa Abraham, ka zaangfah tuah. Lazaruh kha hei thlah law a kutdong kha ti ah va hnim seh law ka lei ah hin run ka thlerh seh, zeicahtiah hi mei chungah hin ka ngan a fak tuk hringhran,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abraham nih a thawh i, “Ka fapa, na nun lioah khan thil ṭha phun kip kha pek na si i Lazaruh nih khan thil ṭhalo vialte a co kha philh hlah ngat; sihmanhsehlaw atu cu anih cu nuam tein a um i nang cu nganfak ngaiin na um."},"26":{"text":"Cu pinah; kan karlak ah horkuang thukpi a um i cucaah hikalei in nangmah leiah tan a duhmi nih khan an tan kho lo i cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in nangmah lei in kanmah leiah rat a duhmi zong an ra kho ve lo,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cun mirumpa nih cun a thawh i, “Asi, ka pa, Lazaruh cu ka pa inn ah khan hun thlah ko,"},"28":{"text":"cuka ah cun chuahpi unau panga ka ngei hna i hung kal seh law annih tal cu hi nganfah innak hmun ah hin an rat nakhnga lo ralrinnak hung pe hna seh,” a ti."},"29":{"text":"Abraham nih cun aa thawh i, “Na unau hna ralrinnak petu dingah cun Moses le profet hna an um ko ṭung; an chimmi kha na unau hna nih cun ngai ko hna ngat seh,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Mirumpa nih cun a hun leh i, “Ka pa, Abraham, cucu a za lo, mi pakhatkhat cu thihnak in a thawh i an sin i a va kal ahcun an nunning kha an ṭhinh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Abraham nih, “Moses le profet kha an bia an ngaih hna lo ahcun, mi pakhatkhat cu thihnak in a thawh hmanh ah an zum hlei lai lo,” a ti."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih a zultu kha a chimh hna i, “Sualnak chungah mi a tlaktertu thil cu an um ṭheo lai; sihmanhsehlaw cu thil hna a umtertu caah cun ṭihnung a va si dah!","title":"Sualnak (Mat 18.6-7 , 21-22 ; Mar 9.42)"},"2":{"text":"Hi ngakchia tete hna lak i pakhat hmanh hi va sualter nakin cu pa cu a hngawng ah facang rialnak lungtumpi i thlaih seh law rilipi chungah hlonh si seh law a caah a ṭha deuh hnga."},"3":{"text":"I ralring ko u. “Na unau nih a sual ahcun va mawhchiat, aa ngaihchih ahcun va ngaithiam.","ref":"Mat 18.15"},"4":{"text":"Ni khat ah na cungah voi sarih a sual i voi sarih ningin, ‘Kaa ngaichih,’ a ti ahcun na ngaihthiam hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih khan Bawipa cu, “Kan zumhnak hi nganter deuh tuah,” an ti.","title":"Zumhnak"},"6":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a leh hna i, “Nannih nih anṭam ci ngaw zumhnak nan ngeih ahcun, hi thingtheihmung kung hi, ‘Na hram in i phawi law rili ah khin vaa phun,’ nan ti ah nan nawl an ngaih ko hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Abiana ah sinum pakhat hei ngei u law, cu nan sinum cu lei hei thuang seh law, asiloah, tuu hei khal seh law, lo in inn i a hung tlun tikah, ‘I rianranh law rawl kha ei,’ nan ti lai maw?","title":"Sinum Ṭuanvo"},"8":{"text":"Ti hlah. Nan i thawh lai i, ‘Ka zanriah kha hei tim, cun rawl ka ei lio le ka din lioah na angki leng kha i hruk law ka bultawl, cu hnuah cun na ei ve te lai i na din ve te lai,’ nan ti deuh lai."},"9":{"text":"Na tuah awk a si timi a tuah ruangah sinum nih cun, na tuahmi a ṭha, tiin lawmhnak hmuh awk a si i mei?"},"10":{"text":"Nannih zong cu bantuk cu nan si ve ko, tuah u tiah fialmi rian kha nan tuah dih tikah, ‘Kannih cu sal santlailo kan si, kan tuah awk hnga rian a simi lawng pei kan tuah ko cu,’ va ti u,” tiah a ti hna."},"11":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jerusalem khua lei i a kalpah ah khan Samaria le Galilee karlak in a kal.","title":"Thinghmui Pahra A Damter Hna"},"12":{"text":"Khua pakhat chungah hin a va lut i cuka ah cun thinghmuimi pahra an rak um i cu hna nih cun an rak ton. Lamhlatpi khin an dir i,"},"13":{"text":"“Jesuh Bawipa, kan zaangfah tuah,” tiah an au."},"14":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a hmuh hna i, “Va kal u law tlangbawi nih khan rak in zoh hna seh,” tiah a ti hna. An kalpah cun lampi ah cun an thiang.","ref":"Lev 14.1-32"},"15":{"text":"An lak i pakhat cu ka dam cang ti a hngalh tikah khan a ra kir i Pathian kha fak piin a thangṭhat."},"16":{"text":"Jesuh ke hram ah khan vawlei ah a bawk i Jesuh cu a lawmh. Cu pa cu Samaria mi a si."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh i, “An pahra ningin an dam lo maw? Pakua tah khuazei ah dah an si kun?"},"18":{"text":"Annih zong ra kir in Pathian kha an thangṭhat kho lo maw? Hi ramdang mipa lawng hi maw a ra kho?” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih amah cu a thawh i, “Tho law kal tuah; na zumhnak nih an damter cang,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Farasi mi a cheu nih Jesuh cu, zeitik ah dah Pathian Pennak cu a tlun lai, tiah an hal. Anih nih a leh hna i, “Pathian Pennak cu hmuh awkin a ra lo.","title":"Pathian Pennak A Ratnak Kong (Mat 24.23-28 , 37-41)"},"21":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih, ‘Zohhmanh, hika ah a um hih, khika ah a um khih,’ an ti kho lo; zeicahtiah Pathian Pennak cu nan chungah pei a um cu,” tiah a ti hna."},"22":{"text":"Cun a zultu kha a thawh hna i, “Nannih nih, Mi Fapa ni kha hmuh kan hei duh dah, nan ti caan a phan te lai; sihmanhsehlaw nan hmu lai lo."},"23":{"text":"‘Khika lei khi zohhmanh u, hika lei hi zohhmanh u,’ tiah aan timi hna an um lai. Sihmanhsehlaw cu zoh awkah cun va chuak hlah u."},"24":{"text":"Nimtlau cu vankam khattelei kam in khattelei kamah a lek i van cu a ceuh bantuk khin Mi Fapa cu amah ni ah cun a si ve lai."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a intuar hmasat le tu chan mi hna nih an hlawt hmasa kha a herh lai."},"26":{"text":"Noah chan ah a rak si bantuk khan Mi Fapa chan zongah a si ve lai.","ref":"Gen 6.5-8"},"27":{"text":"Noah nih lawng chungah a luh i buanchukcho kha a tlun i an thih dih ni tiang hrimhrim kha, an ei an ding an i ṭhi an i um ko.","ref":"Gen 6.5-8"},"28":{"text":"Lot chan i a rak si bantuk khan a si ve lai. An ei, an ding, an i caw an i zuarh, thlaici an cing, inn an sa.","ref":"Gen 18.20—19.25"},"29":{"text":"Lot cu Sodom in a chuah ni ah khan mei le kat cu vancung in a rung sur i a thah dih hna."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun Mi Fapa a langh ni ah cun a si ve lai."},"31":{"text":"“A inn cung i a ummipa cu a inn chung i a ummi thil lak awkah ṭum hlah seh; cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in lo i a ummipa cu inn ah tlung hlah seh.","ref":"Mat 24.17-18; Mar 13.15-16"},"32":{"text":"Lot nupi kha va philh hlah u.","ref":"Gen 19.26"},"33":{"text":"Amah nunnak khamh aa zuammi cu a nunnak cu a sung lai; a nunnak a sungmi nih cun a nunnak cu a khamh lai.","ref":"Mat 10.39; 16.25; Mar 8.35; Luk 9.24; Jhn 12.25"},"34":{"text":"Hihi kan chimh hna: cu zan ah cun mi pahnih ihkhun pakhat ah a rak itmi an um lai, pakhat cu lak a si lai i pakhat cu nganhtak a si lai."},"35":{"text":"Nu pahnih kha fang an su ṭi lai, pakhat cu lak a si lai i pakhat cu chiahtak a si lai."},"36":{"text":"Pa pahnih lo ah rian a ṭuanmi an um lai, pakhat lak a si lai i pakhat cu chiahtak a si lai,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Amah cu a zultu nih cun, “Bawipa, khuazei ah dah?” tiah an hal i, “Saruak umnak ah langta an i pum tawn,” tiah a leh hna."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lungdong loin thla nan cam zungzal awk a si, ti cawnpiaknak caah Jesuh nih hi bianabia hi a chimh hna.","title":"Nuhmeinu le Biaceihtu Bawi Bianabia"},"2":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Khua pakhat ah hin Pathian zong a ṭih lo i mi zong a hmaizah lomi biaceihtu bawi pakhat a rak um."},"3":{"text":"Cun cuka khua ah cun nuhmei pakhat a um ve i ka bia kha ka ceihpiak tuah, tiah atu le atu a ra ti lengmang."},"4":{"text":"Biaceihtu nih caan saupi chung cu a al lengmang,"},"5":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak ah cun, ‘Pathian cu ka ṭih lo i minung kha ka hmaizah hna lo nain, hi nuhmeinu nih hin hnahnawhnak a ka pek lengmang caah a bia cu ka ceihpiak ko lai; cu lo ahcun a ra lengmang ko lai i ka re lam a ka theihter chin lai,’ a ti,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih cun a peh ṭhan i, “A ding lomi biaceihtu bawi nih a chimmi cu nan theih cang."},"7":{"text":"Pathian nih tah amah a mi hna chunzan hlan in a sinah bawmh hal awkah a au lengmangmi hna cu thiamcoh loin maw a um hna hnga? Anmah bawmh awkah cun a khul a nuar ko hnga maw?"},"8":{"text":"Hihi kan chimh hna: anmah cu thiam a coh hna lai i cucu khulrang tein a tuah lai. Sihmanhsehlaw Mi Fapa nih a rat tikah vawlei ah hin zumhnak a hmu te hnga maw?” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Anmah kha kan ṭha tiah aa ruat i midang vialte kha zei a rel lomi hna sinah Jesuh nih hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chim.","title":"Farasi Mi le Ngunkhuai Khawltu Bianabia"},"10":{"text":"“Mi pahnih cu Biakinn i thlacam awkah an hung kal; pakhat pa cu Farasi mi a si i a dang cu ngunkhuai khawltu a si."},"11":{"text":"Farasi pa cu a dir i hi bantukin thla a cam: ‘Maw Pathian, kei cu midang bantukin hak a kaumi, lih a chimmi, nu le pa sualnak a tuahmi, ka si lo caah nangmah cu kan lawmh; cun khi ngunkhuai khawltupa bantuk zong khi ka si lo caah kan lawmh fawn."},"12":{"text":"Zarh khat chungah voi hnih lengmang rawl ka ul i chawva ka hmuhmi vialte cheu hra cheu khat kan pek,’ tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ngunkhuai khawltupa cu lamhlatpi ah khin a dir i vanlei hmanh zoh ngam loin a ṭang aa cum i, ‘Maw Pathian, kei misual cungah hin zaangfahnak ngei ko,’ tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Hihi kan chimh hna: Farasi mipa kha si loin hi pa tu hi a sualnak ngaihthiam in inn ah a ṭinmi cu a si. Zeicahtiah amah le amah aa ngantermi cu ṭhumh an si lai i mi tangah aa dormi cu mi ngan ah ser an si lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 23.12; Luk 14.11"},"15":{"text":"Mi cheu nih an fale kha an cung i a kut a chuanpiak hna nakhnga Jesuh sinah khan an ratpi hna. Sihmanhsehlaw a zultu hna nih khan an rak hmuh hna i an sik hna.","title":"Jesuh Nih Ngakchia Thluachuah A Pek Hna (Mat 19.13-15 ; Mar 10.13-16)"},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih ngakchia cu a auh hna i, “Ngakchia kha ka sinah ratter ko hna u. Annih kha dawn hna hlah u, zeicahtiah Pathian Pennak cu hi bantuk mi hna ta hi pei a si cu."},"17":{"text":"Hihi philh hlah u: Pathian Pennak hi ngakchia nih a rak i cohlan bantukin a cohlang lomi cu, cu Pennak chungah cun an lut bal lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Judah mi haotu pakhat nih a thawh i, “A ṭhami saya, zungzal nunnak hmuh awkah zeidah ka tuah lai?” tiah a ti.","title":"Mirumpa (Mat 9.16-30 ; Mar 10.17-31)"},"19":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh i, “Zeicahdah miṭha tiah na ka ti?” tiah a hal i, “Pathian dah ti lo cu ahohmanh miṭha an um ṭung lo."},"20":{"text":"Nawlbia kha na hngalh ko ṭung hna: Va cung in siseh, nupi cung in siseh, sual hlah, lainawng hlah, fir hlah, lih chim hlah, na nu le na pa upat hna, ti pei an si kha,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 20.12-16; Deu 5.16-20"},"21":{"text":"Mipa nih cun aa thawh i, “Hi nawlbia vialte hi cu ka ngakchiat tein ka zulh lengmang cang hna,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Hi bia cu Jesuh nih a theih tikah, “Pakhat te na bau kun. Na ngeihmi vialte kha va zuar law tangka cu sifakmi kha va ṭhen hna, cun vancung khua ah chawva na ngei lai; cun ra law ka zul,” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi bia cu mipa nih khan a theih tikah a ngaih a chia ngaingai, zeicahtiah amah cu mirum ngaingai a si."},"24":{"text":"Jesuh nih a ngaih a chiat kha a hmuh tikah aa thawh i, “Mirum caah cun Pathian Pennak chung i luh hi a va har hringhran dah."},"25":{"text":"Kalauk ṭhimka chung i luh nakin mirummi Pathian Pennak chung luh cu a har deuh suaumau,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"A bia a theimi nih cun an hal i, “Ahodah khamhnak cu a hmu kho kun lai,” an ti."},"27":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Minung tuah khawh lomi hi Pathian nih cun a tuah khawh ko,” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Cun Peter nih aa thawh i, “Zohhmanh, kannih cu nangmah zulh awkah kan inn kha kan chuahtak ko hna,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh i, “Asi, na chimmi cu ahmaan, cun hihi kan chimh hna: Pathian Pennak ruangah inn siseh, nupi siseh, unau siseh, nu le pa si hna seh, fale si hna seh, a kaltakmi cu"},"30":{"text":"tu chan ah hin a let tampi in rulh an si lai i hmai chan ah zungzal nunnak an hmuh lai,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih zultu pahleihnih kha a dang tein a kalpi hna i, “Ngai hmanh u, Jerusalem ah kan kal lai i khika ah profet hna nih Mi Fapa kong an ṭialmi paohpaoh kha a tling dih lai.","title":"A Thihnak Kong A Voi Thumnak A Chim (Mat 20.17-19 ; Mar 10.32-34)"},"32":{"text":"Jentail mi hna kut ah pek ka si lai i annih nih cun capo ah an ka saih lai i an ka nihsawh lai i cil an ka chak lai."},"33":{"text":"Fung in an ka tuk lai i an ka thah lai, sihmanhsehlaw ni thum ni ah nunnak ah ka tho ṭhan lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"34":{"text":"A zultu hna nih khan hi thil kong hi zeihmanh an hngal lo; a bia sullam kha thuhkanh an si i Jesuh nih a chimmi a sullam kha an hngal lo."},"35":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jeriko khua kha a hei phan deng i awkhlawh pakhat a mit a cawmi hi lam pawngah a rak ṭhu i thil a hal hna.","title":"Mitcaw Awkhlawh A Damter (Mat 20.29-34 ; Mar 10.46-52)"},"36":{"text":"Mizapi an kal lulhmalh kha a theih tikah “Hihi zeidah a si?” tiah a hal hna."},"37":{"text":"Annih nih, “Nazareth khuami Jesuh a lanh lio a si,” tiah an leh."},"38":{"text":"Cun a au i, “Jesuh, David Fapa, ka zaangfah tuah,” a ti."},"39":{"text":"Hmai i a ummi hna nih cun an sik i dai tein um ko, an ti. Sihmanhsehlaw thang chinchin in a au i, “David Fapa, ka zaangfah tuah,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh cu a dir i mitcawpa cu ka sinah ratpi u tiah a ti. A pawng a ra phak tikah Jesuh nih a thawh i,"},"41":{"text":"“Zeidah ka tuahpiak seh ti na ka duh?” tiah a hal. “Bawipa, khua hmuh ṭhan ka duh,” tiah a leh."},"42":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih a thawh i, “Hmu tuah, na zumhnak nih an damter cang,” tiah a ti."},"43":{"text":"Hmakhatte ah khua cu a hun hmu kho i Jesuh kha a zulh i Pathian kha a lawmh. Mizapi nih cucu an hmuh tikah Pathian kha an thangṭhat."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Jeriko khua ah cun a vung lut i khua cu a hei tan.","title":"Jesuh le Zakia"},"2":{"text":"Cuka ah cun ngunkhuai khawltu upa bik pakhat a min Zakia a simi a rak um i amah cu mirum a si."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh cu ahodah a si hnga ti kha hngalh a duh caah hmuh aa zuam i asinain amah cu miniamte a si caah le mizapi nih an phenh caah a hmu kho lo."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah cun hmaiah khan a rak tli i saikamor thingkung pakhat ah, cukalei i a kalmi Jesuh hmuh duh ah cun a rak kai."},"5":{"text":"Cuka hmun cu a phak tikah Jesuh nih cun cunglei kha a hun zoh i Zakia cu, “Zakia, khulrang in rung ṭum, na inn ah kan tlung lai,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Zakia cu, khulrang in a ṭum i lunglawmhnak in a inn ah cun a tlunter."},"7":{"text":"Cu a hmumi vialte cu an zai i, “Hi pa hi misual mi inn i tlun awkah a kal,” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Zakia cu a dir i Bawipa cu, “Bawipa, ngaihmanh, misifak caah ka ngeihmi thil hnarcheu ka pek lai; cun ka hlenmi hna an um ahcun a let li in ka cham hna lai,” tiah a si."},"9":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh i, “Nihin ah hi inn ah khamhnak a phan; hi pa zong hi Abraham tefa a si ve."},"10":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Mi Fapa cu a tlaumi kawl awk le khamh awkah a ra,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 18.11"},"11":{"text":"Hi bia a chimmi a theimi hna sinah khan hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chim. Jerusalem khua kha a hei phanh dengmang cang caah Pathian Pennak kha a lang hnik lengmang cang tiah an ruah.","title":"Sui Tangka Tahchunhnak (Mat 25.14-30)","ref":"Mat 25.14-30"},"12":{"text":"Cucaah a thawh hna i, “Bawi pakhat cu ram hlapi pakhat ah a kal i cuka ram i siangpahrang a si hnuah inn ah ra tlun ṭhan aa tim."},"13":{"text":"A kal hlanah a sal pahra kha a kawh hna i sui tangka phar khat cio a pek hna. Cun a thawh hna i, ‘Ka um lo karah hi hin chaw rak let u,’ a ti hna."},"14":{"text":"A ram mi nih cun amah cu an huat i, ‘Hi pa hi kan siangpahrang si awkah kan duh lo,’ tiin lamkal a hnu in an hei thlah hna."},"15":{"text":"Cu bawi cu siangpahrang ah cun an rak ser i a ra kir. Tangka a pekmi sal hna kha hmakhatte ah a auh hna i, zeizat dah nan hmuh tiah a hal hna."},"16":{"text":"A hmasa bikpa kha a hung chuak i, ‘Bawipa, na ka pekmi sui tangka phar khat khan sui tangka phar hra ka hmuh,’ tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Aa thawh i, ‘A ṭha, nangmah cu sal ṭha na si. Thil hmete ah zumhawktlak na si caah khua pahra uktu ah kan chiah lai,’ a ti."},"18":{"text":"A pahnihnak sal kha a ra i, ‘Bawipa, na ka pekmi sui tangka phar khat khan sui tangka phar nga ka hmuh,’ tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Amah zong cu a thawh i, ‘Khua panga uktu na si lai,’ tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun a dang sal pakhat kha a ra i, ‘Bawipa, na sui tangka kha a um ko; puanchia in ka fun i ka chiah ko."},"21":{"text":"Nangmah cu mikhepkha na si caah kan ṭih, Nangmah ta a si lomi kha na lak i thlaici na tuh lonak hmun ah na zun tawn,’ tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Amah cu a thawh i, ‘Sal ṭhalo. Nangmah bia lila cu nangmah biaceihnak ah ka hman lai. Nangmah nih keimah cu mikhepkha ka si le ka ta a si lomi a la tawn i ka tuh lonak hmun i a zun tawntu ka si cu na hngalh."},"23":{"text":"A si kun ahcun zeicahdah tangka cu tangka chiahnak beng ah na rak chiah lo? Rak chia law cu, ka kir tikah hin a miak he ka hmu hnga lo maw?’ tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Cuka i a dirmi hna cu a thawh hna i, ‘Amah cu sui tangka kha chut u law phar hra a ngeimi pa kha va pe u,’ a ti hna."},"25":{"text":"Annih nih an thawh i, ‘Bawipa, anih cu phar hra a ngeih cang ṭung,’ an ti."},"26":{"text":"Annih cu a leh hna i, ‘A ngeimi paoh kha tam chin chap an si lai i a ngei lomi kha a ngeihmi hnihchunte hmanh kha chuh an si lai.","ref":"Mat 13.12; Mar 4.25; Luk 8.18"},"27":{"text":"Cun an siangpahrang si awkah a ka duh lotu ka ral hna kha cu, hika ah hin ratpi hna u law ka hmaiah that hna u, a ti,’ ” tiah a ti."},"28":{"text":"Jesuh nih hi bianabia a chim dih in an hmaiah cun Jerusalem khua lei ah khan a kal.","title":"Jerusalem Ah Sunparnak In A Lut (Mat 21.1-11 ; Mar 11.1-11 ; Jhn 12.12-19)"},"29":{"text":"Oliv Tlang i Bethfeih le Bethani khua kha a phak deng tikah a zultu pahnih kha hmaiah a hei thlah hna i,"},"30":{"text":"“Nan hmai khua ah khin rak kal u law nan va luhpah ah khin cit bal rih lomi laafa nan hmuh lai. Cucu a hri va phoih u law hika ah hin ratpi u."},"31":{"text":"Pakhatkhat nih, ‘Zeicahdah mah khakha a hri nan phoih?’ an in ti hna ahcun, ‘Bawipa nih a herh,’ tiah va ti ko u,” tiah a ti hna."},"32":{"text":"An va kal i Jesuh nih a chimh hna ningte cun zeizong vialte kha an va hmuh."},"33":{"text":"Laafate cu an phoih lioah khan a ngeitu hna nih khan, “Zeicahdah nan phoih?” tiah an ti hna."},"34":{"text":"Annih nih, “Bawipa nih a herh,” tiah an leh hna i"},"35":{"text":"laafate cu Jesuh sinah khan an kalpi. Cun laa cungah khan an puan an danh i Jesuh cu an citter."},"36":{"text":"A kalnak ah khan lam ah puan kha an phah."},"37":{"text":"Jerusalem khua kha a hei naih i lam cu Oliv Tlang in chuk i a vung zuannak ah khan a zultu mibu nganpi nih cun, an hmuhmi thil lianngan vialte ruangah khan Pathian cu an lawmh i aw fak piin an thangṭhat."},"38":{"text":"“Bawipa min in a rami siangpahrang cu Pathian nih thluachuahnak pe ko seh. Vancung ah daihnak um seh law, Pathian cu sunparnak pek si ko seh,” tiah an au.","ref":"Slm 118.26"},"39":{"text":"Cun mizapi chung cun Farasi mi a cheukhat hna nih Jesuh cu an hun thawh i, “Saya, na zultu hna hi daihter hna,” an ti."},"40":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun a leh hna i, “Hi hna hi an daih ahcun lung hrimhrim hi an au lai,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Khuapi cu a hei naih chin lengmang i a hei hmuh tikah a ṭah i,","title":"Jesuh Nih Jerusalem A Ṭah"},"42":{"text":"“Nihin ah hin daihnak caah zeidah a herh ti kha hei hngal law cu mu! Sihmanhsehlaw cucu na hmu kho ṭung lo."},"43":{"text":"Zeicahtiah na ral nih raltuknak chuntlung in an in kulh i an in hren i a kenkip in an in luhhnawh caan kha a phan lai."},"44":{"text":"Nangmah le na vampang kulh chung i a ummi minung hna cu an in hrawh dih cikcek hna lai: Pathian cu nangmah khamh awkah a rat caan kha na hngalh lo caah cuka hmun ah cun aa chonhmi lung pakhat hmanh leh loin an kaltakmi a um lai lo.”"},"45":{"text":"Jesuh cu Biakinn chungah khan a vung lut i chawdawr pawl kha a ṭhawl hna i,","title":"Jesuh Cu Biakinn Ah A Kal (Mat 21.12-17 ; Mar 11.15-19 ; Jhn 2.13-21)"},"46":{"text":"“Cathiang chungah, ‘Pathian nih ka inn cu thlacamnak inn a si lai,’ a ti, tiah aa ṭial. Sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih cun mifir thuhnak kua ah nan ser cang,” a ti hna.","ref":"Isa 56.7; Jer 7.11"},"47":{"text":"Jesuh nih Biakinn ah khan nifate in a cawnpiak hna. Tlangbawi upa pawl hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le hruaitu pawl nih khan thah an duh,","ref":"Luk 21.37"},"48":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw mi vialte nih khan a bia cu an ngaih i pakhat hrelh hmanh kha an duh lo caah annih nih cu tuahnak ding caah cun lam an hmu kho lo."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat cu Jesuh cu Biakinn i mizapi a cawnpiak lio hna le Thawngṭha kong a chimh lio hna ah tlangbawi upa pawl le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le upa pawl kha an ra i,","title":"Jesuh Cu A Nawl Ngeihnak Kha An Hal (Mat 21.23-27 ; Mar 11.27-33)"},"2":{"text":"“Hi thil tuah khawhnak dingah hin zei nawl dah na ngeih? Aho nih dah nawl an pek, kan chim?” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Bia pakhat in hal ve hna ning."},"4":{"text":"Johan nih tipil pek khawhnak nawl a ngeihmi kha Pathian sin i a hmuhmi maw a si, minung sin i a hmuhmi dah a si, ka chim tuah u?” tiah a ti hna."},"5":{"text":"Annih cu pakhat le pakhat kha an i al i. “Zeitindah kan ti lai? ‘Pathian sinin,’ kan ti ahcun, ‘A si ahcun zeicahdah Johan cu nan zumh kun lo?’ a kan ti lai."},"6":{"text":"Minung sinin; kan ti ahcun, hika i a ummi vialte nih hin Johan cu profet a si hrimhrim tiah an zumh caah lung in an kan cheh lai,” an ti."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah an i thawh i, “Khuazei in dik a hmuh kan hngal lo,” an ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih, “A si ahcun, kei zong nih zei nawl in dah hi thil hi ka tuah hna ti kha kan chim ve hna lai lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"9":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih mizapi cu hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chimh hna. Aa thawh i, “Mipa pakhat nih mitsur dum pakhat a tuah i rianṭuantu hna sinah khan a hlanh i khual a tlawng i saupi a rau.","title":"Mitsur Dum Chung Rianṭuantu Bianabia (Mat 21.33-46 ; Mar 12.1-12)","ref":"Isa 5.1"},"10":{"text":"Mitsur thei lawh caan kha a phak tikah rianṭuantu pawl sinah khan a sal pakhat a hei thlah i ka covo a si hngami kha ka pe ve u tiah a hei hal hna. Sihmanhsehlaw rianṭuantu hna nih khan a sal cu an rak velh i a lawng in an kirter."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah a dang a sal pakhat a hei thlah ṭhan, sihmanhsehlaw hi pa zong cu an rak velh i a lawngin an kirter ṭhiamṭhiam."},"12":{"text":"Cun a sal pathumnak kha a hei thlah ṭhan i amah zong cu an rak ṭhuat i an rak ṭhawl."},"13":{"text":"Cu tikah dum ngeitu nih cun aa thawh i, ‘Zeitindah ka tuah lai? Ka dawtmi ka fapa thengte hi ka hei thlah lai; amah cu an rak hmaizah ṭheo lai,’ tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah cu rianṭuantu pawl nih khan an rak hmuh tikah pakhat le pakhat cu an i ruah i, ‘Hi pa hi dum ngeitu fapa a si. That u sih law dum hi kanmah ta ah a cang lai,’ an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah dum lengah khan an chuah i an thah. Cucaah dum ngeitu nih khan dum rianṭuantu hna kha zeitindah a ti hna lai?"},"16":{"text":"Amah cu a ra lai i cu hna cu a thah hna lai i dum cu midang kha a zohter hna lai,” tiah a ti. Cucu mizapi nih khan an theih tikah, “Si sawh hlah seh,” an ti."},"17":{"text":"Jesuh nih annih cu a zoh hna i, “ ‘Inn satu nih san a tlai lo tiin an hlawtmi lung kha innkil lung ah a cang,’ tiin Cathiang chungah a ummi bia hi tah a sullam zeidah a si kun?” tiah a hal hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Cu lung cung i a tlami paoh cu a kuai cikcek lai i cu lung nih a rialmi hna paoh cu leidip bantukin an dip lai,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna le tlangbawi upa hna nih khan Jesuh cu tlaih colh an duh, zeicahtiah hi bianabia hi kanmah a kan chimhnawh ti kha an i hngalh, sihmanhsehlaw mizapi kha an ṭih hna.","title":"Ngunkhuai Peknak Kong Ah Biahalnak (Mat 22.15-22 ; Mar 12.13-17)"},"20":{"text":"Cucaah caan rem tu kha an bawh i mi ngiatu an thlah hna. “Zumh awktlakmi bantukin nan i umter lai i bia nan hal lai. A bia kha tlaih nan i zuam lai i cu a bia cu nawlngeitu mangki bawi sin i phakpinak ding ca i sonhtarhnak ah kan hman lai,” an ti hna."},"21":{"text":"Cu mingiatu hna nih cun Jesuh cu an thawh i, “Saya, na chimmi le na cawnpiaknak hi ahmaan tiah kan hngalh. Ahohmanh an hmai na zoh hlei fawn hna lo, Pathian nih minung caah a herh a timi biatak kha na cawnpiak ko hna."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah cun kan chim tuah, Rom Siangpahrang sin i ngunkhuai pek hi kan Phung he aa ralchanhmi a si maw si lo?” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih an zernak cu tleng lakin a rak hmuh ṭung i cucaah cun a thawh hna i,"},"24":{"text":"“Ngun tangka phar khat in ka hmuh sak tuah u. Aho hmai le min dah a cuang?” tiah a ti hna."},"25":{"text":"Annih nih, “Siangpahrang hmai le min a cuang,” tiah an leh. Cucaah Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “A si ahcun, Siangpahrang ta a simi cu Siangpahrang kha pe ko u, Pathian ta a simi cu Pathian kha pe ko u,” tiah a ti hna."},"26":{"text":"Cuticun zapi lak i tlaih an i zuamnak cu pakpalawng ah a cang i a lehnak hna cu an khuaruah a har i dai tein an um."},"27":{"text":"Sadusi mi tlawmpal kha Jesuh sinah cun an ra. (Annih cu minung hi thihnak in an tho ṭhan lai lo tiah a timi an si). Annih nih amah cu an thawh i,","title":"Thihnak In Thawh Ṭhannak Kong Biahalnak (Mat 22.23-33 ; Mar 12.18-27)","ref":"Lam 23.8"},"28":{"text":"“Saya, Moses nih nawlbia a kan ṭialpiak i cu nawlbia chungah cun, ‘Mipa pakhatkhat cu a thih i a nupi kha fa ngei loin a roh ahcun, cu pa a unau nih cun, cu nu cu a ṭhit lai, mithi mipa caah khan fa a hrinpiak khawh nakhnga,’ a ti.","ref":"Deu 25.5"},"29":{"text":"Voi khat cu unau pasarih an um; an upa bik cu nupi a ṭhi i fa ngei loin a thi."},"30":{"text":"Cu tikah apahnihnak pa nih khan a ṭhit i fa ngei loin a thihtak ve."},"31":{"text":"Cun apathumnak pa nih khan a ṭhit hoi i fa ngei loin a thihtak ṭhiamṭhiam. Cu bantuk cun an pasarih ningte cun a si — fa ngei loin an thi dih."},"32":{"text":"A hmanung bik ah minu zong cu a thi ve."},"33":{"text":"Mithi hna cu an thawh ṭhan ni ah, amah cu aho nupi cu dah a si lai? An pasarih tein an ṭhit ṭung?” an ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh hna i, “Tu chan mi hna hi cu an i ṭhi i an i um;"},"35":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw thihnak in thawh ṭhanter awktlak a simi hna le a ra lai dingmi chan i um awkah aa tlakmi hna cu an i ṭhi an i um lo."},"36":{"text":"Annih cu vancungmi bantuk an si i an thi kho lo. Annih cu thihnak in thawh ṭhantermi an si cang caah Pathian fa an si."},"37":{"text":"Moses nih a thimi hna cu nunnak ah thawhter ṭhan an si lai ti cu fiang tein a chim ko. A alhmi burbuk kong a chimnak ah khan aa thawh i, ‘Bawipa cu Abraham Pathian, Isak Pathian Jakob Pathian a si,’ a ti.","ref":"Exo 3.6"},"38":{"text":"Cu nih cun Pathian cu a nungmi hna Pathian a si i a thimi hna Pathian a si lo ti kha a fiang tein a langhter — zeicahtiah annih cu amah sinah cun an nung dih,” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya a cheu nih khan an hun i thawh i, “Saya, na lehnak hna cu a ṭha ngaingai,” an ti."},"40":{"text":"Zeicahtiah amah cu bia an hal ngam lo."},"41":{"text":"Jesuh nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Zeitindah Messiah cu David fapa a si lai, tiah an ti khawh?","title":"Messiah Kong Biahalnak (Mat 22.41-46 ; Mar 12.35-37)"},"42":{"text":"Zeicahtiah David hrimhrim nih pei, ‘Bawipa nih ka Bawipa cu,","ref":"Slm 110.1"},"43":{"text":"Na ral vialte hna cu na ke tang i kelamh ah ka chiah hna hlantiang Ka orhlei kamah hin ṭhu tuah,’ tiah Salm cauk chungah a ti cu."},"44":{"text":"David nih khan ‘Bawipa’ tiah a ti ṭung ahcun, zeitindah Messiah cu David fapa cu a si khawh lai?” tiah a ti."},"45":{"text":"Mizapi nih cun an dihlak in an ngaih ko lioah khan Jesuh nih a zultu kha a thawh hna i,","title":"Phungbia Cawnpiaktu Saya A Sik Hna (Mat 23.1-36 ; Mar 12.38-40)"},"46":{"text":"“Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya pawl kha i ralring hna u; annih cu angkifual pipi i hruk in chawh a duhmi, chawdawrnak hmun ah mi nih hmaizahnak in ka chawnbia hna seh ti a duhmi, pumhnak i ṭhutnak ṭha aa cuhmi, puai i hmun ṭha aa hammi an si;"},"47":{"text":"mi nih ka hmu hna seh ti duh ah thla sau pipi in an cam, sihmanhsehlaw nuhmei kha an thilri le an inn tiangin an chuh ṭung hna. Dantatnak an hmuh ding cu a fak chinchinmi a si ko lai,” tiah a ti."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh nih a pawngkam kha a hei zoh i Biakinn tangka chiahnak ah mirum mi nih an thawhlawm an thlak kha a hmuh hna;","title":"Nuhmeinu Thawhlawm (Mar 12.41-44)"},"2":{"text":"cun a si a fak ngaingaimi nuhmeinu zong nih phaisa sen pahnihte a thlak ve kha a hmuh."},"3":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Hihi kan chimh hna: Hi a si a fakmi nuhmeinu nih hin a taktak ti ahcun hawi dang vialte nakin tam deuh a sanh."},"4":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a dang tham nih cun an chawva a hleivuang kha pei an pek ko cu, sihmanhsehlaw hi nu nih hin cun, a si a fak na tein, a nunnak ding ca i aa chiahmi kha pei a dihlak in a pek cu,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"An lak i mi a cheu nih khan Biakinn kong kha an rak ceih i aa dawhnak kong le a lung ṭhaṭha hna le Pathian sin i laksawng an pekchanhmi kong kha an rak chim.","title":"Jesuh Nih Biakinn Rawhnak Kong A Chim (Mat 24.1-2 ; Mar 13.1-2)"},"6":{"text":"Jesuh nih aa thawh i, “Mah hi vialte hi nan hmuh, sihmanhsehlaw hika i lung vialte hi pakhat hmanh an umnak hmun cio i kaltak loin hlonh an si dih lai caan a tlung lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Saya, zeitik ah dah mah hihi a si lai? Cun a caan a phan cang ti a langhtertu dingah zei hmelchunhnak dah a um lai?” tiah an hal.","title":"Harnak le Hremnak (Mat 24.3-14 ; Mar 13.3-13)"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “I ralring u; ahohmanh i hlenter hna hlah u. Zeicahtiah mi tampi keimah min put in an ra lai i, ‘Keimah hi amah cu ka si,’ an ti lai i ‘A caan cu a phan cang,’ an ti lai. Sihmanhsehlaw zul hna hlah u."},"9":{"text":"Raldohnak le ralthawhnak kong nan theih tikah nan thinphang hlah u; cu bantuk thil cu a um hmasa hrim awk a si, sihmanhsehlaw a donghnak a nai cang tinak a si theng lo,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun aa thawh ṭhan i, “Ram pakhat le pakhat an i do lai, cozah pakhat le pakhat an i tu lai;"},"11":{"text":"hmun kip ah ṭih a nungmi lihnin le mangṭam le ngal-eu zawtnak a tlung lai; thil ṭihnung le hmelchunhnak ngan pipi kha van in an lang lai."},"12":{"text":"“Hi thil vialte an tlun hlanah hin nannih cu tlaihkhih nan tong lai i hremnak nan ing lai; pumhnak inn ah khan biaceih awkah an in chuahpi hna lai i thong ah an in thlak hna lai; keimah ruangah siangpahrang hna hmaiah le uktu bawi hna hmaiah an in chuahpi hna lai."},"13":{"text":"Cucu nan ca i Thawngṭha chimnak caan ṭha a si lai."},"14":{"text":"Zeitindah kan i runvennak ding caah bia kan chim lai tiah a hlankan in nan lungre rak thei hlah u;","ref":"Luk 12.11-12"},"15":{"text":"zeicahtiah nan ral ahohmanh nih an in tei hna i an in al khawh hna nakhnga lo, bia le fimnak kha kan pek hna lai."},"16":{"text":"Nan nu le nan pa, nan u nan nau, nan sahlawh nan rualchan, nan hawi nan kom hna nih khan an in rawi hna lai i nannih lak i a cheukhat cu thahnak nan ing lai."},"17":{"text":"Keimah ruangah mi kip nih an in huat hna lai."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nan lu cung samfa fa khat hmanh a tlau lai lo."},"19":{"text":"Fek tein dir ko u, zeicahtiah hitihin pei nan nunnak cu nan khamh lai cu,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih cun, “Nannih nih Jerusalem khua kha ralkap i an kulh nan hmuh tikah a rauh hlanah a rawk cang lai ti kha hngalh u.","title":"Jerusalem Rawhnak Kong (Mat 24.16-21 ; Mar 13.14-19)"},"21":{"text":"Khi tikah Judea ram i a ummi hna cu tlang ah zam hna seh law; khuapi chungah a ummi hna cu chuak hna seh law khualeng ramlak i a ummi hna cu khuapi chungah khan lut hna hlah seh."},"22":{"text":"Zeicahtiah mah hihi ‘Dantatnak Ni’ tiah timi kha a si i Cathiang nih a chimmi vialte cu a tlinnak ding caah umter dingmi an si.","ref":"Hos 9.7"},"23":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun fapawi nu ca le hnuktlai lio nau a ngeimi hna caah zeitluk in dik a har lai. Hi ram chungah hin harnak ṭihnung a tlung lai i hi miphun cungah hin Pathian thinhunnak a tlung lai."},"24":{"text":"Annih cu vainam in thah an si lai i ram kip ah sal ah an hruai hna lai, Jentail mi nih Jerusalem khua cu an naan lai i an caan a dih hlantiang an ke tangah an chiah lai."},"25":{"text":"“Cun ni le thlapa le arfi ah khin hmelchunhnak an lang lai. Vawleicung ram hna cu rili tilet a thomi le a awnmi nih awlokchong in an tuah hna lai.","title":"Mi Fapa Ratnak Kong (Mat 24.29-31 ; Mar 13.24-27)","ref":"Isa 13.10; Eze 32.7; Joe 2.31; Biat 6.12-13"},"26":{"text":"Vawlei cung pumpi i a tlung dingmi thil an ruah ah khan mi cu ṭihnak in a ther in an ther lai; zeicahtiah vancung ṭhawnnak cu an i hnin lai."},"27":{"text":"Cun Mi Fapa cu sunparnak le lianhngannak he khuadawm cung i a rat kha an hmuh lai.","ref":"Dan 7.13; Biat 1.7"},"28":{"text":"Mah hi vialte hi um hram an hun i thawk tikah, dir u law cunglei kha zoh tuah u, zeicahtiah nan tlanhnak cu a nai cang,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih hi tahchunhnak bia hi a chimh hna i, “Theipi kung le thingkung dang hna kha ruat hna hmanh u.","title":"Theipi Kung In Cawnpiaknak (Mat 24.32-35 ; Mar 13.28-31)"},"30":{"text":"Hnahte an hun lak nan hmuh tikah thal a chuak dengmang cang ti kha nan hngalh."},"31":{"text":"Cu bantukin hi thil hna an hung um kha nan hmuh tikah Pathian Pennak cu a nai cang ti kha nan hngalh lai."},"32":{"text":"“Mah hihi philh hlah u: Hi thil vialte hi atu i a nungmi hna an thih dih hlan ah hin a tlung lai."},"33":{"text":"Van le vawlei cu an rawk lai, sihmanhsehlaw ka bia cu an rawk lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"“I ralring tuah u. Zudin sa-einak le khuasak tintuk harnak lawng kha ruat hlah u, cu ti nan si ahcun cu Ni nih cun ruah lopi ah rap bantukin an foih sual hna lai.","title":"Ralrinnak A Herh"},"35":{"text":"Zeicahtiah cu Ni cu vawlei cung i a ummi vialte hna cungah a tlung dingmi a si."},"36":{"text":"Hi a tlung hnga dingmi thil vialte hi him tein chuak lakin nan tan khawh nakhnga, thazang nan ngeih nakhnga le Mi Fapa hmaiah nan dir khawh nakhnga, ralring tein um u law thla va cam zungzal ko u,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Cu hrawng vialte cu Jesuh cu Biakinn ah khan mi kha a cawnpiak hna i zanlei paoh ah khan lengah a chuak i Oliv Tlang ah khan a va riak tawn.","ref":"Luk 19.47"},"38":{"text":"Mi vialte cu amah bia ngaih awkah khan Biakinn ah khan zingka tein an kal tawn."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Lanhtak Puai timi Thilnu Telhlo Changreu Puai kha a nai cang.","title":"Jesuh Rawinak Ding Khuakhannak (Mat 26.1-5 ; Mar 14.1-2 ; Jhn 11.45-53)","ref":"Exo 12.1-27"},"2":{"text":"Tlangbawi upa hna le Phungbia Cawnpiaktu saya hna nih khan mizapi kha an ṭih hna caah zeitindah Jesuh kha a thli in kan thah lai tiah lam an kawl."},"3":{"text":"Khi tikah zultu pahleihnih hna lak i aa tel vemi Judas Iskariot an timi chungah khan Satan cu a lut.","title":"Judas Nih Jesuh Rawi Awk A Hna A Tla (Mat 26.14-16 ; Mar 14.10-11)"},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Judas cu a va kal i tlangbawi upa hna le Biakinn cawngtu hna an bawile hna he khan zeitindah Jesuh cu an sinah a chanh khawh lainak ding kha an ceih."},"5":{"text":"An lung a si ngaingai i phaisa kan in pek lai, tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Cucu Judas zong kha a hna a tla i mizapi hngalh loin zeitindah Jesuh cu an sinah ka lei khawh lai tinak caan rem bawh hram kha a thawk."},"7":{"text":"Thilnu Telhlo Changreu Puai chung i Lanhtak rawl caah tuufa an thah hna ni kha a phan.","title":"Jesuh Nih Lanhtak Zanriah Ei Awk Aa Tim (Mat 26.17-25 ; Mar 14.12-21 ; Jhn 13.21-30)"},"8":{"text":"Jesuh nih Peter le Johan cu a thawh hna i, “Va kal u law Lanhtak zanriah kan ei ding kha va tim tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"9":{"text":"“Khuazei ah dah va tim u tiah na kan duh?” tiah annih nih an ti."},"10":{"text":"Anih nih a thawh hna i. “Ngai hmanh u. Khuapi chung i nan vung luh ah khan ti-um in ti a thanmipa he nan i tong lai. A luhnak inn tiang khan nan hei zulh lai i"},"11":{"text":"cu inn a ngeitu pa cu, ‘Kan sayapa nih, “Khuazei ah dah a ka zultu hna he Lanhtak zanriah kan einak ding khaan cu a si?” a ti,’ tiah nan va hal lai."},"12":{"text":"Cungdot ah khaan kaupi pakhat, ṭhutdan cabuai tlamtling tein an chiahnak an hmuhsak hna lai i cuka ah cun nan va timh lai,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"An va kal i Jesuh nih a chimh hna bantukte khan thil cu an va hmuh hna i annih nih Lanhtak zanriah cu an timh."},"14":{"text":"A caan a phak tikah Jesuh cu lamkaltu hna he khan cabuai ah cun an ṭhu.","title":"Bawipa Zanriah (Mat 26.26-30 ; Mar 14.22-26 ; 1Kor 11.23-25)"},"15":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Sifahnak ka in hlanah hin hi Lanhtak rawl nannih he ei ṭi hi ka duh hringhran."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian Pennak chungah hi rawl hi a sullam taktak langhter a si hlan paoh cu ka ei ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih hrai kha a lak i Pathian sinah lawmhnak bia a chim hnuah, “Hihi i lak u law i hrawm u,"},"18":{"text":"zeicahtiah Pathian Pennak a phanh hlan tiang cu, hi mitsur hang hi ka ding ti lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun chang kha a lak i Pathian sinah lawmhnak bia a chim hnuah a cheu i annih cu a pek hna i, “Hihi ka pum a si, nan ca i ka pekmi cu. Keimah philh lonak ah run tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"20":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in zanriah an ei dih hnuah hrai zong kha a pek hna i “Hi hrai hi nan caah ka thletmi ka thi in khenhchihmi Pathian biakamnak a si.","ref":"Jer 31.31-34"},"21":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw zohhmanh u. Keimah a ka rawitu cu ka sinah cabuai ah hin a um ko.","ref":"Slm 41.9"},"22":{"text":"Pathian nih a khiah cia bantukin Mi Fapa cu a thi lai, sihmanhsehlaw a rawitu caah cun ṭihnung a va si hringhran dah!” tiah a ti."},"23":{"text":"Cun anmah le anmah cu, aho nih dah mah hihi a tuah lai, tiah pakhat le pakhat kha an i hal."},"24":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna lakah khan, ahodah a ngan bik ah ruah awk a si, ti bia alnak kha a chuak.","title":"Ahodah A Ngan Bik","ref":"Mat 18.1; Mar 9.34; Luk 9.46"},"25":{"text":"Jesuh nih a thawh hna i, “Jentail mi siangpahrang hna nih cun an michia kha a lal in an lalhnawh hna i nawl ngeitu hna kha ram ca ‘Thil ṭha tuahtu’ ti an si tawn.","ref":"Mat 20.25-27; Mar 10.42-44"},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu hitihin nan si awk a si lo: nan lak i a ngan bik kha a ngakchia bik bantuk a si awk a si i hruaitu a simi kha sal bantuk a si awk a si.","ref":"Mat 23.11; Mar 9.35"},"27":{"text":"Ahodah a ngan deuh? Rawl ei awkah a ṭhumi kha maw rawl a petu kha dah? Chim hau loin a ṭhumi kha a ngan deuh. Sihmanhsehlaw kei cu nan lakah rawl petu bantukin ka um.","ref":"Jhn 13.12-15"},"28":{"text":"“Harnak ka in caan a dihlak in a ka umpitu cu nanmah nan si;"},"29":{"text":"cun ka Pa nih uknak nawl a ka pek bantukin kei zong nih nannih he biakamnak ka tuah lai."},"30":{"text":"Ka Pennak ah ka cabuai ah nan ding nan ei lai i Israel mi phun hleihnih kha biaceihpiak awkah bawi ṭhutdan cungah nan ṭhu lai,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 19.28"},"31":{"text":"Jesuh nih, “Simon, Simon, ngai-hmanh. Lothlotupa nih facang cu a fang le a hi a thleidan bantukin Satan nih nannih cu nan dihlak in hneksaknak nawl kha a hmuh cang.","title":"Peter Nih A Hlawt Lainak Kong A Chim (Mat 26.31-35 ; Mar 14.27-31 ; Jhn 13.36-38)"},"32":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Simon, na zumhnak a pur nakhnga lo nangmah caah thla ka cam. Cun keimah lei ah na hon i mer ṭhan tikah na unaule kha thazang na pek ve hna lai,” tiah a ti."},"33":{"text":"Peter nih a leh i, “Bawipa, nangmah he thongtlak le thih kha ka ngamh ko,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Jesuh nih a leh ve i, “Peter, tuzan ah, amah cu ka hngal lo, tiah voi thum tiang na ka ti hlan tiang ar a khuang lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Phaisa bawm siseh, zal siseh, kedan siseh i ken loin ka rak in thlah hna ah khan zeital nan bau maw?” tiah a ti. “Zeihmanh kan bau lo,” tiah annih nih an leh.","title":"Tangka Bawm, Zal le Vainam","ref":"Mat 10.9-10; Mar 6.8-9; Luk 9.3; 10.4"},"36":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih, “Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu, phaisa bawm siseh, zal siseh a ngeimi paoh nih i phorh u; cun vainam a ngei lomi paoh nih a angkileng kha zuar seh law pakhat in i cawk seh."},"37":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Cathiang nih, ‘Amah cu misual mi hna sinah rel chih a si cang,’ tiah a timi kha ka kong ah hin a tlin awk a si. Ka kong an rak ṭialmi vialte kha a tling cuahmah cang,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 53.12"},"38":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Bawipa, zohhmanh, hika ah hin vainam pahnih an um ko,” tiah an ti i, “Cucu a za,” tiah a leh hna."},"39":{"text":"Cun Jesuh cu a chuak i a tuah tawn bantuk khan Oliv Tlang ah a kal i a zultu kha a sinah an kal ve.","title":"Jesuh Thla A Cam (Mat 26.36-46 ; Mar 14.32-42)"},"40":{"text":"A hmun kha a phak tikah annih cu a thawh hna i, “Tukforhnak chungah nan tlak sual nakhnga lo thlacam tuah u,” a ti hna."},"41":{"text":"Cun an sin khan lungchep tluk a va kal i a khuk aa bil i thla a cam."},"42":{"text":"“Ka Pa, na hna a tlak ahcun hi hrai hi ka ṭhialpiak ko. Sihmanhsehlaw keimah nawl si loin nangmah nawl si ko seh,” tiah a ti. ("},"43":{"text":"Vancung in vancungmi pakhat a sinah a rung lang i a rung hnemh."},"44":{"text":"Lungthin fak ngaingai in fak chinchin in thla a cam i a thlan cu vawlei ah thi dor bantukin a tla.)"},"45":{"text":"A thlacamnak cun a tho i a zultu hna sinah khan a va kir i an rak i hngilh kha a hmuh hna, an lungre a theih tuk ah an ba dih."},"46":{"text":"Annih cu, “Zeicahdah nan i hngilh? Tukforhnak ah nan tlak nakhnga lo tho u law thlacam u,” a ti hna."},"47":{"text":"Bia a chim lengmang lioah cun mibu kha an ra phan i zultu pahleihnih lak i aa tel vemi Judas nih khan a hun hruai hna. Jesuh cu hnamh awkah a hun fuh.","title":"Jesuh Cu An Tlaih (Mat 26.47-56 ; Mar 14.43-50 ; Jhn 18.3-11)"},"48":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh nih a rak thawh i, “Judas, Mi Fapa hi hnamh in maw na rawi ko lai?” tiah a ti."},"49":{"text":"Jesuh cu a sin i a ummi a zultu hna nih khan thil umtuning kha an hmuh tikah an thawh i, “Bawipa, kan vainam kan hmang hna lai maw?” an ti."},"50":{"text":"Cun an lak i pakhatpa nih khan Tlangbawi Ngan sal kha a orhlei hna pet lak in a tuk."},"51":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw, “Hihi cu a za cang,” tiah Jesuh nih a ti. Mipa a hna kha a tawngh i a damter."},"52":{"text":"Cun amah tlaih awkah a rami tlangbawi upa pawl hna le Biakinn cawngtu hna i an bawi pawl hna le upa hna kha a thawh hna i, “Damiah hei si ning law cu bang, zeicahdah vainam le thingtan he nan ka rathnawh?"},"53":{"text":"Nifate in pei nan sinah Biakinn ah ka um ko cu, tlaih nan ka zalh ṭung lo. Sihmanhsehlaw atu hi cu nanmah le muihnak ṭhawnnak nan caan a si,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Luk 19.47; 21.37"},"54":{"text":"Jesuh cu an tlaih i Tlangbawi Ngan inn ah khan an kalpi; cun Peter nih lamhlatpi khin a zulh.","title":"Peter Nih Jesuh A Hlawt (Mat 26.57-58 , 69-75 ; Mar 14.53-54 , 66-72 ; Jhn 18.12-18 , 25-27)"},"55":{"text":"Tual laifang ah khan mei an kau i mei cu an to i a tomi hna sinah cun Peter cu a ṭhu ve."},"56":{"text":"Cun mei a toh lio cu sinumnu ngakchia pakhat nih a hmuh i dengteo in a zoh i, “Hi pa zong hi amah sinah aa telmi a si ve,” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih aa pheh i, “Minu, a hngalh hmanh ka hngalh ṭung lo,” a ti."},"58":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun pa pakhat nih a hmuh i, “Nangmah zong hi anmah lak i aa telmi na si ve ko,” tiah a ti. Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih cun aa pheh ṭhan i, “Mipa, ka si lo,” tiah a leh."},"59":{"text":"Cu hnu suimilam pakhat tluk ah khin midang pakhat nih ṭhawng chinchin in, “Hi pa hi amah sin i aa telmi a si hrimhrim ko, zeicahtiah Galilee mi pei a si ko hi!” tiah a ti."},"60":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih cun, “Mipa, na chimmi hi zei a si ti awk hmanh ka hngal lo,” tiah a leh. Bia a chim lioah cun, chikkhatte ah khin ar a hung khuang."},"61":{"text":"Bawipa cu a hun i mer i Peter kha a hei zoh i Peter nih cun Bawipa nih, “Tuzan ah ar a khuan hlanah, amah cu ka hngal lo, tiah voi thum tiang naa pheh lai,” a timi kha a lung ah a hung pem."},"62":{"text":"Peter cu a chuak i lunghno ngaiin a ṭap."},"63":{"text":"Jesuh cu a cawngtu hna nih khan nihchuak ah an saih. An tuk,","title":"Jesuh Cu An Nihsawh I An Tuk (Mat 26.67-68 ; Mar 14.65)"},"64":{"text":"a mit an huh i, “Ahodah an tu? Kan chim tuah,” tiah an ti chih."},"65":{"text":"Cuticun nihsawhnak bia kha a cungah tampi an chim."},"66":{"text":"Khua a dei tikah Judah mi upa hna le tlangbawi upa pawl hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna kha an i pum i an hmaiah cun Jesuh cu an chuahpi.","title":"Biaceihtu Khawngsil Hmaiah An Chuahpi (Mat 26.59-66 ; Mar 14.55-64 ; Jhn 18.19-24)"},"67":{"text":"Annih nih an thawh i, “Messiah na si maw si lo kan chim tuah,” an ti. Anih nih, “Kan chimh hna zongah nan ka zum lai lo,"},"68":{"text":"cun bia kan hal hna zongah nan ka let duh fawn lai lo."},"69":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu hin cun Mi Fapa hi Lianngan Bik Pathian orhlei kamah ṭhutter ka si cang lai,” tiah a ti."},"70":{"text":"Cun annih nih an dihlak in, “Pathian Fapa maw na si kun?” an ti. Anih nih a leh hna i, “Nan ka ti bangin ka si,” tiah a ti."},"71":{"text":"Cun annih nih, “Tehte dang zeidah kan herh ti? Amah kaa hrimhrim in pei kan theih ko cang cu,” an ti."}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"An bu ningpi khan an tho i Jesuh cu Pilat hmaiah khan an kalpi.","title":"Pilat Hmaiah Jesuh Taza An Cuai (Mat 27.1-2 , 11-14 ; Mar 15.1-5 ; Jhn 18.28-38)"},"2":{"text":"Anih cu sual kha an phawt i, “Hi pa nih hin kan mi hna a pingah a hruai hna kha kan tlaih, a thawh hna i Sizar Siangpahrang sinah ngunkhuai nan pe lai lo, a ti hna i, keimah hi siangpahrang Khrih cu ka si, a ti hna,” an ti."},"3":{"text":"Cun Pilat nih cun, “Judah mi hna siangpahrang cu na si maw?” tiah a hal. Jesuh nih cun, “Na chim bangin ka si ko,” tiah a leh."},"4":{"text":"Khi tikah Pilat nih cun tlangbawi upa pawl hna le mizapi cu, “Hi pa hi a sualnak zeihmanh ka hmu lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw fak chinchin in an au i, “Hi pa nih hin a cawnpiaknak in mizapi lakah hnahnawhnak a chuahter.
