cun atu i nan hmuhmi le nan theihmi hi kannih a kan toihmi a laksawng kha a si."},"34":{"text":"Zeicah kan ti ahcun amah David cu vancung ah a kai ṭung lo, aa thawh i pei: ‘Bawipa nih ka Bawipa cu, “Ka orhlei kamah hin ṭhu tuah,"},"35":{"text":"Na ke tangah na ral hna cu na kelamh ah ka chiah hna hlan tiangin,” a ti cu,’ tiah a ti kha."},"36":{"text":"“Israel mi vialte hna, nannih nih vailam tahnak thing cungah nan khenh chihmi Jesuh hrimhrim hi Pathian nih Bawipa ah le Messiah ah a ser cang, ti kha fiang tein hngal u,” tiah a ti."},"37":{"text":"Hi kong kha an theih tikah an lungthin a hriah ngaingai hna i Peter le lamkaltu dang kha an thawh hna i, “U le nau hna, zeidah kan tuah kun lai?” an ti."},"38":{"text":"Peter nih annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nan dihlak in, pakhat hmanh bau loin, nan sualnak khan i mer tuah u, nan sualnak kha, ngaihthiam nan si nakhnga nan sualnak khan i mer u law Jesuh Khrih min in tipilnak ing tuah u; cun Pathian laksawng Thiang Thlarau kha nan hmuh lai."},"39":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian nih bia a kamhmi hna cu nanmah hi le nan fale hna hi le lam hlat pipi i a ummi hna zong nan si — Bawipa kan Pathian nih an kawhmi hna paoh caah hin a si,” tiah a ti."},"40":{"text":"Peter nih cun bia dang zong tampi a chimh hna i, “Hi chan ṭhalo cungah a tlung dingmi dantatnak hin luat i zuam ko u,” tiah a forh hna."},"41":{"text":"Mi tampi nih a bia cu an zumh i tipil kha an in; cu ni ah cun an bu ah mi thong thum tluk an i chap."},"42":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna cawnpiaknak ngaih awkah khan atu le atu an i pum i hawikomhnak ah khan an i tel i hawikomhnak rawl an dum ṭi i thla an cam ṭi lengmang."},"43":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna kha Pathian nih khuaruahharnak le hmelchunhnak tampi a tuahter hna i cu nih cun mizapi kha ṭihnak in a khahter hna."},"44":{"text":"A zummi vialte hna cu i kom ṭhipṭhep tein khua an sa i an thil kha pakhat le pakhat an i hrawm.","ref":"Lam 4.32-35"},"45":{"text":"An thil le an ngeihmi kha an zuar hna i tangka an hmuhmi kha a dihlak in an herhning cio paoh in an i phaw."},"46":{"text":"Ni fate in a bute in biakinn chungah khan an i pum i an inn ah khan rawl an i hrawng cio hna i lunglawmhnak lungthin le toidornak lungthin he rawl cu an ei."},"47":{"text":"Pathian kha an thangṭhat i mi vialte nih an hmaizah hna. Cun khamh a si liomi hna cu Bawipa nih ni fate in an bu chungah khan a luhter lengmang hna."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni khat cu, zanlei suimilam pathum, thlacam caan ah khin, Peter le Johan cu biaknak inn ah khan an hung kal.","title":"Peter le Johan Nih Mizeng An Damter"},"2":{"text":"Khika ah, Kutka Dawh timi ah khan a chuah kate in a ke a beimi pakhat kha a rak um. Biakinn i a kalmi hna kha tangka a hal khawh hna nakhnga amah cu ni fate in cu kutka ah cun a puak in an hei puak tawn."},"3":{"text":"Peter le Johan cu an luh kha a hmuh hna tikah, thil ṭhenh a hal hna."},"4":{"text":"Amah cu dengteo in an vun zoh i Peter nih a vun thawh i, “Hun kan zoh,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah zeimaw an ka pek rua lai ti kha a hun i ruahchan i ṭhep loin a hun zoh hna."},"6":{"text":"Cun Peter nih a thawh i, “Sui le ngun zeihmanh ka ngei lo, sihmanhsehlaw ka ngeihmi cu kan pek lai: Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih min in, tho law kal, kan ti,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun a orhlei kut khan a vun thawh i a dirter. Chikkhatte ah khin mipa cu a ke le a fengbeo hna cu an hung ṭhawng i"},"8":{"text":"a tho duak i a dir i aa chawk. Cun an sinah cun biakinn chungah khan a lut i aa chawk i a per a choi i Pathian kha a thangṭhat."},"9":{"text":"Mizapi nih khan aa chawh i Pathian a thangṭhat kha an hmuh;"},"10":{"text":"cun amah cu Kutka Dawh i a ṭhu tawnmi awkhlawhpa a si kha an hngalh tikah a cung i a tlungmi kongah khan an khuaruah a har i an lung zong a ar dih."},"11":{"text":"Mipa cu Peter le Johan sin lawngah khan aa hel caah mizapi cu an khuaruah a har i Solomon Innleng timi ah khan an sinah cun an va le i,","title":"Peter Nih Biakinn Chungah A Chimh Hna"},"12":{"text":"Peter nih a rak hmuh hna tikah khan a rak thawh hna i, “Ka phun hawi Israel mi hna, zeicahdah hi thil kongah nan khuaruah a har i kanmah lehlam cu ngang koin nan kan zoh? Hi pa kan kalter khawh hi kanmah ṭhawnnak in le Pathian hmai i kan ṭhatnak thawngin maw a si tiah nan ruah?"},"13":{"text":"Abraham, Isak le Jakob Pathian, kan pupa hna Pathian nih khan a sal Jesuh cu Pathian sunparnak kha a pek cang. Amah cu nawl ngeitu hna sinah khan nan chanh i Pilat nih ka luatter ko lai a ti hmanh ah khan, Pilat hmai hrimhrim ah, nan hlawt ṭhiamṭhiam.","ref":"Exo 3.15"},"14":{"text":"Amah cu mithiang le miṭha a si nain nannih nih cun nan duh lo i Pilat cu lainawng lehlam kha kan thlahpiak ko, nan ti.","ref":"Mat 27.15-27; Mar 15.6-14; Luk 23.14-23; Jhn 19.12-15"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah nunnak lam ah mi a hruaitu cu nan thah. Sihmanhsehlaw amah cu Pathian nih mithi hna sinin a thawhter i cu a thawhternak tehte cu kanmah hi kan si."},"16":{"text":"Hi kebeipa thazang a petu hi amah min ṭhawnnak cu a si i atu i nan hmuhmi le nan hngalhmi hi amah min zumhnak thawngin tuahmi a si; hi bantukin nan hmaika ah a damtertu hi Jesuh min zumh hi a si."},"17":{"text":"“Ka u le ka nau hna, Jesuh cung i nanmah le nan haotu hna nih nan rak tuahmi kha zei a si ti awk nan rak hngalh lo ruangah a si ti kha fiang tein ka hngalh."},"18":{"text":"Pathian nih hlan lio pi in a profet vialte hna sin khan, ka Messiah nih cun fahnak a in lai, ti kha a rak thanh chung cang i cu a bia cu hiti ning hin a tlinter."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah nan sualnak cu an hnawhpiak hna nakhnga, i ngaihchih u law Pathian leiah khan i mer tuah u."},"20":{"text":"Cun Bawipa nih thlarau thazang thar hmuhnak caan ṭha an pek hna lai i amah nih nan caah a thim cangmi Messiah, Jesuh kha nan sinah a run thlah lai."},"21":{"text":"Pathian nih a thiangmi a profet hna sinin hlan liopi ah a rak thanh cang bantukin, zei zong vialte a thar in ser caan a phak hlantiang vancung ah cun a um ko lai."},"22":{"text":"Moses nih zeitindah a rak ti tiah, ‘Bawipa Pathian nih keimah a ka thlah bantuk hin, nan mi a simi profet pakhat kha aan thlah hna lai. Amah nih an chimhmi hna kha a dihlak in nan ngaih lai.","ref":"Deu 18.15,18"},"23":{"text":"Cu profet nih a chimmi bia a ngai lomi paoh cu Pathian mi hna sinin ṭhen a si lai i hrawh a si lai,’ a ti.","ref":"Deu 18.19"},"24":{"text":"Cun Samuel thawk in a hnu i a ummi profet vialte hna nih, hi atu caan kong hi an dihlak in an bia i khat tein an rak chimchung cio."},"25":{"text":"Pathian nih a profet hna sinin biakamnak a sermi cu nanmah caah a si i nan pupa hna sinah Pathian nih biakamnak a sermi chung i aa telmi cu nan si. Kha biakamnak a ser tikah khan Abraham sinah cun a thawh i, ‘Nangmah na tefa hna thawngin vawleicung mi vialte cu thluachuahnak ka pek hna lai,’ tiah a rak ti.","ref":"Gen 22.18"},"26":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian nih a Sal cu a thim i nan sinah a hmasa bik ah a rak thlah, cuti in a rak thlahnak cu, nan ziaza ṭhalo kha nan mertak hna i thluachuahnak an pek hna nakhnga caah a si,” tiah a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Peter le Johan cu mizapi kha bia an chimh lengmang hna lioah khan, tlangbawi hna le biakinn cawngtu pawl bawi le Sadusi mi hna kha an sinah cun an rak phan,","title":"Peter le Johan Zung Ah An Chuahpi Hna"},"2":{"text":"Lamkaltu pahnih hna nih khan mizapi cu, mithi mi kha thihnak in an tho ṭhan lai, zeicahtiah Jesuh kha thihnak in a tho ṭhan cang i cu nih cun mithi mi kha nunnak ah an tho ṭhan lai ti kha a fianter tiin an cawnpiak hna caah, an cungah khan an thin a hung ngaingai."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah an tlaih hna i cu ni cu a tlai nawn cang caah a thaizing tiang thong ah an thlak hna."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an chimmi a theimi mi tampi nih khan an zumh i an dihlak ah thong nga hrawng an hung si."},"5":{"text":"A thaizing ah cun Judah mi hruitu hna le upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna kha Jerusalem ah khan an i pum."},"6":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Tlangbawi Ngan Annas le Kaiafas le Johan le Alekzandar le Tlangbawi Ngan innchungkhar chungmi mi dangdang zong kha an i tel."},"7":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna kha an hmaiah an dirter hna i, “Mah hihi zeitindah nan tuah? Zei ṭhawnnak dah nan ngeih? Aho min dah nan hman?” tiah an hal hna."},"8":{"text":"Cun Thiang Thlarau in a khatmi Peter nih cun a leh hna i, “Mizapi hruitu hna le upa hna:"},"9":{"text":"A beimipa cungah thil ṭha tuah a sinak kong le zeitindah damter a sinak kha nihin ah hin nan kan hal duhmi cu a si ahcun,"},"10":{"text":"nannih nan dihlak le Israel mi vialte dihlak nih nan hngalh awk cu, hi pa dam hirhiar tein nan hmaiah a dir khawhnak cu Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih, nannih nih nan thah i Pathian nih thihnak in a thawhter ṭhanmi a min ṭhawnnak thawngin a si."},"11":{"text":"Cathiang nih, ‘Inn satu hna nih zei ah nan rel lomi lung cu, Lung santlai bik ah a cang,’ tiah a timi kha Jesuh hi a si.","ref":"Slm 118.22"},"12":{"text":"Amah thawng lawnglawng in khamhnak hi hmuh khawh a si. Zeicahtiah vawlei cung dihlak ah hin a kan khamh khotu ding min dang zeihmanh a um lo,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Biaceihtu hna nih Peter le Johan cu an ralṭhatning kha an hmuh i fimthiamnak zeihmanh a ngei lomi, mi sawhsawh an si ko ti kha an hngalh tikah an khuaruah a har. Khi tikah annih cu Jesuh hawikom an rak si ti kha an hun hngalh."},"14":{"text":"Peter le Johan nih an damtermipa kha an sinah cun a dir kha an hmuh ko caah, annih nih zeihmanh an chim kho lo."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah, biaceihnak hmun khan chuak u, an ti hna i anmah lawngin an run i ceih."},"16":{"text":"“Zeitindah hi mi hna hi kan tuah hna lai? Jerusalem khua chung i a ummi vialte nih, hi thil theihtlei khuaruahhar hi, hi mi hna nih hin an tuah ti cu an hngalh dihmi a si ko i kannih nih, a si lo, kan ti kho fawn ṭung lo."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi thil hi mizapi sinah a karh chin lengmang nakhnga lo, hi mi hna hi Jesuh min in aho sin hmanh ah bia chim ti hlah u, tiah kan thlauh hna lai,” tiah an ti."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah inn chungah khan an kawh ṭhan hna i, thil umtuning zei bantuk a si hmanh ah, Jesuh min in ahohmanh nan cawnpiak hrimhrim hna lai lo i aho sin hmanh ah bia zong nan chim hrimhrim lai lo, tiah an ti hna."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter le Johan nih khan an leh hna i, “Pathian mithmuh ah nanmah bia ngaih cu maw a ṭha deuh Pathian bia ngaih dah a ṭha deuh, ti cu nanmah nih ruat ko u."},"20":{"text":"Zei ti si hmanh ah kannih nih cun kanmah hrimhrim nih kan hmuh komi le kan theih komi cu chim lo cun kan um kho bal lai lo,” an ti hna."},"21":{"text":"Biaceihtu hna nih cun fak chinchin in an hro hna i an thlah hna. Mizapi nih thil a hung ummi kongah khan Pathian cu an thangṭhat lulhmalh caah dantat khawhnak lam kha an hmu kho lo."},"22":{"text":"Hi damnak khuaruahhar an tuahpiakmipa hi kum sawm li lengmi a si."},"23":{"text":"An thlah cangka hna in Peter le Johan cu an bu sinah khan an va kir i tlangbawi upa pawl le upa hna nih an chimmi kha an va chimh hna.","title":"Ralṭhatnak Caah Thla An Cam"},"24":{"text":"Annih nih an theih tikah hmunkhatte ah Pathian sinah thla an cam i, “Bawipa, van le vawlei le rili le an chung i a ummi thil vialte a Sertu,","ref":"Exo 20.11; Neh 9.6; Slm 146.6"},"25":{"text":"na Thiang Thlarau in kan pu David na sal sinah bia na rak chim i, ‘Zeicahdah Jentail mi hna cu an thin a hun i miphun dang hna nih cun pakpalawng khua an khan?","ref":"Slm 2.1-2"},"26":{"text":"Bawipa le a Messiah cu doh awkah vawleicung siangpahrang hna cu an i tim i uktu hna cu an i pum,’ na rak ti."},"27":{"text":"Cuticun Herod le Pontius Pilat cu hi khua chungah hin Jentail mi hna le Israel mi hna he khan, a thiangmi na sal Jesuh, Messiah i na sermi cu doh awkah an i pum taktak.","ref":"Mat 27.1-2; Mar 15.1; Luk 23.1,7-11; Jhn 18.28-29"},"28":{"text":"Nangmah nih a hung um te lai ding na rak ruah ciami le na rak khah ciami vialte kha tlinter awkah an i pum."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah atu cu Bawipa, an kan hronak hi kan hngalhpiak law kannih na sal rual nih hin na bia cu ralṭha chinchin in kan chim nakhnga a nawl kan pe ko."},"30":{"text":"Mi nih damnak an hmuh nakhnga na kut cu samh law a thiangmi na Sal Jesuh min in khuaruahharnak le hmelchunhnak cu umter ko hna,” tiah an ti."},"31":{"text":"Annih nih thla an cam dih tikah an i pumhnak hmun cu aa hnin. Thiang Thlarau in an khat i Pathian bia cu ralṭha ngaiin an chim."},"32":{"text":"Cun zumtu hna cu an bu ningte in an ruahnak le an lungthin aa khat dih. Ahohmanh nih an thil kha, keimah ta, an ti lo i an ngeihmi paoh kha an i hrawm dih.","title":"Thil An I Hrawm","ref":"Lam 2.44-45"},"33":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih khan Bawipa Jesuh thihnak in a thawhṭhannak kong kha fak piin an chim i Pathian nih an dihlak in thluachuahnak tampi a pek hna."},"34":{"text":"An lakah herh baunak a ngeimi ahohmanh an um lo. Lo a ngeimi nih si hna seh, inn a ngeimi nih si hna seh, an thilri cu an zuarh hna tikah a man tangka an hmuhmi cu"},"35":{"text":"lamkaltu hna sinah khan an rak put hna i tangka cu a herhmi paoh kha an herh baunak ning cio ah an phawt hna."},"36":{"text":"Cu bantuk cun Saipras tikulh i a chuakmi Levi mi Josef nih"},"37":{"text":"a lo kha a zuarh i tangka kha a rak put i lamkaltu hna kha a pek hna; Josef cu lamkaltu hna nih khan Barnabas tiah an kawh, a sullam cu Thazang Petu tinak a si."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw midang pakhat a um ve i a min cu Ananias a si, a nupi min cu Safira a si. An thil ngeihmi pakhat kha an zuarh i","title":"Ananias le Safira Kong"},"2":{"text":"a nupi theih tein a man tangka a cheu cu an i chiah i a cheu cu lamkaltu hna sinah khan an rak put."},"3":{"text":"Peter nih anih cu a rak thawh i, “Ananias, zeicahdah Satan cu na lung kha na ukter i na lo man ah na hmuhmi tangka a cheu kha naa chiah i Thiang Thlarau sinah lih na chim?"},"4":{"text":"Na thil cu na zuarh hlanah khan nangmah ta a si, cun na zuarh hnu zongah khan a man cu nangmah ta a si ṭhiamṭhiam ko. A si kun ahcun, zeicahdah cu bantuk thil tuah awkah cun na lung chungin na rak ruah? Minung sinah lih na chim a si ṭung lo, Pathian sinah pei lih na chim a si cu,” tiah a ti."},"5":{"text":"Cu bia cu Ananias nih a theih tikah aa teng bak ko i cu thawng a theimi paoh cu ṭihnak in an khat dih."},"6":{"text":"Tlangval kha an rung lut i a ruak kha an zual i an chuahpi i an vui."},"7":{"text":"Cu hnu suimilam pathum tluk ah khin a nupi kha a rung lut ve, thil umtuning kha zeihmanh a hngal lo."},"8":{"text":"Peter nih amah cu a thawh i, “Hi zat taktak hi maw nan lo man ah khan an in pek hna?” tiah a ti i anih nih, “Asi, hi zat hi a si ko,” tiah a leh. Cun Peter nih cun a thawh i,"},"9":{"text":"“Zeicahdah na va he nan pahnih in Bawipa Thlarau cu hneksak del awkah khua nan rak khan? Na va a va vuitu hna kha innka hram ah an um ko rih khih, nangmah zong an in kalpi ve lai,” tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah a kehram ah khan a tlu i a thi. Tlangval hna cu an rung lut i a thih ve kha an hmuh i an chuahpi i a va kiangah khan an va vui."},"11":{"text":"Khrihfabu le cu thawng a theimi paoh cungah khan ṭihnak nganpi a tlung."},"12":{"text":"Khuaruahharnak tampi le hmelchunhnak tampi kha lamkaltu hna nih cun mizapi lakah khan an tuah.","title":"Khuaruahharnak le Hmelchunhnak"},"13":{"text":"Zumtu hna cu Solomon Innleng timi ah khan an i pum tawn, an bu a lengmi cu ahohmanh an i tel ngam lo nain mi zapi tu nih cun an thangṭhat ko hna."},"14":{"text":"Cuhleiah mi kha an bu ah cun an i chap chin lengmang i Bawipa a zummi hna cu nu he pa he bu nganpi ah an i cang."},"15":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna rianṭuannak thawng cun, mizaw hna cu khuachung lam ah khan an chuahpi hna i Peter aa chawh tikah khan pakhat pahnih tal kha a thla nih tawng hna seh tiin ihkhun cung le pher cungah khan an chiah hna."},"16":{"text":"Cun Jerusalem khua pawngkam khua hna khan mi cu an ra ciammam i an mizaw hna le khuachia nih a tuahmi hna kha an ratpi hna; cun annih cu an dihlak in an dam dih."},"17":{"text":"Cun Tlangbawi Ngan le a hawile hna, cuka hmun i a ummi Sadusi pawl chungmi a simi hna nih khan lamkaltu pawl cu an nahchuah ngaingai hna i cucaah an cungah rian kan ṭuan cang lai, tiah an ti.","title":"Lamkaltu Hremnak An Ing"},"18":{"text":"Lamkaltu kha an tlaih hna i zapi thong ah an thlak hna."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu zan ah cun Bawipa vancungmi nih thonginn kutka kha a hun hna i lamkaltu kha a chuahpi hna i,"},"20":{"text":"“Va kal u law biakinn chungah khan va dir tuah u, cun mizapi kha hi nunnak thar kong kha va chim hna u,” tiah a ti hna."},"21":{"text":"A bia cu lamkaltu hna nih khan an ngaih i khua a dei cangka tein biakinn chungah khan an lut i mizapi cu an cawnpiak hna. Tlangbawi Ngan le a hawile hna kha an ra i Sanhedrin khawngsil pumhnak kha an tuah, cucu Israel miphun khawngsil a ningpi in i pumhnak kha a si; cun lamkaltu hna kha kan hmaiah rak chuahpi hna u, tiin thonginn ah khan mi an hei thlah hna."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an hei thlahmi hna kha an va phak tikah, thong chungah cun lamkaltu pawl kha an hmu hna lo i cucaah cun khawngsil pawl sinah khan an ra kir i an chimh hna,"},"23":{"text":"“Thonginn kan va phak ah cun ṭha tein a rak i hrenh ko i a cawngtu hna kha kutka ah cun an um dih ko; sihmanhsehlaw kutka cu kan vun hun hna tikah a chungah ahohmanh kan hmu hna lo,” an ti."},"24":{"text":"Cu thawng cu biakinn cawngtu bawi le tlangbawi upa hna nih khan an theih tikah, lamkaltu hna cungah cun zei ko dah a tlung hnga, tiah an khuaruah a har."},"25":{"text":"Cun mipa pakhat a rung lut i, “Ngai hmanh u, thong i nan thlakmi hna kha biakinn chungah an dir ko i mi an cawnpiak len ko hna,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah biakinn cawngtu hna bawi cu a mi hna he khan an va kal i lamkaltu cu an ratpi ṭhan hna. Annih nih mizapi nih lung in an kan cheh sual lai ti kha an phan caah thazang cu an hmang ngam lo."},"27":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna kha an run luhpi hna i khawngsil hmaiah khan an dirter hna i Tlangbawi Ngan nih khan kherhlai hram a thawk hna."},"28":{"text":"A thawh hna i, “Hi pa min hin cawnpiak hna hlah u tiah fek tein nawl kan in pek hna, sihmanhsehlaw nan tuahmi hi zohhmanh u! Jerusalem khua hi nan cawnpiaknak in nan khahter i hi pa thihnak hi kanmah tuahmi siter nan duh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 27.25"},"29":{"text":"Peter le lamkaltu dang hna nih cun an leh i, “Minung nakin Pathian nawl kan ngaih deuh awk a si."},"30":{"text":"Nannih nih Jesuh cu vailamtahnak i nan thah hnuah kan pupa hna Pathian nih thihnak in a thawhter ṭhan."},"31":{"text":"Israel mi kha i ngaihchihnak caan ṭha le sual ngaihthiamnak pek awkah amah cu Pathian nih a orhlei kamah khan Hruaitu le Khamhtu in a ṭhutter cang."},"32":{"text":"Hi thil vialte hna tehte hi kanmah hi kan si — kanmah lawng si loin Pathian nih amah nawl a ngaimi hna sinah a pekmi Thiang Thlarau zong hi tehte cu a si ve,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Khawngsil pawl nih hi bia kha an theih tikah an thin a hung tuk hringhran i lamkaltu kha thah an duh ko hna."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an lak i mi pakhat, Farasi a simi a min Gamaliel, Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya, mi vialte nih an hmaizahmi kha khawngsil pawl aa pummi hna lakah cun a hung dir i, lamkaltu hna kha chuahpi hna u, tiah a ti hna."},"35":{"text":"Cun khawngsil pawl cu a thawh hna i, “Israel mi hna, hi mi hna cung i nan tuah duhmi thil kong ah hin i ralring ngaingai u."},"36":{"text":"Kan hnu lei caan tlawmpal ah khan Theudas an timi kha a hung chuak i pa pakhat ka si ve tiah a hun i ti i minung za li tluk nih an zulh. Sihmanhsehlaw amah cu an thah i a zultu hna cu an i ṭhek dih i a rianṭuanmi cu a thi ko."},"37":{"text":"Cun cu pa hnuah cun Galilee mi Judas kha milurel caan ah khan a hung chuak ve; amah zong nih zultu kha a hun ngei tungmang ve, sihmanhsehlaw amah an thah khan a zultu hna cu an i ṭhek dih ṭhan ve ko."},"38":{"text":"Cucaah atu thil zongah hin, nannih nih hi mi hna hi zeihmanh ti hna hlah u. Anmah um in umter ko hna u, zeicahtiah hi khuakhannak le rianṭuannak hi minung sermi men a si ahcun a lo dai ko lai,"},"39":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw Pathian sinin a rami a si ahcun, nan tei kho hlei lai lo. Pathian dotu lehlam ah nan cang sual lai,” tiah a ti hna. Khawngsil pawl nih cun Gamaliel ruah-nak cheuhmi kha an zulh."},"40":{"text":"Lamkaltu kha an auh hna i fung in an tuk hna i Jesuh min in bia chim hrimhrim ti hlah u, tiah an ti hna i an thlah hna."},"41":{"text":"Khawngsil pumhnak cun lamkaltu pawl cu an chuak i Jesuh min ruangah Pathian nih ningzah in awk nan i tlak tiah a ruah hna caah an i lawm ngaingai."},"42":{"text":"Cun nifate in biakinn chung le mi inn kip ah Messiah a simi Jesuh kong Thawngṭha kha an cawnpiak hna i an chimh lengmang hna."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun, zumtu kha an karh chin lengmang tikah, Grik holh a hmangmi Judah mi hna le Judah holh a hmangmi Judah mi hna karlak ah khan siknak a um. Grik holh a hmangmi Judah mi hna nih khan kannih kan nuhmei hna cu ni fate thil i phawtnak ah hrelh deuh an si tiah an zai.","title":"Bawmtu Pasarih"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah lamkaltu pahleihnih hna nih khan zultu dihlak kha an ningpi in an kawh hna i, “Kannih nih Pathian bia chim kha thlahdorh riangmang i tangka i phawtnak kong lawng kha kan tuah ahcun ahmaan hnga lo."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah u le nau hna, nan lakah Thiang Thlarau le fimnak in a khat tiah nan hngalhmi pasarih in thim hna u law, cu hna cu hi thil a tawlreltu ah kan thiah hna lai."},"4":{"text":"Kannih tu cu thlacam le Pathian Bia chimnak ah khan kan caan cu a dihlak in kan hmang ko lai,” tiah an ti."},"5":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih an chimmi cu an dihlak in an lung a si i cucaah zumhnak le Thiang Thlarau in a khatmi Steven, Filip, Prokhoras, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas le Antiok khuami Jentail mi Nikolas, Judah phung a zulmi kha an thim hna."},"6":{"text":"Cu hna cu lamkaltu hna sinah khan an hei chuahpi hna i thla an campiak hna i an lu cungah an kut an chuan."},"7":{"text":"Cuticun Pathian bia cu a karh chin lengmang. Jerusalem khua chungah khan a zummi cu an tam chin lengmang i tlangbawi tampi zong nih cu zumhnak cu an pom ve."},"8":{"text":"Pathian nih thluachuahnak tampi a pekmi le ṭhawnnak in a khatmi Steven nih khan mizapi lakah khan a liannganmi khuaruahharnak le hmelchunhnak kha a ser hna.","title":"Steven An Tlaih"},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mi cheukhat nih amah cu an al; cu hna cu Sal Luat hna pumhnak inn tiah timi i aa pum tawnmi kha an si i cu hna lakah cun Sairin le Alekzandria in a rami Judah mi kha an i tel. Cu hna le Silisia le Asia in a rami Judah mi hna nih khan Steven cu bia an hun al."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Thlarau nih Steven cu fimnak kha a pek caah bia a chim tikah an tei kho lo."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah mi a cheu kha, “Moses le Pathian a thangchiat hna,” tiah ti dingin biaruk an nawh hna."},"12":{"text":"Cuticun mizapi le upa hna le Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya hna kha an tuai hna. Steven cu an fuh i an tlaih i khawngsil hmaiah an chuahpi."},"13":{"text":"Cun amah kong i lih a ṭawntu dingah mi kha an luhpi hna. Cu hna nih cun an i thawh i, “Hi pa nih hin a thiangmi kan biakinn le Moses phung kha a thangchiat zungzal hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun hi Nazareth khuami Jesuh nih hin biakinn hi a ṭheh dih lai i Moses nih a kan pekmi kan phunglam vialte hi a thlen dih lai, a ti kha kan theih,” tiah an ti."},"15":{"text":"Khawngsil chung i a ṭhumi vialte hna nih khan Steven cu dengteo in an zoh i a hmai cu vancungmi hmai bantuk a si kha an hmuh."}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tlangbawi Ngan nih Steven cu a thawh i, “Hihi a si taktak maw?” tiah a hal.","title":"Steven Bia Chimmi"},"2":{"text":"Steven nih cun a leh i, “U le nau le pale hna, ka bia hi ngai tuah u! Kan pu Abraham cu Haran khua i va um awkah a rak i thawh hlan, Mesopotamia ram i a rak um lioah khan sunparnak Pathian cu a sinah a rak lang i,","ref":"Gen 12.1"},"3":{"text":"‘Na innchungkhar le na ram kha chuahtak hna law kan hmuhsak laimi ram ah kal tuah,’ tiah a rak ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Khaldia ram khan a chuak i Haran khua ah khan a um. Cun Abraham cu a pa a thih hnuah atu i nan umnak ram ah hin Pathian nih a rak thawnter.","ref":"Gen 11.31; 12.4"},"5":{"text":"Cu lioah cun hi ram hi a pelpawite hmanh Abraham cu a rak pe lo, pe khat taktak hmanh a rak pe lo; sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih bia a kam i hi ram hi nangmah kan pek lai i nangmah le na hnu i a rung um ding na tefa hna ta a si lai, tiah a ti. Cu biakamnak Pathian nih a rak pek lioah hin Abraham cu fa zeihmanh a ngei lo.","ref":"Gen 12.7; 13.15; 15.18; 17.8"},"6":{"text":"Pathian nih a rak chimhmi cu, ‘Na tefa hna cu miphun dang ram ah an um lai i khika ah sal an si lai i kum za li chung hremnak an ing lai.","ref":"Gen 15.13-14"},"7":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an rianhmi hna miphun cu bia ka ceih hna lai,’ ti hi a si i, ‘Cun a hnuah cu ram cun an chuak lai i hi hmun ah hin an ka biak lai,’ ti zongah Pathian nih cun a ti fawn.","ref":"Exo 3.12"},"8":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih Abraham cu cuarpartannak phunglam kha biakamnak hmelchunhnak caah a pek i cucaah Abraham nih cun Isak kha a chuah hnu zarh khat ah a cuarpar kha a tan. Isak nih Jakob kha a tan ve i Jakob nih kan pupa hleihnih hna kha a vun tan ve hna.","ref":"Gen 17.10-14; 21.2-4; 25.26; 29.31—35.18"},"9":{"text":"“Kan pupa hna nih cun Josef kha an nahchuah i Izipt ram i sal vung si awkah an zuarh. Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih a umpi i","ref":"Gen 37.11,28; 38.2,22"},"10":{"text":"harnak a inmi dihlak chungin him tein a chuahter. Josef cu Izipt siangpahrang Faro hmaiah a chuah tikah khan nuncan dawh le fimnak kha a pek. Faro nih cun Josef cu ram uktu bawi le siangpahrang innchungkhar uktu bawi ah a ser.","ref":"Gen 41.39-41"},"11":{"text":"Cun Izipt ram chung a dihlak le Kanaan ram ah khan mangṭam a tlung i harnak tampi a um. Kan pupa hna nih rawl kha an hmu kho ti lo.","ref":"Gen 42.1-2"},"12":{"text":"Cucaah Jakob nih Izipt ram ah rawl a um ti kha a theih tikah, a kan hringsortu kan pupa a fapa hna kha a vun thlah hna i cucu an vung kal hmasa bik kha a si."},"13":{"text":"An vung tlawn a voi hnihnak ah Josef nih cun a unau hna sinah khan a rak i hngalhter i Faro nih cun Josef innchungkhar kong cu a hun hngalh.","ref":"Gen 45.1,16"},"14":{"text":"Cucaah Josef nih a pa Jakob cu bia a hun cah i amah le a innchungkhar vialte cu Izipt ram ah ra dih u, tiah a ti hna; an dihlak in minung sawm sarih le panga an si.","ref":"Gen 45.9-10,17-18; 46.27"},"15":{"text":"Cun Jakob cu Izipt ram ah cun a vung kal i khika ah khan amah le kan pupa a kan hringsortu hna cu an thi.","ref":"Gen 46.1-7; 49.33"},"16":{"text":"An ruh cu Shekhem ah khan an kalpi hna i khika ah Abraham nih Hamor miphun sinin tangka in a cawkmi thlan ah khan an vui hna.","ref":"Gen 23.3-16; 33.19; 50.7-13; Jos 24.32"},"17":{"text":"“Pathian nih Abraham sinah bia-kamnak a sermi a tlin caan kha a nai tikah Izipt ram i a ummi kan mi hna cu fak piin an karh.","ref":"Exo 1.7-8"},"18":{"text":"A hnu a hnuah cun siangpahrang dang, Josef a hngal lomi nih Izipt ram cu a hun uk."},"19":{"text":"Kan miphun kha a rak hlen hna i a kan hringsortu hna kha a rak hrem hna, an fale kha an thih nakhnga an inn chungin lengah a rak chiahter hna.","ref":"Exo 1.10-11,22"},"20":{"text":"Hi caan lioah hin Moses kha a rak chuak i fa dawh ngai a si. Inn ah thla thum an zohkhenh i","ref":"Exo 2.2"},"21":{"text":"inn cun an chuah tikah Faro fanu nih khan a fa ah a rak i ser i a fapa bantukin a zohkhenh.","ref":"Exo 2.3-10"},"22":{"text":"Moses cu Izipt fimnak vialte kha an cawnter i bia ah siseh, thil tinak ah siseh, mingan ngaingai ah a hung cang."},"23":{"text":"“Moses cu kum sawm li a ti tikah a phunhawi Israel mi kha a va leng hna.","ref":"Exo 2.11-15"},"24":{"text":"Pakhat pa cu Izipt mipa nih a rak hrem lio kha a hmuh i cucaah a phunhawi a simipa cu a bawmh i Izipt mipa cu teirul cham in a thah."},"25":{"text":"(Pathian nih keimah cu anmah luattertu dingah a ka hman lai ti kha an hngalh lai tiah a ruah, sihmanhsehlaw an hngal lo)."},"26":{"text":"A thaizing ah Israel mi pahnih an i velh kha a hmuh hna i an karlak i remnak ser kha aa zuam. A thawh hna i, “Ka duale hna, ka bia hi ngai tuah u, nannih cu u le nau pei nan si cu, zeicahdah pakhat le pakhat nan i velh?” tiah a ti hna."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a sual deuhpa nih khan Moses cu a nam i, “Aho nih dah nangmah cu kan cung i uktu bawi ah an in ser?"},"28":{"text":"Nizan i Izipt mipa na thah bantuk khan maw keimah zong thah na ka duh?” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Hi bia kha Moses nih a theih tikah Izipt ram khan a zam i Midian ram ah a va um. Khika ah fapa pahnih a ngeih hna.","ref":"Exo 18.3-4"},"30":{"text":"“Cun kum sawm li a dih hnuah, Moses sinah cun vancungmi kha Sinai Tlang pawng thetse ram i burbuk a kangmi meizik in a lang.","ref":"Exo 3.1-10"},"31":{"text":"Moses cu a hmuhmi kha a khuaruah a har i cucaah naih tein va zoh awkah burbuk pawngah cun a va kal. Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa aw tu kha a theih i,"},"32":{"text":"‘Keimah cu nan pupa hna Pathian, Abraham le Isak le Jakob Pathian kha ka si,’ tiah a rak ti. Moses cu a ṭih tuk ah a ther in a ther i a zoh hmanh a zoh ngam lo."},"33":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a thawh i, ‘Na kedan kha i phawih, zeicahtiah na dirnak hmun kha hmun thiang a si."},"34":{"text":"Izipt ram chungah ka mi hna nih an inmi le an tuarmi kha ka zoh i ka hmuh. An aihramnak kha ka theih i anmah khamh awkah ka rung ṭum. Ra tuah, Izipt ram ah kan thlah lai,’ tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"“Moses kha Israel mi nih an rak hlawtmipa a si. ‘Kan cung i uktu bawi le biaceihtu ah aho nih dah aan chiah?’ tiah an rak ti, sihmanhsehlaw amah cu a alh hluahmahmi burbuk chungin a sinah a hung langmi vancungmi bawmhnak thawngin, Pathian nih uktu si ding le khamhtu si dingah a rak thlah mipa a si.","ref":"Exo 2.14"},"36":{"text":"A miphun kha Izipt ram in a chuahpi hna i Izipt ram le Rili Sen le thetse ram ah khan kum sawm li chung khuaruahhar le hmelchunhnak thil kha a tuah hna.","ref":"Exo 7.5; 14.21; Nam 14.33"},"37":{"text":"Israel mi sinah, ‘Pathian nih keimah a ka thlah bantukte hin profet pakhat an thlahhnawh te hna lai i amah cu nanmah chungmi a si lai,’ a ti, tiah a rak titu kha Moses cu a si.","ref":"Deu 18.15,18"},"38":{"text":"Amah cu thetse ram i a rak i pummi Israel mi hna sin i a ummi kha a si, amah cu a kan hringsortu hna sin i khua a rak sami le Sinai Tlang ah a sin i bia a rak chimtu vancungmi sin i a ummi kha a si; amah cu Pathian bia zungzal in a nungmi kan sin i phakter awkah a rak latu kha a si.","ref":"Exo 19.1—20.17; Deu 5.1-33"},"39":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw kan pu le kan pa hna nih khan an hlawt i Izipt ram i vung kir ṭhan tu kha an duh deuh."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah Aaron kha an thawh i, ‘Kan hmai i a kal hnga ding pathian kan serpiak tuah hna. Izipt ram in a kan chuahpitu Moses kha zeitin a um kan hngal ti lo,’ an ti.","ref":"Exo 32.1"},"41":{"text":"Khi tikah khan pei cawfa mui in siasal pakhat an ser i raithawinak an pek i anmah lila nih an sermi conglawmhnak ca i puai an ser kha a si cu.","ref":"Exo 32.2-6"},"42":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu Pathian nih a mertak hna i profet hna cauk chungah aa ṭial bang khan vancung arfi kha a biakter hna. Cu cauk chungah cun: ‘Israel mi hna, thetse ram chungah kum sawm li sa nan thah i raithawinak nan tuahmi kha keimah biaknak caah a si lo.","ref":"Amo 5.25-27"},"43":{"text":"Nannih nih nan i phorhmi thlam cu Molok pathian thlam kha a si i Nan i kalpimi milem cu nan pathian Refan arfi siasal kha a si; Annih cu nanmah nih biak awk caah nan ser chommi siasal an si. Cucaah nannih cu Babilon pinah kan kalter hna lai,’ tiin aa ṭial."},"44":{"text":"“Kan pupa hna nih khan, Pathian kan sinah a um ti hngalhnak thlam kha thetse ram ah khan an rak i ngeih ko. Pathian nih Moses a chimh bantuk khan sermi a si i Moses nih a hmuhmi pungsan ning khan tuah a si.","ref":"Exo 25.9,10"},"45":{"text":"Cun a hnu deuh ah a kan hringsortu hna nih kan thlam cu an pupa hna sin khan an lak i Joshua sin i an kal ah khan an i kalpi; an hmai in Pathian nih a dawimi hna ram kha an va lak tikah, thlam kha an i kalpi lengmang i cuka ah cun David chan tiang kha a um.","ref":"Jos 3.14-17"},"46":{"text":"David nih cun Pathian duhdawtnak kha a hmuh i Jakob Pathian caah inn pakhat sak awkah Pathian kha a hal.","ref":"2Sam 7.1-16; 1Cha 17.1-14"},"47":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw inn a vun sakpiaktu taktak cu Solomon a si.","ref":"1Sia 6.1-38; 2Cha 3.1-17"},"48":{"text":"“Sihmanhsehlaw Cung Nung Bik Pathian cu, profet nih,"},"49":{"text":"‘Vancung hi ka ṭhutnak a si i vawlei hi ka kelamh a si. Zei bantuk inn dah na ka sakpiak lai? Khuazei ah dah kaa dinhnak ding hmun cu a si?","ref":"Isa 66.1-2"},"50":{"text":"Hi thil vialte hna a sertu hi keimah ka si lo maw? tiah Bawipa nih a ti,’ a rak ti bangin, minung nih an sakmi inn ah cun a um lo."},"51":{"text":"“Zeitluk lung hakmi dah nan si rih? Zeitluk in dah lungchung in cuarpar aa tan lomi le Pathian bia theihnak leiah a hna aa chehmi nan si rih! Nannih cu nan pupa hna hlikhlekte kha nan si ko, nannih zong nih Thiang Thlarau kha nan donh zungzal ko!","ref":"Isa 63.10"},"52":{"text":"Nan pupa hna nih an rak hrem lomi profet an um maw? Pathian Sal a rat lainak hlanpi in a rak chim chungtu Pathian lamkaltu hna kha an rak thah hna. Cun atu cu nannih nih amah kha nan rawi i nan nawn."},"53":{"text":"Vancungmi nih an in pekmi hna Pathian phungbia a rak latu cu nanmah nan si i asinain cu phungbia a zul lotu cu nanmah ṭhiamṭhiam nan si,” tiah a ti."},"54":{"text":"Steven bia kha khawngsil pawl nih cun an theih tikah a henh in a henh hna i an hacang lawng kha an rial ko.","title":"Steven Lung In An Cheh"},"55":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Thiang Thlarau in a khatmi Steven nih khan van lei khi a hun zoh i Pathian sunparnak kha a hmuh i Jesuh cu Pathian orhlei kamah a dir kha a hmuh."},"56":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Zohhmanh u, vancung aa hun i Pathian orhlei kamah Mi Fapa a dir kha ka hmuh,” tiah a ti."},"57":{"text":"Cu bia an theih tikah fak piin an au i an kut in an hna kha an i phih i an hei zuanhnawh i"},"58":{"text":"khua chung khan lengah an hnuh i lung in an va cheh. Cuti in lung in a cheptu hna nih cun an puan kha, tlangval pakhat a min Saul a simi kehram ah khan an i chiah."},"59":{"text":"Lung in an cheh chih lengmang lioah cun Steven nih, “Bawipa Jesuh, ka thlarau cu nangmah nih cohlang ko,” tiin a au."},"60":{"text":"A khuk aa bil i fak piin a au i “Bawipa, hi sualnak hi an cungah khing hlah,” tiah a ti i a thi colh. Cun Steven an nawn kha Saul zong cu a hna a tla ve."}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu ni hrimhrim cun Jerusalem khua khrihfabu nih hremnak in hram aa thawk. Lamkaltu pawl kha dah ti lo cu, a zummi vialte kha Judea ram le Samaria ram ah an i ṭhek dih.","title":"Saul Nih Khrihfabu A Hrem Hna"},"2":{"text":"Steven kha biaknak lei i aa biatakmi a cheu nih an vui i fak piin an ṭah."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul nih khan khrihfabu cu hrawh aa zuam; inn khat hnu inn khat in a kal i a zummi hna kha nu thlulo pa thlulo in a hnuh hna i thong ah a thlak hna.","ref":"Lam 22.4-5; 26.9-11"},"4":{"text":"Zumtu aa ṭhekmi kha a kenkiplo ah an kal i an kalnak paoh ah thawngṭha kha an chim.","title":"Filip Samaria Ah Thawngṭha A Chim"},"5":{"text":"Filip cu Samaria ram khua ah khan a va kal i Messiah kong kha a va chimh hna."},"6":{"text":"Filip nih a chimmi kha mizapi nih ṭha tein an ngaih. A chimmi kha an ngaih i khuaruahharnak a tuahmi kha an hmuh."},"7":{"text":"Mi tampi chungin khuachia kha aupah in an chuak i a zengmi le a beimi mi tampi kha damnak an hmu."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah Samaria ah cun lawmhnak nganpi a um."},"9":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Simon timi kha a um i amah cu Samaria mi hna, a camh thiamnak in sau nawn an khuaruah a hartertu kha a si. Mingan pakhat ka si aa ti i"},"10":{"text":"cu khua chungmi vialte hna nih cun, a hme bik in a ngan bik tiang, amah bia cu an ngaih. Amah cu Pathian ṭhawnnak “Ṭhawnnak Ngan” timi kha a si, an ti."},"11":{"text":"A camh thiamnak in saupi an khuaruah a rak harter hna caah amah cu an zulh."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Filip chimmi Thawngṭha, Pathian Pennak kong le Jesuh Khrih min kong kha an zumh tikah nu he pa he tipilnak kha an ing."},"13":{"text":"Simon hrimhrim zong nih cun a zumh ve i tipilnak a in dih hnuah Filip sinah cun aa helhum lengmang ve; a nganmi hmelchunhnak hna le khuaruahharnak hna kha a hmuh hna tikah a khuaruah a har ngaingai."},"14":{"text":"Samaria mi nih Pathian bia kha an hmuh ve ti kha Jerusalem khua i a ummi lamkaltu pawl nih khan an theih tikah an sinah cun Peter le Johan kha an hei thlah hna."},"15":{"text":"An va phak tikah zumtu hna nih khan Thiang Thlarau an hmuh nakhnga thla an campiak hna."},"16":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Thiang Thlarau cu annih lakah khan aho cung hmanh ah a tlung rih lo; Bawipa Jesuh min in tipil lawng an rak ing rih."},"17":{"text":"Cun Peter le Johan nih an cungah an kut an chuan i Thiang Thlarau kha an hmuh."},"18":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih an cungah an kut an chuan tikah Thiang Thlarau an hmu ti kha Simon nih a hmuh tikah Peter le Johan kha a thawh hna i,"},"19":{"text":"“Ka kut ka chuanpiakmi hna paoh nih Thiang Thlarau kha an hmuh ve nakhnga hi ṭhawnnak hi ka pe ve u,” tiin phaisa kha pek a zalh hna."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih cun a leh i, “Pathian laksawng cu phaisa in ka cawk khawh lai tiah na ruah ruangah hin nangmah le na phaisa cu hell ah va tla ko u!"},"21":{"text":"Pathian mithmuh ah na lung kha ahmaan lo caah kan rian ṭuannak ah hin zeihmanh naa tel venak a um lo."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah cun hi thil ṭhalo na ruahmi hi i ngaihchih law hi bantuk thil ṭhalo na ruahmi hi an ngaihthiam khawh nakhnga Bawipa sinah thla cam."},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah fiang tein ka hmuhmi cu nahchuahnak in na khat i sual thongtla na si,” tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Simon nih Peter cu a thawh i, “Na chimmi vialte hi pakhat hmanh ka cungah a tlun nakhnga lo Bawipa sinah thla ka campiak tuah,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"An hmuhmi le an theihmi kong an chim dih hnu le Bawipa bia kha an chim dih hnuah Peter le Johan cu Jerusalem khua ah an tlung ṭhan. Lampi ah Thawngṭha kha Samaria ram khua tampi ah an chimpah."},"26":{"text":"Bawipa vancungmi pakhat nih Filip cu a thawh i, “I tim law thlanglei ah vung kal law Jerusalem in Gaza ah a kalmi lam ah khan vung kal tuah,” a ti (Cu lam cu an hmang ti lo).","title":"Filip le Ethiopia Bawi Kong"},"27":{"text":"Cucaah Filip cu aa tim i a kal. Cu lioah cun Ethiopia mi tilditmi pakhat an khua lei i a tlungmi a rak um. Cu pa cu bawi upa pakhat a si i Kandeis ti zongah ti a simi Ethiopia Siangpahrangnu tangka bawi kha a si. Amah cu Pathian biak awkah khan Jerusalem khua ah a va kal i a rangleng in a tlun lei a si. Rangleng aa citpah cun Isaiah cauk kha a rel.","merge":"28"},"29":{"text":"Thiang Thlarau nih Filip cu a thawh i, “Va kal law khi rangleng khi va naih tuah,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Filip cu a va tli i a relmi cu Isaiah cauk chung bia a si kha a theih i, “Na relmi cu a sullam na hngal maw?” tiah a hal."},"31":{"text":"Cu bawi nih cun a thawh i, “Aho tal nih a sullam chimh lo cun zeitindah ka hngalh khawh hnga,” tiah a ti. Cun Filip kha rangleng cungah hin hung kai law ka sinah ṭhu tuah, tiah a sawm."},"32":{"text":"A rak rel lengmangmi caang cu hihi a si: “Amah cu thah awkah hruaimi tuu bantuk a si, amah cu a hmul an meh tikah a awn-au lomi tuufa bantuk a si; bia kaa khat hmanh chim lo tein a um ko.","ref":"Isa 53.7-8"},"33":{"text":"Ningzahnak kha a in, chanhtu ahohmanh a ngei lo. Hi vawlei cung a nunnak cu a dongh cang caah a tefa hna kong kha ahohmanh nih an chim kho lai lo.”"},"34":{"text":"Kha bawi nih khan Filip cu a thawh i, “Profet nih hin aho kong dah a chim, ka chim tuah; amah kong maw aa chim, midang kong dah a chim?” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Filip nih cun a vun i thawh i, hi Baibal cang hin i thawk in Jesuh kong Thawngṭha kha a chimh."},"36":{"text":"An vung zuan lengmang lioah khin ti tlawmpal a rak umnak hmun pakhat kha an phan i cu tikah cu bawi nih cun aa thawh i, “Hika ah hin pei ti a um hi, zei nih dah tipil in a ka donh lai?” tiah a ti. ("},"37":{"text":"Filip nih aa thawh i, “Na lung dihlak in na zumh ahcun tipilnak cu na in ko lai,” tiah a ti. “Ka zumh, Jesuh Khrih cu Pathian Fapa a si ti kha ka zumh ko,” tiah a ti.)"},"38":{"text":"Cu bawi nih cun rangleng cu a dirter i an pahnih cun ti chungah khan an vung kal i Filip nih tipilnak cu a pek."},"39":{"text":"Ti chungin an hung chuah tikah Bawipa Thlarau nih Filip cu lo diam in a lak. Kha bawi nih khan a hmu ṭhan ti lo, sihmanhsehlaw lunglawm ngaiin a kal."},"40":{"text":"Filip cu Ashdod ah khan a hung chuak i Sisaria khua tiang khua kip ah aa chawk i Thawngṭha kha a chimh hna."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu lio hrawngah cun Bawipa zultu pawl kha Saul nih thah awkin a tlerh cuahmah lengmang ko hna. Tlangbawi Ngan sinah a hung kal i","title":"Saul Lungthlennak"},"2":{"text":"Damaskas khua Judah pumhnak inn haotu pawl sin i theihhngalhnak ca kha a hung hal. A duhnak cu khi khua ah khan Bawipa Lam a zulmi ka hmuh hna ahcun nu thlulo pa thlulo in ka tlaih hna lai i Jerusalem ah ka kalpi hna lai, ti a si."},"3":{"text":"Damaskas khua a hei fuh lio, khua pawng a phak ah khin, chikkhatte ah van in ceu pakhat nih a velchum in a run ceuh."},"4":{"text":"Vawlei ah a tlu i aw pakhat nih, “Saul, Saul, zeicahdah na ka hrem?” tiah a ti thawng kha a theih."},"5":{"text":"“Ahodah na si, Bawipa?” tiah a leh. Aw nih cun, “Keimah cu na hremmi Jesuh ka si."},"6":{"text":"Tho law khua chungah khan va lut tuah, khika ah na tuah awk hnga kha an rak in chimh lai,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Saul he a kal ṭimi hna cu cipkhap ti loin an dir ko; aw cu an theih, sihmanhsehlaw ahohmanh an hmu hna lo."},"8":{"text":"Saul cu vawlei cun a hung tho i a mit a hun au, sihmanhsehlaw zeihmanh a hmu kho lo. Cucaah a kut in an hruai i Damaskas khua chungah cun an luhpi."},"9":{"text":"Ni thum chung khua hmu kho loin a um, cu chung vialte cu rawl zong a ei lo, ti zong a ding lo."},"10":{"text":"Damaskas khua ah cun zultu pakhat Ananias an timi a rak um. Cu pa nih cun langhnak a hmuh i cu langhnak a hmuhmi ah cun Bawipa nih, “Ananias,” tiah a ti i anih nih, “Hika ah ka um, Bawipa,” tiah a leh."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa nih cun a thawh i, “I tim law Lam Ding timi ah khan va kal law Judas inn ah khan Tarsas khuami pakhat Saul an timi cu a um maw um lo tiah va hal hna. Amah cu thla a cam lio a si i"},"12":{"text":"langhnak in mipa pakhat Ananias timi a rung luh i khua a hmuh ṭhan nakhnga a cung i a kut a chuan kha a hmuh,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Ananias nih cun a leh i, “Bawipa, mi tampi nih hi pa kong hi an ka chimh; Jerusalem khua i na mi hna cungah thil ṭhalo a tuahmi vialte kha ka theih."},"14":{"text":"Cun Damaskas khua i a rat zongah hin na min an komi hna paoh kha tlaih awkah tlangbawi upa hna sin in nawlngeihnak ca a run i phorh fawn,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun a leh i, “Va kal ko, zeicahtiah amah cu keimah rian ṭuantu dingah, Jentail mi hna le siangpahrang hna le Israel mi hna sinah ka min hngalhter awkah ka thim cang."},"16":{"text":"Cun keimah hrimhrim nih keimah ruangah a in lai dingmi thil vialte kha ka hmuhsak lai,” tiah a ti."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah Ananias cu a va kal i inn ah khan a va lut i Saul cungah cun a kut a va chuan. “Ka nau Saul, hika lei i na rat lio i na sinah a langmi Bawipa — Jesuh hrimhrim — nih khan keimah cu a ka fial. A ka fialnak cu nangmah nih khua na hmuh ṭhan i Thiang Thlarau in na khah nakhnga caah a si,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah khin Saul mit cun nga phokphawher bantuk khi a tla i khua a hmu kho ṭhan. A dir i tipilnak kha a in;"},"19":{"text":"cun rawl a ei dih hnuah a thazang kha a tlung ṭhan. Saul cu Damaskas khua i a ummi zultu hna sinah khan ni tlawmpal a cam."},"20":{"text":"Pumhnak inn ah khan i cungcang loin a va kal i, “Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si,” tiah a chimh hna.","title":"Damaskas Ah Phung A Chim"},"21":{"text":"A bia a theimi paoh cu an khuaruah a har i, “Hi pa hi Jerusalem khua i Bawi Jesuh min a komi paoh a that i hika zongah hin cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in annih kha tlaih i tlangbawi upa hna sinah kalpi awkah a ramipa kha a si lo maw?” an ti."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Saul phungchimmi cu a ṭhawng chin lengmang i Jesuh cu Messiah a si tiah a chim khawhnak kha mi lung a fianter tuk caah Damaskas khua i a ummi Judah mi hna nih khan an let kho lo."},"23":{"text":"Ni tam nawn hnuah khin Judah mi cu an i pum i Saul thahnak dingah khua an khang;","ref":"2Kor 11.32-33"},"24":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw tuah an i timhmi kha a chimtu an rak um. Amah kha thah an duh caah cun chunzan in khua kutka kha an cawngh hna."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zan khat cu Saul kha a hawile nih khua kulhnak vampang a pemnak awng in lengah bawm in an thlak."},"26":{"text":"Saul cu Jerusalem khua ah khan a hung kal i zultu pawl kha komh a hung timh hna. Sihmanhsehlaw annih nih zultu a si ve cang ti kha an rak zum lo i cucaah amah cu an ṭih ngaingai."},"27":{"text":"Khi tikah Barnabas nih khan amah cu a bawmh i lamkaltu pawl sinah khan a kalpi. Zeitindah Saul nih lampi ah Bawipa a hmuhnak kong le Bawipa nih a sinah bia a chimnak kong tehna kha a chimh hna. Damaskas khua i Saul nih ralṭha ngaiin Jesuh min in phung a chimnak zong kha a chimh hna."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah Saul cu an sinah khan a um i Jerusalem khua kha a cul dih i Bawipa min in ralṭha ngaiin phung a chimh hna."},"29":{"text":"Grik holh in a holhmi Judah mi hna he zong khan bia an i ruah i a al zong an i al len, sihmanhsehlaw annih nih cun thah kha an timh."},"30":{"text":"Hi kong kha zultu unau rual hna nih khan an theih tikah Saul kha Sisaria khua ah an kalpi i Tarsas khua ah khan an kalter."},"31":{"text":"Cuticun Judea ram le Galilee ram le Samaria ram i a ummi khrihfabu vialte nih khan daihnak caan an hmu. Bawipa kha ṭihzah ngaiin an um i Thiang Thlarau bawmhnak thawngin an ṭhang i an karh."},"32":{"text":"Peter cu khuazakip ah khan a kal i voi khat cu Lidda khua i a ummi Pathian mi hna kha a va tlawng hna.","title":"Peter Kha Lidda le Joppa A Tlawng"},"33":{"text":"Khika ah mipa pakhat Ainias an timi kha a va hmuh i cu pa cu mizeng a si i a ihkhun in kum riat chung a tho ti lo."},"34":{"text":"Peter nih cun a thawh i, “Ainias, Jesuh Khrih nih an damter cang. Tho law na ihphah kha zual,” tiah a ti. Chikkhatte ah khin Ainias cu a tho."},"35":{"text":"Amah cu Lidda le Sharon i a ummi vialte nih khan an hmuh i Bawipa leiah an i mer."},"36":{"text":"Cun Joppa khua ah hin Jesuh zummi nu pakhat a min Tabitha a simi a um, (amah cu Grik holh cun Dorkas ti a si i a sullam cu sazuk tinak a si.) ṭhatnak tuah le sifak bawmh ah khan a caan vialte cu a hman dih tawn."},"37":{"text":"Cu caan ah cun a rak zaw i a thi. A ruak cu an ṭawl i cunglei dot ah khan an suan."},"38":{"text":"Joppa khua cu Lidda khua khan a hla tuk lo i zultu pawl nih khan Peter cu Lidda ah a um ti an theih tikah mi pahnih an hei thlah hna i, “Khulrang in kan sinah ra ta tuah,” tiah bia an cah."},"39":{"text":"Cucaah Peter cu aa tim i an sinah cun a kal. A va phak tikah cungdot ah khan an kaipi. Nuhmei vialte nih khan a zual in an zual i an ṭahpah khan, Dorkas nih a nun lioah a rak serpiakmi hna angki hna le puan hna kha an hmuhsak."},"40":{"text":"Peter nih an dihlak in a chuahter hna i a khuk aa bil i thla a cam; cun miruak leiah khan a hei i mer i, “Tabitha, tho tuah,” tiah a ti. A mit kha a hun au i Peter kha a hmuh tikah a hung ṭhu."},"41":{"text":"Peter nih a kut a hei chanh i a thawh. Cun a zummi hna le nuhmei hna kha a auh hna i a nung in an sinah cun a pek hna."},"42":{"text":"Hi thawng nih cun Joppa khua kha a cul dih i mi tampi nih Bawipa kha an zumh."},"43":{"text":"Peter cu Joppa khua ah khan saphaw sertu Simon sinah saupi a cam."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Sisaria khua ah hin mipa pakhat a rak um i a min cu Kornelias a si; amah cu Rom ralkapbu pakhat, “Itali Ralkap Bu” timi a haotu kha a si.","title":"Peter le Kornelias"},"2":{"text":"Amah cu biaknak leiah aa zuam ngaingaimipa a si i amah le a innchungkhar nih khan an dihlak in Pathian kha an biak. Amah nih khan Judah mi hna lak i misifak hna kha siang ngaiin a bawmh hna i Pathian sinah thla zong a cam zungzal."},"3":{"text":"Ni khat cu zanlei suimilam pathum tluk ah khin langhnak a hmu i cu langhnak a hmuhmi ah cun Pathian vancungmi pakhat a rung luh i, “Kornelias,” tiah a rung chawnh kha fiang tein a hmuh."},"4":{"text":"Vancungmi kha thinphang ngaiin dengteo in a zoh i, “Zeidah, bawipa?” tiah a ti. Vancungmi nih cun a hun leh i, “Pathian nih na thlacamnak le misifak na bawmh hnanak kha an cohlanpiak i nangmah cu an philh lo."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah atu ah Joppa khua ah mi hei thlah hna law a min Simon Peter a simi pa kha va auhter hna."},"6":{"text":"Amah cu rilikam i a ummi saphaw sertu Simon inn ah a tlung,” tiah a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun amah sinah bia a chimtu vancungmi kha a kal i Kornelias nih cun a inn chung i a sinum pahnih hna le ralkap pakhat kha a auh hna; ralkappa cu biaknak lei i lungthin a ngei ngaingaimi a si i amah Kornelias a zohkhenhtu hna lak i aa tel vemi pakhat kha a si."},"8":{"text":"Thil umtuning vialte kha a chimh hna i Joppa khua ah cun a thlah hna."},"9":{"text":"A thaizing chun hrawng Joppa khua an hei phak deng ah khan, Peter cu thlacam awkah inn cungah a kai."},"10":{"text":"A rawl a ṭam i rawl ei kha a duh; cun rawl an ser lioah khan langhnak a hmu."},"11":{"text":"Van kha aa hung i puan he aa lomi thil a ki ki li in vawlei i an run thlakmi kha a hmuh."},"12":{"text":"A chungah cun saram a phunphun le a lawn in a lawnmi thilnung a phunphun le ramlak va a phunphun kha an um."},"13":{"text":"Aw pakhat nih a hun thawh i, “Tho tuah, Peter, that hna law ei tuah hna,” tiah a ti."},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Peter nih a thawh i, “Ka ei lai lo, Bawipa. Thurhhnawmhmi thil le a thiang lomi thil cu zeihmanh ka ei bal lo,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun aw nih cun a vun chawnh ṭhan i, “Pathian nih a thiang a timi cu zeihmanh nang nih a thianglo ah ruat hlah,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Cu thil cu cuticun voi thum tiang a um i cu hnuah van leiah lak ṭhan a si."},"17":{"text":"Peter cu a hmuhmi langhnak kha a sullam zeidah a si hnga tiah khuaruahhar in a ruah lengmang lioah khan Kornelias nih a thlahmi hna cu Simon inn kha an phan i a kutka hmaiah khan an rak dir cang."},"18":{"text":"An hei auh hna i, “Hika ah hin Simon Peter timi khualpa a um maw?” tiah an hei hal hna."},"19":{"text":"Peter cu langhnak a hmuhmi a sullam kha zeidah a si hnga tiah hngalh aa zuam lengmang lioah khin Thlarau nih a vun thawh i, “Ngaihmanh, minung pathum nih an in kawl len ko."},"20":{"text":"Cucaah i tim law vung ṭum law annih cu keimah nih ka thlahmi hna an si caah an sin i kal kha i thuahthah hlah,” tiah a ti."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah Peter cu a vung ṭum i mi cu a thawh hna i, “Nan kawl lengmangmi cu keimah hi ka si. Zei herh ah dah nan rat?” tiah a ti hna."},"22":{"text":"Annih nih cun an leh i, “Kepṭen Kornelias nih a kan thlahmi kan si. Amah cu miṭha le Pathian a biami a si i Judah mi vialte nih an hmaizah ngaingaimi a si. Amah nih cun na bia kha a theih ve nakhnga Pathian vancungmi pakhat nih nangmah cu a inn rat va sawm awkah amah cu a chimh,” tiah an ti."},"23":{"text":"Peter nih cun mi hna cu, inn chungah rung lut u, tiah a ti hna i cu zan cu khika ah cun an riak. A thaizing cu aa tim i an sinah khan a kal i Joppa khua i unau cheukhat zong kha an kal ve."},"24":{"text":"A kiptuh ah cun Sisaria cu an va phan i cuka ah cun Kornelias le a sahlawh a rualchan hna le a hawikom a rak sawmmi hna nih khan an rak hngah ko."},"25":{"text":"Peter cu a vung luh hnik ah khin Kornelias nih cun a rak don i a hmaiah a rak bawk."},"26":{"text":"Peter nih cun a vun thawh i, “Dir tuah, keimah zong minung pei ka si ve ko cu,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Inn chung an luhpah cun Peter nih khan Kornelias cu bia a ruah lengmang i cuka ah cun mi tampi an rak i pumh kha a hmuh hna."},"28":{"text":"Annih cu a thawh hna i, “Judah mi cu Jentail mi he i len i kai awk le i komh i hawi awk kha an biaknak phung nih a onh hna lo ti cu nannih nih fiang tein nan hngalh. Sihmanhsehlaw mi zeihmanh kha a thur le a thianglo i ka ruah hna nakhnga lo Pathian nih a ka hmuhsak cang."},"29":{"text":"Cucaah nan ka auh tikah zeihmanh alnak um lo tein ka ra ko. Cucaah zeicahdah nan ka auh ka chim tuah u,” tiah a ti hna."},"30":{"text":"Kornelias nih aa thawh i, “Tihni hmasa hmasa chin ah khan atu tikah hin ka inn ah zanlei suimilam pathum ah thla ka cam. Chikkhatte ah khin puan vaar aa aihmi pakhat ka hmaiah khin a hung dir i"},"31":{"text":"a ka thawh i, ‘Kornelias, Pathian nih na thlacamnak kha a theih i sifak na bawmhnak hna kha a philh lo."},"32":{"text":"Joppa khua ah mi hei thlah hna law a min Simon Peter a simi kha va kawhter hna. Amah cu rili kam i a ummi saphaw sertu Simon inn ah a tlung khah,’ tiah a ka ti."},"33":{"text":"Cucaah nangmah cu khulrang in kan kawh i na ra. Atu cu kan dihlak in hika ah hin Pathian hmaika ah kan um i Pathian nih chim awkah an fialmi paoh cu kan chim tuah,” tiah a ti."},"34":{"text":"Peter nih cun aa thawh i, “Atu cu Pathian nih mi vialte kha aa ruang tein a zoh hna ti kha ka hngalh.","title":"Kornelias Inn Ah Peter","ref":"Deu 10.17"},"35":{"text":"Mi zei miphun chungmi hmanh a si ah, amah a ṭihmi paoh le dinnak a tuahmi paoh cu a cohlan hna."},"36":{"text":"Mi vialte Bawipa a simi Jesuh Khrih thawngin Pathian nih remnak Thawngṭha Israel mi a pek hna cu nan hngalh."},"37":{"text":"Johan nih tipilnak kong a chim hnuah khan, Galilee in i thawk in Israel ram dihlak ah thil lianngan a hung ummi kong kha nan hngalh fawn."},"38":{"text":"Cu thil lianngan cu, zeitindah Pathian nih Nazareth khuami Jesuh kha Thiang Thlarau le ṭhawnnak a toih i Pathian nih a umpi caah zeitindah khuazakip ah aa chawh i khuachia ṭhawnnak tangah a ummi vialte a damter hna kha a si."},"39":{"text":"Judah mi hna ram chung le Jerusalem khua i a tuahmi vialte a hngaltu tehte cu kanmah kha kan si. Vailamtahnak ah thir an khenh chih i an thah."},"40":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ni thumnak ni ah Pathian nih thihnak in a thawhter i mi kip sinah si loin,"},"41":{"text":"Pathian nih tehte caah a kan thimmi kanmah sin lawngah khan Pathian nih cun a langhter. Thihnak in a thawh hnuah amah he cun kan ei ṭi kan ding ṭi."},"42":{"text":"Cun mi sinah Thawngṭha chim awk le amah cu Pathian nih a nungmi he a thimi he an biaceihtu ah a ser cang ti tehte khaangtu ah a kan fial."},"43":{"text":"Profet vialte nih amah kong cu an rak chim i amah a zummi paoh cu a min ṭhawnnak thawngin an sualnak kha ngaihthiam an si lai, tiah an ti,” tiah a ti."},"44":{"text":"Peter nih bia a chim lengmang lioah cun a bia a ngaimi hna cungah khan Thiang Thlarau a ṭum.","title":"Jentail Mi Nih Thiang Thlarau An Hmuh"},"45":{"text":"Judah mi lakah zumtu, Joppa khua in Peter a run zul vemi hna nih khan Jentail mi cung zongah Pathian nih a Thiang Thlarau laksawng kha a toih ve ko ti an hmuh tikah an khuaruah a har."},"46":{"text":"Zeicah ti ahcun, holhtheihlo in an holh le Pathian lianhngannak an thangṭhat kha an theih hna caah a si. Cun Peter nih cun,"},"47":{"text":"“Hi mi hna nih hin Thiang Thlarau cu kanmah nih kan rak hmuh bantukte khan an hmuh ve. Cucaah ti in tipilnak in awkah aho nih an dawn kho hna hnga maw?” tiah a ti."},"48":{"text":"Cucaah Jesuh Khrih min in tipil in awk kha a fial hna. Cun kan sinah tlawmpal in cam ko rih, tiah an nawl."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judah peng chung i a ummi lamkaltu hna le unaule hna nih khan Jentail mi zong nih Pathian bia kha an cohlan ve ti kha an theih.","title":"Peter Nih Jerusalem Khrihfabu Thawng A Thanh Hna"},"2":{"text":"Cun Peter cu Jerusalem khua i a hung kal ah khan, Jentail mi hna cu an cuarpar i tan hna seh, ti a duhmi hna nih khan an rak soi i,"},"3":{"text":"“Cuarpar tan lomi Jentail mi hna inn ah na tlung i rawl zong na ei,” tiah an rak ti."},"4":{"text":"Cucaah Peter nih cun thil umtuning vialte kha tling tein a hramthawk tein a chimh hna."},"5":{"text":"Aa thawh i, “Joppa khua ah khan thla ka cam i langhnak kha ka hmuh. Puan nganpi pakhat, a ki pali in van in an run thlakmi he aa lomi thil khi ka hmuh i ka pawngah khan a rung dir."},"6":{"text":"A chung kha ṭha tein ka vun zoh i inn zuat saṭil le ramsa le a lawn in a lawnmi thilnung hna le va kha ka hmuh hna."},"7":{"text":"Cun aw pakhat kha ka theih i, ‘Peter, tho law that hna law ei hna,’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kei nih khan kaa thawh i, ‘Sihlah, Bawipa. Thurhhnawmhmi rawl siseh, a thiang lomi rawl siseh, ka kaa chungah a lut bal lo,’ tiah ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Cun aw nih cun vancung cun a run ka chawnh ṭhan i, ‘Pathian nih a thiang a timi thil paohpaoh cu a thianglo ah rel hna hlah,’ tiah a ti."},"10":{"text":"Hi thil hi voi thum tiang a um i a donghnak ah cun a ningpi in vancung ah khan an run hnuh ṭhan."},"11":{"text":"Cu lio caan thengte ah cun Sisaria khua in ka sinah an rak thlahmi mi pathum hna kha ka tlunnak inn cu an ra phan."},"12":{"text":"Thlarau nih i thuahthah loin an sin i kal awk kha a ka fial. Hi kan unau paruk hna, Joppa khuami hna zong hi ka sinah cun Sisaria khua ah khan an kal ve i kan dihlak in Kornelias inn ah khan kan i ṭhum."},"13":{"text":"Amah nih cun a inn chungah vancungmi pakhat a rung dir i, ‘Joppa khua ah mi hei thlah hna law a min tling Simon Peter a simi mipa pakhat kha va au hna seh."},"14":{"text":"Amah nih cun bia an chimh hna lai i cu bia thawng cun khamhnak nan hmuh lai,’ tiah a chimtu a hmuhnak kha a kan chimh."},"15":{"text":"Cun an sinah bia ka chim tikah khan, a hramthawk i kan cungah a rak tlun bantukte khan, an cungah cun Thiang Thlarau kha a tlung ve."},"16":{"text":"Khi tikah kan Bawipa nih, ‘Johan nih cun ti in tipilnak a pek hna, sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu Thlarau in tipilnak pek nan si lai,’ tiah a rak timi kha ka lung ah a hung pem.","ref":"Lam 1.5"},"17":{"text":"Kannih nih Bawipa Jesuh Khrih kan zumh tikah Pathian nih laksawng a kan pekmi bantukte kha Jentail mi hna zong Pathian nih cun a pek ve hna ti kha a fiang ko; cucaah, a hi kei nih hin maw, Pathian cu ka donh hnga?” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Cu bia cu an theih tikah an soinak cu an ngol i Pathian kha an thangṭhat i, “Pathian nih Jentail mi hna zong, i ngaihchih i nun awkah caan ṭha kha a pek ve hna,” tiah an ti."},"19":{"text":"Steven an thah hnu i hremnak a hung chuakmi nih khan zumtu hna cu a kenkiplo ah a ṭhek dih hna. A cheu cu Foinisia le Saipras le Antiok tiang khan an kal i bia cu Judah mi lawng kha an chimh hna.","title":"Antiok Khua Khrihfabu","ref":"Lam 8.1-4"},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zumtu a cheu, Saipras rammi le Sairin mi hna cu Antiok khua ah khan an kal i Jentail mi zong kha thawng cu an thanh hna i Bawipa Jesuh kong Thawngṭha kha an chimh hna."},"21":{"text":"Bawipa ṭhawnnak kha an sinah a um i mi tampi nih an zumh i Bawipa leiah khan an i mer."},"22":{"text":"Cu thawng cu Jerusalem khua i a ummi Khrihfabu sinah a hung phan i cucaah Barnabas cu Antiok khua ah khan an hei thlah."},"23":{"text":"A va phak i zeitluk in dah Pathian nih annih kha thluachuahnak a pek hna ti kha a hmuh tikah a lung aa lawm i annih cu an dihlak tein Bawipa cu an lungthin a dihumnak in i tlaih awk le a sinah zumhawktlak tein um awk kha a forh hna."},"24":{"text":"Barnabas cu miṭha a si, Thiang Thlarau le zumhnak in a khatmi a si. Cun mi tampi nih Bawipa cu an zumh."},"25":{"text":"Cun Barnabas cu Tarsas khua ah khan a va kal i Saul kha a va kawl."},"26":{"text":"A hmuh tikah Antiok khua ah khan a ratpi i kum khat chung kha Khrihfabu chungmi hna he khan an i pum i mi tampi kha an cawnpiak hna. Antiok khua ah hin pei Jesuh zultu hna kha, “Khrihfa,” tiah an rak ti hmasa bik hna cu."},"27":{"text":"Cu lio hrawngah cun Jerusalem in Antiok ah khan profet tlawmpal an va kal i"},"28":{"text":"an lak i pakhat a min Agabas an timi kha a dir i vawleicung dihlak ah mangṭam a fak ngaimi a tlung lai, tiah Thlarau ṭhawnnak thawngin, a rak chimchung. (Cu mangṭam cu Klaudias siangpahrang a si lioah khan a tlung).","ref":"Lam 21.10"},"29":{"text":"Zultu pawl nih khan anmah le an ti khawh tawk cio ah Judah ram i a ummi unau pawl bawmhnak pek awkah khan an i ceih."},"30":{"text":"Cuticun an tuah i tangka cu khrihfa upa hna sinah khan Barnabas le Saul kut in an kuat."}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi caan lio hrawngah hin Siangpahrang Herod nih khrihfabu chungmi cheukhat kha a hrem hna.","title":"Hremnak A Tam Chin"},"2":{"text":"Johan unau Jeim kha vainam in a thahter hna i"},"3":{"text":"hi nih hin Judah mi kha an lung a lawmhter hna ti kha a hmuh tikah Peter zong kha a tlaihter fawn hna. (Mah hihi Thilnu Phulh Lo Changreu Puai lioah khan a si)."},"4":{"text":"Peter cu an tlaih hnuah thong ah khan an thlak i ralkapbu bu li nih an cawngh; bu khat ah cun ralkap pali lengmang an um. Herod nih aa timhning ah cun Lanhtak Puai dih in zapi hmaiah bia ka ceih te lai, ti a si.","ref":"Exo 12.1-27"},"5":{"text":"Cucaah Peter cu thong chungah khan an chiah ko, asinain khrihfabu chungmi hna nih cun a caah khan thla fak piin an cam."},"6":{"text":"Herod nih zapi hmaiah ka chuahpi cang lai tiah a timi caan a phak lai zan ah khan, Peter cu ralvengtu ralkap pahnih hna karlak ah khan a it. Thirhri pahnih in an hren i thonginn kutka cu ralvengtu nih an cawngh.","title":"Peter Kha Thong Chungin A Luat"},"7":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah khin Bawipa vancungmi pakhat kha khika ah cun a hung dir i thonginn chung cu a ceu. Vancungmi nih cun Peter cu a liang in a hninh i a ṭhangh, “Khulrang in tho tuah!” tiah a ti. Hmakhatte ah Peter kut cun thirhri cu an tla."},"8":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih cun a thawh i, “Na taisawm i sawmh law na kedan i danh tuah,” tiah a ti. Peter nih cu bantuk cun a tuah i vancungmi nih cun, “Na puan kha i aih law hung ka zul,” tiah a ti i,"},"9":{"text":"Peter nih cun thonginn lengah khan a hei zulh. Asinain vancungmi nih a tuahmi cu a taktak a si rua ti awk a hngal lo, langhnak ka hmu rua tiah a ruah."},"10":{"text":"Ralvengtu hna umnak hmasa bik le a pahnihnak kha an hei lonh i khua chung vung lanhnak thir kutka kha an phan. Kutka cu amah tein a rak i hung i annih cu an chuak. Lam kha an vun zul i vancungmi nih khan Peter cu, duak tiah a kaltak."},"11":{"text":"Khi tikah Peter cu a lung a hung fim i, “Atu cu hihi ahmaan tiah ka hngalh cang! Bawipa nih a vancungmi kha a run thlah i Herod kut chung le Judah mi nih ka cungah an i ruahchihmi vialte chungin a ka khamh,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Thil umtuning kha a hung fian tikah Johan Marka nu Mary inn ah khan a va kal. Khika ah cun mi tampi kha an rak i pum i thla an rak cam."},"13":{"text":"Peter nih innleng lei innka kha a vun kingh i an sinumnu Roda an timi nih hun awkah a va kal."},"14":{"text":"Peter aw a si ti kha a hngalh tikah a lung aa lawm tuk i innka cu hung loin a kir i, Peter kha lengah a dir ko, tiah a chimh hna."},"15":{"text":"“Na molh,” tiah an rak ti, sihmanhsehlaw a si hrimhrim ko, tiah a ti peng hna tikah khan, “A vancungmi a si lai,” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Cu lioah cun Peter nih cun innka cu a kingh lengmang ko. Annih nih an va hun i amah cu an hmuh tikah an khuaruah a har."},"17":{"text":"“Dai tein um u,” tiah a kut in a hmuhsak hna i Bawipa nih zeitindah thonginn chungin a chuahnak kha a chimh hna. “Mah hihi Jeim le kan unau dang hna kha va chim hna u,” tiah a ti hna i kaa dang ah a kaltak hna."},"18":{"text":"Cun zinglei a hung si tikah khan Peter hi zei nih dah a ti hnga tiin ralvengtu hna cu awlokchong in an i tuai."},"19":{"text":"Herod nih, kawl u, tiah a ti hna, sihmanhsehlaw an hmu kho lo. Cucaah ralvengtu pawl cu bia nan hal hna lai i nan thah hna lai, tiah a ti. Cu hnuah cun Herod cu Judea ram khan a vung kal i Sisaria khua ah khan caan tlawmpal a vung um."},"20":{"text":"Herod cu Tair le Sidon mi hna cungah khan a thin a hun ngaingai caah, cu hna nih cun a bu in amah cu ton awkah a sinah khan an va kal. A hmasa bik ah siangpahrang inn uktu Blastas kha anmah lei ṭang dingin an i sawm. Cun Herod sinah cun an va kal i i rem ko u sih, tiah an va nawl. Zeicahdah tiah an rawl laknak cu Herod siangpahrang ram hin a si.","title":"Herod Thihnak"},"21":{"text":"An ni tinh ni ah Herod cu a siangpahrang thuam khan aa thuam i a bawiṭhutdan cungah khan a ṭhu i mizapi sinah cun bia a chim."},"22":{"text":"“Bia a chimtu hi minung a si lo, pathian a si,” tiah an au."},"23":{"text":"Herod nih Pathian kha upatnak a pek lo caah Bawipa vancungmi nih chikkhatte ah a vun tuk. Amah cu tholung nih an ei i a thi."},"24":{"text":"Pathian bia cu a karh i a ṭhang chin lengmang."},"25":{"text":"Barnabas le Saul nih khan an rian cu an lim i Jerusalem in an ra kir i Marka kha an i ratpi."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Antiok khua khrihfabu chungah khan profet hna le cawnpiaktu saya hna tlawmpal an um, cu hna cu Barnabas, Simeon (Simeon cu Pa Nak ti zongah an ti), Sairin mi Lusias, Mangki bawi Herod khukṭhi Manaen le Saul kha an si.","title":"Barnabas le Saul An Thlah Hna"},"2":{"text":"Annih nih Bawipa kha an biak i rawl an ulh lioah khan, Thiang Thlarau nih a thawh hna i, “Barnabas le Saul hi, ka thiahmi hna rian kha an ṭuan nakhnga, a dang tein ka chiahpiak hna u,” tiah a ti."},"3":{"text":"Rawl an ulh i thla an cam dih in an cungah an kut an chuan i an thlah hna."},"4":{"text":"Barnabas le Saul cu Thiang Thlarau nih a fial hna bang khan Seleusia khua ah khan an vung kal i cuka cun Saipras tikulh ah tilawng in an kal.","title":"Saipras Tikulh Ah"},"5":{"text":"Salamis khua an phak tikah khika ah Judah mi hna pumhnak inn ah khan Pathian bia kha an chim. An rian a bawmtu hna caah Johan Marka kha an i kalpi."},"6":{"text":"Cu tikulh cu Pafos khua tiangin an hei ṭol i khika ah khan camhthiam a min Bar-Jesuh a simi kha an va ton, amah cu Judah mi a si i profet ka si tiah aa timi a si."},"7":{"text":"Amah cu cu tikulh a uktu bawi Sergius Paulus an timi, mifim ngaingaimipa i a hawikom a si. Uktu bawi nih cun Pathian bia kha theih a duh caah Barnabas le Saul kha a auh hna."},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih cu camhthiam Elimas (cucu a Grik min a si) nih khan a rak al hna i uktu bawi kha Pathian cu zum hlah seh tiah kham aa zuam."},"9":{"text":"Khi tikah Paul ti zongah ti a simi Saul, Thiang Thlarau in a khatmi nih khan camhthiampa cu dengteo in a zoh i,"},"10":{"text":"“Khuachia fa! Nangmah hi a ṭhami thil paohpaoh dohtu na si; nangmah hi hlennak ṭhalo a phunphun in na khat, Bawipa biatak hi lih i canter naa zuam zungzal."},"11":{"text":"Bawipa kut cu atu ah na cungah a tlung lai, na mit a caw lai i caan tlawmpal chung cu chun ceu na hmu lai lo,” tiah a ti. Chikkhatte ah khin Elimas mit cu minmei nak nih a zelh i a kut in a hruaitu dingmi kawl ah i dap lengmang in aa chawk."},"12":{"text":"Thil a hung ummi kha a hmuh tikah uktu bawi cu a zummi ah a cang i Bawipa kong an cawnpiakmi nih khan a lung a sukhai ngaingai."},"13":{"text":"Paul le a hawile hna cu Pafos khua khan tilawng in an kal i Pamfilia ram Perga khua kha an phan; khika khan Johan Marka nih a kirtak hna i Jerusalem khua ah a tluntak hna.","title":"Pisidia Ram Antiok Khua Ah"},"14":{"text":"Perga cun an hei kal i Pisidia ram Antiok khua kha an phan; cun Sabbath ni ah pumhnak inn ah khan an kal i an ṭhu."},"15":{"text":"Cuka mi hna nih Moses Nawlbia Cauk chungin le profet hna caṭialmi chungin an rel hnuah pumhnak inn uktu hna nih cun an i thawh i, “U le nau hna, mizapi caah forhnak bia chim awk nan ngeih ahcun chim tuah hna u,” tiah an ti hna,"},"16":{"text":"Paul cu a dir i a kut in dai u tiah a hmuhsak hna i biachim hram aa thawk: “Ka phunhawi Israel mi hna le Pathian a biami Jentail mi hna, ka bia hi ngai tuah u."},"17":{"text":"Hi Israel miphun Pathian nih hin, kan pupa hna kha a rak thim hna i Izipt ram chung i ramdangmi bantukin khua an vung sak lioah khan miphun nganpi ah a ser hna. Pathian nih a liannganmi a ṭhawnnak in Izipt ram in a chuahter hna i","ref":"Exo 1.7; 12.51"},"18":{"text":"kum sawm li chung thetse ram ah khan a in hna.","ref":"Nam 14.34; Deu 1.31"},"19":{"text":"Kanaan ram chungah miphun phun sarih kha a hrawh hna i a mi hna cu ram ngeitu ah khan a ser hna.","ref":"Deu 7.1; Jos 14.1"},"20":{"text":"cucu kum za li le kum sawm nga lio hrawngah khan a rak si. “Cun cu hnuah cun profet Samuel chan tiang khan biaceihtu kha a pek hna.","ref":"Biac 2.16; 1Sam 3.20"},"21":{"text":"Cun annih nih siangpahrang kan pe tiah an hal tikah Pathian nih Saul, Benjamin phun chungmi Kish fapa kha, kum sawm li chung an siangpahrang si awkah a pek hna.","ref":"1Sam 8.5; 10.21"},"22":{"text":"Amah cu a phuah hnuah Pathian nih cun David kha an siangpahrang ah a ser. Amah kongah Pathian nih a chimmi cu, ‘Jesse fapa David hi ka duhmi phun a si, amah hi tuah tiah ka fialmi a tuah duh dingmi a si,’ ti hi a rak si.","ref":"1Sam 13.14; 16.12; Slm 89.20"},"23":{"text":"Hi pa tefa chung hin, Pathian nih bia a rak kam cang hna bangin, Israel mi cu khamhtu Jesuh kha a pek hna."},"24":{"text":"A rat lainak kha Johan nih a rak timhtuah chung i a timhtuahnak ah cun Israel mi vialte kha nan sualnak i ngaihchih u law tipilnak ing u, a ti hna.","ref":"Mar 1.4; Luk 3.3"},"25":{"text":"Cun Johan nih a rian cu a lim dengmang tikah mizapi cu a thawh hna i, ‘Aho a si ti ah dah nan ka ruah? Keimah cu nan hngahmi hi ka si lo. Sihmanhsehlaw zohhmanh u, amah cu ka hnu in a ra lio i kei cu a kedan phoihtu hmanh ah kaa tlak lo,’ tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 3.11; Mar 1.7; Luk 3.16; Jhn 1.20,27"},"26":{"text":"“Ka u le ka nau hna, Abraham tefa hna le hika i a ummi Jentail mi vialte, Pathian a biami hna: hi khamhnak bia hi kanmah hi pei pek kan si cu."},"27":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Jerusalem i a ummi hna le an hruaitu hna nih khan amah cu Khamhtu a si kha an hngal lo i cuhleiah Sabbath fate an rel lengmangmi profet bia hna zong kha a sullam an hngal hna lo. Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh an thahnak thawng khan profet bia kha an tlinter hna."},"28":{"text":"Annih nih thah awkah aa tlak tinak caah bia an hmu kho lo nain Pilat kha kan thahpiak ko tiah an nawl.","ref":"Mat 27.22-23; Mar 15.13-14; Luk 23.21-23; Jhn 19.5"},"29":{"text":"Amah kongah Cathiang nih a chimmi vialte an tuah dih hnuah vailam cung khan an ṭhumh i thlan ah an vui.","ref":"Mat 27.57-61; Mar 15.42-47; Luk 23.50-56; Jhn 19.38-42"},"30":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Pathian nih mithi hna sin khan a thawhter i"},"31":{"text":"amah sin i Galilee in Jerusalem tiang khual a tlawng tawnmi hna sinah khan voi tampi a lang. Annih cu Israel mi sin i a tehte an si.","ref":"Lam 1.3"},"32":{"text":"Cun atu hi, hi Thawngṭha hi nannih sin phakpi awkah hika i kan ratnak cu a si. Kan pupa hna sinah, ka tuah lai, tiah Pathian nih bia a rak kammi kha, kannih an tefa hna sinah hin atu cu a tuah cang, cucu Jesuh a nunter ṭhan hi a si. Cucu Salm fung hnihnak chung i ‘Nangmah cu ka Fapa na si, nihin ah na Pa ka si cang,’ tiah aa ṭial bantuk khan a si.","merge":"33","ref":"Slm 2.7"},"34":{"text":"“Cun mithi hna sinin a thawhnak kong, thutnak i zeitikhmanh ah a kir ṭhan ti lai lonak kong ah Pathian nih a chimmi cu, ‘A thiangmi le zumh awk a tlakmi thluachuahnak, David ka rak kamhmi kha, nangmah kan pek lai,’ ti hi a si.","ref":"Isa 55.3"},"35":{"text":"“Cun hmun dang ah, ‘Nangmah an tlaihchanmi na sal cu thutnak na inter lai lo,’ tiah a chim bantuk khan a si taktak fawn.","ref":"Slm 16.10"},"36":{"text":"David nih khan amah a caan ah khan Pathian rian cu a rak ṭuan; cun a thi i a hringsortu hna sinah khan vui a si i thutnak kha a in."},"37":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw mithi hna sinin Pathian nih a thawhtermi cu thutnak kha a ing lo."},"38":{"text":"Ka u le ka nau hna, nan dihlak in nan hngalh awk cu, Jesuh thawng hin pei sual ngaihthiamnak bia nan sin i chim hi a si cu; Moses Nawlbia nih an luatter khawh lomi hna sualnak khan pei amah a zummi paohpaoh cu a luatter hna cu.","merge":"39"},"40":{"text":"Cucaah i ralring u law profet nih,"},"41":{"text":"‘Nannih mi nihsawh hmangmi hna, Zohhmanh u, nan khuaruahhar u law thi ko u. Zeicahtiah nanmah nan chan hrimhrim ah ka tuahmi rian hi Nannih nih nan zumh lai lomi thil, midang nih a sullam an in chimh hna hmanh ah nan zumh duh lai lomi a si,’ tiah an chimmi bia hi nan cungah tlunter hlah u,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Hab 1.5"},"42":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas cu pumhnak inn in an ṭin pah ah khan, hmai Sabbath ni ah ra ṭhan u law hi thil kong hi tam deuh in kan chim ṭhan rih u, tiah an sawm hna."},"43":{"text":"Zapi cu pumhnak khan an ṭian hnuah Judah mi a tampi le Judah phung a zulmi Jentail mi mi tampi hna nih khan an zulh hna. Lamkaltu hna nih khan annih cu an chimh hna i Pathian vel chung i um camcin awk kha an forh hna."},"44":{"text":"A hmai Sabbath ni ah cun khua chung i a ummi kha an dihlak dengmang in Bawipa kong bia theih awkah cun an ra chuak."},"45":{"text":"Judah mi nih mizapi kha an hmuh hna tikah nahchuahnak in an khat; Paul nih a chimmi kha an al i amah kha an nihsawh."},"46":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul le Barnabas nih khan ralṭha chinchin in an chimh hna i, “Nannih sin i Pathian bia chim hmasa hi a herh taktakmi a si. Sihmanhsehlaw nannih nih nan duh lo ca le zungzal nunnak hmu dingah aa tlak in nan i ruah lo caah, nannih cu kan in kaltak hna lai i Jentail mi sinah kan kal cang lai."},"47":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Bawipa nih a kan pekmi nawlbia cu: ‘Nannih cu Jentail mi ca i ceunak si awk le Vawlei cung dihlak ca i khamhnak lam si awkah kan chiah hna,’ ti hi a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 42.6; 49.6"},"48":{"text":"Jentail mi hna nih cu bia cu an theih tikah an i lawm i Bawipa cu, cu bia ruangah cun an thangṭhat; cun zungzal nunnak hmu dingah thim a simi hna nih khan an zumh i"},"49":{"text":"khika hrawngah khan Bawipa bia cu a kenkip ah aa ṭhek."},"50":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Judah mi hna nih khan, cu khua chung i hruaitu deuhdeuh a simi hna le Pathian a biaminu, upat hmaizah awk deuh a simi kha an forh hna i Paul le Barnabas cu hrem hram an thawk hna; cun cuka ram cun an dawi hna."},"51":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih khan an kebeh cu an khawnhnawhtak hna i Ikonium ah an kal.","ref":"Mat 10.14; Mar 6.11; Luk 9.5; 10.11"},"52":{"text":"Antiok khua i a ummi zultu hna cu lunglawmhnak le Thiang Thlarau in an khat."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam cun Ikonium khua zongah a si: Paul le Barnabas cu Judah mi pumhnak inn ah khan an va kal i bia kha an chimh hna i Judah mi le Jentail mi mi tampi kha zumtu ah an i cang.","title":"Ikonium Khua Ah"},"2":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a zum duh lomi Judah mi hna nih khan Jentail mi kha an forh hna i unau pawl kha an huatter hna."},"3":{"text":"Khika ah lamkaltu hna kha saupi an cam. Bawipa kong kha ralṭha ngaingai in an chim i a velngeihnak kong an chimmi kha ahmaan ti hmuhsaknak caah khuaruahharnak tuah khawhnak kha a pek hna."},"4":{"text":"Khuachungmi cu an i cheu: a cheu nih Judah mi kha an ṭanh hna i a cheu nih lamkaltu kha an ṭanh hna."},"5":{"text":"Cun Jentail mi hna le Judah mi hna nih khan, an hruaitu hna he, lamkaltu hna kha nihsawh le lung in cheh awk kha an i tim."},"6":{"text":"Cu kong cu lamkaltu hna nih an theih tikah Likaonia ram i a ummi Listra le Derbe khua le cu khua hna pawngkam ram ah khan an zam."},"7":{"text":"Cuka ah cun Thawngṭha kha an va chim."},"8":{"text":"Listra khua ah cun kebeimipa pakhat a rak um; amah cu a chuah kate in a beimi a si i a kal kho bal lo.","title":"Listra le Derbe Khua Ah"},"9":{"text":"Khika ah cun a ṭhu ve i Paul bia kha a ngai ve. Paul nih cun, hi pa nih hin ka chimmi hi a zumh i damh khawh a si lai, ti kha a hmuh caah amah cu dengteo in a vun zoh i"},"10":{"text":"aw thangpi in, “Na ke in ding tein dir tuah,” tiah a ti. Mipa cu a hun i hlawk i aa chawk kho ai."},"11":{"text":"Paul nih a tuahmi kha mibupi nih cun an hmuh tikah an Likaonian holh in an au i, “Minung bantuk ah pathian cu an i cang i kan sinah an rung ṭum,” tiah an ti."},"12":{"text":"Barnabas kha Zeus pathian tiah an ti i Paul kha a holh lengmangtu a si caah Hermes tiah an ti."},"13":{"text":"Khua lengte ah biakinn a ummi Zeus pathian tlangbawi nih khan cawtum hna le pangpar ṭhirual hna kha kutka ah khan a rak put hna. Amah le mizapi hna nih cun lamkaltu hna kha raithawinak pekchanh an timh hna."},"14":{"text":"Barnabas le Paul nih tuah an i zalhmi kha an theih tikah an puan kha an thleh i mibupi chungah cun an zuang cutmat i"},"15":{"text":"“Zeicahdah mah hihi nan tuah? Kannih zong minung sawhsawhte kan si ve ko, nanmah bantuk minung kan si ve ko. Hika i kan ratnak cu nannih kha hi santlailo thil hna hi hlawt i van le vawlei le rili le a chung i a ummi thil vialte a sertu Pathian lei i mer awkah Thawngṭha ra chim kha a si.","ref":"Exo 20.11; Slm 146.6"},"16":{"text":"Hlanah cun mi vialte kha anmah duhning cio lam zulh kha a onh ko hna."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah a um kha thil ṭha a tuahmi in a langhter zungzal ko: van in ruah an pek hna i a caan hmaan te ah thlaiti an pek hna; rawl kha an pek hna i lunglawmhnak in an khahter hna,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna nih hiti in bia an chim na hmanh hin, mibupi cu har le fe in an sin i raithawinak pekchanh kha an kham khawh hna."},"19":{"text":"Pisidia ram Antiok khua le Ikonium khua in Judah mi tlawmpal kha an ra i mizapi cu anmah leiah an ṭanter khawh hna, Paul kha lung in an cheh i a thi cang rua tiah an ruah caah khua lengah khan an hnuh."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zumtu hna nih khan an hun pumhhnawh tikah a tho i khua chungah khan a lut ṭhan. A thaizing ah Barnabas he Derbe khua ah an kal."},"21":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas nih Derbe khua ah cun Thawngṭha kha an chim i zultu tampi an hmuh hna. Cun Listra ah khan an kir i cuka cun Ikonium le Pisidia ram Antiok khua ah khan an kal.","title":"Siria ram Antiok Khua Ah An Kir ṭhan"},"22":{"text":"Zumtu hna kha thazang an pek hna i nan zumhnak ah khan fek tein hmun ko u, tiah an forh hna. “Pathian Pennak chung luh awkah hin harnak tampi kan ton a hau,” tiah an cawnpiak hna."},"23":{"text":"Khrihfabu kip ah khan khrihfa upa an chiah hna i thlacamnak le rawl ulhnak he, an i bochanmi Bawipa kut chungah khan, an chiah hna."},"24":{"text":"Pisidia ram kha an ṭol dih in Pamfilia ram kha an phan."},"25":{"text":"Perga khua ah khan bia cu an chim i Attalia ah khan an vung kal,"},"26":{"text":"cuka cun Antiok khua ah khan lawng in an kir ṭhan; Antiok khua cu, atu ah an limmi an rianṭuan awk caah Pathian velngeihnak chung i an rak sanh hnanak hmun kha a si."},"27":{"text":"Antiok khua an phak tikah khrihfabu kha an pumh hna i Pathian nih anmah thawngin a tuahmi thil vialte kha an chimh hna i Jentail mi zong nih an zumh ve nakhnga an caah lam a hun ti kha an theihter hna."},"28":{"text":"Cuka ah cun zumtu hna sinah khan caan saupi an um."}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Judea ram in mi cheukhat kha Antiok khua ah khan an ra i, “Moses Nawlbia nih a kan cawnpiak bangin, nan cuarpar nan i tan lo ahcun khamhnak nan hmu kho lai lo,” tiah unau pawl kha an cawnpiak hna.","title":"Jerusalem Pumhnak","ref":"Lev 12.3"},"2":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas nih khan cu kong cu fak piin an al hna; cucaah Paul le Barnabas le Antiok khuami cheukhat kha Jerusalem khua ah hung kal hna seh law hi kongah lamkaltu pawl le upa hna kha hung tong hna seh, tiah bia an khiah."},"3":{"text":"Khrihfabu nih khan an hei thlah hna i Foinisia le Samaria an hei tanpah ah khan zeitluk in dah Jentail mi hna nih Pathian leiah an i mer tinak kong kha an chimh hna; cu thawng nih cun unau vialte kha a lawmhter ngaingai hna."},"4":{"text":"Jerusalem khua an va phak tikah khrihfabu le lamkaltu hna le upa hna nih khan an rak conglawmh hna i anmah thawngin Pathian nih a tuahmi vialte kha an chimh hna."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw zumtu hna lakah khan, Farasi bu chung i a simi an rak um i cu hna nih cun an i thawh i, “Annih cu, cuarpar nan i tan lai i Moses Nawlbia kha nan zulh lai, tiah ti awk an si,” tiah an ti."},"6":{"text":"Hi bia ruah ṭi awkah hin lamkaltu hna le upa hna kha an i pum."},"7":{"text":"Saupi an ceih hnuah Peter a dir i, “Ka u le ka nau hna, nannih nih nan hngalh bantukin, Jentail mi hna nih Thawng Ṭha kha an theih i an zumh khawh ve nakhnga, an sin i cu Thawng cu va chim awkah hlan deuhpi ah khan Pathian nih keimah cu nanmah lakin a rak ka thim.","ref":"Lam 10.1-43"},"8":{"text":"Cun minung lungthin a hngaltu Pathian nih Jentail mi a cohlan hnanak cu, kanmah a rak kan pekmi bantuk tein Thiang Thlarau a pek ve hnanak ah hin a lang.","ref":"Lam 2.4;
