10.44"},"9":{"text":"Kannih le annih karlak ah zeihmanh thleidannak a tuah lo; annih nih an zumh caah an lungthin kha a thianter ve ko hna."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah zeicahdah kan pupa nih si hna seh, kannih nih si u sih, kan phorh khawh lomi thilrit cu an liang cung i chonh nan timhnak thawng hin Pathian cu hneksak del nan duh?"},"11":{"text":"Asilo, kannih zong kha kan zumh i pei Bawipa Jesuh vel thawng cun khamhnak kan hmuh kha, annih zong cu cu bantukte cun pei an si ve ko cu,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Barnabas le Paul nih, Pathian nih Jentail mi hna lakah a hman hna i anmah thawngin khuaruahharnak a tuahmi vialte kha an chim tikah, annih cu an ningpi in dai tein an um."},"13":{"text":"Bia an chim dih tikah khan Jeim nih khan aa thawh i, “U le nau hna, ka bia hi ngai tuah u."},"14":{"text":"Simon nih, zeitluk in dah Pathian nih Jentail mi kha an zawn a ruah hna ti cu a kan chimh cang i cu a langhnak cu anmah lakin amah min putu dingah mi aa thimmi hna hi a si."},"15":{"text":"Profet nih an rak chimmi bia cu hi bia he hin aa kheng ngaingai. Cathiang chungah zeitindah a um tiah:","ref":"Amo 9.11-12"},"16":{"text":"‘Hi hnuah hin ka ra kir ṭhan lai i David inn a tlumi kha ka tun ṭhan lai. A rawhnak kha ka remh lai i ka sak ṭhan lai."},"17":{"text":"Cucaah miphun dang vialte, ka mi si awk ca i ka auhmi Jentail mi vialte hna nih khan Bawipa cu an ka kawl lai."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa, hlanlio piin thil a rak chimtu nih cun a ti.’"},"19":{"text":"“Cucaah kei ka ruahnak ah cun Pathian leiah a hun i mermi Jentail mi hna hi harnak kan pek hna awk a si lo."},"20":{"text":"Cu nakin kan tuah awk deuh a si tiah ka ruahmi cu, ca kan kuat hna lai i siasal sinah pekchanh ciami sa cu thurhnawmh cangmi sa a si caah ei nan i sum lai, nu le pa sualnak khan an i sum lai, hngawngdih sa ei nan i sum lai, zei thi hmanh ei nan i sum lai, tiah kan ti hna lai.","ref":"Exo 34.15-17; Lev 17.10-16; 18.6-23"},"21":{"text":"Zeitintiah Moses Nawlbia kha Sabbath ni fate pumhnak inn kip ah caan saupi rel lengmang a si ko cang i khua kip ah a bia kha chim a si ko cang,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Cun lamkaltu hna le upa hna nih khan khrihfabu an dihlak he, an bu chungin mi i thim i Paul le Barnabas sinah Antiok khua i thlah kha an hna a tla. Barsabbas ti zongah timi Judas le Silas kha an thim hna; annih cu an pahnih in unau pawl hna nih khan an upat ngaingaimi an si.","title":"Jentail Khrihfa Sin Cakuat"},"23":{"text":"A tanglei ca hi an kut cun an kuat hna: “Kannih, lamkaltu hna le upa hna, nan unau hna nih, Antiok, Siria le Silisia i a ummi unau vialte, chuahkehnak lei in Jentail mi a simi nan kut kan in tlaih hna."},"24":{"text":"Kannih kan bu chungin mi a cheukhat nih nan sinah an ra i an chimmi nih nan lung an tuai hna i hna an hnawh hna ti kha kan theih; sihmanhsehlaw hi hna hi, hi bantukin va tuah u, tiah kannih nih kan ti hna lo."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah kannih cu kan i pum i nan sin i thlah ding lamkaltu hna thim awkah khan kan hna a tla. Annih cu kan dawtmi kan unau hna Barnabas le Paul,"},"26":{"text":"kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih rian ca i thih ngamh in a cawlmi hna sinah hin an ra lai."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah ca in kan in kuatmi hna an pum in nannih sinah a hung chimtu dingah Judas le Silas hi nan sinah kan rak thlah hna."},"28":{"text":"Hi a herhmi nawlbia hlei in a dang zeihmanh nan cungah khin lo ding kha Thiang Thlarau le kannih kan hnatlaknak a si:"},"29":{"text":"siasal pekchanhmi rawl kha ei i sum u, thi ei kha i sum u, hngawngdih sa ei i sum u, cun nu le pa sualnak kha i sum u. Hi thil hna tuah hi nan i sum ahcun nan caah a ṭha lai. Dam tein,” tiah an ti."},"30":{"text":"Lamkaltu hna cu an thlah hna i Antiok khua ah cun an va kal; khika ah zumtu vialte kha an pumh hna i ca kha an pek hna."},"31":{"text":"Ca kha an rel tikah thazang peknak bia nih khan an lung a lawmhter ngaingai hna."},"32":{"text":"Profet a simi Judas le Silas nih khan unau pawl cu saupi bia an chimh hna i ralṭhatnak le thazang an pek hna."},"33":{"text":"Cuka ah cun sau nawn an um hnuah daihnak in unau pawl nih cun an kalter ṭhan hna i a thlahtu hna sinah khan an kir ṭhan. ("},"34":{"text":"Asinain Silas cu khika um ding khan aa khiak.)"},"35":{"text":"Paul le Barnabas cu Antiok ah khan sau nawn an cam. A dang mi tampi hna he, Bawipa bia kha an cawnpiak hna i an chimh hna."},"36":{"text":"Cu hnu caan tlawmpal ah khin Paul nih Barnabas cu a thawh i, “Va kal ṭhan u si law Bawipa kong kan chimnak khua paoh ah khan kan unau hna kha va tlawng ṭhan hna u si law zeitindah an um ti kha va zoh hna u sih,” tiah a ti.","title":"Paul le Barnabas An I Ṭhen"},"37":{"text":"Barnabas nih khan Johan Marka kha i kalpi ṭhan a duh;"},"38":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw an khual tlawnnak a dongh tiang a rak zulh hna lo i Pamfilia in a rak kirtak hna caah khan Paul nih i kalpi awk cu a ṭha tiah a ruat lo.","ref":"Lam 13.13"},"39":{"text":"Fak piin an i al i pakhat le pakhat an i ṭhen. Barnabas nih Marka kha aa lak i Saipras tikulh leiah lawng in an kal;"},"40":{"text":"cun Paul nih Silas kha aa thim i unau pawl nih khan Bawipa velngeihnak chungah an sanh hna hnuah an kal."},"41":{"text":"Siria le Silisia ram kha an ṭol hna i khrihfabu kha an thazang an fehter hna."}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul cu Derbe khua le Listra khua ah khan a lan chin. Khika ah Khrihfa pakhat a min Timote a simi kha a rak um; a nu zong cu zumtu a si ve i Judah mi a si, sihmanhsehlaw a pa cu Grik mi a si.","title":"Timote, Paul le Silas Sinah A Kal Ve"},"2":{"text":"Listra le Ikonium i a ummi unau pawl vialte nih Timote cu an thangṭhatmi a si."},"3":{"text":"Paul nih cun Timote kha i ṭhit a duh caah a cuarpar kha a tan. Cu bantukin a tuah cu khika hrawng i a ummi Judah mi vialte nih Timote a pa cu Grik mi a si ti kha an hngalh caah a si."},"4":{"text":"Khua khat hnu khua khat an tlawng i an tlawnpah cun zumtu hna cu Jerusalem khua i a ummi lamkaltu hna le upa hna nih an khiahmi phung kha an chimh hna i cu phung cu nan zulh lai tiah an ti hna."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah khrihfabu cu zumhnak ah an ṭhawng chinchin i ni fate in an karh chin lengmang."},"6":{"text":"Asia ram chungah Thiang Thlarau nih Thawngṭha kha chim awkah a onh hna lo caah Frizia le Galatia ram chungah khan khual cu an tlawng.","title":"Troas Ah: Langhnak A Hmuh"},"7":{"text":"Misia ramri an va phak ah khan Bithinia ram chungah luh an i zal i sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh Thlarau nih khan a onh hna lo,"},"8":{"text":"cucaah Misia ram kha an tan i Troas khua ah khan an vung kal."},"9":{"text":"Cu zan ah cun Paul nih langhnak pakhat a hmuh i cu ah cun mipa pakhat, Masidonia mi a simi kha a dir i, “Masidonia leiah hin ra law ra kan bawm,” tiah a ti lengmangmi kha a hmuh."},"10":{"text":"Paul nih hi langhnak a hmuh cangkate in Masidonia lei kal awkah khan kan i tim, zeicahtiah cuka i a ummi hna sin i Thawngṭha chim awkah khan Pathian nih a kan auh tiah kan ruah."},"11":{"text":"Troas in tilawng in kan chuak i ding tein Samothrasia ah khan kan kal i a thaizing ah Neapolis kan phan.","title":"Filipi Khua Ah: Lidia Lungthlennak"},"12":{"text":"Cuka cun ram chungah khan kan lut i Filipi khua kan phan, Filipi khua cu Masidonia ram chung i a um vemi peng peng khat a khualipi a si; cun Rom mi hna ram thar zong a si fawn. Cu khua ah cun ni thum li kan cam."},"13":{"text":"Sabbath ni ah khua chung cun kan chuak i tiva kamah kan kal, cuka ah cun Judah mi hna thlacamnak hmun a um lai tiah kan ruah. Kan ṭhu i aa pummi nu kha bia kan ruah hna."},"14":{"text":"Cu hna lak i kan bia a theimi pakhat cu Lidia a si, amah cu Thiatira khuami a si i maimaw puan a zuarmi a si. Amah cu Pathian a biami nu a si i Paul nih a chimmi bia ngaih awk caah khan Pathian nih a lungthin kha a hunpiak."},"15":{"text":"Amah le a innchung i a ummi hna nih khan tipilnak an in. Cun a kan thawh i, “Keimah cu Bawipa zumtu taktak ah nan ka ruah a si ahcun, ra u law ka inn ah ra ka tlung u,” tiah a kan sawm."},"16":{"text":"Ni khat cu thlacamnak hmun i kan va kal ṭhan tikah khan lim khuavang a ngeimi sal ngaknu pakhat nih a kan ton i cu a lim khuavang nih cun hmailei thil um ding kha a chimter khawh. Cu bantukin hmailei thil kong a chimnak cun a bawile kha tangka tampi a hmuhter hna.","title":"Filipi Thong Ah"},"17":{"text":"Amah nih cun Paul le kannih kha a kan zulh i, “Hi hna hi Cung Nung Bik Pathian sal an si i anmah nih hin zeitindah khamh nan si khawh lainak kha an in thanh hna,” tiah a au."},"18":{"text":"Cuticun ni tampi a au lengmang hnuah Paul cu a ing a puanh i a hnulei ah aa mer i khuavang cu, “Jesuh Khrih min in amah chung khan chuak kan ti,” tiah a ti. Cu cangka cun khuachia cu a chung khan a chuak."},"19":{"text":"A bawile nih kan tangka hmuhnak caan ṭha a dih cang ti kha an hmuh tikah Paul le Silas kha an tlaih hna i zapi pumhnak ah bawi hmaiah an chuahpi hna."},"20":{"text":"Rom mi a simi biaceih bawi hna hmaiah khan an chuahpi hna i, “Hi mi hna hi Judah mi an si i kan khua chungah hnahnawhnak an tuah."},"21":{"text":"Kan upadi he aa ralchanhmi phung kha mi an cawnpiak hna; kannih cu Rom mi kan si i cu phung hna cu a co zong kan cohlang kho hna lai lo i a zulh zong kan zul kho hna lai lo,” an ti."},"22":{"text":"Cu bantukin velh an zalh hnanak ah khan mizapi kha an i ṭom ve i bawi hna nih khan Paul le Silas cu an puan kha an phoih hna i tu hna u tiah ralkap kha an fial hna."},"23":{"text":"Fak piin an tuk hna hnuah thong ah an thlak hna i thonginn bawi cu fek tein na hrenh hna lai tiah nawl an pek."},"24":{"text":"Cu bantukin thonginn bawi nih nawl a hmuh caah thonginn chung chungchin ah khan a chiah hna i an ke ah khan a ritmi hreng a khenh hna."},"25":{"text":"Zanṭim hrawngah khin Paul le Silas cu thla an cam i Pathian sinah thangṭhatnak hla an sa i thongtla dang nih khan an ngaih hna."},"26":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah khin li a hun i hnin i thonginn cu a hram tiangin a hninh dih. Hmakhatte ah innka vialte kha an i hung dih i thongtla pawl thir cikcin vialte kha an i phoih dih."},"27":{"text":"Thonginn bawi kha a hun i hlau i thong innka an i hun kha a hmuh tikah thongtla vialte kha an chuak dih cang tiah a ruah caah a nam kha aa zuh i amahle amah kha thah aa zal."},"28":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul cu fak piin a au i, “Nangmah le nangmah fahnak i pe hlah, kan dihlak in kan um ko,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Thonginn bawi nih khan mei rak pu u tiah a ti hna i khulrang in a lut i Paul le Silas kehram ah cun ther lengmang in a bawk."},"30":{"text":"Cun annih cu a thawh hna i, “Ka bawipale hna, khamhnak hmuhnak dingah zeidah ka tuah lai?” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"“Bawipa Jesuh kha zum law, nangmah he na innchungkhar he khamh nan si lai,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cun Bawipa bia cu amah le a innchung i a ummi vialte kha an chimh hna."},"33":{"text":"Cun cu zan ṭhiamṭhiam ah cun thonginn bawi nih khan a kalpi hna i an hma kha a ṭawlpiak hna; chikkhatte ah amah le a innchungkhar dihlak in tipilnak an ing colh."},"34":{"text":"Paul le Silas cu a inn ah a hun kalpi hna i rawl a pek hna. Amah nih Pathian kha a zumh caah amah le a innchungkhar cu lunglawmhnak in an khat."},"35":{"text":"A thaizing ah Rom nawlngeitu bawi hna nih khan palik bawi an hei thlah hna i, “Kha hna kha rak thlah hna seh,” an ti."},"36":{"text":"Cucaah thonginn bawi nih khan Paul cu a chimh i, “Bawi pawl nih nawl an rak ka pek i nangmah le Silas kha rak thlah hna, an ka ti. Cucaah chuak u law dai tein nan khual tlawnnak dingah khan va kal u,” tiah a ti hna."},"37":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul nih palik bawi pawl kha a thawh hna i, “Kannih cu kan sualnak zeihmanh an kan hmu lo, asinain zapi hmaiah fung in an kan tuk — Rom mi kan si ve ṭung! Cun thong chungah an kan thlak. Cun atu cu a thli tein kalter an kan duh. A si kho lai lo. Rom bawi pawl cu anmah hrimhrim ra hna seh law ra kan chuah hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"38":{"text":"Cu bia cu palik bawi pawl nih khan Rom bawi pawl cu an va chimh hna; cun annih nih Paul le Silas kha Rom mi an si ti an theih tikah an thin a phang."},"39":{"text":"Cucaah an va kal i ngaihthiam an va hal hna; thong chung cun an chuah hna i kan khua hin kaa dang ah kal u, tiah an nawl hna."},"40":{"text":"Paul le Silas cu thonginn khan Lidia inn ah khan an kal. Khika ah unau pawl kha an ton hna i lungṭhawnnak bia an chimh hna hnuah an kal."}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Amfipolis khua le Apollonia khua kha an hei palpah hna i Thesalonika khua kha an phan; khika ah Judah mi pumhnak inn pakhat a rak um.","title":"Thesalonika Khua Ah"},"2":{"text":"Paul nih a tuah tawn bantukin pumhnak inn ah khan a va kal. Khika ah Sabbath ni ni thum chung, mi hna he khan Cathiang chung bia kha an i al i"},"3":{"text":"Messiah cu thihnak a in awk le a thawh ṭhan awk a sinak kong kha Cathiang cun a langhter i a fianter. Paul nih cun a thawh hna i, “Hi kan chimhmi hna Jesuh hi Messiah cu a si,” tiah a ti hna."},"4":{"text":"A cheu cu an lung a pem i Paul le Silas sinah khan an i fon; cun Pathian a biami Grik mi mi tampi hna le nu upa tampi hna zong kha an i fon ve."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Judah mi kha an nah a chuak i khualak i a vak sawhsawhmi zeiruaramlo minung pawl kha an pumh hna i cu hna cu an au an khuang i khua kha a ning piin hnahnawhnak an tuah. Jason inn kha an va nam i an i ruahnak ah cun khika ah khan Paul le Silas kha an rak um lai i mizapi hmaiah kan chuahpi hna lai an ti."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih kha an va hmuh hna lo tikah Jason le unau pawl a cheukhat kha khua uktu bawi hna sinah an hnuh hna i, “Khua kip ah hnahnawhnak a chuahtertu hna kha atu cu kan khua zong an ra phan ve cang i"},"7":{"text":"Jason nih hin a inn ah a tlunter hna. Siangpahrang dang a min Jesuh a simi a um an tinak thawng hin Sizar Siangpahrang nawl a buarmi an dihlak hin an si,” tiah an au."},"8":{"text":"Cuti an au caah cun mibu hna le khua uktu bawi hna cu awlokchong ngaiin an tuah hna."},"9":{"text":"Uktu bawi pawl nih cun Jason le a hawi dang hna cu aamahkhannak tangka an pekter hna hnuah an thlah hna."},"10":{"text":"Zan a si cangka tein unau pawl nih khan Paul le Silas cu Berea khua ah an kalter hna. Khika an va phak tikah Judah mi pumhnak inn ah khan an kal.","title":"Berea Khua Ah"},"11":{"text":"Khika mi hna cu Thesalonika khuami nakkhan an lung a kau deuh. An chimmi kha lungtho ngaiin an ngaih i Paul nih a chimmi kha a si taktak maw si taktak lo ti hngalhnak caah nifate in Cathiang chung kha an kawl."},"12":{"text":"Annih lak i mi tampi nih khan an zumh; cun Grik mi nu tampi mirum le upa a simi hna le Grik mi pa tampi zong nih khan an zumh ve."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Thesalonika khua i a ummi Judah mi hna nih khan Paul nih Berea khua zongah Pathian bia a chim hoi ti an theih tikah an ra i mi cu an hung forh hna i an hung tuai hna."},"14":{"text":"Khulrang in unau pawl nih khan Paul cu rilikam leiah an kalter; sihmanhsehlaw Silas le Timote kha cu Berea khua ah khan an rung cam."},"15":{"text":"Paul a kalpitu hna kha a sinah cun Athens khua tiangin an va kal. Cun Berea khua ah cun an kir ṭhan i Paul nih khan Silas le Timote cu a ran khawh chungin ka sinah ra hna seh, tiah bia a cah hna."},"16":{"text":"Paul cu Athens khua i Silas le Timote a rak hngah lio hna ah khan cu khua cu siasal in a khah kha a hmuh i a awlok a chong.","title":"Athens Khua Ah"},"17":{"text":"Cucaah pumhnak inn ah khan Pathian a biami Judah mi hna le Grik mi hna he khan bia an i al lengmang i zapi tonnak hmun zongah khan khika i a rami paoh he ni fate an i al lengmang."},"18":{"text":"Epikurian cawnpiaktu saya a cheukhat le Stoik cawnpiaktu saya a cheukhat he zong an i al. A cheu nih an thawh i, “Hi mihrutpa, langh a duh ngai ṭungmi hi zeidah a chim len ko hnga?” an ti. A cheu nih, “Ramdangmi hna pathian kong chim dawh a si,” an ti. Hitihin zeicah dah an ti ti ahcun, Paul nih khan Jesuh kong le thawhṭhannak kong a chim caah khan a si."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah Paul cu Areopagas an timi pumhnak hmun ah khan an sawm i an chuahpi. An i thawh i, “Na chim lengmangmi cawnpiaknak thar kong hi hngalh kan duh."},"20":{"text":"Na chimmi kan theihmi a cheukhat hi kan caah khuaruahhar a si i an sullam zeidah a si ti kha kan hngalhter law kan duh hnga,” an ti."},"21":{"text":"(Athens khuami hna le khika i a ummi ramdangmi vialte hna cu thil thar bik kong paoh, i chimh i ruah le va ngaihnak ah an caan vialte a hmang dihmi an si)."},"22":{"text":"Areopagas i aa pummi hna hmaiah cun Paul cu a dir i, “Athens khuami hna! Nannih cu biaknak lei thil paohpaoh ah zuamnak lungthin a ngei ngaingaimi nan si kha ka hmuh."},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah nan khua chung i kaa chawh i nan biaknak hmun kha ka zoh hna tikah biakṭheng pakhat cu a cungah “Hngalh lomi Pathian Caah” tiin aa ṭial kha ka hmuh. Cu nan biakmi cu, a hngalh cu hngal hmanh hlah u law, nan sin i kan thanhmi hna hi a si."},"24":{"text":"Vawlei le a cung i a ummi thil vialte a sertu Pathian hi vancung le vawlei Bawi a si i minung sermi biakinn chungah a ummi a si lo.","ref":"1Sia 8.27; Isa 42.5; Lam 8.27"},"25":{"text":"Cuhleiah Pathian cu minung kha nunnak le thaw le zeizong vialte a petu a si caah minung nih an tuahpiak khawhmi kha a herhmi pakhat hmanh a um lo."},"26":{"text":"Minung pakhat chungin miphun vialte kha a ser hna i vawlei cungah hin khua a sakter hna. A hlankan in an caan le an umnak hmun kha a khiahpiak hna."},"27":{"text":"Hihi zeicahdah a tuah ti ahcun, amah kha an kawl i an dah lengmang tikah khan a hmuh tal an hmu phum hnga maw ti caah a si. Asinain Pathian cu aho kan sin hmanh hin aa hlat lo;"},"28":{"text":"mi a cheukhat nih, “Amah chungah kan nung, kan cawl kan cang i khua kan sa,’ an ti bantuk le, nan hla phuahtu hna nih, ‘Kanmah zong a tefa kan si ve,’ an ti bantuk khan a si."},"29":{"text":"Kannih cu Pathian fa kan si caah, minung nih an fimnak le an thiamnak in an sermi sui milem maw, ngun milem maw, lung milem maw ah khan, Pathian cu kan ruah awk a si lo."},"30":{"text":"Pathian nih hin, minung nih an rak hngalh lo lio caan kha cu hmu duh loin a rak umpiak ko hna, sihmanhsehlaw atu cu khuazeika i a ummi minung hmanh, nan nuncan ṭhalo kha mertak cang hna u, tiah a ti hna."},"31":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a thimmipa thawngin vawlei cung dihlak hi dinnak in biaceih awkah ni a khiah cang. Cucu a si ṭheo lai ti kha mi vialte sin i langhternak caah cu mipa cu thihnak in a thawhter,” tiah a ti."},"32":{"text":"Paul nih thihnak in thawhternak kong a chimmi kha an hun theih tikah a cheu nih an nihsawh i a cheu nih, “Hi kong hi theih ṭhan kan duh,” an ti."},"33":{"text":"Cuticun pumhnak khan Paul cu a chuak."},"34":{"text":"Asinain mi cheu cu amah sinah khan an i fon i a chimmi kha an zumh; cu hna cu Areopagas i biaceih bawi a simi Dionisias tehna, nu pakhat a min Damaris a simi tehna, mi dang tlawmpal kha an si."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun Paul kha Athens khua khan a chuak i Korinth khua ah a kal.","title":"Korinth Khua Ah"},"2":{"text":"Khika ah khan Pontas ram i a chuakmi Akuila kha a va ton, amah cu a nupi Prisilla he khan cu laite ah cun Rom khua in an rak zaam, zeicahtiah Siangpahrang Klaudias nih khan Judah mi vialte kha Rom khua in chuak dih u tiah a ṭhawl hna. Paul nih cun a va leng hna i"},"3":{"text":"an sinah cun a um i an sinah cun rian a ṭuan; amah zong cu anmah bantuk khan saphaw thlam ser in a paw aa cawmmi a si ve."},"4":{"text":"Sabbath fate pumhnak inn ah khan Judah mi he Grik mi he, an lung pemter awkah bia a chimh lengmang hna."},"5":{"text":"Silas le Timote kha Masidonia ram in an rak phanh tikah Paul nih a caan kha a dihlak in phungchimnak ah khan a hman i Jesuh cu Messiah kha a si ti kha Judah mi kha a chimh lengmang hna."},"6":{"text":"Annih nih amah cu an doh i a thang an chiat tikah a puan i leidip kha a thinhnawh hna i, “Nan loh ahcun nanmah mawhchiat awk nan si ko cang lai. Kei cu mawhchiat awk ka si ti lai lo. Atu thawk hin cun Jentail mi sinah ka kal cang lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"7":{"text":"Cucaah annih cu a chuahtak hna i Jentail mi a min Titius Justas a simi inn ah khan a um; amah cu Pathian a biami a si i a inn cu pumhnak inn pawngah khan a si."},"8":{"text":"Pumhnak inn i haotu a simi Krispas le a chungkhar dihlak nih khan an zumh; cun Korinth khua chung i mi tampi hna nih khan bia cu an theih i an zumh i tipilnak an in."},"9":{"text":"Zan khat cu Paul nih cun langhnak a hmuh i cu ah cun Bawipa nih a thawh i, “Na thinphang hlah; chim lengmang ko, ngol lai cih,"},"10":{"text":"zeicahtiah keimah nih kan umpi ko. Hi khua chung i a ummi hna lakah hin mi tampi ka minung an si caah ahohmanh nih harnak an in pe kho lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cucaah Paul cu cuka ah cun kum khat le a cheu a um i Pathian bia kha a cawnpiak hna."},"12":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Gallio cu Rom cozah nih Grik ram uktu bawi ah an ser tikah Judah mi kha an i pum i Paul kha an tlaih i biaceihnak zung ah an chuahpi."},"13":{"text":"An i thawh i, “Hi pa nih hin phung ning in si loin Pathian biak awkah khan mi a lem lengmang hna,” an ti."},"14":{"text":"Paul nih bia chim a hun i zalh hnek lioah khin Gallio nih cun Judah mi cu a thawh hna i, “Judah mi hna, hi thil hi ṭhat lonak le sualnak tuahnak kongah a si ahcun, nan cungah hin lungsaunak ka ngeih awk cu aa dawhmi zong a si ko hnga."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi thil cu bia le min le nanmah phung nan i almi kong a si caah nanmahte nih vaa ceih ko u. Cu bantuk thil kong men biaceihtu si cu ka duh lo!” tiah a ti i"},"16":{"text":"zung chung khan a ṭhawl hna."},"17":{"text":"An dihlak cun pumhnak inn haotu a simi Sosthenes kha an tlaih i zung hmaiah cun an velh. Sihmanhsehlaw Gallio nih khan zeihmanh ah a relpiak hna lo."},"18":{"text":"Paul cu Korinth khua ah khan ni tam nawn a um hnuah a kaltak hna i Prisilla le Akuila he khan Siria leiah lawng in an kal. Lawng i an kal hlanah cun Kenkhria khua ah biakamnak a tuah i a lu kha aa met.","title":"Antiok Khua Ah An Kir","ref":"Nam 6.18"},"19":{"text":"Efesa khua kha an phan i khika ah Paul nih khan Prisilla le Akuila kha a kaltak hna. Pumhnak inn chungah khan a lut i Judah mi kha bia a chimh hna."},"20":{"text":"Annih nih sau piin kan umpi ko an ti nain a si thiam lai lo, tiah a al hna."},"21":{"text":"Efesa khua in a chuahpah ah cun a thawh hna i, “Pathian hnatla a si ahcun, nan sinah ka ra kir ṭhan lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"22":{"text":"Sisaria a phak tikah Jerusalem ah khan a hung kal i khrihfabu kha a hung chawnhbiak hna i cu dih cun Antiok khua ah khan a lan."},"23":{"text":"Cuka ah caan tlawmpal a um hnuah aa thawh ṭhan i Galatia le Frizia ram kha a tlawng hna i zumtu vialte kha thazang a pek hna."},"24":{"text":"Alekzandria khuami Judah mi pakhat a min Apollo a simi kha Efesa khua ah a ra. Amah cu biachim a thiam ngaingaimi a si i Cathiang kha ṭha tein a hngalmi a si.","title":"Apollo, Athens le Korinth Khua Ah"},"25":{"text":"Bawipa Lam kong kha hngal cikcek tein cawnpiakmi a si i Jesuh kong kha lungtho ngaiin a chim i hmaan tein mi kha a cawnpiak hna. Sihmanhsehlaw Johan tipilnak lawnglawng kha a hngalh."},"26":{"text":"Pumhnak inn ah khan ralṭha ngaiin a cawnpiak hna. Cun amah cu Prisilla le Akuila nih khan an theih tikah an inn ah an kalpi i Pathian Lam kong kha hmaan deuh chin in an cawnpiak."},"27":{"text":"Apollo nih cun Grik ram kal kha aa tim, cucaah Efesa khua chung i a ummi a zummi hna nih khan Grik ram i a ummi an unau hna cu ca an kuat hna i amah cu rak conglawmh u tiah an forh hna. Khika ah a phak tikah Pathian velngeihnak thawngin zumtu a simi hna caah khan bawmtu ngaingai a si."},"28":{"text":"Zeicahtiah bia al lei i a ṭhawn caah khan Judah mi cu zapi hmai i bia i al tikah a tei lengmang hna i Cathiang chung khan Jesuh cu Messiah kha a si, ti kha a langhter."}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Apollo kha Korinth khua i a um lioah Paul cu kha peng chungah khan khual a tlawng i Efesa khua kha a phan. Khika ah zultu tlawmpal kha a va hmuh hna i","title":"Efesa Khua Ah Paul A Phan Ṭhan"},"2":{"text":"annih cu a thawh hna i, “Nan zumh ah khan Thiang Thlarau nan rak hmu maw?” tiah a hal hna. Annih nih, “Thiang Thlarau cu a um le um lo hmanh kan hngalh ṭung lo,” tiah an leh."},"3":{"text":"“A si kun ahcun, zei bantuk tipilnak dah nan in kun?” tiah Paul nih cun a hal hna. Annih nih, “Johan tipilnak,” tiah an leh."},"4":{"text":"Cun Paul nih cun a thawh hna i, “Johan tipilnak cu lungthlen hmelchunhnak caah a si, asinain Johan nih khan, ‘Ka hnu in a ra liomi hi nan zumh awk cu a si,’ tiah a ti zungzal hna i cu a hnu in a rami cu Jesuh hi a si,” tiah a ti hna.","ref":"Mat 3.11; Mar 1.4,7-8; Luk 3.4,16; Jhn 1.26-27"},"5":{"text":"Cucu an theih tikah annih cu Bawipa Jesuh min in tipilnak kha an ing."},"6":{"text":"Paul nih an cungah a kut a chuan i Thiang Thlarau kha an cungah a tlung; holh theih loin an holh i Pathian bia zong kha an chim."},"7":{"text":"Annih cu an dihlak in pa pahleihnih tluk an si."},"8":{"text":"Paul cu pumhnak inn chungah khan a lut i thla thum chung mizapi kha ralṭha ngaiin a chimh hna, annih kha heh tiah a al hna i Pathian Pennak kong i an lung a pem nakhnga aa zuam."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw annih lak i a cheukhat cu an lung a khong i an zum duh lo; Bawipa Lam kong kha zapi hmaiah a ṭhalo tiah an ti. Cucaah Paul nih khan a chuahtak hna i zultu pawl kha aa kalpi hna; ni fate in Tirannas biachimnak inn timi ah khan mi kha a cawnpiak hna."},"10":{"text":"Cuticun kum hnih chung a tuah i Asia ram chung i a ummi vialte nih, Judah mi si hna seh, Grik mi si hna seh, Bawipa bia kha an theih."},"11":{"text":"Pathian nih voi dang i a um tawn lomi khuaruahharnak kha Paul kut in a tuah.","title":"Skeva Fapa Hna"},"12":{"text":"A pavuah le a hngawngngerh hna hmanh kha mizaw sin i an hei kalpi hna tikah an zawtnak kha a dam i an chungin khuachia kha an chuak."},"13":{"text":"Judah mi a cheu khuachia ṭhawl i aa chawk lengmangmi hna nih khan cu khuachia ṭhawlnak ah cun Bawipa Jesuh min kha an hman ve. Khuachia cu an thawh hna i, “Paul nih a chimmi Jesuh min in chuak kaan ti,” an ti hna."},"14":{"text":"Cu bantukin a tuahmi cu, Judah mi Tlangbawi Ngan Skeva fapa pasarih an si."},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw khuachia nih cun a thawh hna i, “Jesuh cu ka hngalh i Paul zong cu ka hngalh, sihmanhsehlaw nannih cu ahodah nan si?” tiah a ti hna."},"16":{"text":"Khuachia a ngeimipa nih cun a ṭhuat ciammam hna i a tei hna i hmapu le an puan tlek dihlak in a inn cun an zaam."},"17":{"text":"Efesa khua i a ummi Judah mi le Grik mi vialte hna nih cu kong cu an theih i an thin a phang i Bawipa Jesuh min cu an upat chinchin."},"18":{"text":"A zummi lak i mi tampi kha an ra i zapi hmaiah an tuahmi vialte kha an phuan."},"19":{"text":"Camh a rak hmang tawnmi hna nih khan an cauk kha hmunkhat ah an pumh hna i zapi hmaiah khan an khangh hna. Cauk man cu an tuak tikah tangka thong sawm nga tluk a si."},"20":{"text":"Cuticun Bawipa bia cu a karh chin lengmang i a ṭhang i a ṭhawng chin lengmang."},"21":{"text":"Hi bantukin thil a um hnuah Paul nih Masidonia ram le Grik ram kha ka tlawng lai i Jerusalem ah ka lan colh te lai, tiah a ruah. “Cun cuka ka phak hnuah Rom zong hmuh hrimhrim kaa zuam lai,” tiah a ti.","title":"Efesa Khua Chungah Hnahnawhnak"},"22":{"text":"Cucaah amah a bawmtu pahnih Timote le Erastas kha Masidonia leiah a thlah hna i amah tu cu Asia ram chungah khan caan tam deuh a run hmang."},"23":{"text":"Hi caan lioah hin Bawipa Lam kong ah Efesa khua chungah hnahnawhnak a um."},"24":{"text":"Ngun sosertu pakhat, a min Demetrius a simi nih khan Artemis khuazingnu biakinn lem tete kha ngun in a ser hna i cu rian nih cun a rianṭuantu pawl kha tampi miaknak a pek hna."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah annih cu hmunkhat ah a auh dih hna i, anmah rian bantuk an rian a si vemi zong kha a auh chih hna i, “Ka duale hna, nannih nih nan hngalh bantukin kan chaw hmuhnak cu hi rian hi a si."},"26":{"text":"Cun hipa Paul nih hin zeidah a tuah ti cu nanmahte nih nan i hmuh khawh i nan i theih khawh fawn ko. Aa thawh i, ‘Mi sermi pathian cu pathian an si lo,’ a ti i Efesa khua ah hin siseh, cun Asia ram chung zongah hin a dihlak dengmang in, mi tampi kha an lung a pemter hna."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah cun hi kan rian hi a min a chia cang lai tiah thinphan awk a si ko. Cu lawng hmanh cu si loin, a liannganmi khuazingnu Artemis, Asia ram chung le vawleicung dihlak ah mi kip nih an biakmi hi a lianhngannak hi a lo lai i a biakinn zong hi sullam ngei lo a si lai ti phan awk a si fawn,” tiah a ti hna."},"28":{"text":"Aa pummi hna nih cun cu bia cu an theih tikah an thin a hung ciammam i an au i, “Efesa i a ummi Artemis cu a lianngan ko,” an ti."},"29":{"text":"Cuti i an i tuainak cu khuachung kha a khat dih. Mibu nih cun Paul sin i khual a tlawng vemi Masidonia mi pahnih, Gaius le Aristarkas kha an tlaih hna i bual ah khan an tlikpi hna."},"30":{"text":"Paul nih amah pum in mizapi hmai i va kal kha a duh, sihmanhsehlaw zumtu hna nih khan an thlauh."},"31":{"text":"Cun ram uktu bawi a cheukhat, a hawikom a simi hna zong nih khan, bual ah cun rak chuak hlah seh tiin bia an cah."},"32":{"text":"Cun an i pumhnak cu a ningpi in hnahnawk luri ngaiin a um: mi a cheu an aumi cu thil pakhat a si i a dang an rak aumi cu thil dang a si ve; a tam deuh nih cun zeicahdah kan i pumh ti hmanh kha an hngal lo."},"33":{"text":"Judah mi nih Alekzandar kha hmailei ah an hei chuahter caah khan, hi thil a chuahtertu hi Alekzandar cu a si rua tiah an ruah. Alekzandar nih cun mizapi cu, dai u, tiah a kut a hun zaoh hna i an hmaiah cun aa runvennak bia kha chim hram a hun thawk."},"34":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Judah mi a si kha an hngalh tikah an dihlak cun an au bon khan suimilam pahnih chung an au i, “Efesa khua i a ummi Artemis cu a lianngan ko,” an ti."},"35":{"text":"A donghnak ah khua cazi nih khan mizapi cu a daihter khawh hna. A thawh hna i, “Efesa khuami hna, Efesa khua hi a liannganmi Artemis biakinn a umnak le vancung in a rung tlami lung thiang a umnak a si ti kha ahodah a hngal lomi a um?"},"36":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih, hihi a si lo tiah an ti kho lai lo. Cucaah cun nannih cu nan daih awk a si; ruat setsai loin zeihmanh nan tuah awk a si lo."},"37":{"text":"Hi mi hna nih hin biaknak inn thil kha zeihmanh an fir lo i kan khuazingnu kha zeihmanh a thang an chiat lo nain, hika ah hin nan chuahpi hna."},"38":{"text":"Demetrius le a rianṭuantu hna nih taza an cuai duhmi an um ahcun biaceihnak zung chuah ni a um ko i biaceihtu zong an um fawn ko; cuka ah cun pakhat le pakhat taza i cuai khawh a si ko."},"39":{"text":"Cun cu nak biapi deuh kha nan duh a si ahcun khuami zapi pumhnak ah khiah awk a si fawn ko."},"40":{"text":"Nihin i hi thil a ummi ruangah hin kannih cu hnahnawhnak nan chuahter tiin mawhchiatnak pek kan fawite. Hi hnahnawhnak kongah hin i sonhtarh awk zeihmanh a um lo i hihi zeicahdah hi bantukin a si ti hi ṭha tein chim awk bia kan ngei fawn lo,” tiah a ti."},"41":{"text":"Cu bia a chim dih in pumhnak khan a ṭianter hna."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hnahnawhnak kha a daih tikah Paul nih khan a zummi kha a kawh hna i thazang peknak bia a chimh hna hnuah, dam tein rung um u, tiah a ti hna i Masidonia ram leiah khan a kal.","title":"Masidonia le Grik Ram Ah"},"2":{"text":"Cuka ram chung khua kha a ṭolpah duahmah hna i thazang peknak bia kha a chimh hna. Cun Grik ram kha a phan i"},"3":{"text":"cuka ah cun thla thum a um. Siria i kal dingah a tlam a tlin nawnpah tikah khan Judah mi nih rawi an ka zalh ti kha a hngalh i cucaah Masidonia lei tu khan kal aa tim ṭhan."},"4":{"text":"Berea khuami Pirhas fapa Sopater le Thesalonika khuami Aristarkas le Sekandas le Derbe khuami Gaius le Asia ram mi Timote, Tikhikas le Trofimas kha a sinah cun an kal."},"5":{"text":"An rak kal chung i Troas khua khan an rak kan hngah."},"6":{"text":"Thilnu Phulh Lo Changreu Puai dih in Filipi khua in lawng in kan chuak i ni nga hnuah Troas khua ah kan phak hna; khika ah zarh khat kan cam."},"7":{"text":"Zarh chung hmasa bik ni ah hawikomhnak rawl dum ṭi awkah kan i pum. Paul cu a thaizing a kal ding a si cang caah, mi kha bia a chimh lengmang hna i zanṭim tiang a chimh hna.","title":"Troas A Tlawn Hmanung Bik Tan"},"8":{"text":"Kan i pumhnak khaan, cungdot khaan ah cun meiinn tampi an van."},"9":{"text":"Tlangval pakhat a min Zutikhas an timi kha thlalangawng ah khan a ṭhu i Paul nih ngol loin a chim lengmang caah cun a ngu chin lengmang ve i a donghnak ah cun hngilh taktak tein aa hngilh i inncung dot thumnak cun vawlei ah a tla. An vung char i a thi ko."},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul cu a vung ṭum i a bawhhnawh i a ṭang ah aa behchih. “Nan thinphang hlah u, a nung ko rih!” tiah a ti."},"11":{"text":"Cun inncung ah khan a hung kai ṭhan i changreu kha a cheu i an ei. Annih cu saupi, khuadei tiang, a chimh hna hnuah aa thawh."},"12":{"text":"Tlangvalpa cu inn ah an kalpi i an hna a ngam."},"13":{"text":"Lawng ah khan kan rak kal chung i Assos lei kha kan panh; cuka ah cun Paul cu kan lawng ah khan a hun i cit ve ding a si. Anih cu tlanglam in a kal caah cuticun nan tuah lai tiah a kan ti tak.","title":"Troas In Miletas Ah Kan Kal"},"14":{"text":"Assos i kan sin i a ra phak tikah lawng ah cun aa cit ve i Mitilene ah kan kal."},"15":{"text":"Cuka cun kan chuak i a thaizing ah Khios tikulh zawn kha kan phan. Cun a thaizing nolh ah cun Samos kha kan phan i a kiptuh ah Miletas kha kan phan."},"16":{"text":"Asia ram chungah kan rauh nakhnga lo lawng in Paul nih Efesa khua kha lanhtak aa zal. Jerusalem khua kha khulrang in phak a duh i a si khawh ahcun Pentekos ni tanh manh kha a duh."},"17":{"text":"Paul nih Miletas khua khan mi a thlah hna i Efesa khua khrihfa upa kha rak ka tong hna seh tiah bia a cah hna.","title":"Efesa Khrihfa Upa Kha Ro A Vuih Hna"},"18":{"text":"Annih cu an ra phanh tikah a thawh hna i, “Nan sin i ka um chung vialte, Asia ram chung i ka ra phakka tein zeitindah nan sinah ka umtuning a si kha nan hngalh."},"19":{"text":"Toidorte le mitthli he Bawipa sal ka si bangin, Judah mi nih an ka rawiphiar ruangah harnak ing lengmang in ka rian kha ka ṭuan."},"20":{"text":"Nannih kha zapi lakah siseh, nan inn cio ah siseh, phung kan chimh hna i kan cawnpiak hna tikah nan ca i a ṭha dingmi kha zeihmanh ka nganhtakmi a um lo ti kha nan hngalh."},"21":{"text":"Judah mi nan si ah, Jentail mi nan si ah, Pathian hmaiah nan sualnak kha i ngaihchih i kan Bawipa Jesuh zumh ding kha, nan dihlak in kan forh hna."},"22":{"text":"Atu cu Thiang Thlarau hruainak zulh in Jerusalem khua ah ka kal lai, khika ah ka cungah zeidah a tlung lai ti ka hngal lo."},"23":{"text":"Ka hngalhmi cu Thiang Thlarau nih a ka chimh bantukin, khua kip ah thongtlaknak le harnak nih an ka orh ko ti hi a si."},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawi Jesuh nih a ka fialmi rian, Pathian velngeihnak Thawngṭha chim hi ka lim khawh paoh ahcun ka nunnak hi cu zeihmanh ah ka rel lo.","ref":"2Tim 4.7"},"25":{"text":"“Nan dihlak in kan vahhnawh hna i Pathian Pennak kong kha kan chimh hna. Cun atu cu ahohmanh nih nan ka hmu ṭhan ti lai lo ti kha ka hngalh."},"26":{"text":"Cucaah nihin ah fel tein kan chimh duhmi hna cu, nannih lakah hin pakhatkhat nan tlau ahcun, keimah cu mawhchiat awk ka si hnga lo, ti hi a si."},"27":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian nih aa tinhmi kha a dihumnak in kan chimh dih cikcek hna i ka nganhmi zeihmanh a um lo."},"28":{"text":"Nanmah lila kha i veng u law nan zohkhenh awkah Thiang Thlarau nih an pekmi hna tuurun kha ṭha tein va zohkhenh hna u. Pathian nih amah Fapa thihnak thawngin amah ta ah aa sermi khrihfabu tuukhal kha si ko u."},"29":{"text":"Ka kal hnuah ṭih a nungmi cenghngia kha an ra lai i tuurun kha an ngan hna lai lo ti kha ka hngalh."},"30":{"text":"Cun nanmah bu chung lila zong hin mi a cheu nih a zummi hna kha anmah lei i hruai awkah lih an chim lai caan kha a phan lai."},"31":{"text":"Cucaah ralring tein um ko u, mitthli he chun zan in kum thum chung nan dihlak in kan cawnpiak hna kha philh hlah u."},"32":{"text":"“Atu cu Pathian velngeihnak chung le zohkhenhnak chungah nannih kha kan sanh hna. Amah nih cun an ṭhanter khawh hna i a mi vialte caah a chiahmi thluachuahnak kha an pek khawh hna."},"33":{"text":"Ahohmanh an ngun zong ka hngar hna lo, an sui zong ka hngar hna lo, an hnipuan zong ka mit an thi bal lo."},"34":{"text":"Hi ka kutte hin rian ka ṭuan i keimah le ka hawile nih kan herhmi vialte kha keimahte nih ka chuahpi ti cu nanmah hrimhrim nih nan hngalh ko."},"35":{"text":"Zeizong vialte ah hi bantukin fak piin rianṭuannak thawngin a dermi kha kan bawmh hna awk a si ti cu kan hmuhsak cang hna i Bawipa Jesuh zong nih khan zeitindah a rak ti ti ahcun, ‘Pek leiah hin hmuh lei nakin lunglawmhnak a um deuh,’ a rak ti; cucu kan philh lo awk a si,” tiah a ti."},"36":{"text":"Paul nih bia a chim dih in an dihlak in an khuk an i bil i thla a cam."},"37":{"text":"An ṭahpah in an kuh an hnamh i, dam tein vaa kal ko cang kun, an ti."},"38":{"text":"Nan ka hmu ṭhan ti lai lo, tiah a ti hna caah khan an ngaih a chiat khunnak cu a si. Cun lawng tiang khan an hei thlah."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Dam tein rung um u, tiah kannih zong nih kan ti hna i kan kal. Ding tein lawng cun kan kal i Kos tikulh kha kan phan; a thaizing ah Rods tikulh kha kan phan i cuka cun Patara ah kan lan.","title":"Paul Jerusalem Ah A Kal"},"2":{"text":"Khika ah khan Foinisia i a kal dingmi lawng kha kan hmuh i kan i cit i cu lawng cun kan kal."},"3":{"text":"Saipras tikulh a langhnak tiang kan va phan i cuka cun thlanglei ah kan vung kal i Siria ah kan lan. Tair khua ah tikam ah kan ṭum i cuka ah cun lawng nih a thil phorhmi kha a ṭhumh."},"4":{"text":"Cuka ah cun a zummi tlawmte kan va hmuh hna i an sinah zarh khat kan cam. Thlarau nih a chimh hna bangin, Paul cu Jerusalem khua ah khan kal hlah tiah an thlauh."},"5":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw anmah sin kan camnak caan cu a dongh tikah kan i thawh i kan kal ṭhan. An dihlak in, an nupile le an fale hna he khua leng tiang an kan thlah. Rilikam ah cun kan dihlak in kan khuk kan i bil i thla kan cam."},"6":{"text":"Cun pakhat le pakhat kha, dam tein, kan i ti hna i kannih cu lawng cungah khan kan kai i annih cu inn leiah an tlung."},"7":{"text":"Tair cun kan kal lengmang i Ptolemai kan phan, khika ah unau pawl kha kan hun biakchawnh pah hna i an sinah ni khat kan cam."},"8":{"text":"A thaizing ah kan i thawh ṭhan i Sisaria kan phan, khika ah Thawngṭha chimtu Filip inn ah khan kan tlung. Amah cu Jerusalem khua i mi pasarih an thimmi hna lak i pakhat kha a si.","ref":"Lam 6.5; 8.5"},"9":{"text":"Amah nih cun va a ngei lomi fanu pali a ngeih hna i annih nih cun Pathian bia kha an chim."},"10":{"text":"Cuka i sau nawn kan cam hnuah Judea ram in profet pakhat a min Agabas a simi a ra phan.","ref":"Lam 11.28"},"11":{"text":"Kan sinah cun a ra i Paul taisawm kha aa lak i a kut le a ke kha taisawm cun aa tem i, “Hihi Thiang Thlarau chimmi a si: Hi taisawm a ngeitupa hi hi bantukin Jerusalem khua ah Judah mi nih an ṭem lai i Jentail mi hna kut ah an chanh lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Hi bia cu kan theih tikah khika i a ummi hna le kanmah pawl nih cun Paul cu Jerusalem khua i kal lo awkah kan nawl."},"13":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kan thawh i, “Zeidah nan tuah? Hi bantukin nan ṭah ahcun ka lung nan ka hnoter. Jerusalem ah hin Bawi Jesuh caah ṭemnak huah lawng hi kaa tinhmi a si ṭung lo, thihnak tiang hmanh ka in lai tiah pei kaa timh cu,” tiah a kan ti."},"14":{"text":"Kannih nih a lung kha kan ṭhial khawh lo caah, “Pathian nawl si ko kun seh,” ti tu ah kan ti."},"15":{"text":"Cuka ah caan tlawmpal kan cam hnuah kan thil cu kan i tim i Jerusalem leiah khan kan kal."},"16":{"text":"Sisaria khua i a ummi zultu cheukhat zong kan sinah an kal ve i kan tlunnak dingmi pa inn ah khan an kan hruai — cu pa cu Saipras mi Mnason a si i amah cu hlan lio tein a zummi a rak si."},"17":{"text":"Jerusalem kan phak tikah cun unau pawl nih khan an rak kan conglawmh ngaingai.","title":"Paul Nih Jeim A Len"},"18":{"text":"A thaizing ah Jeim kha va ton awkah Paul le ti cun kan kal i khrihfa upa vialte zong kha an rak tling."},"19":{"text":"Paul nih khan a biakchawnh dih hna in Jentail mi hna sinah Pathian nih amah rianṭuannak thawngin a tuahmi vialte kha tling tein a chimh hna."},"20":{"text":"A chimmi cu an theih tikah Pathian kha an thangṭhat. Cun Paul cu an thawh i, “Unaupa, zeitindah thil umtuning a si cu na hngalh ko. Judah mi lakah hin thong tampi a zumtu an um cang i cu hna cu Phung a ṭanh ngaingaimi an si."},"21":{"text":"Jentail mi ram chung i a ummi Judah mi vialte kha Moses Nawlbia kha hlaw u law nan fale kha an cuarpar tan hna hlah u law Judah phung kha zul hlah u, a ti hna, tiah nangmah kongah khan bia an theih."},"22":{"text":"Annih nih hika na phak kha an hngalh ding ṭheo a si. Cucaah cun zeidah tuah awk a si lai?"},"23":{"text":"Kan in chimhmi hi tuah ko. Hika ah hin biakamnak a tuahmi mi pali an um.","ref":"Nam 6.13-21"},"24":{"text":"Anmah he cun va kal u law thianhnak phungphai an tuahmi kha va tuah ve law liam awk kha va liampiak hna; cun an lu kha an i met kho lai. Cuticun aho paoh nih na kong an rak chimhmi hna kha biatak aa tel lo tiah an hngalh lai i Moses Nawlbia ning tein khua a sami na si tu kha an hngalh lai."},"25":{"text":"Jentail mi zumtu i a simi hna kong tu ah cun, kannih nih ca kan kuat cang hna i siasal sinah pekchanh ciami rawl nan ei lai lo, thi nan ei lai lo, hngawngdih sa paohpaoh nan ei lai lo, pumsa sualnak kha nan tuah lai lo tiah kan biakhiahnak a si tiin kan ti cang hna,” tiah an ti.","ref":"Lam 15.29"},"26":{"text":"Cucaah Paul nih khan mi kha a kalpi hna i a thaizing ah i thianhnak phungphai kha a tuahpi hna. Cun biakinn chungah khan a va lut i an i thianhnak caan a dongh tiangah ni zeizat dah a si lai i cu a dongh tikah an caah raithawinak tuah a herh cio lainak kong kha tlangbawi cu a va chimh."},"27":{"text":"Ni sarih kha a dongh deng nawn tikah khin Asia ram in a rami Judah mi tlawmpal hna nih Paul kha biakinn chungah cun an hmuh. Mizapi kha an tuai ciammam hna i Paul kha an tlaih.","title":"Paul Kha Biakinn Chungah An Tlaih"},"28":{"text":"“Israel mi hna, kan bawm tuah u. Hi pa hi pei a kenkiplo ah a kal i Israel mi ralchanh le Moses Phungbia ralchanh le hi biakinn ralchanh in mi a cawnpiak lengmangtu hna cu a si cu. Cun atu hi hi biakinn chungah hin Jentail mi hna hmanh kha a luhpi hna i a thurhhnawmhter cang,” tiah an au."},"29":{"text":"(Hiti an ti cu, Efesa khuami Trofimas kha Paul he khua chungah an hmuh hna i Paul nih biakinn chungah a luhpi, tiah an ruah caah a si).","ref":"Lam 20.4"},"30":{"text":"I tuainak cu khuapi chungah cun a khat i mi vialte kha an tli an le i Paul kha an tlaih i biakinn chung khan an chuah. Khulrang in innka kha an hrenh."},"31":{"text":"Mibupi nih khan Paul cu thah an timh lioah khin Jerusalem khua cu a ningpi in a buai cang tiin Rom ralkap a haotu hna bawi kha thawng an thanh."},"32":{"text":"Chikkhatte ah cu haotupa nih cun ralbawi tlawmpal le ralkap kha aa kalpi hna i zapi leiah cun an va le. Ralkap he an rat kha an rak hmuh hna tikah Paul an tuk kha an ngol."},"33":{"text":"Ralkap haotu nih cun Paul cu a tlaih i thir cikcin a thuah in nan khih lai tiah a ti. Cun aa thawh i, “Hi pa hi ahodah a si? Zeidah a tuahmi a si?” tiah a hal hna."},"34":{"text":"Zapi lak cun a cheu nih thil pakhat in an rak au, a cheu nih a dang in an rak au. An i tuai tuk caah cun ralkap haotu nih cun thil a rak ummi kha zei set dah a si ti kha a hngal kho lo i cucaah a mi hna kha Paul cu ralhruang chungah hun luhpi u tiah a fial hna."},"35":{"text":"Hleihlak kha an hei phakpi i mibu kha an puarhran tuk caah ralkap nih cun a zawnh in an zawnh."},"36":{"text":"An hnu cun an dawi lulhmalh hna i, “That u,” tiah an au."},"37":{"text":"Ralhruang chungah khan Paul cu an hei luhpi dengmang tikah khin Paul nih ralkapbu haotu kha a chawnh i, “Bia tlawm tein kan chim kho hnga maw?” tiah a ti. “Grik holh na thiam tih?” tiah ralkapbu haotu nih cun a ti i,","title":"Paul Nih A Sual Lonak Bia A Chim"},"38":{"text":"“A si ahcun, kan hnulei deuh i ralthawhnak a thawk i mi thong li hriam he nam he ramlak i a kalpitu hna Izipt mipa kha cu na si lo ti law?” tiah a ti."},"39":{"text":"Paul nih cun, “Kei cu Judah mi, Silisia ram Tarsas khua i a chuakmi ka si; khuapi minthang fapa pei ka si ve tiah. Zaangfahnak tein mizapi sinah hin bia ka chimter ko,” tiah a leh."},"40":{"text":"Ralkapbu haotu nih cun a nawl a pek i hleihlak ah cun Paul cu a dir i mizapi kha a kut a zaoh hna. Dai tein an hung um tikah Paul nih cun Hebru holh in bia kha a chimh hna."}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Paul nih cun a thawh hna i, “U le nau hna le pale hna, nan hmai i kaa humhaknak bia ka chim tikah hin ka bia hi ka ngaihpiak tuah u,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Annih nih Hebru holh in a chim kha an theih tikah an dai chinchin i cun Paul nih cun a bia cu a vun peh i,"},"3":{"text":"“Kei cu Judah mi, Silisia ram Tarsas khua i a chuakmi ka si, sihmanhsehlaw ka ca cawnnak cu hika Jerusalem khua ah hin Gamaliel kut tangah khan a si. Kan pupa hna Phungbia kha fel tein cawnpiak ka rak si i nihin i nanmah vialte tlukte hin Pathian leiah aa pumpemi ka rak si.","ref":"Lam 5.34-39"},"4":{"text":"Hi Lam a zulmi hna hi ka rak hrem hna i ka rak thah hna. Nu he pa he ka rak tlaih hna i thong ah ka rak thlak hna.","ref":"Lam 8.3; 26.9-11"},"5":{"text":"Tlangbawi Ngan le khawngsil upa hna nih khan ka chimmi hi biatak a si kha tehte an khaan khawh. Anmah sin cun Damaskas khua i a ummi Judah mi hna pek awk ca kha kaa lak i cuticun hi mi hna hi tlaih i thir cikcin in khih i Jerusalem khua i hunpi i dantat awkah khan ka kal,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"“Damaskas khua leiah cun kan kal i kan hei phak deng ah khin, chun hrawng a si lai, ka velchum ah ceunak pakhat a hung ceu zuk ko.","title":"Paul Nih A Lungthlennak A Chimh Hna"},"7":{"text":"Vawlei ah ka tlu i aw pakhat nih a ka chawnh kha ka theih i, ‘Saul, Saul, zeicahdah na ka hrem?’ tiah a ti."},"8":{"text":"Kei nih ka thawh i, ‘Ahodah na si, Bawipa?’ tiah ka ti i, ‘Keimah cu na hremmi Nazareth khuami Jesuh ka si,’ tiah a ka ti."},"9":{"text":"Ka sin i a ummi hna nih khan ceu cu an hmuh, sihmanhsehlaw bia a ka chimtu aw kha cu an thei lo."},"10":{"text":"‘Zeidah ka tuah lai, Bawipa?’ tiah ka hal i Bawipa nih cun ‘Tho law Damaskas khua chungah va lut tuah; khika ah Pathian nih na tuah awkah a ruahmi vialte cu an rak in chimh lai,’ tiah a ka ti."},"11":{"text":"Ceunak cu a ceu tuk caah cun ka mit a caw i cucaah ka hawile nih khan ka kut in an ka hruai i Damaskas khua chungah cun an ka luhpi."},"12":{"text":"“Cuka ah cun mipa pakhat a min Ananias a simi kha a rak um, amah cu biaknak lei i lungthin a ngeimi le kan Phunglam a zulmi le Damaskas khua i a ummi Judah mi vialte nih an hmaizahmi a si."},"13":{"text":"Ka sinah khan a ra i ka pawngin a dir i, ‘Ka nau Saul, hmu ṭhan tuah,’ tiah a ka ti. Cu cangkate cun ka vun hmuh colh i amah cu ka hun zoh."},"14":{"text":"Aa thawh i, ‘Kan pupa hna Pathian nih nangmah cu a duhnak kha hngalhter awk le a dingmi a Sal kha hmuh awkah, amah aw hrim in a chimmi bia kha theih awkah an thim."},"15":{"text":"Zeicahtiah na hmuhmi le na theihmi kha mi vialte a chimtu amah tehte na si lai."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah zeicahdah sau deuh ngan a herh? Tho law tipilnak ing ko, amah min na auhnak thawngin na sualnak vialte kha i thianh ko,’ tiah a ka ti."},"17":{"text":"“Jerusalem ah ka kir ṭhan i biakinn chung i thla ka cam lioah langhnak ka hmuh.","title":"Jentail Mi Sin Phungchim Ah A Kawh"},"18":{"text":"Cu langhnak ah cun Bawipa kha ka hmuh i a ka thawh i, ‘Khulrang tein Jerusalem khua hi chuahtak tuah, zeicahtiah hika i a ummi hna nih hin keimah kong i na chimmi bia hi an cohlang lai lo,’ a ka ti."},"19":{"text":"Cun kei nih, ‘Bawipa, pumhnak inn kip ah ka kal i nangmah an zummi kha ka tlaih hna i ka tuk hna cu ṭha tein an hngalh ko."},"20":{"text":"Cun na tehte a simi Steven kha an thah tikah keimah hrimhrim zong kaa tel ve i amah thah kha ka hnatlakpi ve hna i a thattu hna an puan a rak fimhlawmtu kha ka rak si,’ ka ti.","ref":"Lam 7.58"},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Bawipa nih cun a ka thawh i, ‘Kal ko, zeicahtiah ram hlapi i a ummi Jentail mi hna sinah kan thlah lai,’ a ka ti,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Hi tiang a chim ah hin cun mizapi nih khan Paul kha an ngaih ko; sihmanhsehlaw an aw reng chuak khan an au ṭhan i, “Kha pa kha hlo ko u. That ko u. A nung ding tlak a si lo,” an ti."},"23":{"text":"An ai an kiao, an puan kha an hlorh i vuidip kha van ah an vorh."},"24":{"text":"Rom ralkapbu haotu nih cun a mi hna kha Paul cu ralhruang chungah kalpi u law zeicahdah Judah mi nih hi ti hin an auhnawh hnga ti hngalh khawhnak ding caah fungfek in va tu u, tiah nawl a pek hna."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tuk ding i an hun hren ah khin Paul nih cuka i a dirmi bawi cu a thawh i, “Rom mi a simi, zeidah a sual ti hmanh ceih rih lomi tuk hi, na caah upadi ning a si lai maw?” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cu bawi nih cucu a theih tikah ralkapbu haotu sinah cun a va kal i, “Na tuahmi hi zeidah a si ti awk na hngal maw? Hi pa hi Rom mi fawh a si hi!” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"Cucaah ralkapbu haotu bawipa cu Paul sinah khan a va kal i, “Rom mi na si maw, ka chim tuah,” tiah a va ti. Paul nih, “Ka si ko,” tiah a leh."},"28":{"text":"Ralkapbu haotu nih cun, “Tangka tampi pek in kei cu ka si,” tiah a ti. Paul nih, “Kei cu a chuah in aa chuahpimi ka si,” tiah a leh."},"29":{"text":"Paul cu bia kan hal lai tiah a timi hna kha hmakhatte ah an i let ṭhan i ralkapbu haotu cu Paul kha Rom mi a si ti a hun hngalh tikah, thir cikcin in a rak khih kha a thin a phang."},"30":{"text":"Ralkapbu haotu nih cun Judah mi nih Paul hi zei sette dah an puh ti kha hngalh a duh caah a thaizing ah cun Paul cu a thir cikcin kha a phoih i tlangbawi upa hna le khawngsil pawl kha i pum u tiah nawl a pek hna. Cun Paul cu a kalpi i an hmaiah khan a dirter.","title":"Khawngsil Hmaiah An Chuahpi"}}},"23":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khawngsil pawl cu Paul nih dengteo in a zoh hna i, “Ka u le ka nau hna, nihin ni hrimhrim tiangin Pathian hmaika i ka nunning ah ka chiaṭha thleidannak lungthin a thiang,” tiah a ti."},"2":{"text":"Paul pawng i a dirmi hna kha Paul cu a ka ah vun beng u, tiah Tlangbawi Ngan Ananias nih khan a ti hna."},"3":{"text":"Amah cu Paul nih a thawh i, “Si rang thuhmi vampang, nangmah cu Pathian nih an bengh lai. Zeitindah keimah cu Phung ningin ka bia ceih awkah khaka ah khan na ṭhut i Phung he aa ralchanh in, hei beng u, na ti fawn ṭung hna?” tiah a ti.","ref":"Mat 23.27-28"},"4":{"text":"Paul pawng i a dirmi hna nih cun, “Pathian Tlangbawi Ngan na serhsat,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Paul nih a leh hna i, “Ka u le ka nau hna, amah cu Tlangbawi Ngan a si kha ka hngalh lo caah a si. Cathiang chungah, ‘Na mi a uktu hna cu na thangchiat lai lo,’ ti bia a um,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Exo 22.28"},"6":{"text":"Paul nih cuka bu chungmi cu a cheu Sadusi mi an si i a cheu Farasi mi an si kha a hmuh hna tikah khawngsil chungah cun a au i, “Ka u le ka nau hna, kei cu Farasi mi, Farasi mi hna fa ka si. Hika i biaceih i ka um hi a thimi kha nunnak ah an tho ṭhan lai ti ruahchannak ka ngeih ruangah a si,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lam 26.5; Fili 3.5"},"7":{"text":"Cu bia a chim cangka in Farasi mi hna le Sadusi mi hna cu an i si i an kuai."},"8":{"text":"(Zeicahtiah Sadusi mi nih cun mi hi thihnak in an tho ṭhan lai lo, vancungmi an um lo, thlarau zong a um lo, an ti; sihmanhsehlaw Farasi mi nih cun a pathum te hin an zumh dih).","ref":"Mat 22.23; Mar 12.18; Luk 20.27"},"9":{"text":"An aukhuan cu a thang deuh lengmang i Phungbia cawnpiaktu saya cheukhat, Farasi mi pawl a simi kha an dir i fak piin an al hna i, “Hi pa hi a palhnak zeihmanh kan hmu kho lo. Thlarau nih maw vancungmi nih dik a chawnh taktak ko lai,” an ti."},"10":{"text":"An i alnak cu a fak tuk hringhran i ralkapbu haotu nih khan Paul cu an thleh an baoh dih sual lai ti kha a phan caah a ralkap hna kha, mibu chungah cun vung kal u law Paul kha vung la u law ralhruang chungah khan hun luhpi u, tiah a fial hna."},"11":{"text":"Cu zan ah Bawipa cu Paul pawngah khan a dir i, “Na lung ṭhul hlah. Jerusalem khua ah keimah tehte na sinak kha na chim cang, cu bantuk ṭhiamṭhiam in Rom khua zongah na tuah hrimhrim lai,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"A thaizing ah Judah mi a cheukhat kha hmunkhat ah an i tong i khua an khang. Paul kan thah hlanah cun rawl zong kan ei lai lo, ti zong kan ding lai lo, tiah biakamnak an tuah.","title":"Paul Thahnak Ding Khua An Khang"},"13":{"text":"Cu bantukin khua a khang ṭimi hna cu sawm linak tam an si."},"14":{"text":"Cun tlangbawi upa hna le upa dang hna sinah khan an va kal i, “Paul kan thah hlan paohpaoh zeihmanh kan ei lai lo tiin biakamnak kan tuah cang."},"15":{"text":"Cucaah nanmah le khawngsil pawl nih khan Rom ralkap haotu kha bia hei cah u law, Paul kongah bia fiang deuh in theih a duh bantukin i umter u law, Paul kha kan sinah run thlah tuah tiah ti u law, kannih nih hika a phak hlanah rak that dingin timhcia tein kan rak um lai,” an ti."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu an khuakhanmi cu Paul far fapa nih a theih i cucaah ralhruang chungah khan a va lut i Paul kha a chimh."},"17":{"text":"Cun Paul nih ralbawi pakhat kha a kawh i, “Ralkapbu haotu sinah hi tlangvalpa hi hei kalpi tuah, zeilo chimh awk a ngei,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Ralbawipa nih cun a kalpi i ralkapbu haotu sinah cun a hei chuahpi i, “Thongtla Paul nih a ka auh i hi tlangvalpa hi zeilo chim awk a ngeih caah nangmah sinah ratpi awk a ka fial,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"Ralkapbu haotu nih cun a kut in a hruai i amah lawngin aa kalpi i, “Zeidah chimh awk na ka ngeih?” tiah a hal."},"20":{"text":"Tlangvalpa nih cun a thawh i, “Judah mi lak i nawl ngeitu hna nih khan, Paul kongah bia fiang deuh in hngalh a duh bantukin kan i umter lai i nangmah kha biaceihnak khawngsil ah Paul cu thaizing ah hun chuahpi tuah tiah kan nawl lai tiah hnatlaknak an tuah cang."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw an bia cu ngai hna hlah, zeicahtiah minung sawm li a thli tein amah a bawhmi kha an um. Kan thah hlanah cun rawl zong kan ei lai lo, ti zong kan ding lai lo, tiah chiat an i serh. Cu tuah dingah cun atu ah hin timhcia tein an um ko i nangmah biakhiahnak kha an in hngak ko,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Ralkapbu haotu nih cun a thawh i, “Hi kong na ka chimh hi ahohmanh va chim hna hlah,” tiah a ti i tlangvalpa cu a kalter."},"23":{"text":"Cun ralkapbu haotu nih khan ralbawi pahnih kha a auh hna i, “Sisaria i kal awkah ralkap za hnih in va tim hna u; cun rangcung ralkap sawm sarih le feipu za hnih zong va timhter chih hna u law tuzan suimilam pakua ah i thawh dingin i tim u.","title":"Paul Cu Mangki Bawi Feliks Sinah A Kuat"},"24":{"text":"Paul caah khan cit awk rang tim ve hna u law him tein Mangki bawi Feliks sinah phakpi u,” tiah a ti."},"25":{"text":"Cun ralkapbu haotu nih cun ca a ṭial i hi bantuk hi a ṭialmi cu a si:"},"26":{"text":"“Klaudias Lisias nih Mangki Bawipa Feliks sinah ca kan kuat. Na cungah daihnak um ko seh."},"27":{"text":"Judah mi nih hi pa hi an tlaih i an thah dengmang. Amah cu Rom mi a si ti kha ka hngalh i cucaah ka ralkap hna he kan hung kal i kan hung khamh."},"28":{"text":"Sual an puhmi hi zeidah a si hnga ti hngalh ka duh caah khawngsil pawl sinah khan ka vun kalpi."},"29":{"text":"A tuahmi ah thah awk tlak a simi siseh, thong thlak awk tlak a simi siseh, zeihmanh ka hmu lo; sual an puhmi cu anmah phung kong men kha a si ko."},"30":{"text":"Cun Judah mi a cheukhat nih amah thah khawhnak ding khua an khang ti kha ka theih tikah nangmah sinah ka rak kuat ahcun a ṭha lai tiah ka ruah. Cun sual a phawtu hna cu ka thawh hna i amah cu nangmah hmaika ah taza va cuai u, tiah ka ti hna,” tiah a ti."},"31":{"text":"Ralkap pawl nih cun a fial hna ning khan an tuah. Paul cu an va lak i cu zan ah cun Antipatris tiang an kalpi."},"32":{"text":"A thaizing ah ke ralkap pawl cu ralhruang ah khan an kir i rangcung ralkap pawl nih khan an lanhpi."},"33":{"text":"Sisaria tiang kha an kalpi. Mangki bawi kha ca cu an pek i Paul cu amah kut chungah khan an chiah."},"34":{"text":"Mangki bawi nih cun ca kha a rel i Paul cu khuazei peng mi dah na si, tiah a hal. Silisia peng mi a si kha a hngalh tikah,"},"35":{"text":"“Taza an cuaitu hna an rat tikah na bia cu kan ceihpiak te lai,” tiah a ti. Cun Paul cu Herod Siangpahrang inn ah khan va cawng u, tiah ralkap kha a fial hna."}}},"24":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ni nga hnuah Tlangbawi Ngan Ananias cu upa tlawmpal le sihni Tertullas he Sisaria ah khan an kal. Mangki bawi Feliks hmaiah khan an chuak i Paul sual an phawtnak bia cu an chim.","title":"Paul Cu Judah Mi Nih Taza An Cuai"},"2":{"text":"Tertullas cu bia cu chim tuah ti a si i Paul cu hitihin sual cu a phawt: “Bawipa, nangmah nih fimnak in na kan hruainak thawngin daihnak caan saupi kan hmu i kan ram ṭhatnak caah a herhmi remhnak tampi kha tuah a si."},"3":{"text":"Hi kong ah hin kan lung aa lawm ngaingai ko, bawipa."},"4":{"text":"Na caan kha sau tuk lakpiak kan duh lo, cucaah kan chimmi a tawite cu zaangfahnak tein na kan ngaihpiak nakhnga kan in nawl."},"5":{"text":"Hi pa hi hnahnawhnak a tuah lengmangtu, mi ṭihnung a si tiah kan hmuh; vawleicung khuazakip ah Judah mi hna lakah khan hnahnawhnak a thawhter lengmang i amah hi mibu bu khat Nazareth khuami mibu timi a hruitu hna a si."},"6":{"text":"Biakinn zong kha thurhnawmh a zalh i sihmanhsehlaw kan tlaih manh. (Kanmah nih kan phung ningin biaceih kan timh,"},"7":{"text":"sihmanhsehlaw ralkapbu haotu Lisias kha a ra i hramhram in a kan chuh."},"8":{"text":"Cun Lisias nih cun nawlbia a chuah i tazacuai a duhmi nih nangmah hmaiah hin va cuai u, a ti.) Hi pa hi bia na hal tikah sual kan phawtmi vialte hi ahmaanmi lawngte an si ti kha na hngalh ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Judah mi hna cu, cu bantukin sual a phawtnak ah cun an hun i ṭom ve i a chimmi cu ahmaan dih tiah an hun ti."},"10":{"text":"Mangki bawipa nih khan Paul cu bia chim ve tuah tiah a kut a hei zaoh i Paul nih cun, “Nangmah cu hi miphun hna cungah kum tampi biaceihtu na si cang ti kha ka hngalh i cucaah nangmah hmai i humhaknak bia chim hi ka saduhthah ngaingaimi a si.","title":"Feliks Hmaiah A Sual Lonak Bia A Chim"},"11":{"text":"Nangmah nih na hngalh khawh ko bantukin, Jerusalem khua i Pathian biak awkah ka hung kal cu ni hleihnih nakin a tam rih lo."},"12":{"text":"Judah mi hna nih hin biakinn chungah aho he bia kan i al an ka hmu lo, pumhnak inn ah siseh, khuachung khuazeihmanh ah siseh, mizapi kha hnahnawhnak tuah awkah ka forh hna zong kha an ka hmu lo."},"13":{"text":"Cu pinah sual an ka phawtmi zong hi ahmaan tiah an ti khawhnak zeihmanh a um lo."},"14":{"text":"Hi bel hi ka tuah tiah nangmah hmaiah ka ti khawh: Kei cu Lam thar a zulmi ka si (annih nih cun bu thar tiah an ti) i cu ti ning cun kan pupa hna Pathian cu ka biak; zeicahtiah Moses Phungbia chung i aa ṭialmi vialte le profet hna cauk chung i aa ṭialmi vialte kha ka zumh i Pathian i bochan in"},"15":{"text":"hi sual a ka phawtu hna zong nih an i ruahchan vemi, minung hi mi ṭha he mi ṭhalo he thihnak in kan tho ṭhan dih lai, ti hi kaa ruahchanmi a si ve."},"16":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian hmai le minung hmaiah chiaṭha thleidannak thiang ka ngeih khawh nakhnga kaa zuam khawh chungin kaa zuam."},"17":{"text":"“Jerusalem khua in kum tam nawn ka chuah hnuah, ka mi hna cu tangka tlawmpal va pek awk le raithawinak va tuah awkah cuka ah cun ka hung kal.","ref":"Lam 21.17-28"},"18":{"text":"Cu thil Ka tuah lioah cun biaknak inn chung i an ka hmuh hi a si i cu ah cun kan biaknak lei in i thianhnak phung kha ka tuah dih cang. Cu lioah cun ka sinah mibu zeihmanh an um lo i hnahnawhnak zeihmanh a um fawn lo."},"19":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cuka ah cun Asia ram in a rami Judah mi tlawmpal bel an um; annih nih sualphawt awk an ka ngeih a si ahcun bia chimtu dingah anmah cu pei zung ah hin ra chuah awk an si cu."},"20":{"text":"Asiloah hika i a ummi hna nih hin biaceihnak khawngsil hmai i ka dir lioah khan zeital sualnak ka tuah maw chim tuah hna seh,"},"21":{"text":"an hmai i ka dir lio i ka chimmi cu hi bel hi a si: Mithi hna cu nunnak ah an tho ṭhan lai, ti ka zumh ruangah nannih nih nihin ah hin taza nan ka cuai hih, ka ti hna,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Lam 23.6"},"22":{"text":"Cu Lam kong fiang tein a hngalmi Feliks nih cun an bia cu a donghter i, “Nan bia cu ralkapbu haotu Lisias a rat tikah ka khiah te lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"23":{"text":"Paul a cawngtu ralbawipa cu Paul kha luat deuh in na umter lai i a hawile nih a duh herhmi tuahpiak ding kha na thlauh hna lai lo, tiah a ti."},"24":{"text":"Ni tlawmpal hnuah khin Feliks cu a nupi Drusilla he an ra; a nupi cu Judah mi a si. Paul cu ra seh tiah an hei cah i Paul nih Khrih Jesuh zumhnak kong a chimmi kha a ngaih.","title":"Feliks le Drusilla Hmaiah Bia A Chim"},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul nih ṭhatnak kong tehna, mah le mah i sumnak kong tehna, a ra lai dingmi Biaceihnak Ni kong tehna a vun chim tikah Feliks cu a thin a phang i, “Atu cu va kal ko rih; caan ka ngeih tikah kan auh ṭhan te lai,” tiah a ti."},"26":{"text":"Cu hleiah Paul sinin tangka ka hmu lai ti zong kha aa ruahchih pah i cucaah atu le atu a auh lengmang i bia a ruah lengmangnak cu a si."},"27":{"text":"Kum hnih a luan tikah Feliks cu Porsias Festas nih a hun thlen. Feliks nih Judah mi nih ka duh hna seh ti kha a duh caah Paul kha thong chungah khan a chiahtak."}}},"25":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu peng chungah Festas cu a ra phak hnu ni thum ah Sisaria in Jerusalem khua ah a kal.","title":"Rom Siangpahrang Sinah Azu A Khan"},"2":{"text":"Cuka ah cun tlangbawi upa pawl hna le Judah mi hruitu hna nih khan Paul sual an phawtnak cu an rak chimh."},"3":{"text":"Paul cu lam ṭim i rak thah awk kha khua an khan caah Festas cu zaangfahnak tein Paul cu Jerusalem ah ratter ko tiah an nawl."},"4":{"text":"Cun Festas nih cun a leh hna i, “Paul cu Sisaria ah thong chungah a um ko i keimah zong khika ah tuan ah ka kir lai."},"5":{"text":"Mipa nih hin palhnak a tuah a si ahcun, nan haotu hna kha ka sinah kal hna seh law taza cuai hna seh,” tiah a ti."},"6":{"text":"Festas cu an sinah ni riat, ni hra tluk a cam i cun Sisaria khua ah khan a kal. A thaizing ah biaceihnak zung ah khan a ṭhu i Paul cu rak chuahpi u tiah nawl a pek hna."},"7":{"text":"Paul cu a hung phanh tikah Jerusalem in a rami Judah mi hna kha a velchum cun an dir i hi pa nih hin sual fak tampi a tuah tiin sualphawt hram kha an thawk, sihmanhsehlaw an puhmi kha ahmaan tiah an ti khawhmi a um lo."},"8":{"text":"Cun Paul nih khan aa thawh i, “Judah mi Phung kongah siseh, biaknak inn kongah siseh, Rom siangpahrang kongah siseh, zeihmanh sualnak ka tuah lo,” tiah a ti."},"9":{"text":"Festas nih khan Judah mi nih hung ka daw hna seh ti a duh caah Paul cu a thawh i, “Hi sual an in puhmi ruangah hin Jerusalem khua ah kal i ka hmaiah biaceih na duh maw?” tiah a hal."},"10":{"text":"Paul nih aa thawh i, “Siangpahrang biaceihnak zung hrimhrim ah ka chuak lai, khika ah bia cu ka ceih hna seh. Nangmah nih fiang tein na hngalh bantukin Judah mi cungah zeihmanh ṭhat lonak ka tuah lo."},"11":{"text":"Nawlbia kha buar i thihnak tlak thil ka tuah a si ahcun, cu chungin luatternak cu kan hal lo. Sihmanhsehlaw an ka puhmi ah hin biatak zeihmanh a um ṭung lo ahcun ahohmanh nih an kut chungah nan ka chan kho lai lo. Siangpahrang sinah azu ka khan,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"Cun Festas nih cun, fimchimtu aa chiahmi pawl kha ruahnak a hal hna hnuah, “Siangpahrang sinah azu na khan caah siangpahrang sinah na kal lai,” tiah a leh."},"13":{"text":"Cu hnu tlawmpal ah cun Agrippa Siangpahrang le Bernis cu Festas kha hung chawnh ta awkah Sisaria khua ah khan an ra.","title":"Agrippa le Bernis Hmaiah Bia A Chim"},"14":{"text":"Ni hnih ni thum an cam hnuah khin, Festas nih Paul umtuning kong kha Siangpahrang cu a chimh i, “Hika ah hin mipa pakhat, Feliks nih thong i a rak thlakmi a um ko;"},"15":{"text":"cun Jerusalem i ka hung kal tikah Judah mi tlangbawi upa hna le an upa hna nih khan taza an rak cuai i sual na phawt lai, tiah an ka ti."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Rom mi nih cun ahohmanh an si ah taza a cuaitu hna kha hmaitonh tein an ton hna i sual an puhmi kha i chim khawh venak dingah a caan pek lo cun sual an puhmi kha an sinah pek phung a si lo, tiah ka ti hna."},"17":{"text":"Hika i an rat tikah a caan zeihmanh rauhter loin a thaizing hrimhrim ah biaceihnak zung ah ka ṭhu i mipa cu rak chuahpi u tiah nawl ka pek hna."},"18":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw sual a phawtu hna cu an hung dir i an chim tikah an puh rua lai timi sualnak kha pakhat hmanh an puh lo."},"19":{"text":"Annih nih an puhmi cu anmah biaknak kong i an i alnak le mipa pakhat a thi cangmi a min Jesuh an timi, Paul nih a nung ṭhan pei tiah a timi kong a rak si."},"20":{"text":"Hi kong ah hin zeitindah fiang deuh in hngalhnak ka hmuh khawh lai ti kha a ruah awk ka hngal lo i cucaah cun Paul cu Jerusalem khua i hung kal i sual an in puhmi hi khika ah ceihpiak na duh maw tiah ka hal."},"21":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Paul nih khan azu a khaan; thong chungah ka chia ko law Siangpahrang nih ka bia cu chat te ko seh, a ti. Cucaah Siangpahrang sin i ka kuat khawh hlantiang, amah cu thong chung i um dingin nawlbia ka chuah,” tiah a ti."},"22":{"text":"Agrippa nih Festas cu a thawh i, “Hi pa hi keimah hrim nih theih ka duh ve,” tiah a ti. Cun Festas nih cun, “Thaizing ah na theih lai,” tiah a leh."},"23":{"text":"A thaizing ah Agrippa le Bernis cu sunparnak le rumra ngei ngaiin an ra i ralbawi upapa hna le khuachung mi lak i upa deuhdeuh hna he khan pumhnak ah khan khaan chungah cun an ra lut. Festas nih khan nawl a hei pek hna i Paul kha an run luhpi ve."},"24":{"text":"Cun Festas nih cun aa thawh i, “Agrippa Siangpahrang le hika i a ummi vialte hna: Nannih nih hi pa hi nan hmuh. Amah hi Judah mi vialte nih, Jerusalem i a ummi he hika i a ummi he, ka sin i taza an cuaimi cu a si. Amah hi nun awkah aa tlak ti lo tiah an au."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw thah awk tlak sinak caah zeihmanh thil ṭhalo a tuahmi ka hmu kho fawn ṭung lo. Cucaah cun amah zong nih Siangpahrang sin i azu a khan caah kei zong nih Siangpahrang sin i kuat dingah cun ka ruah cang."},"26":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a kong ah hin Siangpahrang sin i ṭial awk set ka ngei lo. Cucaah anih cu nan hmaiah kan hun chuahpi — Agrippa Siangpahrang, nangmah hmai thengtheng ah ka hun chuahpi — zeicahtiah a bia cu kan dothlat hnuah ṭial awk ka ngei deuh lai tiah ka ruah."},"27":{"text":"Keimah ca zongah thongtla pakhat, sualnak an puhmi fiang tein ṭial khawh ṭung loin hei kuat cu aa dawhcah deuh fawn lo,” tiah a ti."}}},"26":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Agrippa nih cun Paul cu a thawh i, “Na kong kha nangmah nih i chim tuah,” tiah a ti. Paul nih cun a kut kha a hun zao i a sual lonak kong kha hitihin a chim:","title":"Agrippa Hmaiah A Sual Lonak Kha A Chim"},"2":{"text":"“Agrippa Siangpahrang, nihin i nangmah hmaiah Judah mi nih an ka puhmi vialte lehnak ka hmuh hi vanṭhat ngai ah kaa rel."},"3":{"text":"Cun hi bantukin kaa rel khunnak cu nangmah cu Judah phung le lam vialte le kan i almi kong ṭha tein a hngalmi na si caah a si. Cucaah lungsau thinfual in na ka ngaihpiak nakhnga kan nawl."},"4":{"text":"“Judah mi vialte hna nih hin, ka ngakchiat tein zeitindah ka nuncanning a si kha an hngalh dih. A hramthawk tein kei cu ka ram chung le Jerusalem khua chung i khua a sami ka si kha an hngalh."},"5":{"text":"Cun annih nih hin an chim duh ahcun an hngalh zungzalmi a si ko, a hramthawk tein kan biaknak chung i a fel bikmi Farasi mi phu i aa tel zungzalmi ka rak si.","ref":"Lam 23.6; Fili 3.5"},"6":{"text":"Cun hika i biaceih awk i ka dir zong hi Pathian nih kan pupa hna sinah biakamnak a rak tuahmi chung i ruahchannak ka ngeih ve ruangah hin a si —"},"7":{"text":"cu ka ruahchanmi cu kan miphun phu hleihnih hna nih Pathian kha chun he zan he an rak biak tikah kan hmuh te lai tiin an rak i ruahchanmi ṭhiamṭhiam kha a si ko. Cu ruahchannak ruangah cun, Bawipa, Judah mi nih sual an ka puh hi a si."},"8":{"text":"Zeicahdah nannih Judah mi nih Pathian nih mithi a thawhter hna, ti cu nan zumh khawh lo?"},"9":{"text":"“Nazareth khuami Jesuh min dohnak caah hin ka tuah khawh chungin ka tuah lai tiah keimah hrimhrim nih hin ka rak ruah i","ref":"Lam 8.3; 22.4-5"},"10":{"text":"cucu Jerusalem i ka rak tuahmi kha a si. Tlangbawi upa hna sin khan nawl peknak ca ka lak i Pathian mi tampi kha thong ah ka thlak hna; cun annih kha thah awk tlak an si tiah bia khiah a si tikah kei zong nih ka hna a rak tlakpi ve hna."},"11":{"text":"Pumhnak inn kip ah khan voi tampi hremnak ka inter hna i an zumhnak kha hlawtter kaa zuam hna. An cungah khan ka thin a hun tuk caah anmah hrem awkah cun ramdang khua hmanh ah ka fuh hna."},"12":{"text":"“Cu bantukin annih hrem awkah cun tlangbawi upa hna sinin nawl peknak ca kha kaa lak i Damaskas khua i ka kal kha a si.","title":"Paul Nih A Lungthlennak Kong A Chim"},"13":{"text":"Lam i kan kal lioah cun, chunlai ah khin, maw Bawipa, vancung in keimah le keimah he a kal ṭimi hna velchum i ni nakin a ceu deuhmi ceu a rung ceu cu ka hmuh."},"14":{"text":"Kan dihlak in vawlei ah kan tlu i Hebru holh in aw pakhat nih a ka chawnh kha ka theih i, ‘Saul, Saul, zeicahdah na ka hrem? Fungzum chuih hi nangmah caah dah kaw a fah ko,’ tiah a ka ti."},"15":{"text":"Cun kei nih, ‘Ahodah na si, Bawipa?’ tiah ka ti i, ‘Keimah cu na hremmi Jesuh ka si."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw tho law na ke in dir tuah. Nangmah cu ka sal i ser kan duh caah na sin i ka langh hi a si; nihin i keimah kong na hmuhmi le hmailei i kan hmuhsak dingmi thil kha, nangmah nih midang kha na chimh hna lai."},"17":{"text":"Nangmah cu kan thlah lainak miphun Israel mi hna le Jentail mi hna sinin kan khamh lai."},"18":{"text":"Nangmah nih an mit kha na deiter hna lai i muihnak in ceunak ah, Satan pennak in Pathian pennak chungah na nunter hna lai; cun keimah an ka zumhnak thawngin an sual ngaihthiamnak kha an hmuh lai i Pathian thimmi hna lakah an i tel ve lai, tiah Bawipa nih cun a ti,” tiah a ti."},"19":{"text":"“Cucaah Agrippa Siangpahrang, vancung in ka hmuhmi langhnak cu al ka duh lo.","title":"Paul Nih A Rian Ṭuannak kong A Chim"},"20":{"text":"A hmasa bik ah Damaskas khua le Jerusalem khua ah, cun Judah mi hna umnak ram dihlak ah, cun Jentail mi hna sinah, ‘Nannih nih nan sualnak kha i ngaichih u law Pathian leiah khan i mer u law nan i ngaihchihnak a langhtertu thil kha tuah hna u,’ tiah ka ti.","ref":"Lam 9.20,28-29"},"21":{"text":"Hi ruangah hin pei Judah mi nih biakinn chung ka um lio i an ka tlaih i thah an ka zalh kha a si ko cu."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw nihin ni tiangah hin Pathian nih a ka bawmh i cucaah cun hika zongah hin a hme sin he a ngan sin he ka hngalhnak bia ka chim khawhnak hi a si. Ka chimmi hi profet hna le Moses nih a si te lai tiah an rak chimmi hrimhrim kha a si:"},"23":{"text":"cucu zeidah a si tiah, Judah mi hna le Jentail mi hna sinah khamhnak ceunak thanh awk caah, Messiah nih cun fahnak kha a in a hau lai i thihnak in a tho ṭhan hmasa bikmi a si lai, ti hi a si ko,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Isa 42.6; 49.6; 1Kor 15.20"},"24":{"text":"Cu bantukin Paul nih a sual lonak kong a chim lioah khan Festas nih cun a hei auh chih i, “Paul, na hrut cang! Na cawn sannak nih an hruhter cang,” tiah a hei ti."},"25":{"text":"Paul nih cun a hun leh ve i, “Ka hrut lo, Bawipa. Ka chimmi bia hi bia hmaan le fimhrin biate an si ko."},"26":{"text":"Siangpahrang Agrippa, na sinah hi bantukin ralṭha ngaiin bia ka chim khawhnak cu, hi thil cu na hngalh dihmi an si caah a si. Hi thil hi a thlithup in a kenne ah tuahmi an si lo caah hngal loin na um lai tiah ka zum lo."},"27":{"text":"Agrippa Siangpahrang, profet cu na zum hna maw? Na zumh hna tiah ka hngalh,” a ti."},"28":{"text":"Agrippa nih Paul cu a thawh i, “Fawi tuk in hen pei Khrihfa ah canter na ka zalh cu,” tiah a ti."},"29":{"text":"Paul nih cun, “A fawi ah siseh, a har ah siseh, Pathian sinah ka thlacamnak cu nangmah le nihin i ka bia a theimi vialte hi keimah bantuk si ve u law ti hi a si — hi thir cincik bel chim lo hin,” tiah a ti."},"30":{"text":"Cun Siangpahrang cu le Mangki bawi le Bernis cu an tho i a dang vialte zong kha an tho ve;"},"31":{"text":"an i ṭhial hnuah khin pakhat le pakhat cu, “Hi pa hi thah awk tlak thil siseh, thong thlak awk tlak thil siseh, zeihmanh a tuahmi a um lo,” tiah an ti."},"32":{"text":"Cun Agrippa nih khan Festas cu, “Siangpahrang sinah azu rak khang hlah seh law cu, thlah awk a si ko hnga,” tiah a ti."}}},"27":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Itali ram ah tilawng in nan kal lai tiah bia an kan khiahpiak tikah, Paul le a dang thongtla tlawmpal hna kha Rom ralkap chung i “Siangpahrang Ralkapbu” timi haotu Julias sinah khan an pek hna.","title":"Paul Cu Rom Khua Ah A Kal"},"2":{"text":"Asia ram tilawng dinhnak khua hna pal aa timmi tilawng pakhat, Adramittium khua tilawng kha, kan i cit i kan kal. Masidonia ram Thesalonika khuami Aristarkas kha kan sinah cun a kal ve."},"3":{"text":"A thaizing ah cun Sidon khua kha kan phan. Julias cu Paul cungah khan a ṭha ngaingai i va kal i a hawikom hna va hmuhtak kha a onh i a herhmi rak pekchanh zong kha a onh hna."},"4":{"text":"Cuka cun kan chuak i thli kha kanmah lei hoih in a hran caah Saipras tikulh thlidaihnak lei phen khan kan kal."},"5":{"text":"Rili cu Silisia le Pamfilia zawn khan kan tan i Lisia peng i Mira khua kha kan phan."},"6":{"text":"Cuka ah cun ralbawipa nih khan Alekzandria khua in Itali ram ah a kal dingmi lawng pakhat a hmuh i cu lawng ah cun a kan citter."},"7":{"text":"Ni tam nawn khulnuar ngaiin kan kal i har lengmang in Nidas khua pawng kha kan phan kho. Thli nih khan cuka lei kal cu a kan donh cang i cucaah Krit tikulh thli daihnak lei phen khan kan vung kal i Salmon vawlei fonghlei pawng khan kan lan."},"8":{"text":"Rilikam naih te khan kan kal thliahmah i har ngaiin Lawng Dinhnak Hnangam timi kha kan phan i cu lawng dinhnak cu Lasia khua in a hla lo."},"9":{"text":"Cuka ah cun saupi kan cam i Tlanhnak Ni zong kha a luan cang caah hmailei i kal ding cu ṭihnung a si cang. Cucaah Paul nih cun ruahnak a pek hna i,"},"10":{"text":"“U le nau hna, hika in hmailei kan kalnak ding hi ṭihnung ngaimi a si lai tiah ka hngalh; nan thil phorhmi le lawng zong nih hin rawhralnak an hmu sual lai i nunnak hlohnak zong a um ko lai,” tiah a ti hna."},"11":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ralbawipa kha lawng cawngtu bawile a ngeitu hna nih an chimmi bia tu kha a lung ah a lut deuh i Paul chimmi bia kha cu a lut kho lo."},"12":{"text":"Cuka lawngdinhnak cu khuasik chung umnak ah a ṭha lo i cucaah tam deuh nih kal i a si khawh ahcun Finiks phak kha an duh. Cu hmun cu Krit tikulh i lawng dinhnak nitlak-thlanglei le nitlak-chaklei a hoihmi kha a si i cuka ah cun khuasik chung kan um lai tiah an ruah."},"13":{"text":"Thlanglei in thlizil kha a hung hrang siahmah i kan khuakhannak cu kan tlinter khawh lai, tiah an ruah; cucaah thir cangai kha an hnuh i Krit tikulh kam cun titlang hnur thluahmah in kan kal.","title":"Tilet A Tho"},"14":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a rauh hlanah khin thli ṭhawng ngai, “Nichuah-chaklei Thli” timi cu tikulh lei cun a rung hrang."},"15":{"text":"Lawng cu a run den ciammam i lawng cu thlichia lei cu hoihter khawh a si ti lo caah cu ti i hoihter kan i zuamnak cu kan ngol i thlitu nih cun a duhnak paoh ah a kalpi thluahmah ko."},"16":{"text":"Kauda tikulh fate a thlanglei i kan kal lioah khan thlitu cu tlawmpal a kan phenh. Khika ah khan har lengmang in lawng i a ummi vokkuang lawng kha hnangam deuh in kan sersiam khawh."},"17":{"text":"Lawng cungah khan an hun khin i lawng cu a velchum in hri in fek tein an ṭem. Libia rilikam lei i rili tang thetse tlang ah khan kan i su sual lai ti an phang i cucaah puanzar kha an ṭhumh i lawng cu thlitu kha an choihter."},"18":{"text":"Thlichia cu a hrang lengmang ko i cucaah a thaizing ah cun lawng chung thil phorhmi kha an hlonh hna i"},"19":{"text":"a kiptuh ah cun an kut in lawng thilri kha an hlonh hna."},"20":{"text":"Ni tampi, ni siseh, arfi si hna seh, hmu kho loin kan um i thlitu cu fak piin a hrang lengmang ko. A donghnak ah cun nun lai hmanh kha kan i ruah ngam ti lo."},"21":{"text":"Cuticun mi cu rawl loin saupi an um tikah Paul cu an hmaiah a dir i, “U le nau hna, ka bia rak ka ngaiin Krit tikulh khan chuak loin rak um u si law, hi harnak le sunghnak vialte hi kan tong hnga lo."},"22":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu cu nan lungdong hlah u, tiah kan nawl hna. Pakhat hmanh kan thi lai lo, lawng bel hi a rawk lai."},"23":{"text":"Zeicahtiah ka biak i a ta ka simi Pathian vancungmi kha zahan ah ka sinah a ra i,"},"24":{"text":"‘Paul, na thinphang hlah. Siangpahrang hmaika ah cun na dir ṭhiamṭhiam ko lai; cun Pathian nih amah ṭhatnak thawngin nangmah sinah a kalmi vialte an nunnak hi nangmah kha an pek,’ a ka ti."},"25":{"text":"Cucaah u le nau hna, nan lungdong hlah u. Zeicahtiah a ka chimh bantukte cun a si ko lai tiah Pathian kha ka zumh."},"26":{"text":"Tikulh pakhatkhat ah titlang ah a kan cheh te ko lai,” tiah a ti."},"27":{"text":"A zan hleinganak a si cang i Mediterranean rili ah cun thlichia nih cun a kan choih cuahmah ko. Zanṭim hrawngah khin lawngcawng pawl nih cun tlang kan naih rua tiin an lung a hring nawn."},"28":{"text":"Cucaah hri ah lung an thlaih i an vun thlak i ti cu pe za khat le pe kul a si; tlawmte hnu deuh ah khin an vun tah ṭhan i pe sawm kua a si."},"29":{"text":"Kan lawng cu lung ah aa su sual lai ti an phan caah a hnulei in thir cangai pali kha ti chungah an thlak hna i khuadei lainak caah thla lawng kan cam ko."},"30":{"text":"Lawngcawng pawl nih khan vokkuanglawng kha ti ah khan an vun thlak i hmailei kamah thir cangai kan thla lai ti bantuk khin an i umter i zam an i tim."},"31":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ralbawipa le ralkap hna cu Paul nih khan, “Hi lawngcawng pawl hi lawng cung i an um peng lo ahcun nan nung lai lo,” tiah a ti hna."},"32":{"text":"Cucaah ralkap pawl nih khan lawng a tlaitu hri kha an pheh hna i lawng cu an thlah."},"33":{"text":"Khua a hung dei dengmang i Paul nih an dihlak in rawl ei u tiah a nawl hna. “Ni hleili chung awlokchong in nan um i hi chung vialte rawl zeihmanh nan ei lo."},"34":{"text":"Cucaah nan nunnak ding caah hin nan herh caah rawl ei u tiah kan nawl hna. Nan lu cung samfa fa khat hmanh a lo lai lo,” tiah a ti."},"35":{"text":"Hi bia a chim dih in Paul nih cun rawl kha aa lak i an hmaika ah cun Pathian sinah thla a cam hnuah a ei."},"36":{"text":"Midang zong kha an lung a hung ṭhawng i an dihlak in tlawmpal cio an ei."},"37":{"text":"Lawng cung i a ummi cu kan dihlak in za hnih sawm sarih le paruk kan si."},"38":{"text":"An dihlak in khim tein an ei dih hnuah lawng kha zaang deuh seh tiah changvut kha rili ah an thlak."},"39":{"text":"Khua a hung dei tikah lawngcawng hna nih khan titlang cu khuazei a si kha an hngal kho lo, sihmanhsehlaw ti fonghlei pakhat kha an hei hmuh i a si khawh ahcun khika ah khan lawng cu kan dinhter lai an ti."},"40":{"text":"Cucaah thircangai kha a hri an chah hna i rili chungah an thlak hna, cun lawng zahnak fung ṭemnak hri kha an phoih hna. Cun lawng kha thli nih hmailei ah kalpi seh tiah a hmailei ah khan puanzar kha an zar i tikam lei cu kan panh."},"41":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw lawng cu thetse tlang ah aa su khut i a tap ai. Lawng cu a hmailei kha thetse chungah cun aa bunh i cawlcang kho ti loin a taan lioah khan a hnulei tu cu tilet nih khan kuai cuahmah in a den ṭualmal ko."},"42":{"text":"Ralkap nih khan thongtla vialte hi kan thah dih hna lai, pakhat hmanh i leuh in luat hna hlah seh, an ti."},"43":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ralbawipa nih khan Paul kha khamh a duh caah a thlauh hna. Cucaah aa leuh khomi paoh tikam leiah i leuh u, tiah nawl a pek hna;"},"44":{"text":"cun a taangmi pawl nih cun thingpheng zeilo ṭukṭak le lawng kuaimi pelpawi kha an i tlaih cio i an zulh hna. Cuticun kan dihlak in him tein titlang ah kan chuak."}}},"28":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Titlang i him tein kan chuah dih tikah cu tikulh cu Malta tikulh a si ti kha kan hngalh.","title":"Malta Tikulh Ah"},"2":{"text":"Cuka rammi hna cu kan cungah an ṭha ngaingai. Ruahpi a sur i khua a sik, cucaah meiphu an kan tihpiak i hung to u tiah an kan ti."},"3":{"text":"Paul cu thinghreu kha a khawmh i mei ah khan a tih hna.
