Cun zeitindah Pathian hmaiah lungphanglo tein kan um cu hitihin a si;","title":"Pathian Hmai Ralṭhat"},"20":{"text":"kan lung nih sual kan phaw kun kaw Pathian cu kan lung nakin a ngan deuh i zeizong vialte kha a hngalh dih."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka fale hna, kan lung nih sual a kan phawt lo ahcun, Pathian cu lungphanglo tein kan fuh ngam i"},"22":{"text":"amah nawl kha kan ngaih ca le a duhmi kha kan tuah caah kan halmi paoh kha kan hmuh."},"23":{"text":"Cun nawl a kan pekmi cu: A Fapa Jesuh Khrih min zumh le Khrih nih nawl a kan pek bantukin pakhat le pakhat i dawt hi a si.","ref":"Jhn 13.34; 15.12,17"},"24":{"text":"Pathian nawl a ngaimi paoh cu Pathian chungah an um i an chungah Pathian kha a um. Cun Pathian kan chungah a um ti kan hngalhnak cu hihi a si: Thlarau a kan pekmi thawngin kannih nih kan hngalh."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Ka fale hna, Thlarau kan ngei, aa timi paoh khan va zum hna hlah u. An ngeihmi Thlarau cu Pathian sinin a rami a si maw si lo ti kha va hlathlai hmasa u. Zeicahtiah profet deu kha vawlei cung a kenkip ah an kal cang.","title":"A Hmaan le A Hmaanlo Thlarau"},"2":{"text":"Pathian Thlarau a si le si lo cu hitihin nan hngalh khawh lai: Jesuh Khrih cu minung in a ra, tiah a timi paoh kha Pathian sinin a rami Thlarau a ngeimi cu an si."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Jesuh kong ah, cucu a si lo, a timi paoh cu Pathian sinin a rami Thlarau a ngei lomi an si. Cu Thlarau cu Khrih Ral sin in a rami a si; a ra lai ti kha nan rak theih cang i atu hi vawlei ah hin a um diam cang."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka fale hna, nannih cu Pathian ta nan si i nal profet kha nan tei cang hna; zeicahtiah nan chung i a ummi Thlarau kha vawlei mi a simi hna chung i a ummi thlarau nakin a ṭhawng deuh."},"5":{"text":"Annih nih cun vawlei cung thil kong kha an chim i vawlei mi an si caah an bia kha vawlei nih a ngaih."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw kannih cu Pathian mi kan si. Pathian a hngalmi paoh nih cun kan bia kha an ngaih, Pathian mi a si lomi paoh nih cun an ngai lo. Cucaah hihi biatak Thlarau le palhnak thlarau kan thleidan khawhnak lam cu a si."},"7":{"text":"Ka fale hna, dawtnak hi Pathian sinin a rami a si caah pakhat le pakhat i daw u sih. Pakhat le pakhat aa dawmi cu Pathian fa an si i Pathian kha an hngalh.","title":"Pathian Cu Dawtnak A Si"},"8":{"text":"Pakhat le pakhat aa daw lomi nih cun Pathian kha an hngal lo, zeicahtiah Pathian cu dawtnak a si."},"9":{"text":"Pathian nih a kan dawtnak a langhterning cu hitihin a si: a Fapa ngeihchun kha vawlei ah hin a run thlah i amah thawngin nunnak kan ngei lai."},"10":{"text":"Dawtnak cu, Pathian kan rak dawt hi a si lo, amah nih a kan dawt i kan sual ngaihthiamnak caah a Fapa kan sinah a run thlah hi a si."},"11":{"text":"Ka fale hna, hihi Pathian nih a kan dawtning a si ahcun, kannih zong pakhat le pakhat kan i dawt ve awk a si."},"12":{"text":"Ahohmanh nih Pathian an hmu bal lo; sihmanhsehlaw pakhat le pakhat kan i dawt ahcun Pathian cu kan chungah a um i kan chungah a dawtnak cu a tling.","ref":"Jhn 1.18"},"13":{"text":"Kannih cu Pathian chungah kan um i Pathian cu kan chungah a um ti fiang tein kan hngalhnak cu Thlarau a kan pekmi ah hin a si."},"14":{"text":"Pa nih a Fapa kha vawlei khamhtu ah a run thlah, ti a hmutu le midang a chimtu hna cu kanmah hi kan si."},"15":{"text":"Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si tiah a titu paoh cu, a chungah Pathian a um i Pathian chungah a ummi a si."},"16":{"text":"Cun kanmah hrimhrim nih Pathian nih a kan dawtnak cu kan hngalh i kan zumh. Pathian cu dawtnak a si i dawtnak chungah a ummi paoh cu Pathian chungah a um i a chungah Pathian a ummi a si."},"17":{"text":"Kannih kan chungah dawtnak kha tlinter a sinak cu, Biaceih Ni ah ṭihnak zeihmanh kan ngeihnak hnga lo caah a si; cun cu bantukin ṭihnak ngei loin kan um khawhnak ding cu hi vawlei cungah hin Khrih bantukin kan nun caah a si."},"18":{"text":"Dawtnak chungah cun ṭihnak a um lo. Dawtnak tling nih cun ṭihnak vialte kha a chuah dih hna. Cucaah ṭihnak a ngeimi cu dawtnak tling a ngei rih lo, zeicahtiah ṭihnak cu dantatnak he aa pehtlaimi a si."},"19":{"text":"Kannih nih Pathian kan dawt cu Pathian nih a kan dawt hmasa caah a si."},"20":{"text":"Mi zeimaw nih, “Pathian ka dawt,” a ti i a unau a huat ṭung ahcun, amah cu mi lihchim a si. Zeicahtiah a hmuhmi a unau hmanh a dawt khawh lo ahcun a hmuh lomi Pathian cu a daw kho lai lo."},"21":{"text":"Cucaah Khrih nih a kan fialmi cu hihi a si: Pathian a dawmi nih cun nan unau kha nan dawt hrimhrim hna lai."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh cu Messiah a si tiah a zummi paoh cu Pathian fa an si; pa a dawmi paoh nih cun a fa zong kha an dawt tawn.","title":"Vawlei Kan Tei"},"2":{"text":"Pathian fa kan dawt hna ti kan hngalhnak cu hihi a si: Pathian kha dawt i a nawl zulh kha a si."},"3":{"text":"Zeicahtiah, Pathian kan dawt ti cu a nawl kan zul tinak a si ko. Cun a nawlbia cu kan caah a har tuk lo,","ref":"Jhn 14.15"},"4":{"text":"zeicahtiah Pathian fa a simi paoh nih cun vawlei kha a tei khawh. Vawlei kan tei khawhnak cu kan zumhnak hin a si."},"5":{"text":"Vawlei cu ahodah a tei kho? Jesuh cu Pathian Fapa a si tiah a zummi lawng nih an tei khawh."},"6":{"text":"A rami cu Jesuh Khrih hi a si, tipil a innak ti le a thihnak thi he a rami a si. Ti he lawng a ra lo, ti he thi he a ra. Cun cucu biatak a si ti kha Thlarau hrimhrim nih tehte a khaan, zeicahtiah biatak cu Thlarau kha a si.","title":"Jesuh Khrih Tehte"},"7":{"text":"Tehte a khaangtu pathum an um:"},"8":{"text":"cu hna cu Thlarau le ti le thi kha an si i an pathum tein an bia aa khat."},"9":{"text":"Minung nih tehte an khaanmi kha kan zumh tawn; Pathian nih tehte a khaanmi cu cu nakcun tam piin a ngan deuh i Pathian nih a Fapa kongah tehte a khaanmi cu atu i kan chimmi hi a si."},"10":{"text":"Cucaah Pathian Fapa a zummi paoh nih cun a lung chungah Pathian i tehte a khaannak bia kha a ngei; sihmanhsehlaw Pathian a zum lomi nih cun Pathian kha lihchim ah a canter i cucu zeicahdah a si ti ahcun, Pathian nih a Fapa kong i tehte a khaanmi kha a zumh lo caah a si."},"11":{"text":"Cu tehte cu hihi a si: Pathian nih zungzal nunnak a kan pek cang i cu nunnak cu a Fapa chungah a um.","ref":"Jhn 3.36"},"12":{"text":"Pathian Fapa a ngeimi paoh nih cun nunnak cu an ngeih i Pathian Fapa a ngei lomi paoh nih cu nunnak cu an ngei lo."},"13":{"text":"Pathian Fapa a zummi nih zungzal nunnak kan ngei ti kha nan i hngalh khawhnak hnga hi ca hi kan kuat hna.","title":"Zungzal Nunnak"},"14":{"text":"Amah duhning in kan hal ahcun, kan halmi paoh kha a kan pek hrimhrim lai ti kan zumh caah Pathian cu ṭihnak zeihmanh um loin kan fuh ngam;"},"15":{"text":"cun kan halmi kha a kan theihpiak ti kan hngalh ahcun kan halmi kha a kan pek ko cang ti zong kha kan hngalh fawn."},"16":{"text":"Mi pakhatkhat nih, a unau pakhatkhat kha, thihnak tiang a phanmi a si lomi sualnak a tuah kha a hmuh ahcun, nunnak a petu ding Pathian sinah khan thla a campiak lai — cucu thihnak tiang a phanmi sualnak a tuah lomi hna caah khan a si. Sihmanhsehlaw thihnak tiang a phanmi sualnak a um i cu kong ahcun Pathian sinah thla nan cam lai ka ti lo."},"17":{"text":"Palh in tuahmi thil vialte hi sual an si ko, sihmanhsehlaw sualnak vialte hi thihnak phanmi sualnak an si dih lo."},"18":{"text":"Pathian fa a simi cu a sual peng lo ti kha kan hngalh, zeicahtiah Pathian Fapa nih khan him tein a umter i Miṭhalopa nih khan a tawng kho lo."},"19":{"text":"Vawlei hi a pumpi in Miṭhalopa kut tangah a um nain kannih cu Pathian mi kan si ti kha kan hngalh."},"20":{"text":"Pathian Fapa cu a ra cang i hngalhnak a kan pek caah Pathian taktak kha kan hngalh. Kan nunnak cu Pathian taktak a simi a Fapa Jesuh Khrih chungah khan a um; amah cu Pathian taktak le zungzal nunnak cu a si."},"21":{"text":"Ka fale hna, pathian deu kha va hrial hna u."}}}}},"63":{"info":{"name":"2Johan","shortname":"2John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrihfa Upa nih, Ka dawtmi Bawinu le a fale hna kha ca kan kuat hna. Keimah lawnglawng hi an dawtu hna ka si lo, biatak kha a hngalmi vialte nih cun an in dawt hna,"},"2":{"text":"zeicahtiah biatak cu kan chungah a hmun i kan sinah a um zungzal lai."},"3":{"text":"Pa Pathian le a Fapa Jesuh Khrih nih velngeihnak le zaangfahnak le daihnak cu an kan pek lai i biatak le dawtnak in kan ta an si zungzal lai."},"4":{"text":"Kan Pa nih a kan fial bantukin na fale cheukhat cu biatak in an nung ti kha ka theih tikah ka lung aa lawm tuk hringhran.","title":"Biatak le Dawtnak"},"5":{"text":"Cucaah cun ka dawtmi Bawinu, pakhat le pakhat i daw hna u sih. Hihi nawlbia thar kan kuatmi a si lo, a hramthawk tein kan rak ngeih cangmi nawlbia kha a si ko.","ref":"Jhn 13.34; 15.12,17"},"6":{"text":"Atu i ka chimmi dawtnak a sullam cu Pathian nawl zul in kan nun awk a si ti hi a si ko. Cu nawlbia cu, a hramthawk tein nan dihlak in nan rak theihmi kha, i daw niakmak tein kan um dih awk a si, ti hi a si."},"7":{"text":"Hlengtu tampi, Jesuh Khrih cu minung in a ra lo pei, a titu hna kha vawlei cungah an i chawk. Cu bantuk mi cu mihlengtu kha an si i Khrih Ral kha an si."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah nan ṭuan lengmang hnawhchanmi kha nan sungh sual nakhnga lo le nan laksawng kha tling tein nan hmuh nakhnga, ralring tein um ko u."},"9":{"text":"Khrih cawnpiaknak chungah um peng loin kar hlei a lammi nih cun Pathian kha an ngei lo. Cawnpiaknak chungah khan a um pengmi nih cun Pa he Fapa he an ngeih hna."},"10":{"text":"Ahohmanh nan sin i an rat tikah hi cawnpiaknak hi an rak i ratpi lo ahcun, tluninn rak onh hna hlah u; “Na cungah daihnak um ko seh,” ti zongah rak ti hna hlah u."},"11":{"text":"Zeicahtiah cu bantukin a cungah daihnak um seh, ti a duhpiaktu kha a thil ṭhalo tuahmi ah khan aa tel vemi ah a cang."},"12":{"text":"Chimh awk tampi kan ngei ko hna, sihmanhsehlaw ca le cahang in si loin a tlawn tu in ka rak in tlawn hna lai i kan i lawmhnak kha a tlin naklai kan pum in bia kan i ruah lai.","title":"Biatlang Kawmnak"},"13":{"text":"Na dawtmi na Unaunu fale hna nih daihnak an in kuat."}}}}},"64":{"info":{"name":"3Johan","shortname":"3John","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khrihfa Upa nih, Ka dawt taktakmi Gaius, ca kan kuat.","ref":"Lam 19.29; Rom 16.23; 1Kor 1.14"},"2":{"text":"Ka dawtmi ka hawi, ngandam tein khua na sak i zeizong vialte na caah rem tein a um nakhnga thla kan campiak — thlarau leiah siarem in khua na sa ti kha ka hngalh."},"3":{"text":"Biatak leiah zeitluk in dah zumhawktlak in na um ti kha kan unau cheukhat nih an ra ka chimh tikah ka lung aa lawm tuk hringhran — nang cu biatak chungah na um zungzal tawn ko bantuk khan."},"4":{"text":"Ka fale biatak chungah khua an sa, ti thawng hlei in a ka lawmhter deuhtu zeihmanh a um ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Ka dawtmi ka hawi, kan unau hna kha na theihhngalh bal lomi an si nain an ca i nan rak tuahmi kha rian ṭha le zumhawktlak ngaingai a si.","title":"Gaius Kha A Thangṭhat"},"6":{"text":"Na rak dawt hnanak kha hika Khrihfabu sinah hin an chim. Hmailei an kalnak ding zongah Pathian duhnak he aa tlak dingin rak bawm ko rih hna."},"7":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Khrih rian ṭuan awk khualtlawn ah khan, a zum lomi sinin bawmhnak zeihmanh la loin, an i thawh."},"8":{"text":"Cucaah biatak rian kha a ṭuanpitu kan si nakhnga, kannih Khrihfami nih hi hna cu kan bawmh awk an si."},"9":{"text":"Khrihfabu sinah ca tawite hi ka ṭial, sihmanhsehlaw an hruaitu si a duhmi Diotrefes nih khan cun ka chimmi hi zeihmanh ah a rel lai lo.","title":"Diotrefes le Demetrius"},"10":{"text":"Ka rat tikah a tuahmi vialte kha ka phuan dih lai; kan konglam i thil ṭhalo tampi a chimmi le lih a chimmi tehna vialte kha. Cun cu lawng cu aa za rih lo, kan unau pawl kha an rat tikah a rak dawnh hna i kan tlung hna seh tiah a titu hna kha i tlunter hna hlah u, tiah a thlauh hna i Khrihfabu chung khan chuah a timh hna."},"11":{"text":"Ka dawtmi ka hawi, a ṭha lomi nawl cu i cawn hlah, a ṭhami nawl tu i cawn ko. Thil ṭha a tuahmi paoh cu Pathian mi an si, thil ṭhalo a tuahmi paoh nih cun Pathian kha an hmu lo."},"12":{"text":"A mi kip nih Demetrius cu an thangṭhat i biatak hrimhrim zong nih a thangṭhat. Cun kannih zong nih kan thangṭhat ve i kan chimmi cu biatak a si ti kha na hngalh."},"13":{"text":"Chimh awk tampi kan ngei ko hna, asinain ca le cahang in chimh cu ka duh lo.","title":"Biatlang Kawmnak"},"14":{"text":"Tuan ah ka rak in hmuh hna lai i cu tikah kan pum tu in kan i ruah hna lai."},"15":{"text":"Nan cungah daihnak um ko seh. Na hawile vialte nih daihnak an in kuat. Kan hawile vialte kha pumpak cio ah an kut rak kan tlaihpiak hna."}}}}},"65":{"info":{"name":"Judas","shortname":"Jude","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih sal le Jeim nau a simi Judas nih, Pathian kawhmi, Pathian kan Pa dawtnak chung le Jesuh Khrih huhphenhnak chungah a ummi kha, ca kan kuat hna.","ref":"Mat 13.55; Mar 6.3"},"2":{"text":"Zaangfahnak le daihnak le dawtnak cu tlamtling tein nan ta si ko hna seh."},"3":{"text":"Ka dawtmi ka hawile hna, kan dihlak in kan i hrawmmi khamhnak kong kha ca in, in chim hna ning ti cu ka duh zungzalmi a si. Sihmanhsehlaw atu ah hin, Pathian nih voi khat ah za lak in a mi a pekmi hna zumhnak kha rak ṭanh u, tiah in chimh hna kha a herh hringhran in ka hngalh caah cu kong cu ca in kua loin kan um kho hna lo.","title":"Cawnpiaktu Hmaanlo Pawl"},"4":{"text":"Zeicahtiah kan lakah hin Pathian zei i a rel lomi kha kan hngalh loin an lut i anmah ziaza ṭhalo thuhphenhnak caah khan Pathian vel kong kha ahmaan loning in an chim i kan Uktu le kan Bawipa a simi Jesuh Khrih kha an hlawt. Hi bantuk mi hna cu sualphawt an si lai ti kha Cathiang nih hlanpi in a rak chimchung cang."},"5":{"text":"Cucaah cun nan hngalh dihmi a si ko nain, Bawipa nih Israel mi cu Izipt ram chungin a chuahter hna i sihmanhsehlaw a hnuah a zum lomi cu a thah hnanak kong kha theihter ṭhan kan duh hna.","ref":"Exo 12.51; Nam 14.29-30"},"6":{"text":"Cun Pathian nih, hi vial hi nan nawl ngeihmi a si lai, tiah a ti i cu chung i a um duh lomi vancungmi hna kong kha philh hlah u. Vawlei tang muihnak ah khin thir cikcin in zungzal an hren hna i sualphawt an si lai ni, ni lianngan a phak tiang cuka ah cun Pathian nih a chiah hna lai."},"7":{"text":"Cun Sodom le Gomorrah le an pawngkam i a ummi khua hna kha philh hna hlah u. Cu khua mi hna nih cun, kha vancungmi hna bantuk khan, nu le pa sualnak kha an tuah i hawi ningkel hmanh in an tuah lo. Annih nih mei hremnak kha zungzal in an huah i cucu mi vialte ca in ralrin peknak a fiang komi thil a si.","ref":"Gen 19.1-24"},"8":{"text":"Atu kan caan i a ummi hna zong cu, cu bantuk cu an si ve. An mang nih khan anmah pum lila cungah a sualter hna; Pathian nawlbia kha zei ah rel loin a umter hna i vancungmi kha a serhsatter hna."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi lak i upa bik Mikhael hmanh, cu bantuk cun a um lo. Moses ruak cu aho nih dah a co lai, ti i Khuachia he an i al lioah khan, Mikhael nih cun Khuachia kha serhsat in sual a phaw ngam lo. “Bawipa nih an sik,” ti tu in a ti.","ref":"Dan 10.13,21; 12.1; Biat 12.7; Deu 34.6; Zek 3.2"},"10":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi mi hna nih hin cun an hngalh lomi thil paoh kha zeirello in an um; cun saram bantukin chuahpimi pumsa duhnak in an hngalhmi kha anmah a hrawktu hna thil cu an si."},"11":{"text":"An caah ṭihnung a va si dah! Kain lam kha an zul. Tangka an duh ruangah Balaam nih palhnak a rak tuahmi leiah khan an kal ve. Korah nih Moses a rak doh bantuk khan mi doh an duh ve i amah bantuk khan hrawh an si ve.","ref":"Gen 4.3-8; Nam 22.1-35; 16.1-35"},"12":{"text":"Annih cu hawikomhnak rawl nan dum ṭi tik i rawl lak i hnawm a ummi bantuk khi an si, ningzah zeihmanh hngal loin an ei i an ding. Anmah zawn lawng an i ruat. Ruah a chungah a um lomi khuadawm, thli nih a choih lengmangmi bantuk khi an si. Fur caan hmanh i thei a tlai lomi thingkung bantuk an si; a hram bongh i a thi taktakmi thingkung bantuk an si."},"13":{"text":"Rili tilet ṭihnung bantuk an si, ningzak a simi an tuahsernak cu tilet buanbara bantukin an lang. A vak a vaimi arfi bantuk an si, cu arfi hna cu Pathian nih muihnak a thuk bik chungah khin hmun a chiahpiak ko hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun Adam thawk in vun rel i paruknak a simi Enok nih khan hi hna kong cu hlanpi ah hitin a rak chim,","ref":"Gen 5.18,21-24"},"15":{"text":"“Zohhmanh, mi vialte kha an bia ceih awk le Pathian zei i a rel lomi misual vialte kha Pathian zeirello in an um ruang i an tuahmi sualnak vialte le Pathian kha zeirello in an thangchiatnak vialte ruang i sualphawt awkah, Bawipa cu a vancungmi mithiang rel cawk lo hna he an ra lai,” a ti."},"16":{"text":"Hi mi hna hi a zungzal in an phun an zai i midang kha an mawhchiat zungzal hna; a sualmi an duhnak kha an zulh; anmah le anmah kha an i thangṭhat i anmah duhning paoh in thil a kal khawh nakhnga midang kha heh tiah an fak hna."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka hawile hna, kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih lamkaltu hna nih an rak chimchungmi kha philh hlah u.","title":"Ralrin Peknak le Cawnpiaknak"},"18":{"text":"An in chimhmi hna cu, “Donghnak ni a phak tikah cun, nanmah an nihsawhtu hna le a ṭha lomi an pumsa duhnak lawng a zulmi hna kha an chuak lai,” ti pei a si kha.","ref":"2Pet 3.3"},"19":{"text":"Hi hna cu ṭhennak a chuahtertu, an pumsa duhnak nih a ukmi, Thlarau a ngei lomi an si."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka hawile hna, nannih cu a thiang bikmi nan zumhnak cungah khan fek chin lengmang in i sa chin lengmang ko u. Thiang Thlarau ṭhawnnak thawng khan thlacam u law"},"21":{"text":"Pathian dawtnak chungah khan um ko u. Cun kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih nih zaang an fah hna ruang i zungzal nunnak an pek hna lai ni cu hngak ko u."},"22":{"text":"Lung awṭawm in a ummi kha an cungah zaangfahnak ngei u;"},"23":{"text":"mei chung khan chuah hna u law khamh hna u. Cun midang zong kha ṭih le hmaizah kemh hna u, sihmanhsehlaw an pumsa duhnak an nehmi puan hrimhrim kha cu hua hna u."},"24":{"text":"Tlu loin an umter khotu hna le a hmaika ah soi awk zeihmanh um lo le lunglawm tein an chuahpi khotu hna —","title":"Thlacamnak le Thangṭhatnak"},"25":{"text":"kan Pathian le kan Khamhtu cungah cun, a liam ciami caan vialte in atu caan in zungzal caan tiang, kan Bawipa Jesuh Khrih thawngin, lianhngannak le sunparnak le ṭhawnnak le nawlngeihnak cu, um zungzal ko seh! Amen."}}}}},"66":{"info":{"name":"Biathlam","shortname":"Rev","abbr":[],"desc":""},"topic":{},"chapter":{"1":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi cauk hi Jesuh Khrih nih a phuanmi thil kong a si. Cu a phuanmi cu a um zau dingmi thil, Pathian nih a sal hna hmuhsak awkah a pekmi kha a si. Cu thil hna cu Khrih nih a sal Johan kha a hngalhter i cu hngalhtertu ah cun a vancungmi kha a thlah i"},"2":{"text":"Johan nih cun a hmuhmi thil vialte cu a chim dih. Pathian sinin hmuhmi bia le Jesuh Khrih nih a phuanmi biatak Johan nih a chim chinmi cu hihi a si."},"3":{"text":"Hi cauk a relmi le hi profet bia a ngai i hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi a zulmi cu lunglawmmi an si. Zeicahtiah hi thil vialte a tlin lai caan cu a naite cang."},"4":{"text":"Asia peng chung i a ummi Khrihfabu pasarih kha Johan nih bia kan cah hna: Atu i a um liomi le a rak um cangmi le a um lai ding a simi Pathian le a bawiṭhutdan hmai i a ummi thlarau pasarih le Jesuh Khrih nih vel le daihnak in pe ko hna seh.","title":"Khrihfabu Pasarih Biakchawnhnak","ref":"Exo 3.14; Biat 4.5"},"5":{"text":"Jesuh Khrih cu zumh awk a tlakmi tehte, hrin hmasa bikmi Fapa, thihnak in thawhter a simi a si i vawlei cung siangpahrang hna a uktu zong a si fawn. Kannih cu a kan dawt i a thihnak thawngin kan sualnak chung khan a kan chuah i","ref":"Isa 55.4; Slm 89.27"},"6":{"text":"a Pathian le a Pa rian kha tlangbawi bantukin a ṭuantu dingah siangpahrang phun ah a kan ser. Cu Jesuh cungah cun sunparnak le ṭhawnnak kha zungzal in zungzal tiang um camcin ko seh! Amen.","ref":"Exo 19.6; Biat 5.10"},"7":{"text":"Zohhmanh u, khuadawm sin khin a ra lio! Mi kip nih an hmuh lai, a rak chuntu hna zong nih khan an hmuh lai. Cun vawlei cung mi vialte cu a cung i an rak tuahmi kha i ngaichih in an ṭap lai. Cu ti hrimhrim cun a si lai! Amen.","ref":"Dan 7.13; Mat 24.30; Mar 13.26; Luk 21.27; 1The 4.17; Zek 12.10; Jhn 19.34,37"},"8":{"text":"Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian nih cun, “Kei cu Alfa le Omega ka si,” a ti, cu Pathian a um liomi le a um cangmi le a um laimi cu, zeizong vialte siangpahrang Bawipa a si.","ref":"Biat 22.13; Exo 3.14"},"9":{"text":"Kei cu nan unau Johan kha ka si. Jesuh ah kan i pehtlaihnak thawngin hremnak nan innak ah ka ing ve, nan umnak a Pennak chungah khan ka um ve i temhinnak nan inmi kha ka ing ve. Pathian bia ka chim ca le Jesuh nih a phuanmi biatak ka phuan ruangah, Patmos tikulh ah khan an ka chiah.","title":"Khrih Kha A Hmuh"},"10":{"text":"Bawipa Ni ah Thlarau nih a ka tlak i ka hnulei in aw thangpi pakhat kha ka theih, cu aw cu muko aw thawng bantuk a si."},"11":{"text":"A ka thawh i, “Na hmuhmi kha ṭial law na ṭialnak cauk cu Khrihfabu pasarih kha kua hna: cu Khrihfabu hna cu Efesa khua le Smyrna khua le Pergamum khua le Thiatira khua le Sardis khua le Filadelfia khua le Laodisia khua i a ummi kha an si,” tiah a ti."},"12":{"text":"A ka chawntu cu ahodah a si hnga tiah ka hun i mer i cuka ah cun sui mei vannak pasarih ka hmuh hna."},"13":{"text":"Cu mei vannak hna lakah cun minung a lomi pakhat a dir i a kemit phiak in angki fual aa hruk i a ṭang ah sui taisawm pakhat aa sawmh.","ref":"Dan 7.13; 10.5"},"14":{"text":"A sam cu tuuhmul bantuk a si i hawhra bantukin a rang i a mit cu mei bantukin a alh;","ref":"Dan 7.9; 10.6"},"15":{"text":"a ke cu somei chungah an tit i tleu tein an hnormi dar bantukin a tleu i a aw cu tisor nganpi thawng bantuk a si.","ref":"Eze 1.24; 43.2"},"16":{"text":"A orhlei kut in arfi pasarih aa put hna i a ka chungin kap hnih in a harmi nam a chuak. A hmai cu chunlai ni ceu bantukin a ceu."},"17":{"text":"Amah cu ka hmuh tikah mithi bantukin a ke hramah ka tlu. A orhlei kut in a vun ka tawngh i, “Na thinphang hlah! Kei cu hmasa bik le hmanung bik kha ka si.","ref":"Isa 44.6; 48.12; Biat 2.8; 22.13"},"18":{"text":"Kei cu a nungmi kha ka si. Ka rak thi, sihmanhsehlaw zohhmanh, zungzal in zungzal tiang ka nung cang. Thihnak cung le mithikhua cungah nawl ka ngei."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah cun na hmuhmi thil, atu i a um liomi thil hna le hmailei ah a um lai dingmi thil hna kha ṭial hna."},"20":{"text":"Ka orhlei kut i na hmuhmi arfi pasarih hna le sui mei vannak pasarih hna an sullam biathli cu hihi a si: arfi pasarih hi Khrihfabu hna i an vancungmi kha an si i mei vannak pasarih hna hi Khrihfabu pasarih hna kha an si,” tiah a ti."}}},"2":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Efesa khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hitihin va ṭial tuah: A orhlei kut in arfi pasarih aa put i sui mei vannak pasarih hna lakah aa chawkmi bia cu hihi a si:","title":"Efesa Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi"},"2":{"text":"Na tuahmi kha ka hngalh ko; zeitluk in dah naa zuam le zeitluk in dah lungsau in na um kha ka hngalh. Mi ṭhalo na in khawh hna lo kha ka hngalh i lamkaltu an si na loin lamkaltu kan si aa timi hna na hneksak hna le milip an si na hliah khawh kha ka hngalh."},"3":{"text":"Na lung a sau, keimah ruangah harnak na in i na lung a dong lo."},"4":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw ka lung na si lonak a um: cucu hmasa i na rak ka dawt bantuk khan na ka daw ti lo."},"5":{"text":"Zeitluk niam i na tlak cang kha philh hlah. Na sualnak kha mertak hna law hmasa i na rak tuah tawnmi kha tuah ṭhan hna. Na sualnak kha na mertak hna lo ahcun, ka ra lai i na mei vannak kha a umnak hmun in ka ṭhial lai."},"6":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw hi ṭhatnak hi na ngei, cucu Nikolas zultu pawl nih an tuahmi kha keimah nih ka huat tlukin na huat ve."},"7":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi bia cu ngai ko u! Teitu a simi cu, Pathian Dum chung i a ummi nunnak thingkung theitlai einak nawl kha ka pek hna lai,” a ti.","ref":"Gen 2.9; Biat 22.2; Eze 28.13; 31.8"},"8":{"text":"“Smyrna khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hitihin va ṭial tuah: Hi bia hi a hmasa bik le a hmanung bik a simi, a thi i a nung ṭhanmi bia a si.","title":"Smyrna Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi","ref":"Isa 44.6; 48.12; Biat 1.17; 22.13"},"9":{"text":"Na harnak kha ka hngalh ko hna; sifak na si kha ka hngalh — sihmanhsehlaw a ngaingai ti ahcun a rummi na si. Judah mi a si lo nain Judah mi ka si aa timi hna nih an in thangchiatnak kha ka hngalh; annih cu Satan ta a simi bu an si!"},"10":{"text":"Sifahnak na in dingmi kha zeihmanh ṭih hna hlah. Hi bia hi ngai hmanh. Khuachia nih khan nangmah hneksaknak caah nanmah lak i a cheu cu thong ah a thlak hna lai; harnak na inmi cu ni hra chung a si lai. Thih tiangin ka cungah zumhawktlak tein um ko; cun nunnak suiluchin kha kan pek lai."},"11":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi bia kha ngai ko u! “Teitu a simi cu thih hnihnak nih harnak a pe kho hna lai lo,” a ti.","ref":"Biat 20.14; 21.8"},"12":{"text":"“Pergamum khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hitihin va ṭial tuah: “Hi bia hi vainam kap hnih har a ngeimi bia kha a si.","title":"Pergamum Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi"},"13":{"text":"Na umnak hmun kha ka hngalh; Satan nih a bawiṭhutdan a chiahnak hmun a si kha ka hngalh. Ka cungah zumhawktlak in na um i keimah ca i zumhawktlak a simi tehte Antipas kha Satan umnak hmun i an thah ah khan, na zumhnak cu na ṭhial tak hlei lo."},"14":{"text":"Asinain na cungah ka lungtlin lonak tlawmpalte a um: cucu Balaam cawnpiaknak a zulmi nan lakah tlawmpal an um kha a si; Balaam nih cun Balak kha, Israel mi cu siasal pekmi rawl einak thawng le nu le pa sualnak thawngin an sual nakhnga, na cawnpiak hna lai, tiah a cawnpiak.","ref":"Exo 16.14-15; 16.33-34; Jhn 6.48-50; Isa 62.2; 65.15"},"15":{"text":"Cun nan lakah Nikolas zultu pawl cawnpiaknak a zulmi zong nan um fawn."},"16":{"text":"Nan i mer lo ahcun nan sinah ka ra zau lai i ka kaa chungin a chuakmi vainam khan kha mi hna kha ka tuk sual hna lai."},"17":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun Thlarau nih Khrihfabu sinah a chimmi bia cu ngai tuah u. “Teitu a simi hna cu thuhmi manna changreu kha tlawmpal in ka pek hna lai. Cun lung rang zong pakhat cio in ka pek hna lai i cu lung cungah cun a cotu cio lawng nih a sullam an hngalhmi min thar kha an i ṭial cio,” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"“Thiatira khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hi bangin va ṭial tuah: Hi bia hi Pathian Fapa, a mit mei alh bantukin a alhmi le a ke dar tleu bantukin a tleumi bia a si.","title":"Thiatira Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi"},"19":{"text":"Na tuahmi kha ka hngalh. Dawtnak na ngeihmi le zumhawktlak na sinak le na rianṭuanmi le na lungsaunak kha ka hngalh hna. A hramthawk ah na rak tuahmi nakin atu ah tam deuh na tuah ti kha ka hngalh."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw na cung i ka lungtlin lonak cu hihi a si. Pathian lamkaltu ka si, aa timi Jezebel kha na dawn lo. Amah nih cun ka salle kha a cawnpiak hna i a ping ah a hruai hna i nu le pa sualnak kha an tuah i siasal pekchanhmi rawl kha an ei.","ref":"1Sia 16.31; 2Sia 9.22,30"},"21":{"text":"Lungthlennak caan kha ka pek ko, sihmanhsehlaw a horduhcuainak lam khan i let ṭhan a duh lo."},"22":{"text":"Cucaah ihkhun cungah ka hlonh lai i cu ihkhun cungah cun amah le amah he nu le pa sualnak a tuahmi kha fak piin temhnak an ing lai. Amah he ṭhat lonak an tuahmi kha an i ngaihchih lo ahcun, atu ah hi temhnak hi an cungah ka tlunter ko lai."},"23":{"text":"Cun a zultu hna zong kha ka thah hna lai i Khrihfabu vialte nih khan keimah cu minung lungthin le duhnak a hngal dihtu ka si kha an hngalh lai. Nannih cu nan tuahmi ning cio ah kan cham hna lai.","ref":"Slm 7.9; Jer 17.10; Slm 62.12"},"24":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw Thiatira khua i a ummi a dang nih cun hi cawnpiaknak ṭhalo cu nan zul lo i midang nih, “Satan biathli thuk,” an timi cu nan hngal lo. Nannih cungah cun thilrit khinh kan duh hna lo."},"25":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw atu i nan ngeihmi kha ka rat tiang fek tein rak i tlaih ko u."},"26":{"text":"Teitu a simi hna le tuah hna seh ti ka duhmi a dongh tiangin a tuahmi hna cu, ka Pa sinin ka hmuhmi nawl ngeihnak kha annih zong ka pek ve hna lai. Miphun dang uknak nawl kha ka pek hna lai i annih cu thirfung in uknak nawl le tlak-um bangin khuainak nawl kha ka pek hna lai. Cun deirel arfi zong kha ka pek hna lai.","ref":"Slm 2.8-9","merge":"27"},"29":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi bia kha ngai tuah u,” tiah a ti."}}},"3":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"“Sardis khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hi bangin va ṭial tuah: Hi bia hi Pathian thlarau pasarih le arfi pasarih a ngeimi bia kha a si. Na tuahmi kha ka hngalh, a nungmi a si tiah na min a thang nain na thi ko.","title":"Sardis Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi"},"2":{"text":"Cucaah cun i hlau law na ngeih rihmi kha a thih taktak hlanah thazang thar la tuah. Zeicahtiah na tuahmi thil kha Pathian mit hmuh ah a tlingmi an si rih lo ti kha ka hmuh."},"3":{"text":"Cucaah cun zeidah an in cawnpiakmi kha a si ti le zeitindah na rak theih ti kha philh hlah, cucu zul law na sualnak kha mertak hna. Naa hlauh lo ahcun mifir bantukin kaan rathnawh lai i ka rat caan kha a hngalh hmanh na hngal lai lo.","ref":"Mat 24.43-44; Luk 12.39-40; Biat 16.15"},"4":{"text":"Asinain Sardis khua i a ummi tlawmpal nih cun nan puan kha thiang tein nan chiah ko. Puan rang aih in keimah sinah nan i chawk lai, zeicahtiah cu bantukin aa chawk dingah cun aa tlakmi nan si."},"5":{"text":"Teitu a simi hna cu hi bantukin puan rang an i aih lai i a nungmi hna cauk chung khan an min cu ka hlo lai lo. Ka Pa le a vancungmi hna hmaiah langhngan in, hi hna cu ka mi an si, ka ti lai.","ref":"Exo 32.32-33; Slm 69.28; Biat 20.12; Mat 10.32; Luk 12.8"},"6":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi cu ngai tuah u,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"“Filadelfia khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hi bangin va ṭial tuah: Hi bia hi a thiangmi le a taktak a simi, David tawh a tlaitu, innka a hun tikah ahohmanh nih an khar khawh ti lomi, a khar tikah ahohmanh nih an hun khawh ti lomi bia kha a si.","title":"Filadelfia Khua Khrihfabu Sin Biacahmi","ref":"Isa 22.22; Job 12.14"},"8":{"text":"Na tuahmi kha ka hngalh; na thazang a tlawm nain kan cawnpiakmi na zulh le ka cungah zumh awk tlak na si kha ka hngalh. Innka pakhat kaan hunpiak i ahohmanh nih an khar kho lai lo."},"9":{"text":"Ngai hmanh! Judah mi kan si tiah aa ti i a si ṭung lomi, milihchim pawl, Satan ta a simi kha, na hmaiah ka ratter hna lai i na ke hramah ka kunter hna lai. Annih nih an dihlak in, kan dawt kha, an hngalh lai.","ref":"Isa 49.23; 60.14; 43.4"},"10":{"text":"Lungsau in um tuah, tiah kan timi kha na zulh caah, vawleicung mi vialte hneksaknak ding caah vawlei cung dihlak ah a tlung laimi harnak caan kha tong loin kan luatter lai."},"11":{"text":"Ka ra zau lai. Na ngeihmi kha ṭha tein i chiah, teinak laksawng na hmuh ding cu ahohmanh nih in chut hna hlah seh."},"12":{"text":"Teitu a simi cu ka Pathian biaknak inn chungah khan tungpi ah ka ser lai i cu biakinn cu zeitikhmanh ah a chuahtak lai lo. Amah cungah cun ka Pathian min kha ka ṭial lai i ka Pathian khualipi, a min Jerusalem thar a simi zong kha a cungah cun ka ṭial lai. Cu khualipi cu ka Pathian sinin vancung khin a rung ṭum lai. Cun a cungah cun ka min thar zong ka ṭial fawn lai.","ref":"Biat 21.2; Isa 62.2; 65.15"},"13":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi bia cu ngai tuah u,” a ti."},"14":{"text":"“Laodisia khua i a ummi Khrihfabu vancungmi sinah hi bangin va ṭial tuah: Hi bia hi zumhawktlak le ahmaan taktakmi tehte Amen bia kha a si; amah cu Pathian nih a sermi vialte hram a si.","title":"Laodisia Khua Khrihfabu Sinah Biacahmi","ref":"Phut 8.22"},"15":{"text":"Na tuahmi kha ka hngalh ko; a kih zong na kik lo, a lum zong na lum lo. A kih zong kik lawlaw, a lum zong lum lawlaw law ka duh."},"16":{"text":"A lum menmen na si i a lum zong na lum lawlaw lo i a kih zong na kih lawlaw fawn lo caah, ka kaa chungin kan chak lai."},"17":{"text":"Ka rum ko, kaa za ko, zeihmanh ka bau lo, na ti. Asinain zeitluk sifak le zaangfah awk tlak dah na si kha naa hngal lo. Na si a fak, puan aih awk hmanh na ngei lo i na mit a caw."},"18":{"text":"Cucaah ruahnak kan cheuh duhmi cu, keimah sinin sui thiang taktak kha ka caw law na rum lai. Cun naa thuamhnak ding le taklawng in na umnak ningzahnak khuhnak ding caah, thil rang i cawk fawn. Cun na mit thuh awkah si zong i cawk law cuticun khua na hmu kho lai."},"19":{"text":"Ka dawtmi cu ka chimhhrin hna i dan ka tat tawn hna. Cucaah cun i biatak law na sualnak kha mertak hna.","ref":"Phut 3.12; Heb 12.6"},"20":{"text":"Ngaihmanh! innka ah ka dir i ka kingh. Ahohmanh an si ah, ka aw a thei i innka a ka hunhmi cu, a inn chungah cun ka lut lai i a sinah rawl ka dum lai i amah zong ka sinah a dum ve lai."},"21":{"text":"Keimah kha teitu ka si i ka Pa pawngah a bawiṭhutdan cungah ka ṭhut bantuk hin, teitu a simi cu ka bawiṭhutdan cung i ka pawngah ṭhutnak nawl kha ka pek hna lai."},"22":{"text":"“Hna nan ngeih ahcun, Thlarau nih Khrihfabu hna sinah a chimmi bia cu ngai tuah u,” a ti."}}},"4":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Hi dih hin langhnak a dang pakhat ka hmuh ṭhan i vancung ah khin innka pakhat aa hungmi kha ka hmuh. Cun hlan deuh ah ka rak theihmi aw, muko aw bantuk a simi kha, a hung thang i, “Hika ah hin hung kai law, hi dih hin zeidah a um lai ti kha kan hmuhsak lai,” a ti.","title":"Vancung Biaknak"},"2":{"text":"Thlarau nih cun khulrang in a ka tlaih. Cun vancung ah cun bawiṭhutdan pakhat a ummi a cungah cun mi pakhat a ṭhut kha ka hmuh.","ref":"Eze 1.26-28; 10.1"},"3":{"text":"A hmai cu jasper lungvar le karnelian lungvar bantukin a tleu i bawiṭhutdan velchum ah cun emeral lungvar mui a kengmi chuncha kha, aa zel."},"4":{"text":"Bawiṭhutdan cu a velchum in bawiṭhutdan dang kul le pali nih an kulh i cu bawiṭhutdan hna cungah cun, puan rang aa aih i sui luchin aa chinhmi upa kul le pali an ṭhu."},"5":{"text":"Bawiṭhutdan cun nimtlau aa lek i khuari thawng kha a thang. Bawiṭhutdan hmaiah cun meifar vanmi pasarih an um i cu hna cu Pathian thlarau pasarih kha an si.","ref":"Exo 19.16; Biat 8.5; 11.19; 16.18; Eze 1.13; Biat 1.4; Zek 4.2"},"6":{"text":"Bawiṭhutdan hmaiah cun thlalang fim bantuk a simi rili a um. Bawiṭhutdan cu a hnulei, a hmailei le a sirlei veve in saram nung pali nih an kulh i cu saram hna cu hmailei he hnulei he mit in an khat.","ref":"Eze 1.22,5-10; 10.14"},"7":{"text":"Saram nung pakhatnak cu chiandeih he an i lo, pahnihnak cu cawfa he an i lo, pathumnak cu a hmai minung hmai bantuk a si, palinak cu a zuang liomi mupi bantuk a si."},"8":{"text":"Saram nung pali hna nih cun thla paruk cio an ngei i an chunglei he an lenglei he mit in an khat. Chunzan in hlasak an ngol lo i: “A thiang, a thiang, a thiang, Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian cu, Amah cu a um cangmi le a um liomi le a um laimi a si,” an ti.","ref":"Eze 1.18; 10.12; Isa 6.2-3"},"9":{"text":"A nungmi saram pali nih cun bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi, zungzal in zungzal tiang a nungmi cu, sunparnak le upatnak le lawmhnak hla in an thangṭhat."},"10":{"text":"Cu bantukin an thangṭhat tikah upa kul le pali kha bawiṭhutdan cung i a ummi hmaiah cun an kun i zungzal in zungzal tiang a nungmi cu an biak. An suiluchin kha bawiṭhutdan hmaiah cun an chiah hna i,"},"11":{"text":"“Kan Bawipa le kan Pathian, Nangmah cu sunparnak le upatnak le lianhngannak kha hmuh awkah aa tlakmi na si. Zeicahtiah zeizong vialte kha nangmah nih na ser hna i Nangmah duhnak bangin annih cu ser an si i nunnak an ngei,” tiah an ti."}}},"5":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi nih cun cazual pakhat a orhlei kut in aa put kha ka hmuh i cu cazual cu a chunglei he a lenglei he aa ṭial dih i cakhenh pasarih in an khenh chih.","title":"Cazual le Tuufa","ref":"Eze 2.9-10; Isa 29.11"},"2":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pakhat a ṭhawng ngaimi kha ka hmuh i cu vancungmi nih cun, “Ahodah cakhenhnak phoih awk le cazual samh awkah aa tlak hnga,” tiah fak piin a ti."},"3":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw cu cazual a phoih i a chung a zoh khotu cu vancung ah siseh, vawleicung ah siseh, vawlei toiah siseh, ahohmanh an hmu kho hna lo."},"4":{"text":"Cu cazual cu phoih i a chung kha a zoh khotu dingah aa tlakmi ahohmanh an hmuh khawh hna lo caah fak piin ka ṭap."},"5":{"text":"Cu tikah upa pakhat nih khan a hun ka chawnh i, “Ṭap hlah! Zohhmanh, Judah phun chungin a chuakmi Chiandeih, David tefa milianngan nih khan, teinak a hmuh cang i cakhenhnak pasarih kha a phoih khawh hna i cazual kha a kau khawh,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Gen 49.9; Isa 11.1,10"},"6":{"text":"Cun Tuufa pakhat, bawiṭhutdan laifang ah a dir i saram nung pali hna le upa hna nih an kulh kha ka hmuh. Tuufa cu an rak thahmi si dawh a si. Ki pasarih le mit pasarih a ngei i a mit pasarih cu Pathian nih vawlei cung khuazakip ah a thlahmi Pathian thlarau pasarih kha an si.","ref":"Isa 53.7; Zek 4.10"},"7":{"text":"Tuufa cu a va kal i bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi orhlei kut i cazual kha a va lak."},"8":{"text":"Cu ti a va lak ahcun saram nung pali hna le upa kul le pali hna kha Tuufa hmaiah cun an kun. Pakhat nih tingtang pakhat cio le zihmui a khatmi sui kheng pakhat cio an i put, sui kheng chung zihmui cu Pathian mi hna thlacamnak kha a si.","ref":"Slm 141.2"},"9":{"text":"Hla thar kha an sa i: “Nangmah cu cazual kha lak awk le a khuhnak kha phoih awkah naa tlak. Zeicahtiah an in thah i na thihnak thawngin, Hrin kip le chung kip le holh kip le phun kip chungin, Minung cu Pathian sinah na phakpi hna.","ref":"Slm 33.3; 98.1; Isa 42.10"},"10":{"text":"Kan Pathian rian tlangbawi bantukin a ṭuantu dingah siangpahrang phun ah na ser hna i Annih nih vawlei cu an uk lai,” an ti.","ref":"Exo 19.6; Biat 1.6"},"11":{"text":"Ka hun zoh ṭhan i vancungmi a rel in rel cawk lomi aw thawng kha ka theih. Annih cu bawiṭhutdan le saram nung pali hna le upa hna velchum ah khan an dir i","ref":"Dan 7.10"},"12":{"text":"fak piin hla an sa i, “An thahmi Tuufa kha, Lianhngannak le rumnak le fimnak le ṭhawnnak le upatnak le sunparnak le thangṭhatnak hmuh awkah aa tlak,” an ti."},"13":{"text":"Cun vancung i a ummi le vawlei cung i a ummi le vawlei toi i a ummi le rili chung i a ummi thilnung vialte nih, “Bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi le Tuufa cu, thangṭhatnak, upatnak, sunparnak le ṭhawnnak kha, An cungah zungzal in zungzal tiang um ko seh,” tiin hla an sak kha ka theih."},"14":{"text":"Saram nung pali hna nih khan, “Amen,” tiin an rak leh hna i upa hna cu an kun i an biak."}}},"6":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cakhenh pasarih chung i pakhatnak a phoih kha ka hmuh. Cun saram nung pali hna lak i pakhat nih khan khuari thawng bantuk a simi aw in, “Ra,” a ti kha ka theih.","title":"Cakhenh"},"2":{"text":"Ka hun zoh i rang rang pakhat ka hmuh. A cung i aa citmi nih cun likuk pakhat aa put i amah cu bawiluchin pakhat an pek. Teitu nih tei awkah aa thawh bantukin aa thawh.","ref":"Zek 1.8; 6.3,6"},"3":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cun cakhenh pahnihnak kha a phoih i saram nung pahnihnak nih, “Ra,” a ti kha ka theih."},"4":{"text":"Rang dang pakhat a hung chuak i rang sen a si. A cung i aa citmi cu, vawlei cung i ral thawhternak ṭhawnnak kha an pek, cucu zeicahdah a si tiah, mi kha pakhat le pakhat i that hna seh, ti caah a si; amah cu vainam nganpi an pek.","ref":"Zek 1.8; 6.2"},"5":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cun cakhenh pathumnak kha a phoih; cun saram nung pathumnak nih, “Ra,” a ti kha ka theih. Ka hun zoh i rang nak pakhat ka hmuh. A cung i aa citmi nih cun cuaithlainak pakhat aa put.","ref":"Zek 6.2,6"},"6":{"text":"Saram nung pali hna lakin a chuakmi aw a lomi aw pakhat ka theih i cu aw nih cun, “Ni khat ni hlawh caah changvut cu khiat khat, barli cu khiat thum. Sihmanhsehlaw oliv chiti le mitsur hang cu hrawk hna hlah,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cun cakhenh palinak kha a phoih i saram nung palinak nih, “Ra,” a ti kha ka theih."},"8":{"text":"Ka hun zoh i rangrau diapduap pakhat ka hmuh. A cung i aa citmi cu a min ah Thihnak a si i Hell nih a hnulei in a zulh. Vawlei cung cheu li cheu khat uknak nawl kha pek an si i ral in siseh, mangṭam in siseh, rai in siseh, sahrang in siseh, mi thah khawhnak nawl kha pek an si.","ref":"Eze 14.21"},"9":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cun cakhenh panga-nak kha a phoih. Pathian bia an chim ruangah le Pathian tehte an sinak ah zumhawktlak in an um ruangah an thahmi hna thlarau kha biakṭheng toiah cun ka hmuh hna."},"10":{"text":"Fak piin an au i, “A lianngan bik Pathian, a thiang i a taktak a simi Pathian, vawleicung mi, a kan thattu hna hi zei can dah kan phuhlam loin na um hna lai i an biaceih loin na um hna lai,” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Annih cu puan rang pakhat cio an pek hna i, “Tlawm tein i din ko rih u. Nanmah bantukin thihnak a ing ve ding nan salhawi le nan unau hna an tling rih lo,” tiah an ti hna."},"12":{"text":"Cun Tuufa nih cakhenh paruknak a phoih kha ka hmuh. A fak ngaimi lihnin a um i ni cu puanchia nak bantukin a nak i thlapa cu thisen bantukin a sen dih.","ref":"Biat 11.13; 16.18; Isa 13.10; Joe 2.10,31; 3.15; Mat 24.29; Mar 13.24-25; Luk 21.25"},"13":{"text":"Cun thli fak nih a kung a hninh tik i theipi kuh a ṭilmi bantuk khin arfi cu vancung in vawlei ah an rung tla.","ref":"Isa 34.4"},"14":{"text":"Cazual an zual bantuk khin van cu a lo i tlang le tikulh vialte cu an umnak hmun in an ṭhial dih hna.","ref":"Biat 16.20"},"15":{"text":"Cun vawlei cung siangpahrang hna le uktu hna le ralbawi hna le mirum hna le miṭhawng hna le midang vialte cu sal he a luatmi he, tlang cung lungkua le lungpi toiah an i thup dih.","ref":"Isa 2.19,21"},"16":{"text":"Tlang le lungpi cu an auh hna i, “Kan nenh u law bawiṭhutdan cungah a ṭhumi hmai le Tuufa thinhunnak cun kan phen tuah u!","ref":"Hos 10.8; Luk 23.30"},"17":{"text":"An thinlinh ni ni lianngan cu an phan cang i aho nih dah a celh lai,” a ti.","ref":"Joe 2.11; Mal 3.2"}}},"7":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun vancungmi pali vawlei kil li cung i an dir kha ka hmuh i vawlei cung thlitu pali hna kha, vawlei cungah siseh, rili cungah siseh, thingkung cungah siseh, an hrannak hnga lo an thlauh hna.","title":"Israel Mi Thong Za Khat Thong Sawm Li le Thong Li","ref":"Jer 49.36; Dan 7.2; Zek 6.5"},"2":{"text":"Cun nichuahlei in vancungmi a dang pakhat a nungmi Pathian cakhenhnak he a rat kha ka hmuh. Pathian nih vawlei le rili hrawh khawhnak nawl a pekmi vancungmi pali kha aw fak piin a auh hna."},"3":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun, “Kan Pathian sal hna kha an cal ah hmelchunhnak kan khenh hna hlan cu vawlei le rili le thingkung kha hrawk hna hlah u,” tiah a ti.","ref":"Eze 9.4,6"},"4":{"text":"Cun an cal ah Pathian cakhenhnak in hmelchunhnak an khenhmi hna cu thong za khat le thong sawm li le thong li an si, Israel phun dihlak chungin an si, tiah an ka chimh."},"5":{"text":"Judah phun in thong hleihnih, Reuben phun in thong hleihnih, Gad phun in thong hleihnih,"},"6":{"text":"Asher phun in thong hleihnih, Naftali phun in thong hleihnih, Manasseh phun in thong hleihnih,"},"7":{"text":"Simeon phun in thong hleihnih, Levi phun in thong hleihnih, Issakhar phun in thong hleihnih,"},"8":{"text":"Zebulun phun in thong hleihnih, Josef phun in thong hleihnih, Benjamin phun in thong hleihnih an si."},"9":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun khua ka hun zoh i mibu nganpi, ahohmanh nih a rel in an rel cawk lomi khi ka hmuh. Annih cu phun kip, ram kip, holh kip le hrin kip chungin a rami an si i bawiṭhutdan hmai le Tuufa hmaiah cun an dir i puan rang an i aih i tum hnah kha an i put.","title":"Mibu Nganpi"},"10":{"text":"Fak piin an au i, “Kan khamhnak cu bawiṭhutdan cungah a ṭhumi Pathian le Tuufa sinin a rami a si,” an ti."},"11":{"text":"Vancungmi vialte cu bawiṭhutdan le upa hna le saram nung pali hna vel chum ah khan an dir. Cun bawiṭhutdan hmaiah cun an kun i Pathian kha an biak i"},"12":{"text":"“Amen! Thangṭhatnak le sunparnak le fimnak le lunglawmhnak le upatnak le ṭhawnnak le thil ti khawhnak cu zungzal in zungzal tiang kan Pathian ta a si! Amen!” an ti."},"13":{"text":"Upa pakhat nih khan a ka hal i, “Puan rang aa aihmi hna hi ahodah an si i khuazei in a rami dah an si?” tiah a ka ti."},"14":{"text":"“Ka hngal lo, bawipa, Nangmah nih ta na hngalh deuh lai,” tiah ka leh. Cun a ka thawh i, “Hi mi hna hi hremnak nganpi a ingmi kha an si; Tuufa thi chungah an puan kha an suk i an puan cu an vaar cang.","ref":"Dan 12.1; Mat 24.21; Mar 13.19"},"15":{"text":"Cucaah cun Pathian bawiṭhutdan hmaiah an dir i chunzan in biakinn chungah a rian kha an ṭuan. Bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi nih khan a umpi hna i a ven hna."},"16":{"text":"Annih cu an ti a hal in an rawl a ṭam ti lai lo; ni nih a linh ti hna lai lo i thlanhri puak in zeihmanh nih a umter ti hna lai lo.","ref":"Isa 49.10"},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah bawiṭhutdan laifang i a ummi Tuufa kha an tuukhal a si lai i nunnak tiput cerhkam ah a kalpi hna lai. Cun Pathian nih an mitthli vialte kha a hnawhpiak dih hna lai,” a ti.","ref":"Slm 23.1; Eze 34.23; Slm 23.2; Isa 49.10; 25.8"}}},"8":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tuufa nih cakhenh pasarihnak kha a phoih i vancung cu suimilam a cheu chung dai ṭhup in a um.","title":"Cakhenh Pasarihnak"},"2":{"text":"Cun Pathian hmaiah a dirmi vancungmi pasarih kha ka hmuh hna i muko pasarih an pek hna."},"3":{"text":"A dang vancungmi pakhat, zihmui khanghnak umte pakhat aa putmi kha a ra i biakṭheng pawngah cun a ra dir. Pathian mi hna an thlacamnak i toih awkah le bawiṭhutdan hmai i a ummi sui biakṭheng cung i khangh awkah zihmui tampi an pek.","ref":"Amo 9.1; Exo 30.1,3"},"4":{"text":"Pathian hmai i a dirmi vancungmi kut cun zihmui khu cu Pathian mi hna thlacamnak he khan an kai ṭi."},"5":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih khan zihmui um cu aa lak i biakṭheng cung i a ummi mei kha a chungah cun a rawn i vawlei cungah a hlonh. Khua a ri; ṭek a tla, nimtlau a lek i li aa hnin.","ref":"Lev 16.12; Eze 10.2; Exo 19.16; Biat 11.19; 16.18"},"6":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pasarih hna nih khan an muko pasarih cu tum awkah an i tim.","title":"Muko Tumnak"},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi pakhatnak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum, rial le mei, thisen he aa cawhmi a sur in vawlei cungah an sur. Vawlei cheu thum cheu khat kha a kang dih, thingkung cheu thum cheu khat kha an kang i ram hring vialte kha an kang dih.","ref":"Exo 9.23-25; Eze 38.22"},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi pahnihnak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum, tlang nganpi a alh hluahmahmi bantuk khi rili chungah a tla. Rili cheu thum cheu khat kha thisen ah a cang i"},"9":{"text":"rili chung i a ummi thilnung cheu thum cheu khat kha an thi, cun sangphawlawng cheu thum cheu khat kha an rawk."},"10":{"text":"Vancungmi pathumnak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum, meifar alh bantuk a simi arfi nganpi pakhat cu van in, tiva cheu thum cheu khat le cerh cheu thum cheu khat cungah, a rung tla.","ref":"Isa 14.12"},"11":{"text":"(Cu arfi cu a min ah ‘A kha’ ti a si). Ti cu cheu thum cheu khat a kha i, ti cu a khaat caah cu ti a dingmi cu mi tampi an thi.","ref":"Jer 9.15"},"12":{"text":"Cun vancungmi palinak nih a muko cu a vun tum, nika cu cheu thum ah cheu khat a beuh i thlapa zong cheu thum ah cheu khat a beuh ve, arfi zong cheu thum ah cheu khat an lo fawn. Cucaah cun an ceunak cu cheu thum ah cheu khat a zor i chun ah ṭhen thum ṭhen khat chung a mui i zan zongah ṭhen thum ṭhen khat chung ceunak a um lo.","ref":"Isa 13.10; Eze 32.7; Joe 2.10,31; 3.15"},"13":{"text":"Cun khua ka hun zoh i vanlai ah sang piin a zuangmi mupi pakhat nih aw fakpi i, “Ṭih a va nung thiam dah! Ṭih a va nung thiam dah! A dang vanmi pathum hna nih an muko an tum ve tikah vawlei mi vialte hna caah zeitluk riamruam in dik ṭih a nun lai!” a ti."}}},"9":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun vancungmi panganak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum, van in vawlei ah arfi pakhat a tlami ka hmuh; dongh hngal lo khor tawh kha amah cu an pek."},"2":{"text":"Dongh hngal lo khor cu arfi nih cun a vun hun i somei nganpi chung i meikhu a chuakmi bantuk meikhu kha a hung chuak hluahmah; cu dongh hngal lo khor in a chuakmi meikhu nih cun ni ceunak le thli kha a muihter dih hna.","ref":"Gen 19.28"},"3":{"text":"Meikhu chung cun khaubawk an chuak i vawlei cungah an rung ṭum; tlangngaikuang ṭhawnnak bantuk kha khaubawk cu an pek hna.","ref":"Exo 10.12-15"},"4":{"text":"Ram hring siseh, thingkung siseh, ramkung siseh, hrawk hna hlah u, tiah an ti hna; an cal ah Pathian hmelchunhnak a ngei lomi lawnglawng kha nan hrawh khawh hna, ti an si.","ref":"Eze 9.4"},"5":{"text":"Hi mi hna thah cu khaubawk kha onh an si lo, a hrem lawng thla nga chung nan hrem hna lai, ti an si. Cu an hrem hnanak fahning cu tlangngaikuang mi henh bantuk khi a si lai."},"6":{"text":"Cu thla nga chung cu kha mi hna nih khan thih an i duh deuh lai, sihmanhsehlaw an thi kho ṭung lai lo; thih kha an i kawh lai, sihmanhsehlaw thihnak nih a zamtak ṭung hna lai.","ref":"Job 3.21; Jer 8.3"},"7":{"text":"Khaubawk cu ral tuknak rangtum he an i lo; an lu ah suiluchin bantuk an i chinh i an hmai cu minung hmai bantuk a si.","ref":"Joe 2.4"},"8":{"text":"An sam cu nu sam bantuk a si i an ha cu chiandeih ha bantuk a si.","ref":"Joe 1.6"},"9":{"text":"An ṭang ah thir angki bantuk an i aih i an thla khawn thawng cu, raltuknak hmun ah a le cutmatmi rangleng tampi thawng bantuk a si.","ref":"Joe 2.5"},"10":{"text":"Tlangngaikuang bantukin mei le mi henhnak zum an ngei i an mei cun minung cu thla nga chung fahnak an pek khawh hna."},"11":{"text":"An uktu ah siangpahrang pakhat an ngei i dongh hngal lo khor a uktu vancungmi kha a si. A min cu Hebru holh in Abaddon ti a si; Grik holh cun Apollyon ti a si i a sullam cu “Hrawktu” tinak a si."},"12":{"text":"Thil ṭihnung hmasa bik cu a dih; hi hnuah hin a dang pahnih a ra ding an um rih."},"13":{"text":"Cun vancungmi paruknak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum, Pathian hmai i a dirmi sui biakṭheng kap khan aw pakhat ka theih.","ref":"Exo 30.1-3"},"14":{"text":"Muko aa putmi vancungmi paruknak kha aw nih cun a thawh i, “Tiva nganpi Zufrates ah hrenmi vancungmi pali kha thlah hna,” tiah a ti."},"15":{"text":"Vancungmi pali cu a thlah hna, annih cu hi suimilam thengte le hi ni thengte le hi thla thengte le hi kum thengte i minung vialte cheu thum cheu khat a thattu ding i rak timhlamhmi kha an si."},"16":{"text":"An rangcung ralkap hna cu nuai za hnih an si tiah an ka chimh."},"17":{"text":"Cun langhnak ka hmuhmi ah cun rangtum hna le an cung i aa citmi cu ka hmuh hna: an ṭangphaw cu mei bantukin a sen, safaiar lungvar bantukin a dum i kat bantukin a eng. Rangtum cu an lu chiandeih lu bantuk an si i an kaa chungin mei le meikhu le kat kha an chuak."},"18":{"text":"Rangtum hna kaa chungin a chuakmi hremnak pathum, mei le meikhu le kat nih cun, minung cheu thum cheu khat an thah hna."},"19":{"text":"Rangtum cu an ṭhawnnak kha an kaa le an mei ah a um. An mei cu lu an ngei i rul bantuk an si, an mei cun mi kha an hrem hna."},"20":{"text":"Hi hremnak pathum nih a thah lomi, a taangmi minung hna nih khan, anmah nih an ser chommi thil kha an mertak hlei hna lo. Khuachia biak kha an ngol lo i sui le ngun le dar le lung le thing in sermi siasal, khua zong a hmu kho lomi, a theih zong a thei kho lomi, a kal zong a kal kho lo mi biak kha an ngol hlei fawn lo.","ref":"Slm 115.4-7; 135.15-17; Dan 5.23"},"21":{"text":"Cun an lainawn le an pumsa camh le an pumsa sualnak le an fir zong kha an i ngaihchih hlei fawn lo."}}},"10":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun vancung in a ṭhawngmi vanmi a dang pakhat a rung ṭum kha ka hmuh. Khuadawm in aa thuam i a lu ah chuncha aa khimh; a hmai cu nika bantuk a si i a ke cu mei tung pipi bantuk an si.","title":"Vancungmi le Cazual Hna"},"2":{"text":"A kut in aa samhmi cazual hmete pakhat aa put. A orhlei ke in rili kha a lamh i a kehlei ke in vawlei kha a lamh,"},"3":{"text":"cun a au ciammam i a aw cu chiandeih run aw bantuk a si. Cu ti a au dih cun, khuari pasarih nih an hun leh."},"4":{"text":"Bia an chim dih cangka cun ṭial kaa tim i sihmanhsehlaw vancung in aw pakhat nih, “Khuari pasarih nih an chimmi kha biathli ah chia, ṭial rih hlah,” tiah a run ka ti kha ka theih."},"5":{"text":"Cun rili cung le vawlei cungah a dirmi vancungmi ka hmuhmi nih khan van leiah a orhlei kut a hler i","ref":"Exo 20.11; Deu 32.40; Dan 12.7; Amo 3.7"},"6":{"text":"zungzal in zungzal tiang a nungmi Pathian, van le a chung i a ummi thil vialte a sertu, vawlei le a chung i a ummi thil vialte a sertu, rili le a chung i a ummi thil vialte a sertu min khan biakamnak a ser. Vancungmi nih cun aa thawh i, “A rau ti lai lo."},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi pasarihnak nih a muko a tum tikah Pathian nih, a sal profet hna sinah a rak chim bang khan, a rak timh thlimi kha a tlinter lai,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Cun vancung in aw ka theihmi nih khan a run ka chawnh ṭhan i, “Rili cung le vawlei cungah a dirmi vancungmi nih aa putmi cazual aa samhmi kha va la tuah,” a ti.","ref":"Eze 2.8—3.3"},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi sinah cun ka va kal i cazual hmete cu ka pe, tiah ka va ti. A ka thawh i, “I lak law ei tuah; na pawpi chungah cun a kha lai, sihmanhsehlaw na ka chungah cun khuaihliti bantukin a thlum lai,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"A kut i cazual hmete cu ka lak i ka ei, ka ka chungah cun khuaihliti bantukin a thlum. Sihmanhsehlaw ka vun dolh tikah ka paw chungah cun a kha."},"11":{"text":"Cun, “Pathian nih miphun dangdang hna le ram dangdang hna le holh phun dangdang hna le siangpahrang tampi hna kong i a chimmi bia kha na chim ṭhan awk a herh lai,” an ka ti."}}},"11":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Tahnak fung caah phaikung pakhat an ka pek i, “Hung kal law Pathian biakinn le biakṭheng kha hung tah hna, cun biakinn chung i Pathian a biami kha hung rel hna.","title":"Tehte Pahnih","ref":"Eze 40.3; Zek 2.1-2"},"2":{"text":"Asinain biakinn lenglei tual kha cu va ngaan rih hna. Va tah rih hna hlah, zeicahtiah kha tual kha cu Pathian a bia lomi, thla sawm li le thla hnih chung, Khua Thiang a naang ding hna ca i chiahmi an si.","ref":"Luk 21.24"},"3":{"text":"Ka tehte pahnih kha ka thlah hna lai, annih cu buri an i aih lai i ni thong khat le za hnih le sawm ruk chung Pathian bia kha an chim lai."},"4":{"text":"Cu tehte pahnih hna cu oliv kung pahnih hna le mei-inn pahnih hna, vawlei Bawipa hmai i a dirmi kha an si.","ref":"Zek 4.3,11-14"},"5":{"text":"Harnak pek a zalmi hna paoh kha an kaa chungin a chuakmi mei in an thah hna; hi bantukin harnak pek a timtu hna paoh cu thah an si lai."},"6":{"text":"Van kharnak nawl kha an ngei i cucaah cun Pathian bia an chim chung cu ruah a sur lai lo. Cerhti put zong kha thi i canternak nawl an ngei fawn. Cun vawlei zong kha an duh tik caan paoh ah hremnak a phunphun in hremnak nawl an ngei.","ref":"1Sia 17.1; Exo 7.17-19; 1Sam 4.8"},"7":{"text":"Cun bia chim awk an ngeihmi an chim dih tikah, dongh hngal lo khor thukpi chungin a hung chuakmi sahrang nih khan a doh hna lai. A tei hna lai i a thah hna lai;","ref":"Dan 7.7,21; Biat 13.5-7; 17.8"},"8":{"text":"an ruak cu khuapi chung lamkalai ah khan an ril lai, cu khua cu an Bawipa vailam i an khenh chihnak khua kha a si. Cu khua cu a min ah minhleng in Sodom, ti asiloah, Izipt ti a si.","ref":"Isa 1.9-10"},"9":{"text":"Phun kip, ram kip, le holh kip chungin a rami hna nih khan an ruak cu ni thum le a cheu chung an zoh hna lai i vui kha onh an si lai lo."},"10":{"text":"Hi profet pahnih hna nih hin vawleicung mi kha temhnak tampi an pek hna caah, hi hna pahnih an thihnak ah hin vawlei cung mi cu an i lawm lai i an thihnak cu an tuk an aih lai i pakhat le pakhat laksawng an i ṭhen lai."},"11":{"text":"Ni thum le a cheu hnuah Pathian sinin nunnak petu thaw kha a ra i an chungah a lut i annih cu an dir; a hmumi vialte hna cu an thlakawk a bar hna.","ref":"Eze 37.10"},"12":{"text":"Cun cu profet pahnih hna nih cun, vancung in, “Hika ah hin hung kai u,” tiah aw thang piin a run titu hna aw kha an theih. An ral nih an zoh ko hna lioah cun, vancung ah khuadawm in an kai.","ref":"2Sia 2.11"},"13":{"text":"Cu caan te ah cun lihnin fak ngaingai pakhat a um; khuapi cu cheu hra cheukhat a rawk i minung thong sarih lihnin nih cun a thah hna. A tangmi pawl cu an thin a phang i vancung Pathian a lianhngannak kha an thangṭhat.","ref":"Biat 6.12; 16.18"},"14":{"text":"Thil ṭihnung pahnihnak cu a dih cang; sihmanhsehlaw zohhmanh, thil ṭihnung pathumnak a ra zau lai."},"15":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pasarihnak nih khan a muko cu a vun tum i aw thawng fakpi vancung ah cun a thang i, “Vawlei cung uknak nawl cu kan Bawipa le a Messiah ta a si cang,” an ti.","title":"Muko Pasarihnak","ref":"Exo 15.18; Dan 2.44; 7.14,27"},"16":{"text":"Cun Pathian hmaiah bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi upa kul le pali hna kha an kun i Pathian cu an biak."},"17":{"text":"“A Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian, Nang cu atu i a ummi le hlan i a rak ummi na si. A liannganmi na ṭhawnnak kha na hman cang i Uknak hram naa thawk cang caah, Na cungah kan i lawm."},"18":{"text":"Atu caan hi na thinhunnak a rat caan le Mithi hna biaceih caan a si caah, Pathian bia lomi cu an thin a hung ngaingai. Cun atu caan hi na sal na profet hna le na mi vialte hna le nangmah an ṭihtu vialte hna kha, A hme a ngan thlu loin laksawng pek caan a si fawn. Cun vawlei a hrawktu hna hrawh caan kha a si,” an ti.","ref":"Slm 2.5; 110.5; 115.13"},"19":{"text":"Vancung i a ummi Pathian biakinn cu a hun i a chung i biakamnak an chiahnak kuang kha a lang. Cun nimtlau a lek, ṭek a tla, khua a ri, li aa hnin i fak piin rial a tla.","ref":"Biat 8.5; 16.18,21"}}},"12":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun van ah khin khuaruahhar a simi hmelchunhnak nganpi pakhat a lang. Minu pakhat a lang i a thuam ah nika a si; thlapa kha a ke in aa lamh i a lu ah arfi hleihnih bawiluchin aa chinh.","title":"Nu le Limkeng"},"2":{"text":"Nau a hring dengmang i nau nganfah in a ai."},"3":{"text":"Cun van ah cun khuaruahhar a simi hmelchunhnak a dang pakhat a lang ṭhan. A ngan ngaingaimi limkeng senpi, lu pasarih le ki pahra a ngeimi kha a hung lang i a lu ah cun bawiluchin pakhat cio an um.","ref":"Dan 7.7"},"4":{"text":"A mei in arfi cheu thum cheu khat kha vancung cun a run kuaih ciammam hna i vawlei ah a thlak hna. Nau a hring dengmangmi nu hmaiah cun a dir i cu a dir cu a fa kha a chuah cangka in ka ei lai ti a duh caah a si.","ref":"Dan 8.10"},"5":{"text":"Cun miphun vialte thirfung in a uktu ding fapa kha minu nih cun a hrin. Sihmanhsehlaw ngakchia cu an lak zau i Pathian le a bawiṭhutdan sinah an kalpi.","ref":"Isa 66.7; Slm 2.9"},"6":{"text":"Minu cu Pathian nih a rak timhpiak cangmi hmun ah thetse ram ah khan a zam i khika ah ni thong khat le ni za hnih le ni sawm ruk an rak zohkhenh."},"7":{"text":"Cun van ah khin raldohnak a um. Mikhael le a vancungmi hna nih khan limkeng cu an doh i limkeng nih cun a vancungmi hna he a rak doh ve hna.","ref":"Dan 10.13,21; 12.1; Jud 9"},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw limkeng cu a sung i amah le a vancungmi hna cu van ah umnak nawl an ngei ti lo."},"9":{"text":"Limkeng nganpi cu lengah an hlonh. Cu limkeng cu rulpi tar, Khuachia, asiloah, Satan timi, vawleicung mi vialte a hleng dihtu hna kha a si. Amah cu a vancungmi vialte hna he vawlei ah an thlak hna.","ref":"Gen 3.1; Luk 10.18"},"10":{"text":"Cun vancung ah cun aw thangpi pakhat ka theih i, “Atu cu Pathian khamhnak a phan cang! Atu cu Pathian nih a ṭhawnnak kha siangpahrang bantukin a langhter cang. Atu cu a Messiah nih khan a nawlngeihnak kha a langhter cang. Kannih kan unau hna sual a puhtu, Pathian hmaiah dir riangmang in chunzan in sual a puh zungzaltu hna kha, vancung in lengah hlonh a si cang.","ref":"Job 1.9-11; Zek 3.1"},"11":{"text":"Kan unau hna nih amah cu Tuufa thi thawngin le an chimmi bia biatak a simi thawngin an tei cang; an nunnak pek kha an rak sian i thih zong an rak ngamh."},"12":{"text":"Cucaah cun nannih van hna le khika i a ummi vialte hna, i lawm tuah u. Sihmanhsehlaw vawlei le rili caah cun ṭihnung a va si hringhran dah! Zeicahtiah Khuachia cu nan sinah a rung ṭum cang i cu pinah caan tawite lawnglawng ka ngei ti kha a hngalh fawn caah a thin a linh in a lin ko,” tiah a ti."},"13":{"text":"Limkeng nih vawlei cungah thlak ka si cang ti kha a hngalh tikah, fapa a hringtu nu kha a dawi colh."},"14":{"text":"Thetse ram chung i aa thuhnak ding hmun i va zuannak ding caah khan minu cu mupi nganpi thla pahnih an pek i cuka hmun ah cun kum thum le a cheu an rak zohkhenh lai caah rulpi nih khan zeihmanh a ti kho lai lo.","ref":"Dan 7.25; 12.7"},"15":{"text":"Cun minu cu fenh seh tiah limkeng nih khan a kaa chungin tilian a chuahter."},"16":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw vawlei nih minu cu a rak bawmh; a kaa kha a an i limkeng kaa chungin a chuakmi tilian kha a rak dolh."},"17":{"text":"Limkeng cu minu cungah khan a thin a hung ngaingai i minu tefa a tang rihmi vialte hna doh awkah khan aa thawh; cu hna cu Pathian nawlbia a ngai i Jesuh nih a phuanmi biatak, zumh awk tlak tein aa tlaihmi kha an si."},"18":{"text":"Cun limkengpi cu rilikam ah khan a dir."}}},"13":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun sahrang pakhat rili chungin a hung chuah kha ka hmuh. Ki pahra le lu pasarih a ngei, a ki cungah cun bawiluchin pakhat cio an um i a lu cungah cun Pathian thangchiatnak min pakhat cio an i ṭial.","title":"Sahrang Pahnih","ref":"Dan 7.3; Biat 17.3,7-12"},"2":{"text":"Ka hmuhmi sahrang cu a mui ah pawlai a lo, a ke cu vom ke bantuk a si i a kaa cu chiandeih kaa bantuk a si. Limkeng nih khan sahrang cu, a ṭhawnnak le a bawi ṭhutdan le a nawlngeihnak a kau ngaingaimi kha a pek.","ref":"Dan 7.4-6"},"3":{"text":"Sahrang lu pakhat cu, voi khat cu rak that cang hna seh law a lo, sihmanhsehlaw cu thihpi awk tlak a hma cu a dam cang. Vawleicung mi vialte cu an khuaruah a har i sahrang cu an zulh."},"4":{"text":"Limkeng nih khan a nawlngeihnak cu sahrang kha a pek caah mi vialte nih limkeng cu an biak. Sahrang zong cu an biak i, “Sahrang bantuk hi ahodah a um hnga? Aho nih dah an doh khawh lai?” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Sahrang cu a ṭhalo tuk hringhranmi thil kha chim onh a si i thla sawm li le thla hnih chung nawlngeihnak ngeih onh a si.","ref":"Dan 7.8,25; 11.36"},"6":{"text":"Pathian le Pathian min le Pathian a umnak hmun vancung khua i a ummi vialte kha a vawlh a pamh hna."},"7":{"text":"Pathian mi kha doh awk le tei awkah onh a si i phun kip ram kip holh kip le mi kip cungah nawlngeihnak nawl pek a si.","ref":"Dan 7.21"},"8":{"text":"Vawlei cung i a ummi vialte hna nih amah cu an biak lai, sihmanhsehlaw vawlei ser hlan in nunnak cauk chung i an min ṭial a simi hna nih cun an bia lai lo, cu nunnak cauk cu thahmi Tuufa ta kha a si.","ref":"Slm 69.28"},"9":{"text":"“Cucaah cun theihnak hna nan ngeih ahcun thei ko u!"},"10":{"text":"Tlaih awk a simi cu tlaih a si hrimhrim ko lai; vainam in thah awk a simi cu vainam in thah a si hrimhrim ko lai. Hi ah hin Pathian mi hna nih in khawhnak an ngeih le zumhawktlak an si kha an langhter awk a hau,” a ti.","ref":"Jer 15.2; 43.11"},"11":{"text":"Cun sahrang a dang pakhat vawlei chungin a hung chuah kha ka hmuh. Tuufa ki bantuk ki pahnih a ngei i limkeng bantukin bia a chim."},"12":{"text":"Sahrang pakhatnak nih a ngeihmi nawlngeihnak kaupi kha amah hmai hrimhrim ah cun a hman. Thihpi awk tlak a simi hma a ing i a dam ṭhanmi sahrang pakhatnak kha, nan biak hrimhrim lai tiah vawlei le a cung i a ummi vialte cu a hnek hna."},"13":{"text":"Sahrang pahnihnak nih cun khuaruahhar ngan pipi kha a tuah hna; mi vialte mit hmuh ah vancung in mei kha vawlei ah a tlakter."},"14":{"text":"Cun vawleicung i khua a sami vialte cu, khuaruahharnak a tuahmi khan a hlen hna; cu khuaruahharnak hna cu sahrang pakhatnak hmaika i tuahnak nawl pek a simi khuaruahharnak kha an si. Vainam in thahhrulhmi a si nain a nungmi sahrang upatnak caah khan milem pakhat nan ser lai, tiah vawlei cung mi vialte kha sahrang nih cun a ti hna."},"15":{"text":"Sahrang pakhatnak milem chungah khan sahrang pahnihnak cu nunnak thaw khumhnak nawl pek a si i cucaah milem cu a holh kho i amah a bia lomi cu a thah hna."},"16":{"text":"Sahrang nih cun mi vialte, a hme si hna seh, a ngan si hna seh, a rum si hna seh, sifak si hna seh, sal si hna seh, a luatmi si hna seh, an dihlak in an orhlei kut asiloah an cal ah hmelchunhnak hramhram in a ngeihter hna."},"17":{"text":"Cu hmelchunhnak an ngeih lo ahcun ahohmanh nih thil kha a cawk zong an caw kho lo i a zuar zong an zuar kho lo, cu hmelchunhnak cu sahrang min, asiloah, sahrang min ca i hmanmi nambar kha a si."},"18":{"text":"Hika ah hin fimnak hman a hau. A fimmi paoh nih cun sahrang nambar cu an tuak khawh ko lai, zeicahtiah cu nambar cu mi pakhat min ca i hmanmi a si. Cu min nambar cu za ruk sawm ruk paruk a si."}}},"14":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khua ka hun zoh i Zion Tlang i Tuufa a dir ko kha ka hmuh; a sinah cun mi sing khat sang li le thong li an um i cu hna cu an cal i amah min le a Pa min khenhmi kha an si.","title":"Tlanhmi Hna Hla An Sa","ref":"Eze 9.4; Biat 7.3"},"2":{"text":"Cun tisor nganpi thawng bantuk le khuari thawng bantuk a simi aw pakhat kha vancung in ka theih. Cu ka theihmi aw cu tingtang tum thiammi nih tingtang in aw dawh an tummi bantuk a si."},"3":{"text":"Sing khat sang li le thong li hna cu bawiṭhutdan le saram nung pali hna le upa hna lei hoih khan an dir. Vawlei cungin tlanh a simi hna lawng nih an thiam khawhmi hla thar kha an sa."},"4":{"text":"Annih cu nu he um ṭi loin thiang tein a ummi an si; nu le pa sinak a hngal lomi an si. Tuufa kha a kalnak kip ah an zulh. A tang rihmi minung hna lakin tlanhmi an si i Pathian sin le Tuufa sinah pekchanh hmasa bikmi an si."},"5":{"text":"Lih an chim bal lo, palhnak zeihmanh an tuah lo.","ref":"Zef 3.13"},"6":{"text":"Vawlei cung mi vialte, phun kip, ram kip, holh kip le mi kip sin i thanh awk a simi, zungzal Thawngṭha aa phorh i vanlai i a zuangmi vancungmi pakhat kha ka hmuh.","title":"Vancungmi Pathum"},"7":{"text":"Aw thang piin, “Pathian kha ṭih u law a lianhngannak kha thangṭhat u. Zeicahtiah amah nih minung vialte bia a ceih hna lai caan kha a phan cang. Van le vawlei le rili le tiput a sertu kha bia u,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Vancungmi pahnihnak nih pakhatnak kha a hun zulh i, “Minu cu a ril cang! Babilon khuapi cu a ril cang. A zu cu mi vialte kha a pek hna i a dinter hna — cu a zu cu a hornak zu ṭhawng kha a si,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 21.9; Jer 51.8; Biat 18.2"},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi pathumnak nih hmasa pahnih hna kha a hun zulh hna i aw fak piin, “Sahrang le a milem a bia i a hmelchunhnak kha a cal ah siseh a kut ah siseh a ngeimi paoh nih cun,"},"10":{"text":"Pathian zu, a thinhunnak zu, a thinhunnak hrai chung i ti cawh hrimhrim loin thletmi kha an din lai. Cu a dingmi vialte cu vancungmi mithiang hna le Tuufa hmaiah, mei chung le kat chungah, hrem an si lai.","ref":"Isa 51.17; Gen 19.24; Eze 38.22"},"11":{"text":"A hremtu hna mei a khu cu zungzal in a kai zungzal ko. Sahrang le a milem a biami le sahrang hmelchunhnak a ngeimi hna caah cun, chun zongah zan zongah lungdaih hnangamnak zeihmanh a um ti lo.","ref":"Isa 34.10"},"12":{"text":"Pathian mi hna, Pathian nawl a ngai i Jesuh cungah zumh awk tlak in khua a sami hna nih cun, hi zawn ah hin in khawhnak an ngeih awk a hau."},"13":{"text":"Cun vancung in aw pakhat ka theih i, “Hihi ṭial tuah: Khrih zumh bu tein a thimi cu lunglawmmi an si,” a ti. Cun Thlarau nih, “A si hrimhrim lai. An rianṭuanmi nih khan a zulh hna lai i rian an ṭuannak cun an i din cang lai,” tiah a leh."},"14":{"text":"Cun khua ka hun zoh i khuadawm rang pakhat ka hmuh, cu cungah cun minung he aa lomi kha a ṭhu, a lu ah sui bawiluchin aa chinh i a kut in a harmi faah pakhat aa put.","title":"Vawlei Cung Rawlṭuan","ref":"Dan 7.13"},"15":{"text":"Biakinn khan a dang vancungmi pakhat a chuak i khuadawm cung i a ṭhumi cu fak piin a auh i, “A caan a cut cang caah na faah kha hmang law facang kha at tuah; vawlei cung rawl cu ṭuan a cu cang,” a ti.","ref":"Joe 3.13"},"16":{"text":"Cun khuadawm cung i a ṭhumi nih khan vawlei ah a faah cu a vun hei i rawl cu a ṭuan."},"17":{"text":"Cun vancung biakinn chung khan vancungmi a dang pakhat a chuah kha ka hmuh ṭhan i amah zong nih cun a har ngaingaimi faah aa put ve."},"18":{"text":"Cun vancungmi dang pakhat, mei uktu a simi kha biakṭheng khan a ra. A har ngaimi faah aa putmi vancungmi kha fak piin a hei auh i, “Na faah kha hmang law mitsur kha an hmin cang caah mitsur lo i a ummi mitsur kha ṭuan hna,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Cucaah vancungmi nih khan a faah cu vawlei ah a vun hei i mitsur ruang mitsur thei kha a ṭuan hna i Pathian thinhunnak mitsur nennak chungah khan a thlak hna."},"20":{"text":"Mitsur thei cu khuapi leng i a ummi mitsur nennak ah khan an nen hna i mitsur nennak chung cun thisen a chuak i khan za hnih a luang i pe nga tluk a thuk.","ref":"Isa 63.3; Ṭah 1.15; Biat 19.15"}}},"15":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun van ah khin khuaruahhar le lianngan ngai a simi hmelchunhnak a dang pakhat ka hmuh ṭhan. Vancungmi pasarih, hremnak pasarih aa putmi kha ka hmuh hna i cu hremnak cu a hmanung bik an si cang, zeicahtiah Pathian thinhun phuannak a donghnak an si.","title":"Vancungmi le Hremnak Hmanung Bik Hna"},"2":{"text":"Khua ka hei zoh i mei he cawhmi thlalang rili he, aa lomi kha ka hmuh. Cun a min, nambar in chimmi sahrang le a milem a teitu hna kha ka hmuh hna. Annih cu thlalang rilikam ah khan an dir i Pathian nih a pekmi hna tingtang kha an i put."},"3":{"text":"Annih cu Pathian sal Moses hla kha le Tuufa hla kha an sa i, “Bawipa, a lianngan bik Pathian, Zeitluk in dah na thil tuahmi hi an lianhngan i khuaruahhar an si. Miphun vialte Siangpahrang, Na lam cu zeitluk in dah a dikmi le a hmaanmi a si!","ref":"Exo 15.1"},"4":{"text":"Bawipa, ahodah nangmah ṭih loin a um ngam lai? Na lianngannak chim duh loin ahodah a um lai? Nangmah lawng a thiangmi na si. Miphun vialte nih na hmaiah an ra lai i an in biak lai, Thil ding na tuahmi kha mi vialte nih hmuh a si caah,” an ti.","ref":"Jer 10.7; Slm 86.9"},"5":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun vancung i biakinn aa hun kha ka hmuh i a chungah cun Biakamnak Thlam kha a um.","ref":"Exo 38.21"},"6":{"text":"Hremnak pasarih aa putmi vancungmi biakinn chungin an chuah kha ka hmuh; puan rang thiang an i aih i an ṭang ah sui ṭangmenh kha an i menh."},"7":{"text":"Cun saram nung pali hna lak i pakhat nih khan vancungmi pasarih hna cu, zungzal in zungzal tiang a nungmi Pathian thinhunnak in a khatmi sui kanto pasarih kha a pek hna."},"8":{"text":"Biakinn cu Pathian sunparnak le lianhngannak meikhu in a khat i vancungmi pasarih nih hremnak pasarih an tlunpimi a dih hlantiang ahohmanh biakinn chungah cun an lut kho lo.","ref":"Exo 40.34; 1Sia 8.10-11; 2Cha 5.13-14; Isa 6.4"}}},"16":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun biakinn khan aw thangpi pakhat nih vancungmi pasarih hna cu, “Va kal u law Pathian thinhunnak kanto pasarih kha vawlei ah va thle hna u,” tiah a ti thawng kha ka theih.","title":"Pathian Thinhunnak Kanto"},"2":{"text":"Vancungmi pakhat cu a kal i a kanto cu vawlei ah khan a bungh. Sahrang hmelchunhnak a ngeimi hna le a milem a biami hna kha ṭih a nung ngaingaimi le a fak ngaingaimi hmachia nih a tlunh hna.","ref":"Exo 9.10"},"3":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pahnihnak nih a kanto cu rili ah a bungh. Ti cu mithi mi chungin a chuakmi thisen bantuk ah a cang i rili chung thilnung vialte cu an thi dih."},"4":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pathumnak nih a kanto cu tiva le tiput cungah khan a bungh i thisen ah an cang dih.","ref":"Exo 7.17-21; Slm 78.44"},"5":{"text":"Ti a uktu vancungmi nih cun, “Hi na tuahmi biaceihnak ah hin na ding ko, maw a Thiang Mi, atu i a um liomi le hlan i a rak um cangmi Pathian!"},"6":{"text":"Pathian mi hna le profet hna kha an thi an rak chuah hna caah nangmah nih annih cu din awkah thi kha na pek ve hna. Annih nih hmuh awk i an i tlakmi kha an hmuh ko,” a ti."},"7":{"text":"Cun biakṭheng khan aw pakhat a rak chuak i “Bawipa, Lian Ngan Bik Pathian, na biakhiahnak cu a dingmi le a hmaanmi an si taktak,” tiah a ti thawng kha ka theih."},"8":{"text":"Cun vancungmi palinak nih a kanto kha ni cungah a bungh i ni cu mi kha khanghnak nawl a hmu."},"9":{"text":"Ni lin nih cun mi kha a kangh hna i hi hremnak cung i nawl a ngeitu Pathian min kha an thang chiat. Asinain an sualnak kha an mertak duh lo i Pathian lianhngannak kha an thangṭhat duh lo."},"10":{"text":"Cun vancungmi panganak nih a kanto cu sahrang bawiṭhutdan cungah khan a bungh. Sahrang pennak ram cungah khan muihnak a tlung ciammam i fahnak an inmi kha a fah tuk caah an lei kha an i seh,","ref":"Exo 10.21"},"11":{"text":"cun fahnak le hmachia an in ruangah khan vancung Pathian cu an thangchiat. Asinain an lam ṭhalo kha an kaltak hlei lo."},"12":{"text":"Cun vancungmi paruknak nih a kanto cu Zufrates tivapi cungah a bungh. Tiva cu a kao i nichuahlei in a rami siangpahrang hna caah khan lam a rak awnter.","ref":"Isa 11.15"},"13":{"text":"Cun thlarau thur pathum, utlak a lomi kha ka hmuh hna; limkeng kaa chung le sahrang kaa chung le nal profet kaa chungin an hung chuak."},"14":{"text":"Annih cu khuachia thlarau, khuaruahharnak a tuah khomi kha an si. Cu thlarau pathum hna cu vawleicung khuazakip ah khan an kal i vawleicung siangpahrang vialte kha an pumh hna. Cu bantukin hmunkhat ah an pumh hna cu, Lianngan Bik Pathian ni lianngan ni ah pakhat le pakhat i do hna seh ti caah a si."},"15":{"text":"“Ngai hmanh, mifir bantukin ka ra lai. Zapi lakah taklawng in an vah nakhnga lo le ningzak in an um nakhnga lo, hngilh lo tein a rak um i a hnipuan ṭha tein a rak i fimhlawmmi cu, lunglawmmi an si,” a ti.","ref":"Mat 24.43-44; Luk 12.39-40; Biat 3.3"},"16":{"text":"Cun thlarau hna nih khan siangpahrang cu hmunkhat ah an pumh hna i cu hmun cu Hebru holh in Armageddon ti a si.","ref":"2Sia 23.29; Zek 12.11"},"17":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pasarihnak nih khan a kanto cu thlitu lakah a bungh. Biakinn chung bawiṭhutdan khan aw thangpi pakhat a ra chuak i, “A dih cang!” tiah a ti."},"18":{"text":"Nimtlau a lek, khua a ri, ṭek a tla i ṭihnung ngaingai in li aa hnin. Minung ser hramthawk in cu bantuk lihnin cu a um bal lo; lihnin vialte lakah lihnin fak bik a si.","ref":"Biat 8.5; 11.13,19"},"19":{"text":"Khualipi cu cheu thum ah a kuai i ram vialte cu an khua kha an rawk dih. Pathian nih a liannganmi Babilon kha a philh lo i a hrai chung zu kha a dinter — a thinhunnak zu kha.","ref":"Isa 51.17"},"20":{"text":"Tikulh vialte kha an lo dih i tlang vialte zong kha an lo dih.","ref":"Biat 6.14"},"21":{"text":"Rial ngan pipi, pawng za khat tiang a ritmi kha van in minung cungah an tla. Cun mi nih rial in hremnak an in ruangah cun Pathian kha an thangchiat, an inmi hremnak cu a fak hringhranmi a si ko.","ref":"Exo 9.23; Biat 11.19"}}},"17":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun vancungmi pasarih lak i pakhat, kanto aa putmi kha ka sinah a ra i, “Ra law, rilipi cungah bawinu ṭhut in a ṭhumi hlawhhlangnu milianngan nu kha, zeitindah dantat a si lai, ti kha kan hmuhsak lai.","title":"Hlawhhlangnu","ref":"Jer 51.13"},"2":{"text":"Vawlei cung siangpahrang hna nih hlawhhlangnu milianngan nu he cun sualnak an tuah i a sualnak zu an dinnak cun vawlei cung mi cu an ri dih,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 23.17; Jer 51.7"},"3":{"text":"Thlarau nih khan a ka tlaih i vancungmi nih khan thetse ram ah a ka kalpi. Cuka ah cun nu pakhat, sahrang sen cung i aa citmi kha ka hmuh i cu sahrang cu a tak khat in min ṭhalo aa ṭial; cu sahrang nih cun lu pasarih le ki pahra a ngei.","ref":"Biat 13.1"},"4":{"text":"Nu cu maimaw le puansen in aa thuam i sui hlawn le lungvar le pale lungvar in aa ṭamh. A kut in sui hrai pakhat aa put i cu sui hrai cu fihnung le ṭeifiak in a khat, cu fihnung le ṭeifiak cu a sualnak theitlai kha an si.","ref":"Jer 51.7"},"5":{"text":"A cal ah min pakhat aa ṭial i cu min cu sullam hleng a ngei. Cu min cu, “A liannganmi Babilon, vawlei cung hlawhhlangnu vialte le sual thurnak vialte nu,” ti a si."},"6":{"text":"Cun cu nu cu, Pathian mi hna thisen le Jesuh cungah zumhawktlak in an um ruangah thahmi hna thisen a rit kha ka hmuh. Amah ka hmuh tikah ka khuaruah a har tuk hringhran."},"7":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun, “Zeicahdah na khuaruah a har? Minu sullam le aa citmi sahrang, lu pasarih le ki pahra a ngeimi sullam cu kan chimh lai."},"8":{"text":"Na hmuhmi sahrang kha hlanah cun a rak nung, asinain atu cu a nung ti lo, rawhralnak a phak hlanah dongh hngal lo khor chung khan a hung chuak lai. Vawlei cung i khua a sami, vawlei ser hlan in nunnak cauk chungah an min a rak i ṭial lomi hna nih khan, sahrang cu an hmuh tikah an khuaruah a har lai, zeicahtiah voi khat cu a rak nung, atu cu a nung ti lo, asinain a hung chuak ṭhan lai.","ref":"Dan 7.7; Biat 11.7; Slm 69.28"},"9":{"text":"“Fim le hngalhthiam a hau. Lu pasarih hi tlang pasarih, nu a ṭhutnak tlang pasarih kha an si. Cun siangpahrang pasarih zong kha an si fawn."},"10":{"text":"Panga cu an ril cang, pakhat cu atu hi siangpahrang a si lio a si i a dang pakhat cu a ra rih lo; a rat tikah caan tlawmte lawng a um lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun hlan i a rak nung i atu i a nung ti lomi sahrang kha, siangpahrang pariatnak a hmasa pasarih bu chung i aa tel vemi kha a si i rawhralnak phak awkah a hung chuak."},"12":{"text":"“Ki pahra na hmuhmi kha siangpahrang pahra, uknak hram aa thawk rih lomi, sihmanhsehlaw sahrang he suimilam pakhat chung uk ṭi dingin nawl pekmi an si.","ref":"Dan 7.24"},"13":{"text":"Hi pahra hna nih hin an dihlak in tinhmi pakhat an ngei i an ṭhawnnak le an nawl ngeihnak cu sahrang kha an pek."},"14":{"text":"Annih nih Tuufa kha an doh lai; sihmanhsehlaw Tuufa le Tuufa nih a kawh hna i a thim hna i zumhawktlak zultu a simi hna nih khan an tei hna lai, zeicahtiah Tuufa cu bawi vialte Bawipa le siangpahrang vialte Siangpahrang a si,” a ti."},"15":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun a ka thawh ṭhan i, “Hlawhhlangnu a ṭhutnak rilipi na hmuhmi kha miphun hna le ram hna le holh hna le mi hna an si."},"16":{"text":"Ki pahra na hmuhmi le sahrang nih khan hlawhhlangnu kha an huat lai i a ngeihmi vialte kha an chuh dih lai i taklawng in an chiah lai; a sa kha an ei lai i amah cu mei in an khangh lai."},"17":{"text":"Zeicahtiah Pathian nih a chimmi bia kha a tlin hlantiang cu, Pathian nih aa tinhmi tuah duhnak kha an lungthin chungah a chiah i cucaah lungnge tein rian an ṭuan i uknak nawl an ngeihmi kha sahrang cu an pek."},"18":{"text":"“Nu na hmuhmi cu vawlei cung siangpahrang hna a uktu khualipi kha a si,” a ti."}}},"18":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi hnuah vancung in vanmi dang pakhat a run kha ka hmuh. Nawlngeihnak a ngan ngaingaimi a ngei i a sunparnak nih vawlei cu a ceuh dih.","title":"Babilon A Ril Cang"},"2":{"text":"Fak piin a au i, “Nu kha a ril cang! Babilon Khualipi kha a tlu cang. Khuachia le thlarau thur nih an umhnawh cang i a thurhnawmmi le fihnung a simi vate a phunphun in a khat cang.","ref":"Isa 13.21; 21.9; Jer 50.39; 51.8; Biat 14.8"},"3":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a zu kha mi vialte a pek hna i a dinter hna — a hornak zu ṭhawng kha a dinter hna. Vawlei cung siangpahrang hna nih amah he cun nu le pa sualnak an tuah i aa sum lomi a hornak nih cun vawlei cung khuazakip chawlet pawl kha a rumter hna,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 23.17; Jer 51.7"},"4":{"text":"Cun vancung in aw pakhat ka theih ṭhan i, “Ka mi hna, chuak tuah u, Amah chung khan chuak tuah u! Sualnak a tuahmi ah khan i tel hlah u, Dantatnak a hmuh ding zong kha i hrawm hlah u.","ref":"Isa 48.20; Jer 50.8; 51.6,45"},"5":{"text":"Zeicahtiah a sualnak cu van tawng in aa pong i Ṭhat lonak a tuahmi kha Pathian nih a philh lo.","ref":"Gen 18.20-21; Jer 51.9"},"6":{"text":"Amah nih a rak in tuah hna bantukte khan amah cu tuah ṭhan ve u; a let hnih in cham u, Nanmah din awkah a rak tuahmi a let hnih ṭhawng khan, Amah din awk cu a hrai chungah khan serpiak u.","ref":"Slm 137.8; Jer 50.29"},"7":{"text":"Sunparnak le nuamhnak amah le amah a rak i pek zat te khan, Temhinnak le ngaihchiatnak pe ve u. Zeicahtiah aa thawh i, Keimah cu bawiṭhutdan cung i a ṭhumi siangpahrang bawinu ka si. Nuhmei ka si lo, ngaihchiatnak cu ka ing bal lai lo, a ti.","ref":"Isa 47.7-9"},"8":{"text":"Hi ruangah hin hremnak nih khan ni khatte ah an tlakphuat lai, rai le ngaihchiatnak le mangṭam nih khan a tlakphuat lai. Amah bia a ceihtu Bawipa Pathian cu a ṭhawngmi a si caah Amah cu mei in khangh a si lai,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"A sualnak le a hornak chungah aa bual vemi vawlei cung siangpahrang hna nih khan a kanghnak meikhu cu an hmuh tikah khuapi cu an ṭah lai.","ref":"Eze 26.16-17"},"10":{"text":"Temhnak a inmi kha an ṭih caah a langhlat piin an dir i cuka cun an i thawh i, “Ṭih a hei nung hringhran dah! Mi tuksa a hei pur hringhran dah! Babilon khualipi, khua lianngan le khua ṭhawng!
