Suimilam pakhat chungah na rawk dih ko!” an ti lai."},"11":{"text":"Vawlei cung chawlet pawl zong amah a rawh ruangah cun an ṭap i an ngaih a chia, zeicahtiah an thilri kha ahohmanh nih an caw ti hna lo;","ref":"Eze 27.31,36"},"12":{"text":"an sui, an ngun, an lungvar, an rili lungvar, le la hmangṭhia in tahmi thilri puan sen, pu, maimaw; cun thingrua theihtlei in sermi thil phun zakip, vui ho le thing man sung in sermi thil phun kip,","ref":"Eze 27.12,13,22"},"13":{"text":"nakzik le musala le zihmui le mura zihmui le frankinsen zihmui le zu le chiti le changvut le facang le caw le tuu le rang le rangleng le sal le minung hmanh kha ahohmanh nih an caw ti hna lo."},"14":{"text":"Chawlet pawl nih cun an thawh i, “Ngei ning ti i saduh na rak thahmi vialte kha an lo dih cang i na rumnak le na sunparnak vialte cu an liam cang; zeitikhmanh ah na hmu ṭhan ti hna lai lo,” an ti."},"15":{"text":"Cu khuapi chung i chaw a rak dawr tawnmi mirum hna nih khan, a temhinnak cu an ṭih caah a langhlat piin a cuanh in an cuanh lai. An ṭap an ai lai i","ref":"Eze 27.30-34"},"16":{"text":"“Khua lianngan kha zeitluk in dah ṭih a nun cang. Zeitluk in dah mi tuksapur a si cang. Puan hmangṭhia le puan sen le maimaw in a rak i thuam tawn i sui hlawn le lung mansung le rili lungvar in a rak i ṭamh tawn."},"17":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw suimilam pakhat chungah a chawva vialte cu an lo dih ai!” an ti lai. Rili lawngcawng bawi vialte hna le khual tlawngmi vialte hna le tilawng rianṭuantu vialte hna le rili cung rianṭuannak in a paw a cawmmi vialte hna cu lamhlatpi in an dir i"},"18":{"text":"a kanghnak meikhu kha an hmuh tikah, “Hi khualipi bantukin a liannganmi khua a um bal lo,” an ti."},"19":{"text":"An lu ah lei dip an i phulh, an ṭap an ai i, “Khua lianngan kha zeitluk in dah ṭih a nun cang. Zeitluk in dah tuksapur a si cang. Rili cungah lawng in chaw a letmi vialte hna nih amah rumnak thawngin mirum an rak si dih. Asinain suimilam pakhat chungah a chaw vialte cu an lo dih ko ee,” an ti."},"20":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw amah a rawh ruangah van cu i lawm ko seh. Pathian mi hna le lamkaltu hna le profet hna, i lawm ko u! Zeicahtiah nan cung i a tuahmi ruangah khan Pathian nih amah cu dan a tat cang!","ref":"Deu 32.43; Jer 51.48"},"21":{"text":"Cun a ṭhawngmi vancungmi pakhat nih facang rialnak lung nganpi tia a simi lung pakhat kha aa cawi i rili chungah a hlonh, “Hi bantuk hin Babilon khualipi hi i let luahmah in hlonh a si lai i zeitikhmanh ah hmuh ṭhan a si ti lai lo.","ref":"Jer 51.63-64; Eze 26.21"},"22":{"text":"A chung i a rak um tawnmi tingtang tum thiam hna le aw dawh tum thiam hna le thonglawi tum thiam hna le muko tum thiam hna nih an tum tawnmi aw kha zeitikhmanh ah theih ṭhan a um ti lai lo. A chungah rianṭuantu an um ti lai lo i facang rialnak thawng kha theih a um ti lai lo.","ref":"Eze 26.13; Isa 24.8; Jer 7.34; 25.10"},"23":{"text":"A chungah meiinn ceu a um ti lai lo; nupi ṭhi tlangval le va ngeimi ngaknu conglawmhnak thawng zong a um ti lai lo. A chung i a rak ummi chawlet pawl cu vawlei cung ah a ṭhawng bik an rak si i hlennak mitleh thiamnak in vawlei cung mi vialte kha an hlen dih hna,” a ti."},"24":{"text":"Profet hna le Pathian mi hna kha a chungah an thisen an chuah hna caah Babilon cu dantat a si cang; asi, vawlei cungah thah a simi vialte hna an thisen cu amah chungah cun hmuh an si dih!","ref":"Jer 51.49"}}},"19":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cu hnuah cun vancung i a ummi mibu nganpi aw thawng bantuk ka theih i, “Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u. Khamhnak le sunparnak le lianhngannak cu kan Pathian ta an si."},"2":{"text":"A biaceihmi cu dingte le hmaan tein a ceih. Vawlei a hornak in a thurhnawmhtertu hlawhhlangnu milianngan nu kha sual a phawt cang. Pathian sal kha a thah hna caah Pathian nih dan a tat cang,” a ti.","ref":"Deu 32.43; 2Sia 9.7"},"3":{"text":"Cun an au ṭhan i, “Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u. Khualipi khanghnak mei a khu cu zungzal in zungzal tiang a kai ko,” an ti.","ref":"Isa 34.10"},"4":{"text":"Upa kul le pali hna le saram nung pali hna nih khan an kun i bawiṭhutdan cungah a ṭhumi Pathian kha an biak i, “A men! Pathian cu thangṭhat ko u,” an ti."},"5":{"text":"Cun bawiṭhutdan khan aw pakhat a rung thang i, “Kan Pathian sal vialte hna le a mi vialte hna le amah a ṭihmi vialte hna, a hme a ngan in, kan Pathian cu thangṭhat tuah u,” a ti.","title":"Tuufa Nupi Ṭhit Puai","ref":"Slm 115.13"},"6":{"text":"Cun mibu nganpi aw bantuk, tisor nganpi thawng bantuk, khuari thawng bantuk a simi aw pakhat kha ka theih. “Bawipa, Lianngan Bik, kan Pathian cu Siangpahrang a si caah, thangṭhat ko u!","ref":"Eze 1.24; Slm 93.1; 97.1; 99.1"},"7":{"text":"I lawm u si law i nuam u sih; a lianngannak cu thangṭhat u sih! Zeicahtiah Tuufa nupi ṭhit caan cu a phan cang i a ṭhit laimi ngaknu cu aa tim cang."},"8":{"text":"Aa thuamhnak dingah, puan hmang ṭhia a thiang i a cer in a cermi kha pek a si cang,” an ti. (Puan hmangṭhia cu Pathian mi hna nih ding tein rian an ṭuanmi kha a si)."},"9":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih cun a ka thawh i, “Mah hihi ṭial tuah: Tuufa nupi ṭhitnak puai i sawmmi hna cu milunglawm an va si dah!” a ti. Cun vancungmi nih cun, “Hi bia hi Pathian bia ngaingai an si,” a ti fawn.","ref":"Mat 22.2-3"},"10":{"text":"Amah biak awkah a ke hramah ka bawk, sihmanhsehlaw a ka thawh i, “Bawk hlah. Keimah zong nangmah bantukin Pathian sal ka si ve, Jesuh nih a phuanmi biatak aa tlaihmi nan unau hna lak i pakhat ka si ve. Pathian tu bia tuah,” a ti. Profet hna kha lungthawhnak a petu cu Jesuh nih a phuanmi biatak kha a si."},"11":{"text":"Cun van kha aa hung i rang rang pakhat ka hmuh. A cung i aa citmi cu a min ah Zumhawktlak le Ahmaanmi ti a si; bia a ceih tik le ral a doh tikah dinnak in a ceih i a doh.","title":"Rang Rang Aa Citmi","ref":"Eze 1.1; Slm 96.13; Isa 11.4"},"12":{"text":"A mit cu meizik bantuk an si i a lu ah bawiluchin tampi aa chinh. A cungah min pakhat aa ṭial, asinain amah dah ti lo nih cun zei a si ti kha ahohmanh nih an hngal lo.","ref":"Dan 10.6"},"13":{"text":"Aa aihmi puan cu thi aa neh dih. An auhnak a min cu “Pathian Bia” ti a si."},"14":{"text":"Vancung ralkap bu nih khan rang rang cungin an zulh i puan rang in an i thuam."},"15":{"text":"A har ngaingaimi nam pakhat a kaa chungin a hung chuak i cu nam cun miphun vialte kha a tei dih hna lai. Annih cu thirfung in a uk hna lai i Lianngan Bik Pathian thinhunnak mitsur nennak chung mitsur kha a nen hna lai.","ref":"Slm 2.9; Isa 63.3; Joe 3.13; Biat 14.20"},"16":{"text":"A puan le a ke ah, “siangpahrang vialte Siangpahrang le bawi vialte Bawi,” tiin aa ṭial."},"17":{"text":"Cun nika chungah vanmi pakhat a dir kha ka hmuh. Van i a zuangmi va vialte kha aw fak piin a auh hna i, “Ra tuah u, Pathian nih rawl danghnak nganpi a ser laimi ah cun i pum tuah u.","ref":"Eze 39.17-20"},"18":{"text":"Siangpahrang hna le ralbawi hna le ralkap hna le rang hna le rangcung ralkap hna le sal hna le miluat hna le mingan hna le mihme hna, an dihlak in, an sa cu rak ei tuah hna u,” a ti."},"19":{"text":"Rang cung i aa citmi le a ralkapbu kha doh awkah sahrang le vawlei cung siangpahrang hna cu an i pum."},"20":{"text":"Sahrang cu an tlaih i thong ah an thlak, cun a hmaika i khuaruahharnak a tuah tawntu nal profet zong kha an tlaih chih. (Sahrang hmelchunhnak a ngeimi hna le sahrang milem a biami hna kha, khuaruahharnak a tuahmi khan a hlen hna). Cun sahrang le nal profet cu an pahnih in kat meialh tili ah a nung in an paih hna.","ref":"Biat 13.1-18"},"21":{"text":"Rang aa citmi kaa chungin a chuakmi vainam nih an ralkap vialte cu a thah dih hna i an sa cu va vialte nih an i serh."}}},"20":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Cun vanmi pakhat vancung in a rung ṭum i dongh hngal lo khor tawh le cikcin nganpi aa put kha ka hmuh."},"2":{"text":"Rulhreu, limkeng kha a tlaih i kum thong khat a hren — cu limkeng cu Khuachia, asiloah, Satan kha a si.","ref":"Gen 3.1"},"3":{"text":"Vanmi nih cun dongh hngal lo khor chungah khan a thlak i kum thong khat kha a dih hlantiang, mi kha a hlen khawh ti hna nakhnga lo, a hrenh i ca a khenh chih. Cu hnuah cun tlawmpal chuah a si te lai."},"4":{"text":"Cun bawiṭhutdan hna le a cung i a ṭhumi hna kha ka hmuh hna; annih cu biaceihnak nawl kha pek an si. Jesuh nih a phuanmi biatak le Pathian bia an chim ruangah thahnak a ingmi thlarau hna zong kha ka hmuh hna. Sahrang kha an bia lo, a milem zong an bia lo, an cal le an ban zongah sahrang hmelchunhnak kha an ngei lo. An hung nung i Khrih he cun siangpahrang bantukin kum thong khat chung uktu bawi an si.","ref":"Dan 7.9,22"},"5":{"text":"(Mithi mi a dang cu kum thong khat a dih hlan kha cu an nung lo). Mah hihi mithi thawhter an si a hmasa u cu a si."},"6":{"text":"Hi mithi thawhter an si a pakhatnak i aa telmi hi cu lunglawmmi le thluachuak hringhranmi an si ko. Thih voi hnihnak nih an cungah nawl zeihmanh a ngei lo; annih cu Pathian le Khrih tlangbawi an si lai i Khrih he cun kum thong khat chung uktu bawi an si lai."},"7":{"text":"Kum thong khat kha a dih tikah Satan cu thong chung khan chuah a si lai i","title":"Satan A Sung"},"8":{"text":"vawlei kil li ah aa ṭhekmi miphun vialte kha hlen awkah aa thawh lai, cu hna cu Gog le Magog kha an si. Satan nih cun i tuk awkah a pumh ciammam hna lai i rili kam thetse zat an si lai.","ref":"Eze 7.2; 38.2,9,15"},"9":{"text":"Vawleicung khuazakip ah khan an i ṭhek i Pathian mi hna umnak hmun le Pathian nih a dawtmi khua kha an kulh. Sihmanhsehlaw van in mei a rung tla i a thah dih hna."},"10":{"text":"Cun annih a hlengtu hna, Khuachia kha, mei le kat tili chungah khan an paih, cuka cu sahrang le nal profet an rak thlaknak hna kha a si; cuka ah cun chunzan in zungzal hrem an si zungzal ko lai."},"11":{"text":"Cun bawiṭhutdan raangpi le a cung i a ṭhumi kha ka hmuh hna. A cung i a ṭhumi hmaika cun vawlei le van kha an zaam i an um ti lo.","title":"Biaceihnak Hmanung Bik","ref":"Dan 7.9-10"},"12":{"text":"Cun mithi mi kha, a ngan he a hme he, bawiṭhutdan hmai i an ṭhut kha ka hmuh. Cauk kha an kau hna, cun cauk a dang pakhat, nunnak cauk zong kha an kau ve. Mithi cu an rak tuahmi cauk chung i aa ṭialning khan an bia an ceih hna."},"13":{"text":"Cun rili nih a chung i a thimi kha a hun chuah hna. Thihnak le mithi khua zong nih khan, an hrenmi mithi kha an hun chuah ve hna. An dihlak in an tuahning cio khan an bia an ceih hna."},"14":{"text":"Cun thihnak le mithi khua cu mei tili chungah khan an paih hna. (Hi mei tili hi thih voi hnihnak cu a si)."},"15":{"text":"Nunnak cauk chungah an min aa ṭial lomi paoh cu mei tili chungah cun an paih hna."}}},"21":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Khi hnuah van thar le vawlei thar kha ka hmuh hna. Van hmasa le vawlei hmasa kha an lo cang i rili kha a um ti lo.","title":"Van Thar le Vawlei Thar","ref":"Isa 65.17; 66.22; 2Pet 3.13"},"2":{"text":"Cun Khua Thiang, Jerusalem thar kha Pathian sinin vancung in a rung ṭum cu ka hmuh, va ngei lai ngaknu nih a va ding ton awkah aa ṭamh bantuk khin aa ṭamh.","ref":"Isa 52.1; 61.10; Biat 3.12"},"3":{"text":"Bawiṭhutdan in aw thangpi pakhat ka theih i, “Pathian umnak inn cu minung hna sinah a um cang. Anmah sinah cun a um lai i annih cu a mi an si lai. Pathian hrimhrim cu an sinah a um lai i amah cu an Pathian a si lai.","ref":"Eze 37.27; Lev 26.11,12"},"4":{"text":"An mitthli vialte kha a hnawh dih hna lai. Thihnak a um ti lai lo, ngaihchiatnak le ṭahnak le fahnak zong a um ti lai lo. Thil hlun vialte cu an lo dih cang,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 25.8; 35.10; 65.19"},"5":{"text":"Cun bawiṭhutdan i a ṭhumi nih cun, “Atu cu thil vialte kha a thar in ka ser dih cang hna,” a ti. A ka thawh i, “Hi bia hi ṭial hna, zeicahtiah ahmaanmi le zumhawktlak a simi bia an si,” a ti."},"6":{"text":"Cun aa thawh i, “Rian ka lim dih cang. Kei cu Alfa le Omega, hramthawknak le donghnak ka si. Tihal paoh nunnak tiput ti kha man loin ka dinter hna lai.","ref":"Isa 55.1"},"7":{"text":"Teitu a simi paoh nih hihi ka sinin an hmuh lai: Keimah cu an Pathian ka si lai i annih cu ka fa an si lai.","ref":"2Sam 7.14; Slm 89.26-27"},"8":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw miralchia le mirawi hmang le fih awk lungthin a ngeimi le lainawngmi le horduhcuaimi le camh hmangmi le siasal biami le lihchimmi vialte hna an umnak ding cu, mei le kat in a alhmi tili, thih voi hnihnak kha a si,” a ti."},"9":{"text":"Vancungmi pasarih hna lak i pakhat, hremnak hmanung bik pasarih in a khatmi kanto pasarih aa putmi kha ka sinah a ra i, “Ra hmanh, Tuufa nupi, va ngei lai ngaknu cu kan hmuhsak lai,” a ti.","title":"Jerusalem Thar"},"10":{"text":"Thlarau nih cun a ka tlaih i vancungmi nih khan tlang sangpi pakhat par ah a ka kaipi. Cun Jerusalem, Khua Thiang kha Pathian sinin vancung in a rung ṭum kha a ka hmuhsak.","ref":"Eze 40.2"},"11":{"text":"Cu khua cu Pathian sunparnak in a cer. Khualipi cu lung man sung, jasper lungvar bantukin a tleu i thlalang bantukin a fiim."},"12":{"text":"Kulhnak vampang nganpi a sang ngaimi pakhat a ngei i cu kulhnak vampang ah cun kutka hleihnih an um i cu kutka hleihnih cu vancungmi hleihnih nih an cawngh hna. Cu kutka ah cun Israel mi phun hleihnih min kha an i ṭial.","ref":"Eze 48.30-35"},"13":{"text":"Kam khat ah kutka pathum cio an um: nichuahlei ah pathum, thlanglei ah pathum, chaklei ah pathum, nitlaklei ah pathum an si."},"14":{"text":"Khua kulhnak vampang cu lung pahleihnih cungah bunh a si i cu lung pahleihnih cungah cun Tuufa lamkaltu pahleihnih hna min kha an i ṭial."},"15":{"text":"A ka chawntu vanmi nih cun khuapi le a kutka hna le a vampang tahnak ah sui in sermi tahnak fung pakhat aa put.","ref":"Eze 40.3"},"16":{"text":"Khuapi cu tungvangpalh a si, a tung le a vang aa can ceote a si. Vanmi nih khan khuapi cu tahnak fung khan a tah i a tung khan thong khat le za nga a si, a vang zong a tung can cu a si i a san zong a tung can ṭhiamṭhiam cu a si."},"17":{"text":"Vanmi nih khan vampang zong cu a tah i amah nih a hmanmi tahnak ningin dong za sawm li pali a sang."},"18":{"text":"Vampang cu jasper lungvar in ser a si i khuapi cu sui thiang in ser a si i thlalang fim in a fim.","ref":"Isa 54.11-12"},"19":{"text":"Khua kulhnak vampang hram cu lung man sung a phunphun in an ṭamh. A tang nung bik lung cu jasper lungvar a si, a pahnihnak cu safaiar lungvar a si, a pathumnak cu agate lungvar a si, a palinak cu emeral lungvar a si,"},"20":{"text":"a panganak cu oniks lungvar a si, a paruknak cu karnelian lungvar a si, a pasarihnak cu khrisolaih lungvar a si, a pariatnak cu beril lungvar a si, a pakuanak cu topaz lungvar a si, a pahranak cu khalsedon lungvar a si, a hlei khatnak cu tarkhua lungvar a si, a hleihnihnak cu amethist lungvar a si."},"21":{"text":"Kutka hleihnih cu rili lungvar hlum pipi hleihnih an si, kutka pakhat ah lungvar hlum pakhat a si ko. Khuapi chung lam cu sui thiang a si i thlalang bantukin a tleu."},"22":{"text":"Khuapi chungah cun biakinn ka hmu lo, zeicahtiah a biakinn cu Lianngan Bik Bawipa Pathian le Tuufa kha a si."},"23":{"text":"Khuapi nih cun ni ceunak siseh, thlapa ceunak siseh a herh lo, zeicahtiah Pathian sunparnak nih cun a ceuh i Tuufa cu a meiinn a si.","ref":"Isa 60.19-20"},"24":{"text":"Vawleicung miphun zakip nih a ceunak thawng cun kalnak an hmuh lai i vawlei cung siangpahrang hna nih cu khuapi chungah cun an chawhlawn kha an ratpi hna lai.","ref":"Isa 60.3"},"25":{"text":"Khuapi kutka cu chunnitlak in an i hung zungzal ko, zeitikhmanh ah an i khar lo, zeicahtiah khika ah zan a um ti lo.","ref":"Isa 60.11"},"26":{"text":"Miphun vialte nih an lianhngannak le rumnak cu, cu khuapi ah cun an rak put lai."},"27":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a thurhnawmmi cu khi khua chungah ahohmanh an lut kho lai lo; ningzah awk thil a tuahmi hna le lih a chimmi hna zong ahohmanh an lut kho lai lo. Tuufa nunnak cauk chung i an min aa ṭialmi lawnglawng cu khuapi chungah cun an lut kho lai.","ref":"Isa 52.1; Eze 44.9"}}},"22":{"verse":{"1":{"text":"Vancungmi nih cun nunnak tiva zong a ka hmuhsak, cu tiva cu Pathian le Tuufa bawiṭhutdan hram in khuapi laifang ah a rung luangmi a si i thlalang bantukin a fiim.","ref":"Eze 47.1; Zek 14.8"},"2":{"text":"Cu tivakam ah cun nunnak thingkung cu a um i kum khat ah voi hleihnih, thla khat ah voi khat lengmang thei a tlai; cun a hnah cu miphun vialte hna caah damnak a si.","ref":"Gen 2.9; Eze 47.12"},"3":{"text":"Pathian nih chiat a serhmi thil paohpaoh cu cu khua chungah cun an um kho lai lo. Pathian bawiṭhutdan le Tuufa bawiṭhutdan cu khuapi chungah cun a um lai i a rianṭuantu hna nih khan an biak lai.","ref":"Zek 14.11"},"4":{"text":"Annih nih a hmai an hmuh lai i a min cu an cal ah aa ṭial lai."},"5":{"text":"Zan a um ti lai lo i meiinn siseh, ni ceunak siseh, an herh ti lai lo, zeicahtiah Bawipa Pathian cu an ceunak a si lai i annih cu siangpahrang bantukin uktu zungzal in zungzal tiang an si lai.","ref":"Isa 60.19; Dan 7.18"},"6":{"text":"Cun vancungmi nih khan a ka thawh i, “Hi bia hi biatak an si i zumhawktlak an si. A Thlarau kha profet hna a petu Bawipa Pathian nih, tuante ah a tlung zau ding thil kha a sal hna hmuhsak awkah, a vanmi kha a run ka thlah,” a ti.","title":"Jesuh Ratnak"},"7":{"text":"Cun Jesuh nih, “Ngai hmanh, ka ra zau lai. Hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi profet bia a zulmi cu lunglawmmi an si,” a ti."},"8":{"text":"Keimah Johan nih hi thil vialte hi ka theih hna i ka hmuh hna. Cun ka theih hna i ka hmuh dih hna tikah, hi thil vialte a ka hmuhsaktu vancungmi ke hram ah cun ka bawk i biak ka zalh."},"9":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw a ka thawh i, “Tuah hlah. Kei zong nangmah bantukin sal ka si ve ko; na unau profet hna le hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi bia a zulmi na unau hna bantukin sal ka si ve ko. Pathian tu bia ko,” a ti."},"10":{"text":"Cun hitihin a ka ti, “Hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi profet chimchung bia hi a thli in i chiah ko hlah. Zeitintiah hi thil vialte cu a tlin lainak caan a nai cang."},"11":{"text":"Miṭhalo cu ṭhat lonak kha tuah lengmang ko seh, fihnung a simi cu fihnung kha tuah lengmang ko seh, miṭha a simi cu ṭhatnak kha tuah lengmang ko seh, mithiang a simi cu thiannak kha tuah lengmang ko seh,” a ti.","ref":"Dan 12.10"},"12":{"text":"Jesuh nih cun, “Ngaihmanh, ka ra zau lai. Mi kip an rianṭuanning cio ah pek awkah ka laksawng cu ka rak i put lai.","ref":"Isa 40.10; 62.11; Slm 28.4; Jer 17.10"},"13":{"text":"Kei cu Alfa le Omega kha ka si, hmasa bik le hmanung bik, hramthawknak le donghnak ka si,” a ti.","ref":"Biat 1.8,17; 2.8; Isa 44.6; 48.12"},"14":{"text":"An puan kha thiang tein a su i nunnak thingkung theitlai ei khawhnak nawl le khuapi kutka chung luhnak nawl a ngeimi cu lunglawmmi an si.","ref":"Gen 2.9; 3.22"},"15":{"text":"Sihmanhsehlaw uico bantuk a simi hna le eih thiammi hna le horduhcuaimi hna le lainawngmi hna le siasal biami hna le bia in siseh tuahnak in siseh lih a chimmi hna kha cu, khuapi lengah cun an um lai."},"16":{"text":"“Keimah, Jesuh nih, Khrihfabu chung i a ummi nannih sinah hi bia cu thanh awkah ka vancungmi kha ka run thlah. Kei cu David tefa kha ka si, kei cu deirel arfi ceu cu ka si,” a ti.","ref":"Isa 11.1,10"},"17":{"text":"Thlarau le va ngei laimi ngaknu nih khan, “Ra u,” an ti. Hi bia a theimi paoh nih khan, “Ra u,” ti ve hna seh. Ti a halmi paoh cu ra u, nunnak ti hi a duhmi paoh nih man loin i lak u.","ref":"Isa 55.1"},"18":{"text":"Keimah Johan nih hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi profet bia a theimi paoh kha ralrinnak kan pek hna: hi bia ah ahohmanh nih bia dang a chap ahcun, hi cauk chungah aa ṭialmi hremnak kha a dantatnak ah Pathian nih a chap lai.","title":"Donghnak","ref":"Deu 4.2; 12.32"},"19":{"text":"Cun hi cauk chung i aa ṭialmi profet bia kha azeihmanh a hlawmi cu, hi cauk chungah aa ṭialmi nunnak thingkung theitlai a co hnga ding le Khua Thiang chung i um venak a co hnga ding cu Pathian nih a lakpiak lai."},"20":{"text":"Hi thil vialte hi ahmaan dih tiah tehte a khaangtu nih, “Tuan ah ka ra hrimhrim lai,” a ti. Cu bantuk cun si ko seh. Bawipa Jesuh, ra ko cang!"},"21":{"text":"Nan dihlak cungah Bawipa Jesuh vel cu um ko seh. Amen."}}}}}}}
